reviews.product_name: Alpha Beta Extra Strength Daily Peel Pads
reviews.review_text: I like this daily peeling, my skin feels smoth and glowing after one use!I received this product as a free sample

reviews.product_name: Plum Plump Hyaluronic Acid Serum
reviews.review_text: I don’t like that it a scented product. But it did not irritated my skin, which is a good think. A little bit goes a long way, so this may last you a long time. I don’t see a huge difference in my skin,but I will continue to use this product, I like how my skin feels when I use it.

reviews.product_name: C-Firma Fresh Vitamin-C Day Serum
reviews.review_text: I have acne prone skin, and I haven’t used any vitamin c skin care. I received this from influenster and i have been noticed a improvement in my skin! I dont feel the under skin bumps and also the scars have diminished. Ive been seeing everybody complaining about the scent, but it doesnt bother me and also it goes away within seconds. If you have acne prone skin i truly recommend this!!

reviews.product_name: Watermelon Pink Juice Oil-Free Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: While I do think this is overpriced, I’ll probably keep buying it... its smells absolutely AMAZING and it worked well on my skin.  I was using Origins energizing gel moisturizer but my i was finding that my nose and in between my eyebrows would still be dry.  Not with this, it absorbed well and keep my t-zone from drying out.

reviews.product_name: Hyaluronic Acid Hydrating Serum
reviews.review_text: I really like this stuff.  My skin has looked really nice since I started using it. No complaints, would buy again.

reviews.product_name: Caffeine Eye Cream
reviews.review_text: This is meh, good not great.  It doesn’t get rid of under eye circles, but it can help if you didn’t get a lot of sleep the night before.  It helps you look perked up until you’re actually perked up.  Otherwise, meh...

reviews.product_name: AHA 30% + BHA 2% Exfoliating Peeling Solution
reviews.review_title: Do not like this way it made my face feel
reviews.review_text: I didn’t like the way this skin feel at all.  I put it on and I couldn’t actually tell if it was a very tingly sensation or light burning.  Afterwards, my skin felt warm and tingly but in an unpleasant sort of way that I was uncomfortable with.  I won’t use this again.  The rest of my skincare regimen is such that after each product, my skin feels well cared for, but this rendered an entire range of nighttime products useless by an icky, uncomfortable feeling.

reviews.product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C
reviews.review_text: I love this! It leaves your lips super soft! I usually don’t sleep with it on all night, because it is a bit sticky. I usually use a lip scrub, and then put this on. After I am done with my skincare routine, I wipe it off.

reviews.product_name: Cleansing & Exfoliating Wipes
reviews.review_text: So nice! It almost smells like rose candy. They leave my face super moisturized and glowey!

reviews.product_name: Lip Glowy Balm
reviews.review_text: Love this! It makes my lips so soft and glossy, and smells amazing! I love using their lip mask, and then in the morning using this balm!

reviews.product_name: Lotus Anti-Aging Night Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I love this product from the smell , to the texture of it. It leaves my skin feeling refreshed and moisturized without feeling super oily my skin type can be very sensitive and it definitely works well with my skin. I would definitively recommend this product if your looking for some new PM skin care products

reviews.product_name: Lotus Anti- Aging Daily Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: My favorite moisturizer at the moment. The smell is subtle and works good with or without makeup. It isn’t heavy and doesn’t leave your skin oily.

reviews.product_name: Daily Greens Oil-Free Gel Moisturizer with Moringa and Papaya
reviews.review_text: I received farmacy daily greens oil free moisturizer complimentary from farmacy to review. I’ve been using the product for a few days and I instantly fell in love with how it made my skin . It didn’t make me feel super oily or sticky. It went on so nice and I’m just in love with it.

reviews.product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C
reviews.review_text: It is the best lip product i have ever used. It makes my lips so plump, i do not use lip balm like i used to do multiple times a day. I use it every day and night and i love it. My lips feel so smooth and hydrated even when it is not on my lips anymore.

reviews.product_name: Glycolic Acid 7% Exfoliating Toning Solution
reviews.review_text: I am new to acids in my skin care routine and i was a little scared to put this on my skin but this is very nice product. Did not irritate my skin at all, tingled for just a second. Also, the first time i used it my face was breaking out so bad because of face wax. It did not hurt my skin and actually calmed down my post face wax skin. I was super surprised at the results i got from this product. Totally worth it.

reviews.product_name: Abeille Royale Advanced Youth Watery Oil
reviews.review_text: Love this product, it luxury in a bottle. Love the way it smells, and the texture of this product. It is literally a watery oil, very different than anything else i have tried. I will highly recommend it

reviews.product_name: Mini Abeille Royale Advanced Youth Watery Oil
reviews.review_text: Love this product, it luxury in a bottle. Love the way it smells, and the texture of this product. It is literally a watery oil, very different than anything else i have tried. I will highly recommend it

reviews.product_name: C-Rush Vitamin C Gel Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I got this from Influenster for an honest review. This isn’t my first product from olehenrikson so I’m not surprised by how much I love it. It really does help fade acne scars so I think it would help with sunspots too. Just be sure to also apply sunscreen consistently. It has a strong citrus smell but it’ll fade in a few minutes. Will definitely repurchase on my own!

reviews.product_name: Cream Skin Toner & Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: Such a good product! I have oily combo skin that’s somewhat sensitive. This is such a life saver during the summer when my skin needs a pick me up and before bed. It makes the skin feel nourished and plump without feeling heavy or tacky. Try this out in store. But it’s a beautiful product!

reviews.product_name: Cicapair Tiger Grass Color Correcting Treatment SPF 30
reviews.review_text: It’s decent but I think I prefer the mask since it dries down more quickly and doesn’t have residue the next morning. But it’s very useful when you’re in a rush in the morning to get out the door!

reviews.product_name: Mini Cicapair Tiger Grass Color Correcting Treatment SPF 30
reviews.review_text: It’s decent but I think I prefer the mask since it dries down more quickly and doesn’t have residue the next morning. But it’s very useful when you’re in a rush in the morning to get out the door!

reviews.product_name: Cold Plunge Pore Mask
reviews.review_text: I received this mask free from Influenster. I love using face masks and this was a great addition to my collection. Fun and easy to apply, dries quickly, and smells good. However, I think my Glam Glow super mud mask tightens my pores better than this mask.

reviews.product_name: The Essence Skincare Boosting Treatment
reviews.review_text: I love the consistency of this product. It’s very thin & watery, and absorbs into the skin so quickly. I hate when moisturizers are too thick and just sit on top of the skin, so this product really works for me. I received this product for free for testing purposes.

reviews.product_name: Mini The Essence  Skincare Boosting Treatment
reviews.review_text: I love the consistency of this product. It’s very thin & watery, and absorbs into the skin so quickly. I hate when moisturizers are too thick and just sit on top of the skin, so this product really works for me. I received this product for free for testing purposes.

reviews.product_name: Violet-C Brightening Serum 20% Vitamin C + 10% AHA
reviews.review_text: High quality packaging and a high quality serum. My face felt smooth and soft after using this product, and my skin was glowing. I like using this before using the Silk Canvas Primer from Tatcha. I received this product as a free sample for testing purposes.

reviews.product_name: Cicapair Tiger Grass Color Correcting Treatment SPF 30
reviews.review_text: I got a free sample from Influenster and Dr. Jart+ and I really liked it. My skin is very sensitive and gets red easily, but this cream makes my skin very uniform and moisturized the whole day.

reviews.review_text: This is one of the best eye creams that I have ever had. Is perfect for sensitive eyes and skin

reviews.product_name: Aqua Bomb Brightening Vitamin C Cream

reviews.product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C
reviews.review_text: First of all, I ADORE Laneige Products and they are so affordable! I have been using this lip mask for about 2 months now and I am hooked. It really makes my lips appear more supple and plump. It’s worth the $20 which I agree is high for a lip balm- but it so SO much more than that!

reviews.product_name: Benefiance Wrinkle Smoothing Eye Cream
reviews.review_text: Obsessed with this eye cream! One of my new favorites. This was sent to me complimentary from Influenster, however this opinion is 100% my own. I haven’t used a Shiseido product yet that i haven’t LOVED. I love this brand.

reviews.product_name: Charlotte’s Magic Serum with Vitamin C
reviews.review_text: Another CT HOLY GRAIL! I’ve been using this product for a week and it’s already a holy grail. I noticed a difference in my face in the morning after a few uses. It made my face super glowy and hydrated! 10/10!!

reviews.product_name: The Dewy Skin Cream Plumping & Hydrating Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I absolutely love this moisturizer, it’s great for people with dry skin. I’m prone to dry patches, and I never had any while using this moisturizer. It made my skin feel so soft and smooth. I just wish there was more of it considering it is a little expensive, but honestly for me it’s worth it.

reviews.product_name: Lip Glowy Balm
reviews.review_text: I love this stuff. It keeps your lips moisturized all day. I just wish they were still selling the clear color :/

reviews.product_name: Watermelon Glow PHA + BHA Pore-Tight Toner
reviews.review_text: If you suffer from dry skin, this toner is probably best for you. It’s very hydrating without feeling greasy or anything. Unfortunately that was the only real benefit I noticed. I didn’t really see a change in skin tone or texture, so while it’s a good toner, I’m just not sure it’s worth the money.

But it definitely didn’t clean my face well enough. I have one spot on my face where I tend to get acne, and it made that area worse. When I wore makeup I used an oil cleanser first then used this, and when I used my toner afterwards, makeup was still coming off on the cotton pad. So clearly it’s not doing a great job at cleansing.

reviews.product_name: Tonique Confort Re-Hydrating Comforting Toner with Acacia Honey

reviews.review_text: I’ve been using this product for the past few days and so far so good! My skin feels and looks much healthier! It smells like lemon cake which is great! Definitely worth buying in the future. Applies really easily

reviews.review_text: This serum is great for oily or acne prone skin. It is not too harsh but it’s effective. It calms my skin and seems to make my pores look smaller. Not sure how effective it is with acne yet... time will tell.

reviews.product_name: Vinoperfect Radiance Dark Spot Serum Vitamin C Alternative
reviews.review_text: This is an awesome hydrating serum. It saved my skin while I was on a beach vacation with overexposure to sun and chlorine. I alternate this with the vinopure serum and I  love them both.

reviews.product_name: Glow2OH Dark Spot Toner
reviews.review_text: I really like this toner. It has helped to improve my skin texture, reduced appearance of pores. Not sure how effective it has been on dark spots but it definitely has helped with my skin’s overall texture!

reviews.product_name: Pure Skin Face Cleanser
reviews.review_text: Removes waterproof mascara!! Will continue to purchase this product forever!

reviews.product_name: Salicylic Acid Acne Healing Dots
reviews.review_text: The little dots feel like a thick rubber feeling. After waking up and peeling it I could sew the difference. I will continue to purchase this product.

reviews.product_name: Watermelon Glow PHA + BHA Pore-Tight Toner
reviews.review_text: Amazing product. I apply a little bit on a cotton ball and let it sit for less then 5 minutes on my nose. Bomb!!

reviews.review_text: Amazing product. I apply a little bit on a cotton ball and let it sit for less then 5 minutes on my nose. Bomb!!

reviews.review_text: I’m testing this for four weeks and so far so good. I love the formula is very light weight and sinks into my skin nicely. No sticky feeling or roll up so far. I also really like the smell. It’s light and natural. Hoping to see results soon!

reviews.product_name: The True Cream Aqua Bomb
reviews.review_text: I have dehydrated skin but not necessarily dry and this is so great. It’s lightweight and cooling but really feels hydrating. My skin doesn’t feel tight at all. I do like something heavier at night but this sits really well under makeup during the day.

reviews.product_name: Dewtopia 20% Acid Night Treatment
reviews.review_text: I received this complimentary from influencer and am enjoying it. The first time I used it my face was bright red so I only use it a few times a week. I feel like it does give a nice glow but I’m waiting to see if it fades any pigmentation. Also I love the citrus smell!

reviews.product_name: Protini Polypeptide Firming Refillable Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: My favorite moisturizer ever. I have acne prone skin, and this genuinely helps heal my face quicker, and it moisturizes flawlesslessly. I love the consistency and the pump system. I’m on my third jar. Love love love drunk elephant.

reviews.product_name: B-Hydra Intensive Hydration Serum with Hyaluronic Acid
reviews.review_text: I use this every morning. I pair it with the sweet chef vitamin c and ginger serum. The b-hydra hydrates my skin without making it look shiny, and the bottle is so cute. One squirt is generally enough for my whole face and one bottle lasts me around 4 months. I’m on my second bottle, and I don’t think I’m going back to any old moisturizer!

reviews.product_name: Cicapair Tiger Grass Color Correcting Treatment SPF 30
reviews.review_text: so amazing, completely corrects all redness. I have super red skin and this blends so well and gives me such a beautiful complexion

reviews.product_name: Mini Cicapair Tiger Grass Color Correcting Treatment SPF 30
reviews.review_text: so amazing, completely corrects all redness. I have super red skin and this blends so well and gives me such a beautiful complexion

reviews.product_name: Greek Yoghurt Nourishing Probiotic Gel-Cream
reviews.review_text: I enjoyed this moisturizer. Did not have a strong scent. Went on well and moisturized well. My only complaint was that it didn’t seem to go well under make up so wore this as a nighttime moisturizer. I received this product as a free sample

reviews.product_name: Ultimate Sun Protector Lotion SPF 50+ Sunscreen
reviews.review_text: This sunscreen is very runny. At first I didn’t love it but it grew on me. It didn’t feel thick when going on. The smell was also not overbearing like some sunscreens can be. I received this as a free sample for my review.

reviews.product_name: Clear Sunscreen Stick SPF 50+
reviews.review_text: Loved this sunscreen stick. It is small and easy to carry Around in a purse or backpack. It has easy application and didn’t leave me feeling greasy. The only reason it didn’t get 5 stars is because of the price. I wish  it was a little cheaper. I received this product as a free sample for my review!

reviews.product_name: The Essence Skincare Boosting Treatment
reviews.review_text: I received this for my honest review from influenster. I used it for about a month and didn’t notice any plumping or firming effects. It does moisturize well but unfortunately made me break out a little because it provided too much moisture for my combination acne prone skin. I might like it better in the winter when my skin can use that extra boost.

reviews.review_text: I like this I got it as a sampler for my birthday. However I find it makes my face feel like theirs a film over it. Good at hydrating , I have acne rosacea I noticed it doesn’t bother it any.

reviews.product_name: Niacinamide 10% + Zinc 1% Oil Control Serum
reviews.review_text: I have terrible acne rosacea and giant pores this in just a few days made everything look smoother and got rid of a lot of the larger bumps.first photo is after second photo is before

reviews.product_name: Cream Skin Toner & Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: The BEST for a compromised skin barrier . Don’t sleep on this

reviews.product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C
reviews.review_text: Absolutely amazing I have never found a lip product that really truly works. This is it. You put this on and go to bed the next morning your lips are so soft, I revived a small sample size but I would 100% fork up the $26 for this product. The sample size would last a good amount of time so I think the large size would last forever

reviews.product_name: Glow Cycle Retin-ALT Power Serum
reviews.review_text: I received the Ole Henriksen Glow Cycle Retin-Alt Power Serum complimentary from Influenster for testing purposes. I originally used it all over my face, but due to it making my skin breakout, I continued use on just my neck alone. I’ve been using it for about a week now, and I’m definitely starting to notice a reduction in the line/wrinkles on my neck. The product itself is beautiful, and it has a hint of a lemonade scent to it which I love. It absorbs well into the skin and doesn’t leave a sticky or greasy residue. I highly recommend it, but only for those who don’t have sensitive or acne prone skin.

reviews.product_name: Urban Environment Fresh-Moisture Sunscreen Broad-Spectrum SPF 42
reviews.review_text: I received this product complimentary from Influenster and Shiseido for testing purposes, and I can honestly say that it’s the best facial sunscreen I’ve ever used! I was in direct sunlight for over two hours today, and while using this sunscreen my face didn’t burn at all. Not one bit of redness. And though this product is considered “dewy”, it didn’t leave my face feeling greasy. Highly recommend!

reviews.product_name: Urban Environment Oil-Free Sunscreen Broad-Spectrum SPF 42
reviews.review_text: I received this product complimentary from Influenster and Shiseido for testing purposes, and I am quickly falling in love with this brand! Once again, I was in direct sunlight for over two hours today, and my face didn’t burn at all while using this sunscreen. I love that this product is oil free, too, because it didn’t leave my face with a sticky or greasy feeling, even while in the sun. Highly recommend!

reviews.product_name: Hyaluronic Acid Hydrating Serum
reviews.review_text: Just tried the Hyaluronic Acid Hydrating Serum for the first time before & I can honestly say it is by far the best hyaluronic acid serum I have ever used so far!! Has kind of a sticky texture but it keeps my skin glowing!!

reviews.product_name: Salicylic Acid Acne + Pore Cleanser
reviews.review_text: Just started using this cleanser & so far it feels amazing on my skin!! First time using a salicylic acid cleanser in awhile, so I was nervous to see how my skin would react but this has the right amount of salicylic acid while it not being overly drying! Planning on using this as my nighttime cleanser!

reviews.product_name: Avocado Soothing Skin Barrier Serum with Ceramides
reviews.review_text: It’s been about 2-3 days I’ve been using this serum & so far, I am loving it!! My face is sensitive, especially when introducing new products to my skin routine. However, this serum feels so nice & gentle on the skin & I find that it goes along with the other skin care products I am using!! Appearance wise, I feel like it may be too soon to say that I can physically see a difference, but I can definitely say that my skin feels much softer & super hydrated!! Although it is pricey, I feel like a little goes a long way as I only need one pump per use.

reviews.product_name: Blueberry Bounce Gentle Cleanser
reviews.review_text: I really like this cleanser. Clean beauty has become almost necessary for my skin and this cleanser was highly rated so I thought I’d try it out. My skin definitely glows after using this cleanser. I recently went on vacation and didn’t bring it with me and when I came back and started using if again, you could TELL there was a difference. I’m not sure if it’s this cleanser or a combination of products I’ve been using but my skin has never been softer. I’m giving it 4/5 stars because I wish it didn’t make my skin feel as “squeaky“ coming off. Overall I really enjoy this cleanser though, smells great, great packaging, clean beauty and makes my skin glow. Haven’t had any problems with it so far.

reviews.product_name: Glow2OH Dark Spot Toner
reviews.review_text: I like this product. I have definitely seen a blurring effect happen with my acne marks through consistent use. This is not a product that necessarily works overnight but if you stick to it, you will see results. It smells nice and goes on nice as well. doesn’t really sting or irritate the skin. Once I finish the mini size, I will be buying the bigger one for sure.

reviews.product_name: Volcanic AHA Pore Clearing Clay Mask
reviews.review_title: Best Clay Mask You'll Ever Use!
reviews.review_text: I am so obsessed with this clay mask. I have combo-oily, acne-prone skin and this is the first and only clay mask I have tried that didn’t dry out my face and cause more harm than good. Every time I use it, my skin looks brighter and clearer and it has helped calm some acne-related irritation as well surprisingly.  This is the only clay mask I will ever use now, it is so dependable and effective. You can’t go wrong.

reviews.product_name: Good Genes All-In-One AHA Lactic Acid Treatment
reviews.review_text: This has transformed my skin! I love it. I was nervous buying it at  first bc it is super expensive but it seriously works. It reduced redness on my oily zones, has brighten my skin and it exfoliates your pores, ive used one bottle and can tell a huge difference. Wish it was less pricey :/

reviews.product_name: Auto Correct Brightening + Depuffing Eye Cream for Dark Circles
reviews.review_text: I love this eye cream, i had under-eye discoloration from sun damage and it brighten my under-eyes, it has also reduced my crown feet. It worked for me!!

reviews.product_name: Violet-C Brightening Serum 20% Vitamin C + 10% AHA
reviews.review_text: Best product!!! This stopped my hormonal breakouts, i searched the ingredients and it’s super clean. It also last a super long time which makes it worth the price. All you need is a little. It is watery but i love it. I def recommend it

reviews.product_name: Lemonade Smoothing Scrub
reviews.review_text: Yessss! I’m in love with this scrub! The smell is amazing and I love how it leaves my skin smooth and glowing! Got it as a complimentary gift.

reviews.product_name: Dewtopia 20% Acid Night Treatment
reviews.review_text: Love the results so far! Smaller pores and more of a glow. Definitely keeping this a part of my every day routine.

reviews.product_name: Indigo Overnight Repair Serum in Cream Treatment
reviews.review_text: Love it!! It’s so rich and moisturizing! Little goes a long way. I have a combination (oily/dry) and this surprisingly balanced me out.

reviews.product_name: Mini Indigo Overnight Repair Serum in Cream Treatment
reviews.review_text: Love it!! It’s so rich and moisturizing! Little goes a long way. I have a combination (oily/dry) and this surprisingly balanced me out.

reviews.product_name: The Water Cream Oil-Free Pore Minimizing Moisturizer
reviews.review_title: Yes for sensitive skin with oily t zone!
reviews.review_text: This moisturizer is definitely worth the money if you have sensitive and oily skin or sensitive with an oily t zone. I had struggled for so long before Tatcha to find the right moisturizer because everything I’ve tried before has given me an allergic reaction but I finally found something lightweight that gives the right amount of moisture and doesn’t make my face react and get red, irritated or bumpy like others have. I definitely would not recommend to someone who has dry skin. The only down side is the price and the amount in the jar. It’s a little pricey and not too much product. I wish it was more affordable but other than that it’s amazing!

reviews.product_name: Mini The Water Cream
reviews.review_title: Yes for sensitive skin with oily t zone!
reviews.review_text: This moisturizer is definitely worth the money if you have sensitive and oily skin or sensitive with an oily t zone. I had struggled for so long before Tatcha to find the right moisturizer because everything I’ve tried before has given me an allergic reaction but I finally found something lightweight that gives the right amount of moisture and doesn’t make my face react and get red, irritated or bumpy like others have. I definitely would not recommend to someone who has dry skin. The only down side is the price and the amount in the jar. It’s a little pricey and not too much product. I wish it was more affordable but other than that it’s amazing!

reviews.product_name: The True Cream Aqua Bomb
reviews.review_text: I have EXTREMELY sensitive skin and have been using the Tatcha water cream for a long time now. I was so scared to try any other product because they have all caused allergic reactions but I’ve been on the look out for something comparable yet cheaper than Tatcha. I have to say THIS IS IT! My face did not break out at all. My skin feels moisturized but not oily. I have to say if you’re more on the dry side I wouldn’t recommend because it may not be moisturizing enough for you but as someone with combination skin, oily t zone, this has worked amazing. I’ve even noticed my t zone oil has been more controlled than it normally is.

reviews.product_name: Facial Treatment Essence (Pitera Essence)
reviews.review_text: I received this product complimentary for testing purposes. Honestly I have to say that this product is amazing, at least on my skin it was. I know a lot of people indicate it didn’t make much of a difference for them but for me personally it has helped tighten my pores tremendously!! I have combination skin but my t zone is usually my problem area being overly oily and my pores are also larger in that area. I used this product alone with my regular routine cleanser and also with other SK-II products and it works great either way. I will say that the trick to this product is to pat it over your face and allow your skin to soak up the product. DO NOT RUB this product over your face, as silly as it sounds it honestly makes a world of a difference.

reviews.product_name: Mini Facial Treatment Essence (Pitera Essence)
reviews.review_text: I received this product complimentary for testing purposes. Honestly I have to say that this product is amazing, at least on my skin it was. I know a lot of people indicate it didn’t make much of a difference for them but for me personally it has helped tighten my pores tremendously!! I have combination skin but my t zone is usually my problem area being overly oily and my pores are also larger in that area. I used this product alone with my regular routine cleanser and also with other SK-II products and it works great either way. I will say that the trick to this product is to pat it over your face and allow your skin to soak up the product. DO NOT RUB this product over your face, as silly as it sounds it honestly makes a world of a difference.

reviews.product_name: Take The Day Off Cleansing Balm Makeup Remover
reviews.review_title: Easy to Waste but it Works
reviews.review_text: I was not a fan of this product when I followed the directions. Massaging it into my face felt alright, but made a huge mess once my mascara dissolved and it just took too long to rinse all the black off. Plus, the jar got tainted with makeup from putting my fingers in it. Now, I take a cotton pad to apply the product, which gets a lot of the makeup off while keeping the jar clean, then I rub it in some and rinse. It seems far more efficient and I don’t waste nearly as much product.

reviews.review_text: It delivers! I use one drop and pat under my eyes right before my eye cream. reviews.product_name: Mini Revitalizing Supreme+ Youth Power Creme Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I liked this moisturizer, it feels like it deeply moisturizes without feeling heavy. It’s a rich cream that has a nice scent, but it may clash with other scents if you have other steps to your skincare regiment. It moisturizes well and in doing so helps diminish fine lines.  I liked how my skin felt plump yet firm.

reviews.product_name: T.L.C. Sukari Babyfacial AHA + BHA Mask
reviews.review_text: I’ve been reading great reviews about this! So when I went to Sephora, I asked for a sample. Went home but didn’t try it right away since I was using Ordinary’s Salicylic Acid. A week after, I tried it and it made my face feels so smooth! The next day it still feels the same! Plus, I noticed that it minimized the blackheads around my T-zone area and its day 4 now. You will feel some tingling for the whole 20mins but its nothing. I cant wait to purchase the real bottle!

reviews.product_name: Ultra Repair Cream Intense Hydration
reviews.review_text: This moisturizer has a thick consistency. It is almost similar to CeraVe, but a tad bit thicker, which I actually don’t mind especially when it’s really doing its job-to moisturize my skin. I use this mostly at night because I know I will wake up to a hydrated skin the next day. I use it for my hands too! I am glad I have found this product! It has a hint of minty fragrance but not overpowering. No more dry flakey skin and my bestie in Winter time! It is just the best!

reviews.product_name: Niacinamide 10% + Zinc 1% Oil Control Serum
reviews.review_text: I wanted to love this product but it just broke me out. I only have used it twice. It gave me tiny pimple bumps, jawline itchiness and redness on cheeks. I gave it a second chance thinking these issues was caused by my moisturizer. I used it again, after a few hours it made my skin itchy again. And I used a different moisturizer this time! Now my face is red and has so many tiny bumps :( Cheap price=cheap results?

reviews.product_name: Niacinamide 10% + Zinc 1% Oil Control Serum
reviews.review_text: I got this a couple of months ago and just recently tried it because my dark sports doesn’t want to leave my face. Before this, I have been using Estee Lauder Crescent White Brightening Spot Correcting Essence (discountinued now I believe) which does an amazing job too! But I wanted a fast result so I looked this one up and read that this lightens up dark spots. I used it first at night. Woke up to a brighter skin! Dark spots noticeably faded away! I use it now morning and night. I top it off with a moisturizer that has green tea in it since I read that it works well with it. It is an amazing product that doesn’t hurt your bank account!

reviews.product_name: Facial Radiance Pads
reviews.review_title: BEST FOR ACNES AND DARK SPOTS!
reviews.review_text: This was sitting in my skincare stash as I didn’t like it the first time I’ve tried it. About a month ago, I was getting so much acne in my forehead. I’ve used so many products and none of them worked until I remembered that I have this. I gave it a second chance since I wanted my acne to go away asap(last resort!). I used it at night, topped it off with a niacinamide serum then moisturizer. Next morning I can see my acne starting to dry up! This is truly a great product if you are acne prone and wants to get rid of dark spots. Make sure to put moisturizer afterwards since this can dry out skin. Saving Tip: I cut mine either in half or quarters depending on how much I need the product. Usually a quarter is enough for me honestly! Also, keep rubbing it until the pad dries out!

reviews.review_text: This product is amazing. I have a combination of dry and oily skin. And this definitely made my skin have a slight glow I love it.

reviews.review_text: This is easily the best eye cream I have ever used. Worth the price and I am officially hooked for life. Lightweight and absorbs easily. I use with one of their serums and have been very happy with the reduced fine lines around my eyes.

reviews.review_text: Love this exfoliator it goes really well with their exfoliating cleanser. My skin is quite oily and also dry. I moisturize a ton after using this

reviews.review_text: Another great product from Belif. Moisturizing, soothing, face feels clean. Nice scent but NOT too powerful.

reviews.product_name: Floral Recovery Overnight Mask with Squalane
reviews.review_text: I have mixed feelings about this product. On the one hand, this has a lovely feel on the skin initially, and the light scent is lovely. It is very soothing and moisturizing, and the packaging is quite luxe - I love that it is glass. On the other hand, it pills no matter how much or little I put on my face - I’ve used it several different ways over the course of a week and it happens every time.

reviews.product_name: Watermelon Glow Niacinamide Sunscreen SPF 50
reviews.review_text: I really enjoy this product! My skin felt plump without being greasy, blended well into my skin, and worked well with my base products. I have a glow to my skin without the grease or tackiness, and it really did stay like that for the majority of the day. It has a cream gel hybrid texture, with a light scent that is unobtrusive. I really like that it leaves no white cast, and that it doesn’t sting my sensitive skin at all. Love it!

reviews.product_name: Tea Elixir Niacinamide & Hyaluronic Acid Anti-Aging Serum
reviews.review_text: I have had issues with Fresh skincare in the past, primarily because the fragrance is generally too heavy for my sensitive skin and nose. That is not the case with this product! I really enjoyed to fragrance it does have, and it didn’t irritate my skin or allergies. That said, I wish it weren’t there in the first place, as usual. My skin is noticeably plumper and smoother than before I started using it.  It has a light texture, as serums usually do, and absorbs quickly. There can be some pilling depending on your SPF if you use it during the day, so just be on the look out for that, as I did have to change up my SPF. The price point is a bit too much for what it is, but I generally feel that way about most luxury skincare. All in all a solid offering.

reviews.product_name: Triple Algae Eye Renewal Balm Eye Cream

Their ingredients and formulas are great, never greasy, but they always have an interesting smell to them. Not bad, but not good. This isn’t a deal breaker for me as I’m not trying to make my face smell good with my skincare routine. I’m not sure if this one is my holy grail and I wasn’t totally blown away after using it, but my under eyes were moisturized and my “starter wrinkles“ (I’m 41) looked slightly less noticeable. So that’s a win in my book. I would buy this one if I was looking for an eye balm in this price range.

reviews.product_name: Cicapair Tiger Grass Color Correcting Treatment SPF 30
reviews.review_text: I have combo-oily, acne prone skin with redness. I’ve been using the Cicapair line for about 2 weeks (mist, serum, gel cream, cream, color corrector). The corrector feels VERY greasy going on my skin. I apply it in the morning after mist, serum, gel cream, and Neutrogena SPF. I’ve continued using the SPF because although this does have SPF 30, not enough of it goes on my face to properly protect my fair, easily burnt skin. I use a TINY amount- just enough for a very thin layer- using more than that seems to make it pill up. I’ve been setting this with Laura Mercier translucent powder (no liquid foundation or concealer). After setting it with powder it does not feel greasy at all and my face has a soft matte finish. It definitely corrects almost ALL of my redness except the worst of it right around/under my nose, which is still noticeably less. I then go in with powder blush/bronzer/highlight and eye makeup. It seems to last well throughout the day, no more oily than usual. I really like this as a quick everyday way to cover my redness without spending the time on foundation/concealer every morning. Just blend in a tiny amount with my fingers, set with powder and go. I wouldn’t use this if I were putting on a full face though, I think it would be too heavy under foundation. I’m highly considering purchasing once it runs out. I received this product free for testing purposes.

reviews.product_name: Cicapair Tiger Grass Cream
reviews.review_text: I have combo-mostly oily, acne prone skin with redness. I’ve been using the Cicapair line for about 2 weeks (mist, serum, gel cream, cream, color corrector). I’ve been using this cream in my night time routine along with the mist and serum and the Farmacy AHA serum. The cream is very thick but is easy to apply. I use a pea size amount, dot it around my face and pat it in with my fingers, focusing mostly on the outer areas of my face where it needs more moisture. It makes my t zone feel slightly greasy, but the rest of my face feels baby soft with a slightly matte finish. It doesn’t seem to have any scent. I’m used to using a lighter weight moisturizer at night and a lot of heavier creams tend to irritate or break my skin out, but I haven’t noticed that with this cream. I like it, but think I will stick with just the Cicapair gel cream for morning and night moisturizer once this runs out. I received this product free for testing purposes.

reviews.product_name: Cicapair Tiger Grass Serum
reviews.review_text: I have combo-mostly oily, acne prone skin with quite a bit of redness. I’ve been using the Cicapair line for about 2 weeks now— mist, serum, gel cream (morning), cream (night), and color corrector (morning) along with Neutrogena SPF (morning) and Farmacy AHA serum (night). I haven’t seen much difference in number of blemishes but they are definitely healing faster compared to my old routine (Simple toner and Neutrogena sensitive skin moisturizer still with same SPF and AHA). I focus applying this on the outer areas of my face where it’s drier as it tends to make my t zone feel greasy. I also like the packaging— the pump dropper makes application very easy. I’m considering purchasing this again when it runs out because I’m seeing good effects from it- my skin is repairing itself quicker from breakouts. I received this product free for testing purposes.

reviews.product_name: Niacinamide 10% + Zinc 1% Oil Control Serum
reviews.review_text: I swear, this product has completely changed my skin for the better. I experienced a very sudden onset of rosacea, dryness, and allergic skin after some recent hormonal changes and as my body readjusted, my skin developed problems I had NEVER experienced before. My once dry, irritated skin is now combination skin... no joke. Niacinamide corrected my skin type and now it’s more balanced. It cleared up my redness/rosacea and my skin glows when I use this. I can’t recommend it enough.

reviews.review_text: This is the first luxury brand moisturizer I’ve ever bought at this sort of price point, so honestly, I went in a little skeptical. But this cream DELIVERS. It feels luxurious and creamy going on, moisturizes deeply, and my skin is absolutely radiant when I wake up the next morning after applying at night. I’ve even noticed less redness and more even tone along with more supple, hydrated skin. This product is worth the money, especially if you have issues with redness and tone, texture, and dry skin!

I’ve noticed more even tone, more supple skin, and a more radiant quality to my skin.

reviews.product_name: Hyaluronic Acid 2% + B5 Hydrating Serum
reviews.review_text: This stuff hydrates your skin!!! Your skin will feel so good and yummy. I have oily skin because my skin is actually dehydrated and this has REALLY helped balance my skin out!! It also has not irritated my terribly sensitive skin. Would definitely recommend!!!

reviews.product_name: T.L.C. Sukari Babyfacial AHA + BHA Mask
reviews.review_text: I slowly built up to this product. I had already been using 10% aha for years. I found that my skin just wasn’t doing anything. It was dull and I had so much texture. I started using the product once a week as recommended, however only for 15 minutes instead of 20 because of how strong it is. I’m about to use it for the fourth week WOW. My skin has changed so much. My stubborn little bumps that I’ve struggled with so much to go away, are FINALLY going away. My skin is much more even and my acne has also subsided! This product WILL make you purge and red at first but if you’re patient for results, you’ll get amazing ones. You definitely CANNOT just use this product willy nilly, it’s a powerful exfoliant and you have to prepare your skin first with lower % AHAs. Definitely would recommend!

reviews.product_name: Brighten-i Eye Cream
reviews.review_text: IT STINGS!!!!! No eye cream should sting and burn your delicate eye area. It also does nothing to brighten and the cream goops out the applicator. I would not recommend. Highly disappointed.

reviews.product_name: Urban Environment Fresh-Moisture Sunscreen Broad-Spectrum SPF 42

reviews.product_name: Hydro Biotic Recovery Sleeping Mask
reviews.review_text: The second ingredient in this is dimethicone, after water. I usually avoid products with dimethicone in them because it clogs my pores, but I thought I would try this to help lock in the moisture from all of my creams and potions overnight. I’m not a fan. It feels heavy in a bad way and smells cheap. There are some good ingredients in here but I feel like they are being buried by so much dimethicone. My skin looked fairly plump and glowy in the morning, but it didn’t last after I washed my face and now I have a fine layer of clogged pores on my forehead.I received this product free in exchange for a review.

reviews.product_name: Auto Correct Brightening + Depuffing Eye Cream for Dark Circles
reviews.review_text: I never know if eye creams ever have any lasting effect! I do know that this cream is instantly brightening and gives a nice smooth surface for my concealer. I don’t have puffiness so I can’t speak to that. Sometimes my eyes are sensitive and this doesn’t bother them at all. It has a nice substantial texture, but isn’t heavy or greasy.

reviews.review_text: My skin is constantly dehydrated but clogs easily. I’m always looking for a rich moisturizer that doesn’t have silicones or heavy butter, which clog my skin. Sometimes I buy things that I don’t want to use right away so this is very helpful in keeping things in tip top shape until I use them. It prolongs the shelf-life which is awesome! My 40 year old skin looks so much brighter and actually glows after using Vitamin C! I have had sun damage in the past so this is working to repair that. I have gotten compliments on my skin and that makes me feel good!

reviews.product_name: Aqua Bomb Overnight Lip Mask
reviews.review_text: This overnight lip mask is awesome! When I put it on at bedtime I feel like I’m doing something extra special for myself. It’s nice when your skin routine can feel like your me-time. You just apply this to your lips before jumping into bed and it works it’s magic overnight. When I wake up my lips are hydrated and smooth! This is a hard task because my lips seem to crack, dry out. and peel, all times of the year and I’ve found nothing to keep them smooth. I really like this product but I’m knocking off a star for price.

reviews.product_name: D-Bronzi Anti-Pollution Bronzing Drops with Peptides
reviews.review_text: OMG GREAT! THIS IS WHAT I’VE BEEN WAITING FOR I HAVE NEVER FOUND A SELF TANNER THAT HAS MADE ME LOOK NATURAL! I KNOW THIS ISN’T A SELF TANNER BUT MIXED WITH MY MOISTURIZER IT GIVES ME THE MOST NATURAL GORGEOUS GLOW I AM IN SHOCK! I RECOMMEND THAT YOU TRY THIS!

reviews.product_name: Hyaluronic Acid 2% + B5 Hydrating Serum
reviews.review_text: I took off one star because the stuff is a little sticky but I put this on my face before I use any moisturizer whether it’s day or night and it makes my skin so much softer it’s kind of like a glue so that your moisturizer doesn’t slide off it’s great!

reviews.product_name: Superberry Hydrate + Glow Dream Night Mask with Vitamin C
reviews.review_text: I love this! i was shocked that after one use my skin looked brighter and clearer!

reviews.product_name: Mini Superberry Hydrate + Glow Dream Mask
reviews.review_text: I love this! i was shocked that after one use my skin looked brighter and clearer!

reviews.product_name: Vitamin Enriched Face Base Priming Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I love this face base. It’s so easy to apply and I love that its a moisturizer as well. I have oily skin and this has helped with oil control. I don’t have to apply powder in the afternoon when I use this base under my liquid foundation.

reviews.product_name: GOOPGLOW Microderm Instant Glow Exfoliator
reviews.review_text: Great exfoliation! My face was so soft and smooth after using this product. Smells nice and super easy to feel pampered after having a long day! Love the ingredients too!! This exfoliator is a keeper!!

reviews.product_name: Mini GOOPGLOW Microderm Instant Glow Exfoliator
reviews.review_text: Great exfoliation! My face was so soft and smooth after using this product. Smells nice and super easy to feel pampered after having a long day! Love the ingredients too!! This exfoliator is a keeper!!

reviews.product_name: Retinol Reform Treatment Serum
reviews.review_text: I love this treatment. It makes my skin feel soft and refreshed after applying.  Helps with uneven skin tone and fine lines and wrinkles. I am at that age where I need to start worrying about using the right products and this is definitely one of them!!

reviews.product_name: Mini Retinol Reform
reviews.review_text: I love this treatment. It makes my skin feel soft and refreshed after applying.  Helps with uneven skin tone and fine lines and wrinkles. I am at that age where I need to start worrying about using the right products and this is definitely one of them!!

reviews.product_name: GinZing Ultra-Hydrating Energy-Boosting Cream
reviews.review_text: During the winter I have combination skin, drier in my t zone area and slightly on my cheeks. Not to mention missing that “glow”. This definitely helps wake up my tired skin and treat my initial problem areas. I’ve tried gel moisturizers in the past (like Clinique), and felt like they never really treated but masked it for the time being. The consistency feels like there’s more substance to it. The smell is really refreshing, like orange zest. Great thing too, it doesn’t feel greasy through out the day under my makeup :)

reviews.product_name: B-Hydra Intensive Hydration Serum with Hyaluronic Acid
reviews.review_text: I have combo skin oil/dry, more dry in the winter + sensitive skin. Great combo right? Recently have been getting chlorine water from swimming, which strips your natural oils. My face has been dry/flakey, and feeling tight after washing up. This product quenches skin, without it feeling greasy afterwards or leaving residue. My skin is getting re-hydrated, and those annoying dry spots are disappearing. GREAT under makeup. Have been using for nearly a week and haven’t seen any break outs or odd reactions. Perfect product for seasonal change, and probably great for summer without making those troubled oil zones burst out. Wish it wasn’t so expensive, but learned to love this line and worth the cost. Little goes along way, so in all you’re getting your moneys worth. Feels good when you finally find those great products :)

reviews.product_name: Superfood Antioxidant Cleanser
reviews.review_text: This cleanser is GREAT!!! Love that it’s vegan, cruelty free and explains what each ingredient promotes. Lathers really well so a little goes a long way; while rinsing you can feel it’s leaving your skin texture soft and smooth. Have been using for about a month now and really keeps my skin in check; barely any break outs in my usual areas; leaving a natural glow! I have sensitive skin (with almost all cleaners drying out my skin), this is very gentle.. I recommend all the time!!

reviews.product_name: Mini Superfood Antioxidant Cleanser
reviews.review_text: This cleanser is GREAT!!! Love that it’s vegan, cruelty free and explains what each ingredient promotes. Lathers really well so a little goes a long way; while rinsing you can feel it’s leaving your skin texture soft and smooth. Have been using for about a month now and really keeps my skin in check; barely any break outs in my usual areas; leaving a natural glow! reviews.product_name: T.L.C. Framboos Glycolic Resurfacing Night Serum
reviews.review_text: Ever since I added this to my skincare routine I’ve gotten so many compliments! Glowing, younger-looking skin... fewer breakouts. I use my clarisonic every other night and this every night, followed by Herbivore orchid youth-preserving oil and then a moisturizer. I live in an incredibly dry climate and it does wonders. It’s QUITE expensive and the smaller size doesn’t last long, but I’m afraid I’m hooked!

reviews.product_name: Salicylic Acid Acne Healing Dots
reviews.review_text: These dots are addictive. When I run out, I worry when I will get my new supply. I don’t break out with cystic acne too often, but when I do, I apply these religiously. They don’t get rid of huge zits overnight, but if you apply them consistently over a few days, the zit will either go back down or come to a head (but completely - you don’t need to put any pressure on it for it to resolve itself). My only gripe is the excessive packaging. It feels quite wasteful. However, I did contact the company about my concerns and they said that the packaging was to preserve the integrity of the product. Thanks for the timely response, Peace Out.

reviews.product_name: Take The Day Off Cleansing Balm Makeup Remover
reviews.review_text: I have used the “Take the Day Off“ liquid for years now - and wanted to try this. While it works super well, I find that it gets in my eyes and kind of coats them for a while and makes my vision blurry. Not the most pleasant sensation - but hopefully using this will be less wasteful than using cotton balls every day.

reviews.product_name: Mini Take The Day Off Cleansing Balm Makeup Remover
reviews.review_text: I have used the “Take the Day Off“ liquid for years now - and wanted to try this. While it works super well, I find that it gets in my eyes and kind of coats them for a while and makes my vision blurry. reviews.product_name: Superberry Hydrate + Glow Dream Oil
reviews.review_text: I love this oil!!! It smells amazing and feels even better. So lightweight yet hydrating and it feels excellent under makeup. I feel like my skin looks glowy and dewy all day under makeup and fresh and hydrated without.

reviews.product_name: Adaptogen Deep Moisturizing Cream with Ashwagandha + Reishi
reviews.review_text: I received this moisturizer and I wanted to use it for a few weeks  before i left a review and yes 5 stars! This is a really amazing moisturizer and it makes my skin look and feel healthier!! I was worried because of the mushroom, as I am sensitive to eating mushrooms but no problems at all. I mainly use this at night because it’s a little too heavy for my combo skin but it never feels greasy. I like to use it to heal my skin from some of my acne treatments and i always wake up to beautiful calm skin. I think this moisturizer is great because so many skin types can use this and it helps them all! Highly recommend and i honestly think this jar will last me a solid 2 months because a little bit goes a long way. Thank you youth to the people for making progressive, clean beauty products!

reviews.product_name: Smart Clinical Repair Wrinkle Correcting Eye Cream
reviews.review_text: First off, I’m not a big Clinique fan (or I wasn’t in the past) but this product is kind of a game changer! I never feel like mid range priced eye creams do a ton for the skin but this one actually made me notice my eyes looked perkier and smoother. My favorite thing about this is the texture - it’s like a whipped cream feel but it absorbs quickly and plumps the fine lines around my eyes instead of drying sticky. I’m only using this at night but I do feel like I look more rested in the am! If you want a retinol eye cream - start here for sure!

reviews.product_name: Squalane + Vitamin C Rose Firming Oil
reviews.review_text: Love love love this product smells great and my skin just loves it

reviews.product_name: Smart Clinical Repair Wrinkle Correcting Eye Cream
reviews.review_text: Product works great and feels light when applied I noticed a difference after just a short time using highly recommend

reviews.product_name: Squalane + Omega Repair Deep Hydration Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: Love love love the product will repurchase again recommend

reviews.product_name: Lip Glowy Balm
reviews.review_text: If you’re looking for something hydrating and non tacky for chapped lips, this is not it. If you want a cute lip gloss, purchase something else. I found myself reapplying all day and ended up with dryer lips than I originally had. This is just an overhyped product with no bang for your buck.

reviews.product_name: Superberry Hydrate + Glow Dream Night Mask with Vitamin C
reviews.review_text: This is so hydrating for my dry/combo skin and DOESNT make me look oily. I recommend using this only as a night mask (as it’s name says). It doesn’t break out my sensitive skin which is a major plus :) however it does take a while to dry so put it on about 30 min before bed to avoid staining your sheets.

reviews.product_name: Mini Superberry Hydrate + Glow Dream Mask
reviews.review_text: This is so hydrating for my dry/combo skin and DOESNT make me look oily. I recommend using this only as a night mask (as it’s name says). It doesn’t break out my sensitive skin which is a major plus :) however it does take a while to dry so put it on about 30 min before bed to avoid staining your sheets.

reviews.product_name: The Camellia Oil 2-in-1 Makeup Remover & Cleanser
reviews.review_text: I wouldn’t use this as a daily cleanser because you’ll run out quick. I use it for cleansing waterproof makeup, or just removing eye makeup or long lasting liquid lipsticks. Then I use my daily cleanser to remove what this oil cleanser did not. My skin was left soft and clean after this cleanser (no breakouts for my sensitive skin!).

reviews.product_name: The Rice Polish Foaming Enzyme Powder
reviews.review_text: I’m in love. I’ve tried about 5 other samples of different exfoliating products (from different brands and price ranges) and I will say this is the best. It’s a very fine powder so it doesn’t damage your skin in the long run, it smells so good (but no perfume to irritate your skin), and the amount of product you get is worth the pricing. I wouldn’t recommend daily use, but maybe twice a week :). After two weeks (added to your skin care routine) my skin was softer, and so clean! It doesn’t leave a weird film on your face after washing off. I would say splurge and treat yourself!!! Just remember this product isn’t a miracle and doesn’t do much alone....so consider adding it to your skin care routine.

reviews.product_name: Hyaluronic Acid Hydrating Serum
reviews.review_title: Finally! A perfect hyaluronic serum for me!!
reviews.review_text: I use this hyaluronic serum by combining 3 drops of it with a 1/2 pea size amount of the Inkey Vitamin C cream and 1/2 pea size amount of the Inkey Q10. For me, this is a perfect combination. It smoothes right into my skin, and I don’t even know it’s there. Very light, and the scent of these  is fresh and clean. Perfect for my combination, over 55+ age face. A plus: leaves my face touchably soft and natural looking. Love it. A+++++

reviews.product_name: Brighten-i Eye Cream
reviews.review_text: One of my favorite items from The Inkey List is this brighten-i eye cream. Works like a dream. Smooths and softens skin right under my eyes, and it brightens within just one application. This is, for me, the best eye cream I’ve ever bought. Light, almost entirely weightless, it absorbs immediately. I don’t even have to reapply it again during the day. Every time, Inkey list products out perform their own advertisement. A+++++

reviews.product_name: Caffeine Eye Cream
reviews.review_title: A Keeper for Life! Works like a Charm!
reviews.review_text: I used this daily for a week before writing a review. My regimen is that I use this before using any moisturizer on my face or near my eye areas. I mix a small dab of this caffeine eye cream with a small dab of Inkey’s I-Brightener. A very small amount goes a long way. Absorbs quickly with no gunked up residue or stickiness. It just smoothes right in. With the first application, this stuff worked like a charm. I didn’t have to reapply it, either, during the day. Worked great even in the full sun while I was gardening and doing yard work over the weekend. So I thought to myself, “okay this works for the first time, let’s see if it continues to work well“. So, I used it daily for one week straight, and I got the same great results each time. I continue to use it to this day and will for a long time. I use the mix above as part of my morning routine and by the time I get to work, I can look in the mirror, and the bags and dark circles under my eyes have been reduced and minimized significantly. For me, this Inkey List caffeine eye cream, along with the Inkey I-brightener, are keepers for life!!! Ordering more of them now, and will order extras to pack into my travel bags, too, so I can never leave home without it. 5*****!!!!

reviews.product_name: GinZing Ultra-Hydrating Energy-Boosting Cream
reviews.review_text: I received this product for free in exchange for a review, but I love the way this moisturizer smells; it really wakes me up in the morning!  It’s extremely hydrating!

reviews.product_name: Hydro Biotic Recovery Sleeping Mask
reviews.review_text: I received this product for free to test it out, but I love it!  It’s very hydrating and doesn’t irritate my sensitive skin.  It smells really nice, too!

reviews.product_name: Plum Plump Hyaluronic Acid Serum
reviews.review_text: I really liked this serum as it was super hydrating but it was a tad sticky. I guess that happens with hyaluronic serums, but that’s why it’s getting 4/5.

reviews.product_name: Hyaluronic Acid 2% + B5 Hydrating Serum
reviews.review_text: Works ok. It was a little sticky but overall would purchase again.

reviews.product_name: Hyaluronic Acid Hydrating Serum
reviews.review_text: The best HA serum I’ve ever used. Absorbs quickly, very hydrating! If you’re torn between this and the ordinary get this instead!

reviews.product_name: Mini Cream Skin Toner & Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: Has completely saved my skin from winter dryness! Beautiful application and leaves my skin so soft. I can easily layer sunscreen or moisturizer over it with no pilling or greasy feeling.

reviews.product_name: Daily UV Defense Invisible Broad Spectrum SPF 36 Sunscreen
reviews.review_text: New favorite face sunscreen. No white cast, no smell, no burning or break outs. I have tried a number of sunscreens and this is my favorite. I would say I like this more than higher end sunscreens that’s I’ve tired.

reviews.product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C
reviews.review_text: I wish it lasted a bit longer, but I love the way it makes my lips feel.

reviews.product_name: Salicylic Acid Acne Healing Dots
reviews.review_text: These are amazing if you have the occasional blemish. They absolutely decrease the life of the blemish on your skin.

reviews.product_name: Hello FAB Coconut Skin Smoothie Priming Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: By far my favourite face moisturizer. Leaves me feeling hydrated, without feeling sticky or weighted down. Also smells so nice and fresh! Great for under makeup.

reviews.product_name: Smart Clinical Repair Wrinkle Correcting Eye Cream
reviews.review_text: Easy to apply eye care. I don’t trust a lot of eye creams as I have very sensitive eyes but this eye cream didn’t cause any issues. I used it at night time and looked nice and bright in the morning.

reviews.product_name: Smart Clinical Repair Wrinkle Correcting Cream
reviews.review_text: This cream gives an ultra smooth application. Feels like it’s smoothing out five lines as you apply it! Relatively scent free, maybe a touch of baby powder type smell if anything.

reviews.product_name: Smart Clinical Repair Wrinkle Correcting Serum
reviews.review_text: Lovely serum, easy to apply, minimal smell. A little goes a long way! Definitely felt like it was smoothing out my skin the first time I applied it.

reviews.product_name: Lip Glowy Balm
reviews.review_text: One of the best lip balms I’ve ever used! It lasts so much longer than others, and I love the light pink tint.

reviews.product_name: AHA 30% + BHA 2% Exfoliating Peeling Solution
reviews.review_text: This mask is great. It’s very thin in consistency, so it’s easy to control the amount you apply. I put on a thin layer, leave on for 10 minutes max, and my skin is so soft the next morning. I plan on using weekly.

reviews.product_name: The Deep Cleanse Gentle Exfoliating Cleanser
reviews.review_text: I bought this cleanser to treat my combination skin and reduce pores on my nose. It definitely accomplished both of those goals. It’s light foamy and has a slight floral scent. Works great with my foreo brush. The bottle design makes it slight tricky to control the amount you use.

reviews.product_name: Mini Deep Cleanse Gentle Exfoliating Cleanser
reviews.review_text: I bought this cleanser to treat my combination skin and reduce pores on my nose. It definitely accomplished both of those goals. It’s light foamy and has a slight floral scent. Works great with my foreo brush. The bottle design makes it slight tricky to control the amount you use.

reviews.product_name: Dreamskin Skin Perfector
reviews.review_text: Dior Dreamskin Skin Perfector is a lightweight is cream. Its in the perfect shade of pink and is lightly scented. I use less then a dime size and it applies smoothly. It can be worn under makeup and I noticed my makeup stayed on longer. This cream will lighten any dark spots and leaves your skin hydrated. I have received multiple compliments on the way my skin looks. This can be used morning and at night as well, just apply to clean face. I recieved this product complimentary for testing purposes from INFLUENSTER.

reviews.product_name: Urban Environment Oil-Free Sunscreen Broad-Spectrum SPF 42
reviews.review_text: This Sunscreen is not greasy and can be worn under makeup and not ruin your makeup application. It’s also moisturizing. I wish they would make the bottle larger.

reviews.product_name: Urban Environment Fresh-Moisture Sunscreen Broad-Spectrum SPF 42
reviews.review_text: Absolute favorite sunscreen can be worn under makeup or just alone. It has a beautiful glow whe. Applied to face. It’s also super light weight and is hyaluronic. This is a must have. I LOVE IT.

reviews.product_name: Cicapair Tiger Grass Color Correcting Treatment SPF 30
reviews.review_text: This is incredible! It’s perfect to spot treat my blemishes on days I’m not wanting to wear makeup. It’s green which cancels out redness from the zit and then turns beige as you run it in which actually helps conceal the blemish! The tiger grass in it soothes the irritated skin and my pimple is usually gone within a day!

reviews.product_name: Mini Cicapair Tiger Grass Color Correcting Treatment SPF 30
reviews.review_text: This is incredible! It’s perfect to spot treat my blemishes on days I’m not wanting to wear makeup.
