The tiger grass in it soothes the irritated skin and my pimple is usually gone within a day!

reviews.product_name: Cicapair Tiger Grass Cream
reviews.review_text: This cream I use at night and it’s not oily or greasy and I love it! It allows my skin to get the hydration it needs while also getting to relax! Blemishes are clear by the morning!

reviews.product_name: Cicapair Tiger Grass Serum
reviews.review_text: this is the holy grail! I use this every night before i go in with the tiger grass cream and it is a product I never knew my skin needed! My breakouts will be minimal if not clear the next morning if i notice them that night! It’s so hydrating and calming!

reviews.product_name: Sugar Lip Balm Hydrating Treatment
reviews.review_text: I received this product gifted by Fresh. This is a very  hydrating chapstick with a natural looking buildable tint. The color gives my lips a “my lips but better“ nude lip look. The packaging feels very nice as well, I like it!

reviews.product_name: Tea Elixir Niacinamide & Hyaluronic Acid Anti-Aging Serum
reviews.review_text: When I first saw tea elixir for some reason I thought this serum would have tea tree, but it’s actual tea and you can definitely smell it! The product has a very earthy/plant scent and the texture is milky. Even though it’s milky, it feels so refreshing on the skin and was not too heavy for my combo skin. I liked how it felt on my skin and I felt very well moisturized. I feel like dry skin folks would love this!

reviews.product_name: Mini Daily Microfoliant Exfoliator
reviews.review_text: I received this product gifted by Dermalogica. I have never tried a powder exfoliant but I have tried powder cleansers in the past. This would be great for travel as it is dry and compact and it was very easy to use. My face looked brighter and smoother after just one use.

reviews.product_name: Daily Microfoliant Exfoliator
reviews.review_text: I received this product gifted by Dermalogica. I have never tried a powder exfoliant but I have tried powder cleansers in the past. This would be great for travel as it is dry and compact and it was very easy to use. My face looked brighter and smoother after just one use.

reviews.product_name: Cicapair Tiger Grass Cream
reviews.review_text: After using this cream in my nightly routine for a few days I noticed my dry, sensitive skin became more hydrated, less flakey and less red! I put the cream on following the calming mist and serum!

reviews.product_name: Cicapair Tiger Grass Serum
reviews.review_text: This serum is so lightweight and great on my sensitive skin. I have noticed my redness getting better after each use. I use it after the calming mist and love the combination!

reviews.product_name: Lotus Anti- Aging Daily Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I’m really loving this moisturizer and after using it for two weeks I can really see a difference. My skin is so much more hydrated and looks bright and smooth. I also love the smell!

reviews.product_name: Caffeine 5% + EGCG Depuffing Eye Serum
reviews.review_text: This product has helped my undereyes dark circles in just 1wk of using this. I’m prone to getting milia and have sensitive skin and this did nothing but give me amazing results.

reviews.product_name: Watermelon Glow Niacinamide Dew Drops
reviews.review_text: First off I love this brand and all their products so I knew off the bat I would love this.  The packaging is super cute. The texture is that of a silky feel that leaves your skin looking and feeling silky and dewy like. It absorbs really well and rather quick. So afterwards I went forward with my makeup and surprisingly it worked as a primer it made my makeup last almost all day, almost. I person like using this alone after my toner and before my moisturizer without makeup so my skin can drink it all up. I tried it alone too and it just immediately made my skin feel so soft and silky and dewy like. Love it thanx

reviews.product_name: The Dewy Serum Resurfacing and Plumping Treatment
reviews.review_text: omg this is the best serum ever! its light yet so fast absorbing and leaves my skin so smooth and revives it. my skin looks so dewy and plumped throughout the day. Get it

reviews.product_name: Glycolic Acid 7% Exfoliating Toning Solution
reviews.review_title: NEED MORE MORE MORE OF THIS AND THE FULL LINE!
reviews.review_text: I couldn’t believe my eyes when I received this and the size, it’s amazing! I ordered 6 items at first, tried all, loved. Then went back and ordered 8 more, so 14 of the 18 stocked by Sephora! Why in the world does Sephora not carry the full line of The Ordinary and also some other brands...Hylamide, NIOD, The Chemistry Brand, STEMM, Fountain, HIF, Ab Crew and ESHO is beyond me!!! Sephora, pick all of these lines up in their full lines, please!!! I literally want everything they make after only two days of using.

reviews.product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C
reviews.review_text: This stuff is amazing! I want a tiny lip balm in exactly the same formula I can carry around all day in my pocket! I was amazed how well this works

reviews.product_name: D-Bronzi Anti-Pollution Bronzing Drops with Peptides
reviews.review_text: I got the full size of this and returned it because I thought the color came out orange and horrible on me. Then I got a sample from another online order. Instead of trying to mix it into a moisturizer I tried doing all of my skincare routine and then at the end, I dotted it on each cheek and blended it out. Came out very natural and warm looking. You might need to play with this to see what works best for you, if at all, and I admit it’s a bit of work. I like it more now but not sure I’d purchase instead of continuing to use powder bronzer

reviews.product_name: Microneedling Anti-Wrinkle Retinol Patches
reviews.review_text: They really really work. I use them on my smile lines and I see a very motivated difference for at least two to three weeks. I will be repurchasing these for sure. I wish they came more in a box, but they’re worth it!

reviews.product_name: Glycolic Acid 7% Exfoliating Toning Solution
reviews.review_text: Another amazing product from The Ordinary! Great price, works great, and my skin is SO much brighter.

reviews.product_name: Multi-Peptide + HA Serum
reviews.review_text: Everything from their line in superb! Including this product. My skin has never looked better. It glows. I’m never pay for products with a huge price tag ever again.

reviews.product_name: Sugar Hydrating Lip Balm
reviews.review_text: This is my favorite balm of all time.  I only wish it came in stick form. Its creamy and my lips feel so hydrated after using it. Definitely buying again.

reviews.product_name: Cold Plunge Pore Mask
reviews.review_text: I’m obsessed with any Ole Henriksen. This did nothing for my skin. I’ll be returning it this week. Save your cash and buy something that actually does something for your skin.

reviews.product_name: Balancing Force Oil Control Toner
reviews.review_text: life saver. will drive hours to find a sephora with it in stock. reduces pores, gets rid of blemishes over night, creates an even texture making skin soft and smooth. i’ve never been more obsessed

reviews.product_name: Hyaluronic Acid Hydrating Serum
reviews.review_text: If i don’t have this in my routine I’ll die. Amazing.

reviews.product_name: Vegan Milk Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: LOVE LOVE LOVE I am beyond picky about moisturizer. I hate everything. Moisturizers either leave me way oily or not even close to moisturized. This is the first moisturizer that actually does what a moisturizer is supposed to do. I hate jars but I’ll make an exception for this. Will never buy another moisturizer again.

reviews.product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C
reviews.review_text: My lips feel AMAZINGLY sofft!! I has such a smooth feeling!

reviews.product_name: Pure Skin Face Cleanser
reviews.review_text: This face wash is so good! I have very acne prone skin and have seen a considerable difference in the amount of breakouts!! Does not dry my skin out too as I have combination skin.

reviews.product_name: Salicylic Acid Acne Healing Dots
reviews.review_text: Always my go to! I get huge under the skin bumps that sometimes never get a head, these reduce picking at my skin and drawing all the nasty stuff out!

reviews.product_name: Alpha Beta Extra Strength Daily Peel Pads
reviews.review_text: I love this daily peek! I wasn’t too fond of the smell, though. The pads are super wet and take a few minutes to go dry (following the directions). My skin was left so soft. No irritation, no sticky residue and my face didn’t look like an oil slick within a few hours. My pores weren’t as visible, either.

reviews.product_name: Auto Correct Brightening + Depuffing Eye Cream for Dark Circles
reviews.review_text: I received this from Bzzagent for free for my honest review. Auto Correct is the best eye cream I have tried yet. To me the cream had some sparkle to it but did not appear that way after I tapped it into my under eye area. There is no harsh smell. The cream is creamy but not heavy. Easily absorbed into my skin. Within minutes, my deep purple circles were drastically reduced and fine lines weren’t noticeable. I look like I got a full 8 hours sleep! My concealer and eye makeup went on smoothly. Throughout the day my concealer did not cake or crease. I have received a lot of compliments since I began using this.

reviews.product_name: ICE Ceramide Moisturizer with Vitamin F
reviews.review_text: I received this from Bzzagent for free for my honest review. This cream is amazing. It is so thick that a little goes along way, literally. The smell isn’t bad and it’s not heavily perfumy either. I love the little spatula, super good idea! The cream soaked right into my skin. I was surprised that I had not a singl breakout considering how thick the cream is and my skin didn’t look or feel oily hours later. My skin is so smooth. My makeup goes on easily with no caking. Overall, my skin looks and feels amazing.

reviews.product_name: The Dewy Skin Cream Plumping & Hydrating Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: Loved it. It’s not too heavy on my skin and it really hydrates the dry areas of my skin. It’s creamy and sinks into my skin nicely

reviews.product_name: The Rice Wash Skin-Softening Cleanser
reviews.review_text: I love it. It’s a thick consistency but it lathers nicely with a little bit of water. Does have a gritty texture which I don’t mind. The smells isn’t overpowering. It’s very easy to wash off and I’ve seen great changes in my skin since i started using. Definitely recommend

reviews.product_name: Mini Rice Wash Skin-Softening Cleanser
reviews.review_text: I love it. It’s a thick consistency but it lathers nicely with a little bit of water. Does have a gritty texture which I don’t mind. The smells isn’t overpowering. It’s very easy to wash off and I’ve seen great changes in my skin since i started using. Definitely recommend

reviews.product_name: Honey Halo Ultra-Hydrating Ceramide Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I love it so much and a little goes a long way. It’s so thick and creamy and sink into the skin so nicely. It doesn’t feel heavy on the skin which I really appreciate and the scent doesn’t bother me but if you really hate the scent of honey definitely avoid this product.

reviews.product_name: Ultimate Sun Protector Lotion SPF 50+ Sunscreen
reviews.review_text: This is definitely one of the best sunscreens I have tried. Smell is good and coverage was great. Used mostly while taking walks in the community. Definitely is worth having in the luggage bag for a vacation.

reviews.product_name: GOOPGLOW 15% Glycolic Acid Overnight Glow Peel
reviews.review_text: At first I was a little scared since it said it was a peel. While applying it it felt really refreshing and left My skin a bit sticky. I left it on my neck and all over my face over night and woke up with my skin looking hydrated and definitely softer looking. Definitely considering as one of my must haves.

reviews.product_name: Mini GOOPGLOW 15% Glycolic Acid Overnight Glow Peel
reviews.review_text: At first I was a little scared since it said it was a peel. While applying it it felt really refreshing and left My skin a bit sticky. I left it on my neck and all over my face over night and woke up with my skin looking hydrated and definitely softer looking. Definitely considering as one of my must haves.

reviews.product_name: Aqua Bomb Cleansing Balm
reviews.review_text: This was a great addition to my traveling bag. I usually use a liquid make up remover and was happily surprised with the results of using this balm. I was happily able to remove my mascara without my eyes burning and did not feel like my skin was super oily afterwards.

reviews.product_name: Green Clean Makeup Removing Cleansing Balm
reviews.review_text: Melts makeup off! Calming and hydrating! Love it

reviews.product_name: Green Clean Makeup Meltaway Cleansing Balm Limited Edition Jumbo
reviews.review_text: Melts makeup off! Calming and hydrating! Love it

reviews.product_name: D-Bronzi Anti-Pollution Bronzing Drops with Peptides
reviews.review_text: LOVE IT gives definition and glow to my face! A little bit of this and concealer and im good to go

reviews.product_name: Luna Sleeping Retinoid Night Oil
reviews.review_text: Got a sample of this awhile back and was blown away by it and finally made the purchase! LOVE IT keeps my skin looking young tight and awake. A permanent part of my routine now.

reviews.product_name: CC+ Cream Oil-Free Matte with SPF 40
reviews.review_text: I actually like this product more than the original it cosmetics cc cream because it’s way less greasy feeling. I deducted a star because it has less coverage than the other version. But I am happy to stay with this version over the other and just use some concealer for extra coverage if needed! I recommend this product.

reviews.product_name: The True Cream Aqua Bomb
reviews.review_text: I’ve been using this and the aqua bomb sleeping mask at night for 2 weeks and I’m a belif-er. I have extremely sensitive combination skin and most products either a) cause irritation or b) don’t work. This product works and feels so soothing on my skin. For the price, this is the best moisturizer I’ve ever used. I’m a fan! Try the mask too - works super well also!

reviews.product_name: Aqua Bomb Sleeping Mask
reviews.review_text: It’s a weird texture but it’s amazing!! I love that it dries and doesn’t get all over your pillow. It locks in all your serums and anti-aging products over night, and you can definitely tell.. In the morning I’m left with moisturized skin that isn’t greasy. I love this product!

reviews.product_name: Midnight Recovery Concentrate Moisturizing Face Oil
reviews.review_text: This product does exactly what it says! I usually use a few drop of this mixed with Marula oil and my face is completely rehydrated.  Love Kiehl’s

reviews.product_name: Midnight Recovery Concentrate Moisturizing Face Oil
reviews.review_text: This product does exactly what it says! I usually use a few drop of this mixed with Marula oil and my face is completely rehydrated.  Love Kiehl’s

reviews.product_name: Lippe Balm
reviews.review_text: Love this product and line! My lips feel completely refreshed every morning after I apply.

reviews.product_name: Glow Cycle Retin-ALT Power Serum
reviews.review_text: Between this and it’s matching night cream I’m addicted! My skin has started glowing and dark spots are fading.

reviews.product_name: Estee Lauder Advanced Night Repair Synchronized Multi-Recovery Complex Serum

reviews.review_text: Not what I expected out of this product! I received this product as a complimentary gift to review with little to no expectations. But I am actually very surprised and impressed with this serum. It may not have the best fragrance but the results after the 2nd use is astonishing! My skin looks and feels a lot tighter and the fine lines are less visible.

reviews.review_text: I received this moisturizer as a complimentary gift as part of the Influenster community and giving my honest review. The moisturizer does it job but doesn’t stand out compared to other moisturizers I’ve used. It does apply on nice and light with a soft water consistency which is unlike other thick moisturizers. So if you’re looking for something that is light but packed with hydration this maybe the product for you.

reviews.product_name: Double Serum Firming & Smoothing Anti-Aging Concentrate
reviews.review_text: I received this serum as a complimentary gift and started using it for a week. I completely fell in love with it. It gave my skin a nice glow and feeling super soft. The scent is also mesmerizing!

reviews.product_name: Smart Clinical Repair Wrinkle Correcting Eye Cream
reviews.review_text: Smart clinical repair wrinkle correcting eye cream is rich in texture but goes on smoothly. It makes the skin feel luxurious and well hydrated.

reviews.product_name: AHA 30% + BHA 2% Exfoliating Peeling Solution
reviews.review_text: I had doubts when I ordered this because of the less than positive reviews—I have sensitive skin and have used products in the past that have chemically burned my face, so obviously a peeling solution with a few bad reviews was questionable. HOWEVER i am incredibly surprised with this. My skin feels effin fab, pores look smaller, and it generally feels less oily.Two things to note: it says to let your face dry completely before using. When it mixes with water the pinprick-y sensation morphs to a full blown burn. You’ll feel it a little when you wash it off. So don’t put it on damp skin. Second, my skin does well with the Dr. Jart, Korres, and Dr. Brandt brands. Alternatively, I will break out in hives with Dr. Bronners peppermint bar soap and the Simple drugstore line of skin care burns my skin. I don’t know if this will help with your decision, but for me this peel is perfect.

reviews.product_name: C.E.O. 15% Vitamin C Brightening Serum
reviews.review_text: Bought a full-sized bottle of this, used it 1x/day until it was out, and saw zero results. It’s a non-greasy formula, feels great on your skin, but at this price point I won’t be repurchasing.

reviews.product_name: Salicylic Acid Acne Healing Dots
reviews.review_text: For hydrocolloid patches, these are pretty good—they’re not a miracle cure, and although I liked the addition of salicylic acid I’ll probably go back to Mighty Patch because if price. These are basically $1 for a <1cm diameter patch, and I honestly can’t say they work any better. Give them a try if you’re curious, I personally wasn’t blown away by the results, but as mentioned, they’re still high quality hydrocolloid patches with acne medication added.

reviews.product_name: Cold Plunge Pore Remedy Moisturizer with BHA/LHA
reviews.review_text: Can confirm the cooling/tingling/slight burning sensation. Tolerable unless applied to dry/raw skin. This has a kind of Jell-O pudding consistency and is a dream to apply; I don’t wear foundation but this is a good base for the Supergoop unseen sunscreen and matte screen. I haven’t been using it long enough to notice any drastic changes to my skins texture, but I have fewer clogged pores overall. Would recommend to anyone struggling to manage comedones.

reviews.product_name: Urban Environment Oil-Free Sunscreen Broad-Spectrum SPF 42
reviews.review_text: I am definitely impressed with this sunscreen as I have combination skin and I also sweat a lot in the summer.  I don’t usually wear sunscreen but I thought this one was fabulous even because it brings a bit of color.  I really recommend it, I loved it.

reviews.product_name: Urban Environment Fresh-Moisture Sunscreen Broad-Spectrum SPF 42
reviews.review_text: I really loved this sunscreen.  I have combination skin and to be honest I don’t usually use a lot of sunscreen because my face feels oilier but with this one I felt that it really leaves my face moisturized and not greasy at all.  It is worth buying and I highly recommend it.

reviews.product_name: Revitalizing Supreme+ Youth Power Creme Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I have combination skin and my skin loves this cream, I have been very impressed by the work it does, I was able to observe the changes it has made in my skin, more hydrated, it is easily absorbed, you do not need to use much product and it has lightened some spots that I had .  I definitely have to buy it.

reviews.product_name: Mini Revitalizing Supreme+ Youth Power Creme Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I have combination skin and my skin loves this cream, I have been very impressed by the work it does, I was able to observe the changes it has made in my skin, more hydrated, it is easily absorbed, you do not need to use much product and it has lightened some spots that I had .  I definitely have to buy it.

reviews.product_name: The Deep Cleanse Gentle Exfoliating Cleanser
reviews.review_text: I’ve read such good reviews on this product, but I just found it to be OK. I wish there was a bit more exfoliation provided by the cleanser. I did not find that my face felt really “cleansed“ after washing. Maybe that’s the hydration others are talking about, but I personally did not like the feeling. The packaging isn’t the best either... I keep mine upside down and shake it to come out, but I think I will still have some product I won’t be able to use that will be left behind. I have oily/combo skin and it’s been difficult to find something that works. For me, this product just didn’t do much. However, I find the moisturizer to provide “just enough“ hydration and I don’t feel like I have a rich moisturizer on.

reviews.product_name: Mini Deep Cleanse Gentle Exfoliating Cleanser

reviews.product_name: Green Clean Makeup Removing Cleansing Balm
reviews.review_text: I love this product. I use it to remove oil and makeup from the day, and find that it does a great job with my oily skin. Then, I cleanse with a foamy or gel cleanser to really do the job. It feels great on the skin and really melts everything away. The price is a little steep, but it really is a great product.

reviews.product_name: Green Clean Makeup Meltaway Cleansing Balm Limited Edition Jumbo
reviews.review_text: I love this product. I use it to remove oil and makeup from the day, and find that it does a great job with my oily skin. Then, I cleanse with a foamy or gel cleanser to really do the job. It feels great on the skin and really melts everything away. The price is a little steep, but it really is a great product.

reviews.product_name: Lip Glowy Balm
reviews.review_text: I LOVE the peach scent. I also found this product to be hydrating, especially when I put it on at night and woke up to soft, hydrated lips in the morning. However, if I put too much on, I found it a bit sticky. I took a star off for the price. But I did really enjoy it, and would likely buy in the future if I felt like splurging or treating myself (I’m fine with buying lip balms from the drug store).

reviews.product_name: Luminous Dewy Skin Mist
reviews.review_text: I really enjoyed this product. It gave my skin a nice, dewy look, which has been a struggle to get during this dry winter. I had set this product aside for some time because I didn’t really notice a difference in the summer while using it (skin gets oily quickly), but I’m glad I picked it up again. It did smudge my eye makeup some, and the price is a bit high for me, but it enjoyed using it when I wanted to add something extra to my look.

reviews.product_name: Estee Lauder Advanced Night Repair Synchronized Multi-Recovery Complex Serum
reviews.review_text: This product is A-Mazing! After one use I could feel my face more hydrated. After more use my skin tone was more even. My face felt plumper. Very easy to use, no sticky residue, no irration or ill affects. Loved how my face feels after using it!

reviews.product_name: Mini Advanced Night Repair Synchronized Multi-Recovery Complex
reviews.review_text: This product is A-Mazing! After one use I could feel my face more hydrated. After more use my skin tone was more even. My face felt plumper. Very easy to use, no sticky residue, no irration or ill affects. Loved how my face feels after using it!

reviews.product_name: Advanced Night Repair Synchronized Multi-Recovery Complex Duo
reviews.review_text: This product is A-Mazing! After one use I could feel my face more hydrated. After more use my skin tone was more even. My face felt plumper. Very easy to use, no sticky residue, no irration or ill affects. Loved how my face feels after using it!

reviews.product_name: Magic Cream Moisturizer with Hyaluronic Acid
reviews.review_text: I love the feel of this but my face is on the oily side. I find that if I use in the morning I feel dewy during the day. I use at night and don’t seem to have any issues.

reviews.product_name: Charlotte’s Magic Serum with Vitamin C
reviews.review_text: Fresh out the shower and had to show off one of my favorite new serums! Charlotte Tilbury knocked it out of the park with her Magic Serum Crystal Elixir! My skin soaks this right up without leaving a residue behind. I hate when my face feels tacky or sticky after applying something to it. This has a nice pleasant,almost herbal smell to it. Not very overpowering but very subtle. My face feels very hydrated after using. After a few days of use I feel it has definitely hydrated my face and has a nice glow to it. I did receive this for free to test and review.

reviews.product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C
reviews.review_text: I love the smell and emolient consistency of this product. it does help smooth cracked dry lips overnight especially around the winter time.

reviews.product_name: Lip Glowy Balm
reviews.review_text: my go-to daily lip moisturizer. I wish they make one with sunscreen for the summertime. this is very mild yet hydrating and does not have a chemical/petroleum jelly smell.

reviews.product_name: D-Bronzi Anti-Pollution Bronzing Drops with Peptides
reviews.review_text: I bought this to mix with a “clean“ facial sunscreen to overcome the white cast but mixing the sunscreen with this made my face very oily. I ditched the sunscreen but kept this because using this product over my moisturizer without the sunscreen made my face look bronzy (as it should). like I went somewhere tropical during quarantine. lol

reviews.product_name: Tonique Confort Re-Hydrating Comforting Toner with Acacia Honey
reviews.review_title: Perfect for sensitive skin and summer heat
reviews.review_text: I have combination skin but lately thanks to the summer heat my skin has been dry, It doesn’t help that I’m also inconsistent with my skin care. Lancôme came up with the perfect formula when they created this product, upon application it will feel cold against your skin and it’s a bit thick (comparable to goo but in a good way) compared to the other toners in the market. It’s refreshing on the skin and it doesn’t have that harsh alcohol-like smell other toners have, in fact it smells really good. It’s perfect for moisturizing sensitive skin like mine. I use this product twice a day and it leaves my skin hydrated the entire day. I would definitely recommend this product especially for the summer.I received this product complimentary in exchange for my honest opinion.

reviews.product_name: Hydra Zen Gel-Cream Oil-Free Moisturizer with Salicylic Acid
reviews.review_text: I have combination skin and I guess you can say my skin has been a little bit stressed out lately due to my lack of sleep. I apply this moisturizing cream gel in the morning after applying my toner, it is pleasantly light on my skin, its cool and calming and has a rose scent that isn’t over powering. If you dislike the smell of roses then this might be a problem for you. My skin looks rested and noticeably hydrated after a few minutes of application, it doesn’t leave my skin greasy in fact the product is easily absorbed. I would definitely recommend this product. I received this product complimentary in exchange for my honest review.

reviews.product_name: Glow Cycle Retin-ALT Power Serum
reviews.review_text: I generally have sensitive skin and I’ve used products in the past with retinol. Most of the products I’ve tried work but I always had to deal with the stinging and sun sensitivity especially since I love being outdoors. Ive been using this product for a week now and was pretty excited that they used a natural retinol alternative that is plant based called Bakuchiol, I’m happy to say that my skin didn’t have an allergic reaction to it and I didn’t feel any sting after application. The serum comes in a white medium sized bottle with a pump that can be locked (perfect size for your purse and the lock to avoid spillage), the product itself is purple and has a milky lemon smell to it (for the lack of a better description). You’ll notice an instant glow minutes after application that will look like you have oily skin but give it a few and it will settle in and make the glow look more natural. After a week of using it, I’ve noticed that my face is generally brighter and skin tone has definitely evened out. Some dark spots have lightened although I haven’t really noticed any changes in the fine lines and wrinkles since it’s only been a while and I don’t have any noticeable ones yet.The product feels slightly sticky on my skin and doesn’t necessarily moisturize it. I have yet to see improvements with my pores. I received this product complimentary in exchange for my honest opinion.

reviews.product_name: Advanced Génifique Radiance Boosting Face Serum
reviews.review_text: Great product! Love the easy application! Made skin feel soft and refreshed.

reviews.product_name: Ultra Facial Moisturizing Cream with Squalane
reviews.review_text: I absolutely LOVE this product! It leaves my skin feeling super hydrated and smooth all day.  I also enjoy that it is scentless.

reviews.product_name: Mini Ultra Facial Moisturizing Cream with Squalane
reviews.review_text: I absolutely LOVE this product! It leaves my skin feeling super hydrated and smooth all day.  I also enjoy that it is scentless.

reviews.product_name: Creamy Eye Treatment with Avocado
reviews.review_text: Great option for an under eye treatment with a cooling touch at the end.  Would definitely recommend it as part of a daily routine.

reviews.product_name: Smart Clinical Repair Wrinkle Correcting Eye Cream
reviews.review_text: i received a small sample size #freeproduct #tryitwithtopbox #topboxcircle for an honest review. I can’t give a full review but as a sample size it did leave my skin (eye area) feeling soft and not greasy. I have combination skin with some dry spots on my face. I did moisturize the dry areas without leaving the rest of my face oily. I has no scent and i do have very sensitive allergic prone skin and did not cause a reaction. It does soak in the skin really fast. I used it in evening after removing make up and in the morning after washing my face.

reviews.product_name: Smart Clinical Repair Wrinkle Correcting Cream
reviews.review_text: i received this #freeproduct from #tryitwithtopbox #topboxcircle for an honest review. I had enough of the sample to use 2 days  I did love the little bit i did get to try, but couldn’t say for long term how it will work with wrinkles or if your skin will be greasy after a few days. What i did notice with a small sample is it soaked up real fast and didn’t leave my skin feeling greasy or oily. I have combination skin and left my dry areas moisturized, I used it twice a day, morning and evening my skin did feel softer after use and i didn’t break out with my highly allergic skin.

reviews.product_name: Smart Clinical Repair Wrinkle Correcting Serum
reviews.review_title: Always loved Clinique for sensitive skin
reviews.review_text: i received this as #freeproduct from #topboxcircle #tryitforfreewithtopbox  for an honest review. I love how non scented this line is i used it morning and evening. Doesn’t leave my skin greasy or oily with zero breakouts. It absorbed fast and left my skin feeling smooth, i loved using this in the morning under my foundation moisturizer. Not sure about any wrinkle remover like my other reviews on the sample reviews, don’t have enough to vouch for this product but the sample did prove it doesn’t leave my skin oily or it doesn’t break out :)

reviews.product_name: Smart Clinical Repair Wrinkle Correcting Eye Cream
reviews.review_text: Aaahhh! I love this!!!! My skin looks amazing and so even! I don’t even notice the fine lines!

reviews.product_name: Smart Clinical Repair Wrinkle Correcting Cream
reviews.review_text: After trying the Smart Clinical Repair Sample, my skin feels soft, supple and nicely hydrated. I love how it feels!

reviews.product_name: Smart Clinical Repair Wrinkle Correcting Serum
reviews.review_text: This Wrinkle Correcting Cream is on point! It plumps up my fine lines so they just disappear!

reviews.product_name: Honeymoon Glow AHA Resurfacing Night Serum
reviews.review_title: Product is amazing. Packaging is not.
reviews.review_text: I love this product. It does exactly what it says it’s going to (rare these days). When applying it before bed, you will wake up the next morning with a GLOWING complexion. It has helped the texture of my skin immensely.That being said, you do not get much product for the price. In addition to that problem, the pump makes it nearly impossible to limit the amount of product you get at a time. While the packing is beautiful, it shoots out large quantities in a projectile fashion, making it difficult to control the amount you get as well as making it easy to waste some from it shooting out into the floor/sink etc.

reviews.product_name: Retinol Eye Stick
reviews.review_title: The only “eye product” I believe in
reviews.review_text: I’ve tried so many eye creams and serums that all claim to do what this product actually does. I’ve used this for about a month now and it is my new holy grail. My dark circles are lighter, texture is smoother and more moisturized, and the fine lines have actually improved. This is by no means a miracle product but I can actually tell a difference since using it which is more than I can say for any other eye product I have tried.

reviews.product_name: Squalane + Omega Repair Deep Hydration Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: Feels like it just sits on my skin. It does actually work and is somewhat moisturizing but feels heavy and sticky for hours after applying. I would say it’s similar to F.A.B’s most popular moisturizer so if you like that one you may like this. My favorites are Peter Thomas Roth Water Drench, Skinfix Barrier, and Murad nutrient-charged water gel. So if you also like those, this Biossance moisturizer may not be for you.

reviews.product_name: Water Drench Hyaluronic Acid Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: Holy grail for Miami, FL weather. I have combination skin but live in a very humid climate and this moisturizer sinks right in and doesn’t leave a thin tacky layer on my skin that I will inevitably just sweat off. I can feel my skin just drink it up. It doesn’t make me oily but it also calms dry patches and keeps them smooth.

reviews.product_name: Benefiance Wrinkle Smoothing Eye Cream
reviews.review_text: This eye cream is very hydrating. I’m using it preventatively. I dab a generous amount on. It’s thick and creamy, absorbs well, and leaves the skin around your eyes soft. This is my second bottle. I’ve tried other eye creams but this is one of my favorites.

reviews.product_name: T.L.C. Sukari Babyfacial AHA + BHA Mask
reviews.review_text: I used this once before the pump broke .. and now I cannot get the product out of the bottle :( The one time I used it, I did like it. Very disappointed with the bottle malfunction.

reviews.product_name: The True Cream Aqua Bomb
reviews.review_text: This feel so good on my skin! My skin is combination/oily, sensitive, and break-out prone. This has not broken me out. On the other hand, it feels very soothing and love the way my skin looks with this moisturizer.

reviews.product_name: CC+ Cream Oil-Free Matte with SPF 40
reviews.review_text: I have this CC cream in the oil-free and non-oil free formulas. I’ve purchased both multiple times. It’s my go-to for an every day quick clean looking face. It covers redness/discoloration really well and quickly. It’s not great for covering textures. If you want a truly full coverage, then use a foundation such as the Fenty Matte foundation, or pair this with a powder foundation on top. My skin is combination/oily and I am break-out prone. The shade “light” in the oil-free formula is a lot lighter than the shade “light” in the regular formula. I like to mix both formulas together, so that i don’t too dry or get shiny, but depends on the season too.

reviews.product_name: Protini Polypeptide Firming Refillable Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: A great moisturizer that has peptides in it which will prevent wrinkles in the long run. I love it.

reviews.product_name: B-Hydra Intensive Hydration Serum with Hyaluronic Acid
reviews.review_text: I love this! Doesn’t make me oily and is perfect for layering. If my skin feels oily, this is enough as a moisturizer; if my skin feels dryer than I add a couple of drops of the DE marula oil or the Fresh seaberry oil.

reviews.product_name: The True Cream Aqua Bomb
reviews.review_text: I used the true cream aqua bomb daily for a week. I really like how cool and refreshing it felt on my face. It does not have much of a scent which I prefer for face products. My skin became more hydrated over the week and looked more bright. A little bit of the toner goes a long way! #freesample

reviews.review_text: I have combination skin - dry and oily and I really liked this moisturizer. It is light weight and leaves my face feeling fresh and hydrated.

reviews.review_text: I just love this cream! I tried many moisturizers from Nivea to LaMer and I was looking for something  that will really  nourish  my skin without  leaving  it greasy. Confidence  in  a cream is just like that. Skin feels hydrated  right  after  you apply  it, cream doesn’t  leave  oily feeling.  I loved using  it after  long day in a sun. I felt like it really  calmed  down  my skin and made it very moisturized.

reviews.product_name: Cream Skin Toner & Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: If you want your skin to be silky smooth and well taken care of but don’t have the time for multiple steps that can take you all night or all day? Then look no further then laneige cream skin which is a toner and moisturizer in one. Simply wash your face with your favorite cleanser, then pour some cream skin into your hands, rub together and Pat into your face gently and feel the beauty arise! I LOVE it and I use mine every morning thank you to topbox circle and laneige for sending me this deluxe size sample to try and review.

reviews.product_name: The True Cream Moisturizing Bomb
reviews.review_text: I use this moisturizer at night following the belif youth serum and I fell in love with only the first use! It instantly left my skin looking and feeling plump and hydrated as can be! This is now my can’t live without product. My skin has been clear and radiant and ready for this dry winter! Highly recommend if you have dry, combo and even sensitive skin! It does have a light citrus scent but nothing overpowering or bothersome. Its the PERFECT moisturizer.

reviews.product_name: Double Serum Firming & Smoothing Anti-Aging Concentrate
reviews.review_text: I receive a 7 day sample pack from butterfly and I have been loving the last 7 days I’m not going to lie here. Its a double action serum that dispenses 2 powerful ingredient combinations that DID give me a stunning glow overall, smooth skin surface and did not bother my sense. I can’t say much for fine lines or wrinkles as it was only 7 days but I would purchase a full size as I love my 7 day sample.

reviews.product_name: Soy Hydrating Gentle Face Cleanser
reviews.review_text: I love this cleanser. I use it religiously in the winter. It’s perfect for getting all my makeup off without leaving my skin feeling stripped and tight. It is gentle and hydrating...all the things I want during the winter. For the summer, I need something a little more heavy duty so I’ll either add another cleanser in or use a cleaning balm in addition. It’s the perfect fuss free cleanser. I did receive this compliments of Influenster but the opinions are my own.

reviews.product_name: Sugar Strawberry Exfoliating Face Wash
reviews.review_text: I received this product complimentary from Influenster and it has quickly become a staple. It’s gentle yet really leaves my skin feeling fresh and smooth. reviews.product_name: Blue Tansy BHA and Enzyme Pore Refining Mask
reviews.review_text: This mask is a life changer when it comes to dull, clogged, and bumpy textured skin.  With just a single use of this mask my skin became resurfaced, smoother, and brighter.  I suffer from hormonal pimples and with the use of this mask those annoying pimples and blackheads vanish and are prevented form popping back up!!! Any uneven texture on checks and forehead disappear leaving skin sooo smooth. Mask doesn’t over-dry skin but leaves it clean, detoxified, and clear!  highly recommended for combination and oily skin types.

reviews.product_name: Lactic Acid 10% + HA 2% Exfoliating Serum
reviews.review_text: This saved my skin from bumpy texture and post acne scars. Just after a few nights of using, I already saw visible improvement. After trying many different products, this is definitely the most effective and you can’t beat the price!

reviews.review_text: I really like this charcoal mask, especially how mild scented it is! Easy to apply, easy to wash off (especially with face wash). I do think my skin is clearer as a result, especially my nose which was experiencing annoying breakouts. I plan to continue using it weekly! This product was complimentary for testing purposes! But my review is honest. :)

My skin looked more plump and glowy, I love it. I don’t really have wrinkles yet or fine lines so I cannot really comment on that aspect but I’ll definitely be testing the results of that on my mom ;)As always, with any exfoliating acid make sure to use sunscreen even if you are indoors.*I received this product complimentary from Sunday Riley in exchange for my honest review.

reviews.product_name: Confidence in a Cream Anti-Aging Hydrating Moisturizer

I really love the ingredients and would definitely recommend this cream.

And as an added plus the damask rose scent is a lovely subtle touch.The packaging is beautiful too!

reviews.review_text: I received this complimentary from Dermalogica. I like how gentle this exfoliater is! This is a unique powder solution. I don’t experience any stinging or irritation. I feel like for that reason I can use this consistently enough to see results and help my acne.

reviews.review_text: I’ve only used it for a for nights but my skin already feels amazing. It feels so much softer, smoother and healthier im general. I wish this had an spf in it so I could use it im the morning as well, but wotks great with my nightly routine for now.

reviews.product_name: Glow Cycle Retin-ALT Power Serum
reviews.review_text: I’ve been using this for about a month now and I admit i am beginning to see results. The fine lines around my eyes are less noticeable and my skin definitely appears brighter. The smell is a little strong and I can’t quite describe it but it fades after a few minutes. It’s not overpowering at all. I got it complimentary from Influenster in exchange for an honest review.

reviews.product_name: Ultimate Sun Protector Lotion SPF 50+ Sunscreen
reviews.review_text: I unfortunately received this free for testing purposes during a time when the weather hasn’t been great for going outside. I did get to test it a clue of times on rare sunny days and works as promised. You definitely do need to give it a good shake or it comes out very separated. It doesn’t have a strong sunblock type of smell which is nice but there is a faint scent. It does feel a little greasy on the skin but to me, most sunscreens do. I would recommend it if you’re willing to spend that much in sunscreen.

reviews.product_name: Water Drench Hyaluronic Acid Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I was previously using the Pink Watermelon Juice lotion for the summer but it was leaving me with more redness and itchiness than normal. A Sephora employee suggested, the fragrance in that was likely to be irritating my skin. I’ve got extremely sensitive skin that’s prone to redness. He suggested this cream and wow, I really love it. It’s practically weightless and hydrating, a little goes a long way and it’s the perfect moisturizer for summer. I get little patches of dry skin even in the summer time but with this, it’s been completely eliminated.

reviews.product_name: Cicapair Tiger Grass Cream
reviews.review_text: In the winter months, my sensitive, redness prone skin needs a lot of TLC and this cream fits the bill. It’s quite thick that it can feel a little difficult to spread it on your face but its quite hydrating. A little bit goes a long way. reviews.review_text: I really like this product and is is working well on my sensitive skin. I used the CEO vitamin c oil before this and like this cream better because I have more control over the product.  I do feel like it has evened out my skin tone and texture.

reviews.review_text: This is just ok.  I’ve been using it for a couple weeks and haven’t noticed much of a difference.  I also son’t feel that it’s very hydrating, so put a hydrating cream on top.  It also has to fully dry before any other products are put on top.

This stuff is fantastic. I’m surprised it only has a 4.8 review because Fresh’s serum is over a 5! Love it! If skin is a little damp before application, serums are said to absorb better into the skin. Thank you Fresh <3

I love it at night and wake up with an even complexion and perfectly hydrated. I even have been putting it on in the day or layering it. It’s all around fantastic and I love how glowy my skin looks.

reviews.product_name: Superberry Hydrate + Glow Dream Night Mask with Vitamin C
reviews.review_title: My new HOLY GRAIL  for dry skin
reviews.review_text: Lately, my skin has been horribly dry to the point of  flaking and no amount of serums and moisturizer seemed to help, it all absorbed too quickly and i still felt dry. The first night I used this mask I put on a layer around 8pm.. when I went to sleep at 11 I could still feel the rich texture of the mask sitting on my skin but slathered on another thin layer just in case. Holy moly. When I woke up my skin was GLOWING! I was Dewey and my face even looked plumped up, the best part- all the flaky skin was gone! My sling was beautifully hydrated and I could still feel the product on my skin but not in a greasy way. I layered my light makeup right over it and felt like a million bucks. I’ve been using it every other night for two weeks and have literally watch my dried out, flaky skin turn into plumped up and ultra hydrated even in this cold weather. Also, one layer is more than enough! I like the way the product does not immediately soak into the skin- makes for a true nighttime mask- it is so rich and luxurious and smells amazing. I’m recommending it to all my girls for this dry time of the year and for the rest as well- who doesn’t want to wake up glowing?

reviews.product_name: Smart Clinical Repair Wrinkle Correcting Eye Cream
reviews.review_title: Great for extra dry under eyes
reviews.review_text: I received this product for free in exchange for my honest opinion. For some unknown reason at first I thought this was meant to be used as a night cream only. So I substituted my normal night eye cream for Clinic’s for a week. My under eye area is very dry so the whipped thick consistency was so nice for me, the level of humectant and moisturizer is so high that I could still feel it on next morning. Don’t get me wrong it doesn’t feel heavy or greasy, but it left my under eyes smooth and moisturized. After I realized it was meant to be used even under make up I added it to my morning routine. I got to be honest, I was thinking worried it wouldn’t do great under concealer and makeup. I was happily surprised of how well it performs under even creamy concealer (tarte’s creamy shape tape) with minimal  to no creasing at all. I also tested it with Laura Mercier concealer and it had no creasing at all. I haven’t seen any PERMANENT wrinkle correcting benefits, yet. But I’m gonna keep using in the next months to see any improvements. Due to all the creaminess and humectants I would say it does have some good temporary wrinkle correction effect, though.

reviews.product_name: Santorini Grape Poreless Skin Cream
reviews.review_title: Perfect balance for combination skin types
reviews.review_text: I received this product for free in exchange for my honest opinion. My combination skin needs something extra on the T zone for oil control and pore minimizing. As a brand, I love almost every product I have try from Korres. When I saw this product I was hesitant about how much would it work because I have try so many others that just don’t work. But korres didn’t disappoint! It’s perfect for my skin because it controls the oil without drying it or causing flakes. It worked great under my make up and kept my T zone oil free longer than other products. It gives a healthy glow to the skin without marking it oily. It’s just the perfect balance for my combination skin. The ingredients list includes hyaluronic and salicylic acids which make so much sense in this product and for combination skin type. Hope you enjoy it as much as I do.

reviews.review_text: I received samples of this product for free in exchange for my honest opinion. This is one of my favorite serums! I have been using for over a year now and it gave my skin a natural healthy glow. I have used other serums that had little to no effect on my skin but this was the first one to actually do something for my skin. When I received the samples last month I already had been using mine for months and Already had my mind made up about it. The scent is absolutely delicious and I combine it for my morning routine with a moisturizer of the brand. This combination gives my skin the hydration, antioxidants and spf it needs and works great under my make up

reviews.product_name: Sugar Hydrating Lip Balm
reviews.review_text: Smelled all 3 in store and blood orange was my fav. Lime mint and watermelon both smell really great too so i’m gonna have to go back for those soon. Really nice and hydrating balm! Doesn’t leave much of a tint for me but works really well at keeping my lips soft and not dry

reviews.review_text: bought this mask back in the beginning of january when it launched and have used it every since night and at least once a day. it feels very luxurious and deeply hydrates my lips. I love that this formula is wax free as well because I feel that other lip masks with wax have felt nice but don’t hydrate my lips as effectively. I added photos so you can see how much i’ve gone through in the 2 and a half months I’ve had my lip mask. I usually apply at night and sometimes during the day as well. I can tell this mask is gonna last me a while and I am definitely going to repurchase when I run out

reviews.review_text: Hands down my favorite everyday cleanser. I get normal/dry on my forehead and more oily on my cheeks and this is perfect for me. It isn’t stripping or harsh at all. You need such a small amount with a little water and it turns into the most beautiful creamy texture. One of these is going to last a looong time. I use this after I do my first cleanse (my oil cleanse) and use this as my second cleanse for the night time and in the morning I use this cleanser. For my skin using this twice a day works perfectly. I know this product isn’t shower friendly so if you wash your face in the shower (like me) I use the deep cleanse from tatcha

It also completely absorbs without leaving a white appearance. Even when layering this with my moisturizer, makeup etc there isn’t any heavy feeling nor separation of my makeup on top of this sunscreen. It’s really worth the cost.

reviews.review_text: I’ve been using squalane oil on my skin for about 2 years now, so I was excited to receive this product to see if it was any better than the current oil I had already been using. This oil really made my skin feel soft, and it sunk in almost immediately so it didn’t leave an oily residue. I have mostly normal skin that can get dried out easily, so I’m not sure if this would be too much for oily skin or not, but it did leave my skin feeling hydrated without feeling oily. The only negative I can say about this is that it did unfortunately make me break out because of the rose scent, but I have super sensitive skin so I’m not going to blame the product for that. Ultimately I would recommend this to anyone that doesn’t have super sensitive skin that is looking for extra moisture!

reviews.review_text: I’ve been using a drugstore micellar water for years, so I was excited to receive this and compare a higher end product with a more affordable one. Ultimately, I don’t think this micellar water is worth the high price tag. It takes almost twice the amount of product as my drugstore one to remove the same amount of makeup, and even after after two cotton pads my face doesn’t feel clean. I think there are definitely better options for a fraction of the price and I will not be repurchasing after I finish the bottle.

reviews.product_name: T.L.C. Sukari Babyfacial AHA + BHA Mask
reviews.review_text: This came in a deluxe sample size in one of the Sephora Favorites boxes I purchased. This is a great product! You’ll definitely feel a bit of tingling when you first apply this, but it eventually subsides. Saw the difference in my complexion after just one use. My face was glowy and happy and bright the next morning!

reviews.product_name: Virgin Marula Luxury Face Oil
reviews.review_text: Gorgeous, GORGEOUS oil. If you’re looking for a good facial oil, this is it! Drunk Elephant’s Virgin Marula Luxury Facial Oil is very lightweight, hydrating, absorbs quickly, and does not leave your face looking greasy. Treat yo’self!

reviews.product_name: The True Cream Aqua Bomb
reviews.review_text: Great cream! I started to see changes since the first day I applied. I have hard days full of work and my kids and it is very hard to take care of my skin. At nights, I clean my face pretty good and I apply Belif and my skin feels like new, elastic, moisture and glowing. I love this product and I definitely recommend it!

reviews.product_name: Smart Clinical Repair Wrinkle Correcting Eye Cream
reviews.review_text: Great cream! I have been using it for a week and I can see how around my eyes have been Improving and my skin looks more moisture. I will definitely buy it again!

reviews.product_name: Santorini Grape Poreless Skin Cream
reviews.review_text: Great cream for improving pores and some breakdown that I had in my face. It is really good. I received this on an influenster campaign and definitely I am going to get it for my self. My skin looks radiant and moisture.

reviews.product_name: T.L.C. Framboos Glycolic Resurfacing Night Serum
reviews.review_text: I have purchased this over and over! I love this. I had texture issues and this completely fixed that! The only thing I don’t like about this product is that you can’t tell when you’re running low.

reviews.product_name: B-Hydra Intensive Hydration Serum with Hyaluronic Acid
reviews.review_text: I love this. I mix it with the DE Vitamin C serum every morning and it really does help moisturize.

reviews.product_name: Green Clean Makeup Removing Cleansing Balm
reviews.review_text: I love this! It does an amazing job at melting off all your makeup! I use this every night. The only thing I don’t like is the packaging because the little lid that holds the scoop can get gunky if you don’t rinse it every night.

reviews.product_name: Green Clean Makeup Meltaway Cleansing Balm Limited Edition Jumbo
reviews.review_text: I love this! It does an amazing job at melting off all your makeup! I use this every night. The only thing I don’t like is the packaging because the little lid that holds the scoop can get gunky if you don’t rinse it every night.

reviews.product_name: Microneedling Anti-Wrinkle Retinol Patches
reviews.review_text: Recently started my anti-aging skin care regime and this was a game changer in the journey. Loved the packaging and easy use instructions. Tried for a week near my eyes and mouth (on visible crows feet) and I am so impressed with the results! The lines look less deep and the creases look lighter for sure! Excited to continue using for some more time and see long lasting results!

reviews.product_name: Retinol Eye Stick
reviews.review_title: Handy to use and hydrates well!
reviews.review_text: Been using this religiously over a week now and results are comparable to my expensive banana eye cream. It makes my under eye skin area look smoother, brighter and more supple - this automatically reducing the visibility of fine lines. I have a combination skin thats typically dry on cheeks and under eye resulting in flakiness. This handy stick definitely helps with hydration without greasiness or heaviness. I like the ease of use and carrying around in purse with the stick style over my tub eye creams. I am excited to see what Retinol does for my fine lines and crows feet over prolonged use. Worth a try if you are keen on preventing aging and fine lines! Just be careful of tugging hard with the stick to release product as the under eye area is delicate.

reviews.product_name: Santorini Grape Poreless Skin Cream
reviews.review_text: Got this from influenster in exchange of my honest review! Have been using it for last 2 weeks and love its effect on my ageing skin - great for hydration and tightening pores. Using it religiously as part of my routine has improved the texture and healthy feel! Highly recommend!

reviews.product_name: Moisturizing Eye Bomb with Squalane
reviews.review_text: I just recently started using the Belif essence, and I’m in love with it. So, when I got the Belif eye bomb, I was pretty excited to try it out! The verdict? It’s amazing. I also use the Origins GinZeng Refreshing Eye Cream, but I have to say I like the eye bomb a lot better! First, it smells so good! I personally think it smells like a Lemonhead --- do they even make those anymore? -- so it has a nice light lemon scent that is super refreshing. Then, in terms of texture, it has a thick consistency, but not in a way that is too heavy as it disperses and absorbs really well into your skin after application. Plus, a little goes a long, long way! I’m excited to see the long-term effects on my skin, but as of now, it’s doing a spectacular job keeping my undereyes nice and hydrated throughout the day! I might even start reaching for this at night-time more often, too. A  product, in my opinion!

reviews.product_name: Glow Cycle Retin-ALT Power Serum
reviews.review_text: I’ve been using this serum for about a week in my morning skincare routine, and I’ve definitely noticed a difference in the brightness of my skin! I was also pleasantly surprised by the smell and color — it’s purple, how fun is that! I don’t know how to describe the smell, but it’s honestly such a nice scent that lingers and lifts my mood every time I catch a whiff. Two thumbs up! I received this complimentary to test out, but I would totally purchase it again after I run out!

reviews.product_name: Rose Deep Hydration Sleeping Mask
reviews.review_text: Before this mask, I had never had the opportunity to try out Fresh’s skincare products, but I had heard so many awesome things about the brand that I was extremely excited to try out this mask. I like keeping a relatively simple routine, so I love overnight masks for the convenience of throwing it on and forgetting about it. However, when I found out this was a two step product, I was a tad disappointed in an extra step. I have to say, despite my initial impression, I quite like this mask. It was sent to me for free for testing purposes, and my honest opinion on this product is that it does its job better than I had expected. For me, the affects are more subtle than other sleeping masks I’ve tried. The product doesn’t wash off slippery as other masks have for me, and I realized it’s because my skin is actually absorbing the product really well. After about a week of regular use, I’ve definitely noticed softer skin. The fact that it’s a two-step product is actually more convenient than I assumed. If you’re into a simple routine, ditch your other essences and moisturizers if they’re not working for you and replace it with this one product. A cleanser, a toner, and this sleeping mask duo is all you would need if you’re starting a brand new routine or if you want to simplify your current one. I’d definitely recommend trying this product!

reviews.product_name: Smart Clinical Repair Wrinkle Correcting Eye Cream
reviews.review_text: I received this #freeproduct as a sample which only allowed a couple of uses so can’t comment on the wrinkle reduction but I really liked this eye cream. It was thicker than the eye creams I have used before. It did not irritate my sensitive skin.

reviews.product_name: Smart Clinical Repair Wrinkle Correcting Cream
reviews.review_text: I received this #freeproduct from topbox. The sample wasn’t large enough to comment on wrinkle reduction but I used it every night for several days. My skin felt very moisturized and smooth after only a small amount. I have very sensitive skin and it did not cause any irritation. Really enjoyed the sample.

reviews.product_name: Smart Clinical Repair Wrinkle Correcting Serum
reviews.review_text: I received this #freeproduct from topbox. It was a small sample so I can’t comment on long term impacts but the serum felt nice on my skin. I have very sensitive skin and it did not cause any irritation.

reviews.product_name: ExfoliKate Glow Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I have combo/acne prone skin, with texture and dullness. This stuff is amazing for me! It makes my skin so soft and smooth. I love the citrusy scent as well, and while it is pretty oily, I think with all of the properties it provides, I really can’t complain.

reviews.product_name: Tonique Confort Re-Hydrating Comforting Toner with Acacia Honey
reviews.review_text: This is probably the best product I’ve used in some time. The first night that I used this, I felt a slight tingle. Over the course of a couple of days of use, I’ve noticed improvement in my skin. Nothing to write home about, but subtle differences. I have dehydrated skin and this in use with the gel moisturizer keeps my skin dewy and hydrated. Makeup applies better in conjunction with this too. I love it.

reviews.product_name: Hydra Zen Gel-Cream Oil-Free Moisturizer with Salicylic Acid
reviews.review_text: I have fallen in love with this moisturizer. I have extremely flakey/dry/dehydrated skin, and this is so hydrating and plumping. My skin seemed to clear up as well. I felt a slight tingle the first night I put this and the cleanser lotion on, so I knew it was doing something good.

reviews.product_name: Watermelon Glow Niacinamide Dew Drops
reviews.review_title: A little goes a long way
reviews.review_text: I received this Watermelon Glow Dew Drops complimentary from Glow Recipe. The product smells awesome, but be wary that a little goes a long way! I like to apply a small drop on each of my upper cheek bones as highlighter over my foundation. I love the long lasting dewy glow it gives me, plus there is no sticky residue. Will order again!

reviews.product_name: 5 Stars Retinol + Niacinamide Eye Serum
reviews.review_text: Have been using this eye serum for a week and so far so good! Super easy to apply and I haven’t felt any stinging or dryness while using it daily.  The texture is really nice, perfect addition to my before-bed routine.

reviews.product_name: GENIUS Liquid Collagen Serum
reviews.review_text: I love this collagen. It’s definitely pricey but makes my skin GLOW. It’s odorless, not sticky, and 1-2 pumps goes a very long way. I’m going to keep using it 1-2 a week so the bottle lasts longer, but absolutely love incorporating this into my routine.  This product was gifted by Algenist in return for my review.

reviews.product_name: GOOPGLOW Microderm Instant Glow Exfoliator
reviews.review_text: GoopGlow Microderm Instant Glow Exfoliator was gifted by Goop for my review. I have to say - I LOVE this product! The smell reminded me of the massage salon I frequent, so instantly I was relaxed. My face feels clean and after a trip to Iowa, my face was feeling rough from the high winds. It feels so smooth and soft. I’m definitely going to be using this product from now on!

reviews.product_name: Mini GOOPGLOW Microderm Instant Glow Exfoliator
reviews.review_text: GoopGlow Microderm Instant Glow Exfoliator was gifted by Goop for my review. I have to say - I LOVE this product! The smell reminded me of the massage salon I frequent, so instantly I was relaxed. My face feels clean and after a trip to Iowa, my face was feeling rough from the high winds. It feels so smooth and soft. I’m definitely going to be using this product from now on!

reviews.product_name: Daily Greens Oil-Free Gel Moisturizer with Moringa and Papaya
reviews.review_text: Farmacy gifted me Daily Greens Oil Free angel Moisturizer and it is the most amazing product! The smell reminds me of a spa, and the gel makes my skin feel fresh and clean. I would recommend this moisturizer to everyone!

reviews.product_name: Good Genes All-In-One AHA Lactic Acid Treatment
reviews.review_text: Good Genes was gifted to me by Sunday Riley and I just love it. The product has made my skin feel so smooth and hydrated. Along with smooth skin, my pores have gotten smaller, and fine ponds seem to have minimized. I would recommend this to anyone!

reviews.product_name: Protini Polypeptide Firming Refillable Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: What a wonderful cream my skin looks so plumped and moisturized when I use this and you can use it alone or mix it in with other creams to add an extra kick! Will deff be buying this item over and over!

reviews.product_name: Retinol Reform Treatment Serum
reviews.review_text: This is amazing! I have tried a lot of retinols, normally they cause me to peel and get red. NOT THIS ONE! This retinol gave results the first night I used it. The following morning my redness was greatly diminished, my pores were so small and my skin looked so smooth. I loved the Drunk elephant retinol the results were great but the side affects the peeling the sensitivity the redness it sucked. So this is just as strong with great results but no side affects or sensitivity. This is so worth the money!

reviews.product_name: Mini Retinol Reform
reviews.review_text: This is amazing! I have tried a lot of retinols, normally they cause me to peel and get red. NOT THIS ONE! This retinol gave results the first night I used it. The following morning my redness was greatly diminished, my pores were so small and my skin looked so smooth. I loved the Drunk elephant retinol the results were great but the side affects the peeling the sensitivity the redness it sucked. So this is just as strong with great results but no side affects or sensitivity. This is so worth the money!

reviews.product_name: Retinol Eye Stick
reviews.review_text: So good! I love it I have used a lot of eyes creams and this stick is awesome it’s super super hydrating it plumps and firms and you can’t beat the price!

reviews.product_name: Good Genes All-In-One AHA Lactic Acid Treatment
reviews.review_text: If you can still buy the old formula in your store, do it. This is a holy grail item for me that, after a day or two of minor breakouts, has completely changed my skin game. Hope Sunday Riley changes the formula back before my big bottle runs out! One pump goes far, though, and can cover my big face / neck.

reviews.product_name: D-Bronzi Anti-Pollution Bronzing Drops with Peptides
reviews.review_text: This is one of the best things I own regarding skincare. It works well with any moisturizer, serum, and even foundation. I’ve tried it on all of my friends who also enjoy the deep glow it produces. I will say it didn’t work well with my face oils but that doesn’t matter since I usually use it with moisturizer. You will not be sorry you bought this!

reviews.product_name: C-Tango Vitamin C Eye Cream
reviews.review_text: This was recommended to me by a store consultant. I haven’t really spent much time with eye cream beyond samples before buying this one. It’s pricey and isn’t the best eye cream I’ve tried but here’s some positives: the packaging is cute, it works well with makeup, and my eyes have reduced their aging / sallowness. It’s aight if money is no option.

reviews.product_name: Soy Hydrating Gentle Face Cleanser
reviews.review_text: I used the Soy Face Cleanser after I had taken my surface makeup off with a wipe. I made a mistake the first time I used it though. I squeezed out the “normal” amount I use for face wash and started applying it on my skin. I quickly realized I used WAY too much! I learned my lesson and have only been using a pea size amount since. My blunder just goes to show you how effective this cleanser is.The scent is also quite nice. It smells very fresh and clean, with a hint of cucumber, which I found to be very soothing. Although packaging doesn’t affect how effective the product is, I do appreciate the simple design, and easy to use squeeze bottle.As a side note…I love the fonts Fresh uses on their packaging! I can’t be the only one who loves a good font.Although it is a gel base, its super rich and a little does go a long way–so the value is great! After washing it off with water and patting my face dry with a towel, I noticed that not only did my skin feel clean, it felt soft. I have never used a cleanser that made my skin feel like I had already put my serums, moisturizers etc. on it. With other products I have found that my natural oils have been drawn out, which isn’t a huge deal breaker for me, as I put oils on my face anyway, but the Soy Face Cleanser preserved my skins structure, whilst cleaning out any impurities.*Gifted Product*

reviews.product_name: Sugar Strawberry Exfoliating Face Wash
reviews.review_text: The instructions say you can use this face wash DAILY, yes daily. As it claims to provide refinement, balance, and a brighter look to the skin. After using the Soy Face Cleanser, I followed the recommendation to finish with the Exfoliating Face Wash. It says to apply product to damp skin, and more water can be added to create a gentler scrub.One, it smells like the strawberry jam my mom used to make, and not that artificial sweetness, which anyone who isn’t living in the 90’s appreciates–glitter body rollers anyone?!The texture of this product is fantastic. It feels gentle on the skin, not rough at all. Like I mentioned, some exfoliators feel like its tearing at your skin, but as you use it, it melts away, leaving no residue. After washing it off, my skin felt soft, looked less dull, and got rid of any uneven texture.I must say, I am pleasantly surprised I like this product as much as I do. I haven’t been using it daily like it says, but I have found every other day is a great pick me up for my skin.*I received products as a gift*

reviews.product_name: Banana Bright 15% Vitamin C Serum
reviews.review_title: A new favourite in Vitamin C
reviews.review_text: I was sent this as a gift to review, but that never stops me from being honest!I’ve been using vitamin c for almost a year now, and have loved what it’s fine for my skin. Some brands I have liked more than others. With the Banana Bright the first thing I noticed was the texture, it’s more of a liquid serum, which is nice as I find vitamin c serums/creams tend to be kind of gritty and abrasive. This one was so smooth and easy to apply, and didn’t leave a texture behind on the skin.I have definitely noticed a difference in my skin—it’s much brighter, although I had hoped more of a change in the texture of my skin.

reviews.product_name: Pure Skin Face Cleanser
reviews.review_text: This is a decent cleanser that doesn’t leave my skin feeling red and patchy after using, and also clears my congested areas. My skin feels very soft after using this.

reviews.product_name: Facial Radiance Pads
reviews.review_text: It definitely does tone and refine my skin, but it leaves it super red and feeling a little tight. (Even after following up with essence and serum and First aid beauty’s new moisturizing collagen cream). Even so, I still love how beautiful my skin looks the morning after using these, so I’ve been using them once a week until I can find something that doesn’t irritate my skin as much.

reviews.product_name: The Dewy Serum Resurfacing and Plumping Treatment
reviews.review_text: This serum doesn’t really seem to do much for me in  the long term and makes my skin a little red. If I wear it my skin is plumped up a little, but it’s temporary. For the price, in my opinion, I feel I’m paying more for the name than the benefits it provides—and I usually love Tatcha products and don’t mind spending a little extra for something that works well for my skin. It just doesn’t wow me like the silk cream did, or even the vitamin c serum. Not bad, but not game changing.

reviews.product_name: Violet-C Brightening Serum 20% Vitamin C + 10% AHA
reviews.review_text: I’ve used this for about two months and I can see a difference in the texture and tone of my skin. My pores look smaller, my face looks firmer and I actually GLOW without needing makeup! It isn’t sticky, greasy, or smelly, and it doesn’t irritate my skin.

reviews.product_name: Vinopure Natural Salicylic Acid Pore Minimizing Serum
reviews.review_text: Love this product. I received it as a complimentary gift for testing purposes.  It smells fresh but does have a strong scent if you are sensitive to smells.  It also has a slightly sticky texture but surprisingly goes on smooth. After a week of use I noticed an improvement in my skin where redness and breakouts are common. I would definitely recommend this product!

reviews.product_name: Hydra Zen Glow Liquid Lightweight Moisturizer with Hyaluronic Acid
reviews.review_text: Love this product! My skin stays hydrated all day! It also leaves a nice healthy glow and makes my skin appear cleared.  It is a lightweight liquid moisturizer so this would be great in the summer for hot days!  The only thing is that it does leave a slight tacky feeling after application. No worry this goes away as the moisturizer soaks I go tour skin. At first I found it kind of odd but after using it a few days I’m starting to really like it!  It makes my makeup stay on better - almost like a 2 in 1 moisturizer and primer!

reviews.product_name: The True Cream Moisturizing Bomb
reviews.review_text: This moisturizer is amazing! It immediately relieved my dry skin and kept me moisturizer all day and night.  The cream feels very light weight and the scent is very calm and mild.  I would absolutely use this again!

reviews.product_name: Checks and Balances Frothy Face Wash
reviews.review_text: Checks and balances works so well. Makeup eye shadow, etc gone. As a bonus great for cleaning brushes. And it’s gentle   Plus you feel clean and smooth.

reviews.product_name: Aqua Bomb Sleeping Mask
reviews.review_title: Like a moist wonderful soft cloud on your face.
reviews.review_text: Like a whole soft wonderful moist mask descended on you. This feels decadent and it works. I put on 30 minutes prior to sleep. So it will soak into my skin. Girl this is wonderful.

reviews.product_name: The True Cream Aqua Bomb
reviews.review_text: Like a cool cloud of moisture on your face. Just great!

reviews.product_name: Creamy Eye Treatment with Avocado
reviews.review_text: I sampled this product first and I loved it. When I applied it I felt that it instantly did things to the appearance of my under eyes which no product has done before! I went and a few days later purchased the full size product (which does cost a bit but I see it lasting a very very long time- as a little goes a long way). It does a great job at keeping my eye area moisturizer and more supple and reducing the appearance of my under eye circles!

reviews.product_name: Lotus Anti-Aging Night Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: My go to night cream!! I wake with soft, hydrated and supple/bouncy looking skin when using this. Little goes a long way as well!

reviews.product_name: Vitamin C Suspension 23% + HA Spheres 2%
reviews.review_text: Actually noticed a difference in the darkness of my acne scars after a couple days using this! I was able to sneak this under my makeup too. Very metallic-y taste if you get it in or around your mouth.. but that can be overlooked given its wonderful concentration of vitamin C. Can’t go wrong with the price either!

reviews.product_name: Cicapair Tiger Grass Color Correcting Treatment SPF 30
reviews.review_text: I received this product for free as a promotion and it was absolutely amazing what a game changer for real the best products I have used!

reviews.product_name: Mini Cicapair Tiger Grass Color Correcting Treatment SPF 30
reviews.review_text: I received this product for free as a promotion and it was absolutely amazing what a game changer for real the best products I have used!

reviews.review_text: I received this product for free as a promotion and it was absolutely amazing what a game changer for real the best products I have used!
