reviews.product_name: Watermelon Pink Juice Oil-Free Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: Smells sooo yummy! Is extremely moisturizing!! I definitely would recommend this to anyone who experienced seasonal dryness.

reviews.product_name: Plum Plump Hyaluronic Acid Serum
reviews.review_text: I love this serum! It feels so good on the skin and makes the appearance of your skin smoother and brighter and plumper! The only down fall is the finish is kinda sticky.

reviews.product_name: Blueberry Bounce Gentle Cleanser
reviews.review_text: Wow! This melts off makeup amazingly! I would warn people to not use this around the eye area because it can burn the eyes or irritate them! But would recommend to people who are trying to get a nice clean after makeup!

reviews.product_name: Ultra Repair Cream Intense Hydration
reviews.review_title: Cleared my dry skin/eczema in 1-2 days
reviews.review_text: I’ve been struggling with dry skin and breakouts during the winter. I continued to get very small pimples on my cheeks and no moisturizer or acne cream helped. This cleared it up in 3 days and continually works every time I use it. I used to get eczema as a child- maybe that’s what this is. If you have exhausted other options definitely give this a try! There is a tingling sensation the first few times you use it- I have VERY sensitive skin and whatever in the formula that caused this didn’t aggravate my skin in any way.

reviews.product_name: The Rice Wash Skin-Softening Cleanser
reviews.review_text: I love this cleanser. I was hesitant because of the price vs size of bottle but a friend recommend it to me so I gave it a try. I have such dry skin and washing my skin with this (plus oils to moisturize after) left my skin more hydrated then it has been in a while. Plus a little goes a long way- it’s quite concentrated so you can use a little bit and just add water and it really lasts a while. I’ve tried many face washes and this has been the best so far!

reviews.product_name: Mini Rice Wash Skin-Softening Cleanser
reviews.review_text: I love this cleanser. I was hesitant because of the price vs size of bottle but a friend recommend it to me so I gave it a try. I have such dry skin and washing my skin with this (plus oils to moisturize after) left my skin more hydrated then it has been in a while. Plus a little goes a long way- it’s quite concentrated so you can use a little bit and just add water and it really lasts a while. I’ve tried many face washes and this has been the best so far!

reviews.product_name: Superberry Hydrate + Glow Dream Oil
reviews.review_text: Truly an amazing product. I struggled with skin for a long time and still so in the winter. Consistent use of this product in the AM/PM will give you beautiful results. I don’t even use moisturizer any more I only use this product to moisturize my face. It also looks beautiful when you mix a little with your foundation, rub together in your hands and apply to face and gives you a gorgeous glowy finish.

reviews.product_name: Clear Sunscreen Stick SPF 50+
reviews.review_title: Easy to use at home and on the go!
reviews.review_text: This sunscreen stick is perfect for throwing in your purse to reapply sunscreen throughout the day. It truly is clear when applied. I’d highly suggest this product to anyone who needs a good sunscreen that’s easy for on the go reapplication.

reviews.product_name: Ultimate Sun Protector Lotion SPF 50+ Sunscreen
reviews.review_text: I absolutely love this sunscreen. It smells nice and absorbs into the skin nicely. My only complaints are that my skin tended to look oily after a while and the price. It didnt leave a white cast though and I’m super excited to use this over the summer!

reviews.product_name: Santorini Grape Poreless Skin Cream
reviews.review_text: I received this product complimentary from Influenster in exchange for an honest review. I love this moisturizer. I love the combination of hyaluronic acid and salicylic acid. As an acne-prone person, it’s hard to find products that dont make your acne worse while hydrating your skin at the same time.

reviews.product_name: Tea Elixir Niacinamide & Hyaluronic Acid Anti-Aging Serum
reviews.review_text: Loved the way this product interacted with my skin.  I’ve noticed recently my face has felt less supple than when I was younger, and wasn’t sure the best products to use to help with it. I’ve been applying this one day and night, and it really has made a difference already! My skin has felt much firmer

reviews.product_name: Mini Daily Microfoliant Exfoliator
reviews.review_text: I really liked that this product came in powder form! I hadn’t tried something like that before and it stands out to me as unique. It worked great for my skin, it wasn’t too harsh (I often have troubles with products irritating my skin), and seemed to make my skin feel and appear smoother. Gifted by dermalogica sampling.

reviews.product_name: Daily Microfoliant Exfoliator
reviews.review_text: I really liked that this product came in powder form! I hadn’t tried something like that before and it stands out to me as unique. It worked great for my skin, it wasn’t too harsh (I often have troubles with products irritating my skin), and seemed to make my skin feel and appear smoother. Gifted by dermalogica sampling.

reviews.product_name: Vitamin Enriched Face Base Priming Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: This is a holy grail for me! One of the biggest things in my makeup routine that’s been hard for me to get right is my base. It always seems to be not moisturizing enough or too oily, causing my makeup to separate. This product soaked deep into my skin and left it feeling wonderfully prepped and moisturized, allowing makeup to go on smoothly.

reviews.product_name: Moisture Surge 100H Auto-Replenishing Hydrator Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I hate the cold, but I live in Northeast US and need year-round moisturizers, especially in the harsh winter. My skin has been going through rough times with wearing a mask for work, the heater always on at home, and makeup. This feels and smells so nice! Loved it!

reviews.product_name: Revitalizing Supreme+ Youth Power Creme Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: This is a great cream! I live on the east coast and the harsh winter means I always need to moisturize. My face instantly felt smoother and brighter from this! The light scent is nice and the cream applies easily and smoothly. I would recommend this!

reviews.product_name: Mini Revitalizing Supreme+ Youth Power Creme Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: This is a great cream! I live on the east coast and the harsh winter means I always need to moisturize. My face instantly felt smoother and brighter from this! The light scent is nice and the cream applies easily and smoothly. I would recommend this!

reviews.review_text: This is the best eye cream I’ve tried in awhile. It’s super soft and silky and dries down extremely well. It tightens and firms as well!

reviews.review_text: Really enjoyed this serum! I received this for testing purposes and was really impressed by how it made my skin look and feel. reviews.review_text: The people deserve this in a chapstick or lipgloss. I LOVE the subtle light pink color it gives my lips so much. Please consider making this color/texture in another formula!

reviews.product_name: T.L.C. Sukari Babyfacial AHA + BHA Mask
reviews.review_text: This product has definitely become a staple in my skin care line-up. I typically use it once a week (normally on Sunday night), leave it on for 20 minutes and make sure not to use any additional harsh products on my face afterwards (my skin freaks out if I over do it). The following day my skin is smooth, bright, glowing and happy! It does burn a bit for the first few minutes but nothing too harsh. I would definitely sample before purchasing but truly recommend this product!

I have a feeling this will be a new staple in my skincare routine.

reviews.product_name: Papaya Sorbet Smoothing Enzyme Cleansing Balm & Makeup Remover
reviews.review_text: This was my first experience using a cleansing balm, and I have to say I am extremely impressed. This is an excellent choice for people who have normal to dry skin like me as this balm is rich and occlusive without being heavy (combo and oily skinned people should check out Herbivore’s new Pink Cloud Jelly Cleanser). This balm is extremely effective at breaking down face and eye makeup, and there is no greasy or oily residue left behind. As with most cleansing balms, it’s usually recommended to follow up with a gentle cleanser to remove any excess makeup/dirt/sweat, but my skin feels very fresh after using just this product. The only product I’d day it doesn’t remove 100% effectively on its own is waterproof mascara, but it’s not hard to follow up with another cheap product to remove any excess on your lashes. Overall, very impressed with the product - I like the product performance, subtle scent, and think it’s reasonably priced for how much you get and how little you have to use. Would definitely recommend giving it a go.

reviews.product_name: 100% Organic Cold-Pressed Rose Hip Seed Oil
reviews.review_text: Great hydrating oil that can’t be beat for the price. I switched over from TO’s plant squalane oil just to see, and I think I like this better for my normal to dry skin. I can actually feel this soaking into my skin and giving it much needed moisture, especially when I layer it over my night cream. If you have oily skin, you may not like the feel of this - it’s not heavy or sticky, but it will sit on your face for a bit. Also, if you don’t like the smell of roses, you probably won’t like this (surprise, it’s rose hip seed oil!). I don’t mind the smell, it smells faintly of rose or floral tea, and doesn’t linger on the skin. Give it a go!

reviews.product_name: Honey Halo Ultra-Hydrating Ceramide Moisturizer
reviews.review_title: A bit pricey, but worth the splurge
reviews.review_text: I have normal to dry skin, and this moisturizer works quite nicely as a night cream. I’ve tried the Milk Vegan Moisturizer and a couple other thicker moisturizers, and this is by far my favorite: as others have said, it looks and feels thick initially, but doesn’t feel heavy or greasy once it goes on, just nourishing. I find it works especially well when I layer a face oil over it for added moisture. The only reason I knocked a star off is for the price - it’s not that unreasonable given the ingredients and performance, just hard to continously repurchase if you’re on a budget. Still worth it though!

reviews.product_name: Ultra Repair Cream Intense Hydration
reviews.review_title: Careful if you have dry sensitive/eczema prone ski
reviews.review_text: I have combo/dry sensitive skin with occasional perioral dermatitis. I wanted something thicker than lotion so I tried this. After I wash my face, I use HA serum then this cream. If you don’t have inflamed skin/open wounds on your face, this is a great moisturizer but since I have the condition around my mouth, this stings for several seconds. I ended up using this everywhere else on my face since I don’t have that reaction elsewhere. Another thing is that I didn’t find this as moisturizing alone and often find myself layering another layer of cream on top. If you have a skintype like mine, I’d suggest just using a cheaper moisturizing cream mixed with a couple drops of non-comedogenic hydrating oil. This is still a good product as it was more moisturizing than my previous lotion. I’d buy again when my eczema is tamed and my skin isn’t as dry.

I received it when my baby was a month old and I was so excited to try it out as my under bags were getting ridiculous. It kept my skin bright and looking refreshed even after the long sleepless nights with a newborn. Would recommend to anyone looking to add vitamin C to their routine.

reviews.product_name: The Water Cream Oil-Free Pore Minimizing Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I’ve struggled with acne and oily skin most of my life, but as my skin is changing into being more combination skin (yay aging), I’ve been on a quest for the perfect moisturizer. This one is my favorite so far! I really did not want to love this because of the price tag, but I do. I’ve been doing month-long trials of different moisturizers, ranging from the basics you can get at any store, to more expensive ones like this. This water cream is wonderfully light, soaks into your skin very quickly, doesn’t leave a greasy shine, but really does hydrate your skin. Best of all, it’s not making me break out! It also just seems to make my skin look really good. I’ve noticed a difference since I started using this. My pores look smaller, and my skin’s texture seems like it is improving (my skin has lots of acne scarring). After months of trials, this is the winner for me. It’s worth every penny.

reviews.product_name: The Deep Cleanse Gentle Exfoliating Cleanser
reviews.review_text: I absolutely love this cleanser. I struggle with acne, and combination skin. This cleanser combined with Tatcha’s Water Cream make my pores disappear and has helped with my annoying adult acne a ton. This is my new go-to face wash!

reviews.product_name: Mini Deep Cleanse Gentle Exfoliating Cleanser
reviews.review_text: I absolutely love this cleanser. I struggle with acne, and combination skin. This cleanser combined with Tatcha’s Water Cream make my pores disappear and has helped with my annoying adult acne a ton. This is my new go-to face wash!

reviews.product_name: Vinopure Natural Salicylic Acid Pore Minimizing Serum
reviews.review_text: I am new to using serums, but I’m already in love with this one. This serum is fantastic. I use it in combination with Caudalie’s toner from the same line, and they work really nicely. I’m nearing 30 and still have combination/oily, acne-prone skin, including hormonal acne which is always so tough to get rid of. Not only does this serum greatly speed up the time it takes for me to get rid of existing acne, but I have also noticed a significant decline in the amount of hormonal acne I’ve gotten over the past couple months. I use it in the morning and at night (as recommended) and it’s doing wonders for my skin. I will definitely continue purchasing this one. It’s worth every penny.

reviews.product_name: Santorini Grape Poreless Skin Cream
reviews.review_text: I have very large pores and was pleasantly surprised by this product this was given to me as a sample from influencer. I went out and bought the product since and it really does blare out the blemishes on your face and my pores look so much smaller the only thing I would say that I would change is I feel it’s a little sticky with application overall this is a great product if you are looking to smooth and balance your skin

reviews.product_name: Urban Environment Oil-Free Sunscreen Broad-Spectrum SPF 42
reviews.review_text: Oily skin game changer!! I’ve used SPF for many years in this stuff has really made me a believer it’s soaks up the oil in my skin and leaves my skin feeling moisturized and dry without a terrible shine. With most spfs you have white streaking as you’re applying it and almost looks sticking and stays there like a residue I had a makeup on top of this and literally could not tell the difference it wore so well. The only downfall is I feel is a little sticky but it does dissipate after a bit.

reviews.product_name: Urban Environment Fresh-Moisture Sunscreen Broad-Spectrum SPF 42
reviews.review_text: This moisturizer is game changer I am a real sub when it comes to SPS because they leave white streaky residue on your skin. Tend to not moisturize and don’t always have the best smell this one is a game changer. I hope they continue to keep this on the market because it wears so well under my makeup or if I am just doing a natural look. I highly recommend this for someone with combination of oily skin and left my skin looking fresh flawless and rejuvenated

reviews.product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C
reviews.review_text: I’m about halfway through my first pot of this lip mask. I bought it without really reading reviews because I needed something overnight for my dry lips. I instantly loved it. It doesn’t feel very sticky going on, huge plus. I thought it would wear off by morning, but I still noticed a very light layer when I woke up. Through the daily sun

reviews.product_name: Lactic Acid 10% + HA 2% Exfoliating Serum
reviews.review_text: I’m on my third bottle and I love it. I use it at night immediately after washing my face. I don’t have sensitive skin, so I have no problem applying it directly to my face. It’s a thin solution, but I let it fully absorb before applying moisturizer. It’s diminished any (small) acne scars and significantly smoothed my skin out overall. I also notice fewer hormonal breakouts, though I can’t be sure it’s from this product. Highly recommend.

reviews.product_name: Squalane + Marine Algae Firming & Lifting Eye Cream
reviews.review_text: I’m only three days into using this and I love it. I had been using the Ole Henriksen Banana Bright and it was okay. I bought based on a recommendation and I couldn’t be happier. It’s moisturizing and works well under my concealer, something the OH did not do. It isn’t heavy or oily and absorbs really nicely. Also to note: I have sensitive eyes and this doesn’t bother them one bit. A little goes a long way so I imagine this will last me quite some time. Highly recommend.

reviews.product_name: PHAT Glow Facial Mask
reviews.review_text: I’ve been really big into skincare lately due to getting older. I generally like majority of products from this brand. I was extremely excited to receive this product complementary for testing purposes! :) This product is pretty unique in the fact of it changes colors when massaging in. It feels like a thick shaving cream almost. My skin after using this was really smooth, had a healthy glow & pores looked shrunk (just like all the claims for the product are ;) ) One last tip— make sure to wash this off really well, otherwise it’ll leave a sticky residue. I’m def going to keep using this

reviews.product_name: Jet Lag Mask
reviews.review_text: I received this product in one of my VoxBoxes from Influenster BUT I already had bought this product w| my own money months prior. It can be used as a mask but I’ve never used it that way.. I use it as a regular/heavy moisturizer and/or eye cream.. As my skin gets realllly dry in winter or if I get bad sunburn in summer.. It doesn’t irritate. It doesn’t leave a sticky residue. It leaves the skin feeling hydrated + a nice glow!

reviews.product_name: Banana Bright 15% Vitamin C Serum
reviews.review_text: I 80% use all of Ole Henriksen skincare. This was the ONE item I didn’t buy during their sale— so I was EXTREMELY happy to receive this for testing purposes. I use it AM & PM, after my toner, before my moisturizer. I can absolutely see a difference in my skin. It looks more glowy, more smooth, feels more hydrated, etcetc. The added oils/fragrance doesn’t irritate my skin. I would def recommend this product to try!

reviews.product_name: Charlotte’s Magic Serum with Vitamin C
reviews.review_text: I’ve used this once so far but will def finish the bottle. Not sure if I’d repurchase due to the hefty price tag + having a ton of other skincare to use. I used it it combo with an essence + moisturizer. It smelled natural. It didn’t irritate my skin. It gave a really pretty glow. Worked well in combo w| other skincare + makeup. I love most things from this brand so was absolutely excited to recieve

reviews.product_name: Aqua Bomb Brightening Vitamin C Cream
reviews.review_text: I’ve used this brand before, and was happy to receive some new products to try. I’ve used this once so far, and so far, I can’t say anything bad about it. I used it as the last step in my morning routine. I loved the texture of it; felt smooth on the skin. It felt & kept my face very moisturized.

reviews.product_name: The Silk Peony Melting Eye Cream
reviews.review_text: The packaging and design of Tatcha, it never fails to disappoint! When I learned about this new eye cream I was pretty excited to try it. The skin around my eyes area is really sensitive so when it comes to choosing eye creams I’m really picky. I gave this eye cream a try and it is working wonders so far. It is hydrating and lightweight. I wear it to sleep every night and my under eyes feels a lot softer. Not quite sure if this blurs fine lines as mentioned since I don’t have much around my eye area. I received this product for complimentary testing purposes.

reviews.product_name: Squalane + Vitamin C Rose Firming Oil
reviews.review_text: This oil have a slight rose smell which is not too overwhelming. I was expecting the oil to be heavier and  meant for nighttime use but surprisingly it feels so light and soft on skin. I have not noticed my skin being brighter yet but it definitely feels more moisturized and soft.

reviews.product_name: Aqua Bomb Overnight Lip Mask
reviews.review_text: I usually have pretty dry lips and hate putting on lip products. Putting this at night before bed works wonders. I wake up with softer lips and not having to apply any in the daytime. It might be a little heavy for daytime use unless you have super dry lips but for nighttime this is perfect.

reviews.product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C
reviews.review_text: Honestly, this product lives up to its hype!! What I love is that it super infuses your lips with moisture without the intense peeling you get from other moisture products. The smell is amazing, not really a flavor to it which I don’t mind. Most shiny and perfect lip mask I’ve ever had!

reviews.product_name: AHA 30% + BHA 2% Exfoliating Peeling Solution
reviews.review_text: I’m surprisingly impressed by this chemical mask. I will lead with saying that I use retin-a so everything sinks into my skin immediately and hat could be why this works as well as it does. It has a slight burn and friends that I’ve shared this with have said the same so my consensus it that it works for everyone! This leaves my face with such a perfect natural shine and really allows other products to penetrate the skin.

reviews.product_name: Facial Radiance Pads
reviews.review_text: These are a super toner for your face. Normally I try to test a product for roughly 30 days before posting a review but I noticed immediate results from these. Their formulation is absolutely perfect. As someone who has used many toners, I love toners that come in the pad form because they are always very saturated and you’re not wasting product by putting it into cotton pads or trying to just apply it with your fingers.

reviews.product_name: Caffeine 5% + EGCG Depuffing Eye Serum
reviews.review_text: This is just okay. It was only $7 so I didn’t really expect it to work, however, a lot of other items work from this brand and they’re also not terribly expensive. It has a good texture and no weird scent by any means. I used it night and say since receiving it and not a difference in the slightest. I have used it under makeup which people have complained about and i actually didn’t notice any weird pooling as they had mentioned. My under eyes concealer of choice is the Tarte Shape Tape. Not the worst, not the best.

reviews.product_name: The Deep Cleanse Gentle Exfoliating Cleanser
reviews.review_text: I love the cleanser. Light, great for sensitive skin. However, the packaging is awful. And it’s not a lot of product for the price.

reviews.product_name: Retinol Anti-Aging Serum
reviews.review_text: I’m 30 with sensitive skin, I use this every night. This serum is affordable and actually works!

reviews.product_name: Umbra Sheer Physical Daily Defense SPF 30
reviews.review_text: My pick after trying a few different ones. Not my end all be all but pretty good and would buy again. I’m fair skinned, acne prone and dry and this works pretty well. I don’t find it as oily as some others I have tried but it does offer some moisture. Sometimes too much as it breaks up on my skin a bit.

reviews.product_name: Luna Sleeping Retinoid Night Oil
reviews.review_text: This saved my skin. I was starting to get adult acne especially around the chin and neck. I think this product had the biggest impact on nearly completely clearing that up. I have pretty sensitive skin and it did not experience any issues with this product. I appreciated that I could find a smaller bottle first which I did. This also lasted quite a long time. I don’t even use it that often and still noticed a difference. I use an acid as well so I do not like to use them on the same night. One Night I do an acid, the next night nothing just moisturizer, next night Luna, next night just moisturizer, next night acid etc.

reviews.product_name: Lippe Balm
reviews.review_text: I actually quite like this product. I feel like it has diminished the fine lines on my lips to a degree. I was questionable about the large size but I have learned how to maneuver it. However, I do find it very expensive for the amount of product you get and it is not super moisturizing. I personally use it as a barrier when I’m doing my skin care to not get retinol near my lips and then before I go to bed I apply a more occlusive lip care product. I would re-purchase but I would like to see the price reduced.

reviews.product_name: Rose & Hyaluronic Acid Deep Hydration Toner
reviews.review_text: I have tried so many toners from drugstore to high-end ones. My fav from drugstore is Thayers. I have gone through 2 bottles, it still works good for my skin. But since my skin starts breaking out. Thayers seems like doesn’t hydrate my skin enough when I use it along with acne treatment. So, I decided to give this Fresh Rose deep hydration toner a try and I’m glad I did. It is very refreshing, it smells amazing. When I use acne treatment I tend to use less layers of skincare. I only do toner-> acne treatment-> booster. I don’t even use moisturizer and this toner works like   one for my skin. Definitely recommended. But careful, some skin types might be reacted with ROSES!! (I have 1 friend like that)

reviews.product_name: Green Clean Makeup Removing Cleansing Balm
reviews.review_text: It’s my 2nd bottle! I just love the scent so much that I have tried so many other cleansing balm, but still go back to this one! Just take your time to massage it on the face, makeup will melt down and leave your skin soft as baby butt ;)

reviews.review_text: I just love it! my skin looks so glowy, I use it 3 days a week

reviews.review_text: Its not for everybody. If your not a skincare junkie then its not for you. The ordinary products are great and each product targets different things. Not all at once. On the website, there’s an extensive info on how to incorporate this product into your beauth regime and what other chemicals may not work. Overall, i highly reccommend!

reviews.product_name: AHA 30% + BHA 2% Exfoliating Peeling Solution
reviews.review_text: This worked so great for me. I do not need to spend $80 for a facial anymore. I did go over 10mins and it made my skin really red and just.. don’t do it. Please make sure you wash it off after 10 mins. It helped with acne scars a lot. I couldn’t recommend this enough if you are obsessed with skincare and you know your facial acids.

reviews.product_name: The Kissu Lip Mask
reviews.review_text: I’ve tried laneige lip mask and other brands as well. I don’t understand why people would use this during day time? Because lip mask tends to be very sticky. It’s a lip mask.. you it leave overnight. Anyways, very hydrating and while it doesn’t remove chapped skin. It’s not plumping, it just hydrates. Would not re-purchased because of the cost and there are other brands that are better.

reviews.product_name: Glow2OH Dark Spot Toner
reviews.review_text: This toner does exactly what it says. I had some hyperpigmentation that was resistant, even to prescription creams. But this toner really made a difference. I saw more fading in two weeks than I had in months of prescribed creams.

reviews.product_name: Barrier+ Triple Lipid-Peptide Face Cream
reviews.review_text: This is your winter moisturizer. Dry, thirsty skin no more with Skinfix on your counter. It hydrates without feeling greasy and absorbs into the skin well. All that forced air indoors and extreme weather used to cause flakiness that I had to counter with cortisone. I’m glad that I now have a steroid free alternative.

reviews.product_name: Mini Barrier+ Triple Lipid-Peptide Face Cream
reviews.review_text: This is your winter moisturizer. Dry, thirsty skin no more with Skinfix on your counter. It hydrates without feeling greasy and absorbs into the skin well. reviews.product_name: Skinlongevity Long Life Herb Anti-Aging Face Serum
reviews.review_text: I got this as a sample from a Sephora Favourites box. I threw it on one night not expecting much more than a layer of moisture. However, the next day I was in for a surprise. It was just a regular morning for me which consists of dragging myself into my bathroom and getting ready for the day in my usual lackluster fashion. But the image that greeted me in the mirror was different that morning. All dullness had been removed from my face, leaving a brightened, hydrated, nourished visage in its place. This is now my 2nd Holy Grail. Get some any way you can….

reviews.product_name: Pure Skin Face Cleanser
reviews.review_text: Great gentle cleanser for combo or normal skin. Love it! Doesnt perform any miracles but it is definetly great for everyday.

reviews.review_text: I like the packaging of this product! I do wish there were more in it though. It isn’t as harsh on my skin like the charcoal ones or those classic white ones. Awesome quality!

reviews.product_name: Microneedling Anti-Wrinkle Retinol Patches
reviews.review_text: I really like this product! It’s so simple to use and very comfortable.  I out it on when I’m going to go sleep. I’m starting to see fine lines on my forehead so I’m looking forward to those  disappearing soon!

reviews.product_name: Retinol Eye Stick
reviews.review_title: Easy to use. Love the stick form!
reviews.review_text: it glides on so easy! I love that it’s in stick form! Definitely going to use this every night. It’s so much better than applying cream. It’s not messy at all!

reviews.product_name: Rose & Hyaluronic Acid Deep Hydration Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: The New Rose & Hyaluronic Acid Deep Hydration Moisturizer was gifted by Fresh and honestly its a lot of freshness, bulgarian roses and hydration in jar! My skin loves it, I use it both AM & PM and I am such a fan of the texture. Non-oily, yet hydrating, what more does one need!

reviews.product_name: 5 Stars Retinol + Niacinamide Eye Serum
reviews.review_title: 5 stars for this 5 star eye serum!
reviews.review_text: I’ve been looking for an effective eye serum and looks like I finally found a favorite! The 5 Stars eye serum is made of five key ingredients that are the perfect blend for a smooth and healthy under eye treatment. I love the non-sticky texture and I could see the results in literally two weeks. Totally recommend buying this one!

reviews.product_name: Sugar Lip Balm Hydrating Treatment
reviews.review_text: Fresh’s lip balms have always been a favorite, and especially the tinted ones! Fresh gifted me their SLT Plum and it is the most nourishing and hydrating lip balm, I carry it with me everywhere. It has an awesome buildable color and texture which I absolutely love!

reviews.product_name: The Water Cream Oil-Free Pore Minimizing Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I love how light this is and how it glides onto my skin. Absolutely incredible and unlike anything else. I’ll never go without.

reviews.product_name: Mini The Water Cream
reviews.review_text: I love how light this is and how it glides onto my skin. Absolutely incredible and unlike anything else. I’ll never go without.

reviews.review_text: Leaves my skin soft and clean. I love it and will continue purchasing.

reviews.review_text: GAME CHANGER. I love the way this makes my skin feel and look. If they stopped making it, I would cry.

reviews.product_name: Mini Superberry Hydrate + Glow Dream Mask
reviews.review_text: GAME CHANGER. I love the way this makes my skin feel and look. If they stopped making it, I would cry.

reviews.product_name: Blueberry Bounce Gentle Cleanser
reviews.review_text: I really wanted to like this. I love the way it smells, but every time I use it, I break out!!! It’s a shame.

reviews.product_name: T.L.C. Framboos Glycolic Resurfacing Night Serum
reviews.review_text: My new holy grail night time skin product! I totally noticed a difference in under a month. Started using this religiously after I purchased “The Little’s” bundle and I’ll never stop! My dark spots have lightened generously and upon waking up I have that nice glow. I follow with DE marula oil and the combo is definitely an all time favorite so far.

reviews.product_name: Vitamin C Suspension 23% + HA Spheres 2%
reviews.review_text: If I paid a lot for the product I’d be upset about the piling, however considering the price - I really can’t complain. It does tingle quite a bit, but in my mind it makes me feel like the product is working. I use in the PM and follow with a heavy moisturizer. Haven’t been using too long, but I can see this becoming a regular product in my routine! Really wish the formula will eventually be reworked because I’m not a fan of the silicone version.

reviews.product_name: Lippe Balm
reviews.review_text: Love this stuff! Gives me the perfect amount of moisture without being greasy, or disappearing right after application. Perfect for winter, but also light enough for summertime if that makes sense! I keep one in my purse at all times! Love that its unscented too. Also, it lasts forever!

reviews.product_name: T.L.C. Sukari Babyfacial AHA + BHA Mask
reviews.review_text: I like this mask a lot, but I don’t LOVE it. I always do notice a difference in my skin, especially the morning after using it. My makeup always sits so beautifully on my skin the day after I use this — my nose seriously looks like porcelain, which for me, having acne-prone skin, is a huge deal. The reason I don’t absolutely love it, is because I feel like I have intensive serums and other more affordable masks that give me very similar (if not the same) results. If you’re concerned about price-point, I would maybe try a more affordable resurfacing treatment before going all out with this product. I’m glad I tried it, and it IS a great product, but I don’t think it does anything that a more affordable product can’t offer.

reviews.product_name: Honeymoon Glow AHA Resurfacing Night Serum
reviews.review_text: I have absolutely noticed a difference in my skin since using this. I have skin that scars and spots very, very easily and I’ve noticed my redness and scarring has diminished significantly and the active blemishes don’t last as long. My skin looks glowy and my pores look smaller. I do still get breakouts, but my skin is very acne prone. I do notice a bit of stinging when I have active breakouts, so if you have super sensitive skin, I think that would be something to consider. But I love, love, love this product. I always feel like my skin is smoother the morning after using this! I was torn between this and a competing product, and I went with this one because of the price difference. Absolutely no regrets!

reviews.product_name: Niacinamide 10% + Zinc 1% Oil Control Serum
reviews.review_text: I purchased this product about a month and a half ago, not expecting much out of a $6 skincare product. I was so, so wrong. This product has given me SUCH drastic results in such a short period of time, it honestly has trumped a lot of my higher end skincare! I tend to have combination skin that’s pretty acne-prone, and I’m Latina, so when I breakout my skin takes it pretty harshly. Before this I was hanging onto redness and scarring for weeks after my blemish was gone. After this I notice my skin bounces back SO much quicker. My pores have gotten significantly smaller. The redness from blemishes goes down within days. I’m absolutely obsessed with this product, I basically bathe in it, morning and night (I typically mix it in with my serums). I would definitely recommend it if you’re looking for an effective skincare product that isn’t going to break the bank!

reviews.product_name: Cleansing & Exfoliating Wipes
reviews.review_text: Clean coconut scent and soft to the touch. My skin feels super moisturized after using these wipes. I will always keep these on hand for fast makeup removal.

reviews.product_name: Ultimate Sun Protector Lotion SPF 50+ Sunscreen
reviews.review_title: Non greasy - fresh scent and works great!
reviews.review_text: I got a sunscreen play box once that had several different brands of sunscreen. I brought it with me on vacation and tried all of them. This one was the only one that didn’t “feel” like I was wearing sunscreen under my makeup. A lot of sunscreens leave my face an oily mess. This goes on very matte (not uncomfortably matte) and smooth. It smells great too! This is a great choice of sunscreen if you are looking for something for your face. A little goes a long way - I ended up getting the smaller full sized bottle that will last me all summer and beyond. No burns either! Highly recommend.

reviews.product_name: Aqua Bomb Hydrating Toner
reviews.review_text: I received a sample in one of my play boxes and once it was gone I knew that I had to have this. I went from Ole Product for oil control that was a little harsh. This does the same job but feels much more soft going in and feels great on my skin.

reviews.product_name: The Serum Stick: Treatment & Touch Up Balm
reviews.review_title: My new favorite product in my skin care routine!!
reviews.review_text: My new favorite product in my skin care routine. Being a single mom of three anything that cuts my time of getting ready is already a plus but this product is more then just convenient and easy to use. This serum stick leaves my skin feeling absolutely amazing and hydrated without the greasy feeling most serums leave behind. its light and one swipe is just enough but not to much. I am loving this serum stick!!! I recieved this in a voxbox for my honest opinion.

reviews.product_name: Charlotte’s Magic Serum with Vitamin C
reviews.review_title: Your new HOLY GRAIL serum is here!!!
reviews.review_text: What a seriously incredible serum. I was skeptical as I’ve tried SO MANY pricey serums with little to no results but this one? This one you could tell a difference immediately!! My skin felt so much softer, more hydrated, and supple. It looked more radiant and luminous then it had in years!! (I’m 37 btw) 100% worth the price, you’ll will NOT be disappointed!!! I recieved this from Influnster free in exchange for my honest review. And this review is HONEST, if I didnt like it I’d tell ya’ll. They don’t penalize you for bad reviews so if this wasn’t the new HOLY GRAIL I believe it to be id have no issue saying so.

reviews.product_name: Smart Clinical Repair Wrinkle Correcting Eye Cream
reviews.review_text: I recieved this from Influenster a couple of weeks ago in exchange for my own personal & honest review and held of giving my review until I felt like I had ample time to use it and give a review that was indeed honest. I do love how moisturizing this product is, I am 39 so I am started to see some signs of aging and was pleasantly suprised when I did start to see a difference. It wasn’t huge ir crazy out there noticeable but then again, which product is? This left my under eye and lid area softer, less noticeable lines, and kind if felt like a little wake me up when I used it in the morning. I would recommend this product.

reviews.product_name: Urban Environment Oil-Free Sunscreen Broad-Spectrum SPF 42
reviews.review_text: Absolutely amazing! So hydrating and oil free! Waterproof too! No clogging my pores and great protection from sun damage.

reviews.product_name: Urban Environment Fresh-Moisture Sunscreen Broad-Spectrum SPF 42
reviews.review_text: Say yes to hydration and skim protection from sun Ray’s! Love the sleek, easy to hold and mess free tube.

reviews.product_name: Smart Clinical Repair Wrinkle Correcting Cream
reviews.review_text: At first I was lathering the product a bit heavy at night thinking my skin was super dry. I was then waking up extremely glossy. I realized a little goes a long way.

reviews.product_name: Superfood Air-Whip Lightweight Moisturizer with Hyaluronic Acid
reviews.review_text: This cream is perfect for my 65 year old skin.  I am very sensitive to any products that feel heavy or have a strong scent, which this does not. It goes on easy and moisturizes in a gentle way.  Yay!

reviews.product_name: Superberry Hydrate + Glow Dream Oil
reviews.review_text: I love using Superberry Hydrate+Glow Oil. My 65 year old face is feeling smoother and younger. Yay!!

reviews.product_name: Adaptogen Deep Moisturizing Cream with Ashwagandha + Reishi
reviews.review_text: This is the nicest face cream!! It has helped my dry skin, especially helpful for easing the lines around my eyes and mouth. I highly recommend it!

reviews.product_name: Mini Adaptogen Deep Moisture Cream with Ashwagandha + Reishi
reviews.review_text: This is the nicest face cream!! It has helped my dry skin, especially helpful for easing the lines around my eyes and mouth. I highly recommend it!

reviews.product_name: Lip Glowy Balm
reviews.review_text: Love the color, feel, and smell! Refuse to live without it! Just repurchased a tube after using up my last one! Makes your lips feel so juicy and look so nice and berry toned! Love it

reviews.product_name: Glow2OH Dark Spot Toner
reviews.review_text: Love this toner! It has helped my acne scarring so much, and makes my face look so glowy, I’ve been using it for months now! If I get close to running out I have to go out and replace it, I refuse to go even a day without it. Bonus it smells amazing and makes your face feel so clean!!

reviews.product_name: C-Rush Vitamin C Gel Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: Love this product!! Makes your face feel so nice and supple! Will not go a day without. And it smells amazing!!

reviews.product_name: Virgin Marula Luxury Face Oil
reviews.review_text: This oil helps hydrate my skin and it runs in ok. My skin did have an oil look right after but wait a few minutes and it absorbs. I used this for two days because I got a sun burn and my skin was flacks and peeling. It works but my skin started to break out, so I only use it when u really need it.

reviews.product_name: Vegan Milk Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: Super moisturizing!! I wanted a thick face cream like buttah! I was headed home to New England for the holidays and I knew my skin would be dry. This stuff is perfect for cooler air and dry skin. The moisture literally stays locked in. While it’s thick, it rubs in very quickly and creamy. I love Tula face moisturizer but this is like $15 cheaper! Definitely recommend.

reviews.product_name: Daily Greens Oil-Free Gel Moisturizer with Moringa and Papaya
reviews.review_text: It’s a good moisturizer, but I wouldn’t buy it again. I like the gel consistency. It’s light weight, but hydrating. This is great for summer months.  My skin glows after using it. Make up applies well over it, but I always use a primer anyway.I do not like that it is scented. It’s a very STRONG citrus scent. My skin hasn’t reacted to it, but I don’t think skincare should have that many added smells to it. You can even see on the ingredients list there are about 3 added citrus scents. If you’re have sensitive skin, I would be careful.

reviews.product_name: Watermelon Pink Juice Oil-Free Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: Happy Saturday my gorgeous babe’s have you tried @glowrecipe Watermelon Pink Juice Moisturizer? Cuz let me tell you its amazing im obsessed with the fresh smell its not over powerful and its great under makeup as a primer. It’s also very light weight and soaks right into the skin. I have combination skin so this works amazing on hotter days as my skin can sometimes get a little oily. It’s made with great combination of antioxidants, hyaluronic acid and 90% watermelon extract and what i love is that it works great mixed with my other skin care routine. If you have dry skin I would recommend that you use it with your goto moisturizer just to give that extra moisture and glow.

reviews.product_name: Mini Daily Microfoliant Exfoliator
reviews.review_text: This was gifted to me by Dermalogica and I been obsessed ever since I first tried this Microfoliant about 4 years ago, it was the very first product I’ve tried from them and I knew I just had to try more. What I love about this one is that it’s gentle enough to used daily but has such a major effect on my skin, it feels so soft and smooth after every use and during this time of year my skin gets so dry and their works so well to remove the dead surface of my skin. I definitely recommen this to everyone.

One think I love about this serum is that it doesn’t feel tacky or sticky my skin soaks it right up and in the morning my skin looks so glowy. I would definitely recommend this serum to my friends.

reviews.product_name: Precleanse Cleansing Oil
reviews.review_text: Just started using it and it’s so good! Always heard such amazing things about it and it didn’t disappoint! Such a good cleanser at a great price, excited to continue using it! Would love to try the other ones too! Got this complimentary from Dermalogica

reviews.review_text: I’ve always heard of Shiseido but have not gotten a chance to try until now. This product lives up to it’s reputation. I can see little changes in the way my under eye skin feels within 2-3 uses. Keeps it looking nice and smooth, can definitely tell the difference when applying make up in comparaisons to prior using it. I would recommend this product!

reviews.product_name: The True Cream Moisturizing Bomb
reviews.review_text: This product leaves my skin feeling very silky smooth and moisturized. My skin was actually very dry from the season changing. Definitely noticed a difference after using this. I would recommend this product.

reviews.product_name: Double Serum Firming & Smoothing Anti-Aging Concentrate
reviews.review_text: This serum does the job and does it right! Definitely noticed a difference within a couple of usage and it leaves my skin feeling smooth and firm. Have used Clarins in the past so I am not surprised that this is a great product. I recommend this product!

reviews.product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C
reviews.review_text: I looove the way this feels and it definitely makes my lips noticeably softer the next morning! I do find that I have to use it pretty much every night to see much of a difference in my lips; they still get pretty chapped if I forget to put it on one night. I was hoping it might help in a more lasting way.

reviews.product_name: Glycolic Acid 7% Exfoliating Toning Solution
reviews.review_text: I hoped this would be a miracle worker but it’s honestly too harsh in my experience. I don’t have particularly sensitive skin but this has stripped my moisture barrier significantly and made me have a pretty bad reaction when I got my eyebrows waxed.

reviews.product_name: Balancing Force Oil Control Toner
reviews.review_text: I’m enjoying this so far! It’s true that you can definitely feel it going into your pores and working. I’m only using it once a day or once every other day because I’m concerned it might dry me out with my Salicylic Acid cleanser, but I love how it makes my skin feels.

reviews.product_name: Salicylic Acid Acne + Pore Cleanser
reviews.review_text: I really appreciate that this doesn’t seem to be drying my skin out! I am using it twice a day and haven’t noticed a huge reduction in acne yet, but my skin definitely isn’t getting worse and I appreciate that it’s gentle enough to use regularly. I do find it annoying that TIL doesn’t apparently use the little plastic sealants on the lids, so both shipments I received had leaked a bit in the box.

reviews.product_name: Superberry Hydrate + Glow Dream Night Mask with Vitamin C
reviews.review_title: Undecided - Should also be Light Protected
reviews.review_text: I sit somewhere in the middle with this product. It’s not bad, but I wouldn’t say it’s a holy grail. The scent is mildly fruity, somewhat pleasant; I can smell some citrus. However, the texture may be what has me on the fence. Upon first application, it slightly felt velvety, which made me go: uh-oh, there’s silicone. My face does not like silicone. I’ll have to try it out the next few days and see how it wears. I’m concerned it might break me out. I have combination, sensitive, acne-prone skin. I LOVE the hylauronic acid   kale moisturizer by this line. I use it daily, it feels very hydrating. This is thicker and I had assumed i’d feel a surge of moisture, i’m not sure though. Something to note though, **** PRODUCTS WITH VITAMIN C SHOULD BE STORED IN AMBER BOTTLES! ***** This ingredient needs to be light protected so it doesn’t break down.

reviews.product_name: A-Passioni Retinol Cream
reviews.review_text: After reading reviews, I was worried this would ruin my skin considering it’s sensitive and acne-prone. Surprisingly, I’m not experiencing any severe dryness as most. In fact, my skin seems to be pretty tolerable and after a months use I may start using this twice weekly. I must disclose that I do have experience with Retinols. In my early twenties I was on Accutane, and i’ve just recently switched to this from Dr. Brandt’s Retinol serum (they made a horrible reformulation). I really have noticed this smoothing out my fine lines, especially on my forehead, and it’s also helping to diminish texture. My complexion appears more supple, even, and my pores even appear smaller. However, I do feel my current skincare regime is aiding in positive results. Don’t use a cleanser that strips your skin, causing extra dryness. Get a good Hyaluronic Acid cream. I didn’t like the serum DE provided with this product; I suggest the cream from Youth to the People. This is probably the most important: Invest in a mild exfoliator that you can use DAILY, such as the Foreo Mini (this is what I use). The Foreo will help unclog the pores so your product can be readily absorbed, and it’ll also slough away any dead skin cells on the surface which may be causing dryness.

reviews.product_name: The True Cream Moisturizing Bomb
reviews.review_text: This product is very moisturizing. My skin felt supple and looks glowy. The problem though is that it breaks me out, especially on my cheeks, which is how I know this product is wrong for me. I so wanted to love this and tried it on and off, but my breakouts only went away when I stopped using this. Sensitive or acne-prone skin, take caution.

reviews.product_name: Daily Greens Oil-Free Gel Moisturizer with Moringa and Papaya
reviews.review_text: After reading some negative reviews I was concerned this was going to break me out. The first week I used this, admittedly I thought my skin might have been too oily and I may have had a small break-out... but since then my skin has been lovely. I’ve been using this for about a month now. I have sensitive, acne-prone skin that reacts to basically anything new I put on it. My skin type is Combination and I’ve always had to use two different products to accommodate my skin needs. I typically have dry, flaky cheeks and an oilier t-zone. This is literally the ONLY product in my 27 years of living that has nurtured both issues. I’m shocked. I don’t have to spend hundreds of  dollars now on two products. Honestly, give it a try!

reviews.product_name: Honey Halo Ultra-Hydrating Ceramide Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I had been using the Daily Greens Oil-free Gel moisturizer which is my perfect moisturizer for my combination skin, but now that the weather has changed for the cold Winter months, my skin (especially my cheeks) have been more dry and flaky. I was worried this wouldn’t provide enough moisture on its own or might clog my skin, but it hasn’t. My skin is glowy, soft, with no break-outs or flakiness. I highly recommend! I’ll switch back to my other moisturizer in the Spring.

reviews.product_name: Green Clean Makeup Removing Cleansing Balm
reviews.review_title: Still looking for the HG or balm cleansers...
reviews.review_text: Not bad. Does a decent job taking off makeup and sunscreen however I can’t seem to get it to take off my mascara completely. I don’t wear waterproof mascara either so I don’t think it should be a problem. Also, it gets into my eyes no matter what and is irritating. It has a light lime sherbet scent which isn’t too strong nor does it linger once rinsed. It does emulsify nicely and rinses away cleanly (but I also second cleanse with another cleanser after).  It’s not a bad cleanser but this definitely will not be my HG makeup cleanser. I will try the next!

reviews.product_name: Blue Tansy BHA and Enzyme Pore Refining Mask
reviews.review_text: I love the smell of this product! I know some have said it’s off putting but I love the herbaceous smell. It makes your skin feel super smooth and helps with some break outs. It is a bit smaller than I was expecting too. I didn’t give this 5 Stars because I’ve noticed after the first few uses I don’t notice a difference afterwards with helping clear up my breakouts. But it is nice and cooling/refreshing so I will keep this and use till it’s finished. I don’t think (as of writing this) that I will repurchase but will update if I do.

reviews.product_name: Lala Retro Whipped Refillable Moisturizer with Ceramides
reviews.review_text: I think this is a great non irritating moisturizer. I do think it is quite overpriced though. I would love for it to be in the $45-50 range. Like I said it is non irritating and works fine on top of my other pieces in my skincare routine but since it doesn’t offer anything like anti-aging or treatment with the moisturizer I do think it is overpriced. I have not decided if I will repurchase yet-I will try others and see if I like them more than this one. If not I will return to this one since it is non irritating to my skin.

reviews.product_name: The True Cream Aqua Bomb
reviews.review_text: I have tried multiple moisturizers and this one is perfect. It’s super lightweight but really moisturizers my skin. Layers well with the rest of my day/nighttime skin care routine. It looks good under make up and doesn’t feel sticky in this LA summer heat. It also gives you a natural from within glow if you throw it on without any face makeup. I’m currently only my 3rd jar!

reviews.product_name: The Dewy Serum Resurfacing and Plumping Treatment
reviews.review_title: Great for plump skin and hydration
reviews.review_text: I just started using this serum but I’ve seen an immediate increase of hydration. I’ve been using this in place of a Hyaluronic serum. It does give your skin a plump, dewy look so that’s something to consider if you don’t enjoy looking “glowy”. It’s a much thicker serum consistency, definitely not light and runny. I would say it could almost be a light moisturizer but I enjoy using it with either my Tatcha dewy cream or Fresh moisturizer. Sits really well under make up and has a pleasant smell. I think I’ll continue to use this and will repurchase. I removed 1 star due to the price. I know Tatcha is on the higher end of the spectrum but by using this x2 day, it won’t last you very long. It’s about the size of their Vitamic C serum and it lasts me 2 months at most.

reviews.product_name: The Dewy Skin Cream Plumping & Hydrating Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: This is my fave moisturizer, I switched from the Fresh Lotus and haven’t gone back. It is thick and it is borderline oily looking when you use too much BUT it does moisturize and leave a glow under make up. A lot of people say this pills but they’re simply not waiting long enough before applying face makeup. I don’t know how long I can pay 70$ for a moisturizer so I am on the hunt for an alternative but there is a reason why it’s a cult favorite.

reviews.product_name: The True Cream Moisturizing Bomb
reviews.review_text: I like how hydrating the formula is. I think it just keeps he exact amount of richness that allows for me to wear it during the day instead of just at bedtime. To be fair I have dry skin.

reviews.product_name: Cold Plunge Pore Remedy Moisturizer with BHA/LHA
reviews.review_title: Good for my acne prone skin
reviews.review_text: I got this complimentary and I’ve only been using it for 3 days so ymmv! My skin tho has been loving it!! It smells similar to the mask, is cooling (great for summer), hydrating but not greasy! The scent could be overwhelming for some people but I personally love it! It’s veryyyy fresh!! I’m curious whether I’ll see any improvements to the skin texture since I’ve been very lazy with actives lately! It seems to be working out well for my acne prone combo skin!

reviews.product_name: Abeille Royale Advanced Youth Watery Oil
reviews.review_text: I love the hydration it provides. It makes my skin look much more radiant and even. The application is very easy. The two cons for me are the price, and the strong scent. Normally I don’t mind the scents and this one dissipated quickly but I found it worth mentioning because a lot of people are sensitive to scent. The price is also up there. Overall it’s a nice product but I don’t think I would get it again. I received this complimentary for testing.

reviews.review_text: Shiseido is a prestige brand, they’re known for their amazing products. Age has a way of creeping up on you before you know it.  I’ll be 48 this year (yikes lol) I prefer to use skincare to help slow the process vs is fillers.    Shiseido Beneficance Wrinkle Smoothing Eye Cream is truly a unique product.  Love the wand applicator, you don’t have to use your finger to apply the product, more companies should do that.  The product is nice and rich and soaks right in to your skin leaving your skin nice and silky.  It’s significantly reduced the puffiness under my eyes in such a short amount of time.  I’m looking forward to seeing the changes in my skin.

reviews.product_name: Abeille Royale Advanced Youth Watery Oil
reviews.review_text: The packaging is beautiful, I love bee on the dropper. This oil makes your skin feel and look smoother. I love the slight smell of floral and sweetness. The product absorbs right into my skin and gives it a beautiful glow. The price is steep but sometimes you have to spend a little. Tomorrow I’ll be 49 and I would like to my skin look nice with or without makeup.

reviews.product_name: Confidence in a Cream Anti-Aging Hydrating Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I just turned 50 on 7/31, finding a good moisturizer is important to me.  This moisturizer is amazing It feel so nice to put on and does not have a strong smell. A little goes a long way, especially if you’re using oils and treatments too. It last throughout the day or night! This is my favorite face moisturizer. I don’t like when I can feel them all day or have to reapply during the day or wake up dry. My skin feels smooth and soft as soon as I apply it.  I would definitely recommend this product to my friends and family.

It wasn’t sticky but absorbed well around the eyes. Would like to purchase the full product to see the result in wrinkles.

I would probably purchase a full size product to find out the result!

reviews.product_name: Smart Clinical Repair Wrinkle Correcting Serum
reviews.review_text: I received this #freeproduct in exchange for a honest review.  #tryitwithtopbox The sample had about 3 application content of the serum. I enjoyed unscented smooth serum which felt quite pleasant. Some serums I’ve used felt very sticky and just sitting on the surface. This serum absorbed into the skin well and quite hydrating. I used it with the other eye cream and the wrinkles correcting cream.

reviews.product_name: Sugar Hydrating Lip Balm
reviews.review_text: I really enjoy this lip balm especially as something to prep the lips before makeup for lipstick or lip gloss later on. It really smooths everything out nd makes it plump. It can also be used as something light to put on before bed. However I took off a star because I don’t think it smells like caramel much and it isn’t really that hydrating. It does an acceptable job but your lips are not super moisturizer or anything. The balm just softens a little and smoothes our your lips and gets rid of any dryness enough to make the next lip product you layer on top look good but you cannot use this as your only lip balm. For winter I think alone, this is not moisturizing enough. I usually pair it with something else or put it on at night on warmer days where my lips aren’t that dry. It is a nice balm to have though and I do love using it as a primer to prep my lips!

reviews.product_name: Take The Day Off Cleansing Balm Makeup Remover
reviews.review_text: I was really skeptical about using an oil based product on my face at first, but I saw the mini size and decided to buy it and give it a try and boy were my assumptions wrong! This product is amazing!! Not only did it take everything off effortlessly, it made my face feel so soft and moisturized afterwards, it was quite unbelievable. My voice did not feel dry whatsoever after using this. I will definitely be buying the full size when I run out of my mini. Must try!

reviews.product_name: Mini Take The Day Off Cleansing Balm Makeup Remover
reviews.review_text: I was really skeptical about using an oil based product on my face at first, but I saw the mini size and decided to buy it and give it a try and boy were my assumptions wrong! reviews.product_name: The True Cream Moisturizing Bomb
reviews.review_text: I love this moisturizer. Even the travel size one lasts you a long time. It’s good for combo-oily skin and the big one lasts me at least a year. A little goes a long way. I also have really sensitive acne-prone skin and this does not break me out at all. It also is not heavy on the skin and is almost like a gel moisturizer except it moisturizes well like a lotion. In addition, it has a very light pleasant scent that does not linger which is always a plus.

reviews.product_name: The Water Cream Oil-Free Pore Minimizing Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I have combo skin that’s dry in the winter and I felt like this evaporated the moment it touched my skin and didn’t really sink in. It wasn’t hydrating enough and for the price point I expected a lot more. I like the dewy skin cream much better. This has more of a gel like consistency and application. I would not call it a cream at all. Maybe a gel cream if even that.

reviews.product_name: Mini The Water Cream
reviews.review_text: I have combo skin that’s dry in the winter and I felt like this evaporated the moment it touched my skin and didn’t really sink in. It wasn’t hydrating enough and for the price point I expected a lot more. I like the dewy skin cream much better. This has more of a gel like consistency and application. I would not call it a cream at all. Maybe a gel cream if even that.

reviews.product_name: Cicapair Tiger Grass Serum
reviews.review_text: I am received this new cicapair serum as a gift from Dr.Jart to exchange for honest review.At first, I am a fan of DrJart cicapair tiger grass cream for years since they first launched and so excited to one of some first one have chosen for this new formulation of cicapair line.After 2 weeks straight using Dr.Jart tiger grass serum, I totally love this formula. Compare to camo drop, I like this better. Soothing my rosacea redness right away. I have some inflammation pimples around chin area and cicapair serum help calming them in a sec. And they go away after 4 days without any acne treatment. Love the result !!!

reviews.product_name: Cicapair Tiger Grass Cream
reviews.review_text: Be a big fan of this product for years and will be using it for the rest o my life. My skin is pretty tough during Winter and sometimes during a year. I mostly get burned rashes around chin, neck, décolleté if weather changes to cold. Even the high neck from my fur sweater touching my skin will cause rashes and pimples too. I had visited too many dermatologist, got lots of medicines and external cream but it just happened a lot to me. Since I found out cicapair tiger grass cream and ceramidin cream , those only 2 creak that will help me survived most intense skin reaction. I swear by those 2 cream and recommended to too many people I’ve known.My husband love to put cicapair cream on his face at night, too. He said he love the scent and also the cool feeling of application.*** I recently received Cicapair Cream as a gift from the brand exchange for my honest thoughts about the product. BUT I also purchased many times in the past and still have been using this product myself

reviews.product_name: Cicapair Tiger Grass Color Correcting Treatment SPF 30
reviews.review_text: Well, this product is a meh for me. I don’t like how messy it is, even I cleaned after using. the product is more in dry side even my skin is combination tend to more oily. the color is somewhat yellow... But to be honest, I have some lazy days and late days, it is my go to product for a fast morning routine. I received this product as a gift exchange for my honest review.

reviews.product_name: Mini Cicapair Tiger Grass Color Correcting Treatment SPF 30
reviews.review_text: Well, this product is a meh for me. reviews.product_name: U.F.O. Salicylic Acid BHA Acne Treatment Face Oil
reviews.review_text: I am not a face oil person but since I bought this, I started buying facial treatment oil. First off, this face oil contain acid salicylic, tea tree oil and black cumin seed oil. Secondly, this is dry oil, soaked in my skin like magic, and doesn’t break off other products stay on top off it. I got a mini size (0.5 oz) and it lasts for awhile. I would recommend and repurchase even this facial oil is expensive. It worth the price tag.

reviews.product_name: Crème de la Mer Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I don’t know why people love this. It is just not for me. I put it in 3 star because it does help moisturizing my skin during tough winter but if the weather not cold, it cause my skin breakout real bad. Too expensive ! There are too many great moisturizer out there will do way better job than this. Anyone who think of buying this, think twice !

reviews.product_name: Mini Crème de la Mer Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I don’t know why people love this. It is just not for me. reviews.product_name: Protini Polypeptide Firming Refillable Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: This moisturizer is everythinggggg! I have sensitive skin so it’s hard to find a moisturizer that works for me skin and this was great! Especially in cold Canadian weather that dries out your skin, this is a saviour. It is pricey but you don’t need to use much so it lasts forever.

reviews.product_name: Hyaluronic Acid 2% + B5 Hydrating Serum
reviews.review_title: Great hylauronic acid for its price
reviews.review_text: This hylauronic acid is super cheap but does the job, it’s great for a quick boost of hydration. My skin feels a little sticky after using it but eventually absorbs and stickiness goes away.

reviews.product_name: Beste No. 9 Jelly Cleanser
reviews.review_text: this is the best cleanser I have ever used. Due to my sensitive skin I find it hard to find a cleansing product that doesn’t make my skin freak out. It leaves my skin feeling clean and refreshed, not dried out at all. I seriously recommend!

reviews.product_name: Cold Plunge Pore Mask
reviews.review_text: LOVE!! I received this product complimentary for testing purposes via Influenster and Ole Henriksen. I noticed a difference in my pores after just two uses. My pores look smaller, it reduced my redness, AND it helped control my oily skin. The bright aqua color is super fun, but can be messy when washing it off. Overall, I love love love this!!

reviews.product_name: The Essence Skincare Boosting Treatment
reviews.review_text: I love this product!! It’s super light and absorbs very well into my skin. I was worried that it would make me oily or make my skin feel cluttered, but it’s amazing! I use it with the Tatcha Violet-C Brightening Serum. The bottle itself is really big, so it’ll last you a long time. You also don’t have to use an excessive amount of product to get your desired result. I’ve been using this for 2 weeks and my skin is already softer and brighter! I received this product for free for testing purposes.

reviews.product_name: Mini The Essence  Skincare Boosting Treatment
reviews.review_text: I love this product!! It’s super light and absorbs very well into my skin. I was worried that it would make me oily or make my skin feel cluttered, but it’s amazing! reviews.product_name: Violet-C Brightening Serum 20% Vitamin C + 10% AHA
reviews.review_text: Absolutely love this product! I’ve never used Tatcha before this and I wish I had! The product goes on smoothly and doesn’t make your skin sticky. I’ve seen my skin tone even out and brighten. It’s super easy to use - 1 to 2 pumps at night and it makes my skin look awesome. I received this product free for testing purposes

reviews.product_name: Tonique Confort Re-Hydrating Comforting Toner with Acacia Honey
reviews.review_text: I just got this in from influenster to try out and give my honest review. I’ve used this for a few days now and i must say i really like it! It had a nice scent to it that is almost floral like .. but not strong. My face feels so smooth and clean after using it. I’ve looked in the mirror before writing this review and noticed how much smoother and not so texturized my face is. This toner is pretty moisturizing. It does not burn my face like other toners do. I definitely recommend this product!

reviews.product_name: Hydra Zen Gel-Cream Oil-Free Moisturizer with Salicylic Acid
reviews.review_text: I just got this in from influenster to test it out and give my honest review. I will say that i am very impressed by this moisturizer! It feels amazing on the skin. The gel like texture is smooth and when applied on just soaks in your skin. I apply this in the morning after using their toner, let it sit for a minute then go on with my usual makeup routine. I worked a 12 hour day today and got home today and my fiancé looked at me and said “wow your makeup looks good today. You look like you’re glowing or something” i was so shocked he even said that! He dosent usually comment on my face that much! Definitely recommend this product!!

reviews.product_name: Estee Lauder Advanced Night Repair Synchronized Multi-Recovery Complex Serum
reviews.review_text: Just finished using a 7 day sample of this serum, complimentary of influenster. In 7 days I’ve noticed my skin brighter and more hydrated! A little goes a long way! It dosent really Have a strong smell which is good for me! Sometimes skin care products smell too strong but this is pretty pleasant smelling to me. I will be purchasing the full sized product to see more results hopefully! It says by week 3 and 4 you will notice fine lines and wrinkles appear reduced and skin feeling firmer. I think this product will deliver because I’ve seen a noticeable difference in just 7 days!

reviews.product_name: Glow2OH Dark Spot Toner
reviews.review_text: I really like this toner. It doesn’t over dry out my skin. It has a good scent. It does clean up an leftover dirt or makeup from my skin after cleansing. I would recommend it to others and would repurchase it in the future.

reviews.product_name: Daily Greens Oil-Free Gel Moisturizer with Moringa and Papaya
reviews.review_text: This product is great. My skin appeared more moisturized and less dry. My skin was looking really dry this winter.  I would recommend this product. I received this product complimentary from Farmacy Beauty.

reviews.product_name: Avocado Soothing Skin Barrier Serum with Ceramides
reviews.review_text: I really like the serum. I saw a difference in my skin and it appeared less dry and more hydrated. I like the texture of the serum and it absorbs good. The serum doesn’t make my skin appear or feel greasy. I will continue to use this in my skincare routine.

reviews.product_name: Hyaluronic Acid 2% + B5 Hydrating Serum
reviews.review_title: I’ll Never Buy Another Hyaluronic Acid
reviews.review_text: If you’re looking for HA don’t get this one! It’s basically pure HA with no fillers. There’s no point in buying a more expensive one because at that point you’re ripping yourself off when you can buy this amazing product for a great price.

reviews.product_name: The Camellia Oil 2-in-1 Makeup Remover & Cleanser
reviews.review_text: I first bought this in a set, and now I’m on my second full sized bottle. My skin has cleared up so much. This product is expensive, but worth it. I tried to switch over to the purity by philosophy cleanser because it was cheaper and had a terrible break out. Never again! The ingredients are so simplistic and don’t contain micro plastics like cleansing balms do. I feel like it does a good job of removing and emulsifying what ever I’m wearing at the time. I use it day and night and I’ve gone through one bottle in about six months.

reviews.product_name: Niacinamide 10% + Zinc 1% Oil Control Serum
reviews.review_text: One of the only constants in my skincare routine. I’ve tried to not use it before and I end up breaking out. Good for acne.

reviews.product_name: 100% Organic Cold-Pressed Rose Hip Seed Oil
reviews.review_text: Broke me out. I was so sad too after all the raving reviews! Not for acne prone skin even though my skin is super dry. For context, I’ve taken acutane before and it still broke me out.

reviews.product_name: GOOPGLOW Microderm Instant Glow Exfoliator
reviews.review_text: I really enjoy goop exfoliating instant facial and find it comparable to my other favorite exfoliating face masks. This product was gifted to me. I leave this on for three minutes and follow up with a nourishing moisturizer. If I use this, I will not use any other acids or active ingredients like retinol. It does sting my skin and I wouldn’t use this on open sores or open breakouts. This stuff is powerful and I really do see results the next morning. I have other AHA and BHA masks that give similar results but this really tightens pores and eliminates breakouts faster than anything I’ve tried. A very good product, and extremely luxury. I won’t use it as often as the packaging says to (2-3 times weekly) because I think it is too strong for that or my skin is too sensitive to handle it. I will cherish this on Skincare Sunday, though.
