reviews.product_name: Watermelon Pink Juice Oil-Free Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: @glowrecipe gifted me their watermelon pink juice moisturizer. It has exceeded my expectations. Even though this moisturizer has fragrance (typically a big “no” from me), it did not irritate my sensitive skin. It makes my face feel plump, hydrated and calm. This is the only moisturizer I’ve used day and night for over a week now. I love it. It’s a gel texture that feels more like a serum and it’s the perfect amount of moisture for my dehydrated but oily, acne-prone skin.

reviews.product_name: Good Genes All-In-One AHA Lactic Acid Treatment
reviews.review_text: Despite the mixed reviews I’ve heard about this product and this company, I actually really love this product, which was gifted to me by the brand. I use it every other night as a serum before moisturizer. Pros: it’s moisturizing and the next morning I wake up with brighter, clearer skin.it also makes my skin immediately glowy. Cons: it can sting if you have open acne or dry patches, and it smells like lemons. My skin had a period of adjustment with this product so I’m using every day was not an option. I think it’s pretty intense for a lactic acidosis serum, so just read the directions, and listen to your skin.

reviews.product_name: Alpha Beta Pore Perfecting & Refining Serum
reviews.review_text: I was hesitant to use thinking this may be too harsh - let alone to use daily. I prefer to exfoliate twice weekly at most. Total opposite though. This was surprisingly gentle on my usually sensitive skin. I do have some signs of enlarged pores around my nose and cheeks due to lupus rash but do not have oily skin. This caused no reaction and left my skin smooth and feeling and looking tight. The price seems a bit harsh (pun intended)

reviews.product_name: Hyaluronic Acid Hydrating Serum
reviews.review_text: I was excited to receive this full size Inkey List Hyaluronic Acid Hydrating Serum for free in exchange for my honest review. I’ve been trying it for a few weeks. I use it after cleansing and before my regular serum and/or moisturizer. Some days I use this then skip straight to sunscreen. On its own, it feels a bit sticky but I think the trick is not to use too much product - I find that a dime size is plenty. For me, I prefer my hyaluronic essence that I already own and use so I probably won’t repurchase this. However, if you don’t have a hyaluronic acid product in your rotation, I think this is one you may want to start out with - especially at this amazing price point. What this does is preps your skin to retain the rest of your products and makes everything work better. Your face will thank you! I knocked a star only because the hyaluronic ingredient in this product is a bit down on this list - I think #5 or so - and I believe there are superior products out there and the fact this feels sticky. Truly though - for this price?! You can’t go wrong. If you hate the sticky feel, you may want to use only at night.

reviews.product_name: Skinlongevity Long Life Herb Anti-Aging Face Serum
reviews.review_text: I received this bareminerals Skinlongevity Long Life Herb Serum sample bottle from PinchMe in exchange for my honest review. It was a decent size so I could try out for several weeks morning and night. I enjoyed the texture of this serum - was very smooth going on. My skin indeed felt soft after application. I appreciate that niacinamide is the third ingredient on this list. To me there is a slight citrus scent but was not bothersome whatsoever. I just did not feel any wow or glowy effect over time and, at this price point, I feel there are better options out here. I may buy this if it were on sale or there was a coupon.

reviews.product_name: Smart Clinical Repair Wrinkle Correcting Cream
reviews.review_title: Good night cream but I’d invest in serum
reviews.review_text: I have tried this entire line - first the serum then the eye cream and now this product. I will say this is my least favorite as I loved and repurchased the other two. The instructions say to use day and night but as with any retinol containing product I only use as night and every other night. Also the consistency of this cream seems as if it would be lightweight but when applying it is more suffocating than it seems - which makes for a beautiful night cream but not a day cream. For reference I have a normal skin type - not oily whatsoever but not dry either - just balanced for now. In winter I can become dehydrated. As far as wrinkle fighting benefits, it is too soon to tell but judging from the entire line I believe this would be promising to use as a set if that’s your thing. To me, investing in their serum may be enough and I’d really recommend that route first.

reviews.product_name: Banana Bright 15% Vitamin C Serum
reviews.review_text: I added this serum into my admittedly pretty full routine. It smells amazing and I was surprised by how thick it was but how fast it absorbed. I didn’t notice a huge change in the week that I’ve been using it, but I was previously using the Tatcha vitamin c and they seem to be similar in results. I found that I only had to use one pump if my skin was still damp from other products, but I needed about two pumps if my skin was dry because of how creamy it is. I would say this is a great option if you don’t have any other vitamin c products in your routine already.

reviews.product_name: Abeille Royale Advanced Youth Watery Oil
reviews.review_text: I really enjoyed this oil! It is very light so I had no trouble fitting it into my skincare routine and it even works well with my rosacea. It is the perfect balance of anti-aging and plumping without feeling too heavy. It does have a distinct smell that I’m not a huge fan of but it goes away quickly. The price is pretty hefty but I only use about 4 drops for my entire face so I won’t have to replace it often. I found it to be comparable to the Fresh rose oil serum but even lighter on the skin. This is a beautiful product both inside and out and the dropper is easy to use.

reviews.product_name: Mini Abeille Royale Advanced Youth Watery Oil

reviews.product_name: C.E.O. 15% Vitamin C Brightening Serum
reviews.review_text: I received this serum free for my honest review. I was able to work it into my full routine fairly easily because of how light it is. The CEO serum is also very hydrating and I did not experience any reaction, even though I do have fairly sensitive skin.

reviews.product_name: Hyaluronic Acid 2% + B5 Hydrating Serum
reviews.review_text: Ever since I switched to the ordinary as my go to skincare brand my skin and hair have never been better. Won’t and never going back!

reviews.product_name: Glycolic Acid 7% Exfoliating Toning Solution

reviews.product_name: Volcanic AHA Pore Clearing Clay Mask
reviews.review_text: This is one of my absolute favourite masks I own to date! You get so much in this little jar it has lasted me almost the entire year:)

reviews.product_name: Hyaluronic Acid 2% + B5 Hydrating Serum
reviews.review_text: Such a steal! I used this for a month and could see visible difference in my skins texture, it made my skin extremely soft and well hydrated. My face looks very healthy now even with blemishes. Highly recommended!!!!

reviews.product_name: Superberry Hydrate + Glow Dream Night Mask with Vitamin C
reviews.review_text: I love this! It makes my skin so so soft hydrated and dewy!!. I ordered first with my sephora points to test it and then ordered the full size! Love this brand and can’t wait to try their other products.

reviews.product_name: Mini Superberry Hydrate + Glow Dream Mask
reviews.review_text: I love this! It makes my skin so so soft hydrated and dewy!!. I ordered first with my sephora points to test it and then ordered the full size! Love this brand and can’t wait to try their other products.

reviews.product_name: Double Serum Firming & Smoothing Anti-Aging Concentrate
reviews.review_title: I like it but wouldn’t buy it.
reviews.review_text: I like the fact that this serum comes with turmeric and 21 plant extracts. It is not tacky and gets absorbs in the skin leaving some sheen. The fragrance is citrusy but it does feel a but not refreshing. I did not see any changes in 7 days of continuous usage of this product but it does feel good after applying. Also the applicator that came wasn’t very user friendly. Full size bottle might be better.

reviews.product_name: Mini Daily Microfoliant Exfoliator
reviews.review_text: This product was gifted by dermalogica sampling. It deeply exfoliates and nourishes my skin leaving it super hydrated. I did not see any brightness that much but overall like it.  It’s easy to use and travel friendly as well. It helps in double cleansing when I take off my makeup!

reviews.product_name: Daily Microfoliant Exfoliator
reviews.review_text: This product was gifted by dermalogica sampling. It deeply exfoliates and nourishes my skin leaving it super hydrated. I did not see any brightness that much but overall like it.  It’s easy to use and travel friendly as well. It helps in double cleansing when I take off my makeup!

reviews.product_name: The Rice Polish Foaming Enzyme Powder
reviews.review_text: I went into Sephora and ask the skin care person there I needed something to exfoliate with daily. I have normal/combination skin so he recommended this and said it was gentle. In my opinion, it’s TOO gentle. My skin feels good after I use it but it doesn’t take away all the dead skin on my face and doesn’t help with blackheads. When I put my makeup on I still can see the foundation clinging to my dry patches even after using a moisturizer and a primer. It’s just frustrating because I payed a lot of this. I’ll probably just keep using it but I need to find a better exfoliate. If you suffer from dead skin/dry patches I definitely don’t recommend.

reviews.product_name: Green Clean Makeup Removing Cleansing Balm
reviews.review_text: This is my must-have for removing makeup. It gets off even the hard to budge stuff like waterproof makeup and liquid lipsticks. I use a makeup eraser or washcloth to wipe it away. Won’t use anything else after using this and my face doesn’t feel drying after using this!

reviews.product_name: Green Clean Makeup Meltaway Cleansing Balm Limited Edition Jumbo
reviews.review_text: This is my must-have for removing makeup. It gets off even the hard to budge stuff like waterproof makeup and liquid lipsticks. I use a makeup eraser or washcloth to wipe it away. Won’t use anything else after using this and my face doesn’t feel drying after using this!

reviews.product_name: Watermelon Glow Niacinamide Sunscreen SPF 50
reviews.review_text: I LOVE this sunscreen! It has hydration that I need and doesn’t pill even after all the steps of skincare that I’ve used. I like that it had an SPF of 50 which helps me feel safer about protecting my skin. I don’t breakout from the formula either which is a plus. Good to wear under makeup. I use this on my facial clients too

reviews.product_name: Floral Recovery Overnight Mask with Squalane
reviews.review_text: This gives my skin that hydration that it needs overnight! I wake up in the morning and it feels smooth and soft. I had a few breakouts but that could be unrelated as I am acne prone and get them frequently.

reviews.product_name: Cleansing & Exfoliating Wipes
reviews.review_text: I can’t live without these.  Takes everything off and leaves my skin clean and soft.  I buy several to make sure I never run out!

reviews.product_name: Clear Improvement Active Charcoal Mask to Clear Pores
reviews.review_text: Nice mask. Cleans pores well.  Makes skin look bright and pores appear smaller. Gentle enough for my sensitive skin.

reviews.product_name: GENIUS Sleeping Collagen Moisturizer
reviews.review_title: Took My Skin to Next Level
reviews.review_text: This product has taken my skin to the next level.  I take care of my skin and have good skin (at 57) but since I’ve added this before bed, my skin is glowing, soft, plump and hydrated.  I’ve received so many compliments and even without makeup my skin looks beautiful.  I love this product!

reviews.product_name: The True Cream Aqua Bomb
reviews.review_text: I have finally found the perfect moisturizer. I have oily, acne prone, 30 something skin that rejects nearly every moisturizer. Since buying the True Cream Aqua Bomb I’ve never looked back. It absorbs perfectly, leaves no greasy feel, and makeup applies flawlessly. Used the 1.68 oz so quickly I bought the 3.37oz. My only wish is that it came in a pump instead.

reviews.product_name: Midnight Recovery Concentrate Moisturizing Face Oil
reviews.review_text: I first received a sample of the Midnight Recovery Concentrate as a 100 point gift and used every last drop, so I bought the full size. I like the texture, its light but absorbs completely and doesn’t sit on my skin. Its a good night time moisturizer, but I haven’t necessarily noticed any anti-aging benefits, which it doesn’t claim to per se. So wishful thinking I suppose!

reviews.product_name: Midnight Recovery Concentrate Moisturizing Face Oil

reviews.product_name: Self Tanning Bronzing Face Drops
reviews.review_text: I have an unhealthy obsession with being tan. A few years ago on Christmas day my mom’s only (tearful) Christmas wish was for me to stop using a tanning bed. I have *mostly* lived up to my promise, which means I’ve tried a gazillion self-tanners. This is my favorite to date. It is very easy to apply and is somehow not streaky at all. I did notice that I could go a little less heavy on my knees and ankles, but I don’t get the creasing around my wrists like with other self-tanners. I have to apply it to my face more often bc I exfoliate every other day, but it still manages to look mostly natural. Self-tanners of the past make my complexion look red/ruddy but this is the closest to a natural bronze (even with the Light Sun-Kissed Glow) I’ve found. It does have that smell when the tanner reacts with your skin, but my boyfriend thinks it smells like peanut butter cups so I guess it could be worse. Highly recommend.

reviews.product_name: Aqua Bomb Hydrating Toner
reviews.review_text: First positive impression is how smooth and soft this toner feels on my face. I definitely think this is super hydrating. Maybe too much for my oily skin. I’ve been using this in combination with the Age Knockdown Bomb, and it is making my skin breakout. So probably not optimal for acne prone skin.

reviews.product_name: Jet Lag Mask
reviews.review_text: If I could give this zero stars I would. This mask destroyed my skin. I broke out literally overnight. And this wasn’t just a few bumps here and there, it was all over! No matter what type of results you may possibly get from this product, it isn’t worth the risk. My face was hot, red, and gnarly.

reviews.review_text: I’ve been using this product for about 2 weeks now. I can tell a difference in the texture is my skin. It’s much smoother. I also feel like it is making my skin tone more even. However, I feel like it may be making my blackheads worse around my nose and chin. So, it’s a give and take.

reviews.product_name: Advanced Night Repair Eye Concentrate Matrix Synchronized Multi-Recovery Complex
reviews.review_text: I’m very pleased with this product. It’s light and smooth on my skin, which I appreciate; I don’t like heavy products around my eyes. I do think it helps with puffiness and crepey skin around my eyes. Overall I’d say my eyes look more youthful. I’d definitely recommend this to friends & family.

reviews.product_name: Hydra Zen Gel-Cream Oil-Free Moisturizer with Salicylic Acid
reviews.review_text: I received this complimentary of Influenster. I have to say it feels absolutely amazing on the skin. It feels super hydrating and is pretty cooling. I use it right in the morning before doing my makeup routine. I highly recommend.

reviews.product_name: Glow Cycle Retin-ALT Power Serum
reviews.review_text: I received this complimentary of Influenster for review purposes. However, this product is very refreshing and you can feel it working when you apply. I love the how my face feels after using and I personally enjoy the smell. Lol. But a little goesSuch a long way so it will definitely last you. I would recommend and repurchase!

reviews.product_name: Dreamskin Skin Perfector
reviews.review_text: I received this complimentary from Influenster and I am so impressed. It leave my skin looks so fresh and so flawless. It’s improved my skin and I love to use it before putting on makeup and makes it look so much better. You literally need the smallest amount. So it’s going to last you quite some time. It doesn’t have a strong scent which is nice and just feels soft on the skin.

reviews.product_name: Squalane + Marine Algae Firming & Lifting Eye Cream
reviews.review_text: Great eye cream. Well moisturizes and nourishes the skin around the eyes. The dark circles under the eyes look less noticeable. It can be used as a makeup base. The cream is quickly absorbed without leaving greasy.I received Squalane + Marine Algae Eye Cream complimentary from Biossance in exchange for my honest opinion.

reviews.product_name: Confidence in a Cream Anti-Aging Hydrating Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: The thick creamy texture with a light fragrance. Easy to apply without leaving stickiness or greesy. The cream nourishes and moisturizes my skin well, does not clog pores, evens out the complexion and contains anti-aging components. Every day the skin looks better, fresher and healthier. I apply each morning and feel like my skin is moisturize throughout the day. I really like the result. Definitely recommend!

reviews.product_name: Retinol Eye Stick
reviews.review_text: Very handy stick formula. Easy to use and apply. Perfectly moisturizes the skin around the eyes and reduces dark circles under the eyes without irritation and redness. Skin looks healthier and fresher

reviews.product_name: Facial Radiance Pads
reviews.review_text: I tried a sample of 6 of these pads based on a Sephora employee recommendation. My skin was dry and flaky, but I use retinoids, so I needed something for sensitive skin. These were amazing! I used the samples (2-3x week), then I purchased the 60 pad size. They have made a noticeable improvement in my texture and tone and have kept breakouts away. Great product!

reviews.product_name: Good Genes All-In-One AHA Lactic Acid Treatment
reviews.review_text: I have tried multiple products on my skin over the years. This product has profoundly changed the texture and look of my face....in a good way! It’s brighter, the dark spots are gone and it looks fresher and younger. It all started with a sample...

reviews.product_name: Natural Moisturizing Factors + HA
reviews.review_text: This is the first The Ordinary product I’ve used. This This product goes on well and doesn’t leave a heavy residue. The moisture level is good, leaving my face “glowy” but not greasy.

reviews.product_name: Triple Algae Eye Renewal Balm Eye Cream
reviews.review_title: Really Brightens The Under Eye Area
reviews.review_text: I was gifted by Algenist this eye cream and have been using it for multiple weeks and I am really seeing a difference in the brightness underneath my eyes.  The formula is rich but not greasy and I appreciate the lack of fragrance (especially around the eye area).

reviews.product_name: Glowscreen Sunscreen SPF 40 PA+++ with Hyaluronic Acid + Niacinamide
reviews.review_text: I absolutely love the texture and the bronzing effect of this sunscreen.  It’s great for the pool or beach where you don’t want to wear makeup but would like something to enhance your skin.  I have light skin that tans easily so the Golden Hour color looked great  - it may not be suitable for very fair skin tones due to its amount of pigment.

reviews.product_name: Mini Daily Microfoliant Exfoliator
reviews.review_title: Doesn't feel like a scrub but does the same job
reviews.review_text: I was gifted by Dermalogica Sampling to test out. The microfoliant was incredibly easy to use and great to travel with.  I felt like it really helped keep my skin clear and removed blackheads.  I was wanting more of an exfoliating “scrub“ feel which it didn’t provide - however, it still held up to its claims!

reviews.product_name: Sugar Hydrating Lip Balm

reviews.product_name: Lip Glowy Balm

reviews.product_name: C-Tango Vitamin C Eye Cream
reviews.review_text: Very hydrating and creamy without being over the top greasy.

reviews.product_name: T.L.C. Sukari Babyfacial AHA + BHA Mask
reviews.review_text: Taking off 1 star for price. A little does go a long way so that’s an upside. I generally use 2 pumps to coat my whole face. I tried SR good genes and like this better even though GG is lactic acid. For my skin needs and wants I think Glygolic AHA’s work better. I also like that this has a BHA. I wouldn’t say my skin transformed over night but after a couple of uses I feel like my skin looks smoother, more radiant and feels softer. Tingles upon application and then settles. I have sensitive combo skin on the dry side w/ hormonal acne that can fluctuate between manageable to bad. I’m in my mid-20s so taking care of my skin is important to me.

reviews.product_name: Cicapair Tiger Grass Cream
reviews.review_title: If you ruined your moisture barrier, use this!
reviews.review_text: This stuff is so hydrating! I also love the scent. I had completely destroyed my moisture barrier after trying to treat some hormonal acne. My skin looked haggard and was so dry. I used this after reading great reviews and OMG after 1 day I saw a dramatic improvement. I think asian skincare is just so much better than western beauty brands. I feel like the emphasis on hydration is really there and asian products work over time to deliver results. Took off one star because of price.

reviews.product_name: D-Bronzi Anti-Pollution Bronzing Drops with Peptides
reviews.review_title: 5 stars and recommend for a skin pick-me-up
reviews.review_text: I love this stuff! I’ve been using it for almost 3-4 years and keep repurchasing. I mix a drop or two with my tinted moisturizer. It wakes my skin up! I’m not sure if I’m reaping the additional skincare benefits but I always received compliments on my skin nonetheless. Highly recommend!

reviews.product_name: Superfood Antioxidant Cleanser
reviews.review_text: Love this cleanser! Have used it for several years now. I love the clean non-filmy feel and the fresh clean scent. I do transfer the product into a smaller squeeze bottle as the pump tends to dispense far too much product and then drip.

reviews.product_name: Alpha Beta Extra Strength Daily Peel Pads
reviews.review_title: Hands down the best face peel ever!
reviews.review_text: I received this product as a free sample in return for my honest review. I am absolutely blown away at how well this peel works. I have acne scars and this not only clears and smooths my face, it reduces acne scars and I love it ! I have never been so satisfied with a face product ever!! Its great when a product can make your face feel clean but its amazing when it does more than one awesome thing to it. It moisturises and cleanses on top of clearing up scaring and making you look as good as ever !The price is a little up there but honestly you are getting what you pay for !!!! And i will continue to buy this amazing product.

reviews.product_name: Rose & Hyaluronic Acid Deep Hydration Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: This moisturizer felt amazing on my face ! It instantly added some moisture to my face and made my face so smooth and soft! It gave me a natural looking glow and it smells great. I was very pleased with this moisturizer and I will continue to use this moisturizer !

reviews.product_name: The True Cream Moisturizing Bomb
reviews.review_text: I recieved this as a free sample and i will be continuing to purchase this cream. Wow it doesnt leave my face oily and have virtually no scent so you just feel moisturized and fresh. It leaves no residue and absorbes quickly. A great daily moisturizer.  LOVE IT!

reviews.product_name: The True Cream Aqua Bomb
reviews.review_text: Genuinely this cream is amazing. I have received samples a few times and I am so happy very time. It has a very very light but clean scent, it never leaves me feeling oily or greasy and its never caused a breakout. I always feel moistureized after using it and it lasts all day. 10/10 would recommend its worth the pruce for sure.

reviews.product_name: Aqua Bomb Overnight Lip Mask
reviews.review_text: I love the belif products. I tested a free sample of the blam and i cant wait for the winter when my lips dry out really badly. It didnt cause any break out and by morning my lips were so soft. Love love love it

reviews.product_name: Alpha Beta Extra Strength Daily Peel Pads
reviews.review_text: Dr Dennis Gross Alpha Beta Extra Strength Daily Peel is a miracle in a box. I have really oily skin in the summer around my nose and chin. I used this peel on those areas and bam no more breakouts and no more wiping my face all day. I am very impressed with this product and will be purchasing from sephora as soon as my samples run out. I am going to tell all of my friends and family about this Daily Peel. I received this product for free and all opinion are my own.

reviews.product_name: Urban Environment Oil-Free Sunscreen Broad-Spectrum SPF 42
reviews.review_text: Shiseido urban environment sunscreen has a light scent. Soaks into skin nicely. Had a little color tint to it but disappears when rubbing in. I love the cute little bottle. Works great on my sensitive skin.

reviews.product_name: Urban Environment Fresh-Moisture Sunscreen Broad-Spectrum SPF 42
reviews.review_text: Shiseido urban environment sunscreen has a light scent. Soaks into skin nicely and leaves my skin feeling moisturized instead of stiff and dry. I love the cute little bottle. Works great on my skin.

reviews.product_name: Santorini Grape Poreless Skin Cream
reviews.review_text: Great product I received complimentary from influenster a sample size for my review. I enjoyed this product, it’s smell and it’s portability. Using it for a few days I noticed some subtle changes. I would definitely use again in the future.

reviews.product_name: Urban Environment Oil-Free Sunscreen Broad-Spectrum SPF 42
reviews.review_text: I really enjoyed using this product. It’s not greasy and goes on great! I can’t wait to use it more in the upcoming summer months. I found a new favorite and I’m so glad local places to me like Sephora carry it. I highly recommend you try it and I will purchase again in the future. I got to try complimentary through influenster.

reviews.product_name: Urban Environment Fresh-Moisture Sunscreen Broad-Spectrum SPF 42
reviews.review_text: I got this product complimentary through influenster so I really enjoyed using it and I can’t wait to use it in the summer it was a great sunscreen that worked all day long I definitely will be purchasing it again in the future I recommend it

reviews.product_name: The Serum Stick: Treatment & Touch Up Balm
reviews.review_text: It’s a great multi purpose product! I actually utilize this more as a prep step prior to my foundation - esp around the under eye area. I have hot eyes and under eyes and it tends to break up my foundation throughout the day but since using this prior it has delayed that from happening. Product goes on smoothly and is incredibly light. Easy to blend and has not caused any break outs. I think the price is a little steep for what it is, but is a original product for girls on the go! Great for travel as well!

reviews.product_name: E-Rase Milki Micellar Water
reviews.review_text: I think this is a great product for sensitive skin due to the gentle formulation. I’m not generally one to use novellas water to remove my makeup as I’m a big fan of oil cleaners but I thought this did a great job at breaking down makeup without stripping the skin. Like some others in the reviews, you do need to go in and apply a little more pressure in breaking down the makeup. Overall i Think this is a good starter product for those looking to double cleanse And don’t want to use an oil cleanser.

reviews.product_name: The Dewy Serum Resurfacing and Plumping Treatment
reviews.review_title: dewy dumpling - with a few pimples
reviews.review_text: A great serum for the morning and makeup prep! The gel like textures seeps into the skin quickly and doesn’t leave it oily but dewy! I love prepping with this prior to adding my foundation. Mixes well with my makeup and provides a radiance underneath that I haven’t received prior with primers. I will say though since utilizing this, I’ve gotten a few more chin pimples but I’m not exactly sure if it’s the product or hormones. So for that I will be knocking off one star until I know more and get to the bottom of this. Might be the addition of squalane as that has caused breakouts in the past. But If you don’t have any issues with that specific ingredient, like with all tatcha products the packaging is great, smell is beautiful and product texture is luxe!

reviews.product_name: The Water Cream Oil-Free Pore Minimizing Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: Lightweight, nice scent. Not greasy, and leaves your skin with the perfect amount of softness. Wouldn’t recommend if you’re looking for something a little heavier during the winter.

reviews.product_name: Mini The Water Cream
reviews.review_text: Lightweight, nice scent. Not greasy, and leaves your skin with the perfect amount of softness. Wouldn’t recommend if you’re looking for something a little heavier during the winter.

reviews.review_text: Nice lightweight cleanser, good for every day use. Love that it doesn’t have a scent.

reviews.product_name: Green Clean Makeup Removing Cleansing Balm
reviews.review_text: Works really well, leaves your skin feeling soft, the scent is lovely. However, it did bother my eyes. Wouldn’t recommend using it on the eyes.

reviews.review_text: Works really well, leaves your skin feeling soft, the scent is lovely. However, it did bother my eyes. Wouldn’t recommend using it on the eyes.

reviews.product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C
reviews.review_text: Great lip mask! This product make my lips very soft. The smell is also amazing.

reviews.review_title: Great exfoliant for a smooth skin.
reviews.review_text: Great product! Purchased the liquid exfoliant for the second time. My skin looks more smooth with less impurities. Unfortunately my blackheads and big  pores aren’t less.

reviews.product_name: Cicapair Tiger Grass Cream
reviews.review_text: this cream is my saving grace for my extremely sensitive skin!! I prefer this over the gel cream even though I’m not a fan of heavier creams. this is definitely a little bit on the denser side, and the smell is not for everyone (it’s refreshing but also gives off a medicated scent as if it’s healing my skin). I used this for 4 weeks along with the mist and serum in my night time skincare routine and it’s changed my skin. it is smoother, no breakouts, more glow and no more dullness. will be purchasing again and again! I received this as a complimentary product for testing purposes.

reviews.product_name: Cicapair Tiger Grass Serum
reviews.review_text: I think this product is a huge hit or a miss depending on the person. fortunately it worked so well for my extremely sensitive skin. I loveeee this product! I use it after applying toner and one pump of this is enough to keep my skin looking healthy. I noticed improvements with my overall complexion after about two weeks. also in love with the scent. I received this as a complimentary product for testing purposes.

reviews.product_name: Vegan Milk Moisturizer
reviews.review_title: Great moisturizer for the winter time
reviews.review_text: To start off, I have combination skin but it turns extremely dry in the wintertime cause I live in Chicago. The packaging is so beautiful and really stands out alongside my other skincare bottles. The only thing I personally don’t like is the consistency.. it reminds me of a body butter and I prefer my creams to be moisturizing but more on the lightweight side. It’s fragrance-free which is amazing for my sensitive skin and really is hydrating, but I think I have yet to see any other mindblowing results. I use it in the morning on days where I’m not wearing make up and my face only starts to feel a tad dry when it hits the 5-6 hour mark. Overall it’s a great daily moisturizer, and I think the formula would help ladies who have really dry and sensitive skin. I received this product as a free sample.

reviews.product_name: Oat Cleansing Balm
reviews.review_text: This balm is pretty fantastic for dry skin even though it is sometimes a little hard to work with. For me to remove make up with it, I have to make sure my face is pretty damp before hand unlike other cleansing balms and then I work it into the skin. It does take a little while to come out too and its hard to wash off. But if you use it as part of a double cleanse, it works smoothly and fantastically while leaving your skin feeling nourished and hydrated. Its also an amazing value especially for a good quality vegan product. I highly suggest trying this out and giving it a chance for some of the difficulties of use.

reviews.product_name: Mini Oat Cleansing Balm
reviews.review_text: This balm is pretty fantastic for dry skin even though it is sometimes a little hard to work with. For me to remove make up with it, I have to make sure my face is pretty damp before hand unlike other cleansing balms and then I work it into the skin. It does take a little while to come out too and its hard to wash off. But if you use it as part of a double cleanse, it works smoothly and fantastically while leaving your skin feeling nourished and hydrated. Its also an amazing value especially for a good quality vegan product. I highly suggest trying this out and giving it a chance for some of the difficulties of use.

reviews.product_name: Luna Sleeping Retinoid Night Oil
reviews.review_text: Its an oil that smells great and honestly it does feel like it gave me a glow. I loved the overall effect but I can’t give it 5 stars knowing the price. There are cheaper products that could give you similar results.

reviews.product_name: Rose & Hyaluronic Acid Deep Hydration Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I absolutely love this cream, it smells amazing if you like rose and it has the most luxurious feel on the skin that I’ve ever had with a cream. I have very sensitive skin and this never irritates it. I knock one star off because even though it is advertised as a very hydrating cream, its actually more like a light gel cream. It melts on great and its fantastic if you already have oily skin or for use as a day cream but it wont work as a night cream for dry skin. I ordered it hoping that it would be a nice and nighttime moisturizer for my combination skin and basically got a gel cream thats almost like a high end and nicer neutrogena hydroboost. I highly recommend it for oily skin, combination skin or anybody wanting a nice experience from their moisturizer. Especially if you want a light moisturizer that soaks into the skin quickly and leaves you feeling hydrated and fresh. However its just not enough for dry skin and I as someone with combination skin, wake up with dry patches if I only use this.

reviews.product_name: Pure Skin Face Cleanser
reviews.review_text: I used to use this all the time before I got acne and it was AMAZING. I don’t use it anymore because I use an acne cleanser but if you don’t suffer from acne, highly recommend this product

reviews.product_name: Cleansing & Exfoliating Wipes
reviews.review_text: I love this product and how it takes EVERYTHING off and leaves my skin feeling very soft and smooth. It doesn’t break me out either and I have acne prone skin. Only thing is it irritates my eyes but I’m willing to over look that if it means my skin won’t break out!

reviews.product_name: The Deep Cleanse Gentle Exfoliating Cleanser
reviews.review_text: This cleanser is my go-to. It’s pricey but you need very little and the 150ml bottle lasted me around 6 months. Worth it. I normally try to save money where I can and  previously bought a cheaper cleanser, but my face broke out severely over night. I had a trial size of this tatcha cleanser that I immediately switched to and within 3-4 days, even my most stubborn acne from before my big break out cleared up. It’s not even marketed for acne but I encourage people to try this. I’ve used cera ve, murad, you name it. Nothing worked like this. Exfoliates well without over drying or irritating the skin. It’s also the only cleanser that doesn’t irritate my skin after getting my face waxed! It is so gentle yet effective. I’ve used this about a year now and I will never switch to anything else. Just bought the 300ml bottle!

reviews.product_name: Double Serum Firming & Smoothing Anti-Aging Concentrate
reviews.review_text: Received this from influenster in the form of pre measured packets. The packets had two compartments that when broken open needed to be mixed together. The product is applied by warming in your hands and pressing it onto your face. Not sure how trilled I am for the extra warming/activating/mixing step but the product itself is very nice. My skin felt hydrated and smooth after applying. I also used the Clarins extra firming energy cream after and both products have been refreshing together.

reviews.product_name: Smart Clinical Repair Wrinkle Correcting Eye Cream
reviews.review_title: Looking forward to long term use
reviews.review_text: I received this as promotional for Influenster and I have been using it for about three weeks. The campaign almost doesn’t allow for enough time to leave an accurate review as it is closing next week. I will say I do like this product. It has a perfect consistency. It is thick and creamy and applies smooth and evenly without being greasy. I don’t have any major concerns and cannot attest for long term effectiveness, but I will say for now I very much enjoy using this product as part of ever day routine.

reviews.product_name: Advanced Night Repair Eye Gel-Cream
reviews.review_text: Tiny bottle packs a punch. The consistency of this eye gel is superior. A very tiny dap goes to amazing lengths at covering the eye area. This has been a very much welcome addition to my routine.

reviews.product_name: Smart Clinical Repair Wrinkle Correcting Eye Cream
reviews.review_title: My New Holy Grail Eye Cream
reviews.review_text: I received a #freeproduct sample from #Topbox for my honest review. The sample was too small to review long term effects but I was able to stretch it out to use morning and evening for four days. The scent is very mild, pleasant and not perfumey. The texture is a big positive to as thicker creams tend to sit too long without fully absorbing & end up running into my eyes no matter how carefully applied, resulting in irritation. This one is more liquid than any eye cream I’ve ever tried & quickly absorbs without wandering around where it doesn’t belong. It’s creamy, not at all greasy, and left my skin soft, looking plumped up & hydrated. The result did reduce the look of fine lines & wrinkles, leaving an overall youth-ier appearance.

reviews.product_name: Smart Clinical Repair Wrinkle Correcting Cream
reviews.review_text: I received #freeproduct sample from #Topbox for my honest review. The sample was too small to review long term effects. I was also testing a different product & there are more steps in my evening skin care routine so I used this as my main daytime moisturizer. My skin is combination with an oiler T-zone so it’s difficult to find products that provide adequate hydration for aging skin without being too greasy. This did the trick and has a silky texture that absorbed quickly & left my skin feeling very soft. Anyone with dry skin might need another product in addition to this to achieve adequate moisturizing. My tinted winter sunscreen is a fairly thick consistency & was able to glide over this cream easily without pilling. The mild barely-there scent is good. The only reason I won’t be purchasing the full size is the price point vs. results. It’s a lovely product but didn’t wow me. For those who purchase high end skincare this is definitely worth giving a try.

reviews.product_name: Smart Clinical Repair Wrinkle Correcting Serum
reviews.review_text: I received #freeproduct sample from #Topbox for my honest review. It was disappointing it was so small for this serum, in particular, as it claims to be as effective as one laser treatment over 16 weeks. The sample I received was enough for three daytime applications. It went on smoothly, and while at first I thought it was going to be greasy, it absorbed well. The other products layered on top easily. I had no adverse effects as I’ve used a retinoids and vitamin C regularly for years and wear sunscreen with high SPF daily. The price point is the biggest thing holding me back from purchasing a full size bottle. All together, my other serums, retinoid & Vitamin C are still far cheaper than this combination product. For those seeking a powerful one-step alternative and are willing to bear the cost, I’d recommend this serum.

reviews.product_name: Moisturizing Eye Bomb with Squalane
reviews.review_text: I absolutely love this eye cream! I have very sensitive, combination skin and so I don’t like products that leave my skin too oily or too dry. This product was perfect in the middle, dried down fairly quickly but left my eye area super moisturized and soft. I highly recommend trying this and I am definitely going to purchase again. I did receive this product complimentary from Influenster.

reviews.product_name: Protini Polypeptide Firming Refillable Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: This is the best moisturizer I’ve used! I have super sensitive skin and my skin is very dry but gets very oily by the end of the day and this moisturizer just works perfectly!

reviews.product_name: Magic Cream Moisturizer with Hyaluronic Acid
reviews.review_text: I recently received this moisturizer and I have been using it daily. I have really sensitive skin and it has been great for me! I was going through some issues where my skin had been very dry prior to this and the magic cream helped immensely. Highly recommend

reviews.review_text: Love this!!  I am absolutely in love with this product. It’s moisturizing and leaves my skin so soft and looks radiant and just so pretty. Reduced the appearance of fine lines.

reviews.product_name: Pure Skin Face Cleanser
reviews.review_text: I was unexpectedly impressed with this cleanser.  I have sensitive, acne prone skin and have used about a million different skin care systems.  I finally landed on an Olay cleanser that I thought I was happy with until I received this one in the December 500 point perk box.  The texture of this is perfect, creamy with a great lather.  The smell is kinda icky, but since it’s fragrance free, I can deal with that.  But the best part is that it cleans off every last molecule of makeup, even my hardest-to-remove mascara and foundation without drying my skin and washes off without leaving behind any residue.  The best part is that after a week, I haven’t had any reaction or product break out, so I think this is my new go-to daily cleanser!

reviews.product_name: Retinol Reform Treatment Serum
reviews.review_title: The Best Retinol I’ve Ever Used
reviews.review_text: I was honestly a bit skeptical to try this as I have never had much luck with retinol products. They are either too strong and cause major skin irritation, or not strong enough and make zero difference. I have persistent milia that will not go away and an esthetician suggested I try this one and holy smokes does it ever work perfectly. The effects were quite quick for me, and all my milia had disappeared within one week. After 1 month of use, my skin is smooth, clear and evenly toned. Best of all, it is never dehydrated, red or irritated. Retinol Reform absolutely lives up to they hype (at least for me) and I would highly recommend giving it a try if you’ve not yet had luck with a retinol product.

reviews.review_text: i’ve had pore issues around my t-zone and this serum worked wonders! i bought it based on reviews and i’m so glad i did. it has a minty fresh smell and it absorbs quickly. i’ve used this product for less than a week and i’ve already seen results. two pumps is more than enough for an entire t-zone so the product will probably last a good amount of time. would definitely recommend!

reviews.review_text: I am new to Algenist products, but have read about how great their line is. This was gifted by Algenist and since then, I have instantly become a huge fan. My undereye circles and bags have become really prominent as I have gotten older. After using this for about 10 days, I’ve noticed a serious difference in my undereyes every morning. The texture is smooth and thick + a little goes a long way. The tub is small, but I know it will last me awhile. We’ll see how this progresses over time, but so far I’m excited!

reviews.product_name: Glowscreen Sunscreen SPF 40 PA+++ with Hyaluronic Acid + Niacinamide
reviews.review_text: I am truly OBSESSED with this sunscreen. I use Supergoop in my everyday routine already, but with the glow + tinted version, it has completely changed my makeup routine. I live in a hotter climate and the “no makeup, makeup” look is preferred. If layered with makeup, it definitely gives you a glow from within.

reviews.review_text: Wow, have always loved their products and was eager to try this. I applied 1 time in the morning and  1 time at night. My skin texture was noticeably smoother, and I have pretty sensitive skin. The texture of the product is not sticky and that was a concern of mine. I’ll continue to use as time goes on.

reviews.product_name: A-Passioni Retinol Cream
reviews.review_text: Amazing product. After just a few days of use I woke up with baby smooth, even skin that made me say “wow“ out loud to myself in the mirror (actually).

reviews.product_name: Luminous Dewy Skin Mist
reviews.review_text: I’ve tried a lot of facial mists over the years, and this is the first and only that not only hydrates my skin but makes a *visible* difference. This makes me look like I just stepped out of the pond in Tuck Everlasting and then was promptly sprinkled with the finest of fairy dusts. Worth the price.

reviews.product_name: F-Balm Electrolyte Waterfacial Mask
reviews.review_text: Layering this on top of (any) exfoliating acid is my favourite skincare combo. Always wake up with plump, even skin.

reviews.product_name: Alpha Beta Extra Strength Daily Peel Pads
reviews.review_text: I really love these! Received as a sample in a subscription box. Didn’t plan on loving them as much as I do - but I’m shocked at the amount of resurfacing I get w/ this product, honestly - this brand in general. I love the liquid resurfacing peel, but the travel friendly version in the dailies is amazing! I’ll admit the price is more than I want to pay, but they work so well that I will fork out the cash for them. I don’t often say that - if it’s bad or mediocre I pass. This is good stuff!!!!! I love direct acids for the face, and this product does more for my skin and discoloration than anything I’ve ever used. Be sure to add SPF in the mornings after using as they make you more sun sensitive! If you’re not going to take that time - you make want to skip these. But, if you use them as directed in conjunction w/ SPF - you will love the results. Next sale, I’m stocking UP! ;)

reviews.product_name: Auto Correct Brightening + Depuffing Eye Cream for Dark Circles
reviews.review_text: I really like this product. I’m obsessed with the ICE Moisturizing cream and was also sent this eye cream to try. I really think it’s only a day time appropriate product and therefore, I had to take off a star. I suppose you could use it at night as well, but I just don’t really want something shiny at night. This has a luminosity to it that I feel is beautiful under concealer for day time. I love the caffeine and I do feel that it helps to de-puff my undereyes. However, I think also that I wouldn’t use caffeine in that area before sleeping. I just see this as a daytime eye treatment, and that is fine by me. However, it could be a bit misleading by the name. It does have wonderful actives like horse chestnut and ginseng!Now then, if you are ok with this price point knowing that you will either need a separate eye product at night or use your moisturizer up under your eyes, then absolutely do what works best for YOU! I personally haven’t had any issues doing just that, this cream in the morning and my moisturizer or oil around the eyes at night. And by using it only in the morning, I really LOVE the formula and it certainly does aid in depuffing and brightening my eyes. I don’t know what’s up with all the puffiness all of a sudden, but my gosh am I puffy! I don’t really get terrible dark circles, but I have some darkness and undereye wrinkles which I will have to update on if they diminish over the use of this bottle!

reviews.product_name: ICE Ceramide Moisturizer with Vitamin F
reviews.review_title: No, really, out of all of them - this is THE ONE!
reviews.review_text: I am EXTREMELY and pleasantly surprised by how much I love this moisturizer! I was sent this product to try, but honestly, I was skeptical. Boy, was I wrong, horribly and shockingly wrong!Here’s why: I have searched far and wide for a moisturizer that is intensely moisturizing without being greasy and this is the one! I can’t get over how hydrated my skin is with this product. Again, it’s hydrated and plump with NO GREASE, NO SHINE, NO OIL! I noticed that recommended skin types do not include oily skin, so perhaps if that is you, you might want a different moisturizer. But, if you are dry, normal or perhaps a combination skin, this product is bloody amazing! I was prepared to be like Meh. But, instead, I’m like “place in cart!“ Strengthens the barrier with ceramides and aids with fine lines and wrinkles, loss of firmness and elasticity, and dullness and uneven texture. Those are seriously my problem areas, so SOLD! Also, for anyone wondering, this product is going to last for a very long time! It seems to be so thick that it takes very little. The price tag on this one I feel is reasonable for something that truly works and will last a while! Side note: smells a bit like almond/cherry, but very mild and supposedly all natural scent! No heavy fragrance - we LOVE THAT! ;)

reviews.product_name: Natural Moisturizing Factors + HA
reviews.review_text: Great Moisturizer I am so prone to milia, and that you have to have them extracted. Most heavy creams cause me to get these. This cream does not. It went on well, it absorbed well and my skin feels really soft and smooth. I have ordered other products but I’m having to get them directly from the company. I do wish the bottle was bigger.

reviews.product_name: Lactic Acid 10% + HA 2% Exfoliating Serum
reviews.review_text: I love this! My skin is flawless! I had an IPL photofacial. As soon as it healed, I started using this at night. No more tiny zits, just smooth skin.

reviews.product_name: Cleansing & Exfoliating Wipes
reviews.review_text: I really like these! I’ve tried almost all the different scents that they have. The best ones are definitely: watermelon, cucumber & coconut. They do cost a little more than other makeup wipes (the ones I was buying before are $5-$7) but I like to treat myself and get these sometimes. They not only smell amazing but do a good job at removing ALL my makeup. If you haven’t tried these, you should!

reviews.product_name: Lip Glowy Balm
reviews.review_text: I really like this! I wasn’t sure if I would or not because I heard that it’s quite different from the Lip Sleeping Mask. In my opinion, it is different but not significantly different. It’s pretty much the same ingredients, but this is less thick and more glossy. It smells pretty good and the berry one even gives a bit of a pink tint to my lips. I was worried I would use up the tube super quickly because it looks so small, but I’ve had my tube for 5 months now. I don’t use it every day though, I use it about once a week. This product also lasts for a long time once applied, you only need to reapply every 3 or 4 hours which is great. When I run out, I will be repurchasing!

reviews.product_name: Pure Skin Face Cleanser
reviews.review_text: This cleanser is the best! I’ve tried so many different face cleansers and nothing compares to this. It doesn’t dry my skin, in fact every time after I use it my skin is left feeling super soft and fresh. It has basically no scent, it does lather up but definitely doesn’t take the moisture away from your skin! The first time I got this it was given to me as a gift and I didn’t think I would really like it. But I’m so glad I did. I usually get the smaller (2 oz) size and the tube lasts me 4-5 months. I use it every day too. It’s not overly expensive and gets the job done. I wish I had known about this cleanser sooner, I’ll be sticking with it from now on because it’s just that good!

reviews.product_name: 5 Stars Retinol + Niacinamide Eye Serum
reviews.review_text: I am loving this eye cream so far. It is very gentle retinol and makes my under eye dark circles and bags more concealable and less noticeable in the morning. My eyes look more moisturized and awake when I wake up. I love this and it is helping me prevent aging I use it about every other day.

reviews.product_name: Floral Recovery Overnight Mask with Squalane
reviews.review_text: I loved this mask it was super gentle for my sensitive skin. I put it on before bed and it made my skin feel very hydrated and moisturized when I woke up. I love it. It is very rich and smooth in texture and massages oh well.

reviews.product_name: Watermelon Glow Niacinamide Sunscreen SPF 50
reviews.review_text: I love this face SPF lotion. It doesn’t have your typical sunscreen white cast or greasy feel to it, and it applies really smoothly under my makeup. It did not feel greasy at all and smells super good. It kept my skin protected when I went to the beach and it did not break me out which is a win because my skin is sensitive and breaks out easy.

reviews.product_name: The Dewy Serum Resurfacing and Plumping Treatment
reviews.review_text: I highly recommend this product for several reasons. First it saved my dry skin! Too it’s very lightweight but makes my skin feel like well hydrated. Also this product is long lasting.Finally, it plumps my skin as advertised , making my fine lines less visible. I honestly believe every skin type, young or mature, would benefit from using this product.

reviews.product_name: Magic Cream Moisturizer with Hyaluronic Acid
reviews.review_text: I need a moisturizer that stays with me all day to keep my skin moist and healthy. This is the first cream I’ve found that truly does that without feeling the least bit heavy or greasy.     I was totally surprised at how well it absorbed and how soft my skin felt, even after one or two uses. My face feels a little tighter since using it.          I highly recommend!!

reviews.product_name: Confidence in a Cream Anti-Aging Hydrating Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I received a sample of this very, very high end product called “Confidence in a Cream“ and it was truly magical in the way it made my face feel and look. 1. It is creamy and applies to the skin without dragging or pulling. It does not leave your skin feeling greasy or heavy.2. It has a clean smell.3. It has not caused irritation or break out - which is pretty impressive considering my skin is sensitive to new products.4. I feel like it holds moisture into my skin all day. I no longer have to reapply moisturizer mid-day because of my dry skin.5. Makes my skin feel soft and look fresh and dewy.I highly, recommend this moisturizer. I use it every day, and yes I see a difference!!

reviews.product_name: Aqua Bomb Cleansing Balm
reviews.review_text: The belif aqua bomb cleansing bomb was really fun to use and I liked the feel of the product changing texture when you work it into your skin. The formula helped take my makeup off with ease, and left my skin feeling moisturized after cleansing. I would recommend this to anyone who wants the properties of a cleanser but doesn’t want to dry out their face.

reviews.product_name: Volcanic AHA Pore Clearing Clay Mask
reviews.review_text: The texture of the clay mask is AMAZING! It’s a paste but goes on so smoothly, with some textured pieces for light exfoliation. It didn’t irritate my skin, but gave me a tingling sensation, and made my face feel so clean. The scent is subtle but pleasant. #freeproduct #trywithtopbox

reviews.product_name: Moisture Surge 100H Auto-Replenishing Hydrator Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I really enjoyed using this moisturizer - Clinique never fails to disappoint. The formula was light, and hydrating, easy to work into my skin, and left my luminous but not greasy. I applied it before bed but I’m sure it would be a good base under makeup too, to keep it looking fresh and hydrated during the day.

reviews.product_name: Watermelon Glow PHA + BHA Pore-Tight Toner
reviews.review_text: I absolutely love it! It smells so good and it is so relaxing. The packaging is adorable and the product itself it’s great! My skin has been looking great since I started wearing it.

reviews.product_name: Mini Watermelon Glow PHA + BHA Pore-Tight Toner
reviews.review_text: I absolutely love it! It smells so good and it is so relaxing. The packaging is adorable and the product itself it’s great! My skin has been looking great since I started wearing it.

reviews.product_name: GOOPGLOW 15% Glycolic Acid Overnight Glow Peel
reviews.review_text: I was very hesitant about trying this product because I had heard that it hurt some people however it worked like a charm for me. I absolutely loved it! My skin was looking so amazing and glowing the next day! The packaging was adorable and while it did sting a little, it was not bad at all and totally worth it. I’d say it really depends on your skin type whether you should use it or not, if you have sensitive skin it might not be the best move.

reviews.product_name: Skinlongevity Long Life Herb Anti-Aging Face Serum
reviews.review_text: It is amazing! The packaging is gorgeous, it smells delicious and my skin has been feeling amazing ever since I started using it. And on top of everything, ITS VEGAN!  I completely recommend!

reviews.product_name: Protini Polypeptide Firming Refillable Moisturizer
reviews.review_title: ask for samples or buy it but you need to try it!
reviews.review_text: This moisturizer has turned my skin into perfect flawless skin. I cannot express how much I love it! I have combination, sensitive acne prone skin and most moisturizer tent to either be too dry or too oily for me. I tried Belif aqua bomb and it was good but after a while it broke me out, also tried tatcha water cream and it wasn’t moisturizing enough and cause breakouts as well. This one hasn’t done any of that. It has cleared my acne like magic and makes it so soft and plump! I feel like no matter what I get oily during the day BUT this one has also helped with that! I love the fact that it has no silicones or any harsh ingredients. With the results you get you won’t even care about the price! Worth every penny. I have found my holy grail moisturizer!! And I couldn’t be happier with the results.

reviews.product_name: AHA 30% + BHA 2% Exfoliating Peeling Solution
reviews.review_text: I’ve used this about 4 times and I already love it! The price is what led me to it at first. Then the results got me to repurchase a few more bottles. Even my husband loves it. It tingles a little when applied but once i wash it off my face feels incredibly soft! And it helps with acne scars. Also noticed my pores look smaller. Definitely recommended this to a few people already because of how good it works. And for this price honestly it’s amazing.

reviews.product_name: Glycolic Acid 7% Exfoliating Toning Solution
reviews.review_title: didn’t work for my face but…
reviews.review_text: I’ve been using natural deodorant for the past few years, and though I like it; it doesn’t really keep me from sweating which can cause odor :( but I started using this right after I shower and let me just say this is like a deodorant in toner form. I literally don’t stink at all! Even after sweating all day and being from Arizona you know that happens a lot. Also noticed my underarms look lighter and smoother than before, also helps me prevent ingrown hairs. I honestly recommend this to everyone. Specially if you’re like me who uses natural deodorant and maybe even not use one at all!

reviews.product_name: Avocado Fine Line Eye Cream with Retinol
reviews.review_text: Not sure what the hype is about. I used this product overnight and didn’t see any results. The texture feels nice and the little spoon it comes with is super cute, but it doesn’t depuff or moisturize like I thought it would. I didn’t see any difference at all. Really disappointed after reading so many good reviews.

reviews.product_name: The Serum Stick: Treatment & Touch Up Balm
reviews.review_text: This is an interesting product. I haven’t seen a concept like it before. The stick is nice for under-eye hydration when you need a quick fix throughout the day without ruining your makeup. My eye area usually gets pretty dry, even when I apply eye cream every morning, so it’s nice to have this as an option. The stick is silky smooth and glides on really easily. It provides ok hydration, nothing super lasting though. I would say this isn’t a must have to keep in my skincare collection, but it’s nice to have.

reviews.product_name: Capture Totale Super Potent Eye Serum
reviews.review_title: Like, but not for a second purchase
reviews.review_text: I’ve used this product every day for several weeks now to give it a fair go and review. Here are my pros: very hydrating for someone who has dryer skin under eyes; love the metal tip for a cooling sensation when applying; formula is light, not tacky, and absorbs quickly; I think it helps a little with diminishing the look of crows feet. Here’s what I dislike: I wish there was a better way to control the product coming out—I often feel like too much squeezes out and I’m wasting product; I haven’t seen any help depuffing (which I need and was looking forward to); the product has added fragrance, which I find totally unnecessary; overall haven’t seen any major results. Bottom line is that this is a glorified hydrator and not much else. I do like it, but I don’t think it’s worth a second purchase.

reviews.product_name: C-Firma Fresh Vitamin-C Day Serum
reviews.review_text: Love that you get to mix the product on your own so the efficacy of the product is effective the minute you mix it and will last. You don’t have to worry how long it’s been sitting on the shelf. The product absorbs nicely into the skin. At first it feels tacky on the skin but then it absorbs and feels great. I will wait longer to comment on the brightening effect, but so far I would definitely recommend this serum!

reviews.product_name: Indigo Overnight Repair Serum in Cream Treatment
reviews.review_text: I am very impressed with this cream. Not only is the packaging luxurious from the weightiness of the jar, but the cream is silky, yet thick and a little goes a long way. I have mild roasacea and this product absolutely delivers in terms of minimizing redness. It’s gentle, yet effective and makes my sensitive skin feel nourished in the morning. The only critique I have is that I wish there was a place on the jar to keep the spatula, but even that is not enough to demote a star. It’s 5/5 for me— I will be a repeat customer and will most likely explore other Tatcha products after discovering my love for this product.

reviews.product_name: Mini Indigo Overnight Repair Serum in Cream Treatment
reviews.review_text: I am very impressed with this cream. Not only is the packaging luxurious from the weightiness of the jar, but the cream is silky, yet thick and a little goes a long way. I have mild roasacea and this product absolutely delivers in terms of minimizing redness. It’s gentle, yet effective and makes my sensitive skin feel nourished in the morning. reviews.product_name: Squalane + Omega Repair Deep Hydration Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I’ve tried the Biossance squalane oil and wasn’t very impressed, so I wasn’t sure what to expect with this moisturizer. I’m actually pleasantly surprised with the level of hydration it provides. I’ve been using it for about a week now and my skin feels supple and hydrated. My only complaint is that there is a very faint unpleasant smell when the product emulsifies in your hands as it absorbs on your face. I can’t describe it, but it’s very odd. Other than that, I’ve been enjoying it! Thanks, Influenster for providing this product complimentary to try!

reviews.product_name: Beste No. 9 Jelly Cleanser
reviews.review_text: I was skeptical at first since my skin is sensitive, but I found that Beste No.9 did not strip oil from my skin. It did feel clean and my makeup was gone. No overbearing fragrance and it did the job.

reviews.product_name: T.L.C. Framboos Glycolic Resurfacing Night Serum
reviews.review_text: First off this is a pricy product, but if you can only afford to spend one one amazing product then TLC Framboos Night Serum is the only one to buy. It is a bit strong so I use it about every third night. I have seen a dramatic difference in my skin and also has even out my skin tone.

reviews.product_name: Lala Retro Whipped Refillable Moisturizer with Ceramides
reviews.review_text: I have somewhat sensitive skin, but read so many positive reviews that I was excited to try this product. It is pricy but so worth the money. My skin is so much more hydrated and supple looking. My skin tone has improved and no dry patches from the cold weather.

reviews.product_name: C-Tango Vitamin C Eye Cream
reviews.review_text: I have loved all of the Drunk Elephant products so far. This is the only one I didn’t see any difference with my under eye circles or darkness. I will continue using to see if it does improve later down the road. Feels good going on but no results.

reviews.product_name: Protini Polypeptide Firming Refillable Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I use this cream at night and when I wake up my skin feels like brand new. I haven’t had skin this soft in years!  It doesn’t sting or irritate my skin at all. There is no odor to the cream and it glides on beautifully. I love the pump on the jar...no dipping fingers into the jar. Love this cream!!

reviews.product_name: B-Hydra Intensive Hydration Serum with Hyaluronic Acid
reviews.review_text: This is like a drink of water for your skin. I have dry skin and when I apply this, my skin soaks it in and feels so nice. It isn’t greasy at all and it works so well with either the La La cream or the Protini cream. I can’t say enough good about this gel.

reviews.product_name: D-Bronzi Anti-Pollution Bronzing Drops with Peptides
reviews.review_text: Another winner from Drunk Elephant!!  This is the perfect serum to mix in with a moisturizer or oil to get a natural bronzy glow. You can make it as light or as dark as you want. Love love love it!!

reviews.product_name: Ultra Facial Moisturizing Cream with Squalane
reviews.review_text: Great product if you want something natural but refined and basic as it gets. This cream is very light weight and has a lot of hydration retention. Perfect for living conditions where there’s humidity, if you live in a dry climate it’s not enough. Smells like the smell “nothing”, still a smell, but completely goes away when applied and massaged in.

reviews.product_name: Mini Ultra Facial Moisturizing Cream with Squalane
reviews.review_text: Great product if you want something natural but refined and basic as it gets. This cream is very light weight and has a lot of hydration retention. reviews.product_name: Creamy Eye Treatment with Avocado
reviews.review_text: You have to try this product. It was made with an oil molecule that had water trapped inside of it, so it originally applies really thick but then breaks down super thin. It’s best when you apply it super thick on the eye area and let it do its thing! Wonderful if you use quite a bit as an “eye mask/heavy treatment”. Smells like nothing leaves the skin a little wet and extremely hydrated.

reviews.product_name: Midnight Recovery Concentrate Moisturizing Face Oil
reviews.review_title: Smells incredible and leaves skin feeling it
reviews.review_text: If you love your skin, you’ll get this product. Light weight, not greasy, doesn’t make you break out, only enhances your skin and leaves it dewy, glowy, and soft. Helps reduce redness and heal breakouts really well. Not enough moisture on its own, definitely needs something on top of it. Smells like a special lavender blend not just lavender but it’s really present.
