reviews.review_text: I used the Smart Clinical Repair Wrinkle Correcting Eye Cream for approximately a week and was pleasantly surprised with the consistency of the cream which was light and did not leave a residue as with most eye creams.  I am hopeful with extended use of this product it would visibly improve fine lines and dark circles. #freeproduct

reviews.product_name: Smart Clinical Repair Wrinkle Correcting Cream
reviews.review_text: I used the Clinic Smart Clinical Repair Wrinkle Correcting Cream for approximately one week at nighttime.  The cream was rich in texture however when applied was light and creamy.  My skin did feel smoother after one week and I believe with prolonged use would reduce my fine lines and wrinkles. I am excited that this cream is now part of Clinique’s advanced de aging line. #freeproduct

reviews.product_name: Smart Clinical Repair Wrinkle Correcting Serum
reviews.review_title: A new addition to my skincare routine!
reviews.review_text: After using this product for approximately a week, I was pleasantly surprised how my skin felt, smoother and tighter. My skin was well moisturized for the day and my make up applied well over the cream. I will be adding this product to my skincare routine.  #freeproduct

reviews.product_name: B-Hydra Intensive Hydration Serum with Hyaluronic Acid
reviews.review_text: honestly amazing my skin is so hydrated from using this product

reviews.product_name: T.L.C. Sukari Babyfacial AHA + BHA Mask
reviews.review_text: I use this every Sunday night and my skin has never felt or looked better!!!!

reviews.product_name: D-Bronzi Anti-Pollution Bronzing Drops with Peptides
reviews.review_text: this makes you look like you just got back from the beach without the harmful uv rays!

reviews.product_name: T.L.C. Framboos Glycolic Resurfacing Night Serum
reviews.review_text: I’ve used this every other day for a week and let me tell you, I won’t ever stop using this for as long as it works for me. I’ve had terrible acne all my life, and my scarring has significantly diminished. I also have less dry, flaking patches than usual, but I’ve also been using Sunday Riley UFO oil and the DE whipped moisturizer so I can’t for sure say it’s this, but I’m sure it’s contributing. The product is very slippy, meaning one small pump easily covers the whole face without tugging the product around in the slightest. No scents on ant if the DE products I’ve tried, which is nice. Overall, amazing.

reviews.product_name: U.F.O. Salicylic Acid BHA Acne Treatment Face Oil
reviews.review_text: I have never had clear skin for more than a day at a time (for me, clear still means small bumps, just not the cystic acne I usually have) I wash my face every day, use face masks, etc and do everything I can to make it clear. I picked this up during along with some Drunk Elephant skincare the VIB sale and have been using it for one week. My skin isn’t dry where I use this, like when I use spot treatments like the Origins one, but I don’t have new breakouts, I just have some left over that I’m still battling. Besides the pungent been smell that lingers for about 15 minutes, I have no complaints. I’ve almost never shown bare face photos before, especially showcasing acne, but I can now because I am happy with where it is now. I will forever repurchase.

reviews.product_name: B-Hydra Intensive Hydration Serum with Hyaluronic Acid
reviews.review_text: Right off the bat, if you are really dry you won’t like this. It is not hydrating enough by itself even for me with combo skin. However, someone more oily may really like this. It would work really well under makeup, since it absorbs quickly and doesn’t leave any greasy/wet residue, so makeup will apply without any streaks or lines that might occur with something thicker. I like to use this mixed with something heavier or under an oil, or as a moisturizer I can put on in the middle of the day if I need something a little more. I love Drunk Elephant products and they make up most of my skincare routine, but I think I would splurge on one of their other items instead of an okay moisturizer that you could find a more effective one elsewhere. (I have a mini that came in a kit that I’m not mad at, but I would recommend trying a trial version in a pack with their other products to test it out first if you’re really dead set on this one)

reviews.product_name: T.L.C. Sukari Babyfacial AHA + BHA Mask
reviews.review_text: Rake it with a grain of salt because this is only my second time using it, but I read a lot of reviews and have a couple things to say that I didn’t see.1. It smells like PlayDoh. Not necessarily a good or bad thing, but just to prepare you.2. It tastes like PlayDoh. This is not pleasant. Do your best to not accidentally get it on your lips.3. You will feel burning on every single microscopic abrasion on your face. I wouldn’t use this if you pick at your face, pop pimples frequently, or soon after exfoliating with a physical exfoliant unless it’s very gentle because it does hurt quite a bit, but foes away after it sirs for a minute or so.That being said, I think it did make an instantaneous change in the softness of my skin to the touch. It felt very smooth and soft right after I rinsed it off, which doesn’t happen often since I struggle with acne. I haven’t used it much so I can’t say any continuous effects it has/will have on acne, but I do like it.

reviews.product_name: Luna Sleeping Retinoid Night Oil
reviews.review_text: I liked this product when I was using it. It didn’t help or hurt my acne, but I have chronically red skin, especially on my cheeks and T zone, and after only a few uses it started helping diminish that. I can’t use it since I added AHA and BHA products in my skincare  (the warnings say not to use with any retinols which this is) and I figured I’d play it safe and just stick to one and switch up routines every once in a while. It has a distinct herbal/mintish smell which I started liking after a couple uses, but it is noticeable for a while after application. Overall, it’s pretty good.

reviews.product_name: Virgin Marula Luxury Face Oil
reviews.review_text: I got a couple of these in sets I bought around the holidays. I use it pretty often because I have it, but I haven’t seen a huge difference in my skin because of this in particular. I used 100% argan and 100% jojoba oil and really liked those just as much, which are both cheaper. This is a little lighter feeling than some other oil alternatives, so it depends what you’re looking for, but I wanted to love this and it just hasn’t been a miracle product for me unfortunately. I still enjoy it, but wouldn’t necessarily repurchase.

reviews.product_name: The Rice Wash Skin-Softening Cleanser
reviews.review_title: Great cleanser, dry skin after though
reviews.review_text: Its a great cleanser no doubt. I feel very refreshed and cleansed after, however my skin feels VERY tight and dry after. Kinda disappointed, because I was hoping it was going to be a dewy finish, but I suppose it never claimed that. All my skincare products layer beautifully on top, and it did not break me out. Just wish it was more moisturizing! Smells great, but I do know fragrance is a huge irritant for most people. There is a slight exfoliation from the rice powder, but nothing too abrasive.

reviews.product_name: Mini Rice Wash Skin-Softening Cleanser
reviews.review_title: Great cleanser, dry skin after though
reviews.review_text: Its a great cleanser no doubt. I feel very refreshed and cleansed after, however my skin feels VERY tight and dry after. Kinda disappointed, because I was hoping it was going to be a dewy finish, but I suppose it never claimed that. All my skincare products layer beautifully on top, and it did not break me out. Just wish it was more moisturizing! Smells great, but I do know fragrance is a huge irritant for most people. There is a slight exfoliation from the rice powder, but nothing too abrasive.

reviews.product_name: Slaai  Makeup-Melting Butter Cleanser
reviews.review_text: This product may be marketed as unscented, but whatever the smell is, it smells like super glue or melted plastic. It does well to remove the day away and the sunscreen i wear, HOWEVER it leaves a greasy film over my face even when I’ve rinsed with water. It does go away when I use my double cleansing system. Don’t get it in your eyes, it made my vision very cloudy and it irritated them.

reviews.product_name: The Dewy Serum Resurfacing and Plumping Treatment
reviews.review_title: Great serum, wished it was bigger!
reviews.review_text: This serum is amazing. It goes on very smoothly (needed about 2 pumps for my whole face) and leaves me moisturized and glowing. My only gripe is that it is SO tiny, and honestly, it feels very light in my hand. Kinda wished it was made with maybe a glass bottle so at least it didn’t feel cheap in my hand! The serum speaks for itself, however.

reviews.product_name: Squalane + Omega Repair Deep Hydration Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I got this as prt of the skincare set that came with the Vit C oil and phyto-retinol serum. My skin loves this moisturizer! It looks glowy and smooth. The one thing I cannot get over is the SMELL. It smells like sweaty feet. The smell goes away, but it ruins it for me.

reviews.product_name: Aqua Bomb Overnight Lip Mask
reviews.review_text: This is a nice lip mask pretty mild pleasant scent and does the job at hydrating the lips. But I honestly don’t think it’s anything special and the price point is high for the amount of product you get. I think I will stick to my keys lip mask it’s Alicia keys line at Ulta and it’s amazing half the price for dbl the amount of product.

reviews.product_name: Santorini Grape Poreless Skin Cream
reviews.review_text: Really enjoyed this cream! It’s light weight and the scent is very mild. It gives the skin a nice hydrated look before makeup is a great base! Would def reccomend!

reviews.product_name: Urban Environment Oil-Free Sunscreen Broad-Spectrum SPF 42
reviews.review_text: I am in love with this sunscreen! It goes on without effort literally blends in like a dream!! No white case no pilling no patchiness under makeup! It had a nice light clean scent! If your like me and dispise other sunscreens this is the one for you! Get it you will not be disappointed!! I’m soo happy I was gifted this or I would have never even known about it I already ordered 2 more so I never run out!!!

reviews.product_name: Urban Environment Fresh-Moisture Sunscreen Broad-Spectrum SPF 42
reviews.review_text: This has become my all time favorite sunscreen in a matter of weeks!!!It is soo light weight and hydrating! Has a very mild clean scent!! Makes any makeup put on top of look beautiful!! Absorbes perfectly! There is literally not enough good things to say! If your on the fence it is worth it and you will not be disappointed!! And that’s coming from someone who hates almost all of the other sunscreens I’ve ever tried!!

reviews.review_text: I love this sunscreen! I used it on our recent trip to San Diego and it kept my skin protected very well. It’s a great consistency, sinks into the skin, and has a nice light scent. I would purchase this again when I run out.

reviews.review_text: received this product free for review. I likethe smell, it’s not sticky or oily and is definitely hydrating. Very lightweight! #complimentary

reviews.product_name: Vegan Milk Moisturizer
reviews.review_title: Dry and sensitive? Perfect for you
reviews.review_text: I have fairly dry skin, especially in the winter. This moisturizer kept my skin feeling good all day long. It’s not heavy or sticky feeling and does not have a very strong scent. I have very sensitive skin and typically only use moisturizer recommended by an association. However, this did not cause any Irritation!

reviews.product_name: Plum Plump Hyaluronic Acid Serum
reviews.review_text: This product is great if you want hydrated skin. I used it morning and night without any issues with oil. It also smells great

reviews.product_name: Advanced Night Repair Eye Gel-Cream
reviews.review_text: I wasn’t expecting a lot from this product as I have disappointed by eye creams in the past. however, I saw results with this one. It applied really well under eye and was not irritating. I noticed increased firmness.

reviews.product_name: Hyaluronic Acid Hydrating Serum
reviews.review_text: I’ve been using this serum for about two months and I am hooked.  My skin noticeably looks more plump and smooth.  I notice I am not as oily as I typically am.  It has this tacky feeling after it absorbs that I personally enjoy.  A little goes a long way and it has no scent. Love the simplicity of this serum.

reviews.product_name: Caffeine Eye Cream
reviews.review_text: So happy with this eye cream! The texture is gel like and it’s easy to apply under the eyes.  It spreads well and absorbs quickly.  I’ve noticed my dark circles are gone, and they’re less puffy in the AM.  I use this AM and PM.

reviews.product_name: Retinol Anti-Aging Serum
reviews.review_text: Newbie to retinol and very happy with my results.  This was my first retinol product that I tried.  I feel like I do see a noticeable difference in some smile lines and lines on my forehead.  I did notice some slight irritation around my nose which was very new for me as I rarely get little red bumps, it was almost like a rash.  So I discontinued using it everyday and did it every other day and it went away.  My skin overall feels and looks smoother.  I notice small bumps are no longer visible.  The scent kind of reminds me of turmeric or spices which I’ve grown used to.  I highly recommend if you’re trying retinol for the first time.  It’s a great introduction to it!

reviews.product_name: Vinoperfect Radiance Dark Spot Serum Vitamin C Alternative
reviews.review_text: I used this in conjunction with the Vinoperfect Brightening Essence. It absorbs fairly well, though it feels a little sticky (but in a moisturizing way). Others reported fantastic results that I just haven’t seen. In the end, for me the Resveratrol Lift Serum works much better. I do think this product is high-quality; building a good skincare regimen involves finding the product that works best for you, and I suspect this would work well for others.

reviews.product_name: Lip Glowy Balm
reviews.review_title: Nice shine, okay results, high price
reviews.review_text: A good shiny lip balm... which is something I can buy for half this price. The grapefruit has a light smell and negligible color. I am a big fan of the nighttime laneige lip mask, but that has a unique thickness that, for me, provides noteworthy results in lip softness, making it worth it’s cost. This one is pleasant enough, but not special. I will use it up this summer but will replace it with drugstore options.

reviews.product_name: Lotus Anti-Aging Night Moisturizer
reviews.review_title: Soothing on the skin, soothing scent
reviews.review_text: This stuff looks thick in its creaminess, but goes on with an airy quality (cool like a gel but feels lighter). With my oily, sensitive skin, it does a fantastic job of providing soothing moisture without greasiness, residue, or redness. I love using it on nights when my skin has taken a beating from wind or sun, or on alternate nights with a peel product. I am also a fan of the fresh rose mask/moisturizer/eye gel products, for their similarly soothing, sensitive qualities. The scent of this one helps me relax into sleep.

reviews.product_name: Creamy Eye Treatment with Avocado
reviews.review_title: Great For Dry Skin; Combo/Oily Skin Beware
reviews.review_text: This is one of those high quality products that is pointedly for dry skin types. The texture is seriously thick and rich, but it is good stuff! If you live in a place where the elements chap your exposed skin, or you have a *really* dry eye area, this will be uniquely helpful. On the other hand, if you have combo/oily skin and/or you live in a moderate climate (frankly, most places not Minnesota or the Russian tundra or the Orkney Islands) keep in mind that repeated use is likely to contribute to either blackheads or milia (white bumps). Fun fact: In 1988 Kiehl’s sponsored the Everest Expedition, where climbers scaled Mt. Everest and took Kiehl’s products with them! Yup, this stuff would have been great for that trip.

reviews.product_name: Ultra Facial Moisturizing Cream with Squalane
reviews.review_text: I don’t use many face creams because I have oily skin and they usually make it worse. This one didn’t make me oily, but it didn’t feel like it soaked in all the way. I did like it though and feel as though it comes hand in hand with their facial cleanser.

reviews.product_name: Mini Ultra Facial Moisturizing Cream with Squalane
reviews.review_text: I don’t use many face creams because I have oily skin and they usually make it worse. This one didn’t make me oily, but it didn’t feel like it soaked in all the way. I did like it though and feel as though it comes hand in hand with their facial cleanser.

reviews.product_name: Creamy Eye Treatment with Avocado
reviews.review_text: I love this cream! I have been feeling my eyes droop and the bags growing as my toddler ages... I put this on at night and feel instantly brighter and look more alive and awake. It tightens and makes me feel More me and younger!

reviews.product_name: Tea Elixir Niacinamide & Hyaluronic Acid Anti-Aging Serum
reviews.review_text: I love this product! I’ve noticed my skin being tight and seeing little wrinkles. So I got this. My skin has had more elasticity in the last week AND I’ve noticed a smoother look to my skin. It is such a smooth apply and sits evenly under my makeup for the day and feels refreshing in the evening.

reviews.product_name: The True Cream Aqua Bomb
reviews.review_text: My new favorite moisturizer! It’s very light weight but SO hydrating! It’s not greasy at all, and absorbs quickly. It makes my skin very smooth, so it’s a wonderful base under foundation. I have SUPER sensitive skin and it’s not irritating at all. Love this stuff!

reviews.product_name: GENIUS Sleeping Collagen Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I am OBSESSED with this night cream. I have incredibly sensitive skin. I’m very cautious about trying new products because I break-out easily. I can’t say enough amazing things about this sleeping collagen. I started noticing a difference in the quality and smoothness of my skin almost immediately. It has a very velvety texture, so it goes on smoothly and a little goes a long way. I use it on my face, neck and decollete. It doesn’t have a strong fragrance, which is great for me because of my allergies. If I go to bed with a pimple, I’ll wake up and my blemish is gone! I absolutely love this GENIUS line. I also use the anti-aging face wash, which is great.

reviews.product_name: GENIUS Liquid Collagen Serum
reviews.review_title: Amazing product if you have the patience!
reviews.review_text: I have been using this product for about 7 months, and I can finally say I’m a believer. The smell is strong and the dropper is not user friendly (reasons why I marked off a star) but I can honestly say, I see a difference in my skin. It wasn’t immediate, took about 3 months for my skin to get adjusted (I have sensitive skin). Now I see true and visible change in my skin’s hydration, pigmentation, and smoothness. I use this once daily in combination with the genius collagen night cream. I had deep forehead lines that have visibly reduced. The same goes for the fine lines around my eyes. My skin looks plump and radiant. I love this serum!

reviews.product_name: Ultimate Sun Protector Lotion SPF 50+ Sunscreen
reviews.review_text: I have been pretty bad at wearing SPF in the past because I haven’t found one that works for me. I was pleasantly surprised by this sun screen! I don’t like sunscreens that I can feel sitting on my face or ones that leave a white cast. This one has neither of those qualities. It feels more like a moisturizer or a serum than a normal sunscreen. It also has a pearlescent tint to it that’s almost like a brightening primer. I can’t speak to the “wetforce” and “heatforce”, but I really enjoy this sunscreen and I’m excited to put it on everyday!

reviews.product_name: C-Firma Fresh Vitamin-C Day Serum
reviews.review_text: I have never noticed a difference in my skin when using other Vitamin C products, but after using this product for just a few weeks I was able to see a difference. My skin looked brighter and felt firmer. I was also able to easily incorporate it into my skincare routine and it didn’t make me breakout or anything. As others have mentioned it doesn’t smell amazing, but that’s typical of vitamin c in general. I think it’s really smart they revamped the packaging so you mix it yourself. I will say when mixing it myself I realized the internal packaging looks quite small, so I wonder how long the product itself will last before repurchasing.

reviews.product_name: Aqua Bomb Overnight Lip Mask
reviews.review_text: I really love that this lip mask isn’t a thick mask and is more like an ointment or balm. I personally don’t like to use really thick lip masks and I like to be able to use a lip mask under my lipstick. This one is really nice to use as a lip balm as well and I can definitely feel it working. I would definitely recommend.

reviews.product_name: Cream Skin Toner & Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I’ve been using this products for a couple of weeks now, I have combination skin and it’s hydrating and moisturizing without been oily, it’s very lightweight and feels comfortable on the skin.  I’ve been using it before  I go to sleep and when I wake up, my skin feels so good. I like the package. I received this product as a gift from Laneige.

The sample only allowed a total of about 6 uses so I can’t say hisy this will work in the long term, but it seems like it’d do a good job.  I knocked a star off due to the fact that I seem to need more to cover my face and it’s not cheap.  $89 for a face cream isn’t too obnoxious no, but there are better more budget friendly creeks out there.

Estee Lauder has a good reputation and a great track record of quality products.

reviews.product_name: Beste No. 9 Jelly Cleanser
reviews.review_text: I’m so glad I received a sample of this, it’s my new holy grail. It doesn’t irritate my super sensitive skin, doesn’t leave a weird film or dry out my skin, and you need the teeny tiniest amount of it so this bottle is going to last forever, making it SUCH a good price for the quality.

reviews.product_name: 100% Organic Cold-Pressed Rose Hip Seed Oil
reviews.review_text: The best rosehip oil I’ve tried, you get so much for such a low cost.

reviews.product_name: C-Tango Vitamin C Eye Cream
reviews.review_text: I’ve had dark circles my entire life. I’m talking hereditary, purple, not-even-concealer-can-cover-them-up dark circles. And this is the only thing I’ve ever tried in my life that makes a difference. I tried a sample of this and for the first time, I started looking like I slept for 20 hours or just had a facial. And when the sample ran out and my bags returned to normal, I was really hesitant to buy the full size because I didn’t know for sure if it was the cream since I had only tried it for a few days. But sure enough, as soon as I started using it again, I had the same results. I don’t know what my life was before this eye cream. I’ve worn tinted moisturizer and NOT put any concealer under my eyes, which is an entirely new concept for me. The fact that I can leave my house without concealer and feel like I still look healthy and alive is absolutely life changing.

reviews.review_text: Great for sensitive skin! My skin is reactive to essential oils, fragrance and harsh surfactants. This is the only cleanser I’ve tried so far that doesn’t make me skin feel like it’s on fire, or like it’s been stripped. Nice clean scent, and I like how it lathers. Minus one star just because it does make my skin feel slightly tight, and maybe isn’t fantastic at removing makeup. But I oil cleanse and it works for removing the oil from my skin!

reviews.product_name: Umbra Sheer Physical Daily Defense SPF 30
reviews.review_text: - This sunscreen is physical so it has a definite white cast when applied (I’m really pale but I still see a white cast unless I really massage it into my skin).+ It doesn’t irritate my skin which is a huge plus- It smells awful, but maybe I’m just sensitive to scents. + It’s fine under makeup for me, as long as I let it soak in for a good 10min and use a primer on top. All in all it seems like a standard mineral sunscreen, and offers good protection.

reviews.product_name: Pure Skin Face Cleanser
reviews.review_text: I really love this, it doesn’t smell of anything really and just leaves your skin feeling clean

reviews.product_name: Superberry Hydrate + Glow Dream Night Mask with Vitamin C
reviews.review_text: When I use it at night, my skin is visibly supple and glowing the next day. Even my boyfriend notices, and will now say “did you use that yellow stuff last night? Your skin looks so nice today” and my heart swells. You only need like a small pea-sized amount if you press it in to your face. It’s incredible and I love it and it’s so worth the price.

reviews.product_name: Mini Superberry Hydrate + Glow Dream Mask

reviews.product_name: Lippe Balm
reviews.review_text: This is one of the only lip balms that works for me. Even vaseline feels more drying than it is hydrating. I am constantly biting the dry skin off my lips (thanks anxiety!) and this helps to make my lips stay soft so there’s no skin to peel off of them. This stuff actually absorbs in to my lips and makes them feel softer within minutes. I don’t need to reapply constantly, either, so a little goes a long way. My only issue is that I always forget to use it, but that’s not a problem with the product of course!

reviews.product_name: Soy Hydrating Gentle Face Cleanser
reviews.review_text: it has cleared up my skin SO MUCH! and it takes off all the makeup even mascara!!! 100/10 recommended

reviews.product_name: Sugar Advanced Lip Balm Intense Hydration Treatment
reviews.review_text: i had the translucent one and it is my favorite thing ever. so i decided to get this one too! it is soooo soft on my lips and moisturizes my lips so well. the color is very good and subtle.

reviews.product_name: Slaai  Makeup-Melting Butter Cleanser
reviews.review_title: makes me feel like I have a film on my face
reviews.review_text: This product does a good job removing makeup but leaves a very weird film on even after cleansing after putting it on. My face doesn’t feel clean after. I have a lot left since it’s a huge jar but I plan on only using it for my eyes. I don’t love the smell but it’s fine since I use it before I go to bed. I do like the little spatula that comes with it though.

reviews.product_name: Caffeine Eye Cream
reviews.review_text: If you wake up and having puffy, tired eyes you need this. It’s very affordable and it doesn’t cause any sensitivity or breakouts. It depuffs my eyes so quickly it is a staple in my morning school routine. And the packaging is so satisfying in my opinion.

reviews.product_name: Double Serum Firming & Smoothing Anti-Aging Concentrate
reviews.review_text: I love Clarins Double Serum! I was able to try a 7-day trial for free through Influenster to facilitate an honest review. This product is incredible and enjoyable because it actually worked with visible results quickly. The packets were extremely small, but it’s an oil serum that shouldn’t be applied bulkily, I’m assuming, and helps for when I buy the product to use it appropriately. It was interesting trying to combine the two serums in one, but it was also effective. In the first day, my skin was smoother from the serum, the third day it was softer and beginning to brighten... at the end of the 7 days, my skin was brighter, firmer from my fine lines, smoother, and softer. I was also very hormonal when I tried this and couldn’t believe the wonders it did for my skin without any help from my body. I can’t wait to try it regularly for a month. I was so confident after using it because it blurred blemishes and fine wrinkles. It’s one of the best products for skincare that I’ve ever used. I highly recommend and will be buying soon!

reviews.product_name: Lemonade Smoothing Scrub
reviews.review_text: Can you say “summer time feeling so fine“ in the dead of winter? Ole Henriksen Lemonade Soothing Scrub was fun all around, it smoothed my skin and brightened it subtly. My pores tightened and lightened. After using on my face, I ventured and used elsewhere because of the sweet scent. I highly recommend for those looking to beat the winter blues!

reviews.product_name: Revitalizing Supreme+ Youth Power Creme Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: The best creme I’ve used in the past decade, no joke or embellishment. My skin felt like soft, plushy silk and glowed like I was a decade younger. I love it! It kept me hydrated all day and alone helped boost my natural skin, but would be ideal under my makeup as well. I highly recommend if you’re looking to soften and glow.

reviews.review_text: Got this as a sample in one of my previous Sephora orders - didn’t even ask for it.  Put this on at 9 am.  It’s clear - feels like my Smashbox Photo Finish Primer. I’m fair skinned - normally if I don’t reapply when I’m skiing I’m in trouble.  Now I’m buying a full bottle.  Enthusiastic fan.  And it’s so lightweight - this is going to be awesome for summertime.  You can for sure wear it under makeup.

reviews.review_text: This is my favorite moisturizer, all weather. My skin feels replenished, clean and CLEAR. A little goes a long way, and while I’ve tried others, my super sensitive skin doesn’t love anything quite like Protini. Great for no makeup, or right before a photo shoot ♥️

reviews.review_text: Origin masks are great quality masks. I’ve used the charcoal mask for years and purchased this during a few weeks of texturized skin. The skin soothed the skin and helped even the texture of my skin. The smell is pretty great too.

reviews.product_name: Mini Take The Day Off Cleansing Balm Makeup Remover
reviews.review_text: This is a great cleanser that removes all makeup. I would recommend for anyone with sensitive skin!

reviews.review_text: This moisturizer is amazing. I was hesitant at first due to it being a heavy moisturizer but it is actually the opposite. It does the job of deeply moisturizing your skin but it melts in seamlessly. I have combination skin and find it doesn’t make me super oily and helps with my dry spots very well. The smell is strange but I associate that with being unscented. All in all a great product and works great with their Vit c face oil.

reviews.product_name: Oat Cleansing Balm
reviews.review_text: I bought this cleansing balm to see if it would be a good dupe for the Clinique take the day off balm. It did a nice job removing makeup but felt goopy and didn’t dissolve well. The style of product delivery via tube is wasteful. I thought I finished it but cut it open and there was tons of product left. The biggest plus was that it’s gentle and didn’t make my face feel dry after. If you don’t want to spend tons of money this is a good option but it definitely does not match Clinique’s cleansing balm.

reviews.review_text: I was looking for a cream that I could wear under my makeup. My go to cream was sold out so I bought this one to try. I have dry, acne prone skin. When I use this with my primer, it gives me the smoothest base to work off of. My foundation looks so fresh and doesn’t fade at all. As a cream by itself it does its job. Sometimes I feel a burning sensation, but it goes away quickly. The smell is also very strong. It smells like pine trees and a little bit like cleaning products. The smell goes away quickly, but like the burning, it goes away quickly. I do like this moisturizer but I will not be purchasing again because I like the Lanseige one better.

reviews.product_name: Glycolic Acid 7% Exfoliating Toning Solution
reviews.review_text: I got this stuff to help fade acne scars and even out skin tone/texture. You have to start slow with this stuff because its strong, if you have sensitive skin, I recommend watering it down or using it on a rotation. It will sting if your skin is not prepared or unable to handle it. Despite the unpleasant feeling, it really helped fade my acne scars and improve texture with a glowy type finish. They haven’t 100% faded, but they faded enough for me to be satisfied, especially for the price point.

reviews.product_name: Glycolic Acid 7% Exfoliating Toning Solution
reviews.review_title: Used as a KP Treatment Serum
reviews.review_text: Used this solution as a chemical exfoliant serum for my upper arms to treat my Keratosis Polaris alongside the rest of my products and seemed to help! Also can’t go wrong with the price and size.

reviews.product_name: D-Bronzi Anti-Pollution Bronzing Drops with Peptides
reviews.review_text: Love adding a couple of drops to my moisturizer or serums for an extra bronzy glow! Have also been adding a couple drops to my physical sunscreens that tend to give me a white cast. A few drops helps minimize the white cast and gives a nice tint!

reviews.product_name: Avocado Soothing Skin Barrier Serum with Ceramides
reviews.review_title: Great for my rosacea prone skin!
reviews.review_text: Great for my sensitive  rosacea prone skin! Consistency is milky so easy to add into a routine and works well with other products. I see a difference with continued use! And of course the packaging is adorable and the pump super practical and clean.

reviews.product_name: Rose & Hyaluronic Acid Deep Hydration Toner
reviews.review_text: My favourite holy grail toner! Super hydrating and great as a first prep step after cleansing and before other products. I noticed a huge improvement in my overall hydration and now don’t have to use hyaluronic serums as often. I use without a cotton pad and just apply by pooling into hands and patting into skin. When used each day lasts me a good 4-5 months. Near end of products life rose petals do start to clog the top but the stopper can be easily removed to prevent this.

reviews.product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C
reviews.review_text: This is a great overnight lip mask. It goes on a bit thick so beware because that might get on your pillow. But you wake up with nice, soft lips! Smells great too.

reviews.product_name: Lip Glowy Balm
reviews.review_text: I was afraid that this balm would be sticky but that’s not the case at all. The consistency is really good, it has a nice glossy finish and it doesn’t dry out your lips.

reviews.product_name: The Silk Peony Melting Eye Cream
reviews.review_text: The best eye cream I’ve found. I like to put it on in the morning before I put on my makeup because the pearly tone of it helps reflect the light and makes me look less tired. Nice consistency and you don’t need a lot for impact so it lasts a long time. Good bang for your buck.

reviews.product_name: Violet-C Brightening Serum 20% Vitamin C + 10% AHA

reviews.review_text: This stuff is great. It is light. Not sticky at all. I use it at night but I would totally use this in the day under my makeup because it is so light. It really does help to brighten my skin too. My skin has always been dull and blah but after using this for the last 2 months, my skin is definitely happy. My skin is glowing nicely.

reviews.review_title: Great at making makeup melt away.
reviews.review_text: Wonderful makeup remover. Gets my eye makeup off without any scrubbing or pressure. Comes off easily with light rubbing so that my eye area stays youthful. I use it every night and it really does great at melting my makeup away.

If you’re looking for something that leaves your skin feeling clean and soft definitely try this.

reviews.product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C
reviews.review_text: I know what you’re thinking- is this product really that great? The answer is YES! This product is literally my favorite K-beauty product of all time. It’s perfect for all skin types and skin tones and leaves your lips moisturized. If you are considering getting any lip balm/mask from Sephora, GET THIS ONE!!

reviews.product_name: Protini Polypeptide Firming Refillable Moisturizer

reviews.product_name: Beste No. 9 Jelly Cleanser

reviews.product_name: Lala Retro Whipped Refillable Moisturizer with Ceramides

This product is now one of my favorites and makes putting on sunscreen much more enjoyable as this one doesn’t leave a white residue or ANY residue for that matter. It also doesn’t burn my skin and it feels super natural and not oily at all! I do understand that it is a bit pricey but it is 100% worth it in my book!

reviews.product_name: Clear Improvement Pore Clearing Moisturizer with Salicylic Acid
reviews.review_text: I received this product from Influenster to review & this was actually my first time trying anything from Origins. So far I’m impressed. This moisturizer contains salicylic acid to help breakouts but is not drying like so many other products for combination or acne prone skin. I love that it helps with my mild breakouts while not stripping or irritating my skin. It is moisturizing but it’s not a heavy duty moisturizer, so if you have dry skin this may not work for you. My combination skin found it the perfect amount of moisturizer for the daytime. It does have a very herbal odor, to me it was more of a relaxing herbal smell (somewhat lavender-y?), but I can see some people being put off by the scent. So if you are sensitive to smells I definitely recommend smelling it in person before buying.

reviews.product_name: Squalane + Vitamin C Rose Firming Oil
reviews.review_title: First Face Oil I've Ever Liked
reviews.review_text: I received this product to review from Influenster. It wasn’t something I would have picked up on my own, but I was very pleasantly surprised. I have combination skin & normally oils make my face really oily or feel just plain slimy, this one absorbs really nicely. It leaves just a hint of an oil feeling but sinks in quite quickly. It smells like real roses, & a little goes a really long way. It took me just 2 drops for my whole face. The only reason it is 4 stars instead of 5 is because it still leaves my forehead oily & for those with combination skin I might advise saving it to use in winter. The packaging is really sleek & I’m really pleased I got to try this product.

reviews.product_name: Revitalizing Supreme+ Youth Power Creme Moisturizer
reviews.review_title: Just the right weight for combo skin
reviews.review_text: Nicely moisturizing without leaving me feeling oily. I have combo skin & sometimes thicker moisturizers leave more forehead an oil slick. It feels rather thick on 1st contact but almost melts as it warms up. It absorbs well & feels lightweight once it’s on but afterward it feels like you used a heavier cream. I received this from Influenster to review but may well rebuy it after my mini runs out.

reviews.product_name: Self-Tanning Water
reviews.review_text: Left my skin sun-kissed and not orange-y, doesn’t last that long though and the spray bottle is a little hard to use when doing your back because obviously it doesn’t work upside down.

reviews.product_name: Green Clean Makeup Removing Cleansing Balm
reviews.review_text: Cleans waterproof eye makeup so easily with a very small amount and you don’t lose any eyelashes from wash cloths or cotton pads because you don’t need them!

reviews.review_text: Cleans waterproof eye makeup so easily with a very small amount and you don’t lose any eyelashes from wash cloths or cotton pads because you don’t need them!

reviews.product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C
reviews.review_text: So nourishing and plumps my lips slightly for sure. Jar lasts forever.

reviews.product_name: Soy Hydrating Gentle Face Cleanser
reviews.review_text: I have very dry and sensitive skin and this cleanser has been a GAME CHANGER! It is soooo soft and removes my makeup completely! It doesn’t have much of a scent and is so gentle. Very very happy with it! *received free for testing purposes

reviews.product_name: Sugar Strawberry Exfoliating Face Wash
reviews.review_text: So soft and gentle but still exfoliates! Hands down the best exfoliate I’ve ever tried! It works wonderfully even for my dry and sensitive skin and smells so good! *received this free for testing purposes

reviews.product_name: Vitamin Enriched Face Base Priming Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I have really dry skin and it’s hard to find a primer that actually keeps my face moisturized and my makeup lasting! This is the best primer I have ever used and plan on continuing to use it and purchase again! It feels like the perfect mix between a velvety primer and a moisturizer.

reviews.product_name: Adaptogen Deep Moisturizing Cream with Ashwagandha + Reishi
reviews.review_text: Really happy with this cream.  Heavier than their previous moisturizers, which works well for my dry skin.  I will continue using this.

reviews.product_name: Mini Adaptogen Deep Moisture Cream with Ashwagandha + Reishi
reviews.review_text: Really happy with this cream.  Heavier than their previous moisturizers, which works well for my dry skin.  I will continue using this.

reviews.product_name: Superfood Air-Whip Lightweight Moisturizer with Hyaluronic Acid
reviews.review_text: Very lightweight moisturizer that is still hydrating.

reviews.product_name: Superberry Hydrate + Glow Dream Night Mask with Vitamin C
reviews.review_text: I’m quite pleased with this mask.  I am switching over to all clean products and this fits the bill, while still being very hydrating.  The smell is glorious, and I wake up in the morning with a noticeable difference in my skin.

reviews.product_name: Mini Superberry Hydrate + Glow Dream Mask
reviews.review_text: I’m quite pleased with this mask.  I am switching over to all clean products and this fits the bill, while still being very hydrating.  The smell is glorious, and I wake up in the morning with a noticeable difference in my skin.

reviews.product_name: Plum Plump Hyaluronic Acid Serum
reviews.review_text: I think is a good product for integrating some hyaluronic acid into your routine! The bottle is pretty and easy to use. The smell is very realistic to plums—a mixture of sweet, sour, and sharp. The smell can come off a bit strong at times, and the serum can feel a bit tacky when applying before you apply your next product. Overall, I think it is a good product and I recommend it!

reviews.product_name: Caffeine 5% + EGCG Depuffing Eye Serum
reviews.review_text: I really like this product for eliminating some puffiness around the eyes, and especially lightening dark circles. My only issue is these benefits go away really quickly if you stop using the product for any time.

reviews.product_name: ICE Ceramide Moisturizer with Vitamin F
reviews.review_title: Products Work Differently for Every Face
reviews.review_text: I have to imagine peoples’ reactions to the smell is similar to how some people like the taste of cilantro and some people taste soap. For me? This moisturizer is amazingly creamy and nourishing, smells incredible, and is worth every penny! Just gotta remember that a product that works great for me and 800 other reviewers, can cause an adverse reaction in someone else—always ALWAYS patch test if you’re concerned!

reviews.product_name: Umbra Sheer Physical Daily Defense SPF 30
reviews.review_text: I’ve been using this product for sometime now and it works really well. The only issue I have with it is it is on the thicker side, especially the older it gets. I got to the bottom of it and I had it for months but it got a little dry. But it does last for a long time which is good. For the price you cant beat it. And it has a high concentration of zinc oxide which would account for its consistency.  If you want something that works I would say use this product. I would like to add that you have to make sure to really rub it in, if you do then you won’t see it. For darker skinned ladies, I would think it would present itself as a little more of a challenge. All in all, I plan to continue to use this sunscreen and I recommend it. A tip, make sure to moisturize before hand, it will help it to blend nicely.

reviews.product_name: C.E.O. 15% Vitamin C Brightening Serum
reviews.review_text: Absolutely love this serum. I love Sunday Riley products and I absolutely adore this. I used a trial size that was sent to me and had to repurchase the full-size. I noticed the next morning after using this in my night time skin care regimen that my skin had this amazing glow and looked three shades brighter. It is somewhat on the strong side so I only use this when I need a pick me up. Plus it is summer right now and I don’t want to go overboard on the vitamin C or retinol. But when it comes winter again I will most likely be using this at least three times a week. Right now it’s about once a week. I am a 35 year old female with combination skin, more on the dry side. I highly recommend this product.

reviews.product_name: ICE Ceramide Moisturizer with Vitamin F
reviews.review_text: My favorite moisturizer ever. I love Sunday Riley products and I used to use the vitamin C moisturizer, but this was much more moisturizing for my skin and I just love everything about it. The smell is great, it makes my skin appear to have that glass like appearance that we love, and just an amazing moisturizer overall. I will never use another moisturizer. I am 35 years old, and I experience breakouts pretty much only now when I eat sugar. My skin has gotten dryer over time now that I’m getting older, I used to have pretty oily skin. Now I’m just focused on maintaining the moisture in my skin to help with aging. This does all of that.

reviews.product_name: Hyaluronic Acid 2% + B5 Hydrating Serum
reviews.review_text: I have been using HA products for the last 5 years, and tried many different price points, and this beats them all!I use it every morning, as part of my routine. It makes my skin look fresh and well rested, and helps my makeup to go on smoothly. I never encountered any reaction with any other products I paired it with, regardless of brand or consistency. However, I do let the product sink in for 5-10 minutes, before I apply my foundation.As this product has no additional fragrance/perfume, it has a distinctive smell to it, which doesn’t bother me personally, and goes away quickly, but it might take some time to get used to it, if you are sensitive to smells.The formula itself has a thicker consistency, kind of reminds me of castor oil in a weird way, but it can be worked into the skin easily with quickly massaging in for 5-10 seconds. It doesn’t leave my skin with a greasy feel, and it’s immediately hydrating.

reviews.product_name: AHA 30% + BHA 2% Exfoliating Peeling Solution
reviews.review_text: I bought this product on a whim after reading the reviews, and girl, that was the best choice I made that day!Read the product info and the directions carefully before using it for the first time, as this will pack a punch, and can be harmful, if you are not following the instruction. I felt a slight tingle in my skin, but no other irritation, or redness.After removing it, my skin felt immediately improved, and squeaky clean. It helps me with my blemishes, as I have very light skin, the scars can remain for a few weeks, but this solution helped with evening my skin tone out.I would not recommend using it before applying makeup (because it’s a peeling solution, duh), or during the summer months, unless you constantly lather yourself with high SPF protection, and don’t use it more than twice a week, unless you want to look like a burn victim...

reviews.product_name: Glycolic Acid 7% Exfoliating Toning Solution
reviews.review_text: This toner is just amazing! I use it sparingly, 2-3 times per week, as I don’t want to overdo it. If I have any blemishes, or I can see my skin is getting a bit iffy, due to hormonal changes during my cycle, I use this product at night, and can see the difference the next morning. It also helps to eliminate any discoloration on my skin, with consistent use.A little goes a long way, I personally never encountered any discomfort while using the toner, but it might cause irritation, if you have sensitive skin, or use it too frequently.

reviews.product_name: Niacinamide 10% + Zinc 1% Oil Control Serum
reviews.review_text: Love this product and especially for such a great price.

reviews.product_name: Lip Glowy Balm
reviews.review_text: I love this product, I will always repurchase it. Lasts long and it’s good pricing. MY FAV

reviews.product_name: Magic Cream Moisturizer with Hyaluronic Acid
reviews.review_text: This product made my skin rash and swell, I don’t have sensitive skin. I’ve tried many different creams and never had this happen, it’s definitely not for all skin types.

reviews.product_name: Salicylic Acid Acne + Pore Cleanser
reviews.review_text: I find this is for more acne prone skin, still is super good but nothing special.

reviews.product_name: The True Cream Aqua Bomb
reviews.review_text: I loved this cleansing balm. It was super smooth and took of my makeup amazingly without leaving behind any type of film. It is great to use on its own or as part of a double cleansing routine. The texture was so nice and my skin felt hydrated and not at all stripped after use. I also liked that the scent wasn’t very strong at all so this would probably be good for sensitive skin.

reviews.product_name: The True Cream Moisturizing Bomb
reviews.review_text: I loved this cleansing balm. The texture was super smooth and light and it felt really good on my skin. It did a great job of removing my makeup and my skin felt super hydrated afterwards and not at all dry or stripped. This would be a great cleanser on its own or as part of a double cleansing routine. I also really liked that the smell wasn’t very strong so it would be good for sensitive skin!

reviews.product_name: Lemonade Smoothing Scrub
reviews.review_text: One of the things that I found really cool about this product is that it is both a chemical and well as a (gentle) physical exfoliant! I definitely noticed a difference in the texture of my skin, as well as my skin appearing overall brighter. It definitely have a pretty noticeable scent to it but I didn’t find it too strong. I am honestly really enjoying this product and I’ve found it to be really helpful in keeping my skin clear and feeling super smooth and soft without irritating my skin at all!*I received this product complimentary of ole henriksen and Influenster for reviewing purposes

reviews.product_name: Green Clean Makeup Removing Cleansing Balm
reviews.review_text: Takes of the thickest, stay-put make-up, but I broke out badly around the eyes.  Formula too thick for my sensitive skin.

reviews.product_name: Green Clean Makeup Meltaway Cleansing Balm Limited Edition Jumbo
reviews.review_text: Takes of the thickest, stay-put make-up, but I broke out badly around the eyes.  Formula too thick for my sensitive skin.

reviews.product_name: Lippe Balm
reviews.review_text: I use this at night before bed and have noticed a difference with the texture of my lips’ skin. I was experiencing flakiness, but it’s gone now!

reviews.product_name: Checks and Balances Frothy Face Wash
reviews.review_text: After pregnancy, my skin suddenly became dry with rough patches on my cheeks, so I had to find a new cleanser.  This one is gentle and is frothy, and while it hasn’t made my skin worse, I still have some tightness.  Still, the best option I have found so far at a reasonable price.

reviews.product_name: The Dewy Skin Cream Plumping & Hydrating Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I developed very dry skin after pregnancy and it took me a while to find skincare products that wouldn’t worsen the dryness.  This moisturizer saved my skin!  My only complaint is the strong smell.

reviews.product_name: Niacinamide 10% + Zinc 1% Oil Control Serum
reviews.review_text: So affordable and I absolutely noticed a difference when I started using it in terms of blemishes. I know everyone’s skin reacts differently, like my sister tried it and it wasn’t for her- she developed little white bumps but I saw none of that so just try it out and see if it works for you!

reviews.product_name: Ultra Facial Moisturizing Cream with Squalane
reviews.review_text: I’ve only tried the mini but wow… right away I noticed how much more moisturized my skin felt. I will be buying this again-full size!

reviews.product_name: Mini Ultra Facial Moisturizing Cream with Squalane
reviews.review_text: I’ve only tried the mini but wow… right away I noticed how much more moisturized my skin felt. I will be buying this again-full size!

reviews.product_name: Hello FAB Coconut Skin Smoothie Priming Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: This is the creamiest, glowiest, drink of water you’ll put on your face! I love it so much and treat myself to it every year. I love how it adds a gorgeous hydrated sheen to my skin to wear alone, but also a great base before make up!

reviews.product_name: Ultimate Sun Protector Lotion SPF 50+ Sunscreen
reviews.review_text: Let’s be honest - this is an expensive sunscreen product, so the expectation is that this should be a bottle of magic. And it honestly is! While the formula is runnier than I was expecting, it soaks into the skin so easily (without leaving grease.) It works well for all areas of the body, and helps me feel confident I won’t damage my (extremely sun-prone) skin. While it’s definitely a luxury item at that price point, the long-lasting benefits are so worth it.

reviews.product_name: Clear Sunscreen Stick SPF 50+
reviews.review_text: I LOVE this sunscreen stick!! The product glides on so smoothly and feels luxurious against the skin - not overly oily or greasy like I was expecting. The packaging is perfect for travel, and it works as a great final step in a morning skincare routine as well as a touch up throughout the day. I have combination skin and so far it hasn’t given me any reactions. I would definitely recommend, it’s worth the price point!

reviews.product_name: Urban Environment Fresh-Moisture Sunscreen Broad-Spectrum SPF 42
reviews.review_text: I love this formula - it’s moisturizing without feeling too oily and the product itself has been very effective. The only complaint is that the packaging is so small!

reviews.product_name: The True Cream Moisturizing Bomb
reviews.review_text: I love the texture because it’s not too thick. Feel comfortable. Very subtle smell. Packaging is cute too.

reviews.product_name: Squalane + Vitamin C Rose Firming Oil
reviews.review_text: It’s so hard to find a face oil which smells this great, like actual roses. (That’s why I rarely use face oil until this). Packaging is so elegant and it’s easy to use. Loveeeeeee

reviews.product_name: Clear Sunscreen Stick SPF 50+
reviews.review_text: This is a perfect on-the-go product! It is not sticky at all like I was afraid and it gives you a natural glow. You can totally use it under and over makeup. It’s a nice thing to have to touch up when you are out.

reviews.product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C
reviews.review_text: Purchased this almost a year ago and still have over 1/3 of the package left. Unfortunately had to return the gummy flavour one as it stained my sheets. The original berry is def the way to go! Super moisturizing and you can use it as your lip balm during the day as well.

reviews.product_name: Green Clean Makeup Removing Cleansing Balm
reviews.review_text: Have bought this multiple times (along with the limited edition Christmas set) and it really does get everything off! I use a lot of sunscreen and I can def feel the difference between just using a foaming cleanser vs going in with this cleansing balm first. You honestly only need a tiny bit and it goes a long way.

I use a lot of sunscreen and I can def feel the difference between just using a foaming cleanser vs going in with this cleansing balm first. You honestly only need a tiny bit and it goes a long way.

reviews.product_name: Mini Superfood Antioxidant Cleanser

reviews.product_name: The Dewy Skin Cream Plumping & Hydrating Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: As someone with sensitive combo skin this honestly did nothing for me. Felt like I had to constantly reapply and def didn’t give my skin a dewy look and feel. Packaging is cute tho!

reviews.product_name: Honey Halo Ultra-Hydrating Ceramide Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: Honestly really wished I wouldn’t like this due to the price tag lol. This does wonders for my skin and I can even see the difference overnight. The smell might be strong for some (they aren’t kidding when they say honey) but it is so so hydrating. The packaging is super cute and sturdy so I will def be reusing it along with the magnetic scoop as well!

reviews.product_name: Multi-Peptide + HA Serum
reviews.review_text: Hydrating and gives me a glow, definitely worth the price

reviews.product_name: 100% Organic Cold-Pressed Rose Hip Seed Oil
reviews.review_text: Definitely brightened my skin and helps to clear it of any blemishes and scaring while staying hydrating, but I have cut it back to a once a week oil for my skin as it is high powered for me.

reviews.product_name: Facial Treatment Essence (Pitera Essence)
reviews.review_text: Keeps skin clear, smooth texture, hydrated. The one thing to splurge on. Essential part of my routine.

reviews.product_name: Mini Facial Treatment Essence (Pitera Essence)
reviews.review_text: Keeps skin clear, smooth texture, hydrated. The one thing to splurge on. Essential part of my routine.

reviews.product_name: Watermelon Glow PHA + BHA Pore-Tight Toner
reviews.review_text: Let me start off by saying that I have acne prone combo skin and that I have been on accutane. I do occasionally get new breakouts but I did find that this particular toner gave me new acne. After about 2 months of use, it stoped breaking me out and started hydrating my skin however, this did nothing for my blackheads that are on my nose. This leads me to believe that the BHA and PHA are not high enough for me. Once I have a higher concentration toner to get rid of my blackheads, I will be repurchasing this toner to up keep my face so I do recommend it! It’s a pleasure to use.

reviews.product_name: Avocado Fine Line Eye Cream with Retinol
reviews.review_text: I really enjoyed this product. My eyes are very sensitive and I usually am very uncomfortable with products around my eyes. This was very comfortable and I found it worked very well with keeping my under eyes hydrated and helped with slightly fading my dark under eyes. However, this is definitely gonna be a product that it will take some time to see the full results.

reviews.product_name: Avocado Soothing Skin Barrier Serum with Ceramides
reviews.review_text: I have acne prone skin and am very bad for picking my skin. When I apply this serum on my red and irritated skin, I find that it not only calms the redness but makes my skin feel much better without irritation. Would definitely recommend

reviews.product_name: Blueberry Bounce Gentle Cleanser
reviews.review_text: I have been using this cleanser for about 2 months now and I found that this combined with the tatcha rice wash has been doing amazing things for my skin. I have never felt smoother and I always feel clean but not dried out when I use this! Definitely recommend! I wouldn’t give it 5 starts though for a few reasons; 1. The price. It’s very expensive for a cleanser. 2. Effectiveness. Because I use this with another cleanser i can’t say that it is 100% effective by itself. I have used it on its own and it was ok but I did not get the same results as I do when I use it with the tatcha. Because it works so well with the tatcha I will be repurchasing and I do recommend it as one of your double cleansing steps!

reviews.product_name: Glow2OH Dark Spot Toner
reviews.review_text: I’m a big user of this brands skincare. I use their anti oil cleanser and toner and their walnut scrub. I was overjoyed when Influenster decided to send me this new toner full sized for free to test out and review! This is one of the best products they’ve sent me so far. The toner smells so refreshing of citrus and it feels so fresh on the skin! It even seems to help when my rosacea flares up! I’ve been using for about a week now and am head over heels in love. Will be repurchasing for sure, I see results already!

reviews.product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C
reviews.review_text: Oh my god, I can’t get enough of this lip mask. Influenster sent me the grapefruit one in their spring things voxbox free for testing purposes and it’s so yummy! It works so well, way better than anything else I’ve ever used on chapped lips. I have the original one too, and now I love being able to switch between both yummy options. Definitely recommend to everyone!!!!

reviews.product_name: Cream Skin Toner & Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: This is a wonderful toner that doesn’t dry out your skin as it’s for moisturizing! I don’t feel like it adds a lot of moisture to my skin, as I have a pretty good moisturizing routine as is. I wouldn’t say it’s heavy enough to use without moisturizer either and I see it as more of a toner but I do like using it in my routine. I got this product complimentary from Influenster for testing purposes.

reviews.product_name: Aqua Bomb Hydrating Toner
reviews.review_text: I really like this toner! I am usually not one to reach for toners I must say, but I will definitely consider using this for the time being. This toner leaves my face feeling refreshed and hydrated. I’ve never been a fan of toners because it feels like they are stripping but this is not like that at all! Thank you Belif and influenster for the opportunity to try this out. *I was given this product to test out, but all opinions are my own.

reviews.product_name: The True Cream Moisturizing Bomb
reviews.review_text: I love this moisturizer for summer. It is so lightweight and also smells light and citrusy. It doesn’t irritate my skin and absorbed really quick. I feel like I will repurchase once I run out, but your get a lot of product.

reviews.product_name: Hyaluronic Acid 2% + B5 Hydrating Serum
reviews.review_text: Honestly this is the best product I’ve found in a long time. I’ve been using it morning and night for about 3 weeks and I’ve already seen a massive change in my skin. I was on accutane previously so going off of it was hard on my skin. I started seeing weird breakouts, skin dullness, and textures I haven’t seen before. Since I started using this my skin look plumper, more even, hydrated and I’m breaking out less. My skin literally looks like I have a filter when I take a picture. It’s that good!! My fine lines have also disappeared and the few I have on my neck are also a lot less noticeable!

reviews.product_name: Vitamin Enriched Face Base Priming Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: Amazing product! My face powder goes on smooth the primer smells so good and is super moisturizing!

reviews.product_name: The Water Cream Oil-Free Pore Minimizing Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: Game changer! I received a sample size and was hooked the moment I applied this to my face! It’s so hydrating and has such a smooth soft texture my skin has become more hydrated and almost more glowing if that makes sense?! Lol either way it’s an amazing cream I have the full sized one coming in the mail!

reviews.product_name: Mini The Water Cream
reviews.review_text: Game changer! I received a sample size and was hooked the moment I applied this to my face! It’s so hydrating and has such a smooth soft texture my skin has become more hydrated and almost more glowing if that makes sense?! Lol either way it’s an amazing cream I have the full sized one coming in the mail!

reviews.product_name: The Silk Peony Melting Eye Cream
reviews.review_text: I absolutely love this eye cream! I apply it each night before bed I don’t completely rub it into my skin but just dab it on with my fingertips. I find after a new months of applying it I have noticed a difference with the fine lines that were forming under my eyes due to age lol. It’s a fair price point too considering some eye creams are well over 100 dollars. This is a gem for a good price! Worth it!

reviews.product_name: Magic Cream Moisturizer with Hyaluronic Acid
reviews.review_text: There is no doubt in my mind that the Charlotte Tilbury Magic Cream is hydrating. It is very moisturizing. It finishes with a slightly tacky texture which works fairly well under foundation. I didn’t notice any firming qualities or pore minimization.  The cream has a subtle scent which isn’t obnoxious. Overall I would say it is a great hydrator for parched skin.

reviews.product_name: Moisture Surge 100H Auto-Replenishing Hydrator Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I wasn’t excited to put this in my face as dimethicone  was the second ingredient listed. My skin doesn’t like it. I tried it on my super dry hands though. I was pleased that there isn’t any real detectable fragrance. My skin was quite hydrated until I had to wash my hands-again! The texture is obviously smooth with the dimethicone-drying down to almost a satin finish.

reviews.product_name: Smart Clinical Repair Wrinkle Correcting Eye Cream
reviews.review_text: I am so grateful to Influenster for allowing me to try out this product for free! All opinions are my own. First of all this eye cream is very thick and hydrating. It applies smoothly and sinks right into the skin. The skin around my eyes stays hydrated  and plumped for hours! The only downside that I would say is that if you are prone to milia, this might be a little thick for you.

reviews.product_name: Santorini Grape Poreless Skin Cream
reviews.review_text: Thank you to Influenster and Korres for this complimentary product to try and review! The Korres Santorini Grape Poreless Skin Cream is very easy to apply. The gel like texture glides on smoothly and evenly. My skin feels slightly tacky , but only for a few minutes. This cream calmed down redness and made my pores look more refined. There is a slight scent-but nothing obnoxious.

reviews.product_name: Rose & Hyaluronic Acid Deep Hydration Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: Absolutely love this moisturizer! If you like the scent of any other fresh products (which I do) you’ll love this one as well. The scent is light and floral, and smells super refreshing without being too heavy. I have pretty sensitive skin and was battling a peeling burn, and after sleeping in a thick layer of this overnight I had a whole new face in the morning. Super moisturizing, and even though the cream is pretty thick, it layers really well under makeup (I have a pretty oily tzone and  things lasted day!) It sinks in pretty well so sliding isn’t an issue. I feel like the jar will last a while, and honestly I’d probably re-purchase again.

reviews.product_name: Barrier+ Triple Lipid-Peptide Face Cream
reviews.review_text: I love the whole skin fix line, and this is no exception. It genuinely does leave my skin super soft and I swear blemishes/scabs/bumble heal faster when using this line. I will say this is a little heavier, so it’s better at night than under makeup for me (though I do have oily skin), but if you’re more chronically dry it might be a twice a day type of deal.

reviews.product_name: Mini Barrier+ Triple Lipid-Peptide Face Cream

reviews.product_name: 5 Stars Retinol + Niacinamide Eye Serum
reviews.review_title: Great gentle retinol for sensitive skin too!
reviews.review_text: Ok, so I’ve been using this for a little over a week, and like to be fair, retinol is a longer term product than that, so I can’t say this like immediately changes my face. What I can say is that I have pretty sensitive skin, and some retinol products have caused irritation in the past, but I haven’t had that issue with this - I think it helps that it’s formulated for the more sensitive under eye area. It doesn’t feel too goopy/greasy on the skin, and seems to layer well with other skincare. Overall a fan initially, and definitely feels nice to apply. Hoping to see results with longer term use.

reviews.product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C
reviews.review_text: I use this all the time, not just at night. I also have the lipgloss. I love the texture and the smell. I know it’s probably true that your lips will dry out if you stop using it but I don’t mind this addiction.

reviews.product_name: Green Clean Makeup Removing Cleansing Balm
reviews.review_text: It does what is says, melts your make up. Even that stubborn mascara. I use my fingers to spread it and then wipe with a reusable cloth. You should still use a cleanser after this because the balm can be very heavy even after wiping it off.

reviews.review_text: In my experience putting this and hand sanitizer would be the same thing. All I feel is burning on certain spots when I put it on and that’s it. I don’t hate it but definitely won’t be purchasing again, too expensive.

reviews.product_name: Vinosource-Hydra Moisturizing Sorbet
reviews.review_text: Amazing lightweight moisturizer, I love this brand and it has been my ally for a couple years now. I have gone through 4 of these already. Love it and will continue to use

reviews.product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C
reviews.review_text: This product is my go to for winter dry chapped lips. It goes on so nice and really helps!

reviews.product_name: PHAT Glow Facial Mask
reviews.review_text: Wow, this product has blown me away. I am usually stuck in a rut when it comes to face products because I have ones that I love and done see any point venturing out but I received this product complimentary for testing purposes and it is fantastic. After one use I noticed that my skin is brighter and softer, it’s very easy to use, just apply and let sit for 15 mins and then wash off. I have sensitive skin and it did not bother me at all. I will continue to use this product in my face regiment.

reviews.product_name: Cold Plunge Pore Remedy Moisturizer with BHA/LHA
reviews.review_text: This pore remedy moisturizer with BHA/LHA is wonderful! The mint really does wake up your skin when you apply it. I have sensitive skin and this is wonderful for it and does not cause any reactions. I have noticed that it substantially reduced the size of my pores since using it on a regular basis.

reviews.product_name: Smart Clinical Repair Wrinkle Correcting Eye Cream
reviews.review_text: This cream is perfect for my eyes because there’s no perfume or fragrance. I use it in the evening, during my skin routine, and i love what i see the morning in the mirror!  #freeproduct

reviews.product_name: Smart Clinical Repair Wrinkle Correcting Cream
reviews.review_title: Glad to have found this product!
reviews.review_text: I discover this product in my morning routine and i was pleasantly surprised by the fact that there is no fragrance or perfume. I really like the feeling it leaves on my skin. It’s not sticky, and it’s very pleasant to use. I recommand it totally! #freeproduct

reviews.product_name: Smart Clinical Repair Wrinkle Correcting Serum
reviews.review_title: A good thing to start my routine!
reviews.review_text: This serum is a good way for me to start my matinal routine. I love how my skin react after using it. #freeproduct

reviews.product_name: Good Genes All-In-One AHA Lactic Acid Treatment
reviews.review_text: Got this product to try, I have combination sensitive acne prone skin and considering the formulation of sunday riley (Clean+Cruelty Free) I decided to give this a try. To see full results ofc one is supposed to wait 28 days, however, I just reallly didn’t see this do it for me. I don’t have major texture/fine lines so that’s not an issue for me, and it didn’t worsen that however i feel like it made little pimples come out in areas i don’t break out in (my cheeks) which is how I know this wasn’t purging. also the FRAGRANCE??? it smelt like a kitchen, and not necessarily in a good way. My sensitive skin didn’t overreact but I just found the fragrance too overwhelming. For someone who wants that exfoliation for the anti aging benefits, i definitely would recommend this. But otherwise I don’t want to risk it with this:/ Definitely not terrible... but for spending 100+ you want results that deliver

reviews.product_name: Watermelon Glow Niacinamide Dew Drops
reviews.review_text: bought this product with my hard owned coinnn because I LOVE the packaging, its beautiful and clearly high quality. I was hoping this formulation of niacinamide wouldn’t break me out considering that’s what TO’s niacinamide serum did to me. As a primer, this gives a dewy glow with that fresh watermelon scent, comparable to hydro grip with dewy benefits. However, as a serum overnight I noticed my skin was a bit more oily and slightly congested. This doesn’t have those exfoliating properties to be causing purging so I stopped using it as a serum. Acne prone people, beware and proceed with caution but that glow is WORTH trying it. I love it under makeup.

reviews.product_name: Green Clean Makeup Removing Cleansing Balm
reviews.review_title: SO GLAD i took the plunge
reviews.review_text: ended up taking the plunge after trying multiple cleansing oils that didn’t wow me. I absolutely love this product. Took my full face of glam off in a minute and is the perfect first cleanse in my double cleanse routine. Smells like a lime sorbet but it doesn’t irritate my sensitive skin. It does leave a bit of that smokey residue in the eyes but I find that to be a common trait with a lot of cleansing balms/oils, and it is a lot less than other ones (eg. Pure coconut oil). This truly works amazingly.

reviews.product_name: Superfood Antioxidant Cleanser
reviews.review_text: Bought this for myself after the hype went around for it. I expect a cleanser to leave my skin feeling refreshed, however, I know that a cleanser will not stop me from having breakouts because that is not the point of a cleanser (at least this one). I have combo acne prone skin and realllly like this. Compared to the soy face cleanser, its more purifying and deep cleaning. I do NOT use this to take off my makeup and the times I tried at the beginning of using this product it did not go well. As a 2nd cleanse it works great. Would not recommend this cleanser for dryer skin as I felt it to leave my skin deeply cleansed and on days I felt dry I’d have to go in with a hydrating toner and mist after this. Smells amazing, like a green smoothie!!! But a light enough scent that it doesn’t over power my sensitive skin. Everyone with combo/oily skin should give this a try.

reviews.product_name: Honey Halo Ultra-Hydrating Ceramide Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I received this product complimentary from Farmacy Beauty to test and give my honest opinion about it, and let me just say it’s amazing! I have very dry, sensitive skin and this has been really giving me a hydrated look and feel! The consistency is a nice creamy formula and it’s made with such good ingredients. I’ve had no issues with feeling overly greasy or getting any breakouts/clogged pores with this product. I use this morning and nightly and can already tell this is going to be my new holy grail cream. Also the packaging is so luxurious! The glass bottle with a wooden looking top is such a nice touch.

reviews.product_name: Jet Lag Mask
reviews.review_text: My skin is always so dry no matter what I try nothing tends to make my skin ever feel hydrated..until this!! I absolutely love how this mask makes my skin feel and look! It’s a nice and creamy texture without being to sticky or thick. Sometimes when my skin even needs extra hydration I will leave the mask on and just bloat it into my skin with a warm towel. I was gifted by Summer Fridays to share my honest opinion.

reviews.review_text: This cleanser is quickly becoming a new staple in my skincare routine!! The powder formula is so unique and gentle. It cleanses your skin while also giving a gentle exfoliation! Ever since I’ve started using this my skin has a radiant glow to it and my pores visibly look so much smaller!

reviews.product_name: Superberry Hydrate + Glow Dream Night Mask with Vitamin C
reviews.review_text: My skin has been in crisis for the last year or so. I hit 40 and Hello Hormonal Acne!!! I wanted to try something natural and ordered the minis kit. This mask has been a lifesaver!! I have been using it every night for the last month as my nighttime moisturizer and it I amazing. I find that in the morning my redness is way down, any nasty bumps from the following day are either greatly reduced or gone, and my skin feels great.I thought my acne was from oily skin but actually just the opposite !! My skin was flaky and dry and this moisturizer took care of that.I feel like I am gushing now, but seriously , this is great stuff .

reviews.review_title: Love this as a day cream
reviews.review_text: I use this as my day cream. I have dry skin and tend to get breakouts on my jawline. This cream is very soothing and does not irritate my skin at all. It is quite hydrating but does not leave my skin feeling greasy. If I need an extra added boost of moisture I use this over the YTTP Superberry Hydrate and Glow Oil. I have been using the line for over a month and my skin is brighter and smoother looking .My breakouts have also been greatly reduced.
