reviews.product_name: Superberry Hydrate + Glow Dream Oil
reviews.review_text: I adore this product. I use this when I want to have a nice glow or when my skin is super dry under the YTTP Adaptogen cream. This has been great for my acne prone skin . I thought my acne was from oil, but nooooo.... my skin was super dry and needed to get moisture to bring it back. Since I started using about about 2 months ago my skin is brighter, smoother and my breakouts are greatly reduced !!

reviews.product_name: B-Hydra Intensive Hydration Serum with Hyaluronic Acid
reviews.review_text: I’ve used this in the past and have recently been trying it again. I am disappointed by it again. The recommended routine was this mixed with c firma, paired with the shaba under eye, and the umbra sheer. This wasn’t enough moisturization for my skin in the harsh northeastern winters. I have had better luck with some other products from other skincare lines. I like this, but I don’t love it. Its light, the pump is easy to use, and there isn’t any piling or residue issues with makeup application. When I’ve used this in warmer weather, with higher humidity, it’s been more enjoyable. Its just not for me during the winter.

reviews.product_name: Umbra Sheer Physical Daily Defense SPF 30
reviews.review_text: I’ve tried a lot of.mineral sunscreens this year, and I had been wanting to try this from Drunk Elephant, because they have such a good reputation. I was shocked to find that the sunscreen leaves a white cast all over my skin. I’m a very pale person, and it showed up streaky and ghostly. To use the recommended amount of mineral sunscreen, it takes several minutes to rub this into my face and neck, and even then a cast is left. It is also quite oily, which is okay for me during the winter but I can’t imagine using this during the summer and not looking like a grease ball shortly into my day.

reviews.product_name: Benefiance Wrinkle Smoothing Eye Cream
reviews.review_text: This is a very creamy and emollient eye cream, and a little bit goes a LONG way. It definitely hydrates well and leaves my skin feeling soft and plump. If you are looking for an eye cream in this price range, you won’t be disappointed. Having used it for about a week, I can see the difference in hydration of my under eye skin, and my wrinkles are minimized. I received this product complimentary to test and provide my honest review.

reviews.product_name: Estee Lauder Advanced Night Repair Synchronized Multi-Recovery Complex Serum
reviews.review_text: I received this free for testing purposes. I like this! It’s different than just about any other product I’ve used in that I can see an immediate difference in my skin. I don’t know which ingredient causes the instant glow, but it’s visible. I can’t say whether it is significantly better than other similar products beyond that, but it is nice, and if you like Estee products you’ll probably find this to be enjoyable. The scent is nice, light and floral, it’s a good texture and a little goes a long way.

reviews.product_name: T.L.C. Sukari Babyfacial AHA + BHA Mask
reviews.review_text: My facial skin is persnickety. Some days super resilient, other days hyper-sensitive and will burn just for fun if you give it side-eye. Drunk Elephant’s BabyFacial is magical and never irritates my skin. Every time I use it (theoretically weekly, realistically semi-monthly), my face glows the next day. I use it in conjunction with Drunk Elephant’s Virgin Marula Oil, after cleansing with Drunk Elephant’s Pekee Bar or Beste No. 9 cleanser for outstanding results.

reviews.product_name: Avocado Fine Line Eye Cream with Retinol
reviews.review_text: This is a product I sampled from a local shop, liked, purchased, and have since repurchased. This is my every night eye product. Skincare around my eyes is absolutely critical as I rapidly approach my 40th birthday. I have taken fairly good care of my skin since I intermittently worked in spas (day and medical) as a teen and young adult, but tended to neglect the skin around my eyes. Once I did start looking for eye creams I struggled to find something that played nice with my sensitive eyes and contacts. The GLOW RECIPE Avocado Melt Retinol Eye Sleeping Mask has nenver irritated the skin around my eyes. I apply entirely around my eye, including on my eyelid. Even when I am a bit leaky-eyed from allergies, this product has been gentle and, along with the rest of my eye skin care regimen, keeping my fine lines very minimal.

reviews.product_name: Adaptogen Deep Moisturizing Cream with Ashwagandha + Reishi
reviews.review_text: I used YOUTH TO THE PEOPLE Adaptogen Deep Moisture Cream with Ashwagandha + Reishi a couple times, both during the day and as the last step in my evening ritual for my very dry skin. Both times I felt like this moisturizer just sat on top of my skin and did not absorb at all. My skin very rarely gets a greasy feeling (not even from La Mer’s regular Creme  or Nivea’s cream!), but this felt like an oil slick. I have tried a few of the YTTP products so far, and I just do not think this brand works for me. This is really disappointing because I admire the brand, but the products and I do not get along. I would suggest that you try a sample to see if it works for you.

reviews.product_name: Facial Treatment Essence (Pitera Essence)
reviews.review_text: In comparison with the other SK-II products that I have used, the SK-II Pitera Facial Treatment Essence is wonderfully light and comfortable to use. It makes application of subsequent products absorb very well and my skin feels bouncy and clear. I love that it helps reduce the a lot of the redness in my skin. I have used Tatcha’s Essence and the SK-II interchangeably and either is a great option. Tatcha has almost no fragrance and SK-II has a light scent that quickly dissipates. I love having an Essence in my routine and would happily recommend the SK-II to anyone wanting to add one to their regimen.

reviews.product_name: C-Rush Vitamin C Gel Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: This product is a new staple in my skin care routine! I received the C Rush Brightening Gel Creme in a Voxbox from Influenster about three and a half weeks ago, and I’ve already used almost all of it! I apply the brightening gel morning and night and it makes my skin feel so smooth and look so much brighter! It’s not heavy on the skin and it doesn’t make my face feel greasy. I seriously notice a difference if I don’t apply this before I do my makeup for the day. I will definitely be repurchasing this when I run out and I definitely recommend trying it!

reviews.product_name: Ultra Facial Moisturizing Cream with Squalane
reviews.review_text: I received this face wash in an Influenster Voxbox, and I’m so thankful because I am absolutely in love with this product! I recently went on a beach vacation with my family and this is the only face cream I packed. The product is gentle and light and does not clog my pores. Even when I got a little sunburned, it didn’t irritate my skin. I highly recommend this!

reviews.review_text: I was really really happy with this product. My skin feels soft and smooth, and it has given me back my glow. Love it!

reviews.review_title: Works quickly and has great results
reviews.review_text: I was really very impressed with this serum. I’m a bit self conscious about my large pores and this definitely helped to improve them. My face looks and feels better after using this!

reviews.product_name: Soy Hydrating Gentle Face Cleanser
reviews.review_text: Really cleanses the face without stripping it or drying it out. I do notice a positive difference in my skin when I use this, which is rare with cleansers. I only use mineral foundation so I don’t know how it works at removing heavy makeup, though it does remove my mascara. It’s pricey though and I need to use quite a bit to cleanse my entire face. I’m trying something new currently, but have repurchased this many times and would recommend this if you’re having a hard time finding a gentle, yet effective, cleanser.

reviews.product_name: T.L.C. Framboos Glycolic Resurfacing Night Serum
reviews.review_title: Non irritating and helps with hyperpigmentation
reviews.review_text: I love this serum. Most serums break me out or irritate my skin. This didn’t irritate or break me out, and has really helped in fading dark spots and hyperpigmentation. The packaging is hygienic and protects the ingredients from light or air. It’s expensive but definitely worth it in my opinion.

reviews.product_name: Creamy Eye Treatment with Avocado
reviews.review_text: Such a rich, creamy, non-irritating eye cream that moisturizers dry under eye skin. My eyes are very sensitive to a lot of eye creams and this has never bothered them. Also, really inexpensive as a little goes a long way.

reviews.product_name: The True Cream Moisturizing Bomb
reviews.review_text: 5 stars! This is my go to cream for that punch of hydration my skin needs! Really great for sensitive skin like mine and also lasts me a good few months.  Great price as well!

reviews.product_name: Niacinamide 10% + Zinc 1% Oil Control Serum
reviews.review_text: This stuff is a miracle, it seriously got rid of my acne.  My skin looks so much better.  This serum will for sure be a part of my routine as long as i can still buy it.  I have found that I run out in just under a month, but for the price I would buy this every week if needed.  Thank you Hyram!!!

reviews.product_name: Natural Moisturizing Factors + HA
reviews.review_text: I love this moisturizer! I have dry and sensitive skin and it works so well.  It really leaves my face hydrated without any greasy feeling.  My only advice is that it soaks in very fast so I can’t just get a bit in my hands and apply it, I have to apply smaller dots around my face then rub it in.  The price and quality in ON POINT for this moisturizer.  The ordinary is my new go to brand for skin care

reviews.product_name: Adaptogen Deep Moisturizing Cream with Ashwagandha + Reishi
reviews.review_text: I got this as a sample.  It feels lightweight and goes on easy seems pretty moisturizing but unfortunately it made my lips feel tingly and did nothing for my redness.  In fact, it made me have more redness.  I have mostly dry sensitive skin with some oiliness in my T zone.  Maybe this would be better for someone with dry skin who does not have sensitive skin.  Won’t be buying the full size.  I’ll stick to my The Ordinary moisturizer, works way better and 50$ less.

reviews.product_name: Mini Adaptogen Deep Moisture Cream with Ashwagandha + Reishi

reviews.product_name: Caffeine 5% + EGCG Depuffing Eye Serum
reviews.review_text: I’m a mom of 2 under 2 and my dark circles are crazy...until I started using this. I noticed an improvement right away and now after about 2 weeks of use, I still look tired, but I don’t look one foot in the grave. Ordered a second bottle.

reviews.product_name: Cleansing & Exfoliating Wipes
reviews.review_text: They don’t hold much moisture and it takes several to remove any makeup, it made my skin break out.

reviews.product_name: Hyaluronic Acid 2% + B5 Hydrating Serum
reviews.review_text: Absolutely LOVE this product. I love that it’s vegan, I love that it’s simple, I love that it works and I LOVE that I can add it to other DIY skin care. It has done amazing things to rid the dry spots and signs of aging plaguing my face. Amazing. I’ve bought 6 bottles or so now and the quality is always there.

reviews.product_name: Natural Moisturizing Factors + HA
reviews.review_text: Feels a bit waxy, but otherwise very comfortable, very moisturizing and is amazing with the hyaluronic acid and caffeine solution.

reviews.product_name: C-Rush Vitamin C Gel Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: #OleGlow I use the vitamin c serum and have loved it, I received this product at the perfect time. With the weather changing, my skin literally felt like an alligator with all it’s scales. I’ve tried masks and FAB ultra repair moisturizer and nothing worked. I put this on and instantly my skin felt less dry and was glowing. I received this complimentary for sampling purposes but all opinions are mine. I will be buying this product when I am through with this jar. new HG!!

reviews.product_name: Jet Lag Mask
reviews.review_text: Absorbs quickly and smells so good! This leaves my face looking so soft and moisturized. I use it as a night mask but also on windy days to keep my fave protected.

reviews.product_name: Mini Jet Lag Mask
reviews.review_text: Absorbs quickly and smells so good! This leaves my face looking so soft and moisturized. I use it as a night mask but also on windy days to keep my fave protected.

reviews.review_text: Great results! Loved the way it felt and looked. It did improve my skins brightness

reviews.product_name: 5 Stars Retinol + Niacinamide Eye Serum
reviews.review_text: I absolutely loved this product! It went on super smooth and did not irritate my eyes which normally happens with under eye cream. I have used quite a few and I have to say this is one of my favorites for sure!

reviews.product_name: Precleanse Cleansing Oil
reviews.review_text: I love this product. I use it every night to get rid of my makeup and it works like a dream. I’ve previously used this before and I will continue to use it. Definitely a staple product!! I am obsessed. Gifted by Dermalogica

reviews.product_name: Mini Precleanse Cleansing Oil
reviews.review_text: I love this product. I use it every night to get rid of my makeup and it works like a dream. I’ve previously used this before and I will continue to use it. Definitely a staple product!! I am obsessed. Gifted by Dermalogica

reviews.product_name: Floral Recovery Overnight Mask with Squalane
reviews.review_text: So far I am absolutely loving this product. I have a lot of fine lines and it makes my skin feel absolutely amazing every time I use it. I have always been a fan of Fresh and this product has become a quick favorite!

reviews.product_name: U.F.O. Salicylic Acid BHA Acne Treatment Face Oil
reviews.review_text: This has become a staple in my morning and night skincare routine. I used to be extremely oily, dehydrated skin and acne prone. I am now acne free, normal skin and no longer have dehydrated skin. Each time I go to wash my face I am disbelief about how smooth and bright my skin is looking.

reviews.product_name: Revitalizing Supreme+ Youth Power Creme Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: This is a hydrating facial lotion that also softens the skin. I have found that I like to layer it with other serums for an additional hydration. It isn’t the most hydrating lotion and does need to be layered. I also was not a fan of the strong perfume, after a couple of days my skin broke out due to sensitivity to it.

reviews.product_name: Mini Revitalizing Supreme+ Youth Power Creme Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: This is a hydrating facial lotion that also softens the skin. I have found that I like to layer it with other serums for an additional hydration. It isn’t the most hydrating lotion and does need to be layered. I also was not a fan of the strong perfume, after a couple of days my skin broke out due to sensitivity to it.

reviews.product_name: Santorini Grape Poreless Skin Cream
reviews.review_text: This is a moisturizer, I do like how there isn’t a strong perfume scent. But wasn’t wowed by it, I found it was not as hydrating or softening as other products I use. I will stick to my favorites like Belif Moisture Bomb and Cosrx All In One, as I prefer the glass skin look.

reviews.product_name: Urban Environment Oil-Free Sunscreen Broad-Spectrum SPF 42
reviews.review_text: I used this sunscreen for my arms, shoulders, and chest instead of the face since I prefer a dewy, glass skin look. It dries down quickly and doesn’t have a tacky or oily texture. I also liked how the sunscreen scent was not as strong as others. I probably will not repurchase this, due to not using it on my face, and there are more affordable body spfs.

reviews.product_name: Urban Environment Fresh-Moisture Sunscreen Broad-Spectrum SPF 42
reviews.review_text: I liked this sunscreen a lot for my face and will continue to use it. It is moisturizing without the oily or tacky texture. Also, it does have the typical sunscreen scent but is not as strong. I also like how it gives my skin a healthy glow. Honestly, I do not know if I would repurchase this, but so far both my face and I are liking it.

reviews.product_name: Green Clean Makeup Removing Cleansing Balm
reviews.review_text: The smell is very herbal and it might not be my favorite thing, but there are two important things I discovered after slathering this balm on my face.There is no real effort to take the makeup off. A little bit of water and yes, the balm really does “melt“ your makeup. This includes your mascara. In my case, there was no irritation or swelling. This will remove your mascara. Stubborn, sticky mascara formula? It came right off. No scrubbing needed.I really want to push how gentle this formula is. Clean beauty doesn’t mean free from common allergens or other suspect ingredients. Most of the active ingredients I found aren’t too offensive on the skin.This product also helped reduce painful swelling from a recent breakout. This was unexpected, but I’ll take it.Surprising and incredible. I will likely purchase this in the future. If you have oily, combination, and/or acne-prone skin, this is something to keep in mind.

reviews.product_name: Honeymoon Glow AHA Resurfacing Night Serum
reviews.review_text: I had a small sample of Honey Moon Glow show up with a recent purchase. Thought why not. The ingredients aren’t anything I’m allergic to. Sadly most of the Clean products at Sephora usually contain my most common allergens. This does not and the smell was pleasant instead of overpowering.This doesn’t need the generous amount it claims for you to see results if you’re looking for acne help. For me, it ended up forcing acne to surface so I could treat it immediately while keeping my skin even-toned and hydrated. I have fewer dry patches on my face, but no more acne on my chin from my sweating due to severe pain. This is a first.This does work quickly and you’ll see results, but keep up with it. Twice a week worked for me, but if you feel hidden acne trying to slip through, put a layer on with some extra love where you can feel it.Worth a purchase and I will certainly be picking up a full bottle in the future. Just for the help with my acne alone, it was worth the trouble.

reviews.product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C
reviews.review_text: Slap it on right before you roll over to sleep and it fixes everything terrible you did to your lips that day. Even better? Works under your eyes if none of your eye creams have been successful in soothing any dry skin problems you’ve incurred.However this isn’t regular lip balm. You could do that, but you’re just going to find it wearing off and you’re not going to get the full effect.

reviews.product_name: Glow Cycle Retin-ALT Power Serum
reviews.review_text: I got this complimentary to try out and review and I highly recommend this product! I’ve been using it for a few weeks and I can definitely tell that it has made my skin smoother and the dark spots on my eyelids lighter. Plus it smells really good!

reviews.product_name: Jet Lag Mask
reviews.review_text: Thank god for this mask! My skin was feeling super dry because of the weather change and this is so hydrating. My skin felt so great afterwards.

reviews.product_name: Mini Jet Lag Mask
reviews.review_text: Thank god for this mask! My skin was feeling super dry because of the weather change and this is so hydrating. My skin felt so great afterwards.

reviews.product_name: Greek Yoghurt Nourishing Probiotic Gel-Cream
reviews.review_text: I received this product to try out complimentary and it was actually quite nice. I have combination skin and sometimes the foundation I use can add to any dryness. This product added the perfect amount of moisture on days where my skin wasn’t the best. I also really enjoyed using it on my neck, chest, and hands. Do recommend.

reviews.product_name: The Water Cream Oil-Free Pore Minimizing Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I’ve been using this moisturizer for a few years now, and it’s definitely my go-to. I have combo skin, and this hydrates my dry patches without making my T zone greasy. Highly recommend.

reviews.product_name: Mini The Water Cream
reviews.review_text: I’ve been using this moisturizer for a few years now, and it’s definitely my go-to. I have combo skin, and this hydrates my dry patches without making my T zone greasy. Highly recommend.

reviews.product_name: Unseen Sunscreen SPF 40 PA+++
reviews.review_text: Really is unseen. No white cast whatsoever and goes under makeup nicely.

reviews.product_name: Mini Unseen Sunscreen SPF 40 PA+++
reviews.review_text: Really is unseen. No white cast whatsoever and goes under makeup nicely.

reviews.product_name: Plum Plump Hyaluronic Acid Serum
reviews.review_text: I use this twice a day and have been for about a year now. My skin is plump, hydrated, and looking snatched. It’s a really great serum.

reviews.product_name: Facial Treatment Essence (Pitera Essence)
reviews.review_title: Great for difficult skin that hates everything
reviews.review_text: I just have unfortunate skin. I’m in my 30s but have had acne (moderate/hormonal/under the skin) for most of my life. I’ve tried prescription topicals, diets, supplements, a myriad of face washes, skincare systems and spot treatments, adapalene, etc. I’ve tried almost everything. I think the issue is that my skin is not at all oily, but instead is dry and sensitive, so most acne products just make it worse. Then I found SKII. In combination with Shiseido Ultimune, used daily for about 3 months, I’ve noticed an improvement in texture/scarring, discoloration and dryness. My skin responds to almost nothing, so for there to be a visible change at all is incredible. I think it’s the fungi that are in both products, honestly. I highly recommend this if your skin is sensitive, aging   acne prone. If nothing else works, try this. I feel like people who are blessed with naturally clear and generally balanced complexions may not notice much of change, but for those of us that continually struggle this is a godsend.

reviews.product_name: Pure Skin Face Cleanser
reviews.review_title: Lovely texture, appropriate for sensitive skin
reviews.review_text: My best friend recommended this to me and is obsessed with it, so I figured I’d give it a try! Overall, it’s a really nice product with a mild smell and rich texture. I have difficult skin and was hoping the clean and gentle formula might help acne and irritation. It’s a no go for improving breakouts on me, but it definitely hasn’t hurt my easily irritated combination-dry skin. I’m nearly through the tube now and would absolutely recommend this to people with sensitive skin of any type.

reviews.product_name: Checks and Balances Frothy Face Wash
reviews.review_title: Gentle, light scent and good for combination skin
reviews.review_text: This is a “just come back to it” kind of face wash. It’s one of my old reliables. I’ve used it on and off since I was a teenager. I’m now in my 30s, so that longevity tells you this is tried and true for lots of people! It’s just a well rounded cleanser. The smell isn’t over the top, it’s creamy, not too hard on my dry spots but still cleanses my oilier forehead. My acne has mostly faded away as I’ve gotten older, but when I had moderately bad acne this was still gentle, didn’t make breakouts worse (it also won’t clear them though, so if you have acne or very oily skin, I’d maybe look for something more specific to that need). Highly recommend for combination/dry skin.

reviews.product_name: Aqua Bomb Sleeping Mask
reviews.review_text: This masks feels so soothing as it goes on.  Love the jelly-like texture.  Soaks in completely after a few minutes.  When wake up in the morning my face is soft and smooth.  Would absolutely buy again.

reviews.product_name: Soy Hydrating Gentle Face Cleanser
reviews.review_text: I finally found a facial cleanser that cleans well and does not strip my skin.  I have very sensitive skin with rosacea and this is my fav.

reviews.product_name: Smart Clinical Repair Wrinkle Correcting Eye Cream
reviews.review_text: I really like this new eye cream! It feels cool, soothing, and refreshing going on.  It is just the right consistency—not too heavy and not too light.  In the week since I have been using it, I can see some difference with my under eye area feeling smoother and more moisturized after consistent use.  I highly recommend trying it and will purchase this when I run out.

reviews.product_name: Lip Glowy Balm
reviews.review_text: I’ve really been enjoying this balm. I love the grapefruit scent and I can’t wait to try the other three. It’s so smooth and not at all sticky. I feel that it lasts a good amount of time as well. I even like the packaging!

reviews.product_name: Brazilian Kiss Cupuaçu Lip Butter
reviews.review_text: I love the scent of this product, but it’s just okay at hydrating my lips. For the amount I received and the price I payed, I expected a quality, moisturizing, and soothing lip butter, not a waxy chap stick.

reviews.product_name: Mini Rose & Hyaluronic Acid Deep Hydration Toner
reviews.review_text: The way it moisturizes, the scent, and the way it makes my face feel clean and fresh are the reasons why I love this toner. The bottle is also really pretty with all the petals floating around. I haven’t had any issues with clogging and I’m down to the last fifth or so of my bottle. I feel it’s worth the price for what you get!

reviews.product_name: Sugar Hydrating Lip Balm
reviews.review_text: This balm smells wonderful and the packaging looks slick and expensive, but what you get just doesn’t match what you pay. It isn’t great at keeping my lips moisturized and that’s the main reason I made the purchase.

reviews.product_name: Sugar Hydrating Lip Balm
reviews.review_text: Great scent and moisturizes well. I feel it’s a bit pricey for the amount you get, but I consider it an indulgence to buy fancy balms here and there. I would like to try their other flavors to compare.

reviews.product_name: Alpha Beta Extra Strength Daily Peel Pads
reviews.review_text: This is my favorite skin care product of all time. I use these twice a week before bed, followed by a good night cream and I wake up with the softest, glowiest skin. Absolutely love. If you’re on the fence, by the mini pack of 5 for $17. Great way to see how they work for your skin.

reviews.product_name: Glow2OH Dark Spot Toner
reviews.review_text: Was skeptical about whether this would make a difference in my skincare routine, but I’ve used it for about a month and I can definitely tell a difference when I skip it. I use the Dr. Dennis Gross Extra Strength Peel Pads for a more intense exfoliation once a week, but this toner helps keep my skin soft and smooth and glowy between peels.

reviews.product_name: Superberry Hydrate + Glow Dream Oil
reviews.review_text: I live in a super dry climate, and am constantly looking for a face oil that with lock in moisture and give me a healthy glow. This oil is lightweight but also extremely hydrating. I apply it in the morning and give it 20-30 mins to absorb before applying my makeup, and then apply again at night. Huge fan. Will repurchase.

reviews.product_name: Slaai  Makeup-Melting Butter Cleanser
reviews.review_text: Purchased this on a whim and was super disappointed. It removes makeup well, but it does not rinse clean. Even after repeatedly rinsing I felt like I had a film on my face. If you’re looking for a good cleansing balm, I would strongly recommend Farmacy’s line.

reviews.product_name: Double Serum Firming & Smoothing Anti-Aging Concentrate
reviews.review_text: I love this product and use it regularly unless it’s sweltering hot out. It’s light, smells nice and does seem to improve the texture of my skin (over 40 skin I should say...)

reviews.product_name: Checks and Balances Frothy Face Wash
reviews.review_text: I’ve used this product for years and it’s my favourite that I always go back to. I have oily/combination yet sensitive skin and it strips the oil without irritating. Perfect especially in the summer. One of my top 5 products.

reviews.product_name: Clear Sunscreen Stick SPF 50+
reviews.review_text: Great but you don’t get much! It goes on smoothly and is invisible and it seems to do the trick. I was shocked though when I realized how little there actually was in the tube. I love Shiseido sunscreens, they could give us more for the price though for this one.

reviews.product_name: Cicapair Tiger Grass Color Correcting Treatment SPF 30
reviews.review_text: I can see how this works for some people but it felt too thick and looked yellow on my skin. I over applied at first try so then applied lighter which was better but still not great. Also by applying such a thin layer, I’m pretty sure it wasn’t enough for the spf 30 to work. Not great for my combo/aging skin. Plus rubbed off on everything! Wouldn’t repurchase and won’t force myself to use it all up, at least I bought the small size.

reviews.product_name: Volcanic AHA Pore Clearing Clay Mask
reviews.review_text: This is a very nice mask. It feels good in use and leaves my skin smooth. It did help clear up blemishes when I used it for spot treatments and made those areas less oily. I received this product complimentary from innisfree in exchange for my honest review.

reviews.product_name: Daily Greens Oil-Free Gel Moisturizer with Moringa and Papaya
reviews.review_text: I received this product complimentary from Farmacy Beauty for reviewing purposes, and I may have a new favorite moisturizer. I have normal skin, so I don’t apply moisturizer daily even though I should. This oil-free gel moisturizer is so light and the scent refreshing, that now I want to apply moisturizer daily. It has a matte finish with hydration that lasts all day long for me. I also found it very soothing and nourishing for a recent sunburn while camping, and I used this gel since I didn’t have aloe with me. It worked beautifully!

reviews.product_name: Good Genes All-In-One AHA Lactic Acid Treatment
reviews.review_title: Left my skin smooth, soft and radiant!
reviews.review_text: Sunday Riley gifted me their Good Genes All-in-One Lactic Acid Treatment in exchange for my honest review. This is a great exfoliator that leaves my skin smooth, soft and radiant. I recently finished up a resurfacing serum from a different brand, and I didn’t expect this new one to keep up with those results, but it exceeded my expectations. After one week of use, my skin continues to glow with clarity. My skin tone is even, radiant and the smoothest my skin has ever been. It’s also keeping fine lines and wrinkles at bay even with my maturing skin thanks to its plumping benefits. Although I can’t say this product alone gave me beautiful results since I was already happy with my skin, I can say it’s just as good as other high-end lactic acid treatments I’ve tried. It has a nice clean, kind of citrus scent and it absorbs very well. I love the subtle scent even more than the last treatment I tried. I would happily recommend this product. It’s keeping my skin happy and pretty.

reviews.product_name: 5 Stars Retinol + Niacinamide Eye Serum
reviews.review_text: My trouble areas are around / under my eyes AND my crows feet so this product targets exactly what I need. I love how it’s a night time thing (i am sure you could use more often if you wanted...) That makes it feel less overwhelming and feels very effective for that reason. I enjoyed the smell the feel and the application process of this cream. It’s too early to say if it works VERY well but I’ve seen some changes and softening of lines and will continue to use it!! I received this product for free but my thoughts are my own!!

reviews.product_name: Retinol Youth Renewal Serum
reviews.review_text: Wow this stuff is amazing. I saw results almost immediately! I am tempted to use it day and night just because it seems to be working so well, I want to keep using it! It does tingle a little and I don’t have super sensitive skin so that’s something to consider if you’re sensitive. You shouldnt start using it every day if that’s the case.

reviews.product_name: Good Genes All-In-One AHA Lactic Acid Treatment
Niacinamide 10% + Zinc 1% Oil Control Serum

reviews.product_name: Blue Tansy BHA and Enzyme Pore Refining Mask

To be honest I haven’t noticed any transformational differences. This would be good for people who have sensitive skin because this is very gentle. I use a retinol and the AHA BHA mask by the ordinary in my weekly routine and this product is definitely the most gentle out of the three.

reviews.product_name: Smart Clinical Repair Wrinkle Correcting Eye Cream
reviews.review_title: A good result after 3 days with a sample.
reviews.review_text: I used this #freeproduct sample and  for three days, morning and evening, with very promising results. The crepey wrinkles on my eyelids and under my eyes did plump up.  I will be purchasing a full size in anticipation for similar results for prolonged use.  There was no redness,  no itching or sloughing and the absorption rate was fast and complete.  I wear eye makeup and am fussy about eye creams that will clog pores and trap eye shadow and mascara, no problems here.  My tolerance for prolonged use differs with many products so this will be joining my small eye cream collection, and just possibly, replacing them.

reviews.product_name: Smart Clinical Repair Wrinkle Correcting Cream
reviews.review_title: A promising addition to the retinol race.
reviews.review_text: This is a review for a #freeproduct that worked for me.  The product claims are for results in 9 weeks and the samples provided were good for three to four days.  The cream is a bit sticky but mixed with the serum both absorbed quickly.  I have used other retinols, many of which have irritated my sensitive skin, not so with this Clinique product. It does eventually absorb and leaves no greasy or shiny finish.  The other thing I like in comparison to others...it did not sit on the skin and slough off, something I find with many other comparable products, particularly when you use a sunscreen of any kind. I would be interested to see results after weeks of use.

reviews.product_name: Smart Clinical Repair Wrinkle Correcting Serum
reviews.review_text: This review is a 4 out of 5 as the sample size #freeproduct was not enough to know if there would be any tolerance issues. This serum absorbs beautifully, is light, no fragrance and my skin loved it...soft and silky to the touch. Clinique suggests using the cream, eye cream and serum together in one program.  I would suggest mixing the serum with the cream as it helps the cream absorb more quickly and it isn’t sticky.  I would recommend this serum for first time users and long term users looking for a change or something new.

reviews.product_name: Protini Polypeptide Firming Refillable Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: Many pros about this one. I love the smell; nice and light, not heavily perfumed. This moisturizer makes my skin feel so CREAMY and doesn’t make me break out. I had dry patches above my eyes until this sweet thang came along and fixed it.Only 4 stars because I think 90 bucks is pretty expensive for a full size, but if you have the expendable income, this is a solid moisturizer.Plus, I think the container is gorgeous and love reusing it for other samples I receive.

reviews.product_name: Vegan Milk Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: Okay so I bought this when it was on sale for 50% off, and man do I ever think it was an awesome purchase for 25 bucks. I wouldn’t pay 50 for it though, I don’t think. It is scentless which is kinda neat, and the texture is super cool. Like whipped cream, kind of. Just a nice, rich moisturizer. And I gotta admit, it’s hydrating.Anyway I would even spend 40 bucks on this, but I think I will wait until the next sale.

reviews.product_name: Squalane + Omega Repair Deep Hydration Moisturizer
reviews.review_title: Best moisturizer I ever used, smells weird though
reviews.review_text: I cannot tell you how much healthier this moisturizer made my face feel. It is light and non-greasy, and hydrates your skin like nothing I’ve used before. I have an acne-prone face (it’s pretty persistent) and this shockingly didn’t break me out. I would give it 5 stars, BUT after using two samples and getting a full size, I gotta say...this stuff smells a little funky. I can hack it, because I truly love the results, but I can understand the smell putting people off. Still. I will continue to recommend this moisturizer to everyone I know. Regardless of how it smells, it makes your skin so plump and hydrated!

reviews.product_name: Original Skin Retexturizing Mask with Rose Clay
reviews.review_text: Great mask to use once or twice a week really seems to make an improvement in the texture of my skin. After each use my face feels soft and smooth and my pimples are reduced in size. Not overly drying but feels like it sucks out impurities

reviews.product_name: Pure Skin Face Cleanser
reviews.review_text: A good, basic, non-irritating cleanser to use in alternation/ alongside with more active based products! Cleans away dirt and oil without feeling overly stripping. Would repurchase :)

reviews.review_title: Goes on smooth and less visible Pores
reviews.review_text: I received this Estēe Lauder advanced Night Repair Eye Concentrate from Influenster for testing purposes. After trying for a week or so I love it. The skin under my eyes is softer and some of the visible pores I had are getting less noticeable. I would definitely recommend adding this to your skincare regimen. It also goes on smoothly and doesn’t leave my skin feeling greasy.

reviews.product_name: Smart Clinical Repair Wrinkle Correcting Cream
reviews.review_text: I received a sample size from Influenster in exchange for an honest review. The pros...it absorbs nicely, doesn’t leave my face feeling greasy and it has a pleasant smell. The Con...I don’t know how well it will help with fine lines. A sample may be too small to fully determine the effects honestly. I do like how my skin feels though.

reviews.product_name: Good Genes All-In-One AHA Lactic Acid Treatment
reviews.review_title: Used 2 mini trial sizes. Finally caved! Worth it!!
reviews.review_text: Love this product. I kept trying to convince myself it wasn’t worth the price - but I really do think it is worth every penny. I first tried Good Genes in the Flash Fix duo package (small travel size of Good Genes and Ceramic Slip for around $30). I went through one travel size, liked it, skin looked great - but convinced myself it wasn’t just due to this treatment. Didn’t repurchase it.....until my skin went on the fritz again (acne, dry spots, oily areas, the works). After not having any luck with other products I bought a second flash fix duo for the Good Genes bottle. It helped instantly.....and now I’ve finally come around to buying the full size. So far, so great - 1/2 pump is enough for my face and neck. I put this on in the evenings and my skin is looking bright and clear! It helps keep my hormonal acne at bay, lighten up acne spots, revive dull looking skin, and help with anti-aging. What more could I ask for?

reviews.product_name: Creamy Eye Treatment with Avocado
reviews.review_title: Love for a hydrating night time eye cream
reviews.review_text: I use this nightly as an evening eye treatment. Originally I kept focusing on getting something with anti-aging or targeted for wrinkles - but have noticed a more hydrated appearance in my under eye area. I have repurchased this multiple times!

reviews.product_name: Squalane + Omega Repair Deep Hydration Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I always battle with dry skin during the Midwest winters and have been unsuccessful in trying to find a moisturizer that keeps my skin feeling hydrated for more than 10 minutes after I put it on - even when I’ve resorted to heavier creams. I’ve been using this biossance moisturizer for about a month now, morning and night, and I can tell that my skin feels and looks so much healthier and hydrated than it ever has before in mid-January. I will be using this regularly from now on. Some people remarked on the smell, but I don’t really think the smell is bad or even that strong. You don’t smell anything after putting it on your skin.

reviews.product_name: Glycolic Acid 7% Exfoliating Toning Solution
reviews.review_text: This toner is amazing which is why it’s probably always out of stock!Ever since quarantine started, I’ve been wearing masks every day as I’m an essential worker. This has helped me so much with acne and irritation along my neck and jawline from having wearing my mask! I had angry, red pimples all over my neck and this has made them disappear!To start, I wash my face with a gentle face wash (cetaphil daily), put some of this on a cotton round and wipe my face, then follow up with Kiehl’s Ultra Facial Cream and it’s been working wonders! My skin looks so smooth, gotten rid of all my acne, and it has evened out my texture!

reviews.product_name: Lippe Balm
reviews.review_text: This is my favorite lip balm. Although a bit pricey, this is the only one that works for my chronically dry lips. I apply it nightly and wake up to smooth lips!

reviews.review_text: I bought this product because I loved the smell. I wasn’t expecting it to work miracles, but I was wrong. It totally did. I noticed the difference while wearing a lip stain the next day. No flaking! I’m hooked.

reviews.product_name: Ultra Repair Cream Intense Hydration
reviews.review_text: This is my holy grail of healing lotions. It absorbs well and keeps my hands soft. No greasy feeling at all (can’t stand that most lotions are just slimy). I have a tube at home, in the car, and at my desk. I love this hand cream and will never use another - I’m in love!

reviews.review_text: When I am having dry skin flare ups, this is my go to! I don’t know what it is but it helps smooth and calm my skin right away. I use this product in my PM routine and when I wake up my skin looks better than ever. I received this as a sample for testing purposes.

reviews.product_name: C-Rush Vitamin C Gel Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I love this moisturizer so much! I hydrates my dry skin so well and makes it feel so soft and smooth. I also get the best glow from it that’s not too intense but very healthy! It makes my dry patches go away and looks amazing under makeup too!

reviews.product_name: Watermelon Glow Niacinamide Dew Drops
reviews.review_text: I honestly love all glow recipe products! This one is amazing. My skin feels so hydrated and plump after using it. I’ve been adding it to my morning routine and it’s working well with all of my other products and under makeup! The consistency is thin so it absorbs pretty fast, too! *gifted by Glow Recipe

reviews.product_name: Magic Cream Moisturizer with Hyaluronic Acid
reviews.review_text: I loveee this moisturizer! My skin drinks it right up! It’s a thicker cream and it’s perfect for dry skin. It has a very pleasant and subtle scent. It absorbs into the skin and leaves you feeling super moisturized. Honestly one of the best ones I’ve tried for dry skin!

reviews.product_name: Rose Deep Hydration Sleeping Mask
reviews.review_text: Alot of people don’t like overnight masks because of them typically being tacky, super thick, or just uncomfortable on the skin- but this mask is none of those things! i got mine complimentary from Influenster, I absolutely LOVE this mask and it’s lightweight formula is perfect for my combination skin. I wake up in the morning with beautiful

reviews.product_name: Hyaluronic Acid Hydrating Serum
reviews.review_text: Absolutely LOVE!! I received Hyaluronic Acid from Influenster and using this in conjunction with the Inkey List Q10 and Polyglutamic Acid did some MAGIC for my skin. Not only is the product incredible but it’s only $8!! I’ve had all three for almost two months now and I am JUST running out- and I’ve used each one atleast once a day, sometimes twice a day. I found my new favorite and AFFORDABLE brand at Sephora!!

reviews.product_name: Avocado Fine Line Eye Cream with Retinol
reviews.review_text: I primarily use this product at nighttime after toning but before serums as I find that to be the most effective. I love the green tint the avocado gives to the product, it brightens the under eye while minimizing redness in this areas. I have very redness-prone skin to I like to bring this down just on the tops of my cheeks where I have a good amount of redness, and it helps immensely the next morning. When I wake up in the morning, my skin is glowing like it never has before. I highly recommended this product.

reviews.product_name: Alpha Beta Pore Perfecting & Refining Serum
reviews.review_text: All I can say is this has helped my huge pores tremendously. I’m 30 and it’s the worst on my nose and chin. Pore strips have never helped me although I have used them many times and have tried different brands. I’m so happy I found this product to help me.

reviews.product_name: Aqua Bomb Cleansing Balm
reviews.review_text: This stuff is really the bomb!!! I love howIt melts the makeup away after a long day and I don’t have to sit and scrub my face nor use multiple products. It smells great too. I have used It for 6 days so far and I haven’t even had a breakout using it like I have with other cleansers. This definitely is a must have and is now one of my favorite products.

reviews.product_name: Ultra Facial Moisturizing Cream with Squalane
reviews.review_text: I added this to my nightly skin routine. I can tell a different after a little over a week. In the winter I get really dry skin and this has helped moisturize it and now my makeup is looking so great!

reviews.product_name: Mini Ultra Facial Moisturizing Cream with Squalane
reviews.review_text: I added this to my nightly skin routine. I can tell a different after a little over a week. In the winter I get really dry skin and this has helped moisturize it and now my makeup is looking so great!

reviews.product_name: The Camellia Oil 2-in-1 Makeup Remover & Cleanser
reviews.review_text: I use this everyday. Morning and night. It takes off a lot of make up and is good for my sensitive skin. I follow up with the Tatcha enzyme powder on days I need a deeper clean.

reviews.product_name: Lip Glowy Balm
reviews.review_text: wow, smells exactly like grapefruit juice. very refreshing. this is more of an everyday type of gloss. it doesn’t have much pigment but it makes the lips so hydrated and juicy!

reviews.product_name: Greek Yoghurt Nourishing Probiotic Gel-Cream
reviews.review_text: I have sensitive eczema prone skin and this moisturizer worked great for me. It really sinks into your skin and hydrates it. Mild scent. I also use the korres Greek yogurt face wash and I recommend the whole line for sensitive skin. I received this complentary for testing purposes but all opinions are my own and I’ll be purchasing to use in the summer!

reviews.product_name: Sugar Hydrating Lip Balm
reviews.review_text: I love it! The scent and texture is amazing! I give it 4 stars and not 5 because it doesn’t last on lips, it’s totally gone after an hour, but I adore it other than that. Quick question to those who tried it: Do you know any perfume that smells like it?

reviews.product_name: Tonique Confort Re-Hydrating Comforting Toner with Acacia Honey
reviews.review_text: This stuff feels so good to put on. The rose scent didn’t annoy me like some say. It’s gel-like and very cooling. I find gel toners to be extremely useful for the glass skin look and this is one of the best I tried. Adds sort of a layer which overall makes the skin look smoother, if that makes sense. Wish it was scentless for sensitive skin but anyway I really like it.

reviews.product_name: Hydra Zen Gel-Cream Oil-Free Moisturizer with Salicylic Acid
reviews.review_text: Solid product. Spreads easily, cool feeling, matte finish. Contains both Alcohol Denat and Fragrance so can’t give it a 5 but I’ll give it a 4 I liked the texture and the fact that it did not irritate my sensitive skin.

reviews.product_name: Auto Correct Brightening + Depuffing Eye Cream for Dark Circles
reviews.review_text: I must say that since I started using this product I have noticed a great change around my eyes and the spots and wrinkles have been noticeably reduced.

reviews.product_name: ICE Ceramide Moisturizer with Vitamin F
reviews.review_text: When I received this cream, I was impressed because when applying it on my face it felt very cold, it was a strange sensation, but after using it for a long time I must say that I adore the feeling of cold and the hydration that it leaves on my face is perfect

reviews.product_name: Ready Steady Glow Daily AHA Tonic
reviews.review_text: I loved using this toner. What I liked the most is that my skin was not irritated at all, it felt fresher and more comfortable, I definitely recommend it.

reviews.product_name: Mini Ready Steady Glow Daily AHA Tonic
reviews.review_text: I loved using this toner. What I liked the most is that my skin was not irritated at all, it felt fresher and more comfortable, I definitely recommend it.

reviews.product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C
reviews.review_title: best ever! not just for sleeping
reviews.review_text: I’m addicted! I use at night and when I need to give my lips that added pout and wow factor! I’m a die hard dior gloss fan but this really blew my standards. Great amount great value! Buy this you won’t be disappointed

reviews.product_name: Dreamskin Skin Perfector
reviews.review_text: This is  amazing stuff. Pricy but for what I have spent on trying primers and luminous creams this one is worth it. Tones and enhances make up stays all day. Wish Dior did less scented stuff but this is so good I put up with it. Got a sample and sucked it dry bought it immediately after the first 3 days of using. Will never go back to another primer!

reviews.product_name: Cicapair Tiger Grass Color Correcting Treatment SPF 30
reviews.review_title: amazing coverage and red is gone
reviews.review_text: OK I don’t know why this one’s getting so much flack but I tried it and it’s amazing I have fair skin that’s prone to red patches and this literally neutralized any red I actually bought it because I thought it was basically a sunscreen and I was shocked that it actually turns skin tone colour once rubbed in almost like a really nice foundation all I had to do was set this baby with powder and I had beautiful glowing skin all day and it gives you the perfect coverage I was really surprised at the amount of coverage it gave. This is way better then your regular sub screen. Also would be great for fair to med skin. Will be my summer go too! Glad I took the chance and tried it. You also don’t need a lot at all. So it should last me a few months. This totally meets the protection and gives you a beautiful not full on mat look. Skin looks completely flawless. Set with a powder and be done.

reviews.product_name: Moisturizing Eye Bomb with Squalane
reviews.review_text: I did not like using eye cream before trying the Belif Eye Bomb. I first tried it when I redeemed a mini version as a reward, and I adored it. I have the full size now. I have really sensitive eyes and other eye creams always made them itch, but this one doesn’t. It is so hydrating and instead of leaving a greasy or creasy texture, as other eye creams do, this absorbs into your skin while leaving a very thin, bouncy hydration behind. I will be buying this again.

reviews.product_name: The Rice Wash Skin-Softening Cleanser
reviews.review_title: The BEST way to begin your skincare routine!
reviews.review_text: Wow, the texture of this cleanser is just so beautiful and hard to describe. It is really heavy before you add any water, and then when you do you feel the exfoliation in the first five to ten seconds of your face washing, but then afterward it becomes a gentle, softening cleanser. I don’t have super sensitive skin but my skin does tend to get irritated with exfoliating products. I usually stay away from exfoliation more than once a week, but this product is gentle enough to use on a daily basis without stripping your skin. The scent is divine and you actually feel your skin become plumper right after you use it (must be the hyaluronic acid). I don’t usually notice any visible effects from a cleanser (it either cleanses my face or it doesn’t) but I actually do with this one. Highly recommend.

reviews.product_name: Mini Rice Wash Skin-Softening Cleanser
reviews.review_title: The BEST way to begin your skincare routine!
reviews.review_text: Wow, the texture of this cleanser is just so beautiful and hard to describe. reviews.product_name: Banana Bright 15% Vitamin C Serum
reviews.review_title: My New FAVORITE Vitamin C Serum!
reviews.review_text: I LOVED this serum! I tried a trial size and I am so ready to buy the full-size product. My favorite vitamin C serum until I tried this one was the Ole Henriksen Truth Serum. I was skeptical about this one because of the banana scent—I don’t like anything smelling like bananas other than fresh bananas. However, I was so pleasantly surprised. I might like this serum more than the Truth Serum, and that is saying a lot. This is the kind of skincare product that almost does your foundation’s job better than your foundation. It immediately brightens your skin and evens out your skin tone without feeling like an added layer that does not let your skin breathe. Plus, the scent, in my opinion, does not actually smell like bananas. It is certainly strong (so if you don’t like strong scents in your skincare then this is not the serum for you), but it smells so beautifully citrusy. If you are unsure about using a Vitamin C product in the first place, you should really look into it. It has so many benefits—perhaps the most important ones being that it helps your sunscreen work better and that it helps with hyperpigmentation.

reviews.product_name: Violet-C Brightening Serum 20% Vitamin C + 10% AHA
reviews.review_text: The packaging is gorgeous, which you’d expect for the price. The consistency is very thin, but thicker than the Tatcha essence. I haven’t seen a huge difference (I’ve been using it in conjunction with the essence, which I really like). It hasn’t made me break out or get more oily. I wish it had a nice light scent. I will definitely keep it in my skin care routine, but am unlikely to re-purchase. I received this complimentary in exchange for my honest testimony.

reviews.product_name: The Essence Skincare Boosting Treatment
reviews.review_text: The Tatcha packaging makes you feel really luxurious, which you’d expect for the price. The essence itself is not a cream or lotion, but a thin liquid. There isn’t a strong smell. I am excited about the effect it has been having on my dry, flaky skin (thanks, MN winter).  I received this product complimentary for review purposes.

reviews.product_name: Mini The Essence  Skincare Boosting Treatment
reviews.review_text: The Tatcha packaging makes you feel really luxurious, which you’d expect for the price. The essence itself is not a cream or lotion, but a thin liquid. There isn’t a strong smell. I am excited about the effect it has been having on my dry, flaky skin (thanks, MN winter).  I received this product complimentary for review purposes.

reviews.product_name: Greek Yoghurt Foaming Cream Cleanser
reviews.review_text: I liked the cleanser. I have combination skin and it was smoothing and gentle, but I wasn’t incredibly blown away with the product. Honestly, I expected better results than my normal cleanser which is half the price. I wouldn’t repurchase since I think the price is too high for the results I saw. I received this for free in exchange for my honest opinion.

reviews.product_name: Retinol Reform Treatment Serum
reviews.review_text: Was in need of a good retinol product & omgggg am I glad I came across this product! Literally, after just one use I woke up the next morning after applying it before bed & my skin felt sooo smooth and glowy. I didn’t feel greasy & felt very restoring for my skin. Definitely noticing a difference! Very happy!

reviews.product_name: Mini Retinol Reform
reviews.review_text: Was in need of a good retinol product & omgggg am I glad I came across this product! Literally, after just one use I woke up the next morning after applying it before bed & my skin felt sooo smooth and glowy. I didn’t feel greasy & felt very restoring for my skin. Definitely noticing a difference! Very happy!

reviews.product_name: Lemonade Smoothing Scrub
reviews.review_text: SO GOOD!!! Leaves my skin feeling soo soft after using it. I only use it 3 days a week. My cheeks have become so dry lately for some reason. It helps with the dry build up & nasty textured feeling skin. Holy grail!

reviews.product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C
reviews.review_title: Just be cautious if you’re prone to breakouts
reviews.review_text: Was a little skeptical at first when I woke up after applying this on my lips the night before because I had a ton of access skin coming off of my lips. But I guess that means it’s working? lol. It’s an amazing product leaving my lips very soft after just two uses so far. I do recommend looking at different scents if you have sensitive skin. I think I broke out under my lip the next day and I think ir was from the product. Otherwise it does what it’s supposed to do!

reviews.product_name: Lip Butter Balm
reviews.review_text: Leaves my lips sooo soft & buttery.. it doesn’t leave them flaky after it comes off. Love it!!!!

reviews.product_name: Vitamin Enriched Face Base Priming Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I really like this product.  I love that is a 2in1 which saves me time in the morning.  As a moisturizer it has just the right amount of hydration without being greasy.  I like the texture and it smells amazing , exactly like Origins’ Night a Mins.  Maybe it’s all the vitamins packed in there. It makes a smooth base as a primer. I tried it with different foundations and it works great for my skin, it sets my base nice. It would be nice to even use it alone,  I feel like it blurs imperfections a little bit.  Overall I don’t see any cons. I received it complimentary but will get another one for sure.

reviews.product_name: Hydra Zen Glow Liquid Lightweight Moisturizer with Hyaluronic Acid
reviews.review_text: This moisturizer smells so amazing.  It makes my skin very smooth and keeps it hydrated through the day.  I use it together with the Skin Feels Good foundation from Lancome.  The design of the product  is so beautiful. I would definitely recommend trying it. It has natural hyaluronic acid and is packed with skin loving oils. It works like a blurring primer as well and it’s not greasy. Thank you Influenster! I love it! I received this product complimentary for review purposes.

reviews.product_name: Aqua Bomb Overnight Lip Mask
reviews.review_text: The lip mask works really well. It’s very moisturizing and stays on all night. I was a little disappointed that it doesn’t have any scent or taste and it is a little too greasy. But if you have very dry lips this product is a very good choice.

reviews.product_name: Sugar Lip Balm Hydrating Treatment
reviews.review_text: Fresh gifted me this lip treatment. It’s so nourishing and hydrating on the lips. I really enjoy the formula and love that it has sugar and fruit oils in it. I got the shade Icon, which is red. With it being in a format of a lip balm, it’s hard to apply such a bold color neatly. I would recommend sticking with more neutral colors that won’t be as messy to apply.

reviews.product_name: Tea Elixir Niacinamide & Hyaluronic Acid Anti-Aging Serum
reviews.review_text: I received this product complementary from Fresh. The packaging is a heavy glass, double walled bottle. Very pretty. It smells like matcha green tea to me, which I think makes it feel luxurious. It feels hydrating on my skin and has a milky texture. It sinks into my skin and leaves it feeling hydrating. I’ve even been skipping moisturizer at night! As to long term benefits, I cannot speak to that. I will have to use it for longer. I think the price point is too high, though.

reviews.product_name: Mini Daily Microfoliant Exfoliator
reviews.review_text: I received this product complimentary from Dermalogica Sampling. I really enjoy this. I have sensitive, acne-prone skin and even though this is a physical exfoliator, it is gentle enough to use on my acne. My skin definitely felt smoother after using it and it feels gentle enough to use daily.

reviews.product_name: Daily Microfoliant Exfoliator
reviews.review_text: I received this product complimentary from Dermalogica Sampling. I really enjoy this. I have sensitive, acne-prone skin and even though this is a physical exfoliator, it is gentle enough to use on my acne. My skin definitely felt smoother after using it and it feels gentle enough to use daily.

reviews.product_name: Niacinamide 10% + Zinc 1% Oil Control Serum
reviews.review_title: Excellent product at a low cost
reviews.review_text: I’ve struggled with acne for many years. While this is not the only product I’ve been using to fight acne, it did help a lot. It applies nicely to the skin (I only use around three drops, otherwise it gets “soapy“) and it leaves my skin feeling refreshed. It is an excellent product at a low cost. I definitely recommend it even to people who do not have acne.

reviews.product_name: AHA 30% + BHA 2% Exfoliating Peeling Solution
reviews.review_text: This product leaves my skin extremely soft. It does tingle a little bit, but not too much. I use it only once a week and leave it for 8 minutes. I don’t wear much makeup, but I can definitely see why it would be easy to apply foundation the next day. Definitely recommend it.

reviews.product_name: Caffeine 5% + EGCG Depuffing Eye Serum
reviews.review_title: Nice product but not for dark circles
reviews.review_text: I don’t have bags under eyes, I mostly have dark/purple circles. I’ve been using it for around a month and not much change in color. But it does give me a “fresh“ look even when I’m tired, so I give it 4 stars.

reviews.product_name: The Water Cream Oil-Free Pore Minimizing Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: It makes your skin so soft after applying!!!! I recommend this!!!!!

reviews.product_name: Mini The Water Cream

reviews.product_name: Soy Hydrating Gentle Face Cleanser
reviews.review_text: This has changed my skin!!! I’ve had acne for years until I started using this!!! 10/10 recommend!!!!

reviews.product_name: Superfood Antioxidant Cleanser
reviews.review_text: Love this product! I have very sensitive skin and a scent sensitivity. My husband has a skin condition that makes it hard for him to find a good face wash. This product works well for both of us as a daily use. I notice major improvement in his skin with less blackhead when he uses this face wash. Guys have it easy. The smell is nice and clean like green tea (duh). I cannot recommend this superfood cleanser enough.

reviews.product_name: Mini Superfood Antioxidant Cleanser
reviews.review_text: Love this product! I have very sensitive skin and a scent sensitivity. My husband has a skin condition that makes it hard for him to find a good face wash. This product works well for both of us as a daily use. I notice major improvement in his skin with less blackhead when he uses this face wash. Guys have it easy. The smell is nice and clean like green tea (duh). I cannot recommend this superfood cleanser enough.

reviews.product_name: Adaptogen Deep Moisturizing Cream with Ashwagandha + Reishi
reviews.review_text: Love this product. I have sensitive skin and this is nice and cooling when I feel like my skin is burning / stinging from who knows what. The smell isn’t bad (just kind of earthy) and I am extremely scent sensitive.

reviews.product_name: Mini Adaptogen Deep Moisture Cream with Ashwagandha + Reishi
reviews.review_text: Love this product. I have sensitive skin and this is nice and cooling when I feel like my skin is burning / stinging from who knows what. The smell isn’t bad (just kind of earthy) and I am extremely scent sensitive.

reviews.product_name: Superfood Air-Whip Lightweight Moisturizer with Hyaluronic Acid
reviews.review_text: The only special thing about this one is it is probably the least scented face cream from YTP that I have tried. The others are more moisturizing in my opinion but this one is not bad by any means. I live in Alaska so it’s not my winter go to. I got it in a set. Probably won’t buy again but don’t regret the purchase or trying it. Works just fine on my super sensitive skin. I just have other YTP that I go to and don’t like having a ton of products. Recommend trying this in the mini size or in a set.

reviews.product_name: Superberry Hydrate + Glow Dream Oil
reviews.review_title: Can also be used on the hair
reviews.review_text: Not a huge fan of this on my face. Nice on very dry spots / areas like around the nose when you are sick. Side use I like putting a little on the very driest ends of my hair. It makes a nice hair oil. Subtle natural smell, light fruity and earthy. I got mine in a set. Probably won’t buy again but don’t regret it. A little goes a long way.

reviews.product_name: Magic Cream Moisturizer with Hyaluronic Acid
reviews.review_text: I am enjoying this cream. It is thick, but it absorbs quickly into the skin so it is a nice day cream prior to makeup. It does have a scent to it, but it isn’t overwhelming and I think it comes from the oils in the product and isn’t an added fragrance which I avoid in skincare products. The scent does go away fairly quickly upon application. My skin has looked a lot more healthy since using this because I was dealing with a lot of dryness due to some acne treatments I’ve been using. I haven’t had any dryness since beginning to use this product, but I’m also not overly oily which can tend to be a problem for my crazy, acne prone skin. I received this product complimentary for sampling purposes but all opinions are my own.

reviews.product_name: Ultimate Sun Protector Lotion SPF 50+ Sunscreen
reviews.review_text: I received this product for free in exchange for my review, so unfortunately I did not know the ingredients until I received it. This is not safe for pregnancy (which I currently am), but I did go ahead and use it one time to be able to give a review. First, it smells strongly of grapefruit and tangerine. I am very sensitive to scent right now, but it is pleasant. It does linger throughout the day. It isn’t a standard white sunscreen and comes out beige. It blends in well and is a bit more on the glowy side. I wouldn’t recommend this if you are concerned about oil control. But for my normal skin, I don’t mind the level of dewiness. Makeup went on over it perfectly.

reviews.product_name: Indigo Overnight Repair Serum in Cream Treatment
reviews.review_text: I received this product for free from Tatcha and Influenster. I absolutely love tj us night cream. The texture is perfection. It feels so lovely and hydrating on the skin. It has a really nice body to the cream that makes it feel so good on the face but it also sinks in really well. I also love that it is not fragranced. I’m super impressed! My only complaint is that I wish the little scoop had a place to live instead of just floating around my bathroom counter.

reviews.product_name: Mini Indigo Overnight Repair Serum in Cream Treatment
reviews.review_text: I received this product for free from Tatcha and Influenster. I absolutely love tj us night cream. The texture is perfection. It feels so lovely and hydrating on the skin. It has a really nice body to the cream that makes it feel so good on the face but it also sinks in really well. I also love that it is not fragranced. I’m super impressed! My only complaint is that I wish the little scoop had a place to live instead of just floating around my bathroom counter.

reviews.product_name: Aqua Bomb Overnight Lip Mask
reviews.review_title: Pleasant usage experience, no lasting difference
reviews.review_text: I received this product for free in exchange for my review. I really enjoy using this overnight lip mask because it is a nice, thick consistency and has no odor or taste. It feels good and protective on the lips. However, I haven’t really noticed any difference overall in hydration in my lips, so I don’t think it is adding lasting moisture into my lips as they’re just as dry as usual.

reviews.product_name: Double Serum Firming & Smoothing Anti-Aging Concentrate
reviews.review_text: Honestly, I’m not sure why this product is so expensive. It smells like a haircare product and has made no change to my skin. I did receive a sample size of this for free in exchange for my review, so to be fair, over more time it could possibly prove to be more effective, but honestly I think there is far better skincare for a fraction of the price and without the fragrance.

reviews.product_name: Retinol Eye Stick
reviews.review_text: (complimentary from Peace Out Skin Care) I love the Peace Out Skin Care pimple patches so I was excited to try this retinol eye stick. There is definitely a nice ease to the product and it goes on smoothly! I am not sure if I see any miracle work yet but I am excited to keep using it and see!

reviews.product_name: Watermelon Glow Niacinamide Sunscreen SPF 50
reviews.review_text: *This product was gifted for review*Ok yes! This is great. It is very light weight but also provides a nice glow. It almost feels like there is a cooling effect to it as well. Can’t wait to use this all summer!

reviews.product_name: Tea Elixir Niacinamide & Hyaluronic Acid Anti-Aging Serum
reviews.review_text: Ok I’m a big fan! First off this smells amazing and leave my skin glowing! Will definitely repurchase.

reviews.product_name: Lotus Anti-Aging Night Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I love this night face cream! I love how hydrating this made my skin feel right after application. The formula was thicker which I really liked. I woke up each morning with smooth feeling and hydrated skin. I would definitely recommend this to everyone.

reviews.product_name: Lotus Anti- Aging Daily Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I use this face cream every single morning. I love the way it feels on my face and the application was so smooth. My skin felt hydrated all day. I would recommend!

reviews.product_name: Skinlongevity Long Life Herb Anti-Aging Face Serum
reviews.review_text: I’ve only been using this for a week but I love the way this serum applies. Two pumps is perfect and applies so smoothly. I feel like my skin absorbs it up (in a good way). I actually love the fact this is vegan!  I’m starting to appreciate that benefit in beauty products more and more. Using this serum is so far so good! I’ll continue using and hopefully start seeing improvement in my skin!

reviews.product_name: Skinlongevity Long Life Herb Anti-Aging Face Serum
reviews.review_text: Like this product. It made my skin very smooth and helped diminish the fine lines around my eyes. I didn’t really see any difference in the lines on my forehead but those are a bit deeper.

reviews.product_name: Double Serum Firming & Smoothing Anti-Aging Concentrate
reviews.review_text: Love this product! It goes on smoothly and a little goes a long way. I’ve been using it for a little while and I feel like my skin texture has really improved, both in its evenness, brightness, and fine lines. Highly recommend! I received this product first free in exchange for a written review.

reviews.product_name: Santorini Grape Poreless Skin Cream
reviews.review_text: This cream is fantastic- it feels so rich but it is not heavy or greasy at all. It feels smooth going on and absorbs well.  Helped to minimize the large pores I have on my nose. Definitely recommend.

reviews.product_name: The Essence Skincare Boosting Treatment
reviews.review_text: This is the third product I’ve tried from Tatcha. Previously, I used their water cream and cleanser. I was skeptical towards the concept of the essence as an additional step in skincare routine, but this product changed my mind. I used it after applying a toner and before my serums and you don’t need much to see it work. I was surprised to see my skin instantly hydrated and later on it felt plump and smooth. This is one of few products which shows you an immediate effect upon first use and overall skin improvement during the first week of usage. The essence feels expensive: a glass bottle and the creative packaging add toIt. The travel size is 75 ML which is quite a lot. Even though the product is expensive the spout regulates the amount you put in your palms, which will make the product last. I highly recommend it and will definitely repurchase in the future.

reviews.product_name: Squalane + Omega Repair Deep Hydration Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I received this product from Influenster in exchange for my honest review. This is the first product I am using from Biossance. While I thought this cream will be thick and heavy, the texture of it was deceiving. Right after the application, it absorbed into my skin right away leaving it silky and smooth. For its richness, it is uniquely lightweight. I truly enjoyed how it feels on my face. I think it’s great for being worn under the makeup with a primer. The smell was somewhat off-putting, it has the earthy notes of umami, but I was not bothered as it evaporated quickly. I think it lacks richness for a night time moisturizer, but if you pair it will a sleeping mask - it will be perfect. Great product, I truly enjoyed it.

reviews.product_name: Confidence in a Cream Anti-Aging Hydrating Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I received this product in exchange for my honest review. I have been testing this cream for some time now, and all i can say that it really works. My fine lines became less prominent and looks so much better. The cream itself is very rich in texture, though fast-absorbent. The smell is pleasant and is not overpowering. It works greatly under makeup or as an overnight cream. Find my new holy grail. Will definitely repurchase.

reviews.product_name: PHAT Glow Facial Mask
Ultra Glow Serum: Glow + Strengthen Vitamin C Serum
reviews.review_text: My skin is GLOWING!!! Such a great price point and product!!!

reviews.product_name: Yo Glow AHA & BHA Facial Enzyme Scrub
reviews.review_text: WOWWW. I instantly saw results with my first use. Y skin was soooo smooth and my make up application was flawless . I can’t wait to see the continuous results! Will def recommend!

reviews.product_name: Mini Yo Glow AHA & BHA Facial Enzyme Scrub
reviews.review_text: WOWWW. I instantly saw results with my first use. Y skin was soooo smooth and my make up application was flawless . I can’t wait to see the continuous results! Will def recommend!

reviews.product_name: Rose & Hyaluronic Acid Deep Hydration Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I have been trying this out and so far it has been great! First off, I love that it comes in think glass packaging. When you open it really smells like roses. I am a big fan of rose scents so I love that but it’s also not overbearing enough to offend anyone. It’s a smooth thick consistency that absorbs pretty quickly! My fine lines do not appear the next morning and my skin feels plump and hydrated!

reviews.product_name: Jet Lag Mask
reviews.review_title: Really Good extra mask to add to routine!
reviews.review_text: This mask was very helpful! I feel that it adds an extra layer of moisture to my face that I definitely need. I am happy that it is fragrance-free and does not sting at all. Sometimes my face is sensitive because of my retional routine.

reviews.product_name: Mini Jet Lag Mask
reviews.review_title: Really Good extra mask to add to routine!
reviews.review_text: This mask was very helpful! I feel that it adds an extra layer of moisture to my face that I definitely need. I am happy that it is fragrance-free and does not sting at all. Sometimes my face is sensitive because of my retional routine.

reviews.product_name: Ginzing Vitamin C Eye Cream to Brighten and Depuff
reviews.review_text: I would say this product definitely instantly illuminates your under-eye area as soon as you put it on. It might not be the best for darker skin tone colors as it has a white-ish base to it . A little goes a long way! Will have to see about overall brightening to the under eye complexion

reviews.product_name: Good Genes All-In-One AHA Lactic Acid Treatment
reviews.review_title: So far so good... And it smells wonderful!
reviews.review_text: I received Good Genes complimentary from Sunday Riley in exchange for my honest review. I’ve been using Good Genes for about 10 days. I was skeptical that it would have any instant plumping effect, but I actually did notice my fine lines were a little less noticable after applying. I have not been using it long enough to notice long term effects, but in the short term, it leaves my skin feeling very soft and smooth. Probably my favorite thing is that Good Genes smells divine! Lemongrass is an ingredient and features heavily in the scent. I will definitely continue using this product in the morning to help achieve a smooth base for makeup. Looking forward to seeing better and better results in the long term. For now I am rating it a 4 - very good.

reviews.product_name: Precleanse Cleansing Oil
reviews.review_text: I love this cleansing oil! I’m a big fan of double cleansing. This oil feels silky-smooth and smells wonderful (kind of an herbal/botanical scent). It is a true non-lathering cleansing oil. It does not rinse completely clean, which some people may not like. I don’t mind, because it leaves my skin really soft, and I always follow with a gel cleanser anyway. I would not recommend this for solo cleansing use if you have oily skin, as it might be too heavy. The 5.1 oz size is ample for daily use and will last a while. I like the convenient pump bottle. The only thing that would make it better is be sustainable packaging. Overall, I think this is a great product!

reviews.product_name: Mini Precleanse Cleansing Oil
reviews.review_text: I love this cleansing oil! I’m a big fan of double cleansing. This oil feels silky-smooth and smells wonderful (kind of an herbal/botanical scent).
