Overall, I think this is a great product!

reviews.product_name: Retinol Eye Stick
reviews.review_text: I like that this goes on smoothly and does not feel sticky. I use it under my eyes but also on the fine lines on my forehead. This stick will last a long time!

reviews.product_name: ExfoliKate Glow Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I’m usually hesitant to try new moisturizers for fear of how they will react to my oily skin, but I was excited about this product because I’ve found AHAs help to keep my oil under control.  It hydrates my skin without breaking it out like many other moisturizers have.  I’ve been using it every other night for about three weeks and love how lightweight it is.  Since my skin is somewhat sensitive and I use another product with AHAs it would be too much for my skin to use on a nightly basis.

reviews.product_name: Creamy Eye Treatment with Avocado
reviews.review_text: I don’t have a problem with under eye dryness so I wasn’t sure what this cream could do for me, but I’ve noticed my dark circles have become lighter and less noticeable since I started using this.*I received this free from Influenster free for testing purposes

reviews.product_name: Confidence in a Cream Anti-Aging Hydrating Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: Worked well with my oily/acne-prone skin and didn’t cause any breakouts. Moisturized my skin without it feeling greasy like some other creams. I feel like my skin looks less dull and a little plumper after using this for just a few weeks.

reviews.product_name: Honeymoon Glow AHA Resurfacing Night Serum
reviews.review_text: I was a bit anxious about purchasing this because I have relatively sensitive skin, but I’m so glad I purchased it! I’ve used other AHA and BHA products in the past, mostly toners, but this is the first serum I’ve used. It did sting a bit the first time I used it, but that hasn’t been a problem since! I recently started a new job as a nurse, and my skins been acting up from stress, and this had calmed my redness and helped with texture. The packaging is beautiful as well! Love it!

reviews.product_name: Green Clean Makeup Removing Cleansing Balm
reviews.review_text: I have tried so many cleansing balms and this is by far my favorite! It is gentle and doesn’t leave the skin feeling tight and dry, and it manages to remove all of my makeup! It melts like a dream and doesn’t feel sticky or stiff like other balls I’ve used in the past. I just finished my second tub and am already set to pick up a new one!

reviews.product_name: Green Clean Makeup Meltaway Cleansing Balm Limited Edition Jumbo
reviews.review_text: I have tried so many cleansing balms and this is by far my favorite! It is gentle and doesn’t leave the skin feeling tight and dry, and it manages to remove all of my makeup! It melts like a dream and doesn’t feel sticky or stiff like other balls I’ve used in the past. I just finished my second tub and am already set to pick up a new one!

reviews.product_name: T.L.C. Sukari Babyfacial AHA + BHA Mask
reviews.review_text: I absolutely love this mask! I have used my fair share of chemical exfoliants in mask, toner, and serum forms, but this is by far my favorite! I use the mask once a week and follow up with my favorite oil and moisturizer and my face is so soft when I wake up the next morning! I’ve also noticed that after use, and acne that has been brewing under the surface of my skin seems to dissipate, and any spots that I already have reduce in size as well.Unlike other products, I’ve experienced no irritation or redness while in use or after washing the product off. Love it and will continue to purchase!

reviews.product_name: D-Bronzi Anti-Pollution Bronzing Drops with Peptides
reviews.review_text: Bought this on a whim since I’ve heard such great things about DE products, and this is one of the few that was within my price range. I’ve only used it a few times, but I’m still trying to figure out the best way for my face. So far I like mixing it with my primer best. On pale skin it looks super streaky and orange when you first put it on, but eventually blends beautifully into the skin. I’ve also noticed it’s warming?? I get an all over glow on my face in places that are normally very matte. Love it and can’t wait to keep using it!

reviews.product_name: Mini Virgin Marula LuxuryFace Oil
reviews.review_title: Overall a very nice face oil!
reviews.review_text: After using this oil for a few months, my skin definitely feels so much more hydrated and balanced. I get incredibly dry skin in the winter and this has prevented peeling and dry patches. I really enjoy mixing this in with my moisturizer in the day time too! And the mini size is plenty big enough. Has lasted me for months and I’ve been using everyday!

reviews.product_name: Good Genes All-In-One AHA Lactic Acid Treatment
reviews.review_text: Nice product to apply, lovely packaging, smells great, didn’t irritate my skin, but I’m just not sure it did anything! It’s also very confusing figuring out where this goes in your routine. I would just apply after cleansing and follow with moisturizer to increase efficacy, but didn’t see results enough to justify repurchasing. Such a bummer since this product was so highly recommended to me!

reviews.product_name: The True Cream Aqua Bomb
reviews.review_title: a great moisturizer for warmer weather
reviews.review_text: I received this product for free in exchange for my honest review. This is SUCH a delightfully light and refreshing moisturizer. Perfect for warmer months when I can’t stand to have something heavy on the skin. Smells great, feels amazing, and gives me glow! Hands down one of my favorites!

reviews.product_name: The Water Cream Oil-Free Pore Minimizing Moisturizer
reviews.review_title: The best moisturizer I've ever used
reviews.review_text: This is the perfect moisturizer for my dehydrated oily skin. So light and not at all greasy. Provides the perfect amount of moisture for any season for my skin.

reviews.product_name: Mini The Water Cream
reviews.review_title: The best moisturizer I've ever used
reviews.review_text: This is the perfect moisturizer for my dehydrated oily skin. So light and not at all greasy. Provides the perfect amount of moisture for any season for my skin.

reviews.product_name: Vinoperfect Radiance Dark Spot Serum Vitamin C Alternative
reviews.review_text: Smells lovely, gentle on my sensitive skin, reduces redness.

reviews.product_name: The Camellia Oil 2-in-1 Makeup Remover & Cleanser
reviews.review_text: This is my first oil cleanser. I was disappointed when applying it because I thought there was no way it was getting all of the makeup off my face. I’m so glad to be wrong! It’s so super convenient that it goes on dry skin too! I can apply it and then hop in the shower to rinse in the morning, or rinse at the sink in the evening. Love being able to store it in one place.

reviews.product_name: Precleanse Cleansing Oil
reviews.review_text: Too oily.  Hear me out.  I’ve only ever used Tatcha’s oil cleanser, which I like very much.  This one takes your makeup off just as well, but unlike Tatcha’s, you MUST use a cleanser to remove the oil from your face.  While that’s my usual practice, sometimes I just want to swipe some cotton with miscellar water across my face and be done. Not happening with this stuff. I’m sure it’s perfect for someone who’s used to this type of oil precleanse, but it’s just not for me.

reviews.product_name: Pure Skin Face Cleanser
reviews.review_text: I love this cleanser!!! I originally bought this during the 21 days worth of beauty sales at Ulta, but they only carry the smaller size. This cleanser does a great job of taking off your makeup and is gentle on the eyes. After cleansing, my face feels clean but definitely not too dry. I have combination skin and amoily on my t—zone.

reviews.product_name: Jet Lag Mask
reviews.review_text: Holy grail product!!!! Can’t wait to repurchase this, also the product last a long time. I purchased this back in September and it’s now February and I still half a little less than half the tube. Definitely worth the money!!

reviews.product_name: Mini Jet Lag Mask
reviews.review_text: Holy grail product!!!! Can’t wait to repurchase this, also the product last a long time. I purchased this back in September and it’s now February and I still half a little less than half the tube. Definitely worth the money!!

reviews.product_name: Balancing Force Oil Control Toner
reviews.review_text: Just started using this product but so far so good, I love the cooling effect that I feel when using it.

reviews.product_name: AHA 30% + BHA 2% Exfoliating Peeling Solution
reviews.review_text: My first use definitely felt abrasive, but since there was no irritation after I removed it, I decided to keep giving it a chance. It has only been a week and I’m so happy with my results so far. I am 21 and had been suffering from borderline cystic acne for months, which I had never experienced before. I was using all my masks and taking care of my skin/health, but nothing worked. I finally bought a few products from this line around a week ago and I’m seriously amazed at how quickly my acne has disappeared.  I’ve also been using their sasylic acid and the buffet. My sun damage and fine lines on my forehead have noticeably decreased. Very impressed

reviews.product_name: Glycolic Acid 7% Exfoliating Toning Solution
reviews.review_text: Kind of amazed at how much stuff is on my face even after cleaning lol. This toner, along with their AHA peel and sasylic acid have literally cured my acne and I’ve tried so many other lines. Very happy

reviews.product_name: Multi-Peptide + HA Serum
reviews.review_text: I’ve only been using this for about a week and I’m already noticing a big difference in the little fine lines on my forehead. I’m only 21, but definitely have a lot of sun damage. I’ve also been using their AHA peel which may also be contributing to the quick results.

reviews.product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C
reviews.review_text: I’ve been waiting for this for awhile now and I’m happy. It does what it says. Took my winter lips away overnight. There’s so much in the bottle and I like the applicator that comes with it.

reviews.product_name: Cleansing & Exfoliating Wipes
reviews.review_text: Loved these. They were great for sensitive skin and smells like cucumber and coconut water

reviews.product_name: Hello FAB Coconut Water Cream
reviews.review_text: I’m hooked. It consistently works and blends well with my serums for layering. I am on my 3rd bottle and I am in skin love.

reviews.product_name: Glowscreen Sunscreen SPF 40 PA+++ with Hyaluronic Acid + Niacinamide
reviews.review_text: I’ve been using the supergoop unseen sunscreen for a while and had been obsessed with it so when I had the chance to try this out too, I was so excited. It has a very glowy finish and does look nice under makeup. In comparison to the unseen, I’d say the glow screen is better for those with dry skin and the unseen for those with oily.

reviews.product_name: Sugar Lip Balm Hydrating Treatment
reviews.review_text: I love the clean ingredients in this! the color was very buildable so if I wanted a light tint, I could achieve that, but if I wanted something darker I could get that too. it was supperrrr hydrating and nourishing on my lips, very comfortable to wear! this was gifted by Fresh.

reviews.product_name: Tea Elixir Niacinamide & Hyaluronic Acid Anti-Aging Serum
reviews.review_text: Ooh this serum is really cool! The new technology behind these ingredients is really interesting. It makes my skin feel great and have definitely noticed an improvement in the glossiness that I have. I recommend

reviews.product_name: Squalane + Omega Repair Deep Hydration Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: This thick, luxurious cream feels heavenly on my dry, sensitive skin. I saw that it was a new product as Sephora so I tried a sample, and haven’t looked back! Pricey but worth it in my opinion, at least in the harsh winter when I struggle to find a moisturizing enough cream to avoid irritated/flaky skin. Currently using this as a reparative night cream because of its rich texture, and squalane oil during the day.

reviews.product_name: Superfood Air-Whip Lightweight Moisturizer with Hyaluronic Acid
reviews.review_text: My skin would absorb this within minutes and still be left feeling dry. I was literally applying it in layers in the winter but my face was still flaking! I had high hopes because this brand looks great, but unfortunately this was an overpriced product that left my sensitive skin feeling tight and under-hydrated. Will not re-purchase. For $10 more, I opted for the Squalane   Omega Repair Cream by Biossance and had way better results.

reviews.product_name: SEA drink of H2O hydrating boost moisturizer
reviews.review_text: My face isn’t dry after using this so I guess it gets the job done, but it feels like the product never fully absorbs into the skin - a sticky layer always remains. There’s definitely better moisturizers out there at this price point.

reviews.product_name: Superfood Antioxidant Cleanser
reviews.review_text: My skin looks great when using this cleanser, but it definitely feels more dry. I’m therefore not able to use this product in the winter. The bottle also unfortunately leaked, so some of the product was wasted. Would give 5 stars if the packaging was fixed and the formula was a bit more hydrating.

reviews.product_name: Mini Superfood Antioxidant Cleanser
reviews.review_text: My skin looks great when using this cleanser, but it definitely feels more dry. I’m therefore not able to use this product in the winter. The bottle also unfortunately leaked, so some of the product was wasted. Would give 5 stars if the packaging was fixed and the formula was a bit more hydrating.

reviews.product_name: The Kissu Lip Mask
reviews.review_text: Unfortunately, it felt like this product just sat on top of my dry lips without improving their hydration at all. A disappointing purchase.

reviews.product_name: Barrier+ Triple Lipid-Peptide Face Cream
reviews.review_text: If you have dry and sensitive skin, this is worth the splurge! I’ve always struggled to find a hydrating enough cream, especially in the brutal Canadian winter months. This is the best moisturizer I’ve found so far! It feels like it actually sinks into my skin, unlike some other expensive moisturizers I’ve tried that seem to just sit on top. On my third one and will continue to repurchase!

reviews.product_name: Mini Barrier+ Triple Lipid-Peptide Face Cream

reviews.product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C
reviews.review_text: I got this in my Sephora Play! Subscription bag and I absolutely love it. I put a small amount on before bed and wake up with the softest lips. I also like to use this as a Lip Balm too during the day. Highly recommend.

reviews.product_name: The True Cream Moisturizing Bomb
reviews.review_text: This has to be my favorite moisturizer ever. It smells amazing and a little goes a huge way. This has lasted me a few months. I will always repurchase. It’s also such a good price for what you get! I like the packaging. It’s sooo moisturizing. The best!

reviews.product_name: The Kissu Lip Mask
reviews.review_text: I was on a no buy for lip products in 2020... for reasons. But I saw this and I knew I had to have it. First off, I love this brand. Their products just feel luxurious, their packaging is so clean and overall everything works amazingly. This lip mask is no exception. It has such a nice light scent. A little goes a huge way. And my lips feel so moisturized. Honestly I use this during the day. I only have to apply 1-2 times. My lips feel amazing the entire day. Definitely worth the money!

reviews.product_name: Soy Hydrating Gentle Face Cleanser
reviews.review_text: Perfectly fine cleanser, nothing too exciting. I like the small size for traveling.

reviews.product_name: B-Hydra Intensive Hydration Serum with Hyaluronic Acid
reviews.review_text: My favorite thing to put on my skin. Perfect texture and perfect finish for my oily skin during the day. I feel hydrated and shine free for most of the day. Really lightweight and most likely great under makeup. I find it a tad less moisturizing at night, but for the day there is no comparison. My absolute have to have it all the time, even if it’s $50 product. Love it.

reviews.product_name: U.F.O. Salicylic Acid BHA Acne Treatment Face Oil
reviews.review_text: I’ve been using this for months and really enjoy the results. I feel it has improved my acne and I find it a very dry oil and doesn’t make me feel greasy even with naturally oily skin. I actually enjoy the cute UFO green gimmick, I wish more companies would make the marketing fun and actually back it up with great product. This product achieves that for me. Must have in my routine

reviews.product_name: Cicapair Tiger Grass Cream
reviews.review_title: got it as a deluxe sample, can’t live without it
reviews.review_text: Very great product, does exactly what it says it does. I got this as a deluxe sample and love it. I find it so calming and see instant results when I use it on irritated skin. I can’t see how someone could use all of the full size version. I don’t find I need much product at all to see results.

reviews.product_name: Salicylic Acid Acne + Pore Cleanser
reviews.review_text: This came at a great time. I, like many others, get monthly hormonal breakouts and while this didn’t prevent them, it did help clear them up within 2 days or so rather than 7+ days.

reviews.product_name: Facial Treatment Essence (Pitera Essence)
reviews.review_text: The biggest benefit is that this does a good job of hydrating. The texture feels just like water but it does dry down just slightly tacky. It doesn’t interfere with any other skincare. I did find it difficult to dispense just the right amount and for the price, it felt very wasteful when too much product came out.

reviews.product_name: Mini Facial Treatment Essence (Pitera Essence)

I’m acne prone and this doesn’t irritate my skin. In fact, I’ve been using this for 3 weeks and my skin looks better than it has in months. This is one of the best skincare products I’ve ever used.

reviews.product_name: Pure Skin Face Cleanser
reviews.review_text: Love this cleanser! Cleans very well and feels great going on. Definitely recommend for a light cleanser.

reviews.product_name: Sugar Advanced Lip Balm Intense Hydration Treatment
reviews.review_text: Only stuff I’ll put on my lips. LOVE all of the Sugar lip line!! My normally dry and cracked lips are very happy.

reviews.product_name: Mini Virgin Marula LuxuryFace Oil
reviews.review_text: This is ok, but not sure it’s worth the price. It feels good going on, but is a little thicker than I can use more than once a week. I do love the cleanser by Drunk Elephant though!!

reviews.product_name: Superberry Hydrate + Glow Dream Night Mask with Vitamin C
reviews.review_text: Wake up and my skin looks amazing. First overnight mask I have purchased, and I will buy this again before trying a new one. Highly recommend!

reviews.product_name: Mini Superberry Hydrate + Glow Dream Mask
reviews.review_text: Wake up and my skin looks amazing. First overnight mask I have purchased, and I will buy this again before trying a new one. Highly recommend!

reviews.review_text: Makeup comes right off, and the texture of the soap is so nice!

reviews.product_name: Mini Superfood Antioxidant Cleanser
reviews.review_text: Makeup comes right off, and the texture of the soap is so nice!

reviews.product_name: Cream Skin Toner & Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: Really enjoying this! I use it either before or after my serums - I can’t really tell a difference, but I think serum first is better to ensure it has the best impact. This has a milky/watery texture and it doesn’t leave any kind of oil residue, just moisture!

reviews.product_name: Advanced Génifique Radiance Boosting Face Serum
reviews.review_text: I am so thrilled i got this product in my complimentary Influenster Voxbox. Since using this syrum i have not needed ANY lotion, they stuck gold with this thing!

reviews.product_name: Ultimate Sun Protector Lotion SPF 50+ Sunscreen
reviews.review_text: I live in southern california; the sun is bright and environment, hot, most of the time. I tried this product thanks to influenster and I’m so happy I did. I used this on an all day hiking trip with my 2 dogs, complete with lake swimming and for the first time EVER, i didn’t burn!! This stuff works.

reviews.product_name: Santorini Grape Poreless Skin Cream
reviews.review_text: It mostly works; I love that the cream is lightweight, absorbed quickly, smells great...Unfortunately I didn’t see that much pore shrinking :( I’ve been using the product for 3 weeks now so maybe I need to keep using a bit longer.  I did see some shrinking though.

reviews.product_name: Smart Clinical Repair Wrinkle Correcting Eye Cream
reviews.review_text: I received this product #topbox#gotitforfree for my honest review. The sample size was very small to notice much. However, when I put it on it felt very smooth around the eyes area. The scent was very pleasant. I have always been a fan of Clinique make up.  So I do see myself buying this product and using it for the long run.

reviews.product_name: Smart Clinical Repair Wrinkle Correcting Cream
reviews.review_text: I received this Clinique Smart Clinical Repair Wrinkle Correcting Cream for my honest review. The sample size lasted around 4 applications. I applied it in the morning and at night. The cream is creamy and it did feel a bit sticky on the face. The scent was pleasant not too strong. I didn’t notice a bit much change to my face since it is a sample size. I am sure if I used it long enough I will see a result.

reviews.product_name: Smart Clinical Repair Wrinkle Correcting Serum
reviews.review_text: I received this Clinique smart clinical repair wrinkle correcting serum for my honest review. The sample size lasted me about two applications, my skin felt smooth and soft instantly right after using this serum. I love how it absorb quickly and leaving my skin feeling super smooth all day. Too soon to tell if this product helps with the wrinkle repair but if I used it long enough I am sure I will see a good results. Thank you topbox and Sephora. #freeproduct,#trywithtopbox.

reviews.product_name: GENIUS Sleeping Collagen Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: First off, I appreciate that this product isn’t full of perfume

reviews.product_name: Benefiance Wrinkle Smoothing Eye Cream
reviews.review_text: I’ve been using this almost a month now & love it. Its *super* moisturizing. My last eye cream just wasn’t this good at holding moisture in under my eyes. They’re much plumper looking. I just use it before bed & a little on under my makeup. I highly recommend if you’re looking for deep moisture treatment. Trust that your undereyes will glow after applying this. I recieved this product complimentary for review purposes from influenster, but that would never sway my opinion. I fully plan to purchase this after finishing the current one.

reviews.product_name: Aqua Bomb Cleansing Balm
reviews.review_text: I love this brand. I’ve been using their aqua bomb for years and just recently started using the gel cleanser. So I was excited to try the cleansing bomb. It has that signature Belif scent which is delish. It removes makeup well & doesn’t leave a film or anything behind. If you like cleansing balms this one is great. I recieved this product complimentary for review purposes from influenster. All opinions are my own.

reviews.product_name: Cold Plunge Pore Remedy Moisturizer with BHA/LHA
reviews.review_text: Taking the plunge with Cold Plunge Pore Remedy Moisturizer and my skin feels nice, chilled and refreshed! It has a thick, creamy consistency that is also gel-like and cool to the touch! It’s like the feeling of the cool alpines in a bottle! It controls oil too, leaving your skin looking very matte and shine free, and still glowy! I highly recommend the taking the “Cold Plunge” from Ole Henriksen!

reviews.product_name: Aqua Bomb Overnight Lip Mask
reviews.review_text: Great lip balm! The Aqua bomb lip mask has little to no taste or smell, and lays on my lips super thick to hydrate and soften. I put on each night and wake up with lips that are oh, so soft! I’ve needed this through the winter months and had greatly helped my dry chapped lips! Highly recommend!

reviews.product_name: Floral Recovery Overnight Mask with Squalane
reviews.review_text: The Fresh Floral Recovery Calming Mask is amazing! It feels so smooth and the rich texture sinks right into my skin. It is formulated with Vitamin-C and Squalane, which my skin loves! I use it overnight and wake up with bright, and refreshed skin. It also does wonders at calming the redness in my cheeks- which flares up during these winter months. There is little to no scent, it just smells fresh and clean if anything. This is a very wonderful and moisturizing mask that I would highly recommend!

reviews.product_name: Clear Improvement Pore Clearing Moisturizer with Salicylic Acid
reviews.review_text: Really enjoy this product! Consistency is a little heavy at first but once it soaks in you can barely feel it. Leaves your skin super soft and has really improved my acne spots! It has a minty smell but it isn’t too strong or overpowering. I received this product complimentary for review purposes.

reviews.product_name: Vegan Milk Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: Awesome product! I received this product complimentary from Influenster to test and I honestly love it! Iv loved this brand in the passed however have never tried their skincare and I am pleasantly surprised! Kind of a thicker formula but not heavy on the skin. Really has no smell which is kind of a pleasant change to the weird scents you can get from moisturizers. Would 100% recommend!

reviews.product_name: Squalane + Omega Repair Deep Hydration Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I revived this product for testing purposes by influenster. Genuinely surprised by this product. I have extremely sensitive acne prone skin so I’m always very afraid of trying new products because I’ll either have some kind of reaction or it will make me break out like crazy. This product however has done neither of these things and my skin is no longer dry as the Sahara. I will absolutely continue using this product. I definitely recommend to people who otherwise have major sensitivities because this product has been life changing for me.

reviews.product_name: Dewtopia 20% Acid Night Treatment
reviews.review_text: I was nervous to try this product as it has 20% acid and that seems kind of scary at first to put on your face. Mnot gonna lie. I thought that it felt really light and refreshing. Some face products leave me feeling oily and gross but this didn’t. I thought the scent was nice and light, it didn’t overwhelm like some products do and think that it is a great addition to my routine.

reviews.product_name: Aqua Bomb Overnight Lip Mask
reviews.review_text: I love how this product easily applies. It’s very smooth and soft, it doesn’t have a flavor either. It’s not sticky like some lip products. I haven’t noticed a huge difference yet but I think it’ll really be helpful when it gets colder.

reviews.product_name: Santorini Grape Poreless Skin Cream
reviews.review_text: Very light and moisterizing. I like how its not greasy at all and leaves your skin feeling very refreshed.

reviews.product_name: Superfood Antioxidant Cleanser
reviews.review_text: I’m 3 days into using this product and am already noticing significant changes in my skin. My skin tends to be dry but also prone to hormonal or stress breakouts. This cleanser leaves my skin feeling clean and fresh without stripping it or causing tightness. The all-natural ingredients are gentle enough for my skin as a redhead with sensitive skin. Love this product!

reviews.product_name: Mini Superfood Antioxidant Cleanser
reviews.review_text: I’m 3 days into using this product and am already noticing significant changes in my skin. My skin tends to be dry but also prone to hormonal or stress breakouts. This cleanser leaves my skin feeling clean and fresh without stripping it or causing tightness. The all-natural ingredients are gentle enough for my skin as a redhead with sensitive skin. Love this product!

reviews.product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C
reviews.review_text: Obsessed with this product and it has immediately become a staple in my evening routine. I’ve always had dry lips - especially during the cold Canadian winter months. The moisture I get from this product overnight is enough to last me the entire day. I don’t need to carry around lip balm at all times anymore! The scent is lovely, the texture is great, and the little rubber spatula that comes with it is an excellent touch. Love it!

reviews.product_name: Glycolic Acid 7% Exfoliating Toning Solution
reviews.review_text: Glycolic acid has been my preferred exfoliant for the last couple of years. I use it once a week on a cotton round to wipe away dead and flakey skin. Recently tried this formula because of the lower price point. Great value! Works great and will last a long time.

reviews.product_name: Adaptogen Deep Moisturizing Cream with Ashwagandha + Reishi
reviews.review_text: Really wanted to love this product... love the brand and have had great experiences with their other products. This moisturizer definitely moisturizes very well. First when I tried it I thought I had hit the jackpot - my skin was smooth and super hydrated. However after about a week of using it, the breakouts started. Really horrible acne started to pop up across my t-zone. They went away when I switched moisturizer. I still use this product occasionally for an extra boost of moisture, but keep it light and avoid continuous use. Disappointing.

reviews.product_name: Mini Adaptogen Deep Moisture Cream with Ashwagandha + Reishi
reviews.review_text: Really wanted to love this product... love the brand and have had great experiences with their other products. This moisturizer definitely moisturizes very well. First when I tried it I thought I had hit the jackpot - my skin was smooth and super hydrated. However after about a week of using it, the breakouts started. Really horrible acne started to pop up across my t-zone. They went away when I switched moisturizer. I still use this product occasionally for an extra boost of moisture, but keep it light and avoid continuous use. Disappointing.

reviews.product_name: Hyaluronic Acid 2% + B5 Hydrating Serum
reviews.review_text: Hyaluronic acid is one of my favorite ingredients in skincare because it draws moisture to your skin. Having extreme dry patches, this is one of the only things that has solved that issue. I notice right away when I don’t use this before my moisturizer because those dry patches will come right back.

reviews.product_name: Glycolic Acid 7% Exfoliating Toning Solution
reviews.review_text: The percentage is a little high for my skin. I have very acne prone, dry, sometimes oily, sensitive, combo skin. If I only use it once a week it’s great but any more than that I get rebound breakouts.

reviews.product_name: Niacinamide 10% + Zinc 1% Oil Control Serum
reviews.review_text: It didn’t solve my acne problem but it did significantly help! My skin is very back and forth with being oily or dry or covered in acne or all 3. This serum significantly helped balance it out and cleared up about 95% of my acne since I started using it about a month ago. The only down side is if you use too much it does pull on your skin with your moisturizer but that’s what I’ve found with most serums.

reviews.product_name: The True Cream Aqua Bomb
reviews.review_text: I absolutely love this product, I used it after the belif makeup removing cleansing balm and my skin has never felt so soft.  My skin feels so soft that I just want to keep touching it!

reviews.product_name: Aqua Bomb Cleansing Balm
reviews.review_text: At first I wasn’t sure how I felt because I’ve never used a product that was a “balm” before.  The smell and texture weirded me out so much BUT once I actually used it I was BLOWN AWAY, my skin feels cleaner than it has ever felt and it removed every speck of makeup.  My face feels so soft I can’t stop rubbing it!

reviews.product_name: Cold Plunge Pore Remedy Moisturizer with BHA/LHA
reviews.review_text: The packaging is nice and simple, which I like, and I love the way it feels on my skin.  The only thing I didn’t like it the smell (which is very strong and smells like vicks).  I would recommend this product as long as you don’t mind strong smells.

reviews.product_name: Good Genes All-In-One AHA Lactic Acid Treatment
reviews.review_text: To start I enjoy the smell of this. I’m not a huge fan of scented skin care but this has just a subtle sweet smell to it that doesn’t seem to bother me. I have been using this for a few days now and while I don’t see a reduction in any fine lines I do notice that some of my larger pores seem to have gone away. I am hoping that with a little more continuing use I will start to notice more of an effect on the fine lines. My skin texture also seems to feel the same but I’ve had no adverse reactions to using the cream.  Skin clarity may seem a bit better since the start of this, but I’m curious as to how it is after stopping the use of this item. My only issue with it is that when using it as a serum instead of a face mask, my face feels sticky for hours afterward. I don’t have sensitive skin but enjoy using this as a face mask more than a leave on treatment.  I did receive this complimentary from Sunday Riley in exchange for review.

reviews.product_name: Avocado Soothing Skin Barrier Serum with Ceramides
reviews.review_text: I received this product complimentary from Glow Recipe in exchange for review. After having children, my face has a handful of problems with it. Two of them being dryness and redness on my checks, so I was very excited to try out this product and see what it could do. I was a bit skeptical at first because I honestly don’t like the smell of avocado, but this does not smell the same way so do not despair! The texture is fine, not too thick but not runny so you aren’t dripping it everywhere once it is dispensed.   After using for a full week I noticed a small amount of redness decrease, but the hydration is my favorite part. My skin definitely feels more hydrated and refreshed then prior to using this product. The application is very easy and comes out with no issues. The serum rubs in smoothly and absorbs quickly into the skin. The feeling of the application is gone very quickly and there is no residue left on my skin after a brief minute or so.  I enjoy this product and will continue to use it in my skin care routine going forward and appreciate that this is one of the better skin care products that I have used.

reviews.product_name: Capture Totale Super Potent Eye Serum
reviews.review_text: I was really looking forward to use this to help with the baggage and puffiness under my very tired eyes. The application itself is pretty easy though I did have a hard time figuring out how hard to squeeze the tube to apply the right amount of serum. The applicator is nice and cool and immediately starts to reduce puffiness around the eyes. It also acts as a nice massage while rubbing in the serum.  After a few weeks of usage I noticed a bit tighter skin but nothing significant. I hope that with some more usage I start to see very drastic results. I have noticed no redness or irritation after using the serum which is great and look forward to continued results. This was received for free in exchange for review.

reviews.product_name: Superfood Antioxidant Cleanser
reviews.review_text: only been using this for a couple weeks but i love this cleanser for nighttime after using my makeup remover. leaves my face feeling clean without drying it out. i’ve gotten some in my eye before too, and it didn’t sting!

reviews.product_name: Mini Superfood Antioxidant Cleanser
reviews.review_text: only been using this for a couple weeks but i love this cleanser for nighttime after using my makeup remover. leaves my face feeling clean without drying it out. i’ve gotten some in my eye before too, and it didn’t sting!

reviews.product_name: The Water Cream Oil-Free Pore Minimizing Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: my favourite day time moisturizer. so light weight and just melts into the skin. i have combination skin so it works perfectly for me! if you have super dry skin, probably wouldn’t recommend. but for someone with my skin type, its worth the hefty price tag!

reviews.product_name: Mini The Water Cream
reviews.review_text: my favourite day time moisturizer. so light weight and just melts into the skin. i have combination skin so it works perfectly for me! if you have super dry skin, probably wouldn’t recommend. but for someone with my skin type, its worth the hefty price tag!

reviews.product_name: The Dewy Skin Cream Plumping & Hydrating Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: love this moisturizer for the winter time when my skin gets incredibly dry! feels like heaven to apply, and smells bomb! i avoid it in the summer because it starts to pill up, but perfect for the cold weather!

reviews.product_name: T.L.C. Framboos Glycolic Resurfacing Night Serum
reviews.review_text: I’ve struggled with acne for nearly 13 years and very rarely come across products with pretty immediate results. I bought the sample size of this to try, skeptical of the price, and used it every night until the bottle was finished. My blemishes were reduced in number and severity, and I woke up with skin that looked noticeably less dull. It does tingle when applying, especially on sores/pimples. I came back and bought the full bottle, and considering the tiny amount that covers my face, it’ll last me a long time even using daily. I recommend this to anyone looking for an addition to their nightly routine that helps acne-prone skin start to clear.

reviews.product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C
reviews.review_text: I get incredibly dry skin during the winter and my lips tend to appear cracked and bloody every morning. I tried this on a whim and I’m pretty impressed. It works best with consistent use, and chapstick is still a necessity throughout the day, but this has cured my overnight dehydration. I apply this nightly as the last step before bed, and love the applicator to keep the product germ-free. I wake up with soft lips, no dead skin or cracking!

reviews.product_name: Balancing Force Oil Control Toner
reviews.review_text: I was recommended this line from a fellow oily skin sufferer and I’m obsessed. This toner is my favorite to use in the morning before serums and moisturizer. It smells refreshingly minty and isn’t harsh on my skin like some oil-fighting products tend to be.

reviews.product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C
reviews.review_text: THANK GOD FOR THIS. I have eternally dry, flaky lips and I started sleeping in this every night and my lips have never looked better. I swear it’s reduced my lip lines, as well. It is a thicker consistency and smells like berries. My lipsticks look so much better on my lips after I’ve incorporated this into my routine. It’s a staple in my nightly regimen! You need this!

reviews.product_name: T.L.C. Framboos Glycolic Resurfacing Night Serum
reviews.review_text: Absolute in love with this product. I have light, combo/oily skin and I’m very prone to dark spots and texture. This has eliminated any texture on my skin and has significantly faded all of my dark spots, as well as given my skin a healthy glow. I can’t tell you how many compliments I’ve received on my skin the past few months. Another plus is a little of this stuff goes a long way. I bought it in February and just ran out in September and I used it every single night. That’s 7 months. So, if you’re afraid of the price tag, you shouldn’t be. It was only about $13 a month for as long as it lasted me. I am definitely repurchasing and will continue to use this magical product as long as it’s available.

reviews.product_name: U.F.O. Salicylic Acid BHA Acne Treatment Face Oil
reviews.review_text: This green oil has done so much for my skin. I have light, combo/oily skin and get little clogged pores in my t-zone as well as black heads on and around my nose and the center of my chin. I am also prone to cystic acne on the outer sides of my chin near the corners of my mouth and this has eliminated all of those issues completely and keeps my skin looking flawless and blemish-free. I haven’t had a cystic pimple in six months and even prescription medication hasn’t been that successful for me. I’ve gone through two .5 oz bottles and I will definitely continue to repurchase.

reviews.product_name: Rose & Hyaluronic Acid Deep Hydration Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: happy I only purchased a mini size. pills and feels sticky. I’m very sensitive to texture so the stickiness makes it to wear I can only wear it to bed. I want to try the rose mask but am nervous after using this.

reviews.review_text: this moisturizer is my absolute favorite. so smooth. I have combo skin

reviews.product_name: Mini Superberry Hydrate + Glow Dream Mask
reviews.review_text: this moisturizer is my absolute favorite. so smooth. I have combo skin

reviews.product_name: Salicylic Acid Acne Healing Dots
reviews.review_text: amazing results. but SO overpriced................

reviews.product_name: Lip Butter Balm
reviews.review_text: Love this so much. Doesn’t seem like there was a whole lot of product but I don’t even care, definitely buying again.

reviews.product_name: Dreamskin Skin Perfector
reviews.review_text: I can actually see i difference.The size of my pores in a matter or 4days . I have always been bad with skin care and even I managed  to get results . Well worth the money.

reviews.product_name: Smart Clinical Repair Wrinkle Correcting Eye Cream
reviews.review_title: Look at the inner corner of my eye.
reviews.review_text: I am starting to show some small wrinkle around my eyes. The wrinkle correcting eye cream honestly made a nice difference, I knowThere will not be a lot of visible results. But will be great for preventitive

reviews.product_name: Smart Clinical Repair Wrinkle Correcting Cream
reviews.review_text: After one use I can see how much of the product when into my skin. I love how hydrated my skin looks . This might be a bit over kill for my skin but I gave some to my mom also and she is just loving the resulted .

reviews.product_name: Tonique Confort Re-Hydrating Comforting Toner with Acacia Honey
reviews.review_text: I received this product from Influenster to review and it’s truly the best toner I’ve ever used! I’ve never used a toner that actually left my skin feeling hydrated.. which is amazing because I hate how dry some toners make my skin feel! I have combo skin, it didn’t make me oily at all! Just hydrated!

reviews.product_name: Hydra Zen Gel-Cream Oil-Free Moisturizer with Salicylic Acid
reviews.review_text: I received this product from Influenster to review and I LOVE it! Makes my skin look so healthy, plump

reviews.product_name: Magic Cream Moisturizer with Hyaluronic Acid
reviews.review_text: Amazing! I received this product for free from influencer to test out. Love using it before applying my makeup! Makes me look glowy and fresh!

reviews.product_name: Tea Elixir Niacinamide & Hyaluronic Acid Anti-Aging Serum
reviews.review_text: This serum is perfection! The Tea Elixir has helped my skin so much in the past week - using it morning and night. The formula is hydrating but not incredibly sticky, allowing the rest of my skincare to apply easily , and during the day, keeps my face primed for makeup. I’ve seen my complexion glowing when using this serum and my skin feels and looks softer and more supple. I highly recommend this to anyone with combo/oily skin - not sure how it would feel on super dry skin

reviews.product_name: GENIUS Liquid Collagen Serum
reviews.review_text: I am loving this serum so much! I have always wanted to try the Collagen Serum but the dropper bottle always deterred me. Now that it is in a new pump, I had to use it! It’s been amazing for my skin - I use it right after the shower and after about 10 days I have really noticed a difference! My skin is much more supple and and soft, as well as more elastic to the touch! I highly recommend this serum especially as the colder months are approaching! This was gifted by Algenist

reviews.product_name: Retinol Youth Renewal Serum
reviews.review_text: Amazing product so far! I have very sensitive skin so I am wary of retinol - but I have yet to have any reaction with this! I can see my skins texture improving after only a few days of use! I highly recommend for sensitive skin people

reviews.product_name: Mini Retinol Youth Renewal Serum
reviews.review_text: Amazing product so far! I have very sensitive skin so I am wary of retinol - but I have yet to have any reaction with this! I can see my skins texture improving after only a few days of use! I highly recommend for sensitive skin people

reviews.product_name: Hyaluronic Acid 2% + B5 Hydrating Serum
reviews.review_text: Maybe it’s all in my head, but I think my face looks and feels softer after using it every day for a week.

reviews.product_name: Vitamin C Suspension 23% + HA Spheres 2%
reviews.review_text: I LOVE THIS. Whenever I put this on at night, my skin is absolutely luminous and flawless the next day. The only downside is that it is sticky, and you need a fair bit of time for it to absorb. Usually I just put kleenex over my face before I go to sleep!

reviews.product_name: Cold Plunge Pore Remedy Moisturizer with BHA/LHA
reviews.review_title: Does what it says! Best for combo skin
reviews.review_text: I really like the feeling of this product. The packaging is nice and heavy, and the cool, refreshing cream goes on smoothly and dries without stickiness. I have combo skin and it works wonderfully for me. Because of the salicylic acid, it is fairly drying, but keeps my occasional shininess at bay. This was a complimentary product I received through Influenster.

reviews.product_name: Glowscreen Sunscreen SPF 40 PA+++ with Hyaluronic Acid + Niacinamide
reviews.review_text: This stuff is really interesting! I like that it’s a primer and can also be used as a highlighter. The texture is really nice and melts right into my skin, doesn’t feel oily or sticky at all. One issue I can see is that it might be too dark for those who are really pale. The shade was a tad dark on me and I’m on the paler side, so probably won’t be used as a highlighter. However, when I rubbed it in it was fine!

reviews.product_name: Sugar Lip Balm Hydrating Treatment
reviews.review_text: Love this product!! Fresh always delivers the best lip products that are beautiful and also functional. I love the screw on packaging especially because then it doesn’t fall apart in my bag! It keeps my lips moisturized for hours! This was complimentary from Fresh.

reviews.product_name: Tea Elixir Niacinamide & Hyaluronic Acid Anti-Aging Serum
reviews.review_text: Love this stuff! Smells very fresh and clean, not too strong but definitely a scent. Melts into the skin nicely, It doesn’t leave any sticky residue behind which is nice. The packaging is very sturdy and I like it a lot! Overall I really like it!

reviews.product_name: Green Clean Makeup Removing Cleansing Balm
reviews.review_text: This product definitely removes makeup as it claims but my skin was not left with a very clean feeling and it caused me to break out. I have very sensitive skin and so that isn’t uncommon and doesn’t really make me dislike the product. The real problem I have with this is that Farmacy is selling this as a “clean” product ( and Sephora advertises it as such) but despite that it apparently contains PEGs that are bad for us and the environment. Between that and my skin reaction it’s a no go for me.

reviews.product_name: Green Clean Makeup Meltaway Cleansing Balm Limited Edition Jumbo
reviews.review_text: This product definitely removes makeup as it claims but my skin was not left with a very clean feeling and it caused me to break out. I have very sensitive skin and so that isn’t uncommon and doesn’t really make me dislike the product. The real problem I have with this is that Farmacy is selling this as a “clean” product ( and Sephora advertises it as such) but despite that it apparently contains PEGs that are bad for us and the environment. Between that and my skin reaction it’s a no go for me.

reviews.product_name: Facial Radiance Pads
reviews.review_text: This is a fantastic product. I have VERY sensitive skin but, as advertised, they do not irritate my skin at all. Instead they give my skin a great glow, help clear my skin, make my pores smaller and balance it. My face can feel tight after washing but then I use one of these and my skin feels almost like it doesn’t need moisturizer. I can’t say how much I love them!

reviews.product_name: Adaptogen Deep Moisturizing Cream with Ashwagandha + Reishi
reviews.review_text: I LOVE THIS MOISTURIZER. It is amazing. It really is for all skin types. Mine is very sensitive combo skin with rosacea. It has helped with the redness immensely. It has also improved the tone and texture of my skin, made it glowy, and caused me to have fewer breakouts!  It’s a miracle cream and a little goes a very long way so it is worth every penny.

reviews.product_name: Mini Adaptogen Deep Moisture Cream with Ashwagandha + Reishi
reviews.review_text: I LOVE THIS MOISTURIZER. It is amazing. It really is for all skin types. Mine is very sensitive combo skin with rosacea. It has helped with the redness immensely. It has also improved the tone and texture of my skin, made it glowy, and caused me to have fewer breakouts!  It’s a miracle cream and a little goes a very long way so it is worth every penny.

reviews.product_name: Lotus Anti-Aging Night Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: This is a miracle cream!!! I put this on the first night I got it and the next morning when I looked in the mirror I LITERALLY gasped. It reverses signs of aging, stress, and environmental toxins. I can go to bed with skin that is red, blotchy, rough and giant pores and I will wake up with glowing, soft skin with tight pores and no redness. If you try it you won’t be sorry!

reviews.product_name: 5 Stars Retinol + Niacinamide Eye Serum
reviews.review_text: Great Product! Super light and super hydrating. I using it for a week now an irritation or other side effects. I will definitely recommend to people that looking a light retinol eye cream. Plus the price is great!

reviews.review_text: Great sunscreen, not greasy or sticky texture. I like the way it feels, with no itchiness all over glowing or over drying the skin.  I definitely recommend it for sensitive skin because it did not irritate me at all.

reviews.product_name: Confidence in a Cream Anti-Aging Hydrating Moisturizer

reviews.product_name: Double Serum Firming & Smoothing Anti-Aging Concentrate
reviews.review_text: I was absolutely thrilled to be selected to review these products as I’ve always heard amazing things about this brand but it’s pretty pricy. I was so excited to open the box when it got here but I can’t lie, I was pretty disappointed to see such small sample sizes. This in particular came with 7 packets which I used every night for a week. The serum itself felt wonderful on my skin and very moisturizerizing. I did notice that my skin felt more firm and radiant, but it’s really hard to judge a product in just a week. I can say that if this is a product that won’t break the bank for you, I would definitely recommend it. It worked well in the time frame I used it, especially paired with the extra firming energy cream.

reviews.product_name: The Essence Skincare Boosting Treatment
reviews.review_text: I received this essence from Influenster in exchange for my honest review and I’m really glad I did because it has been a game changer for my skin. The packaging is gorgeous. The glass is nice and heavy, you can tell it’s expensive just looking at it. It has made my skin so supple and soft. I use it after cleansing and it absorbs so nicely and all my products afterwards sit nicely on top and seem to even absorb better than without the essence. All in all I’m very pleased with the product and would definitely repurchase and recommend it to others!

The packaging was really nice and the bottle even feels luxurious. I would definitely recommend this product!

reviews.product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C

reviews.product_name: Alpha Beta Extra Strength Daily Peel Pads
reviews.review_text: Amazing results instantly and only getting better day by day. If you have oily uneven and blemish prone skin this is definitely something I would try. Makes your skin smooth glowing more even and dries out breakouts really quickly.

reviews.review_text: Love this toner! My skin is really turning around and I’m almost 50! I thought it was too late but this has proved me wrong. I use it with The Ordinary Buffet serum and I am one happy camper!!

reviews.review_text: Out of all the moisturizers I’ve tried, this worked wonders for my skin. And only after a week of using this, I saw great improvements on my skin. The oils in my T-zone has been controlled, and the dry patches on my cheeks vanished like magic. I’ve been using this for two months now and I gradually lessen the usage of any Acne Treatments. *After I saw great results in the 1st week I decided to buy other Tatcha products:•Tatcha The Deep Cleanse•Tatcha The Essence •Tatcha Rice Polish Enzyme (Deep)*After a month of using products from Tatcha, I also sampled a product from Drunk Elephant called TLC Framboos and I’m sooo amazed by how they worked well together. -The results are amazing! But I soon learned from my esthetician that those feelings just means that the natural oils in my skin are stripped off leaving my face dry and soon greasy as a jug of oil even after using mattifying products. So I continued this product and I’m sooo glad I did because it really helped me clear out my breakouts.

Most of the exfoliants I used before were physical and would always leave my skin dry, red, and scratched. I’m sooo glad to have found this product.

reviews.review_text: Love this product!! Day one, it makes your skin feel so soft and dewy. I let it absorb a little bit and then added my usual daily moisturizer and my make up went on as it normally does. As I started using it every night, my skin became more glowing and healthy looking!

reviews.review_text: Ok wow. This mask is light weight, and a total rockstar! My skin was so dewy and soft after using this as a night mask the first time I tried it. It feels like your skin just drank a gallon of water! Love this product.

reviews.review_title: Nice product that easily fits in your purse
reviews.review_text: So easy to use and feels so nice on your skin. Doesn’t look greasy or smell weird. Definitely gives your skin a nice refresh. Seems like it will last a long time. All in all, great product, great brand.

reviews.product_name: The Essence Skincare Boosting Treatment
reviews.review_text: I have heard about the Tatcha brand a lot from watching beauty gurus in YouTube, but I never actually experienced this brand until now. It was a little weird trying to get the product out because it has a little spout for the opening and it is liquid so I really didn’t know how to apply it correctly. I just put it on my hands and then applied to the face. When putting it on it give your skin a tacky feeling, so it maybe could work as a primer. After a few uses, you can definitely feel your face becoming softer and just looking more luxurious overall. This is an expensive brand, but is totally worth it if you’re willing to pay! I received Tatcha The Essence for free for testing purposes.

Not only does the bottle look luxurious, it also give your skin the same effect. I used this product after using the Tatcha The Essence plumbin skin softener. This duo keeps your skin feeling the greatest it could ever feel. It does have a big price tag, but it is definitely worth it if you are willing to pay the price.

reviews.product_name: The True Cream Moisturizing Bomb
reviews.review_text: This is a great moisturizer. I have a combination face and this product really gave me the added moisture without making me more oily. The texture was nice and made my skin look amazing.

reviews.product_name: The Dewy Serum Resurfacing and Plumping Treatment
reviews.review_text: Beside from the elegant packaging, I was pleasantly surprised to feel the texture of this product. It is a milky serum, and after the first use I truly feel more hydrated. It is quite costly, but tatcha has built a great brand that you can trust. I will have to use this product more to see the long term effects, but from what I can see, it will be great for my acne prone and oily face. The product is lightweight and doesn’t make my face feel gross like other products, it absorbs into the skin without leaving an oily residue.

reviews.product_name: ExfoliKate Glow Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: My face after using this feels so soft. It gave my skin a nice healthy glow. The smell is lovely not very strong but noticeable. I received this product complimentary for sampling purposes.

reviews.product_name: Estee Lauder Advanced Night Repair Synchronized Multi-Recovery Complex Serum
reviews.review_text: I noticed right away and after a week how different my skin was. I recently moved to a different state and my skin has been more dry than ever, this definitely helped put the moisture back into my skin. My face is smoother, softer, moisturized.

reviews.product_name: Mini Advanced Night Repair Synchronized Multi-Recovery Complex
reviews.review_text: I noticed right away and after a week how different my skin was. I recently moved to a different state and my skin has been more dry than ever, this definitely helped put the moisture back into my skin. My face is smoother, softer, moisturized.

reviews.review_text: Really healed my cracking dry lips! My lips feel so smooth and buttery. A little goes a long way too! Totally worth it I enjoy their products.

reviews.product_name: Squalane + Omega Repair Deep Hydration Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: The product was very moisturizing and thick but it did absorb really nicely into the skin. The only two setbacks I would say for myself was there was a Slight smell but the smell does go away once on your face. The second is since I only have combination skin type and I live in a humid area I really don’t need the moisture but if you have dry skin this would be perfect.

reviews.product_name: Santorini Grape Poreless Skin Cream
reviews.review_text: I received this complimentary  from inflenster! Omg, this stuff is awesome. It smooths out my pores with out feeling heavy or waxy. It’s so smooth and silky. Definitely a new staple for under makeup or alone.

reviews.product_name: Urban Environment Fresh-Moisture Sunscreen Broad-Spectrum SPF 42
reviews.review_text: My new go to!!! I love this stuff. I recently used at the beach, not a bit of burn. I always use facial sunscreen but still burn. This stuff works!!! Smells great isn’t greasy and makes my skin feel and look amazing. I will be wearing everyday.

reviews.product_name: Urban Environment Oil-Free Sunscreen Broad-Spectrum SPF 42
reviews.review_text: This sunscreen is a game changer. I always burn on my face, every time. I have tried a ton of different facial sunscreens and this one works. It’s not greasy and blends into the skin evenly with no residue. I am a customer for life.

reviews.product_name: Smart Clinical Repair Wrinkle Correcting Cream
reviews.review_text: This cream is amazing. It’s so silky smooth and doesn’t feel greasy at all. After several weeks of use I noticed firmer looking skin around my eyes and overall smoothness.

reviews.product_name: Soy Hydrating Gentle Face Cleanser
reviews.review_text: I have been using this cleanser now for about 10 years and it is amazing. It has a lovely smell and cleans while being super gentle on your skin. It will not remove heavy eye makeup (that’s what makeup remover is for) but it easily removes face powders and other basic makeup at the end of the day as well as gives you a refreshed feel for AM use. I also love that it is a clean product. I have never broken out since using this cleanser. I am dabbling in other cleansers right now to see what’s new and out there but this staple is still my trusty sidekick go to. It really works for all ages.

reviews.product_name: Crème de la Mer Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: Wonderful product and smell but man that price tag really slaps you in the face. It definitely works (you press and pat into your skin as opposed to “rubbing in” with most other moisturizers). Your skin will feel cool, clean and refreshed especially if paired with the La Mer treatment lotion. Bottom line: you can find a great moisturizer that works almost if not just as well for about 1/4 of the price.

reviews.product_name: Double Serum Firming & Smoothing Anti-Aging Concentrate
reviews.review_text: I used this product as part of the Clarins age control regimen (serum, eye cream, and moisturizer). While I found the eye cream to be mostly ineffective for me, the serum and the moisturizer did their job. After a few days my skin definitely felt more hydrated and firm. There are other regimens I like to mix it up with now, but the Clarins age control serum and cream are good additions to the mix!

reviews.product_name: Lotus Anti-Aging Night Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: Love this moisturizer - especially for the price!! Great night cream with a mild but pleasant scent. For the price it works like a charm - my skin feels hydrated and refreshed when I go to bed and dewy and fresh in the morning. No cons with this one! Fresh did it again!

reviews.product_name: Protini Polypeptide Firming Refillable Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: Bought and tried out D-Bronzi, C-Firma, B-Hydra along with this Protini moisturizer and this is by far the winner!! While the jury is still out on the other DE products I bought I absolutely love how this makes my skin feel. It almost feels like my moisturizer is tightening and lifting!! My one criticism (like other reviewers) is the packaging. I’m not a huge fan of the cold-cream-like pumps and you don’t know how much you have left when you need to reorder. For this reason and the hefty price tag I would give it 4 stars instead of 5, but still a great product and I will continue to use!!

reviews.product_name: D-Bronzi Anti-Pollution Bronzing Drops with Peptides
reviews.review_text: I purchased D Bronzi, C Firma, B Hydra and Protoni Polypetide Moisturizer as a DE newbie. With fair skin, I was very impressed with the nice glow-y and stream-free color this gave me, but I cannot figure out how to appropriately mix this for effect unless I don’t wear makeup. I tried mixing with the Protini (DE recommends you blend with other DE products), but the effect is completely lost if you add makeup after. Mixing with sunscreen after makeup also showed little to no bronzing benefit, so I am at a loss here for how this is practical unless you plan to go out without makeup. I will return or run it out but I do t plan to repurchase unless I figure out how to make this product work for me.

reviews.product_name: Salicylic Acid Acne + Pore Cleanser
reviews.review_text: my nightly face wash! i used to use the la roche posay salicylic acid cleanser, but i found this one to be more effective for my skin. it does not contain menthol which can be an irritating ingredient. the price tag for this cleanser is something that stood out. imo, the inkey list is one of my favorite and most effective brand at an amazing price. def love this for acne prone skin ;)

reviews.product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C
reviews.review_text: I love this product! So I did receive this product free for testing purposes, but I actually already owned this in the vanilla, so I was super excited when I found out it was apart of the products I was receiving! I have dry lips and this as helped me so much! I put it on every night before bed and leave it on all night and my lips are overall more hydrated!

reviews.product_name: Hello FAB Coconut Skin Smoothie Priming Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: Love this primer! it has worked well with any foundation I have used with it. It keeps my make up on all day and keeps my skin hydrated! I have liked this one better then higher priced one and ones that are more popular. I think this one is super underrated and is my FAV.

reviews.product_name: Slaai  Makeup-Melting Butter Cleanser
reviews.review_text: I really liked this product. I was nervous if I was going to like it because it’s different then the products I normally use to remove my makeup. I’ve never used a melting butter type of product. But it removed everything and is gentle on the skin. You do need to wash your face after but that’s the same with any oil or makeup removing products like this. I was super happy with the results and with only needed a little bit of product it will for sure last me a long time!

reviews.product_name: Aqua Bomb Cleansing Balm
reviews.review_text: I enjoyed this product, I did find that I needed to use a little more product then I would when I would use my drunk elephant balm. Although, I found the smell of this was much better and it didn’t leave my face feeling waxy like the other brand. I do recommend using a balm like this to remove makeup, before washing with a cleanser. I received this product free for testing purposes

reviews.product_name: Unseen Sunscreen SPF 40 PA+++
reviews.review_text: I have been looking for a sunscreen because my esthetician said its something that should be included in your morning regimen. I tried a few sunscreens, drug store and high-end within a 6 month period. I would break out or my skin would get irritated. I finally tried supergoop and i was pleased with everything about this product. I do have sensitive skin and it didn’t irritate my skin at all, there is no scent so that’s also a plus for me. This is very lightweight, it doesn’t have a whitecast so it doesn’t affect the look of your makeup. Also, makeup does apply very smoothly over this. I have been using this as my primer as well. Nothing bad to say about this product, its a great purchase and worth every dollar.

reviews.product_name: Mini Unseen Sunscreen SPF 40 PA+++
reviews.review_text: I have been looking for a sunscreen because my esthetician said its something that should be included in your morning regimen. I tried a few sunscreens, drug store and high-end within a 6 month period. I would break out or my skin would get irritated. I finally tried supergoop and i was pleased with everything about this product. I do have sensitive skin and it didn’t irritate my skin at all, there is no scent so that’s also a plus for me. This is very lightweight, it doesn’t have a whitecast so it doesn’t affect the look of your makeup. Also, makeup does apply very smoothly over this. I have been using this as my primer as well. Nothing bad to say about this product, its a great purchase and worth every dollar.

reviews.product_name: Protini Polypeptide Firming Refillable Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I have been looking for a good moisturizer for years, I have combination skin and I live in Chicago. We have brutally cold winters and extremely hot summers, so its very hard to find a year round moisturizer. I started using this moisturizer last winter, it is light yet very hydrating and not greasy at all, it definitely did its job. My skin looks plump, glowy and healthy. I wasn’t sure how well this would work in the summer because I normally have change the moisturizer I use depending on season but to my surprise this worked for me in the summer as well. I love this moisturizer its a bit pricey but well worth every dollar.

reviews.product_name: Beste No. 9 Jelly Cleanser
reviews.review_text: I LOVE this cleanser.. I have combination and sensitive skin and I am always scared to try new cleansers because of that but after using DE Protini Polypeptide Moisturizer and loving what it did to my skin i decided to try more of there products. I had to use it for about a week before noticing a difference because again you have to let your skin get used to the change. Also, you will definitely have a clean feeling after each use. I feel my skin is now softer, it glows and I can now skip wearing makeup on occasion because my skin is so clear.This cleanser has played a big roll in clearing up my skin. RECOMMEND!

reviews.product_name: Virgin Marula Luxury Face Oil
reviews.review_text: I have been using for about a month now, I use this after i was my face and moisturize. I use 2-3 drops and pat into my face and neck. This has completely changed my mind on facial oils, I have combo skin so I have was always hesitant to use these type of products but I am so happy I stepped out of my comfort zone. My skin has cleared up so much and it looks so healthy and glowy. I used to wear foundation everyday but now I only use concealer, I owe this to this miracle oil. My skin looks so much healthier that I don’t feel the need to use foundation every day. I cant wait to see what long use of this will do my skin. I highly recommend.

reviews.product_name: Jet Lag Mask
reviews.review_title: Love the fresh slight peppermint feeling
reviews.review_text: I love the slight peppermint fragrance and cooling feel to this mask! This mask is gentle enough on my sensitive skin, and is even gentle enough to use over and near my eyes! This mask is good to wear overnight, and is great to use on my dry spots under makeup as well. This product did not irritate or break me out at all, and is great to use everyday.

reviews.review_text: I love this product. Let me start off by saying I was skeptical because the grit was so fine feeling. But wow does this product pack a punch. This scrub instantly brightens and brings a glow to your face. Others notice after I have used it and I always get compliments after I do. My only problem is the lack of information on the actual bottle. The ingredients and instructions are on the packaging, so once you toss the packaging, you are left with having to remember how to use this product.

reviews.product_name: Skinlongevity Long Life Herb Anti-Aging Face Serum
reviews.review_title: Love this serum on my sensitive skin!
reviews.review_text: I just started using the bare minerals skin longevity serum and I am loving it. I have extremely sensitive skin, and this serum does not irritate my skin. It does not make my skin more oily, or dry it out either. I’m excited to see what the next few weeks does to my skin. This serum is thin, light weight, and smells fresh with a slight citrus smell. It does not feel like you have anything extra on your skin. I’m able to apply moisturizer and makeup with no problem after applying.

reviews.product_name: C-Firma Fresh Vitamin-C Day Serum
reviews.review_title: Good even for dry sensitive skin
reviews.review_text: Y’all! I got to be a mad scientist and mix things up with this serum! So fun! It was very easy to mix, and shake up to activate the Vitamin C serum. I love that you mix it yourself, the pro is that the serum will last the full 6 months! More bang for your buck! And the container is easy for me to use and with no dropper everything stays sealed! Hello to NO contamination or oxidation! It may seem pricy at first, but when broken down, it’s LESS than 50 cents a day (when used daily for the full 6 months)! Totally worth it! My skin did get a little irritated at first, showed signs of redness and a slight tingle, but goes away pretty soon after completing my normal skincare regimen. After just using for a short amount of time, I feel like I can already see a difference!

reviews.product_name: Watermelon Glow Niacinamide Dew Drops
reviews.review_text: Glow Recipe gifted me their newest baby from the watermelon family! The texture of this product felt like a light weight gel that smells just like the delicious watermelon Glow Recipe skincare products. When mixing the serum into my foundation (FENTY Beauty) it helped keep my skin feeling fresh and hydrated. It absorbs quickly into my skin alone too and does not feel sticky. This left my skin feeling hydrated and I definitely was left with a glow.  I have only been using this for a couple of days now and I need to gather my thoughts on this one. One if the times I did use this with makeup, my skin felt itchy but I’m unable to tell if it was the new skin tint I was trying or the serum. I’ll be trying it out more. **Gifted by Glow Recipe, but opinions are my own.

reviews.product_name: Honeymoon Glow AHA Resurfacing Night Serum
reviews.review_text: The best exfoliating serum out here!! It’s very hydrating, sinks in nicely and seriously leaves your skin glowing the next morning

reviews.product_name: Daily Greens Oil-Free Gel Moisturizer with Moringa and Papaya
reviews.review_text: It’s hydrating and lightweight but it smells so so bad...

reviews.product_name: Lip Butter Balm
reviews.review_text: The most perfect lip balm formula with better packaging. It now comes with a great applicator that just makes it better! The same amazing formula that leaves your lips hydrated, moisturized but not sticky. Definitely a must have!

reviews.product_name: Barrier+ Triple Lipid-Peptide Face Cream
reviews.review_text: New favorite moisturizer. I love that this is so sanitary so you don’t have to dig your fingers into the tub. I love that I can use this day and night, without feeling heavy! It also sinks into my skin well.

reviews.product_name: Mini Barrier+ Triple Lipid-Peptide Face Cream
reviews.review_text: New favorite moisturizer. I love that this is so sanitary so you don’t have to dig your fingers into the tub. I love that I can use this day and night, without feeling heavy! It also sinks into my skin well.

reviews.product_name: Original Skin Matte Moisturizer with Willowherb
reviews.review_text: I have the sample size of this product, and I tried it out for the first time yesterday morning around my T-zone. The first thing I noticed was the strong fragrance, in the beginning I kind of liked the smell but once on my face I got a headache. It defiantly makes your skin matte as it claims, but after applying foundation it wasn’t sitting well on my skin, and was breaking apart on the inner parts of my nose. I ended up taking all of my makeup off, and going bare face that day. The next day I woke up with little bumps on my face where I had applied the moisturizer. It’s unfortunate, because I really wanted to like this product.

reviews.product_name: Green Clean Makeup Removing Cleansing Balm
reviews.review_text: At first I loved this product, but even then it always irritated my eyes. Then when I reached for it again months later my face started burning!! Complaints: Leaves face feeling dry and irritated if you have sensitive skin. Over time the lid came detached from this other lid that was just glued in place to lock the product in. I think this happened because of the oil seeping in on the glue..for an expensive brand I’d think packaging wouldn’t be an issue but it was. Benefits: A lot goes a long way, and it has a nice smell. It gets makeup off great. But at what cost..

reviews.product_name: Ultra Facial Moisturizing Cream with Squalane
reviews.review_title: very hydrating/ good for sensitive skin
reviews.review_text: I’ve been using this product for over a year now, repurchased 2x so I think I’m ready to give my thoughts. It’s a really great moisturizer for I think all skin types, I’ve used it when my face was oily, when my face was dry from retinol, I’ve used it during breakouts. And let me just say this is an amazing fragrance free moisturizer. I don’t agree though that it’s light weight, it’s more of a night time moisturizer. It’s not overly heavy, but it’s called and ultra facial cream...so it’s hydrating. I’m not a fan of anything else from Kiehl’s and it is pricy. But it comes with a great amount, like this is the first time I’ve had the biggest size and I’ve had it for months now and I haven’t even reached half of it yet. I think it’s worth the try, I’d get the smaller oz and see what happens.
