reviews.review_text: I got this as a sample and although it made my skin feel baby smooth I couldn’t stand the smell. It smells like cold medicine, and for the price it should not smell bad. I also noticed when layering my other products on top it starting peeling.

reviews.product_name: Mini Facial Treatment Essence (Pitera Essence)
reviews.review_text: I got this as a sample and although it made my skin feel baby smooth I couldn’t stand the smell. It smells like cold medicine, and for the price it should not smell bad. I also noticed when layering my other products on top it starting peeling.

reviews.product_name: Cream Skin Toner & Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I purchased this when my skin was really damaged and dry, and this really helped repair my skin barrier. It took away the dry patches and really left my skin feeling hydrated and plump. It’s not to heavy or to light, it’s just right. I noticed it has a bit of a tacky feeling at first, but I find that it’s best applied patted into the skin with the palms of your hands. For me once I patted it into my skin the tackiness went away. It has no smell, and after a month of use I haven’t experienced any irritation or breakout from this product. If you have oily skin this could be enough to substitute your moisturizer, if you don’t use any drying actives or other drying products. If you do I recommend finishing your routine with a moisturizer.

reviews.product_name: AHA 30% + BHA 2% Exfoliating Peeling Solution
reviews.review_text: I’ve been using this once every 5 days for the past month and I see a dramatic difference in my overall complexing. My dark spots are less dark, my pores look smaller, and my skin looks smoother. This definitely stings when applying, but after a few minutes it dies down. I recommend using for less then 10 minutes, I leave it on for 8 minutes before rinsing it off. I also recommend using this once a week and no more then that, as this is a very strong exfoliant. Please look into what other products you can’t use after this in your routine, like retinol. With any AHA/BHA, I can’t stress enough the importance of wearing sunscreen after using this. If you have sensitive skin I would ignore this product all together.

reviews.product_name: Niacinamide 10% + Zinc 1% Oil Control Serum
reviews.review_text: Application: sticky, has a white film when rubbed on the skin that goes away, no smell. I find that less is more with this product. In the first few days of use I saw a noticeable difference in skin brightness and smoothness, my mom even complemented the way my skin looked. But by mid week I kept getting white heads on my chin, forehead, and cheeks. No cystic acne though. I knew this product can make your skin purge before it gets better because of the zinc, so I continued to use it for weeks. The breakouts eventually went away, but now I’m dealing with another issue. Every time I apply it I’m getting extreme flushing in the cheeks. I get cherry red, and my skin gets hot....And then the redness goes away after an hour. I  know it’s this product because all I use is a cleanser, this, and a moisturizer that I’ve been using for a long time. Overall my experience with this product is disappointing considering the amount of hype it gets. I still get pimples, I haven’t seen a change in my post inflammatory pigmentation, and I’m not even sure if it’s helped with oil production because I my skin isn’t particularly oily. (I went in buying this product to fade my dark spots) it works wonders for others, but my skin isn’t a fan.

reviews.product_name: Adaptogen Deep Moisturizing Cream with Ashwagandha + Reishi
reviews.review_text: I love this, and I’m more then half way done! I have combination oily skin, and it leaves my skin feeling hydrated, but not greasy. I will say that If you have dry skin, this might not be enough moisture for you. I noticed this moisturizer really calms down the redness around my nose, which is great. It has a faint earthy smell of mushrooms...which I’ve grown to love. I think I’ll be repurchasing when mine runs out.

But I’m happy to say that the results are wonderful. The dark circles and fine lines aren’t as visible and my the area around my eyes look & feel better than before.

reviews.product_name: Auto Correct Brightening + Depuffing Eye Cream for Dark Circles
reviews.review_text: I’ve ever tried Sunday Riley products before now and I must say that I’m extremely impressed. The product actually carries though on its promise. My eyes aren’t puffy any longer. I, also, like that it doesn’t feel greasy when applying.

reviews.product_name: ICE Ceramide Moisturizer with Vitamin F
reviews.review_text: I love how this moisturizing cream goes on my face without feeling greasy. My face tends to get dry and this cream works immediately to remedy that problem.

reviews.review_text: PINCHme sent me a sample of bareMinerals Skinlongevity Long Life Herb Anti-Aging Face Serum in exchange for my honest review. The sample was actually too small to know if reduces fine lines and wrinkles. But it did leave my face feeling smooth and it didn’t leave a greasy feeling. The application was simple. My face felt clean and refreshed.

reviews.product_name: Caffeine Eye Cream
reviews.review_text: Overall I thought thia was a pretty good product. It went on smoothly and easy and didn’t feel heavy or greasy. It did seem to help my under eye area and I would recommend it.

reviews.review_text: I was a big fan of this IT cosmetics cream. It was so smooth going on and it didn’t feel too heavy on my face. I used it mostly overnight. The scent was light and pleasant which was just perfect for me. The product is somewhat expensive but a little goes a long way. Overall, this was a win for me.

reviews.product_name: Mini Daily Microfoliant Exfoliator
reviews.review_text: I was really interested in trying this because it was a powder exfoliating cleanser. I was a little unsure about the amount of water to use but pretty much did a 1 to 1 ratio. My skin feels really clean and smooth after and I would definitely use this again. I would probably give it 4.5 stars. I received this complimentary from Dermalogica sampling.

The cream has a rich texture but doesn’t feel heavy and a little bit goes a long way. The morning after I used it, my skin was so smooth. I would buy this again and definitely recommend it. I received this complimentary from Farmacy Beauty.

reviews.product_name: Avocado Fine Line Eye Cream with Retinol
reviews.review_text: I love how easy this product is to use just dab a small amount under my eyes and go to sleep. I’ve noticed in the morning underneath my eyes feels firmer and I don’t have the tired eye look. I received this product complimentary from influenster but would definitely recommend purchasing!

reviews.review_text: I’m in my late 20s and skin care has become really important to me to keep my skin youthful. This product is perfect for preventing the signs of aging. The hyaluronic serum is great for wrinkles and breakouts. I haven’t used a glow recipe product I didn’t love!

reviews.review_text: I love this stuff. I’ve been using it for almost a year (not same bottle, repurchased). Vitamin C has done wonders for my skin, specifically this formulation of it. The serum is creamy and lightweight, has a slight tackiness to it until it dries down/absorbs, has helped my skin tone even out, and has helped improve the look of scars. Smell is pleasant and does not linger. This serum gives my oily skin a radiant glow without appearing greasy. Will continue to repurchase.

reviews.product_name: SEA drink of H2O hydrating boost moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I am shocked at how much I love this. I have combo/oily skin and need a moisturizer that is lightweight to the touch (don’t need to add to my oil) but heavy duty on the hydration (I live in the desert and my skin can be dehydrated). This moisturizer delivers on both counts. When first applied, it feels cool and almost “wet” because of the gel texture. This doesn’t feel heavy on my face and isn’t sticky. My makeup applies over top with zero issue. Highly recommend.

reviews.product_name: Mini Sugar Strawberry Exfoliating Face Wash
reviews.review_text: This scrub smells wonderful but was ineffective for me. The sugar dissolves almost as soon as it comes into contact with my face. The dissolved-sugar-face-wash feels kind of thick and is not a texture I want on my face. Will not repurchase.

reviews.product_name: Green Clean Makeup Removing Cleansing Balm
reviews.review_text: There is nothing to not love about this cleansing balm. The texture is light. Scent is faint and pleasant (*almost like lemongrass? faint fresh citrus. I love it.) I use this as my first cleanse and it removes most all of my makeup. Other balms have left oily residue behind, like a film on my face. This balm does not do that. It rinses clean away. Absolutely adore this product.

reviews.review_text: There is nothing to not love about this cleansing balm. The texture is light. Scent is faint and pleasant (*almost like lemongrass? faint fresh citrus. I love it.) reviews.review_text: I am in love with this serum! I’ve used hyaluronic acid products in the past but never noticed much difference or benefit. But with this - wow! The serum is slightly thick, which I love. It doesn’t run through my fingers or drip down my face. The hydration it offers is incredible. My skin was sensitive and peeling it was so dry (medication reaction) and this helped so much. Now that my skin is sorted out and back to my normal, I’m still using this everyday. I live in the desert and this is a lifesaver. One pump is plenty for my whole face. New holy grail staple product for me.

reviews.product_name: Glowscreen Sunscreen SPF 40 PA+++ with Hyaluronic Acid + Niacinamide
reviews.review_text: Okay this product is amazing. I got the deeper shade and I thought it was going to be too dark, but it turned out to be perfect. The color is basically a tint and looks so good. I wasn’t sure if the glow was going to be too much, but it’s perfect and natural. I have oily skin so I will have to see if it gets too oily in the sun.

reviews.product_name: Tea Elixir Niacinamide & Hyaluronic Acid Anti-Aging Serum
reviews.review_text: This face serum is definitely something that you should try out. I have been using this face serum for about two weeks and I feel like I have seen a difference. I feel like my skin is more balanced and more even. Definitely will have to keep my eye on it but so far I like it!

reviews.product_name: Hyaluronic Acid 2% + B5 Hydrating Serum
reviews.review_title: A good add to your daily face regimen
reviews.review_text: It seems the HA is in every moisturizing product on the market practically. So, when I found The Ordinary’s bare bones version of it, I quickly added it to my regimen. For the price, I happily slather it on my face to supercharge my face creams. Very happy with it and will continue to purchase.

reviews.product_name: Natural Moisturizing Factors + HA
reviews.review_text: It took my skin a few weeks to get used to this cream. I kept having small break outs. But once it came into balance, I have used it as my regular face cream with no ill effects. The application is smooth and easy. I do apply a generous amount but at this price, it doesn’t bother me. Super happy with it. Will purchase again.

reviews.product_name: 100% Organic Cold-Pressed Rose Hip Seed Oil
reviews.review_text: Love this product. I have tried other face oils but this version is rich, heavy, and (I find) very helpful in keeping the moisturizer sealed on my skin when I apply it before bedtime. Would not apply in the day as make-up tends to run. Will repurchase.

reviews.product_name: Alpha Beta Extra Strength Daily Peel Pads
reviews.review_text: Worked really nice to take the dead layer of skin off of my face before I had put foundation on. No flakes! However, your face can be a little red after using so I would do it a few hours before you go any where. I enjoyed my sample and would recommend it. Wish it was a little cheaper.

reviews.product_name: Microneedling Anti-Wrinkle Retinol Patches
reviews.review_text: I was nervous to try this product, ya know tiny dissolvable needles to enhance serum absorption sounded painful. But it doesn’t hurt at all! I used it on a spot where I’ve had this red dot forever and it’s not gone but definitely smaller and more flat. The issues I have are the price for what you get. They’re small, think smallest Long bandaid in the variety pack that’s only good for childrens fingers and you get 6 of them. So not ideal for medium or large treatment areas more some of the lone rebel fine line wrinkle. Also make sure your skin is freshly washed thoroughly dried and with no moisturizer or serum in the area you’re going to put it on or it won’t stick. So if you’re a night sweater it’d be better use on a lounge around the house day.

reviews.product_name: Daily Greens Oil-Free Gel Moisturizer with Moringa and Papaya
reviews.review_text: I received this Complimentary from FARMACY BEAUTY. I got to try farmacy’s beauty daily greens moisturizer and overall I like the product. It does have an “herb-y” scent I was not a fan of but once applied I did not notice the scent anymore. The product comes in a twist off jar and has a gel like consistency. A pea size amount was plenty for my entire face. It absorbed quickly and did not leave a “residue”, my face felt silky dry. I happened to be able to test out its calming effects, my face was irritated and red and after using the moisturizer I did notice significant reduction in the irritation later that day.

reviews.product_name: Daily UV Defense Invisible Broad Spectrum SPF 36 Sunscreen
reviews.review_text: I received this product complimentary from innisfree. This sunscreen with moisturizer is overall a good product. The consistency is nice. you squeeze the bottle to dispense product through the nozzle and it’s easy to control how much you squeeze out. It doesn’t have much of a smell and it absorbs pretty nicely into my skin. I find that facial sunscreens often leave a oily residue but this product has a little of that but not much. I would say it’s better then my prior facial sunscreen.

reviews.product_name: Auto Correct Brightening + Depuffing Eye Cream for Dark Circles
reviews.review_text: Just ok. It does seem to help with puffiness under the eyes but I wasn’t a big fan of the tingling associated with it. I wouldn’t buy this product again but overall it worked ok.

reviews.product_name: ICE Ceramide Moisturizer with Vitamin F
reviews.review_text: I had such high hopes for this moisturizer but I’m not a fan at all. It’s too thick, it doesn’t absorb well into my face. I actually feel like my acne worsened while wearing because my pores couldn’t breathe. Overall do not like

reviews.product_name: Mini Daily Microfoliant Exfoliator
reviews.review_text: Gifted by Dermalogica. The Daily Microfoliant Exfoliator overall is nice. It has white granulars that you mix with water to scrub your face. It’s not overly drying or harsh on the face. It’s more of a gentle exfoliator.

reviews.product_name: Daily Microfoliant Exfoliator
reviews.review_text: Gifted by Dermalogica. The Daily Microfoliant Exfoliator overall is nice. It has white granulars that you mix with water to scrub your face. It’s not overly drying or harsh on the face. It’s more of a gentle exfoliator.

reviews.product_name: Santorini Grape Poreless Skin Cream
reviews.review_text: I received this product for free from Influenster in exchange for my honest review. The cream has a pleasant fragrance that is subtle. It glides on easily and feels fresh and hydrating as you’re applying it. My skin felt super smooth afterwards, and this cream is perfect to use before applying makeup. The salicylic acid helps to keep pores clean but does not dry it out. The hyaluronic acid and santorini grape extract keep my face feeling moisturized. Throughout the day, my skin continues to feel fresh and smooth.

reviews.product_name: Triple Algae Eye Renewal Balm Eye Cream
reviews.review_text: I received this product as a free sample. It feels wonderful going on and has a subtle, pleasant scent. It absorbs very quickly, and I can definitely see a difference in firmness and fine lines

reviews.product_name: T.L.C. Framboos Glycolic Resurfacing Night Serum
reviews.review_text: I received this product free from Influenster in exchange for my honest review. First, the packaging of this bottle is so cute and fun! I only need to use a small amount of this for my whole face. In the morning, my skin looks brighter and feels smoother. I like to use this 2-3 days a week for exfoliation.

reviews.product_name: Lala Retro Whipped Refillable Moisturizer with Ceramides
reviews.review_text: I love the light, whipped texture of this cream. It feels amazing going on and layers well after the glycolic serum at night. It really hydrates and nourishes my skin, and it feels super soft in the morning.

reviews.product_name: Watermelon Glow PHA + BHA Pore-Tight Toner
reviews.review_text: Okay, hear me out.. THIS toner is incredible. But, It looks gooey, and it even feels a bit “gooey” if you will. If you let it set on your skin about 5 mins, and proceed with your skin care, it will start to soak in. Even after a few mins, it does feel slightly sticky to the touch. I use this, the Glow Recipe Oil Free Moisturizer, as well as the Dew Drops. All 3 products are the same way imo. I was concerned about how my makeup would look over the texture I could feel. HOWEVER! I am beyond impressed at how smooth my foundation settled on my skin today. I couldn’t believe it! My makeup hasn’t moved all day. I can definitely recommend this product, coupled with the others. I have combination, dull/textured skin. Trying to shrink pore size. Hears to hoping this helps. Will update in a month or so! ☺️

reviews.product_name: Mini Watermelon Glow PHA + BHA Pore-Tight Toner
reviews.review_text: Okay, hear me out.. THIS toner is incredible. But, It looks gooey, and it even feels a bit “gooey” if you will. If you let it set on your skin about 5 mins, and proceed with your skin care, it will start to soak in. Even after a few mins, it does feel slightly sticky to the touch. I use this, the Glow Recipe Oil Free Moisturizer, as well as the Dew Drops. All 3 products are the same way imo. I was concerned about how my makeup would look over the texture I could feel. HOWEVER! I am beyond impressed at how smooth my foundation settled on my skin today. I couldn’t believe it! My makeup hasn’t moved all day. I can definitely recommend this product, coupled with the others. I have combination, dull/textured skin. Trying to shrink pore size. Hears to hoping this helps. Will update in a month or so! ☺️

reviews.product_name: Squalane + Vitamin C Rose Firming Oil
reviews.review_text: As I’ve gotten older, my skin has been getting dryer and much more dull looking (this took me a while to figure out, as I grew up with incredibly oily skin). My pores were huge, my makeup was caking as soon as I put it on, but then I would have oily looking skin by the end of the day. I could not figure it out. Until, many MUA videos later I realized I was still using everything for oily skin. Salicylic acid, clay masks, etc etc. When in fact, I’m now in my mid 30’s and need MOISTURE!!!!! Or else your skin is going to make it for you! And then some. I was turned onto the entire Biossance line by Sephora. I LOVE this Rose oil. It’s very hard for me to love putting an oil on my face lol, but this is great for my night time routine. I use a few drops on my face, and down my neck. It takes a bit to absorb, which is why I don’t use it during the day. I also think it’s a bit heavy under my makeup (but it is wearable under makeup). I haven’t tried many other oils, so I can’t compare it to any others. But this is very luxurious, and so is the rest of the Biossance line for dry/dull skin. I give 4/5 only Bc it’s a bit heavy for daytime use for me personally :) but I highly recommend for DRY skin :)

reviews.product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C
reviews.review_text: I am obsessed with this stuff!!!! It has re-hydrated my lips so quickly. I did read some reviews from people who said it made their lips dryer, but I think if you OVER-USE a product like this, it can do the opposite to your lips/skin. So there’s no need to constantly have this product on your lips, that’s why it’s a sleep mask lol. Anyway- I do use it a little during the day (usually in AM, before I leave the house), but mostly just at night. I couldn’t be more pleased.

reviews.product_name: Dewtopia 20% Acid Night Treatment
reviews.review_title: Well, this is was a surprise!
reviews.review_text: Uh… wow. I received this as a sample, and I saw improvement by night 3. Just in terms of skin texture. I could see my pores getting smaller, and just not as prominent. I have continued to use it, the sample has lasted me almost 2 weeks now, and I am beyond impressed. This product - plus my Pyconogel from The Ordinary, is quite the duo for pore texture. I have ordered the full size! :)

reviews.product_name: Daily Greens Oil-Free Gel Moisturizer with Moringa and Papaya
reviews.review_text: I love this farmacy daily greens oil free gel moisturizer. It is perfect for my combination skin. It is very hydrating and it does not give that oily feeling that some moisturizers give right after application. After using this a few days I notice my skin doesn’t look so oily. The container is glass and packaging is cute. I recommend this to everyone.I received this complimentary by farmacy for review purposes, however, all opinions are my own.

reviews.product_name: Volcanic AHA Pore Clearing Clay Mask
reviews.review_text: I tried this mask and love it. It left my skin feeling soft and smooth. It has a great texture and it’s not too drying. I would recommend this to everyone. I love that it is also so affordable, I want to try other innisfree products. I received this free for my review, all opinions are my own.

reviews.product_name: Crème de la Mer Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I received this product complimentary from La Mer for my review, all opinions are my own. The moisturizing cream is awesome. A little goes a long way and you have to warm up the product on your fingertips then apply it. It is very moisturizing and feels amazing and does not make me oily. It has a nice light fragrance. I would recommend it but it is expensive.

reviews.product_name: Mini Crème de la Mer Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I received this product complimentary from La Mer for my review, all opinions are my own. The moisturizing cream is awesome. A little goes a long way and you have to warm up the product on your fingertips then apply it. It is very moisturizing and feels amazing and does not make me oily. It has a nice light fragrance. I would recommend it but it is expensive.

reviews.product_name: Mini Daily Microfoliant Exfoliator
reviews.review_text: I received this complimentary from dermalogica to test out and I have to say this microfoliant is amazing and leaves my skin feeling very soft. It is not too rough on the skin and does not irritate. I would recommend this to everyone. I think it is suitable for all skin types and will help.

reviews.product_name: Daily Microfoliant Exfoliator
reviews.review_text: I received this complimentary from dermalogica to test out and I have to say this microfoliant is amazing and leaves my skin feeling very soft. It is not too rough on the skin and does not irritate. I would recommend this to everyone. I think it is suitable for all skin types and will help.

reviews.product_name: Ultra Repair Cream Intense Hydration
reviews.review_text: I really like this moisturizer. Very thick and will last literally forever. It’s actually a huge bottle so it will last ages

reviews.product_name: Glycolic Acid 7% Exfoliating Toning Solution
reviews.review_text: I love this toner as a dandruff treatment. I would never put this on my face. It kills dandruff like a dream though.

reviews.product_name: Watermelon Glow Niacinamide Dew Drops
reviews.review_text: Absolutely love this product! I use it i my under eyes before makeup to prevent creasing. The smell is a bit overwhelming but it’s not horrible.

reviews.product_name: Glowscreen Sunscreen SPF 40 PA+++ with Hyaluronic Acid + Niacinamide
reviews.review_text: Works well under makeup, but on no makeup days it makes my skin look very greasy. Maybe it’s just too light a shade but I would only recommend to people with dry/ combo skin or as a under makeup primer.

reviews.product_name: Lip Butter Balm
reviews.review_text: I adore this lip balm. Repurchased 3 times. A bit too pricy for a lip balm but I think it’s worth it

reviews.product_name: Lip Glowy Balm
reviews.review_text: This lip balm is very hydrating! I also have the lip sleeping masks and this balm is very similar to them. Good quality product for dry lips.

reviews.product_name: PHAT Glow Facial Mask
reviews.review_text: I use this face mask once a week as an exfoliator to help the texture of my skin and it works really well. It’s really sticky but washes off easily and leaves my skin feeling baby soft!

reviews.product_name: Banana Bright 15% Vitamin C Serum
reviews.review_text: So good! This serum sinks into the skin well; is a lightweight formula, and smells like a bag of navel oranges lovingly smacked you in the face-it’s awesome!

reviews.product_name: Rose Deep Hydration Sleeping Mask
reviews.review_text: Whenever I use a strong exfoliating mask, I always use this sleeping mask afterward to help rehydrate my face. I like the two step system and think both of these products work well together. You don’t need a lot of product which helps since this is expensive!

reviews.product_name: Sugar Advanced Lip Balm Intense Hydration Treatment
reviews.review_text: This is one of my faves. Goes on smooth with a light, pleasant scent. Also long lasting.

reviews.product_name: Beste No. 9 Jelly Cleanser
reviews.review_text: I have only ever used one specific item for removing my eye makeup and lip sticks/stains because it was the only thing that worked. After reading the reviews, I was totally interested. I’m always looking for natural/cruelty free products and I feel DE is very trustworthy on this promise, with some extensive explaining how they’re products are made. I was weary though because not all their products are for me. I used it for a week before I wrote this review. It really actually removes all the makeup. I played with it dry and wet and all. It did not hurt my eyes, has a pleasant plain smell, and actually is not as drying as other gentle cleaners I’ve used. I don’t have acne concerns, so I can’t speak to that. I just have super sensitive skin that can’t handle even some of the most natural, sensitive washes. It may cost a bit more than my old cleanser, but I am probably able to cut out the extra makeup remover, so it evens out. I’m here for it.

reviews.product_name: Slaai  Makeup-Melting Butter Cleanser
reviews.review_text: Simple review: Melts and hydrates beautifully with zero scent. Did not remove allllll of my mascara, but nothing Beste didn’t clear up. Did not make my eyes filmy compared to a similar product.

reviews.product_name: Unseen Sunscreen SPF 40 PA+++
reviews.review_text: Most of the reviews I read focused on how this product works with makeup, and the consistency of the product. It is clear gel, goes on smooth, wears well with makeup, feels like a primer. But my 5 star review is for the fact that I haven’t ever been able to find a face sunscreen that did not irritate my skin and eyes beyond belief. Like, they were actually painful, even natural ones like DE. Though I haven’t given it a full romp in the sun for an effectiveness test, this is the gentlest facial sunscreen I have found for everyday wear. It’s not at all irritating. It hardly seems like sunscreen. It is my new holy grail for face sunscreen, and I have tried many. Thank you Supergoop for a highly functional yet GENTLE product.

reviews.product_name: Soy Hydrating Gentle Face Cleanser
reviews.review_text: This fresh soy cleanser is a very gentle face cleanser. To me it smelled like cucumbers. It does not make your face feel tight when washed off, so you know it did not leave your skin striped of all the natural oils. It’s perfect to prep the skin for exfoliating. I received this product complimentary for review purposes.

reviews.product_name: Sugar Strawberry Exfoliating Face Wash
reviews.review_text: Perfect for the summer! With the sugar strawberry exfoliating face wash I have a pro tip I recommend not having your face super wet only slightly damp. Once you start scrubbing it in it instantly starts dissolving. So make sure you dry your face almost completely before scrubbing it if you want a good scrubbing. It did not strip my skin which means my face did not feel tight after washing it off. Which is perfect for all skin because if it takes all the oil from your skin your face starts to produce excess oil and you look to greasy. I received this product complimentary for review purposes.

reviews.product_name: Ultimate Sun Protector Lotion SPF 50+ Sunscreen
reviews.review_text: I love it! When I first squeezed some out it seemed watery BUT it’s not! Crazy, rubbing it in it feels so soft and moisturizing, there is no visible residue left on the skin. It absorbs in the skin perfectly without leaving skin dry. The best thing is that it is ocean-friendly and Hawaii compliant. It would have been great except it had all these chemicals that are not good for us like TALC, Dimethicone, Peg/Ppg-9/2 Dimethyl Ether, Alcohol 40-B, Alcohol, and FRAGRANCE.

reviews.product_name: Clear Sunscreen Stick SPF 50+
reviews.review_text: I love it! Rubbing it in it feels so soft and moisturizing, there is no visible residue left on the skin. It absorbs in the skin perfectly without leaving skin dry. The best thing is that it is ocean-friendly and Hawaii compliant. It would have been great except it had all these chemicals that are not good for us like Mineral Oil, Tocopheryl Acetate,PEG/PPG-14/7 Dimethyl Ether, Lecithin,Glycyrrhiza Glabra (Licorice) Root Extract, Castor Oil/Ipdi Copolymer,BHT, PEG-6, Peg/Ppg-9/2 Dimethyl Ether, Alcohol 40-B, Alcohol, and FRAGRANCE.

reviews.product_name: Yo Glow AHA & BHA Facial Enzyme Scrub
reviews.review_text: Okay, this is an all around YESS!! I used it first a few times, mostly on it’s own and then worked into my full skincare routine. It is PURE MAGIC. I could feel the enzymes working and scrubbing away at the impurities. After rubbing in circles and washing it off, my skin immediately felt lighter, clearer, and smoother. The appearance of my skin settled within a couple of minutes, my face is super sensitive, and left a even glow of fresh skin.  I had no bad reactions, whether using alone on clean skin or in a full routine with other brands products. I will definitely continue using this and cannot wait to see what other skincare products Huda will introduce!

reviews.product_name: Revitalizing Supreme+ Youth Power Creme Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: A face creme that actually does what it says! The feel is amazing, not too heavy but can tell it stays on all day. This is definitely going to be my go-to daily face creme.

reviews.product_name: Mini Revitalizing Supreme+ Youth Power Creme Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: A face creme that actually does what it says! The feel is amazing, not too heavy but can tell it stays on all day. This is definitely going to be my go-to daily face creme.

reviews.product_name: Double Serum Firming & Smoothing Anti-Aging Concentrate
reviews.review_text: This is worth every drop and every dollar. Within a week my skin was looking so good! I’m going to be adding this to every wishlist I can!

reviews.product_name: Advanced Night Repair Eye Gel-Cream
reviews.review_text: I received this product free to try. The texture is different than I’m used to but that’s my only complaint. I definitely noticed improvement to dark circles.

reviews.product_name: Protini Polypeptide Firming Refillable Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: This is a product I didn’t know I needed but am SO happy I bought! I have been using Sunday Riley Good Genes for a while but felt like it was drying out and breaking out my skin occasionally. When I introduced this cream into the mix I found the perfect balance! If you’re questioning just buy it!

reviews.product_name: D-Bronzi Anti-Pollution Bronzing Drops with Peptides
reviews.review_text: Was a little on the fence about this because I thought it might make me orange-y and look weird. I only currently use powder bronzer. WOW did this stuff blow me away- it look super natural and blends seamlessly into my skin. The best part- I look tan, glowing and healthy!

reviews.product_name: Cicapair Tiger Grass Color Correcting Treatment SPF 30
reviews.review_text: I can’t echo the statements of “it’s my new foundation” enough! I have uneven, reddish and pigmentation spots on my face. I rarely leave the house without foundation and would never go to work without it... until now! I put on the Dr Jart repair serum then slather on the color corrector. I use a little Glossier cloud paint on my check and my skin is done for the day! It’s so light and comfortable. If you’re curious just give this a try! You won’t be disappointed.

reviews.product_name: Cicapair Tiger Grass Serum
reviews.review_title: a new staple in my skincare routine!
reviews.review_text: An absolute staple in my skincare routine now! It’s calming, hydrating but not at all oily and stopped my break outs! I put this on before makeup in the morning and after washing at night. If you’re looking for a miracle serum try this!

reviews.product_name: Floral Recovery Overnight Mask with Squalane
reviews.review_text: I am not a huge fan of the fact that it has a fragrance but I love fresh products and I have been using it only for a couple of days and so far I have been liking it. Leaves my skin feeling super soft and hydrated.

reviews.product_name: Watermelon Glow Niacinamide Sunscreen SPF 50
reviews.review_text: I enjoy the cream’s texture and how it doesn’t appear white or oily like most sunscreens I’ve used before. This is a must-have for this summer! Highly recommended; I would buy it again in a heartbeat!!

reviews.product_name: Tea Elixir Niacinamide & Hyaluronic Acid Anti-Aging Serum
reviews.review_text: The serum is quite good, light, and quickly absorbs into the skin. It is wonderful to use as the first thing in the morning because it smells so delicious and invigorating. My skin now appears incredibly soft, supple, and moisturized thanks to this lotion. I like this stuff a lot so far.

reviews.product_name: Mini Daily Microfoliant Exfoliator
reviews.review_text: I’ve been using this for years and continue to be happy with this! It’s gentle enough to use daily and has really brightened and cleared up my skin.  I love how gentle it is on my skin. Definitely worth the money. Gifted by Dermatologica Sampling

reviews.product_name: Daily Microfoliant Exfoliator
reviews.review_text: I’ve been using this for years and continue to be happy with this! It’s gentle enough to use daily and has really brightened and cleared up my skin.  I love how gentle it is on my skin. Definitely worth the money. Gifted by Dermatologica Sampling

reviews.product_name: Luminous Dewy Skin Mist
reviews.review_text: The only downside to this product is the price point. Everything else about it I love however if you have sensitive skin I wouldn’t use it if you’re irritated at all due to the fragrance however other than that mid day when you don’t want to put more moisturizer on but you want a little dew and moisture and glow to your face it’s perfect it makes you so glowy and luminous I wish it was less expensive I have the trial size from the tatcha best sellers set which id definitely recommend for those curious about tatcha but I don’t know if I’ll be repurchasing because of the price I can’t see myself spending 50 dollars on a spray but If you got the coin I definitely would recommend!

reviews.product_name: Original Skin Retexturizing Mask with Rose Clay
reviews.review_text: I really love this mask it’s so lovely it a simple but great product with simple but great results it makes your skin soft and supple and takes away all the redness and Rosacea I haven’t been able to get rid of my whole life it was so nice to see such a bright even complexion I loved it i will be using this as a staple for years to come 100 percent

reviews.product_name: Vinoperfect Radiance Dark Spot Serum Vitamin C Alternative
reviews.review_text: So this is marketed as a dark spot serum however whenever I use it my skin feels so incredibly plump and supple and glowing I have glass skin and it’s literally plumped it boings lol I feel like a babies bottom but more glowy I literally look like I’m wearing highlighter I love this serum so so much I included a picture so you can see the immediate results it’s truly one of the best serums I’ve used in my life.

reviews.product_name: Superberry Hydrate + Glow Dream Night Mask with Vitamin C
reviews.review_text: Honestly this is one of the best things I’ve ever put on my face. Not your average mask. I was worried about an overnight mask because I roll around on my face during the night so I didn’t understand how it would work if it would just wipe off and I’d waste it. I read a comment that said they gently massaged it in before they went to bed and it melted into their skin. That was the most helpful comment I read however I advise not rubbing it in with trial and error I’ve realized even if you don’t massaged it at all after a couple hours it just starts to slowly melt into the skin and become a sort of thick velvet cocoon on your face and I’d advise not massaging it and giving it as much time to act as a mask and absorb into the skin as it can. By morning your skin is quite literally a dream it’s a glowing satin dream! And if you only get one mask in your collection I swear coming from a cosmetologist and a skincare guru I swear by this!

reviews.product_name: Aqua Bomb Overnight Lip Mask
reviews.review_text: Loving this! It’s fairly quick to absorb but leaves my lips feeling moisturized all day! It’s a great prep step in the morning or great as an overnight treatment!

reviews.product_name: Floral Recovery Overnight Mask with Squalane
reviews.review_text: The packaging is stunning. It’s a matte lavender.  The texture of the product is thick & a nice medium of creaminess. The product has a  light lavender scent which I like since it is so faint. I’ve been wearing this as an over night mask & my skin is feeling soft in the morning. It’s gentle enough that I think I could use it every night but I’m enjoying rotating it! I have sensitive combo skin!

reviews.product_name: Watermelon Glow Niacinamide Sunscreen SPF 50
reviews.review_text: This formula feels light weight on the skin & the packaging is super cute! There is a light watermelon scent  but once the product is blended in it just smells like regular sunscreen. I also think that if you use a lot of sunscreen you would blow through this product, there isn’t a lot of product for the price point. This also began to peel badly on my skin after about 20 minutes. I didn’t even try it with makeup since it was already peeling.

reviews.product_name: Watermelon Glow PHA + BHA Pore-Tight Toner
reviews.review_text: I’m really enjoying this so far! It has the classic glow recipe scent. The bottle is huge. The packaging is glass & heavy, I love how luxurious it feels. The texture is a bit different for a toner, it has a more gel like consistency. I haven’t had any adverse reactions to this product and I have combo + sensitive skin. I’m not sure how much it’s done for my pores because I haven’t been trying it long enough to see those results but due to the ingredient list I feel like I will get those results.

reviews.product_name: Mini Watermelon Glow PHA + BHA Pore-Tight Toner
reviews.review_text: I’m really enjoying this so far! It has the classic glow recipe scent. The bottle is huge. The packaging is glass & heavy, I love how luxurious it feels. The texture is a bit different for a toner, it has a more gel like consistency. I haven’t had any adverse reactions to this product and I have combo + sensitive skin. I’m not sure how much it’s done for my pores because I haven’t been trying it long enough to see those results but due to the ingredient list I feel like I will get those results.

reviews.product_name: Tea Elixir Niacinamide & Hyaluronic Acid Anti-Aging Serum
reviews.review_text: For starters this packaging is STUNNING!! It’s weighted nicely as well & feels very lux! The product Consistency is like a creamy/milk. It appears to be a cloudy white. There is a light sent it kind of reminds me of tea tree. It’s not overpowering though in my opinion and feeds quickly after applying on the skin. Overall I am really loving this product, I’ve noticed that my skin does Fillmore hydrated and softer. I can definitely see this becoming a permanent part of my skin care routine!

reviews.product_name: T.L.C. Sukari Babyfacial AHA + BHA Mask
reviews.review_text: Very effective chemical peel that I can honestly say made a difference in my complexion. I have super sensitive skin so I am always weary of acids; this didn’t irritate me at all. What I do is put it on my skin before a shower so my pores are closed as normally, leave it on for 20 min, then wash off with cool water. I then wait before putting oil or moisturizer until my face is calm. I do expect a bit of redness after washing it off which is why I wait before putting moisturizer; I find giving my skin a chance to rest works very well. It’s also expensive but I’ve literally had the same bottle since 2018 because you only use a thin layer so it was very cost effective compared to getting facial.

reviews.product_name: C.E.O. 15% Vitamin C Brightening Serum
reviews.review_text: I’m impressed. I recently was dealing with fading acne dark spots from a breakout (bad sort of cystic acne) during my period recently. So I started using this sample since I had it in my drawer and I’d read that Vitamin C Is good for fading acne. By the time I tried this, I’d had these fading scars for a good week and they were just as dark red and wide as they were a week prior, zero change. Using this serum I saw a noticeable difference in DAYS. I’m really impressed because to be honest my acne scars can sometimes look dark for weeks, if not months, and I’m often stuck trying to hide them with concealer. The red spots now are super light pink, and they also shrunk in width so they’re tiny and flat. I couldn’t be happier because I don’t wear much makeup in quarantine so I love how much clearer my complexion looks. I plan on buying the full size to use for acne is in the healing phase so I can speed up the fading process.

reviews.product_name: The Dewy Skin Cream Plumping & Hydrating Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I bought this for my mom’s birthday and she loved it. Gave a very nice glow and smells amazing. For me the best part is actually the packaging and I haven’t seen anyone mention this so maybe I am just late but - the top of the lid has this pretty gold bow. But if you look closely, the bow stick pulls out because it’s actually a beauty spatula that you use like a little spoon to take your product out so you don’t need to touch with fingers. Very clever. My mom kept the spatula to use with other skincare too.

reviews.product_name: ICE Ceramide Moisturizer with Vitamin F
reviews.review_text: Very thick but smooth gliding cream. It smells sweet - vaguely like cherry vanilla (very gentle scent) which is so pleasant and relaxing. (I actually wish they made a body lotion or body oil with this soft scent.) I have extremely dry skin which develops patches of dryness, flakes, redness, and rosacea in winter, especially around cheeks. This has prevented that. Usually I need to use a humidifier at night to make my skin more moist in winter but this year I didn’t! So to me that’s clear effectiveness. I use a decent scoop of this (it comes with a beauty spatula to prevent touching it with fingers) but if you aren’t nearly as dry as me, you’ll definitely use less. Even with my massive scoops, I’ve had it for a month and it’s only 1/3 gone. Bonus: It does not cause pilling when I put my mineral SPF on.

reviews.product_name: SEA drink of H2O hydrating boost moisturizer
reviews.review_text: Very cool product! All bunch of good ingredients, nice texture, smell is very subtitled, did not make my sensitive mix skin breakout like so many other face cream ... the only downside is that I found I took a lot of time to absorb and left me a bit sticky in the mean time.

reviews.product_name: Sugar Hydrating Lip Balm
reviews.review_text: Love it!! I am a big fan of the advanced therapy was not so impressed with the rose honey nude samples . Also tried the minty one and I like the caramel better.

reviews.product_name: The Deep Cleanse Gentle Exfoliating Cleanser
reviews.review_text: Gross and weird texture, did not make me break out but would invest in a better smelling and better texture product. I got to say the marketing of this brand is amazing. The product description made me want to absolutely try it and the packaging is every princess dreams.

reviews.product_name: Mini Deep Cleanse Gentle Exfoliating Cleanser
reviews.review_text: Gross and weird texture, did not make me break out but would invest in a better smelling and better texture product. I got to say the marketing of this brand is amazing. The product description made me want to absolutely try it and the packaging is every princess dreams.

reviews.product_name: Cicapair Tiger Grass Cream
reviews.review_text: I have a bunch of hand cream that are good moisturizer. But once my hands are really dry, there is nothing even a cortisone cream can help and it takes weeks to heel. Has soon has I put the tiger grass cream on I had relief from itching and I noticed the next morning that my skin was healing and much faster. I am just amazed by the results!! So thankful this product exists!! I have no idea what ingredients in this particular cream made it happen, but I would recommend it to every one that struggle finding a good cream for eczema!!

reviews.product_name: Sugar Advanced Lip Balm Intense Hydration Treatment
reviews.review_text: Simply amazing!!! The only recommendation I have is to keep this next to your night stand or beauty cabinets because it can break. Other than that this product is flawless!! My lips are my best feature and this feels like I am taking care of them in a short and long term. I have tried a lot and keep rebuying this one.

reviews.product_name: Lactic Acid 10% + HA 2% Exfoliating Serum
reviews.review_text: Very good product! I bought it second time. Really amazed how it works.

reviews.product_name: Hyaluronic Acid 2% + B5 Hydrating Serum
reviews.review_text: Great product. It works perfect for my skin and I am ordinary’s fan!

reviews.product_name: AHA 30% + BHA 2% Exfoliating Peeling Solution
reviews.review_text: Not good as expected. It dried my face skin so I use it on shoulders. My face skin does not need that strong acid.

reviews.product_name: Take The Day Off Cleansing Balm Makeup Remover
reviews.review_text: I use it every morning and night routine. I it protects my skin barrier and clear my skin well.

reviews.review_text: This was gifted by Dermalogica. This is a really effective cleansing oil. It removes all of my makeup including mascara without much trouble, and rinses away really easily. My only complaint is the packaging. The oil is really thin and if you’re not super careful it’ll kinda spray out and make a mess.

reviews.product_name: Watermelon Glow Niacinamide Sunscreen SPF 50
reviews.review_text: I had such high hopes for this because I love the brand but I’m so disappointed! It pills really badly no matter what I’ve tried. I even tried just putting on bare skin with no product underneath and it still pilled. It’s especially disappointing because the finish is really nice before it starts pilling.

reviews.product_name: Triple Algae Eye Renewal Balm Eye Cream
reviews.review_text: Really lovely rich eye cream! I love the texture of it – it feels so hydrating but not too heavy or greasy. My undereyes are very dry which can emphasize fine lines. The skin looks nice and plumped with this.

reviews.product_name: Sugar Lip Balm Hydrating Treatment
reviews.review_text: This is a really lovely lip balm. I can’t necessary say it’s “worth” the price, but if you’d like to splurge on a nice treat, this is a good choice! Perfect “my lips but better” tint, feels really smooth and comfortable, and has a lovely soft scent.

reviews.product_name: Mini Daily Microfoliant Exfoliator
reviews.review_text: This is a perfect physical exfoliant. I was scared of physical exfoliation for awhile because I have sensitive, acne-prone skin and I definitely used too much St. Ives back in the day! But this is definitely not that. It’s so gentle, and my skin ends up looking calmer after I’ve used this than before.

reviews.product_name: The True Cream Aqua Bomb
reviews.review_text: Will never use any other moisturizer. Only thing that works for my severe dry skin under makeup without being greasy or going away in a couple hours. This hydration lasts all day and I’m so impressed. I have tried hundreds of moisturizers and this one is hands down the best. I can’t live without it and I wish I could bath in it!!!

reviews.product_name: Vitamin Enriched Face Base Priming Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I had heard people raving about this but was kind of dead set on my smashbox primerizer, didn’t think it could get better than that and I was having a hard time accepting the price tag. After the first use I was truly blown away. I am a makeup artist and have used this one several people with different skin types and every time it just elevated the foundation to a whole new level of perfection. I truly don’t think I can wear foundation without it. It’s THAT good. A little goes a long way so it is absolutely worth the cost

reviews.product_name: Aqua Bomb Sleeping Mask
reviews.review_text: Belif is easily my favorite skin care brand and this completed my collection (I have both moisture bomb and aqua bomb, the face mist, eye bomb) and this is just as good as the others. I can’t imagine not having this in my life. I’ve repurchased aqua bomb 3 times and I will def repurchase this. My skin has never look better. I can finally wear matte foundation and I’ve never been able to because of my dry skin issues

reviews.product_name: Skinlongevity Long Life Herb Anti-Aging Face Serum
reviews.review_text: This is a very nice feeling serum and I have noticed a brighter complexion since using it. I haven’t noticed much in the way of reducing fine lines but my skin looks and feels more supple and gooey after using for about a month  I received this free to try from influenster.

reviews.product_name: Glow2OH Dark Spot Toner
reviews.review_title: If you’re here thinking about it…buy it!!!
reviews.review_text: Love it!!!! Can’t recommend Ole Henriksen enough. There is nothing I can say here that would make people believe how great this man’s products are. They just really are perfect. Started buying because it was “high end” for my price point at the time. I have tried more expensive brands and nothing works as well. I use this at night and it is so noticeable when I miss a night.

reviews.product_name: Vinopure Natural Salicylic Acid Pore Minimizing Serum
reviews.review_text: Amazing, but give it a week or so, while consistently using, to see results! Some might see a flare up before progress, do not dismay.I suggest using with the toner of the same line, and the Caudalie moisturizing toner to calm the skin.

reviews.product_name: Retinol Eye Stick
reviews.review_title: I don’t know for sure if it works, but I LOVE IT!
reviews.review_text: I can’t remember how I looked before it, but I think it works incredibly well… Even if it has a placebo effect I am buying it again. I tried it on my laugh lines and it did make a difference there, but there were two problems. 1. I think it works while it’s on, but maybe not long term (will have to buy a second time to be sure)2. It makes me break out when I use it on my smile lines, but I will test and make sure that is not my normal acne

reviews.product_name: Squalane + Marine Algae Firming & Lifting Eye Cream
reviews.review_title: Recommend if top lid is a concern…
reviews.review_text: I love this product. I’m not sure I see a difference in my under eye area, it moistens it enough when using, but I don’t see long term effects. On my eye lid is where I see the difference and that’s enough for me.

reviews.product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C
reviews.review_text: This is amazing. Perfect before going to bed and your lips are ready for any liquid or regular lipgloss. Smells delicious too! I got a free sample then immediately bought the full size

reviews.product_name: Cleansing & Exfoliating Wipes
reviews.review_text: The best makeup wipes for an amazing price! I mean makeup wipes from the drugstore are the same price. The coconut is so softening and the charcoal is great exfoliating. I personally stick with the green tea wipes. It removes ALL makeup, exfoliates my skin, gets all oils out, and prevents breakouts

reviews.product_name: The Rice Wash Skin-Softening Cleanser
reviews.review_text: This product is AMAZING like all of my Tatcha products. This is the staple of my skincare routine and I have pretty oily skin. It’s the perfect size that lasts awhile because you don’t need a lot for a good cleanse and a soft, smooth finish on the skin! (Also recommend this with the water cream moisturizer)

reviews.review_text: 𝐏𝐫𝐨𝐬: lightweight, smells amazing, great moisture throughout the day, perfect for dry lips in winter too, just as good as lip mask𝐂𝐨𝐧𝐬: may have to reapply often

reviews.product_name: D-Bronzi Anti-Pollution Bronzing Drops with Peptides
reviews.review_text: Best Product I have ever used!!! It doesn’t break me out and makes me look so naturally tan. I wear this with concealer and powder and looks beautiful. I’m going to stock up on more bottles. I cannot get enough of this product.

reviews.product_name: Honeymoon Glow AHA Resurfacing Night Serum
reviews.review_text: Holy moly! I bought this during the Sephora sale and i have only used it twice now. It’s AMAZING!! I didnt have high expectations for this as it’s a serum and I usually only use physical exfoliants. My skin is sensitive so I only use it once a week. When I wake up In the morning my skin is baby butt smooth. It’s insane. I will forever repurchase this now and skip the harsh scrubs I was using before. Start off once a week and build up to twice is my best advice. The sting in the beginning when you first apply it only lasts 10 seconds tops and then it’s gone. I typically don’t put a moisturizer on top of it because I dont feel dry. Best of luck! :)

reviews.product_name: C-Rush Vitamin C Gel Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: Smells amazing!!! Brightens skin. Wakes me up in the morning. However I dont think it’s the most moisturizing product out there. May be better for oily and normal skin folks. Did I mention it smells incredible like freshly squeezed oranges.

reviews.product_name: C-Tango Vitamin C Eye Cream
reviews.review_text: Thought I loved this eye cream until I noticed so much milia forming!!! My under eyes are dark now too. So odd and disappointing. Will give to my mom and hope it works for her more mature skin.

reviews.product_name: Self Tanning Bronzing Face Drops
reviews.review_text: AMAZING! Im light skin toned and I purchased the darkest color. It works perfectly. I used 5-6 drops per limb. Only down side is there’s a tiny self tan smell but the color is worth it. Also makes your skin feel soft! No staining of clothes or sheets I will repurchase this for sure!!! Highly recommend.

reviews.product_name: Clear Improvement Pore Clearing Moisturizer with Salicylic Acid
reviews.review_text: Amazing!! This product is great! It got rid of my breakouts super quickly without over drying my skin. It smells great and it goes on super light. Love this product!

reviews.product_name: Greek Yoghurt Nourishing Probiotic Gel-Cream
reviews.review_text: This is my favorite! It makes your skin feel so soft and hydrated without feeling oily. It also helped my acne and is a staple in my routine.

reviews.product_name: Estee Lauder Advanced Night Repair Synchronized Multi-Recovery Complex Serum
reviews.review_text: Good! This product was good! I definitely saw a difference in my skin after using this. My skin became firmer and hydrated. My only complaint is that this serum definitely smells kinda bad.

reviews.product_name: Clear Sunscreen Stick SPF 50+
reviews.review_text: Amazing! This product is great! Seriously goes on seamlessly and fells great on.

reviews.product_name: Alpha Beta Extra Strength Daily Peel Pads
reviews.review_text: Love this product! I normally have sensitive skin so was hesitant to try this “extra strength” formula. It does not irritate my skin, feels light and is not drying. After a few weeks of use, my skin tone is more even, fine lines are disappearing, and even deeper set wrinkles appear smoother. I was hopeful that it would help with my adult acne and large pores in addition as many other reviewers commented on this benefit. Unfortunately, it did not seem to benefit that area for me.

reviews.product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C
reviews.review_text: Here me out. This stuff is great. At first it totally looks and feels like one of those overly thick, sticky lipglosses from a plastic pallet you’d use as a kid in the 90s...I was turned off at first but decided to give it a whirl. I rubbed it in for about 10 seconds which made the consistency feel much nicer and like something I could actually go to bed with on. The next day my lips felt soft, smooth and plump. I didn’t reach for chapstick all day (which is saying a lot) and my lips are better prepped for lipstick and liner.

reviews.product_name: Squalane + Vitamin C Rose Firming Oil
reviews.review_text: I got a sample of the Biossance Squalane + Vitamin C Rose Oil. As soon as I used it, I was impressed. I’ve tried so many face oils and they always end up being too heavy, too light, tacky, there’s almost something. This oil feels wonderful. It’s great for my dry, patchy and sensitive skin without feeling heavy too heavy. Only removing 1 star because of price but I will likely buy the bottle nonetheless.

reviews.product_name: Watermelon Glow Niacinamide Dew Drops
reviews.review_text: I add a pump to my cc cream and it’s gorgeous. It creates a dewy (but not shiny) look, without it my cc cream makes me look a little dull. It has also helped with my dry, winter skin. I have also dabbed a small amount over my cream for a subtle highlighter. Although the bottle is small, a little goes a long way.

reviews.product_name: Hyaluronic Acid 2% + B5 Hydrating Serum
reviews.review_text: I have combination skin that’s more dehydrated in winter months. This serum made my skin feel tight and dry and was unable to layer any products without major piling. I tried different combinations and amount of product, to no avail. Will not be repurchasing.

reviews.product_name: Original Skin Matte Moisturizer with Willowherb
reviews.review_text: I received this product free to test from Influenster. It is a very nice moisturizer that leaves the skin soft, matte, and smooth. I give this product 4 stars because I am super dry, and although it is very hydrating, I like a dewy moisturizer. I would definitely recommend to someone who is more oily or prefers to be more matte.

reviews.product_name: Aqua Bomb Sleeping Mask
reviews.review_text: This mask is great, I received it as a free sample from Influenster and it’s so hydrating and makes my skin so soft and plump in the morning!

reviews.product_name: Glow2OH Dark Spot Toner
reviews.review_text: So I’ve been using this toner for about ten days now and WOW!!! I normally use the Tarte Knockout which I still love, but I’ve been using it for almost a year and my skin needed a change because it was too used to it. This toner did make me purge a little at first, got a few breakouts on my cheek and some tiny bumps on my forehead but now they’re going away and my skin is so bright and smooth! I can’t wait to see if it helps lighten my acne scarring. I’ve gotten so many compliments on my skin and it smells DELICIOUS. And $28??? Yes, please!!

reviews.product_name: Alpha Beta Extra Strength Daily Peel Pads
reviews.review_text: I’ve worked at Sephora for almost two years now and EVERYONE has always raves about these... why has it taken so long for me to try them? I have no idea, because WOW. I’ve only been using it for 4 days and I already notice a tremendous difference. Immediately my skin is so much softer and smoother. And I’ve had awful texture from traveling and it’s gotten it to smooth out so well. I’m obsessed. Definitely worth the splurge!

reviews.product_name: Avocado Soothing Skin Barrier Serum with Ceramides
reviews.review_text: I loved this serum so much!!!!! My skin is looking healthier. Really helps to improve the glow and moist of it. My makeup looks better now. This was gifted by recipe glow to me in enchanted of my honest review.

reviews.review_text: I love Lamer and this moisturizer is perfect. Just use a little bit of it, warn it up between your fingers before depositing it cause it makes a huge difference. Gifted by Lamer in exchange of my honest review. It smells really gooood!

reviews.review_text: Fresh’s hyaluronic acid moisturizer features a new clean formula with 72-hour hydration and a lightweight texture for plump, dewy skin. It’s wonderful and the essence is amazing. My sling looks moist and not oily. Gifted by Fresh.

reviews.product_name: Mini Daily Microfoliant Exfoliator
reviews.review_text: This daily microfoliant sampling was gifted by dermatológica in exchange of my honest review and this smells nice and although I didn’t use enough time but I can say that is a good product. Thank you dermatológica.

reviews.product_name: Daily Microfoliant Exfoliator

reviews.product_name: Green Clean Makeup Removing Cleansing Balm
reviews.review_text: This is so nice. I’ve tried several cleansing balms, but this one replaced my past HG. Yes, its expensive, less than an 1/8th teaspoon is needed for my entire face (if that). Its soft, gentle doesn’t have weird fillers, feels luxurious, and gentle enough not to hurt the eyes but still strong enough to remove stubborn eye makeup (I tend to wear lots of eyeliner and KVD x Billy Joel Armstrong smudgey pencil makeup). Try a sample or buy the mini before you splurge on the full size.

reviews.review_text: Its okay...Its moisturizing, but it does not boost the lasting effect of my foundation

reviews.product_name: The Camellia Oil 2-in-1 Makeup Remover & Cleanser
reviews.review_text: So this is useful for no makeup days (when I wear only suncreen). When I’m wearing makeup (I wear light-medium coverage, dewy foundations) I have to use at least 2 pumps to get the makeup off. This also doesn’t work well for eye make-up. For waterproof makeup, this does not get that off. And for the price...I have found other oil cleansers that are 1/4 of the price that do a better job. I returned this.

reviews.product_name: Vinopure Natural Salicylic Acid Pore Minimizing Serum
reviews.review_text: I like this product because it doesn’t leave my skin greasy and its easy to use my skin absorbs it quickly.#trywithtopbox #freeproduct

reviews.product_name: Good Genes All-In-One AHA Lactic Acid Treatment
reviews.review_text: I have dry spots and a few dark spots on my face. Its always been a struggle to find good products that don’t makr.my skin greasy. I love this product! It was easy to use and made my skin feel so soft! It’s also has helped my skin get back to its glow. It doesn’t take much so I know this will last- well worth it!complimentary from Sunday Riley

reviews.product_name: Rose & Hyaluronic Acid Deep Hydration Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: This product really left my skin smooth and glowing. It feel refreshing and not greasy and has a very nice light after scent. This product goes in well without leaving any greasy residue. I definitely recommend this type of product.

reviews.product_name: Mini Daily Microfoliant Exfoliator
reviews.review_text: I really like how my skin felt after using these products for a few days. It felt much smoother and much softer. I also like that it didnt irritate my skin at all like many other products.*received complimentary from dermalogica*

reviews.product_name: Rose Deep Hydration Sleeping Mask
reviews.review_text: I am absolutely in love with the Fresh Rose Deep Hydration Sleeping Mask! I have combination skin and after using this, I wake up with my skin feeling balanced, hydrated, and pump! The first step is a lightweight gel that feels refreshing and absorbs into my skin quickly. The second step is a light water-cream texture that locks in the moisture. The mask has a light refreshing rose scent that is relaxing and not irritating at all. I received this product for free to review.

reviews.product_name: Smart Clinical Repair Wrinkle Correcting Eye Cream
reviews.review_text: I received a sachet sample of the CliniqueSmart Clinical Repair Wrinkle Correcting Eye Cream from #TryWithTopBox and Clinique for free in exchange for my honest review. I can’t comment on the long-term effectiveness and “wrinkle correcting“ ability of the product because it was just a 1mL sample. However, the eye cream was very moisturizing and helped smooth my under-eye area. I didn’t notice any irritation when using this product. #freeproduct

reviews.product_name: Smart Clinical Repair Wrinkle Correcting Cream
reviews.review_text: I received a sample of the Clinique Smart Clinical Repair Wrinkle Correcting Cream from #TryWithTopBox and Clinique in exchange for my honest review. I can’t comment on the long-term effectiveness and the “wrinkle correcting“ ability of the product because it was just a 5mL sample. However, the cream was very nourishing and left my skin feeling smooth, soft and hydrated all day long. The cream has a light fresh scent and did not irritate my sensitive skin. It absorbs quickly and wears well under my sunscreen and makeup.#freeproduct

reviews.product_name: Smart Clinical Repair Wrinkle Correcting Serum
reviews.review_text: I received a sachet sample of the Clinique Smart Clinical Repair Wrinkle Correcting Serum from #TryWithTopBox and Clinique for free in exchange for my honest review. I can’t comment on the long-term effectiveness and “wrinkle correcting“ ability of this product because it was just a 1mL sample. The serum has a light fresh scent. It absorbed quickly and left my skin feeling soft and hydrated. It didn’t feel sticky and didn’t pill under the Clinique Smart Clinical Repair Wrinkle Correcting Cream.#freeproduct

reviews.product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C
reviews.review_title: Great value, very rich and hydrating!
reviews.review_text: This lip sleeping mask keeps my lips hydrated all night, and they are so supple when I wake up in the morning.  This jar will last forever.  It has more product than another brand of balm that I use at night, and more than another brand of lip mask - and yet the Laneige is the cheapest.  You don’t need to slather on a whole lot - about the size of a grain of rice (or maybe even a bit less than that??) for your upper lip and then another one for your lower lip; that’s sufficient.  There is a berry scent, but it’s very light and not at all annoying.  This is the 3rd Laneige product I’ve tried, and so far I love them all, it’s 3 for 3!

reviews.product_name: Umbra Sheer Physical Daily Defense SPF 30
reviews.review_title: I wanted to love this, but....  :(
reviews.review_text: When I applied a little bit of this on my hand when I was in the store, it felt fine, so I bought the full size.  Unfortunately, once applied on my face, it felt so greasy and took so long to be absorbed by my skin.  I’m giving this 2 stars because it’s a clean product (DE had excellent intentions in creating this brand), I like the idea of a physical sunscreen, and you do get a lot of product for the price (as compared to other similarly-priced SPFs found on Spehora).  However, I will only be using this on no-makeup days (plus I’ll use it on other parts of my body as well) and I will not be repurchasing it once it’s all gone.

reviews.product_name: Luna Sleeping Retinoid Night Oil
reviews.review_text: I have a tiny bottle of this, included with my Play Smarts Skincare box.  After using it and testing it out for several nights, I’m hooked!  You only need a couple of drops, warm it up in your hands, then press gently onto your face.  My skin feels wonderful once the oil sinks in; give it several minutes.  I know people are turned off by the scent, which is somewhat herbal (?), but I actually like it.  Will be purchasing a bigger size bottle of this!

reviews.product_name: Good Genes All-In-One AHA Lactic Acid Treatment
reviews.review_text: I have a small tube of this which I received in my Sephora Play Smarts Box, and per the recommendation, I have been applying it on my face after having let the Sunday Riley Luna Night Sleeping Oil sink in for about 5-10 minutes.  It makes my skin so soft and supple.  There is a sort of medicinal smell, but it dissipates quickly and it’s not so bad, it’s definitely not a hindrance to my continued use of the product.

reviews.product_name: Lippe Balm
reviews.review_text: Personally, I don’t like my lip balms to be glossy, slippery, shimmery,or waxy-feeling, so DE’s Lippe Balm met my standards.  I’ve been using it for a month now.  It’s very moisturizing and it doesn’t feel like it’s just sitting on top of my lips; I really love the formulation.  The bigger circumference of the lip balm was a little weird at first, but I quickly got used to it, and I now prefer it over the “normal“ sized stick lip balms.  I will repurchase when I run out.

reviews.product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C
reviews.review_text: Total dry lip lifesaver! I use it year round but it’s especially great in the winter.

reviews.product_name: Superfood Air-Whip Lightweight Moisturizer with Hyaluronic Acid
reviews.review_text: This has been an absolute game changer in my skin care routine! For years I’ve gotten cystic acne that flairs up from stress. Since starting to use this about a year ago I’ve gotten maybe two cysts in the last year. This seriously feels like a cool drink of water on your face every morning. I use it after my vitamin c serum and it absorbs super well. I have combo skin and don’t notice any excessive oily skin when I use this under spf and makeup.

reviews.product_name: Watermelon Glow Niacinamide Dew Drops
reviews.review_text: This stuff really is amazing. I saw it on tiktok and then remembered I had a sample. It was love at first use. I dab by foundation on my face and then blend it in with a few pumps of this on my hands. It is perfect. I don’t know how but it highlights you in all the right spots. I’m obsessed.

reviews.product_name: Self-Tanning Water Refill
reviews.review_text: I love this tanning water! I use to use the isle of paradise drops and this is so much better. Pour this into a mister bottle from Amazon, rub with a tanning glove and your tan will be flawless. I prep by putting some lotion on dry spots and I do my hands last with just a light pat with whatever is left on my glove. I felt like the tan lasted me almost a week and left my skin really well moisturized and soft. A little goes a long way and I can’t believe how little I’ve used out of my spray bottle with two applications already. You will not regret buying this as soon as it’s back in stock!

reviews.product_name: Glow2OH Dark Spot Toner
reviews.review_text: I received this product free from Indluenster to test out before it’s official launch and I’m happy to have been lucky enough to try it out. This stuff is great!  It leaves my skin feeling soft and has a lovely scent. It leaves a slight tingle when first applied but dissipates quickly. I was skeptical at first with my sensitive skin that it might leave me looking red or blotchy due to the AHAs, but so far so good. I have found this especially good for me right now with the cold winter weather here in the Canadian prairies. I’m hoping to see more long term results with continued use, because right now it’s helping to decrease the darker pigmentation that I have currently. This product is a must try for anyone looking to even out their skin tone!!

reviews.product_name: The True Cream Aqua Bomb
reviews.review_title: Great moisturizer for the warm months!
reviews.review_text: This is a really nice cream with a smooth and refreshing gel texture. It absorbs nicely into the skin and does not leave my face feeling too tacky. It sits well under makeup application as well. It doesn’t irritate my sensitive skin and does not have any overwhelming scent to it. Unfortunately, this for not enough moisture or hydration for me in the winter months so this is cannot be used year round for me. Canadian winters can be brutal on the skin and this doesn’t work for me for about half the year. If you live in a milder climate, this may become a holy grail. A really nice product that is worth the try.

reviews.product_name: Aqua Bomb Overnight Lip Mask
reviews.review_text: This product reminds me so much of the Laneige lip sleeping mask. It has a smooth texture that allows for a very thin or a thicker application. This makes it very versatile and user friendly. I really appreciate that it has no noteable scent to it. The lack of scent makes it more appealing to those who (like my husband) don’t want to smell fruity or sweet while they are trying to sleep. The lip mask itself does not leave your lips feeling sticky at all upon application.  It is hydrating and does the job overnight. I wake up with my lips feeling moisturized and ready for the day. The consistency of this product makes it easy to use during the day under other lip products as well. I highly recommend this for those who like the Laniege mask but don’t want the scent. The two products are very comparable. I will definitely repurchase this!

reviews.product_name: Moisture Surge 100H Auto-Replenishing Hydrator Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I really enjoyed using this moisturizer. It has a nice gel consistency that makes for easy application. I find it is slightly tacky afterwards, but will set down eventually. It sits nicely under sunscreen and makeup without trouble. I find it very hydrating and a perfect product for those with dry skin but want something not a heavy feeling to use in the warmer months. I also think that a little goes a long way with this product. I can’t make note on anything in terms of long term benefits, but I have always had good luck with Clinique moisturizers. This is one that I would definitely consider purchasing.

reviews.product_name: Clear Sunscreen Stick SPF 50+
reviews.review_text: Best little sunscreen stick. Goes on clear, but does Finally! A portable sunscreen that doesn’t require me to touch my face with my hands for reapplication! Does not leave an oily or shiny finish. Feels super smooth when applying. Works well over my foundation when reapplying. Love!!

reviews.product_name: GENIUS Sleeping Collagen Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I love Algenist products and was excited to try this based on the rave reviews. I was disappointed this did nothing to moisturize my skin. I woke up with my skin feeling much drier than when I would use the Algenist overnight restorative cream. I used a sample I received for about a week.

reviews.product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C
reviews.review_text: I used to use Bite Beauty before they changed to a vegan formula. This works equally well, and for the price and the amount you get this is better! It works really well as a overnight lip balm and I wake up with my lips soft and moisturized in the AM.

reviews.product_name: Glowscreen Sunscreen SPF 40 PA+++ with Hyaluronic Acid + Niacinamide
reviews.review_text: Love this! It gives me a healthy glow and is the perfect consistency. Lightweight and blends in easily and doesn’t make me look like a disco-ball. Perfect for days I don’t wear foundation.

reviews.product_name: Mini Glowscreen Sunscreen SPF 40 PA+++ with Hyaluronic Acid + Niacinamide
reviews.review_text: Love this! It gives me a healthy glow and is the perfect consistency. Lightweight and blends in easily and doesn’t make me look like a disco-ball. Perfect for days I don’t wear foundation.

reviews.product_name: The Rice Wash Skin-Softening Cleanser
reviews.review_text: I was pleasantly surprised by this cleanser. It doesn’t dry my skin out at and I’ve tested this by not applying anything after cleansing for an hour just to see how it felt. (I have combo skin) I think it does a pretty good job of cleansing, but you still need to use a make up remover before using this to remove any eye shadow or mascara. The only complaint I have about this cleanser is the strong scent. It’s similar to Tatcha The Silk Cream moisturizer but much stronger. It dissipates quickly after you rinse so that’s why I kept the 5 stars.

reviews.product_name: Mini Rice Wash Skin-Softening Cleanser
reviews.review_text: I was pleasantly surprised by this cleanser. It doesn’t dry my skin out at and I’ve tested this by not applying anything after cleansing for an hour just to see how it felt. It dissipates quickly after you rinse so that’s why I kept the 5 stars.

reviews.product_name: Barrier+ Triple Lipid-Peptide Face Cream
reviews.review_text: I had high hopes based on the high number of reviews, but this doesn’t do much better for my skin than other moisturizers I’ve used. The dry winter weather caused eczema patches around my eyes and I was hoping this would help, but it did nothing. Just sits on the surface of my skin and doesn’t absorb very well. It’s ok as a regular moisturizer, but I think for the price it’s not worth it. I’m sticking to FAB ultra repair cream.

reviews.product_name: Mini Barrier+ Triple Lipid-Peptide Face Cream

reviews.product_name: Revitalizing Supreme+ Youth Power Creme Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I only used this once, and I can’t bring myself to use it again. The added fragrance is so strong, it feels like I’m slathering cologne scented lotion on my face; and it gave me a headache. However, I do think this works well to provide moisture, it feels light at first, but provides a good deal of moisture throughout the day. I’m 40 yo with combination skin, and this did a good job to keep my skin hydrated. If the fragrance wasn’t so strong, or if it was fragrance free, I would continue using this.
