reviews.product_name: Facial Radiance Pads
reviews.review_text: I use these on the nights when I’m too lazy to wash my face, but still need to get the sunscreen off. They aren’t anything super special, but they get the job done!

reviews.product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C
reviews.review_text: This doesn’t do anything differently than applying chapstick at night does. Although it smells nice, it’s super sticky and doesn’t last long. I won’t be repurchasing.

reviews.product_name: Good Genes All-In-One AHA Lactic Acid Treatment
reviews.review_text: I am so obsessed with this product. I use this every night and it keeps my skin so smooth. I have rosacea and this doesn’t make me break out, which is huge! I try to stock up when it’s on sale, but this product is definitely worth the price.

reviews.product_name: Cicapair Tiger Grass Color Correcting Treatment SPF 30
reviews.review_text: Holy smokes this stuff is incredible!! I have rosacea so I’ve tried plenty of green correcting treatments and they all just left a weird tint on my skin. Not this stuff!! It’s super easy to apply, you only need a very small amount, and it makes my skin look flawless. Under foundation this helps even everything out, but on a daily basis I use this on its own! I love this product!!

reviews.product_name: Mini Cicapair Tiger Grass Color Correcting Treatment SPF 30
reviews.review_text: Holy smokes this stuff is incredible!! I have rosacea so I’ve tried plenty of green correcting treatments and they all just left a weird tint on my skin. Not this stuff!! reviews.product_name: Ultra Facial Moisturizing Cream with Squalane
reviews.review_text: This is a great moisturizer, but it’s so expensive and you need a lot of it. I went through the 1oz (which actually isn’t even a true ounce) jar much quicker than other moisturizers. It made my skin soft, but wasn’t anything revolutionary for the price. I’ll be going back to my First Aid Beauty moisturizer.

reviews.product_name: Mini Ultra Facial Moisturizing Cream with Squalane

reviews.product_name: Ultimate Sun Protector Lotion SPF 50+ Sunscreen
reviews.review_text: I love skin care. Using sunscreen on your face helps to keep your complexion even, is one of the many causes of uneven skin tones. It protects your skin against the sun’s harmful UV rays. I apply the Sun Protector Lotion after applying moisturizer and then I do makeup. I also use it on my body especially more now that it’s getting warmer here in Texas and we’re having sunny days. it feels very silky and comes with an spf 50+ & goes on clear, rubs in quickly without any residue. I love the Clear Sunscreen Stick, it’s so conveniently carry on the go. I keep it in my purse and apply it through the day. This collection is wonderful as this ocean friendly formula is free of oxybenzone and octinoxate.

reviews.product_name: Watermelon Glow Niacinamide Sunscreen SPF 50
reviews.review_text: Love this lotion and all its wonderful benefits and ingredients. Feels very hydrating without feeling sticky. I love that it has spf and hyaluronic acid. It also helps with evening your skin tone. I highly recommend.

reviews.product_name: Tea Elixir Niacinamide & Hyaluronic Acid Anti-Aging Serum
reviews.review_text: This serum feels so refreshing and hydrating. I use three drops and press it on my face gently.  I love the all the key benefits. It leaves my skin feeling very soft and rejuvenated. I also love that it don’t make your skin feel sticky.

reviews.product_name: Triple Algae Eye Renewal Balm Eye Cream
reviews.review_text: This balm is great..the texture is smooth and goes on flawlessly. I have been a big advocate for algenist products and now will be adding this to my list.

reviews.product_name: Jet Lag Mask
reviews.review_text: I love this mask. It feels good on my skin but a little on the sticky side but don’t mind. It keeps my skin hydrated and not too thick either. The package is a little small was expecting a larger bottle but besides that I’m satisfied.

reviews.product_name: Mini Jet Lag Mask
reviews.review_text: I love this mask. It feels good on my skin but a little on the sticky side but don’t mind. It keeps my skin hydrated and not too thick either. The package is a little small was expecting a larger bottle but besides that I’m satisfied.

reviews.product_name: Mini Daily Microfoliant Exfoliator
reviews.review_text: I enjoyed using this exfoliant. The sample packets made thrm easy to use and travel with without carrying thr whole bottle. It is not harsh on my sensitive skin and lefy it feeling clean and fresh. I would recommend it.

reviews.product_name: Daily Microfoliant Exfoliator
reviews.review_text: I enjoyed using this exfoliant. The sample packets made thrm easy to use and travel with without carrying thr whole bottle. It is not harsh on my sensitive skin and lefy it feeling clean and fresh. I would recommend it.

reviews.product_name: Oil-Absorbing Pore Treatment Strips
reviews.review_text: I used these pore strips on my cheeks and nose and noticed a reducibly difference in the size of my pores. I felt this product really cleaned up my skin and made it feel clean and clear with the excess stuff removed.

reviews.product_name: Violet-C Brightening Serum 20% Vitamin C + 10% AHA
reviews.review_text: I received this free through an influencer box. It has already been working! I have a pretty thourough skin regime, but my face already looks smoother and more radiant. I am looking forward to seeing the longer term effects of this serum and adding it to my regime.

reviews.product_name: The Essence Skincare Boosting Treatment
reviews.review_text: I received this free through my influencer box. I really like this product, I find it to be very similar to SKII’s essence, which is much pricier. As far as long term effects I will have to continue use to see how it stands up against SKII

reviews.product_name: Mini The Essence  Skincare Boosting Treatment

reviews.review_text: Great exfoliator! Smells great and leave skin looking bright and feeling smooth!I received this product for free through influenster

reviews.product_name: Mini GOOPGLOW Microderm Instant Glow Exfoliator
reviews.review_text: Great exfoliator! Smells great and leave skin looking bright and feeling smooth!I received this product for free through influenster

reviews.product_name: Lemonade Smoothing Scrub
reviews.review_text: Love this! I received complimentary from Influenster but I definitely think this will become a new staple! I use a pore strip right after and the combination helps to get rid of blackheads

reviews.product_name: Alpha Beta Extra Strength Daily Peel Pads
reviews.review_text: This product delivers. I have sensitive skin, and this product is a great balance between non irritating but effective.

reviews.product_name: Daily Greens Oil-Free Gel Moisturizer with Moringa and Papaya
reviews.review_title: Troubled skin? This is for you!
reviews.review_text: I received Farmacy’s DAILY GREENS oil-free gel moisturizer with moringa and papaya complimentary from Sephora in exchange for my honest review. I adore this product! I have combination skin and have started to develop aging skin issues, as well as have thinning skin due to medications. This moisturizer is light, sinks right in, and doesn’t make my face itchy or red. Saw results immediately, and my skin looks softly dewy, not fake greasy-dewy. Comfortable and long lasting. Looks like they have a customer for life now!

reviews.product_name: Vinopure Natural Salicylic Acid Pore Minimizing Serum
reviews.review_text: I’m very pleased with Vinopure Natural Salicylic Acid Pore Minimizing Serum! I’ve shied away from serums before, as they just seem to block up my pores and highlight scars, but this product did neither. My skin feels soft and smooth afterward, with no sticky or gooey feel.

reviews.product_name: Good Genes All-In-One AHA Lactic Acid Treatment
reviews.review_text: The Sunday Riley Good Genes is a delight to use. It made my skin soft, with no icky residues. The scent is pleasant without being overwhelming. I think my smile lines are already fading away, and my foundation sits more smoothly. Can’t wait to see long term effects! I received this product complimentary from Sunday Riley in exchange for my honest review

reviews.product_name: Clear Improvement Active Charcoal Mask to Clear Pores
reviews.review_text: I just started using this mask again after a long time and I forgot how much I love it. It goes on smoothly and feels cool on the skin. I like that it tightens as it dries so I know when to wash it off. It leaves my skin feeling clean and refreshed. I received this complimentary for testing purposes.

reviews.product_name: Sugar Strawberry Exfoliating Face Wash
reviews.review_text: I received this fave wash to test out and I have been using it for a few weeks now (a few times a week) and I love it! It’s so cool how it starts off a little gritty and then melts in to a smooth, lathery face wash. I also like that it’s not overly sweet smelling.

reviews.product_name: Plum Plump Hyaluronic Acid Serum
reviews.review_text: I have been loving this Serum. It’s nice and hydrating and I don’t notice a scent. My skin was really dry prior to using this from wearing a mask all day at work and this has really helped.

reviews.product_name: Squalane + Omega Repair Deep Hydration Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: This does a great job of moisturizing. My face has been dry lately and this has really helped. It’s not 5 stars for me though because it smells and not a good smell. The smell only lasts for a few seconds though so it’s not too bad.

reviews.product_name: Vitamin Enriched Face Base Priming Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: This stuff is amazing. Smooths your skin and is perfect before makeup. Use as a primer or as both a primer and moisturizer. Great for dry or combo.

reviews.product_name: Banana Bright 15% Vitamin C Serum
reviews.review_text: I am trying to figure out if the new formula has any benefits to it. It seems to be performing like the old formula but I’m thrown off with the new consistency. I still like and recommend!

reviews.product_name: GOOPGLOW Microderm Instant Glow Exfoliator
reviews.review_text: I like this a lot! It has very tiny exfoliant beads which I like. It feels gentle on the skin but also effective. I knocked it down a star for price. I’m not sure it’s worth that much.

reviews.product_name: Mini GOOPGLOW Microderm Instant Glow Exfoliator
reviews.review_text: I like this a lot! It has very tiny exfoliant beads which I like. It feels gentle on the skin but also effective. I knocked it down a star for price. I’m not sure it’s worth that much.

reviews.product_name: Advanced Night Repair Eye Concentrate Matrix Synchronized Multi-Recovery Complex
reviews.review_text: So far so good. I LOVE the applicator. It’s simple but feels really good on the under eye. The serum itself seems to be de puffing. I took one star off because I noticed these very smalll bumps on my under eye. I get these with all eye serums so it’s not unique.

reviews.product_name: Ultimate Sun Protector Lotion SPF 50+ Sunscreen
reviews.review_text: This lotion smells great, plus it spreads and absorbs well. I didn’t notice any white “veil” on my skin. I personally love that the packaging is recyclable too! Big plus in my book.

reviews.product_name: Clear Sunscreen Stick SPF 50+
reviews.review_text: Easy to use and smells good! I like the easy twist up part of the packaging. I personally like to rub it in once I apply, but the glide on stick is still really easy to use.

reviews.product_name: Lip Glowy Balm
reviews.review_text: LOVE this stuff! It’s so flattering on the lips and lasts a surprisingly long time for being a glossy balm. Yet it’s not sticky... it actually smoothes my lips like a mask too. AND it smells fantastic! Win win!

reviews.product_name: Honeymoon Glow AHA Resurfacing Night Serum
reviews.review_text: This is the best night serum I have found. It’s definitely  1st place for me, with a close second being the Biossance night serum. Nothing else I’ve tried comes close to these. It definitely tingles and feels warm after applying, and I experience a flush sometimes, but since it’s at night that doesn’t bother me. In the morning I wake up with soft, smooth, and clear skin! Definitely a repeat buyer of this one, which is rare for me!

reviews.product_name: Original Skin Matte Moisturizer with Willowherb
reviews.review_text: I loved this moisturizer! I received it complimentary as a free sample and the matte formula is perfect. I love the way it makes my skin feel and the scent is absolutely great! Highly recommend as a new product to try.

reviews.product_name: Original Skin Retexturizing Mask with Rose Clay
reviews.review_text: I love the rose clay component of this mask. I received it as a free sample and it has been very important in my skin routine. The formula feels great on my skin and leaves me feeling fresh

reviews.product_name: C-Rush Vitamin C Gel Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I liked this product a lot. The smell is really good and the gel applies really well on your face. Definitely a great mouisturizer and felt my skin was brighter after applying. Received complimentary via influenster.

reviews.product_name: Glow2OH Dark Spot Toner
reviews.review_text: I received this complimentary from influenster. I enjoyed this product. It’s a quality toner and feels good on my skin. Not too harsh compared to other toners

reviews.product_name: Magic Cream Moisturizer with Hyaluronic Acid
reviews.review_title: Very Fancy and a happy face too!
reviews.review_text: I received this moisturizer to try as a complimentary product from Influenster and I’m so thankful I got it because I’ve found a new favorite moisturizer! The cream is so silky soft and it has made my face feel so soft, even in the winter when my face usually gets so dried out! And I love the smell - it’s a faint flower/powder smell and makes me feel fancy when I put it on!

reviews.product_name: Skinlongevity Long Life Herb Anti-Aging Face Serum
reviews.review_text: I received the bareMinerals Skinlongevity Serum complimentary to try and it might be one of my favorite products I’ve ever tried. The serum is basically perfect for me. I love the light citrus smell of the serum. I love the way it feels when I rub it in. It’s not sticky; it feels lightweight and clean. And I can definitely tell my skin looks brighter, happier and any fine lines I have are reduced. It’s a truly great product.

reviews.product_name: Urban Environment Oil-Free Sunscreen Broad-Spectrum SPF 42
reviews.review_text: I LOVE Shiseido products. They can be found in all facets of my skin care routine. So when I got the opportunity to try their SPF for free I knew I wouldn’t be disappointed. It goes on smooth. It is  lightweight and doesn’t make your skin feel sticky. And for someone with a sun allergy its nice to not be itchy after a day in the sun!

reviews.product_name: Urban Environment Fresh-Moisture Sunscreen Broad-Spectrum SPF 42
reviews.review_text: I LOVE Shiseido products. They can be found in all facets of my skin care routine. So when I got the opportunity to try their SPF for free I knew I wouldn’t be disappointed. It goes on smooth. It is  lightweight and doesn’t make your skin feel sticky. And for someone with a sun allergy its nice to not be itchy after a day in the sun!

reviews.product_name: Lotus Anti-Aging Night Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: This product is AMAZING! I love the way it makes my skin feel when I wake up in the morning. I’ve only used it a few times now and am already noticing a difference. It feels softer and just looks all around healthier. It also smells so good! A very fresh (of course) smell!

reviews.product_name: Lotus Anti- Aging Daily Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: Wow wow wow, this moisturizer. I’m in love with this product. I have dry/oily skin and this does a great job not over or under hydrating. It smells so fresh and clean also! My skin feels so smooth and soft after using this. I highly recommend!

reviews.product_name: The Rice Wash Skin-Softening Cleanser
reviews.review_text: I received this product complimentary of Influenster for testing purposes. WOW!!! I seriously absolutely loved this face wash. It isn’t harsh or drying to the skin. It left my face feeling clean and smooth. I love to use it especially in my morning routine. I really liked how the entire product was created with Japanese culture in mind also. It was really cool to learn a little bit of history along with the added benefits of the ingredients. This will definitely be a product I’ll be keeping in my skincare line up. Also it is fragranced but only slightly - smells amazing. Couldn’t recommend more! I would also say I have combo skin and it worked perfectly for me - no over drying or over hydrating, just perfect!

reviews.product_name: GOOPGLOW Microderm Instant Glow Exfoliator
reviews.review_text: I received this product from Influenster to test and review. I don’t use this every day  just to avoid over exfoliating but I love using this every couple days just to reset and clear up the breakouts! I wouldn’t say I see a huge difference in my skin but it’s definitely smooth after using it!

reviews.review_text: I received this product from Influenster to review. This overnight repair cream is amazing!! I would highly recommend for anyone with dry skin or who needs to repair their moisture barrier. I don’t need to use it every night during the summer but I could see myself using this much more often in the winter. Great product overall!! Feels very high quality.

reviews.product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C
reviews.review_text: my holy grail lip mask & this one smells and tasted like sour gummy bears i love it. i use it every night & wake up with baby soft lips. i use it throughout the day as a lip balm too.

reviews.product_name: Hyaluronic Acid 2% + B5 Hydrating Serum
reviews.review_title: perfect addition to my skin-care routine!
reviews.review_text: i love it! makes my skin super plump and soft when i apply while skin is still wet then follow up with moisturizer & an occlusive for best results, also you cant beat the price & only need a couple drops at a time.

reviews.product_name: AHA 30% + BHA 2% Exfoliating Peeling Solution
reviews.review_text: i love this product it makes my skin SO SOFT after using it once a week.

reviews.product_name: The Rice Polish Foaming Enzyme Powder
reviews.review_text: It’s a bit abrasive on the skin & the ph is really high in this product, but it smells good & feels nice when applying it but it is quite stripping.

reviews.product_name: Mini Watermelon Pink Juice Oil-Free Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: wanted to like it but it broke me out. smells so yummy but not worth it for me.

reviews.product_name: Niacinamide 10% + Zinc 1% Oil Control Serum
reviews.review_text: This product is seriously amazing for my skin. I use a very small amount of pat it all over my skin and within a few days my skin clears up. It works so well. I can tell when I haven’t been using it because I get more breakouts.

reviews.product_name: Hyaluronic Acid 2% + B5 Hydrating Serum
reviews.review_text: Love this product. Love the dropper. I used it all up and decided to try Inky List next. I prefer the ordinary.

reviews.product_name: Watermelon Glow PHA + BHA Pore-Tight Toner
reviews.review_text: I tried this in a small size first and loved it. It’s gentle and moisturizing. It leaves my skin feeling nice. I love the formula, it’s thicker and easier to use.

reviews.product_name: Mini Watermelon Glow PHA + BHA Pore-Tight Toner
reviews.review_text: I tried this in a small size first and loved it. It’s gentle and moisturizing. It leaves my skin feeling nice. I love the formula, it’s thicker and easier to use.

reviews.product_name: The Dewy Skin Cream Plumping & Hydrating Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I first for this in the mini size and fell in love. It’s such a smooth formula and spreads beautifully. I’ve since purchased 2 of the large jars. Perfect for my dry-combo skin, doesn’t make me oily.

reviews.product_name: Hyaluronic Acid Hydrating Serum
reviews.review_text: I’m not overly excited about this product. It’s just okay. I prefer the Ordinary Hyaluronic acid.

reviews.product_name: Sugar Hydrating Lip Balm
reviews.review_text: A wonderful balm but definitely a strong caramel smell and taste so if you don’t like sweet, stay away. I put this on at night before bed for a little added moisture.

reviews.product_name: Hyaluronic Acid 2% + B5 Hydrating Serum
reviews.review_title: Easy step to add in for improving moisture
reviews.review_text: Love love love! This serum is great for helping to repair the moisture barrier and draw in moisture. It is helping me keep dry, flaky, winter skin at bay. I use it AM and PM after cleansing or masking. When I have problem skin, I will also add in The Ordinary’s Niacinamide and/or Salicylic Acid to the Hyaluronic Acid and apply all at once.To avoid any pilling, use less product. You probably only need two or three drops max! More than that and the product goes on too thick and doesn’t dry down properly.

reviews.product_name: Take The Day Off Cleansing Balm Makeup Remover
reviews.review_text: This stuff is a makeup removing game changer. No tugging, no dry or leftover residue. Just rub and rinse. The big tub lasts me nearly a year with almost daily use.

reviews.product_name: Mini Take The Day Off Cleansing Balm Makeup Remover
reviews.review_text: This stuff is a makeup removing game changer. No tugging, no dry or leftover residue. Just rub and rinse. The big tub lasts me nearly a year with almost daily use.

reviews.product_name: Cicapair Tiger Grass Color Correcting Treatment SPF 30
reviews.review_text: Love this for my redness. Helps around my nose and on my cheeks, where I’m prone to red patches and rosacea. Bought a small jar for my dad, who has terrible rosacea. He’s not into “skincare” but was impressed with how well this worked. Plus, I love that it gives him a little bit of sun protection. This applies easily, blends well, and is great to use with or without makeup.

reviews.product_name: Mini Cicapair Tiger Grass Color Correcting Treatment SPF 30
reviews.review_text: Love this for my redness. Helps around my nose and on my cheeks, where I’m prone to red patches and rosacea. Bought a small jar for my dad, who has terrible rosacea. reviews.product_name: Superfood Air-Whip Lightweight Moisturizer with Hyaluronic Acid
reviews.review_text: When I first got this it was really small, however it is a full 2 fl oz instead of 1.67 oz but it is air-whipped. It comes with a spatula, which is a very nice since it’s price. For me the product is actually worth it. It’s a lighter moisturizer that I use at night, and it does make my skin feel really good in the morning and soft, but it’s not the most hydrating if you use thicker creams. However if you do like a lighter moisturizer it is really good and I would repurchase this again when I run out.

reviews.product_name: Beste No. 9 Jelly Cleanser
reviews.review_text: The product reminds me exactly of the CosRx Good Morning Gel Cleanser which is so much cheaper and also gentler for you skin and removes makeup better. It isn’t advertised for that but it takes it off really well and better than this :(

reviews.product_name: Glow2OH Dark Spot Toner
reviews.review_text: I really enjoyed this toner that this is the main way I use to exfoliate my face. I’ve tried a lot of toners like this and have seen my most results and smoothness in texture of my skin. However, I would get a sample of smaller version if your skin has been exposed to a lot of acids before. Otherwise, loved this and favorite exfoliating toner ;)

reviews.product_name: AHA 30% + BHA 2% Exfoliating Peeling Solution
reviews.review_text: It’s super cheap and act shows results. At first using it, I did think it was dining anything or really help my skin other than mild smoothness of my skin but I kept using it and the texture of my skin is so smooth and with my normal skincare has now become softer but also what I love most is my hyperpigmentation is disappearing and mild skin texture plus pimples on my face. Def don’t leave in too long and can be strong but amazing results

reviews.product_name: Brighten-i Eye Cream
reviews.review_text: Bought for the cooling metal tip but product is very thin and has no effects. Separates easily in tube and doesn’t create a barrier enough to protect from water loss and works better for like light light morning eye cream

reviews.product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C
reviews.review_text: I got the original berry and I put it on every night and it’s helped repair my damaged lips from an allergic reaction I had but I’ve been using it for about two years now. Advice I’d have though is not to over apply at night cause you’ll definitely feel it unless you want that over pout effect. Containers lasted a long time and actually worth the hype especially even for being a lip balm. It’s not gonna change your life like that but it is a really good lip balm and gel texture.

reviews.product_name: Lippe Balm
reviews.review_text: Love this .I am going through 1 per month and just received a new one and it seems they made it larger . There is nothing like this for lips in my opinion !

reviews.product_name: B-Hydra Intensive Hydration Serum with Hyaluronic Acid
reviews.review_text: Really like  this combined with the Vitamin C .Gives me a glowing look .

reviews.product_name: T.L.C. Framboos Glycolic Resurfacing Night Serum
reviews.review_text: I really like this but I  had problems initially with over exfoliating. I was using it every night and broke out . I have very dry skin and am 63 so it was too much .I now use it 2-3 times a week and it is perfect . For those of you with dry skin don’t over do

reviews.product_name: D-Bronzi Anti-Pollution Bronzing Drops with Peptides
reviews.review_text: I really like it . I like how it goes on and I don’t have to wear foundation . It’s a natural look .

reviews.product_name: Protini Polypeptide Firming Refillable Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: Seems to sit on top of my skin . Doesn’t moisturize at all and when I wake up my skin is bone dry . I don’t mind spending the money on a great product but this is not a great product . I hope it works well for other people . I like LaLa Retro a bit better . I won’t be repurchasing .I even use it with their beautiful oil and still nada !

reviews.product_name: GOOPGLOW Microderm Instant Glow Exfoliator
reviews.review_text: I received GOOPGLOW Microderm Instant Glow Exfoliator complimentary from Goop in exchange for testing and review. This stuff is like magic in a jar! My skin has never been so smooth, soft and radiant! It literally is glowing. I like in the Midwest so Winters here are harsh on the skin, worse for people who already have sensitive dry skin. After the first time of using GoopGlow my skin felt like I had just left a high end spa and received a professional facial. I love using it before going to bed at night, it detoxes my skin and gets me ready for the next day. I haven’t had a break out or dry patches since I started using this. I’m not sure how I lived my life to this point without it, but I will never go without it again. I absolutely love this product!!!

reviews.product_name: Daily Greens Oil-Free Gel Moisturizer with Moringa and Papaya
reviews.review_text: This Daily Greens oil-free gel moisturizer is absolutely perfect for my oily/dry combination skin. It works magic in the areas that are dry, but doesn’t create extra oil in the areas that I get oily. I actually think it gives me an even moisture throughout my entire face. I love the scent, it’s so refreshing! I use it both morning and night. I’m not sure I can live without this product!! It’s definitely my new favorite!!I received this product complimentary from Farmacy Beauty. #greensforall @farmacybeauty

reviews.product_name: Barrier+ Triple Lipid-Peptide Face Cream
reviews.review_text: I received this Better + Triple lipid peptide cream gifted by skinfix in exchange for an honest review. I couldn’t be more please with this cream as my fall dry skin is now replenished and youthful looking. Its made of quality ingredients and although it’s very creamy, I don’t feel weighed down and have had no breakouts. I now get compliments on my glowing skin! Love it!!

reviews.product_name: Mini Barrier+ Triple Lipid-Peptide Face Cream
reviews.review_text: I received this Better + Triple lipid peptide cream gifted by skinfix in exchange for an honest review. I couldn’t be more please with this cream as my fall dry skin is now replenished and youthful looking. Its made of quality ingredients and although it’s very creamy, I don’t feel weighed down and have had no breakouts. I now get compliments on my glowing skin! Love it!!

reviews.product_name: Good Genes All-In-One AHA Lactic Acid Treatment
reviews.review_text: I received Sunday Riley Good Genes was gifted by Sunday Riley in exchange for an honest review . I absolutely fell in love with this cream right away. I knew after the first application I would be happy with the product. Within the first 2 days I could see an increase in the clarity of my skin and reduction in the size of my wrinkles. May face is moisturized and full body life. I absolutely love this stuff.

reviews.product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C
reviews.review_text: Received this as a free sample and pleasantly surprised! Even though it leaves a dry finish on the lips by the morning it does add plumpness and has a softening effect. A thin layer is enough and a little goes a long way! I liked it more compared to other lip treatments that I’ve tried, such as Clinique’s All About Lips.

reviews.product_name: Lotus Anti-Aging Night Moisturizer
reviews.review_title: great cream but pls cut down on fragrance
reviews.review_text: I really love how nourishing this cream is for my skin! I have combination skin and it strikes a perfect balance without ever feeling excessive. I just wish the fragrance wasn’t as strong. Also, as with other Fresh creams, jar packaging exposes product to air...Not sure why they’re keeping it that way.

reviews.product_name: Honey Halo Ultra-Hydrating Ceramide Moisturizer
reviews.review_title: recommend, few things to keep in mind...
reviews.review_text: I should start by saying that my skin is combination acne prone, so I don’t usually buy heavy moisturizers. This winter I needed something more substantial to follow up a lactic acid cleanser and another daily exfoliant as my skin was becoming flakey and had frequent reactionary breakouts. This has worked great and has been replenishing. My skin has recovered and I’m even noticing some improvement on discolouration due to acne scars. This being told I can see why other reviews mention it’s not hydrating enough - it’s feels more buttery. I’m applying a toner (spray) before and it helps locks in moisture and feels balanced. Would purchase again and also curious about trying out the lighter version of it available on the Farmacy moisturizers line.

reviews.product_name: 100% Organic Cold-Pressed Rose Hip Seed Oil
reviews.review_text: This little bottle seems to last forever. I ended up not using it as intended, as part of my daily moisturizing routine, as it turned out to be a little heavy for me and caused me to breakout. But it made a great inexpensive eye serum - no problems at all there, in fact super happy with that application.

reviews.product_name: The Rice Wash Skin-Softening Cleanser
reviews.review_text: I really like this cleanser. It has a nice subtle smell and a little goes a long way. It’s very gentle on the skin and I didn’t break out when I used it.I recently got this product from the trend-mood box.

reviews.product_name: Mini Rice Wash Skin-Softening Cleanser
reviews.review_text: I really like this cleanser. It has a nice subtle smell and a little goes a long way. It’s very gentle on the skin and I didn’t break out when I used it.I recently got this product from the trend-mood box.

reviews.product_name: Luminous Dewy Skin Mist
reviews.review_text: have combination skin so I don’t typically purchase dewy products but decided to try this. If you have really oily skin this might not be good for you but for me it left my face looking nice and glowy. I was surprised it worked out for me.I recently purchased this from trend-mood box.

reviews.product_name: The Serum Stick: Treatment & Touch Up Balm
reviews.review_text: I really like this serum. It sinks into the skin right away. I’ve used it on its own and over makeup when I have a few dry patches. You still need to apply moisturizer but it layers nicely with other products.I recently purchased this from trend-mood box.

reviews.product_name: Dreamskin Skin Perfector
reviews.review_text: I received this from Influenster for my Honest review. I’ve been using this for a few days now usually in the morning after moisturizer before sunscreen. The smell is amazing and it works well with other products. I do have a few acne scars on my face and haven’t noticed a difference, but I might need to try this longer to see results. However, it leaves a really nice glow on my face and I enjoy using this. Took 1 star off because I haven’t seen a reduction in my dark spots.

reviews.product_name: Protini Polypeptide Firming Refillable Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: Seriously love this product!! I’ve been searching for a good moisturizer for such a long time and came across this. I was debating at first to get it or not due to the high price but I’m so glad I did! No regrets! This moisturizer has such a unique texture, it feels like silk when you spread it on your face and this best thing about it is all the benefits it gives and also it’s silicon-free, which i’m all in for. Products with a lot of silicon in it usually breaks me out for some reason so I’m glad DE doesn’t have silicon in any of their products. =) I use this moisturizer day and night. I have oily skin and it’s really light weight, sinks in so well and leave no greasy residue! Will repurchase again.

reviews.product_name: B-Hydra Intensive Hydration Serum with Hyaluronic Acid
reviews.review_text: I really enjoy this product from DE now that I know how to really use it. This is not a moisturizer, it’s more of a serum/essence type product. So, you’ll need to lock it in with some type of oil or a moisturizer or it’ll evaporate throughout the day/night. How I Iove to use this is to add 1-2 pumps into my TLC Framboos (night) and also the C-firma (morning) and it just makes the serums glide on my face so smoothly and also add an extra shot of hydration. =) Will keep repurchasing!

reviews.product_name: Virgin Marula Luxury Face Oil
reviews.review_text: This oil is literally a luxury. I love this oil as a mixer to my other DE products, I usually mix 1-2 drops of oil unto my Protini at night for extra moisture and also 1 drop in the morning unto my Umbra Sunscreen, it just makes it glides on so easily. I haven’t used this by itself yet, so I got no opinions on that but I really enjoy mixing this oil with other skincare products. I have oily/acne-prone skin, this has not broken me out! yay! =) Will repurchase!

reviews.product_name: D-Bronzi Anti-Pollution Bronzing Drops with Peptides
reviews.review_text: I seriously love this stuff, It gives such a nice bronzy summery glow to the skin! I don’t wear foundation at all and this just gives the perfect flush of color. I mix 1 pump of D-Bronzi to Umbra and I also add 1 drop of murula oil for extra moisture, the best combination ever! DE has exceeded my expectations with all their products. =)

reviews.product_name: Superfood Antioxidant Cleanser
reviews.review_text: Love this cleanser! I swear my skin has never felt so good after using this and their moisturizer. I have acne prone, combination skin, so it’s hard to find a balanced wash without drying out my face. This doesn’t make me feel super dry and my skins feels so good!

reviews.product_name: Mini Superfood Antioxidant Cleanser
reviews.review_text: Love this cleanser! I swear my skin has never felt so good after using this and their moisturizer. I have acne prone, combination skin, so it’s hard to find a balanced wash without drying out my face. This doesn’t make me feel super dry and my skins feels so good!

reviews.product_name: Superfood Air-Whip Lightweight Moisturizer with Hyaluronic Acid
reviews.review_text: This is the best moisturizer for my acne prone, combination skin! It’s the perfect amount of moisture with out making me extra oily throughout the day! My skin has never felt or looked better since I started using this in combination with their cleanser.

reviews.product_name: Superberry Hydrate + Glow Dream Oil
reviews.review_text: I love this brand so when this came out I knew it would be a winner! It’s not sticky or super oily and it it absorbs really well! I have a really oily t-zone so I did have some concerns that it would peek through my foundation throughout the day, but it just gave my a really nice glow! Definitely give it a try!

reviews.product_name: Adaptogen Deep Moisturizing Cream with Ashwagandha + Reishi
reviews.review_text: I’m so glad they came out with this! I have been a long time wearer of their Kale and Spinach cream, but have always wanted something with a bit more moisture for night time. Well my cries have been heard! Still light weight, but super hydrating! My skin feels great when I wake up and have noticed my skin isn’t as dull since I started using this product. I always struggle to find that balance between enough moisture and too much moisture (pores clog very easily), have definitely found it with the mushrooms!

reviews.product_name: Mini Adaptogen Deep Moisture Cream with Ashwagandha + Reishi

reviews.product_name: 100% Organic Cold-Pressed Rose Hip Seed Oil
reviews.review_text: It’s a very good oil specially for this price! I like to use it after a few days of using my retinol cream.

reviews.product_name: AHA 30% + BHA 2% Exfoliating Peeling Solution
reviews.review_title: It’s ok for someones first facial peel use
reviews.review_text: I finished one bottle. Calms the breakouts a little bit, doesn’t cause pealing on my skin, probably because i’m used to stronger acids. I was expecting something a little stronger because of so many good reviews

reviews.product_name: Sugar Advanced Lip Balm Intense Hydration Treatment
reviews.review_text: I don’t know how this balm has so many 5 stars. It didn’t do anything for my lips. It is just like any regular lip balms but 3 times more expensive.

reviews.product_name: Squalane + Omega Repair Deep Hydration Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: Amazing texture and good hudration! Love how fast it absorbs. It was the only cream that didn’t burn my skin after using retinol for a few days. It really feels “clean”.

reviews.product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C
reviews.review_text: Better than most of the other lip balm type of products that i have used before. I use it every night and sometimes during the day too. It feels little sticky when i apply it but after that i don’t feel anything during the day. Pretty hydrating and long lasting product.

reviews.product_name: Daily UV Defense Invisible Broad Spectrum SPF 36 Sunscreen
reviews.review_text: I love it! It’s not white, not greasy, not sticky. I have dry skin and i apply it over any of my face creams and it absorbs really fast, can’t feel i have something “extra” on my face. Good price also and it’s a clean product.

reviews.product_name: Blue Tansy BHA and Enzyme Pore Refining Mask
reviews.review_text: As other reviewers have said, it expires after 2-3 months. Mine became green also! Such an expensive product should last longer.

reviews.product_name: Crème de la Mer Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I absolutely love this cream, my face feels so moist! When I learned I had to apply it tapping after rubbing in my hands, and not rubbing it my face, it was a game changer! It absorbs better and I feel fresh for longer. This was gifted by La Mer.

reviews.product_name: Mini Crème de la Mer Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I absolutely love this cream, my face feels so moist! When I learned I had to apply it tapping after rubbing in my hands, and not rubbing it my face, it was a game changer! It absorbs better and I feel fresh for longer. This was gifted by La Mer.

reviews.review_text: For some reason, when I came back to look for my review of this product, I couldn’t find it.In my initial review, I wrote that this made my skin slightly irritated/itchy upon use and therefore I couldn’t justify the price even though I did think it was a pretty nice moisturizer (I liked the cream to water aspect a lot).Currently after around 2-3 weeks, there is barely any irritation upon use. That being said, I have learned that this product contains fragrances, which in general are not good for the skin. Even so, I do find it nice and cooling and like it much more now that it doesn’t make my my skin feel as irritated. I will definitely continue using it until it’s empty. But, the fragrance thing and initial irritation still bother me, so I’m unsure if I will be repurchasing this (in addition, it’s quite pricey). Due to above reasons along with the high price point, I also cannot in good conscience recommend this to anyone, though I am okay with using it on my own skin despite it having fragrance.

reviews.review_title: Nice but smells kinda medicinal to me
reviews.review_text: I’ve used this a few times now. I like it better than the laneige lip mask that everyone raves about. I especially like the wide packaging, it makes it easy to use my fingers with my slightly long nails (not very long, but long enough to make potted items a bit of a pain sometimes). It’s pretty moisturizing for my chronically dry and chapped lips, but after it fades my lips still feel a little dry, but not as much as usual so I do think it works well enough for me as most lip balms I’ve tried actually tend to make my lips feel drier afterwards. I took a point off because I find it a little medicinal smelling/tasting. It’s not too bad once you get used to it, but it gives me a slight headache. I’m thinking of maybe purchasing another flavor, since it might just be the watermelon one?

reviews.product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C
reviews.review_title: Great Formula, Smells Like Maple Syrup
reviews.review_text: So I’ve recently rediscovered these. I originally had the Berry flavor, but because I hated the smell so much, I only used it a few times before abandoning it. Then I saw some of these new released holiday flavors. I actually wanted to order peppermint as well, but sadly that was sold out. So I got gingersnap. I couldn’t remember how I felt, so I started using the Berry flavor again in the meantime, before this arrived. The formula was actually way better than I remembered, it works super well at keeping my lips soft and doesn’t dry them out even after it fades a little. That being said, I really still dislike the Berry flavor. It’s very medicinal to me. So I was really looking forward to gingersnap. Sadly, gingersnap does not at all smell like gingersnaps. It’s got none of that spicy smell. It’s very sweet, and like a review I read on this flavor earlier, smells very much like maple syrup. Because of that, I deduct a point (or half a point really). The smell isn’t terrible, just not gingersnap. It’s vaguely reminiscent of fresh’s caramel balm smell I think. So far from the couple of times I’ve tried it, the formula is pretty much the same! Big fan. I hope they release more scents though. I would love to see Peach Tea rereleased, since right now only Vanilla appeals to me from what’s available.

reviews.product_name: Blue Tansy BHA and Enzyme Pore Refining Mask
reviews.review_text: Typically I have oily/combo skin, but lately I have been having extremely horrible breakouts as well as a lot of redness. I heard this was good to reduce breakouts as well as calm the skin so I tried this out. Here are my thoughts: 1. Love the smell (smells like blueberries to me) 2. Gave my skin a cooling sensation while it was on. 3. Calmed my skin (reduced redness, breakouts were slightly less irritated and did not dry out my skin). The only downside I see is that since this mask is pretty much all natural it does tend to expire quite quickly. I will say it does start turning a sort of greenish color after a few weeks upon opening. I am not sure if that is just because it is exposed to oxygen or what. However, I have continued to use it and it works just the same. Just something to keep in mind. Also since it does not last as long as other face masks that are not all natural, it is quite pricey in my opinion. I wish they would sell a mini sized.

I think if maybe you had more normal skin or sensitive skin this would be the perfect product for you. But this doesn’t deep cleanse my pores enough for me to be wowed and repurchase. They should re-name this from Deep Cleanse to Gentle Cleanse.

I was hoping this product would not cause me to break out but it did. Just use with caution if you have skin that is sensitive to products and breaks out from them like me.

reviews.product_name: Jet Lag Mask
reviews.review_text: So I have oily/combo skin but for some reason had been having extremely dry skin the pas two weeks. I am talking about to the point where my skin is peeling all over. I tried a little packet of this that I received as a sample and OMG I love it. I smeared it all over and a little bit of a thick layer just because I was so dry and I left it on for 12 minutes. I damped a wash cloth and ever so slightly gently wiped any excess off my skin. It left we with very moisturized and glowy skin but it didn’t feel like it was clogging my pores. I later used my other packet the next week and still amazing results. No breakouts either which is AMAZING for me because I def have acne prone skin. I also recommend putting this under your eyes if you have dry under eyes as well as it works wonders! Highly highly recommend!

reviews.review_text: i haven’t tried these dots on top of a “un popped“ pimple yet because i was told they work best after you pop a pimple and they do! after you pop anything on your face you want to seal it anyways to avoid additional bacteria. this does just that while pulling any other gunk to the surface of the dot. and after you remove it, the pimple it completely flat, clean, and healed!!!

reviews.review_text: Absolutely love this. I got a free sample with a Sephora order and immediately bought the full size. Bought this months ago and I’m barely half way through the tub, and again I use it every night!

reviews.product_name: Ultra Repair Cream Intense Hydration
reviews.review_text: Seriously, buy the big one. You won’t regret it. I cannot get enough of this moisturizer. I would buy this by the barrel if I could. I’ve been using this as a daily moisturizer for years now. I use it on my face and body. For my face I typically just use it at night as it is a heavier moisturizer and use FAB’s face specific moisturizer in the morning. But on days I think I really need the extra hydration I’ll use it in the morning as well. My skin is incredibly sensitive and this not only moisturizes, sinks in fast, and wears well under makeup...it also calms my skin after iritation! Weather it’s a new skin care product that burns, new laundry soap that itches, dry hands from hospital sanitizers, or an allergic reaction, I know this moisturizer will calm and soothe my skin.

reviews.product_name: Pure Skin Face Cleanser
reviews.review_text: Wonderful gentle daily cleanser. My skin never feels dry or stripped after using, however, it cleans everything off your skin no problem. Even my eye makeup. It’s the only cleanser I’ve used for years now and I have no plans to change anytime soon.

reviews.product_name: Hello FAB Coconut Skin Smoothie Priming Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: This is a wonderful luminizing moisturizer.  I use this on my no makeup days because it makes my skin look smoother and gives me a subtle sexy glow. Only giving 4 stars because it’s a terrible primer, haha. It pills under makeup. I wanted to like it so badly as a primer I tried it several different times with several different products.

reviews.product_name: GENIUS Sleeping Collagen Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I have really dry skin and struggle with finding an anti-aging cream that also addresses my winter skin issues. This is a thick cream but it absorbs immediately without a greasy feeling. I also have sensitive skin and no issues.

reviews.product_name: Ultimate Sun Protector Lotion SPF 50+ Sunscreen
reviews.review_text: Love love love this sunscreen! It doesn’t seem like sunscreen at all, there’s no horrible smell or white cast. It actually feels more like a light moisturizer and gives you a subtle glow. It spreads easily and I would 100% buy again

reviews.product_name: Clear Sunscreen Stick SPF 50+
reviews.review_title: great on the go sunscreen option
reviews.review_text: Lightweight, not greasy and easy to apply. The packaging is also perfect for on the go - I suggest keeping it in your purse to reapply throughout the day.

reviews.product_name: Dewtopia 20% Acid Night Treatment
reviews.review_text: I love this for weekly use. It helps with texture and gives you a nice glow in the morning. Goes on smooth and can be used under regular moisturizer.

reviews.product_name: Sugar Hydrating Lip Balm
reviews.review_text: Ive always loved their lip products, but this one trumps them all! It is my favorite lip balm right now. I use it at night before i go to bed and while I’m getting ready (putting makeup on) so that my lips are soft and ready for whatever other lip product I want to wear for the day! I wish the smell was more like caramel and less “lemony“, but the performance outshines the smell.

reviews.product_name: Moisturizing Eye Bomb with Squalane
reviews.review_text: My newest fave! A little goes a long way. This cream is so refreshing and literally lasts all day. I have allergies year round and am always rubbing and irritating the skin around my eyes. This cream brought life back to my skin. Makeup applies nicely over it and it doesn’t seem to crease, move, or anything else weird that some creams can make foundation and concealer do. I enjoyed this and the facial cream that came with it so much that I bought the full sizes and travel kit so I can have them when I go on my next trip. I received this product complimentary for sampling purposes.

reviews.product_name: Aqua Bomb Hydrating Toner
reviews.review_text: This was super hydrating and refreshing with my morning routine. I do think it helped hydrate. I didn’t get the right skin feeling I normally would. The only thing I didn’t like was that it seemed like it made my breakouts on my chin worse or made me breakout.

reviews.product_name: The Serum Stick: Treatment & Touch Up Balm
reviews.review_text: Love it! I received this via Influenster and I use it almost every day now. I use it under my eyes and anywhere I else I feel dry. I use it before my moisturizer, but I can say that in this winter weather my skin has never been dry in the places it normally is - under my eyes, around my nose, forehead, and around my mouth. The price is hefty but a little goes a long way. I don’t have any problems with it dragging, as heat from your face, hand, mouth warms it up fast so it glides effortlessly.

reviews.product_name: 5 Stars Retinol + Niacinamide Eye Serum
reviews.review_text: I received this product as a gift and love it! I am a huge fan of the brand, after a week of use, I can notice my dark circles have improved when I wake up after I use them at night. I also love the tube and applicator how it allows you to spread the product without touching the product itself.

reviews.product_name: Floral Recovery Overnight Mask with Squalane
reviews.review_text: Love this mask, it is very refreshing and makes my skin feel clean and calm! It has a pleasant smell and I like to use it as an overnight mask for extra hydration and a deep clean! One of my fave brands it this will last a long time

reviews.product_name: Watermelon Glow Niacinamide Sunscreen SPF 50
reviews.review_text: Love this SPF! It feels like a nice hydrating serum that sits really nice under my make up every day. There does have a slight smell to it but it doesn’t bother me too much - feel like this would last a long time!

reviews.product_name: Tea Elixir Niacinamide & Hyaluronic Acid Anti-Aging Serum
reviews.review_text: Love this serum! First off, this is a very large jar with lots of product in it and I like the dropper, it works well and is easy to use. I have been using this for over a week and feel like my texture and redness have gone away,

reviews.product_name: Cicapair Tiger Grass Cream
reviews.review_title: This cream is a dream for cystic acne!
reviews.review_text: This product should have 5 stars from every review! I’m currently 31 years old and have battled cystic acne since I was 14. It has gotten a lot better through proper skincare that I have found over the years that works for me. With that being said, I still have cysts deep under the skin come up from time to time. Recently I had a few stressors in my life which will almost always cause a breakout. On a Monday morning I felt a cyst forming deep under the skin on my chin and it was swollen and very sore. The total size would have been like the size of a coin dollar (like double the circumfrenece of a quarter). It hurt! I immediately started applying the cream that morning and wore it under my makeup. I continued this cycle for 7 full days using the ointment morning and night. Anyone who has had cystic acne before knows when one starts that deep you have a few weeks ahead of you battling that one cyst. I can seriously say in 7 full days the cyst shrunk dramatically (more than 50% in 24 hours). The cream also brought it to the surface way faster than if I had let it form on it’s own. I’ve tried spot treatments in the past that are super drying that only make it worse in my opinion. This cream is seriously a dream! I will use this on every breakout I have from now on. I use the cream at the end of my normal skincare so on top of my moisturizer and I just use it on the spots that need it. I would have had to battle this for a minimum of 4 weeks without this cream and instead I was able to decrease the length of time with this cream to 7 full days. That to me is incredible! Also bc of the healing properties of the cream, I highly doubt there will be any scarring. If there is it will be very very minimal. If you struggle with breakouts I highly recommend this! I did not use any other acne treatment during this time. Only my normal skincare and this at the end.

reviews.product_name: Original Skin Retexturizing Mask with Rose Clay
reviews.review_title: Buy it now! You won't regret it!
reviews.review_text: This product is truly AMAZING! I received a sample in my August Sephora Play box and could not be any more pleased with how well it worked. I’m 31 with sensitive, acne prone skin (cystic acne). I have to be careful about what I use in my skincare routine. I try to keep it as natural as possible...but I wear makeup to work daily. This product delivered incredible results after only 1 use. I will use this twice a week in my standard skincare routine moving forward. I first cleansed my face. Then I let it dry fully. Next I applied the mask. I do not like floral scents really but this did not smell of roses to me. It smelled more like grapefruit. I let it sit for 12 minutes (forgot to set my timer) and wet the mask to scrub away impurities. Next I applied my serum and moisturizers for the night. I would recommend using at night so your skin can truly soak up all the skin benefits of this mask. It worked some serious magic! It removed all of my dead skin. This morning I also noticed it reduced the SIZE and REDNESS of two cystic pimples I had on my face. This product is a must try!

reviews.product_name: The Silk Peony Melting Eye Cream
reviews.review_title: Provides great hydration for the eye area!
reviews.review_text: I’ve been using this eye cream for right at 7 days now and have done both nighttime and daytime. Here are my thoughts:Daytime use: I’ve worn it during the day with and without makeup. It works great under makeup and does not make my makeup separate at all! When I wear it alone there is no oily look to the area either. Nighttime use: I used a little too much my first time trying the product and I could feel it sitting on my skin. Use a light hand to pickup the product and apply. IT TRULY DOES FEEL LIKE SINK ON YOUR SKIN! I love the way it glides on and doesn’t look oily at all. Also, I have very sensitive skin and this product caused ZERO reactions or breakouts. My last thought on the product is around the amount of product for the price. I honestly think that the one jar will last an entire year! The packaging is also beautiful!I received this product as a free sample to form my honest opinion.

reviews.product_name: Papaya Sorbet Smoothing Enzyme Cleansing Balm & Makeup Remover
reviews.review_text: I have to say I am a fan of this product. Most cleansing balms turn oily once they start to melt which I also like. This product is much different. It almost feels like it is moisturizing while you are breaking down your makeup. It still breaks down your makeup too! The smell is light and subtle but also fresh. The only downfall would have to be my eye makeup. I have very sensitive eyes with any eye and all makeup removers and this one proves to be no different. Other than that I am a fan! Worth a try! I recieved this product for testing purposes. All opinions are my own.

reviews.product_name: Jet Lag Mask
reviews.review_text: This product was gifted by Summer Fridays. The product came out smooth with a nice amount of thickness. It went on evenly. My skin felt firm and hydrated afterward. It was better than other masks I have tried. I am going to incorporate this into my weekly skin care routine.

reviews.product_name: Mini Jet Lag Mask
reviews.review_text: This product was gifted by Summer Fridays. The product came out smooth with a nice amount of thickness. It went on evenly. My skin felt firm and hydrated afterward. It was better than other masks I have tried. I am going to incorporate this into my weekly skin care routine.

reviews.product_name: Glowscreen Sunscreen SPF 40 PA+++ with Hyaluronic Acid + Niacinamide
reviews.review_text: I love super goop and this was no disappointment. It felt nice on my skin and absorbed well. I liked the shiny glow it gave to my skin. As someone who doesn’t wear makeup it was a nice touch of shimmer and shine I don’t normally have. Some fun sun protection.

reviews.product_name: Tea Elixir Niacinamide & Hyaluronic Acid Anti-Aging Serum
reviews.review_text: I am really enjoying the serum. It has a very smooth clean texture and it absorbs really fast. After it’s absorbed my skin feels soft and smooth right away with no residue or stickiness. And fit perfectly into my daily routine and I’m already seeing results

reviews.product_name: Retinol Youth Renewal Serum
reviews.review_text: I am loving this new retinol. It is working fast and my skin is not red or irritated. I like that it has a thicker texture and it smooths in nicely. I feel like some of my forehead lines are starting to be less noticeable which is amazing.

reviews.product_name: Mini Retinol Youth Renewal Serum
reviews.review_text: I am loving this new retinol. It is working fast and my skin is not red or irritated. I like that it has a thicker texture and it smooths in nicely. I feel like some of my forehead lines are starting to be less noticeable which is amazing.

reviews.product_name: T.L.C. Framboos Glycolic Resurfacing Night Serum
reviews.review_text: I’ve been using this the past week and it’s not terrible, but I don’t think it’s done anything really. Easy to use, soaks into my skin well, and no scent. I will keep using this until I finish the bottle. It’s pretty expensive so I expect to see results.

reviews.product_name: Beste No. 9 Jelly Cleanser
reviews.review_text: I’ve used a lot of cleansers over the years and this is a pretty good one. I do think it’s too expensive and you can get something else and save your money (like purpose). You only have to use a little bit and it works pretty well. I would recommend for people who love this brand.

reviews.product_name: Lala Retro Whipped Refillable Moisturizer with Ceramides
reviews.review_text: This is a great brand that I really like. It’s a nice moisturizer but I don’t think it’s enough for night time. I like something thicker. No scent and soaks in well.

reviews.product_name: Lippe Balm
reviews.review_text: So this is a good brand and it’s a cute little package. I do not feel like the balm is thick enough and doesn’t last too long on my lips. It’s convenient to carry with me, but I would not recommend this to people to use alone on your lips. You could use this first and then apply a lipstick.

reviews.product_name: C-Tango Vitamin C Eye Cream
reviews.review_text: So I’ve used two other brands similar to this and I might like this the best. I like that you can open and close the container and even travel with it while not worrying about losing product. Nice consistency for under eyes and I didn’t notice a scent. I’d recommend this to my friends. Of course this brand is pricey.

reviews.product_name: Benefiance Wrinkle Smoothing Eye Cream
reviews.review_title: New eye cream for aging eyes
reviews.review_text: Lately I’ve noticed that the skin around my eyes is dry and wrinkly. I’ve tried lots of different eye creams. Some make my skin red and burn. This is the first time using a Shiseido product and it’s been nice. A little goes a long way and I can tell there’s still product on my face in the morning. I also have dry eyelids and I’ve been putting a dot of cream on them too. It totally got rid of the dry flakey eyelid skin. Very moisturizing but not life altering. But maybe nothing is going to make me look 20 again. I’d recommend this to people. Little to no scent.

reviews.product_name: The Essence Skincare Boosting Treatment
reviews.review_text: I’ve used This brand of products before but this was completely new to me. This is almost a water type consistency and it is clear. You pour a little out onto your palm and then press it into your face. Reminds me of a dermalogica hydrating booster product. No scent, no reactions noted, and seemed to absorb into my skin quickly. Did I see any results? Idk. It certainly didn’t make things worse. Would I purchase this? Possibly if I can get it on sale…even though it’s a small bottle it does last a long time. You don’t need much. Good product and good brand! Give it a try!

reviews.product_name: Mini The Essence  Skincare Boosting Treatment
reviews.review_text: I’ve used This brand of products before but this was completely new to me. This is almost a water type consistency and it is clear. You pour a little out onto your palm and then press it into your face. Reminds me of a dermalogica hydrating booster product. No scent, no reactions noted, and seemed to absorb into my skin quickly. You don’t need much. Good product and good brand! Give it a try!

reviews.product_name: Revitalizing Supreme+ Youth Power Creme Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I received a trial size of this product free from Influenster in exchange for my honest review. I’ve used it up and I love it! I have oily skin and I normally find moisturizers too oily for me. This cream is not greasy yet keeps my skin hydrated. For those who have dry skins, please be general with the amount of use, it could dry out a bit if you have super dry skin. I did see my skin brighter after using it for about a week, surprised!

reviews.product_name: Mini Revitalizing Supreme+ Youth Power Creme Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I received a trial size of this product free from Influenster in exchange for my honest review. I’ve used it up and I love it! I have oily skin and I normally find moisturizers too oily for me. This cream is not greasy yet keeps my skin hydrated. For those who have dry skins, please be general with the amount of use, it could dry out a bit if you have super dry skin. I did see my skin brighter after using it for about a week, surprised!

reviews.product_name: Santorini Grape Poreless Skin Cream
reviews.review_text: I received a trial size from Influenster and Korres in exchange for my honest review. I have oily skin and large pores on my nose, as well as some around the nose area. I’ve been using this cream for almost 2 weeks and I’ve seen some differences. I like that it’s very lightweight, which is my top priority when it comes to a day cream. I used it only in my day routine and it worked fine. It smoothed my skin and I see my large pores were shrunk just after about 3-4 days of use. I’m glad they put both salicylic acid and hyaluronic acid in one product, keeping your skin hydrated while preventing the possible dryness and harshness of salicylic acid.

reviews.product_name: Vinoperfect Radiance Dark Spot Serum Vitamin C Alternative
reviews.review_text: I received this #freeproduct from #trywithtopbox in exchange for my honest review.It keeps my skin hydrated. I have oily skin, this serum feels sticky on my face. It takes some time to absorb. Just don’t use too much product, a few drops should be fine. Dark spots are stubborn and it may take much longer time than one bottle’s use. I used it twice a day, with spf 30 in the day, for 3 weeks but haven’t seen it doing much about my dark spots. and I’ll keep using it up.

reviews.product_name: Vinopure Natural Salicylic Acid Pore Minimizing Serum
reviews.review_text: I receive a #freeproduct from topbox in exchange for my honest review. I have oily skin and have suffered from large pore problems for many years. I used it only at night to avoid irritation. After using it for almost a week, I was able to see my pores near the nose area shrunk and my blackheads and I have fewer blackheads than before. The salicylic acid is working! It’s lightweight and it absorbed fast. I’d recommend it to those who have acne or pore problems.

reviews.product_name: Revitalizing Supreme+ Youth Power Creme Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: This is a luxurious creme with a gel cream texture. It applies to the skin so smoothly and I felt a cooling effect. After applying the cream, my skin looks so dewy. I do noticed that it help minimize my fine lines around the check area since that area is on the drier side. The formula is great for people with dry skin. It is not oily but a little sticky on the skin. It does contain fragrance, but it did not irradiate my rosacea.

reviews.product_name: Mini Revitalizing Supreme+ Youth Power Creme Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: This is a luxurious creme with a gel cream texture. It applies to the skin so smoothly and I felt a cooling effect. After applying the cream, my skin looks so dewy. I do noticed that it help minimize my fine lines around the check area since that area is on the drier side. The formula is great for people with dry skin. It is not oily but a little sticky on the skin. It does contain fragrance, but it did not irradiate my rosacea.

reviews.product_name: Mini Daily Microfoliant Exfoliator
reviews.review_text: Really enjoyed using a powder cleanser. It’s easy to travel with and easy to clean if spilled. The exfoliating powder lathered well, and a little goes a long way. It is definitely gentle enough for daily use as it is not drying to skin. I have use this for a week, do notice my skin is a little bit brighter. I have dry and dehydrated skin, the cleanser did not cause any issue so I definitely recommend this.

reviews.product_name: Daily Microfoliant Exfoliator
reviews.review_text: Really enjoyed using a powder cleanser. It’s easy to travel with and easy to clean if spilled. The exfoliating powder lathered well, and a little goes a long way. It is definitely gentle enough for daily use as it is not drying to skin. I have use this for a week, do notice my skin is a little bit brighter. I have dry and dehydrated skin, the cleanser did not cause any issue so I definitely recommend this.

reviews.product_name: GENIUS Liquid Collagen Serum
reviews.review_text: I was gifted by Algenist. I really enjoyed using this collagen. My skin felt smoothed and plumped. They finally came out with a pump bottle! I used the dropper version before, the dropper was harder to get the product out of the bottle.

reviews.product_name: Good Genes All-In-One AHA Lactic Acid Treatment
reviews.review_text: Complimentary from Sunday Riley. A gentle exfoliating treatment that was not irritating to my dry and sensitive skin. It did helped lighten up my pimple scars and my skin looks brighter. My husband who has tan skin, also uses this treatment, I noticed his face was smoother. Although this was gifted, I have used this product in the past.

reviews.product_name: Magic Cream Moisturizer with Hyaluronic Acid
reviews.review_text: First of all - the packaging is beautiful. The box is like you’re opening a treasure box and the container is stunning - like a jewel. The cream itself is so luxurious and your skin soaks it up. My skin is left nice and soft to the touch.

reviews.product_name: Watermelon Glow Niacinamide Sunscreen SPF 50
reviews.review_text: This is my first time trying Glow Recipe and I loved everything about this product! It is a very lightweight sunscreen that feels light to the touch but leaves a glow on the skin. It is absorbed easily to the skin without leaving any greasy residue and does not leave any white cast like some other sunscreens. It provides spa 50 and has amazing ingredients such as hyaluronic acid and I love the light scent of watermelon - so yummy! This product was gifted but opinions are my own.

reviews.product_name: Tea Elixir Niacinamide & Hyaluronic Acid Anti-Aging Serum
reviews.review_text: I’m a huge fan of Fresh products but have mostly been using Fresh face wash and cream. This is the first time trying their serum and was so excited to receive it!  The packaging for this product is beautiful and I love the bottle that it comes in.  Just reading the ingredient list and what this product claims to do… i couldn’t wait to try it. I haven’t been using it that long yet but I have noticed my skin more plump and hydrated. There is a subtle scent of tea tree so those are scent sensitive should be mindful when using this product. I am noticing a small change in my skin so looking forward to the benefits after continued use!

reviews.product_name: Mini Daily Microfoliant Exfoliator
reviews.review_text: This has easily become one of my new favorite exfoliants. I love that the texture is soft but enough to feel like it is exfoliation all the gunk from your skin. It washes off beautifully and great to incorporate into your skin regime. Every time I use it I do feel like my skin is softer afterwards.

reviews.product_name: Daily Microfoliant Exfoliator
reviews.review_text: This has easily become one of my new favorite exfoliants. I love that the texture is soft but enough to feel like it is exfoliation all the gunk from your skin. It washes off beautifully and great to incorporate into your skin regime. Every time I use it I do feel like my skin is softer afterwards.

reviews.product_name: Squalane + Omega Repair Deep Hydration Moisturizer
reviews.review_title: Perfect PM moisturizer for combination skin
reviews.review_text: I really don’t mind the smell of it as it wont lingers. I have combination - acne prone skin and this moisturizer works perfect for my PM routine as i tend to dry out in the evening. I’m on my 2nd tube now, the only reason i don’t give 5 stars is the price.

reviews.product_name: Slaai  Makeup-Melting Butter Cleanser
reviews.review_text: It’s an OKAY product. There’s much better balm cleanser that are cheaper than this.

reviews.product_name: A-Passioni Retinol Cream
reviews.review_text: I wanted to love DE product so much after seeing so many good reviews. Guess they’re not meant for my skin. I’ve used this for about 6-7 months once or twice a week and it still irritates me. I have used other retinol 1%, hence i was keen to try this one out. I gave the rest to my long time Retinol user friend and it seems to work better on her, no major changes tho but does not irritates her skin.

reviews.product_name: Banana Bright 15% Vitamin C Serum
reviews.review_text: I am new to a vitamin C. I have used drunk elephant vit c in the past and find it too strong and leaves a sticky feeling. This don’t leave that sticky feeling but still strong and i find myself purging from using this. So I’ve only use it max twice a week now and it works perfect.

reviews.product_name: Salicylic Acid Acne Healing Dots
reviews.review_text: Guys this don’t heal my acne. I’m notorious with big cyst acne so nothing topical can help those kind of acne. But...I know some of us like to pop a pimple even tho we know we’re not supposed too, so this healing dot is a perfect dot to cover that open skin after of course you clean your skin and disinfectant the spot.

reviews.product_name: Avocado Soothing Skin Barrier Serum with Ceramides
reviews.review_text: I’ve only been using this for a week and i know I’ll be getting the second bottle soon. My PM time routine always more serious than AM, i switch between Retinol, Lactic Acid or Azelaic Acid for my acne prone skin. So my AM routine i like something more calming and this is product to help calm my skin. I also like to use Cerave PM moisturizer and it has Ceramides on it, but its not the same and not as effective.

reviews.product_name: Clear Improvement Pore Clearing Moisturizer with Salicylic Acid
reviews.review_text: As someone who received this at my peak time of breaking out, I could say this really works. It goes on smooth, smells good, and is also a great moisturizer that doesn’t irritate sensitive skin. I used it for about 2 weeks and immediately noticed that my skin was clearer and not as prone to breaking out again. I would recommend using this every other day though, because it contains salicylic acid and if used with other acne creams your face will tend to be a bit dry. Overall loved it and I think its well worth the price. I received this product complimentary for testing purposes.

reviews.product_name: Facial Treatment Essence (Pitera Essence)
reviews.review_text: I’ve been using this product for a while now and I have nothing but good things to say. Not even kidding you’ll notice a difference right after the first use! It does smell a little sour due to the yeast but once you get past that it’ll work wonders on your skin. It absorbs easily, leaves your skin feeling moisturized and soft. I use it at night and the next day my acne is always better. Highly recommend, as theres no other product like it! Packaging is also super cute and doesn’t feel cheap at all.

reviews.product_name: Mini Facial Treatment Essence (Pitera Essence)
reviews.review_text: I’ve been using this product for a while now and I have nothing but good things to say. Not even kidding you’ll notice a difference right after the first use! It does smell a little sour due to the yeast but once you get past that it’ll work wonders on your skin. It absorbs easily, leaves your skin feeling moisturized and soft. I use it at night and the next day my acne is always better. Highly recommend, as theres no other product like it! Packaging is also super cute and doesn’t feel cheap at all.

reviews.product_name: Santorini Grape Poreless Skin Cream
reviews.review_text: Really liked this skin cream!! It is lightweight, not heavy scented, and absorbs into the skin well. I used it daily and noticed a definite increase in hydration. The “poreless“ effect is definitely there but I wouldn’t rely on it as a primer. It does layer well underneath makeup and doesn’t make you look oily throughout the day. Overall, a solid staple to any skincare routine and I would definitely recommend giving it a try!

reviews.product_name: Aqua Bomb Brightening Vitamin C Cream
reviews.review_text: I’ve always used the belif aqua bomb so I knew this variation wouldn’t disappoint. It smells more citrusy compared to the original but delivers just the same in terms of moisture. My skin always feels super soft and as someone who is eczema/acne prone, I never have dry spots or breakouts while using this. I do use this product with a vitamin c serum and my dark spots are definitely noticeably lighter. I highly recommend this for all skin types!

reviews.product_name: Green Clean Makeup Removing Cleansing Balm
reviews.review_text: I’ve tried so many makeup removers and balms. This is the only one that actually removes makeup (and I do full face daily) and rises off without an oily residue feeling

reviews.product_name: Green Clean Makeup Meltaway Cleansing Balm Limited Edition Jumbo
reviews.review_text: I’ve tried so many makeup removers and balms. This is the only one that actually removes makeup (and I do full face daily) and rises off without an oily residue feeling

reviews.product_name: Ultra Repair Cream Intense Hydration
reviews.review_text: This cream is amazing for sensitive skin! The hydration does not leave a greasy feeling at all. Myself and my children tend to get eczema from time to time and this cream helps with the flare ups. Hydrating and simple, yet really effective!

reviews.product_name: Hyaluronic Acid 2% + B5 Hydrating Serum
reviews.review_text: The Ordinary does a great job creating solid products for a great price! The hyaluronic acid + B5 is a great humectant! For the price- it’s awesome!

reviews.product_name: Moisturizing Eye Bomb with Squalane
reviews.review_text: I received this as a sample and I was not impressed. It wasn’t as moisturizing as I thought it would be when reading the great reviews. I’m in my late 30s so I will probably do best with a thicker cream.

reviews.product_name: Hello FAB Coconut Water Cream
reviews.review_text: Love this cream! It smells great (not too strong- just a soft coconut smell) and I can place sunscreen on top of it without it creating pilling. It dries down quickly but gives a good amount of moisture. I use this in the morning because it’s refreshing and doesn’t have a thick, creamy feeling. Also, I have no issues putting foundation over it.

reviews.product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C
reviews.review_text: I like this mask for night time however if you apply too much and it spreads to the skin around your lips it can break you out so be careful. A little goes a long way and you get a lot of product for the amount you pay - will causally be purchasing here and there but not consistently

reviews.product_name: Sugar Hydrating Lip Balm
reviews.review_text: Love how moisturizing this lip balm is and maybe it’s a good thing it isn’t heavily scented. I was hoping it would smell more like caramel- can’t smell it at all

reviews.product_name: Mini Ultra Facial Moisturizing Cream with Squalane
reviews.review_text: Really nice moisturizer however if you are on a budget then go for Nivea. Feels identical. Regardless this is great for any skin type in my opinion
