reviews.product_name: Salicylic Acid Acne Healing Dots
reviews.review_text: Game changer with your breakouts. Makes it easier not to pop and cause scaring. I like this better than the bandaids you get at shoppers (which work just as well!) because it has acne fighting ingredients. I still use the bandaids though! Both are a great addition to your skin care routine, I would hope that they can make bigger sizes to help with cluster breakouts

reviews.product_name: Vinopure Natural Salicylic Acid Pore Minimizing Serum
reviews.review_text: This is my favorite skincare product ever purchased! You can kind of see the results within a couple of uses. Smells very refreshing.  I have combo/acne prone skin and this helped make my face look radiant and even toned. It can be a little drying but use a moisturizer or oil after and you will wake up with nice skin.

reviews.product_name: Cicapair Tiger Grass Color Correcting Treatment SPF 30
reviews.review_text: I really don’t like this on my combo/sensitive skin. It does not absorb into the skin so you can feel it on your skin when you touch it. I think that’s why it clogged up my pores and I got little bumps all over. Maybe use it only on the certain areas not the entire face if you have skin concerns. It does not make my foundation look good; I can see dry patches and pores are big.

reviews.review_text: Usually I would not spend this much on a cleansing balm but I must have it! It feels so good on the skin. The texture and scent are heavenly. It melts when you put it on. Feels very luxurious. Will splurge on this again.

reviews.product_name: Green Clean Makeup Meltaway Cleansing Balm Limited Edition Jumbo
reviews.review_text: Usually I would not spend this much on a cleansing balm but I must have it! It feels so good on the skin. The texture and scent are heavenly. It melts when you put it on. Feels very luxurious. Will splurge on this again.

reviews.product_name: Beste No. 9 Jelly Cleanser
reviews.review_text: Feels nice and seems to clean skin well but beware this product is not for people with dry skin. My skin feels a bit too tight and dried out after I use it. If you have drier or sensitive skin this may not be gentle enough for you.

reviews.product_name: Squalane + Vitamin C Rose Firming Oil
reviews.review_text: This is the first oil I used that doesn’t feel so sticky and heavy. It feels moisturizing and makes me look glowy. It makes your skin look healthy. It’s pricey but I really feel good when I put this on.

reviews.product_name: GENIUS Liquid Collagen Serum
reviews.review_text: It isn’t a bad product, but the dropper does not dispense the product. I got it in my sephora play box.

reviews.product_name: Honeymoon Glow AHA Resurfacing Night Serum
reviews.review_text: I usually am not sensitive to skincare products, but this made my skin burn. I also didn’t care for the way it smelled, but I do like the container it came in.

reviews.product_name: The True Cream Moisturizing Bomb
reviews.review_title: My number one pick from now on
reviews.review_text: I got a sample of this is a Sephora play among online order samples & I love it. I love everything about it the texture, the smell, the application, the way it feels on my face & how smooth it makes my face feel, etc. I love using a gel moisturizer at night & this is now my number 1 pick. I can see why it is a cult favorite now.

reviews.product_name: The True Cream Aqua Bomb
reviews.review_text: Definitely a favorite moisturizer. I love the gel formula and the way it feels on my skin. I also enjoy the lemony scent. This is definitely worth the money.

reviews.product_name: Lala Retro Whipped Refillable Moisturizer with Ceramides
reviews.review_text: I got this as a Sephora play sample & as a sample with an order. I love this moisturizer because it makes my skin feel hydrated. I LOVE the whipped formula too. I am disappointed at how high the price is to buy the full size though.

reviews.product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C
reviews.review_text: It’s like an SOS in a jar! This lip mask feels like a balm and makes my lips feel soft and silky over night! Normally I tend to reapply lip balm to keep my lips from getting chappy but after trying this mask, I did not have to constantly reapply any lip balms anymore! It’s great for mornings and mid days too and stays on really well. My lips tend to get dry all season long so this actually helps make my lips feel soft! The smell is light and fruity which I love!

reviews.product_name: Auto Correct Brightening + Depuffing Eye Cream for Dark Circles
reviews.review_text: I first got this as a sample as I was on the search for an eye cream that would help with my dark circles and small fine lines. After trying this for a couple weeks I decided to get the full bottle of it as I do see mild results. It does help brighten my under eyes and works REALLY well under concealer! I also noticed that it helps with puffiness too and my concealer doesn’t look cakey when I use this as a primer. It has some light reflecting particles which I enjoy and it doesn’t look TOO dramatic unlike other eye creams like Origins. The reason why I’m giving this 4\5 is because I do not see a Big difference where it makes me go wow, and the price is a little steep.

reviews.product_name: Ultra Glow Serum: Glow + Strengthen Vitamin C Serum
reviews.review_text: Great for this price point. I use it as a nightly serum and it’s easy to work with. In terms of brightness, I haven’t really notice that much of a difference but it makes my skin feels smooth every time I wake up so that’s a plus!

reviews.product_name: Avocado Fine Line Eye Cream with Retinol
reviews.review_text: It’s a good eye cream. I use it every other day nightly and each time, I wake up with nice plump eyes and my fine lines are less visible (it makes my concealer application a lot easier as it doesn’t crease!) I love the glass jar and how it looks! My dark circles does appear slightly lighter but it doesn’t 100% go away.

reviews.product_name: Lip Glowy Balm
reviews.review_text: Very moisturizing lip balm, very glossy, and just little bit of color. My lips felt smooth and soft after wearing it, and it held up OK with drinking. I love the fruity scents, and the overall look of it. Would love to try other products from Laneige. #tryitwithtopbox #laneige #freeproduct

reviews.product_name: Cream Skin Toner & Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I enjoyed using the Laneige Cream skin toner and moisturizer on my skin. It left my skin feeling smooth and soft, and glowing. I will recommend it to others and try other laneige products for sure. #freeproduct #laneige #laneigeca #topbox

reviews.product_name: The True Cream Aqua Bomb
reviews.review_text: I enjoy using this moisturizer from belief - it is light and absorbs quickly which is great for summer/hot days. My skin looked nice and plump after using it and I liked the slightly herbal scent. Will definitely be looking out for more products to try from belief #gotitfree #tryitout #productreview

reviews.product_name: Aqua Bomb Overnight Lip Mask
reviews.review_text: Great product for dry lips due to sun and wind. After leaving it on overnight my lips felt smooth, soft and plump. It didn’t feel sticky or heavy which is great. Will definitely be looking out for more products from belief. #freeproduct #tryitout #review

reviews.product_name: The True Cream Moisturizing Bomb
reviews.review_text: Love this moisturizer, from the summer months to the winter months this cream is a true life saver. It works for my dehydrated skin and my husbands oily skin. Makes it nice that we can both use the same moisturizer.  It has a beautifully weightless texture and absorbs in no time at all. I highly recommend this product!

reviews.product_name: GOOPGLOW 15% Glycolic Acid Overnight Glow Peel
reviews.review_text: I’m so impressed by these peels! I’m a strong promoter of Dennis gross alpha beta peels but this gives them a run for their money. I feel like the overnight usage allows the products to sink deep into my skin. I felt dewy and refreshed upon waking up. I’m definitely trying these again! Recommend trying them yourself!

reviews.product_name: Mini GOOPGLOW 15% Glycolic Acid Overnight Glow Peel

reviews.product_name: GOOPGLOW Microderm Instant Glow Exfoliator
reviews.review_text: Impressive product. I’ve always loved a physical exfoliation and this product DELIVERS. The grit is fine like sand you can feel the dead skin cell falling away when you use it. It’s hard to find a fine grit exfoliator these days and that’s reflected in the price. Any comparable system is going to run you the same amount. But the real kicker is the gentle acid IN the product leaving it on for 3 minutes after you exfoliate and boom your a new woman.

Love this product for normal/combo skin. Might not be heavy enough for dry skin!

reviews.review_text: Hydrating and so refreshing for the undereyes. The texture is so creaming smooth, it feels so light and clean under the eye.

reviews.review_text: I have loved clinique for years! I was so excited to revive this to review. It’s light weight, non grease and feels hydrating. I’m 35 and I will be getting the full size soon!

reviews.review_text: I love this moisturizing cream from belief, it is very soothing going onto the skin and I like the consistency of it. A little bit goes a long way and it doesn’t have a strong scent either.

reviews.review_text: I love this moisturizing cream from belief, it is very soothing going onto the skin and I like the consistency of it. A little bit goes a long way and it doesn’t have a strong scent either.

reviews.product_name: Ultra Facial Moisturizing Cream with Squalane
reviews.review_text: I’ve been using this product since perhaps forever. You don’t feel like it’s doing much, but whenever I got experimental and use other products and got severe redness and breakouts, this cream always saves my face in less than two weeks. It also goes well with many other products such as the Kiehl’s skin oil. I mix it with my night cream to add more moisture. I panick when I run out of this cream at home. This cream is so mild but really protects and hydrates the skin. I can’t say how much I appreciate it!

reviews.product_name: Superfood Air-Whip Lightweight Moisturizer with Hyaluronic Acid
reviews.review_title: Reduces grease and doesn't clog pores!
reviews.review_text: I have combination skin that breaks out like crazy if I try on the wrong moisturizer (new serum, toner or foundation is fine, but not moisturizers). I have never heard of this brand before, but the ingredients sounds like a yummy smoothie so I got a mini size, and I love it! I mix it with Murad perfect skin lotion. Usually my face would be very greasy around 5pm, and I would have to blot continuously from then on, which also takes away my foundation. With this moisturizer, my face would still look fresh by 8pm. There would still be some grease but much reduced than before. However, I think this one alone may not be moisturizing enough for a dry New York winter night, so I use it during the day and something heavier at night. I already purchased the full size and I’m very excited to open it!

reviews.product_name: Crème de la Mer Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I tried my mom’s La Mer when I was a teenager with massive breakouts one day. And my newly home-extracted , bound-to-be-crusty-and -inflamed wounds on my face all flattened, and the new scars disappeared!Fast forward a decade to last week, I used retinal for the first time for 7-days straight, along with my regular acids and physical exfoliation (terribly bad idea). In combination with my hormonal breakouts, I felt like a zombie whose face was about to melt off. I stopped all products and just went for the La Mer concentrate followed by a big scoop of this cream. I did the same thing the next morning, and when I took off my makeup tonight I was shocked! My scars quite obviously faded, my skin tone was more even and generally brighter, and my entire face looked plump and hydrated with even smaller pores! My face looked like it just enjoyed a nice sheet mask and not covered in makeup for 13 hours. Just two uses was able to repair my zombie-apocalypse face and made it look much better than before. I don’t use it regularly, only when my face is in need of desperate recovery, and this cream never fails. People say that there are too much petroleum, and it’s overpriced for it’s ingredients, but until I find a cheaper equivalent that can do what this cream does to me, I’ll always keep a little jar in my cabinet.
