reviews.product_name: Salicylic Acid Acne Healing Dots
reviews.review_text: I’m inpatient, so I prefer to use benzoyl peroxide and BHA for treating a red and closed breakout. I only use this patch when the breakout ruptures (or when I pop it). I make sure all the gunk is out, clean the area with some antiseptic and then put this patch on. It prevents the open wound from developing a dark and hard crust, which takes more than a week to come off. It also calms down any residual Inflammation overnight. When I take it off in the morning, the redness and swelling are usually gone or very minimal, and I can cover up the area with concealer smoothly, without the texture making it more prominent. Overall, it makes the healing process much faster. Combined with regular exfoliation and azaleic acid, the post-acne marks remain red for a few days before disappearing completely! It’s quite expensive, but it has been the best acne patch I’ve used!

reviews.product_name: Alpha Beta Extra Strength Daily Peel Pads
reviews.review_text: I got a free sample (3 sheets) from PinchMe.com. It’s was a bit drying the first time I used it but it was effective! It removed all the dirt and you can feel the ingredients working their magic. It is also so easy to use! I would recommend this product.

reviews.product_name: Alpha Beta Pore Perfecting & Refining Serum
reviews.review_text: This product is amazing! Very effective and I saw results after a week. My skin looks even and more firm, whereas before you could definitely see my pores. It even feels softer. I recommend this product!

reviews.product_name: Skinlongevity Long Life Herb Anti-Aging Face Serum
reviews.review_text: I received a free sample of Bareminerals, Skinlongevity Long Life Herb Serum from Pinchme and I love this product. It feels light and the serum feels luxurious when you put it on your hands. I used it twice and notice the difference on my face. It softened my face and left a glow, There is no fragrance which I prefer and it is worth the buy.

reviews.product_name: Triple Algae Eye Renewal Balm Eye Cream
reviews.review_text: Algenist’s Triple Algae Eye Renewal Balm with Multi-Peptide Complex is an overall good product. It glides and applies smoothly on your skin. It’s not thick and lasts for awhile, you feel the nourishment. There isn’t a noticeable difference on the dark under eyes but it definitely firmed up the area! I enjoy that feature and the ingredients are great for your skin.

reviews.product_name: The True Cream Aqua Bomb
reviews.review_title: Great for oily skin and people who fake tan face!
reviews.review_text: Just picked this up a few days ago with the holiday gift set that included the small eye cream and sleep mask. If you can still get your hands on it in your Sephora you should, because it’s the cost of just this moisturizer itself and both of the other items included are great. I normally have quite oily skin, but in the cold winter months it’s more combination. I’m still oily through my T-zone but my skin can be dry and flaky all over at the same time. The texture is somewhere between a gel and a rich cream, which I think makes this a perfect more heavy moisturizer for those of us with oily skin but still looking for a lot of hydration. My face makeup sits very well on top of it and after I use it I don’t have that tight feeling in my forehead, which usually helps me gauge how moisturizing something is. This hasn’t broken me out at all and doesn’t make my skin anymore oily than it would normally be with any other face cream, and that’s really all I could ask for in terms of oil. I think this would still provide enough hydration for all skin types, even though I have heard some people suggest it might not be as effective for dryer skin. I use the Clinique Self Sun gradual tanner for the face almost daily in the winter and one of my favorite parts about this moisturizer is that I can mix them together and it doesn’t diminish the strength of the fake tan too much like my other moisturizers have. I like to mix them for a more subtle color and to still hydrate my skin but other face creams will completely negate the face tan. Overall I highly recommend this product and think it’s definitely worth the price.

reviews.product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C
reviews.review_text: So perfect. A very tiny bit goes SUCH a long way that the price tag is worth it to me. Consistency is unlike anything I’ve ever felt on my lips, and I’m not stranger to buying expensive lip balms/ conditioners.

reviews.product_name: Hyaluronic Acid 2% + B5 Hydrating Serum
reviews.review_text: I have very oil skin, especially in the summer. I’ve been using this for 2-3 weeks now and I feel like I can’t really tell any sort of difference in my skin. It’s not an AWFUL product and I’m glad to see that it worked for some people, but it hasn’t done anything for me. I’ll try to stick with it and see if my oilyness turns the corner. The way you’re supposed to use a product like this is apply it to wet skin. This leaves my skin feeling a bit sticky and that is only resolved after using moisturizer.

reviews.product_name: Self Tanning Bronzing Face Drops
reviews.review_title: a pale olive skinned girl’s dream
reviews.review_text: I used to use the Clinique face self tanner for the winter months and always cut it with moisturizer. It was great to find a product that is meant to be mixed with your moisturizer because I could never skip moisturizing in the winter. for anyone with olive skin, definitely go with the green tanner. I usually used 1-2 drops almost every night after my tan faded in the winter. This definitely works. Be careful around the forehead and sideburn areas as it can build up there if you aren’t careful and don’t exfoliate there enough. As far as the coconut oil in this- I don’t like the idea of putting coconut oil on my face and I am definitely acne prone but this never broke me out. I think there’s such a small amount in the product and you’re diluting it with your moisturizer so it doesnt really mess up my skin. Also wasn’t really drying either. I definitely recommend and I love that this suits my undertone more than other face tanners.

reviews.product_name: U.F.O. Salicylic Acid BHA Acne Treatment Face Oil
reviews.review_text: I used this at the end of 2017 when I had my annual bout of acne as a stressed college student. I bought it in the kit with the mattifying toner and sulfur mask. This product was the main event but think it’s worth mentioning I was using those products too. Yes this product stinks due to the acne fighting ingredients, but I remember it working very well. I have had very oily skin since I was a teenager, and despite this being an oil, this didn’t clog my pores or break me out more. I can’t say how this product would react with dry skin but I suspect it would still work fine. It’s worth mentioning that the product did warn of skin purging during the first few weeks, so if you’re finding that you’re breaking out during the first week or two, I would say maybe give it a little more time. Also, I really do not think you need to order the large size bottle. I had the smaller one that came in the kit; I never finished it and ended up throwing it away due to it expiring after I didn’t need to use it anymore. I’m considering purchasing again because I have been using curology for a year after having months of painful acne in sept 2019, which worked and kept my skin clear at the time, but two months ago in October of 2020 I started breaking out the same way again and my curology hasn’t been helping at all despite upping my active ingredient percentages. Other than curology, this was literally the only thing I remember that dramatically cleared my acne and kept it away until I had another skin issue months after I stopped using it. I’ve been staying away from Sunday Riley products since it came out that their employees had been posting 5 star reviews to boost the company’s ratings online. But I remember this working so well and so quickly for me that I think I may have to try it again. I’m giving 4 stars because the product worked for me but also to hopefully balance out the star rating so it is more accurate to what actual consumers would rate it.

reviews.product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C
reviews.review_text: This is the absolute best lip product I’ve ever used. It feels so good on the lips, has the feel of a true luxury product. I got the Christmas set which has various flavors. There is something special about this particular version, IDK if it has to do with the flavoring, but it works the best. I really wish Sephora sold the lime apple flavor because it comes in at a close second. This is literally the only thing that gets my lips in any kind of good condition during the harsh midwest winter. Get this, you won’t regret and it lasts forever.

reviews.product_name: T.L.C. Framboos Glycolic Resurfacing Night Serum
reviews.review_title: I'm back in my high school skin!
reviews.review_text: Um what? I used this for the first time last night and had immediate results. I’m 34, but look very young. I’m just barely starting to get enlarged pores and minor fine lines. After one, yes ONE night of use, I have my high school skin back. What is this skin crack? It’s magic and yes, you should buy some. It is very expensive, but you use a teeny tiny amount so the cost per use is actually very affordable.

reviews.product_name: 100% Organic Cold-Pressed Rose Hip Seed Oil
reviews.review_text: I use this when my skin is angry and needs to calm down. It’s a great moisturizer too. I can even use it during the summer when my skin swings towards the oily side.

reviews.product_name: Soy Hydrating Gentle Face Cleanser
reviews.review_text: This is all over the place, I got so many free samples, and I just never really used it enough to regularly like it. i finally got a full size in my Boxy and use it in the shower now. WHOA. This stuff is IT. My skin is finicky as heck and this is a really great product! My only complaint is that it does leave my skin a little bit on the dry/tight side, but it’s winter so that’s to be expected. Give this cleaner a try, it’s worth it.

reviews.product_name: Aqua Bomb Cleansing Balm
reviews.review_text: I was given this product complimentary to review! I love this balm, it melts your makeup off and it’s super easy to rinse off when the formula melts on your skin. It doesn’t leave a film over your skin like I find with other cleansing balms. It doesn’t strip your skin either. If I had to nitpick, I’d say that the scent is a bit too strong for my liking especially if you accidentally use too much. The scent itself is quite nice however - almost like lemon & eucalyptus.

reviews.product_name: The True Cream Aqua Bomb
reviews.review_text: It’s on the lighter side of a gel moisturizer but it packs a punch of hydration into the skin. Perfect for layering underneath makeup or using it as a base to set up for a heavier face cream when you’re doing your night routine.

reviews.product_name: Aqua Bomb Overnight Lip Mask
reviews.review_text: It’s comparable to the Laneige lip mask but has a thicker, more buttery consistency. Super nourishing and hydrating - you can immediately notice a difference the next morning. It’s really rich and has a similar feel to their cleansing balm in the sense that it’s super light on scent and taste and melts on your skin like a dream. Would highly recommend.

reviews.product_name: The True Cream Moisturizing Bomb
reviews.review_text: This is a nice water-based gel moisturizer. Unlike the Tatcha Water Cream which didn’t really feel moisturizing, it has a super lightweight texture but actually hydrates my skin. I would recommend this for oily to normal skin types because it’s so light. It’s really nice for a day moisturizer to layer underneath makeup. Good for the summer time too.

reviews.product_name: Plum Plump Hyaluronic Acid Serum
reviews.review_text: It’s okay. Inkeylist’s Hyaluronic Acid achieves the same effect and is not nearly as sticky as this one. It reminds me a lot of the same stickiness that the Ordinary’s hyaluronic acid has, which I was not a fan of. This just feels pretty gimmicky with the cute packaging.

reviews.product_name: ExfoliKate Glow Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: The smell and texture alone sold me on this product!! I sampled it on my hand at Sephora and walked around the mall for an hour and immediately ran back in Sephora to purchase. This compliments Kate’s ExfoliKate line perfectly!!

reviews.product_name: Dreamskin Skin Perfector
reviews.review_text: I love how radiant this primer makes my makeup look halfway through the day. I use a matte foundation and this really helps to liven my skin. It hasn’t caused any new breakouts also which is a plus. I received this product free for testing purposes.

reviews.product_name: The Dewy Serum Resurfacing and Plumping Treatment
reviews.review_text: I love this serum! It gives me great radiance even with my matte foundations like Chanel Ultra ale Teint and Eatee Lauder Double Wear that usually are resistant. My makeup applies beautifully over it. Will definitely re-purchase.

reviews.product_name: Urban Environment Fresh-Moisture Sunscreen Broad-Spectrum SPF 42
reviews.review_text: This is my favorite sunscreen. It doesn’t interfere with my makeup application. It isn’t itchy which I have issues with other sunscreens because of this. I’ll be using this all summer.

reviews.product_name: Precleanse Cleansing Oil
reviews.review_text: This stuff is really amazing! It helps to clean my makeup and any kind of dirt, oil from my face. Very easy to apply and very perfect for my combination skin. I never had any issues using dermatologica products. I highly recommend this product. Gifted by dermatologica.

reviews.product_name: Mini Precleanse Cleansing Oil
reviews.review_text: This stuff is really amazing! It helps to clean my makeup and any kind of dirt, oil from my face. Very easy to apply and very perfect for my combination skin. I never had any issues using dermatologica products. I highly recommend this product. Gifted by dermatologica.

reviews.product_name: Plum Plump Hyaluronic Acid Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: This moisturizer has become my best friend for this winter season. I don’t know how this made my skin so plumped and hydrating. This also helped me to get that perfect glow in the morning and night as well. Love it so much.

reviews.product_name: Mini Plum Plump Hyaluronic Acid Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: This moisturizer has become my best friend for this winter season. I don’t know how this made my skin so plumped and hydrating. This also helped me to get that perfect glow in the morning and night as well. Love it so much.

reviews.product_name: Floral Recovery Overnight Mask with Squalane
reviews.review_text: This face mask has been so amazing on my skin these days. A holy grail product. The smell is amazing and makes my skin so fresh and smooth. It also helps to deeply clean my pores. I highly recommend this product.

reviews.product_name: Vitamin Enriched Face Base Priming Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: This moisturizer has been one of my favorites now. I cannot explain how amazing this moisturizer is. It is perfect for my combination skin. I use this as a daily moisturizer and even as a primer on my skin. Love it!

reviews.product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C
reviews.review_text: I’m on my second jar of this.. they last for ages, close to a year! I love the cute little spatula, it’s so adorable and also keeps things slightly more hygienic. I started battling dry lips after moving to a really dry province in Canada. This has helped immensely. I slather a thick layer on every night and in the morning, wake up with smooth lips. The product typically has fully absorbed by morning. I do like the sweet candy flavour better than the original berry one, which gave me a bit of a headache. Out of all the Laneige products I’ve tried to date, this remains my favourite.

reviews.product_name: The True Cream Moisturizing Bomb
reviews.review_text: So good. Smells incredible. Looks incredible under make-up. Stands up to a dry Canadian prairie winter. But too pricey for how quickly I go through it! Had to transition to a more affordable brand that gives same results but is a less luxe experience than this cream offers.

reviews.product_name: Lip Glowy Balm
reviews.review_title: A decent, glossy balm that smells heavenly!
reviews.review_text: Smells delicious, scent is such a mood booster! Looks nice and glossy on, ok wear time. Not a serious hydrator for me, not something I’d use to prep my lips, but something I’d wear on its own. Very basic balm that was nice to try, but not necessarily something I’d repurchase as there are so many options out there.

reviews.product_name: Caffeine 5% + EGCG Depuffing Eye Serum
reviews.review_title: A meh product that has minimal effect if any.
reviews.review_text: Just finished my second bottle.. not quite sure that it’s doing anything as my eye cream is also brightening/de-puffing, but my dark circles look marginally better at best, after 6+ months of use. The one thing I really dislike about this is that the product builds up around rim of bottle and oxides into this very gross, thick crust that reminds me of foam housing insulation. This has happened on both bottles, even though I’m careful not to get product everywhere.

reviews.product_name: Natural Moisturizing Factors + HA
reviews.review_title: The best basic moisturizer you'll find
reviews.review_text: I’ve been using this for about a year. This is as basic a moisturizer as it gets.. I was looking for something that sat a little nicer under my makeup than Cetaphil and Cerave and this is it. It works for me in both dry Canadian winters as well as during summers with my very oily skin. I like to apply this with slightly damp skin or hands as I find it applies too thick otherwise. I do have a few moisturizers I like better, mostly for superficial reasons, but this one is so affordable while still being effective that I can’t justify the other moisturizers that I might like better that cost 5X more.

reviews.product_name: Glow2OH Dark Spot Toner
reviews.review_text: Absolutely love this. Was a bit sceptical of toners before trying this as had never really used them before. Got this as part of gift set (with other Ole Henriksen products) and this is by far my fave. Will definitely rebuy! It is also lasting me ages, I’ve been using for 5 months (once a day) and still have over half left. My skin is brighter and clearer. Dark spots have gone and my skin has a more even color tone.

reviews.product_name: Niacinamide 10% + Zinc 1% Oil Control Serum
reviews.review_text: For the first few months, I didn’t really notice any big differences after using this. However, I’ve now been using for a few months and I’ve realised I haven’t had a spot in months! Usually I would get a few every month but using this (alongside a high quality dermalogica facial) has definitely made me break out less! Unfortunately it hasn’t noticeably changed the size of my pores but I’m not sure if any product can! Will be rebuying based on the lack of break outs for sure. After cleansing I apply this followed by Buffet, The Ordinary moisturiser and then my SPF. I also use the granactive retinoid in the eve. I have seen such an improvement from all these products!

reviews.product_name: AHA 30% + BHA 2% Exfoliating Peeling Solution
reviews.review_text: This mask is incredible! I’ve been using once a week for about 8 months and it has improved my skin so much. After use, my skin is brighter and smoother. I think, alongside some other the ordinary products, it has transformed my skin and made it look so youthful! Without a doubt recommend to anyone. If its your first time using acids, begin with keeping it on for a short period (eg 3-5 mins) and take it slow.

reviews.product_name: Greek Yoghurt Foaming Cream Cleanser
reviews.review_text: This is THE best cleanser and face wash I’ve ever used. Been trying to find a face wash/cleanser that is better than average for years. Tried loads of expensive ones but they all felt basic. This though!!!! First time I used it, my skin felt amazing. It makes your skin so soft! Smell is gorgeous but not overpowering. Love that it gently removes make up + cleanses! Not only that but Ive noticed my skin is genuinely smoother, brighter and generally healthier since using this face wash. I’d say it’s one of the best beauty products I’ve ever used and as I said, I’ve experimented with a lot of pricey ones! 100% recommend.

reviews.product_name: Clear Improvement Charcoal Honey Mask to Purify and Nourish
reviews.review_text: I loved this mask!  It goes on and comes off easily.  Make sure you use a warm towel to open your pores up before applying, apply evenly and let it dry!  It’s that easy!  It has a tingle/cool feeling as it dries.  When I washed it off, it left my skin smooth and hydrated. I received this product complimentary for testing purposes.

reviews.product_name: Cicapair Tiger Grass Color Correcting Treatment SPF 30
reviews.review_text: I originally saw this on TikTok and was blown away by what I was seeing, of course had to try it out. IT IS AMAZING. I’m more of an all natural type of gal, I don’t like make up and things that sit heavy on my face. This is light weight and it corrects your redness. A little goes a long way. Make sure you follow the directions and I’m sure you will fall in love too.

reviews.product_name: Mini Cicapair Tiger Grass Color Correcting Treatment SPF 30
reviews.review_text: I originally saw this on TikTok and was blown away by what I was seeing, of course had to try it out. IT IS AMAZING. I’m more of an all natural type of gal, I don’t like make up and things that sit heavy on my face. This is light weight and it corrects your redness. A little goes a long way. Make sure you follow the directions and I’m sure you will fall in love too.

reviews.product_name: Ultra Facial Moisturizing Cream with Squalane
reviews.review_text: I’ve swapped my usual moisturizer out for the last couple of weeks and I love this moisturizer. It’s perfect hydrating my dry skin during our cold and dry winter. I have sensitive skin and I’ve not experienced any breakouts or irritation. If you struggle with dry sensitive skin I’d say give it a try! Also a little goes a long way.

reviews.product_name: Mini Ultra Facial Moisturizing Cream with Squalane
reviews.review_text: I’ve swapped my usual moisturizer out for the last couple of weeks and I love this moisturizer. It’s perfect hydrating my dry skin during our cold and dry winter. I have sensitive skin and I’ve not experienced any breakouts or irritation. If you struggle with dry sensitive skin I’d say give it a try! Also a little goes a long way.

reviews.product_name: Advanced Night Repair Eye Gel-Cream
reviews.review_text: I received a sample size of this to try and I was blown away by the results. It absorbs well and a little goes a long way. I noticed brighter less tired eyes in about 5 days. Definitely will be purchasing once it becomes available.

reviews.product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C
reviews.review_text: I WILL NEVER EVER RUN OUT OF THIS LIP MASK! I apply it at night after my skincare routine and I wake to super soft lips. It feels so good on my lips with good slip and a pillow like feel. I have applied during the day as well. So far this lip mask is the BEST lip balm I’ve EVER used. There’s a good amount of product for the price too. I cannot recommend enough to everyone who wants smooth, soft and healthy lips!!

reviews.product_name: The True Cream Moisturizing Bomb
reviews.review_title: A MUST TRY AND MUST HAVE!!
reviews.review_text: This a holy grail moisturizer for my skin! I cannot say enough about how much I love how my skin craves this product and soaks it up! I’ve not had any breakouts or issues from using this product. I’ve recommended this belif moisturizer to everyone I know and more. My skincare regimen will NEVER be without this product.

reviews.product_name: Slaai  Makeup-Melting Butter Cleanser
reviews.review_text: This is a wonderfully effective cleansing balm! I use a thin dime size amount on magnetic scoop provided on the jars lid. I rub my fingertips together and apply directly onto dry skin with or without makeup on it. I work the balm into my skin well and then add warm water to my face and neck. The balm turns into a milky emulsion and after rinsing my skin thoroughly my skin is completely clean without any residue whatsoever. My skin is left clean and not stripped of all its moisture. I can work the cleansing balm into my eyes and lashes without any burning, stinging or cloudy vision. I had no breakouts from this cleansing balm either. I can not recommend it enough to everyone! Now Drunk Elephant Slaai cleansing balm and Pharmacy Green Clean are my ONLY cleansing balms! I wish I could give this product 10 stars!!!

reviews.product_name: B-Hydra Intensive Hydration Serum with Hyaluronic Acid
reviews.review_text: I use this serum in conjunction with the Drunk Elephant C-Firma Day serum each and every morning. I apply both serums to my face/neck/chest everyday all year round. During colder weather I’ll apply an additional moisturizer on top of them both to seal in my skincare after waiting 5-10 min to let C-Firma and B-Hydra absorb into my skin well. I truly enjoy using them together every morning. I let them absorb and finish off with a facial oil pressed into my skin and finally my SPF. I highly recommend Drunk Elephant skincare products!

reviews.product_name: Good Genes All-In-One AHA Lactic Acid Treatment
reviews.review_text: I recently received Good Genes all in one treatment gifted by Sunday Riley, and I noticed a big difference in my pores , and my fine lines have started to look less noticable. I love how it doesn’t take very much to cover my face, it feels silky when I apply it, and it’s made my face look so much smoother. It does tingle for the first few days, but it goes away.

reviews.product_name: Avocado Soothing Skin Barrier Serum with Ceramides
reviews.review_text: The Glow Recipe avocado serum, is truly one of the best I’ve used so far, it goes on smooth and absorbs really fast. I love how it’s mad my skin so soft and I even have a glow , it’s perfect for anyone who has dull skin . I’m definitely going to keep using it.

reviews.product_name: Revitalizing Supreme+ Youth Power Creme Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: The Estee Lauder revitalizing supreme +youth power creme has exceeded my expectations.  It’s rich , creamy  and really doesn’t take very much . I noticed a difference in a few days of using it, the cream made my face very soft and had a little glow to it. I’m definitely going to keep using this cream on a daily basis.

reviews.product_name: Mini Revitalizing Supreme+ Youth Power Creme Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: The Estee Lauder revitalizing supreme +youth power creme has exceeded my expectations.  It’s rich , creamy  and really doesn’t take very much . I noticed a difference in a few days of using it, the cream made my face very soft and had a little glow to it. I’m definitely going to keep using this cream on a daily basis.

reviews.product_name: Mini Daily Microfoliant Exfoliator
reviews.review_text: The Dermalogica daily microfoliant was really easy to use , just mix and apply to face . What I really loved is that first time use and I could see results,  smoother, brighter than my face was before , gifted by Dermalogica Sampling

reviews.product_name: Daily Microfoliant Exfoliator
reviews.review_text: The Dermalogica daily microfoliant was really easy to use , just mix and apply to face . What I really loved is that first time use and I could see results,  smoother, brighter than my face was before , gifted by Dermalogica Sampling

reviews.product_name: Lotus Anti-Aging Night Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I love this product! It has made my skin feel super soft and hydrated. It also works all night long which I love. It has a light fragrance to it which is great because it’s smells good without being overpowering. I would definitely recommend it!

reviews.product_name: Lotus Anti- Aging Daily Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I love this moisturizer! It has made my skin feel super soft and hydrated. It has some fragrance to it but it is very light and not overpowering. My skin has been feeling so refreshed since I started using it. I would definitely recommend it!

reviews.product_name: Aqua Bomb Brightening Vitamin C Cream
reviews.review_text: Great cream! It’s soft and light. It makes my skin feel very soft and doesn’t irritate it at all. I received it free from Influenster for complimentary testing purposes. I will definitely be buying it for myself!

reviews.product_name: Aqua Bomb Overnight Lip Mask
reviews.review_text: This is a good overnight lip mask! It removes all the dry and dead skin.

reviews.product_name: Retinol Anti-Aging Serum
reviews.review_text: I love that its a clean product. I did receive this product but honestly I loved it and will be buying it again. The price is just right. Decent size tube also. Made my skin feel super soft and glowing. Didn’t feel greasy or too heavy. Used it after I washed my face, then applied serum and moisturizer after like normal. Will be buying for sure when I run out.

reviews.product_name: Retinol Reform Treatment Serum
reviews.review_text: I used this product on cleansed skin before bedtime, then I used my normal night cream. Let me tell you I noticed my skin softer. It left my face feeling clean and fresh. With no oily feeling after. In the morning my face felt more hydrated. I will definitely be throwing this into my skin care routine a few times a week.

reviews.product_name: Mini Retinol Reform
reviews.review_text: I used this product on cleansed skin before bedtime, then I used my normal night cream. Let me tell you I noticed my skin softer. It left my face feeling clean and fresh. With no oily feeling after. In the morning my face felt more hydrated. I will definitely be throwing this into my skin care routine a few times a week.

reviews.product_name: Alpha Beta Extra Strength Daily Peel Pads
reviews.review_text: I have to say once again I’m blown away by Dr  Gross skincare line. These are easy to use for travel. You will see results immediately.  My skin was softer, and brighter. Fines lined lines dissapeared.  Something I will definitely continue to use.

reviews.product_name: Advanced Night Repair Eye Gel-Cream
reviews.review_text: Recieved this product for my honest review and it’s a YES for me. Within one week I noticed a difference in my dark circles. I’m turning 40 this year and my skin has been dry.  This gave me some much needed hydration.

reviews.product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C
reviews.review_text: I received this product complimentary for testing purposes and was really happy with how soft they made my lips. The scent was a bonus. This will be a life saver when it’s winter.

reviews.product_name: Cream Skin Toner & Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I loved this toner. This quickly became a part of my daily skincare routine. It left my skin feeling super refreshed, hydrated and soft. I would for sure get this product again.

reviews.product_name: The True Cream Aqua Bomb
reviews.review_text: I really liked this moisturizer! It is super lightweight and applies onto the skin like gel. It absorbed into my skin very quickly and left of feeling hydrated and glowy.

reviews.product_name: Aqua Bomb Hydrating Toner
reviews.review_text: This is a great toner! Super gentle but effective way to clear your skin. I loved that it didn’t strip my skin and left it feeling great. I have super sensitive skin and this didn’t irritate it at all.

reviews.product_name: T.L.C. Sukari Babyfacial AHA + BHA Mask
reviews.review_text: I can’t believe that I had no negative reaction from this! Finally a product that did not aggravate my very sensitive skin. It actually does what it claims! It resurfaces and reveals smooth skin. Yay!

reviews.product_name: The Rice Polish Foaming Enzyme Powder
reviews.review_text: This is an excellent gentle scrub for very sensitive skin. It leaves my skin smooth, bright, and polished. Using once a week, the travel size will last me a few months.

reviews.product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C
reviews.review_text: This is excellent at moisturizing my very dry lips. And it’s not just for bedtime! I just ordered the 100 point reward as an extra for my purse!

reviews.product_name: Ready Steady Glow Daily AHA Tonic
reviews.review_text: I’ve been wanting to add a lactic acid to my skincare routine, so I was really hoping this would work for me. Unfortunately it irritated my sensitive skin. It’s also very sticky, even after applying moisturizer.

reviews.product_name: Mini Ready Steady Glow Daily AHA Tonic
reviews.review_text: I’ve been wanting to add a lactic acid to my skincare routine, so I was really hoping this would work for me. Unfortunately it irritated my sensitive skin. It’s also very sticky, even after applying moisturizer.

reviews.product_name: Banana Bright 15% Vitamin C Serum
reviews.review_text: I received this from Influenster and I’m so glad I did! This is a beautiful smelling serum that sinks nicely into the skin and plays well with my other skin care. After a week of use I’ve noticed my skin is brighter looking and has a glow to it. I love Vitamin C products and this is a great addition to my routine.

reviews.product_name: Aqua Bomb Cleansing Balm
reviews.review_text: I love cleansing balms, and this one is no exception. It has a nice, fresh scent and feels great when massages into the skin. It starts as a solid, but quickly turns into an oil when massaged onto the face. I especially like that it rinses clean with no oily residue. It did a good job of taking off my makeup, but I always follow up with a gentle cleanser anyways. Left my skin feeling soft and clean, not stripped. I received this compliments of Influenster but can see myself purchasing it again.

reviews.product_name: The True Cream Aqua Bomb
reviews.review_text: This is a nice, lightweight moisturizer that works well for my dry skin. The gel texture spreads evenly and sinks in quickly leaving my skin feeling hydrated. One star off because I don’t care for the scent, but that’s personal preference.

reviews.product_name: Cicapair Tiger Grass Serum
reviews.review_text: It was just ok. The dropper kept the product protected from bacteria but it also ended up leaving a lot of product behind that I couldn’t get out once it got below a certain level. The serum didn’t irritate my skin but I also didn’t notice it making much of an improvement in my redness. I wouldn’t buy it again.

reviews.product_name: Niacinamide 10% + Zinc 1% Oil Control Serum
reviews.review_title: That’s a No For Me Dawg
reviews.review_text: Literally saw zero difference with this. I get occasional breakouts and have rosacea so I was hoping this would do more for my redness. I can’t speak for people who have acne scars but this definitely didn’t help my redness or prevent breakouts. Nice texture and cheap. That’s it.

reviews.product_name: Glycolic Acid 7% Exfoliating Toning Solution
reviews.review_text: This is great for getting the last bit of makeup off while resurfacing your skin. I have sensitive skin with rosacea and this didn’t aggravate it.  I used it after cleansing but before essence and serums. I noticed a difference in my skin fairly quickly.

reviews.product_name: Watermelon Glow Niacinamide Dew Drops
reviews.review_text: This smells nice, feels good putting on, and makes a nice dewy glow on the skin afterwards. BUT I don’t notice it making a difference in the appearance of my skin. Maybe overall it’s less dry appearing?  But that’s it. No difference in pores or skin tone. I still get occasional breakouts. It’s business as usual. I bought this on James Welch’s recommendation because we have similar skin types and I was just underwhelmed. Not sure what I spent so much money for?  I’ll go back to just getting HA acid serum from TO or Inkey List.

reviews.product_name: The True Cream Moisturizing Bomb
reviews.review_text: The product itself is amazing. Lightweight but somehow incredibly rich texture at the same time. My skin feels so moisturized after using this!  It has a really light and natural fragrance that is really pleasant. It doesn’t irritate my reactive skin and it really moisturizes for a long time. I feel like my skin has improved since using it!  I wish they would change the packaging though, I don’t like dipping my finger in the pot.

reviews.product_name: The Dewy Serum Resurfacing and Plumping Treatment
reviews.review_text: received this product for free or complimentary for testing purposes So hydrating! I started using it a few weeks ago, morning and night. The glow in the morning is great but waking up with the skin so soft and radiant is even better. Another thing I like is that it is gentle on my skin.

reviews.product_name: Revitalizing Supreme+ Youth Power Creme Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: My skin is smooth and soft, it gave me a beautiful glow. I am using morning and night, after my serum. Works great Under makeup. Actually I feel it makes my make up even better! Awesome product!

reviews.product_name: Mini Revitalizing Supreme+ Youth Power Creme Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: My skin is smooth and soft, it gave me a beautiful glow. I am using morning and night, after my serum. Works great Under makeup. Actually I feel it makes my make up even better! Awesome product!

reviews.product_name: Confidence in a Cream Anti-Aging Hydrating Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: My experience with IT cosmetics products is always wonderful. This confidence in a créam is amazing as usual with it cosmetic. Keeps my skin hydrated and radiant. I think it is perfect to use morning/night and before makeup! Awesome product

reviews.product_name: Hyaluronic Acid Hydrating Serum
reviews.review_text: I’ve been using this product everyday 2x a day (morning and night) since I received it and I love it!  It quickly absorbs into the skin!  It has made my skin feel so smooth, hydrated, and plump especially for living in a dry climate like LA! Just FYI, a little goes a long way!I love that The Inkey List focuses its money more on the product rather than the packaging and branding resulting in it being so affordable!!  I also love that this product is made without all of those unnecessary fillers and preservatives. Even though I did receive this product for free for testing purposes, I would definitely purchase it!

reviews.product_name: B-Hydra Intensive Hydration Serum with Hyaluronic Acid
reviews.review_text: This product has been my holy grail while I’ve traveling for the holidays! Since just adding this one product into my routine, it has helped reduced redness, flakiness, and has cleared out my skin from breakouts.  I love that the product is lightweight and not sticky! My skin has been glowing, plump, and so hydrated ever since I started using this product. I love that it is designed to work well with other products.  I also love that Drunk Elephant is a clean brand!  I did receive this product for free for testing purposes however, I did end up purchasing it for my brother because he was looking for a Hyaluronic Acid and out of all of the ones I’ve used so far, this has been my favorite!

reviews.product_name: Umbra Sheer Physical Daily Defense SPF 30
reviews.review_title: Good For Your Skin And The Environment
reviews.review_text: This is such an amazing sunscreen! I’ve used the tinted one before which is equally as great but I also really like this one as Drunk Elephant Umbra Tinte Physical Daily Defense Broad Spectrum Sunscreen SPF 30 (tinted). When first applied, it is super creamy and there is that white residue, BUT within a minute, it completely disappears!  In terms of ingredients, it has many beneficial natural ingredients for the skin!  What’s unique about this sunscreen is that it has Marula oil (Drunk Elephant is famous for theirs) in it so it is also very hydrating for those winter months and also post sunburn!  This sunscreen protects and heals the skin!  I also like that this ISN’T a chemical sunscreen and IS reef safe!  Not only are you doing good to your skin, but also to the environment!  I did receive this for free for testing purposes but that doesn’t change my perception on this item!

reviews.product_name: Advanced Génifique Radiance Boosting Face Serum
reviews.review_text: This burned my skin within minutes. Had to remove it. My skin is a little sensitive, but not excessively so, so I wouldn’t recommend this if your skin is at all sensitive.

reviews.product_name: Vegan Milk Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: HOLY COW this is amazing. This is a thick, luxurious moisturizer and my dry winter skin is IN LOVE. I love that it’s silicone free and doesn’t pill/roll off my skin, and I really notice that my skin is well hydrated all day long. New holy grail for winter skin!

reviews.product_name: F-Balm Electrolyte Waterfacial Mask
reviews.review_text: How has this product been on the market less than 3 weeks and it already has an old smell? I LOVE unscented products but this seriously smells like something in it has already gone bad. I’m also really not impressed with the level of hydration. I’ve tried it a few times now in combo with my other skincare and by itself and it just isn’t giving me a hydrated feeling when I wake up the next morning. I do have fairly dry skin so perhaps this is better for more oily types but if it advertises intense hydration, it should deliver.

reviews.product_name: Superberry Hydrate + Glow Dream Night Mask with Vitamin C
reviews.review_text: This smells nice without being overbearing. It feels great when I apply it to my skin, but when I wake up in the morning my skin feels very dry, not moisturized at all. My typical evening routine is retinol and a few drops of oil after I get out of the shower post-workout, then add a moisturizer right before bed, and this replaced my moisturizer step. I feel like my skin is happier with their Adaptogen Deep Moisture Cream than this.

reviews.product_name: Mini Superberry Hydrate + Glow Dream Mask
reviews.review_text: This smells nice without being overbearing. It feels great when I apply it to my skin, but when I wake up in the morning my skin feels very dry, not moisturized at all. My typical evening routine is retinol and a few drops of oil after I get out of the shower post-workout, then add a moisturizer right before bed, and this replaced my moisturizer step. I feel like my skin is happier with their Adaptogen Deep Moisture Cream than this.

reviews.product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C
reviews.review_text: I use this stuff nightly. It goes on nicely, feels luxurious, and my lips still feel very well moisturized when I wake up the next morning. The jar also lasts forever. Definitely a must-have!

reviews.product_name: 5 Stars Retinol + Niacinamide Eye Serum
reviews.review_text: I have been using this for about 2 months. I cannot use it every night - usually 2 nights on, 1 night off - or else my skin gets too sensitive. That said, I have noticed an honest to goodness improvement in the fine lines under my eyes. They aren’t gone, but they are DEFINITELY less deep/defined. If you have sensitive skin or if you also used vitamin C in the mornings, be warned! This product packs a punch and you’ll need to moisturize well. 100% worth it though, and I will forever be repurchasing this one.

reviews.product_name: Squalane + Omega Repair Deep Hydration Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: Excellent texture, gives long-lasting moisture for my very dry skin. I ignored the reviews about half-empty jars as I understand how selling by fluid oz works, but when people say it smells like feet, they’re right. It 100% smells like feet. I’ll keep using it for winter skin but won’t be rebuying.

reviews.product_name: Capture Totale Super Potent Eye Serum
reviews.review_text: I had noticed that I had fine lines and wrinkles due to aging and tanning beds. I have used this for about 2 weeks and I have noticed that some of the worse lines and wrinkles are not as noticeable as before. This is a creamy gel that soaks into the skin and I have sensitive skin and so far this has not bothered me.

reviews.product_name: The Essence Skincare Boosting Treatment
reviews.review_text: Product is very watery so be careful when applying because you will waste alot. All I can tell is that my skin is softer other than that my skin is the same.

reviews.product_name: Mini The Essence  Skincare Boosting Treatment
reviews.review_text: Product is very watery so be careful when applying because you will waste alot. All I can tell is that my skin is softer other than that my skin is the same.

reviews.product_name: Santorini Grape Poreless Skin Cream
reviews.review_text: From what I have used so far this is a great moisturizer for your face especially if you live in the dry winter climate. I use in the morning and my face feels soft and hydrated all day.

reviews.product_name: Hello FAB Coconut Skin Smoothie Priming Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I have dry skin and purchased this as I was looking for a hydrating primer which would also minimize my pores. I feel like this should be used as a moisturizer only as it did nothing for my pores and I don’t find my foundation lasting or looking good all day. My face looks cakey/powdery after a few hours. I won’t be repurchasing.

reviews.product_name: Green Clean Makeup Removing Cleansing Balm
reviews.review_text: This is a great balm. I used Clinique and Pixi previously and didn’t have mych to compare to. After just one use, I was in love with this product. It has a light, clean scent and removes my makeup including my eye makeup. I don’t think there can be anything better.

reviews.product_name: Green Clean Makeup Meltaway Cleansing Balm Limited Edition Jumbo
reviews.review_text: This is a great balm. I used Clinique and Pixi previously and didn’t have mych to compare to. After just one use, I was in love with this product. It has a light, clean scent and removes my makeup including my eye makeup. I don’t think there can be anything better.

reviews.product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C
reviews.review_text: I think it goes without saying, this Mask is amazing!!! All the positive reviews are not for nothing. If you haven’t purchased this yet, you truly are missing out on an essential item in your lip care.

reviews.product_name: Superberry Hydrate + Glow Dream Night Mask with Vitamin C
reviews.review_text: AMAZING! I have dry skin and this product keeps my skin soft and supple.  This is better than any cream or moisturizer I have ever used. An absolute staple.

reviews.product_name: Mini Superberry Hydrate + Glow Dream Mask
reviews.review_text: AMAZING! I have dry skin and this product keeps my skin soft and supple.  This is better than any cream or moisturizer I have ever used. An absolute staple.

reviews.product_name: Luna Sleeping Retinoid Night Oil
reviews.review_text: I purchased this as part of a set with their moisturizer and was not impressed with either product. The oil did moisturize my skin but I didn’t see any results from whatever retinol is claimed to be in the product. I have since tried other brands. I would never purchase this again or recommend this product. I’ll stick with DE Retinol which is worth the extra bucks.

reviews.product_name: A-Passioni Retinol Cream
reviews.review_text: Im not new to acids but I am new to retinol. I usually have dry skin, and with this added to my nightly skincare routine, I feel complete. A little bit does go a long way, I use a small pea sized amount on five areas of my face, 3 on my neck and three on my chest. I was scared it would be too drying but with a hydrating cleanser, glow recipes plum plump hyaluronic acid serum, a good toner and with an oil I use lastly most nights, Im good. I also recommend their marula oil. I do think my skin looks better. Im very critical of skincare products, I spend a lot of money on skincare and consider myself a fanatic... so i dont say this lightly when i say this is a good quality and effective product. I find since its soo thick and creamy, I can use less than my usual vitamin c serum and I find the price to be right. I will repurchase and I do lastly recommend that you keep this in a skincare fridge or a fridge you have at home.

reviews.product_name: Watermelon Glow Niacinamide Dew Drops
reviews.review_title: i did not get this for free.
reviews.review_text: I am pleasantly surprised by this serum, i thought it would be shimmery since you can use this as a highlighter. i bought this for skincare purposes, i really love how this dew drop serum sinks in its slightly tacky which i like and it smells really good. i do notice my skin is more even and hydrated and less red! i used two pumps under my moisturizer and one pump with my night cream and my skin feels plump and healthy. I’m gonna buy this again when i run out and explore other Glow Recipe products!

reviews.product_name: Honey Halo Ultra-Hydrating Ceramide Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I love that it smells like good quality honey, but if you are sensitive to scents then it might bother you. I dont notice it after its applied. Im very acne prone and this really nourishes my acne and dryness, it doesn’t make it worse which is a little rare for me. Definitely hydrating but not overly so, I can wear this night or day and I do. Its not greasy or thick its light and creamy but packs a hydrating punch. Its a really good versatile cream and I recommend it! I bought the largest size and Im so glad I did because i can tell it will last a while since you don’t need a lot! I think it helps my redness too and my angry acne is soothed.

reviews.product_name: The True Cream Aqua Bomb
reviews.review_text: I enjoyed this face quencher. I have super dry skin especially in my cheeks and under eyes. I slathered this on when I got it and my skin instantly drank it up and my face feels so much nicer! I definitely enjoyed this

reviews.product_name: C-Firma Fresh Vitamin-C Day Serum
reviews.review_text: Really liked that you now mix this product yourself to get the most out of the potency of it. It’s very refreshing and not sticky. Definitely noticed brightening. Very much enjoyed this product.

reviews.product_name: Santorini Grape Poreless Skin Cream
reviews.review_text: Really enjoyed this skin cream for my dry skin. Made my face feel very fresh and soft and best of all not greasy.

reviews.product_name: Good Genes All-In-One AHA Lactic Acid Treatment
reviews.review_text: I receive good genes , gifted by Sunday Riley and let me tell you this product is amazing  , after trying it for a few days I can say that I have seen I little change , my huge pores are not as visible it has left my face softer then ever, not a strong Smell I use it as a leave in treatment , added to my nightly routine.

reviews.product_name: Ultra Facial Moisturizing Cream with Squalane
reviews.review_text: This product work great on my dry skin, does not feel heavy when applied to my face, my face feels hydrated for house and easy when applying my make up, not sticky and does no have a smell which is a plus for me.

reviews.product_name: Mini Ultra Facial Moisturizing Cream with Squalane
reviews.review_text: This product work great on my dry skin, does not feel heavy when applied to my face, my face feels hydrated for house and easy when applying my make up, not sticky and does no have a smell which is a plus for me.

reviews.product_name: Dewtopia 20% Acid Night Treatment
reviews.review_text: Love how my face feels soft and hydrated all day long

reviews.product_name: Floral Recovery Overnight Mask with Squalane
reviews.review_text: This mask is incredibly hydrating and leaves my skin feeling supple and glowing. I have sensitive skin and this is my new fave mask. Has a pleasant smell,  not too overpowering. My boyfriend love this one too, his skin is even more sensitive than mine.

reviews.product_name: Sugar Lip Balm Hydrating Treatment
reviews.review_text: Lovely lip treatment! Super hydrating and made my lips really soft. Just a hint of pretty color. The vessel is quite lovely. They were kind enough to send me this complimentary from Fresh to test, but they are one of my fave brands and I will def be getting this again! I am a huge lip product lover and this passes the test.

reviews.product_name: Tea Elixir Niacinamide & Hyaluronic Acid Anti-Aging Serum
reviews.review_text: Has a nice lightweight milky texture and a pleasant natural smell. The packaging is super luxe, and the product did not disappoint. It left me skin feeling super hydrated and smooth. I paired it with the sugar lip treatment and these two are literally rescuing my skin from this dry summer heat.

reviews.product_name: Vegan Milk Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: This has instantly become my favorite moisturizer. I have really dry skin, especially in the colder months. This moisturizer is very thick and a little goes a long way. It keeps me hydrated all day long and it makes my foundation go on so smoothly. I definitely recommend if you have dry skin! You will love it!

reviews.product_name: Ultimate Sun Protector Lotion SPF 50+ Sunscreen
reviews.review_text: I love this spf! It blends into my skin so effortlessly and does not have a white cast. It does have a scent but it’s not a strong one for me. I absolutely love it!

reviews.product_name: Clear Sunscreen Stick SPF 50+
reviews.review_text: I love this! It is perfect for traveling and when you are on the go to reapply your spf. The formula is not so thick and doesn’t leave a whitecast.

reviews.product_name: Barrier+ Triple Lipid-Peptide Face Cream
reviews.review_text: I am 47 yrs old and my skin has very recently become very dry esp around my eyes, my chin, and nose. This cream is very rich and non-irritating. I kept slathering it on heavily until the dryness resolved; after several days it did. Now I just apply in the morning and evening. It is great under make up and really a must have for dryer skin at my age group.I am about to begin a regimen with The Ordinary and I will use this atop their serums. Excited to see the results!

reviews.product_name: Mini Barrier+ Triple Lipid-Peptide Face Cream
reviews.review_text: I am 47 yrs old and my skin has very recently become very dry esp around my eyes, my chin, and nose. This cream is very rich and non-irritating. I kept slathering it on heavily until the dryness resolved; after several days it did. Now I just apply in the morning and evening. It is great under make up and really a must have for dryer skin at my age group.I am about to begin a regimen with The Ordinary and I will use this atop their serums. Excited to see the results!

reviews.product_name: Vitamin C Suspension 23% + HA Spheres 2%
reviews.review_text: I use this product differently than described by The Ordinary. I layer a good amount on my face, pressing it in.  After 30 mins or so, I rub my skin really well and it seems to have an exfoliating effect for me (maybe due to the grittiness). What I am left with is extremely smooth skin and no gritty texture - skin completely ready for make up application. Makep application is even better if I put on a soothing product like dilo oil (kate sommerville) after this ordinary product.This Vit C product does sting around my eyes and irritate them so I tend to avoid it in this area but everywhere else, it is great.

reviews.product_name: Facial Treatment Essence (Pitera Essence)
reviews.review_title: This is just a three star product
reviews.review_text: This raved about so I decided to try it.It honestly doesn’t do much if anything. I saw no effects, positive or negative.The marketing campaign is well done but seriously misleading. If Pitera is such a great ingredient, SKII needs to up their game and the Pitera levels in this product. Until this is revised, don’t waste your money - get a cheaper essence instead.I gave this three stars because I enjoyed using it but could not assign more because of its lack of umph. I could have easily assigned it two stars.

reviews.product_name: Mini Facial Treatment Essence (Pitera Essence)
reviews.review_title: This is just a three star product
reviews.review_text: This raved about so I decided to try it.It honestly doesn’t do much if anything. I saw no effects, positive or negative.The marketing campaign is well done but seriously misleading. If Pitera is such a great ingredient, SKII needs to up their game and the Pitera levels in this product. Until this is revised, don’t waste your money - get a cheaper essence instead.I gave this three stars because I enjoyed using it but could not assign more because of its lack of umph. I could have easily assigned it two stars.

reviews.product_name: Niacinamide 10% + Zinc 1% Oil Control Serum
reviews.review_title: Niacinamide as a treatment is great
reviews.review_text: I use this product more as a treatment every few days than as a daily/nightly use product.I layer this on my face and let it dry - it definitely leaves a layer that will pill up - then layer on TO 23% Vitamin C lotion. After letting that set, I rub both products into my skin really well. It pills a lot and makes a bit of a mess but my skin is softer than any other product leaves it. It is completely exfoliated after this orocess. This treatment works so well for me I had to write about it. My skin is sensitive so I can only do this every four days or so but what a difference. Moisturizers work much better after this because they absorb so well, it is incredible. This is likely not the intended use but it works for me and no other product leaves my skin so supple. I hope others try this!

reviews.product_name: ExfoliKate Glow Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: This moisturizer has made a huge difference in the appearance of my skin! My skin feels great after applying and also doesn’t look dull. I use a heavier cream at night as I have drier skin but use this in the morning and feel it leaves my skin glowing!

reviews.product_name: Glowscreen Sunscreen SPF 40 PA+++ with Hyaluronic Acid + Niacinamide
reviews.review_text: Love this SPF! Looks beautiful under makeup or by itself. I love the slight glow it gives without being too shiny. Has definitely become my go to sunscreen for everyday wear.

reviews.product_name: Mini Glowscreen Sunscreen SPF 40 PA+++ with Hyaluronic Acid + Niacinamide
reviews.review_text: Love this SPF! Looks beautiful under makeup or by itself. I love the slight glow it gives without being too shiny. Has definitely become my go to sunscreen for everyday wear.

reviews.product_name: Honey Halo Ultra-Hydrating Ceramide Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: The only moisturizer that has replenished my dry skin! After having my daughter and breastfeeding my skin became very dry. This moisturizer has been a game changer. My skin feels plump and moisturized in the morning and I feel my makeup doesn’t settle on dry patches. (I do use a lighter moisturizer for day) I’ve just started to get my husband to use it as well since he is currently on Accutane and his skin has been very dry. His skin looks so hydrated now, barely any dry, flaky skin.

reviews.product_name: Watermelon Pink Juice Oil-Free Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I loved it. it smelled amazing and left my skin smooth after it dried into my skin. I ran through the product faster than i expected. This is not a “a little goes a long way“ product, but its only because it absorbed into your skin pretty quick which is perfect for my dry skin.

reviews.product_name: Avocado Soothing Skin Barrier Serum with Ceramides
reviews.review_text: This is the first “anti-redness” serum/product that has ACTUALLY worked for my sensitive dry acne prone skin! I’ve tried sooooo many that haven’t worked like this little serum does. I used it 2x a day for 4 weeks and decided to switch it up these past 2 weeks in only using it at night and it still delivers on its effectiveness! My redness is finally under control and all I need to do is find a product that will actually fade my old acne scars ;(

reviews.product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C
reviews.review_text: I love it! After one use it immediately rehydrated my lips from dry and cracked to moisturized and plump. I am pregnant and I am constantly drinking water but still my lips remained dry. I tried numerous chapsticks that helped for a few hours but nothing like this.

reviews.product_name: Hyaluronic Acid 2% + B5 Hydrating Serum
reviews.review_text: It’s a great product doesn’t layer well with anything so you do have to use it alone but totally worth the price. I want to try some others from this brand before I would repurchase but if you need a good hyaluronic acid is definitely worth it. I’ve used expensive brand that won’t layer well either so don’t not try it because of that.

reviews.product_name: Natural Moisturizing Factors + HA
reviews.review_text: This is so great I upgraded to the bigger size for my next purchase. It’s a great moisturizer for dry sensitive skin. I’m super allergic to fragrance now so to find some affordable options really makes me happy.

reviews.product_name: Vitamin C Suspension 23% + HA Spheres 2%
reviews.review_text: This is the best value you will ever get out of a vitamin c serum. The gritty texture is something to get use to but I’ve worked with professional brands that sell this stable powder for $60+. It’s the best I’ve tried because when you have a bit of water on skin it will Dissolve making it active which is why it’s so stable. No expiring or turning bad . It’s activated by water left on the skin or from your moisturizer you put on next. I love the whole line of products and will never change. They allow myself to try them all for the price of 1 luxury brand serum that’s loaded with unnecessary fragrance while this brand is fragrance free. You really have no chance of losing with these products.

reviews.product_name: The True Cream Aqua Bomb
reviews.review_text: I received this product complementary for testing purposes from Influenster and I really, really love this! I was skeptic as it claims to work for all skin types, when I see that, usually that means it’s not hydrating enough for my dry, particular skin. However! This Gel formula is moisturizing without an oily, greasy feel so I do believe that oily and combo would also enjoy this on their skin. My skin is hydrated, supple, plumped, feels luxurious and refreshed and the smell is very fresh and amazing, but not over powering. My bf said my skin looked flawless, say no more. Note that a little goes a long way, you don’t need much so this will last and is def worth the price. I highly recommend anyone looking to try. The only reason I gave it 4 stars instead of 5 is that it remains tacky on the skin for some time, having said that, it does feel like it sinks into my skin.

reviews.product_name: Aqua Bomb Hydrating Toner
reviews.review_text: I received this product complementary for testing purposes from Influenster and Belif and I love this toner. I have never met a toner that left my skin feeling hydrated and removed makeup debris. I haves used it for 2 weeks, my skin feeling hydrated , clean and refreshed and supple. I have dry finicky skin and a lot of toners are too drying. I am into the ingredients and the smell is amazing, very refreshing, luxurious and not over-powering. I will def  purchase and I highly recommend this for all skin types.

reviews.product_name: Abeille Royale Advanced Youth Watery Oil
reviews.review_text: I didn’t know what to expect but this is a beautifulProduct. I thought it would be oily and not soak into my skin but it does. The scent is lovely, but not overpowering and feels luxurious on my skin. I noticed that the lines on my forehead are definitely reduced after 3 weeks of use. I have dry skin, and it leaves my skin supple and hydrated without greasiness. It does leave the skin a slight but tacky but mot too much. I feel my skin does look more youthful and radiant.

reviews.product_name: Mini Abeille Royale Advanced Youth Watery Oil
reviews.review_text: I didn’t know what to expect but this is a beautifulProduct. I thought it would be oily and not soak into my skin but it does. The scent is lovely, but not overpowering and feels luxurious on my skin. I noticed that the lines on my forehead are definitely reduced after 3 weeks of use. I have dry skin, and it leaves my skin supple and hydrated without greasiness. It does leave the skin a slight but tacky but mot too much. I feel my skin does look more youthful and radiant.

reviews.product_name: GENIUS Liquid Collagen Serum
reviews.review_text: I’m on my second bottle of this. It is super moisturizing. If you have dry skin, this is a great serum. It contains niacinamide which is an anti-aging ingredient I love because it’s non-irritating and helps with age spots. The Concentrated Reconstructing Serum is similar but lighter.

reviews.product_name: The Dewy Serum Resurfacing and Plumping Treatment
reviews.review_text: Nice day serum for dry, mature skin. However I had a bad photo reaction while using it after only a few minutes in the sun. Made my neck itch for days after stopping use.

reviews.product_name: The Silk Peony Melting Eye Cream
reviews.review_text: I first tried this eye cream with a deluxe sample. I have very dry crepey eye skin. This eye cream is very good. It hydrates and plumps the skin around the eyes to substantially improve skin texture. I am on my 4th jar.

reviews.product_name: The Dewy Skin Cream Plumping & Hydrating Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: Love this stuff. Adorable packaging. If only it was refillable. Scented. Lovely lavender color and rich texture. Long lasting moisture for dry winter skin. Dewy finish.

reviews.product_name: Tonique Confort Re-Hydrating Comforting Toner with Acacia Honey
reviews.review_text: This toner gave me clogged pores after using it for a month. Heavy but not unpleasant fragrance.

reviews.product_name: Beste No. 9 Jelly Cleanser
reviews.review_text: Bought this for my sister.  She LOVES this cleanser for removing makeup.  She’s very picky and says this is a great cleanser.

reviews.product_name: T.L.C. Sukari Babyfacial AHA + BHA Mask
reviews.review_text: Bought this for my sister.  She LOVES this stuff and she is super picky!  She changes her mind all the time, but she has been using DE for over 1 year and says she will never change.  She has found her holy grail.

reviews.product_name: Protini Polypeptide Firming Refillable Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I cannot live without this moisturizer.  I ran out for 1 month and began looking like a raisin...at least 10 years older!  Got back with this firming moisturizer and the marula oil and my face is young and fresh again.  I cannot run out of this ANYMORE!!!

reviews.product_name: Salicylic Acid Acne Healing Dots
reviews.review_title: It did work, but took some time
reviews.review_text: I had a pimple on my forehead for about 4 or 5 days and it would just not go away. I decided to use a peace out acne dot on it. After my first use, the redness had finally subsided and the pimple wasn’t as painful. After three uses it was gone. I’ve had acne resistant to treatment before, so maybe this product would work better for someone who has pimples here and there rather than all the time.

reviews.product_name: Urban Environment Fresh-Moisture Sunscreen Broad-Spectrum SPF 42
reviews.review_text: I liked using this as a daily sunscreen. It is the consistency of a normal lotion and has a faint smell of sunscreen that fades quickly and doesn’t last all day. This is a huge plus for me because I don’t want to smell sunscreen all day and I don’t want others to think I smell like sunscreen all day either. It does leave a slightly shiny, hydrated skin type of look. I applied it first before primer and makeup. My makeup still stayed on all day. reviews.review_title: A New Addition To My Beauty Routine!
reviews.review_text: I have tried other Drunk Elephant products and was not impressed by them so I didn’t have high expectations for this one. I was also hoping I wouldn’t love this because of the price. Within a day, I saw results. I have severe eczema and the only thing that has provided some relief is a prescription ointment. I’ve been using this for about a month now, and this has made my skin the best it has been in years. I keep getting compliments on how beautiful my skin looks and how much it glows. As someone with eczema, this is the biggest compliment I could receive! I use one pump a day, and you can barely tell I’ve used it based on how much is left.  There are 3 negatives that I can think of, but the benefits definitely outweigh them.  I did end up spilling some when I was mixing, but it really wasn’t much. Another negative is the smell and feeling. My skin was left sticky and it had a weird smell to it. I put a lotion on after and the smell and feeling went away. My final negative is the price. Since I only use one pump, I think it is completely worth the cost. I absolutely love this product and I will definitely be purchasing this in the future!

reviews.product_name: Indigo Overnight Repair Serum in Cream Treatment

reviews.review_text: I received this after I used up my usual night cream and couldn’t find it so I was very excited! When I started using this, I immediately started seeing results. I had never seen my skin look so even and glowy! A little goes a long way and you can really feel it sealing in moisture, which some people might feel greasy or sticky. I wake up with soft and refreshed skin! I don’t even need my eczema medication anymore! I have received so many compliment on my skin since using this and I am so happy that I finally found a solution to my eczema. I love this product so much that I even bought the body butter from this collection! Rhe packaging on both are so cute and feel luxurious. The only negatives I can think of are the applicator spoon and the price. While I love that it has a spoon so I don’t have to put my finger inside the jar, I wish the spoon attached to the jar somehow. I haven’t lost it yet, but I have dropped it many times already. The other negative would be the price. This product is $88 for only 1.7 oz. I have been using this for about a month, and still have a lot of product left. I will purchase this when I run out, because I no longer need to use a prescription ointment and I have never felt so confident with my skin. I know want to try more products from this company!

reviews.review_text: Such a great serum, goes on really smooth over the skin. Leaves the skin plump and bouncy. Gives. Nice glow and the packaging is so pretty and good quality too. It’s very lightweight, not greasy or tacky at all. My skin looks healthy and glowing. Love it.

reviews.product_name: Lippe Balm
reviews.review_text: Have 3, one by my bed, one in my bag, and one in my bathroom.  Not sticky like Burts Bees, very slick texture. When you apply at night, lips are still soft in the morning. long lasting.

reviews.product_name: Protini Polypeptide Firming Refillable Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I have both the Drunk Elephant moisturizers and go between both depending on what my skin needs.  I use this mainly at night because of its firming properties, but like it during the day too. Still a rich cream but thinner than their other. Moisturized all day. Not giving five stars because sometimes it stings when applying the entire drunk elephant routine, even when I am less aggressive with applying all the products. I am on about my 4th jar, will continue to repurchase unless I find something amazing.

reviews.product_name: Self Tanning Bronzing Face Drops
reviews.review_text: I apply about 3 drops into my Drunk Elephant moisturizers about once a week. gives nice healthy glow. can apply either day or night. be sure to diffuse the edges of your moisturizer or else you can get a harsh line. smell is not like most fake tanners, which I like.

reviews.product_name: Pure Skin Face Cleanser
reviews.review_text: This is my favorite Face Cleanser. I have used this for years. I have dry skin and this does not dry out my skin.It suds up well and I use with the Sephora scrubby cleaner.  I use with Origins GinZing moisturizer

reviews.product_name: Cleansing & Exfoliating Wipes
reviews.review_text: I buy the Green Tea scent for my daughter and mother it is an exfoliating wipe. I find it a little rough but they like them. They do smell nice. I love the Yuzu scent. It is great for removing make up especially eye make up. It smells great too. I want to try the Rose sometime.

reviews.product_name: GinZing Ultra-Hydrating Energy-Boosting Cream
reviews.review_text: This is my all time favorite moisturizer. I have been using this for years. I have very dry skin and this smooths my skin out. I use it morning and night. I love the fresh orange smell too. Would recommend.

reviews.product_name: Green Clean Makeup Removing Cleansing Balm
reviews.review_text: My new Holy Grail makeup remover.  Melts everything and smells divine!  All my makeup, even mascara comes off effortlessly.  I used to hate taking off my mascara, I felt like I had to go over and over my lashes.  But now I use it the way the company advises and it comes off easily with no harsh rubbing, at 57 years old I do not need to be rubbing my eye area morevvthan absolutely necessary.

But I use it every night as my second cleanse if I’m wearing makeup,  if not it’s my only cleanser before all my Drunk Elephant goodies.  I only use Drunk Elephant skincare now, besides my balm and my 57 year old skin has not looked this good for 30 years!

reviews.product_name: A-Passioni Retinol Cream
reviews.review_text: The texture and amount to use is perfect for my skin.  I can see improvement after two months  of use and highly recommend this product for anyone wanting to try retinol.  Easy to use.

reviews.review_text: After just one week I noticed a huge improvement in my skin texture, pore size, acne scars & regular scars, and a noticeable glow. I highly recommend having this as a staple in your skincare, after 3 weeks of using it I am a firm believer in this miracle in a bottle!

reviews.review_text: I have very very sensitive skin, and this product didn’t irritate me or break it out at all. I also noticed a lot less breakouts after I started using it too. i’ve been using it for over two months now. This is a holy grail and must have product for me now. I highly highly recommend

reviews.product_name: Skinlongevity Long Life Herb Anti-Aging Face Serum
reviews.review_text: I really love this serum! My skin is really sensitive and I have a lot of redness. This serum seriously calms my skin down within minutes. The redness is gone and my skin has been glowing so much more since I started using this!

reviews.review_text: This eye cream is very hydrating and thick, which I love. You also don’t need a lot to have it be effective. It also layers well under makeup. I do find it to be a bit expensive but if you are looking for some extra under eye hydration, then this is a good choice

reviews.product_name: Aqua Bomb Brightening Vitamin C Cream
reviews.review_text: This moisturizer has a really nice refreshing scent. It left my face feeling moisturized throughout the day which doesn’t always happen as I have really dry skin. I didn’t notice that my skin was significantly brighter or anything. Personally I would just stick with the original aqua bomb.

reviews.product_name: Green Clean Makeup Removing Cleansing Balm
reviews.review_text: Love this product! One of the easiest makeup balms I’ve tried! It’s amazing!

reviews.review_text: I received a free sample of this product from Pinch me. I love it . My skin is softer and looks healthier. I will continue to use it. I highly recommend it.

reviews.product_name: Alpha Beta Pore Perfecting & Refining Serum
reviews.review_text: Dr. Dennis Gross Alpha Beta Pore Perfecting Serum is a wonderful product. I noticed positive results quickly. My pores became smaller and tighter. reviews.product_name: Confidence in a Cream Anti-Aging Hydrating Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I love Confidence in a Creme. It is an excellent moisturizer.  It makes my skin feel so soft and moisturized.  It has made my fine lines and wrinkles less noticeable.  My skin looks and feels healthier. It works better than other products that I have tried.  I will continue to use this product and highly recommend it.

reviews.product_name: Cleansing & Exfoliating Wipes
reviews.review_text: I always have to buy a pack of the watermelon wipes when I go to Sephora! They smell amazing, and don’t leave your skin feeling depleted of moisture like many other makeup wipes do.

reviews.product_name: Sugar Advanced Lip Balm Intense Hydration Treatment
reviews.review_text: This is hands-down the best lip balm I have ever tried! I got a free sample with my Sephora points, and now I’m hooked! reviews.product_name: Multi-Peptide + HA Serum
reviews.review_title: Great serum for anti-aging and hydration.
reviews.review_text: This is a great serum. I have noticed a reduction in fine lines, and an increase in skin hydration since using this. The Ordinary is such an incredible brand. This is one of my favorite products from them.

reviews.product_name: Skinlongevity Long Life Herb Anti-Aging Face Serum
reviews.review_text: I’ve been using this serum twice a day for 3 weeks and I’ve noticed a difference in my skin tone. It’s lightened up my sun spots and reduced some of my fine lines. The scent is subtle and not long lasting. I have really dry sensitive skin and the product does seep into my skin. The weather here has been mainly 70% humidity while trying this product. I am considering repurchasing as a preventative from future fine lines.

reviews.product_name: Advanced Night Repair Eye Concentrate Matrix Synchronized Multi-Recovery Complex
reviews.review_text: The applicator is kind of nice to have because I hate getting product under nails. The draw back is the reach to scoop all the product out from the bottle. The cream has a light medicine scent. I didn’t notice a big difference and I’ve been using it for 3 weeks. I have dry sensitive skin and it did not irritate my skin. This product was not a wow factor for me, but it might work for others.

reviews.product_name: Smart Clinical Repair Wrinkle Correcting Eye Cream
reviews.review_text: This is a decent moisturizing eye cream. I  didn’t notice it correcting my minor wrinkles. It might help prevent new ones I guess. The price point might be steep if it’s only moisturizing.

reviews.product_name: Santorini Grape Poreless Skin Cream
reviews.review_text: My sensitive skin dry skin approves. I don’t feel like I have huge pores so I can’t really tell if they minimized. I can tell that my skin is noticeably softer. The cream has a light pleasant scent. I’ve been applying it at night. I am considering repurchasing this item.

reviews.review_text: I love this product. The whole Caudalie line is really helping me with this maskne. Such an elegant bottle and it smells so clean. It’s part of my everyday ritual and I always feel so glamorous. Every morning and evening is my spa time.
