reviews.product_name: Smart Clinical Repair Wrinkle Correcting Cream
reviews.review_text: I have really dry skin.  This moisturizer has made my skin feel so soft and smooth anytime I have used it.  It leaves my skin feeling & looking so nice & plump. reviews.product_name: Glow2OH Dark Spot Toner
reviews.review_text: I did find this toner to brighten up my skin. I have been using it at night and while it does tingle a bit, it seems to be doing the trick. It has been a part of my nightly ritual. Don’t forget to use SPF the next morning! My makeup seems to be sitting nicer and smoother on my face. Definitely will continue to use it.I received this product as a complimentary free sample to test.

reviews.product_name: Magic Cream Moisturizer with Hyaluronic Acid
reviews.review_title: Good stuff! Going to keep using it!
reviews.review_text: Wasn’t sure what to expect at first but enjoyed the smell and consistency and feel on my skin. I can’t say it for sure has erased any of my wrinkles but do feel like it helped even out some skin tone and hydrate my dry skin. I noticed I needed to be careful in the sun and my skin felt sensitive the day after use on a long hike. Will continue to use it in hopes of rewinding all of my signs of aging, especially the crows feet around my eyes!!

reviews.product_name: Plum Plump Hyaluronic Acid Serum
reviews.review_text: My skin could use some serious love and moisture as well as glow and just a little extra love as I’m in the sun a lot. I will say I did struggle to figure out how to operate the bottle for a day or two and couldn’t manage to get the top off with the pump, but after getting that sorted out, I’m using it daily and love how it makes my skin feel refreshed!

It also made my pores look bigger and basically made my skin look dull and nothing like it normally does.  Please try a sample before you waste money on this product.

reviews.review_text: I don’t often write reviews for products but this stuff is A-MAZING.  My dry skin is hydrated and glowing.  I haven’t been breaking out at all. My skin is much brighter. My mom tried it once and referred to it as miraculous. And it is!!

reviews.review_text: I love all Youth to the People products, but this oil is really something special.  I use it at night under the Adaptogen Deep Moisturizer, and I put two drops in with my CC cream in the morning. My skin looks smooth, bright, and hydrated.  The fine lines I notice on my forehead seem to have almost disappeared.  A must buy. I bought it for my mother and she loves it as well.

reviews.product_name: Adaptogen Deep Moisturizing Cream with Ashwagandha + Reishi
reviews.review_text: I love this moisturizer. It’s lightweight but extremely moisturizing and calming. I also love that it’s clean.

reviews.review_text: I was so pleasantly surprised with this product! I’m always wary of “overnight” products for some reason just because I always worry about having a reaction or breaking out. My lips have never been better! Not only does this moisturizer but it also smoothed out lines on the lips! Gave it that super smooth “injection” look if you know what I mean! Also a little bit goes a long way and it comes with so much product.

reviews.product_name: Cold Plunge Pore Mask
reviews.review_text: This is one of my first products from OleHenriksen and I have to say I’m in love. This mask feels so nice and cooling on the skin and what I really like is that unlike other clay masks it doesn’t give you that dry, tightening feeling or crack on your face. Got as a sample but will definitely be purchasing full size

reviews.product_name: Protini Polypeptide Firming Refillable Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: This product although on the pricier end, is well worth the money. The ingredients are all good quality and it even has the clean Sephora seal of approval on it! I have combo/very dry flaky skin and with this moisturizer you feel an immediate improvement to the skin. One of the things I love about it is it doesn’t leave you looking greasy, it just makes your skin look naturally healthy and radiant! Since using this product my texture has improved and so have my fine lines!

reviews.product_name: Advanced Génifique Radiance Boosting Face Serum
reviews.review_text: Really good for right after cleansing. I used this in the morning and night time, right after cleansing. It does have a light fragrance to it and it leaves skin feeling very dewy. I did receive this product for testing purposes.

reviews.product_name: Magic Cream Moisturizer with Hyaluronic Acid
reviews.review_text: The cream itself is very moisturizing and it feels like it sinks in to your skin. I used it at night for about 4 nights in a row now. My skin feels very soft and very hydrated. However, I don’t really like the smell and the texture of the cream. The smell is very rosey and it’s a bit strong for my taste. I prefer non scented items. Also, the texture: it feels very sticky like sunscreen. So after putting the cream on, I always want to wash my hands because it’s so sticky and I dislike that feeling of having sunscreen - like feeling on my hands. I did like that the cream contained rosehip and camelia oils and hyaluronic acid. My other skin care routine products include these ingredients as well. Tip: I use Magic Cream only during night time. First day, I used it in the morning but it made my makeup greasy after applying on top of the Magic Cream. I received this product complimentary for reviewing purposes but all the opinion is my own.

reviews.product_name: The True Cream Moisturizing Bomb
reviews.review_text: Love this product! I love how it feels on my skin and it’s very refreshing. The only thing I would mention is that it is a very heavy texture cream so it does take some effort with your fingers for your skin to absorb all or most of the cream. Other than that, I would recommend this product and it really moisturized my skin!

It made my skin feel so hydrated and plump. My skin feels softer when I use this and I don’t have to use as much serum or moisturizer.

reviews.product_name: Violet-C Brightening Serum 20% Vitamin C + 10% AHA
reviews.review_text: I received this product complimentary from Influenster to try and I really enjoyed it! It made my skin look and feel very even in tone and texture and helped my skin feel hydrated! I truly enjoyed it.

reviews.product_name: Violet-C Brightening Serum 20% Vitamin C + 10% AHA
reviews.review_text: I’ve been using this product daily for over 6 weeks with only other tatcha products and all I can say is wow!  I’ve always looked for my holy grail of skin care, and used a mix of la Mer, DE, Sunday Riley, biossance, SKII you name it I put it on my face!  Switching to tatcha transformed my skin the way I always hoped something would!  I’m 40 years old and people now think I’m in my late 20s to 30s!  As for this product specifically, my age spots and freackling is almost non existent now!  I truly have makeup optional skin!  It brightens differently than any other vitamin C product I’ve used, as my entire face has a more uniform appearance and general brightness to it!  1 pump is more than enough for your whole face.  I use morning and night and ALWAYS follow with sunscreen!  You’re gonna love it, so prepare your bank account, lol!!

reviews.product_name: Papaya Sorbet Smoothing Enzyme Cleansing Balm & Makeup Remover
reviews.review_text: I am a die hard tatcha girl, but have been venturing out a bit lately and glow recipe has not disappointed!  My usual is the camellia cleansing oil by tatcha, but this is a great alternative and I’m reaching for this instead!  It feels so thick and rich on my skin and smells just like fresh papaya!  I will say when you first add water it changes the texture and feels almost like lard on your skin.  Then one more splash of water and it starts to breakdown beautifully.  I love that my skin feels moisturized and glowing after this step instead of desperate for the next step of my routine.  When I am beyond exhausted, I can use this and my favorite face oil and just go to bed and wake up glowing like I used my 10 step regimen!

reviews.product_name: Indigo Overnight Repair Serum in Cream Treatment
reviews.review_text: Amazing product!  I use mostly all tatcha, but every now and then I get overzealous with the peels and acids.  I received a sample of this, and it literally fixed the redness, bumps and irritation in one night!  Pretty hooked to say the least!

reviews.product_name: Mini Indigo Overnight Repair Serum in Cream Treatment
reviews.review_text: Amazing product!  I use mostly all tatcha, but every now and then I get overzealous with the peels and acids.  I received a sample of this, and it literally fixed the redness, bumps and irritation in one night!  Pretty hooked to say the least!

reviews.product_name: Blue Tansy BHA and Enzyme Pore Refining Mask
reviews.review_text: This mask has transformed my skin. This was the first product that I ever purchased from Sephora and the only reason I returned and gave other products a chance. Gave me a reason to believe that products that actually do what they promise exist. The mask stings a bit upon application, but the sensation subsided after a minute or so. After 2-3 uses that sensations goes away all together. I personally saw instant results after just one use- my skin became softer, smoother, cleaner, and clearer. My small pimples subsided and red spots disappeared all together. My pores were significantly smaller and all blackheads were gone. I cannot praise this product enough. I recommended it to all my friends.

reviews.product_name: Niacinamide 10% + Zinc 1% Oil Control Serum
reviews.review_text: I love love love this product! The niacinamide tighten and minimizes pores and the zinc helps eliminate acne. It’s an established part of my nightly regiment. It works best when used twice a day (morning & night) but the only downside is that this product doesn’t completely absorb into the skin and when make up is applied it rolls into little goops.

reviews.product_name: Clear Improvement Charcoal Honey Mask to Purify and Nourish
reviews.review_text: Loved this product after first use and now it’s part of my regular routine. Leaves my skin feeling tighter, nourished and supple. Although not an actual benefit for the skin, the mask is very beautiful with a coppery shimmer finish.

reviews.product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C
reviews.review_text: So moisturizing! Earlier this year I had to get 6 rounds of chemotherapy which made my skin beyond dry. Using this every night before bed has helped my lips come back from the dead! It’s a little expensive but with the small amount needed each time this could easily last for a very long time.

reviews.product_name: Facial Radiance Pads
reviews.review_text: These little cleansing pads are awesome! They are slightly exfoliating and really help to get the dead skin off my nose. I use them at night before my moisturizer and I do feel as if my skin is brighter.

reviews.product_name: Aqua Bomb Brightening Vitamin C Cream
reviews.review_title: Great for oily or combo skin
reviews.review_text: My skin is dry, not only due to living somewhere with so much sun but also because it was damaged during my radiation and chemotherapy treatments. So, when I get the chance to try a new moisturizer I am in! First thing I noticed when I opened this was that it smelled so good. Not super strong, that’s not good in skincare, but very subtly fresh and citrusy. It also is a gel like texture like the regular Aqua Bomb which makes it glide onto your skin. If you keep it in the fridge it’s so soothing and cooling. I’ve used this now for just about a month, added it to my nighttime routine, I stretched this sample as far as it would go and I am really enjoying it. It’s moisturizing without being too heavy. I’ve you have oily or combo skin this will be perfect for you. It works well to put over a serum.I love that it’s got vitamins C and E, and four types of hyaluronic acid. Hyaluronic acid is so beneficial and something our bodies naturally produce. It is really good at retaining water, helps with your skins elasticity, can reduce scarring, and even helps wounds heal faster. The vitamin C will help with aging and brightening of the skin. I always love when a product has hyaluronic acid because so far it’s been so helpful in getting my skin back to it’s pre C state.If you’re extra dry like me you may need to put another moisturizer on top, but if you don’t have desert dry skin, or even oily skin, this is the one for you! Regardless, with the benefits of this one I will definitely consider using it under one of my heavier creams. With the sample size it’s hard to say if the brightening works but my dark spots do look slightly better. It would definitely be worth it to purchase the full size to see what using it longer could do.

reviews.product_name: The Water Cream Oil-Free Pore Minimizing Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I got this with my points didn’t realize until after purchasing that it’s not ideal for dry skin types. I really love the light rose scent and thought the lightweight texture would be ideal for a summer moisturizer. I tried this out and didn’t feel that it did anything for me. It didn’t weigh my skin down at all and is incredibly light and fresh. I honestly couldn’t feel it on my skin at all. My skin felt a bit itchy and dry by the end of the day which was a deal breaker. I don’t have oily or combo skin, my skin type is dry and a bit sensitive. But I did notice this moisturizer REALLY kept my oils in check. I could see how this would be balancing for some but for me it just dried my skin out! I have small pores but I noticed that my pores looked even better. Seeing that it prevented excess oil, it makes perfect sense that this would shrink pores! It didn’t give me that natural luster that my rich moisture creams do but it gave me a glassy sheen.

reviews.review_text: I LOVE this serum. I use it as a hyaluronic acid serum and it works incredibly well on my whole face (lips, eyes, you name it) to quench my extremely dry skin. It just adds that extra moisture under my moisturizer that I need particularly badly in the winter. It feels so light and cooling upon application! However, when I got to the bottom of the bottle I can’t seem to open the container. I ended up looking for another hyaluronic acid serum to try out just because having all this product left at the bottom of the container that I can’t get to and use is a waste. Product is 5 stars but took off 1 star because of this. I wish they would change this :(

reviews.product_name: Plum Plump Hyaluronic Acid Serum
reviews.review_text: The formula is very sticky and I don’t like how it feels. Haven’t noticed any additional hydration or plumping when I use it versus when I just use my moisturizer. Not a fan.

reviews.product_name: F-Balm Electrolyte Waterfacial Mask
reviews.review_text: This product isn’t that great as a hydrating overnight mask but it’s fantastic at keeping oil at bay. I have very dry skin that gets oily on the nose. If I apply moisturizer and oil is starting to bead up on my nose, this will stop it in its tracks if I apply it over top! I believe it’s due to the higher niacinamide content. Great product has become a winter staple. I use it in the day for this purpose as the final step in my routine instead of at night.

reviews.product_name: Barrier+ Triple Lipid-Peptide Face Cream
reviews.review_text: Well I really wanted to love this. I tried a small sample that I had received and though okay this may be something great. So I bought it. Unfortunately I had an odd reaction, mini breakout? Little itchy red even. I tried again and the same thing. I am huge Shiseido Fan, and was using Drunk Elephant and wanted something more. This was not it. I want the moisture but I don’t know. My daughter loves the lotion version. I dont think it will be enough hydration and given the reaction... I am a bit sad.

I suddenly went from combination oil to dry and my skin is loving this. Drinks it up. I am able to still use my serums no issues . My skin is hydrated and healthy ! Looks good feels good . No problems applying sunscreen after , or makeup if that’s the route I go. I went from DE to this and I am thrilled!

reviews.product_name: Good Genes All-In-One AHA Lactic Acid Treatment
reviews.review_text: this is skin changing . pushing 50 and having highly sensitive and allergenic skin is so problematic. This is an amazing product that is gentle yet effect for everyone, all ages. It exfoliates while keeping those pores tight. MY dermatologist even noticed how great my skin was looking. I had used the samples I had for a few weeks then bought the bottle I am halfway through it. A little goes a long way ,pricey but worth every cent.

reviews.product_name: C.E.O. 15% Vitamin C Brightening Serum
reviews.review_text: Wow tried a sample with my points and I loved it. I was searching for another C since DE changed their formula. This is amazing and moisturizing. It absorbs in nicely. I can’t say what is is that makes my face glow, but it does. Feels so refreshed and looks that way after apply my moisturizer. Makeup applies well. I purchased a bottle to continue using. Costly but having sensitive skin I stick with what I can. This is working and I love it.

reviews.product_name: C-Firma Fresh Vitamin-C Day Serum
reviews.review_text: WHY THE CHANGED FORMULA? I am so sad. This was my got to for so long. This is not the same , I understand the mixing the formulation for stability reasons. However that shouldn’t change the makeup of the product . This is different. I can feel it and see it. So this is a waste of money. I would rather have the old ones back. extremely disappointed.

reviews.product_name: The True Cream Aqua Bomb
reviews.review_text: This is an all around amazing moisturizer. The gel formula makes it lightweight yet so hydrating without clogging your pores. I can definitely see it being my go to moisturizer for the summer. It also plays well with different products in my skincare routine which is a huge plus for me. It’s refreshing and makes your skin feel buttery smooth in the morning. I could see this working for so many different skin types.

reviews.product_name: Urban Environment Oil-Free Sunscreen Broad-Spectrum SPF 42
reviews.review_text: I’ve always loved Shiseido sunscreen products. Their previous version was the only sunscreen I used for the longest time because it was the only sunscreen that stayed matte and didn’t break me out. This latest version is just as amazing if not even better! It lightweight and absorbs into the skin quickly, leaving behind no residue at all. There is no white cast or piling, and it sits beautifully under makeup. It’s absolutely perfect for more oily skin types but would work so well for all types. It doesn’t feel like you’re wearing sunscreen which is something so unique to this Shiseido product. I will forever continue to purchase.

reviews.product_name: Urban Environment Fresh-Moisture Sunscreen Broad-Spectrum SPF 42
reviews.review_text: Shiseido has been killing the sunscreen game with their sunscreens lately and their newest versions are just as amazing as ever, and packed with amazing ingredients like hyaluronic acid to keep skin plump and hydrated. My dry skin loves how hydrating this formula is. It absorbs so nicely into the skin and feels so lightweight, unlike other sunscreens which feel heavy and greasy and slide around all day. This is holy grail product for me and will pick it over other sunscreens every time.

reviews.product_name: Sugar Lip Balm Hydrating Treatment
reviews.review_text: I love the scent of this and am so grateful to have been gifted by Fresh. It makes my lips so smooth and the color is perfect for summer! I like my lip color to be really sheer and this gives me that option.

reviews.product_name: Tea Elixir Niacinamide & Hyaluronic Acid Anti-Aging Serum
reviews.review_text: I love the feel of this serum in my skin! So lightweight and absorbs quickly. It truly has made my skin more glowy and smooth in just a matter of weeks since I’ve consistently used it. And a bonus for a great scent & cute packaging!

reviews.product_name: C-Firma Fresh Vitamin-C Day Serum
reviews.review_text: My absolute favorite vitamin c serum! I love that you mix it yourself too. It’s a perfect base before makeup too and smells amazing! 1000% worth the price everytime - I can’t get enough of this product!

reviews.product_name: Skinlongevity Long Life Herb Anti-Aging Face Serum
reviews.review_text: I received this product for free from pinch me. I especially like that it’s cruelty-free and synthetic fragrance free. You can also pat it on over your make-up for extra radiance, I really like this serum.Its lightweight and has a good herby smell.I used it for over a month but can’t say I felt any magical difference however I really think it will give me results in long run.The composition of the serum is pure, aimed at strengthening and smoothing the texture of the skin, as well as to protect the skin from free radicals and harmful environmental influences

reviews.product_name: Ginzing Vitamin C Eye Cream to Brighten and Depuff
reviews.review_text: I received this from BZZAGENT in exchange for my review. I have never tried this brand but overall I’m happy with the quality. I got warm and my skin tone isn’t super dark. It blends nicely and has a nice light weight feeling on the skin. I feel like the orangey like tones the warm has does help conceal the dark circles a bit. My eyes look a bit brighter but haven’t noticed a huge difference in the puffiness. This is pretty expensive to me for a eye cream I’m hoping to see a bigger difference in the next few weeks.

reviews.product_name: Clear Improvement Pore Clearing Moisturizer with Salicylic Acid
reviews.review_text: If you have break outs or blackheads i think this cream could work wonders for you, it really helped clear up my black heads I don’t usually break out but I do have a black head problem and this helped so much when it came to reducing my black heads, the smell is fine I don’t find it too over whelming, I used a very light hand with this product and only applied it at night. A little goes a long way. It has a thick consistency and felt moisturizing on first application then dried very quickly into my skin. It mattifies well I was afraid that the salicylic acid would dry out my skin but it wasn’t as bad as I expect I have super dry skin that’s why I only use it at night I don’t want to dry my skin out anymore, this product is great for black heads I totally recommend

reviews.product_name: Volcanic AHA Pore Clearing Clay Mask
reviews.review_text: I recieved this clay mask  gifted by innisfree to review. This is my second time trying a product from the brand and I absolutely love it. I love the lava like smell. reviews.review_text: I recieved this complimentary from Glow Recipe free to try. Before I even get into the product, this packaging is super awe some. For me using on no makeup days you skin looks glowy like a post facial glow. My skin looked like glass. When I used as a primer my skin still glowed but like a glow from within. I did add a second layer to my high points on my Cheeks. I have dry skin and this nourished my skin soo much. You have to let it absorb properly into the skin. Oily skin people may not like this as much. But my dry skin loves it. I have also seen an improved texture in my skin since using it so ita not just a glowy primer.

reviews.product_name: GENIUS Sleeping Collagen Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: This product has worked wonders on my perennially extremely dry skin. I’ve been using this cream for the past 2 weeks and I’ve seen a noticeable difference already. It is a relatively thick night cream that really works hard on my skin while I sleep. The texture makes my skin feel buttery soft in the morning and the cream absorbs really well into the skin. I didn’t feel any icky sticky feelings as I slept on my side. Definitely recommend! Ps. I received this product complimentary for sampling purposes but all opinions are my own.

reviews.product_name: Soy Hydrating Gentle Face Cleanser
reviews.review_text: This is a great, gentle everyday facial cleanser that can be used both AM and PM. I liken it to the glossier jelly cleanser, but I think fresh‘s soy cleanser is a little better. It leaves my skin hydrated while also feeling clean. And it removes my makeup as well! I received this product complimentary for review purposes.

reviews.product_name: Sugar Strawberry Exfoliating Face Wash
reviews.review_text: I am a fan of this product. First off, it smells AMAZING!!!! Second, I love the exfoliating sugar that dissolves after you rub the scrub into your face. It really feels like the crystals are getting at my pores. It leaves my skin feeling so soft while not over drying. I have dry skin, so this product is wonderful. Would definitely recommend

reviews.review_text: This is truly the best face cream I’ve ever used. I’ve tried drunk elephant, Clinique, LaMer, Lancôme, Shiseido, L’Oréal, oil of Olay— I could go on and on. It’s luxury in a jar. Highly recommend! Oh! And I have sensitive- DRY- skin year round.  It’s the best.

reviews.review_text: I received this eye cream from Topboxcircle as a #freeproduct. It was just a small packet. I can’t comment about the wrinkles because I don’t have enough of it to put it to the test. It is unscented, light and fresh. Fast absorbing too.

reviews.review_text: I quite enjoyed using this product. The texture was nice, the spreadability, the absorption rate, and how it made my skin feel afterwards. But I just absolutely can not get behind paying $120 for a 30mL product. I don’t think it’s THAT good. Sorry, DE.

reviews.product_name: Lala Retro Whipped Refillable Moisturizer with Ceramides
reviews.review_text: While I quite like the texture and spreadability of the product, along with its moisturization, the smell (not bad or raunchy, not perfume either, but almost an ’old’ smell) is hard to get by. Especially as this product caused me to breakout, necessitating ceased use of it, I wondered if the smell wasn’t more indicative of a bigger problem. And I see I’m not the only one complaining about the smell. Thankfully I received a sample of this, and did not purchase the full-size, as I WOULD be returning it had I. I don’t mind Drunk Elephants, but this one just isn’t for me.

reviews.product_name: Niacinamide 10% + Zinc 1% Oil Control Serum
reviews.review_title: I want to like this, I really do, but....
reviews.review_text: It’s not producing any results for me, and I have a difficult time understanding the hype. I’ve used it consistently for months now, having purchased 3 bottles... And I’m not even sure why, seeing as the first one didn’t do anything for me, let alone the second bottle. I do wonder if my skin-type has anything to do with it, as from what I gather from the product description AND all the reviews, is that it seems to work well on oily blemish-prone skin. I’m combo-DRY, with large, clogged pores in my T-Zone, but I don’t really struggle with oiliness -- not even in my T-Zone. So maybe it’s just that it’s not suited for my skin-type? I don’t know. Though, from everything I read and hear, it should have done SOMETHING for my large, clogged pores. I’ll admit, I DO like the texture and consistency of this product, and I like applying it as my first step after toning, before other serums, as it leaves a polished feeling on my skin, and makes layering a breeze. Sometimes I use it alone (without other serums) under moisturizer, as almost a primer for my makeup, and that works well, too. It’s almost as though it aids in polishing my skin-texture, but only temporarily. Nothing longterm. I’ve been using TO’s Anhydrous Salicylic 2% Solution for two weeks with better results ---- and, again, I think it’s everything to do with my skin-type, as my skin just thrives in the squalane of the SA product. Ah, well, to each their own. I’d still recommend it as it seems to work well for others.

reviews.product_name: Glycolic Acid 7% Exfoliating Toning Solution
reviews.review_title: I Might be in Love... With Glycolic Acid?
reviews.review_text: I bought this recently when Deciem offered a 30% code. I bought it to have it, but didn’t expect to use it anytime soon, as my only experience with Glycolic Acid was years ago with Proactiv’s Toner, which hurt my skin quite badly. So, I took it slow. Not only did I perform TWO 24hr patch tests to be sure I could use this, I then performed two more to determine if and how it would react to other products I use. I started with 2x a week, then 4x, and now I use it about 6x a week... Give or take. I always make sure to give my skin at least one or two breaks from acids per week. Surprisingly, it’s gentler than I ever thought it would be & I never experienced irritation (just redness).  This could be in due part to making sure I am thoroughly hydrated and moisturized when using... Or it could be because I apply AFTER hyaluronic acid. I do this because Hyaluronic Acid works best applied to damp skin, so it’s the first thing I apply after cleansing. Then I wait a minute or two for my skin to dry *completely* before moving on to this. This is important. I find it gentle enough that it can be used with other actives (like TO’s Salicylic Acid) though I’d not recommend it to acid newbs or those less experienced. (Don’t forget your patch tests!!)  Now, my skin-tone is the most even and glowiest it’s ever been. So much so that my grandmother asked me what was wrong with me, my face was “shiny“ -- I said, “No, Grandma, I’m just glowing.“ Then we chuckled. In all fairness, I thought this was going to be an overhyped product, and typically I avoid overhyped products -- but I’ve been converted. And I’m glad I stuck it out. Full disclosure: I do use Bakuchiol in my AM + PM routine, and I think the two combined make the difference, as I didn’t notice such drastic results until I incorporated the Bakuchiol into my extensive routine. Here’s B&A pics. I applied a filter JUST to highlight texture and irregular tone in my Before images.

reviews.product_name: Watermelon Glow PHA + BHA Pore-Tight Toner
reviews.review_text: Usually I don’t buy into the hype or overhype of products, but something told me to jump on the Glow [Recipe] Train, and I’m glad I did. This ’toner’ (more like an essence) is absolutely wonderful to use and is like a tall refreshment for my combo-dry skin. It’s fast absorbing and dries down to a smooth, refined, non-tacky texture without the dryness -- perfect for a makeup base! I figured when I read conflicting accounts of a watermelon-scented product vs “this doesn’t smell at all like watermelon“ that it likely smelled like *real* fresh watermelon and not the synthetic (candy) watermelon scent with which we’re all familiar... And I was right. If you’ve ever drank a fresh-squeezed watermelon juice, that’s just what it smells like. I prefer to apply this using just my fingers (it’s so soft) as a little goes a LONG way -- much further than if using cotton pads/rounds -- and I’ve not noticed any “stringy clouds“ or “floaters“ in the product, though I attribute such comments to the cactus water (neat addition.)  As for the plunger, I initially thought this was a silly complaint as the little ring-handle makes it easy-peazy to remove, but with time mine broke (even though I anticipated such and thus was gentle removing everytime). This is kind of a bummer as I must store my cosmetics away when not in use due to curious children, and thus, can’t rely on just keeping the packaging upright. It will require using my nails to remove going forward, which I’m not thrilled about.  While I’ve not noticed an improvement in my enlarged clogged pores, longterm, it provides a slight immediate refined and smooth appearance, and I will continue to use and purchase just because it’s such a treat for my skin..Now that my go-to nourishing toner has been discontinued, it’ll serve as replacement. It’s super gentle, it’s hydrating, nourishing, makes a perfect base for makeup application, and is a great addition to my AM routine when I give my skin a break from extensive PM routines.

reviews.product_name: Ultra Repair Cream Intense Hydration
reviews.review_title: ACTUALLY SOOTHES SKIN & GETS RID OF REDNESS
reviews.review_text: I absolutely LOVE this moisturizer. I’m a total beauty addict and there isn’t much I haven’t tried in the way of skincare. This product really stands out! It has an amazing, thick texture, and a lovely scent. I use a lot of strong products on my face (containing AHA’s- like Lactic Acid & Glycolic Acid, BHA- Salicylic Acid, forms of Vitamin C- like Ascorbic Acid & THD Ascorbate, Retinoids, etc.), and this cream is the first I have used that actually soothes my skin. Anyone who uses acids on the regular knows it’s something you have to build your skin up to using, and even when your skin is used to it- irritation can occur. I was blown away when I put this cream on my face and it felt so soothing, and took away the redness! I can’t recommend this moisturizer enough to anyone who has sensitive skin, has a skin condition like eczema, or is like me and uses strong skincare products. Plus, it’s insanely moisturizing. That being said, it is not one of those moisturizers that you use and it instantly soaks right into the skin. This cream does actually feel like a cream, but I wouldn’t go as far to say that it feels greasy (I have combination skin and I don’t like anything greasy that feels like it clogs pores). I will always have a big tub of this stuff around for sure. It really does work wonders on dry skin!

reviews.product_name: Squalane + Omega Repair Deep Hydration Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: The first time I used this cream, my jaw dropped at how lovely the texture is. It has a very silky quality to it that makes it the most enjoyable thick cream I use. I have combination skin that easily becomes greasy, and I have never had a problem using this product. I wouldn’t go wild and slather it on thick in the summer time if you’re like me and have combination skin, but a nice thin layer of it works perfectly for me. I’m very confused by the reviews commenting on the smell. It definitely doesn’t have a fake, sweet parfume smell, but it also doesn’t have a “sour” odor. I find it to have a pretty plain scent, similar to other unscented products. But, everyone’s scent is different, so it’s possible it comes off more earthy to others.  The price point is high, but the quality and clean ingredients justify it for me. This is the first Biossance product I have used, and I’m really looking forward to purchasing others. Their new mask is in my Top 3 on my skincare wishlist right now (and it’s a longgg one).

reviews.product_name: Auto Correct Brightening + Depuffing Eye Cream for Dark Circles
reviews.review_title: THE BEST EYE CREAM FOR DEPUFFING
reviews.review_text: My number 1. issue with my skin is the puffiness around my eyes. When I wakeup the puffiness lasts longer than it does for most people, and sometimes it is also there during the day/night for no apparent reason. It’s one of those things that goes pretty unnoticed by most people since it’s not obvious, but to me it is all I see. This eye cream is my ABSOLUTE favorite one that I never leave the house without using. I skip on makeup most days since my skin is pretty in check thanks to my large and very loved skincare collection, but I always use this eye cream. It is absolutely amazing at depuffing the eye area, and making you look awake and bright. I truly don’t understand the negative reviews talking about it not working for some. There is a very noticeable difference on days I accidentally skip on this. My boyfriend has even noticed when I have looked more tired than usual, and it was from not using this eye cream. I am also so confused by the reviews commenting on “glitter” in this eye cream. I don’t even see a shimmer to be honest, I just find it very brightening. Overall, I adore this eye cream. I absolutely always have a backup ready to use so I am never without it. Sunday Riley is one of my FAVORITE brands. I highly suggest trying their Good Genes Lactic Acid Treatment. It is another product that I have used daily for a long time, and really love since is shows amazing results.

reviews.product_name: Glycolic Acid 7% Exfoliating Toning Solution
reviews.review_text: Wow, this toner helped tighten my pores. I love acids. Lactic, glycolic, salicylic, azelaic, mandelic, gimme all the acids. None of my other products containing acids that are meant to shrink pores have made such a difference so quickly. I know pores are supposed to be visible on your face, especially your nose, but I still use a lot of products that are supposed to tighten them. I never do a review this early on (less than a full month of use, usually at least 6 weeks), but the results are already there. The pores on my nose are very noticeably smaller since I added this toner to my routine. Reading the reviews, I thought there had to be some exaggeration going on. But, I still had very high hopes for this toner. I’m so impressed that it actually surpassed my expectations. The pores on my nose were the most noticeable to me. Within a week with consistent use, they are barely visible. The thing that surprised me the most about this toner is actually how non-drying it is. I expected it to feel harsher on my skin. After thorough cleansing and exfoliation, you definitely feel a tingle. However, it actually leaves your skin feeling supple instead of stripped. I expected my pores to shrink, but I definitely didn’t expect to be able to skip on a moisturizer. For someone with dry skin, I wouldn’t recommend this. But, for someone with combination skin that gets easily oily (especially in the warmer months), I do. Using this toner in combination with a hydrating serum, (plus a few other products, I customize my routine every time) has become my perfect routine for healthy, glowing skin.

reviews.product_name: Estee Lauder Advanced Night Repair Synchronized Multi-Recovery Complex Serum
reviews.review_text: My favorite thing about this serum is how glowy it leaves my skin. It’s definitely hydrating, but it doesn’t clog my pores. Other hyaluronic acid serums I’ve used have left my face tacky. This serum has a smooth texture that soaks in nicely, and leaves my face feeling plump. My only complaint is that using this serum in my nighttime routine during the hotter months, leaves my combination skin oilier in the morning then I prefer. My skin gets very easily shinny during the summer, so for someone with my skin type, I suggest using this serum in the drier months when the extra hydration is necessary. I cannot speak of the anti-aging benefits for this serum. Aging is not one of my skin concerns, yet. However, I can see how it would do a nice job of plumping fine lines, thanks to the hyaluronic acid. After using this serum for two weeks, the only real lasting result I saw was hydration. My skin is always glowy and healthy looking in the morning after using this in my nighttime routine. If you do want to use this product for the anti-aging benefits, I suggest purchasing the full size. The smaller option lasted me two weeks, since I am petite and have a smaller face. For most people, it only lasted them one week. Which, of course, wouldn’t give you the full results from a skincare product.

reviews.review_text: I actually was suprised how much I liked this product and probably would not have tried it if it was not sent to me for a review. I usually use very high end products from my plastic surgeon’s office and was very impressed. It was non-greasy which is usually what I look for. Super moisturizing and just nice overall.

reviews.product_name: Hydra Zen Glow Liquid Lightweight Moisturizer with Hyaluronic Acid
reviews.review_title: Great for combination skin- pleasantly surprised.
reviews.review_text: I am not super impressed by moisturizers usually. I feel like a lot of times they are generally the same for a wide variety of prices. I actually really liked this one from Lancôme. There are two main reasons; it is super lightweight and does not effect your makeup application. Also, I have combination skin. Super oily some days and other days super dry. This stuff could take care of my really dry days, but also not add oily to my skin when I had an oily day. I took some time before I reviewed this product because I really don’t feel like you get a good feeling for a product like this until you use it for a few weeks.

reviews.product_name: Skinlongevity Long Life Herb Anti-Aging Face Serum
reviews.review_text: I recently received this complimentary for a review and I am loving it so far. My skin is glowing and my redness has really calmed down. I feel like even my fine lines look smoother. I am looking forward to seeing how it works over the next few weeks.

reviews.product_name: Ultimate Sun Protector Lotion SPF 50+ Sunscreen
reviews.review_text: This is a perfect sunscreen for outside use it. It applies well and smells great. I would not use on your face if you have oily skin for every day use, but it would perfect for a sunny day at the beach. This is a really great luxurious sunscreen.

reviews.product_name: Clear Sunscreen Stick SPF 50+
reviews.review_text: I loved how light weight and non greasy this was. You could easily apply this to your face as your every day sunscreen. Also great for quick reapply on sunny days.

It comes individually wrapped which makes application a breeze. The one side of the pad exfoliates while the other side buffs.  Very durable and doesn’t fall apart while applying.

Gave it a better appeal to the item. It came out in the perfect amount. I love how quickly it soaked into my skin and just helped my glow.

reviews.review_text: The scent of this item is just amazing! It comes off a bit strong at first but then whines down nicely. It has that rose scent you want without the odd back scent. It soaks in very nicely and keeps your skin very supple throughout the day.

reviews.review_text: I received this item complimentary from Summer Fridays. Absolutely loved this product and it was so easy to use. reviews.review_text: This is great for summer. I have a new “thing” developing with my skincare regimen. I’m ditching foundation and making a serious commitment to my skin. This has been great over a tinted sunscreen and I’ve also added it as an eye color. A little goes along way.

reviews.product_name: Beste No. 9 Jelly Cleanser
reviews.review_text: I really like how gentle this is. My face is clean but not tight and dry. A little goes along way!!

reviews.product_name: Lippe Balm
reviews.review_text: I love this lip balm, I’m not sure it’s any better than my other “homemade” options. It definitely keeps my lips soft and hydrated and I’ve been using it more as a night mask now because it’s not really convenient to bring the container with me.

reviews.product_name: AHA 30% + BHA 2% Exfoliating Peeling Solution
reviews.review_text: Amazing! Seriously. This is strong, probably the strongest peel I’ve ever had, even from my esthetician. I left it on the whole 10 the first time(I’m no peel virgin) and I had some peeling around my nose on day 2. I wouldn’t recommend keeping it on the whole 10 if you have sensitive skin.

reviews.product_name: Blue Tansy BHA and Enzyme Pore Refining Mask
reviews.review_text: I really like using this! I’m on day 3 of the initial period and I’ve had no irritation at all. I have a feeling this is going to be a repeat purchase for me because I love that I can use it more than once a week. It’s definitely not strong like a peel but the difference in texture is immediate.

reviews.product_name: Green Clean Makeup Removing Cleansing Balm
reviews.review_text: I think this will be a repeat. I’ve tried other cleansing oils and I always feel filmy and this works great, no residue after my second cleanser. It smells pretty strong, almond is mostly what I smell. I like it and a little goes along ways.

reviews.product_name: Green Clean Makeup Meltaway Cleansing Balm Limited Edition Jumbo
reviews.review_text: I think this will be a repeat. I’ve tried other cleansing oils and I always feel filmy and this works great, no residue after my second cleanser. It smells pretty strong, almond is mostly what I smell. I like it and a little goes along ways.

The description say can be use it as a primer, so I try it underneath makeup and skin look glowing and dewy. After trying both way, I prefer to use it as an hydrating serum layer with my other serum.

reviews.product_name: Good Genes All-In-One AHA Lactic Acid Treatment
reviews.review_text: The product was gifted by Sunday Riley to review.  I use it in my evening routine alone and then apply moisturizer on top every other night. It’s very light and absorb very well.  I see noticeable differences, my skin was glowing and texture improved a bit. Overall, I like it but don’t like the smell of the product.

reviews.review_text: The product was gifted by Glow Recipe to review.  I have combination/sensitive skin.  The serum was light and easy to apply. It’s quick absorption and work great layering underneath another serum.  It’s hydrated enough, yet not too heavy. The scent is light and refreshing. My skin does look more dewy after applying the serum.

reviews.review_text: I used to be one of those that believed that your skin was only clean when it felt insanely stripped and tight… big mistake! After I started trying more gentle cleansers my whole experience changed. One of my favorites is xxx. I’ve been using it as part of my double cleanser for a while now and I can’t recommend it enough! It is very gentle, lathers nicely and smells amazing. It’s superfood ingredients and powerful antioxidants clean and balance your skin’s pH without drying or stripping. If you’re looking to stay away from fragrances this might not be for you.

It’s thick texture locks in moisture and delivers antioxidants helping my lips be the softest they’ve ever been!

reviews.review_text: I’ve tried other cleansing balms before and this is by far my favorite. It has a sorbet like texture that melts in your hands and dissolved even the strongest mascara. The scent is amazing, did not irritate my skin and emulsifies beautifully when applying water, leaving no greasy residue. I use it every day as my first cleanse to remove my makeup and sunscreen and love it! Like most cleansing balms, it can make your vision blurry for a little bit after using.

I  try to focus application only to the areas of concern (T-zone) since it can be drying or even irritating in areas like my cheeks that were already dry/sensitive.

reviews.review_text: The texture and scent of this moisturizer is absolutely amazing! I have sensitive skin and I’m always worried about strong scents since I don’t know how I’ll react, but had no problems with it. The consistency is deliciously thick and love it as a night moisturizer.

reviews.review_text: The texture and scent of this moisturizer is absolutely amazing! I have sensitive skin and I’m always worried about strong scents since I don’t know how I’ll react, but had no problems with it. The consistency is deliciously thick and love it as a night moisturizer.

reviews.product_name: Triple Algae Eye Renewal Balm Eye Cream
reviews.review_text: I’m a big fan of eye creams and this didn’t disappoint. My under eye area can be quite sensitive and this cream didn’t cause any irritation. I used the 10 day sample both morning and night and though I didn’t see a shocking difference my skin felt very moisturized. It was occlusive enough for me to enjoy it as a night cream and worked well enough with my makeup for it to be part of my morning routine. I used it while traveling and really helped keep my skin healthy and hydrated even after several flights.

reviews.review_text: Review Time! Goop gifted me the new 15% Glycolic + Fruit Extracts Overnight Peel.-I LOVED the Instant Exfoliating Mask, I still dream about how good it made my skin look. I figured these would be amazing too. Spoiler Alert: They are.-It’s a pre-soaked mitt of sorts and you rub on your face, neck, and chest. Leave on for 15 minutes then you can put on moisturizer. Sleep. Wake up. Rinse off and voila, glowing skin. I even took photos of my face without make up (I apologize)! I really love them my only “complaint” is I’m not sure if I was using the right side. Is it the softer side or do I use the more coarse? Or a combo? I chose combo. (Checked Website - it’s dual!). I really think it does wonders for my skin. If you tried the Instant Exfoliation Facial and that was too harsh, these are not as intense. I felt a little tingling but it was minimal. Highly recommend. I know they are pricey but totally worth it in my opinion (and my skin type!).-*gifted but this is my honest opinion of the product*

reviews.review_text: Rating 4.5I really enjoyed this SPF. It had been warmer the past few weeks while I tested it out. I prefer to use on my body as it is very moisturizing. Almost excessive. It doesn’t feel greasy, but it feels like you put on too much moisturizer and now it’s trying to sink in. However, I’d rather that than it be drying. No white cast and no noticeable smell. It’s also ocean compliant so that is a huge bonus for me!

reviews.product_name: Watermelon Glow Niacinamide Dew Drops
reviews.review_text: Glow Recipe kindly sent me over their new Watermelon Glow Niacinamide Dew Drops. I loved the watermelon line, and it smells fantastic, so I knew I would love this.My skin is not a super fan of pure Niacinamide (i.e., The Ordinary one). I never use it frequently enough to get the benefits. I have used this every day for three weeks, but I wanted to make sure I really used it. It is slightly tacky when first put on, and if I use over SPF (please, I am most definitely not wearing makeup). When used as a serum and under moisturizer, I do not notice any tackiness. I also like to mix it with my SPF or moisturizer and that also helps with the texture. I love the subtle glow/glittery look that it gives my skin. This is going to continue to be a staple in my lineup.

reviews.product_name: Santorini Grape Poreless Skin Cream
reviews.review_text: I really enjoyed trying this moisturizer via Influenster. I love that it contains salicylic acid to help with any breakouts. It left my skin feeling hydrated but not greasy. I can only give 4 stars as this was a sample size and I could not fully test it as I normally would. First impressions are positive, but would want to fully test for 3 weeks for a more in-depth review.

reviews.product_name: Magic Cream Moisturizer with Hyaluronic Acid
reviews.review_text: I really enjoyed using this moisturizer as it’s thick hydrating, and a great makeup primer. However, for moisturizers, the price point is very high, especially when many other brands create a great moisturizer for much less. If you are looking for a luxury moisturizer, I would suggest that this would be a good fit for you, with the caveat that if you have oily or blemish-prone skin, it might be a little bit too heavy for you.

reviews.product_name: Tea Elixir Niacinamide & Hyaluronic Acid Anti-Aging Serum
reviews.review_text: As someone always on the lookout for new skincare products, I was intrigued when I came across the Fresh Tea Elixir Skin Resilience Activating Serum. This serum claims to help improve skin elasticity and firmness while also providing antioxidant protection. After using the Fresh Tea Elixir Skin Resilience Activating Serum for a few weeks, I noticed a significant improvement in the overall appearance of my skin. My skin felt softer and more hydrated. I was really impressed with this product and would definitely recommend it to anyone looking for a new skincare routine.

reviews.product_name: Niacinamide 10% + Zinc 1% Oil Control Serum
reviews.review_text: I was really looking forward to trying the Ordinary products because they were so hyped but did not find them any special. Niacinamide did absolutely nothing to my blemishes - I did not feel like using any product which is really weird. It also feels a bit sticky after applying which I found unpleasant. Not for my skin type, I guess

reviews.product_name: The Water Cream Oil-Free Pore Minimizing Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I really love Tatcha products and this one is not an exception - it works amazing on my sensitive skin, moisturizes well and doesn’t make me break out. It is so easy to apply and it actually feels like water on skin! I recommend this cream to anyone who has sensitive skin and easily breaks out. I was really tempted to give 5 stars because of its quality but decided that 4 will be fair because my bottle was almost half empty.

reviews.product_name: Mini The Water Cream
reviews.review_text: I really love Tatcha products and this one is not an exception - it works amazing on my sensitive skin, moisturizes well and doesn’t make me break out. It is so easy to apply and it actually feels like water on skin! I recommend this cream to anyone who has sensitive skin and easily breaks out. I was really tempted to give 5 stars because of its quality but decided that 4 will be fair because my bottle was almost half empty.

reviews.product_name: The Deep Cleanse Gentle Exfoliating Cleanser
reviews.review_text: I love this cleanser - it is one of the best I ever used. I thought it would be very harsh because of the granules but it is so gentle! It cleanses so well, doesn’t dry my skin and helps my reduce my acne. reviews.product_name: Natural Moisturizing Factors + HA
reviews.review_text: Fair skin and on the mend after cystic acne.I had a bad year last year and suffered from cystic acne, after many trials with prescription meds my doctor put me on Accutane. As most on accutane know you cannot use and do a lot of things most beauty addicts love, like waxing and using most anti aging/ beauty products. This moisturizer saved my life. It was gentle enough but strong enough to keep my skin hydrated and from peeling for the most part. I had a small adjustment period but only due to the meds not the product. This moisturizer kept me sane and moisturized during my recovery. I am at the tail end of my dosage and I will be using this moisturizer for life. Best part is the price tag.I have tried many moisturizers in the past, some good some bad but this one fits just right.I urge anyone else who suffers from acne, life long or sudden, to try this tooo.

reviews.review_text: I was skeptical of this mask at first, giving that I’ve used many chemical exfoliant masks before and have seen nice but not outstanding results.This product was gifted to me for testing purposes, my opinions are my own. Let me tell you this - GOOPGLOW is a totally different story! My skin felt so smooth and soft and continues to feel amazing days after I’ve used this mask! It’s truly wonderful - especially after my skin wasn’t at its best state after lots of flights and travel. I wasn’t a big fan of texture as it was a bit hard to spread and massage it in, but it was easy to rinse with a cloth and it didn’t leave my skin tight or uncomfortable. It was a little tingly but nothing major or again, uncomfortable. In fact, I enjoyed having this mask on - it doesn’t have a heavy fragrance, and I feel it’s actually working. I’d definitely recommend this mask to anyone looking for an exfoliant, giving the results AND the ingredients are amazing (ingredients are very important to me).

reviews.product_name: Estee Lauder Advanced Night Repair Synchronized Multi-Recovery Complex Serum
reviews.review_title: Good product but not entirely for me.
reviews.review_text: I didn’t have any expectations when first tried this serum and let me tell you what actually happened after a week of use twice a day. I used it morning and night both on my face and my neck (I always take product to neck and décolleté area) and at first - I saw no difference. The product didn’t smell of anything in particular, went on nicely and didn’t feel sticky so that was good. I also liked the ingredients a lot, since actives were pretty high on the list. However, sadly, I’ve developed little bumps on my face after using it, it was the only new introduction to my skincare. My neck though felt great - it was smooth, soft and didn’t have any irritation. So overall, I’m very happy with the product when used on neck area. I would consider this product when shopping for skincare for the neck and the décolleté, but not for the face (because of the breakouts). If you have normal and not sensitive skin, I believe you’d be very happy with it on the face too.

reviews.review_text: I absolutely love this serum! Let me start by saying that this serum was gifted to my by Glow recipe. I started using it the moment I received it and felt in love!- texture is very lightweight and not sticky at all- this serum has a very light and pleasant smell, but not overpowering - after 3 uses my skin looked so good! Redness around past breakouts was almost gone, it felt less sensitive (normally it can burn when I apply some products but now it didn’t)- I was hydrated all day without feeling oily. Needless to say, I’d be recommending this serum to everyone! And will be purchasing more when I run out - it’s so good!And important note: it didn’t break me out, and I have quite picky skin when it comes to this aspect.

reviews.product_name: Rose & Hyaluronic Acid Deep Hydration Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: Amazing nourishing cream!Let me start by saying that this product has been gifted to me from the brand in exchange for my opinion. I absolutely love this cream! It’s quite nourishing while still being lightweight, which I appreciate so much! I’ve started using a retinol product and my skin has been drier that usual and nothing seemed to help until I tried this cream - my face instantly felt moisturized, hydrated and supple. I feel it would be a great winter cream as well, but even now during hot and humid summer I very much enjoy it!It has a rose scent which is quite strong but goes away quickly when you apply it. It doesn’t bother me at all, in fact it gives that awesome spa like feel. Overall, I’d recommend this face cream for anyone with dry/normal skin, or if you’re looking for a bit more nourishment to add to your routine.

reviews.product_name: The Rice Polish Foaming Enzyme Powder
Niacinamide 10% + Zinc 1% Oil Control Serum
reviews.review_text: I bought this after contacting the company for suggestions on a skincare routine. According to DECEIM, you should only be using this product at night (after Buffet, but before any oils). The product goes on well, though becomes sticky really quickly. I usually just put in on my T-Zone and chin every other night, alternating with my regular toner, as well as a spot treatment on any new blemish. So far, it’s worked really well to reduce the appearance of my pores, prevent inflammation of new zits and makes my problem areas less shiny.

reviews.product_name: Caffeine 5% + EGCG Depuffing Eye Serum
reviews.review_text: Before buying this product, please note that though it claims to rid both puffiness and dark circles, their website (TO) does have a pretty big disclaimer about probably not working for most people’s dark circles, as it could be genetic or linked to something else. So going in knowing that my dark circles most likely won’t go away, I have to say that I’m pretty pleased with how great this product rids of my morning eye-puffiness. Super easy to use, silky and absorbs rapidly. A good face/eye primer would prevent any creasing or flaking of TO products.

reviews.product_name: Beste No. 9 Jelly Cleanser
reviews.review_text: I got this as my free birthday gift at Sephora. I was keeping it in case I was out of my regular cleanser. I don’t get the hype around this brand, so far I haven’t been impressed by the products and this one is no different. It didn’t leave my skin feeling clean or fresh. I’ll be throwing this out once my regular cleanser gets delivered.

reviews.product_name: Avocado Fine Line Eye Cream with Retinol
reviews.review_text: This mask/cream feels great and goes on smooth. I’ve only used this for a couple of days and I’ve already noticed a difference - Less puffy and brighter! I’m knocking down a star for two reasons: It’s a pricey product for how tiny the bottle is; The narrow bottle neck is awful, as well as that tiny spatula they give you with it.

reviews.product_name: Vitamin C Suspension 23% + HA Spheres 2%
reviews.review_text: This is perfect for nighttime use. I use it every other day, alternating with retinol. The texture is ’meh’, but I find that using very little product and warming it between my palms before applying helps mitigate the grittiness. My skin looks glowy, soft and plump in the morning! Overall, great product and I’ll definitely repurchase!

reviews.review_text: Got this a while back as a sample. The texture is nice, but it’s a lightweight cream and doesn’t deliver enough hydration for me. It hasn’t made any differences under my eyes either. I can’t see why anyone would spend CAD$71 on 0.5oz.

reviews.review_text: Got this sample with my points. I like the texture and feel on my face. It absorbed quickly and little goes a long way. That being said, the fragrance is just too intense! It smells like something your old aunt would wear too much of! If this was fragrance-free, I’d consider buying it.

reviews.review_text: I got a sample, which I used on a trip over the holidays. The packaging is nice/simple. The texture of the cleanser feels nice, but that’s it. It’s too gentle even for my sensitive/combo skin. It didn’t lift or cleanse anything. Felt like I needed a scrubbing mask afterwards to get all the dead skin and dirt out. I wouldn’t purchase or recommend this.

reviews.product_name: Ginzing Vitamin C Eye Cream to Brighten and Depuff
reviews.review_text: I have dry, puffy eyes and this was recommended to me. I bought the it full-size in the original shade, mainly because the packaging of the mini wasn’t appealing to me. I’m about halfway through the jar and it’s ’meh’ at best. The good: The colour is super sheer, which leaves a nice shimmer/highlight under the eye. The bad: It’s not hydrating, the shimmer dried and creased under my eyes after a few hours. It also did nothing to depuff my tired eyes. I’m now layering it on top of Clinique’s All About Eyes Rich for the shimmer. I won’t rebuy.

reviews.product_name: Salicylic Acid Acne Healing Dots
reviews.review_text: Anytime I feel like a zit is about to show up, I’ll plop one of those on overnight. I’ll wake up with an already healing blemish. I’ve also tried them on big white heads and they definitely sped up the healing process!

reviews.product_name: Retinol Eye Stick
reviews.review_text: I like the stick, glides well once it’s been warmed up a bit. I start on the outside of my eyes to warm it up, then move my way around the eye. Super hydrating, didn’t irritate my eyes at all. I would consider this a great intro to retinol, but probably won’t work on mature skin. I can see this becoming a staple when traveling!

reviews.product_name: Mini Daily Microfoliant Exfoliator
reviews.review_text: I tried this product because I was in desperate need of a new exfoliator. I have never tried a dry base exfoliant so this type of product was completely new to me! I was a little wary at first because I thought it could be a little irritating to sensitive skin but surprisingly it was anything but that! Yes the texture is a bit grainy but it’s still suitable enough for sensitive skin and once wet in between palm of hands provides the right amount of exfoliation without being too rough. Benefits of owning this product include giving your skin nutrients like rice enzymes to polish skin making it smoother and softer, salicylic acid to help with break-outs; rice bran, licorice, and white tea to help balance uneven skin tones and colloidal oatmeal to help calm skin. I love that this product is gentle enough to use every day.. a little goes a long way! I would definitely repurchase this product and highly recommend it to family and friends.*** I received this product for free in exchange for my unbiased and honest review.

My skin was hydrated throughout the whole day and after applying your makeup, it gives you a glow to your skin that you’ve never seen! Must have serum, I’ll definitely be purchasing the whole line of skincare.

reviews.product_name: Double Serum Firming & Smoothing Anti-Aging Concentrate
reviews.review_text: I really liked this product, I highly recommend. I instantly saw my skin smoother and radiant when I paired it with the Clarins Extra - Firming Energy. Used morning & nightly constantly for 2 weeks. This gave me a healthy-looking glow that revived my skin.

reviews.product_name: Abeille Royale Advanced Youth Watery Oil
reviews.review_text: This visibly hydrated my skin without it being super oily. I love the clean ingredients! It softens your fine lines and wrinkles to give you a beautiful glow. I applied it AM & PM. It went perfectly with my makeup and gave me a plump.

reviews.product_name: Mini Abeille Royale Advanced Youth Watery Oil
reviews.review_text: This visibly hydrated my skin without it being super oily. I love the clean ingredients! It softens your fine lines and wrinkles to give you a beautiful glow. I applied it AM & PM. It went perfectly with my makeup and gave me a plump.

reviews.product_name: Ultra Glow Serum: Glow + Strengthen Vitamin C Serum
reviews.review_text: After using this serum for the past week, my skin is so soft & glowy!

reviews.review_text: I absolutely love this product. when I bought it I thought it was a face mask I apply after cleansing and I didn’t know it was a overnight mask but having a over night mask made me fell in love with the product even more. my skin is starting to get super dry since the transition into the winter weather and this mask makes my skin feel nice and plumped in the morning and doesn’t feel so dried out

reviews.product_name: Soy Hydrating Gentle Face Cleanser
reviews.review_title: The BEST gentle cleanser out there!!!
reviews.review_text: I love this cleanser, I used to use the glossier milky jelly cleanser and decided to switch to this one. It was the best decision ever, super gentle and great at removing minimal makeup (if you use a full face of makeup, it may not be the best at removing it all). It has kind of a cucumber smell, but its very minimal. Would recommend for anyone looking for a simple basic cleanser, that won’t irritate or strip your face.

reviews.product_name: Superfood Antioxidant Cleanser
reviews.review_text: This is a great cleanser, works amazing for every skin type. Also for the price you get a lot of product which is always good. I don’t think that with this cleanser you would see any dramatical changes in your skin, but it won’t strip it or anything like that. It’s a great option to start or for the morning cleanse. Regarding makeup, it won´t take all your makeup off.

reviews.product_name: Mini Superfood Antioxidant Cleanser
reviews.review_text: This is a great cleanser, works amazing for every skin type. Also for the price you get a lot of product which is always good. reviews.product_name: Glow2OH Dark Spot Toner
reviews.review_text: I think that this is my favorite AHA toner out there. It’s not harsh or anything like that, I started using three tomes I week and worked my way up to every day. I notice some changes on my skin, like clearer complexion and overall better texture. It also helped with my hyperpigmentation. If you have something extreme or severe, you may need something stronger. But for keeping the skin balanced and healthy looking it’s a great option and I’ve tried many out there.

reviews.product_name: The Deep Cleanse Gentle Exfoliating Cleanser
reviews.review_text: I know that this is an expensive cleanser, but I’m really obsessed with it. It is really gentle, but you will feel your face really clean, without any dryness or irritation. If you are the kind of person that is looking for a real cleanser that won’t be harsh, this is the best out there.

reviews.product_name: Mini Deep Cleanse Gentle Exfoliating Cleanser
reviews.review_text: I know that this is an expensive cleanser, but I’m really obsessed with it. It is really gentle, but you will feel your face really clean, without any dryness or irritation. If you are the kind of person that is looking for a real cleanser that won’t be harsh, this is the best out there.

reviews.product_name: Balancing Force Oil Control Toner
reviews.review_title: Good For Acne Prone / Oily Skin
reviews.review_text: If you have an acne prone skin I think you would love this. i used this when I was breaking out, and it really help me. It balanced my oil production (I wasn’t looking shinny at the end of the day) and help clear my complexion. Now a have a more normal complexion and I do find that it’s a little stripping, so I stopped using it.

reviews.product_name: Rose & Hyaluronic Acid Deep Hydration Toner
reviews.review_text: This toner was become one of my favorites out there. Don’t think that this toner will do anything dramatical, but it’s a great toner to just keep your skin hydrated and healthy looking. It doesn’t strip or irritate my skin, I love using it in the morning or before applying any AHA/BHA serums, that are more harsh on the skin.

reviews.product_name: Cream Skin Toner & Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: i have combination skin where tzone is oily and chin and cheeks get super dry. i use this toner with cotton pad at night to wipe off dirt from all day and i put it on with my hands in the morning to get the full benefit of the hydration. ive been using it for a week now and my skin feels soft and clear. i got this as a gift from laneige

reviews.product_name: GOOPGLOW 15% Glycolic Acid Overnight Glow Peel
reviews.review_text: my go to easy exfoliation for dry flaky skin in winter. super smooth and baby soft and ready for even makeup application

reviews.product_name: Mini GOOPGLOW 15% Glycolic Acid Overnight Glow Peel
reviews.review_text: my go to easy exfoliation for dry flaky skin in winter. super smooth and baby soft and ready for even makeup application

reviews.product_name: 5 Stars Retinol + Niacinamide Eye Serum
reviews.review_text: I have recently discovered the benefits of retinoid. It is the only ingredient that I think is worth paying premium for. If you are not incorporating retinoid into your skincare you must do it. it basically turns your skin younger. It makes your skin supple, youthful, plump and bright. Its best known for its effect on wrinkles. This product is going to help with the thin skin around your eyes! Highly recommend

reviews.product_name: Floral Recovery Overnight Mask with Squalane
reviews.review_text: Just go buy it!!! i have been using it at night after my tretinoin. The cream feels very thick at first and as if its sitting on my skin like a mask. But voilà in the morning my face feels so soft and supple like magic. i cannot live without it. It calms down my skin from tret. love it.

reviews.product_name: Confidence in a Cream Anti-Aging Hydrating Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: light and hydrating. i wake up with super soft supple skin. smells amazing too. good for middle aged skin that needs extra boost in moisture

reviews.product_name: Virgin Marula Luxury Face Oil
reviews.review_text: I’ve used all sorts of oil: Argan, morrocan, Sunday riley oils, Jojoba oil, coconut oil

reviews.product_name: Greek Yoghurt Foaming Cream Cleanser
reviews.review_text: I’ve tried face cleansers from khiel’s, first aid beauty, Fresh, Clinique, Amore Pacific, Shiseido, Ren, Drunk elephant and this is my holy grail! It’s ultra gentle and doesn’t irritate my super sensitive skin but still makes my skin feel like it’s clean. It’s moisturizing but doesn’t leave a film on my face. It has a lovely, faint scent. It’s green! Love you, Korres!

reviews.product_name: Blue Tansy BHA and Enzyme Pore Refining Mask
reviews.review_text: Wow... this mask is SO good. It’s been a long time since I’ve seen visible results from a product. I have extremely sensitive, reactive skin with rosacea and I have to be extremely careful with acids/vitamin C/retinol and the like. I struggle to find chemical exfoliators that are affective but that don’t make my skin erupt in a dry, scaly, rash. This product made a visible difference in my skin but is ultra gentle and non-irritating. I used it for 5 minutes every other day the first week and then once a week there after. I do feel tingling with use but it goes away. My skin is SO clear and is literally glowing everyday. It also feels BABY soft. My nose seems clearer and less congested too. Somehow my skin doesn’t turn red or irritated. Wow! I’m just so impressed!!

reviews.product_name: Jet Lag Mask
reviews.review_title: Burned my face but healed my hands!
reviews.review_text: I have super sensitive skin on my face and unfortunately, this mask burned my face and irritated it. I tried using it as a primer and same thing plus the texture is very sticky and doesn’t have any slip and doesn’t really sink in. I was super bummed then I saw a comment saying this healed someone’s eczema on their hands. Well, my hands are a disaster because I’m a nurse- SUPER dry, peeling cuticles that are always burning. So I tried this mask as a hand mask and OVERNIGHT my hands were healed!!! I seriously couldn’t believe it. I will keep this mask for that reason... it’s an incredible hand mask!

reviews.review_text: I’m all for luxe products but I really didn’t notice a difference using this. It also has a fermented smell to me that I find odd and I usually can tolerate fragrances. It’s refreshing and gentle and evens your skin tone but nothing worth $99 for a MINI size.

reviews.product_name: Squalane + Marine Algae Firming & Lifting Eye Cream
reviews.review_text: I got a sample of this and although it’s rich and moisturizing, it ended up giving me milia around my eyes and cheeks. I really wanted to like this because it’s so lush but I guess my skin can’t tolerate how heavy this eye cream is.

reviews.product_name: The Silk Peony Melting Eye Cream
reviews.review_title: Helps my dry under-eyes without giving me milia!
reviews.review_text: The texture of this is literally like butter. Rub your finger on it in a circular motion a few times (4-5) and let it melt to get a thin layer on your finger and trust me, that is all you need. I dab just a bit gently on my under-eyes every night. My eye area is very sensitive and I get milia very easily. I don’t prefer water/gel creams because I feel like they don’t do anything and can burn. but If an eye cream is too rich or sillicone heavy, it can clog my skin and give me milia/bumps. This eye cream strikes the perfect balance. It’s creamy and thick but not too occlusive or sillicone-y. Since using this, I notice my eye area is less dry/wrinkly, more refined, less crepe-y. To me, this won’t help with bags or depuffing, so if that’s your concern don’t use this.

reviews.product_name: Watermelon Glow Niacinamide Dew Drops
reviews.review_text: I loved this product that glow recipe gifted me!! The texture is nice and smooth and it soaks into my skin very nicely! So well that I love using it under my make up for those dry patches that always show through my foundation! It makes my skin look dewy even under a full face of make up!

reviews.product_name: Barrier+ Triple Lipid-Peptide Face Cream
reviews.review_text: I love how smooth it feels going on my face! The packaging is so cute and convenient! It gives out just what you need and doesn’t create a mess like other tubes or containers! It feels so creamy and I love it!

reviews.product_name: Mini Barrier+ Triple Lipid-Peptide Face Cream
reviews.review_text: I love how smooth it feels going on my face! The packaging is so cute and convenient! It gives out just what you need and doesn’t create a mess like other tubes or containers! It feels so creamy and I love it!

reviews.review_text: This feels so good under my eyes! as soon as I put it on it feels cool and moisturizing. The consistency is nice, not too thing but not too heavy I like how it’s just thing enough to soak into my skin. The application is super easy also!

reviews.review_text: I was gifted by  Dermalogica and I ove this! This is my favorite brand anyways but this really helped my skin feel so clean and soft after use. I would definitely definitely recommend! It’s a little pricey but I think it is worth it!

reviews.review_text: I’m very happy with the The INKEY List Salicylic Acid Acne + Pore Cleanser. I have less little pimples since using it and I feel that blackheads are less noticeable. I’m very glad I came across this product!

reviews.product_name: Alpha Beta Extra Strength Daily Peel Pads
reviews.review_text: I love it’s pads. My skin looks more subtle & glowy after using it. I recommend it.
