reviews.review_text: I received this product complimentary from Sunday Riley and I like it a lot. My skin texture looks better and my fine lines look diminished. It has a subtle citrusy scent. I apply it at night and leave it overnight a few nights per week and in the morning my skin looks nice.

reviews.product_name: Triple Algae Eye Renewal Balm Eye Cream
reviews.review_text: I really like the Algenist Triple Algae Eye Renewal Balm. I have dark circles, eye puffiness and fine lines and this balm makes my eye area look much better. It’s rich but not greasy, it absorbs well. My eye area looks more smooth, supple and I overall look more youthful and rested. I received this product complimentary from Algenist.

reviews.product_name: Mini Daily Microfoliant Exfoliator
reviews.review_text: I love the Darmalogica Daily Microfoliant cleanser. My skin feels very clean after using it. It’s a different kind of face cleaner. I add a bit of water to the powder and it turns into a paste. I was pleasantly surprised with the results. I received this product complimentary from Dermalogica.

reviews.product_name: Daily Microfoliant Exfoliator
reviews.review_text: I love the Darmalogica Daily Microfoliant cleanser. My skin feels very clean after using it. It’s a different kind of face cleaner. I add a bit of water to the powder and it turns into a paste. I was pleasantly surprised with the results. I received this product complimentary from Dermalogica.

reviews.product_name: 5 Stars Retinol + Niacinamide Eye Serum
reviews.review_text: I am someone that needs eye treatments or the skin under my eyes gets super dried out. I am also in my 30s so I have fine lines and the beginnings of crows feet. I am so happy that I found this retinol serum! Usually, retinol around my eyes is a no go, but this one is so gentle. I noticed that my fine lines started to look softer in 3 days, and I didn’t experience any irritation so far! I highly recommend following up with an eye cream on top of this treatment if you tend to get dry skin like me. Overall a wonderful product that I will be keeping backups of for the future!

reviews.product_name: Ginzing Vitamin C Eye Cream to Brighten and Depuff
reviews.review_text: I absolutely love this eye cream for the daytime. It doesn’t make my makeup crease and keeps my under eye area hydrated. I love that it is formulated with niacinamide, my eyes look so much brighter. I highly recommend this one!

reviews.product_name: Vitamin Enriched Face Base Priming Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I have always wanted to try the Bobbi Brown Face Base. It has a cult following and it’s supposed to be amazing under heavy foundation and dry skin. Let me tell you, this primer lives up to the hype! I can’t believe how good it makes my skin feel and it makes makeup application super easy! Now I don’t know how I’m going to be able to love without it. You only need a drop to prime your whole face, so the jar should last several months. Honestly, you need this in your life if you wear makeup daily.

reviews.product_name: Sugar Lip Balm Hydrating Treatment
reviews.review_text: I have been using Fresh lip products for many years. I love their lip balms because they keep my lips super hydrated, even in the winter months. My lips usually get so dry that they crack, but they haven’t done that since I discovered the Fresh Sugar Lip Treatment line. This tinted lip balm is perfect for summer. It is a beautiful plum shade that can be worn sheer or built up to a deeper purple. It is very flattering and I have been wearing it with no other makeup for the last few weeks. I highly recommend this one! Fresh gifted me this lip balm, all opinions are my own.

reviews.product_name: Confidence in a Cream Anti-Aging Hydrating Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: If you wear a full coverage foundation and your skin starts feeling dry towards the end of the day, try using this moisturizer before primer. It is so hydrating and nourishing, and it really makes my foundations look amazing all day. I used to get dry patches from wearing too much makeup, but this cream fixed that problem! I haven’t had any dry patches since including this in my makeup routine. I can’t recommend it enough!

reviews.product_name: Balancing Force Oil Control Toner
reviews.review_text: I’ve Had it for a few weeks and so far so good! I would like to give it at least 3 months to see if there are good results

reviews.product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C
reviews.review_text: I got this as a sample and fell in love instantly! It works sooooooo well! I love the sent ( I have the original) and a little goes a long way! Price is so fair,more bang for your buck and my lips are so soft the next day!!!

reviews.product_name: Caffeine 5% + EGCG Depuffing Eye Serum
reviews.review_text: I enjoy this gel like texture on the under eyes,a little goes a long way and the price is amazing! I actually never really see a difference though in the dark circles when I apply eye products like this but I guess it will help not have wrinkles around the eyes for when I’m older.

reviews.product_name: Water Drench Hyaluronic Acid Moisturizer
reviews.review_title: Love it! New holy grail product!
reviews.review_text: I love this item!!! It’s a bit pricey but I honestly believe it’s worth it. Originally got it as a sample and wanted to purchase it right away but it was out of stock and I could see why. Not oily, moisturizers so well and instantly melts into the skin. Not dry but has somewhat of a cooling effect that is not cold. Very light weight. Absorbs into the skin and has a blurring effect and feel but not like silicone or heavy. Seriously I think this is the best moisturizer right now because it’s at the top of my list! It is a bit pricey but definitely worth it and a little goes a longgggg way!

reviews.product_name: The Deep Cleanse Gentle Exfoliating Cleanser
reviews.review_text: Love this exfoliating cleanser. I use it twice a week and it’s not harsh on the skin. I have very sensitive skin. I got this originally as a sample and the mini bottle lasted I believe a month or more. A little goes a long way. There may be better exfoliating products out there but I bought a full size and will use it till it’s gone and may buy a different brand by then if I find something else similar or better but hopefully lower price.

reviews.product_name: Vitamin C Suspension 23% + HA Spheres 2%
reviews.review_text: I love this product. Price point is great and it is deff detoxifying for the face. I love the way it works and feels. Only downfall is I wish they sold a bigger bottle of it because this one lasted me a couple weeks..maybe 3? I do like a reasonable layer..not too thick and not too thin but The Origins or Fresh charcoal masks are a higher price point but last longer somehow..

reviews.product_name: Advanced Génifique Radiance Boosting Face Serum
reviews.review_text: I have been using this product for about a week now both in the morning before my usual routine and at night before I go to bed. First off, I want to talk about the product packaging. You definitely get what you pay for because it comes in a luxurious glass bottle. The dropper also makes it very easy to get the product and control the amount you use. The dropper also clicks in place when you screw it into the bottle so that the next time you unscrew it you have a dropper full of product. Now, the actual product has done wonders for me in terms of hydration. I usually shower in the evenings and sometimes I come out with my face quite dry. The serum took care of that even before I moisturized!! My skin also looks healthier and even has a bit of a glow to it. It usually looks quite dull from all the late nights I spend staying up studying - college life haha... I would definitely recommend this product; a little goes a long way! I received this complementary from Influenster for testing purposes.

reviews.product_name: Salicylic Acid Acne Healing Dots
reviews.review_text: I really love this product! After a couple nights of using this on a pimple I could visibly notice a difference. Although it doesn’t completely get rid of a pimple overnight, you can see reduction in size and redness. I didn’t experience any drying yet. I received this product free from Influenster for testing purposes.

reviews.product_name: T.L.C. Framboos Glycolic Resurfacing Night Serum
reviews.review_text: Holy grail product for acne-prone skin! It really helps with evening skin tone and making your skin feel new and refreshed.

reviews.product_name: Lotus Anti-Aging Night Moisturizer

I would however recommend it and give it your own try as it works different for everyone. I would try it again.

reviews.product_name: Multi-Peptide + HA Serum
reviews.review_text: This entire line has changed my skin completely. For the better. I am SO glad to see it at Sephora now. This product is wonderful. Makes a great base for layering your other products. Absorbs well and sits Well under makeup and other serums.

reviews.product_name: Hyaluronic Acid 2% + B5 Hydrating Serum
reviews.review_text: Like everything else from this line this is a wonderful product. I use this every morning without issue and all its claims are true. This whole line has changed my skin. From texture, to breakouts, to tone. I threw everything else out and use only products from this line. So happy to see them at Sephora. And the price is amazing so that doesn’t hurt

reviews.product_name: Caffeine 5% + EGCG Depuffing Eye Serum
reviews.review_text: There’s a reason this, and so many of this lines products are constantly sold out - they work wonders and they’re amazingly priced. This product is no exception. I always have a back up. I use only facial products from this line. I’m obsessed!

reviews.product_name: 100% Organic Cold-Pressed Rose Hip Seed Oil
reviews.review_text: I love and trust everything from this line. I’d never used rose hip seed oil before so when i saw this I decided to give it a go. I was worried it may break me out. It did not disappoint in anyway. This entire line has totally changed my skin. I haven’t even had the smallest blemish since. Truly. I threw everything I used to use out and only use this line.

reviews.product_name: Glycolic Acid 7% Exfoliating Toning Solution
reviews.review_text: Fantastic. This is a wonderful product, does exactly what it’s supposed to do. This entire line has changed my skin to be the best version of itself. recommend this line all the time.

reviews.product_name: Clear Improvement Active Charcoal Mask to Clear Pores
reviews.review_text: This is a good product but I feel like my cleanser does more. I’m also not a big fan of the smell but for the most part it does what it claims to do. I don’t think I would purchase this again since sometimes it doesn’t do much in my opinion. It’s worth a try, especially if you have large pores, I think it would work more for those with larger pores. Though I think it’s worth a try if you’re looking for a charcoal mask, it wouldn’t be in my recommendation list when it comes to masks. I love Origins though, they have much better products than this.

reviews.product_name: GinZing Ultra-Hydrating Energy-Boosting Cream
reviews.review_text: I bought this about a week ago and I’m already obsessed! I love anything that smells like oranges and anything along those lines. I’m also a big fan of Origins and I love it! I used to be scare of buying moisturizers because I felt like they clogged my pores and felt like they where too thick for my liking but this one is the complete opposite. Yet, when I apply it I feel like my skin is so drenched with moisture (in a good way). I love it and I can see how much of a difference it makes. I apply this after washing my face with the exfoliating scrub from this line and my skin looks so refreshed and glows. It definitely wakes you up, lol. Worth it! The size of the product is also huge, I was amazed!

reviews.product_name: Sugar Hydrating Lip Balm
reviews.review_text: The absolute best. The first balm I tried from FRESH was the caramel balm and it was pretty good. Now, as soon as I saw this one I had to try it! I love anything with coconut and pretty much buy anything that’s coconut scented. I was kind of scared that this would dry my lips more than it would actually help them like some of the balms I’ve tried but boy, was I wrong! I have very dry lips regardless of how much water I drink which is probably due to the weather (AZ). This is very moisturizing and it actually lasts! I am almost out but will definitely be restocking! I hope this doesn’t get discontinued since it’s only limited edition. I absolutely love it because of how much work it puts in lol. It’s so worth it! The smell is such a plus! It’s not too overwhelming. I just love it! The only down plus I could possibly think of is there’s not much product but that’s ok, it might be because of how often I apply it. Still worth it.

reviews.product_name: Good Genes All-In-One AHA Lactic Acid Treatment
reviews.review_text: I was so excited to sample this. I purchased multiple orders over the course of a week so I kept choosing this as a sample and I’m so glad I did. When I first applied this and smelled it I told myself “This isn’t worth it, I don’t care. Smells never really bother me but this is on a whole other level”. I then saw what it did to my skin and I fell in love. I applied it at night (two nights) and my skin was so plumped, clear with a glow. The smell does last but now I find myself obsessing over the smell for some reason. It kind of has like a citrus smell to it mixed with a medicine/ chemical smell lol. Now, i just want to smell it all day and apply it. I will definitely be purchasing the full size. Not to mention, that I keep seeing it everywhere and others raving about it. You won’t regret it.

reviews.product_name: The Water Cream Oil-Free Pore Minimizing Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I had a sample of this and immediately bought the full size! The smell, first of all, is amazing! I can’t describe it. Second, the moisture it provides is amazing and it makes your skin glow! I can also tell that it minimizes my pores. It makes my makeup application so much easier! My makeup has improved as it appears flawless, it’s such an amazing base. I bought this back in August, it is now January. I use it everyday! With or without makeup. A little goes a long way. I also recently realized that there’s a little spatula attached to the bow (on top) to apply it! Wish I would’ve realized this earlier lol. Recently, I feel like it’s not providing all the moisture I want but I would definitely repurchase because my skin is sensitive and dry and the smell wasn’t overpowering. Also, this didn’t make me breakout which often happens with products that are scented.

reviews.product_name: Mini The Water Cream
reviews.review_text: I had a sample of this and immediately bought the full size! The smell, first of all, is amazing! I can’t describe it. Second, the moisture it provides is amazing and it makes your skin glow! I can also tell that it minimizes my pores. It makes my makeup application so much easier! My makeup has improved as it appears flawless, it’s such an amazing base. I bought this back in August, it is now January. I use it everyday! With or without makeup. A little goes a long way. I also recently realized that there’s a little spatula attached to the bow (on top) to apply it! Wish I would’ve realized this earlier lol. Recently, I feel like it’s not providing all the moisture I want but I would definitely repurchase because my skin is sensitive and dry and the smell wasn’t overpowering. Also, this didn’t make me breakout which often happens with products that are scented.

reviews.product_name: Midnight Recovery Concentrate Moisturizing Face Oil
reviews.review_text: This really does the job. It provides so much hydration. It doesn’t have much of a scent. I received a sample and I noticed the difference so much. It just felt so different vs not applying it. I would definitely recommend buying it! I can’t imagine the difference it makes over time!

reviews.product_name: Midnight Recovery Concentrate Moisturizing Face Oil
reviews.review_text: This really does the job. It provides so much hydration. It doesn’t have much of a scent. I received a sample and I noticed the difference so much. It just felt so different vs not applying it. I would definitely recommend buying it! I can’t imagine the difference it makes over time!

reviews.product_name: Sugar Advanced Lip Balm Intense Hydration Treatment
reviews.review_text: This is a bit on the pricey side for a chapstick, specially if you’re constantly misplacing them (which I can’t relate to now lol). It is really hydrating and instantly makes your lips look hydrated and plump. At first, I didn’t really care for it and regretted buying it bc I didn’t feel my lips hydrated until I would look in a mirror and see how hydrated and good they looked. It doesn’t have a smell and it lasted me a pretty good amount of time. I would say like a month or maybe even two (and I apply it daily- I just use several). I do think it’s worth a try and more than just the typical chapstick. Plus, the packaging is so sturdy. It’s a bit on the heavy side as it’s not made of plastic. If you could spare the money, why not! It’s worth a try!

reviews.product_name: Vitamin C Suspension 23% + HA Spheres 2%
reviews.review_text: This makes your skin glow on a whole other level! I am all about Vitamin C and the price was a steal! I used it several times and the consistency is a bit thinner than lotion but still not too thin. As excited as I was to try it, I felt like it didn’t make much of a difference. I stopped using it in general after a while bc I just didn’t care for it anymore. I also felt like it had too many chemicals (which what else did I expect). I do think it’s worth a try! I was just inconsistent with it as I didn’t feel like it was doing much over time. Now, as for the smell it doesn’t really have a strong scent. I have dry, sensitive skin and it didn’t really sting my skin or irritate it. Still think it’s worth a try.

reviews.product_name: Mini Greek Yoghurt Foaming Cream Cleanser
reviews.review_text: My skin is dry/ oily nose/ sensitive/ acne prone. Prior to this, I was using my first aid one and loved it. Decided I wanted to try something new bc of my breakouts and I decided to purchase the mini. It has lasted me a while. I do find that it’s pretty good at removing my makeup- although, it doesn’t state anything about that being one of it’s major purposes. I do find it’s hydrating and not drying for everyday use. There is really no scent/ fragrance to it. It kind of smells like play doh to me. I haven’t noticed that it irritates my skin or makes me breakout which I love but I haven’t noticed it diminishing my breakouts or improving my skin texture. I don’t think I would repurchase but do think it’s worth trying the mini to see if it works for your skin. It does leave my skin feeling clean.

reviews.product_name: Vegan Milk Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: Bought this on a recommendation from one of the girls at sephora. I have fairly dry skin. I love this crap. Its super moisturizing and you don’t need a lot so its going to last me a while and save me money while also saving my skin. Thanks Milk!

reviews.product_name: Unseen Sunscreen SPF 40 PA+++
reviews.review_text: I love supergoop products and the unseen sunscreen is beautiful. it goes on feeling like a primer and has great sun protection.

reviews.product_name: Mini Unseen Sunscreen SPF 40 PA+++
reviews.review_text: I love supergoop products and the unseen sunscreen is beautiful. it goes on feeling like a primer and has great sun protection.

reviews.product_name: Superberry Hydrate + Glow Dream Night Mask with Vitamin C
reviews.review_text: this is the best over night mask ever. my skin is always so hydrated and happy in the morning. I need it.

reviews.product_name: Mini Superberry Hydrate + Glow Dream Mask
reviews.review_text: this is the best over night mask ever. my skin is always so hydrated and happy in the morning. I need it.

reviews.product_name: Glowscreen Sunscreen SPF 40 PA+++ with Hyaluronic Acid + Niacinamide
reviews.review_text: this is such a beautiful product. it gives a nice glow and can be worn alone but still protects. I love it.

reviews.product_name: Mini Glowscreen Sunscreen SPF 40 PA+++ with Hyaluronic Acid + Niacinamide
reviews.review_text: this is such a beautiful product. it gives a nice glow and can be worn alone but still protects. I love it.

reviews.product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C
reviews.review_text: Smells nice, tub lasts forever, and it really hydrates the lips. I use on myself and my toddler at bedtime.

reviews.product_name: Green Clean Makeup Removing Cleansing Balm
reviews.review_text: I really like the feel and smell of this balm and it does a wonderful job of removing makeup.

reviews.product_name: Green Clean Makeup Meltaway Cleansing Balm Limited Edition Jumbo
reviews.review_text: I really like the feel and smell of this balm and it does a wonderful job of removing makeup.

reviews.product_name: Barrier+ Triple Lipid-Peptide Face Cream
reviews.review_text: I received this complimentary from skinfix. This cream really took me by surprise! I have combo skin but I have a lot of acne and my skin also tends to be dehydrated so it gets complicated to find the right balance.  I have been loving this as a night time cream and it has not failed me yet. I wake up with supple skin every morning and I have a feeling this will be great for the winter time. it absorbs quickly and has not clogged my pores. I’m very impressed.

reviews.product_name: Mini Barrier+ Triple Lipid-Peptide Face Cream
reviews.review_text: I received this complimentary from skinfix. This cream really took me by surprise! I have combo skin but I have a lot of acne and my skin also tends to be dehydrated so it gets complicated to find the right balance.  I have been loving this as a night time cream and it has not failed me yet. I wake up with supple skin every morning and I have a feeling this will be great for the winter time. it absorbs quickly and has not clogged my pores. I’m very impressed.

reviews.product_name: Floral Recovery Overnight Mask with Squalane
reviews.review_text: The perfect luxe touch to any night time routine. I love applying this as my last step to seal all of my potions and lotions down. This has a very light scent and it comes in a very heavy jar that feels very luxurious. I usually apply a thin layer and wake up with beautiful plump skin in the mornings. This is fantastic and so perfect for my winter time skin.

reviews.product_name: Vitamin Enriched Face Base Priming Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: This is worth a try! I was a bit skeptical at first but I used it today in the morning and my makeup truly looks so good and my skin also feels very moisturized. This is a great product and the hype is real!

reviews.product_name: Salicylic Acid Acne Healing Dots
reviews.review_text: This was gifted by peace out. These acne dots have a good grip and lasted through the night without budging or sliding around.  In the morning I found that my blemish had reduced in size and it was less red and irritated. This is a great “rescue skin“ type of product to have handy.

reviews.product_name: Tea Elixir Niacinamide & Hyaluronic Acid Anti-Aging Serum
reviews.review_text: This new serum from Fresh has been such an amazing addition to my routine. It’s equipped with wonderful skincare ingredients like Hyaluronic acid to add hydration to the skin and Niacinamide to improve the look of pores. I’ve been using this every day since I received it and I’ve been waking up with super bouncy and clearer looking skin. I’m super impressed. Well done Fresh! gifted by Fresh.

reviews.product_name: Lippe Balm
reviews.review_text: I actually really like this product. I use chapstick daily once it gets cold out but I never had one that leaves my lips moisturized without being greasy. I definitely see a difference once I started using the Drunk Elephant lip balm. It makes my lips feel hydrated and actually helps the dry spots recover. It also doesn’t have a strong scent which I really like.

reviews.product_name: T.L.C. Framboos Glycolic Resurfacing Night Serum
reviews.review_text: I really love this product. During my period, my pores get super congested (sometimes I even get cystic pimples) and theres nothing that I can do about it. Using this product has helped clean out my pores even when my skin is being stubborn. It starts working pretty quickly, which is a bonus that I wasn’t expecting. I recommended it to a friend and now both of us are hooked.

reviews.product_name: Lala Retro Whipped Refillable Moisturizer with Ceramides
reviews.review_text: I really like this moisturizer because it does a great job moisturizing my skin overnight without clogging pores or making my skin feel oily and gross. During the winter I turn to a heavier moisturizer and this is my new fave. You can control how much you dispense and you don’t need a lot of product for your whole face. I’d definitely recommend trying this moisturizer to help save winter skin!!

reviews.product_name: Beste No. 9 Jelly Cleanser
reviews.review_text: I think this is a great cleanser. I like to use it as my second step during double cleansing. I first use an oil cleanser to melt away all my make up and then use this to make sure my skin is completely clean. I love the way it makes my skin feel after and preps it for all of my other products.

reviews.product_name: C-Tango Vitamin C Eye Cream
reviews.review_text: I really like this product. During finals, I always get dark circles under my eyes and I always look tired, but this product helps me look more awake and refreshed. If I had a long day, I use this product so I wake up looking more refreshed.

reviews.product_name: Vegan Milk Moisturizer
reviews.review_title: Great for day time in the winter
reviews.review_text: I really love this moisturizer. I was looking for a day cream for the winter and bought this on a whim. I find this to be thick enough to be moisturizing in the winter, but also light enough to wear during the day without feeling greasy. I don’t find it to be too oily to wear under makeup but I’m curious to see how it holds up in the summer (i think it’ll be too heavy for me as i like to use gel moisturizers in the summer)

reviews.product_name: Advanced Génifique Radiance Boosting Face Serum
reviews.review_text: To start, I loved the bottle! When you twist the cap back on it automatically pumps the next amount to use in the tube. The texture is smooth and lays on the skin nicely. I use it at night after washing my face and using a toner.

reviews.product_name: Aqua Bomb Sleeping Mask
reviews.review_text: At first when I used this mask, I noticed I broke out a little. I continued to use the product and my face did get better (assuming the long face just wasn’t use to the new product). My face felt extremely hydrated when I woke up and lasted throughout the day. The texture was a bit much at first, but I quickly got use to it! Overall I would use this product again for hydrating my skin. I receive this product complimentary for testing purposes.

reviews.product_name: Ultimate Sun Protector Lotion SPF 50+ Sunscreen
reviews.review_text: This sunscreen is great! It comes out as it might be sticky, but after a couple minutes your skin absorbs it and it feels great! I break out easily and I have yet to break out from this product.

reviews.product_name: Aqua Bomb Overnight Lip Mask
reviews.review_text: I got this product for free to review. I enjoy this mask! I feel it is comparable to other lip masks I’ve used. I feel like lips are moisturized in theAM! Worst in the coldMN!

reviews.product_name: T.L.C. Framboos Glycolic Resurfacing Night Serum
reviews.review_text: I received this product complimentary for my honest review. I tried to be consistent with this product, but I will not be adding it to my routine. It feels light but somewhat sticky during application. Every time I’ve used this product I have gotten at least 1 pimple over night. I did not notice a difference in texture at later 1 month of using. Overall, I felt this product did not work for me the way I read other reviews.

reviews.product_name: Lala Retro Whipped Refillable Moisturizer with Ceramides
reviews.review_text: I received this product complimentary for my honest review. I really enjoy this moisturizer! It had a great consistency, doesn’t feel sticky on your face, and gets the job done. Overall, this had been a great moisturizer that hadn’t made me break out.

reviews.product_name: Retinol Reform Treatment Serum
reviews.review_text: I received Shani Darden’s Retinol Reform as a free sample from PinchME and I had never heard about this brand but I’m always up for any retinol out there. It worked as expected however 10ml are nothing when you have a big round face so I decided to use it only in my eyes. Even though I have very oily eyelids it worked very well and did not make them oilier or caused any breakouts. I’m very pleased with how it performs but since I am new to the product I don’t know if the “fragrance free“ feature is a real thing or if the product I got was rancid because it smelled like an old perfume that has been sitting on your granny’s table for years, thats how i can describe and it did not harm my eyes or anything so I’ve kept using it but I think I will forever wonder what should it really smell like... or not smell like. Overall, I give thisp roduct 4 stars just because of the scent.

reviews.product_name: Mini Retinol Reform
reviews.review_text: I received Shani Darden’s Retinol Reform as a free sample from PinchME and I had never heard about this brand but I’m always up for any retinol out there. It worked as expected however 10ml are nothing when you have a big round face so I decided to use it only in my eyes. Overall, I give thisp roduct 4 stars just because of the scent.

reviews.product_name: Rose & Hyaluronic Acid Deep Hydration Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I got very excited when I received my product complimentary from Fresh.  I had already tried the fresh Rose Face Mask so I was sure I was gonna like this deep hydration face cream, but little did I know how much I’d LOVE it!! It is just so rich and creamy, it basically melts on your face and having such an oily complexion I am thrilled and completely surprised at how well my skin reacted to a deep hydration product. I decided to try it only at nights in the first few days but now I have started using it am and pm, either way I don’t go super heavy on my foundation so it works for me, but I’d say it is ticker than the face creams I am used to using. A little goes a long way so apply by the drop until you can calculate how much you need. The scent of roses is amazing and a great way of both starting and closing your day.

reviews.product_name: Jet Lag Mask
reviews.review_text: This product is indeed for all skin types, including oily like mine. At first I was afraid it was gonna be too much for me but after the first night using it as a mask I decided to use it as a regular moisturizer and I was surprised it did not clog my pores or cause any breakouts. It is a deep hydration cream, it’s a heavy cream and I can only compare it to the Nivea blue (the classic blue jar) which I totally love btw and wether you decide to use it as a mask or as an all nighter and bo matter what skin type you have I believe it is a product you will like.  I definitely recommend this product

reviews.product_name: Mini Jet Lag Mask
reviews.review_text: This product is indeed for all skin types, including oily like mine. At first I was afraid it was gonna be too much for me but after the first night using it as a mask I decided to use it as a regular moisturizer and I was surprised it did not clog my pores or cause any breakouts. It is a deep hydration cream, it’s a heavy cream and I can only compare it to the Nivea blue (the classic blue jar) which I totally love btw and wether you decide to use it as a mask or as an all nighter and bo matter what skin type you have I believe it is a product you will like.  I definitely recommend this product

reviews.product_name: Ginzing Vitamin C Eye Cream to Brighten and Depuff
reviews.review_text: I really liked this product but I am not too crazy about it being tinted, so I decided to use it only in the mornings before work, my under eyes won’t look as puffy after a few minutes. The texture is great, is not heavy, quite light actually and comes in a fair size small pot. I’d but it again.

reviews.product_name: Confidence in a Cream Anti-Aging Hydrating Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I loved this cream, specially the “clean” scent is just so nice, it definitely adds to my “fresh” feeling after showering and it’s extremely nourishing. I use it as the last step of my night time routine, I love how fast absorbing it is even though it feels really heavy. Among all its ingredients it has many that I already use so it definitely reduced the amount of steps. I do feel a little tingle after I apply it but it lasts less than a minute and that’s it. I’m very pleased with this product.

reviews.product_name: Rose & Hyaluronic Acid Deep Hydration Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: This cream has such a nice texture and left my skin feeling super hydrated and dewy. It’s very light and I was able to easily layer SPF on top. The smell was a little strong but that’s just my opinion. It was a natural floral scent.

reviews.product_name: 5 Stars Retinol + Niacinamide Eye Serum
reviews.review_text: I love this applicator! It’s so great for my under eyes and the retinol is gentle enough to not irritate my skin. The texture is great too, not too thick and not too watery. It’s easily absorbed into my under eye and it brightens them as well.

reviews.product_name: Watermelon Glow Niacinamide Sunscreen SPF 50
reviews.review_text: Love this sunscreen! It creates such a nice dewy base for my face makeup and doesn’t leave a white cast. It is the perfect consistency and has so many great ingredients to brighten my skin! Will be wearing this daily!

reviews.product_name: Triple Algae Eye Renewal Balm Eye Cream
reviews.review_text: Gifted by Algenist. This eye cream is fabulous! The texture is similar to other eye creams I’ve tried but with a more bouncy finish. It really does what it claims to, my under eyes look brighter already. I love this brand too, vegan and no nonsense!

reviews.product_name: Tea Elixir Niacinamide & Hyaluronic Acid Anti-Aging Serum
reviews.review_text: I love this serum! It is so soothing and I have been using it every night after I moisturize and it’s been helping my skin stay calm and getting rid of a lot of redness. It also feels really luxurious and spa-like!

reviews.product_name: Clear Improvement Charcoal Honey Mask to Purify and Nourish
reviews.review_text: I really like this mask. It dries nicely on my face and doesn’t pull the skin. After taking it off, my skin feels smooth and the pores look smaller. I would recommend this product! I received this free to review but all thoughts are my own.

reviews.product_name: The Serum Stick: Treatment & Touch Up Balm
reviews.review_text: The serum stick was a complimentary gift from Influenster. I like the serum stick for my eyes and forehead. Fills lines and moisturizes well. Unfortunately around my laugh lines it made me break out. I’m usually not prone to breaking out with serums so I stopped using it.

reviews.product_name: Dreamskin Skin Perfector
reviews.review_text: This serum really works! I have seen a noticeable improvement in my skin texture and overall pore size since starting Dream Skin. I had just gotten back from the beach and my skin was dry - this product helped lock in moisture and was a great base for makeup as well. Packaging is beautiful - the bottle is easy to use and love how its available in a refill format.

reviews.product_name: The Dewy Serum Resurfacing and Plumping Treatment
reviews.review_text: I received this product complimentary from Influenster. I absolutely recommend this serum! Not only is it extremely hydrating, makes my skin soft, and is gentle on my sensitive skin, but it smells great! Typically I do not like scented skincare products but this serum smells good when you first apply and then absorbs without scent (which is what I like!). I wake up after using the serum at night and can visibly see my skin looking plumper and hydrated. Thanks Influenster and Tatcha!!

reviews.product_name: Aqua Bomb Overnight Lip Mask
reviews.review_text: I received a sample size from Influenster. The product was easy to apply and felt moisturizing. Morning after using the product my lips feel smooth. I gave 4/5 because I have a different brand that I think moisturizes just a bit more.

reviews.product_name: The Dewy Serum Resurfacing and Plumping Treatment
reviews.review_text: This feels so amazing on the skin! After using it morning and night for two weeks, I noticed a difference not only in the luminosity of my skin but in the texture as well. I highly recommend trying this, especially if you’re a Tatcha fan!

reviews.product_name: 5 Stars Retinol + Niacinamide Eye Serum
reviews.review_text: I love the packaging on this product. The product itself feels really nice and cooling on the undereyes. It has a nice creamy texture that sinks into the skin quickly and easily. I haven’t noticed the biggest difference in my undereye darkness or anything, but this product does feel lovely on the skin.

reviews.product_name: Floral Recovery Overnight Mask with Squalane
reviews.review_text: This product is so nice! It’s exactly what my skin needs this winter. It’s thick but sinks in quickly, is super hydrating, and has a pleasant scent. The packaging is nice and hefty. All in all, I’m loving this!

reviews.product_name: Sugar Lip Balm Hydrating Treatment
reviews.review_text: I have been a fan of these lip balms for years and I love this one! I enjoy how it has just a tint of color. It hydrates nicely. All in all, I really enjoy this lip balm. I carry it in my work bag and love how convenient it is! I received this complimentary from Fresh.

reviews.product_name: Tea Elixir Niacinamide & Hyaluronic Acid Anti-Aging Serum
reviews.review_text: I’ve really noticed a difference in how my skin looks since starting to use this. My skin looks so smooth, my texture is less noticeable, and my redness isn’t as bad. However, as much as I like this serum, it’s super expensive.

reviews.product_name: 5 Stars Retinol + Niacinamide Eye Serum
reviews.review_text: Really nice, hydrating and plumping eye product. I notice that my under eye makeup creases less when using it. Does not feel oily, but also not drying like some retinoid products can be for me. Love that it has Niacidimide.

reviews.product_name: Watermelon Glow Niacinamide Sunscreen SPF 50
reviews.review_text: This product does not disappoint! I absolutely love the original formula, so when I heard this was coming out as an SPF Version, I was really excited. It’s very lightweight on the skin, and is not serum like, like the original. Not greasy at all, and doesn’t leave a white cast on my face. Extremely light scent, somewhat reminiscent of typical SPF products. Feels hydrating all day, and I definitely continue to see a difference in the evenness of my skin tone using this.

reviews.product_name: Tea Elixir Niacinamide & Hyaluronic Acid Anti-Aging Serum
reviews.review_text: I absolutely love this serum. It smells divine. So good that it really incentivizes my need to apply it regularly. My skin feels amazing after continuous use, and it’s definitely feeling like my skin’s elasticity is improving.

reviews.product_name: Mini Daily Microfoliant Exfoliator
reviews.review_text: Classic product, have used it for years. Very gentle but effective for sure. I love how unique and versatile it is to use as well! Great to travel with, and of course convenient that you can use it daily.  Gifted by Dermalogica sampling

reviews.product_name: GENIUS Liquid Collagen Serum
reviews.review_text: I really love how this makes my skin feel. It firms, but also feels really hydrating at the same time. I use it twice a day, before makeup (serum, primer, spf, makeup,) and before bed. Does not interfere with my makeup products at all. I definitely think this will be a staple. gifted by Algenist

reviews.product_name: Magic Cream Moisturizer with Hyaluronic Acid
reviews.review_title: Magic!! Like it say on the box ☺️
reviews.review_text: This is called a magic cream for a reason! I loved it!! Since this product it’s on a pricey side, I wanted to used this for a full month before giving my honest opinion on it. I LOVE IT! Although the consistency of the cream is on the thicker, when you applied it, it feel super light. It give you this little nice glow. I love it! After using for a month I do see a difference in my skin. It’s brighter and my tone is more even. Would totally recommend it! This product was received complimentary from @influenster in exchange for my honest opinion.

reviews.product_name: T.L.C. Framboos Glycolic Resurfacing Night Serum
reviews.review_text: This product is AMAZING. I felt the difference right after the first the application. It instantly made my skin so smooth and soft.  I can’t wait to see how my skin would look and feel after using it for a while.  I’m addicted.

reviews.product_name: Beste No. 9 Jelly Cleanser
reviews.review_text: I’ve been using this cleanser for a couple of week   now and so far so good. I love the jelly texture and how it is easy to washed this off.  It leaves my skin feeling clean and fresh.  Does not dry my skin at all.

reviews.product_name: Lala Retro Whipped Refillable Moisturizer with Ceramides
reviews.review_title: Give me all the whipped cream!
reviews.review_text: Love!! I’ve only been using this cream along their T.L.C Framboos Glycolic night serum for only 2 nights and I can already feel the difference. Its amazing!!  It made my skin so smooth and soft. I’m addicted.

reviews.product_name: Lippe Balm
reviews.review_text: Bringing lip balm to another level! This is extremely moisturizing. It feels really good on the lips and made my lips super soft and smooth. I also leave this in my purse in case I’m in need of a moisturizer for my hands and skin! Love that it’s multi purpose :)

reviews.product_name: C-Tango Vitamin C Eye Cream
reviews.review_text: I have been using this for at least 2 weeks now and have been pretty happy with the product. I’ve been using it exclusively at night. Although I love how it feels when I apply it under my eyes, the cool sensation feels so good and how it absorbs well I didn’t see any major difference for my dark circle or puffiness.

reviews.product_name: Retinol Eye Stick
reviews.review_text: I normally prefer not to use retinol products around my eyes because I tend to break out when I’ve used other retinol eye products before, but with this stick I’ve had no issues, reactions, or sensitivities. It goes on well with the stick design and has no fragrance which I like.

reviews.product_name: Salicylic Acid Acne Healing Dots
reviews.review_text: I’ve tried a few brands of acne dots like these, and while these are the most expensive of the bunch, they seem to work better. For one they’re thicker and seem to stick much better and stay on all night. I think that these work slightly faster than my cheaper acne dots, but like other dots they seem to work best when a zit has already popped. They’re also fairly large and only come in one size, which sometimes feels like a waste for a small zit. Still, having these for particularly difficult zits works out great.

reviews.product_name: Rose & Hyaluronic Acid Deep Hydration Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I received this product from fresh complimentary to review. This moisturizer smells amazing and is rich and creamy. It reminds me of their rose face mask with how much it smells like fresh rose petals. It feels thick when you scoop it out of the container and feels a little oily at first when you apply, but then it absorbs pretty quickly and doesn’t feel greasy. It has two types of hyaluronic acids in it to help boost moisture, and I found that it was quite moisturizing, but it wasn’t able to tackle super dry spots on my skin by itself (adding my face oil on top helped to bridge this gap in moisture).

reviews.product_name: Jet Lag Mask
reviews.review_text: I received this product complimentary from Summer Fridays in exchange for my honest review. This mask provides intense hydration to skin in a formula that is clean and without fragrance. It is a no rinse-off formula, so after letting it sit for 10 minutes you wipe it off. I did love the hydration that this mask provided but the no-rinse formula was a little weird for me, and after I applied my serum and lotion after blotting I did start to notice pilling about half an hour later. When I do rinse off this mask after letting it sit I don’t have any pilling issues so this method, though different from the package instructions, ended up working much better for me.

reviews.product_name: Lip Glowy Balm
reviews.review_text: I purchased this about a week ago. Perfect amount of gloss and shine. It isn’t sticky and feels great on the lips. My lips feel great during and after it fades away. It’s a gloss and a balm and as such you will need to reapply during the day but that’s normal. I love the scent and it isn’t overpowering. A must have definitely! Much better than other balms at sephora!

reviews.product_name: Green Clean Makeup Removing Cleansing Balm
reviews.review_text: It takes off all my makeup, even waterproof - no issues. Find it best if I keep my eyes closed while I work it into my lash line and keep them closed until I wash it off. It doesn’t leave a film over my eyes but there’s something that bothers me when I don’t keep my eyes closed the whole time. Great product, would repurchase here and there as there are cheaper balms that I love as well.

reviews.product_name: Green Clean Makeup Meltaway Cleansing Balm Limited Edition Jumbo
reviews.review_text: It takes off all my makeup, even waterproof - no issues. Find it best if I keep my eyes closed while I work it into my lash line and keep them closed until I wash it off. reviews.product_name: B-Hydra Intensive Hydration Serum with Hyaluronic Acid
reviews.review_text: Love this stuff. Many use it as a moisturizer itself and it’s good like that but not the best. After watching Dr.Dray’s review on it, I listened to her explain how this is a “humectant” essentially meaning you should use it with a moisturizer and not necessarily on it’s own in order for it to do what it is supposed to do. I don’t know why that is surprising even as this is a SERUM. Makes sense that it wouldn’t be used on its own. A bonus for me is that it has niacinamide in it as that keeps my skin nice and calm. Doesn’t leave a greasy film and feels very soothing. This serum is wonderful for boosting moisture. I have dry skin with acne and acne scars. Drunk Elephant products have really helped my skin. I fully recommend this serum!

reviews.product_name: Slaai  Makeup-Melting Butter Cleanser
reviews.review_title: Good balm but on the drier side!
reviews.review_text: I live for Drunk Elephant. I love all of their products - I even have some love for their least loved product - their sunscreen. I was very excited to try this and generally do enjoy it. I used up the entire mini that came in the Midi Commitee set and it lasted me about 2-3 weeks. I would take a small amount, rub it between my fingers (dry hands) and then rub into my dry face. Essentially, I found this balm too dry. I kept having to increase the amount I used because it just wasn’t enough to remove all of my makeup. The product works like a charm but I felt that I need way more than I would using another cult favourite balm. It gets 4 stars for doing what it’s supposed to do - melt your makeup. It gets 1 star off for the fact that I need a larger amount to completely remove said makeup. For the price, I don’t believe I would be getting my money’s worth. If there was more product for the same price, then yes, this balm is the BALM. The bamboo booster is wonderful - I would use a bit of balm on my eyes first then take more balm and mix it with the booster for the rest of my face 2x a week. I would recommend this product as I believe everyone should try it at least once and then decide if this is for you and your needs. I wear a full face of makeup everyday (lots of acne so I wear primer, foundation, concealer and powder plus blush, bronzer, eye makeup...etc.) If you don’t wear a lot of makeup, I suppose this would be more bang for your buck then it is for me. In the end, the consistency is just too dry for my needs.

reviews.product_name: Good Genes All-In-One AHA Lactic Acid Treatment
reviews.review_text: This is the honestly the best product. It’s the one thing that FINALLY cleared up my skin. I have struggled with acne since 2015. I have spent so much money and decided to try this. Been using it exclusively for 2 months and my skin is finally clear. I was hesistant to try it because of the reviews about the brand but I am so happy I did. Give it a try!!

reviews.product_name: Avocado Fine Line Eye Cream with Retinol
reviews.review_text: Used for three nights. Instantly made my undereyes look super dark. On day 4, i woke up with bumps along my lower lash lines. I looked more tired and it was not moisturizing at all. The container is so bad, impossible to get the product out without a spatula. Returned it.

reviews.product_name: Blue Tansy BHA and Enzyme Pore Refining Mask
reviews.review_text: I’ve almost used up all of my first jar of this, and honestly I don’t see the hype.  I really wanted to love it, given all of the really positive reviews, but it just didn’t live up to my expectations at all.  I can’t say anything bad happened from using the mask, but it also didn’t improve my skin at all.  Also, I really did not enjoy the fragrance in it.

reviews.product_name: Watermelon Pink Juice Oil-Free Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: Love how light and fresh it feels!  And the watermelon scent is amazing.  As someone prone to breakouts, I am always cautious when trying new skincare products, but I can say that this never breaks me out!  It provides the perfect amount of moisture and keeps the skin looking glowy!!

reviews.product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C
reviews.review_title: Waiting to see what the hype is about..
reviews.review_text: While it feels nice on and seems to smell pretty good, I’ve used this for a couple nights now and haven’t noticed a difference in my lips afterwards.  I was really excited to try this, but I’m really not sure what all the hype is about.  I’ll keep using it and see if anything changes over time, but so far i’m not overly impressed... my normal lip balms seem to have the same if not a better hydrating effect then this.

reviews.product_name: Self Tanning Bronzing Face Drops
reviews.review_text: I have tried numerous self tanners, and this one really is almost exactly identical to the Tanologist drops from Target.  Similar price point, smell, consistency, and color.  Had higher hopes for this, but was not overly impressed.  Will continue to use here and there for a boost of tan, but that’s about it.

reviews.product_name: Water Drench Hyaluronic Acid Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: Picked this up after reading reviews, and was so happy it lived up to the hype.  Super lightweight, you don’t need to use a lot to cover your face&neck.  It melts into the skin giving you a healthy, dewy, but not greasy look.  I always have a problem with moisturizers either being too thick, too matte (not hydrating enough), or too greasy, and this is none of those things.  It’s amazing, I have tried so many moisturizers and never found one I loved until this!! Even in cold MN winters or humid summers, it’s provides the right amount of hydration.

reviews.product_name: Retinol Reform Treatment Serum
reviews.review_text: I have actually only used this a few times, but so far, I’m impressed! It’s super gentle, doesn’t sting or burn (even with acne).  It also isn’t greasy or sticky like a lot of retinols I’ve tried, it’s super lightweight when applied and sinks into the skin well!  It also gives a beautiful glow and definitely helps even out texture, acne, and fine lines.  Excited to see more long term results!

reviews.product_name: Mini Retinol Reform
reviews.review_text: I have actually only used this a few times, but so far, I’m impressed! It’s super gentle, doesn’t sting or burn (even with acne).  It also isn’t greasy or sticky like a lot of retinols I’ve tried, it’s super lightweight when applied and sinks into the skin well!  It also gives a beautiful glow and definitely helps even out texture, acne, and fine lines.  Excited to see more long term results!

reviews.product_name: Alpha Beta Extra Strength Daily Peel Pads
reviews.review_text: I love this extra strength peel! I use it once daily and my skin always feels so smooth afterwards.  It definitely helps with some texture and minimizing of pores/fine lines a bit which is great.  Definitely my favorite chemical exfoliant/peel and would highly recommend.  It really is worth it and having them as individual wipes is great because you can’t really use too much or waste any! :) For reference: I have active acne, combination dry skin, clogged pores, and lines on my forehead/smile lines and neck and this product works wonders!! Bonus that it doesn’t break me out at all compared to other products I’ve tried (especially retinols)

reviews.product_name: Skin Perfecting 2% BHA Liquid Exfoliant
reviews.review_text: I really don’t know why so many people love this product.  I use it on a cotton pad to sweep across my face and the texture is super oily where it doesn’t settle into the skin for a long time and makes me feel gross as I already have some oily areas on my face.  As for exfoliating and helping with blackheads/pores/acne, I could never get over the oily texture enough to actually use it consistently to see a difference.. I do still use it occasionally when I feel like my pores are super congested but can’t say it really helps.

reviews.product_name: Plum Plump Hyaluronic Acid Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: Super hydrating yet lightweight.  Goes perfectly with the other glow recipe serums (plum plump serum, watermelon glow drops, and guava vit c serum).  In texture and feel, it is similar to the Summer Fridays Cloud Dew Cream, which is what I have been using religiously since it dropped.  Not sure which I prefer yet, but this is a lovely moisturizer for someone like myself with acne prone combo skin.  I can say it is also hydrating enough for the winter or nighttime, as I live in MN and was able to wear this on a dry, cold day and still retain moisture.  Glow recipe never disappoints.

reviews.review_text: I have tried many products that claim to blur imperfections and make your skin look better without makeup. This is the only product so far that really does make a difference in the way my skin looks. The texture is beautiful, I love the packaging and it makes me feel more confident. My only holdup is the price for less than 2oz.

reviews.product_name: Auto Correct Brightening + Depuffing Eye Cream for Dark Circles
reviews.review_text: The packaging itself feels nice & luxurious. I like that the eye cream is in a pump so that you are not contaminating it like in a jar. The cream is thick but absorbs well. My under eyes are more hydrated and it helps to improve the overall appearance. I only gave it 4 stars because of the price for 1/2 oz and the fact that I didn’t see any drastic reduction in puffiness or discoloration.

reviews.product_name: ICE Ceramide Moisturizer with Vitamin F
reviews.review_text: This is probably the thickest face cream I have ever used. Despite that, it does not leave a greasy residue. It’s a little difficult to rub in. I appreciate that it includes a little tool to scoop product out of the jar. The price is fair for the oz you receive. My skin feels softer and looks plumper because of the ceramides.

reviews.product_name: Sugar Lip Balm Hydrating Treatment
reviews.review_text: This product was gifted by Fresh for my review. The packaging is nice & high end with a twist off cap. The lip balm feels very nourishing on my lips and the color is the perfect shade for summer. I have light to light medium neutral undertones & this shade works well for me.

reviews.product_name: Confidence in a Cream Anti-Aging Hydrating Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: This cream is great for dry skin. It plumps up fine lines and is a great prep for makeup. My skin feels so soft and smooth when I use this. I love using it at night because it’s thick.

reviews.product_name: Tea Elixir Niacinamide & Hyaluronic Acid Anti-Aging Serum
reviews.review_text: The packaging itself is BEAUTIFUL! This is a product you’ll want displayed on your vanity. My skin leans toward dry and this leaves my skin feeling more hydrated and soft. This layers well with other products in my routine.

reviews.product_name: Vitamin C Suspension 23% + HA Spheres 2%
reviews.review_text: This stuff is really oily and might be really uncomfortable if applied to the whole face. I use this as spot treatment on my face and on hyperpigmentation hyperpigmentation that I have on my abdomen from eczema and it lightened all those spots really well. Because of this I don’t really mind the oily feel. I also only use at night so. I repurchased several tubes!

reviews.product_name: 5 Stars Retinol + Niacinamide Eye Serum
reviews.review_text: The packaging for this eye serum is really pretty. It has a bult in applicator that feel nice to apply. This contains a blend of retinols to help smooth fine lines and wrinkles and is packed with niacinamide to brighten ceramide to support the skin barrier. This will take some to see an effect so I can’t speak on that yet. However this feels lightweight and nourishing to the eye area and is super gentle & non irritating. The texture doesn’t feel heavy at all.  Overall this is a great eye serum! It is a bit on the pricier side though for 15mL.

reviews.product_name: Floral Recovery Overnight Mask with Squalane
reviews.review_text: This is such a pleasant cream to use, I was worried it might be too heavy but it isn’t! The packaging is lovely & the cream has a pleasant consistency. It doesn’t feel too heavy or too light. It does feel lightly soothing but I’ll have to re-test this when my skin is more irritated but so far I am pleased with the results.

reviews.product_name: Vitamin Enriched Face Base Priming Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: This is definitely a great base for dry skin. It worked well for my oily skin, but I think dry skin types will appreciate this the most. It provides moisture & combats dry flakes so your makeup sits better on your skin by creating a smooth base. It doesn’t feel sticky oily or heavy either.

reviews.product_name: Sugar Lip Balm Hydrating Treatment
reviews.review_text: This was gifted by fresh. I absolutely love this lip balm! It is super moisturizing for my insanely chapped lips but doesn’t feel too greasy or sticky. It has a sheer red tint that is very buildable and adds a nice swash of color to the lips. The packaging is premium and has a twist lock cap so you don’t have to worry about the cap coming loose.

reviews.product_name: Tea Elixir Niacinamide & Hyaluronic Acid Anti-Aging Serum
reviews.review_text: I’ve used this product a few times so I can’t speak on long term effects, but so far this has been a pleasant serum to use. It has a white milky consistency but doesn’t feel sticky when applied. I prefer to use this in the morning due to the antioxidants. My skin feels lightly hydrated and smooth after using this.

reviews.product_name: The Serum Stick: Treatment & Touch Up Balm
reviews.review_title: Great moisturizer for dry skin and chapped lips
reviews.review_text: I used to have oily combo but now my skin got so dry in the winter none of my make up goes well even if I put on facial  oil everyday. I use only SKIi, Blithe and Glow recipe and Herbivore they are all more clean beauty. Before tacha was too oily but now that I have dry skin I started venture into their line again. Tacha has great ingredient and since I am a busy mom I like thing that is easy to use and this was perfect for my dry skin. I use it as almost moisturizer swap all over my face. It goes on smooth and the serum get sank into my skin within 2 minute. It was not as heavy as I thought and it also did not break me out which is rare for a product since a lot of thing break me out easily. I also put  on my severe chapped lips and it really is helping me surpringly because I used so many lip mask from Langie to Bite and those gave temporary relife but left sticky base but tacha serum stick cured my bleeding lip in few minutes after putting on without any stickiness. I am very surprised how well the stick serum is performing. It does not have any scent either which is great for those who are sensitive to fragrance. I wished it had more product but it seems little goes a long way. So happy with the product althought I was not expecting much it truly helped me with my dryness. But I do not recommend putting over make up althought it says it can it will cause contamination and could lead to breakout to sensitive skin so putting on clean face is best choice.

reviews.product_name: Ultimate Sun Protector Lotion SPF 50+ Sunscreen
reviews.review_text: I thought it will be super white liquid but it was kinda champange gold color ! It melt to skin like moisturizing body oil! It doesn’t make my skin dry at all. But it does have tackiness. But not uncomfortable like other spf lotion. So far quite impressed. I have used this brand before like 20 years ago but they have imporved since then.

reviews.product_name: Clear Sunscreen Stick SPF 50+
reviews.review_title: Super easy to use and non sticky
reviews.review_text: Wow such an interesting product! It like clear gel slide on smooth and disappear on skin. I never seen soemthing like this in a form of stick. Usually it white stick and sticky but this wasn’t. So far it very easy to use ! I hope it helps prevent sunburn!

reviews.review_title: Meant to be used as a double cleanse!
reviews.review_text: First, most of these reviews talk about how this product leaves a waxy residue on the skin. But, these types of balms are meant to be used as the FIRST step in a double cleanse. It is meant to breakdown the makeup, not completely cleanse your face! This should be massaged on dry skin, then add water and massage until it becomes milky, and then remove completely. The second step is then to use a gel like face cleanser to remove everything. When used appropriately, this balm is absolutely amazing! It makes my skin feel plump, hydrated and breaks down waterproof makeup so easily!

This stick is a fantastic idea and something I’ve never even heard of before I saw it. This works almost like vaseline (in that it provides a moisturizing protective barrier to tame flaky skin) but much more feminine and luxurious application and not nearly as thick. Love this idea, very easy applicator.

reviews.product_name: T.L.C. Sukari Babyfacial AHA + BHA Mask
reviews.review_text: I was more than a little reluctant to throw $80 at ANY product regardless of the great reviews. I’m 48 and more than a little jaded when it comes to “miracle“ or “game changer“ products. My Sephora Inside JCP made me a 5-pot sample package of Babyfacial and I can now consider myself a convert. The sample gives me about 2 masks per pot. That’s applying it thicker than a night cream too....It’s a thick application each time. Here’s what Babyfacial has done for me: evened out my texture to an awe-inducing degree. My not-so-fine lines? Smoothed down to nearly nothing. My little textural bumps? Gone baby gone. My forehead wrinkles are even smoother. I’m truly amazed! I make sure to use the marula oil afterwards and moisturize well. Here’s what I learned NOT to do: use this more than recommended or follow with the Framboos serum. SERIOUSLY hurt my not-terribly-sensitive skin for a few days afterward. There’s powerful acids at work here to do the magic. Ladies, respect the instructions! I had to slather on heavy duty ointment and cream after my overzealous 2-days-in-a-row applications. It healed and now I’m happily back on the Babyfacial bandwagon. Yes it’s expensive. But it works. I’m buying it during the Appreciation Sale.

I have to finish my Ole Henrikson oil-based remover balm (also good, I just really prefer the texture and ease of Green Clean) before I can justify another makeup remover. As soon as I need to replace it though, I’m buying the big boy of Green Clean.

reviews.product_name: Honeymoon Glow AHA Resurfacing Night Serum
reviews.review_text: I already reviewed this, not sure why it’s not posted anymore (maybe because I mentioned the brand whose serum I no longer use and replaced with this one...Idk).  But I just find it necessary to give my props to this game-changer product. Honeymoon Glow has done beautiful things for my almost-50-year-old skin. My texture has smoothed out to a very noticeable level. My pores have shrunk significantly. My fine lines and coarser wrinkles have faded and become SO much less pronounced. Even my skin’s tone has improved and become more uniform in color. I’m so pleased with Farmacy for offering a product that rivals a much more pricey, much more hyped. I’ve used (and really liked) the other brand’s AHA serum, but the concentration of Honeymoon Glow is higher and I get more bang for my buck (AHAs have been in my skincare regimen for years so my skin can handle the stronger acid content without breaking out, drying out or in general freaking out.). I still use my beloved Babyfacial for once or twice-weekly deep repair, but Honeymoon Glow is my nightly go-to serum. I’ve never tried using it during the day due to sun sensitivity and possible makeup breakup and I’ve never tried the serum without a moisturizer over top of it as my skin is getting drier with time. I was impressed enough to buy a second bottle during VIB sale time even though I still had about 2/3 of my first bottle left. For the upcoming spring VIB sale, this is already in my cart.

reviews.product_name: Glycolic Acid 7% Exfoliating Toning Solution
reviews.review_title: Broke up my "marriage" to Mario Badescu toner
reviews.review_text: I’m really loving The Ordinary products! Tried this toner to see how it compared to my much-loved and frequently purchased Mario Badescu glycolic toner...and love it even more! My skin does well with glycolic acid. I’ve incorporated it into my skincare for the last couple years (basically since I got serious about taking care of my skin and slowing the aging process) and find it’s what does the most for my nearly-50-year-old skin issues with the least irritation. My cleansers (ExfoliKate and Microdelivery) have glycolic acid, my every-other-night serum (Farmacy Honeymoon Glow) is brimming with it, and my favorite masks (DE Babyfacial and The Ordinary AHA/BHA “blood“ mask) are chockful of it. My skin tolerates glycolic remarkably well and this toner preps it for all the products I use on top of it. It’s not super drying as many glycolic toners can be. It makes my skin feel clean and smooth.  I feel it helps control breakouts too. Plus you get a huge bottle for less than $8! This toner does everything my ride-or-die Mario Badescu toner has done for me for years but with slightly less dryness and at a more palatable price. Highly highly recommend this (and the other Ordinary products I’ve tried).

reviews.product_name: Multi-Peptide + HA Serum
reviews.review_text: My new HG serum! I bought not having high expectations despite all the good reviews (I’m a bit jaded after trying so many “miracles“ that just left me unimpressed). I’ve tried and liked a few Ordinary products (their retinol is one of few I can use without flaking or irritation and I’m really digging the “blood mask“) but I wasn’t expecting such immediate and noticeable results as Buffet gave me. Within the first week of using this remarkable serum, my hydration levels have increased dramatically, my coarse wrinkles in my forehead and undereye have faded, my pores (ALWAYS a source of discontent) look SO much smaller and refined and my skin has stayed clear even through my usual “time of the month“ breakout cycle. For under $20, I couldn’t BE more impressed. Buffet even soothed my skin on my chin after I got really overzealous with exfoliating and had a rash with peeling, flaking skin that nothing I previously used would touch. I top Buffet with Perricone Essential Fx moisturizer (another HG for me) and my skin looks 8-10 years younger. I do find the serum sticky upon initial application but topping it with moisturizer completely gets rid of that for me. I pray Sephora keeps The Ordinary line and expands to include their foundations (also wonderful products).

I was excited to try this, but unfortunately it didn’t work for me. I used it a good handful of times to give it a chance, but after every time I used it, I ended up with pretty red irritation bumps on my chin and around my nose. It took a couple days and a heavy duty moisturizer to get my skin back to normal. I don’t have super sensitive skin (but obviously some things can still do it) which is why I was surprised, especially with this “soy, gentle cleanser”. Pretty bummed.

reviews.review_text: Ok. I was pretty skeptical about this, because I’m usually not a fan of “color changing magic” that is supposed to adjust to your skin tone after application. I usually end up looking like a shiny penny. But this is pretty close to magic. I have light rosacea on my face (especially my cheek area), and I have KP red bumps above my eyebrows. This neutralized it extremely well, and felt soothing too. No harsh color change. I don’t use a lot- maybe a pea size amount. Is spreads nicely, and doesn’t leave my skin feeling heavy. Not to mention, for it being an extra layer of protection it feels wonderful. I will use this with a little setting powder for a more refined look, and it works wonderfully. It’s perfectly fine by itself though (even for a combo skin girl like me). Dare I say it helps smooth my pores and fine lines too...? It lasts throughout the day, and I don’t feel any more oily than I normally would at the end of a long day. I’m really glad I decided to get this- I’ll for sure be buying the full size when this is all gone!

reviews.review_text: Probably my favorite cleanser of all time. I’ve tried so many and keep coming back to this one. It’s light and gel like, possible to use on the delicate eye area(which is a big plus for me when I don’t feel like or forgot to remove my eye makeup prior to stepping into the shower) and has a lovely cucumber spa-like fragrance. Only drawback I would say is that if you are going full glam you might want to use this as a second cleanse or just in the morning as it is very gentle. It’s a beautiful product but I’ve noticed that if I had a lot of makeup on when I tone afterwards there’s a bit of residue left. Good for sensitive skin.

reviews.product_name: Clear Improvement Active Charcoal Mask to Clear Pores
reviews.review_text: Hands down best charcoal mask I’ve ever used. First purchase was probably 15 years ago and still using it. Great for a use as a full mask, spot treatment on the face as well as used for spots on the body. As you get older though might want to multi-mask and use on oilier areas or just where spots are as I’ve noticed it really clarifies but also can suck the moisture right out of your face. I like doing the mask at night and going through a moisturizing routine afterwards works good. Highly recommend.

reviews.review_text: This is a lovely nighttime lip mask. The spatula is a nice touch so you aren’t digging in the pot. A lot of product for the price and lasts longer then I expected. Pleasantly surprised so I purchased more from this brand to try out. Anyone else feel that the flavor is slightly reminiscent of 90’s cherry chapstick? Just a hint of that flavor but not completely. What I like most is waking up in the morning and seeing that there is still a layer on to wipe off and my lips are soft and plump. Not dry even if it’s dry outside. I will continue to use this. Highly recommend.

reviews.product_name: Hyaluronic Acid 2% + B5 Hydrating Serum
reviews.review_text: Have gone through a few bottles of this and am so glad Sephora carries it now. I used to purchase through a website but so glad I can purchase now through the Sephora app when I run out. This is great just after the shower to seal in moisture before finishing your moisturizing routine. It’s a bit firming and tightening and just lovely. When I don’t use this I really notice a difference. No wonder it’s sold out so much. I purchase a few at a time to make sure I have backups. For the price this is great and if you haven’t taken the plunge yet I would say go for it. Try it. You won’t be disappointed.

reviews.product_name: Protini Polypeptide Firming Refillable Moisturizer
reviews.review_title: Not for me but may be for you
reviews.review_text: My skin did like this moisturizer but I did have small break outs after I started using it and consistently while being used. My skin felt a bit firmer and definitely moisturized. I backed off from use to see if the breakouts would go away and they did. Nothing else was a factor as I tested this over a span lasting more than six months. I also only used other products consistently during that timeframe that didn’t cause issues and even tried with and without those products being used in conjunction and same result. Now, when I exfoliated more regularly and directly before application the breakouts were a bit less. And when I say breakouts I mean in a very minor way. Nothing too intense but a bit noticeable. So if you are prone to breakouts I would say be wary and exfoliate well with use. Combo to dry skin would benefit from this the most. Especially in a dry climate. If you live in a very humid location and you are more oily prone I wouldn’t exactly say this would be for you. But then again it’s a very good product and who knows, it might just be the best thing you’ve ever tried.I’ve liked every Drunk Elephant product that I’ve purchased. This though I’m not planning on repurchasing as it just didn’t work for my skin type and I’m not such a fan of breaking out as an adult.

reviews.product_name: Vitamin Enriched Face Base Priming Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I recently tried this all in one priming moisturizer. I loved the softness and feel of the of this primer, but the moisturizer part just fell a bit short. The primer was great but there’s a few things that I don’t like. As I received a sample of this, I like the squeeze tube it is in, but as I watch beauty influencers and see advertising it shows this product in a jar. Jars like this for primers and skin care like this allow it to be more prone for bacteria as you ha e to scoop in each time. It also makes the product expire it’s nutrients and extra benefits faster than the alternative. I liked the product using it under my foundation, but I would need to use my own Clinique moisturizer first and then this to feel better. I use Clinique face products except for primer as I use Mac, but I definitely loved the feel of this one. There’s pros and cons to all but this base was good and I would recommend. reviews.review_text: I love IT cosmetics skincare products and this Confidence in a Cream Anti-Aging Armour is no different. The fast-absorbing cream looks nice and thick and contains skin-loving ceramides, Squalane, Niacinamide, Hyaluronic Acid and Peptide-Lipid complex. Upon application, my skin felt super soft and looked healthier and plumper. I began using it at night only because I wasn’t sure if it would be too heavy for daytime but because it absorbs so quickly and doesn’t leave a heavy or greasy feel, I’m able to use it during the day, too. This is definitely a keeper and I am looking forward to seeing how much of a difference it makes in the winter when my skin normally becomes a bit drier!!

reviews.product_name: Mini Daily Microfoliant Exfoliator
reviews.review_text: One of the most important parts of my self care routine is taking great care of my skin. I was really excited to try out Daily Microfoliant complimentary from Dermologica, in exchange for my honest review. There are so many products on the market that use harsh ingredients to exfoliate and smooth the skin. When I learned that this is a rice-based powder that activates when wet, I couldn’t wait to try it. Once activated by water, Daily Microfoliant releases Salicylic Acid, Papain and Rice Enzymes to exfoliate and polish, while Colloidal Oatmeal and Allantoin helps to sooth and keep the skin calm. They say it’s gentle enough to use daily, but I don’t use it everyday. I’ve used it every 2-3 days, which was perfect for me! Once my hands are very wet, I empty the packet into my hands and rub them together to make a thicker, creamy paste. I apply in soft, circular motions for about a minute and then rinse and pat my face dry. I’ve definitely noticed a brighter complexion after only a few uses. This is definitely a product I will purchase and continue to use, especially since Dermologica is cruelty free. The Daily Microfoliant is vegan, silicone free, and free of parabens, dyes, artificial fragrance and gluten. It also comes in a sustainable package, which can be recycled. I love brands that not only care about our skin, but also the planet and our furry friends. This is a keeper and I look forward to trying more products from Dermologica!!!

I had never seen a moisturizer in which you can replace the pod and not have to keep buying the whole jar again. I would definitely recommend this moisturizer especially during winter!
