I had never seen a moisturizer in which you can replace the pod and not have to keep buying the whole jar again. I would definitely recommend this moisturizer especially during winter!

reviews.product_name: Vitamin Enriched Face Base Priming Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: Love how thick, rich, and creamy this product feels. A little goes a long way, which is great in terms that the product will last a long time.  It absorbs nicely into the skin and gives it a bouncy, plump, hydrated feel.  I haven’t had it pill with any of my other skincare products nor makeup products. If used without makeup, it gives you a nice healthy glow!

reviews.product_name: Tea Elixir Niacinamide & Hyaluronic Acid Anti-Aging Serum
reviews.review_text: Not a big fan of the light tea tree scent but it’s calming/relaxing. This serum makes my skin glow and gives it a nice bounce and plumpness. My skin looks more even toned. My skin soaks it up so quickly too. It did not cause any break out, irritation, nor dryness. It has a dropper dispenser which is great to keep everything hygienic and the product lasting longer since there’s no contamination.

reviews.product_name: Honeymoon Glow AHA Resurfacing Night Serum
reviews.review_text: This product is one of the MOST AMAZING products I have ever used for skincare! I’ve been using this for about 3 weeks now and my skin feels so much softer, looks very glowy, and even my very stubborn acne scars have started lightening up! You can feel it start to work even on the first night you apply it! It also instantly hydrated these dry patches I had along my neck and jawline from using other, stronger products. And, it smells just like real honey (so, no strong smells that would indicate stronger ingredients)! A little also goes a long way--I use no more than 2 pumps for the entirety of my face and my neck.

reviews.product_name: Ultra Repair Cream Intense Hydration
reviews.review_text: First off, to tell you of this AMAZING product, I’d like to introduce you to my father: Age 59, hasn’t used lotion in about 10+ years, and lives in the dry mountains of Southern California. So, his skin is beyond repair at this point—so that if he should scratch an itch during winter (just a scratch), he breaks the skin and starts bleeding. But, this right here helped save him when I forced him to use it! It absorbs very easily, is non greasy, and it has been working on damage accumulated over 10 years (with once a day use, over the course of 1.5 weeks)! Upon first use, you can already feel your skin softening. It’s also been working wonders on my old scars and discolorations! A very big bonus for me too is that it’s been so moisturizing on my face! My face is soft and balanced for a good 10 hours after using this to help me against dry, Southern California winters!

reviews.product_name: Superfood Antioxidant Cleanser
reviews.review_text: I love how this cleanser is very gentle on the skin and it has helped with my oily skin. My skin feels more refreshed and healthier when using it. The smell is very delightful. However, when it comes to helping out with dullness or uneven skin tone, I haven’t noticed a big enough difference--I’m already on my second bottle and a mini size. Would recommend for people who have sensitive, oily skin

reviews.product_name: Mini Superfood Antioxidant Cleanser
reviews.review_text: I love how this cleanser is very gentle on the skin and it has helped with my oily skin. My skin feels more refreshed and healthier when using it. The smell is very delightful. However, when it comes to helping out with dullness or uneven skin tone, I haven’t noticed a big enough difference--I’m already on my second bottle and a mini size. reviews.product_name: Luminous Dewy Skin Mist
reviews.review_text: Does it hydrate? Yes. Does it give you a glowy look? Yes. But, does it also feel sticky on your face and takes a moment to settle in? Unfortunately, yes. I am a supporter of Tatcha products and I’m usually completely in love with the products I try with them. Did I completely adore this product? As much as I wanted to, that stickiness that sticks on your skin really bothered me for a solid 5 minutes while waiting for it to go away. But, if that’s something that you can put up with in your routine, then I say go for it. In other aspects, it has worked for me.

reviews.product_name: The Dewy Skin Cream Plumping & Hydrating Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: This is an amazing moisturizer...I just can’t wear it alone in the AM because instead of giving me a “glowy“ look, it makes me look oily. Now, if I wear it under makeup in the AM, then it does help with my dry patches that I sometimes get when putting on some foundations. I completely love it when I use it in the PM, as it does everything I want in a healthy, moisturizing moisturizer: Completely moisturizes, reduces the look of my pores, and gives me a healthy glow for when I wake up. I’m more used to lighter feeling moisturizes, but this is quite thick as well. Overall, it is a great moisturizer to use to help repair dry skin and get a glowing look.

reviews.product_name: Skinlongevity Long Life Herb Anti-Aging Face Serum
reviews.review_text: I received a sample of SKINLONGEVITY LONG LIFE HERB SERUM in exchange for a review. The scent wasn’t overpowering. It absorbed quickly into my skin and didn’t leave an oily residue. Unfortunately the sample was for a single use, so I cannot attest to long term benefits.

reviews.product_name: Good Genes All-In-One AHA Lactic Acid Treatment
reviews.review_text: I was gifted bySunday Riley’s Good Genes All-In-One Lactic Acid Treatment. The product is well packaged; on three sides of the package, there are directions, description, and an explanation of the key ingredients and their functions within the product. I was worried that licorice might be a dominant scent, but I was pleasantly surprised that lemongrass was the primary scent. The scent was very light. The directions were very simple to follow; I just needed one pump as a leave-on treatment. I used this product at night, and my face remained moisturized the following day. My skin does have light pink splotches, but this treatment seems to even out my skin tone. Lactic acid is a mild acid, but I was weary that multiple applications might be too harsh on my skin; the instructions does have caution for sensitive skin. Actually, I did not encounter any issues after using this product for multiple days. I’m very happy with the results.

reviews.product_name: Rose & Hyaluronic Acid Deep Hydration Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I was gifted Fresh Rose Deep Hydration Cream product sample in exchange for a review. This is product is quite a bargain as one container is 1.6 fl oz. The active ingredient is hyaluronic acid, which reduces appearance of fine lines and helps the skin retain moisture. The scent is of fresh roses, but I would prefer a scent just a little less strong. This cream keeps my skin soft and evens out my skin tone. The texture of the cream is light. I use this cream at night and my skin looks dewy in the morning.

reviews.product_name: Triple Algae Eye Renewal Balm Eye Cream
reviews.review_text: I was pleased that I was provided enough of Triple Algae Eye Renewal Balm with Multi-Peptide Complex to use for ten days to give a fair assessment of the product. The texture is light spreads easily. I noticed my fine lines decreased. There’s a dark circles around my eyes also lessened. The area around my eyes feel moisturized.

reviews.product_name: Mini Daily Microfoliant Exfoliator
reviews.review_text: I was gifted by Dermalogica Sampling a 7 day trial of the Daily Microfoliant. The powder is white an not too course. The scent was fairly subtle, but it did remind me of cake batter. The exfoliant was gentle on my skin. A little does go a long way. I did spend some time trying to figure out the best consistency of mixing the microfoliant with water.

reviews.product_name: Protini Polypeptide Firming Refillable Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I just started using the drunk elephant line, although I don’t use all of their products, I’m off to a great start!! My skin absolutely loves the protini cream. It’s a bit more than I’ve ever spent on face cream but it’s worth every penny.

reviews.product_name: Pure Skin Face Cleanser
reviews.review_text: Good product and reasonably priced. My skin feels very clean and moisturized after I use this.

reviews.product_name: B-Hydra Intensive Hydration Serum with Hyaluronic Acid
reviews.review_text: This is a must for my skin. I think some people get confused as to what this product is. This is for a extra boost of hydration. I have dry mature skin so I use this every morning with my C-Firma or the days I don’t wear my Vit C I still use it with the Protini. I also mix this in with my Lala at night when I feel my skin needs some extra moisture. Which is pretty much every night in the winter. Although people with very oily skin may be able to use this on its own without a moisturizer. A quick tip... if you are using the C-Firma and find your skin feels tacky or dry after, mix this in with it and it works like a charm!! Takes that feeling away.

reviews.product_name: Lippe Balm
reviews.review_text: Love this lip balm!  I use it every night and bought myself a second one to keep in my purse. I use it under my eyes as well. Love all drunk elephant products!!

reviews.product_name: Virgin Marula Luxury Face Oil
reviews.review_text: Love love love this product! Worth every penny!!

reviews.product_name: The Water Cream Oil-Free Pore Minimizing Moisturizer
reviews.review_title: Perfect for Combo Skin + V Dry Cheeks
reviews.review_text: I got the sample size and will be ordering the full size soon. I’m so thoroughly impressed with the difference it made in my skin. I did my night routine of double cleansing, toner, eye cream and then this. The application was surprising - I used it before learning about this “water technology.” It goes on like a gel-like cream and then it does become more watery. At first I thought my toner and eye cream hadn’t set yet! But no - it was just this cream essentially melting into the skin. I felt like it needed time to “sink in” or dry up a little bit. I woke up to my skin feeling so supple and soft, even on my normally dry cheeks. BUT my T zone was not oily at all. I didn’t need to moisturize before my foundation - every thing still feels smooth and soft. I would recommend applying in upward strokes though. We’re supposed to fight gravity, not go with it. (;

reviews.product_name: The Deep Cleanse Gentle Exfoliating Cleanser
reviews.review_title: Perf for Daily Use & My Combo Skin
reviews.review_text: I got the mini with my points and I am SOLD. I’ve always been very unsure about gel cleansers with my combination skin. They either don’t sit right, rub right, or wash right. But this definitely has the exfoliating feature that left my face feeling super clean. The exfoliation wasn’t too harsh for me, and I definitely feel I can use it everyday. I did focus the scrubbing more on my t zone and my jaw line where my current acne is. I think people with sensitive skin may want to skip every other day or two, just because I personally feel a little drier than other similar cleansers I’ve tried. For anyone unsure, this would be the second cleanser of your routine, after your oil cleanser. This does not go near the eyes! The smell is so light and pleasant - brings me to a garden or a spa.

reviews.product_name: Hyaluronic Acid Hydrating Serum
reviews.review_text: Some toners are hit and miss in terms of facial moisturizing and THIS hyaluronic acid is PERFECT for that first step of hydration. Now I can apply toners on top freely without worrying if I’ll feel “moisturized” enough with it. This is a new essential to my routine.

reviews.product_name: Niacinamide 10% + Zinc 1% Oil Control Serum
reviews.review_text: Holy grail. New essential to my routine. I’ve been very good about my skincare but looking for an extra push to expedite my skin turnover rate, in addition to my prescription tretinoin. My hormones were crazy and raging this past cycle, and it feels like I haven’t had clear skin in years. I only learned about my hormonal acne this past fall. These pics were from 24 March and 5 April, respectively. The only change was this niacinamide. I have combo skin with drier than normal cheeks, and super dry in the winter. I hope this helps you too! xx

reviews.product_name: Hyaluronic Acid 2% + B5 Hydrating Serum
reviews.review_text: Between me and my boyfriend and friends... We have purchased this product multiple times, haha. It is THAT great. I think it’s a great addition to my routine, it’s my first step before my toner. If you’re on tretinoin like I am, and you’re going through that flaky burn purge, it’ll sting! :cDoes it clear my skin? No, but it keeps me moisturized for a lot longer than before this product. It’s my holy grail - something I’ll repurchase for the rest of my life for sure.

reviews.product_name: Unseen Sunscreen SPF 40 PA+++
reviews.review_text: I love this sunscreen. I’m a medium light skin person, so sometimes sunscreens can leave a white cast on me. This product is so great and goes on so smooth. I think depending on the products of you routine, there could be pilling. I experienced pilling when my skin was peeling, so it’s not a moisturising sort of sunscreen. But otherwise, it goes on real smooth, unscented [or very neutral, I should say], and I do not dread putting it on. [Let’s be real - sometimes sunscreen is a chore!] Unless you’re using a powder foundation, I wouldn’t use this as a primer - it’s quite slick after you apply it. Would recommend for all the medium tones and darker! :)

The cream is lightweight and it doesn’t make your skin look/feel oily. I have combonation skin and I sometimes breakout through moisturizers, but this cream makes my skin look more clean. Although it’s a little bit pricey, I definitely think it’s worth every dollar!

reviews.review_text: I recently recieved the original rice polish powder as a gift from my coworker. Today was my first time using it. First impressions- the packaging is smart (they have a switch to open a small hole to prevent a lot from spilling). I used a little bit and while I was massaging it into my skin, it felt nice. The results were amazing after rinsing, makes your skin feel like a smooth canvas and also (for myself personally) close some pores. A must have and totally worth the money!

reviews.product_name: Superfood Antioxidant Cleanser
reviews.review_text: I wasn’t sure about buying the full size product because I switch cleansers very often and I’m not committed to one brand so I bought the travel size to try. Definitely worth the money & the packaging is very cute.

reviews.review_text: My skin and lips become very dry during the winter so the sales associate recommended this product and I am truly impressed. The application process is so easy and the little rubber applicator is so so cute! This lip sleeping mask hydrates and makes your lips feel so soft. Laneige has many other products amazing for giving you hydration and the whole line is in my opinion very affordable.

reviews.product_name: Cleansing & Exfoliating Wipes
reviews.review_text: I first purchased these wipes during the summer when they first were being sold. I wear heavy eye makeup and I prefer using wipes over cleansing removers. After using these wipes for the first week, I find it very hydrating and it doesn’t leave your skin dry! The scent is also very nice and it removes all your makeup. I restocked about 4 packs so far and I can’t wait to try the other wipes!

reviews.product_name: Original Skin Matte Moisturizer with Willowherb
reviews.review_text: I tested this cream on my hand and decided to purchase it. The cream does what it says, very quick and neat matte finish so it doesn’t make your skin look oily. However, after using it for 3 days, it began to dry out my skin like crazy. I have never used a moisturizer that made my skin look that patchy and flaky before. I had to give this to a friend who has very oily skin, but it doesn’t work for combination skin unfortunately. I wish it was more moisturizing.

reviews.product_name: The Essence Skincare Boosting Treatment
reviews.review_text: I received the product for free for testing purposes from Influenster and Tatcha in exchange of my honest review. It makes my skin feels so cool, refreshed and soft. It boosted my hydration, making my products have a better effect. Definitely a great product to use in the skincare routine.

According to Shiseido, it has a fresh-moisture with hyaluronic acid, a hydrating formula that maintains skin’s moisture for 12 hours. It is a great product that doesn’t leave my skin oily. I feel protected and it provides simplicity to my daily skincare routine because it is 2-in-1 product and I don’t need to use a second product.

reviews.product_name: Urban Environment Oil-Free Sunscreen Broad-Spectrum SPF 42
reviews.review_text: This sunscreen is so incredible: fast- absorbing, oil-free, with Hyaluronic Acid that hydrates skin, and doubles as a face primer. I feel my skin after using really matte, and it didn’t leave a white cast at all on my skin, in spite of it is a combination filter ( has both chemical and physical). This product is water resistant for up to 40 minutes.

reviews.product_name: Ultra Glow Serum: Glow + Strengthen Vitamin C Serum
reviews.review_text: This serum is so good! After many years experimenting products, I realized that Vitamin C makes my face breakout but not this one. I am using it for a few days and I feel my skin is so hydrated and smooth. Also It absorbs very well and it is not sticky.

reviews.review_text: Gifted from the brand.I really enjoyed this serum. Avocados work really nice for my skin and calms my redness down. This serum wasn’t sticky at all and melted right into my skin. reviews.product_name: Rose & Hyaluronic Acid Deep Hydration Moisturizer

reviews.product_name: Soy Hydrating Gentle Face Cleanser
reviews.review_text: I got this complimentary from Influenster. The scent is very cucumber melon and refreshing. I like how it removes the leftover traces of makeup I missed when wiping it off. However, the consistency is a little off as it is more liquidy than I expected. If the formula was more gel like, I’m sure I would have given it 5 stars. I received this product complimentary for review purposes.

reviews.product_name: Sugar Strawberry Exfoliating Face Wash
reviews.review_text: I got this product complimentary from Influenster. After opening the scrub, I immediately was hit by the strong strawberry gummy snacks type smell. The smell turns into a more manageable smell as you wash your face. I love how smooth it makes my skin and the product is amazing. The scent is nostalgic but a little too strong for my liking. I received this product complimentary for review purposes.

reviews.product_name: Vitamin Enriched Face Base Priming Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: This product is amazing! It’s just tacky enough that it makes my foundation lay on top nicely. I love the smell and the texture. Would definitely recommend to anyone who has combination skin, as it stays natural. I received this product for free or complimentary for testing purposes.

reviews.product_name: Alpha Beta Extra Strength Daily Peel Pads
reviews.review_text: Worked great! This peel left my face feeling amazing. I love how well portioned out they are. It’s small but very strong. I’ve only used it once and I’ve seen results. Can’t wait to see what happens after a few uses.

reviews.product_name: Dreamskin Skin Perfector
reviews.review_text: This is definitely a luxury product! If you’re looking for something to splurge and pamper hour skin, this is your product. I have scarring from acne when I was in my teens and this did wonders to both blur my pores and the hyperpigmentation. I can see how the floral scent may not be for everyone but I didn’t mind it. I did receive this product complimentary for review but my opinions are my own.

reviews.review_text: I used this in combination with other SK-II products and love the regimen. This essence is very liquidy which allows it to absorb quickly into my skin. I sprinkle a little onto my hands and pat my face gently to apply. I love how softer and more moisturized my skin has become after using this system.

reviews.review_text: This is a really great product! You get a lot of it for such an amazing price. I actually see a difference in my dark circle. They’re much lighter now.

reviews.product_name: Brazilian Kiss Cupuaçu Lip Butter
reviews.review_text: I love this but way too expensive for a chapstick. It smells heavenly just like the other products in this line and it keeps lips so soft and smooth.

reviews.product_name: Creamy Eye Treatment with Avocado
reviews.review_text: This is the weirdest consistency that I’ve ever experienced. It feels like a regular cream at first then while applying it it starts to feel thicker like it’s dragging across my skin. Then the texture suddenly becomes watery. It even leaves what looks like white casts. Once it dries down it feels normal. But this is the weirdest thing ever and it made me want to return it immediately.

reviews.product_name: Oat Cleansing Balm
reviews.review_text: I love this cleansing balm! It doesn’t leave a greasy feel to the skin and it feels moisturizing. This is one of the best cleansing balms I’ve used especially for the price!

reviews.product_name: Mini Oat Cleansing Balm
reviews.review_text: I love this cleansing balm! It doesn’t leave a greasy feel to the skin and it feels moisturizing. This is one of the best cleansing balms I’ve used especially for the price!

reviews.product_name: Original Skin Matte Moisturizer with Willowherb
reviews.review_text: I don’t know where to start. I love everything about this moisturizer. First of all, it smells like orange citrus dreams. I love the texture it’s so unlike other moisturizers ive tried. I rub it in circles into my skin at night and my face is so soft and perfect in the morning. And you can use this as a primer for make up! GIRL. I got this free from influenster for testing and reviewing purposes.

reviews.product_name: Original Skin Retexturizing Mask with Rose Clay
reviews.review_text: This mask smells so amazing. I love the cooling effect that it has on my face and it dries a perfect mask without having to use too much. As you wash it off it kind of exfoliates your skin with the texture of the mask and leaves me feeling so refreshed and clean. I love it. I got this complimentary from influenster.

reviews.product_name: Cold Plunge Pore Mask
reviews.review_text: The cooling clay really works! I love this face mask. This left my pores noticeably smaller & I woke up with my skin feeling super soft. And it’s such a cute mask. Bc of the alpha hydroxy acid, I always follow a pore mask like this with witch hazel toner, a vitamin c serum & most importantly sunscreen! Thank you @influenster for sending me this & a cute little applicator brush! #TakethePlunge #complimentary

reviews.product_name: Cream Skin Toner & Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I love 2 in 1 products. This is a toner and moisturizer. I found that this product is used better as a toner but it did leave my skin feeling smooth and softer. It feels nice on the face using a cotton pad!

reviews.product_name: The True Cream Aqua Bomb
reviews.review_text: Love these cream! It’s light weight and doesn’t feel heavy on the skin, but keeps your skin feeling moisturized and smooth! Love wearing this under my makeup!

reviews.product_name: Aqua Bomb Cleansing Balm
reviews.review_text: Love this product! My makeup came off so easily and left my skin feeling so soft and smooth! So much softer and gentle on the skin rather than using a makeup wipe!

reviews.product_name: Vegan Milk Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I really like that this product is all vegan and natural. It provides great moisture however I don’t like the greasy texture it leaves after. It lasts very long and keeps my skin hydrated all day but it’s difficult to apply makeup over this moisturizer because of the oil content. Nevertheless it’s a great product and I’ll continue using it on my days off because it keeps my skin moist and healthy

reviews.product_name: Watermelon Glow PHA + BHA Pore-Tight Toner
reviews.review_text: I received this product complimentary via Influenster. I have always been a fan of glow recipe products. This toner is by far one of the best I’ve owned. It’s very gentle on skin and gives results in just about a weeks use. I’ve noticed my pores tightening and my skin looking healthier. It’s a great product for tired, dehydrated skin and works well in all skin types (my type is combination). It also has a pleasantly scent compared to other toners.

reviews.product_name: Mini Watermelon Glow PHA + BHA Pore-Tight Toner

reviews.review_text: I used this peel with the free sample I received complimentary of Influenster. I was unable to note a difference in just one use of this peel however it has a great scent and you can feel a slight tingle in your skin on application. Post application it left my skin feeling really smooth and evened out my skin tone to come point especially between my face and neck. Will consider buying the 4 pack for a trial

reviews.review_text: This serum is packed with effective ingredients and doesn’t leave your face oily. I appreciate their effort to use ingredients that are produced sustainably as well as glass packaging! I also like that they disclose what is in the added fragrance on their website. It is a very subtle scent and naturally derived! Four stars because of a lack of research on the effectiveness of the fruit extracts used

reviews.product_name: Ultimate Sun Protector Lotion SPF 50+ Sunscreen
reviews.review_text: It applies very easily and really does prevent sunburn well. It also leaves my skin very dewy and radiant. Some people with oily skin make think it looks greasy. It’s almost watery so you have to shake the bottle really well. It also smells good! The price of this product may keep me from repurchasing but it is a great sunscreen.

reviews.product_name: Clear Sunscreen Stick SPF 50+
reviews.review_text: It is almost fun to apply. It is a perfect size and texture for easy application. I thought I wouldn’t like this but it is hands-free and does prevent sunburn well. No need to rub it in.

reviews.product_name: Cicapair Tiger Grass Color Correcting Treatment SPF 30
reviews.review_text: Honestly this product is AMAZING. I only use a very small amount and I don’t even need foundation/concealer (I generally don’t wear enough makeup to begin with). This really eliminates redness, and I will DEFINITELY be buying this product. I received this product complimentary for testing purposes.

reviews.product_name: Mini Cicapair Tiger Grass Color Correcting Treatment SPF 30
reviews.review_text: Honestly this product is AMAZING. I only use a very small amount and I don’t even need foundation/concealer (I generally don’t wear enough makeup to begin with). This really eliminates redness, and I will DEFINITELY be buying this product. I received this product complimentary for testing purposes.

reviews.product_name: Cicapair Tiger Grass Cream
reviews.review_text: This product is fantastic for red skin. In combination with the gel and the serum it drastically changes redness and helps with sensitive skin. It is helps with dry skin and does not feel super thick on the skin. I would definitely recommend this product. I received this product complimentary for testing purposes.

reviews.product_name: Cicapair Tiger Grass Serum
reviews.review_text: I love this serum. This works so well to calm redness and sensitive skin. Makes my skin feel very soft and clean. I would highly recommend this to anyone with light redness. I use this product in combination with the gel and cream. I received this product complimentary for testing purposes.

reviews.product_name: Adaptogen Deep Moisturizing Cream with Ashwagandha + Reishi
reviews.review_text: This face cream is Everything! I received a deluxe sample with my order and I couldn’t be more delighted!! What a great moisturizer and overall product! The fact that it’s also a “clean” product makes this moisturizer that much better! Can’t wait to purchase the full size and try more of this line!

reviews.product_name: Mini Adaptogen Deep Moisture Cream with Ashwagandha + Reishi

reviews.product_name: Hello FAB Coconut Water Cream
reviews.review_text: This cream is amazing!! I love it! Makes my skin feel so soft and hydrated! I’m so glad I decided to try it! Even my bestie is hooked!! F-A-B looks good on me!!

reviews.product_name: Cleansing & Exfoliating Wipes
reviews.review_text: Love these wipes, they smell amazing. The only issue I have is how tiny they are. That’s my only complaint.

reviews.product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C
reviews.review_text: Solid product! One of my girlfriends said it saved her abnormally cracked and dried lips while she was on accutane so I scooped up a sample size and it’s lasted me well over a year at this rate and still goin. It’s hydrating and smells great and I love the texture. The only reason I took a star off is because I just love the agave lip mask by bite better. BUT this one by laneige can be worn as you regularly go about your day and the bite one is a little to goopy for that. Happy shopping!

reviews.product_name: Vinosource-Hydra Moisturizing Sorbet
reviews.review_text: Holy grail alert! I’ll admit this is a little pricey, but every time I try to divert to another moisturizer I always just say dream about this one. I’ve decided it is worth it to feel what it makes me feel. Smooth, not at all sticky, lightweight but hydrating, brightening and cooling. And my acne always thrives under this.

reviews.product_name: Original Skin Retexturizing Mask with Rose Clay
reviews.review_title: smoothing and calming for my skin type
reviews.review_text: I have had this mask in my rotation for years! It calms irritation, improves redness, and smooths texture for me. I will say however for my roommate who has more acne (scabbing from picking and beneath the skin) and did not feel like this did her any favors. Everyone’s skin is different and this works great for me consistently!

reviews.product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C
reviews.review_text: Love this. I can tell if I don’t use this at night.. makes a huge difference. You get a lot for your money. I also love the spatula it comes with so you don’t have to stick your finger in it.

reviews.product_name: The True Cream Aqua Bomb
reviews.review_text: Love this stuff. I have combo skin and after applying my serum and nightly facial oil I always need an extra boost of hydration and this gives it to me and it feels soooo nice! I can use this during the day too. I’m on my second thing of it. Addicting.

reviews.product_name: Greek Yoghurt Foaming Cream Cleanser
reviews.review_text: This stuff is a game changer!! I have sensitive/combo skin and this has helped so much with my skin. Like another reviewer said, this stuff is amazing with the Clarisonic! I only need a little bit. This stuff also takes off my makeup. I just bought my second bottle and I’m not even close to finishing my first. That’s how much I’m obsessed with it!!! Will always repurchase this stuff.

reviews.product_name: Avocado Soothing Skin Barrier Serum with Ceramides
reviews.review_text: I received this serum in exchange for my honest review and I was completely taken back on the change in my face in one day! My face is super red 80% of the time I tried this for 2 days and the redness on my face has decreased my 50%. I love the texture also its not super oily which is always a turnoff for me when it comes to face care. The best part is it smells amazing and refreshing!

reviews.product_name: Jet Lag Mask
reviews.review_text: I received this product to try complimentary from summer fridays for my honest opinion. I really enjoyed how this made my face feel after use. I applied it left it on for 10 minutes then gently rinsed. My skin looked a little brighter and it was soft. I felt refreshed . I also would say it gave me a little glow.

reviews.review_title: Not a bad option for on the go!
reviews.review_text: Not a terrible stick. Makes on the go application a breeze. Subtle scent, and doesn’t make me super greasy. Pretty good!

reviews.product_name: Aqua Bomb Brightening Vitamin C Cream
reviews.review_text: This is a good, shelf stable vitamin C cream. Doesn’t burn or sting like a lot of other brands. Smells great.

reviews.review_text: If you get a pimple with cyst on it this product is great for it but if it’s just a red pimple you get it won’t do nothing to it. But it still a great product

reviews.review_text: The product is good but sometimes it won’t stick right on the top of my nose so it won’t get everything . But once you leave it over night you can see the stuff on the strip

reviews.review_text: I have acne combo skin & I like to double cleanse and this product makes your skin feel so smooth after one wash & it smell good too.

reviews.product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C
reviews.review_text: This formula is absolutely amazing! It has a thick consistency that is very soothing for chapped and even extremely dry lips. You automatically feel a difference. Been using for 3 months and still have plenty. Lips are soft and significantly less dry thought the day. Honestly prefer to Lip Glowy Balm even in the daytime.

reviews.product_name: Lip Glowy Balm
reviews.review_text: I have been a huge fan of the sleeping mask and this is perfect for the daytime! Plus the packaging is super cute!

reviews.product_name: Lip Glowy Balm
reviews.review_text: Tried the peach and it was great but this is my new favorite! It has a much more significant scent and it’s great!

reviews.product_name: Vegan Milk Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I have combo skin that can sometimes get oily and is prone to blemishes. I’ve tried my fair share of moisturizers and have found many targeted towards combo skin to be too lightweight and not moisturizing enough. THIS IS AMAZING! This product has made my skin dewy and plump and soaks in wonderfully.

reviews.product_name: Rose Deep Hydration Sleeping Mask
reviews.review_text: I loved this product. My face felt so hydrated the following day. I enjoyed that it was a two step mask and both felt so luxurious when applying. Usually my face can be sensitive to products with strong scents but not this. The smell was light and floral scented. I really enjoyed applying the mask. I was very fortunate to receive complimentary for testing purposes.

reviews.product_name: Cold Plunge Pore Remedy Moisturizer with BHA/LHA
reviews.review_text: I received this product from Influenster for testing purposes. I love Ole Henriksen products and have used many in the past! This moisturizer does not disappoint. It’s very light weight and feels cooling when applied. I think this moisturizer will be a perfect summer moisturizer when the humidity tends to make all moisturizers melt off my face. The texture of this is a light cream texture that applies very nice. It does not feel heavy which will make this a great morning moisturizer. If you are dry skin, you may want to opt for something more moisturizing. The product sinks into the skin well and makes my skin feel hydrated. I cannot comment on oil control as I lean toward a combo dry skin type, but I am a fan of the overall texture and moisturizing factor!

reviews.product_name: Abeille Royale Advanced Youth Watery Oil
reviews.review_text: I received this product free from Influenster for an honest review! I enjoyed how the oil felt during application, it has a light feel that worked very well while rolling my face with a cooled jade roller. The product absorbed really nicely, making my face feel lightly moisturized while still leaving room to apply my nightly moisturizer. My only qualm would be the scent which personally, is not my desired scent. Overall, 4/5 stars for application, feel and packaging!

reviews.review_text: This is expensive for how tiny it is, and all it really does is make my face look like a grease hall. The smell is okay but it doesn’t really do much for me.

reviews.product_name: Brazilian Kiss Cupuaçu Lip Butter
reviews.review_text: It’s basically an overpriced lip balm. It does the same thing as any other balm from the drugstore and the smell gets kind of annoying after a few uses.

reviews.product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C
reviews.review_title: Best thing you can put on your lips
reviews.review_text: If you are looking for a lip treatment with amazing results, look no further than the Laneige lip sleeping mask. A generous amount of this before you go to bed will give you the most plump, soft lips you have ever experienced, no flakes guaranteed. Not to mention how long the tub will last you even with consistent generous use. The little applicator is nice if you don’t want to dip your fingers into the product and it’s really easy to clean with just a little tissue paper. I highly recommend this to anyone who wants to pamper their lips and is willing to pay the money for it.

reviews.product_name: Sugar Hydrating Lip Balm
reviews.review_text: This balm does exactly what is claims to do with the pleasantry of a caramel kick to it. The packaging isn’t annoying to open and I don’t find the caramel scent unbearable. It adds a nice sheen to the lips and lasts a decent amount of time before having to apply again. I’m taking off a star because I find that the balm doesn’t do much for flaky lips and requires exfoliation beforehand instead of melting away the dead skin, but overall it is still a nice hydrating balm.

reviews.product_name: Sugar Hydrating Lip Balm
reviews.review_text: If you’re looking for a cozy lip balm that will keep your lips hydrated while also smelling like a treat fitting especially for the colder months, caramel is your best pick! I’ve taken off a star due to the packaging not being the most sanitary, but other than that, this balm is truly a delight to use. It stays on for a few hours before you have to reapply and it gives your lips a light sheen. Formula is truly sheer so it will not give much color (if any at all) if that is what you’re looking for. Would definitely like to repurchase in the future!

reviews.product_name: Lip Butter Balm
reviews.review_text: If you are in store for a higher-than-drugstore quality lip balm, look no further than here! The new packaging is exactly what this balm needed because now it’s so much easier to apply without even touching the product or risking it spilling out of the tube. It’s moisturizing, long-lasting, and leaves a nice shine on your lips fit for that everyday glossy look. The scent is slightly there but nothing overbearing. Seriously, you won’t be disappointed with this product! Apply before bed for supple lips in the morning. It’s great!

reviews.product_name: Soy Hydrating Gentle Face Cleanser
reviews.review_text: My skin has felt so hydrated using this product. My face never feels dry or tight when I’ve used it. the smell is pleasant and simple. It has done lots for my skin in the week and a half that I’ve been using it. I recommend this product to everyone! Especially if you have sensitive skin.

reviews.product_name: Sugar Strawberry Exfoliating Face Wash
reviews.review_text: This product works really well for my acne prone skin. I like that the exfoliants are gentle on my skin. It’s gentle but not to the point where it barely works. I would buy this product and I do recommend it! I received this product complimentary for review purposes.

reviews.product_name: The True Cream Aqua Bomb
reviews.review_text: I love this product! My skin is currently dehydrated but usually it’s normal/combination and I needed a product that was hydrating but also gentle. Thankfully influenster sent this moisturizer to me right on time! My skin feels very hydrated through out the day and I definitely recommend it.

reviews.product_name: Aqua Bomb Hydrating Toner
reviews.review_text: I currently have a hydrating toner on my routine and this one isn’t as good. It leaves my skin feeling hydrated but not for long and I feel like I have to use a lot to feel the same affect as the one I’ve been using. So all in all it’s good but could be better.

reviews.product_name: Hyaluronic Acid 2% + B5 Hydrating Serum
reviews.review_title: Excellent mix in to your existing routine
reviews.review_text: I mix this in with my day and night serums. I love it! It absorbs quickly and I can feel the difference after a couple of uses. I even got my partner to try it and he noted a difference after 1 use. We live in Alberta and the climate is super dry so hydration is a main priority when looking at skin care products.

reviews.product_name: Aqua Bomb Hydrating Toner
reviews.review_text: Delightfully refreshing and hydrating. I’ve been loving this brand lately so when I ran out of toner this was at the top of my list. I love using it AM and PM. There’s a soft cooling sensation that makes my skin feel so refreshed. Would definitely recommend!

reviews.product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C
reviews.review_text: I use this product all throughout the day. It’s incredibly hydrating and I really love the variety of scents. This is a lip product a continuously re-purchase. I can’t recommend it enough. I would say the only downside is that it does come in a pot and I’ve lost the spatula a few times. It’s only ever bothered me when I have nail extensions and I accidentally stab my product a bit

reviews.product_name: Sugar Strawberry Exfoliating Face Wash
reviews.review_title: Alright but the Soy is better
reviews.review_text: When judging this cleanser on its own it’s just “okay”. I mostly loved the smell since it really is like fresh strawberries on your face. However, I didn’t feel like the sugar gave me a really thorough physical exfoliation and after it melted and it was just the cleanser, my face just didn’t feel as “clean”. In comparison to the Soy Face cleanser, I think the soy offers a better deep clean without the sticky feeling. I would recommend putting this in dry to damp if you want to get more out of the sugar. Or warm it up in your hands to melt if you want to skip out on the exfoliation.

reviews.product_name: Rose & Hyaluronic Acid Deep Hydration Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: This lightweight cream is moisturizing and is suitable for combination skin types. I love the scent of their rose products and this cream did not irritate my skin. I received this product from Fresh for my honest review.

reviews.product_name: Mini Daily Microfoliant Exfoliator
reviews.review_text: This cleanser is gentle to use on my sensitive skin. It exfoliates and leaves my skin feeling smooth. There is no fragrance. This comes in a powder and you put it in water to create a creamy paste. This is great for all skin types. I was gifted by Dermalogica Sampling for my honest review.

I really like the instructions and clear ingredientes all stated in the package so I know when it’s best to use the product.

reviews.review_text: This was one of my favorites from their entire line of products. I think the fact that i can apply it whenever is need it and it is made of clean ingredients really is a plus. Price wise is a bit high for such a small product but quality wise it’s nice.

reviews.review_text: My favorite product from their entire product line. I would say it’s very absorbent so I use it morning and night time.

Apart from visibly reducing my small wrinkles in a few applications, I’ve noticed that the pigmentation of my dark circles has also decreased. I’m loving this gentle product so far, a must for my daily routine!

The scent is also great, not too strong but also not too perfumed (synthetic fragrance-free formula) .I only used like a quarter sized amount and it was plenty so a little goes a long away. I also enjoy that this is considered clean product at sephora meaning that it is formulated without a list of over 50 ingredients, including sulfates (SLS and SLES), parabens, phthalates, and more. I would recommend trying this product

reviews.review_text: I have combination skin, I’ve only used this product for a few days so far it has minimizes the appearance of my pores, does a great job controlling oil in my t-zone area and leaves a slightly cooling sensation on the face, nice consistency, not too heavy or too light, smells great (like eucalyptus) It contains BHA and LHA to help loosen and life dead skin cells that lead to clogged pores. It also contains Alpine Willow extract  which nourishes and conditions skin with rich antioxidant levels and I love the fact that it contains salicylic acid, but it’s not too powerful that it dries out my skin.

It does not have a white cast and won’t rub off on surfaces or clothing. I even have gotten my husband to use this during bike rides to protect the back of his neck and it doesn’t give him a sticky feeling. Would definitely repurchase this again!

reviews.product_name: Retinol Eye Stick
reviews.review_title: Effective retinol eye cream with no irritation!
reviews.review_text: I received gift card to select a product of my choice to review.Knowing how strong and sensitizing retinol can be, I was initially hesitant to use a product with retinol around a delicate area like the eyes. Much to my surprise and pleasure, after using the Peace Out Skincare Retinol Eye Stick for a few weeks, I can report that I have experienced NO irritation, dryness, or flaky skin around my eyes from this product! Not only have I not experienced any negative effects, I’ve also found that this eye stick has helped smooth the lines I have forming under my eyes. I love a multi-use product and this eye stick provides both anti-aging benefits and hydration, to leave my undereyes moisturized and firm. I also love how convenient the eye stick is, which makes it so easy to apply and keep the product targeted (no worries about it getting into eyes!). I highly recommend the Retinol Eye Stick to anyone looking to reduce fine lines around the eye area (hot tip: I also like to use are a targeted treatment on my smile lines!)

reviews.review_text: The Rice Polish Foaming Enzyme Powder in Calming is so AMAZING! I got a hydrafacial (which was top notch) and got a couple samples from my esthetician. One was a gentle cleanse and the other a more intense cleanser for night time. The later one gave me the worst case of contact dermatitis I have EVER had. I know it was the cleanser and not the hydrafacial because I didn’t use the more intense cleanser (called x-trap) until 3 days after the hydrafacial. After using the intense cleanser, my skin reacted in a way I have never experienced before. I went back to my normal skin care and had barely any changes after 3 days. So I decided it was time to get better skincare. I did a lot of research and ended up in the “Clean at Sephora” section. Tatcha caught my eye and I did more research. Then I decided Tatcha was the one. 3 days into my skin care of the (PM) cleansing oil, calming rice enzyme & indigo cream. (AM) Korres Greek Yogurt Cleanser to use w/ my Clarisonic  (Tatcha doesn’t have a simple gel cleanser) with the water cream. I can’t tell you how much better my skin looked after 3 days. Almost all of the contact dermatitis was gone. After 1 week-10days my skin was completely clear. After 2 weeks my skin looks so smooth and calm. It’s a TOUCH dry, but that’s expected with my super dry skin. This combo of products will be my skincare routine for the rest of time. I just wish Tatcha had a gel cleanser!!! Thanks for healing my skin Tatcha!!!

reviews.product_name: Retinol Eye Stick
reviews.review_text: I LOVE this product. The packaging is perfect and application is super easy. Gently apply along upper and lower occipital bones before moving to the lid and under eye- this COMPLETELY eliminates other complaints of “pulling”.  I have sensitive skin and didn’t react badly to the retinol with daily use.

I really did begin to notice my skin improving and looking super healthy!! I know it’s pricey but I am truly amazed!! I will be buying this as it appear now to be my holy grail of skincare!!I love the scent of it!! I received this complimentary in exchange for my honest review. My thoughts are my own.

reviews.product_name: Confidence in a Cream Anti-Aging Hydrating Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: This is one of the best moisturizers that works amazing on your skin. Not only does it hydrate but gives your skin that amazing glow. I love the scent of this face cream. I have sensitive and dry skin but not irritation. I noticed my skin looking healthy and feeling smooth. The texture is thick but absorbs beautifully into my skin. Love this cream!!

reviews.product_name: Magic Cream Moisturizer with Hyaluronic Acid
reviews.review_text: Yes, I am obsessed with the Charlotte Tilbury Magic Cream Moisturizer with Hyaluronic Acid. This is such a luxurious cream from the packaging to the texture of it. It feels amazing and love the lights scent it has.  It works well under my makeup and does leave your skin feeling hydrated.  Love it!!

reviews.product_name: Double Serum Firming & Smoothing Anti-Aging Concentrate
reviews.review_text: This serum feels great on my skin. I enjoyed using it. My skin feels more hydrated after using it and smoother textured. I’d recommend it to anyone. It did not irritate me. Great for any skin type. I received it free to try for 7 days.

reviews.product_name: Alpha Beta Extra Strength Daily Peel Pads
reviews.review_text: Excellent formula, and it is non-irritating to my skin which is dry and sensitive. I’d recommend this to anyone who needs exfoliation and cell turnover. The only reason I would take a star away is because I’d rather a stronger formula that you use less often, and something that has less waste.

reviews.product_name: Yo Glow AHA & BHA Facial Enzyme Scrub
reviews.review_text: This sweet gentle face scrub is perfect for my sensitive dry skin. It didn’t irritate my skin or feel abrasive like physical scrubs can do. I received it free to try from Huda and Influenster. And I’m so happy I was able to try it because I’d buy it myself.

reviews.product_name: Mini Yo Glow AHA & BHA Facial Enzyme Scrub
reviews.review_text: This sweet gentle face scrub is perfect for my sensitive dry skin. It didn’t irritate my skin or feel abrasive like physical scrubs can do. I received it free to try from Huda and Influenster. And I’m so happy I was able to try it because I’d buy it myself.

reviews.product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C
reviews.review_text: I ALWAYS had chapped lips, no matter how much water I drank, no matter what lip product I used. I felt there’s nothing I could do because I already exfoliate, have bought the most expensive lip products etc. Well I saw the rave reviews on this and figured why not. It has totally transformed my lips! Seriously within one night I woke up with baby sift lips. After a week, even better if possible. I’m 34 and I’ve seen some fine lines smooth out as well. I can finally apply matte lipsticks without them sticking to every dry spot and crack. I use it during the day sometimes too not as a mask but just a little for some added moisture. It’s great to wear while you do your skin care and prep before makeup. I will repurchase and repurchase again!

reviews.product_name: Clear Improvement Active Charcoal Mask to Clear Pores
reviews.review_text: I am an Origins Girl already. I love almost all their products. This mask is no different. I adore it. I have pretty normal/dry skin with some redness and fine lines. I’m also very pale. Some masks like this leave me red and irritated because my skin can be sensitive. This mask is great. It’s like a yummy smelling, cooling, relaxing mask in one. It definitely cleans out your pores as it dries and gets tighter on the skin. After rinsing with warm water your skin is squeaky clean. Your skin (if it’s like mine at all) might feel a little tighter (firmer) but I just go in right away with a good hydrating serum. I use it about once a week. I would absolutely recommend. I did receive THIS tube free for testing but I have purchased it in my own in the past and will in the future. All opinions are my own!

reviews.product_name: T.L.C. Sukari Babyfacial AHA + BHA Mask
reviews.review_text: This mask is AMAZING. It’s seriously the only mask I have ever used that has given me immediate results before. This one does! The packaging is super cute and expensive looking (and feeling) The only downside is that since it has light sensitive chemicals in it, there is no way to tell how much product you have left. The mask itself is kinda a yellowey color and a creamy thin consistency. A little goes a long way and spreads easily on to the skin. Now, the FEELING of it. I have very fair, dry, sensitive skin with a tiny bit of redness issues. When I first put the mask on my skin it burned, not unbearable but uncomfortable. However, the feeling only lasted about 60 seconds and then it was fine. Also only the most sensitive parts of my skin felt that way. After I rinsed it off my skin felt very soft actually! I was amazed it wasn’t super drying. I love the oil that comes with it too. It makes my skin feel baby soft! Like I said I could SEE results immediately. My skin was plumped up, my fine lines were very diminished and my skin just felt great! It’s SO PRICEY so I’m 50/50 on whether or not I will repurchase it (but let’s be honest I’m a makeup and skin care addict so I probably will lol) All in all a great mask. I can’t wait to see what my skin looks like after using it a few times!

reviews.product_name: The Silk Peony Melting Eye Cream
reviews.review_text: Okay, first of all- the packaging is presh. Loved it. Made me smile. Next, I opened it. Looked like a cream, okay- I’ll try it. Third, the touch. Smooth. Silk. Creamy. Loved. It! So soft. Yes I want this on my eyes ASAP. Fourth, the scent! Wowzer! So light and floral. Fresh. Perfect. Bottle it up and take that scent with you because you’ll be in love. Seriously impressed. #EyeLoveSilkPeony  #complimentary thanks to  @tatcha @Influenster

reviews.review_text: I didn’t know I needed this product when I got it. It’s incredible and my skin feels so plump and soft. I highly recommend and will be buying in the future.

reviews.review_text: Enjoyed this product. Definitely made dark circles lighter. It was a great product to use and will definitely continue using.

reviews.review_text: If you have dry skin & need a moisturizer that will ILLUMINATE your skin & prep your face for makeup, this product is worth the splurge. I have tried many moisturizers that would quiche my thirsty skin while also leaving my skin dewy & luminous. I have yet to find a moisturizer that acts the same as this one. Grips well to the skin without sliding, hydrated & skin will GLOW.

reviews.review_title: I was skeptical, but yeah I’m obsessed
reviews.review_text: There’s a reason everyone loves this product! I have dry, sensitive and acne prone skin & my skin DRINKS THIS UP! It’s so incredibly smooth, gentle & effective! reviews.review_text: This felt really refreshing on my face and I think it actually helped clear up some blemishes. It’s rather sticky though, I’m not sure if I want to use it in my am ritual but it was great at night. When I put my Plum Plump serum on it smoothed everything out though ant my face felt silky. It’s very gentle too, so don’t be worried if you have sensitive skin. Definitely would recommend to anyone looking for a good toner!

Plus the packaging is so beautiful and I love that the bottle is in the shape of a real plum, so adorable!

reviews.product_name: Papaya Sorbet Smoothing Enzyme Cleansing Balm & Makeup Remover
reviews.review_text: This balm is so gentle yet effective! I always use the Korean 1:1 method for cleansing and with this product I could feel the dead skin peeling away towards the end of the minute. I try to use this 2-3 times a week and I just love it. After cleansing with this balm my skin feels so soft and clean. I’ve noticed that my skin really does glow after using this. The Blueberry Bounce cleanser feels especially nice after using the balm. I recommend this product 100%

reviews.product_name: GENIUS Sleeping Collagen Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I’m so excited to share my experiences with the amazing Algenist Genius Sleeping Collagen! There is so much to love about this cream AND the Liquid Collagen from the GENIUS collection.First off, it’s VEGAN, what??! Yeah baby, hook it up!!! I’m so sick of chemicals and animal products in everything, this algae-based collagen just gives me happiness.Second, like many of us this New Year, I’m trying to focus more on self care and self love - especially focusing on neglected areas like skin health. After only a few weeks of using the Sleeping Collagen every night (diligently! after a gentle cleanse with an all-natural facewash) I’ve already started feeling like my skin is refreshed in the morning. My skin is very dry AND sensitive (super fun combo) so a lot of things irritate it. However this makes it feel springy and fresh all day, and hasn’t upset my face at all!Third, I am a major stresser, and I have a ton of sleep issues. Adding this to my routine makes me feel like I can sleep a little more comfortably and relax a little bit after my personal spa treatment.Overall, I just love it!!I received this product complimentary for sampling purposes, but all opinions are my own.

reviews.review_text: Received this product free from influenster and I love it.  I’m already a big Belief fan and this cleanser is a great addition to the aqua bomb that I use every night. Their products always have a lovely light scent and never strip my skin.  The cleanser does a fantastic job breaking down my eye makeup and doesn’t leave a residual film when I wash it off. Great product!

reviews.product_name: Cold Plunge Pore Remedy Moisturizer with BHA/LHA
reviews.review_text: Generally in the fall and winter I prefer a heavier and more moisturizing cream but for the spring and summer, this is fab!  It has a mild scent that I enjoy and doesn’t break me out. Will definitely be using this all summer in the hot weather to keep my skin hydrated.  Would certainly recommend to anyone with normal to oily skin or those who prefer a lightweight moisturizer for hotter weather.

reviews.product_name: Moisture Surge 100H Auto-Replenishing Hydrator Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: Good for day use. Not moisturizing enough for overnight, but it works well in the daytime under makeup.  Haven’t used a Clinique moisturizer before, but this one is pretty good. Likely a good moisturizer if you have normal or combo skin.

reviews.product_name: The Kissu Lip Mask
reviews.review_text: feels like an instant hug on my lips. it’s very glossy, kinda thick, kinda sticky, but i personally don’t mind. plus the packaging is so cute i love the spoon

reviews.product_name: Volcanic AHA Pore Clearing Clay Mask
reviews.review_text: i apply a thin layer, and rinse off when it’s completely dry. i use this mask around every monday as i work in a restaurant on the weekends so that is when my skin gets most oily. this isn’t a life changing product, but it does help to get rid of unwanted oils. it did not do much for my acne, although it helps slightly to prevent forehead acne from oil buildup. it seems to be able to absorb a fair amount of oil from my skin, although i do have dry skin to begin with. i find that when i rinse it off my skin feels refreshed, it has a slight cooling effect, and i would say feels about 10% smoother than before applying the mask. my skin looks slightly brighter after rinsing it off, and i don’t find this mask too stripping for my dry skin. this isn’t irritating at all which is great considering it is a clay mask. i would recommend this mask for people with dry, combination skin. for me personally i find this mask works best on my forehead and nose which is where i get the oiliest. it doesn’t do much for my cheeks or chin. overall definitely worth a try! great price point for the amount of product. i don’t think you can go wrong with this :o)

reviews.product_name: Salicylic Acid Acne + Pore Cleanser
reviews.review_text: i’ve been using this product on and off for the past 6 months, and i do notice results during the time i’m using it. i have combination sensitive acne prone skin and when i notice more acne than usual, i use this for a couple weeks and it really smooths out my skin and gets rid of blackheads !

reviews.product_name: The Water Cream Oil-Free Pore Minimizing Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: This cream is AMAZING! It says it’s mainly meant for normal to oily skin. However, my face is dryer than the Sahara and it’s my holy grail product! It has such a wonderful consistency and glides on so well. My skin soaked it up and feels so incredible after! A little goes a long way, even for dry skin! So this jar lasts ages and I use it day and night! I’ve noticed a vast improvement in my pores and skin tone. The smell is so delicate and beautiful! Definitely a must have for my regimen!

reviews.product_name: T.L.C. Framboos Glycolic Resurfacing Night Serum
reviews.review_text: Having to wear a mask to work for 12 hours every day was killing my skin. I wanted to wear less make up but my skin was awfulB Uneven texture and tone, redness galore. 2 weeks into using this product and my skin is so much brighter, the tone is so much more even, and the gross bumpy texture is so much improved. I’m able to wear far less make up because I feel so confident about my skin! LOVE this

reviews.product_name: Violet-C Brightening Serum 20% Vitamin C + 10% AHA
reviews.review_text: This product is amazing! Being a nurse, I’ve been having to wear a mask to work and it’s been driving my skin crazy. I was having the dullest, uneven tone and texture and redness. 2 weeks into using this daily and my skin is brighter and more even. Im able to wear less and less make up to work which my skin loves also and I’m getting constant compliments!

reviews.product_name: 5 Stars Retinol + Niacinamide Eye Serum
reviews.review_text: I have recently started using this product on my nighttime routine and I’m very excited about it. The texture of the product is creamy and feels very soft on the skin. The applicator has a very cooling effect and feels very nice. The product is very gentle with the skin knowing that the under eye area is very delicate. The only thing is that i think the price is a bit too much.

reviews.product_name: Sugar Lip Balm Hydrating Treatment
reviews.review_text: This lip balm was gifted to me by Fresh. It is very hydrating and has a sheer tint to it which makes lips look juicier. Doesn’t really have a wow scent but it doesn’t matter when the product is that good. It’s become my favorite.

reviews.product_name: Tea Elixir Niacinamide & Hyaluronic Acid Anti-Aging Serum
reviews.review_text: I love trying out new serums and first of all this bottle is gorgeous. My vanity looks so good. The serum has a bit of a light scent which is really good and fresh. It glides smoothly on skin and the day after my skin felt so porcelain like. It was smooth and soft like a baby’s butt.

reviews.product_name: The Camellia Oil 2-in-1 Makeup Remover & Cleanser
reviews.review_text: I love this product.  I use it as a first step in a two step cleanse.  I only need two pumps in order to clean my whole face so the small ($15) bottle lasted me 4 (almost 5) months.  It doesn’t really have a strong fragrance or anything to it either which is a big plus as well.  I do have fairly dry skin with eczema in certain patches though so someone with oily skin may not like this as much.

reviews.product_name: Soy Hydrating Gentle Face Cleanser
reviews.review_text: If you have dry skin and are looking for a non stripping cleanser this is a great one.  I use it as a second step in a two step cleansing routine, but have also used it on its own and have found that it does a great job of cleaning my skin.  It is non/low foaming so if you have oily or combination-oily skin this may not work as well to clean your skin.  I accidentally bought the full size instead of the mini last September and am still using the same bottle (it’s now April) because a little goes such a long way.  There is a very light cucumber sent and as it foams a very light rose scent comes out, so if you’re sensitive to either of those (or to scents in general) you may want to stay away.

reviews.product_name: Slaai  Makeup-Melting Butter Cleanser
reviews.review_title: Better than the Farmacy one in my opinion
reviews.review_text: For reference I have dry, sensitive, acne and eczema prone skin.Pros:  no strong smell, does not strip skin, no breakouts from continuous use (I’ve had it for a little over a month), is clearly going to last for several more months.  Definitely helps remove sebum plugs.Cons:  Overtime mine has melted through a bit more, doesn’t effect the performance but given that my house is between 74-76F this should not be an issue so be warned if you live somewhere warm.  You will be left with a slight film if you aren’t a double cleanser, I am so I don’t really care but for some people this will be an issue.  If you use the physical exfoliate (I usually just use a chemical one) it is hard to accurately measure how much you need.Overall this is a really solid product with a few minor issues that can be chalked up to personal preference.  I probably will repurchase.

reviews.product_name: Double Serum Firming & Smoothing Anti-Aging Concentrate
reviews.review_title: Smoother skin in less than 7 days!
reviews.review_text: It makes your skin smoother after using it for a couple of days. I got a seven day sample from Influenster and I honestly thought that it wasn’t going to be enough time to test out the product and write a review on it but I was wrong. In actually does say what it does and the applicator is pretty cool because you mix the two ingredients yourself.

reviews.product_name: Advanced Génifique Radiance Boosting Face Serum
reviews.review_title: Bomb asf. I’m not just saying that.
reviews.review_text: So I received this from Influenster and honestly I love it. It says to use it day and night and that’s what I do. I don’t know if it’s making my skin more youth ful but it is controlling the dryness. Before my skin would crack with foundation and now it doesn’t!! I wish it wasn’t as pricey though but I know good skin care is pricey.

reviews.product_name: Estee Lauder Advanced Night Repair Synchronized Multi-Recovery Complex Serum
reviews.review_text: I really enjoyed this product, it was a very thin serum. I got this as a 7 day sample and it did hydrate my skin but I dont think I was able to notice a huge difference in 7 days besides the hydration.
