reviews.product_name: Ultra Facial Moisturizing Cream with Squalane
reviews.review_text: i love this cream! not too thick and greasy feeling. perfect for dry skin and sensitive skin. moisturizes my super dry skin all day and night. doesn’t have any fragrance which i love, and it’s a great price.

reviews.product_name: Mini Ultra Facial Moisturizing Cream with Squalane
reviews.review_text: i love this cream! not too thick and greasy feeling. perfect for dry skin and sensitive skin. moisturizes my super dry skin all day and night. doesn’t have any fragrance which i love, and it’s a great price.

reviews.product_name: AHA 30% + BHA 2% Exfoliating Peeling Solution
reviews.review_text: i love this! not too drying on dry skin and doesn’t burn horribly. but it still gives you a nice tingle to let you know it’s working. after one use i could feel a difference!

reviews.product_name: Greek Yoghurt Foaming Cream Cleanser
reviews.review_text: My sensitive skin loves this cleanser! I have extremely dry, red, sensitive skin. I’m super cautious with what I put on my face but Influenster gave me a free sample to try and I wanted to see what all the fuss was about, and y’all let me tell ya, my skin LOVED this product. My skin felt so clean and soft afterwards and I didn’t breakout or turn red. My face also didn’t feel “tight” afterwards like some products tend to do. I loved this so much! Definitely worth it!

reviews.product_name: Skinlongevity Long Life Herb Anti-Aging Face Serum
reviews.review_text: This serum is the bomb! I’m only 27 and I use anti aging serum because let’s be real, life can be stressful and it’s good to get a head start on beautiful skin! This serum doesn’t break out my sensitive skin and the smell is very minimal. You can use it alone, but I mix it with my moisturizer because my skin is super dry. It is definitely a must have for beautiful looking skin! I received this product for testing purposes from Influenster and it is so good!

reviews.product_name: The Essence Skincare Boosting Treatment
reviews.review_text: I started using this product a few weeks ago. I apply this product immediately after washing my face with cleanser. I have noticed that my skin is more hydrated and plump. The fine lines around my mouth are not as visible as before! The scent is very light and the product is as well. Definitely a must try!! I received this product From influenster In return for my honest review. :)

reviews.product_name: Mini The Essence  Skincare Boosting Treatment
reviews.review_text: I started using this product a few weeks ago. I apply this product immediately after washing my face with cleanser. I have noticed that my skin is more hydrated and plump. The fine lines around my mouth are not as visible as before! The scent is very light and the product is as well. Definitely a must try!! I received this product From influenster In return for my honest review. :)

reviews.product_name: Indigo Overnight Repair Serum in Cream Treatment
reviews.review_text: so great for dry skin!! i have very, very dry skin, but this stuff is an absolute life saver. in one night it got rid of dry patches i’ve had for years. it’s definitely pricy but a little goes a long way! i also love the packaging— it feels luxurious, and the added little applicator thing is a nice touch

reviews.product_name: Mini Indigo Overnight Repair Serum in Cream Treatment
reviews.review_text: so great for dry skin!! i have very, very dry skin, but this stuff is an absolute life saver. in one night it got rid of dry patches i’ve had for years. it’s definitely pricy but a little goes a long way! i also love the packaging— it feels luxurious, and the added little applicator thing is a nice touch

reviews.product_name: Santorini Grape Poreless Skin Cream
reviews.review_text: this is a nice moisturizer! it absorbs well into the skin and wears well under makeup. however, i have very dry skin and i didn’t think that this was as moisturizing as i would have liked it to be. it also felt a little runny/cheap.i received this product for free from influenster in exchange for an honest review!

reviews.product_name: Charlotte’s Magic Serum with Vitamin C
reviews.review_text: this serum is nice— it’s a gorgeous package, it has a nice subtle smell, and it absorbs into the skin well. i put it on in the morning under makeup and it is very hydrating. however i took off one star for the price— even though this bottle will last a while, the price is just so exorbitant for what it is

reviews.product_name: Glycolic Acid 7% Exfoliating Toning Solution
reviews.review_title: A holy grail for dry, textured skin
reviews.review_text: I’ve tried five or six toners in my day, and nothing is as nice as this. It’s definitely strong, so I only use it at night -- but it doesn’t ’burn’ or have that gross chemical smell. My skin, especially in my problem areas like my nose and forehead, is so much smoother and feels plumper, softer, and more hydrated. This is seriously a lifesaver if you’re like me and have dry, troublesome skin.

reviews.product_name: Caffeine 5% + EGCG Depuffing Eye Serum
reviews.review_text: I’ve been using this product twice a day, after toner and before moisturizer, for a week. In that time the contour of my eye has become much less pronounced, and while I still do have dark circles, they’re not as dark and have gotten smaller. More than anything, my skin *feels* better - it feels hydrated and healther; no tightness, sagginess, or dryness.However, this is definitely not an eye cream like Tarte or Clinique, though; it’s a serum. If you’re looking for something to replace your under-eye concealer, then this product isn’t for you.

reviews.product_name: Multi-Peptide + HA Serum
reviews.review_text: This is an incredible serum. I’ve used peptides that cost 4 times this one and got similar results; my skin looks and feels smoother and holds moisture far better, especially if you pair this with the Ordinary Hyaluronic Acid. I have had some problems with it enlarging the pores around my nose, but it’s a pretty small price to pay for my skin feeling so healthy.

reviews.product_name: Moisturizing Eye Bomb with Squalane
reviews.review_text: I have a deluxe sized sample of this, but am not sure I’d buy a full size. I think I’d prefer something a little thicker and creamier. It’s definitely a slippery gel-cream consistency rather than an emollient cream. Nice fresh ginger scent. Does a good/sufficient job of moisturizing. Have not experienced any irritation. I can see this being a pretty good day time eye cream, but I currently already have a day time cream I like better so I’ve been using this at night and am not sure it’s right for me for that use.

reviews.product_name: Watermelon Glow Niacinamide Sunscreen SPF 50
reviews.review_text: This smells so wonderful and actually makes me WANT to use sunscreen, so that’s a big plus for me. It gives a really glowy finish too. That said, pilling IS A THING. I’m about halfway through the tube and after trial and error, this plays really well with the Glow Recipe watermelon juice gel moisturizer. It doesn’t play well with... literally any other moisturizer I’ve tried under it. It’s not a big deal on WFH days, quick errand trips, hanging out with good friends, etc., but I’d be a little self conscious about the potential pilling if I were going *out out*.  I’ve also noticed that using less product helps to avoid the pilling, but that not exactly what we want in a sunscreen! When I’m done with this tube I’m going to try something else, but honestly the fact that it smells so great (but doesn’t irritate my skin), looks and feels nice,  making me use it on a regular basis is worth a lot so I might come back to it later.

reviews.product_name: Squalane + Marine Algae Firming & Lifting Eye Cream
reviews.review_text: Nice fairly thick cream. No scent. Didn’t irritate my eyes (yay!)

reviews.product_name: Greek Yoghurt Foaming Cream Cleanser
reviews.review_text: This product is definitely like what it sounds—it is creamy and moisturizing. Currently, I have VERY dry skin, so my go to is still going to be an oil cleanser, but once summer comes around I will be using this more. It is still moisturizing and doesn’t seem to strip the skin. My skin feels soft and refreshed after using it. There is a slight scent but it smells like sweet greek yogurt (imagine that). Great product overall! I’m not quite sure if it would be fully worth the price point though—it depends on your skin needs! I received this product complimentary for testing purposes and I think it’s helpful for normal to slightly dry skin.

reviews.product_name: Cicapair Tiger Grass Cream
reviews.review_text: I genuinely love this product. Although I’m not sure if I’ve been using it long enough to 100% say it’s made a huge difference in my skin, I have been using it for about a month now every night and haven’t as frequent of acne I’ve noticed. I wake up and my skin looks more even and I don’t have breakouts by the end of the day either. I’m a little mad that I like this so much to be honest because I did receive this product free for testing purposes but now I think I’m gonna have to buy it.... which is basically the only reason I’d give it 4 stars is because it is very expensive.

reviews.product_name: Cicapair Tiger Grass Serum
reviews.review_text: I’m not sure if I’ve been using this product long enough to notice a huge difference, but this in combination with the cream in this line at night is doing great things for my skin! I did receive this free for testing purposes, and I’m not sure yet if I’ll purchase it considering the hefty price but if it continues to help my skin I will!

reviews.product_name: Oat Cleansing Balm
reviews.review_text: This is amazing for taking off your makeup! I use this before I use my cleanser. My skin is super sensitive and this does not irritate my skin! You do not need much product, and it goes well with my cetaphil face cleanser! It is super affordable and all my friends love it! This is perfect for a double cleansing technique!

reviews.product_name: Mini Oat Cleansing Balm
reviews.review_text: This is amazing for taking off your makeup! I use this before I use my cleanser. My skin is super sensitive and this does not irritate my skin! You do not need much product, and it goes well with my cetaphil face cleanser! It is super affordable and all my friends love it! This is perfect for a double cleansing technique!

reviews.product_name: Santorini Grape Poreless Skin Cream
reviews.review_text: Loved this moisturizer, I have large pores and dry skin. It really helped smooth out my skin, I could tell a difference when I applied makeup, and notice how easier it went on, without creasing in my pores, or clinging onto my dry spots. It definitely is an amazing moisturizer for smoothing and moisturizing.

reviews.product_name: Ultra Glow Serum: Glow + Strengthen Vitamin C Serum
reviews.review_text: I really enjoyed this serum, it gave me a pretty glow and hydrated my skin. It is more liquid than most serums I’ve tried, but I really liked to mix it with my moisturizer!

reviews.product_name: Dreamskin Skin Perfector
reviews.review_text: Very hydrating, silky primer. Felt luxurious on my skin. Lovely perfume like scent that might be a little strong for some people, but I quite liked it. The pearlescent quality made my skin slightly dewy. Did a decent job of blurring my pores. Beautiful lux packaging. I look forward to determining if it has any long term benefits.

reviews.product_name: Ultimate Sun Protector Lotion SPF 50+ Sunscreen
reviews.review_text: This sunscreen is expensive, but it comes in the largest container of facial sunscreen I’ve seen. At 150ml, it’s got a pretty good bang for its buck. Makeup applies nicely on top because the sunscreen absorbs well.

reviews.product_name: Advanced Night Repair Eye Concentrate Matrix Synchronized Multi-Recovery Complex
reviews.review_text: I’m going to preface this review by stating I’m 35. I’ve got some fine lines, not deep wrinkles. I noticed that this eye cream provided great hydration and moisture and was nice and thick, which in feel all eye cream should be. But I didn’t notice any visible difference under my eyes. Perhaps continued use would help me prevent wrinkles or perhaps I’m just not the target audience for this particular product. So though it was enjoyable to use, I really didn’t notice a difference.

reviews.product_name: Ultra Repair Cream Intense Hydration
reviews.review_text: I wanted to like this product so much. I have combination skin. I have have sections that are so dry and flaky and others that are pretty normal. Well, this stuff did cure the dryness, but it also made my skin so oily that I was having all kinds of breakouts.

reviews.product_name: The True Cream Moisturizing Bomb
reviews.review_text: I’ve tried SO hard to find a moisturizer that comes close to this because ya girls ballin on a budget. I haven’t been able to find anything that makes my skin feel this good. I’ve been stubborn, but it’s a product I’ll have to keep purchasing. I have dry skin and in the winter it’s impossible. Forget makeup all together because it’s going to be an uneven, textured, and flaky mess. Using this product I’ve been able to not only go without makeup confidently, but it makes my skin so ready for great makeup application. I seriously can’t recommend enough. (I also recommend their sleep mask. It’s AMAZING)

reviews.product_name: Aqua Bomb Sleeping Mask
reviews.review_text: I use this SO MUCH. I love this product. Like I don’t even know what to say other than stop looking at the comments and add to cart. I pair this with their moisturizer and my face feels so hydrated and glowy. (And that’s hard when ya got dry skin. Is for me anyway). I’ve also used this with different moisturizers and it still works wonders. Loveeeeee

reviews.product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C
reviews.review_text: This is a holy grail product for me. I keep chapped lips and I apply a thick layer of this every night before bed and it helps my lips so much to not be as dry. And it lasts SO LONG. Definitely worth the money

reviews.product_name: Advanced Génifique Radiance Boosting Face Serum
reviews.review_text: I received this product complimentary and I am so thankful because I will continue buying! This serum made my skin feel supple and soft. I love the dropper applicator.

reviews.product_name: The Dewy Serum Resurfacing and Plumping Treatment
reviews.review_text: This serum is so hydrating and my skin is plump and juicy. I mix a little in my foundation as well. The scent is faint and the texture is gorgeous.

reviews.product_name: The Essence Skincare Boosting Treatment
reviews.review_text: I love this product. The packaging is beautiful, as always. My skin has been super irritated lately and one week after using this, my irritation is gone. It doesn’t really have a scent.

reviews.product_name: Mini The Essence  Skincare Boosting Treatment
reviews.review_text: I love this product. The packaging is beautiful, as always. My skin has been super irritated lately and one week after using this, my irritation is gone. It doesn’t really have a scent.

reviews.product_name: Barrier+ Triple Lipid-Peptide Face Cream
reviews.review_title: Great moisturizer, but pump is a bit unreliable
reviews.review_text: I bought this myself - quite jealous of the other reviewers who seem to have gotten it gifted! I have very dry skin and was looking for an unscented, soothing, healing moisturizer for winter. Happy to say it’s performing well so far! The flakiness on my forehead is gone. The one issue I have is that the pump for mine seems faulty. I have to pump a bunch before getting even a pea sized amount out. I hope I don’t have to return it, there’s a lot of product left.

reviews.product_name: Mini Barrier+ Triple Lipid-Peptide Face Cream

reviews.product_name: Plum Plump Hyaluronic Acid Serum
reviews.review_text: I have very dry skin and live in a pretty dry climate. I also have very little fat on my face and always wanted plumper skin. I’ve always struggled to keep my skin glowy. This DEFINITELY helps! It’s already a staple in my skincare routine, both day and night. It layers well with my other serums too. I’d like to try this on top of their dew drops product sometime!

reviews.product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C
reviews.review_text: When I have angry, red, dry lips, I put this on at night and by the morning they don’t hurt. I’ve always gone to sleep with some sort of lip balm on but this is the best I’ve tried. Love this, the candy scent is delectable and definitely want to try the others!

reviews.product_name: Water Drench Hyaluronic Acid Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: My face loves this stuff, and the texture is absolutely amazing! it definitely deserves to be called “Cloud Cream“, that’s for sure

reviews.product_name: The Camellia Oil 2-in-1 Makeup Remover & Cleanser
reviews.review_text: This stuff instantly brightens my skin and I can see a definite difference in the texture of my skin. I use Bioderma Crealine to remove my makeup and then this to remove everything else and my skin has never looked better

reviews.product_name: Vinoperfect Radiance Dark Spot Serum Vitamin C Alternative
reviews.review_text: I’ve had this serum for six months now, and after almost nightly use there’s still a quarter of it left. I first got this serum in the birthday kit from 2017 and I didn’t notice an immediate improvement the next morning, but after it ran out, I realized that this was what had been giving my skin that special glow. After a few weeks of using this serum, my dark spots and acne scars had faded, I looked younger, and my skin was radiant. I’m glad I bought the full size, this serum was definitely worth the investment

reviews.product_name: Hello FAB Coconut Skin Smoothie Priming Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: Best primer for dry skin, I have tried everything from drugstore to really high end and still coming crawling back to this one. I have even chose this over the Bobbi Brown vitamin E primer, and that one is still really good, but this one is waaaaayyyy better. I have finally found my holy grail primer for my dry skin.

reviews.product_name: Green Clean Makeup Removing Cleansing Balm
reviews.review_text: This is a good product but I feel like it is making me breakout, i don’t know which ingredient it is or if it’s the scent, but it has brought out pimples in places i never usually get them, in terms of it removing makeup, it is fantastic, it doesn’t leave a film over my skin and removes my waterproof mascara, all in all I would recommend it but not to someone prone to breakouts.

reviews.product_name: Green Clean Makeup Meltaway Cleansing Balm Limited Edition Jumbo
reviews.review_text: This is a good product but I feel like it is making me breakout, i don’t know which ingredient it is or if it’s the scent, but it has brought out pimples in places i never usually get them, in terms of it removing makeup, it is fantastic, it doesn’t leave a film over my skin and removes my waterproof mascara, all in all I would recommend it but not to someone prone to breakouts.

reviews.product_name: Superfood Antioxidant Cleanser
reviews.review_text: I have dry skin and I love this cleanser, my face feels so clean after using this product, no film or residue left on the face. I can not recommend this enough! I love this so much I even bought the mini for honeymoon trip!

reviews.product_name: Mini Superfood Antioxidant Cleanser
reviews.review_text: I have dry skin and I love this cleanser, my face feels so clean after using this product, no film or residue left on the face. I can not recommend this enough! I love this so much I even bought the mini for honeymoon trip!

reviews.product_name: Lip Glowy Balm
reviews.review_text: This is soooo good, it isn’t sticky like other tube lip glosses or balms, just a nice glide and my lips are so hydrated and soft! I love it sooo much! I used the glow recipe lip balm and that dried out my lips but this saved my lips!! Can’t recommend enough! I am buy 3 more tubes asap

reviews.product_name: C-Firma Fresh Vitamin-C Day Serum
reviews.review_title: so far the best Vit C serum I’ve tried!
reviews.review_text: This is worth every penny to me. I love how they keep the actives separate so you can ensure your getting a fresh product. The packaging is amazing. So fun to open up and the pump twists to close to keep a tight seal l. I’ve been using this every morning for about a month and so far the serum is still nice and clear and hasn’t oxidized a bit. I’ve noticed my skin is more vibrant and even toned. I saw reviews that said it smelled bad but it really doesn’t to me and I put the watermelon pink juice moisturizer from glow recipe over it to cover up any smell.

reviews.product_name: Unseen Sunscreen SPF 40 PA+++
reviews.review_text: 100000/10 sunscreen. Mattifying, invisible, pleasant smell. I wear this under my make up and have never had pilling. The bottle lasts for a while if you just put it on once a day like I do. I use their powder sunscreen to reapply throughout the day. This also doesn’t sting your eyes like most sunscreens so I am able to get it all around the sensitive eye area to keep it protected.

reviews.product_name: Mini Unseen Sunscreen SPF 40 PA+++
reviews.review_text: 100000/10 sunscreen. Mattifying, invisible, pleasant smell. I wear this under my make up and have never had pilling. The bottle lasts for a while if you just put it on once a day like I do. I use their powder sunscreen to reapply throughout the day. This also doesn’t sting your eyes like most sunscreens so I am able to get it all around the sensitive eye area to keep it protected.

reviews.product_name: Indigo Overnight Repair Serum in Cream Treatment
reviews.review_text: This is such a great night cream. A little goes a long way. I use tretinoin and always get some skin flaking from being dry. That stopped when I started using this at night. The jar is beautiful and comes with the gold scooper to keep your moisturizer clean and uncontaminated.

reviews.product_name: Mini Indigo Overnight Repair Serum in Cream Treatment
reviews.review_text: This is such a great night cream. A little goes a long way. I use tretinoin and always get some skin flaking from being dry. That stopped when I started using this at night. The jar is beautiful and comes with the gold scooper to keep your moisturizer clean and uncontaminated.

reviews.product_name: Volcanic AHA Pore Clearing Clay Mask
reviews.review_text: I was gifted by Innisfree this Super Volcanic Clusters Pore Clearing Clay Mask , and I have been using it for a few weeks, it is amazing. My pores have gotten smaller, and my skin looks so great. It has Volcanic ash, and is a natural ingredient that forms when lava from a Volcanic eruption solidifies on Jeju Island. It really absorbs sebum, and dirt. This Innisfree clay mask is free from mineral oils or animal ingredients, and artificial fragrances. The texture is soft, and feels almost like a mousse, it spreads easy and dries quickly.  The clay in this product is good for your skin, it is a purifier, a disinfectant, and an exfoliant. This clay also unclogs pores. It has really brightened my skin, I haven’t even had the occasional breakout since I’ve been using this. It has a very light pleasant scent, and it feels very comfortable on my face. It hasn’t dried out or irritated my skin, and my face is much softer. I’m loving the Korean Beauty more and more. This is an excellent product and I will be purchasing it for sure.

reviews.product_name: Good Genes All-In-One AHA Lactic Acid Treatment
reviews.review_text: I was gifted by Sunday Riley , Good Gene’s. This product is amazing. Its gentle yet effective. You can see results literally instantly,  my skin is brighter, tighter, my pores are smaller, my lines are smoother. My skin feels fantastic. I will definitely be using this again, and again. You can use it everyday. I reccomend only using it at night and avoid sunlight.

reviews.product_name: Jet Lag Mask
reviews.review_text: I really enjoyed this Summer Fridays Jet Lag Mask,  overall it is amazing. I love that you can use it as an overnight mask or for a quick 10 minute pick me up mask. It really soothes, and calms my dry skin. I love the consistency, the ingredients, it’s not heavily scented. I havent had any adverse reactions. I’d definitely buy this again!!! Love it Summer Fridays.

reviews.product_name: Mini Jet Lag Mask
reviews.review_text: I really enjoyed this Summer Fridays Jet Lag Mask,  overall it is amazing. I love that you can use it as an overnight mask or for a quick 10 minute pick me up mask. It really soothes, and calms my dry skin. I love the consistency, the ingredients, it’s not heavily scented. I havent had any adverse reactions. I’d definitely buy this again!!! Love it Summer Fridays.

reviews.product_name: Lotus Anti-Aging Night Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: This night cream is light and refreshing. I usually prefer a thicker cream but this one absorbs well and hydrates.

reviews.product_name: Lotus Anti- Aging Daily Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: Love this moisturizer for day time. Light, fresh scent and absorbs well.

reviews.product_name: Benefiance Wrinkle Smoothing Eye Cream
reviews.review_text: You can tell this cream is effective. A little goes a long way as it is very thick

reviews.product_name: C-Rush Vitamin C Gel Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: This vitamin c infused moisturizer is giving my skin the glow and hydration I have been dreaming of! Instantly after use, my skin is illuminated, as if I’m wearing a highlighter. It also takes away the dullness and redness in my skin. I am also excited about the anti aging benefits it has, preventing fine lines and wrinkles which I have around my mouth and eyes when I smile. Also, the smell of this product is AMAZING! It smells like creamcicles! It is a great way overall to freshen up your skin. For the price, it’ll last awhile and does a great job so I think it is worth it. I will be buying more from this line in the future! Thank you Influenster for sending me this product for free to test in return!

reviews.product_name: Aqua Bomb Sleeping Mask
reviews.review_text: I received this product complimentary from Influenster. The few first times I used it, I used a little too much for my sensitive skin, the hyllareuntic acid irritated my skin and made it itch. However I haven’t used as much at a time and my skin has been great with it! It really hydrated it and made it glow. When I woke up in the morning my skin looked very dewy. This is great to add in some extra moisture when you need it! Love it.

reviews.product_name: Squalane + Vitamin C Rose Firming Oil
reviews.review_text: This is honestly one of the best - if not the best - facial oils I’ve ever used. It’s very hydrating without feeling heavy or oily. It seeps into the skin and leaves it feeling silk smooth. I use it about 3 times a week and have not broken out or gotten irritated by it. I have very sensitive acne prone skin, so this amazes me. The long term benefits from vitamin c and Squalane will be great for my skin, and after a month of using I’m already starting to see improvements in brightness, scars, and texture. LOVE THIS!

reviews.product_name: Adaptogen Deep Moisturizing Cream with Ashwagandha + Reishi
reviews.review_text: I struggle with excess sebum around my nose and chin which results in some really bad clogged pores.  I’ve used so many moisturizers that claim to prevent clogged pores.  And very few have performed as effectively as this one.  I’m able to have no make up days again, because this has truly leveled out the oil production and clogged pores.  It’s not a miracle worker, a proper cleansing routine is a must, but I don’t plan on trying any other products so long as this one exists.

reviews.product_name: The Essence Skincare Boosting Treatment
reviews.review_text: This is a phenomenal product!  Without a doubt.  But I’ve found it’s most effective in the short term.  So if you expect this to change your skin over time, I haven’t found that to work.  BUT if you want your make up for the night to have a juiced up canvas, ABSOLUTELY use this as the first step in your skin care prep for makeup.  It gives so much immediate hydration that it plumps up the uneven texture and let’s your foundation sit seamlessly.  I haven’t found another essence, in this price range per ounce, that truly improves my makeup application.

reviews.product_name: A-Passioni Retinol Cream
reviews.review_text: Retinol will, in fact, make your skin peel.  It will cause breakouts/purging.  And this can last about a month.  Its normal.   If this is too strong for you, buffer it by putting your face lotion on first and layer this on top to acclimate your skin to it.  I use chemical exfoliants regularly so my skin has no issue with this, and I use it about twice a week.

reviews.product_name: B-Hydra Intensive Hydration Serum with Hyaluronic Acid
reviews.review_text: I’m not overly sensitive to any of the ingredients in this product, but this gave me cystic acne all over my forehead and chin.  I never introduce more than 1 skin care product into my routine at a time, so this was the only change I made.  I found that it sat on top of my skin rather than absorbing in, leaving a greasy feeling.

reviews.product_name: Superfood Antioxidant Cleanser
reviews.review_title: Great for dry and sensitive skin!
reviews.review_text: LOVE! I got this product as Hyram recommended it and am I looking for cruelty free and vegan products. I was worried cuz a lot of reviews for this product are for oily or combo skin, and mine is very dry. I would add too that my skin is also very sensitive but this product is amazing for it. I skin does not feel stripped or dry after using this. I use this as the second step in my double cleanse. I have been using this for months and have already repurchased

reviews.review_title: Works amazing for my redness on my dry skin
reviews.review_text: I have dry skin and use this for my rosacea and its incredible! I normally only get the odd pimple so I can’t really share how it works for acne, but I found it to really help the redness in my face go down and is not drying (on my very dry skin). I highly recommend for anyone with dry skin looking to help with redness! I also have very sensitive skin and have never had a problem with this!

reviews.product_name: Oat Cleansing Balm
reviews.review_text: I don’t usually write reviews but I saw that this product only had 3.6 stars on average and needed to help increase it. This product is absolutely amazing. I don’t kid when I say they could sell this for over 50$ and I’d still buy it. This is my fav product ever!!!

reviews.product_name: The Rice Polish Foaming Enzyme Powder
reviews.review_text: I bought this YESTERDAY because my skin was peeling from a new retinol I added into my routine. My skin has never felt so smooth in years. This is such a gentle (yet abrasive enough) exfoliater. I 10/10 recommend to anyone

reviews.product_name: Midnight Recovery Concentrate Moisturizing Face Oil
reviews.review_text: This is one of the best facial oils I have ever purchased. I have dry skin, and in the winter time, my skin gets so itchy and dull. I purchased the 30ml bottle just to try out and it was the best CA$62 I’d ever spent. This oil has made such a big difference in the appearance of my skin. You barely need any oil for your full face. I find two to three drops and it’s enough for my face. It feels so good on the skin. The scent is a little bit stronger than what i’m used to in my skincare, but after going to a Kiehl’s store a few weeks ago, the girl said that the fragrance of their products are not added, it is the smell of the ingredients - which makes sense because of the lavender smell the product has. I cannot recommend this product more!!!!!

reviews.product_name: Sugar Strawberry Exfoliating Face Wash
reviews.review_text: I received this from Influenster and was hesitant on trying it out since I had a scent sensitivity to the soy cleanser but it has such a gentle smell to, its perfect. I was expecting a larger more gritty texture but it was gentle enough for anybody who has sensitive skin. My only complaint of it is that it wasn’t gritty enough to get the dead skin off of my skin right away. You would definitely need to use it a few times to actually reduce the amount of texture on the face. This definitely seems similar to their body exfoliator with a better scent.

reviews.product_name: Avocado Soothing Skin Barrier Serum with Ceramides
reviews.review_text: This product was gifted to me by Glow Recipe. This serum is fast absorbing, hydrating, and really does help reduce redness. When I applied it over a red patch on my face, it was instantly less noticeable. The almost gel like consistency is very nice and perfect for my normal/combo skin. It absorbed almost instantly and made my skin look and feel hydrated. This is the best serum I’ve tried thus far and I am happy to keep using it.

reviews.product_name: Rose & Hyaluronic Acid Deep Hydration Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I received this product complimentary from Fresh. I love all things rose and this certainly does not disappoint. The fragrance reminds me of a mix of rose petals and cucumber- similar to Fresh’s soy face cleanser. This moisturizer is so thick and dreamy which I especially enjoy at night, but you can use it in the daytime as well under makeup. My skin was so soft and supple after just one use, and after continued use throughout the week, my skin is noticeably more hydrated and plump. I love this face cream!

reviews.product_name: Mini Daily Microfoliant Exfoliator
reviews.review_text: I have been a huge fan of Dermalogica and their products for years. Their products were recommended to me by an esthetician and they helped save my skin when I was going through my worst phases of acne and dryness. This is the perfect exfoliant for day or night. It’s gentle enough to use daily because it doesn’t strip or over-exfoliate my skin. My skin feels so soft and smooth after every use. Plus a little bit goes a long way so the value is definitely there. This is an absolute must-have! This product was gifted by Dermalogica.

reviews.review_text: I receive a small sample #freeproduct of this from #topboxcircle to exchange for my honest review. I use it as part of my night routine, this eye cream has a thick texture but it feels light and absorbs well on my skin.

reviews.product_name: Smart Clinical Repair Wrinkle Correcting Cream
reviews.review_text: I receive a small sample #freeproduct of this from #topboxcircle to exchange for my honest review. I like that it has a thick creamy texture which feels very moisturizing, and it goes on smoothly and doesn’t feel greasy.

reviews.product_name: Smart Clinical Repair Wrinkle Correcting Serum
reviews.review_text: I receive a small sample #freeproduct of this from #topboxcircle to exchange for my honest review. This serum contains retinoid so I only use it at night before applying my moisturizer. This serum is light and applies easily, also a little bit goes a long way.

reviews.product_name: Glow Cycle Retin-ALT Power Serum
reviews.review_text: Love this product, my skin is looking so good and bright. I have dry skin and a really bad dermatitis and this product has been the best thing I have try in a while. I received this product complimentary for testing purposes.

reviews.product_name: GOOPGLOW Microderm Instant Glow Exfoliator
reviews.review_text: Love this product, I’m not a fan of exfoliating because I have super dry skin but this is amazing. I have used it once this past week and my face felt so fresh, even two days after.

reviews.product_name: Mini GOOPGLOW Microderm Instant Glow Exfoliator
reviews.review_text: Love this product, I’m not a fan of exfoliating because I have super dry skin but this is amazing. I have used it once this past week and my face felt so fresh, even two days after.

reviews.product_name: Revitalizing Supreme+ Youth Power Creme Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I love this product, it makes my skin look healthy and shinny. I’m super dry and this cold weather didn’t help my skin at all but this moisturize help me through it .

reviews.product_name: Mini Revitalizing Supreme+ Youth Power Creme Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I love this product, it makes my skin look healthy and shinny. I’m super dry and this cold weather didn’t help my skin at all but this moisturize help me through it .

reviews.review_text: My absolute favorite makeup remover! I love how it melts the makeup away and leaves the skin feeling smooth and nice! Second time buying it

reviews.product_name: Green Clean Makeup Meltaway Cleansing Balm Limited Edition Jumbo
reviews.review_text: My absolute favorite makeup remover! I love how it melts the makeup away and leaves the skin feeling smooth and nice! Second time buying it

reviews.product_name: Protini Polypeptide Firming Refillable Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: So I went to the store with my mind set on another product. After talking to the employee I ended up trying this. Best decision I ever made. My skin felt so smooth and so hydrated after just 2 uses. Definitely obsessed.

reviews.product_name: Watermelon Glow Niacinamide Dew Drops
reviews.review_text: I received this product complimentary from Glow Recipe. As a dry skin girlie, I have a lot of issues with dry patches and dullness but this absolute GEM of a product has given life to my skincare and makeup routine. I apply it before my makeup application, kinda like a primer, and it gives me the most stunning glow making my skin look so healthy and plump. This is a product I would definitely would buy again.

reviews.product_name: Alpha Beta Extra Strength Daily Peel Pads
reviews.review_text: I received a trial sample from PINCHme and I saw immediate results! I noticed clearer, smoother and softer skin. I would definitely like to include this in my beauty regimen!

reviews.product_name: Alpha Beta Pore Perfecting & Refining Serum
reviews.review_text: I received a free sample from PINCHme and I gave it a try to see if it does what it claims...and it does! I don’t have large pores to begin with, but this helped shrink them down even smaller and they weren’t even visible! Also, the alpha beta properties are good for the skin...I highly recommend!

reviews.product_name: Salicylic Acid Acne + Pore Cleanser
reviews.review_title: Great product at an affordable price point.
reviews.review_text: This cleanser does a good job of ridding my skin of excess impurities, however, I cannot use salicylic products but once or twice a week due to overdrying of my skin. I have combination skin and my T-zone is what gets a little oily. If your skin is on the oilier side and/or you suffer from acne, this is a great product for you. Salicylic cleans on deeper level and helps to clear away dead skin cells.

reviews.product_name: GinZing Ultra-Hydrating Energy-Boosting Cream
reviews.review_text: Love this moisturizer. It took me a while to get used to it, but it’s my favorite summertime moisturizer now. I have extremely sensitive skin and this does not irritate it at all. I only use it in the morning as I need a more intense moisturizer for the evening. Only things I don’t like are the price (but it IS Origins) and the scent (it smells kind of like lemon pledge.)

reviews.product_name: Cold Plunge Pore Mask
reviews.review_text: This product works really well on my skin. I have very picky combination skin, and it’s hard for me to find a product that doesn’t irritate my skin but still addresses my acne and blackhead issues. This mask has done wonders for my face. Personally, it’s worked really well for controlling my problem acne areas and drawing impurities out of my skin. My skin has been smoother and clearer since I’ve been using this mask. It also doesn’t dry my skin out, which has been really nice. I wasn’t initially a fan of the minty feeling but it’s not something I kind now. Will definitely be repurchasing.

reviews.product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C
reviews.review_text: Soooo good. I see a lot of reviewers saying it’s an overrated lip balm but I beg to differ. This stuff conditions my lips like no other. I live in the midwest directly south of Ontario and we have very rough winters. Using this morning and night prevents dryness and cracking on a level no other lip balm can keep up with! It seems like a lot of money to pay but it will last forever also. My friend purchased hers in Korea over a year ago and it’s not even halfway gone, and she uses minimum 3 times a day. Plus with the spatula tool, you can keep this pot very sanitary to keep it for as long as you can. Plus, with any products that are made in Korea you can trust they are ethically produced and are not tested on animals.

reviews.product_name: Good Genes All-In-One AHA Lactic Acid Treatment
reviews.review_text: Product was gifted by Sunday Riley! As someone with sensitive skin, it can be a little scary trying a new skincare treatment, but this one is amazing!  No irritation, just plump, smooth skin. I’ve noticed this helps with keeping breakouts down. I also appreciate all the soothing and hydrating ingredients this includes.

reviews.product_name: Plum Plump Hyaluronic Acid Serum
reviews.review_title: Great makeup primer for normal to dry skin types!
reviews.review_text: This was gifted by Glow Recipe via Octoly. I’ve heard a lot of different opinions on this and Glow Recipe in general, so I was really excited to try it for myself! As a regular skincare product is okay, hydrating and gives a dewy look, although it does wear off. But as a makeup primer?? AMAZING! It makes my makeup look so fresh and skin like and I honestly feel my makeup looks and wears better with it underneath. It’s a small bottle (smaller than expected) but a little good a long way, just 1-2 pumps is more than generous.

reviews.product_name: 5 Stars Retinol + Niacinamide Eye Serum
reviews.review_text: I really love all the star ingredients this eye cream includes; retinol, Niacinamide (something i have yet to experience in an eye cream),  and collagen. I really like how moisturizing this is since my undereye area is so dry.

reviews.product_name: Floral Recovery Overnight Mask with Squalane
reviews.review_text: I really love Fresh products. Mostly because they are non irritating on my sensitive skin. And this is a really great non-irritating formula that does a great job at moisturizing especially in these winter months. But I don’t find it calms my skin, or helps even skin tone or anything extra than a basic moisturizer does.

reviews.product_name: Ultra Facial Moisturizing Cream with Squalane
reviews.review_text: Got this as a deluxe sample.. its very nice, makes my skin wonderfully soft! I may buy the full size one some day, its price is very reasonable.

reviews.product_name: Mini Ultra Facial Moisturizing Cream with Squalane
reviews.review_text: Got this as a deluxe sample.. its very nice, makes my skin wonderfully soft! I may buy the full size one some day, its price is very reasonable.

reviews.product_name: Natural Moisturizing Factors + HA
reviews.review_text: Not bad, but not good either.. Just wasnt moisturizing enough for me. So didnt see the point of using it. Id have to put another moisturizer over it anyways... May be ok for someone with oily/normal skin.  I gave it 3 stars since theres nothing wrong with it and the price is great!! I wouldnt recommend it for dry skin types though

reviews.product_name: 100% Organic Cold-Pressed Rose Hip Seed Oil
reviews.review_text: This seems ok, its my first time using rosehip seed oil, so I have no comparisons to other brands.... I dont notice anything different in my skin but Ive only been using about a week, its a great price so its worth it to keep using and see what happens. The one big complaint I have which is why Im giving it 4 stars instead of 5 is the dropper! It doesnt hold the oil, it spills out everywhere as soon as I take it out of the bottle, I see nobody else has complained of this, so wondering if I got a bad dropper?? This wastes alot of oil since alot of it gets on my counter, etc.

reviews.product_name: Squalane + Omega Repair Deep Hydration Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I used a sample of this and I really loved it! Feels very softening and moisturizing for my skin. I love the ingredients in it also. This will be on my list of things to purchase once I’m able to!

reviews.product_name: Honeymoon Glow AHA Resurfacing Night Serum
reviews.review_text: This serum is alright. Nothing spectacular, but overall it’s worth using. I use 3 nights a week, doesn’t sting or irritate my skin which is good. So I’ll probably start using more often, maybe I’ll notice more of an affect that way. It doesn’t smell good to me, odd scent.... I’ll finish using this bottle, but may keep searching for other aha serums.

reviews.product_name: Alpha Beta Extra Strength Daily Peel Pads
reviews.review_title: Chemical Peel Works Great, Not for Daily
reviews.review_text: Very simple to use and works like a great chemical peel. It is too drying to use regularly for those with sensitive skin and takes adjusting when first starting to use, but makes a huge difference.

reviews.product_name: Greek Yoghurt Foaming Cream Cleanser
reviews.review_text: This was gentle from the start. I didn’t need to use very much to get my face covered. It effectively removed sweat, oil and makeup without drying out my face. Left my skin super smooth and moisturized. I did get this a s a free sample through influenster, but will be back to buy this as I loved everything about it. Due to the price, I will likely not use every day but will definitely be adding it into my skin care rotation.

reviews.product_name: Magic Cream Moisturizer with Hyaluronic Acid
reviews.review_text: A little goes a long ways with this one. Very moisturizing. Works great as a primer and fills in fine lines nicely. Does leave face looking shiny and a bit sticky, but great for under foundation.

reviews.product_name: Superberry Hydrate + Glow Dream Night Mask with Vitamin C
reviews.review_text: I received this as a reward and fell in love with it! It is the only thing that combats my Retin-A flaky and dehydrated skin without the slightest hint of irritation. It smells like and glides on like a dream. I wake up with brighter, more even, and more hydrated skin. I had to purchase the full size because this stuff is amazing!

reviews.review_text: This product is amazing. If you’re on the fence, do yourself a favor and just buy it.

reviews.review_text: It helped me with my dry skin. Cheap but worth like gold. This is my third bottle since spring.

reviews.product_name: Mini Lotus Anti-Aging Night Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I use it as a night time moisturizer after retinol serum, it has a good smell and a nice texture, leave the skin smooth and refresh. Definetly buy it again.

reviews.product_name: Glycolic Acid 7% Exfoliating Toning Solution
reviews.review_text: Perfect toner for everyday use. It is gently exfoliate and my skin is clear and soft after using it.

reviews.product_name: Salicylic Acid Acne Healing Dots
reviews.review_title: Pimple patches are a beauty must have
reviews.review_text: These are beauty must haves, especially when you are wearing face masks and breakout. I enjoy having these to clear up my pimples faster and also to protect in case I accidentally scratch it. I use these generally overnight or during the day. They definitely cut the appearance of a pimple down.

reviews.product_name: Crème de la Mer Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I am enjoying the moisturizing cream I received complimentary from La Mer. Make sure to rub it between your hands first until clear and then pat on your face my skin felt soft and looked bright. Unfortunately it’s rather expensive so I probably won’t buy in the future.

reviews.product_name: Mini Crème de la Mer Moisturizer

reviews.product_name: Ultra Facial Moisturizing Cream with Squalane
reviews.review_text: I really love this face cream. It makes my skin feel so soft and looks so bright. I feel like it does a great job moisturizing, especially as someone with dry skin. I’ve been using it twice a day - AM and PM. I highly recommend it and I certainly plan to buy it in the future.

reviews.product_name: Mini Ultra Facial Moisturizing Cream with Squalane
reviews.review_text: I really love this face cream. It makes my skin feel so soft and looks so bright. I feel like it does a great job moisturizing, especially as someone with dry skin. I’ve been using it twice a day - AM and PM. I highly recommend it and I certainly plan to buy it in the future.

reviews.product_name: Hyaluronic Acid Hydrating Serum
reviews.review_text: During my pregnancy i noticed my forehead was starting to become so incredibly dry that new wrinkles were actually forming. I have been using this product for maybe two weeks, my skin feels healthier, looks glowier and though the wrinkles are still there the moisturizing affect from this product really hides how deep they are.

reviews.product_name: Crème de la Mer Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: Ugh. Sigh. I love the smell of this product. At first it was hard to rub into my face so i looked into their technique. It worked a lot better at moisturizing my skin but i whole heartedly feel like i paid 400$ for teenage acne. I would be shocked if someone said they used this and didn’t see new HUGE PIMPLES. I’ve had this for 4 months and have used it less than ten times. It is a novelty item in my opinion, looks nice on my vanity but horrible for your skin. I do really like the soft cream though.

reviews.product_name: Volcanic AHA Pore Clearing Clay Mask
reviews.review_text: This left my skin flawless. I have very large pores, i self tan so my pores are usually visible from self tanner being stuck in them. This product left my natural skin glowing and flawless. I highly recommend trying this product if you are searching for a clay mask. I usually use Kheils and origins and this is a million times better than both!

reviews.product_name: Jet Lag Mask
reviews.review_text: I had rough skin on my chest. A mix of dead skin, sweat acne and sun damage.. used this mask one time and was so pleased at the difference. Evened out a lot of rough spots and evened my skin tone. Will continue to use chest up!

reviews.product_name: Mini Jet Lag Mask
reviews.review_text: I had rough skin on my chest. A mix of dead skin, sweat acne and sun damage.. used this mask one time and was so pleased at the difference. Evened out a lot of rough spots and evened my skin tone. Will continue to use chest up!

reviews.product_name: Magic Cream Moisturizer with Hyaluronic Acid
reviews.review_text: I got this as a sample so I can’t attest to its long term abilities but I found this moisturizer to be so heavy, almost felt like sunscreen. The smell was nice but I didn’t the magic affects everyone raves about, mostly just made me feel greasy.

reviews.product_name: Niacinamide 10% + Zinc 1% Oil Control Serum
reviews.review_text: Beware! My skin purged like nobody’s business for the first 4 weeks of using this! But after I suffered through, my skin was glowing and even and I had less redness! The only downside is that if you use too much it pills like crazy and your face will be covered in flakey product. Definitely recommend though, it just takes a while to get used to using it!

reviews.product_name: Squalane + Vitamin C Rose Firming Oil
reviews.review_text: I have dry but acne prone skin so oils are very hit and miss for me. This barely feels like an oil!! It doesn’t leave me feeling greasy at all! I’ve been using this for a week (in combination with the lactic acid serum from the Let it Glow kit) and I’ve noticed a big difference in my acne scars and dark spots!! My skin looks so bright and healthy! The downfall is the price but it seems like it lasts a good while!

reviews.product_name: Brighten-i Eye Cream
reviews.review_text: In terms of brightening, 100% does its job. Temporarily. It doesn’t do much for long-term brightening, but works for in the moment. It does have a glitter in it which adds a nice glow. However, it is so incredibly drying. After a few uses it left me with red, scaly under eyes. I would not recommend this for anyone with dry or sensitive skin.

reviews.product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C
reviews.review_text: This product is great at moisturizing your lips or keeping your already moisturizer lips soft. But it does very little to moisturize and repair dry lips. Cold Canada winters are rough on my lips and unfortunately this product doesn’t do much to heal them when they are cracked and dry. But when my lips are already moisturizer this does a great job at hydrating them!

reviews.product_name: Papaya Sorbet Smoothing Enzyme Cleansing Balm & Makeup Remover
reviews.review_title: Amazing when you use it right!
reviews.review_text: This is THE best cleansing balm I’ve tried. For my extremely dry skin, I found it to be hydrating and not drying! I don’t wear a ton of makeup and no eye make up considering I have lash extensions but it takes off my foundation perfectly!! It’s not meant to be a one time cleanser, which is why people find it leaves their skin oily or with a thin film. I follow it up with my Herbivore cleanser and my skin feels so clean!! Make sure to read how to use it properly!!

reviews.product_name: The True Cream Aqua Bomb
reviews.review_text: I LOVE this stuff. It seriously is so hydrating and is so effective. I can’t wait to use this after long plane rides and during dry summer weather! My skin soaks it up, a little goes a long way and the texture is so spot on. It makes my skin happy!

reviews.product_name: Dreamskin Skin Perfector
reviews.review_title: Dewy, smooth finish, high price point
reviews.review_text: So I really like this product. It applies really well and evenly, no clumping. It leaves a really dewy, beautiful finish and your skin feels so moisturized. As a primer I think it does the job but I do prefer it alone because it does even out your skin tone and perfect it! However I think this price point is a bit high for what it is and I think there are more affordable options for the same product.

reviews.product_name: Cicapair Tiger Grass Color Correcting Treatment SPF 30
reviews.review_text: Works, but drying. I saw this being hyped up all over tik tok! I was dying to try it. I will say it evened my skin gone and smoothed it out for a no makeup look! However, especially with my dry skin during winter, I realized it was really drying and I’m concerned it won’t work out for me in the long run because of this. I just got my skin back to a good place in terms of hydration so I might try again.

reviews.product_name: Mini Cicapair Tiger Grass Color Correcting Treatment SPF 30
reviews.review_text: Works, but drying. I saw this being hyped up all over tik tok! I was dying to try it. I will say it evened my skin gone and smoothed it out for a no makeup look! However, especially with my dry skin during winter, I realized it was really drying and I’m concerned it won’t work out for me in the long run because of this. I just got my skin back to a good place in terms of hydration so I might try again.

reviews.product_name: Superfood Air-Whip Lightweight Moisturizer with Hyaluronic Acid
reviews.review_text: This product has done wonders for my skin. It is very lightweight, and does not clog pores which is an issue for me with a lot of moisturizers. Because it is lightweight I find it sometimes isn’t enough moisture, but I love another reviews’ comment about using it underneath another heavier cream. My pores have shrunk so much since I’ve started using this, which I didn’t expect at all. It has also helped with redness, fine lines, and has just smoothed my skin. I will be purchasing my third one soon! Love it.

reviews.product_name: A-Passioni Retinol Cream
reviews.review_text: I have struggled with acne since I was a teenager and now I’m approaching my 30’s. In 2018 I’ve spent $5000 at Sephora in skincare products trying EVERYTHING that was said to be helpful with acne, and nothing worked. I would still get cystic acne, or have breakouts once a month. I was always afraid to try retinol products but finally decided to give this a try.Absolutely nothing has worked for my skin and I am very surprised that this product and retinol would have solved my problem all along. After plenty of research, I started off using this once a week for a month, eventually twice a week, and now I use it every 3 days at night, with a vitamin c product in the morning (I personally prefer the Ren Flash 1 minute facial). I might start using it every other day because I’m so excited with the results.For the first time in my life, my acne scars are seriously fading, I haven’t had a breakout in months (usually I wake up every morning with a new breakout - I’ve lived in darkness, it’s sad), my pores are much smaller and my skin texture is just so much smoother. I finally am closer to having glass skin that I’ve been trying to get for years.I absolutely recommend this product to anyone that has struggled with acne. Thank you so much Drunk Elephant for giving me my self esteem <3

reviews.product_name: The Kissu Lip Mask
reviews.review_text: I thought this was just going to be a fun purchase to spoil myself, but I’ve been using this for two weeks and my lips are noticeably more full and healthy. I’ve noticed they also hold more colour now when I apply tinted lip balm throughout the day. I’m 31 and my lips just aren’t as plump as they used to be, but this mask really brought more life into them lol.Definitely a new necessity in my night time routine!

reviews.product_name: Green Clean Makeup Removing Cleansing Balm
reviews.review_text: I like this a lot!! Good stuff, feels great, smells wonderful! Won’t use it bc I don’t do a separate makeup remover from my cleanser. Sorry, great product, just not necessary for me.

reviews.product_name: Green Clean Makeup Meltaway Cleansing Balm Limited Edition Jumbo
reviews.review_text: I like this a lot!! Good stuff, feels great, smells wonderful! Won’t use it bc I don’t do a separate makeup remover from my cleanser. Sorry, great product, just not necessary for me.

reviews.product_name: Moisturizing Eye Bomb with Squalane
reviews.review_text: So, I don’t have a lot to base this review on except use of this one product. I gave it 4 stars instead of 5 ONLY BECAUSE I HAVE NEVER USED EYE CREAM BEFORE. But I love this!! It is amazing!! It feels good, it’s not greasy (I have an allergy to some eye stuff and I did not have a reaction to this one). Terrific product!! I’d buy (won’t have to bc a little dab’ll do ya!! Also an excellent quality)

reviews.product_name: Cleansing & Exfoliating Wipes
reviews.review_text: GREAT WIPES!! LOVE!! Smells delicious and leaves your face feeling so fresh!! Love the exfoliating side (many wipes don’t have!!) Only negative is that you need to be gentle with the exfoliating side bc it can be a tad rough if you scrub too hard! Just be gentle.

reviews.product_name: Soy Hydrating Gentle Face Cleanser
reviews.review_text: Fresh scent. It smells like cucumber and lemon to me. My skin feels plump and cool after using it with my Clarisonic.

reviews.product_name: Magic Cream Moisturizer with Hyaluronic Acid
reviews.review_title: A little dab will do ya
reviews.review_text: Use with a light hand or else you will get pilling.  It is a nice cream but I am not sure if it is any better than some other products that are out there for half of the price.

reviews.product_name: Charlotte’s Magic Serum with Vitamin C
reviews.review_text: Hardly any scent and soaks into the skin quickly leaving it supple and hydrated.  I feel like long term usage has made my skin more firm. I like to put this on a clean face before I apply primer and makeup.  I’m not a fan of using it with a thick cream because it pills up on my skin.

reviews.product_name: Salicylic Acid Acne Healing Dots
reviews.review_text: These dots work so well! I occasionally have a few pimples that will show up and theyre good for those, but dont work that well on cystic acne (showed results for me but takes a lot of patches). I would definitely say they bring swelling/redness down drastically overnight. The price adds up if you have to use multiple for one spot but they work wonderfully on most spots.

reviews.product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C
reviews.review_text: I use this as a lip sleeping mask and sometimes as a normal lip balm, just lightly applied. I love it so much I buy them as gifts for everyone because its just that amazing. Amazing smell as well.

reviews.product_name: Lactic Acid 10% + HA 2% Exfoliating Serum
reviews.review_text: You don’t need a lot of this to cover your entire face (3-4 drops max). I noticed results within a few days. I deal with small rough patches on my forehead and cheeks, this cleared them up right away. I usually mix with my moisturizer to tone down the strength.

reviews.product_name: Alpha Beta Extra Strength Daily Peel Pads
reviews.review_text: I have VERY sensitive skin with some mild acne and prone to dry skin. This product is amazing at smoothing out the face. Whenever I use it consistently my skin glows and I have ZERO acne/bumps. I think the longer you use it the better results you will see but if you are someone who likes instant results this will not disappoint.

reviews.product_name: Vitamin Enriched Face Base Priming Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: This will last you for so long. It smells great. Goes on smooth. I’ll probably look for a new primer once I’m done with this one but I wasn’t disappointed with this.

reviews.product_name: C-Rush Vitamin C Gel Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: A decent moisturizer that smells amazing and goes on nicely. It gives me a nice glow. I have dry skin and I feel like it does a good job of hydrating. My only issue with it is that I have sensitive skin and it does nothing to calm down redness if that’s something you struggle with. If my skin is already red I won’t use it but if I’m having a calm skin day I will use it. It’s a good creme to use with other products but it’s not something I want to use everyday.

reviews.product_name: C-Rush Vitamin C Gel Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: A decent moisturizer that smells amazing and goes on nicely. It gives me a nice glow. I have dry skin and I feel like it does a good job of hydrating. My only issue with it is that I have sensitive skin and it does nothing to calm down redness if that’s something you struggle with. If my skin is already red I won’t use it but if I’m having a calm skin day I will use it. It’s a good creme to use with other products but it’s not something I want to use everyday.

reviews.product_name: The Water Cream Oil-Free Pore Minimizing Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: Love it! Works for dry skin. I have received many compliments on my skin, so the results are noticeable!

reviews.product_name: Mini The Water Cream
reviews.review_text: Love it! Works for dry skin. I have received many compliments on my skin, so the results are noticeable!

reviews.product_name: The Dewy Skin Cream Plumping & Hydrating Moisturizer
The Rice Polish Foaming Enzyme Powder
Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C
reviews.review_text: I’ve actually been using this grapefruit lip mask every night before bed for the last month religiously because a) the grapefruity smell is amazing and b) I have a bad habit of biting my lips and it dries them out but the lip mask prevents the dryness. The lip mask makes my lips really soft and hydrated! It also repairs cracking from dryness and prevents it from happening in the first place. *I received the mask complimentary for test purposes.

reviews.product_name: PHAT Glow Facial Mask
reviews.review_text: So I have super sensitive skin and I’ve tried several other products that have similar claims and I’ve found that PHAt is by far my favourite one and doesn’t give me the slight redness or even peeling that some other products have given me, my skin is incredibly smooth and somewhat brighter after using the product, and my pores are noticeably reduced. I also let my friend try this (we were on weekend trip together), who noticed much softer skin and reduced acne. I got this complimentary for test purposes but I 100% plan on purchasing after I run out of this stuff.

reviews.product_name: Moisture Surge 100H Auto-Replenishing Hydrator Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: Really hydrating moisturizer that has a really pleasant texture - more of a gel than cream formulation, which I think is nice as the weather gets warmer and the air gets less dry! I also like that there’s no offensive scent.

reviews.product_name: Squalane + Marine Algae Firming & Lifting Eye Cream
reviews.review_text: This eye cream and surprisingly quick to absorb and really lovely on the skin. It feels much thicker than normal creams but isnt heavy at all! I got this for free for promo from influencer and really love it! My makeup looks better during the day and it absorbs quickly enough to wear under makeup but also is light enough to wear at night without feeling heavy!

reviews.product_name: Microneedling Anti-Wrinkle Retinol Patches
reviews.review_text: I guess I could be short winded and say ... I love these but that wouldn’t do it justice. I love these like Jack loved Rose, like Jim loves Pam, like Forrest loves Jen-nay. They leave no irritation, no film, they stay out and don’t budge and are comfortable enough to sleep in! I have a fantastically stressful job that’s given me some beautifully deep brow lines to the point my makeup would sink into that Grand Canyon in minutes, not any more baby! I have bought three boxes and will be buying more. I use them over night while I sleep twice a week for 2 weeks maybe once a month? Result... I’m 30 and someone told me the other day I looked like I was in my early 20s, AND THEY DONT EVEN LIKE ME ENOUGH TO LIE TO ME! I have horribly sensitive skin and have never woken up irritated or inflamed. My makeup doesn’t sink in to my brow lines anymore and they are painless and effective so... for the people in the back... I LOVE THESE

reviews.product_name: Squalane + Vitamin C Rose Firming Oil
reviews.review_text: I’m actually super impressed with this product. I was skeptical going into this but got it as a free sample to try and am in love. It’s super moisturizing, and I have really bad redness on my cheeks and this actually noticeably brightened my cheeks along with the rest of my face, basically overnight. I want to slather my body with it and just glow all over but I guess I will settle with face! A little goes a long way and it smells so nice it’s relaxing to use before bed. I honestly love this. Even though I got it complimentary to try I will keep buying!

reviews.product_name: Yo Glow AHA & BHA Facial Enzyme Scrub
reviews.review_text: I got this as a sample and I absolutely loved it. I have dry, acne prone skin and it took off all the dead skin on my face and left me looking fresh and brighter. My skin felt clean after and it did not irritate my sensitive skin! I loved it so much I went and bought a large size of it.

reviews.product_name: Mini Yo Glow AHA & BHA Facial Enzyme Scrub
reviews.review_text: I got this as a sample and I absolutely loved it. I have dry, acne prone skin and it took off all the dead skin on my face and left me looking fresh and brighter. My skin felt clean after and it did not irritate my sensitive skin! I loved it so much I went and bought a large size of it.

reviews.product_name: Yo Glow AHA & BHA Facial Enzyme Scrub
reviews.review_text: Amazing, leaves my skin so soft and I follow up with a moisturizer afterword for perfectly soft skin. I have sensitive and dry skin and this is a great refresh during the week

reviews.product_name: Mini Yo Glow AHA & BHA Facial Enzyme Scrub
reviews.review_text: Amazing, leaves my skin so soft and I follow up with a moisturizer afterword for perfectly soft skin. I have sensitive and dry skin and this is a great refresh during the week

reviews.product_name: Niacinamide 10% + Zinc 1% Oil Control Serum
reviews.review_title: Be patient and you’ll love it!!!
reviews.review_text: I decided to try this out because I had heard really positive reviews about this product. When I first started using it (nighttime only) my face broke out a bit around my upper cheek and nose area. Safe to say that I have now used it more 1 month and my pores are smaller, my acne redness has been reduced and skin is smooth. It definitely takes time to see the results. I do have very sensitive skin and this is now a must have product for me. Make sure to pat into the skin for the best absorption!

reviews.product_name: Squalane + Omega Repair Deep Hydration Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I had been using the First Aid Beauty ultra repair cream for years and in the last month my skin was dull, dry and not absorbing the crème.  I decided to give this a try with the small 30ml container and it changed my skin! All my dry patches were gone and my redness from my pre existing acne scars are starting to fade. This has been a miracle worker. The smell is strong but goes unnoticed once you rub in! Worth every penny

reviews.product_name: Umbra Sheer Physical Daily Defense SPF 30
reviews.review_text: The photo is after 8 hours of wear under foundation and powder blush. I actually am really impressed by this product. I have tried a few spf products and I always find that they oxidize and look orange. This one wears so well under foundation and doesn’t feel too greasy. It doesn’t quite dry down but it also doesn’t slide around on my face and make my makeup look patchy. I’ve worn it to work for a twelve hour day and still looked fresh. I’m not crazy about the smell but it goes away quickly. I took off one star because I do find that it has a white cast on my skin even though it is advertised as not having one. I will definitely purchase once mine is gone.

reviews.product_name: B-Hydra Intensive Hydration Serum with Hyaluronic Acid
reviews.review_text: I’ve been using one pump of this and one pump of cfirma everyday for a week and I’ve already  noticed a difference in the texture and bounce of my skin. I’m not crazy about the smell but it fades very quickly once it absorbs into my skin. I will definitely repurchase this and continue to use.

reviews.product_name: Benefiance Wrinkle Smoothing Eye Cream
reviews.review_text: I like this product so much more than I thought I would. It comes in a beautiful luxe jar with a spatula. It has a very light clean scent that fades in just a few minutes. I’ve only used this a couple of times but already I notice a difference in the way my under eye concealer wears throughout the day, it’s much smoother and doesn’t settle into my fine lines. It has to be a result of the moisturizing and slight plumping effect of this cream. Product claims noticeable results in a week so I’ll have to wait and see, but I think I believe the hype!

reviews.product_name: GENIUS Sleeping Collagen Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: The moisturizer goes on super smooth and just a little bit goes a long way. It has just a tiny scent that is very fresh and it moisturizes extremely well. I only liked to use it at night since it is a little bit oily. I recieved this product complimentary from Influenster.

reviews.product_name: Greek Yoghurt Nourishing Probiotic Gel-Cream
reviews.review_text: Moisturizers well and kept my skin clear and soft. It feels very light on the skin. It absorbs super quickly so I used more compared to my normal moisturizer and I didn’t love the smell, but overall I would recommend.

reviews.product_name: Revitalizing Supreme+ Youth Power Creme Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: This moisturizer is thick so you only need a little. It was very moisturizing and absorbed well but I did have some small breakouts on my chin/forehead while using which I’m not sure were caused by this. I only had the small trial size to try though so it may have evened out with longer use.

reviews.product_name: Mini Revitalizing Supreme+ Youth Power Creme Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: This moisturizer is thick so you only need a little. It was very moisturizing and absorbed well but I did have some small breakouts on my chin/forehead while using which I’m not sure were caused by this. I only had the small trial size to try though so it may have evened out with longer use.

reviews.product_name: Superfood Antioxidant Cleanser
reviews.review_text: I’ve used this cleanser for 5 months now and I can say its worth it. I do have more dry/sensitive skin  (obviously after the first few times of using a new cleanser your skin will “Purge“) purging is normal for every ones skin, when adding a new product. But after 4 nights it was gone and my skin was clear again (purging may take longer to go away because everyone’s skin is different). I use this only at night after I use a cleansing balm or by itself. I can say at least for me, every cleanser I use I do get dry flakes. it doesn’t leave my skin over stripped.

reviews.product_name: Mini Superfood Antioxidant Cleanser
