reviews.product_name: Unseen Sunscreen SPF 40 PA+++
reviews.review_text: I love this way better than the glow screen and that says a lot because I have dry skin. Definitely gonna repurchase again when the glow screen is done.

reviews.product_name: Mini Unseen Sunscreen SPF 40 PA+++
reviews.review_text: I love this way better than the glow screen and that says a lot because I have dry skin. Definitely gonna repurchase again when the glow screen is done.

reviews.product_name: Glowscreen Sunscreen SPF 40 PA+++ with Hyaluronic Acid + Niacinamide
reviews.review_text: It’s alright I’ve had this for a few months. It’s a good sunscreen but it’s wayyyy to glowy for me and I have dry sensitive skin. This did work for me on my skin. I’m gonna try the other sunscreens in the brand.

reviews.product_name: Mini Glowscreen Sunscreen SPF 40 PA+++ with Hyaluronic Acid + Niacinamide
reviews.review_text: It’s alright I’ve had this for a few months. It’s a good sunscreen but it’s wayyyy to glowy for me and I have dry sensitive skin. This did work for me on my skin. I’m gonna try the other sunscreens in the brand.

reviews.product_name: Green Clean Makeup Removing Cleansing Balm
reviews.review_text: I love to test a product for more than a month before writing a review. For someone who has very sensitive and dry skin, I do approve of this. I’ve done research for sensitive skin safe products and this was the top rated product, and I can see why.

reviews.product_name: Green Clean Makeup Meltaway Cleansing Balm Limited Edition Jumbo
reviews.review_text: I love to test a product for more than a month before writing a review. For someone who has very sensitive and dry skin, I do approve of this. I’ve done research for sensitive skin safe products and this was the top rated product, and I can see why.

reviews.product_name: Mini Glowscreen Sunscreen SPF 40 PA+++ with Hyaluronic Acid + Niacinamide
reviews.review_text: It’s a good sunscreen don’t get me wrong. Pros of this product are the high spf, and the glow. Cons of this product is that it broke out my neck. It does peel after I applied moisturizer and I let my moisturizer soak in completely.

reviews.product_name: Beste No. 9 Jelly Cleanser
reviews.review_text: Once I figured out that you can use this on dry skin to remove makeup, and then you use water to moisten and wash off, it was a game changer for me. It truly gets all my makeup off, including mascara and eyeliner (which is always what’s left behind) and my face feels fresh and clean but not stripped afterwards.

reviews.product_name: Plum Plump Hyaluronic Acid Serum
reviews.review_text: I purchased this through a Trendmood box, and was excited to give it a go! A hydrating hyaluronic serum, very light on skin and soaks in easily. It does have a faint “plummy“ smell, which is why I only gave it 4 stars, since some may be sensitive to it (it doesn’t bother me though!) Love to use it under moisturizer and it keeps my skin nice and plum, even in the dessert conditions I live in.

reviews.product_name: Retinol Reform Treatment Serum
reviews.review_text: I have been a retinol user for years, and was quite interested in this one since it has some gentle exfoliating lactic acidosis as well as retinol in the formula. I always wake up with bright smooth skin ans no irritation. Take that with a grain of salt though, as my skin doesn’t get easily irritated with retinol in general as I’ve spent a few years getting it accustomed! Anyway, I highly recommend this for gentle exfoliation and retinol all in one serum.

reviews.product_name: Mini Retinol Reform
reviews.review_text: I have been a retinol user for years, and was quite interested in this one since it has some gentle exfoliating lactic acidosis as well as retinol in the formula. I always wake up with bright smooth skin ans no irritation. Take that with a grain of salt though, as my skin doesn’t get easily irritated with retinol in general as I’ve spent a few years getting it accustomed! Anyway, I highly recommend this for gentle exfoliation and retinol all in one serum.

reviews.product_name: Facial Radiance Pads
reviews.review_text: I was scared to try these because I had major problems with the stridex pads in the red box, and was worried I’d have a similar reaction with these since I’m so sensitive. WRONG! All active zits were significantly smaller the next morning and it seems like my texture/closed comedones are going away!! I’m so thrilled. Definitely going to keep using them and hopefully buy the full size.

reviews.product_name: Take The Day Off Cleansing Balm Makeup Remover
reviews.review_text: Clogged my pores AND broke me out. Being returned, sadly.

reviews.product_name: Mini Take The Day Off Cleansing Balm Makeup Remover
reviews.review_text: Clogged my pores AND broke me out. Being returned, sadly.

reviews.product_name: Superberry Hydrate + Glow Dream Oil
reviews.review_text: I’ve tried using 3 drops of this at nighttime before bed to help seal in my moisturizer but it hasn’t really done anything. It also hasn’t done anything bad though which is why I gave it a 3. My skins super sensitive so this doesn’t irritate it which is nice but it’s not life changing or something I can’t live without. The price is nice.

reviews.product_name: Blue Tansy BHA and Enzyme Pore Refining Mask
reviews.review_text: I was skeptical buying this mask since there’s so much hype around it but decided to try it during the vib sale. I’m so glad I did. First, I LOATHE the smell. It’s so strong. But, after using it for two weeks every other day, all the texture and clogged pores are almost gone. Really love the results so I can get past the smell. I’ve started getting used to it. Also, be VERY CAREFUL opening it every time. It’s insanely liquidy and can accidentally pour out if you’re holding it at the slightest angle.

reviews.product_name: Honeymoon Glow AHA Resurfacing Night Serum
reviews.review_text: I’m on spironolactone so I rarely break out. After using this twice, I got VERY angry zits above my lip and below my chin. Maybe I’m just really sensitive to this type of AHA.

reviews.product_name: Vegan Milk Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: This is lightweight but still very hydrating, and that’s coming from someone who has a lot of trouble finding moisturizers that hydrate well enough. I like using this during the day with my spf, it’s become a staple in my routine.

reviews.product_name: Moisturizing Eye Bomb with Squalane
reviews.review_text: Love this! I mainly used it for a cream for under my makeup. Went very well underneath my foundation and bronzer. Very moisturizing. Didn’t notice a difference with dark spots but helped with wrinkles! Also a plus that it’s “clean.“

reviews.product_name: C-Tango Vitamin C Eye Cream
reviews.review_text: I like this because I think it helps prevent wrinkles and keeps my underage very moisturized BUT doesn’t do anything for my dark circles ... I mean to be honest, I haven’t found any eye cream that helps with dark circles. It goes under makeup very well. I also love that it’s “clean.“

reviews.product_name: Cold Plunge Pore Mask
reviews.review_text: This is amazing. I was so hesitant to buy it because the price but this cleared my face in one use. I have extremely sensitive skin and rosacea and my skin wasn’t bothered.

reviews.product_name: Smart Clinical Repair Wrinkle Correcting Eye Cream
reviews.review_text: I received this Clinique Wrinkle Correcting Eye Cream sample Packet from TopBox Circle as a free product. I used it a couple of times morning and night and it felt really nice. The texture is smooth and thick but it absorbed in very quickly. I like that it doesn’t have any smell and it didn’t irritate my eyes. However I could not tell if it’s going to improve wrinkle reductions because of the sample’s limited usage. I enjoyed using it and would like to try it again to see its benefits. #freeproduct

reviews.product_name: Smart Clinical Repair Wrinkle Correcting Cream
reviews.review_text: I received this Clinique Wrinkle Correcting Cream sample from TopBox Circle as a free product. I used it for about a week morning and night and I really liked it. The texture is rich and smooth  and it doesn’t have any scent which is nice. My skin felt nourished and hydrated instantly. I wish it came with a larger portion so that I might tell if it has long term benefits such as wrinkle reduction and youthful looking. #freeproduct

reviews.product_name: Smart Clinical Repair Wrinkle Correcting Serum
reviews.review_text: I received this Clinique Wrinkle Correcting Serum sample packet from TopBox Circle as a free product. I got to try it with my evening routine and it worked well. I like the non-greasy lightweight texture and it doesn’t have any smell which is awesome. My skin didn’t get irritated and felt hydrated after applying it over my face. However, I didn’t get to see a huge improvement on wrinkle reductions because the sample only served about 3 times usage. I enjoyed using it and would like to try it again to see its benefits. #freeproduct

reviews.product_name: Good Genes All-In-One AHA Lactic Acid Treatment
reviews.review_text: I have been using Sunday Riley Good Genes for 12 days. The first day, I noticed my skin was less dull. The second day, my skin started to get flaky, which continued for 5 more days. From that day forward, my skin has looked and felt amazing. It is brighter, appears tighter, and fine lines have become less noticeable. I have not noticed any change in my pores. Even though I have dry skin to begin with, this product does not exacerbate that. I do follow it with my regular moisturizer must days, however. This product smells great when applying (seems slightly citrusy to me), but the fragrance is not overpowerful and does not linger. I have not experienced any redness, irritation, or breakouts. I intend to keep using it to see if I get more results. (I received this product complimentary from Sunday Riley in exchange for my honest review.)

reviews.product_name: Ready Steady Glow Daily AHA Tonic
reviews.review_text: I have dry skin and have been using the Ren AHA tonic nightly for about 2 weeks. It does tingle a bit. Ren toner still manages to remove more gunk from my face even though I thoroughly pre-cleanse and clean my face. This tonic does not dehydrate my skin like some toners, but it does not offer me any soothing moisture either (it simply does what it is supposed to do). It does feel very slightly sticky, but I follow it with my nighttime moisturizer and no longer notice it after that. I do notice my skin to be a bit brighter. My favorite part of this tonic is how it exfoliates and reduces the appearance of any blackheads I have. I would recommend it.

reviews.review_text: I have a thorough skin regimen, but this is the first pre-cleanser I’ve used. I wasn’t sure what advantage this product would add to my routine, but I ended up really liking it. The PreCleanse is thin/watery, but does get a little thicker after I add a little water to my face. It starts the process of loosening the makeup and dirt from my face at the end of the day, so I don’t feel the need to scrub or use cleansers that dry out my skin. It’s not greasy and is easy to rinse away. I like it.

reviews.product_name: Tonique Confort Re-Hydrating Comforting Toner with Acacia Honey
reviews.review_text: I tend to have considerably sensitive skin, especially when it comes to the skincare I employ, so I was a little leery about some of the items on this ingredient list, specifically the fragrance. After using the product for a few days at a time on a couple of occasions, I’m overall fairly pleased with the result. The consistency of the product is unique and one of its strengths in my opinion—just slightly thicker than a typical toner liquid, but not not as think as a gel or creme; which seems to contribute to a more substantial hydration with more staying power than the water-like consistency of other toners. Additionally, it still dries fairly quickly, so as to not hold up the moisturizer step that will likely follow. A slight drawback of this product for me is the fragrance—both as an ingredient and the actual smell. Though the smell isn’t bad, it’s more pungent than what I would expect from a product advertised as having “sensitive” and “zen” qualities, though the toner is more mild in fragrance than the accompanying moisturizer in the same product line. (I’ll mention that I use primarily simple skincare, so I am typically more accustomed to a milder fragrance.) While I’m personally not particularly fond of a rose scent, this product certainly has notes of that rose fragrance, which seems to be really “in” right now. All in all, I am pleased with the product and while I received it complementary for testing purposes, I will continue to use it, as it has not caused any adverse reactions in my sensitive skin—though I’ll likely aim to mask the strong-ish fragrance by following with my more mild fragranced moisturizers overtop.

reviews.product_name: Hydra Zen Gel-Cream Oil-Free Moisturizer with Salicylic Acid
reviews.review_title: Lovely product, but not for sensitives
reviews.review_text: I tend to have considerably sensitive skin, especially when it comes to the skincare I employ, so I was a little leery about some of the items on this ingredient list, specifically the fragrance. My best attempt at describing the fragrance would be be that it somewhat resembles an older woman’s perfume—though it does have notes of the “rose” scent that seems to be really “in” right now. It’s much more pungent than what I would expect from a product advertised as having “sensitive” and “zen” qualities. The fragrance wouldn’t necessarily be a deal breaker, though it would take a concerted effort to try to ignore, but unfortunately, the moisturizer also caused small breakouts on my forehead and chin. While I wouldn’t describe the breakouts as really bad—few white head and other small bumps like “heat bumps”—it was clear that my sensitive skin was reacting adversity to this product for one reason or another. (For reference, I tried this product on several occasions for quality control, always with the above mentioned result.) Ultimately, this product is not for me; I would advise other moderate-to-severe sensitive skin users to proceed with caution. (As a consolation, the toner in this same line does seem to be a more mild formula, and I do not react to that—if you’re just wanting to try this product line, that might be a good place to start.) Other skin types may very well enjoy this product— pretty container, nice gel consistency— but it is one such product a Sensitive Sally like myself simply cannot withstand. I received this product for free for testing purposes.

reviews.product_name: Clear Sunscreen Stick SPF 50+
reviews.review_text: Pleasantly surprised (and a little shocked) by this product. Unlike other sunscreen sticks I’ve used, this one glides on super smoothly (no drag or pulling), smells nice, and isn’t super drying. Plus, it’s craaazy water resistant, as it stood up to my morning workout, no problem—and I had to wash my face a few times in the shower to really get it off. So it’s the real deal! Though it does have “fragrance” listed (usually a hard pass for me), it is the very last ingredient indicating trace amounts, and my sensitive skin didn’t have any adverse reaction. In fact, this is the only chemical sunscreen I’ve tried that didn’t give any negative reaction. Definitely keeping this on hand as my go-to water resistant SPF protection, and will for sure repurchase.

reviews.product_name: Ultimate Sun Protector Lotion SPF 50+ Sunscreen
reviews.review_text: Overall, really like this product, though i’d like the price point to be a little more accessible for all. Great high SPF 50, easy application, and effective water resistance. As someone with sensitive skin, I usually have negative reactions to chemical sunscreens, but not this one! Very gentle formula. It does require shaking before application, which I found a little odd, but I think it has something to do with the pigment of the formula. It must be shaken to mix into the light tan color that results, which then dried relatively clear on my skin. Delivers on all claims for sure: given the price point, I’d reserve for outdoor activities which really need the water-resistance.

reviews.review_text: I received this product in an Influenster vox box and I was not disappointed! I’ve been using it for the past couple of weeks and can definitely see a difference in my skin. It seems smoother and more firm. Definitely recommend this product !

reviews.review_text: I am super picky about my “acid” treatments and I totally love this one. I would absolutely recommend to anyone who wants to try and better their skin tone.The company did talk about a “tingling” effect, but I did not experience that. I also have sensitive skin, but have used many products like this one, I would recommend taking it slow at first if you have never used anything like it before.

reviews.review_text: I received this product for free from Influenster in exchange for my honest review. I really loved this skin cream. reviews.review_text: I’m not going to lie, I received the sample size of this and it allowed me to use the product about 3 times. So I don’t feel like I can give a 100% review. But more like 95%. From what I can tell when I used it, my skin felt very hydrated and refreshed. It was thick and creamy but not to the point where you felt like you had crap all over your face!

I’m so happy to have received this complimentary from Sunday Riley.

reviews.product_name: Mini Daily Microfoliant Exfoliator
reviews.review_text: I love this magical little powder. Leaves my skin feeling so smooth. I keep it right in my shower so it’s easiest to grab and use. I just have to be careful to shake a little out at a time. It really is effective!  I was gifted by Dermalogica Sampling

reviews.review_title: My eyes look brighter even with no sleep!!
reviews.review_text: I am in love! I had never tried Sunday Riley products when I started using this eye cream and the Ice Moisturizer. Being honest with everyone, menopause has wreaked havoc with my sleep and my eyes were really looking tired and well...old!  This eye cream gives me the look of a full nights sleep and then some. It’s light and doesn’t settle into fine lines but luxurious enough to smooth out or blur little imperfections. Now I can’t wait to try other items in this line!  A new favorite!!

reviews.product_name: ICE Ceramide Moisturizer with Vitamin F
reviews.review_title: So glad I gave this luxurious cream a chance!!
reviews.review_text: I have to admit, when I first tried this moisturizer, I was a little skeptical. I am blessed with normal skin, natural aging concerns with fine lines and wrinkles but overall good, not too dry and not too oily. This cream felt a bit thick and heavy the first time I tried it. I should not have worried, my skin just drank it up and I was left with baby soft skin. During my morning routine, it is the perfect canvas for my primer and foundation. Both go on smoothly and I seem to have a more natural glow all day. But my night routine really told the story. I love a good night serum but decided to try this cream on its on. Morning after morning, I am waking up with dewy soft skin that again, just glows. I’m noticing a much smoother texture after regular use and even my hands are enjoying the benefits. Sunday Riley is definitely a new favorite!!

reviews.product_name: Confidence in a Cream Anti-Aging Hydrating Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I have been a fan of IT Cosmetics for a number of years but had never tried their skincare, in particular, the Confidence in a Cream Moisturizer. At first it seemed a little heavy and I wasn’t sure it was for me but I have it a few days and I’m thrilled that I did. After a couple of days, I noticed that my skin seemed to start just drinking in this cream. My skin looks fresh and dewy and it feels so soft, like it did 20 years ago!! My foundation glides on easily over it and glows all day without looking and feeling greasy. A win and a new staple in my a.m. and p.m. routine!!

reviews.product_name: Soy Hydrating Gentle Face Cleanser
reviews.review_text: I love this cleanser! It also smells super natural! I like how this product cleanse my face and leaves it feeling super smooth and clean. I love the texture of the wash as well. definitely does it job and no irritation!

reviews.product_name: Sugar Strawberry Exfoliating Face Wash
reviews.review_text: I was so excited to try this exfoliating face wash! What I love about the product is the way it smells like strawberry jam! I’ve never tried a face wash that smells so natural and realistic. I wanted to eat it. I definitely think this face wash is suitable for daily use as the sugar was super gentle and melted quickly into my skin. It almost felt like it was meant to feel slightly oily after the sugar melted to lock in the moisture in my face. Unlike the other face wash I used, I felt hydrated afterwards. It did not make me feel like the scrub had scraped my skin off. The reason I gave this product a 4 stars is because I don’t think it is for every skin type due to the oily feeling afterwards. I would limit to maybe 2-3 times a week to avoid clogged pores.

reviews.product_name: Original Skin Matte Moisturizer with Willowherb
reviews.review_text: I honestly really loved this moisturizer!! So I’ve tried Clinique, bobby brown, clarins, benefi moisturizers, pretty much you name it I bought it. My skin can easily get clogged up because of oil in moisturizers, so all these other moisturizers would clog my skin (i normally only wear a moisturizer and run out the door) and I typically wear my moisturizers from 9-5. I kid you not I would be so oily by like hour 5 and my skin would fee dirty or just you know oily like I could feel the breakouts forming. I never knew what to do because I need a moisturizer, but wow ever since trying this product, i now know what the problem was: I needed something that hydrated my skin while not making it oily. I have been trying this product since the beginning of September and I have not had ONE breakout or new bump appear on my skin! Do you know how crazy that is for me?! I used to get a blemish or something once a week! The texture of this lotion is not smooth but feels like theyre are grains in it or something which I dont care because it smooths out beautifully once applied. Also the scent is so pleasant, win win! I received this product as a free sample to try out.

reviews.product_name: Original Skin Retexturizing Mask with Rose Clay
reviews.review_text: This is hands down my FAVORITE MASK. I’m a mask connoisseur, I’ve tried high-end to drugstore, and this is honestly in my top 5. I’ve bough this product countless times, so I was excited to get a bonus when I received this product as a free sample.

reviews.review_text: This gel creme is honestly what my skin has been missing. I have an olive, medium complexion so any acne or blemish will leave a dark spot for a hot minute. I just got done with my time of the month, which is when i get the most blemishes and will definitely leave a spot on my face. I used this gel creme religiously for a few weeks now and they honestly are getting lighter faster than usual. Also the smell just wakes you up in the morning. I also like the fact the gel creme is suuper hydrating and just melts into your skin instantly! I received this product complimentary for sampling purposes and all opinions are your own.

The only thing I don’t love about it is it’s more of a dry oil. The texture of it at first is almost dry but then when you rub it in it get oily. I don’t love the dry feeling but overall it’s a great face oil. And it hasn’t broken me out at all!

The cream itself is pretty thick, so you only need a little to spread all over. I have pretty dry skin, and I still don’t have to use much.Since using this, I’ve noticed in almost a week that my dry skin looks and feels more hydrated. The redness I tend to get around my nose area has calmed down (not all the way, but you can see the difference. My skin tone just feels more even, which makes me feel better about my face without makeup, but has also helped the look of how my makeup sits on my face. This product is pricey, but because you only need so little, it’s definitly am investment that should last you a bit.

reviews.product_name: Greek Yoghurt Foaming Cream Cleanser
reviews.review_text: I instantly fell in love with this product. I was given this product to test out and I can honestly say I think J found my new holy grail facial cleanser. It is gentle on my skin yet somehow still manages to deeply cleanse it, it has an amazing scent thats not too strong, and most importantly when I get out of the shower my skin looks transformed. Love love loveeee this cleanser.

reviews.product_name: Moisturizing Eye Bomb with Squalane
reviews.review_text: Loved this product. Feels amazing on the skin and moisturizes beautifully!

reviews.product_name: The True Cream Aqua Bomb
reviews.review_text: LOVE IT so hydrating and is not greasy at all. It is the perfect addition to my night routine

reviews.product_name: C-Rush Vitamin C Gel Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I absolutely love this product. I have tried a MILLION brightening creams and they always leave me looking super greasy (I have combo skin). This moisturizer goes on like butter. It doesn’t get greasy, but it gives a nice boost to the look of your skin. I am very pleased with the way my skin has looked since I started using this. Pro tip: A LITTLE GOES A LONG WAY! Do not go over board unless your skin just soaks up product. I received this product complimentary for sampling purposes but all opinions are my own.

reviews.product_name: Lotus Anti-Aging Night Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I really enjoyed this night cream. I already and a big Fresh fan, but this sent it over the edge. This moisturizer is not greasy and super light so it’s great to sleep in. I truly think it has helped with the evenness of my skin and tone.

reviews.product_name: Lotus Anti- Aging Daily Moisturizer
reviews.review_title: COMBO DRY! This is for you!
reviews.review_text: This is the best anti-aging, texture improving, skin tone evenning moisturizer for dry/combo skin. I get super oily in my t zone but my cheeks and around my mouth is SUPER dry and flaky. This has helped while also improving my skin in general. I hate heavy and oily moisturizers, but this one is so nice and light weight and build able. I love it.

reviews.product_name: Sugar Lip Balm Hydrating Treatment
reviews.review_text: Such a wonderful color and very refreshing for my lips. I struggle with chapped lips so this lipstick has been very refreshing. I think this will become my goto lipstick in the future! It is perfect for every day wear and I love how it complements my skinetone. This was gifted by Fresh to me.

reviews.product_name: Tea Elixir Niacinamide & Hyaluronic Acid Anti-Aging Serum
reviews.review_text: My skin feels tighter and more refreshed after using this serum. For the price, I would be a little cautious; I have found that my skin gets a little used to products and the effect is no longer as prominent. Hoping this will continue to have great effects!

reviews.product_name: Mini Daily Microfoliant Exfoliator
reviews.review_text: I’ve used this product in the past and have been looking for a dupe purely because of cost. 5 years later, and I’m still back and using this microfoliant. Best exfoliator I have ever used and I have yet to find a better product! This was gifted by Demalogica Sampling.

reviews.review_text: So far so great!! Put a dot on last night over a pimple that was appearing and when I took it off this morning the inflammation was gone! You could tell the dot really worked. I can’t wait to continue using these.  Would definitely recommend to others!

reviews.review_text: Continous usage of this product has improved my skin greatly! My texture has decreased, and my skin is also looking more hydrated. I do believe this product is overpriced compared to the quantity that you get, but the product itself is highly recommended!

reviews.product_name: The True Cream Moisturizing Bomb
reviews.review_text: LOVE this moisturizer! It’s been a life saver with the recent colder months I haven’t gotten my usual dry itchy skin. It’s fairly thick but does melt into the skin nicely. I will probably switch between this and the Aqua bomb depending on the season.

reviews.product_name: Lemonade Smoothing Scrub
reviews.review_text: Left my skin feeling soooo smooth!! Love this exfoliate and super happy it didn’t irritate my skin at all.

reviews.product_name: Moisture Surge 100H Auto-Replenishing Hydrator Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: Great lightweight moisturizer for summer! Didn’t make my skin greasy and kept my face hydrated all day

reviews.product_name: Good Genes All-In-One AHA Lactic Acid Treatment
reviews.review_title: Wow what a difference this makes!
reviews.review_text: I used this more like a mask applying for about 15 minutes then wash it off. I only need about 2 pumps to fully cover my face and get nice coverage. After my very first use, I noticed my skin to be softer after, more so the more days I used it. I didn’t realize how rough my skin was until trying this product, now I won’t ever go back the difference is amazing. When you pump it in your hand it seems and looks thick but when you apply it to your face it just melts into your skin it’s wonderful. I love that it’s not runny when you pump it out of the bottle that helps make it less messy and no waste. I am very happy with how my skin is after the short time I have had to use it and will continue to use this daily I can’t imagine life without it now. I received this complimentary from Sunday Riley however the thoughts are from my own experience.

reviews.product_name: Facial Treatment Essence (Pitera Essence)
reviews.review_text: This pitera essence has worked wonders on my skin. It feels like you are just rubbing water into your skin as it leaves it feeling clean. It’s not oily as I expected and blends in fast. Since I started using this I notice my skin more evenly colored. I am beyond pleased with my results and will continue to use this.

reviews.product_name: Mini Facial Treatment Essence (Pitera Essence)
reviews.review_text: This pitera essence has worked wonders on my skin. It feels like you are just rubbing water into your skin as it leaves it feeling clean. It’s not oily as I expected and blends in fast. Since I started using this I notice my skin more evenly colored. I am beyond pleased with my results and will continue to use this.

reviews.product_name: Charlotte’s Magic Serum with Vitamin C
reviews.review_text: Charlotte’s Magic Serum is the perfect name for this elixir. It works like magic. I can not say how much I loved using this for the past month. It has an eyedropper so you don’t waste any of it. It has a thin consistency but not too thin that it just drips off your face before you get a chance to rub it in, which is something I like about this product. I don’t like when the serum is too runny so this one is perfect. It absorbs into the skin with ease and really fast. It doesn’t leave my face feeling sticky. It makes my skin feel smoother but not to the point that it’s tight. It has a light perfume-type scent that isn’t bothersome and doesn’t last. I find since I started using this my pores are less noticeable and my skin has a nicer shine and overall healthy look to it. I really love the quality of this and highly recommend it, it’s a product you won’t regret using.

reviews.product_name: Original Skin Matte Moisturizer with Willowherb
reviews.review_text: My new favorites moisturizer. I used to use a different moisturizer and I never strayed from it. But after trying this one, I’m in love. I typically don’t like scented facial moisturizers however this one smells amazing. Doesn’t leave a feeling like you have something on your face as it’s very light.

reviews.product_name: Original Skin Retexturizing Mask with Rose Clay
reviews.review_text: I received this as a sample and honestly have never really used many face masks before. But after using this one, my face felt so refreshed. I use it once a week now as part of my routine.

reviews.product_name: Double Serum Firming & Smoothing Anti-Aging Concentrate
reviews.review_text: I love this serum. Admittedly, it’s a bit tough to use the sample and get both sides. Besides that, it feel great on the skin; not sticky. It absorbs really well. I would totally buy this but maaaaybe on sale as it is pricey.

reviews.product_name: Alpha Beta Pore Perfecting & Refining Serum
reviews.review_text: It makes my skin looks so soft and smooth. I will continue to use it to enhance my skin condition.

reviews.review_text: This product saved my dry skin during the winter. The only thing I dislike, is that is takes a bit of time for the product to fully sink into my skin and can feel sticky if I put it on right before bed.

reviews.product_name: Glow Cycle Retin-ALT Power Serum
reviews.review_text: Love this product! I’ve always been hesitant to use anything with retinol so I love that this is an alternative to retinol! As 30 approaches Ive been searching for great products and love how natural this one is in comparison to most! So thankful Influenster sent me a bottle complimentary. Im. Ow hooked!

reviews.product_name: Lotus Anti-Aging Night Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I’ve used this lotus dream night cream for about 3 weeks now and really love it. I can tell it actually absorbs into my skin rather than just sitting on top of it. My only complaint is that the scent is a bit stronger than I would like. It’s a nice scent, it’s just strong. Luckily the scent disappears quickly.

reviews.product_name: Lotus Anti- Aging Daily Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I’ve used this lotus youth preserve moisturizer cream for about 3 weeks now and really love it. I can tell it actually absorbs into my skin rather than just sitting on top of it. I live in NYC to my skin normally struggles in the winter with the cold weather, harsh wind and tough city air- but this has helped a ton! My only complaint is that the scent is a bit stronger than I would like. It’s a nice scent, it’s just strong. Luckily the scent disappears quickly.

reviews.product_name: Lotus Anti-Aging Night Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: Good but not great; I like the way this makes my skin feel and it seems to sink in very well deminishing fine lines but it doesn’t seem to mix well with the eye cream from this same line. Putting both of them on together at night before bed, I noticed the combo creates a pill effect. Using it without the eye cream I really enjoy it.

reviews.product_name: Lotus Anti- Aging Daily Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: Great moisturizer for daily use. I throw this on after I wash my face in the morning and notice an immediate impact on my fine lines. Over the last 3 weeks, I’ve noticed an improvemt in the texture and feel of my skin as well. Also, I love the fresh smell!

reviews.product_name: Dreamskin Skin Perfector
reviews.review_text: This product is AMAZING. I have some sun damage on my forehead and upper lip and this absolutely diminished my dark spots in both places. I also fine this product to be a great makeup primer, it helps my foundation go on smooth and flawless.

reviews.review_text: I received this collagen through a promotional campaign and I’ve already seen results after using it for two weeks. My skin is much more moisturized and glowy. It smells great and it stays on throughout the night. I would definitely recommend this product !

reviews.product_name: Squalane + Marine Algae Firming & Lifting Eye Cream
reviews.review_text: I received the Biossance Eye Cream via Influenster and I am absolutely loving it. The smooth, creamy texture makes it an easy addition to my nighttime routine. I wake up looking refreshed and hydrated.

reviews.product_name: The Rice Wash Skin-Softening Cleanser
reviews.review_text: Love, love, love this cleanser. It leaves my skin feeling clean and tight. I’ve been using it for over a month and I can already see a difference. I would definitely recommend this for anyone with sensitive skin.

reviews.product_name: Mini Rice Wash Skin-Softening Cleanser
reviews.review_text: Love, love, love this cleanser. It leaves my skin feeling clean and tight. I’ve been using it for over a month and I can already see a difference. I would definitely recommend this for anyone with sensitive skin.

reviews.product_name: Dreamskin Skin Perfector
reviews.review_text: The Dior Dreamskin Skin Perfector is amazing. It takes only a small amount to transform your facial skin into a sillky smooth flawless look. The product glides easily across your face making application simple for use my anyone. Skin imperfections became nearly invisible upon application of makeup. After repeated usage this magic potion helped bring life back to my dry, dull looking skin. The consistency of the product is perfect as it doesn’t drup or run off your fingers when applying.  It is also lightly scented, however those who may be sensitive to certain smells may find it to strong. The dreamskin perfector comes in a pump type container that allows for simple dispensing of the product. This product belongs in every woman’s skin regimen.

reviews.product_name: Revitalizing Supreme+ Youth Power Creme Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: Revitalizing Supreme+ Youth Power Creme Moisturizer is a great consistency. It feels rich and luxurious and is amazing when applied to my skin. I have noticed that it reduces fine lines and wrinkles and adds the perfect amount of moisture to my dry thirsty skin. It helps to add a perfect glow to my face.

reviews.review_text: Revitalizing Supreme+ Youth Power Creme Moisturizer is a great consistency. It feels rich and luxurious and is amazing when applied to my skin. reviews.review_title: KORRES Santorini Grape Poreless Skin Cream
reviews.review_text: The santorini grape porkers skin cream is awesome. It is so light weight on my face for any season including the hot humid ball season outdoors. The consistency out of the container is perfect and it won’t slide off my finger when applying. It feels amazing on my dry skin and provides the perfect amount of moisture without leaving behind any residue or oily look. I was impressed with the mostly natural ingredients. This was received free for my fair review from Influenster.

reviews.product_name: Alpha Beta Extra Strength Daily Peel Pads
reviews.review_text: I tried this sample size and it was amazing! Left my skin feeling smooth! Smelled good even!

reviews.product_name: Skinlongevity Long Life Herb Anti-Aging Face Serum
reviews.review_text: This serum feels amazing on your face. I highly recommend using it if you are prone to breaking out because I am and it was amazing and never once broke me out. I tried this for free through pinch me thank you so much for letting me try this out I will definitely be trying to add this to my list of things to buy when I run out of the serum I’m using now!

reviews.product_name: Good Genes All-In-One AHA Lactic Acid Treatment
reviews.review_text: Gifted by Sunday Riley. I absolutely love this product! Wasn’t greasy and didn’t break me out at all! Even smelled great! I highly recommend this product!

reviews.product_name: Beste No. 9 Jelly Cleanser
reviews.review_text: This is a great gel to cream cleanser; I like how it changes texture as it warms on my skin.  Unscented, which is always good for facial products.  I have tried MANY cleansers on my middle aged skin, and this is gentle but effective.  I would definitely purchase again!

reviews.product_name: C-Tango Vitamin C Eye Cream
reviews.review_text: C-Tango is a good eye cream.  It feels good on the skin and is hydrating and soothing.  I’m not a fan of the packaging though;  I’m not sure why the packaging is so big and clunky for a 15ml product.  That being said, I would definitely repurchase this during a Sephora sale.  It’s one of many eye creams that I enjoy using!

reviews.product_name: T.L.C. Framboos Glycolic Resurfacing Night Serum
reviews.review_text: I really feel that TLC Framboos is a high quality serum.  I definitely get the tingling right after application, but it doesn’t burn uncomfortably.  I am 49 and my middle aged skin is noticably improved if I stick to a good quality regimen, so I will definitely repurchase Framboos for anti aging!

reviews.product_name: Lala Retro Whipped Refillable Moisturizer with Ceramides
reviews.review_text: Lala Retro is one of many Drunk Elephant products that I’ve used and enjoyed.  The texture is very nice and I can actually FEEL it working.  Not a fan of the packaging necessarily.... it’s not the easiest to completely empty, so I feel product probably gets wasted.  Still, a good product that I would purchase again!

reviews.product_name: Confidence in a Cream Anti-Aging Hydrating Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I really enjoyed IT Confidence in a Cream!   It glides on the skin and absorbs quickly with no greasy feeling.  I like that it’s not overly fragranced.  My skin does look and FEEL nicer after applying; I can tell that is does have a real benefit.  I would definitely purchase this cream again as a mainstay to my nighttime skincare routine!

reviews.product_name: Watermelon Glow Niacinamide Dew Drops
reviews.review_text: * gifted by Glow Recipe * I am a Glow Recipe lover!! Their products not only have the cutest packaging but have some of the best skincare ingredients! These new dew drops are nothing short of amazing! They give your skin such a glow from within look and I LOVE all of the many different ways you can use it! I love applying it at the end of my skincare routine and also mixing it in with my tinted moisturizer/foundation! Another amazing launch from Glow Recipe that I think many will enjoy!!

reviews.product_name: Avocado Soothing Skin Barrier Serum with Ceramides
reviews.review_text: A HOLY GRAIL product for redness!! Everything about this product is perfection!! The texture is super lightweight and glides onto the skin so smoothly! I love the instant reduce in redness this serum gives! This serum works so well at overall brightening and smoothing complexion! Truly a holy grail product!

reviews.product_name: Plum Plump Hyaluronic Acid Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I AM OBSESSED!!! This moisturizer is so so so good! It leaves my skin feeling hydrated and with a glow! It is super lightweight and absorbs quickly! I love that this has refill pods too. I would definitely recommend this moisturizer!

reviews.product_name: Mini Plum Plump Hyaluronic Acid Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I AM OBSESSED!!! This moisturizer is so so so good! It leaves my skin feeling hydrated and with a glow! It is super lightweight and absorbs quickly! I love that this has refill pods too. I would definitely recommend this moisturizer!

reviews.product_name: Sugar Lip Balm Hydrating Treatment
reviews.review_text: WOW! I have been wearing this everyday since I got it! It is the perfect amount of tint and hydrates my lips all day long. The rose scent is pretty and not overpowering! The tint is a pink berry shade that looks super natural.

reviews.product_name: Pure Skin Face Cleanser
reviews.review_text: I have oily-combo skin, and have really enjoyed using this. I just finished my first tube and will be buying another. You really get a lot of bang for your buck. It leaves my face feeling clean but not stripped. Would highly recommend for the price point. Note: I find this is a hit or miss product. Some people swear by it, some say it did nothing for them. Get a sample!

reviews.product_name: Facial Radiance Pads
reviews.review_title: A great intro to acid toning for sensitive skin!
reviews.review_text: Gentle, and gets the job done. I have sensitive skin and the thought of acids was daunting. These are great for travel, I now use something stronger (I also don’t like that FAB doesn’t list the % of acids but I’ve heard it’s rather low), but would highly recommend for a newbie!

reviews.product_name: Cicapair Tiger Grass Serum
reviews.review_text: Sooo I get very red sometimes and heard that this was a godsend. I tried a sample, loved it, and bought the product - howeverrrrrr - I haven’t rebought it, and simply changed my diet and the redness has subsided. I will say it does slightly reduce redness and gives your face à feeling of calm. Would be interested in trying the overnight mask to see how they fair. But they’re & $75 and not something I can splurge on atm. Give it a try!

reviews.product_name: Luminous Dewy Skin Mist
reviews.review_text: For $24 I expected this to last a little longer than a week. I didn’t really notice a difference in skin luminosity, although the packaging is beautiful. Doubt i’ll repurchase.

reviews.product_name: Lip Glowy Balm
reviews.review_text: V cute. Sort of in between a gloss and a balm, makes your lips look super hydrated and shiny, but not like theres a layer of gloss on. I layer this on top of a lip oil.

reviews.product_name: Beste No. 9 Jelly Cleanser
reviews.review_title: Great cleanse but dry skin possible
reviews.review_text: Alright, so half and half of these reviews are right. The jelly smells nice in my opinon and goes on perfectly with some foaming and washing  your skin feels very clean and fresh.I think the problem is when it comes to your rountine this clenser should only be used once per day and with that one use you need to moisturize. I find if you do that, then your skin won’t be dry or red afterwards. I find the best time is night time because after a long day of work, I build up a lot of oil. So if you are a dry skin user, reconsider this product. Combination people like me can use it once per day as the package says. Oily skin individuals might get away twice but I would reccommend moisturizing afterwards. Cute package, a little pricey as I may switch back to my Oirigins Clenser.

reviews.product_name: Brazilian Kiss Cupuaçu Lip Butter
reviews.review_title: My girlfriend wont stop stealing this!
reviews.review_text: This balm is large which is great I cannot lose this. Its soft and keeps the lips not dryed out or flaky and has a subtle smell of its products. I would say if youre just buying for smell, skip this but for a good lip balm for day to day routine, get this. Worth the price lasts me over 6 months. My girlfriend often steals this so I am buying her one for Christmas.

reviews.product_name: Salicylic Acid Acne Healing Dots

reviews.product_name: Rose & Hyaluronic Acid Deep Hydration Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I love this moisturizer it doesn’t irritate my skin or cause any breakouts for me. I feel like a rich old lady when I put this on my face.

reviews.product_name: A-Passioni Retinol Cream
reviews.review_text: HOLY S#@%!!! I am shook. My skin looks soooo good! I am 39 and I’m just starting to get some fine lines around my lips. The so-called “smoking wrinkles“, except I don’t smoke. I also have some wrinkles between my eyebrows and across my forehead and those are a little deeper. I have been using tretinoin for about a year and I see MUCH better results from the Drunk Elephant retinol cream. I use DE C-Firma serum during the day and the A-Passioni at night and the fine lines around my mouth are completely gone. GONE! I can still see the lines on my forehead but they are much less noticeable. Thank You Drunk Elephant!

reviews.product_name: Unseen Sunscreen SPF 40 PA+++
reviews.review_text: I get the hype now. This sunscreen feels exactly like a silicone primer and has zero scent. It is truly unseen and unscented. Like another person wrote, it feels like velvet on the skin. I wouldn’t say it leaves my skin matte, it’s more of a satin finish. Don’t get me wrong, I love a dewy moment (my other go-to sunscreen is The Beet Shield), but if I’m wearing a radiant foundation it can be a little too much with a glowy sunscreen too. However, foundation goes on beautifully over this product and I don’t look like an oil slick.

For anyone wondering, I feel like this bottle would last many months, so it’s worth it for sure.

reviews.product_name: Mini Original Skin Retexturizing Mask with Rose Clay
reviews.review_text: This mask actually works pretty well. I have large pores, rosacea, and cystic acne, so I need all the help I can get when it comes to skin care. When I used this, I noticed that my skin looks tighter and more balanced... definitely calmer as well. The package is small, but a little goes a long way.

reviews.product_name: Avocado Soothing Skin Barrier Serum with Ceramides
reviews.review_text: The positive reviews of this serum really confuse me. I have rosacea and redness throughout my face and was hoping this product would be a game-changer based on all of the 5-star ratings. Unfortunately this did absolutely nothing to help with redness, and even the hydrating aspects were questionable. I am always excited to try products with such great reviews and recommendations, but this one was a huge disappointment. I’d pay double the price of this for a product that actually worked.

reviews.product_name: 5 Stars Retinol + Niacinamide Eye Serum
reviews.review_text: I have always heard so many good things about Sunday Riley, the first time using this five star eye cream and I’m really loving this. The smells and packaging is awesome, looking forward to see more changes of the dark circles.

I’ve used SO many different kinds of “gentle” face washes that are not meant to strip the skin, and they do not compare to this. Although the price of this is up there, I definitely believe it’s worth it. You don’t need that much to rinse your entire face, it smells wonderful (slightly fruity), and it has made my skin so soft and calm! I will buy this over and over again

reviews.product_name: Hyaluronic Acid 2% + B5 Hydrating Serum
reviews.review_title: it feels good but it doesn’t play well

My skin does feel better when I use it, but I can only use it as my last step because it pills and flakes when I put a n y t h i n g else on top. I usually love the ordinary, but this product is not one I’ll restock. Find a different hyaluronic acid that won’t react with other moisturizers!

This and the fact that I didn’t notice a change in any brightness / lines made me disappointed in the product.

reviews.review_title: good for travel, but didn’t help with skin texture
reviews.review_text: I’m giving this four stars because it is super light and is virtually weightless, and it definitely gets the job done. However, I have dry, sensitive, textured skin, and even after washing my face after using this, it almost seems like it emphasized my texture. This product was the only thing I changed in my skin care routine and make up removal routine, so I am a little bummed out that it affected my skin so much.

The patches come in a box, and they come in two separate resealable bags. Why? It’s such a waste! One sheet per bag? I’m trying to be more environmentally cautious, and I DEFINITELY would not have bought these had I known how wasteful the packaging was.

reviews.product_name: Vegan Milk Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I have dry, textured / acne-prone, sensitive skin. So far, this product has not broken me out and has added good moisture. Make sure you don’t use a lot — I barely use a pea-sized amount for my cheeks and about the same for my forehead.

reviews.review_text: This took me some time to warm up to. At first, it just felt as though it sat on my skin and didn’t absorb. However, I figured out that I needed the right toner for my skin to soak it up. I use the Ole Henriksen balancing force toner (since my skin is pretty oily), and now, my skin drinks this right up! It has made my skin softer and more hydrated. It does make me a bit oily, but nothing I can’t handle. Now that I know what works, I use it everyday. I suggest knowing what toner / face wash work best for you, and it’ll absorb well into skin!

Love it!!!.*Received this product complimentary for testing purposes, all opinions are my own* I received this product complimentary for review purposes.

reviews.product_name: Rose & Hyaluronic Acid Deep Hydration Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: Freshbeautygiftedme with this Rose Deep Hydration Face Cream. I love that it has Damask rose extract and two types of hyaluronic acid, both are known to plump skin with moisture and for it’s anti-aging effects. This cream feels amazing, refreshing and nourishing on the skin. It is light and creamy. When I opened the jar, I can instantly smell the sweet rose scent. The smell is very sensual and relaxing. If you want to pamper yourself and experience the benefits of the Damask rose on your skin, give this moisturizer a try and hope you enjoy it as much as I do.

reviews.product_name: Watermelon Glow PHA + BHA Pore-Tight Toner
reviews.review_text: I love this toner from glow. This BHA toner is everything. The scent is amazing. Perfect for any skin types. It made my pores appear smaller. I am very impressed.  My face looks more radiant and healthier. Everybody noticed this transformation in my skin. Highly recommend!

reviews.product_name: Mini Watermelon Glow PHA + BHA Pore-Tight Toner
reviews.review_text: I love this toner from glow. This BHA toner is everything. The scent is amazing. Perfect for any skin types. It made my pores appear smaller. I am very impressed.  My face looks more radiant and healthier. Everybody noticed this transformation in my skin. Highly recommend!

reviews.product_name: Glowscreen Sunscreen SPF 40 PA+++ with Hyaluronic Acid + Niacinamide
reviews.review_text: This supergoop glowscreen is an ultimate must have.  It has Hyaluronic Acid and Vitamin B5, sea lavender and cocoa peptides all known to be beneficial to the skin. This made my skin look radiant and smooth. I don’t have to even put make up in the morning when I use this because it made me look fresh and glowing. It also SPF 40, so it’s a multi-tasker primer.  This primer is also made of clean ingredients, cruelty-free and gluten-free which is a huge plus. The formula is non-sticky and very lightweight which is perfect for Cali weather. Overall, I love it and would definitely add in my skincare routine.

reviews.product_name: Daily Greens Oil-Free Gel Moisturizer with Moringa and Papaya
reviews.review_text: Farmacy gifted me their new daily greens moisturizer! This is ideal for those with combo/oily skin! It’s a gel formula which tends to be my favorite! It definitely absorbed fast (don’t use a lot of product or else it won’t) and felt very lightweight which I love for during the day. Makeup wore really well on top of it. The scent is light and earthy, very pleasant nothing overwhelming! Overall I really enjoyed this! Does exactly what it says and will be perfect as we approach the summer months in NY!

reviews.product_name: Watermelon Glow Niacinamide Dew Drops
reviews.review_text: These dew drops give a beautiful glow from within. The texture is lightweight and absorb well into the skin. I’ve been using it as a makeup primer and it looks great with a matte foundation - almost gave it a more natural finish. My makeup stayed on the whole day. I also mixed this in with my blush and it gave such a nice glow but not sparkly - it looked so natural! Plus it has skin benefits so can’t go wrong with this! *this product was gifted by glow recipe

reviews.product_name: Avocado Soothing Skin Barrier Serum with Ceramides
reviews.review_text: Love how lightweight this product is. I apply on damp skin and it absorbs so nicely. As someone with oily skin this is a perfect hydration boost without the heaviness or potential to clog my pores. Packaging is really cute too which is a plus!

reviews.product_name: Floral Recovery Overnight Mask with Squalane
reviews.review_text: Really enjoy this overnight face mask! I do have sensitive skin and this worked well for when my skin felt a little irritated. I did think my skin looked more even and toned after using. The texture is nice and doesn’t feel too heavy!

reviews.product_name: Ultimate Sun Protector Lotion SPF 50+ Sunscreen
reviews.review_text: This is a great product.  First, I love that it’s now ocean-friendly!! So important. I wish more states joined Hawaii on increasing ingredient restrictions to make our oceans cleaner and safer.Ok onto the product - the sunscreen feels super super light, smooth, and blends onto your skin really easily.  I have sensitive skin so I did worry that it was a little oily on my face at first, but that went away quickly.  I didn’t break out from wearing it (woo!) and it didn’t dry out my skin either.It also has a light, floral scent that sticks around all day.  It’s not overpowering but does stay with you!  I don’t fully understand the heatforce technology so I can’t say whether that made a difference, but overall I would recommend.

reviews.product_name: Revitalizing Supreme+ Youth Power Creme Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I received a mini size of this creme to try out, and it’s really nice!  The creme has a soft scent and feels light on your skin.  It adds moisture, but it wasn’t enough for me because I have pretty dry skin and need a heavier moisturizer.  I had my mom try it as well and she actually loved it and is ready to buy the full size!

reviews.review_text: I like this sunscreen, it has a very light refreshing scent and goes on smoothly.  I didn’t notice my skin feeling oily or dry after applying.  I’ll be using this all summer!

reviews.product_name: Urban Environment Fresh-Moisture Sunscreen Broad-Spectrum SPF 42
reviews.review_text: The sunscreen is hydrating but not heavy or greasy.  It has a very light scent and a high spf which is great! Would recommend.

reviews.product_name: Revitalizing Supreme+ Youth Power Creme Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: This product goes on really well and it is very rich and moisturizing.  It may be a little heavy if you don’t need that type of moisture, but is great for dry skin.  I don’t love the fragrance in estee lauder products though so I won’t be purchasing the full size, but it could be great for others!

reviews.product_name: T.L.C. Sukari Babyfacial AHA + BHA Mask
reviews.review_text: AHHHHMAZING! my skin looks better now than it did in my 20s. At first, I did have sensitized skin and it was very tingly feeling but now I can use this 2x per week, no issues. No more dark patches, byyyee acne scars, and hello baby fresh skin

reviews.product_name: Lippe Balm
reviews.review_text: The balm is definitely hydrating upon application, however, it does wear off rather quickly. There is not a lot of product for the price and due to how big the top is, it is hard to get on just your lips. Overall, I feel this is a good, but overpriced chapstick.

reviews.product_name: A-Passioni Retinol Cream
reviews.review_text: I use DE exclusively and did not experience any burning or peeling despite never having used a retinol product before. I did my research and read the reviews and this is what worked for me : I started with 2x week application. I used B-Hydra and mixed the A-Passioni with a couple drops Marula oil. Three weeks later, I’m using it nightly and my skin is looking amazing. A lot of the texture is gone.  My skin is soft and smooth. This is a must have product but you definitely have to build up to daily use and use with a moisturizer

reviews.product_name: Slaai  Makeup-Melting Butter Cleanser
reviews.review_title: A little goes a long way
reviews.review_text: Just a little bit rubbed into my hands on a dry face and all my make up melts away. I do have to really work it in where my eye make up is, but it gets the job done and leaves my skin feeling fresh and not too dry. I use the bamboo booster once or twice a week for a nice exfoliation. Love this!

reviews.product_name: F-Balm Electrolyte Waterfacial Mask
reviews.review_text: Amazing overnight hydration mask. I was not oily the next morning and my skin felt amazing. Another great addition to the DE family

reviews.product_name: Cold Plunge Pore Mask
reviews.review_text: Love this clay mask. I got this when it was Sephora 100 point perk. After a week I felt and saw a huge difference. My pores were smaller, redness was lighter and left my skin smooth and brighter. I will for sure purchase the larger size. The cooling of the mask is very refreshing.

reviews.product_name: Soy Hydrating Gentle Face Cleanser
reviews.review_title: Smells like your at a spa
reviews.review_text: Bought the smaller one to try and love it. After use your skin feels smooth and soft. Smells like cucumbers, like your at a spa. I don’t use it to help me fully take my make off.  But it helps to take off what’s left.

reviews.product_name: The Water Cream Oil-Free Pore Minimizing Moisturizer

reviews.review_text: This product does what it’s suppose too. I do find it’s a little to pricy. You can get product cheaper that does the exact same thing. It’s nice that it has a light vanilla scent.

reviews.product_name: Alpha Beta Extra Strength Daily Peel Pads
reviews.review_text: This product is convenient and effective.  There are two quick and easy steps.  The product gives a wonderful cooling sensation.  I would highly recommend using this product during the warmer months.  The packaging is small enough to pack for traveling.  My skin tone looked a little more even and felt balanced.  I will buy this product in the future.

reviews.product_name: Urban Environment Oil-Free Sunscreen Broad-Spectrum SPF 42
reviews.review_text: This is my first time using a Shiseido product.  This product claims that the hyaluronic acid used in the product will keep your skin smooth and hydrated.  I did not find this to be true for me.  The product also makes a claim that this product is oil-free and mattifying.  This was the case for me.  The fact that this is not hydrating doesn’t bother me.  In fact, this is my new favorite facial sunscreen, because it doesn’t make my face feel greasy or cause breakouts.  It absorbed into my skin right away.  This product has a thin, almost watery consistency, so be sure to shake before use.  I found that it worked beautifully under my makeup.  I’m glad I received this product, because it will be my go-to sunscreen this summer.

reviews.product_name: Urban Environment Fresh-Moisture Sunscreen Broad-Spectrum SPF 42
reviews.review_text: I tried Shiseido’s Urban Environment Fresh-Moisture Sunscreen Broad Spectrum SPF 42.  I did find this formula to be somewhat moisturizing.  My skin has been a little dry lately, so it quickly absorbed the product.  I love that this sunscreen goes on smoothly and does not feel greasy like other sunscreens do.  I will definitely buy when I run out.

reviews.product_name: Smart Clinical Repair Wrinkle Correcting Cream
reviews.review_text: I have oily combination skin, and one of my concerns is my wrinkles on my forehead and other fine lines on my face.  The cream does moisturize, but I’m not sure about it’s claims.  I didn’t notice any immediate results.  Supposedly 85% say lines and wrinkles looked reduced after using for 4 weeks.  I received a sample size, so I was not using this product for 4 weeks.  I didn’t notice a change in my forehead wrinkles.  My smile lines may have softened slightly, but I feel like I need more time to give a thorough review.

reviews.product_name: Ultimate Sun Protector Lotion SPF 50+ Sunscreen
reviews.review_text: Now this is a truly luxurious sunscreen. It has a super silky feel to it and absorbs so easily. I generally use it on my body but my fiancé uses it on his face. He usually is indifferent to sunscreens but he kept mentioning how much he liked it and how nice it smelled. Can’t sit to use this on hot days

reviews.product_name: The Essence Skincare Boosting Treatment
reviews.review_text: The next day after using this I definitely feel like my face is softer. It works great before my retinol and moisturizer. However I don’t use it every night because I feel like it makes me break out a little if I use it too often. But I definitely will continue to use it to give my skin a little moisture boost, which is much needed in this dry climate.

reviews.product_name: Mini The Essence  Skincare Boosting Treatment
reviews.review_text: The next day after using this I definitely feel like my face is softer. It works great before my retinol and moisturizer. However I don’t use it every night because I feel like it makes me break out a little if I use it too often. But I definitely will continue to use it to give my skin a little moisture boost, which is much needed in this dry climate.

reviews.product_name: Urban Environment Oil-Free Sunscreen Broad-Spectrum SPF 42
reviews.review_text: Shiseido makes really nice sunscreens that rub in so well and don’t leave a white cast, and this one was the same. I’m taking a star off because for me,  this clogged the pores on my face a bit but it worked great on my body for a day at the beach. The size is perfect for traveling. A bit expensive but would use again.

reviews.product_name: Urban Environment Fresh-Moisture Sunscreen Broad-Spectrum SPF 42
reviews.review_text: This is similar to the other shisiedo urban environment sunscreen but I feel like this one is more formulated for the body. That’s how I’ve been using it and I feel like it works great. It rubs in easily, leaves no white cast, and works well on my pale skin on a hot sunny day. This is an easy bottle to throw into your bag on the go. It’s expensive but I would absolutely use again.

reviews.product_name: Protini Polypeptide Firming Refillable Moisturizer
reviews.review_title: Expensive but my skin loves it!
reviews.review_text: I wear this at night and my skin loves it! I dont need a full pump for my face. The pump mechanism is fun an all but it seems a waste of packaging. I wish it was more cost effective but my picky picky skin is super happy. It soaks into my cheeks very quickly and my whole face writhing a few minutes. In the morning, I still feel hydrated. It’s getting to be a little heavy for my oily zone in the humid South but my cheeks still adore it. Will be good for all over in the winter, again.

reviews.product_name: Superfood Antioxidant Cleanser
reviews.review_text: A great face wash that my spouse and I can both use. It’s especially good for the oily parts of the face. Maybe a little much for my dry cheeks. I love the glass bottle and the dispensed amount is perfect. Overall, a great product.

reviews.product_name: Mini Superfood Antioxidant Cleanser
reviews.review_text: A great face wash that my spouse and I can both use. It’s especially good for the oily parts of the face. Maybe a little much for my dry cheeks. I love the glass bottle and the dispensed amount is perfect. Overall, a great product.

reviews.product_name: Niacinamide 10% + Zinc 1% Oil Control Serum
reviews.review_title: Not an expert but seems fine.
reviews.review_text: I have never used a niacinamide serum before, though it’s been in other products. Its sticky but dried smoothly. Maybe that’s normal...? Easy to apply. The bottle looks small but is lasting us a long time because you dont need much.

reviews.product_name: Hello FAB Coconut Water Cream
reviews.review_text: Spouse with combo/oily skin loves this!! Soaks in quickly, not heavy or thick, leaves skin moisturized without making it greasy.My skin doesn’t love it. I love the texture and application but my skin won’t play nice. Great product. Not everything works well for everyone, and that’s ok!

reviews.product_name: E-Rase Milki Micellar Water
reviews.review_text: I received this complimentary product to facilitate my review. Initially, this milk micellar water had a slight thicker consistency compared to other micellar waters, most likely due to the milky texture. In terms of scent, this made me think I was eating cereal and applying milk to my skin. But this water felt very refreshing! I use this in the middle of the day if I need to refreshen up my skin and at night to help remove my makeup. This water does not dry out my skin but leaves a nice clean feeling and I have no so plain fa so far. However, the downside is that this product is quite expensive.

reviews.product_name: The Essence Skincare Boosting Treatment
reviews.review_text: This essence provides the moisture my skin needs! It is not irritating to my skin and it has the least ingredients to provide the best possible effect for my skin. My skin looks bright and looks very plump and hydrated. However, considering the price, I really do think that this is a tad over priced and definitely think the price is worth it!

reviews.product_name: Mini The Essence  Skincare Boosting Treatment
