reviews.product_name: Urban Environment Oil-Free Sunscreen Broad-Spectrum SPF 42
reviews.review_text: Let me tell you, good sunscreens are very hard to come by!! I received this from Influenster to help facilitate my review. At first when I poured this into my hand, I almost thought that this was a tinted sunscreen. Based on the color, it had me worried that it wouldn’t blend well into my skin color, but I was wrong. This was not tinted & it had a nice thin consistency. When the sunscreen has a light & thin consistency, it makes it very easy to spread & less tugging on the skin. I am absolutely in love with this sunscreen & would definitely purchase another when the time comes.

reviews.product_name: Urban Environment Fresh-Moisture Sunscreen Broad-Spectrum SPF 42
reviews.review_text: At first, I was a bit concerned when I saw the product coming out of the bottle very thick. But once I started spreading it onto my skin, the sunscreen was very light! It felt moisturizing on my skin & it did not feel tight. Wearing this sunscreen throughout the day, I did not get oily nor did it feel heavy on my skin after a while. I would definitely be purchasing this again when the time comes!

reviews.product_name: T.L.C. Framboos Glycolic Resurfacing Night Serum
reviews.review_text: Favorite serum ever! When I wake up my skin always looks nice and has an even skin tone and small pores, very easy to apply and a little pump goes a long way!

reviews.product_name: T.L.C. Sukari Babyfacial AHA + BHA Mask
reviews.review_text: Burns a lot when you first use it but the second time around its not bad, It really took away a lot of my texture that I was mostly concerned with and made my skin very smooth and clear.

reviews.product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C
reviews.review_text: I personally wouldn’t use this at night since its super moisturizing but this is amazing for dry lips. It comes with a little applicator so you dont have to use your fingers and its super cute!

reviews.product_name: Lala Retro Whipped Refillable Moisturizer with Ceramides
reviews.review_text: Love this moisturizer! Lightweight but penetrates the skin amazingly. I use it with a facial oil to lock in the moisture and always see amazing results. I have acne prone skin and it has never broken me out

reviews.product_name: Aqua Bomb Overnight Lip Mask
reviews.review_text: I received the belif Aqua Bomb overnight Lip Mask from Influenster and belif in exchange for my honest review.  I applied a generous amount at night and when I woke up my lips were so soft and hydrated. I really like that it doesn’t have a flavor or scent. It’s texture is pretty thick and the packaging is so nice! Plus its derm approved! It’s my new nightstand essential!

reviews.product_name: Squalane + Omega Repair Deep Hydration Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I received the Biossance Squalane + Omega repair cream from Bioassance and Influenster in exchange for my honest review. It is a heavy duty cream that provides a lots of hydration but I prefer a cream that has more of a scent to it. I do like that this was non-comedogenic so it’s great for acne prone or oily skin. It also helps to seal in the skins moisture barrier.

reviews.product_name: Advanced Night Repair Eye Gel-Cream
reviews.review_text: I received the Estee Lauder advanced night repair by gel cream from Influenster and Estee Lauder in exchange for my honest review. Since using this cream for two weeks now, I have seen a significant improvement in the dark circles under my eyes. I look less tired and more refreshed. I like that this cream is not greasy and provide the perfect amount of hydration.

reviews.product_name: T.L.C. Framboos Glycolic Resurfacing Night Serum
reviews.review_text: I received the Drunk Elephant TLC Framboos voxbox from Influenster and Drunk Elephant in exchange for my honest review. The Drunk Elephant TLC Framboos glycolic resurfacing night serum after using for a 1-2 weeks gave me much even, brighter toned skin! It gently exfoliates and resurfaces. No harsh scents and left my skin visibly smoother.

reviews.product_name: Lala Retro Whipped Refillable Moisturizer with Ceramides
reviews.review_text: I received the Drunk Elephant TLC Framboos voxbox from Influenster and Drunk Elephant in exchange for my honest review. The Lala retro whipped moisturizer w/ ceramides is so nice! IT’s light whipped texture and practically scent-free formula is perfect for hydrating those with sensitive skin. It seems a bit thick/heavy at first but it blends into your skin so nicely!

reviews.product_name: Good Genes All-In-One AHA Lactic Acid Treatment
reviews.review_text: I love my Good Genes...can’t live without it! I recommend giving this product a full 6 weeks to start really seeing results as your skin will go through a purging stage, getting rid of all the bad stuff. But my skin is the softest and smoothest it’s been in years with the help of this product! REMEMBER: wear your SPF daily with Good Genes!

reviews.product_name: Facial Radiance Pads
reviews.review_text: Don’t know what I would do without these! They were introduced to me by a fellow Cast member and they are now part of my every day routine. SO gentle, but still very effective. Have repurchased loads of times!

reviews.product_name: The Dewy Skin Cream Plumping & Hydrating Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: To say I’m obsessed with this cream is an understatement. I have never felt a moisturizer that feels as luxurious and nourishing as this one. If you have dry skin and want some luminosity back, you will LOVE this. I personally like to use this product as a night cream but looks beautiful under makeup as well. A little goes a long way, just be sure to not overuse!

reviews.product_name: Cicapair Tiger Grass Serum
reviews.review_text: So soothing! I’ve been using this since early summer and I’m truly obsessed with the way it makes my skin feel! Great product for those of you with sensitive skin like me, really helps to calm my skin, soothe, and rehydrate.

reviews.product_name: Greek Yoghurt Nourishing Probiotic Gel-Cream
reviews.review_text: I received this as a complimentary product for testing and I am loving it. It makes my skin feel refreshed and soft! I have combination skin and this product works perfectly on me. The texture of product is great and I definitely will be purchasing! 5 stars!

reviews.product_name: Ultimate Sun Protector Lotion SPF 50+ Sunscreen
reviews.review_text: Really loved using this sunscreen! It is light weight and not greasy. It is moisturizing and I enjoyed the scent, didn’t remind me of other sunscreens having the traditional sunscreen smell. Overall it is a great product, I deducted a star because it says for face & body and I found that it ran a bit and got into my eyes somehow. Other than that I really liked it!

reviews.product_name: Dewtopia 20% Acid Night Treatment
reviews.review_text: I really enjoy everything about this product. It helps my skin feel firm moisturized and refreshed after using it. I also love the scent, lemons are so bright and fresh.

reviews.product_name: Indigo Overnight Repair Serum in Cream Treatment
reviews.review_text: This product really blows my mind. I received this complimentary product to try and it definitely did not disappoint. My skin feels firmer and moisturized. It really gives my skin a glow and the texture of my skin feels so good in the mornings after using this overnight cream. I will definitely purchase this product!

reviews.product_name: Mini Indigo Overnight Repair Serum in Cream Treatment
reviews.review_text: This product really blows my mind. I received this complimentary product to try and it definitely did not disappoint. My skin feels firmer and moisturized. It really gives my skin a glow and the texture of my skin feels so good in the mornings after using this overnight cream. I will definitely purchase this product!

reviews.product_name: Skinlongevity Long Life Herb Anti-Aging Face Serum
reviews.review_text: Initially, I was surprised by how watery this product is. After using it, though, it goes on very easily and has a nice cooling effect when you apply it that is great in this heat. It’s also very light, so you don’t feel like there is heavy cream or anything sitting on your face, it settles in and provides a fresh feel. It has a nice, light scent that I really enjoy as well. It just feels healthy and I’m really enjoying it!

reviews.product_name: Santorini Grape Poreless Skin Cream
reviews.review_text: I tried this product when my skin was very dry and it wasn’t great because I needed something more moisturizing. That being said, it had a great lineup of ingredients and I’m excited to try it more since the weather has mellowed to see how I feel about it. Would not recommend for dry skin though.

reviews.product_name: Urban Environment Oil-Free Sunscreen Broad-Spectrum SPF 42
reviews.review_text: I was shocked to see the price on this, but it is a really good product. It doesn’t make your face feel oily at all and absorbs quickly. My only complaint is that it smells like sunscreen and that is a smell that I’m not a huge fan of. I love all of the ingredients though and I think it’s a fair trade off.

reviews.product_name: Urban Environment Fresh-Moisture Sunscreen Broad-Spectrum SPF 42
reviews.review_text: The price tag on these products surprised me, until I looked at the ingredients. They are made with such high quality ingredients that are worth the price to take care of your skin. I don’t love the sunscreen smell, but I do love the way this product feels on my skin. Would def recommend buying if you’re up in the air!

reviews.product_name: Smart Clinical Repair Wrinkle Correcting Serum
reviews.review_text: This is a great product! It works well! It helped even my skin out! It helped a little with my redness. I am just starting to get a couple wrinkles and fine lines. It did seem to smooth those out a little. Over all I really like it!

reviews.product_name: Urban Environment Oil-Free Sunscreen Broad-Spectrum SPF 42
reviews.review_title: It's a really nice really fancy sunscreen!
reviews.review_text: This is a really fancy sunscreen! It has an SPF of 42 and it is oil free. 2 things that work well for most skin tones. This does have a very slight tint but it appears to be a all in one tint. kinda like a beauty balm. It also has a slight scent. Its like a sunscreen meets skincare scent but it’s not overbearing and dissipates through the day. It’s very lightweight and not greasy feeling like some sunscreens. It is nice but for the price, 35$ for an ounce,personally I would go for something else but if you have the money and want this supercharged sunscreen then go for it!This was gifted by influenster.

reviews.product_name: Urban Environment Fresh-Moisture Sunscreen Broad-Spectrum SPF 42
reviews.review_title: Sunscreen meets skincare in a bottle
reviews.review_text: This is a really nice sunscreen! It has an SPF of 42. It also has Hyaluronic acid which helps increase and trap moisture. 2 things that work well for dry skin. This has a very slight scent. Its like a sunscreen meets skincare scent but it’s not overbearing and dissipates through the day. It’s very lightweight, the oily feeling goes away after a couple minutes and it then feels nice and smooth. It is nice but for the price, 38$ for an 1.8 oz, I am sure this one will get used but for the price idk if I will get it again. If you have the money and dry skin and this may be your thing! I highly recommend it!

reviews.product_name: Smart Clinical Repair Wrinkle Correcting Cream
reviews.review_text: This is a nice anti aging cream. It feels kind of like a water cream it’s very lightweight in texture, absorbs not nicely. I got mine free and since the amount was a sample size jar, I don’t have enough to really judge the true anti aging components but it does moisturize well. My skin does look a bit brighter and more even. I think long term useage this could really work!

reviews.product_name: Magic Cream Moisturizer with Hyaluronic Acid
reviews.review_text: i love this product? it is super lightweight and oil free and is great for everyday and under makeup. it also has a very refreshing cooling scent. i like to keep mine in the fridge and apply it cold!

reviews.product_name: Watermelon Glow Niacinamide Sunscreen SPF 50
reviews.review_text: the glow is really nice! it gives you a shiny dewy finish and is light weight. it is a little sticky but that is normal for most sunscreens. the scent is nice and not overpowering and would be great for sumner

reviews.product_name: Watermelon Glow PHA + BHA Pore-Tight Toner
reviews.review_text: this brand makes such good and clean skincare!! it hydrated my skin, gave me a glow, and tightened pores.  i love the scent of it and it’s perfect to use in the morning. also is gentle enough for sensitive skin

reviews.product_name: Mini Daily Microfoliant Exfoliator
reviews.review_text: this actually was a pretty good exfoliator. i usually just use an exfoliator glove but this product really evened out my skin for when i apply self tanner and it made it really smooth. i would only recommend using this once a week for sensitive skin. gifted by dermalogica sampling

reviews.product_name: Capture Totale Super Potent Eye Serum
reviews.review_text: I’m in love with this Dior Eye serum! The bottle itself is beautiful and I love the applicator. First time using on. At first it’s cold and feels really good and the serum itself is nice and light and soaks in nicely. My eyes feel more open like they got a lift and my eye area is feeling soft. I really don’t like the smell of it but it does go away. That will not stop me from buying more when I run out.

reviews.product_name: Urban Environment Oil-Free Sunscreen Broad-Spectrum SPF 42
reviews.review_text: I received this product free from Influenster and Shiseido for my honest review. I am very happy I was able to try this dual care sunscreen. I live at the beach and the sun here is super strong. I always need a good sunscreen for my light skin. This stuff is really great! It is super light, soaks right in, doesn’t smell like sunscreen, and it moisturizes. I would definitely buy this once I run out.

reviews.product_name: Urban Environment Fresh-Moisture Sunscreen Broad-Spectrum SPF 42
reviews.review_text: I received this product free from Influenster and Shiseido for my honest opinion.I am super glad I was able to try this product. I live at the beach and always need sunscreen for my light skin. This stuff is really great! It’s super light, soaks right in, doesn’t smell like sunscreen, and it moisturizes. All in one. What more could you ask for. My skin feels great after using this. I would definitely buy once I have finished this one.

reviews.product_name: Smart Clinical Repair Wrinkle Correcting Cream
reviews.review_text: The repair cream is pretty thick and really doesn’t have a smell. Too thick right now where I live that is still hot. Would be better in the winter for me. Didn’t soak in great. Being a sample and minimal use I did not see any change. Maybe if used longer.

reviews.product_name: Greek Yoghurt Nourishing Probiotic Gel-Cream
reviews.review_title: Soothed my dry and delicate skin
reviews.review_text: I’ve been dealing with dryness near my eyes due to winter and using tret.  This cream smells wonderful and has soothed my skin.  Even though I applied it near my eyes, I experienced zero irritation.  I received this product as a free sample but will consider repurchasing.

reviews.product_name: Skinlongevity Long Life Herb Anti-Aging Face Serum
reviews.review_text: This product goes on silky sheer, sinks into the skin easily,  and layers with other products in my routine and, makeup without, pilling.   It’s got a light, clean scent that I also really like.  I’m not sure if I see a difference in my skin yet, but with it’s clean formula, I know I’m doing my face good every time I use it!  I received this product complimentary from Influenster.

reviews.product_name: E-Rase Milki Micellar Water
reviews.review_text: Works as advertised, but I wasn’t blown away.  I felt like I had to squeeze quite a bit of product into the cotton pad in order for it to stay moist long enough to go over my entire face.  At this price, I’d expect something more amazing.  I love DE but I’m sticking with Garnier micellar water for now.

reviews.product_name: E-Rase Milki Micellar Water Mini
reviews.review_text: Works as advertised, but I wasn’t blown away. I love DE but I’m sticking with Garnier micellar water for now.

reviews.product_name: The True Cream Aqua Bomb
reviews.review_text: Solid, lightweight moisturizing cream.  It leaves a cool slight tingle behind, and I have no problem layering makeup over it!

reviews.product_name: Glow Cycle Retin-ALT Power Serum
reviews.review_text: This product seems to be doing wonders for my skin. In just a few days I have noticed my skin feels smooth, bright, and less red than my usual discoloration. I am looking forward to seeing the long term benefits. The smell is very pleasant, smells like lemons. Application is easy, just rub in circular motions upward and it soaks quickly into skin without leaving any greasy feeling. I would definitely recommend this product. I did receive this product complimentary for my honest review and all opinions are my own.

reviews.product_name: Estee Lauder Advanced Night Repair Synchronized Multi-Recovery Complex Serum
reviews.review_text: I’ve only been using it for a couple of weeks but so far I feel it makes my skin feel great. I have smooth, hydrated, and plump skin. I have not experienced any sensitivity from this product. It smells great too! Not heavily fragrant.

reviews.product_name: Mini Advanced Night Repair Synchronized Multi-Recovery Complex
reviews.review_text: I’ve only been using it for a couple of weeks but so far I feel it makes my skin feel great. I have smooth, hydrated, and plump skin. I have not experienced any sensitivity from this product. It smells great too! Not heavily fragrant.

reviews.product_name: Advanced Night Repair Synchronized Multi-Recovery Complex Duo
reviews.review_text: I’ve only been using it for a couple of weeks but so far I feel it makes my skin feel great. I have smooth, hydrated, and plump skin. I have not experienced any sensitivity from this product. It smells great too! Not heavily fragrant.

reviews.product_name: Aqua Bomb Overnight Lip Mask
reviews.review_text: This lip mask is perfect for the winter. I put it on right before bed and my lips stay hydrated all day. I’m so glad j was able to try this as a sample because I will definitely purchase.

reviews.product_name: Charlotte’s Magic Serum with Vitamin C
reviews.review_text: This serum works very well in my opinion. As someone who is very sensitive to fragrance, I actually don’t mind the smell of this. It isn’t overpowering and it smells very high-end and luxurious. It applies easily and leaves the skin slightly sticky but very glowy and hydrated. It wears well under makeup too. I would definitely recommend if you are looking for a higher end serum.

reviews.product_name: Vitamin Enriched Face Base Priming Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I use this mainly as a moisturizer because I hardly ever wear makeup. It’s easy to apply and dries quickly. The redness in my face isnt as visible and I can see a reduction of my pores. Leaves my face looking fresh. It has a slight odor but isnt a bad one.i would definitely recommend this product and will continue to use. I received this as a free sample to test.

reviews.product_name: Plum Plump Hyaluronic Acid Serum
reviews.review_text: When I received the Plum Plum from Glow Recipe as a complementary product from Influenster, I added a small pump to my morning routine.The faint scent dissipated almost immediately, and the lightweight gel sank in just as quickly.The most noticeable thing was the dramatic plumping, smoothing effect it had especially on the dry sections of skin around my nose and cheeks. A few days of using this product and you wouldn’t even have known my skin was dry. I will definitely continue to use this product.

reviews.product_name: The Dewy Serum Resurfacing and Plumping Treatment
reviews.review_text: I love the consistency of this product. It’s a little thicker than a regular serum...like a milky lotion. It left my skin feeling very hydrated. I did notice a slight Dewey look to my skin but it was nothing overly dramatic. I have also notice my skin looking better and fine lines are gradually disappearing. I’m sure my skin will continue to improve by using this product.

reviews.product_name: The True Cream Aqua Bomb
reviews.review_text: I received this product from Influenster to try for free and give my honest opinion. It’s very moisturizing and leaves skin feeling super hydrated. It’s very lightweight and a little goes a long way. The only negative for me is the scent. Not something I particularly like but can look past it.

reviews.product_name: U.F.O. Salicylic Acid BHA Acne Treatment Face Oil
reviews.review_text: Have been using this for 2 days now, and my few breakouts are completely gone and I have very large pores and they are almost invisible! I am truly shook. Definitely recommend. I’ll have to see how this works out in the future

reviews.product_name: Brazilian Kiss Cupuaçu Lip Butter
reviews.review_text: My lips have never been smoother! Smells AMAZING and feels amazing! Will never go back to regular old lip balm... will be repurchasing for sure!

reviews.product_name: The Water Cream Oil-Free Pore Minimizing Moisturizer

reviews.product_name: Jet Lag Mask
reviews.review_title: Most versatile product for brightening & moisture
reviews.review_text: This is just a lovely product over-all. It has every ingredient you could want for your skin. When the proper amount is applied, it leaves your skin glowing and supple, and soaks in to the skin really nicely. I use this primarially as an over night eye cream, and it has left my eyes looking the best they ever have. As a new mom, this makes me unbelievably grateful- goodbye tired, dark eyes! I have also noticed better eyelash health. This works wonders as a 10 minute moisture boost, especially after acid based masks (my choice being herbivore blue tansy) to really get a glow. This can also be used as an over night sleeping mask, especially since it contains vitamin c and e which I find work wonders when combined with vitamin a. I’m in love with the versatility of this product, and no matter what I use it for, I wake up to visibly brightened and moisturized skin. Will repurchase.

reviews.product_name: Blue Tansy BHA and Enzyme Pore Refining Mask
reviews.review_title: Highly recommened for instant, perceivable results
reviews.review_text: This product is an actual Holy Grail. I have problematic skin that is relatively unpredictable. Dealing with severe hormonal breakouts (cystic acne), sensitivity, pregnancy induced hyperpigmentation, as well as frustratingly uneven texture and perserverant white bumps on my chin and around my nose: I have honestly tried it all. Blue Tansy leaves my skin feeling soft, helping to regulate my oil production in a way that doesnt leave my skin dry or sensitive. In fact, this product is so gentle I have been able to use it on a nightly basis, with maybe one or two rest days; mind you, I am no stranger to acids! This instantly soothes inflamed skin and reduces redness to a significant degree, and the same goes for blemishes and scarring. The texture of my skin had evened out after 3 nights of use, and my complextion was like glass. It honestly does it all, and I could not recommend this product enough. I would say this would even be a great introduction product to acids, and in terms of my current love affair - the only aha/bha product worth using. Honestly, I am so addicted my other acid masks are collecting dust. Definitely will repurchase, again and again.

reviews.review_text: A beautifully formulated, gentle cream to foam cleanser that never dries out your skin yet is completely effective ... my husband, who works with airplane engine oil in a maintenance shop, uses this cleanser to “take the day off“. Simply leaves you cleansed without feeling stripped, and isnt that all you really need in a cleanser?

I love this on rushed mornings as an only cleanse with a warm wash cloth. Its a generous amount of product, you truly need only half a pump so it lasts a long time.

reviews.product_name: ExfoliKate Glow Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I tried hard not to love this moisturizer... I’m pretty new to having a skincare routine, so I’d asked one of my local Sephora reps for some suggestions on a product that would help my dry, flaky skin improve. She gave me a few samples, including the Exfolikate Glow.  That night I tried it out and I. Was. HOOKED. It made such an immediate difference for me that I was excitedly texting my friends about the improvement to my skin, and I actually stopped wearing makeup for the next few days because I was reluctant to cover up my new glow. Despite my love of this stuff, $65 is a bit pricey, and I wasn’t sure if the results were so good because of the product or just because my skin had been neglected for so long and was finally getting some attention, so I decided to try a few other products instead. Over the next few weeks I tried several other moisturizers, but nothing gave me the same results, and I couldn’t stop thinking about the Exfolikate Glow, so I finally caved and bought some. My skin is so glad I did! This stuff can be greasy if you apply too much at once, but a little goes a long way, so a thin layer absorbs quickly and completely and the results are great! I have a sensitivity to strong smells too, but I really like the light scent of this product. I feel like I haven’t been using it long enough yet to call it a Holy Grail item, but it’s well on its way!

reviews.product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C
reviews.review_text: I’ve been using the Bite Beauty agave lip mask but had heard a lot of praise for this one, so I thought I’d give it a try. First impressions, I love the smell! It isn’t overpowering and fades quickly enough, but it’s pleasant. The little spatula applicator is cute, effective, easy to clean, and comes with its own little envelope to protect it when not in use. The shape of the applicator makes it easy to get every little bit of product out of the jar too. The product itself doesn’t have a taste at all and has a nice consistency. It applies almost like a cream but sort of melts into your lips as it warms to your body temp. It feels smooth and hydrating without being too thick (or too thin!) or sticky. It leaves my lips feeling softer and smoother than before. I still prefer the thicker agave mask for overnight wear, but I’ve been using the Laneige mask during the day in place of my former lip balm. It’s lightweight enough to be comfortable but has more staying power than most other balms I’ve tried. I only have to apply it a couple of times a day instead of constantly trying to keep balm on my lips. Even once the mask has worn off, my lips stay soft and hydrated longer, so its great for use before applying lipsticks. Even my matte liquid lipsticks feel better and less drying after using this. This mask has definitely become a must-have part of my skincare routine, and a little goes a long way, so despite the price tag, it’s a good value. I expect this jar to last a long time, so in the long term, it will be less expensive than the constant supply of “cheaper“ balms and with much better results. I definitely intend to purchase this again if/when this jar runs out.Oh, one other tip: Since I’m using this during the day, I like to keep it with me, but the jar is a bit bulky to be carrying around in my purse. I depot a little bit into one of the Sephora sample pots with the spatula and carry that with me instead.

reviews.product_name: Water Drench Hyaluronic Acid Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I’d give this 10 stars if I could! It’s definitely a new Holy Grail for me. This stuff is lightweight and absorbs SO easily without leaving any greasy/oily feeling behind, and the smallest amount goes a long way, so a jar will last for ages. My skin looks and feels plump, soft, and hydrated. I even use this stuff on my lips! There’s no noticeable scent (or even taste), and it really does pack a lot of moisture in. The results last for a couple of days as promised, so if I forget to apply it a time or two, my skin doesn’t suffer for it. This is one of my top 2 favourite moisturizers ever, and I’m a skincare junkie. I will definitely repurchase this.

reviews.product_name: Vitamin Enriched Face Base Priming Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: This primer feels nice on the skin, sinks in well, and has a lovely scent to it. I don’t usually like perfume-y products, but it’s a light scent of peonies and citrus (to me) and is actually nice. I tried the primer both on its own and under makeup. Alone it provided a layer of extra softness to my skin, but I wouldn’t use it as a moisturizer since I didn’t find it very hydrating. Under makeup it provided a good base for my makeup and everything went on with a nice, smooth finish. I didn’t notice any particular difference in length of wear (my makeup already usually lasts as long as I need it to), but I did notice that the makeup came off more cleanly and thoroughly when I removed it in the evening. I have dry skin and usually have makeup clinging to some dry patches at the end of the day, but I was pleasantly surprised to find that my skin had not been dried out with this product. I would definitely recommend it as a primer for dry skin.

reviews.product_name: Protini Polypeptide Firming Refillable Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I have nothing bad to say about this product! The packaging is great, air-tight and the pump ensures you aren’t contaminating the product with your fingers. It is a lightweight, hydrating formula and makes your skin feel awesome. I love the benefits of the peptides.

reviews.product_name: Beste No. 9 Jelly Cleanser
reviews.review_text: This is a great water-based cleanser. I use it in the morning and evening as a 2nd cleanse after an oil-based cleanser. It leaves my skin feeling clean and does not dry it out. I can’t give it 5 stars because it is pricey for a basic cleanser and it does not remove make-up well on its own as it claims. It is still my favourite water-based cleanser and I will probably re-purchase it.

reviews.product_name: Virgin Marula Luxury Face Oil
reviews.review_title: Great addition to your DE routine
reviews.review_text: I love this. Pricey? Yes. But this is a cold-pressed oil, ethically sourced, and the packaging is lovely so I don’t mind spending the extra $. I mix this in with the Protini moisturizer at night and it gives my skin an extra boost of moisture. I definitely look more glowy in the morning, but it is by no means greasy. This does not clog my pores or cause me to break out and I have combo skin. Love this!

reviews.product_name: Green Clean Makeup Removing Cleansing Balm
reviews.review_text: This balm does the job and I will continue to use it! Only 4 stars because the fragrance is quite strong and it has plastic in the ingredients.

reviews.product_name: Green Clean Makeup Meltaway Cleansing Balm Limited Edition Jumbo
reviews.review_text: This balm does the job and I will continue to use it! Only 4 stars because the fragrance is quite strong and it has plastic in the ingredients.

reviews.product_name: T.L.C. Sukari Babyfacial AHA + BHA Mask
reviews.review_text: Okay. This Sukari Babyfacial does sting on my skin. However, I realize it does its job. After using this product, my skin feels like baby as the name of this product suggested. I only use it once a week although I’m pretty used to facials and skincare. This contains high percentage of AHA and BHA so if you are not used to exfoliating, I recommend you to use other exfoliating products that contain less AHA and BHA then use this product later.

reviews.product_name: Facial Treatment Essence (Pitera Essence)
reviews.review_text: This essence is a must item for my skincare routine. I love using this essence with cotton pads after applying toner. I see changes on my skin after using this essence. I highly recommend this product when you are mid 20s to 30s.

reviews.product_name: Mini Facial Treatment Essence (Pitera Essence)
reviews.review_text: This essence is a must item for my skincare routine. I love using this essence with cotton pads after applying toner. I see changes on my skin after using this essence. I highly recommend this product when you are mid 20s to 30s.

reviews.product_name: Lotus Anti-Aging Night Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: First of all, it smells like peach so I love it! This is pretty cheap compared to other night cream but it does its job as well. I recently fell in love with this product!

reviews.product_name: Watermelon Pink Juice Oil-Free Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I personally love everything with fruits. Glow Recipe is known for using different fruits in their skincare products, such as watermelon, avocado, blueberry, and pineapple. This is my 4th bottle of Watermelon pink juice and I’m loving it so far. I only use this for a morning skincare moisturizer before wearing a makeup since it can be too light for the night time skincare. I have a combination skin (little more towards oily skin) so it doesn’t dehydrate my skin. You might feel little dry if you have really dry skin though.

reviews.product_name: C-Rush Vitamin C Gel Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I was GIDDY to try this product because I’ve been looking for something with vitamin c for a while now and this did not disappoint. I love the scent, the amount of product you get in a full size bottle, and lightweight feeling after using it! It makes my skin incredibly soft. I struggle with dryness around my chin and mouth but this was moisturizing enough to leave me flake free! I use it morning and night and I’ve noticed the scars on my face have started to fade! It really does brighten your skin up and leaves it feeling so healthy. Only downside is that when used alone it feels a little oily afterwards but not enough to make me uncomfortable, just enough to notice. It layers perfectly under my daily makeup! I received this product free for testing but all opinions are my own. Thanks influenster and ole henriksen!

reviews.product_name: Banana Bright 15% Vitamin C Serum
reviews.review_text: This is a great vitamin c product. I did notice a difference after 7 days in my skin tone and dark spots. Even after getting additional blemishes, which typically scar on me, the vitamin c serum helped reduce the scaring and darkness. My only issue is that it does feel sticky on your skin after applying. Pro tip: make sure you use sunscreen after applying! It will save your skin from any oxidation and damage from the sun! The serum consistency is night and light and has a great scent that makes it pleasant to use. For once, the bottle is accurately sized for the price! This is a great choice if you want to add vitamin c into your routine!

reviews.review_text: I’ve been so interested in trying this brand and I’m glad I got the chance! I found that you do need more than you might with other brands to get the effect you want. It does exfoliate well but not quite as much as others I’ve tried. The scent is very natural and pleasant too! Very easy to use for an at home facial!

reviews.review_text: While this product performed well, the scent was a little too bizarre for my liking. All in all, it’s a decent product, but for my skin type I’d probably stick to my normal moisturizer. I received this product complimentary for the purpose of testing.

reviews.product_name: Benefiance Wrinkle Smoothing Eye Cream
reviews.review_text: I was not prepared to love this cream as much as I do! First off, the packaging is awesome. It feels sturdy and luxurious. Next, the scent is just amazing. It’s so fresh! But the most important point is IT WORKS SO WELL! I’ve been using this twice a day for just over a week now and I can’t believe the difference in the fine lines around my under eye it has made. Seriously, I’m hooked!

reviews.product_name: The Dewy Serum Resurfacing and Plumping Treatment
reviews.review_text: My skin has been so dry this winter and this serum has been my saving grace! I cant believe how hydrated, plump, and subtle my skin has been in the short time I’ve been using this. This is definitely going to be a lasting step in my skincare routine!

reviews.product_name: Virgin Marula Luxury Face Oil
reviews.review_text: I’m not someone who likes oils, but I heard good things about this so I got the 100 point perk when it was available. I didn’t break out from it though, so that’s a good thing. I don’t think this is worth the hype being DE. Buy something else in the line over this if you’re not into oils like me.

reviews.product_name: Good Genes All-In-One AHA Lactic Acid Treatment
reviews.review_text: This is the ONE skincare product that I see a difference with immediately. My skin is smooth, soft and amazing the morning after I use this at night. reviews.product_name: Banana Bright 15% Vitamin C Serum
reviews.review_text: My skin loves vitamin c. I got this serum to replace the Bareminerals one I can’t get anymore. I tried the Banana Bright eye cream, but this is so much better. This isn’t sticky and it sinks in fairly quickly. It also doesn’t seem to react with any of my other skin care.

reviews.product_name: Glycolic Acid 7% Exfoliating Toning Solution
reviews.review_text: This works! I just started struggling with hormonal acne and I wanted to try a glycolic acid to see if it would help. This is a ton of product for such a good price.

reviews.review_text: This toner reminds me of Listerine in that when you feel it burning you know it’s working! Now, that being said, it does not burn when applied. I think my direct quote to a coworker was “I just tried this toner and my face is buzzing,” which I totally love by the way.  It reminds me of the Ole Lemon Strip Flash Peel which I loved back in the day, but in a much easier to use toner form. I definitely felt a tightening of the pores and smoother skin after using this product, as well as a brightening of my dark spots. My skin can lean on the sensitive side, and when I first started using this my skin was initially very irritated, but after using it once or twice a week to build up my tolerance I have had only good results from it. If you are sensitive I would recommend building up your tolerance by using it a couple times a week to start, and pair it with a calming and hydrating moisturizer such as Ole’s Nurture Me.

reviews.review_text: I was super excited to try this product because I absolutely LOVE everything else in the range, however, this did not live up to my expectations. While this cleansing balm DID break down all my makeup (including long-wearing mascara), it was near impossible to remove completely without a wash cloth. When I added water, it did not work up into a milky texture like I am accustomed to experiencing with other cleansers like this. While I wasn’t too thriled with balm itself, the bamboo boost that comes with it is great gentle exfoliation. Hopefully they sell it on its own in the future.

It did not rinse off as easily as other cleansing balms I have tried and I had to go in with a washcloth to get rid of the oily film that was left behind. Not the worst one I have tried, also not the best. If you don’t mind going in with a washcloth, this is a decent option. Solid 3!

reviews.review_title: Time to de-stress skin, perfect daily moisturizer!
reviews.review_text: What a wonderful moisturizer! I love the Lancôme Hydra Zen Anti-Stress Glow Liquid Moisturizer, not only does it provide my sensitive skin with gentle, all day hydration but it also protects my skin from daily environmental influence such as dirty air and the sun that can both cause dehydration and dull skin tone. With Hydra Zen I can trust that my skin stays well hydrated throughout the day and it also adds a beautiful, natural looking glow to my skin. Added aloe vera and rose extract are soothing the skin, while hyaluronic and amino acids aid in renewing the skin’s surface barrier and evening out the skin tone over time for a healthy, glowing, perfect look. Great lotion for day and night use, I highly recommend this product! A must have.

reviews.product_name: Crème de la Mer Moisturizer
reviews.review_title: AMAZING! The best hydration for facial skin!
reviews.review_text: I love this Creme De La Mer, which I received a sample of, gifted by La Mer. This Creme De La Mer is amazing and holds the secret to well hydrated, supple and healthy skin that glows! This cream is ultra moisturizing with its skin loving ingredients, such as natural sea kelp, and relieves dryness after the first use. A little bit definitely goes a long way with this Creme De La Mer, simply make sure to follow usage instructions and warm up the cream between your finger tips, you will know when it is ready to apply when it turns from white and thick to a smooth and translucent texture and color. Once applied to the skin I love how it makes my skin instantly appear dewy and more even looking. Even though this is a thicker consistency, which you will feel upon applying it, it will only stay that way for about ten to twenty minutes, and then it will have completely absorbed into the skin and there’s no greasy or heavy residue left behind. This luxurious cream hydrated my dry facial and neck skin back to healthy, I love it! You should definitely give it a try, excellent quality and worth it! I highly recommend it!

reviews.review_title: The best gentle exfoliant I’ve ever tried!
reviews.review_text: Dermalogica gifted me these Dermalogica Microfoliant sample packets to try complimentary in return for my honest opinion. Dermalogica Microfoliant comes in powder form and is activated by water, turning it into a gentle foamy and creamy paste that exfoliates the skin and reveals brighter smoother skin with the help of Papain Enzymes and Salicylic Acid that help get rid of excess oil, clear clogged pores and make skin feel smooth and soft. Phytic Acid, derived from rice bran, helps balance the skin tone naturally and colloidal oatmeal calms any redness and irritation, for a visibly brighter and overall more even, healthier appearance. This exfoliant is gentle enough for daily use and it left my skin feeling soft and refreshed. It’s a wonderful product, I really enjoyed using it and I would definitely recommend it!

reviews.product_name: CC+ Cream Oil-Free Matte with SPF 40
reviews.review_title: Review from someone who purchased this
reviews.review_text: I did not receive this free.  I bought it with the kit of skin care products.  I’m very oily with only a few dry areas around my mouth.  I can’t use the original CC cream as it unfortunately causes me to break out.  This does not.  It’s quite thick and I get the best application with a sponge or very dense foundation brush (specifically the Tarte Airbuki brush).  I apply this sparingly for light coverage all over, then build up to medium coverage where I need it.  When I first apply it, there does appear to be some cakiness in my dry areas, but it resolves over about half an hour.  I do set it with powder.  Once applied, I don’t have any trouble with this foundation.  It doesn’t break up or oxidize on me.  I do get more “glowy“ as the day goes on, but I don’t become an oil slick for many hours.  While I do wish it was a little bit thinner formula to apply, I overall find this to be a great foundation for me and my oily skin.  As we’re all different though, getting a sample before purchasing it is probably wise.

reviews.review_text: To begin, I would like to disclose this product was gifted complimentary from La Mer in exchange for a review. I do not think this moisturizer is worth the money since their are so many other good moisturizers on the market for less than 60% of the price. However if you have the funds it does feel nice and does leave you moisturized. I do wish this was more affordable for everyone to try. It is dewy and lays very well under makeup.

reviews.review_text: The was gifted to me by Biossance, I absolutely love the brand and this eye cream is no exception. It makes my eyes feel so hydrated and makes me feel fresh. It almost has a luminous look , I can’t speak for long term use age but I am very hopeful for this eye cream!o

reviews.product_name: Mini Daily Microfoliant Exfoliator
reviews.review_text: I tried this product gifted by Dermalogica Sampling all for a few days and can say that it is a little difficult to work with because it is a powder but once you get used to it it is a nice thing to add to the routine I feel like it gives me slight exfoliation and cleansing without stripping my skin

reviews.product_name: Daily Microfoliant Exfoliator

reviews.product_name: CC+ Cream Oil-Free Matte with SPF 40
reviews.review_text: Wow! I am so upset that it took me so long to try this product. This CC cream has the full coverage of a foundation but is so lightweight. I have oily/combo skin, and it wears well and stays matte all day.

reviews.product_name: Ultimate Sun Protector Lotion SPF 50+ Sunscreen
reviews.review_text: I love that this sunscreen has a slight tint, however be sure to shake it up A TON before opening the cap as it is quite oily. I do like that it is moisturizing unlike many sunscreens. The smell is nice, but I can see where some would find it overpowering.

reviews.product_name: Clear Sunscreen Stick SPF 50+
reviews.review_text: I really like this stick sunscreen! The texture is lightweight and absorbs well. Not greasy at all, but I might be hesitant to use it on my face since I have very oily skin. It’s great to keep in your bag for when you’re in a pinch. The application is smooth and the scent is subtle.

reviews.product_name: Protini Polypeptide Firming Refillable Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: Seriously, this stuff is like angle wings in a jar. It makes your skin so soft and not oily at all. It removes fine lines and gives you a healthy glow, no matter what mood you be in. Highly recommend.

reviews.product_name: Lotus Anti- Aging Daily Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: Honestly, best moisturizer I’ve ever tried. I love it so much. It isn’t oily, but has the perfect amount of absorption. My skin is so smooth and my fine lines disappeared after a few uses. I used to be obsessed with the Drunk Elephant moisturizers and honestly so glad I got this instead. Way cheaper and way better results!

reviews.product_name: Plum Plump Hyaluronic Acid Serum
reviews.review_text: So I bought this after I researched the ingredients and made sure it was fungal acne safe. And good news, it is! Not only does it not make me break out and itch, it also makes my skin look incredibly dewy and has smoothed over my fine lines! I love this product so much! I think any product that makes you put away your makeup because you are looking fine without it is a thumbs up product for me.

reviews.product_name: Checks and Balances Frothy Face Wash
reviews.review_text: My gateway into higher end cleansers—I love the way this cleanser feels.  It is non-drying but really feels like a deep clean.  It gets so frothy, which means I can use a very small amount to get my entire face clean.  Therefore, it takes forever for me to use up the entire product, so I don’t feel like I am wasting my money.

reviews.product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C
reviews.review_text: It really is great.  It feels moisturizing when you put it on, and when you wake up your lips are still not dried out.  Ever since using this I feel like my lipstick looks better on my lips (used to often look crusty).  It’s a huuuge container too, so it will take a long time to go through.

reviews.product_name: Caffeine 5% + EGCG Depuffing Eye Serum
reviews.review_text: I am so glad I tried this. It absorbs right into my undereyes when I use it, feels refreshing, and doesn’t cause me irritation.  I tend to like eye products that have caffeine and/are gel based so  it makes sense I like this.  I have had dark circles my whole life and this helps keep me looking bright.  I don’t think you’ll like it if you are looking for tins of moisture/wrinkle reduction but if you just want to look awake it’s good to use for daytime.  Will repurchase.

reviews.product_name: The True Cream Moisturizing Bomb
reviews.review_text: I received a large sample of this in the Jan ‘19 Beauty Skin pack. It’s a thick cream, you only need to apply a very small bit to cover your entire face. Because of its thickness, I would only use this as a night moisturizer. I didn’t break out and my skin definitely still felt soft and supple in the morning. There’s very little fragrance so my husband used it as well for these dry winter days.

reviews.product_name: The Deep Cleanse Gentle Exfoliating Cleanser
reviews.review_text: I absolutely love the gentle exfoliation this gel provides. The fruit extract is just textured enough to feel but not so rough that it will hurt the skin, even with everyday use. Daily exfoliant washes would normally leave my skin a little sensitive and oily, but this formula makes my skin feel both clean and hydrated, even after repeated use. My only complaint would be the ease of getting the product out towards the end of the bottle- the bottle is a little too sturdy to get the full product out.

reviews.product_name: Mini Deep Cleanse Gentle Exfoliating Cleanser
reviews.review_text: I absolutely love the gentle exfoliation this gel provides. The fruit extract is just textured enough to feel but not so rough that it will hurt the skin, even with everyday use. reviews.product_name: Lemonade Smoothing Scrub
reviews.review_text: Absolutely love the small, it’s exactly like fresh, sugar-sweetened lemons. The exfoliation gets the job done without being too harsh. I actually pace myself on when to use it because it smells so good but I want it to last. Only reason it’s not 5 stars is that you get such a small amount for the price.

reviews.product_name: Daily Greens Oil-Free Gel Moisturizer with Moringa and Papaya
reviews.review_text: I received this product complimentary from Farmacy Beauty.  It is light and proves to be an excellent option for my combination skin.  The perk of it all is that it is not oily like other moisturizers.  It leaves my skin soft and supple.  I highly recommend!!

reviews.product_name: Volcanic AHA Pore Clearing Clay Mask
reviews.review_text: I received this product complimentary from innisfree.  I was not a regular user of clay masks but I am now!!!  I have used this twice a week since I received the product and I can see the difference in not only my larger pores but also my skin is less oily.  It makes my skin feel refreshed and felt wonderful.  I highly recommend!!

reviews.product_name: Skin Perfecting 2% BHA Liquid Exfoliant
reviews.review_text: This is an excellent product that gives quick results.  I had several large pores that it has cleared up and has left my skin much softer and more clear.  I use it nightly before bedtime with great results.  I definitely recommend this product!  I received this Skin Perfecting 2% BHA Liquid Exfoliant complimentary from Paula’s Choice.

reviews.product_name: Oil-Absorbing Pore Treatment Strips
reviews.review_text: Great easy product to use! I used this at night slept with it on and in the morning you really do noticed smaller pores, cleaner skin and you see all the build up oils, white and blackheads that it removes! It’s super easy to use and I think the price point is also good. I would definitely recommend!

reviews.product_name: GENIUS Sleeping Collagen Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I’ve been testing this out for 5 nights now and pairing it with the Genius Liquid Collagen and my skin is moisturized, plump, radiant and extremely soft!! Use it overnight for best results and rinse off in the morning. The ingredients and benefits from this is incredible! I would recommend for any skin type and specially for more mature skin as well. I received this as a complimentary gift for the purpose of an honest review.

reviews.product_name: Tea Elixir Niacinamide & Hyaluronic Acid Anti-Aging Serum
reviews.review_text: This product is one of a kind! It smooths texture, gives you glow, hydrates and plumps your skin! I apply day and night to my face and neck and the next morning the results are overnight! The scent is very mild and natural it doesn’t irritate the skin. A MUST HAVE!

reviews.product_name: The Water Cream Oil-Free Pore Minimizing Moisturizer
reviews.review_title: Try it Before you Judge it!
reviews.review_text: I absolutely LOVE LOVE Tatchas water cream! Works SO well at hydrating my oily skin WITHOUT causing breakouts!! I know people are saying if you need hydration “just drink water”! For people like me that are on a daily fluid restriction this works AMAZING!!! A TINY pea size covers my entire face, neck and décolletage! So you are DEFINITELY getting your monies worth here!! I only use at night for fear I MAY look too dewy during the day, I prefer a matte look, but I still highly recommend to all my loves out there with oily/acne prone skin!! It’s AMAZING!! So worth it! Will repurchase!

reviews.product_name: Protini Polypeptide Firming Refillable Moisturizer
reviews.review_title: I didnt want to love it
reviews.review_text: I am a huge DE addict. To the point- I make US trips to pick up my babyfacials. I started encountering dry skin and needed a moisturizer. I purchased this because of DEs reputation but was hoping it was meh so I can just return it. (I didnt need ANOTHER DE addiction). It was revolutionary when it came to moisturizing my skin. I have mixed skin (oily in most places with areas of dryness around my nose/chin) and I always have moisturizers either make my whole face look shiny (over moisturizes) or if it was a great formula for my oily skin - not moisturizing enough (tatcha!). This is the perfect for BOTH my skin types. I can control the moisture by either pumping more or less. I never knew I would be the person to be rambling about a moisturizer- but this is it. I use about 2 pumps a day and it has lasted me about a year.

reviews.product_name: The Water Cream Oil-Free Pore Minimizing Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I have purchased the trial size of this two times over the past 2 years I usually take it on my tropical holidays and love it. I finally decided to splurge and get the full size during the sale. I have mixed skin, usually oily skin with areas around my nose/chin that dry up. I have no idea why but this product did not work for me in my everyday life. I’ve had it for about 1.5 weeks and I am using SO MUCH PRODUCT to get the moisture my face needs. This is almost a $100 product, I shouldn’t have to use 2-3 scoops for my 2 patches of dry skin to be moisturized and by the time I was back from work- MY FACE WOULD BE DRY AGAIN! It smells heavenly but I couldn’t justify the amount of moisturizer I was using daily. At that rate, this container would be done in 2 months with daily use. My usual moisturizer- DE protini is wicked and moisturizes my skin in an instant and it lasts me about 6-8 months.

reviews.product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C
reviews.review_text: I’ve been using this product since 2017. I ordered my first bottle straight from Laneige (it literally came with all text in Korean lol) so happy Sephora started selling it because it was missions to get! My hubs loves it, my mom loves it, my friends love it, everyone who needed a lip balm has tried it and has been hooked. If you’re okay with the gloss- it can be used in the daytime as well. I use this as a lip balm and whenever my lips need intense moisture. I now keep one in the car, coffee table, night table and at my desk at work. My hubs will never admit it but he cant live without it either... and his lips are moisturized too. Before I started sharing this product it lasted me about a year. Sharing with my hubs- a bottle will last about 6months.

reviews.product_name: B-Hydra Intensive Hydration Serum with Hyaluronic Acid
reviews.review_text: I want to start off by just saying- this is not a moisturizer. Its a serum for hydrating. Different things.I initially purchased this in 2017 and was like frig what a crap moisturizer. Whats all the hype?! I didn’t return it because I am super intimidated returning expensive products (at the time, I was young and silly). THEN I purchased the DE protini and one summer morning was like “wait a second why dont I use half a pump of this serum with the protini“ and thats when I took the time to research what the purpose of a serum is etc. because young and silly me had no idea. I now alternate between this product and my DE Framboos serum at night to maintain my skins moisture. I wake up to super refreshed hydrated face and usually “top it“ with my protini. If you want to get this as a moisturizer- dont. You will not be satisfied. It’s purpose is to COMPLIMENT your moisturizer. It helps your skin absorb whatever moisturizer you DO put on. I also want to add its not a necessity in my routine. I ran out of it and didn’t replace it for 4 months. But I ended up getting a new one in the spring sale because it does help my skin absorb moisture and its a must for me in the summer months since I like to use less moisturizer.

reviews.product_name: C.E.O. 15% Vitamin C Brightening Serum
reviews.review_text: I got this as part of the Sephora Travel bag and was so excited to give it a try! While it did lighten my acne scars and give me an awesome glow, I broke out all over my face which was a huge bummer. Still giving it four stars though because despite the breakout, it was very effective.

reviews.review_text: Good for just a touch of coverage when you don’t want to use foundation! Used the whole jar.

reviews.review_text: This is the best facial self tanner I have ever tried- and I am a self proclaimed self tanner addict... My favorite thing about this is that I can add it to my normal moisturizer and work it into my skin care routine without skipping any steps. Highly recommend.

reviews.product_name: Aqua Bomb Overnight Lip Mask
reviews.review_text: I love this overnight lip mask! There isn’t a night that I go to bed without putting this on first. It hydrated so we’ll that I never have to use a lip scrub — which I love! 10/10 would recommend!

reviews.product_name: Urban Environment Oil-Free Sunscreen Broad-Spectrum SPF 42
reviews.review_text: Love this product! Perfect on my skin, light and isn’t too oily! I can’t wait to wear this on my face and body all summer long! 10/10 recommend!

reviews.product_name: Urban Environment Fresh-Moisture Sunscreen Broad-Spectrum SPF 42
reviews.review_text: Love this product! I have super sensitive skin and I always break out to different sunscreen no matter how clean or great they are my skin hates them — but not this! I love the fragrance and the feel of it on my skin! Plus my face doesn’t break out. I can’t wait to use this all summer long!

reviews.review_text: I m using this since 4 months and love it.. I helps in reducing the visibility of my pores and keep the oil control on my face.. though it doesn’t made my pores go away but helped a lot…

reviews.product_name: C-Rush Vitamin C Gel Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: Best moisturiser ever.. I have really oily skin but I doesn’t effect that.. it is light weight and helps me in hydrating..

reviews.product_name: Watermelon Glow Niacinamide Dew Drops
reviews.review_text: Great to use before makeup.. I just mix few drops in my foundation and tAAaaaaaaaadaaaaaaa my foundation blends easily with out any hastle.

reviews.product_name: Hydra Zen Gel-Cream Oil-Free Moisturizer with Salicylic Acid
reviews.review_text: This product is absolutely phenomenal. I have pretty normal skin but in the summer months when I’m busy soaking up the sun my face tends to get a little more dry. I’ve been using this product consecutively for around 2 weeks and i can feel and see a difference. My face has a glow, my makeup goes on more smooth, and my dry spots have vanished. The smell is absolutely wonderful, not over powering, and the texture is creamy but has a cooling effect when applied. I love the fact my skin doesn’t feel sticky after i apply the product and dries extremely fast. I have been a faithful user of Lancôme products for years so when i received this product Complementary for testing purposes i was over the moon. This will continue to be a part of my beauty routine for years to come.

reviews.product_name: Tonique Confort Re-Hydrating Comforting Toner with Acacia Honey
reviews.review_text: I’ve used a lot of different toners over the year. The main issue i run into is that they dry my skin out a lot of times. The Lancôme Toner is amazing in the fact it tones and hydrates.  You can physically feel the difference it makes when used constantly. I will use this toner for years to come. I’m so thankful i was chosen to test this out complimentary.

reviews.product_name: Powerful-Strength Dark Circle Reducing Vitamin C Eye Serum
reviews.review_title: Tired mom eyes to life again.
reviews.review_text: Let me start by saying that over all this is a great product. I’ve used this product everyday for two and half weeks and I really noticed a difference in the puffiness and dark circles under my eyes. I went from tired toddler mom to looking like I had life in my eyes once again. You don’t need much. Just a tiny squeeze of product because it’s thick and it a little goes a long way. It has a nice smell that isn’t over powering which I love in a face product. I didn’t notice a dramatic change in a week like it claims which is why I gave it 4 star instead of 5 but I did start seeing real results by two weeks and even more noticeable results after two and a half. I would definitely recommend this product.

reviews.product_name: Midnight Recovery Concentrate Moisturizing Face Oil
reviews.review_text: I love the smell!! It smells like pure lavender oil and it’s great to use before bed! The scent soothes you down and let’s you become tired. But it’s great to use whenever as well! Daytime or nighttime! Loved this product!!!!

reviews.product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C
reviews.review_text: I have very dry lips, and nothing has worked for me so I decided to try this. I read sooooo many reviews of how soft people’s lips were the next morning so I thought this would work wonders. I’ve been using it for little more than a week and have seen no difference. I don’t know if it’s making them worse, especially since I use lip balm, oil, and scrub every day and night, and I don’t see how those 3 things can’t make my lips soft. I love the smell, and my lips feel soft after I apply it, but the next morning is like I never put anything on my lips.

reviews.product_name: Salicylic Acid Acne Healing Dots
reviews.review_text: Ok. I know these don’t make a pimple go away, just make it better. Worked pretty good on my smaller pimple, reduces the little redness it had and brought it down a little. But on my bigger pimple, it did almost nothing, it’s almost just as red, didn’t bring it down. Not very impressed since in the picture they made it look like these things worked wonders! The acne in the pictures were much worse than mine and it says they were left on for 6 hours. I left mine on all night! I don’t really understand. What I will say is that they are very discreet. They’re almost my exact skin color so I feel like I could go out of the house in them. But I still don’t reccomend.

reviews.review_text: My new fave moisturizer! Nice creamy gel formula, nice and light not heavy. Made my skin super soft and moisturized. Also, a little. it goes a long way!

But that’s my only complaint.

reviews.product_name: Mini Deep Cleanse Gentle Exfoliating Cleanser
reviews.review_text: I can’t tell you just how lovely this feels on your skin. The tiny pieces of natural exfoliant aren’t gritty or hard on your face. Soooooooo soft and gentle. Feels like silk! Since it’s a gel like texture, its extremely soft and light, not thick and heavy like other cleansers. The bottle is a little thick, so it’s kind of hard to squeeze out. But that’s my only complaint.

reviews.product_name: Greek Yoghurt Foaming Cream Cleanser
reviews.review_text: This cleanser made my skin feel so soft and the very mild fragrance made the whole experience nice. I liked to use this in the morning before work because it was nice and gentle. For my acne prone skin, I used a salicylic acid cleanser at night. Honestly, it felt like my skin was definitely clean but not stripped dry. I received this product for free for testing purposes.

reviews.product_name: Vegan Milk Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: This works great as both a night-time moisturizer and a daytime moisturizer under makeup. I’ve never had an issue with it combining with any of my other products and pilling either. I recently tried the Estée Lauder double wear foundation and without this moisturizer, it looked too dry on my super oily skin (which originally baffled me). The texture isn’t too sticky or anything, it feels like it absorbs pretty quickly. I love the packaging too! Big enough to get my long nails in for just a little bit because a little goes a long way.

reviews.product_name: C-Firma Fresh Vitamin-C Day Serum
reviews.review_text: I LOVE the idea of mixing the product to keep it fresh and it’s recyclable. It was fun to mix and easy to do. I really enjoyed putting this on in the mornings for all the hydration it provides. I definitely saw an improvement in texture and hydration. I don’t currently struggle with the firmness of my skin so I can’t speak to its effects in that aspect. The texture is pretty liquidy so I dispensed the product in my palm. After a bit it started to turn the lines in my palm slightly orange but went away when I stopped doing that. If you can afford it, I’d definitely recommend trying it, especially if you need more hydration in your routine.

reviews.product_name: Lactic Acid 10% + HA 2% Exfoliating Serum
reviews.review_text: THIS SERUM IS CRACK FOR THE SKIN!!! I have oily, combination with acne prone skin typically on my t zone and I have used this 3 times and have seen a huge difference on my skin. I alternate between this and the glycolic acid. This doesn’t sting, tingle or anything (for me), I use it as my night time routine on alternate nights. I wash my face with the YTTP cleanser, lactic acid, TO HA acid, TO alpha arbutin+HA and my TO rosehip oil. It’s only been 2 weeks and I’ve seen a remarkable difference on the texture of my skin and the amount of pimples I have. It goes on so smooth. But make sure to put on a high spf in the mornings to protect your skin. I can not recommend this enough. I will continue to repurchase this.

reviews.product_name: Superfood Antioxidant Cleanser
reviews.review_text: I don’t get the hype surrounding this cleanser. I didn’t feel clean after I used it. I felt like my skin was still dirty. I used TO glycolic toner after I washed my face, and the amount of dirt that came off after using the cleanser, pretty much confirmed it’s not for me. My African black soap does a much better job of removing impurities and dirt. It’s a pretty generic cleanser and cerave foaming cleanser in my opinion is better than this.

reviews.product_name: Mini Superfood Antioxidant Cleanser
reviews.review_text: I don’t get the hype surrounding this cleanser. I didn’t feel clean after I used it. I felt like my skin was still dirty. I used TO glycolic toner after I washed my face, and the amount of dirt that came off after using the cleanser, pretty much confirmed it’s not for me. My African black soap does a much better job of removing impurities and dirt. It’s a pretty generic cleanser and cerave foaming cleanser in my opinion is better than this.

reviews.product_name: The Water Cream Oil-Free Pore Minimizing Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I’ve been looking for a good light weight summer moisturizer and my journey ended here. I’ve tried so many moisturizers and none made my skin feel as good as this one. I had samples and when I finished it, I took the plunge and bought the full one. I have oily acne prone skin and this just makes me skin feel so moisturizer and smooth, I love it. Highly recommended.

reviews.product_name: Mini The Water Cream
reviews.review_text: I’ve been looking for a good light weight summer moisturizer and my journey ended here. I’ve tried so many moisturizers and none made my skin feel as good as this one. I had samples and when I finished it, I took the plunge and bought the full one. I have oily acne prone skin and this just makes me skin feel so moisturizer and smooth, I love it. Highly recommended.

reviews.product_name: Banana Bright 15% Vitamin C Serum
reviews.review_text: I love this!!!! I’ve been using it for a year and this combined with my daily routine has given me exceptional results. I use this an LHA cleaner +LHA toner (skinceuticals) then phloretin Cf serum +banana bright serum + tatcha water moisturizer and of course a sunscreen and I continue to get compliments on my skin everyday! Will repurchase!!! My dark spots, hyperpigmentation has improved drastically and I’ve noticed when I don’t use it, my skin looks dull.

reviews.product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C
reviews.review_text: I will try to be as blunt and honest as I can. It’s winter here in New England and the air is cold and dry and the winds can make it feel like my skin is peeling off. I wander into Sephora to find something to help my ever-chapped, peeling lips. My friends have raved to me about this lip mask, and to quote “Seriously, I’ve used this once and it gave me the softest lips ever! You have to get it!“ Okay, so I buy it, the price seems nice, especially if I want those buttery smooth lips that are promised. I’ve used it a couple of weeks now and I can honestly say I’m fairly disappointed. I half-expected this mask to make my lips as smooth as a baby’s bottom in one use. Sadly, it does not really do anything except keep my lips moist all night, the same way my other basic lip balms have done. I will use the jar until it’s gone and hey, it smells amazing, but I probably won’t buy it again. It just doesn’t seem like it’s worth $20 for results I can get from a $3 drugstore chapstick.

reviews.product_name: Greek Yoghurt Foaming Cream Cleanser
reviews.review_text: This is an amazing, gentle cleanser. I can understand why some people find the smell fairly repulsive; I was only used to it because I had a sample of the yoghurt face mask so I was expecting it. However, the soft skin and purified pores this cleanser leaves in its wake is worth the sour cream smell. I used to use Clinique oily visage formula but it didn’t seem to really DO anything (it seemed equivalent to splashing water on my face). This cleanser is, hands down, the best I’ve ever used.

reviews.product_name: AHA 30% + BHA 2% Exfoliating Peeling Solution
reviews.review_text: Wowzas, I don’t have sensitive skin but I applied this mask after gentle cleansing and it stung like a mother. It didn’t burn, per se, but it more got under the skin and made my eyes well up. After the stinging gradually subsided, I meandered around for ten minutes until washing it off and holy smokes, my skin looked incredible! Smoother, brighter, and supple to the touch. I put on rosehip oil and then aloe and when I woke up the next morning, the glow was even more radiant. Magic in a bottle. Just make sure you don’t have super sensitive skin or open acne flares because you might pass out from the pain.

reviews.product_name: Skinlongevity Long Life Herb Anti-Aging Face Serum
reviews.review_text: I got this as a free sample but I’m only 20 so I don’t use anti-aging products and handed it off to my mother. She is 60, Korean, and happy to try it out to give her honest opinion (she never lies). After a month, she said it absorbed quickly to her face and neck and left a nice dewy appearance. On the other hand, she said she would probably try to find an equally effective product on the cheaper side before actually buying it.

reviews.product_name: Superberry Hydrate + Glow Dream Night Mask with Vitamin C
reviews.review_text: This is the first product I’ve tried from Youth to the People. Put it on before bed, woke up in the morning and my boyfriend said I was glowing. So yeah I’d say it works and the title is accurate. I was nervous to try because I have oily acne prone skin, especially break out prone with plant extracts, but I had no problems with this. It’s perfect for the extra hydration I need in the winter. Also want to add I bought this with my own money.

reviews.product_name: Mini Superberry Hydrate + Glow Dream Mask
reviews.review_text: This is the first product I’ve tried from Youth to the People. Put it on before bed, woke up in the morning and my boyfriend said I was glowing. So yeah I’d say it works and the title is accurate. I was nervous to try because I have oily acne prone skin, especially break out prone with plant extracts, but I had no problems with this. It’s perfect for the extra hydration I need in the winter. Also want to add I bought this with my own money.

reviews.product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C
reviews.review_text: So many great reviews this really doesn’t need another one. It’s amazing. Just wanted to add that all I got was the small free sample container 5 or 6 months ago and that free sample has lasted my boyfriend and me using this almost daily sometimes multiple times per day. I’m probably only halfway through. The biggest plus is it has gotten my boyfriend away from using that really gross smelling / tasting Carmax lip stuff. Boys and girls alike can benefit from this. And if your boyfriends are chapstick addicts who would never think to step into Sephora for a lip product, definitely get this for them because it’ll change their life.

reviews.product_name: Cream Skin Toner & Moisturizer
reviews.review_title: A review for my oily skinned guys and gals
reviews.review_text: This has thousands of great reviews, but I still wanted to leave one from someone with super oily skin since it is marketed towards dry skin. So many products say “for all skin types” but this is the one product I have tried and truly believe it is a miracle for all skin types. I love this toner. I thought as it got warmer I wouldn’t be repurchasing, but after a few days I realized I needed her back in my life. It’s the heaviest toner I have ever used, but it is still a toner. So it’s really nourishing yet lightweight making it perfect for all skin types. Even with my oily skin, I still do not use this as just a moisturizer most of the time. If I’m in a rush or super tired and just want to go to bed without doing a whole skincare routine I will just use this after washing my face. But for daily use I use a lighter toner with a cotton pad to get any gunk off my face washing may have missed, then dump some of the Laneige cream skin in my hands and pat on my face. Then I follow up with any serums and a lightweight moisturizer. Since I use this after a lighter toner, you’d think it’s not needed. Which is what I thought too. But without it I notice a huge difference in my skin. Props to the formulators for this one. Sometimes in the winter my skin gets dehydrated and this is perfect to layer up and feel nourished instead of layering up with a heavier moisturizer that will just make me greasy. Also I can have really sensitive skin and this never made me break out. I will repurchase again and again. If you haven’t tried it, please do.

reviews.product_name: Cicapair Tiger Grass Serum
reviews.review_text: The redness on my cheeks have reduced a little after three weeks use. I am hoping to achieve better results as time goes on! This product is easy to use and very functional.

reviews.product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C
reviews.review_text: Keeps my lips feeling smooth all day and all night.

reviews.product_name: Cleansing & Exfoliating Wipes
reviews.review_text: These wipes are magical. Leave my skin feeling so smooth!

reviews.product_name: The Essence Skincare Boosting Treatment
reviews.review_title: If only there was a better applicator
reviews.review_text: I’m not sure exactly how much this helps on its own, as I’ve used it in conjunction with the violet serum every day, but it does appear to help the absorbtion of my eye cream. It’s non-irritating, calming and smooth. I took a star off because application is extremely difficult. You pour it into your hand (it has literally the texture of water), and then you have to try to smooth it on your face - as it all runs through your fingers and over the sides of your palms. I’ve sorted that I basically have to be bent completely over at a 90 degree angle and press quickly into the skin, then spread a bit from there... difficult but, can be done. I like the feel, and that it’s neither greasy nor dry and absorbs well into the skin. I received this complimentary from influenster, but I will buy again in conjunction with the serum once I’m out.
