reviews.product_name: Violet-C Brightening Serum 20% Vitamin C + 10% AHA
reviews.review_text: I received this in a VoxBox, and that being said, will be purchasing this once it runs out. I have had an ongoing struggle with my skin pretty much my entire adult life - if it’s not one thing it’s another. Either I’m breaking out, or too oily, or have dry patches. Dark spots. You name it, I’ve had one or all of the issues at some point. This is the only thing I’ve used where my skin looks good enough when I wake up to go makeup-free. I’ve tried all the products, Sunday Riley, Ole Henrickson, Dior, the list is endless. This is the only one that’s made my skin clear, even, and neither too oily nor dry in any way. I’m a huge, huge fan. The smell is light and pleasant, and fades almost immediately. The only thing I have trouble with is how watery the serum is, once you pump into your hand you run the risk of it dripping right between your fingers. I’ve never encountered that with a serum before, but as long as it works I’ll figure out how to get it on my face. I received this product complimentary for review purposes.

reviews.product_name: U.F.O. Salicylic Acid BHA Acne Treatment Face Oil
reviews.review_text: I keep trying other products for some reason and they never do anything for me, then I’ll go back to this and every time I’m like, “WHY DID I STOP?????” I have oily skin that breaks apart my makeup on my t-zone typically within 2 hours. I’m talking, to combat this, I have to do a: moisturize, two matte primer application, double wear foundation, matte setting powder, matte setting spray, system. My skin is a tough one. I suffer from hormonal breakouts, large & congested pores on my nose and scarring from the pimples I couldn’t stop myself from popping. I also occasionally get breakouts on my chest, hormonal & also sometimes from not being able to shower soon enough after the gym (that dang “lets grab dinner!” After the gym gets me every time). I have practiced the exfoliating, masks, moisturizing, etc, routines I’m supposed to. And yet I will break out, get ultra oily, have giant honkin pores, have ultra pigmented areas of my face. I say all this to tell you this is the ONLLYYYYYYYYYYYYYYY product that has made any noticeable change to my skin. After a few days of use I stop breaking out entirely (even small pimples, and any residual ones shrink and disappear), discoloration fades and becomes even, pores shrink, and I notice my nose is less oily over the day. My makeup lays better the next morning. My chest clears up entirely. It’s literally a GD miracle and yet I consistently get used to it, take it for granted and try something new and shiny. I always come back. The smell kinda sucks but I’ve really smelled way worse. It does take some time to dry down into your skin. I don’t imagine this could be the first step in anyone’s makeup routine but before bed it’s awesome. If your skin is remotely like mine you really need to give this stuff a go. I use four drops total for my face, neck and chest all together. Lasts forever.

reviews.product_name: Volcanic AHA Pore Clearing Clay Mask
reviews.review_text: The Pore Clearing clay mask 2X with Super Volcanic clusters makes my face feel so soft to the touch after each use, it don’t make your face dried or or oily after using it, it helps to cool on contact, absorbs excess oil with visibly smaller pores, all while helping to improve the overall look texture of skin,this product is a complimentary from

reviews.product_name: Mini Daily Microfoliant Exfoliator
reviews.review_text: The dermalogica samples I really love use these on my skin it makes it soft and glowing and it’s easy to use it’s a powder and add a little water to it and rub it in your skin, I never used such an amazing product before, I was gifted  by Dermalogica Sampling

reviews.product_name: Daily Microfoliant Exfoliator

reviews.product_name: Retinol Eye Stick
reviews.review_text: The Peace Out retinol eye product from Sephora helps so much around my eyes especially with bags under my eyes and leaves your skin feeling soft, I love using this product it’s a very trusted brand to use and I definitely recommend it to others to try

reviews.product_name: The Dewy Skin Cream Plumping & Hydrating Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: So I received this lovely gem from makeupbymario when I attended the masterclass. I was soo speechless on the wonders this cream did for my skin. It made it look youthful, controlled my oils and it’s soo cooling which is great for skin! I love this!

reviews.product_name: Clear Improvement Pore Clearing Moisturizer with Salicylic Acid
reviews.review_title: Huge Pores.. NEVER heard of her!
reviews.review_text: This moisturizer feels so silky and smooth when apply to the face and a few days later my pores have been minimized! I’ve never been happier with a moisturizer until I found this lovely gem. This was complementary from Influenster!

reviews.product_name: Skinlongevity Long Life Herb Anti-Aging Face Serum
reviews.review_text: I received this product free for testing purposes. After a few weeks of testing out this product, I can honestly see a difference in my skin. It helps control my oil and leaves my skin a natural glowing finish. I never thought I would see the day where my skin would be glowing and not oily.

reviews.product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C
reviews.review_text: awesome lip mask! one of my favs along with the bite beauty agave mask. I literally won’t go without this

reviews.product_name: Dreamskin Skin Perfector
reviews.review_text: To cut to the chase this product is BOMB! Let’s start with the claims of blurring imperfections and fine lines both immediately and over time.. Check! It definitely does work immediately and I’ve only been using for 5 days but my skin is soooo soft when I use this. It also claims to illuminate the skin and it does that beautifully, like not too highlighted all over the face but more like a gorgeous, subtle glow from within.I love that it is refillable, at least the 50 ml bottle is, so that makes it a touch more affordable. Dior is a premium name and you definitely get a premium product. I’ll have to see more of the long term effects before deciding if I will repurchase but this far I’m in love. Makeup also applies beautifully over this. It’s almost like a primer and treatment in one. Overall it’s a splurge but well worth it if you decide to purchase.

reviews.product_name: Advanced Night Repair Eye Concentrate Matrix Synchronized Multi-Recovery Complex
reviews.review_title: An eye product that ACTUALLY WORKS
reviews.review_text: I have terrible dark circles and after a couple weeks of using this I see a noticeable difference in my eye area. I’m always skeptical of eye serums that claim to reduce fine lines, puffiness, and/or darkness but this serum showed me you can get results. I see reduced darkness, more hydration and less fine lines. I really enjoy this product and I will definitely repurchase. If you buy I recommend using the wand, it’s so gentle and it seems I use less that way since none is absorbed into my fingers. If you look at my photos the first shows my dark circles the first time using it and the second photo with the stripe shirt is only 10 days of using it. Much less darkness (still dark though) and like I said more hydrated with less fine lines.

reviews.product_name: The Water Cream Oil-Free Pore Minimizing Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: My favorite moisturizer ever!!! I’ve used this for a few years now and my skin has never been better. I love that my skin feels moisturized and dewy but not greasy. It’s a little pricey but definitely worth it!

reviews.product_name: Mini The Water Cream
reviews.review_text: My favorite moisturizer ever!!! I’ve used this for a few years now and my skin has never been better. I love that my skin feels moisturized and dewy but not greasy. It’s a little pricey but definitely worth it!

reviews.product_name: The Camellia Oil 2-in-1 Makeup Remover & Cleanser
reviews.review_text: I have used this cleanser for a few years now and absolutely love it. It has given me the best skin I’ve ever had. I love how it feels on my face. It really makes my face feel clean while not drying it out or making it feel oily. I remember it was somewhat odd at first to not wet my face first but I got used to it quickly. This also is great at removing makeup. I never need to wipe my face first or wash twice because my makeup held on. All in all I love this cleanser.

reviews.product_name: Violet-C Brightening Serum 20% Vitamin C + 10% AHA
reviews.review_text: I have suffered with acne scars and dark spots for many years. This product was the first to really lighten these spots. It has made my skin look better than it ever has! I saw instant results. I even notice whenever I do get a zit, this fades the mark quicker.

reviews.product_name: T.L.C. Framboos Glycolic Resurfacing Night Serum
reviews.review_text: I LOVE this product! I have oily, acne prone, slightly sensitive skin. This has definitely make my skin less oily and cleared up a lot of my clogged pores. AND I feel like my pores are visibly smaller. I would definitely continue to use this and keep seeing better results as it’s only been a few weeks of using. It has no scent and glides on like a dream, sinking right into my skin. Love love love.

reviews.product_name: Beste No. 9 Jelly Cleanser
reviews.review_text: I really like this cleanser! I have oily, acne prone, somewhat sensitive skin. I had no problems with this breaking me out or causing a reaction. I use it only in the morning to remove my nighttime clay acne cleanser. I like how my skin feels after, very clean. I also like the texture of the cleanser

reviews.product_name: Lala Retro Whipped Refillable Moisturizer with Ceramides
reviews.review_text: Pretty decent moisturizer. I have oily, acne prone skin so I use this sparingly. After an at home peel or microdermabrasion or if my skin is feeling/looking a little dry I will use this at night. Doesn’t feel heavy or greasy, soaks right in. Not a huge fan of the press down dispensing application though.

reviews.product_name: Lippe Balm
reviews.review_text: This was just eh for me. I really love Drunk Elephant products but I probably wouldnt buy this for myself. It’s nice for day use but I need a heavier product for nighttime as I wear liquid lips everyday and need something super hydrating. But when I’m just running to the gym or on no makeup days I do pop this on.

reviews.product_name: C-Tango Vitamin C Eye Cream
reviews.review_text: Love this eye cream! I’m 35 and just starting to use eye creams. This soaks right in and isn’t greasy. It’s got a nice cream texture and no smell. I need to use it for a few more months to really see any long term results but so far so good! I would definitely buy this product for myself and continue to use it!

reviews.product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C
reviews.review_text: I like it! I put this at night then wake up with soft and smooth lips! Lovely!

reviews.product_name: Protini Polypeptide Firming Refillable Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I’ve been using drunk elephant products for 3 yrs already and noticed a big difference in my skin. This made my face smooth to touch!

reviews.product_name: Crème de la Mer Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: This is my moisturizer to rescue my super dry skin days! It’s so good but so expensive. I just tried it but not going to be my routine moisturizer due to its price.

reviews.product_name: Mini Crème de la Mer Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: This is my moisturizer to rescue my super dry skin days! It’s so good but so expensive. I just tried it but not going to be my routine moisturizer due to its price.

reviews.product_name: Ultimate Sun Protector Lotion SPF 50+ Sunscreen
reviews.review_text: Highly recommend this for people with skin! This goes on so nicely, no white residue. I love this sunscreen for the beach or river or biking or whatever I take it everywhere with me. It’s wonderful coverage and I just think it’s perfect for covering your tattoos and want them to stay bright!

reviews.product_name: Clear Sunscreen Stick SPF 50+
reviews.review_text: In love! This is the best, easiest to use sunscreen ever. This is a 100! No scent which I love. Its goes on perfect for full coverage and in Florida it’s all about outside activities and you need sunscreen year round. Love how easy this is to just keep in your bag for ease of use.

reviews.product_name: Santorini Grape Poreless Skin Cream
reviews.review_text: This cream is light. But seems to really do what it says it will. I like how it makes my pores appear smaller. It feels nice under makeup and doesn’t get too heavy but it’s moisturizing enough to be good for my older skin

reviews.product_name: Auto Correct Brightening + Depuffing Eye Cream for Dark Circles
reviews.review_text: I love Sunday Riley products and this eye cream does not disappoint.

reviews.product_name: ICE Ceramide Moisturizer with Vitamin F

reviews.product_name: Powerful-Strength Dark Circle Reducing Vitamin C Eye Serum

reviews.product_name: Auto Correct Brightening + Depuffing Eye Cream for Dark Circles
reviews.review_text: The Sunday Riley auto correct brightening and depuffing eye contour cream works great! It reduced the look off puffiness under my eyes and made them appear lest tired. They made my eyes look more vibrant and beautiful.  I really enjoy this product and think the packaging is great. It comes in an easy pump bottle. The bottle is a great long lasting size. Would recommend this product.

reviews.product_name: ICE Ceramide Moisturizer with Vitamin F
reviews.review_text: The Sunday Riley ICE ceramide moisturizing cream works great!  It has a nice thickness and texture too it without feeling too heavy. My skin absorbed the moisture right away leaving my face feeling nice and smooth.  The jar is a very generous long lasting size. There is a slight scent too it that is not my favorite but it is not bad. I would recommend this product.

reviews.product_name: Ginzing Vitamin C Eye Cream to Brighten and Depuff
reviews.review_text: The ginzing vitamin c eye cream works great. It goes on really nice and feels refreshing.  It helps to brighten and depuff my eyes. I have been happy using this product.

reviews.product_name: Natural Moisturizing Factors + HA
reviews.review_text: This is another product I bought after seeing YouTubers talk about how awesome it was and that’s re correct. This moisturizer is great and I will definitely buy again.

reviews.product_name: 100% Organic Cold-Pressed Rose Hip Seed Oil
reviews.review_text: I started using in my skincare routine after starting trentinon and was experiencing dryness. This is amazing and has helped my skin to handle trentinon better.

reviews.product_name: Mini Skin Perfecting 2% BHA Liquid Exfoliant
reviews.review_text: I started using this product after seeing YouTubers talking about it. I’ve only being using it for a week and my face has cleared up so much. I have oily, acne prone skin and this is a huge must in my skincare line.

reviews.review_text: this stuff is really amazing! I have repurchased this product because it is so effective at removing makeup. reviews.product_name: PHAT Glow Facial Mask
reviews.review_text: This mask is really great! I’ve used it a few times since receiving it and I really feel as though it made my skin softer, more supple and more radiant. It also helped me with some texture I was experiencing after having traveled a lot over the past few weeks! Initially the mask was tingling my face, but it’s really nothing bothersome. I also really love the scent! It’s not too strong and really pleasant. I’m happy to have a mask that acts as a chemical exfoliant as I am no longer using physical exfoliators! I’m excited to continue using this product and seeing what it does for my skin. Disclaimer: I received this product for free for testing purposes.

reviews.product_name: Hyaluronic Acid 2% + B5 Hydrating Serum
reviews.review_text: This is such a great serum! It does an amazing job at moisturizing my combo skin, especially given the fact that we are now in the winter months and my skin can get dry! I only need a few drops for this serum to be effective, which is amazing! And for the price, this product truly can’t be beat. This product doesn’t leave my skin feeling sticky or oily. It sinks into the skin well enough for me to layer my moisturizer on top after.

reviews.product_name: Smart Clinical Repair Wrinkle Correcting Eye Cream
reviews.review_text: I received this #freeproduct from #trywithtopbox in exchange for my honest review.  I’m usually interested in trying different eye creams and was glad to receive this one.  At the moment, I do not have wrinkles around my eyes, so it’s hard to say if the little sachet I received was helpful; but I do love clinique products in general.  The eye cream did go on smoothly, absorbed fast, and left my eye area feeling more hydrated.

reviews.product_name: Smart Clinical Repair Wrinkle Correcting Cream
reviews.review_title: love how it makes my skin feel
reviews.review_text: I’m at the age now where wrinkles are becoming a concern, so I was glad to receive a #freeproduct from #trywithtopbox.  This cream goes on smooth, has a light scent that is not overpowering.  It absorbs fast into my skin leaving it feeling moisturized.  However, due to it being a small sample size, after finishing it, I was still not able to see any definitive results.  I love clinique products and would love to continue trying it to see if there are any notable changes in my skin.

reviews.product_name: Smart Clinical Repair Wrinkle Correcting Serum
reviews.review_text: I am now experimenting with different serums for wrinkles and was happy to try the #freeproduct with #trywithtopbox.  Although it was only a small sachet, it did go on smooth and left my skin feeling soft and hydrated.  I don’t have wrinkles at the moment, but am looking to prevent it.  I’ve always loved clinique products, so I’m sure with long-term use, it would help!

reviews.product_name: Skinlongevity Long Life Herb Anti-Aging Face Serum
reviews.review_text: I’ve been using it for a few days and notice smoother and softer skin. I received this product from Influenster for testing purposes. I love it, smells really good, it’s soft and my face looks glowing!

reviews.product_name: Ultimate Sun Protector Lotion SPF 50+ Sunscreen
reviews.review_text: Love this! I really feel protected when I use it and it leaves my skin with a perfect finish and a great texture. Definitely you better try this

reviews.product_name: Clear Sunscreen Stick SPF 50+
reviews.review_text: I love texture! It make my skin looks radiant when I used, it’s just perfect to carry out any time

reviews.product_name: Niacinamide 10% + Zinc 1% Oil Control Serum
reviews.review_text: I’m on my second bottle of this serum, along with using a face wash and a moisturizer, my skin has cleared up so quickly! Definitely so glad I added this to my skin care routine! My skin is quite oily and I break out quick, but using this regularly I very rarely get any break outs anymore! And you can’t beat the price!

reviews.product_name: AHA 30% + BHA 2% Exfoliating Peeling Solution
reviews.review_text: This is a GREAT aha bha mask! It does sting a little while using but nothing unbearable. But it is SO worth it! After using my skin feels so refreshed and smooth! And it gets dead skin off and helps clear up break outs! I only use about once every 5-7 days, so it doesn’t over strip or dry my skin. Love this mask and it’s a great price because one bottle lasts a good while!

reviews.product_name: Salicylic Acid Acne + Pore Cleanser
reviews.review_text: Really helps clear up skin! One of the strongest Salicylic Acid cleansers I’ve seen that doesn’t have harmful drying alcohols or fragrances in it! Plus it’s low priced and one bottle lasts a good while. It doesn’t sting when using, but you can feel the clean difference of your skin after using. Definitely a great cleanser to have in your skin care routine!

reviews.product_name: Superfood Antioxidant Cleanser
reviews.review_text: I love this soap. It is very mild and doesn’t dry my skin out but you can still feel the clean. I dropped off one star because the soap slowly leaks out of the pump and leaves a bit of a mess on my countertop, but that’s my only complaint.

reviews.product_name: Mini Superfood Antioxidant Cleanser
reviews.review_text: I love this soap. It is very mild and doesn’t dry my skin out but you can still feel the clean. I dropped off one star because the soap slowly leaks out of the pump and leaves a bit of a mess on my countertop, but that’s my only complaint.

reviews.product_name: Midnight Recovery Concentrate Moisturizing Face Oil
reviews.review_text: I love this serum. I got it as a sample and knew after my first use I would buy the full size. It makes my skin feel so soft and reduces the appearance of fine lines after application. Consistent use has helped my skin so much. A+++!

reviews.product_name: Midnight Recovery Concentrate Moisturizing Face Oil
reviews.review_text: I love this serum. I got it as a sample and knew after my first use I would buy the full size. It makes my skin feel so soft and reduces the appearance of fine lines after application. Consistent use has helped my skin so much. A+++!

reviews.product_name: Cleansing & Exfoliating Wipes
reviews.review_text: I cannot believe I spent so many years spending so much money on other exfoliating wipes. These are amazing. The bamboo is very intense so if you’re not used to strong exfoliation maybe try another one. The wipes are pretty large so I cut mine in half making these even more economical.

reviews.product_name: Greek Yoghurt Foaming Cream Cleanser
reviews.review_text: I got a travel size through influencer for free. This product smells amazing, feels luxurious and cleanses really well. I would highly recommend it!!

reviews.product_name: C-Firma Fresh Vitamin-C Day Serum
reviews.review_text: This is a cool product. I love the freshness of it and got smooth and even my face looks because of this product. It looks brighter after I use it as well. I make sure I wear spf when I use it though otherwise the spots come right back and it doesn’t work the same. I also used to have the old serum that was already mixed and this one is way cooler.

reviews.product_name: Aqua Bomb Overnight Lip Mask
reviews.review_text: I was gifted this lip mask from influenster in exchange for my honest review. I do like this lip mask a lot, however, I get really dry lips in the winter and this isn’t doing enough for me. I wish it exfoliated the dry lips more.

reviews.product_name: Aqua Bomb Cleansing Balm
reviews.review_text: This is a really great make up remover I always double cleanse so trying this one out was nice. It doesn’t irritate or sting my eyes which is always a plus and washes off nice no residue behind. I was gifted this product as a ample to try from Influenster. I would def repurchase when I run out. Only 4 stars because I prefer things from a pump

reviews.product_name: Aqua Bomb Overnight Lip Mask
reviews.review_text: I received this product complimentary for my honest review of this product. The first thing I will start with this is a very thick Vaseline type product but it give your lips the most plump shiny finish. I use this not only at night but first thing in the morning after I was my face and prep my lips for lipstick and it’s amazing at softening them. When I use this before bed I find my lips to be more hydrated and zero dryness I think this will be great for going into the winter months. I prefer this over the lip butter from laneige. I will def repurchase when I’m out.

reviews.product_name: The True Cream Moisturizing Bomb
reviews.review_text: This is a great cream for night time and the Aqua bomb is great for daytime. This one is too rich for me to wear during the day. It absorbs well and I always wake up with the softest skin. I only got to use it for a week before my sample ran out but I will purchase it after I finish up my other moisturizer. I was gifted this from Influenster for my honest review.

reviews.product_name: The Rice Wash Skin-Softening Cleanser
reviews.review_text: I received this product from Trendmood box. I fell in love with it after first use. It cleanses so well and leaves my very soft and it is not drying at all. The smell is very soothing. I will recommend it to all skin types.

reviews.product_name: Mini Rice Wash Skin-Softening Cleanser
reviews.review_text: I received this product from Trendmood box. I fell in love with it after first use. It cleanses so well and leaves my very soft and it is not drying at all. The smell is very soothing. I will recommend it to all skin types.

reviews.product_name: Luminous Dewy Skin Mist
reviews.review_text: I received this product from Trendmood box. It is very moisturizing and leaves my skin luminous. And a little goes a long way. But I don’t like its smell.

reviews.product_name: The Serum Stick: Treatment & Touch Up Balm
reviews.review_text: I received this product from Trendmood box. I love the packaging. It is like a cute lipstick. But you can use it under eye. I am oily combination. The formula is too thick and oily for me.

reviews.product_name: The Silk Peony Melting Eye Cream
reviews.review_text: I have been using Tatcha The Silk Peony for a couple weeks now. I use it in the morning and at night and lightly dab under my eye as well as my eyelid and I can honestly say that I have seen a difference. I am in the sun a lot and this cream is extremely moisturizing and I have noticed my fine lines are appearing smoother. A few of my coworkers have noticed as well and asked what I have been doing. The cream seems to go a long way. I have been using it a few weeks and it barely looks like I have used any. Although this product was sent to me complimentary I was no asked to give a positive review, just an honest review and this is my honest review. I would recommend this product for anyone that is looking for extra moisture and to smooth fine lines.

reviews.product_name: GOOPGLOW Microderm Instant Glow Exfoliator
reviews.review_text: I have been using the GOOPGLOE Microderm Instant Glow Exfoliator for a couple weeks now. I use it in the shower a few times a week after I’ve washed my face. I personally think it is a great exfoliator. It is not too harsh on my sensitive skin but it feels strong enough to get rid of all of the dead skin. I am left with super smooth, glowing skin. I especially love using this after I’ve taken off my make up because it really deep cleans.

reviews.product_name: Mini GOOPGLOW Microderm Instant Glow Exfoliator
reviews.review_text: I have been using the GOOPGLOE Microderm Instant Glow Exfoliator for a couple weeks now. I use it in the shower a few times a week after I’ve washed my face. I personally think it is a great exfoliator. It is not too harsh on my sensitive skin but it feels strong enough to get rid of all of the dead skin. I am left with super smooth, glowing skin. I especially love using this after I’ve taken off my make up because it really deep cleans.

reviews.product_name: The True Cream Aqua Bomb
reviews.review_text: I honestly love the belif true cream aqua bomb. My skin gets very dry and this is like a miracle worker for dry skin. I use it in the morning and night after cleansing and it leaves my skin soft and hydrated. It is very lightweight and does not deal greasy. It has a mild scent which I appreciate and the consistency is perfect. Not too thin and not to thick. Definitely my favorite moisturizer!

reviews.product_name: Urban Environment Oil-Free Sunscreen Broad-Spectrum SPF 42
reviews.review_text: Really loved how this felt on my skin, although it does have a bit of a “sunscreen” scent. Overall it worked well under my makeup and didn’t leave my skin feeling oily at all.

reviews.product_name: Urban Environment Fresh-Moisture Sunscreen Broad-Spectrum SPF 42
reviews.review_text: Really loved how this felt on my skin. Overall it worked well under my makeup and didn’t leave my skin feeling oily at all.  I would definitely recommend this sunscreen.

reviews.product_name: Smart Clinical Repair Wrinkle Correcting Cream
reviews.review_text: Love how smooth my skin feels after using this product. A little goes a long way!

reviews.product_name: Vitamin Enriched Face Base Priming Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I received this product through Influenster for free for testing purposes. I’ve always enjoyed Bobbi Brown’s makeup, but had never really tried skincare. This was definitely a good product, but I don’t think I’ll make it part of my everyday skincare routine. I have very oily skin and was concerned that it might be too greasy for me, but it really wasn’t! My only complaint was that it didn’t help my skin stay matte for the entire day under my makeup, which is what I really look for in a moisturizer and primer.

reviews.product_name: The True Cream Moisturizing Bomb
reviews.review_text: As someone with oily skin, I’m usually skeptical about heavy moisturizing products, but this is great! I usually opt to use it as a night product, and my skin is always super soft after I wash my face the next morning!

reviews.product_name: Banana Bright 15% Vitamin C Serum
reviews.review_text: I received this for free testing purposes, and I love it! I had already used the Banana Bright eye cream, so I was really excited to try this out. It’s nice and light, smells amazing and I could really see and feel a difference in my skin. I’ll definitely be purchasing once I run out!

reviews.product_name: AHA 30% + BHA 2% Exfoliating Peeling Solution
reviews.review_text: Oh the burn! Not like it burns you but you will FEEL this working. Amazing results, soft and just new feeling skin in 10 mins. Totally worth feeling like you have bees stinging your face

reviews.product_name: Soy Hydrating Gentle Face Cleanser
reviews.review_title: You better like the smell of cucumber
reviews.review_text: I do like the way this product feels. I think it cleanses beautifully and doesnt strip the skin. However, the cucumber smell is almost overwhelming. If that’s not a deal breaker for you this stuff is great. Dont expect any slip or bubbles. It really is just a gel. You spread it on and wipe it around and rinse. It’s not milky or foamy at all.

reviews.product_name: Cold Plunge Pore Mask
reviews.review_text: If you have oily skin that tends to be inflamed, THIS. It is so cooling and calming and sucks all the extra gunk out and makes your skin feel so clean. Big big fan. I have also tried the moisturizer from this line and it is great for oily skin especially under makeup as well, these products are just very well done.

reviews.product_name: Glowscreen Sunscreen SPF 40 PA+++ with Hyaluronic Acid + Niacinamide
reviews.review_text: I received a sample of this product and it is gorgeous. the tint gives your face this healthy glow but it’s not greasy and wears so smooth under makeup. definitely buying full size.

reviews.product_name: Mini Glowscreen Sunscreen SPF 40 PA+++ with Hyaluronic Acid + Niacinamide
reviews.review_text: I received a sample of this product and it is gorgeous. the tint gives your face this healthy glow but it’s not greasy and wears so smooth under makeup. definitely buying full size.

reviews.product_name: Vinoperfect Radiance Dark Spot Serum Vitamin C Alternative
reviews.review_text: This serum was a miracle for my skin. I never took care of my skin in my teen years or even in my early 20s. I had uneven skin tone and acne spots that left me feeling awful about my skin. I started seeing results within two months and it kept progressing. Three years later, I still use this serum and it’s the only one that I have used. After consistent use, my skin has seen dramatic differences. Complexion is brighter, even skin tone, and the acne spots are gone. People have asked me what foundation I use and you know what I tell them? I’m not wearing foundation. It’s that amazing. Highly recommend this!

reviews.product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C
reviews.review_text: I honestly love this stuff so much. I apply it every night before I go to bed and I wake up to super moisturized lips. To really test it out, I stopped using it for about a week and once I applied it after the hiatus, there was a big difference in the morning.

reviews.product_name: Lip Glowy Balm
reviews.review_text: Really like this balm. Keeps my lips hydrated. I use this during the day in combination with the lip mask at night and it’s really made a difference for me. I do find myself reapplying it a few times during the day, but I don’t find that to be a big deal. Price point I think is fair. Smells great, consistency is perfect for a day time. I can’t complain about this product

reviews.product_name: Ultimate Sun Protector Lotion SPF 50+ Sunscreen
reviews.review_text: The scent is really pleasant for sunscreen. Although other sunscreens have a chemical smell, this product makes me feel like putting on sunscreen is more of a positive experience. The only thing troubling about this is the consistency: it’s quite liquidy, but with enough patience and careful rubbing in, the sunscreen application can rub into the skin successfully.

reviews.product_name: Clear Sunscreen Stick SPF 50+
reviews.review_text: Great for the on-the-go application. I love the packaging, the scent, and the feel against my skin. When you open the stick, it’s an ombre effect of blue glitter to clear. The case is like a twist deodorant stick and glides on like a gel solid deodorant base. The scent is fresh like clean linen and the texture isn’t too heavy!

reviews.product_name: Magic Cream Moisturizer with Hyaluronic Acid
reviews.review_text: I’ve been meaning to use hyaluronic acid in my daily skincare routine and this moisturizer is a happy medium! I wasn’t sure if jumping into acids for my face would be too harsh but this Magic Cream has a “magic“ formula to balance the cream moisturizer with the hyaluronic acid. Love the packaging; made me feel extra fancy putting my cream on

reviews.product_name: 100% Organic Cold-Pressed Rose Hip Seed Oil
reviews.review_text: Love this oil! No fake scent, it’s the real deal for rise hip oil lovers.

reviews.product_name: Lip Glowy Balm
reviews.review_text: cleanest peach scent! smells like real peaches; Love THIS!!

reviews.product_name: Cleansing & Exfoliating Wipes
reviews.review_text: i used the grapefruit wipes a d they are my apres gym go to!! love these and wont leave home without them.

reviews.product_name: Take The Day Off Cleansing Balm Makeup Remover
reviews.review_text: Love!!! I was turned on to cleansing balms through Beauty Counter but couldn’t stomach paying $80/jar. This is an excellent Dupe and takes all my makeup off. I use this first to remove most of my makeup and follow up with philosophy purity cleanser. Not sure I’ll ever find another cleanser that holds a candle to this one to take off ALL my makeup; even waterproof.

reviews.product_name: Mini Take The Day Off Cleansing Balm Makeup Remover
reviews.review_text: Love!!! I was turned on to cleansing balms through Beauty Counter but couldn’t stomach paying $80/jar. This is an excellent Dupe and takes all my makeup off. I use this first to remove most of my makeup and follow up with philosophy purity cleanser. Not sure I’ll ever find another cleanser that holds a candle to this one to take off ALL my makeup; even waterproof.

reviews.product_name: T.L.C. Framboos Glycolic Resurfacing Night Serum
reviews.review_text: I have the entire Drunk Elephant line and love most of it. If you’re going to splurge, this is an absolute must have out of everything they make. I have very oily, texture ridden skin and this serum has worked miracles. Skin is very smooth now with a noticeable difference since I started using it. I’ve had my current bottle for about 2 months. This is now a staple that will remain in my skin care routine.

reviews.product_name: Moisturizing Eye Bomb with Squalane
reviews.review_text: I’m only giving this 4 stars since it hasn’t entirely resolved my dry under eyes; but I did repurchase. One of the best moisturizers I’ve used. I had just finished a jar of bye bye under eye by It Cosmetics that worked well, but I feel this provides a lot more moisture and wears really well under makeup. I wish this cream would allow me to be someone who could bake their under eye, but I don’t think any cream will ever get me there. Regardless, a fantastic product and I love the smell.

reviews.product_name: Benefiance Wrinkle Smoothing Eye Cream
reviews.review_title: A little bit goes a long way
reviews.review_text: I’ve been looking for a great eye cream, and I’m super impressed by this one. Although it’s a little pricey, a little bit of it goes a long way. I love that there’s not much of a scent to it and it keeps the skin under your eye moisturized. I’ve been using it for about a week, and although I haven’t seen any changes, like the brand claims I should see, overall I like it and would consider buying it again.

reviews.product_name: Smart Clinical Repair Wrinkle Correcting Serum
reviews.review_text: I’ve been using this serum for about two weeks. I haven’t noticed any drastic changes yet, but it does go on smoothly and soaks into the skin well. There is virtually no scent and doesn’t irritate my skin.

reviews.product_name: Confidence in a Cream Anti-Aging Hydrating Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I have really enjoyed using IT Cosmetics Confidence in a Cream. It has a very light scent, but not overwhelming and it’s the perfect texture. It’s rich and creamy but soaks in well into the skin. I would definitely recommend using. The only drawback is that I don’t believe it has SPF in it.

reviews.product_name: Soy Hydrating Gentle Face Cleanser
reviews.review_text: This soy face cleanser is just amazing. I received that by Influenster and tried on my face and is just so helpful. After you use this you’ll feel that your skin is so soft and looks so good. I highly recommend this! I received this product complimentary for review purposes.

reviews.product_name: Sugar Strawberry Exfoliating Face Wash
reviews.review_text: I just loved this exfoliating so much. When you try it on your face, you’ll see how this works so good to clean and renew your skin. Also that’s smells so delicious like strawberry’s. I highly recommend this product. I receive it by Influenster. I received this product complimentary for review purposes.

reviews.product_name: Ultimate Sun Protector Lotion SPF 50+ Sunscreen
reviews.review_text: Amazing product. It’s very easy to apply and it does not get oily while you using it. I’ve already used it for over two weeks and has been great so far. I highly recommend it.

reviews.product_name: Superfood Antioxidant Cleanser
reviews.review_text: Great cleanser! My new favorite. It smells healthy and my skin doesn’t feel stripped.

reviews.product_name: Mini Superfood Antioxidant Cleanser
reviews.review_text: Great cleanser! My new favorite. It smells healthy and my skin doesn’t feel stripped.

reviews.product_name: Daily Greens Oil-Free Gel Moisturizer with Moringa and Papaya
reviews.review_text: Great for oily skin! I’m just not a fan of papaya and the smell could be a little better in my opinion. But awesome moisturizer and worth it. My skin feels hydrated and it’s lightweight.

reviews.product_name: Retinol Reform Treatment Serum
reviews.review_text: This is the first retinol I’ve tried and it works great!. Saw an improvement in my skin. A lot smoother and I feel like it helped my acne. I gave it 4 stars because I wasn’t fond of the smell. Its supposed to be fragrance free but I smell burnt cinnamon rolls lol

reviews.product_name: Mini Retinol Reform
reviews.review_text: This is the first retinol I’ve tried and it works great!. Saw an improvement in my skin. A lot smoother and I feel like it helped my acne. I gave it 4 stars because I wasn’t fond of the smell. Its supposed to be fragrance free but I smell burnt cinnamon rolls lol

reviews.product_name: Niacinamide 10% + Zinc 1% Oil Control Serum
reviews.review_text: The price for this is definitely worth it. It goes on kind of sticky but about after an hour it was fine. I feel like after even the first use it dried up acne and they were almost gone overnight. Highly recommended.

reviews.product_name: The Water Cream Oil-Free Pore Minimizing Moisturizer
reviews.review_title: Good but not worth the hype
reviews.review_text: This is very light weight, has an earthy fresh scent. Felt like it just melted into my skin very clean. Did well with my oily skin, however $68? I just don’t think it’s worth they price or hype. I feel like there are other products that could get the job done.

reviews.product_name: Mini The Water Cream
reviews.review_title: Good but not worth the hype
reviews.review_text: This is very light weight, has an earthy fresh scent. Felt like it just melted into my skin very clean. Did well with my oily skin, however $68? I just don’t think it’s worth they price or hype. I feel like there are other products that could get the job done.

reviews.product_name: Balancing Force Oil Control Toner
reviews.review_text: This product is a life saver. I have oily skin, and this toner clears my acne and got rid of all of my oil! I was also using the matching cleanser and moisturizer but I felt like the moisturizer didn’t help with the oiliness, so I only use it on my face except in my t zone. I’ve had zero problems since! The cleanser from this line is great too. All of this is perfect for extremely sensitive skin, and I highly recommend this line for someone looking to transform oily acne prone skin!

reviews.product_name: Clear Improvement Charcoal Honey Mask to Purify and Nourish
reviews.review_text: This mask is unlike any mask I’ve tried. Usually when using charcoal masks I feel like all the moisture has been sucked from my skin, and dryer than the Mohave desert! This mask is purifying but not drying! The honey acts as a wonderful antiseptic for breakouts and blemishes. Also... it’s STUNNING! smells divine too!

reviews.product_name: Vegan Milk Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: This moisturizer is really thick but feels light weight on the skin. I love that it is vegan and feels expensive. I would love to use a whole line of Milks skincare.

reviews.product_name: Skinlongevity Long Life Herb Anti-Aging Face Serum
reviews.review_text: I think the concept of this serum is great. I don’t like overly scented face products so this was hard to like. I thought the consistency was a bit greasy too. I want to try this serum again in the drier months come winter. I did receive this product complimentary.

reviews.product_name: E-Rase Milki Micellar Water
reviews.review_text: I am obsessed with this novella water. I have sensitive skin and my skin can get irritated easily. This product removes makeup like a bit does not strip your skin. My skin feels plumped and rereleased after using this product! I wish it wasn’t so expensive, but I’m in love!

reviews.product_name: E-Rase Milki Micellar Water Mini
reviews.review_text: I am obsessed with this novella water. I have sensitive skin and my skin can get irritated easily. This product removes makeup like a bit does not strip your skin. My skin feels plumped and rereleased after using this product! I wish it wasn’t so expensive, but I’m in love!

reviews.product_name: The True Cream Aqua Bomb
reviews.review_text: I couldn’t quite get this moisturizer to work for me. I am not the biggest fan of gel moisturizers on my skin. I felt it was a bit to scented and felt a bit plasticy on my skin. Not for me.

reviews.product_name: Lippe Balm
reviews.review_text: If you are looking not only for a product that soothes and prevents chapped, dry lips but also improves the look and feel of your lips over time this is the perfect one. It feels great both when it’s on and once absorbed. My lips are noticeably smoother and more moisturized than before I started using Lippe Balm and appear more plump. It’s small enough to keep on a tiny purse and use throughout the day. No significant flavor or scent, but a light fruitiness perhaps from all the natural extracts. I got this product as part of a Drunk Elephant trial set and can say 100% this will be a lip product I am loyally dedicated to from here on out!

reviews.product_name: AHA 30% + BHA 2% Exfoliating Peeling Solution
reviews.review_text: A friend recommended this product to me with the phrase “It can literally remove a hangover from your face“ ... and boy was she right! This powerful little stuff scared me at first given how its instructions insist repeatedly that you cannot leave it on for longer than 10 min, but it really does the job. Yes it can tingle a bit at first but in a good way! I would NOT recommend using this after a scrub facewash, at the risk of overexfoliating (did it by accident once -- NOT pleasant!!) I definitely recommend only using it about twice per week as the instructions say, and making sure to deeply hydrate afterward. When I use this product, i always notice a few hours later that all of my little acne scars, sun spots, and other little hyperpigmentations are significantly lightened and my face is overall brighter within a couple of hours. I like to use this before applying self-tanner, and about an hour before applying makeup so that i am always revealing my freshest, brightest skin.

reviews.product_name: Self Tanning Bronzing Face Drops
reviews.review_text: The most natural-looking glow you will ever find in a bottle. It is so subtle (I use about 5-6 drops for arms, another 5-6 drops per leg, and another 6-8 drops for abdomen, and about 4-5 for my face). As with any tanning product, you of course need to be mindful of washing your hands thoriughly after application, and always apply in circles to avoid streaks. I used this for the first time prior to a holiday party and had multiple people ask if i had gone on vacation recently because i had a natural glow. One thing i love about this product is how good it works on my face. After applying this mixed in with my daily moisturizer, i don’t wear face makeup for days afterward because i don’t need to!! Another thing i love about his product over other tanning products I’ve used is that you are moisturizing as you do it, as opposed to other foam applications that call for your skin to be exfoliated and dry with the exception of moisturizing your knees and elbows. Particularly in the winter time, skipping the moisturizer is not preferable for me, so this is a game changer!

reviews.product_name: The Dewy Skin Cream Plumping & Hydrating Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: This cream does feel very nice and even smells nice. I have oil skin and this product doesn’t leave my face feeling greasy, however I feel I may need to try the water cream version instead. This one I learned is for dry skin. I didn’t see a huge change. I do love Tatcha products still, but this one is not for me.

reviews.product_name: The Camellia Oil 2-in-1 Makeup Remover & Cleanser
reviews.review_text: I highly recommend this product for oily skin! You need to apply it when your face is dry. I use this first then I use  a second cleanser and my face has never felt so good! I will definitely be buying more of this.

reviews.product_name: The Silk Peony Melting Eye Cream
reviews.review_text: I love Tatcha products but this one didn’t wow me like other products have. It made small improvements underneath my eyes but not a significant difference. Maybe it works differently on everyone because my mom who is in her 60’s loves it. For the price I paid I honestly did expect better results. Not everyone can afford $200 eye creams, I’m a mom of three who is just trying not to look like a zombie lol. I rather spend extra time on my skincare than makeup. This cream feels great but I wish it made a bigger difference.

reviews.product_name: The Deep Cleanse Gentle Exfoliating Cleanser
reviews.review_text: I will be buying more of this cleanser!! I love how it exfoliates but not too much/rough, my face feels great afterwards. For people with oily skin (such as myself) I would highly recommend using one step camellia cleansing oil for and then use the deep cleanse. Trust me it works! I felt a difference the very first use and I couldn’t believe it! Tatcha for another win!

reviews.product_name: Mini Deep Cleanse Gentle Exfoliating Cleanser
reviews.review_text: I will be buying more of this cleanser!! I love how it exfoliates but not too much/rough, my face feels great afterwards. For people with oily skin (such as myself) I would highly recommend using one step camellia cleansing oil for and then use the deep cleanse. Trust me it works! I felt a difference the very first use and I couldn’t believe it! Tatcha for another win!

reviews.product_name: Soy Hydrating Gentle Face Cleanser
reviews.review_text: Got it first a sample and I loved it. I didn’t purchase full size at first because I thought it was too expensive for a cleanser but I finally caved not being satisfied with anything else and I don’t regret it. It really does a great job and feels amazingly fresh. On days I wear little or no makeup the cleanser alone is enough. For a full makeup I do cleanse with oil first and then this and it works wonders in getting rid of the oil and residual makeup. I can say with confidence I will repurchase again.

reviews.product_name: C-Tango Vitamin C Eye Cream
reviews.review_title: like the product. hate the pump
reviews.review_text: Overall it’s a very good eye cream. I have fine lines under my eyes and while they’re still there the product does seem to diminish the look of them. I like the texture that’s nourishing and tightening but absorbs very well. What I don’t like is the pump system. The bottle is opaque and the pump is starting to have issues pumping the thick cream so I fear a lot will go to waste in the end and I do think it’s a shame given the small amount of product and the price tag.

reviews.product_name: 5 Stars Retinol + Niacinamide Eye Serum
reviews.review_text: I love this brand but this product will not be repurchased. I used it 2 nights in a row. Application was amazing and the product sank in beautifully. However the second day when I applied my day eye cream it burned! I decided to take a break on the product and wear my usual night cream and it burned too. My conclusion is that 5 stars has made my eye area super sensitive and I am not comfortable with that. By the way, I have used retinol eye cream before and did not have this effect.

reviews.product_name: Good Genes All-In-One AHA Lactic Acid Treatment
reviews.review_title: a must have in my routine
reviews.review_text: This is my favorite skincare product and the one I keep coming back to. I like rotation in my skincare routine but I always see a difference when I use good genes. I use it every other day at nighttime and after a few days my skin is less red, more even in texture and pigmentation and just overall more youthful looking. I understand some people are sensitive to the ingredients so I would suggest getting a sample first but if you you can tolerate it I recommended 100%

reviews.product_name: Brazilian Kiss Cupuaçu Lip Butter
reviews.review_text: This stuff is amazing!!! It smells so good and makes your lips so soft!!! I can’t go anywhere without it!

reviews.product_name: Take The Day Off Cleansing Balm Makeup Remover
reviews.review_text: Ah-mazing!  Since I started using this product to take my makeup off prior to cleansing it has changed my life!  I don’t feel like I’m scrubbing harshly to get makeup off now and my face thanks me !

reviews.product_name: Mini Take The Day Off Cleansing Balm Makeup Remover
reviews.review_text: Ah-mazing!  Since I started using this product to take my makeup off prior to cleansing it has changed my life!  I don’t feel like I’m scrubbing harshly to get makeup off now and my face thanks me !

reviews.product_name: C-Rush Vitamin C Gel Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I wanted to love this product as I used a good amount of my points to get the full size of this product.  I like the way it smells but it left my skin feeling sticky.  The product doesn’t seem to want to absorb even hours later! I would not be able to ever use this in the a.m. before applying makeup.  Maybe if it had been more of a gel it would’ve worked better.... I don’t want to waste the product so I may try to use it on my body instead.  I just really don’t like the way it makes my face feel.

reviews.product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C
reviews.review_text: I wanted to love this product but I felt like my lips were more dry and almost irritated the next morning for whatever reason. There may be an ingredient that just didn’t agree with my skin.  I ended up returning.

reviews.product_name: The Rice Polish Foaming Enzyme Powder
reviews.review_text: I love this product!  Leaves my face feeling so refreshed and clean afterwards!

reviews.product_name: Alpha Beta Extra Strength Daily Peel Pads
reviews.review_title: Makes my skin soft and smooth!
reviews.review_text: This product contains AHA, which is a chemical exfoliator. This will remove the dead skin cells and reveal smoother, more even skin. I do not use this product daily, because it can be harsh on my skin. So I use it twice a week with great results. I highly recommend this for people with hyperpigmentation, wrinkles, and flaky skin. But you need to use a good broad spectrum sunscreen when using this product.

reviews.product_name: Lotus Anti-Aging Night Moisturizer
reviews.review_title: Didn’t make my acne prone, oily skin breakout!
reviews.review_text: I have always been a fresh product fan because of the natural, earthy, tea like smell of their products. When I try this cream I was both worried and excitedSince I have to boil the acne prone skin, and this cream is really thick. My first time using it, I used a little too much, and my skin feel heavy and greasy. I was worried that I will be seeing new pimples on my face the next day. But to my surprise,, Since I have to boil the acne prone skin, and this cream is really thick. My first time using it, I used a little too much, and my skin feel heavy and greasy. I was worried that I will be seeing new pimples on my face the next day. But to my surprise, my face was smooth, hydrated, and nourished. So the next day, are used less product, and my skin felt balanced. I’m happy to say that I have found a new night cream for my acne prone, oily skin.

reviews.product_name: Lotus Anti- Aging Daily Moisturizer
reviews.review_title: A great day cream for oily skin!
reviews.review_text: Since I have acne prone, oily skin, I’m very picky about my daytime moisturizer. I normally use emulsion, which is a lighter version of a cream. So when I try this lotus cream, it did feel thicker and heavier than my normal emulsion. I was scared that this cream is too thick and will clog my pores and the fragrance will aggravate my sensitive skin – but it didn’t. My face was smooth and balanced. I like the ingredients list and how this brand tries to use natural ingredients in all of their products. My face face felt nourished and firm after a week of consecutive use. Now I know I can enjoy this cream and its amazing smell without having to worry about breakouts.

reviews.product_name: Aqua Bomb Sleeping Mask
reviews.review_text: I love the whole Belif product line and started using the eye cream first because it gives a lot of hydration without making your skin oily or feeling too heavy. The sleep mask is also like that because it gives your skin deep hydration without clogging your pores. I received a complimentary product, but my review is my honest opinion. I love this mask because it has a water/gel feel to it, but works well for all skin types. I have oily skin and thought it might make me breakout, but it didn’t at all. My skin looked really refreshed after using it and washing my face in the morning. A tip I learned is that when I put the mask in the refrigerator it gave my skin a nice cooling sensation in addition to the hydration. Overall, I highly recommend it for all skin types.

reviews.product_name: Greek Yoghurt Foaming Cream Cleanser
reviews.review_title: Cream Cleanser for All Skin Types
reviews.review_text: This Korres foaming cream cleanser surprised me in a good way. It has a lot of clean and nourishing ingredients, which I love but it also worked well on my oily skin. Normally cream cleansers don’t work with my oily and acne prone skin, but this cleanser is amazing. My skin felt soft and clean after I used it and I love how it foams nicely. Korres is a great brand so I’m not surprised that their cleanser is also wonderful. I highly recommend this product for all skin types! Please note that I received a complimentary sample of this product for testing purposes, but this is my honest review.

reviews.product_name: Smart Clinical Repair Wrinkle Correcting Eye Cream
reviews.review_text: I received a sample in exchange for my honest review. In my opinion, this eye cream wasn’t my favorite. It left a residue on my under eyes the following day after my nightly application and I didn’t feel like it absorbed well. I also don’t like that it isn’t a clean formula. It has a creamy consistency, which is nice but it didn’t remove dark circles or fine lines. Overall, it’s okay but nothing special in comparison to competitive eye creams.

reviews.product_name: Santorini Grape Poreless Skin Cream
reviews.review_text: I received a sample in exchange for my honest review of this Poreless Skin Cream. Overall, I really liked this moisturizer. It has a nice natural scent and works for my oily, acne-prone skin. The most unique benefit of this product is that it truly minimizes the look of my pores, which is fantastic! The negative is that they add fragrance to the product, which is unnecessary for skincare. Otherwise, I really liked this product!

reviews.product_name: T.L.C. Framboos Glycolic Resurfacing Night Serum
reviews.review_text: I love this serum and I especially love mixing it with the purple moisturizer cream at night like DE recommends. I love glycolic overall for my skin as it helps to neutralize my skin and reduce inflammation, among other benefits. I typically use glycolic pads in the morning and then this serum at night and it’s been the best combination, especially for someone with oily skin (and combination skin in the winter).

reviews.product_name: Lala Retro Whipped Refillable Moisturizer with Ceramides
reviews.review_title: Works exactly the way it should
reviews.review_text: This cream mixed with glycolic gel gives the perfect amount of moisture to my skin at night. I’m always left feeling clean and supple. I got this product during the winter season when my skin usually dries up and this fixed it immediately. I would definitely re-purchase.

reviews.product_name: Lippe Balm
reviews.review_text: I feel like there’s definitely better products out there for a longer lasting moisturized lip. I typically throw a little bit of vaseline on my lips in the morning and apply some chapstick later in the day. This product works the same as my usual routine so I can’t exactly justify the price but I did get it complimentary.

reviews.product_name: C-Tango Vitamin C Eye Cream
reviews.review_text: I don’t have super bad eye circles so I haven’t found a single cream that has had any sort of positive effect on my eyes. They’re all the same in terms of neutral-ness, including this one. My main problem with under eyes is the tiny bumps right under that don’t seem to go away with any product yet.

reviews.product_name: Advanced Génifique Radiance Boosting Face Serum
reviews.review_text: I received my first bottle as a gift from my mother who swears by it and I have been using it daily ever since. I have sensitive, acne prone skin and this has never irritated my skin or caused any breakouts, but rather it has made my skin smooth, hydrated and any visible pores or wrinkles have vanished. It is absolutely worth the price to me and I have had extremely noticeable results while using it.

reviews.product_name: Hydra Zen Glow Liquid Lightweight Moisturizer with Hyaluronic Acid
reviews.review_text: This product smells absolutely amazing! It melts into my skin and feels very lightweight. I have combo/oily skin and it gave me a natural glow but not oily looking. My skin has been so soft since using this. I definitely recommend.

reviews.product_name: Benefiance Wrinkle Smoothing Eye Cream
reviews.review_text: This eye cream has been working really well for me so far. I have been using it nightly for just over a week now and I really have noticed an improvement with my fine lines. My under eye lines are pretty deep, especially on one side and of course they are still visible, but they have definitely diminished some already. I also have very textured eyelids which is not great for my extremely close up photos of my detailed eye looks I do so I have been using this on my upper lids where its textured and I have really noticed the texture diminishing there which is wonderful. The cream itself feels really nice on my skin and a little goes a very long way! It is a little on the greasy side but I use it before bed so that doesn’t bother me. It is pricey but like I said, a little goes a long way so it will last awhile and it is effective so its worth it in my opinion. I would definitely and have definitely recommended this to anyone in need of a good wrinkle eye cream!

reviews.product_name: Superfood Air-Whip Lightweight Moisturizer with Hyaluronic Acid
reviews.review_text: This is the best moisturizer I have tried so far. I have pretty oily skin and this moisturizer is lightweight enough to not feel filmy or greasy on my skin, but super hydrating. It absorbs fast and leaves my skin soft. Moisturizing enough for most days, though I do like switching to something a little more dense during the winter.

reviews.product_name: The True Cream Aqua Bomb
reviews.review_title: Has alcohol, made me break out.
reviews.review_text: I really wanted to like this, I like the branding and was looking for a less expensive alternative to my YTTP air whip moisturizer, I wash my face twice a day and wanted something else to alternate it with. It smells strongly of alcohol and it made my skin get oily really fast (I have naturally oily skin), it also made me break out. I probably won’t try anything else from this brand since I didn’t like the face wash either.

reviews.product_name: Superfood Antioxidant Cleanser
reviews.review_text: I have oily skin and this is one of very few cleansers I have tried that actually removed all of the oil from my face. Jelly cleansers always leave some oil on my face and this does a great job of thoroughly cleansing without over drying my face. It has a very light, natural scent and looks cool, I do not use the pump, I refill my smaller bottles.

reviews.product_name: Mini Superfood Antioxidant Cleanser
reviews.review_text: I have oily skin and this is one of very few cleansers I have tried that actually removed all of the oil from my face. Jelly cleansers always leave some oil on my face and this does a great job of thoroughly cleansing without over drying my face. It has a very light, natural scent and looks cool, I do not use the pump, I refill my smaller bottles.

reviews.product_name: Superberry Hydrate + Glow Dream Night Mask with Vitamin C
reviews.review_text: I love this might mask! i have pretty oily skin and thought that something like his might just feel overly thick on my face, but it doesn’t. It does have a thick texture but I’ve found that if you don’t like the feeling of something sitting on your face then you can just use less and spread it out. It moisturizes and nourishes my face and makes my face feel as soft as a baby’s bum. I don’t wake up with an oily face at all and smell is AMAZING, it’s like a fruity tart scent, not floral or sweet.

reviews.product_name: Mini Superberry Hydrate + Glow Dream Mask
reviews.review_text: I love this might mask! i have pretty oily skin and thought that something like his might just feel overly thick on my face, but it doesn’t. It does have a thick texture but I’ve found that if you don’t like the feeling of something sitting on your face then you can just use less and spread it out. It moisturizes and nourishes my face and makes my face feel as soft as a baby’s bum. I don’t wake up with an oily face at all and smell is AMAZING, it’s like a fruity tart scent, not floral or sweet.

reviews.product_name: 5 Stars Retinol + Niacinamide Eye Serum
reviews.review_text: This product from Sunday Riley is actually 5 STARS!The packaging looks expensive and feels heavy on your hand, you get a great amount of product in the tube that comes in, and the tip the applicator feels cold so I used it to massage the product on my under eye area. It has one of my favorite ingredients which is niacinamide; it helps to brighten the area and it also helps with discoloration GREAT for dark circles!I will definitely keep this product on my everyday skin care routine.

reviews.product_name: Retinol Youth Renewal Serum
reviews.review_text: This serum is amazing, it moisturizes and a little goes a long way! I have been using it every night before going to bed and I’m starting to see my skin improving’ definitely 1000/10. Gifted by the brand

reviews.product_name: Mini Retinol Youth Renewal Serum
reviews.review_text: This serum is amazing, it moisturizes and a little goes a long way! I have been using it every night before going to bed and I’m starting to see my skin improving’ definitely 1000/10. Gifted by the brand

reviews.product_name: Tea Elixir Niacinamide & Hyaluronic Acid Anti-Aging Serum
reviews.review_text: Love this serum the smell is really good and hydrating on the skin I use it every day and every night It leaves my face feeling shiny and healthy. Can’t wait to see how it will look in several days

reviews.product_name: Daily Greens Oil-Free Gel Moisturizer with Moringa and Papaya
reviews.review_text: #farmacygiftedme I received this moisturizer complimentary from Farmacy! Being afraid of heavy moisturizer this one was good for my combination skin! I love how it’s oil-free and silicone-free that it is lightweight as well! I love how this moisturizer has ingredients for exfoliation and 4 different types of hyaluronic acids! I only tried it for 2 days and I must say I am impressed! I love how gorgeous the green texture of the moisture as well! Thank you so much Farmacy!

reviews.product_name: Honey Halo Ultra-Hydrating Ceramide Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I received this product complimentary from Farmacy Beauty and I love it so much, this cream is perfect for the fall to winter time. It is extremely hydrating and lightly scented as well! Overall I love it!! I love how it has ceramide in it!!

reviews.product_name: Volcanic AHA Pore Clearing Clay Mask
reviews.review_text: I received this complimentary from Innisfree volcanic clay mask and I have used this clay mask and I love how creamy it is! It gently seeps out sebum deep inside the skin. It keeps my skin nice, clean and soft!! The best thing is it doesn’t dry out my skin unlike other clay masks!

reviews.product_name: Watermelon Pink Juice Oil-Free Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I was gifted by Glow Recipe Watermelon Moisturizer and I was already a longtime fan of this wonderful moisturizer! I love how good it smells and how it keeps my skin so so hydrated plus plumped as well! Overall I will keep buying this once I run out and can we just admire the gorgeous pink packaging as well!

reviews.product_name: Watermelon Glow Niacinamide Dew Drops
reviews.review_text: I received this complimentary from Glow Recipe and first of all let’s talk about the gorgeous packaging! I love how the texture is and the scent as well! There’s like tiny specks of glitter and I love how when you apply it onto your skin it shimmers as well! It easily absorbs onto your skin easily and I love it!

reviews.product_name: Good Genes All-In-One AHA Lactic Acid Treatment
reviews.review_text: I have been using Sunday Riley good genes for the longest time already! I was so happy when I got this as a Complimentary from Sunday Riley. There lactic acid is amazing and this will be like my fifth bottle of using it! It really has changed my skin for the better.

reviews.product_name: Rose & Hyaluronic Acid Deep Hydration Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I have been a huge fan of Fresh Beauty skincare. I love how hydrating it makes my skin feel and the reformation I love it! I love anything rose scented and I’m a fan.

reviews.product_name: Honeymoon Glow AHA Resurfacing Night Serum
reviews.review_text: I have been using this Honeymoon glow for a long time and this is one of the best serums I have ever used! This just has AHA in it and it has transformed my skin for the better! This will always be a definite repurchase.

reviews.product_name: Barrier+ Triple Lipid-Peptide Face Cream
reviews.review_text: I love this moisturizer so much!! Love how you push the top and it pumps out, it’s extremely hydrating making my skin looks soft and plump. I love mixing this with retinol and it makes my skin look like wonders!

reviews.product_name: Mini Barrier+ Triple Lipid-Peptide Face Cream
reviews.review_text: I love this moisturizer so much!! Love how you push the top and it pumps out, it’s extremely hydrating making my skin looks soft and plump. I love mixing this with retinol and it makes my skin look like wonders!

reviews.product_name: 5 Stars Retinol + Niacinamide Eye Serum
reviews.review_text: I was so excited to use this serum because it contained retinoid! I love the blue packaging it’s so so cute! I noticed after 2 use my under eye looked so much brighter and less puffy! My under eye looks so smooth and hydrated as well.

reviews.product_name: Plum Plump Hyaluronic Acid Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I have been using Glow Recipe skincare for the longest time and this Hyaluronic Acid cream is the best!! I love how it’s refillable so it reduces waste and it keeps my skin so soft and moisturized for winter skin ready.

reviews.product_name: Mini Plum Plump Hyaluronic Acid Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I have been using Glow Recipe skincare for the longest time and this Hyaluronic Acid cream is the best!! I love how it’s refillable so it reduces waste and it keeps my skin so soft and moisturized for winter skin ready.

reviews.product_name: Ultimate Sun Protector Lotion SPF 50+ Sunscreen
reviews.review_text: Very good product overall. This feels good on the skin and doesnt leave a white cast. Skin does not look oily after applying this. Good thing about this is it features heatforce and wetforce which is good if youre in a warm area and sweat a lot. I consider this perfect to use on any setting: everyday use, sports, beach, as its SPF 50 (high enough)

reviews.product_name: 5 Stars Retinol + Niacinamide Eye Serum
reviews.review_text: Sunday Riley is one of my favorite brands out on the market right now. This serum was just the cherry on top for my night routine. Super lightweight but leaves your skin so soothed! Honestly loved it. Ingredients are great, retinoid % is perfect to start off with retinoids in case you have not incorporated it in your Skincare.

reviews.product_name: Vitamin Enriched Face Base Priming Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: Amazing texture. This is perfect to layer with my nighttime exfoliant. This cream restores dehydrated skin and is super good for the skin barrier. Leaves you feeling sooo nourished. Texture is rich, skin absorbs in about 2 minutes.

reviews.product_name: Floral Recovery Overnight Mask with Squalane
reviews.review_text: Great mask. The ingredients are clean and have amazing properties. This really leaves a natural glow after and super soft skin. Will keep using weekly! The smells is also very good and reminds me of a spa

reviews.product_name: Magic Cream Moisturizer with Hyaluronic Acid
reviews.review_text: Cant believe how magic this cream is. Just amazing. Makeup is on another level sitting on top of this moisturizer. Consistency is light but creamy, just different from anything else. Skin is dewy and healthy

reviews.product_name: Tea Elixir Niacinamide & Hyaluronic Acid Anti-Aging Serum
reviews.review_text: This is very fast absorbing, and non sticky which I like! Feels like a hydrating milk and could even act as a moisturizer if you have oily skin. Definitely one of the best products I’ve tried from Fresh.

reviews.product_name: Mini Daily Microfoliant Exfoliator
reviews.review_text: I received this complimentary from dermalogica sampling but have used the full size product for about 4 months and have seen good results so far. Black heads have reduced. Make sure to avoid sensitive areas. Also make sure to massage softly, the idea is to gently exfoliate not to strip off your skin. If this is done correctly then you will see your skin clear up!

reviews.product_name: Daily Microfoliant Exfoliator
reviews.review_text: I received this complimentary from dermalogica sampling but have used the full size product for about 4 months and have seen good results so far. Black heads have reduced. Make sure to avoid sensitive areas. Also make sure to massage softly, the idea is to gently exfoliate not to strip off your skin. If this is done correctly then you will see your skin clear up!

reviews.product_name: Green Clean Makeup Removing Cleansing Balm
reviews.review_text: Does a good job breaking down makeup and sunscreen. Price point is on the higher side but I do find it works well. Does not irritate my sensitive cystic acne prone skin. I have repurchased for travel.

reviews.product_name: Green Clean Makeup Meltaway Cleansing Balm Limited Edition Jumbo
reviews.review_text: Does a good job breaking down makeup and sunscreen. Price point is on the higher side but I do find it works well. Does not irritate my sensitive cystic acne prone skin. I have repurchased for travel.

reviews.product_name: Take The Day Off Cleansing Balm Makeup Remover
reviews.review_text: Does the job. No issues with break outs with my sensitive acne prone skin. Definitely needs a second cleanse with a gentle cleanser. I have others I prefer a bit more but this one would work in a pinch.

reviews.product_name: Mini Take The Day Off Cleansing Balm Makeup Remover
reviews.review_text: Does the job. No issues with break outs with my sensitive acne prone skin. Definitely needs a second cleanse with a gentle cleanser. I have others I prefer a bit more but this one would work in a pinch.

reviews.product_name: Hyaluronic Acid 2% + B5 Hydrating Serum
reviews.review_text: I prefer the other hydration serums in this line. This can pill up with other products when layering.

reviews.product_name: 100% Organic Cold-Pressed Rose Hip Seed Oil
reviews.review_text: Heavier oil, great for winter time. Be careful if you have sensitive skin, it can cause break outs. Can go rancid much like other oils, so I do like that it’s in a smaller sized bottle.

reviews.product_name: Multi-Peptide + HA Serum
reviews.review_text: Good beginner product. I found it added to the over all skin health and look of hydration. If you are sensitive or acne prone, be careful as there is a bit of castor oil in this product.

reviews.product_name: Vitamin C Suspension 23% + HA Spheres 2%
reviews.review_text: Not beginner friendly. You need to ease into the one since it is quite strong. Oily and slightly gritty texture. Does not mix well with layering. But works very well as a Vitamin C product.

reviews.product_name: Mini Virgin Marula LuxuryFace Oil
reviews.review_text: Really enjoy this marula oil, it’s light and absorbs well. The price point is high but I do find a difference for myself when comparing this product to other marula oils. I have purchased this multiple times. It’s great for spring and fall when you need a lighter oil.

reviews.product_name: Protini Polypeptide Firming Refillable Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I use a lot for peptide based skincare products in my repertoire and thoroughly enjoy having various forms in my routine. I’m on the fence about how well this worked. I would say I liked this product as a basic moisturizer but for the price point, I wished it packed more of a punch related to it’s claims. I don’t know that I noticed a significant amount of improvement in my skin.

reviews.product_name: Sugar Advanced Lip Balm Intense Hydration Treatment
reviews.review_text: I have bought this multiple times. Works well but I don’t have overly dry lips. I would say maybe not as effective for places where you have harsher winters. I prefer Bite Agave Lip Mask for those purposes. Wish the price point wasn’t so high.

reviews.product_name: B-Hydra Intensive Hydration Serum with Hyaluronic Acid

reviews.product_name: Mini GOOPGLOW Microderm Instant Glow Exfoliator
reviews.review_text: Good gifted me this wonderful exfoliator in exchange for my honest review. I love this product! I use tons of different chemical exfoliators (i.e. the Sukari Babyfacial, Phat Facial, The Ordinary AHA/BHA peel, etc. for reference) and I don’t usually use physical exfoliants because I’m satisfied with just the chemical ones. This product uses both chemical and physical exfoliants and reveals smooth, soft, and brighter skin immediately after using it! I think the combination of chemical and physical exfoliants does such an amazing job at revealing fresh skin. My skin is softer than ever and I leave this on for about 3 minutes before rinsing—so it’s super quick to use too! The product is packaged in a small jar (a little goes a long way) and it’s pretty basic packaging, I can’t complain. My hyperpigmentation from acne blemishes has significantly faded from using this product just a couple times—I can’t wait to see long term results! Also, make sure to wear sunscreen after using this product so you don’t harm your freshly exposed skin cells! I try and use a foundation with SPF in it because my skin looks so gorgeous under makeup after I use this (I’m a huge makeup-wearer but skin looks awesome after this without makeup too). My skin texture looks way better each time I use this. This product is amazing and I honestly think anyone with dryness, texture, lines, pores, hyperpigmentation or someone just wanting to try exfoliating would love this. Warning though: once you start you won’t want to stop! It’s just that good! Price is high but you can get a free sample at Sephora before buying this and you’ll see immediate results after one use—I promise the product will do the convincing!
