reviews.product_name: C-Tango Vitamin C Eye Cream
reviews.review_text: This eye cream is super gentle and effective! I decided to get a Vitamin-C eye cream because I have some hyperpigmentation scars around my orbital bone from over-plucking my eyebrows and I wanted to try and fade them with something gentle/safe enough for the eye area. I had a sample of this from my Drunk Elephant “The Littles” set and I was immediately impressed. It’s a cream, so it’s more hydrating than gel eye creams. It sits nicely under makeup too. It’s super nourishing and I noticed the hydration made me look more awake within a few days of use. My scars have definitely faded too! I also love how this product has a pump applicator instead of having to use your finger to scoop it from a jar—pumps keep the product more sanitary! I don’t have many fine lines around my eyes so I’m not sure how well it targets those. The lines I have under my eyes when I smile haven’t gotten worse and this cream fills them enough so that when I do my makeup you can barely see them. Because this fixed the hyperpigmentation from my eyebrow-plucking scars, I think it would definitely be effective for anyone with any sort of darkness/hyperpigmentation around their eye area. It is a bit pricey, but a little goes a long way—I use a pea sized amount AM & PM and split it, using half for each eye. I don’t have much to compare it to, but I like it a lot more than Tatcha Silk Peony, Saturday Skin Wide Awake, and a tiny bit better than the Fresh Black Tea Anti-Aging Eye Cream (which is also amazing but I don’t love that it comes in a jar). I definitely recommend trying this out! Because the price is a little steep, I’d recommend trying a free sample from Sephora or trying out The Littles kit if you’re hesitant about purchasing it. I also love that it’s fragrance-free and has clean ingredients! Drunk Elephant has some great products and this is one of my favorites from them. I definitely recommend trying this out if you’re in the market for a brightening and hydrating eye cream!

reviews.product_name: The Rice Wash Skin-Softening Cleanser
reviews.review_title: Not the worst, not the best
reviews.review_text: I’m giving this cleanser 3 stars because it’s decent, but not my favorite cleanser. The fragrance is very overpowering. I love the signature Tatcha fragrance in their other products, but in this it smells too much like chemicals and it’s extremely strong. The fragrance/cleanser didn’t break me out at all though, so that’s a plus! I have normal skin and this cleanser is made for normal and dry skin, however, this cleanser makes my skin feel dry. I’m not sure if it would be better for oily skin either since oily skin still needs hydration. I do like the slight graininess in the texture and I like the consistency. It feels like a thick cream and it feels nice when it’s on your skin (the dryness occurs after it’s washed off). It also does a good job of removing dirt and oil from the skin. 3/5 stars because it’s better than some cleansers, but I prefer my Fresh Soy Face Cleanser because it’s a lot less stripping and performs similarly. I will continue to use this up because it honestly is decent! It has other good reviews and I LOVE other Tatcha products, so I definitely suggest trying this out if you’re hesitant because it may work for you better than it works for me :) I’ve been using it for about 2 weeks and haven’t noticed skin brightening yet, but that typically takes about 6-8 weeks I think? I’ve had some impressive results from other Tatcha products so I’m hopeful this one will brighten as well. It has some great ingredients!

It’s easily one of the most lightweight oils I’ve used while still being rich and very conditioning. It seriously helps with so many things... my skin feels very smooth and soft, and it has helped soften up the fine lines around my eyes. reviews.review_text: I love Sunday Riley! They are my favorite brand ever! and it is the absolute best! It couldn’t come in a better time! I needed help with my under eye and this definitely made everything better. No more crows feet!

reviews.review_text: I absolutely love this product. I need the collagen. It’s really nice on my skin. It goes on smooth and nicely absorbed in my skin. I love how it doesn’t irritate my skin and make it all right. It’s a really soothing healing on my face I love it.

reviews.review_text: I received this product complimentary from Farmacy Beauty. First of all, the jar is so cute! Love that it is glass. reviews.product_name: Watermelon Glow Niacinamide Dew Drops
reviews.review_text: I received this product complimentary from Glow Recipe to share my honest thoughts, and honestly I LOVE IT! I live in a cold, dry climate and this keeps my skin looking so dewy and hydrated. It’s really nice for non makeup days when you want to have a pretty glow. It’s also perfect under makeup and is a nice additional touch before foundation to prime the skin with a dewy, radiant look. It’s not sticky or tacky at all, just really smooth and absorbs nicely in the skin. It makes my face look fresh and healthy. Love this addition to my skincare routine!

reviews.product_name: Good Genes All-In-One AHA Lactic Acid Treatment
reviews.review_text: I received Good Genes gifted by Sunday Riley. I am a huge fan of Sunday Riley products because they are effective! I am not just saying this, Good Genes is AMAZING. I literally cannot live without it. I apply it every single night and wake up with clear, radiant skin. When I look at my face in the mirror after consistently using Good Genes, I really notice a difference. My face feels smoother, texture more even, and overall better clarity. I love applying it before makeup to improve my pore situation. I don’t really use this for fine lines and wrinkles because I don’t expect any store bought product to do much when it comes to that. However, this is excellent if you want to improve the overall appearance of your skin. I am obsessed

reviews.product_name: Plum Plump Hyaluronic Acid Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I am always impressed by Glow Recipe and love their fun packaging! This product is super hydrating and perfect for my dry winter skin. I live in a very cold mountain climate so I need skincare products that get the job done, and this does just that. It really makes my skin glow and look/feel really healthy and nourished. It’s not at all greasy and my skin absorbs it nicely, so it’s easy to wear under makeup. I apply this at night and wake up with my skin still looking so fresh and dewy. Another great product from Glow Recipe!

It’s the ideal winter skin product for those super cold, windy days when your skin begins to chap. It’s gentle enough for daily use which is awesome too!

reviews.product_name: Vitamin Enriched Face Base Priming Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: Okay so I live in a ski town where it is VERY cold and dry, so my makeup is constantly looking “off“ because it settles into the little dry patches on my face. Whether I’m applying this as a moisturizer before skiing, or as a primer before makeup, this formula hydrates and smoothes my skin like no other. It’s so easy to apply and I love the luxe packaging. Every time I reach for it, it feels like such a luxurious experience. I’ve never used such a hydrating primer before! Love it.

reviews.product_name: Protini Polypeptide Firming Refillable Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: It’s the perfect amount of hydration, there’s no scent and your skin feels very soft. Also, could be good for any skin type, from oily to sensitive.But it’s an expensive one !

reviews.product_name: Barrier+ Triple Lipid-Peptide Face Cream
reviews.review_text: This product is really too rich, it feels and smells like thick butter when you apply it. As it’s really expensive, I don’t understand the hype around this. It smells really  bad, like rotten butter...

reviews.product_name: Mini Abeille Royale Advanced Youth Watery Oil
reviews.review_title: Better than a regular face oil
reviews.review_text: I usually don’t like face oils, as it makes my face an oily mess, but this one is different. I really liked the watery texture, it makes the skin softer, hydrated but not oily.

reviews.product_name: Abeille Royale Advanced Youth Watery Oil
reviews.review_title: Better than a regular face oil
reviews.review_text: I usually don’t like face oils, as it makes my face an oily mess, but this one is different. I really liked the watery texture, it makes the skin softer, hydrated but not oily.

reviews.product_name: The Serum Stick: Treatment & Touch Up Balm
reviews.review_text: I received this as a sample from unfluenster’s to try on. I am surprised to see a serum in a stick shape. I it easy to glide on my face. I feel pretty light weight, and I feel some soft hydration on my skin. I can easily apply this as a touch up hydrate ontop of my makeuo

reviews.product_name: Watermelon Pink Juice Oil-Free Moisturizer
reviews.review_title: Dont remember how many bottle i have used already
reviews.review_text: I have finished a couple of bottles of this moisturizer and I am still loving it. Just at the time to get a new one, gifted by Glow Recipe a new bottle of it. I am just too excited.I have combination skin (more towards oily) with adult acne monthly. This is a super lightweight gel-emulsion texture moisturizer it will not giving me a greasy feeling but freshness. It contains malic acid and hyaluronic acid which helps me to gently exfoliate but still leave me lots of moisture. It also contains soothing antioxidant-rich botanicals extract which helps to soothe sensitive skin. I have a high standard of the product when comes to moisturizer that it does help me in oil control for not getting excessive oil after a whole day and still feel moisture. However, it does contain fragrance (less than 0.5% of fragrance), it may irritate sensitive skin. I suggest doing a patch test before applying on the face.  But it just smells too good with the composed of almost 90% real watermelon.It is vegan, cruelty-free, and clean at Sephora that I really love this product more.

reviews.product_name: Ultimate Sun Protector Lotion SPF 50+ Sunscreen
reviews.review_text: After my first try, I love it. The first impression is a bit oily, so don’t forget to shake well before use. After applying this lightweight sunscreen let it stay and aboard, it will not feel greasy anymore. I like there is no white residue. And it does not have a fragrance. I love how it is nice and smooth after apply, and I can easily apply my makeup on top of it.

reviews.product_name: Watermelon Glow Niacinamide Dew Drops
reviews.review_text: I was gifted by Glow Recipe to try out their new product. First of all, I love the signature watermelon scent. Secondly, I like the texture itself, which is not too thick or watery. It is a very lightweight serum and absorbs quickly. I layer it before moisturizer in my AM routine. I like how it gives me the glowy hydration. I have problems with acne dark spots so I am loving the niacinamide ingredients which can help to reduce hyperpigmentation and also minimize pores. I definitely will stick with this serum in my skincare routine.

reviews.product_name: Good Genes All-In-One AHA Lactic Acid Treatment
reviews.review_text: I received this complimentary from Sunday Riley.  I have been using this lactic acid for years. It has been helping me to improve my complexion texture. It has a mild AHA formula which is suitable for my skin that helps to clear up my blemish and dark spot faster. You gotta use it regularly to see the result. I do not use it every day but every other 2 days to reduce too exfoliate and cause flakey if you have a dryer face.

reviews.product_name: Honeymoon Glow AHA Resurfacing Night Serum
reviews.review_text: I am gifted by Farmacy Beauty to try on. I have been using this serum for years and I love it. For my combination skin type, I used it 1-2 times a week which I think works the best for me. I love it is a blend of AHA and BHA which helps to clear up my acne.

reviews.product_name: Vitamin Enriched Face Base Priming Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: i have been using this cream for so many years. I love the texture it is heavy and rich which fives my dry skin moisture and smooth in the winter days. I Love it so much and have continue restocking it.

reviews.product_name: Aqua Bomb Sleeping Mask
reviews.review_text: I received this free for testing purposes. I automatically think of the leneige sleeping mask. It has similar look, texture, and feel. This one is a bit more like gelatin. I do like how this feels and it does moisturize my face well overnight. Very luxurious. I’m sure I can find a cheaper alternative though.

reviews.product_name: Beste No. 9 Jelly Cleanser
reviews.review_text: What I appreciate about this cleanser is that it doesn’t contain many irritating ingredients or fragrance. It feels very tailored for sensitive skin. That being said, I feel it doesn’t foam up as much as it could compared to regular cleansers. It also doesn’t have that squeaky clean feeling, more like a hydrated one. It’s nice for what it is, but you can probably find comparable cleansers on the market for cheaper.

reviews.product_name: T.L.C. Framboos Glycolic Resurfacing Night Serum
reviews.review_text: This is my first product with Glycolic being the active ingredient. I can’t say to the effectiveness as it’s only been a week and the review deadline for this complimentary product is soon. However I do feel it sting a bit when I used it and there was immediate flaking as the skin exfoliated. I’ll need more time to introduce the product but the peeling does indicate that it works. I appreciate the clear and thin consistency. It allows the product to spread quickly and easily. The price however is ridiculous. I would hope there are alternatives.

reviews.product_name: Lala Retro Whipped Refillable Moisturizer with Ceramides
reviews.review_text: I received this complimentary for review but the review date is so soon, it’s hard to tell if it actually works. I appreciate the clean ingredients and the fact that it’s fragrance free. It doesn’t feel irritating at all and feels relatively moisturizing. I think this is something I can only use during the winter when my skin is dry. I appreciate the ph level to help with skin actives. It’s nice, but I’d hope to find something with a better price tag.

reviews.product_name: C-Tango Vitamin C Eye Cream
reviews.review_text: I received this complimentary but the review due date is too soon to tell whether or not it actually works. in general as packaging of st. As all of the other fabulous drunk elephant products. Product comes out as a white cream that spreads easily. I appreciate the clean ingredients. So far I seem to be getting milia from this so it might not work for more sensitive skin around the eyes. I have not noticed any difference in my under eye appearance but again, it might be too soon to tell.

reviews.product_name: Lippe Balm
reviews.review_text: I received this complimentary but the review deadline is too soon to tell if this product really does anything. As a brand, it’s clean, free of fragrance which is great. The balm is cream in color and applied pretty well. Overall, it seems like an average balm. Incredibly pricey for what it is. You could probably pass on this.

reviews.product_name: Benefiance Wrinkle Smoothing Eye Cream
reviews.review_text: The first thing I noticed about this product is the packaging. It comes in a glass jar with a spoon to help get product in a hygienic way. The non symmetrical oblong shape of the cap drives me nuts though. They’ve discovered a way to force all of us to keep this product on top because you physically cannot stack anything on top of it. The product is a light beige color that has a florally scent that I could pass on. It’s a light weight cream that is honestly on the greasy side. It never sinks into the skin, just sits on top of it. I tried using less but it also doesn’t spread very well. It claims to target 6 types of eye wrinkles. I tried it for 2 weeks every day on 1 eye and it looks pretty much the same as the other. It is maybe slightly less wrinkled. But not a life changing product at this price. I received this product complimentary for review.

reviews.product_name: Squalane + Omega Repair Deep Hydration Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: This first thing I notice about this is the scent. Since it’s a clean product, there are no added fragrances. I’m not sure what it is, but I imagine damp fish food. After using it for a week, I never got used to the scent. Sometimes I feel like I’m going to gag, it’s just awful. The scent definitely lingers and takes a long time to wear off. It’s rather off putting. otherwise it’s white and comes in a jar. Easy to put on, thin enough to spread. Takes a bit of time to sink in. I haven’t noticed dramatically any differences compared to a regular moisturizer. Would not buy again.

reviews.product_name: E-Rase Milki Micellar Water Mini
reviews.review_text: I was excited to receive this complimentary for testing purposes. I don’t use Micellar Water often, but love to try them out. Packaging was pretty standard. Flip cap and small spout. The viscosity of the product helps keep it from running everywhere.The product has the weirdest consistency. It comes out faint white and cloudy with a thicker than water consistency. I’ve seen some people say it’s akin to some “bodily fluids“...  The scent was rather mild. To me, it smells faintly of cream cheese frosting. Not too bothersome and the doesn’t linger after using it. As far as performance, I think it does the job well. Saturate the cotton pad with about 5 drops on each side to get my entire face. I wear light foundation and waterproof eyeliner. It removes everything quite well. It doesn’t burn when you run it over your eyes either. I generally like to double cleanse, but could get away with not doing so with this one. It leaves a light moisturized feeling on the skin, not too greasy. Outside of removing makeup, I probably would not use this as a refresher. Maybe as a winter mid day “my skin is feeling dry“ situation, but then I’d just use a regular moisturizer. As a Micellar Water, I think it’s good. However the price point is what makes it difficult to think about purchasing full price. I would probably only consider this on sale.

reviews.product_name: C-Rush Vitamin C Gel Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: This stuff is great. Nice orange gel texture, smells wonderfully like orange creamsicle, goes on smoothly. I’ve found a lot of other moisturizers burn my mask irritated skin, but this one doesn’t. When I wash it off on the morning, my skin feels soft and almost slippy. If you put too much on, I’ve found it doesn’t dry down too well. Leaves a slight sticky residue on my fingers. It’s quite pricey and I didn’t notice any brightening, but it’s good for moisturizing my skin.

reviews.product_name: Ultimate Sun Protector Lotion SPF 50+ Sunscreen
reviews.review_text: Received this free for review. Very watery and must be shaken before use. It’s light beige in color and blends in with no white cast. The formula leaves a slight greasy layer over the skin. My primer and foundation blended well over top. I did not notice any extra oil on my face after a full day. Scent is like a sweet citrus... With a hint of B.O.... I generally would prefer a face-specific sunscreen, but will use it on my face if I had to over standard sunscreens. Didn’t break me out after a week of use. A decent sunscreen for the body. But probably not worth the price tag. There is no spf expiration date written anywhere on the bottle either, so be careful.

reviews.product_name: Clear Sunscreen Stick SPF 50+
reviews.review_text: Received this free for review. This sunscreen comes in a clear stick, deodorant style. It surprisingly glided well over the skin. Slightly greasier than the lotion counterpart. Foundation blended well over top. I didn’t break out after a week of use.Scent is like a sweet citrus... With a hint of B.O.... There is only 0.52 oz of product, so I assume it’s mainly for your face. I would only use this if you’re on the go, doing outside things and need quick sunscreen. If I’m putting it on under makeup, I’d just use a liquid sunscreen since I’m blending it in with fingers anyway. I do notice it’s hard to make sure you covered your whole face since it’s clear and doesn’t blend like a liquid. I end up putting on extra just to make sure I don’t miss spots. Pricey for what it is. Not something I’d pay for convenience.

reviews.product_name: GOOPGLOW Microderm Instant Glow Exfoliator
reviews.review_text: This stuff is packed with exfoliants. It has both chemical and physical exfoliants. I’d use it very sparingly and gently. I do notice my face get really smooth afterwards. I do not recommend it for sensitive skin. It smells like the apricot scrubs and is a bit finer in scrubbies. The jar is a really heavy nice jar, but it would be easier if it was in a squeeze tube. Lastly, the price is insane! Fun to use, would not purchase because the price. I received this free for review.

reviews.product_name: Mini GOOPGLOW Microderm Instant Glow Exfoliator
reviews.review_text: This stuff is packed with exfoliants. It has both chemical and physical exfoliants. I’d use it very sparingly and gently. I do notice my face get really smooth afterwards. I do not recommend it for sensitive skin. It smells like the apricot scrubs and is a bit finer in scrubbies. The jar is a really heavy nice jar, but it would be easier if it was in a squeeze tube. Lastly, the price is insane! Fun to use, would not purchase because the price. I received this free for review.

reviews.product_name: Dewtopia 20% Acid Night Treatment
reviews.review_text: I received this complimentary from influenster for review. I have mild acne that’s kept at bay with differin. I used this 1-2 times a week for a few weeks. Though I’d need more time to evaluate, I do think this works. Having both BHA and AHA is a decent amount of exfoliant. My skin feels smoother. Texture feels ever so slightly better. Skin tone is slightly more even. I am definitely interested to see what this does long term. My milia have also gotten better. The smell is also delicious. Like lemon candy. The tingly part I don’t like, but that’s part of using acids maybe? Makes me think I’m having an allergic reaction. Like most serums, it’s pricey for the ounce. Wish it wasn’t so expensive.

reviews.product_name: Magic Cream Moisturizer with Hyaluronic Acid
reviews.review_text: I received this product free for review. Boy is this the thickest moisturizer I’ve ever used. It would really do well with a scoop as it does get under my nails. I generally have oily skin and I don’t mind using this I use the smallest amount and dab it over my skin. I’ll also spray a toner on top to thin it out for easier spreading. While I don’t think it’s revolutionary, it moisturizes well with a very gentle floral scent. It plays well with SPF and makeup with no pilling. No sensitivity issues either! It’s just really up there with the price tag that not everyone can afford.

reviews.product_name: Santorini Grape Poreless Skin Cream
reviews.review_text: I received this product free for review. I can’t comment on the packaging as I received a sample size. The more I use this, the more I dislike the scent. It has an earthy fruity scent that I don’t prefer. I feel that it is a standard cream moisturizer, not gel like they claim. It generally absorbed quickly. However, I did find that it burned a little when my skin was already irritated with mask wearing. I liked the active ingredients of salicylic acid and hyaluronic acid. After 4 weeks of daily use, I dont see much of a difference. Salicylic acid just might not be strong enough for my skin type as I use differin. It claims to blur pores, control shine, and hydrate. I think it layered well under makeup. It only ever so sightly blurred and controlled shine. It was really minor and felt like a standard moisturizer. It’s overall nice, but not mind-blowing. While I will use this up, I don’t think I would purchase a full size.

reviews.product_name: Double Serum Firming & Smoothing Anti-Aging Concentrate
reviews.review_text: I received this product free for review. I only received 7 Days worth of product. This review is based on a week of use. This comes out of the packet as a golden oil on one side and clear oil on the other. They mixed well and applied easily. I didn’t like the style of the packet sample because it was hard to squeeze it out with one hand and catch the product with the other. It was hard to get all of the product out. There was no irritation. It has the standard department store floral scent that eventually dissipated. It claims to firm, smooth, and make skin radiant. Looks like there is more of the orange oil than the clear, so it is hard to get the correct ratio of each side. I see no major differences other than hydrating. I would only purchase this if it were on sale.

reviews.product_name: Jet Lag Mask
reviews.review_title: If you want dewy, glowing skin
reviews.review_text: By far the best for moisture locking! If you want dewy, glowing skin this is the mask to use! Your skin will literally soak up all the goodness in this and make you glow in minutes (for real) I used it overnight and woke up with hydrated skin! Only fault is no directions on how many times per week to use, don’t want to over hydrate! Otherwise obsessed!

reviews.product_name: Mini Jet Lag Mask
reviews.review_title: If you want dewy, glowing skin
reviews.review_text: By far the best for moisture locking! If you want dewy, glowing skin this is the mask to use! Your skin will literally soak up all the goodness in this and make you glow in minutes (for real) I used it overnight and woke up with hydrated skin! Only fault is no directions on how many times per week to use, don’t want to over hydrate! Otherwise obsessed!

reviews.product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C
reviews.review_text: Put this on overnight and wake up with soft and hydrated lips! The product is thick and covers your whole lips with just a little amount. I wouldn’t use it during the day or under a lip. I use it at night and can go all the next day without applying chapstick! I’ve had this for about 6 months and not even close to finishing the pot. So much product for your money!

reviews.product_name: Protini Polypeptide Firming Refillable Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: Very lightweight and blends in very well. My skin is clear and smooth. I haven’t noticed a difference in brightening but a huge difference in smoothing and moisture.

reviews.product_name: Ultra Facial Moisturizing Cream with Squalane
reviews.review_text: Didn’t really like this cream. It moisturized but not as well as some of he other moisturizers I’ve tried. I also couldn’t stand the smell! Returned this product.

reviews.product_name: Mini Ultra Facial Moisturizing Cream with Squalane
reviews.review_text: Didn’t really like this cream. It moisturized but not as well as some of he other moisturizers I’ve tried. I also couldn’t stand the smell! Returned this product.

reviews.product_name: Creamy Eye Treatment with Avocado
reviews.review_text: This product is not creamy but oily. I barely put any product on my eye before wiping excess off. Didn’t notice any changes in brightness or moisture. Returned this product.

reviews.product_name: Superberry Hydrate + Glow Dream Oil
reviews.review_text: AMAZING! I use this before my moisturized at night and wake up with clear, dewy, glowing skin. I have combo skin so I only use at night!

reviews.product_name: Cold Plunge Pore Mask
reviews.review_text: Great mask for your t zone! I didn’t put it in my cheeks, just t zone and after a few uses I noticed my pores decrease in size and clearer. It gives a cooling sensation without leaving you dried. Very refreshing and works!

reviews.product_name: The Rice Polish Foaming Enzyme Powder
reviews.review_text: One of the best exfoliators I have ever used. It’s gentle but still can feel the exfoliation. Not abrasive but gets the job done and leaves your skin soft and glowing. Highly recommend for exfoliation.

reviews.product_name: Superberry Hydrate + Glow Dream Night Mask with Vitamin C
reviews.review_text: Awesome overnight mask! It’s super thick, so you don’t need a lot of product to cover. You’ll wake up to glowing skin that lasts all day without a sticky residue!

reviews.product_name: Mini Superberry Hydrate + Glow Dream Mask
reviews.review_text: Awesome overnight mask! It’s super thick, so you don’t need a lot of product to cover. You’ll wake up to glowing skin that lasts all day without a sticky residue!

reviews.product_name: Protini Polypeptide Firming Refillable Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I cannot rave about this moisturizer enough...it totally changed my skin (along with the babyfacial). After wearing this morning and night for a few months, my skin is supremely soft, hydrated yet never ever has an uncomfortable “oily” feeling. I have combination/dry skin that is annoyingly prone to persistent hormonal acne (I’m 31). I’m one of those who has tried everything under the sun and after using this, I’ll never change. It’s worth the money and at least worth getting a sample to see for yourself. It’s also worth noting, the packaging is excellent as it doesn’t expose the good ingredients to air and bacteria (why is bad jar packaging so prevalent??)...this also does not contain fragrance (natural or synthetic...both are bad!), essential oils, and alcohol.

reviews.product_name: AHA 30% + BHA 2% Exfoliating Peeling Solution
reviews.review_text: I can’t believe I spent over 8 times the price of this for Babyfacial. I do like babyfacial but the difference in cost for something that performs just as well if not better is crazy. This is a mask to do carefully however you shouldn’t be afraid! I would begin carefully and do it for maybe half the time starting out if you don’t have experience with these peels. They have made a huge difference in my skin and in my opinion everyone should be using them (unless you have extremely sensitive skin) instead of physical exfoliaters which damage your skin and gives you a false sense of cleanliness. I have been using tretinoin.05% for 2 years and I alternate every other night between that and framboos glycolic serum and once a week use this mask. I also apply flora and bast cbd oil every morning. I used to suffer from VERY persistent adult hormonal acne (I’ve seriously tried everything under the sun)...I believe everything is helping but I strongly believe the cbd oil and this mask have changed my skin texture completely.

reviews.product_name: Squalane + Marine Algae Firming & Lifting Eye Cream
reviews.review_text: Biossance- please redo the packaging for this and put it in a pump container or airless jar. While this has excellent ingredients, every time they are exposed to air they start to lose their efficacy. Not to mention the hygiene problem of repeatedly sticking your finger in. Please please please re do the packaging!

reviews.product_name: The Kissu Lip Mask
reviews.review_text: Ridiculous that a) people get free products and then asked to write reviews and b) they are reviewing the old formulation when it has changed. Quite simply, this mask is terrible. I feel robbed. You get way less than the laniege and pay way more (the laniege blows this out of the water and in my humble opinion is the absolute best although I’m still searching!) this is sticky and sits on top of your lips instead of actually healing them. My lips are actually drier after wearing this than before! And for that price and reason, that’s why I feel robbed. This was the same experience I had with the biossance lip mask by the way.

reviews.product_name: F-Balm Electrolyte Waterfacial Mask
reviews.review_text: I will keep this short and simple and give you a little secret. I have combo VERY acne prone 32 yr old skin. I did not receive this for free and paid in full. This did not break me out although I discovered a wonderful way to use this and it’s not as a face mask. I apply this under my eyes every morning and it does what no eye cream (expensive and drugstore) has never been able to do...it seriously moisturizes, smooths and brightens. And the price isn’t so bad for how much you get and how much you use if you use as an eye cream. And their regular eye cream is 60 and you only get .5 oz. you get almost 2 oz of this and it absolutely blows it away.

reviews.product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C
reviews.review_text: This is the very best out there. I’ve searched for something comparable or better (I’m a product hoarder) and nothing remotely comes close. Really wish they would come out with a fragrance free version. Stays put AND fully moisturizes my lips. Can’t ask for more. Blows every other lip balm/mask out of the water. Anyone saying this doesn’t work must be hiii.

reviews.product_name: Honeymoon Glow AHA Resurfacing Night Serum
reviews.review_text: This is an excellent aha serum. I use this every morning (yes you can use in morning as long as you apply a great sunscreen over it) and it gives me the most gorgeous glow all day and into the evening. I should say I have experience with chemical exfoliants so I wear this every day no problem (I use tretinoin at night) so if you don’t have experience I’d suggest starting off slow. I apply YTTP facial spray right after I cleanse my face in morning, then this, then I apply flora + Bast cbd oil. Then I apply supergoop cc cream (has high spf). Research shows that your skin should be slightly damp before you apply aha’s and they penetrate better.

reviews.product_name: Glowscreen Sunscreen SPF 40 PA+++ with Hyaluronic Acid + Niacinamide
reviews.review_text: I honestly have no cons for this product (unusual-I’m picky and usually find SOMETHING I don’t like)...I would call this almost a very sheer tint. I was expecting this to be too oily or shiny. This gave my skin the most dewy beautiful glow and made it feel and look “bouncy” rather than an oil slick. I put this on and don’t feel like I need cc cream on top (supergoop cc cream is the best at Sephora in my opinion)...I just add some concealer and lip balm and I’m good to go. Did not break me out and I have very adult acne prone skin.

reviews.product_name: Mini Glowscreen Sunscreen SPF 40 PA+++ with Hyaluronic Acid + Niacinamide
reviews.review_text: I honestly have no cons for this product (unusual-I’m picky and usually find SOMETHING I don’t like)...I would call this almost a very sheer tint. Did not break me out and I have very adult acne prone skin.

reviews.product_name: GOOPGLOW Microderm Instant Glow Exfoliator
reviews.review_text: Worth every hard earned penny. I use a little scoop as I don’t like sticking my finger in jars. I also leave on a little longer than the recommended time. But boy do I notice a difference in my skin. This isn’t abrasive and it really gives me the most beautiful glow. I thought gwyneth was full of it until I actually tried these goop products and I’m a believer now. Lol

reviews.product_name: Mini GOOPGLOW Microderm Instant Glow Exfoliator
reviews.review_text: Worth every hard earned penny. I use a little scoop as I don’t like sticking my finger in jars. I also leave on a little longer than the recommended time. But boy do I notice a difference in my skin. This isn’t abrasive and it really gives me the most beautiful glow. I thought gwyneth was full of it until I actually tried these goop products and I’m a believer now. Lol

reviews.product_name: Vinoperfect Radiance Dark Spot Serum Vitamin C Alternative
reviews.review_text: Why did they absolutely ruin an otherwise great serum by adding parfum (fragrance!) to it? Caudalie does this with pretty much all their skincare and it’s annoying.

reviews.product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C
reviews.review_text: I am reviewing the new scent, peach iced tea, specifically. By now everyone knows the actual formula is the very best…I’ve tried others and always always keep this handy. Can’t be without it. I am not into most of their scents though as I hate scents that are artificial/too sweet. I do like their original and grapefruit though. I was really curious about this new one as I love anything peach. I noticed a ton of people saying it barely has a scent or doesn’t smell peachy..I am here to confirm this DOES smell pretty much exclusively like peach…exactly like their glowy balm. The smell is not subtle as people have been saying but it’s not overwhelming either, which I appreciate. I absolutely love it and hope they come out with more “natural” scents like this instead of all the fake candy scents.

reviews.product_name: Vinopure Natural Salicylic Acid Pore Minimizing Serum
reviews.review_text: This serum is terrible. It claims to fight acne but is loaded with skin sensitizer..alcohol (dries out skin but actually makes the problem worse) is near the top, then you have peppermint oil and limonene (fragrance), etc. do research before spending your hard earned money ladies!

reviews.product_name: The Water Cream Oil-Free Pore Minimizing Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I have the entire Tatcha line and it was worth the splurge. A little goes a long way honestly. I use the camellia cleansing oil, enzyme rice powder, plumping essence followed by the silk cream at night and during the day I use the same products but substitute the silk cream with the water cream instead. Holy!! Everyone has commented on my skin, I rarely have to wear foundation or powder anymore, that’s how fantastic my skin is after using Tatcha. Don’t let the price blind you, it’s worth every penny.

reviews.product_name: Mini The Water Cream
reviews.review_text: I have the entire Tatcha line and it was worth the splurge. A little goes a long way honestly. I use the camellia cleansing oil, enzyme rice powder, plumping essence followed by the silk cream at night and during the day I use the same products but substitute the silk cream with the water cream instead. Don’t let the price blind you, it’s worth every penny.

reviews.product_name: The Essence Skincare Boosting Treatment
reviews.review_text: Noticed results in skin absorption and texture within a week. Best to use with the skin care line but I think as a stand alone product you can use it with other brands. I just prefer to be consistent. Well worth the splurge if you ask me.

reviews.product_name: Mini The Essence  Skincare Boosting Treatment
reviews.review_text: Noticed results in skin absorption and texture within a week. Best to use with the skin care line but I think as a stand alone product you can use it with other brands. I just prefer to be consistent. Well worth the splurge if you ask me.

reviews.product_name: The Camellia Oil 2-in-1 Makeup Remover & Cleanser
reviews.review_text: Great cleansing oil for combination oily/dry patch skin. I prefer it as a regular dailtcleansing oil/wash as I find the oil doesn’t completely remove waterproof eyeliner and mascara as well as my Shu Uemura sublime cleansing oil.

reviews.product_name: The Rice Polish Foaming Enzyme Powder
reviews.review_text: I purchased the mini set “Kyoto cleanse“ and I must tell you that after trying the product for a week I went and bought the full size right away. the texture and complexion of my face is baby smooth and soft. Favourite exfoliant I’ve tried so far (and trust me I’ve tried alot)!!

reviews.product_name: The Rice Polish Foaming Enzyme Powder
reviews.review_text: I use this 2x every day and I’ve had no issues with it. I have combination skin and eczema, so you could see my skepticism when the Sephora beauty advisor suggested the usage but holy cow! They were spot on and I don’t think I’d be able to go without it, my skin is smooth and clear.. no redness!! I literally bought 2 backups during the vib rouge sale afterwards. Trust me. Try it.

reviews.product_name: 100% Organic Cold-Pressed Rose Hip Seed Oil
reviews.review_title: GREAT FOR ECZEMA OR SENSITIVE SKIN
reviews.review_text: I always purchase from the Deciem website and I am extra happy Sephora decided to carry this line as well! The Rosehip Oil is a blessing in a bottle. Whenever I break out in an eczma heat rash, this really goes a long way to calm and heal my skin. Ladies... dont expect results right away. It took about 2 weeks of regular use but afterwards you wont regret! Got my sister hooked on their products too! I hope they start carrying their line of foundation.

reviews.product_name: Magic Cream Moisturizer with Hyaluronic Acid
reviews.review_title: READ THIS BEFORE YOU DECIDE TO PURCHASE.
reviews.review_text: Let me start of by saying, for those 1 star reviews who complained about breaking out, the ingrediants are oil based and there IS SPF meaning its a cream you wear during the DAY, so no ladies you cannot use this as a night cream. I use both her magic cream and ultra rich night cream and it really does give amazing results despite the price point. As i have combination sensitive skin, its hard for me to find products that work/dont give me adverse effects, i tried this and within a week i saw and felt results, my sking feels bouncy, the texture and fine lines have diminished and i glow (literally without any makeup). I highly recommend this product but ladies PLEASE DO YOUR HOMEWORK BEFORE YOU BUY SKINCARE.

reviews.product_name: PHAT Glow Facial Mask
reviews.review_text: I am really surprised at how well this product was on my skin considering I suffer from eczema and have combination skin. My skin felt very smooth and soft after the first application with no redness or sensitivity issues. I will update on continued use for long term effects but so far so good! I received this product complimentary for testing purposes.

reviews.product_name: Hyaluronic Acid Hydrating Serum
reviews.review_text: My favorite inkey product! I tried several and found this one to make the most difference in my face and will be repurchasing!! I received from Influenster to test and give my honest opinion.

reviews.product_name: Caffeine Eye Cream
reviews.review_text: After using this product for a month I did see a decrease in the darkness under my eyes. I didn’t notice the fine lines decreasing or anything like that, but definitely less darkness. I received this product from Influenster to test and give my honest opinion.

reviews.product_name: F-Balm Electrolyte Waterfacial Mask
reviews.review_text: I received this product for free to test and write my honest opinion. I absolutely love drunk elephant! Literally one of my favorite skin care brands. I actually got a sample of this product from Sephora prior to learning I was receiving it to test so I had Ben using it for a week already. This is such a hydrating mask. I have been having such dry skin this winter, even though I’m currently living in California! My skin was also breaking out quite a bit. This product definitely helped with the dryness, didn’t make my acne worse and had given me such a soft face!! Helps my foundation sit on my face and look more natural since I’ve been using this at night.

reviews.product_name: Avocado Fine Line Eye Cream with Retinol
reviews.review_text: I received this product was gifted by Glow Recipe to test, and review. All opinions are my own. I’ve used this product for a little less than a week and am loving it so far! I don’t have lining underneath my eyes yet, and I’m working hard to prevent that. This is a product I will be using to do so! It’s a wonderful texture that feels very hydrating underneath my eyes.  It definitely makes my eyes more hydrated. I haven’t noticed any brightening but plan on continuing to use to to see how it does. I wear this as an overnight mask, and remove it in the morning. This product also works well with any makeup that you wear the next day (once product is removed). Overall, I’m a fan and it’s been added to my daily routine!

reviews.product_name: Watermelon Glow Niacinamide Dew Drops
reviews.review_text: I received this product complimentary from Glow Recipe in exchange for an honest review.  This is a great product!! I use it underneath my makeup and it gives my foundation gorgeous glow! My makeup lasts throughout the work day without any issues. It absorbs beautifully into my skin, and I love the consistency of this product!

reviews.product_name: Avocado Soothing Skin Barrier Serum with Ceramides
reviews.review_text: I received this product as a gift in exchange for my honest review! This hyaluronic plumping serum is so lightweight and feels great on my skin! It’s super hydrating and is making my skin feel very moisturized! I can’t wait to see what the long term effects of this are!!

reviews.product_name: Honeymoon Glow AHA Resurfacing Night Serum
reviews.review_text: This is one of my favorite products from Farmacy! It’s a staple in my night routine, and leave me skin looking sooo smooth and almost glass like the next day! I love when I can see results from a product this quickly. I really can tell the different the next morning if I’ve used this or not the night before. Winner!! Gifted by Farmacy Beauty.

reviews.product_name: Jet Lag Mask
reviews.review_text: I loved the original formula so I was super curious to try the new version and was definitely not disappointed! Quality is the same between the two formulas in my opinion, and I will definitely continue to use this mask and will purchase once I’m out!!

reviews.product_name: Mini Jet Lag Mask
reviews.review_text: I loved the original formula so I was super curious to try the new version and was definitely not disappointed! Quality is the same between the two formulas in my opinion, and I will definitely continue to use this mask and will purchase once I’m out!!

reviews.product_name: 5 Stars Retinol + Niacinamide Eye Serum
reviews.review_text: Loving this product! New addition to my routine and I’ve been enjoying it. My eyes are a little more sensitive since using it but I expected that because I have sensitive skin. This product was complimentary in exchange for an honest review.

reviews.product_name: Floral Recovery Overnight Mask with Squalane
reviews.review_text: Thankful I was able to test this product i received complimentary in exchange for my honest review. I’m a huge fan of this product, I love applying it before bedtime and find that it does calm the redness of my skin, especially when breaking out. I did think this was a little too strongly scented.

reviews.product_name: Plum Plump Hyaluronic Acid Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I’ve been loving this product so much! It’s the extra hydration boost that I need this time of the month and absolutely love how it makes my skin look and feel throughout the day. I’ve been using it on a no makeup day, and underneath my makeup and have been loving both!

reviews.product_name: Mini Plum Plump Hyaluronic Acid Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I’ve been loving this product so much! It’s the extra hydration boost that I need this time of the month and absolutely love how it makes my skin look and feel throughout the day. I’ve been using it on a no makeup day, and underneath my makeup and have been loving both!

reviews.product_name: 5 Stars Retinol + Niacinamide Eye Serum
reviews.review_text: I absolutely love retinoids eye creams, and this one from Sunday Riley is so smooth and absorbs so well that it’s become a new favorite! I also love the inclusion of niacinamide to brighten and help with dark circles. Definitely recommend this eye serum to anyone looking for a lightweight eye product to help with fine lines and dark circles!

reviews.product_name: Precleanse Cleansing Oil
reviews.review_text: This cleansing oil by Dermalogica is the perfect first cleanse step in my routine. This oil cleanser helps remove any trace of makeup, sunscreen, and dirt for a deeper cleanse, all without breaking me out! Definitely recommend if you’re looking for a first cleanse. Gifted by Dermalogica.

reviews.product_name: Mini Precleanse Cleansing Oil
reviews.review_text: This cleansing oil by Dermalogica is the perfect first cleanse step in my routine. This oil cleanser helps remove any trace of makeup, sunscreen, and dirt for a deeper cleanse, all without breaking me out! Definitely recommend if you’re looking for a first cleanse. Gifted by Dermalogica.

reviews.product_name: Vitamin Enriched Face Base Priming Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: This is one of my all time favorite primers! It gives my skin such a healthy glow, while hydrating and protecting it. I’ve been using this for years, and it’s honestly such a staple at this point. Definitely recommend.

reviews.product_name: Mini Daily Microfoliant Exfoliator
reviews.review_text: Dermalogica is one of my favorite brands, and this microexfoliant is amazing! It is a great way to gently exfoliate your face without being too harsh or striping. I love how soft my skin feels afterwards. Gifted by Dermalogica.

reviews.product_name: Daily Microfoliant Exfoliator
reviews.review_text: Dermalogica is one of my favorite brands, and this microexfoliant is amazing! It is a great way to gently exfoliate your face without being too harsh or striping. I love how soft my skin feels afterwards. Gifted by Dermalogica.

reviews.product_name: Santorini Grape Poreless Skin Cream
reviews.review_text: This lightweight gel moisturizer is great for combo/oily skin types! I love that it has hyaluronic acid and salicylic acid to hydrate and exfoliate.

reviews.product_name: Self Tanning Bronzing Face Drops
reviews.review_text: This was such an instant-results type of product that was so easy to use! I’ve never used self tanner before, but these drops were super easy to mix into my moisturizer and apply to my face giving it a nice glow! I also didn’t notice any staining of my hands. Gifted by isle of paradise.

reviews.product_name: Sugar Lip Balm Hydrating Treatment
reviews.review_text: Absolutely love this lip balm from Fresh! I’ve used other colors before but this Plum color gives such a nice deep berry that looks so gorgeous on the lips. I would say it’s definitely one of the more pigmented shades. 100% recommend. Gifted by Fresh.

reviews.product_name: Tea Elixir Niacinamide & Hyaluronic Acid Anti-Aging Serum
reviews.review_text: Wow this new launch from Fresh is insane! I’ve been loving this Tea Elixir serum to keep my skin bouncy and hydrated! It’s such a nice formulation, and leaves my skin so dewy. Definitely recommend you check this out!

reviews.product_name: Brazilian Kiss Cupuaçu Lip Butter
reviews.review_text: Downright indulgent. Most luxurious lip butter ever...and the smell is addicting....buy now!

reviews.product_name: Tonique Confort Re-Hydrating Comforting Toner with Acacia Honey
reviews.review_text: For starters, I have sensitive skin and most products irritate me. This is perfect! The smell is light, the texture is soft and very welcoming. My skin feels so moisturized and soothed. I received this product complimentary through voxbox for testing purposes.

reviews.product_name: Hydra Zen Gel-Cream Oil-Free Moisturizer with Salicylic Acid
reviews.review_text: I absolutely adored this gel moisturizer. The scent is light and the texture is unique. I’m usually very critical of most facial products due to my sensitive skin, this is super gentle yet effective! I am impressed. I received this product complimentary in voxbox for testing purposes.

reviews.product_name: Cicapair Tiger Grass Cream
reviews.review_text: A little thicker than the gel version but delightfully so. Light scent and good for sensitive skin. I enjoyed it and would buy again. I received this complimentary from Influenster in exchange for my honest opinion.

reviews.product_name: Cicapair Tiger Grass Serum
reviews.review_text: The coolest packaging I have seen. The juice inside is very nice as well. Not harsh on my sensitive acne prone skin. I enjoyed using it. Only a slight scent so it’s not irritating to the nose. I received this product complimentary from influenster in exchange for my honest opinion.

reviews.product_name: T.L.C. Framboos Glycolic Resurfacing Night Serum
reviews.review_text: Love the resurfacing power of this product. Totally gives you a glow. That being said, I have sensitive skin and use this product sparingly. Once or twice a week is enough for me. Love the clean ingredients and natural formulation.

reviews.product_name: Beste No. 9 Jelly Cleanser
reviews.review_text: Wow, this cleanser is everything! Clean ingredients and gentle on my sensitive skin. Can’t wait to try their other products!

reviews.product_name: Lala Retro Whipped Refillable Moisturizer with Ceramides
reviews.review_text: So far, I like this moisturizing cream. The packaging takes a little bit of getting used to but my sensitive eczema prone skin enjoyed the moisture it also Absorbed quickly and didn’t have any scent which is always appreciated.

reviews.product_name: Lippe Balm
reviews.review_text: Moisturizing! I have been meaning to try this for some time. I love that its unscented and clean! Hoping they come out with a tinted version for sure!

reviews.product_name: C-Tango Vitamin C Eye Cream
reviews.review_text: I was hesitant to try this bc Vitamin C can be very irritating. I would use this by diluting it with your favorite moisturizer. It has a definite brightening effect.

reviews.product_name: Ultra Repair Cream Intense Hydration
reviews.review_text: Love it…it’s so hydrating. Would definitely recommend. I have combination skin but it never gave me any break outs.

reviews.product_name: Oat Cleansing Balm
reviews.review_text: Omg..it’s melt’s my makeup so fast.. but I feel little bit of waxy feeling on my skin afterwards. I do follow up with regular cleanser. This is the first inkey list product I ever tried. Will definitely want to try more.

reviews.product_name: Mini Oat Cleansing Balm
reviews.review_text: Omg..it’s melt’s my makeup so fast.. but I feel little bit of waxy feeling on my skin afterwards. I do follow up with regular cleanser. This is the first inkey list product I ever tried. Will definitely want to try more.

reviews.product_name: Glowscreen Sunscreen SPF 40 PA+++ with Hyaluronic Acid + Niacinamide
reviews.review_title: First of all wow second of all wow
reviews.review_text: Ok, first of all wow second of all wow. I totally get the hype on the Glow screen now! It’s super lightweight, blends into the skin easily, feels hydrating of skin and leave your skin with a healthy glow. I have combination skin, it looks too shiny on my t-zone, but I can manage that with some setting powder. It has semi-thick texture with no scent. It does pill little if I apply to many layers of skincare care products on my skin.

reviews.product_name: Sugar Lip Balm Hydrating Treatment
reviews.review_text: I received Sugar Icon Tinted Lip Balm complimentary from Fresh.The formula is soft, moisturizing, with a subtle shine. Not waxy or too thick. The sheer tint is perfect for everyday wear. There’s no scent or flavor. Most lip products dry my lips out instantly, but not this. Love it!

reviews.product_name: Tea Elixir Niacinamide & Hyaluronic Acid Anti-Aging Serum
reviews.review_title: It's a great addition to my routine.
reviews.review_text: I put this on straight out of the shower and layer my other products on top of it. It smell refreshing and the texture is perfect. It moisturizes perfectly and gives the face a beautiful glow and it doesn’t feel like it’s just sitting on top of your skin. After a couple of days of using this serum my skin looked and felt smoother. It’s a great addition to my routine.

reviews.product_name: Mini Daily Microfoliant Exfoliator
reviews.review_text: I have classic combination skin with the occasional hormonal break out. I’ve struggled finding an exfoliant that cleans my skin, but doesn’t strip it/leave it feeling too dry. This brightens, smooths and evens out my skin tone feeling fresh.Complimentary from Dermalogica Sampling.

reviews.product_name: Daily Microfoliant Exfoliator
reviews.review_text: I have classic combination skin with the occasional hormonal break out. I’ve struggled finding an exfoliant that cleans my skin, but doesn’t strip it/leave it feeling too dry. This brightens, smooths and evens out my skin tone feeling fresh.Complimentary from Dermalogica Sampling.

reviews.product_name: GENIUS Liquid Collagen Serum
reviews.review_text: This product really did provide excellent light hydration and gives your skin an amazing glow. Right after putting this on my skin felt really hydrated and much smoother. I can definitely feel the difference vs. using just a moisturizer alone. Really happy to add this step to my routine.

reviews.product_name: T.L.C. Framboos Glycolic Resurfacing Night Serum
reviews.review_text: This might be my favorite DE product.  Not only do I use this every night,  but some mornings I’ll use it as well. It keeps my pores from getting clogged, and has really helped with the evening out of my acne marks.  I’ll use it forever!

reviews.product_name: T.L.C. Sukari Babyfacial AHA + BHA Mask
reviews.review_text: This facial has amazed me more than any skincare product I have EVER used.  I use it every Sunday and it blows my mind every time.  It sings and itches for a while; the first time i used it I thought my skin would be red and irritated when i took it off,  but instead i looked in the mirror to the most even skintone I’ve ever seen. The craziest thing is that my pores have gotten,  or at least look exponentially smaller. I love this so much that on Wednesdays sometimes I will do a quick 10 minute babyfacial mixed with Marula for a little maintenance. I’m a little bummed that mine seemed to have an air-bubble in the middle.  I had a couple of pumps with no product which sucked since it’s not cheap.  Otherwise it’s worth every penny.

reviews.product_name: A-Passioni Retinol Cream
reviews.review_text: I had never used retinol before this.  My skin did need to adjust, i.e. peeling and purging which freaked me out for about a month.  Now I use this every other day, I truly feel that my skin tone is more even,  and I’m so excited to see my texture improve as well!

reviews.product_name: Protini Polypeptide Firming Refillable Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: Eh, it’s Alright. Honestly I don’t have anything great or poor to say about it. The Lala Retro is way better in my opinion. This has a gel like feelTo it, which isn’t bad, but for me I enjoy the creamy texture of lala.

reviews.product_name: Niacinamide 10% + Zinc 1% Oil Control Serum
reviews.review_text: Absolutely recommend this, as a 30 year old former drunk elephant fanatic turned The Ordinary fanatic who has been suffering from acne since high school.... yah I like this. I’ve had a huge reduction in breakout since I’ve been using this since January.

reviews.product_name: Beste No. 9 Jelly Cleanser
reviews.review_text: Been using this for three years. Melts the makeup right off, skin remains soft and not tight after use, gentle scent. I have yet to find a better cleanser! I highly recommend for sensitive skin.

reviews.product_name: Lala Retro Whipped Refillable Moisturizer with Ceramides
reviews.review_text: Best DE moisturizer. Creamy, perfect texture. I was worried it would be too thick for my sensitive skin but it’s perfect. I’ve used protini and I prefer this one. I have been using this for two years and have re purchased twice. Love love love this. Doesn’t clog my pores.

reviews.product_name: Multi-Peptide + HA Serum
reviews.review_text: Just a great moisturizing serum! My skin is always soft the morning after I use this, and I’ll use it under my makeup. Love it, love the ordinary!

reviews.product_name: Lactic Acid 10% + HA 2% Exfoliating Serum
reviews.review_text: Amazing, the ordinary has been a staple for me since I started with the Mandelic acid in January. I’ve been using this lactic acid since February and I’m impressed. I have re purchased this twice. I have pale skin and am a picker of my acne. This has been a huge help in reducing my red marks from acne and scarring from picking. I recommend and will continue to purchase this as it is now essential in my routine!

reviews.product_name: Virgin Marula Luxury Face Oil
reviews.review_text: I’ve tried many facial oils and this, by far, is the best of them all.  It hydrates, smooths, clears, and soothes your skin.  Redness & irritation?  Put some DE oil on it.  Dry patches?  Put some DE oil on it. Put this on at night and wake up with smooth skin.  Put under or over your makeup and enjoy extra hydration.  This is holy grail status (and it takes a lot to get to holy grail status for me).

reviews.product_name: Jet Lag Mask
reviews.review_text: I’m not sure if this product was just overhyped for a beloved YouTuber or if it just didn’t mix well with the chemistry of my skin.  But it dried out my skin within within minutes.  I tried this every other day for 2 wks and the same result each time.  In fact, it made me look older and I swear it looks like it darkens my skin tone after about an hour or so of putting it on.  I tried using it as an overnight mask and I woke up with dry skin (and accentuated wrinkles I didn’t even know I had!  I wanted to love it so I kept trying to see if it would eventually work out and give me some good results but, unfortunately, I’m going to have to return it :(

reviews.product_name: Balancing Force Oil Control Toner
reviews.review_text: This is the best $26 I’ve ever spent!  I woke up with new skin!  I’ve tried so many products and nothing has ever really worked for my large pores...until NOW!  This product somehow magically shrinks my pores and controls my oily areas while calming and soothing out my dry spots.  It really does balance out your skin and is not overly drying.  I’m so glad I bought this!

reviews.product_name: Good Genes All-In-One AHA Lactic Acid Treatment
reviews.review_text: What is this magic potion in a bottle?!?!  Good Genes is everything I’ve been looking for!!  Ive been a prescription Retin-A user for many yrs, which is an amazing anti-aging miracle but causes very dry skin.  I look much younger than my age and I attribute that to my Retin-A.  I just recently decided I can no longer take being as dry as the desert so I’ve been looking for something comparable for retexturing, exfoliation, smoothing, and anti-aging...that wouldn’t dry out my skin the same way.  I found it. Good Genes is giving me the same skin that I get from prescription Retin-A without the dry side effects!  It’s the magic potion that I’ve been searching for.  Some reviewers are complaining about breakouts or patchiness, that only happens if you had bad skin before using this product. Just like with Retin-A, Good Genes will force the skin to “turnover” by purging out the impurities and any dry areas you had will appear scaly for a few days (maybe a week or more if you’re skin was really bad)...but after everything is purged, you will wake up with gorgeous new skin and everyone will ask you what you’re using for your face so they can go out and buy it too.  So if you have some of those reactions initially, it’s a GOOD thing!  It means it’s working!!  If you’re new to the anti-aging game and use a product and do not notice any initial purging, then you know it’s not working.  I, myself, have not noticed any breakouts or peeling but that’s because I already purged my skin long long ago and have maintained it ever since.  Good Genes works and yet it’s mild enough to not interrupt the skin’s natural hydration process the way other harsher products do.  SR came up with the perfect formula!  Yay!!

reviews.product_name: Vinosource-Hydra Moisturizing Sorbet
reviews.review_text: Feels nice and light on the skin at first but then it basically evaporated after a few minutes and I was left with dry skin again.  Not moisturizing enough for dry skin types.  Probably only good for those with normal to oily skin.

reviews.product_name: Ultra Facial Moisturizing Cream with Squalane
reviews.review_text: One of the very few products that made me breakout.  I am NOT acne prone and never have been.  But I used this cream for a few days and broke out like crazy.  The acne stopped once I ceased using this cream.  Not for me.

reviews.product_name: Mini Ultra Facial Moisturizing Cream with Squalane

reviews.product_name: Facial Treatment Essence (Pitera Essence)
reviews.review_text: I did not want to like this...but it only took 3 days of use before my skin began to transform from dry and dull to hydrated and radiant.  This product truly does plump up the skin and stops breakouts from occurring.  I’m now a believer.  I just wish it wasn’t so expensive.  But I have to say it’s worth it.  There goes my wallet.

reviews.product_name: Vinoperfect Radiance Dark Spot Serum Vitamin C Alternative
reviews.review_text: 30 min after I put this on, I had little bumps all over my face.  Washed my face and the bumps disappeared 30 min after.  This is not for sensitive skin.  Beware.

reviews.product_name: Hyaluronic Acid 2% + B5 Hydrating Serum
reviews.review_text: A MUST-HAVE for dry skin.  I tend to break out or get milia or get irritation whenever I use intense moisturizers.  So I stick to my fav lightweight moisturizers, knowing they won’t be hydrating enough for my dry dry skin in the winter.  BUT NOW, this serum intensifies my regular moisturizers by providing that extra boost of hydration I need without irritating my sensitive skin or causing acne.  I’ve been using this for 2 wks now and it’s been amazing.  I massage it in before my moisturizer every night and I wake up with fresher, more hydrated skin.  I don’t use this in the morning because it takes a long time to sink into the skin and might mess with the consistency of my makeup.  Nightly use has been sufficient for me and the price is unbeatable.

reviews.product_name: 100% Organic Cold-Pressed Rose Hip Seed Oil
reviews.review_title: WHAT A GREAT PRICE FOR A GREAT PRODUCT!
reviews.review_text: At first, I thought I prefer my Marula Oil because it felt more hydrating but I decided to keep trying with this one.  After two weeks, I noticed the huge difference.  This rose hip seed oil: 1) has more anti-aging benefits 2) is a dry oil so it feels less hydrating but i realized that I wake up with plumper hydrated skin, 3) it has brightened my skin, my skin looks fresher 4) my skin feels smoother 5) it’s MUCH CHEAPER. This oil has now become a staple in my nighttime routine.  I still use my Marula Oil in the mornings because its high in Vitamin C, and works better than the rose seed oil as a makeup primer.  But now I’m going to save some money with my $9 nighttime oil!  Everyone needs this.

reviews.review_text: It’s been 2 weeks of using this and I can already see a difference.  My skin tone is more even and then dark spots (from scarring and sunspots) are fading to a lighter, more manageable color.  I haven’t had to pull out my spot concealer because my foundation is able to cover them up nicely. This means less makeup on my face and I’m super happy about that.  It also does a great job of keeping pores less visible.  Overall a great buy.

reviews.product_name: Estee Lauder Advanced Night Repair Synchronized Multi-Recovery Complex Serum
reviews.review_text: First let me say as a user of this line of products for many years, the need for this product depends on your age.  The process of cell renewal occurs when we sleep; our skin goes into recovery mode.  As we get older, this recovery mode no longer works the same way on its own and so this product helps to facilitate it.  When I was younger, this serum made no difference.  I think it’s because I was renewing my cells naturally on my own back then so I couldn’t see a difference.  So I stopped using it.  BUT, now that I’m older, I can’t live without this serum.  If I travel without it, my skin gets mad at me.  I now need this in my life every single night.  I do not recommend this serum to anyone under the age of 30.  I would highly highly highly recommend this as a holy grail to anyone aged 30+.  It’s a must-have for me.

reviews.review_text: Once a week of this super-powered mask.  That’s all you need to renew your skin.  My previous skincare routine was working great for me until masks became a part of our lives. I added this to my weekend mask routine and it’s made such a huge difference.  This is almost as good as getting a professional facial at a spa.  I love it.

reviews.review_text: Probably the most hydrating moisturizer I’ve ever used...so much so that I would not need to use it every day.  I would say it kept my skin hydrated for up to 2 days and I was pretty shocked about it because my skin is super dry in the winters.  This would be too much to use daily for me (I can already see my sensitive skin reacting poorly to the daily over-moisturizing). I’ll only need it to rescue me on desert dry skin days or after retin-A treatments.  And for that, I’ll be thankful.

reviews.product_name: Superberry Hydrate + Glow Dream Night Mask with Vitamin C
reviews.review_text: This was gave me a greasy, uncomfortable feeling (too thick for an overnight mask) but I figured I’d see it it was worth it.  I woke up the next morning to skin that felt drier and my wrinkles and pores had been emphasized. And I looked older and haggard the entire day.  That is not the result i want from a mask. I am a skincare junkie and have found a huge collection of masks that I adore and other products with this latest oil-soluble Vit C that I love but this one is no for me.  But I have yet to find a YTTP product that works for me. Either they break me out or irritate my sensitive skin or they just don’t work for me.

reviews.review_text: I had been using this moisturizer for years, gone through a about a dozen of them.  But I didn’t realize it’s true power until I switched over to a few other moisturizers I thought were more hydrating for the last 6 months.  Last week, I switched back to Lala Retro and the difference in my skin is HUGE.  I’m in awe at how much better my skin looks now that Lala Retro is back in my life.   Now I know.  This really is the best moisturizer for dry skin.  Keeps my skin hydrated all day and all night!  Won’t switch again and I hope they never discontinue it!

reviews.product_name: Magic Cream Moisturizer with Hyaluronic Acid
reviews.review_text: All the videos and ads make you want to buy this moisturizer…but seriously, I’ve tried so many other moisturizers that are more hydrating and perform better for a much more affordable price. It’s not bad but it’s just a lot of hype for something that is “just okay”.  And I’m a huge Charlotte tilbury fan (love the lipsticks, flawless filter, powders, and more).  But I keep trying this cream to see if i can get it to work its magic for me…but it is seriously “just okay”.   Not worth the price.  Save some money and get Drunk Elephant or Tatcha instead for all-day moisture that plumps the skin.

reviews.product_name: Mini Barrier+ Triple Lipid-Peptide Face Cream
reviews.review_text: I am a skincare junkie and I can honestly say this is my LEAST favorite moisturizer of all the dozens and dozens that I’ve used.  It initially impresses with its smooth texture and that key ingredient list.  But this formula does not sink in well.  It kind of just sits on your face and then rubs off.  I figured I’d keep trying it to see how it works. Switching to to this moisturizer actually made my skin even more dry.  I stopped the trial and returned back to my usual favs to rescue my skin. If you have dry skin, go for Drunk Elephant, Ren, or Tatcha for immediate plumping and hydration. Skinfix looks good on paper but there are too many other products that are more effective for similar pricing.  Or if you have the budget, the Skinceuticals version of triple lipids is the best barrier moisturizer you’ll ever try.  I’ve decided to finally stop spending my money on products that people are given for free for review.

reviews.review_text: This cleansing balm has a texture like whipped butter and smells just like fresh papaya! The papaya scent is perfect, it’s so bright and refreshing using it. It melted off my makeup efficiently and quickly, without leaving my skin feeling stripped. After using it, my face looked more radiant and moisturized, and it hasn’t caused any increase in breakouts. I had almost given up on cleansing balms even though my skin is dry because they always seem to flare up my acne, but this one is a total game changer! My skin absolutely loves it & it makes me happy every time I use it because of how bright and summery it smells.

reviews.product_name: Daily UV Defense Invisible Broad Spectrum SPF 36 Sunscreen
reviews.review_text: This sunscreen is fantastic! The packaging is fairly standard, but came safety sealed which is so important with skincare products. The sunscreen itself is a light cream texture with a mild herbal floral scent. I love that it’s not heavily scented and smells natural, it soaks into the skin perfectly, more like a good moisturizer than a normal sunscreen. It didn’t leave my skin feeling tacky or oily, instead it looks perfectly hydrated & radiant. It works perfectly under makeup and didn’t cause any foundation seperation or movement & didn’t leave that odd white cast that some do. My skin is very prone to breakouts with sunscreen, but so far this one hasn’t irritated it a bit. This sunscreen is definitely an HG product, I actually look forward to applying sunscreen now!

reviews.review_title: My skin has never looked better!
reviews.review_text: Good Genes is the first lactic acid based serum that hasn’t caused irritation with my sensitive skin. My skin loves the balance this lactic based serum has with the soothing arnica and other natural ingredients. It’s improved the appearance of the pores around my nose, lightened acne scaring in my chin area, and left my skins texture buttery smooth. I love that it’s cruelty free, natural, and ridiculously effective. Good genes has become an absolute staple in my skincare routine, and my skin has never looked better! This product was gifted by Sunday Riley.

Overall though, I think this is a fantastic product that gives real results for dehydrated and/or aging skin! This product was gifted by La Mer in exchange for my honest review.

This works so much better for me than other hyaluronic acid based creams, my skin stays feeling moisturized for longer with this cream & it leaves such a pretty dewy finish. I’ve been enjoying wearing this alone and under makeup—it works well both ways. Under makeup I’ve noticed it doesn’t pill or cause my foundation to split—this is a must try for all my dry skin baddies!

reviews.review_text: Thank you so much sundayriley for this most loved- Good Genes All-In-One-Lactic-Acid TreatmentMain Ingredients: Lactic acid (AHA), licorice, lemongrass, prickly pear extract, arnica, aloeSkin Type: Dry             Texture:  White creamy        Fragrance: lemongrassMy Experience:I heard from so many people about Sunday Riley products- how effective and amazing they are! I noticed it was easier to smear moisturizer on my face, and I did not need to use as much of it.  This exfoliating serum is so unlike others- it feels like putting lotion on your face! After using, my face is hydrated and glowing- but not in a greasy way.  I thought the aroma was very refreshing like ginger, but it is a lemongrass scent. I am looking forward to the other wonderful benefits this product has to offer, such as brightening the appearance of dark spots, and reducing the look of lines and wrinkles.  I used this product many times and I am confident to say it does not break out my skin!  I will be re-purchasing this product. I am addicted to it as much as my Lancome products!Gifted by Sunday Riley

reviews.product_name: Volcanic AHA Pore Clearing Clay Mask
reviews.review_text: I received this product complimentary from innisfree. I had a great experience with this Innisfree super volcanic pore clay mask! It’s a pretty small jar, only 3.38 ounces, but a little goes a long way. I have used it twice so far on my entire face and there’s only a small amount missing from the jar. It gives you such a luxurious feeling and leaves your skin looking noticeably better, less oily, almost a matte finish and definitely cleaner after just one use. When dry, the mask doesn’t tingle and it gives you a minimal tightening sensation, nothing too crazy or uncomfortable. When it’s time to wash it off, you just get your fingers wet with warm water and swirl it around. It has a very soft, fine exfoliating effect. The volcanic clusters help absorb extra sebum and the AHA helps to exfoliate and minimize pore size. To use, I put this on my face and let it sit 15-20 minutes. This clay mask worked great for my combination skin. What I also love about Innisfree is that it’s a great, very affordable brand delivering effective products!

reviews.product_name: Watermelon Glow Niacinamide Dew Drops
reviews.review_text: I received this product gifted by Glow Recipe. It has a watermelon scent to it that smells absolutely amazing!! After almost 2 weeks using this my skin has been looking great! I have less breakouts and I feel like it’s helping with my skin texture too. I use it in the morning and at night before bed. My skin looks more plump and dewy in the morning.  This product is amazing!! Highlighted Ingredients:- Niacinamide: Vitamin B3 and antioxidants visibly reduce hyperpigmentation, correct the look of dullness, and minimize the appearance of pores.- Watermelon: Hydrates, delivers essential vitamins and amino acids, and visibly brightens skin.- Hyaluronic Acid: A humectant that anchors moisture within the skin, keeping it hydrated and bouncy by retaining 1000 times its weight in water.

reviews.review_text: This is SO good. I mean, it’s just a cleanser. If you want your make-up gone and to not have that tight, weird feeling post-wash, this is perfection. It doesn’t do much for acne or anything else — but it’ll get your make-up off and feels good. :)
