reviews.product_name: Facial Radiance Pads
reviews.review_text: I got the 60-pack as part of the Skin Summit set — and unexpectedly really love it! I figured it would be like a miscellar water/light toner. But it actually gives a nice amount of exfoliation and is super non-irritating! I saw another reviewer say she cuts them in half to make them last longer — this is a genius idea. It works really well. There’s enough product on half to go over the whole face (use both sides).

reviews.product_name: T.L.C. Sukari Babyfacial AHA + BHA Mask
reviews.review_text: Seriously, this is amazing. In Canada, they aren’t selling this for whatever reason... but I got it shipped to an American address because it sounded awesome. I hope Sephora Canada gets this soon because DANG. My skin has never been smoother. And it really helped with hyperpigmentation from recent spots!

reviews.product_name: C.E.O. 15% Vitamin C Brightening Serum
reviews.review_text: LOVE this! I’ve been using it every other night for about a month. Smells lightly orange-y, and evens out my skintone. I’ve also found that it has helped remove recent blemish marks. It’s led to some foundation-free days :) Will likely repurchase!

reviews.product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C
reviews.review_text: Meh. It’s not very moisturizing for me! It does make my lips very smooth and it feels nice. But if your lips are cracking or feel tight in anyway, use something else. Good for when your lips are ALREADY moisturized and you just want something that feels nice.

reviews.product_name: C.E.O. 15% Vitamin C Brightening Serum
reviews.review_text: This is a great Vitamin C serum! I actually *wish* I didn’t love it as much as I do... because it’s raaather pricey. But it’s the best Vit. C I’ve ever tried. Dries down nicely, smells lightly-orangey, and I always wake up with smoother skin that has less blemish pigmentation. Will be repurchasing.

reviews.product_name: Niacinamide 10% + Zinc 1% Oil Control Serum
reviews.review_text: This is a great, cheap summer product! I found it really helped keep my oil under control last summer. And it sat nice under make-up. It *did* make my skin kind of tacky, but that was fine for me. Something to note for personal preference though. For the price, this is everything I wanted and more.

reviews.product_name: Lippe Balm
reviews.review_text: This lasts maybe 10 minutes on my lips (I am not licking it off, it just fades SO quick) and does little to nothing in the way of hydration. The price point is legitimately deranged for this product. I got it in a kit, so I didn’t buy it on its own — and thank goodness. If you are looking for anything more than 10 minute moisture, look elsewhere.

reviews.product_name: B-Hydra Intensive Hydration Serum with Hyaluronic Acid
reviews.review_text: Wow. This provides very little moisture, is not long-lasting, and is extremely expensive. Glad I got this as a deluxe trial size because this is not something to spend money on. Please look elsewhere.

reviews.product_name: Virgin Marula Luxury Face Oil
reviews.review_text: It’s fine. It doesn’t do much for me. It makes my skin soft when it’s on, but once it’s off it’s like it was never there. And it’s too oily/greasy to use during the day... so what’s really the point? I think if you’re looking for a marula oil to use as an occlusive, go with the one from The Ordinary. This is far too expensive to be such a meh product.

reviews.product_name: Beste No. 9 Jelly Cleanser
reviews.review_title: I love jelly cleansers but this one DOES NOT WORK
reviews.review_text: This cleanser is borderline terrible! Even using a makeup remover to take makeup off before washing, this leaves so much residue behind! I never feel clean (and I don’t mean stripped and squeaky — I mean able to pat my face on a white towel and not leave foundation behind). Not acceptable. Especially at this price point. I’ve found all the Drunk Elephant products I’ve tried to be average or below. Don’t think I’ll be purchasing from the brand again.

reviews.product_name: Lala Retro Whipped Refillable Moisturizer with Ceramides
reviews.review_text: This is one of the very few Drunk Elephant products that I like (so I am not some DE stan) — but this moisturizer is really good. AND there’s no smell at all. Which I love. Good winter moisturizer. Took one star off because I don’t think it’s worth the price. FAB ultra repair cream costs less and is better.

reviews.review_text: Wanted to love it because people say it’s great — but it’s chock full of fragrance. I don’t even have super sensitive skin, but fragrance can feel drying. Which is the opposite of what I want in a moisturizer...

reviews.product_name: Avocado Soothing Skin Barrier Serum with Ceramides
reviews.review_text: I am obsessed with this serum that glow recipe gifted me! It has helped with my redness and irritation so much! My skin feels so much better and the serum meshes well with the rest of my skincare routine. It is also super quick to absorb.

reviews.product_name: Self Tanning Bronzing Face Drops
reviews.review_text: This is hands down the best self-tanner I have tried. Other than the usual self-tanner smell you can’t avoid, the color is beautiful as long as you actually apply it correctly. You add the drops to your lotion per section of your body you are working on and apply in a circular motion to avoid this “streaking” some speak of. I have insane amounts of scarring and I bruise really easy which is why I use this- to cover it up. I am fair but olive and 4 drops per section of skin is perfectly natural looking. I am going to try out the dark to see how it works. No, I don’t put this on my face because I’m acne prone. I have also noticed the lotion I use makes a huge difference in how the color pays off. The Neccessaire body lotion works the best. The Sol De J natural lotion is far too thick that it takes forever for it to sink into the skin and I don’t feel the color looks as good. Just play around. Don’t give up too soon!

I also feel like there is no where near as much product in them now as the OG tube. I’m glad I have backups of the OG because I won’t repurchase this one.

reviews.product_name: Cicapair Tiger Grass Color Correcting Treatment SPF 30
reviews.review_text: Okay this product does not smell great. Anyone who says it does is deluding themselves. It has the texture of mud and the odor of something you’d use to disinfect a toilet. But it DOES make you less red instantly, and if used sparingly and per the instructions, can replace foundation so long as you have no large blemishes or dark circles. I have extremely pale, pink toned skin and it works great for me. I love that it has SPF. I will say that going overboard will make you look like the wicked witch of the west. I’ve also found it cannot be used with any powders or in combination with most concealers. But if you want to de-red-ify your face in 20 seconds, this is the product that will do that every time.

reviews.review_text: Literal perfection if you use it as recommended. It dramatically improved my oily but sensitive and breakout prone skin. Start with 1x per week and wash it off early if you feel genuine pain. It leaves skin baby smooth but delicate. Don’t combine with a strong retinol or other acids/exfoliating agents and wear sunscreen after using, you really can get a chemical burn.

reviews.product_name: Natural Moisturizing Factors + HA
reviews.review_title: Find me a better moisturizer for the price
reviews.review_text: Is it La Mer? No. But it’s less than ten dollars and gets the job done. It’s your basic, average moisturizer. Use it on your face, your elbows, your feet, whatever. No weird smells. No weird dyes. Nothing that makes you break out or itch.

reviews.product_name: CC+ Cream Oil-Free Matte with SPF 40
reviews.review_text: I’m on my second tube of this stuff and really like it. It’s thick and creamy, buildable, and doesn’t turn orange and oxidize during the day. The sunscreen is great- I love the high SPF. The formula doesn’t break out my very sensitive, oily skin unless I sleep in it by accident. It can be used with a setting powder or spray and will last a full eight hours unless you sweat. It doesn’t replace foundation though, at least not for me. It’s just a heavier BB.

It’s super gentle for every day usage too and easy to slip into your night time routine before or after your moisturizer! I’ve already had amazing results so far and I can’t wait to continue using it to see better results.

reviews.product_name: Floral Recovery Overnight Mask with Squalane
reviews.review_text: I love the new Fresh floral recovery calming mask! I was a bit hesitant at first because I thought the smell would be too powerful but I ended up loving it! I have a lot of coloring to my skin and this mask really helped reduce and calm the redness! Check this out if you’re looking for a new night mask!

reviews.review_text: I really love this base! It has a lovely citrus scent and creates a great hydrating and smooth layer under your makeup. I don’t think this is an absolutely necessary step in your makeup routine but it’s a lovely addition!

reviews.product_name: Greek Yoghurt Foaming Cream Cleanser
reviews.review_text: I received this item for free from Influenster for testing purposes. My skin is sensitive, but this is super gentle and forgiving! It doesn’t dry my skin out like a lot of other products. Love the all natural ingredients.

reviews.product_name: Lip Glowy Balm
reviews.review_title: Just as nice as I expected it to be
reviews.review_text: I picked this up yesterday at my local Sephora inside JCPenny and I really like it a lot so far! This is my first Laneige product and it was exactly as nice as I expected it to be. The peach smell is very light but definitely there. It’s not strong or “in your face“ at all, but it’s a nice touch. It doesn’t have much of a taste at all. The tint is very, very light and barely there, but it makes my lips look lovely! It lets your natural lip color shine through but makes them look way glossier. It lasts longer than a lot of lip glosses I’ve tried, and doesn’t immediately wash off with eating or drinking. It wears off naturally and doesn’t leave a weird film or anything like so many other products. And the tube is super convenient for whipping out of your purse and applying whenever, wherever! I like it so much I may even buy the other ones eventually!

reviews.product_name: Skinlongevity Long Life Herb Anti-Aging Face Serum
reviews.review_title: Lovely summer serum with great ingredients
reviews.review_text: I received this serum around a week and a half ago and I’m loving it so far! The bright, fresh citrus scent makes it perfect for summer. It’s lightweight and absorbs quickly into the skin, and it wears well under sunscreen and foundation. The bottle tells you to use 2 pumps over the face and neck, but I’ve found that one pump is more than enough.One awesome thing I noticed is that it seemed to fade an annoying acne scar on my upper lip that I was having issues with for a while! It says it can take up to 4 weeks to see results, but I’ve already noticed a slight reduction in redness. I really enjoy the clean ingredients, and the bottle is really well-made as well. It looks beautiful with all my other skincare products!Overall the formula seems gentle and I love the smell. reviews.review_text: I cannot write enough good things about this bottle of miracle. It’s cost efficient, light weight and super EFFECTIVE. I had bad breakouts during pregnancy, and this helped fade my acne scars gradually. It’s a long term effort so don’t expect to fade your scars in a month. reviews.review_text: I use it as a “barrier“ between the pimple and mask. reviews.review_text: This product is a blessing sent from skin care gods. It’s cost efficient and has significantly reduce my breakouts and faded my acne scar. I use it twice a day (am and pm) as indicated and always made sure to moisturize thoroughly. Always, always put on sunscreen if you go out afterwards because SA thins out our skin surface causing our skin to be more prone to sun damage. (Regardless if you use this product or not, you should always sun screen it up!) My skin will be slightly red but it will fade within the next few hours, it’s not an allergic reaction because my skin does not itch or feel tight after.  Overall, I am very happy with this purchase. The only negative I would say is the bottle is tiny. I assume I will need to repurchase after 3 months.

It has a nice texture that applies smoothly and evenly. However, due to cost I probably would not consider purchasing this again. I think their other products out there that I like just as much with a more budget friendly price tag.

reviews.product_name: Advanced Night Repair Eye Concentrate Matrix Synchronized Multi-Recovery Complex
reviews.review_text: I received a free sample size of this product from influencer as part of a voxbox and exchange for my honest review. I like the pretty packaging  and little applicator wand. The wand is cool to the touch when you apply the product to the skin and I feel like a wand will help to get the product out of the bottom of the container. The cream goes on smooth and evenly. It doesn’t pill up when you apply other product on top. I haven’t taken any before & after photos for comparison but I do think it helps with my morning puffiness under my eyes. I would consider purchasing this again, but the price point of the full size product is a little bit prohibitive. Also,  estee lauder is not a cruelty free company which is something i look for when purchasing.

reviews.product_name: Double Serum Firming & Smoothing Anti-Aging Concentrate
reviews.review_text: I received sample of this product from influencer in exchange for my honest review. I don’t love the packaging of the sample sized product. It seems like a lot of plastic packaging waste and it was a little difficult to get all of both components of the serum out. However,  I think the full size packaging would solve this problem nicely since it looks like it’s a pump that would expel both components evenly. i like the texture of the serum - is lightweight and moisturizing without feeling too oily or greasy. i can’t really tell a difference in my fine lines versus with other products,  but i have only used it a few times.  the scent is light and fresh,  won’t fight with other products.  i would consider buying this again,  particularly in winter when i need a little extra moisture boost.

reviews.product_name: Revitalizing Supreme+ Youth Power Creme Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I recieved a free sample of this product from #influenster in exchange for my honest review.  Packaging: pretty,  nice quality container, easy to access product, no waste d/t container shape. Product: creamy,  smooth,  light texture leaves skin feeling moisturized but not oily or greasy. Hard to assess anti-aging benefits d/t size of sample.  Cons: cost - it’s a high end moisturizer which is reflected in the price point.

reviews.product_name: Blue Tansy BHA and Enzyme Pore Refining Mask
reviews.review_title: The smell is driving me crazy
reviews.review_text: I’ve used this a couple of times over the last few days. I definitely notice that my skin is smoother and softer after I wipe the mask off. I haven’t noticed too much of a difference in redness, but my skin always seems to be blotchy no matter what. The one thing I cannot stand is the smell. It’s such a unique smell and it honestly brings on a migraine. I know some people like it, but I just can’t do it. I’m going to keep using it because it was not cheap and I see some positive effects after use, but I don’t know that I can purchase it again. If you can handle the smell, then I definitely think this is a product to try.

reviews.product_name: The Deep Cleanse Gentle Exfoliating Cleanser
reviews.review_title: Great cleanser, but I hate the bottle.
reviews.review_text: I have only been using this product for about a week, but so far I really like it. It smells nice, leaves my skin feeling clean and fresh, and the exfoliating fibers really help to keep my face clear and smooth. My one complaint is the bottle. The way this cleanser is packaged makes it really difficult to get the right amount out. I usually end up getting too much (because a little does go a long way) and for $38 a bottle, I really don’t want to waste any. Plus, it takes me a few squeezes to get anything out of the bottle. I would definitely recommend this to anyone, but will definitely warn the about the bottle. I would probably order this again because I really love Tatcha products, but I will be looking around for another option as well.

reviews.product_name: The Water Cream Oil-Free Pore Minimizing Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I love this moisturizer! I have oily skin and I am pretty selective about moisturizers. I had been using a gel moisturizer that I got from my esthetician and it was kind of bleh. So I decided to splurge on this one and I’m obsessed. It smells so lovely, it has a pretty fresh scent. It is really light and a little bit goes a long way. I typically use about a dime size (sometimes even less) and it covers my entire face without leaving too much of a “lotion-y“ residue. I will definitely be keeping this in my skincare arsenal.

reviews.product_name: Mini The Water Cream
reviews.review_text: I love this moisturizer! I have oily skin and I am pretty selective about moisturizers. I had been using a gel moisturizer that I got from my esthetician and it was kind of bleh. reviews.product_name: Glow2OH Dark Spot Toner
reviews.review_text: I love everything about this toner. I am not an influencer, I am not getting paid for this review, and I am not receiving any benefits for my opinion. I simply love it! It smells WONDERFUL!! I’ve noticed such a transformation in skin after using this every night for a month. I don’t use it twice daily, mostly because I want it to last and I also use a different toner in the morning. It does leave a bit of a residue I’ve noticed, similar to what it feels like when I get salt water on my skin. I don’t mind it and I always put on my moisturizer after. I can’t wait to purchase again!

reviews.product_name: Honeymoon Glow AHA Resurfacing Night Serum
reviews.review_text: This stuff is great! I used to use Skin Editor from Bioelements and that was my first exposure with AHA’s. It worked only ok, so I decided to try something else. I have Farmacy’s Honey Potion and I love it, so I decided to try this out too. It’s a bit sticky, so I don’t use a lot (one pump). I have pretty sensitive, fair skin so I don’t use this every single night. Sometimes, my skin gets a bit red in spots, but since I’m just getting into bed after using it, I don’t mind and this won’t stop me from buying again. I have noticed less hormonal breakouts, smoother skin, and a more balanced complexion. Definitely will keep purchasing!

reviews.product_name: Lala Retro Whipped Refillable Moisturizer with Ceramides
reviews.review_text: There is so much I love about this cream! First I love the packaging. It’s so simple to just push the top down and the perfect amount comes out. This really helps in not wasting product. It does sit a little heavy feeling on the face at first but I kind of like that. It’s very rich and moisturizing. My fave feels so soft in the morning! And that says a lot because I live in the dessert/ dry climate. The scent is not my favorite but not bad.

reviews.product_name: Lippe Balm
reviews.review_text: I’m honestly surprised at some of the lower star ratings. While this is on a bit of the pricier side, it feels so good on my lips. I live in dry climate and it’s winter so I am always battling chapped lips for me and my kids. This feels so refreshing, even my kids love it. I also love how it’s larger surface to get the whole area covered quickly. No weird smell or taste.

reviews.product_name: C-Tango Vitamin C Eye Cream
reviews.review_text: I like the feel of this eye creamer and I love the packaging - it’s cute and the pump is great. It feels refreshing on my skin when I use it each night. I wish it had a little more brightening effect, but otherwise I’ve enjoyed using it. It’s thick and rich, which feels so moisturizing at night.

reviews.product_name: T.L.C. Framboos Glycolic Resurfacing Night Serum
reviews.review_text: Ok, this stuff feels like magic. It’s crazy. I’ve been dealing with very dry skin that breaks out by my jawline. I have been using this every night and my skin has had no breakouts and just feels so clean and smooth. I LOVE this stuff.

reviews.review_text: This cleanser doesn’t have the best smell, but it cleans all my makeup off very well. I like the ingredients and that it doesn’t feel thick and heavy on my skin when using it. My face feels light and very clean after using it. I especially love this paired with the night serum. Such a good combo!

reviews.review_text: Absolutely love this product. It is just as advertised a glowy lip balm. My lips are extremely dry and this adds the perfect amount of hydration that leaves my lips looking glossy without accentuating the dryness like some other lip balms tend to. It has a hint of colour to it but is very natural and wearable. It is stunning and has a great scent. Definitely worth the money if you are looking for a new go to lip balm.

reviews.review_text: This spray is INCREDIBLE. I have extremely dry skin and have been looking for a spray that keeps me looking hydrated and dewy throughout the day and this is exactly that. It doesn’t leave you looking oily or greasy it simply leaves a beautiful glow to the skin. I am obsessed with this and will continue to use this!!!

I apply this underneath my foundation and it looks beautiful, I believe it is worth every penny, and it smells amazing

This is most definitely my new favourite moisturizer and is worth every penny, would recommended to anyone looking to try a new day time moisturizer!!

reviews.product_name: Sugar Hydrating Lip Balm
reviews.review_text: I absolutely LOVE this lip balm. It is so moisturizing and leaves my lips feeling so soft. I use this before bed as a lip mask and there is still lip balm on my lips when I wake up in the morning it is absolutely incredible. I much prefer this lip balm over the laneige lip mask. Would definitely suggest this to anyone looking for a new moisturizing lip balm!!

reviews.product_name: Adaptogen Deep Moisturizing Cream with Ashwagandha + Reishi
reviews.review_text: This moisturizer is fantastic! I was scared to use it because the consistency was so thick  (that usually translates to irritation or break outs for me) but this stuff is the exception to the rule! I’ve been using it for about a week (a little goes a long way) and my skin looks fantastic! Less redness, and my skin stays moisturized all day, and zero break outs!!! Take THAT winter dryness!I’m curious how my skin will react to it during warmer weather- but this is definitely my new go-to during bitter cold Chicago winters!

I feel like after applying, my skin looks a little more greasy than fresh and dewy, but overall I enjoyed this moisturizer. I think it works better for slightly more mature skin!

reviews.product_name: The Dewy Skin Cream Plumping & Hydrating Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: The Tatcha Dewy Skin Cream is FANTASTIC! A little goes a long way for my combination skin. On a normal day I use less than 2 ice cream sprinkles worth of product to achieve a glassy glowing complexion. The spatula provided is not only hygienic, but an amazing tool for dabbing the moisturizer exactly where I want it. A single 1.7oz jar can last me 4-6 months. I no longer wear foundation, so I can’t speak for how it works under face makeup, but I do use Supergoop Unseen Sunscreen primer and the products work together beautifully (no pilling) for a blurred, dewy, glowing look.

reviews.product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C
reviews.review_text: This stuff is incredible!!! I’ve had incredibly chapped lips my entire life. It’s a constant issue for me- the center of my bottom lip near the inside of my mouth will dry up about 10 minutes after applying chapstick. It’s SO annoying!!! I’ve tried everything to smooth and hydrate them, but nothing has worked as well as this mask!!! I use the Lush brand sugar scrub to exfoliate my lips, then apply a thin layer of the Laneige lip sleeping mask, and when I wake up, not only are my lips smooth, but they’re noticeably more plump! This stuff has changed the look and feel of my lips. I’m SO happy I tried this!!!

reviews.product_name: Unseen Sunscreen SPF 40 PA+++
reviews.review_text: I’ve been looking for a sunscreen like this my whole life. It’s amazing. It glides across my skin effortlessly. No white cast, weird oily sheen, or “sun block smell.” I’ve never found a sunscreen that actually improved the look of my skin. I’m really happy this stuff exists!!!

reviews.product_name: Mini Unseen Sunscreen SPF 40 PA+++

reviews.product_name: Lactic Acid 10% + HA 2% Exfoliating Serum
reviews.review_text: Impressive price point, and beautiful glass dropper bottle.I will have this on my shelf forever. I tried a lotion sample recently that broke out my chin. In the evening I washed my face, dabbed The Ordinary lactic acid onto my skin, then applied my trusted calming moisturizer. I woke up to smooth skin with virtually no blemishes, reduced dark spots, and noticeably shrunken pores. It makes me feel like I have a little more control over my unpredictable skin!You just have to be very careful in the sun for at least a week after using! Lots of sunscreen, and bring a hat- your skin will thank you!Just try this stuff if it sounds right for you!!!

reviews.product_name: Glowscreen Sunscreen SPF 40 PA+++ with Hyaluronic Acid + Niacinamide
reviews.review_text: I love the unseen sunscreen, but the glow screen is a “no” for me. This stuff exaggerates every line and pore on my face. I’m almost 30 but this made me look 40. (40 is fabulous- but not what I’m going for, lol) There’s no smoothing effect, so this stuff just sinks in to every flaw and puts a spotlight on it. If you already have flawless skin, and you just want to look a little more radiant, then this would be good to add to your routine- otherwise I’d recommend the unseen sunscreen.

reviews.review_text: Ok I love this stuff. It works great and my chapped lips are so much better by morning. There is no scent and no taste which is important to me as well. Love this and will buy again!

reviews.product_name: T.L.C. Framboos Glycolic Resurfacing Night Serum
reviews.review_text: I’m really enjoying this stuff! Not to be a nerd but the packaging is great and I love the fact that you can twist open and close the pump so I can throw it in my bag. This goes on smooth and doesn’t sting. I didn’t have issues even though I have sensitive skin. It also has a light to almost non-existent scent which is important to me. I will continue to add this to my routine.

reviews.product_name: Lala Retro Whipped Refillable Moisturizer with Ceramides
reviews.review_text: I received a sample size of this and really liked it. It goes on smooth and has a light scent. No issues with my sensitive skin either. Seems really hydrating and I might just buy a full size next!

reviews.product_name: Take The Day Off Cleansing Balm Makeup Remover
reviews.review_text: Love this stuff! I was using coconut oil to take my makeup off but felt I could never get the oily feeling off my face after many cleansers. This balm just takes all my makeup off and my face is completely clean after with no residue! Highly recommend and will continue to purchase!

reviews.product_name: Mini Take The Day Off Cleansing Balm Makeup Remover
reviews.review_text: Love this stuff! I was using coconut oil to take my makeup off but felt I could never get the oily feeling off my face after many cleansers. This balm just takes all my makeup off and my face is completely clean after with no residue! Highly recommend and will continue to purchase!

reviews.product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C
reviews.review_text: This mask is so good! I love the smell and how creamy it feels on my lips. I subtracted 1 star because I definitely don’t wake up with it still lathered on my lips. I’ve been using it for about a month now and I still have so much left so will definitely last you a good amount of time!

reviews.product_name: Moisturizing Eye Bomb with Squalane
reviews.review_text: I got a sample of this in my Play Box for the month of February and it’s incredible. The gel is so creamy and makes my under eyes the smoothest they’ve ever been. Since I’m in my 20’s I feel I don’t need the thick creams that most eye creams are. Will definitely purchase the full size when I run out.

reviews.product_name: T.L.C. Framboos Glycolic Resurfacing Night Serum
reviews.review_text: I was SO hesitant to spend $90 on a serum so I’ve bought everything else under the sun. I bought a Sephora set in the winter that had a mini of this night serum and GOODBYE TEXTURE! I bought a full size during the spring sale and I’m SO HAPPY I DID! My mom even mentioned how clear my skin was looking! I can’t recommend this enough and will continue to purchase this miracle worker!

reviews.product_name: Virgin Marula Luxury Face Oil
reviews.review_text: I have dry skin and have been using this for about 10 months and just ran out. At first I didn’t notice a big difference when I mixed it in with my moisturizer, but recently I have been putting it on before moisturizer and I’m noticing my skin is so much more hydrated than before. I just purchased another bottle!

reviews.product_name: Beste No. 9 Jelly Cleanser
reviews.review_text: Really simple, clean cleanser. I don’t like to irritate my skin, especially when I’m having a bad breakout. This cleanser is gentle and leaves my skin feeling balanced/ refreshed.

reviews.product_name: Protini Polypeptide Firming Refillable Moisturizer
reviews.review_title: permanently added into my daily routine!
reviews.review_text: My favorite moisturizer, hands down. I always try to find something similar and more affordable, but I always end up going back to Protini (I first tried this product as one of my free Sephora birthday gifts). I love how light weight it is and how it’s unscented.

reviews.product_name: Hyaluronic Acid 2% + B5 Hydrating Serum
reviews.review_text: I really like this product! The serum is hydrating and has a great consistency. It’s not too sticky or oily at all. It sits under my moisturizer and makeup perfectly.

reviews.product_name: T.L.C. Framboos Glycolic Resurfacing Night Serum
reviews.review_text: I use this product every other night (I use a retinol on other nights) and I love how to helps my skin! It’s light and a little goes a long way!

reviews.product_name: T.L.C. Sukari Babyfacial AHA + BHA Mask
reviews.review_text: I love drunk elephant. This was one of the last products that I tried from their line, but I love it! I use it every Sunday to exfoliate my skin. Takes a little getting used to (maybe like 4 uses) because it tingles a lot at first; it was hard to wait the whole 20 minutes. But stick with it, you’ll love it!

reviews.product_name: Unseen Sunscreen SPF 40 PA+++
reviews.review_text: I love sunscreen so I’ve tried a lot. And nothing really compares to this one. No white cast whatsoever. Feels soft and smooth, and just melts into the skin. For the price, little goes such a long way. Couldn’t be happier with this product.

reviews.product_name: Mini Unseen Sunscreen SPF 40 PA+++
reviews.review_text: I love sunscreen so I’ve tried a lot. And nothing really compares to this one. No white cast whatsoever. Feels soft and smooth, and just melts into the skin. For the price, little goes such a long way. Couldn’t be happier with this product.

reviews.product_name: GENIUS Liquid Collagen Serum
reviews.review_text: My skin drank this stuff up! It made my skin feel full and smooth. I have sensitive oily/combo skin and I’m in my mid-twenties, and this did not aggravate my skin. I was hesitant to purchase at first since some people were having issues with reddness, itchiness, and dryness, so I only used the sample size so far. Now I am considering getting the full size! I could easily add this into my daily routine or at least have it as a special product for the weekend to give my skin some life.

reviews.product_name: Superfood Air-Whip Lightweight Moisturizer with Hyaluronic Acid
reviews.review_text: I love this moisturizer! It evens out my skin since I mainly have normal to oily skin with redness from sensitivity. My nose is the oiliest part of my face and when I use the moisturizer, it calms my skin down and I wake up with even skin that leans closer to normal. I think it would be perfect for those with combo and oily skin that have trouble maintaining their skin in the summertime. It plays nicely with my makeup and I can get away with gently powdering over my face for full days because it reduced the redness in my sensitive skin and lessened how oily I get. I will be repurchasing! I think it would be a great staple piece in my skincare :)

reviews.product_name: Superberry Hydrate + Glow Dream Night Mask with Vitamin C
reviews.review_text: I was so surprised when I got my first sample. Some of the products are hit or miss with me from YTTP. I’ve tried the air-whip moisturizer because I saw it was good for oily-dehydrated skin and loved it. So I got a sample of this to test it out and see if it was worth getting a full size and BOY IT’S GREAT. I noticed when my skin is dry, it softens and hydrates while reducing the amount of sebum on my T zone so I barely get oily throughout the night and day. I got a 2nd sample with my points and plan to get a full size once they’re both out. I love using it as my moisturizer after a toner and serum.

reviews.product_name: Mini Superberry Hydrate + Glow Dream Mask
reviews.review_text: I was so surprised when I got my first sample. Some of the products are hit or miss with me from YTTP. I’ve tried the air-whip moisturizer because I saw it was good for oily-dehydrated skin and loved it. So I got a sample of this to test it out and see if it was worth getting a full size and BOY IT’S GREAT. I noticed when my skin is dry, it softens and hydrates while reducing the amount of sebum on my T zone so I barely get oily throughout the night and day. I got a 2nd sample with my points and plan to get a full size once they’re both out. I love using it as my moisturizer after a toner and serum.

reviews.product_name: Plum Plump Hyaluronic Acid Serum
reviews.review_text: This serum is soooo nice and helped me with my dehydrated skin. It’s silky smooth and light weight. I wake up with soft plump skin. I would definitely repurchase again.

reviews.product_name: Ultra Repair Cream Intense Hydration
reviews.review_text: I have combo/oily dehydrated skin and I’m allergic to eucalyptus (last ingredient on the list). I’m surprised that I don’t have any itchiness from the eucalyptus and my skin LOVES this formula. It takes a moment for it to sink in but I’m left with soft and refreshed skin. I think this is one of my favorite moisturizers. I only received the sample size with my points but I plan to get the big size once I’m out!!

reviews.product_name: C.E.O. 15% Vitamin C Brightening Serum
reviews.review_text: I was hesitant to try this at first because of the price. I was using products from The Ordinary, and while I think they tend to work decently well, I hate the texture of pretty much all of them. CEO’s texture is exactly what I wanted - a creamy serum that isn’t sticky and that my skin soaks up well. My skin is brighter and more even-toned when I use 1/2 a pump about once very other day. (I do think the instructions say to use WAY too much.) I used to wear a lot of makeup every day and now I rarely use any! I’m feeling pretty loyal to SR now. Just bought Good Genes and will be trying A+ when my current retinoid runs out.

reviews.product_name: Papaya Sorbet Smoothing Enzyme Cleansing Balm & Makeup Remover
reviews.review_text: Pros: nice container, comes with a spatula, nice texture, smells decent - fruity and kind of like a cocktail.Cons: seems to leave a film on my face, which isn’t a huge deal because it comes off during my second cleanse, but I really don’t like it.I wouldn’t NOT recommend it, but I think there are better options. The scent is a little to heavy for me and it really bothers me that it doesn’t seem to come off very well until I do my second cleanse.I will finish this jar but probably won’t repurchase. I still really like this brand overall.

reviews.product_name: Barrier+ Triple Lipid-Peptide Face Cream
reviews.review_text: Helped my skin so much after I overdid it and wrecked my moisture barrier! It’s very thick and rich. Not at all a problem for night time, but since I also used it in the morning, I would give it about 10-15 minutes to absorb before applying sunscreen. I will probably continue using at night, but use something lighter during the day since my skin has healed.

reviews.product_name: Mini Barrier+ Triple Lipid-Peptide Face Cream
reviews.review_text: Helped my skin so much after I overdid it and wrecked my moisture barrier! It’s very thick and rich. Not at all a problem for night time, but since I also used it in the morning, I would give it about 10-15 minutes to absorb before applying sunscreen. I will probably continue using at night, but use something lighter during the day since my skin has healed.

reviews.product_name: Squalane + Marine Algae Firming & Lifting Eye Cream
reviews.review_text: I really love this stuff. It feels silky and luxurious and is super hydrating. It also doesn’t have a scent. I usually like a light scent to my products, but not for something that goes near the eyes, so this is great. It also lasts a long time. I’ve had it for 5 months, and at this rate it’ll last me a year or more. I luckily don’t have any lines around my eyes yet, so I can’t speak to how this product helps wrinkles and fine lines, but I do think the skin around my eyes looks more plump and hydrated versus not using an eye cream.

reviews.product_name: Avocado Fine Line Eye Cream with Retinol
reviews.review_text: Glow Recipe can be hit and miss for me, but I really like this eye cream. The texture is great, like a mix between a rich cream and a thick gel. It’s not irritating and has no scent. A little goes a long way. I’ve probably got about a month left of use and I’ve been using it for 8 months. I only use it at night because of the retinol. It’s hard for me to say if it does much for wrinkles or fine lines because I don’t really have any yet (just being preventative right now), but my eye area has generally looked better since I started using it. Bonus, Glow Recipe’s packaging is really cute.

reviews.product_name: The Water Cream Oil-Free Pore Minimizing Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I love this stuff. I had worked my way through several samples and couldn’t bring myself to buy the full-size, so I spent a lot of time looking for dupes. I just couldn’t find anything that compared. It melts into my skin so quickly without any stickiness and leaves my face feeling super soft. It’s a perfect warm-weather moisturizer for me (I live in the Midwest where summers are hot and humid.) My skin actually leans dry but this stuff still does the job. I seriously love it. In the colder months when I get really dry I, I use Tatcha’s Dewy Skin Cream. It doesn’t sink in as easily as this one but my skin drinks it up in the cold weather. If I could only have one though, it would be this one. I never thought I’d find a moisturizer that absorbs so well.It also smells amazing, in my opinion. I know some people are adverse to fragrance, but I think it’s light enough and a really nice smell. It’s earthy but a little sweet, nothing overwhelming.I pretty much don’t ever give five-star reviews to skincare products because they never seem to live up to the hype, but this is my exception. And I’ve never said this about a product before (and I’ve tried a lot), but I’m pretty sure I can’t go without this now! It’s my absolute favorite.

And I’ve never said this about a product before (and I’ve tried a lot), but I’m pretty sure I can’t go without this now! It’s my absolute favorite.

reviews.product_name: Original Skin Retexturizing Mask with Rose Clay
reviews.review_text: I received a sample of the Original Skin mask, and wow, I’m impressed!  I have enlarged pores and old acne scars, and just with one application, my pores were more refined and my scars smoother.  I’ve tried so many masks, and this is the first one to give such impressive results.  Even my husband asked me the next day if I changed my make-up because my skin looked really good.  Nope!  Same make-up, but I believe the mask worked so well that my make-up applied smoother than usual.  I do recommend, especially if you have maturing and/or problematic skin.

reviews.product_name: Superfood Antioxidant Cleanser
reviews.review_text: This cleanser performs very well and has a nice fresh scent. I only knocked off 1 star because I’ve found it to be a tad too drying for my combination skin. Perhaps this may be better for me during summer when it is hot and humid? For now, though, I cannot use this cleanser every day because of it being a little too drying. I definitely recommend it if you have oily skin or after working out, etc.

reviews.product_name: Mini Superfood Antioxidant Cleanser
reviews.review_text: This cleanser performs very well and has a nice fresh scent. I only knocked off 1 star because I’ve found it to be a tad too drying for my combination skin. Perhaps this may be better for me during summer when it is hot and humid? For now, though, I cannot use this cleanser every day because of it being a little too drying. I definitely recommend it if you have oily skin or after working out, etc.

reviews.product_name: Vinosource-Hydra Moisturizing Sorbet
reviews.review_text: I love this moisturizer because it’s light-weight yet nourishing for my combination skin. It wears well underneath make-up, and it’s amazing on no make-up days. It has a cooling feel and helps to smooth pores, too.

reviews.product_name: Mini Watermelon Pink Juice Oil-Free Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I have combination skin that’s oilier during the summertime but still needs a moisturizer. The Pink Juice Oil-Free Moisturizer has worked nicely as a lightweight formula for summer. It feels refreshing and plumping without stickiness or making my face an oil slick.

reviews.product_name: Multi-Peptide + HA Serum
reviews.review_text: So far this product is working beautifully and I’m noticing improvement with complexion and fine lines. I have a sensitive acne-prone skin, and this hasn’t caused any negative reaction or break-out (surprisingly it is hard to find face products that don’t cause issues). I appreciate there is no scent or added perfumes.This is a solid and affordable option for those with sensitive skin who simply want a serum that works without added unnecessary ingredients like perfume.

reviews.product_name: Tonique Confort Re-Hydrating Comforting Toner with Acacia Honey
reviews.review_text: I received tonique confort for testing purposes and I like it! The rose water smells amazing and it was thicker than I expected. Left my skin feeling fresh and moisturized. I’m not sure where it fits in as a necessity to my skincare regime but it’s been a nice treat.

reviews.product_name: Hydra Zen Gel-Cream Oil-Free Moisturizer with Salicylic Acid
reviews.review_text: I received Hydra Zen Gel moisturizer complimentary for testing purposes and I like it! The rose water addition smells wonderful and leaves skin feeling refreshed; however, I can’t give it 5 stars because it was a bit heavy for my skin. Will definitely continue use to see if the feeling improves!

reviews.product_name: B-Hydra Intensive Hydration Serum with Hyaluronic Acid
reviews.review_text: Fantastically hydrating and wonderful when used in conjunction with Drunk Elephant vitamin C serum, leaves my skin looking awake and refreshed. I’m looking forward to seeing the long term results!

reviews.product_name: Umbra Sheer Physical Daily Defense SPF 30
reviews.review_text: I’m incredibly fair skinned with a history of melanoma so daily SPF is non-negotiable for me. Umbra sheer is super light weight and goes on easily after moisturizer. It’s scent free and I will definitely continue use.

reviews.product_name: Smart Clinical Repair Wrinkle Correcting Eye Cream
reviews.review_text: I’ve been using this product for about a week now and so far so great! It’s moisturizing, gentle, smells nice, and helps plump my fine lines!

reviews.product_name: Mini Virgin Marula LuxuryFace Oil
reviews.review_text: Hear me out. I am NOT a facial oil person. But this stuff works wonders. it doesn’t feel greasy and soaks right in, but give you a lot of hydration (depending on how many drops you add)

reviews.product_name: Retinol Anti-Aging Serum
reviews.review_text: I like the texture of this, as well as the fragrance free aspect. The squalene also helps me feel somewhat hydrated before moisturizer, doesn’t dry me out!

reviews.product_name: Watermelon Glow Niacinamide Dew Drops
reviews.review_text: This is my new favorite product i’ve ever used. it makes me look so glowy and bright and hydrated with no gross feeling. this brand changed my skin in a great way

reviews.product_name: The True Cream Aqua Bomb
reviews.review_text: This is the most lightweight, dewy, hydrating moisturizer around. I tried it because I fell in love with the moisturizer gel concept after trying Stila’s Face The Day (but not available on Sephora so tried this!). I love the way this feels on my face - so fresh and light! My skin glows with this stuff.

reviews.product_name: Soy Hydrating Gentle Face Cleanser
reviews.review_text: I love the smell - one of my favorite face washes. The mini size is my favorite to keep in my bag for travel.

reviews.product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C
reviews.review_text: I use this EVERY night and it has last 2 years!! It is my favorite- smooth, feels great and stays on. I will use this forever.

reviews.product_name: Greek Yoghurt Foaming Cream Cleanser
reviews.review_text: I enjoyed using this cleanser. I tried washing my face with both with my FOREO and just my hands. Both ways it foamed up nicely. It felt like a very gentle cleanser but my face still felt very clean after using it. My only complain it I personally found the scent a little strong and perfumey but the smell doesn’t linger so it wasn’t an issue. I did receive this product free from influenster for review purposes.

reviews.product_name: Alpha Beta Pore Perfecting & Refining Serum
reviews.review_title: Nice serum, does what it's intended to do
reviews.review_text: I tried this serum through PINCH ME. I enjoyed trying it. At first I didn’t notice a difference but by the end of the week my pores were definitely less visible. I have not yet decided if I will purchase a bottle but I totally recommend it for those who have blackheads and visible pores.

reviews.product_name: Plum Plump Hyaluronic Acid Serum
reviews.review_text: I received a bottle of this from influenster for free to try. I ave tried a few things from this brand before, the watermelon juice serum and the pineapple stuff and I really didn’t care for those. They were sticky and left my face feeling weird. I love this though. Hello hydration!! I will be buying more when my bottle is empty!

reviews.product_name: Sugar Hydrating Lip Balm
reviews.review_text: I love the smell of this and how moisturizing it is! It doesn’t taste the best though.  Only thing is after using it I noticed my lips were drier. I didn’t see hyaluronic acid or glycerin in the ingredients so maybe it’s just me.

reviews.product_name: Cold Plunge Pore Mask
reviews.review_text: I love this mask! The color is so pretty for one and for two it cleanses your skin so thoroughly. After I washed it off my skin was so soft and looked so much cleaner especially my pores. Only thing is it’s a little pricey. I recommend waiting til it’s on sale on the brands website. I got this and the sauna scrub for $11.02!

reviews.product_name: Rose & Hyaluronic Acid Deep Hydration Toner
reviews.review_text: I liked the way this toner made my skin look but it has too much fragrance in my opinion. Overall if you don’t mind the heavy rose smell it’s good! It left my skin hydrated and didn’t make me break out or red. (I have sensitive skin)

reviews.product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C
reviews.review_text: This is my least favorite, not because it’s bad I just prefer the vanilla and original. I don’t mind the smell, but I don’t prefer it. The formula is still amazing though! So hydrating and leaves my lips so soft and never dry

reviews.product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C
reviews.review_text: Smells like strawberry banana and is so freaking hydrating. I rotate between this one and the other two and my lips are never dry. It basically melts onto ur lips.

reviews.product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C
reviews.review_text: I have all three and the vanilla is by far my favorite. It smells so good. the formula is the same through out I just love vanilla so much! It is so hydrating. I always put it on before I go to bed and it leaves my lip so soft and never dry. I highly recommend.

reviews.product_name: Dreamskin Skin Perfector
reviews.review_text: I like this skin perfecting primer. It has a silky texture and good skincare ingredients. As a makeup artist, I used this on myself and my clients and got beautiful results. 1 drawback was it made my skin itch a tiny bit but I will still use it.

reviews.product_name: Aqua Bomb Overnight Lip Mask
reviews.review_text: I received this product free from @influenster in exchange for my honest review. I always battle chapped lips so this a product I can get behind! Quite simply, it works. The texture is thick and rich with hydrating ingredients. When I sleep in it, I wake up with nice soft smooth lips!

reviews.product_name: Revitalizing Supreme+ Youth Power Creme Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: This is a very rich, thick moisturizing cream. My skin feels very hydrated after using and I love that there is no greasy residue. I helps with fine lines and lack of firmness. I would reccomend to those with dry skin.

reviews.product_name: Mini Revitalizing Supreme+ Youth Power Creme Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: This is a very rich, thick moisturizing cream. My skin feels very hydrated after using and I love that there is no greasy residue. I helps with fine lines and lack of firmness. I would reccomend to those with dry skin.

reviews.product_name: Vegan Milk Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: Goes on heavy at first but then feels very light! Made my skin sooooo soft!

reviews.product_name: Watermelon Glow PHA + BHA Pore-Tight Toner
reviews.review_text: Love this! Smells great and feels great on my skin!

reviews.product_name: Mini Watermelon Glow PHA + BHA Pore-Tight Toner
reviews.review_text: Love this! Smells great and feels great on my skin!

reviews.product_name: The Dewy Serum Resurfacing and Plumping Treatment
reviews.review_text: Love this! Super lightweight and goes so smoothly in skin. Smells great!

reviews.product_name: The Essence Skincare Boosting Treatment
reviews.review_text: This product is life changing! At first glance and because I cannot lie, this product looked like plain water to me however, after researching it a bit further on the Tatcha website I decided to give it a go. And I am so happy I did! I have always enjoyed low maitenance skincare routines, and this is so easy to incorporate. You simply splash a tiny bit on your palm (has a feet spout dispenser) and press it into the skin. After continued use, I can definitely say it makes my skin so hydrated, even in tone, and as if my moisture barrier is not being compromised. Although the price is steep, it is really worth the plunge and did not make me break out. In fact, it has significantly helped in reducing breakouts and inflammation.

reviews.product_name: Mini The Essence  Skincare Boosting Treatment
reviews.review_text: This product is life changing! reviews.product_name: Violet-C Brightening Serum 20% Vitamin C + 10% AHA
reviews.review_text: I absolutely love this product! I have been using it for roughly around one month now and have seen great results, but also really enjoy and look forward to using the product each and every day. I use the product after cleansing my skin, and following the tatcha essence. The product is smooth, lightweight, and offers a barely-there feel. You can feel it soaking in after application and it leaves the skin so smooth. I can not recommend this enough! It really stands out from other vitamin-c serums, as my skin is much more noticeably smoother, brighter, and even in texture.

reviews.product_name: Vegan Milk Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: This moisturizer is absolutely AMAZING! Hands down the best one I honestly think I have ever used. I have extremely sensitive skin and this did not irritate me at all and in fact, healed my skin more than any other has in a very long time (if not ever). I cannot recommend this enough and, i also want to add, if you have normal- dry skin you will probably like this best. Others, I would simply use at night. It is not sticky at all and sinks right into the skin (won’t even get on your pillow at night). Amazing amazing product!!

reviews.product_name: Ultimate Sun Protector Lotion SPF 50+ Sunscreen
reviews.review_text: This sunscreen works so well. I love the feel of the sunscreen. It does not feel sticky or slimy. The packaging is really luxurious and the size of the bottle is pretty substantial. It will last a long time.

reviews.product_name: Clear Sunscreen Stick SPF 50+
reviews.review_text: This sunscreen stick is amazing. The packaging is lovely and compact. Perfect to throw in your bag for quick touchups. The sunscreen glides on smoothly and does not feel sticky and slimy. I really like the scent and think this will be a great addition to my skincare routine. I received this item for review purposes but the opinions are my own

reviews.product_name: Advanced Night Repair Eye Gel-Cream
reviews.review_text: Luxurious and thick eye cream that goes on smooth and provides long term hydration

reviews.product_name: GENIUS Sleeping Collagen Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: This is a must-have! The thick cream allows your skin to drench and moisturize overnight. After two weeks I could tell a huge difference in my skin firmness and softness.Careful not to put too much on - a little goes a long way!

reviews.product_name: Sugar Strawberry Exfoliating Face Wash

The texture is somewhere between a cream and a whip, it sinks into the skin so quickly and I don’t have to rub and tug on my face. It’s so soft and non-intrusive, there’s no annoying fragrance and I know it will last me all night despite the light weight texture. As a bonus, the dry patch around my eye is gone, and only pops up if I skip on an application. Will never have to try a new moisturizer again!

reviews.product_name: Honeymoon Glow AHA Resurfacing Night Serum

reviews.review_text: I was looking for a new moisturizer for the winter months when I stumbled upon this product. My skin type I would classify as normal, but with the occasional breakout. I was a little worried, because, in the past with heavier creams my face will react by getting little small bumps mostly in my t-zone. However, I have had this product for maybe a week now and I still have not broken out. A little product goes a long way. I also appreciate that I do not notice a fragrance with this moisturizer. Definitely would repurchase.

reviews.review_title: Great product, if a bit watery
reviews.review_text: Sunday Riley Auto Correct really helps with de-puffing eyes and getting rid of dark circles. I cannot tell you anything about fine lines and wrinkles, as I don’t have them. However, it is a bit watery. I like the fact that you only need a tiny amount of the product to cover the entire eye area. That is a huge plus, it will take forever to use up this bottle, It comes in a 0.5 fl.oz. bottle. I noticed my dark circles and puffiness were gone within about a week of using regularly, so that is a positive.

reviews.product_name: ICE Ceramide Moisturizer with Vitamin F
reviews.review_text: I have very dry skin (all my life but worse now due to menopause) and this cream is extremely rich and thick. It is chock full of ceramides and glycerin to help moisturize the skin and keep it hydrated. It definitely works well, somewhat better than other creams. I would only recommend this cream for those with dry and mature skins, as it is so think and rich. It would be too heavy for those with sebum production. ICE does sink into the skin though and leaves it feeling soft and supple, Definitely worth the price and I would actually purchase this cream even though i received it as a free sample. It has been keeping my dry skin on lockdown throughout the cold winter nights.

reviews.product_name: Ready Steady Glow Daily AHA Tonic
reviews.review_text: This tonic is very powerful. I would recommend its use on everyone except those with sensitive skin types (if you have sensitive skin and want to try it, do a patch test first). Dry and mature skins can use this but possibly only 2-3 times a week at the most. If you have normal skin, use this 3-4 times a week. Combination and oily skins could use this tonic more times, up to every day. I would say people with acneic skin can use this daily too. Make sure not to use it on open lesions. I used it on my dry skin and the next two days my skin was literally coming off my face in in little balls when I rubbed on it. It exfoliates very well. Brightening effects take longer, as the ingredients in it have to literally stop melanin production in the melanocytes. As the skin exfoliates though and moves up through the layers of the epidermis through the 30 day cycle, skin will brighten and you will notice a difference. Almost all of the ingredients listed in this formula have brightening properties. Some have dual exfoliating/brightening properties. This product also helps to clear clogged pores, so you might notice a little purging too. I had a little bit of purging on my chin after I started to use it. I love this tonic and feel it is useful for those who want to achieve gentle exfoliation of the skin and some mild to moderate brightening effects. When I mean gentle, I mean a gentle yet powerful exfoliation that is not physical (like a scrub). I prefer chemical exfoliants over scrubs because they loosen the cells that are held together rather than literally tearing them off of the skin. Plus this tonic smells divine!

reviews.review_text: I used this as a body sunscreen as I normally use moisturizer with SPF in it for my face. I found this product to be a non-sticky and non-oily sunscreen once set, which is something I enjoy in my sunscreen products.

reviews.review_title: Nice and easy sunscreen for your face

While putting it on initially I was worried that it would be greasy but after I distributed the product over my face and let it set, it felt like I hadn’t even put anything on my face. If you are to put face makeup on over top of this I would suggest letting it set first before applying any concealer or foundation (as you should with most sunscreens or moisturizers).

reviews.review_text: The Kiehl’s Ultra Facial Cream with Squalane is a nice basic moisturizer. The texture is nice, it smells like nothing (no fragrance and no off putting natural scent. I love that kiehl’s uses a lot of natural ingredients. The Kiehl’s Ultra Facial Cream with Squalane leaves my very dry skin moisturized for the majority of the day, does not clog my pores or any other negatives you can run into with some moisturizers. I haven’t been able to evaluate long term results, since I have only been using it for a few weeks. I do like it, nothing stands out about it but it is a good basic dependable moisturizer made with good ingredients.

reviews.product_name: Smart Clinical Repair Wrinkle Correcting Cream
reviews.review_text: I was a little wary of the smart clinical wrinkle repair living up to its claims. I have new (40s) dry skin that I’m still learning how to navigate. I always had hydrated skin with few blemishes. As I have aged it needs moisture but then the products cause breakouts or clogged pores. That is not the case with this Clinique product. I’m going to sound cheese saying this, but using this nightly has caused my skin to be younger again. It stays hydrated, no breakouts and my emerging wrinkles are kept at bay. I’m shocked. My biggest applause is keeping my skin hydrated all night and into the next day. I put a very light moisturizer on in the morning and I’m golden. I got this as a sample and already bought the full size. It’s a holy grail for me now.

I loved it so much, and I have super sensitive skin that reacts to everything so when my skin liked this I was hooked! I bought the full size and put the pump in and noticed the next day a green ooze of cleanser all down the bottle and onto my shower floor. I have lost at least 1/3 of all the product due to the pressure or whatever is causing the excess leakage. When I repurchase, I won’t be putting the pump in. The price can also seem steep but this is 8 oz, and the price per oz is actually very comparable to ’cheaper’ options!

reviews.product_name: Cleansing & Exfoliating Wipes
reviews.review_text: Five stars all the way. Sephora really tries to make sure that the products they produce are completely as good as any other products available in their store which...is more than some other bigger beauty retailers that I wont mention but name is a 4 letter word and starts  with a “U“ ...their products range anywhere from subpar to entirely terrible...but not sephora. Sephora offers excellent products at fair prices and these wipes are a great example of that. I have very dry sensitive skin.  most of the most gentle face creams and serums make my skin burn. THAT’S  how sensitive. These smelled wonderful.  Like fresh roses.  They were so gentle and didnt burn my face (most wipes do) and they actually remove makeup very well. I highly recommend these. On a side note...these wipes along with all makeup wipes...do not remove mascara very easily. Everyone knows that. So if you’re judging the quality of a wipe by how fast or how well it removes dried on mascara from your lashes...you’re gonna be disappointed in every brand you find.

reviews.product_name: Vitamin Enriched Face Base Priming Moisturizer
reviews.review_title: you might be surprised at how i use this - READ ON
reviews.review_text: This is far too moisturizing to use as a primer on my combo leaning dry skin. BUT I am 38 years old and as of late, my under eye area is becoming harder and harder to find a good concealer for and I must wear concealer due to hereditary  dark circles. I use moisturizer and an eye cream but the creases are so bad. I couldn’t get a smooth application until THIS. I got curious one day and dabbed a little on my under eyes over my already set eye cream. Waited a minute for it to sink in then put on my Kylie concealer. MAGIC!!! It was so smooth and wrinkle free so, the next day I got curious... if it works that good for me with my best concealer ... let me try it with the one that creases the worst so I used the Nars pot of concealer that all the you tubers rave about but I’ve never been able to wear because it’s too thick and too matte . It looked even more beautiful. My point is: if this stuff doesn’t initially work as an all over the face primer .. if it’s too greasy and makes your foundation slip around... try it under your eyes or just on the drier parts of your face ... anywhere you crease at ... maybe even laugh lines. It’s definitely the perfect fix for dryness and creases !!!

reviews.product_name: B-Hydra Intensive Hydration Serum with Hyaluronic Acid
reviews.review_text: This serum is pretty good. I have really dry skin so I almost wish it was a bit more hydrating. However, it does have a nice consistency and it doesn’t irritate my skin. This would probably be great for someone with oily skin.

reviews.product_name: Umbra Sheer Physical Daily Defense SPF 30
reviews.review_text: I’m not sure why this product has mixed reviews! I loved this spf. Granted, it is a bit thick so it may be best for someone like me who has dry skin. It didn’t leave a crazy white cast on me or anything, but it made my skin feel smooth prior to applying my makeup. I have no complains. I would repurchase.

reviews.product_name: Ultimate Sun Protector Lotion SPF 50+ Sunscreen
reviews.review_text: I love the thin consistency of this product. I wish the face version had the same consistency! This is thin and has a light pleasant smell. I have sensitive skin and this does not irritate my skin at all.

reviews.product_name: The True Cream Aqua Bomb
reviews.review_text: I received this product free to try in exchange for a review. I liked this product and it was really hydrating for my dry skin. I will use this in the day time since it’s not heavy enough for evening. Great moisturizer

reviews.product_name: Vegan Milk Moisturizer
reviews.review_title: not for dry patch prone dry skin

reviews.review_text: I received Ole Henriksen Dewtopia for free from Influenster for my honest opinion. I really love this product. It absorbs fast. The consistency is a thicker gel like serum. reviews.review_text: I received Kiehl’s Eye Serum for free from Bzz Agent for my honest opinion. I used this serum for 8 weeks and can totally see a difference with the darkness under my eyes. It is smoothing and hydrating. Im in love with the texture. This has become a new staple in my everyday skincare routine!

reviews.product_name: Vinoperfect Radiance Dark Spot Serum Vitamin C Alternative
reviews.review_text: I received this serum as a #freeproduct from #trywithtopbox for my opinion. I think this serum is really great! It’s very lightweight with a milky type texture. reviews.product_name: Confidence in a Cream Anti-Aging Hydrating Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I received this cream for free from Influenster and IT Cosmetics for my opinion. This is one of my favorite moisturizers. I love it can be used both day and night and be effective. It’s super absorbent leaving your skin very hydrated. Love this!

reviews.product_name: Good Genes All-In-One AHA Lactic Acid Treatment

I have blemishes on my face and it seems like getting clearer now .Since it’s winter now this really helps to moisturized my skin better.Totally love this product although their is a scent of herbs or roots. But it disappears after you applied and it don’t stayed.I will say if you have dry skin and in even skin tone try this product and see.

reviews.product_name: Squalane + Marine Algae Firming & Lifting Eye Cream
reviews.review_text: I’ve been using this for a few weeks and this eye cream is so nice it’s light it absorbs faster,and it doesn’t sting . I noticed how it brightened my dark circle  and moisturizer my undereye. I like how it make my skin softer and I would highly recommend it to used it together with  the Biossance night serum to get the maximum results.

reviews.product_name: Avocado Soothing Skin Barrier Serum with Ceramides
reviews.review_text: Recently glowrecipe gifted me their newly launched serum that is Avocado Ceramide Redness Relief Serum in exchange for my honest thoughts! reviews.product_name: Plum Plump Hyaluronic Acid Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: This cream is lovely! It nicely hydrates the skin, makes the skin glowy & plumpy. Instantly absorbs into the skin and works nicely with other skincare products too. I have super dry skin and that’s why I prefer thick rich creams. This one is very lightweight & still nicely hydrates the skin. I personally love to use this in AM, but you can use this in the PM too. I love anything which has Hyaluronic and this Cream doesn’t disappoint me. Plus the packaging is too cute to resist. Overall, it’s a wonderful cream that makes your skin soft and gives you beautiful radiant, glowy, plumpy skin!

reviews.product_name: Mini Plum Plump Hyaluronic Acid Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: This cream is lovely! It nicely hydrates the skin, makes the skin glowy & plumpy. Instantly absorbs into the skin and works nicely with other skincare products too. reviews.product_name: Vitamin Enriched Face Base Priming Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: This Cream was on my wishlist for so long. I heard so many good things about this Moisturizer! My skin is extremely dry & dehydrated, if after just cleanser I apply this Moisturizer, then it feels it does not give me good hydration. But if I use this after my CTS routine, then it’s a wonderful Moisturizer. I always look for nice Hydrating Primers which help my skin to calm & reduce the dryness, I like this one. For me, it gives me an extra dose of Moisturizer before my makeup. If you have Normal, Combination, and Oily Skin, then this Moisturizer gonna work amazingly on your skin. I also love the scent, very refreshing, but not overpowering! Overall, I am enjoying this Face Base!

reviews.product_name: Tea Elixir Niacinamide & Hyaluronic Acid Anti-Aging Serum
reviews.review_text: It comes in a beautiful green glass dropper bottle, love the packaging. Has a milky texture that quickly absorbs into the skin. Doesn’t feels heavy, greasy, or oily. The formula is gentle on the skin and doesn’t give me breakouts or redness. After using this skin looks fresh, soft, smooth, and nourished. It’s been a few days of using this and I can see that it improving my skin texture. So far I am enjoying this and will keep using it for long-term results!!

reviews.product_name: Cream Skin Toner & Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: This stuff is incredible! It has a thin, milky, silky consistency. I don’t believe it’s fragranced and it leaves my skin so hydrated. I use it morning and night. It can be a lil tacky feeling if I use too much, so in the AM I use a tiny amount and pay into my skin. PM I’m much more generous. Another fantastic laneige product!

reviews.product_name: Watermelon Glow Niacinamide Dew Drops
reviews.review_text: I love these dew drops!! The bottle is gorgeous and feels so comfortable in my hand. The texture is similar to the other products in the watermelon glow line. Thin like a serum and glass looking. It surprisingly doesn’t feel tacky. It glides over the skin and absorbs quickly leaving a healthy glow behind. Dries down quickly. It’s lovely as a serum but my favorite way to use jt is over my moisturizer for a healthy glassy glow. I was a little worried about pilling- both the pink juice moisturizer and watermelon sleep mask have pilled  on my face— but was pleasantly surprised! No pilling so far and I’ve used many times already. I’ve also tried it under foundation and it worked well as a primer. The fragrance doesn’t really bother me but I’d much prefer this to be fragrance-free. I don’t like fragrance in my skincare. Overall the dew drops are a home run! Would recommend to anyone who likes the glass skin vibe

reviews.product_name: Advanced Night Repair Eye Concentrate Matrix Synchronized Multi-Recovery Complex
reviews.review_text: I received a deluxe sample complimentary from Influenster for my honest review. I’ve used this morning and night for two weeks and I really like this. Overall I enjoyed this, and if I had prominent eleven lines I would consider purchasing the full size.

reviews.product_name: Tea Elixir Niacinamide & Hyaluronic Acid Anti-Aging Serum
reviews.review_text: I was so pleasantly surprised with this fresh serum! This is a very gentle formula and after using for a week I noticed smoother and hydrated skin. It has a lovely herbal smell. The dropper is a little finicky and takes a couple tries to get out a full serving. This is a great option for people like me who want to improve skin texture without using a bunch of aha/bhas.  I’m enjoying this so much!

reviews.product_name: AHA 30% + BHA 2% Exfoliating Peeling Solution
reviews.review_text: As suggested by Dr. Mark Strom, I use 5 drops at a time for 10 minutes once or twice per week.  I am extremely pleased with the results.  My pores look smaller and smaller.  My skin looks more even and brighter with each passing week.  I also like that this product is quick to apply and easy to remove, so you can do it quickly before bed.  I always use a gentle cleanser the next day.  This works just as good as more expensive products I have tried that are messy to remove.  I’m keeping this in my skin care rotation for the long haul.  Look at this 39 year old baby skin!  (No makeup or beauty filter...just good lighting).

reviews.product_name: Water Drench Hyaluronic Acid Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: This is my favorite moisturizer.  It feels smooth and amazing on the skin.  It feels light which is surpirsing considering how well it moisturizes.  I use it morning and night as a part of my skincare routine.  I lucked up and was able to score a 5 oz or only $100 at the last sale.  I pair this with a rosewater toner from Hertiage and hyaluronic acid from The Ordinary.  My dry skin is smooth and plump with moisture.  The attached photo is good lighting only.  My skin is clean with no makeup, and no beauty filter.  And did I mention I’m 39.  My skin looks better now than it did 10 years ago.

reviews.product_name: Caffeine Eye Cream
reviews.review_text: I like this product for reducing puffiness.  It doesn’t do as good of a job with brightening g and managing fine lines as the GLAMGLOW Bright eyes or the Kate Sommerville, but it is 25% of the cost of GLAMGLOW and 7.5% the cost of Kate Sommerville.  For the money, no complaints.  This is a great budget friendly product.  It is especially great for people under 40 who have less lines to manage.  As I am at the 40 mark, I need a bit more help than this product gives me.  I still use it at night, but go with the GLAMGLOW in the morning as it is more hydrating and really gets to work on the lines.  If you are less dry and less old...lol, this may be a 5 star product for you.

reviews.product_name: Watermelon Glow Niacinamide Dew Drops
reviews.review_title: Instant Glow???...Meh. Nice Long Term Results
reviews.review_text: I have been using this, one pump AM/PM for about 3 weeks.  This is a nice serum.  I enjoy the scent and how it feels on my skin.  My skin is looking more even toned.  The “shine“ it gives you only lasts about an hour, and it looks the same as rubbing a bit of cheap hair gel on the skin.  Based on the reviews, I was expecting something really spectacular. This is a nice niacinamide serum and I enjoy it, but I’m going to investigate some less expensive niacinamide serums as I purchased this for the “instant glow“ and it doesn’t deliver on that front.  Pictured are two swatches.  The one on the left is cheap hair gel, the one on the right is the Watermelon Dew Drops.

reviews.product_name: B-Hydra Intensive Hydration Serum with Hyaluronic Acid

reviews.review_text: I purchased this product on the recommendation of a Sephora in-store skincare advisor, but I’m a bit on the fence. I really wanted something treat the dryness around my nose and mouth, but I haven’t seen much improvement. It hasn’t gotten worse, but also hasn’t gotten better.

reviews.review_text: I used to think nothing would help the dark circles under my eyes due to chronic sinus problems, but I have been really impressed by this product! The pump mechanism is really neat, too.

reviews.review_text: These removing makeup towels work very well removing makeup and dirt, leaving the skin soft and without irritation. The scent is nice and light. I have to say it was a nice surprise, cause I wasn’t expecting such a good quality for the price. Totally worth it.

reviews.review_text: This is an ok moisturizer. reviews.product_name: 100% Organic Cold-Pressed Rose Hip Seed Oil
reviews.review_text: This is a good and affordable rose hip seed oil. It leaves your skin very soft and smooth. It feels very light in the skin, which also makes me think that it doesn’t necessarily has a long lasting effect. I apply it at night before going to bed, and my skin is soft next morning, but by the afternoon, not so much. I have other oils (like jojoba and sunflower oil) that make my skin softer for a longer period of time. But other than that, it’s a nice affordable option.

reviews.product_name: The Deep Cleanse Gentle Exfoliating Cleanser
reviews.review_title: Nice Cleanser but a bit pricy.
reviews.review_text: Not sure what happened to other people and this cleanser but my sensitive skin does not have any issues with it. Granted, it’s too pricy for what it is, but I don’t get any irritation, or a film over my skin after use, or break outs. I have combo skin with very dehydrated/dry skin and oily t-zone, and my skin feels clean and soft after use without dryness and without any residue. But I also don’t overuse this cleanser. Most people are using this product everyday, or every other day, but I never use it more than twice a week at the most (mostly once a week). It is an EXFOLIATING cleanser and this kind of products are not meant to be use often even if the instructions in the package says to use daily. Most people that over-exfoliate have lots of skin issues when using a product like this one but that’s not the fault of the product. Just use a very gentle cleanser for everyday with low acidity and an exfoliating product once or twice a week. I mostly alternate every 3-4 days the use of this physical exfoliating cleanser with a chemical exfoliator (Paula’s Choice or Saturday Skin). With this product less use is more.

My makeup sits beautifully atop it avid lasts longer without looking cake-y or breaking up around my noise and smile lines. I’m loving this one y’all! It’s been a win win win for this dry skinned diva!

reviews.product_name: Auto Correct Brightening + Depuffing Eye Cream for Dark Circles
reviews.review_text: I ask a lot of my eye cream and Sunday Riley delivers in spades. I have hereditarily dry, dehydrated skin that come winter can flake and scale.
