reviews.product_name: Mini Revitalizing Supreme+ Youth Power Creme Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I received sample size of this product complimentary and I love it! It feels so nice on the skin, nice texture, nice scent. Skin feels so much smoother and hydrated!

reviews.product_name: Watermelon Glow Niacinamide Sunscreen SPF 50
reviews.review_text: First of all let’s start I love Glow Recipe! Even now you will find their watermelon face mask on my make up table! I am so happy to be receiving their sunscreen! It feels so light on the skin and it’s lightly scented (which I love!), makes my skin hydrated and glowy. Light weight on the skin, can be used as base for the make up, will let you know using for few more weeks if it does even out skin tone!!

reviews.product_name: Salicylic Acid Acne Healing Dots
reviews.review_text: First time using such a product and I cannot believe I never knew about it before hand!! Lessens the skin irritation and visible lessens the puffiness around acne spot. No discomfort of sleeping with this path - makes perfect for using it while sleeping

reviews.product_name: Tea Elixir Niacinamide & Hyaluronic Acid Anti-Aging Serum
reviews.review_text: Let me start thatTea Elixir Skin Resilience Activating Serum was gifted to me by Fresh. Love the feel it gives to my face, glow! My skin looks so much healthier after using it for few weeks already!

reviews.product_name: Mini Daily Microfoliant Exfoliator
reviews.review_text: I have sensitive skin. The kind that gets really inflamed and bumpy even when I just *look* at an acid peel. I also think I have perioral dermatitis (appt with the doc next month). But this exfoliant not only calms and SOOTHES all of that but also exfoliates and makes my skin look and feel amazing. I am loyal to this exfoliant above all others.

reviews.product_name: Daily Microfoliant Exfoliator
reviews.review_text: I have sensitive skin. The kind that gets really inflamed and bumpy even when I just *look* at an acid peel. I also think I have perioral dermatitis (appt with the doc next month). But this exfoliant not only calms and SOOTHES all of that but also exfoliates and makes my skin look and feel amazing. reviews.product_name: Squalane + Omega Repair Deep Hydration Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I first tried this cream in a sample and loved it. But my dumb dumb self kept shopping around (because I’m a product junky) and was failing miserably with horrible skin flare-ups. I kid you not, after a particularly bad reaction to a particular cream, I went back in to Sephora and bought another sample size (because I wasnt ready to commit to the real deal) and within days, my skin looks infinitely better. I have dry, sensitive skin and this is now part of my go-to for my winter arsenal.

reviews.product_name: AHA 30% + BHA 2% Exfoliating Peeling Solution
reviews.review_text: Love. Use with caution on sensitive skin (which I have) but this is one of my favorite peeling masks I’ve tried. I have sensitive/dry skin so as long as I put something nourishing on after I use this (Farmacy Niacinamide Night Mask, FAB Arnica Rescue Mask), its a great product that makes my skin look smooth and glowy.

reviews.product_name: Cold Plunge Pore Remedy Moisturizer with BHA/LHA
reviews.review_text: I want to give this five stars, I do. But I think it’s a little too intense for my sensitive skin? It does make my skin look AMAZING once the product settles down. But I have learned not to wear this around anyone that I don’t want to look red and splotchy in front of. Ideally, I wear it before bed. It does sting and has a cooling/burning sensation which can be a little irritating. But, again, once that settles down, it does make my skin look smooth the next morning. I will say I’ve never actually had a lasting negative reaction to it (breakouts, rash, flare ups, etc)

reviews.product_name: Vitamin C Suspension 23% + HA Spheres 2%
reviews.review_text: I absolutely love this product. The texture is grainy because of the vitamin C Powder, however, if you mix this product with another serum/moisturizer it is almost undetectable. I specifically bought this product instead of the 30% because this product is silicone free, so it doesn’t pill under or break up my foundation. This is a part of my every day skincare routine and I have not had any issues so far! Truly does what it says- evens out skin tone and overall is a great vitamin C serum especially for the price. Stings a bit at first but I like that because it makes me feel like it’s absorbing and working. Overall I am very happy with my purchase

reviews.product_name: Glowscreen Sunscreen SPF 40 PA+++ with Hyaluronic Acid + Niacinamide
reviews.review_text: Y’all, I am OBSESSED with this sunscreen. I’ve been using for just over a month and could not be more pleased. I have an extensive family history of melanoma, so I absolutely have to wear sunscreen every single day. This is my new holy grail product. I have extremely dry, sensitive skin and this works wonders for me. Does not break me out and looks beautiful. I was wary of this because it does contain SOME silicones and I use a water based primer and foundation, but I have had no issues with separation when I wear this under my makeup. I will buy this again and again and again.

reviews.product_name: Mini Glowscreen Sunscreen SPF 40 PA+++ with Hyaluronic Acid + Niacinamide
reviews.review_text: Y’all, I am OBSESSED with this sunscreen. I’ve been using for just over a month and could not be more pleased. I have an extensive family history of melanoma, so I absolutely have to wear sunscreen every single day. This is my new holy grail product. I have extremely dry, sensitive skin and this works wonders for me. Does not break me out and looks beautiful. I will buy this again and again and again.

reviews.product_name: Papaya Sorbet Smoothing Enzyme Cleansing Balm & Makeup Remover
reviews.review_text: I have been using this product for just over a week and I can honestly say I am never turning back. Like the product description & many reviews mention, this HAS to be used as part of a double cleanse. It’s more of a makeup remover than a cleanser, which is why you need to use another cleanser after, but I have truly never had SUCH great results with a makeup remover. There is absolutely never a trace of makeup left on my face, when when using waterproof products, eyelashes, and long wear products. It does feel oily upon application, but that’s the point. It breaks up all makeup & sunscreen and is then meant to be followed with a cleanser to actually cleanse the skin. I have extremely dry, sensitive skin and I have nothing but good things to say. 10/10 recommend.

reviews.product_name: D-Bronzi Anti-Pollution Bronzing Drops with Peptides
reviews.review_text: I’ve used this product for years and I LOVE the reformulation to the mix in drops. Makes it so much easier to customize what you mix it into and how much you use! The perfect glowy bronze under makeup or for your no makeup makeup look.

reviews.product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C
reviews.review_text: Okay, so this stuff is just amazing.  My lips were horribly chapped when I bought it.  One night really helped; two completely cured my chapped lips.  Love the smell.

reviews.product_name: The True Cream Moisturizing Bomb
reviews.review_text: This is a nice moisturizer.  It keeps my dry skin moist all day long.  Smells good.  I don’t notice any other benefits, but if you want a good moisturizer this is a good choice.

reviews.product_name: Banana Bright 15% Vitamin C Serum
reviews.review_text: So far I really like this vintamin c serum.  It smells good and it is moisturizing, unlike many vitamin c serums.  I haven’t noticed any more brightness with this serum than with other vitamin C serums yet, but I’ve only used it for a few days.  It doesn’t sting like some vitamin c serums.  Seems like a good choice if you’re looking for a vintamin c serum.

reviews.product_name: The Camellia Oil 2-in-1 Makeup Remover & Cleanser
reviews.review_text: I’ve tried a lot of cleansing oils.  Most are too heavy and leave an oily film after rinsing.  The two I like best are this one, Tacha’s, and DHC’s.  This one is based on camellia oil.  It smells great and dissolves makeup easily.  It rinses well, leaving my skin feel soft and moisturized but clean.  DHC’s is good too. It smells like olive oil and cleans and rinses off just as well.  However, it doesn’t leave my skin feeling as moisturized.  Of the two, Tatcha’s works best for me.

reviews.product_name: Glow2OH Dark Spot Toner
reviews.review_text: I received this product for free from Influenster for testing purposes. I’ve been using the olehenriksen GLow2OH Dark Spot Toner every night before bed and I’ve been noticing a difference. It helps with fine lines, dark spots, wrinkles, dullness, and uneven texture. My skin has never felt or looked better. It’s been helping my skin look glowly and helps get rid of my scarring. The only thing is it contains high potency AHAs which only means your skin might be more sensitive to light so just wear sunscreen everyday to protect it. I highly recommend this product. I have dry and sensitive skin and this has been working like a dream for me. .#buhbyedarkspots #contest #complimentary @olehenriksen @influenster @influensterca

reviews.product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C
reviews.review_text: I received @laneigeca Lip Sleeping Mask in GrapeFruit from @influenster for testing purposes. This product right here is my all time favourite lip mask. It smells amazing, makes my lips super soft and hydrated. I have really dry lips and this product has been saving me. I am going to continue to purchase this product and try out the vanilla lip mask. I’ve used the berry one as well and I love it. This product retails for $24 at Sephora Canada. I highly recommend it. #ISleptWithLANEIGE #KissedbyLANEIGE #contest #complimentary @laneigeca @Influenster

reviews.product_name: The True Cream Aqua Bomb
reviews.review_text: I received this product complimentary from Influenster! I have super dry skin and sometimes I get eczema patches on my face. This moisturizer is super hydrating and lightweight and has been really helping with my dry skin. Its gel formula feels so nice and cooling on my face especially when I apply it from my skin fridge. I really love how moisturizing and cooking it feels on my skin. Perfect for these summer days. Would definitely purchase!

reviews.product_name: Aqua Bomb Hydrating Toner
reviews.review_text: I received this product complimentary from Influenster! This toner is so great and really helps with my dry skin. It gives my skin a nice glow and helps with my pores. It also helps get rid of that extra dirty that stays on Your face after removing your makeup and cleansing. I would definitely recommend

reviews.product_name: Rose & Hyaluronic Acid Deep Hydration Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I got this product gifted by Fresh Beauty, and I was pleasant surprised by it! It’s a beautiful moisturizer with sleek packaging and smells of roses, and it is so so hydrating! It has incredible ingredients for dry skin and it’s kept my skin well-moisturized in the dry summer heat!

reviews.product_name: Plum Plump Hyaluronic Acid Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: This launch was so perfect for Glow Recipe! Their products are incredible and this was no exception! The texture is lightweight and absorbs so easily into my skin, and it has the lightest fresh scent. The packaging is so pretty and it makes my skin feel so hydrated and plump - and that hydration lasts!

reviews.product_name: Mini Plum Plump Hyaluronic Acid Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: This launch was so perfect for Glow Recipe! Their products are incredible and this was no exception! The texture is lightweight and absorbs so easily into my skin, and it has the lightest fresh scent. The packaging is so pretty and it makes my skin feel so hydrated and plump - and that hydration lasts!

reviews.product_name: Floral Recovery Overnight Mask with Squalane
reviews.review_text: This mask is a lovely product and I was so excited to try it! It is super refreshing and light cream texture-wise, and when I use it at night I always wake up with hydrated skin (even though my skin is so dry in winter!). I really like this product and I’m definitely going to continue using it!

reviews.product_name: Glowscreen Sunscreen SPF 40 PA+++ with Hyaluronic Acid + Niacinamide
reviews.review_text: This product is a NEED for summer! I absolutely love the skincare ingredients that it’s infused with - saves my dry skin. And the product itself blends in easily and gives a natural and bronzey glow that can actually work as a light skin tint for the no-makeup makeup days! Love it

reviews.product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C
reviews.review_text: I got this as part of my set for my birthday gift. So it feels really smooth on, I love chapsticks and lipbalms. I have noticed that I haven’t felt my lips needed to use balm lately since I’ve been using this. I would say maybe use once a week or so that your lips don’t become dependent on it.

reviews.product_name: The True Cream Moisturizing Bomb
reviews.review_text: Very very hydrating. This is without a doubt the most hydrating moisturizer I’ve ever used. I have normal/dry skin. More dry in the winter and honestly my skin was so soft after using this. It layers well too

reviews.product_name: Yo Glow AHA & BHA Facial Enzyme Scrub
reviews.review_text: This stuff is amazing!!! I got it as a beauty reward and one my skin was so soft and glowy! I just added a big one so I won’t be without when the samples end. I almost never leave reviews because most skin care doesn’t do what it claims. Well this does!

reviews.product_name: Mini Yo Glow AHA & BHA Facial Enzyme Scrub
reviews.review_text: This stuff is amazing!!! I got it as a beauty reward and one my skin was so soft and glowy! I just added a big one so I won’t be without when the samples end. I almost never leave reviews because most skin care doesn’t do what it claims. Well this does!

reviews.product_name: Self Tanning Bronzing Face Drops
reviews.review_title: Great for a glow, but not a real tan
reviews.review_text: So I usually use regular self tanner. And it works great. But I’m a mom and with a toddler it gets hard to keep up because I’m tired and not in the mood to full on sleep in sticky tanner all night after a long day lol. So this stuff was easy, just added it to moisturizer. It did leave a nice glow. But I’d say only you will notice. Others might notice a glow but I doubt anyone will notice it as a tan. So if you want your face to match your body, def try this. But if you want an actual tan try something else.

reviews.product_name: Lip Glowy Balm
reviews.review_text: Absolutely love this balm. Not only is it a cute pink, but it leaves your lips super hydrated. It’s not sticky and looks natural! Definitely recommend!

reviews.product_name: The Rice Wash Skin-Softening Cleanser
reviews.review_text: I absolutely love this cleanser! My fave feels so hydrated. I have a daily routine, and it became just that... a routine. I now get excited to wake up and clean my face!! Tatcha is amazing and I highly recommend this product.

reviews.product_name: Mini Rice Wash Skin-Softening Cleanser
reviews.review_text: I absolutely love this cleanser! My fave feels so hydrated. I have a daily routine, and it became just that... a routine. I now get excited to wake up and clean my face!! Tatcha is amazing and I highly recommend this product.

reviews.product_name: Luminous Dewy Skin Mist
reviews.review_title: Great for an extra boost of hydration
reviews.review_text: I love using the Dewy Skin Mist as the last step in my face cleansing routine. If my face feels dry, this always does the trick. I especially love using a face or Jade roller with it!

reviews.product_name: The Serum Stick: Treatment & Touch Up Balm
reviews.review_title: Great for fine lines and extra hydration
reviews.review_text: I absolutely love Tatcha! Most of my reviews are 5 stars. I gave this 4 stars bc I attempted to use over my makeup and it moved around my concealer. I would recommend to use as an extra touch of hydration. I put this on my face and fine lines while I’m watching TV and as an additional spa like treatment!

reviews.product_name: Oil-Absorbing Pore Treatment Strips
reviews.review_text: I received this sample from Pinch me . I really like this product. It stays on 4 to 6 hours according to instructions.

reviews.product_name: Good Genes All-In-One AHA Lactic Acid Treatment
reviews.review_text: I received sample complimentary from Sunday Riley. I cant say that i see improvements on my fine lines but it does make my skin smooth. It has great scent and the texture is very light. The packaging is pump and easy to use.

reviews.product_name: Capture Totale Super Potent Eye Serum
reviews.review_text: i have been using the eye serum for more than a week now. i like that my eye area got more hydrated however, i didnt notice much difference yet with the dark circles. The application is very easy with the flexible metal tip.

reviews.product_name: The Essence Skincare Boosting Treatment
reviews.review_text: I received tatcha product complimentary from influenster for honest review. The product is lightweight however it is very watery formula.  The packaging is difficult to use. Product spilled all over.

reviews.product_name: Mini The Essence  Skincare Boosting Treatment
reviews.review_text: I received tatcha product complimentary from influenster for honest review. The product is lightweight however it is very watery formula.  The packaging is difficult to use. Product spilled all over.

reviews.product_name: Lip Butter Balm
reviews.review_text: I received this product complimentary from summer fridays. The vanilla scent is nice and it is not overwhelming.  My lips felt hydrated after using the lip butter balm. The packaging was not the best.

reviews.product_name: Soy Hydrating Gentle Face Cleanser
reviews.review_text: Although I received my current bottle free from Influenster to try, I have bought several bottles of this with my own money. I adore the cucumber scent and the gel texture. This is definitely a luxury face wash but if you’re interested in trying it and you have the budget, I don’t think you’ll be disappointed.

reviews.product_name: Sugar Strawberry Exfoliating Face Wash
reviews.review_text: I received this product complimentary from Influenster to try. I really enjoy the entire experience of using this product! It has a lovely strawberry and cream type smell. When you first put it on your face, it has subtle grains to it, but as you massage it into your face, the grains disappear and it turns into a lovely gel consistency. I also love that it’s in a tube as opposed to a tub. I will definitely be buying another one in the future.

reviews.product_name: Greek Yoghurt Nourishing Probiotic Gel-Cream
reviews.review_text: I received a sample size of this through Influenster to test. I really enjoy the consistency of the product. It’s a nice gel texture that wears well. It’s definitely worth getting a sample to try if you’re interested in the product.

reviews.product_name: Plum Plump Hyaluronic Acid Serum
reviews.review_text: I received this free from Influenster for testing. I’ve really been enjoying using this. My face feels soft after more hydrated after using it. It sinks into my skin nicely. My only con is that it does feel a little sticky on your face in the beginning, but it does go away after a while. I would consider buying it once this bottle is done.

reviews.product_name: The Dewy Skin Cream Plumping & Hydrating Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I have dry skin and this is my absolute holy grail!!! I always come back to this. So dewy and plumping. Does not feel heavy or sit on top of my skin.

reviews.product_name: Self Tanning Bronzing Face Drops
reviews.review_text: Holy grail for self Tanner!!! I don’t understand the negative reviews. I think streaking would be a result of not blending well enough or the serum/moisturizer you mixed it with. I’ve never had an issue with it and have been using this for years! It does have a slight fake tan smell to it but it has never bothered me and I am very sensitive to smell. definitely recommend!

reviews.product_name: Squalane + Vitamin C Rose Firming Oil
reviews.review_text: Wow!! Not sure what made me try this since oils have never worked well for me. I have dry skin but they always seem to feel heavy and sit on top of my skin. This is amazing!! I put it on top of moisturizer as the last step of skin care at night and during the day and have noticed that my skin is so much smoother!! Can’t speak for results of fading any dark spots yet, but super happy about the results I’ve seen so far! Definitely recommend

reviews.product_name: Plum Plump Hyaluronic Acid Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: Really liking this moisturizer so far!! It is plumping and hydrating, perfect for daytime layered under makeup with other skincare. However, I have dry skin and it is not moisturizing enough for me for night time. Nonetheless, still a great day cream for supple hydrated looking skin!!

reviews.product_name: Mini Plum Plump Hyaluronic Acid Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: Really liking this moisturizer so far!! It is plumping and hydrating, perfect for daytime layered under makeup with other skincare. However, I have dry skin and it is not moisturizing enough for me for night time. Nonetheless, still a great day cream for supple hydrated looking skin!!

reviews.product_name: Squalane + Omega Repair Deep Hydration Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: This one is a no for me. Smells like tequila when you first apply, it does dissipate quickly. It is very thick and not in a good way. It feels like you are putting body cream on your face. Feels heavy and sits on top of the skin- doesn’t feel like it absorbs. Wayyy better clean moisturizers out there

reviews.product_name: Cicapair Tiger Grass Color Correcting Treatment SPF 30
reviews.review_text: Great product! A little goes a very long way! I apply this with my finger tips. This provides enough coverage for me that I can skip foundation. The only reason I gave this 4 starts instead of 5 is that I find it to be very thick, so I prefer the color correcting drops. The drops provide less coverage, but they give a more dewy, glowy finish.

reviews.product_name: Mini Cicapair Tiger Grass Color Correcting Treatment SPF 30
reviews.review_text: Great product! A little goes a very long way! I apply this with my finger tips. This provides enough coverage for me that I can skip foundation. The only reason I gave this 4 starts instead of 5 is that I find it to be very thick, so I prefer the color correcting drops. The drops provide less coverage, but they give a more dewy, glowy finish.

reviews.product_name: Self Tanning Bronzing Face Drops
reviews.review_text: These drops are wonderful! They provide very natural looking color and are extremely easy to use. I don’t notice any unpleasant self tanner smells. I also purchased these in the medium shade, but I personally would recommend going with the dark shade. The dark shade should last longer since you can use fewer drops than the medium to achieve the same results. The color usually lasts several days. I usually apply the drops about 2-3 days per week. I would recommend using a very moisturizing face lotion to mix with the drops. You definitely do not want to apply this to flaky or peeling skin. My ONLY complaint is the packaging... The dropper seems to be poor quality. I ordered these drops several weeks ago and had to return them because about 1/4 of the bottle leaked out. Fortunately the next bottle I purchased did not leak.

reviews.product_name: Niacinamide 10% + Zinc 1% Oil Control Serum
reviews.review_text: I can’t believe how quickly this product goes out of stock! If you are able to purchase these while they are in stock, it will be worth it!!! The main reason I purchased this was to help minimize the appearance of my pores. I have been using for about 4 days and my pores already look smaller. The serum absorbs well into my skin and a little bit goes a long way. Many people mention that they experience purging with this product, but I must be lucky as so far I have not experienced any purging. When this comes back in stock I plan to purchase a backup bottle!

reviews.product_name: Retinol Anti-Aging Serum
reviews.review_text: This is my first ever retinol cream. I am in my early twenties and do not yet have wrinkles. I am simply using this to help prevent wrinkles and help minimize fine lines on my forehead. I have been using this for about 4 weeks now (every night) and my skin has a smoother appearance so far. The fine lines aren’t completely gone, but they are smaller. I would imagine I will have better results with longer use. I have very sensitive skin, and this has not made my skin irritated or broken my skin out. I don’t notice any burning when I apply this retinol. I think this would be a great and inexpensive option for anyone looking to try retinol for the first time and also for anyone with sensitive skin. I am always careful to apply sunscreen each morning, as this can make you more sensitive to the sun. I would definitely recommend giving this a try if you are looking to try out retinol products.

reviews.product_name: SEA drink of H2O hydrating boost moisturizer
reviews.review_text: this isn’t the worst moisturizer I have ever used, but it definitely isn’t great. It has sort of a gel consistency. I don’t find it to be very hydrating, and it pills really badly on my face even if I only use a tiny bit of product. On the plus side, this didn’t irritate my skin at all and this comes in very cute packaging. I just don’t think this is an effective moisturizer. I even tried mixing this with other heavier creams, and still did not find this to be effective.

reviews.product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C
reviews.review_text: I’m not a fan of this... I’m honestly not sure why so many people love this product. It feels thick and sticky on the lips and I find it to be extremely messy. It honestly doesn’t do anything more for my lips than vaseline (but it does smell better than Vaseline). I have tried applying smaller amounts and I still feel that annoying sticky feeling. When I wake up in the morning my lips don’t feel much more moisturized than they would have if I had just used a regular lip balm. One positive about this product is it didn’t irritate my sensitive skin. I just think this isn’t effective enough to justify the steep price.

reviews.product_name: GENIUS Sleeping Collagen Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I received this product complimentary from Influenster for for testing purposes. I tried to give this product a few weeks before writing a review. I have extremely dry and sensitive skin.  The first time using this, I used at night after washing my face. I did use the liquid collagen as well. I found the texture to be surprising, it was much thicker than anticipated. There was little to no fragrance, which I appreciate. Both products went on very easy. A little goes a long way! Within a week, I noticed a significant difference in my skin. It wasn’t dry and flaky and my fine lines and wrinkles appeared less prominent. I would recommend this product.

reviews.product_name: B-Hydra Intensive Hydration Serum with Hyaluronic Acid
reviews.review_text: Drunk Elephant has easily become my favorite skin care line. I have dry, sensitive skin. I really love how lightweight this formula is and appreciate that it’s fragrance free. On its own it’s just okay. But pair it with C-Firma during the day and Framboos at night and you’ll notice an improvement in texture and tone in your skin In a week!! Worth the investment.

reviews.product_name: Umbra Sheer Physical Daily Defense SPF 30
reviews.review_text: I have Lupus so sunscreen is an important part of my daily routine. I love this particular sunscreen because it doesn’t smell, it’s sheer as described and is lightweight. I’ve had no problems wearing this over my usual skin care routine, however I don’t know how it would hold up over makeup. That’s why I buy foundation with SPF.

reviews.product_name: Plum Plump Hyaluronic Acid Serum
reviews.review_text: I received this Complimentary product to review from Influencer. I really enjoyed this serum. It’s lightweight, has a faint pleasant smell, isn’t sticky and I noticed a difference in my skin after one application. I don’t know how effective it is on fine lines and wrinkles as I’ve only used this for one week, but you will see a visible difference in how plump and hydrated your skin appears.

reviews.product_name: Multi-Peptide + HA Serum
reviews.review_text: Huge surprise how much I like this.  Usually when I product says it helps with uneven texture, I just roll my eyes.  This actually did!!  The skin underneath my eyes saw an improvement within just 1 week.

reviews.product_name: The Rice Wash Skin-Softening Cleanser
reviews.review_text: Yay!!!  Was so excited to get this in a recently purchased Trendmood box. I love the Deep Cleanse, but I need something more mild. This is perfect. Pretty easy on my sensitive skin.

reviews.product_name: Mini Rice Wash Skin-Softening Cleanser
reviews.review_text: Yay!!!  Was so excited to get this in a recently purchased Trendmood box. I love the Deep Cleanse, but I need something more mild. This is perfect. Pretty easy on my sensitive skin.

reviews.product_name: Luminous Dewy Skin Mist
reviews.review_text: Usually I don’t like a luminous/glowy mist type spray. I got this in my Trendmood box recently. It’s a bit too dewy for me, but much nicer than the Pixi Glow Mist I was using. So a good change, but would love just a tiny bit less dew.

reviews.product_name: The Serum Stick: Treatment & Touch Up Balm
reviews.review_text: This was the main reason I purchased the latest Trendmood box and it did not disappoint!  I love this. I’m a huge fan a skincare/makeup sticks. This one just glided over my skin without tugging any areas. Refreshing.

reviews.product_name: Cicapair Tiger Grass Color Correcting Treatment SPF 30
reviews.review_text: Amazing. Covers redness and gives beautiful glow. I received this for complimentary testing

reviews.product_name: Mini Cicapair Tiger Grass Color Correcting Treatment SPF 30
reviews.review_text: Amazing. Covers redness and gives beautiful glow. I received this for complimentary testing

reviews.product_name: Cicapair Tiger Grass Cream

reviews.review_text: This cream has a lovely rose smell I really like the consistency of it I think it’s a great level of moisturisation for dry skin in the summertime.  I have been using it after I apply right right now in in the evening but I would use it during the day under make up

reviews.review_text: I’ve used glowscreen for ages, it’s a go to in the summertime.  Works well as a primer under makeup, even all cream formulas.  I wish it didn’t have benzene ingredients, but I’ll trade off for the glow it gives.

reviews.product_name: Glowscreen Sunscreen SPF 40 PA+++ with Hyaluronic Acid + Niacinamide
reviews.review_text: We all know and love glowscreen and this new shade is it!! I love the tint and the option to go for something a little less disco ball esque than the original shade.  It’s an everyday go to under my makeup.

reviews.product_name: Sugar Lip Balm Hydrating Treatment
reviews.review_text: Sugars lip balms are my favourite thing to keep in my handbag for a quick touch up!  Much nicer Color payoff than a chapstick but definitely the same level of moisture if not better. The packaging is so nice As well.  Gifted by fresh.

reviews.product_name: Tea Elixir Niacinamide & Hyaluronic Acid Anti-Aging Serum
reviews.review_text: I really like this serum I feel like the quality is very high and it comes in the most beautiful green glass dropper bottle.  I am still unsure if it did anything amazing for my skin. It’s definitely hydrating and provides a little immediate brightening but I have enjoyed using it!

reviews.product_name: Honey Halo Ultra-Hydrating Ceramide Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: Repurchase for me-Absolutely adore this moisturizer ! It is light, yet somehow dense enough for me to feel that my skin is being adequately quenched. For me, this is a night time moisturizer. I’ve been using this product for about 7 months now and I have noticed a significant difference in my skin; my skin is noticeably more plump, brightened, and less dry patches. I love Farmacy as a brand and am just so impressed with this product! The packaging is also durable- glass base with a wooden lid. My favourite aspect, packaging wise, is definitely the spatula that comes with the product! Keeping things hygienic and safe. Run don’t walk to your nearest Sephora!

reviews.product_name: Green Clean Makeup Removing Cleansing Balm
reviews.review_text: Love love love this product ! Love how there’s a spatula with the product for hygienic purpose; love the lime scent; love the overall performance . Definitely would recommend this product, especially over other brands version of a cleansing balm.

reviews.product_name: Green Clean Makeup Meltaway Cleansing Balm Limited Edition Jumbo
reviews.review_text: Love love love this product ! Love how there’s a spatula with the product for hygienic purpose; love the lime scent; love the overall performance . Definitely would recommend this product, especially over other brands version of a cleansing balm.

reviews.product_name: Lala Retro Whipped Refillable Moisturizer with Ceramides
reviews.review_text: Background: I used to think I was an oil slick. I thought my skin was so oily that I didn’t even need moisturizer for the day- boy was I wrong. Turns out I was actually extremely dry and that my oil glands would hyper produce because I’d strip the ever living life out of my pores and then not replenish them. Upon coming to the realization that I have dry skin, I went to ye ol Sephora for a moisturizer. I got recommended this product and fell in LOVE! It is moisturizing, yet not heavy which I find essential for my day time moisturizer. My skin just feels absolutely amazing after I apply this product and I do not get any irritation either! A true God send. I probably would not suggest this product as a time time moisturizer if you have oily skin; but hey you’re your own person.

reviews.product_name: Salicylic Acid Acne Healing Dots
reviews.review_text: What a treat. This product is absolutely unreal. Any blemish I have, whether it be a white head or an underground demon, these patches do the trick. After I cleanse my face at night and moisturize I put one of these bad boys on each little terror and when I awaken my blemishes are virtually gone or dramatically minimized.These patches seriously are worth every penny. I tried some from a local drugstore and they did not perform remotely as well. Side note, I absolutely love waking up and checking out the white collection of oil and gunk that the hydrocolloid patches collect. Sooo satisfying.

reviews.product_name: SEA drink of H2O hydrating boost moisturizer
reviews.review_text: Love it! My new go to! I use this every night and morning. Super hydrating and refreshing. Love it!

reviews.product_name: Jet Lag Mask
reviews.review_text: Wow!! Finally!! I have very dry skin. I have probably tried almost every product at Sephora. Currently using Ole Henriksen Truth line. I purchased this yesterday and tried it last night. I applied all over my face and slept with it on, I didn’t remove it. My face immediately absorbed the cream so it wasn’t heavy or greasy. This morning my face felt soft, smooth and not dry!!! I will be definitely be using this all winter!!! A definite re-purchase!!!

reviews.review_text: I am loving this Daily UV Defense Sunscreen from innisfree. Innisfree gifted me Daily UV Defense sunscreen.Its water based and safe for the reef and I am really amazed by the fact that it’s safe for our ocean. I apply it everyday before applying makeup and it doesn’t make my skin appear greasy. Great protection from the sun. It’s not sticky and it’s great for the skin too for everyday application. Great quality. Contains vitamin E which is good for skin.

reviews.product_name: Barrier+ Triple Lipid-Peptide Face Cream
reviews.review_text: I was gifted by skinfix for my honest and unbiased opinion.I have to say that I am in love with this rich moisturizing cream. I like the design of the jar which also includes a pump. Which is slightly different concept. This cream really helps skin to restore after sun damage and stress. I love the slight fragrance it’s not overpowering. It makes my skin really smooth and radiant. I was able to get rid of all the sun damage with the regular use of this cream. It helps in reducing redness and irritation. Provides skin with all the essential nutrients needed to ease aging as well. I massage my forehead with this cream regularly to help me with the wrinkles too.I had no irritation or redness after using this.My skin is somewhat dry and this really provides great hydration.I am impressed that this works. I was initially skeptical but now I am happy that it’s worth trying ! Rich and thick much needed for winter!

reviews.product_name: Avocado Soothing Skin Barrier Serum with Ceramides
reviews.review_text: I was gifted this product by Glow Recipe.  I have a very sensitive skin and my skin has so much redness and dryness too. I also have uneven skin tone which bothers me. I decided to try this serum as it’s infused with the goodness of avocado. The serum is a game changer for me. It’s been almost 2 weeks now since I started using it and I notice my skin getting better. This serum is light weight and so soothing to my skin. No irritation at all. My pores have reduced and I notice less redness than before. It really helps. It doesn’t make my skin greasy. Yet it provides great hydration to my skin. My skin is getting smoother than before and I have noticed that the uneven skin tone is getting blended well. Hopefully with the continued usage I will reap more benefits!

reviews.product_name: Magic Cream Moisturizer with Hyaluronic Acid
reviews.review_text: I have tried many moisturizers and serums but I never got this kind of results which I got from Charlotte Tilbury Magic cream. The jar looks so luxurious. It smells so good. My skin was so dry and my skin tone was not even at all. I also had fine lines on my forehead. After I started using this I could see instant results. I used it at night for the first time and the next day my skin felt so hydrated and soft. After a few days of usage I could see more differences in my skin. My fine lines were less visible and my skin felt pumped too. My skin started getting brighter and smoother with each usage. I am so satisfied with this magic cream. It has great ingredients which make my skin healthy. I liked the fact that it’s not greasy nor it leaves an oily look. It makes my skin shiny and radiant. I am loving this overall. I am so glad that I received this in exchange to my honest feedback.

reviews.review_text: Okay you guys there’s a reason why this product is SO hyped up!! It’s AMAZING I don’t know what it is but it tops every other cleansing balm! It’s super light yet takes everything off so easily u barely have to rub your face, the papaya enzymes in this RLLY do exfoliate your skin in the most gentle way and my sensitive combo skin is smooth and NOT red afterwards it’s the BEST!!!

reviews.review_text: This stuff is amazing Glow Recipe never disappoints! My skin is super sensitive this is the only bha my skin can handle and the phas makes it so hydrating/super gentle exfoliation. LOVE IT.

reviews.review_title: Smooths and Brightens my Sensitive Skin Instantly!
reviews.review_text: My skin is SUPER sensitive especially my under eyes, my skin loves ALL biossance products and this eye cream is my favorite! It glides on to ur skin and soaks in leaving no greasy residue. Smooths and brightens instantly!

reviews.product_name: Squalane + Vitamin C Rose Firming Oil
reviews.review_title: Woke up with Clear brighter skin in the A.M.
reviews.review_text: This stuff is addicting you can notice bright clearer skin the very next day I love putting this on as my last step before I sleep especially in the winter! My skin soaks this up and the vitamin C really does make a difference. I use their water based vitamin C in the morning and this at night my skin has never looked better!

reviews.product_name: Glow2OH Dark Spot Toner
reviews.review_text: I received this product complementary for testing purposes and was super excited about it! I don’t struggle with dark spots so it’s hard for me to judge based on that but I have been using this for about 2 weeks now and have definitely noticed a difference. My skin tone is definitely more even and brighter and I find that I don’t have as many blackheads/pimples! The only thing I don’t love is that because I have sensitive skin, I find it a bit drying and can irritate some areas. Overall would recommend!!

reviews.product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C
reviews.review_text: I received this product complimentary from Influenster for testing purposes and wow do I love it!! First of all the smell is great, but it makes my lips so soft all day and I barely have to re apply! I don’t even just use this as a sleeping mask, I like to use it all day!! I love the shine that it gives my lips and how it isn’t sticky at all. I will definitely be purchasing!

reviews.product_name: Aqua Bomb Cleansing Balm
reviews.review_text: I received this product complimentary for testing purposes from Influenster! I’ve been using this product for about 2 weeks now and I love it! A little goes a long way and it removes all of your makeup even the mascara. It’s good for sensitive and dry skin, but isn’t too oily like other brands I have tried! I wouldn’t say that it is a must have, and it’s a bit pricy, but would definitely recommend if you are looking for a good cleansing balm and if you have dry, sensitive skin!

reviews.product_name: The True Cream Aqua Bomb
reviews.review_text: I received this product complimentary from influenster and I was super excited to try! It’s definitely pricy for the amount you receive, as I found that my sample went super quick. I think this is a great moisturizer for the summer or for people who have oilier skin, but I definitely wouldn’t recommend for people with super dry skin. It kept my skin moisturized all day, and was great under makeup. Overall no complaints and would purchase during a sale!

reviews.product_name: T.L.C. Framboos Glycolic Resurfacing Night Serum
reviews.review_text: I have not taken good care of my skin through the years, but am attempting to do better. I use this product probably 3-4 nights a week. I can say it makes a difference. I also use an oil over it, typically the drunken elephant oil. My skin feels smoother, and pores less noticeable. Other serums have not done much, and oil alone does almost nothing.

reviews.product_name: B-Hydra Intensive Hydration Serum with Hyaluronic Acid
reviews.review_text: I can’t say enough good things about this product. I use it daily over the company’s C serum. Its a light weight moisturizer that seems to work equally as well on my dry patches as my oily ones. When I travel to dry climates, my skin drinks this up like no one’s business and feels glorious. A little goes a long way with all serums, and this bottle usually lasts me 6 months. Pricey, for sure, but better than any other moisturizer I have tried.

reviews.product_name: Midnight Recovery Concentrate Moisturizing Face Oil
reviews.review_text: I wanted to like this. The price was good, I like the brand. But the smell is strong and I don’t feel like it did anything. I switched back to my other brand before this product even ran out. I will use it as a back up or for travel.

reviews.product_name: Midnight Recovery Concentrate Moisturizing Face Oil
reviews.review_text: I wanted to like this. The price was good, I like the brand. But the smell is strong and I don’t feel like it did anything. I switched back to my other brand before this product even ran out. I will use it as a back up or for travel.

reviews.product_name: The True Cream Aqua Bomb
reviews.review_text: I have combination skin that is pretty dang sensitive. I love this stuff. It is cooling and moisturizing without being heavy at all. I don’t get dry throughout the day, and have stopped using some other serums, because I just don’t need it anymore. Only reason this gets 4 stars is because I am going through it quicker than I would like.

reviews.product_name: Hyaluronic Acid 2% + B5 Hydrating Serum
reviews.review_text: Best serum I have purchased. Noticeable difference in my skin in a few days of regular use.

reviews.product_name: Lemonade Smoothing Scrub
reviews.review_text: This scrub is amazing! It leaves my skin feeling clean and refreshed! It gives me a great glow after as well. The citrus is a great way to start my morning, very refreshing. The smell isn’t too overpowering either, it’s just right. I like to incorporate this in my morning routine 2-3 x a week! I definitely recommend this to be a part of your skincare routine for brighter and healthier looking skin!

reviews.product_name: Urban Environment Oil-Free Sunscreen Broad-Spectrum SPF 42
reviews.review_text: This sunscreen is great for days where you don’t want to wear much makeup! It leaves you with such a nice glow as well as protects your skin. I love to use it as a primer before applying my makeup as well. I’ve also used it in the pool since it’s waterproof and it sticks to your skin so you don’t have any running of the product. Love this!

reviews.product_name: Urban Environment Fresh-Moisture Sunscreen Broad-Spectrum SPF 42
reviews.review_text: This sunscreen is a must have. It works so good.  I tend to have dry skin and I feel like it did an amazing job making sure that my skin stayed moisturized through out the day while protecting it as well. There was also no white cast after applying.

reviews.product_name: Revitalizing Supreme+ Youth Power Creme Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I received this product to review but it was a small sample. I liked the thick texture of the Creme, it left my skin feels hydrated and clean. I have dry skin so hydration is definitely something I need.

reviews.product_name: Mini Revitalizing Supreme+ Youth Power Creme Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I received this product to review but it was a small sample. I liked the thick texture of the Creme, it left my skin feels hydrated and clean. I have dry skin so hydration is definitely something I need.

reviews.product_name: Yo Glow AHA & BHA Facial Enzyme Scrub
reviews.review_text: My skin is much more even, my dark spots are fading and it helps combat any active blemishes.  So everyone know Huda and how she backs her products all the way so I knew this would be no different. It has a light smell that I would wear as a purfume if I could. This is a must have in every skin care routine!!!

reviews.product_name: Capture Totale Super Potent Eye Serum
reviews.review_title: Stop your search with this product!!
reviews.review_text: This product is incredible. I have dark circles with sullen, tired lines and this is a life saver. I never really enjoyed taking pictures because it’s a constant reminder of something I can’t easily fix. I’ve tried dozens of eye creams and nothing compares to the magic this works. The smell is a fresh light scent. It works amazing alone or with concealer but after three weeks you will find yourself using less and less concealer. The application tip is so precise and really works the product into your skin gently and efficiently. I would give this six stars if I could because it is just that good. Below I’ve attached two picture one before using Dior Capture Totale Super Potent Eye serum and one three weeks into it. You be the judge. My confidence has skyrocketed (and my husband loves using it too!)

reviews.product_name: Aqua Bomb Overnight Lip Mask
reviews.review_text: This is an incredible product that gives over night results but even better with prolonged use. It doesn’t have a taste or smell and feels like a silky lip balm. I have to wear a mark at work all day which ends up with my lips being super dry and this helped me battle the chapped itchy feeling. I sometimes use it before work under my mask because it stays well and also keeps them hydrated through my shifts. I know this is going to be great for the winter!

reviews.product_name: Squalane + Omega Repair Deep Hydration Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: Really moisturizing with great ingredients! Has a kinda funky smell so I only give it four stars but otherwise it’s it amazing! It provides long lasting hydrations and I love the soft texture of the formula. Overall I would definitely purchase again and if looking forward to trying their other products.

reviews.product_name: Microneedling Anti-Wrinkle Retinol Patches
reviews.review_text: I received my sample from Pinchme to try Peace Out patches and I’m happy I did.  I am pleased with how great these patches worked on my wrinkles. This is definitely an anti-wrinkle product I am going to keep using And plan to purchase more today!!!!!

reviews.product_name: Benefiance Wrinkle Smoothing Eye Cream
reviews.review_text: I was excited to be chosen to try the Shiseido wrinkle smoothing eye cream for free❤️I have been using this amazing eye cream for a little over a week and I’m in love with this product. It makes my eyes so soft and look amazing. The only suggestion is to not use to much if your using it before applying your makeup. It will pull your makeup into creases which are very noticeable after setting powder. As long as your careful this won’t happen. This is the best eye cream to use before bed❤️❤️❤️

reviews.product_name: Retinol Reform Treatment Serum
reviews.review_text: This retinol product has been absolutely amazing! I use it every night without irritation and it applies nicely. I am eager to see the results with continued use. So exciting

reviews.product_name: Mini Retinol Reform
reviews.review_text: This retinol product has been absolutely amazing! I use it every night without irritation and it applies nicely. I am eager to see the results with continued use. So exciting

reviews.product_name: Triple Algae Eye Renewal Balm Eye Cream
reviews.review_text: I absolutely love how moisturized my eyes feel after using this amazing eye renewal balm. It has done wonders for my fine lines in making them have a smoother appearance.

reviews.product_name: Papaya Sorbet Smoothing Enzyme Cleansing Balm & Makeup Remover
reviews.review_title: Great balm that doesn’t dry out your skin
reviews.review_text: I received these products complimentary from Influenster for testing purposes. The are so many great things about this product. For starters the packaging is absolutely gorgeous and the balm comes with a little scoop for you to take out the product. I used this product to remove my makeup and it did a pretty good job. I usually use micellar water but this balm did a way better job than micellar water. The reason why I took 1 star off is because while rising it does take a while to get rid of the product, when they say to rinse thoroughly they mean it. At the end my face ended up looking and feeling great. I was impressed by the fact it didn’t dry my skin at all.

reviews.product_name: Ultimate Sun Protector Lotion SPF 50+ Sunscreen
reviews.review_text: I absolutely love this sunscreen!! This is the first sunscreen from Shiseido I’ve ever gotten and I can’t believe it took me so long to discover it! The texture is amazing! It is super lightweight and it applies very smoothly. It actually reminds me a lot of the Dior backstage primer, I know they are completely different products but the texture and the scent is identical. A little bit goes a long way!!! At first it might seem oily but give it a couple minutes and the lotion will penetrate your skin and leave it feeling nice and smooth. After using the typical oily, thick, white sunscreen this is definitely a game changer!!! It is also ocean-friendly and Hawaii compliant!!

reviews.product_name: Urban Environment Oil-Free Sunscreen Broad-Spectrum SPF 42
reviews.review_text: I really liked this sunscreen! I think it is very similar to their Ultimate sun protection lotion which I also love. This product is super moisturizing and sits great on the skin. It has a liquid consistency that makes it super easy to apply. It doesn’t leave a white cast even though I have brown skin.

reviews.product_name: Urban Environment Fresh-Moisture Sunscreen Broad-Spectrum SPF 42
reviews.review_text: This product is amazing! I have tried Shiseido sunscreens in the past, so I knew the products are good. But this sunscreen is definitely my new favorite from the brand. At first, I was out of by the consistency. It has a glue like consistency, so I was worried I was t going to be easy to blend but I was wrong. The sunscreen is blendable, moisturizing and it doesn’t leave a white cast!

reviews.product_name: Jet Lag Mask
reviews.review_text: Wanted to love this mask. Another case of industry hype I guess. Broke me out & broke my mom out who is 50 & has no regular acne!

reviews.product_name: Mini Jet Lag Mask
reviews.review_text: Wanted to love this mask. Another case of industry hype I guess. Broke me out & broke my mom out who is 50 & has no regular acne!

reviews.review_text: I prefer eye cream to serum. This may do a bit for dark under eyes but I wakeup with small red bumps!!

reviews.review_text: Amazing product. Exfoliating leaves my skin paler on my face than body. This mixes into any moisturizer, I have tried drubk elephant and the ordinary cheap moisturizers. Gives you a beautiful bronze glow that is customizable for skin tones. Better than any face fake tan I have used.

reviews.product_name: 100% Organic Cold-Pressed Rose Hip Seed Oil
reviews.review_text: Amazing oil for my eczema dry - acne prone skin. I’ve got both my brother and sister hooked. Much better for my skin type than the “B” oil. A bit heavy, best for night time.

reviews.product_name: Banana Bright 15% Vitamin C Serum
reviews.review_text: Love this serum. Has a silky slip texture and smells like fresh citrus. Isn’t sticky at all and layers well with other products. Instantly brightens and the long term results are great. I use it every morning!

reviews.product_name: Niacinamide 10% + Zinc 1% Oil Control Serum
reviews.review_text: I first bought this product around a year ago and since then I haven’t stopped using it. It has been a life changer when it comes to sebum production on my forehead and cheeks. After a whole day out I’ll look in the mirror and oiliness will barely be seen. I stopped using it when I ran out of my first bottle and was waiting for the next one and immediately saw a change. My Holy grail.

reviews.product_name: Ultra Repair Cream Intense Hydration
reviews.review_text: My skin type is usually combo leaning more towards oily but once winter hits I start getting some dry flakes on my face and nothing has worked better for it than this cream. The colloidal oatmeal that this product uses is amazing and really gives you that nice hydrating factor that I have found that others lack.

reviews.product_name: AHA 30% + BHA 2% Exfoliating Peeling Solution
reviews.review_title: The best mask with the best price
reviews.review_text: Let’s be honest, I don’t really need to explain how good this mask is. You can see results even after just the first time using it. It is a amazing when it comes to making your skin more even and can we even talk about that price? I have been using this mask  every week for more than 6 months and I still have more than half of the bottle left. For $7.20! It’s incomparable.

reviews.product_name: Caffeine 5% + EGCG Depuffing Eye Serum
reviews.review_title: Did nothing for me but still good price
reviews.review_text: I think I used it for about 4 months before I gave up and in all that time I didn’t even use 1/4 of the bottle. It works for some, it doesn’t for others. It is still pretty cheap so it doesn’t feel as bad when it ends up not working.

reviews.product_name: Natural Moisturizing Factors + HA
reviews.review_text: I have tried many moisturizers because I’m the type that even if I have something good that works for my skin I want to try new things. No matter how many new moisturizers I try I always end up coming back to this moisturizer for using during the day. It’s lightweight, it doesn’t make my skin oilier, it has no fragrance and just feels nice while doing its job.

That being said I love the metal applicator, knowing it wasn’t working for me I would still put it on because I just found the applicator nice and fun.

reviews.product_name: Alpha Beta Extra Strength Daily Peel Pads

Although I will not use it regularly because it is too expensive to do so I will continue to use it occasionally.

reviews.product_name: Original Skin Matte Moisturizer with Willowherb
reviews.review_text: I generally love the Origins brand and was excited to try this moisturizer. Before trying it out, I read a bit about it and was nervous about the reviews that mentioned it causing excess dryness and even flaking. After trying it though, I can tell you this moisturizer is actually the holy grail for those that struggle with oily skin. I think some of the other reviewers must not have truly oily skin and as a result I could see that this moisturizer would be very drying for them. It has a nice fresh, slightly floral scent, goes on light and non-greasy, and it really does keep my skin matte and not so oily throughout the day. It has slightly improved my acne as well. I do occasionally need to use this in combination with another moisturizer however as it isn’t the most hydrating and although I have oily skin occasionally my acne facial care products will dry my skin too much.

reviews.product_name: Retinol Reform Treatment Serum
reviews.review_text: I have been using this retinol reform cream for two weeks. I was afraid it would irritate my skin but thankfully I had no redness or irritation (I have used retinols in the past). My skin seems a bit brighter and make up glides on a bit easier. I have no yet noticed any anti-aging properties but time will tell! I must note that I hate the smell of this product and as such removed one star.

reviews.product_name: Blueberry Bounce Gentle Cleanser
reviews.review_text: My skin is super sensitive so I was looking for a gentle cleanser. This definitely does that but I feel like it wasn’t enough. It’s great and I’ll finish the bottle but I don’t think I will repurchase

reviews.product_name: Aqua Bomb Hydrating Toner
reviews.review_text: This Aqua Bomb hydrating toner is really just that: a hydrating bomb. I loved it right from the moment I smelled it. It makes you feel like you’re at the spa, while also having an aromatherapy session. It relaxes me every single time. That being said, I see how scent sensitive people would not agree with the scent, I personally didn’t find it overpowering. Next thing is how moisturizing it feels the moment it makes contact with my skin. It feels very calming and soothing on my skin, but it’s super lightweight and gentle while doing so.  My skin is going through a moment rn: flakiness, redness, dryness. So quite honestly I didn’t think this tones was going to work, but I was wrong; The moment I put it on my skin feels instantly more elastic and plump.  The sodium hyaluronate in it makes mu skin feel sooo smooth. The Napiers formula works amazing in this product.  I have no complaints about this toner.The only thing that I would seek some improvement on is the dispenser. I used to have one with a push down dispenser that made it so easy to just soak the cotton ball.  but I guess thats just me being lazy... Overall, I am very please with Belif once again. Clean beauty anyone? XThanks Belif!

reviews.product_name: The True Cream Aqua Bomb
reviews.review_text: I already wrote a review before, but I just wanted to sy that the more I use this gel-cream, the more my skin appreciates it. I was going through a VERY rough patch with my skin for the past 6month , and worsened 2-3months ago going through quarantine stress I guess? But since I’ve been religiously using it alongside the aqua-bomb toner I’ve noticed my skin keeps making a turn for the best, slowly but surely.

reviews.product_name: Beste No. 9 Jelly Cleanser
reviews.review_text: This Drunk Elephant Beste Jelly Cleanser is a real must have. A little bit goes a very long way, and it does an amazing job, effortlessly. My favorite part about the packaging, is how convenient the lid is, all you have to do to dispense is turn it, and then turn it again once you have the desired amount.  #skincare #skincareroutine #spanight #selfcare #drunkelephant #musthaves

A little wide note is that I might be a itty bit biased since I actually like the product quite a bit, and the scent makes me feel great! reviews.review_text: I cannot say enough good things about this line. I have used the aqua line and really enjoyed it. This was my first time using the cream and it’s just the right amount of richness without leaving my oily skin a greasy mess.

This has lasted for months (then again I use it only 4 days a week). I like how it is cheap too. It’s worth it because your skin isn’t the only thing that needs to be loved and cared for.

reviews.review_text: Made my skin really moisturized and hydrated. Had a very very light smell. But it smelled good. Took a while to soak into my skin and was a bit greasy before it did. Helped my dry spots on my face though! Overall it’s a good product!

reviews.review_text: Just like the glow recipe sleeping mask, I love this! I am very picky when it comes to skincare but I absolutely LOVE Asian skincare. This product again is a thick oil like consistency but doesn’t leave your face greasy or oily. Soaks into the skin fast and leaves it smooth. It smells exactly like watermelon but it’s not too strong. Love the packaging and the light pink color.

reviews.review_text: Amazing product! Use it after moisturizer to lock in all the moisture for the night!! Such a good smell! Love that biossance is an EWG certified brand; very important to me. Also use this product when I forget my body lotion to just give my skin the extra hydration and glow!

reviews.product_name: Protini Polypeptide Firming Refillable Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: This product has been a game changer for me. It’s hydrating, it feels smooth over my face, it gets absorbed quickly and isn’t sticky, and I can definitely see some of my fine lines disappearing slowly especially those around my mouth. I especially like the product packaging as it allows you to get the amount you need without having to touch the actual bulk of the product - it’s basically a slightly more interesting pump system where you press the top of the product and it dispenses a certain amount based on how much you’ve pressed. Kind of a weird pump in essence. I haven’t ran low yet though so I’m unsure if the pump mech will give any issues when I’m low. Hopefully not... I know it says to use this product as a shot of protein, but I’ve pretty much been using it as my moisturizer and adding on a diff brand moisturizer I have only one or two nights a week.

reviews.product_name: Pure Skin Face Cleanser
reviews.review_text: This cleanser is actually OK. It gets the job done, but I do feel like it just cleanses the surface and doesn’t get deep enough. It’s definitely not bad and I think for the price it is a great deal. If you combine it with deep cleaning couple times a week it will likely be perfectly adequate. I was happy with it for some time since I never put any make up on and it’s just the daily build up I need to clean but I’d prefer to get something that cleans deeper and also works in other ways (fine lines, etc). I may purchase again simply to keep it in the shower, though I won’t use it as my main cleanser.

reviews.product_name: Clear Improvement Active Charcoal Mask to Clear Pores
reviews.review_text: This is a favorite product of mine that I received as a sample and I really need to order more of. It clears up any blackheads I may have appearing around my note area instantly after I use it. I’m sure the benefits would be even better if used regularly which I havent been doing. A little of it does go a long way and the price is decent. If you’re happy with your routine but need a once or twice a week mask bc your pores are starting to show up, you should give this product a try. My husband can even tell the difference before and after I use this mask which says a lot.

reviews.product_name: B-Hydra Intensive Hydration Serum with Hyaluronic Acid
reviews.review_text: I’ve never had issues with dry skin until I moved to Colorado... A month after our move I started to notice my skin was drier than its ever been and I started to notice fine lines, too! Which, yes, I’m getting older but I wouldn’t have expected to move from having no lines to quite apparent ones in a matter of a month so I’d like to believe it was the dryness. At any rate, I added this product to my routine and I can definitely say that I can notice the extra hydration it provides. I’m unsure why some reviews say it’s sticky - I didn’t find it sticky and I think it’s very easy to spread over my face. I’ve been using it for my lower neck/shoulder area as well and with the extra hydration I can definitely see the fine lines in this area improving. I only use 2 small pumps with each wash and that’s it. It’s enough for my whole face and part of my neck. It also absorbs very quickly which is a plus. Doesn’t make skin feel sticky or anything like that either. If you’re happy with your routine but need juuuust a bit of extra hydration I’d say give this product a try.

I usually don’t care for scented skin care products but this doesn’t bother me at all.

reviews.product_name: Unseen Sunscreen SPF 40 PA+++
reviews.review_text: This is the best sun screen I have ever used. It works great to protect my skin and it wears very well under my make up on my oily skin. I’ve been using this sun screen for a long time now and wouldn’t use anything else.

reviews.product_name: Mini Unseen Sunscreen SPF 40 PA+++
reviews.review_text: This is the best sun screen I have ever used. It works great to protect my skin and it wears very well under my make up on my oily skin. I’ve been using this sun screen for a long time now and wouldn’t use anything else.

reviews.product_name: Magic Cream Moisturizer with Hyaluronic Acid
reviews.review_text: I received this cream, for free from Influenster, in exchange for my honest review.  I do not have dry skin but combination skin and I was pleasantly surprised that this cream did not make my skin appear oily, even under makeup.  My makeup didn’t even move or shift on my skin with this cream either, which is something I was expecting from a cream that was so moisturizing.  I like to use this day and night.  The reason why this is 4 stars and not 5 is because I didn’t see any huge difference in my skin except that it was moisturized.

reviews.product_name: Mini Daily Microfoliant Exfoliator
reviews.review_text: Every once in a while, your skin needs an extra push or scrub, to get deep into pores and get those impurities out.  I like this product by Dermologica because it is mild enough to use every day, although I think that once a week would suffice, it lathers up, and it’s a great size.  A little goes a long way, and if you use it once a week, than you can bet that this product will last you a long time.  The ingredients are clean and it smells fresh.  Your skin will be feeling so smooth afterwards.  I would definitely recommend it!

reviews.product_name: Capture Totale Super Potent Eye Serum
reviews.review_text: I absolutely LOVE Dior Capture Totale Super Potent Eye Serum.  The applicator is genius and always feels cool on my tired eyes.  I work 12-hour shifts and sometimes I work graves, and with a toddler, I need all the help I can get to achieve that “awake and refreshed look“.  Well, this is definitely it!  I’m sure you can stick this in one of those mini-refrigerators and achieve an even cooler eye serum, but the applicator seems sufficient enough for me.  The formula is non-greasy and I wear it underneath my makeup with no issues.  At bedtime, it plumps and “glows-up“ the undereye area.  The applicator is genius and since it is in a tube, you won’t run the risk of the serum losing its potency or efficacy.  A little goes a long way.  I have noticed a reduction in puffiness, fine lines, and a brightening effect. Just a note - when I think of a serum, I think of something a little thicker and “oily“ and this has none of that; it is more like the consistency of a lotion.  I haven’t noticed a scent, so if you like scent-free or light-scented products, then this should work well for you.  I have been using it consistently for 3 weeks, morning and night, and I feel like this tube will last me another good 1-2 months....

reviews.product_name: Smart Clinical Repair Wrinkle Correcting Eye Cream
reviews.review_text: Clinique Smart Clinical Repair Wrinkle Correcting Eye Cream is a very nice under-eye cream for everyday use.  I use it under my makeup and for my nighttime routine, with no issues.  It leaves my undereye area moisturized all day long with no breakouts.  A lot of heavier eye creams will make my skin breakout, but I did not notice that issue with this one.  I can’t say that I have noticed a reduction in wrinkles.  The first photo was taken on Dec. 22 and the final one was taken on Jan. 21, a full month of using the product, and I don’t notice anything different.  It could also be that I don’t have many wrinkles to work with, but I am using this as a preventative measure.  For reference, I am 38 years old with combination skin, and my under-eye area tends to be on the drier side.  The major issue I have with this eye cream is that it comes in a pot and not in a tube.  When the cream is constantly exposed to the elements, it loses it efficacy.

reviews.review_title: fixed my dehydrated lips from oral surgery
reviews.review_text: Background: had 6 dental surgeries in a span of 8 months and this took a toll on my lips. I needed more than just good chapstick. I found this and though I’ll try it since it isn’t even expensive. I cannot tell you how hydrating this is. I do not wake up with cracked bleeding lips anymore. A little goes a long way so this is a LOT of product in the jar. I feel this is a must have for normal lips too. I’m excited to try Laneige’s other products and really digging k-beauty.

reviews.product_name: Good Genes All-In-One AHA Lactic Acid Treatment
reviews.review_text: I was initially hesitant to buy this because of the price point and since I just turned 30 I thought I wouldn’t need something so expensive and “strong“. I went ahead and bought it during a sale and let me tell you.. THIS IS WORTH IT. A little background: I have had cystic acne since I was 16 and being south Asian I’m very prone to hyper-pigmentation and scarring. This absolutely helped with the scarring and texture. Another thing I noticed is a glow to the skin. Brown girls will understand the dullness we have to our skin sometimes, this product brings a healthy glow and I don’t really need foundation anymore. If you are hesitant to buy this because of the price point, I suggest go ahead as this will be an investment. One pump is more than enough so a little goes a long way. the 50 ml bottle lasted me 10 months.

reviews.product_name: Niacinamide 10% + Zinc 1% Oil Control Serum
reviews.review_text: I have oily skin and USED to break out. I have an excellent skin care regime that I barely ever breakout. Being South Asian I scar easily and I had acne scars from a year ago. I read this would help with scars so started using it. I broke out EVERYWHERE. I never break out around my nose or cheeks. I broke out on my neck too. I used it for a month thinking my skin needs time to adjust but it just kept getting worse. Now I have so many scars that will last years!!! I am so mad I can’t even..My sister on the other hand says it works for her. So this may suit some and not others. Proceed with caution.

reviews.review_text: I personally have the hardest time removing mascara. I have naturally thick and long lashes, so there’s always a lot to remove. This is the only stuff that gets it ALL off. Because I have skin on the dryer side, and I’ll do full glam makeup, I almost always triple cleanse in some kind of way, either by using this stuff twice, but more often following up with two applications of my everyday cleanser. But this by far does the best job of removing the tough to remove makeup, whether is mascara or vivid paints.

I make sure to fully massage it into my skin, and then, if I have the time, give it 5-10 minutes to absorb. I then follow in with my moisturizer. I know drunk elephant promotes using their products as “cocktails.“ I’ve personally never found this method effective, with other drunk elephant products or not. I feel like I don’t get the individual benefit that one product is supposed to give, and mixing them cancels them out.

reviews.product_name: Good Genes All-In-One AHA Lactic Acid Treatment
reviews.review_text: Honestly I am a long time user of the Sunday Riley Good Genes, and when they reformulated this product I was scared to repurchase. I’m so glad I received this product complimentary from Sunday Riley and try it again. I should never have been skeptical, my love has reawakened. No matter your skin type, lactic acid can be beneficial for skin renewal and promote hydration to give skin a softer, smoother and more gooey appearance. That is exactly what the Sunday Riley Good Genes All-In-One Lactic Acid Treatment does for my skin, it’s like a facial in a bottle, I just apply this, with a light facial oil on top and go to bed, then I wake up with glowy skin as if I just had a wonderful spa treatment. Good genes combines with Luna is also a fantastic combo! If you’ve been on the dense, definitely try this product out, I highly recommend it. Just don’t use any other BHA or AHA type products in your routine that night and make sure to be gentle with your skin to ensure best results.

I’ve had this serum for a few days now and I usually use a calming and soothing serum every night so I just switched out my serums for a few days. I always wash, apply an active serum, a calming serum, moisturizer and oil. This serum is extremely lightweight, it blended easily with the rest of my products, it does have a light fragrance due to the lavender and sandalwood extract (wish it didn’t) but isn’t overbearing. I noticed that throughout the evening it helped to calm some of th redness around my mouth and nose. Overall I am impressed it’s serves well for both oily skins and dry and works extremely well to provide hydration. I highly recommend that you give this product a try. I received this product from Glow Recipe complementary in exchange for my honest review.

reviews.review_text: Amazing sunscreen! I love that it completely absorbs into my skin and there’s no white residue. I’ve recommended it to friends and family too

reviews.product_name: Alpha Beta Extra Strength Daily Peel Pads
reviews.review_text: This product is strong for me because I have sensitive skin, but I do appreciate a quality product like this.

reviews.product_name: Alpha Beta Pore Perfecting & Refining Serum
reviews.review_text: I have sensitive skin, so I was hesitant to try this serum. In my late 20s, the pores on my cheeks became larger. After using this serum, you can tell my pores were smaller and skin felt tighter. I am not concerned with making my pores appear smaller, but it is good to try a good quality serum.

reviews.product_name: Benefiance Wrinkle Smoothing Eye Cream
reviews.review_text: For this product, a small amount is enough for the hydration you need. I use this before sleeping and when in morning. I have noticed a difference in my fine lines, as well. The price point is definitely on the higher side, but this product will last you for a long time.

reviews.product_name: Skinlongevity Long Life Herb Anti-Aging Face Serum
reviews.review_text: I received this product complimentary and loved how this serum made my skin feel the next day. I applied the serum at night.

reviews.product_name: Caffeine Eye Cream
reviews.review_text: This eye cream is light weight and gets absorbed easily. I would typically use it in the morning to depuff my under eyes before applying makeup. It is working well for me!

reviews.product_name: The Serum Stick: Treatment & Touch Up Balm
reviews.review_text: Amazing product from Tatcha! The first time ever for me to try a serum in stick form, it’s definitely travel friendly. Also, the serum is fragrance free, definitely up my alley. Applies on my face smooth, does not irritate my skin. I have been using this under foundation around my dryer areas, definitely helps my foundation to last on my skin and keeps my skin away from cracking.

reviews.product_name: Squalane + Vitamin C Rose Firming Oil
reviews.review_title: Good Product For the Right Areas
reviews.review_text: So I have this product on hand for a week, and I used it everyday. I have combo skin and my cheeks are very sensitive. And I like this product. It dose not bring irritation to my skin and does a good job taking care of it. However, it is a little bit heavy for a full face use. I would only use it on my cheeks because that is the areas that I need the most care on. And definitely use this primarily in the nighttime as it is a skin oil.

reviews.product_name: Estee Lauder Advanced Night Repair Synchronized Multi-Recovery Complex Serum
reviews.review_text: Have been using the mini size of this serum and I like it. It does not irritate my skin and gets absorb quite well. I was having some red pimples scars on my skin before using this and this serum definitely help the scars to look less red!

reviews.product_name: Mini Advanced Night Repair Synchronized Multi-Recovery Complex
reviews.review_text: Have been using the mini size of this serum and I like it. It does not irritate my skin and gets absorb quite well. I was having some red pimples scars on my skin before using this and this serum definitely help the scars to look less red!

reviews.product_name: Vinoperfect Radiance Dark Spot Serum Vitamin C Alternative
reviews.review_text: Ive been using this for about a week now and it has taken away my redness and i can already see some sun spots fading away and some old acne scars. Its so light and smells lovely. I use the essence then this serum then the overnight cream. Im obsessed with this line!!

reviews.product_name: Jet Lag Mask
reviews.review_title: just what my skin had been wanting
reviews.review_text: I saw Nicole Guerreros IG story and her skin looked AMAZING so i had to purchase this. I used it last night as an overnight mask and im obsessed. I woke up and my face was one even tone. No redness. I just washed with water and added some Drunk Elephant marula oil. Its def worth it im already obsessed! My skin feels really good and hydrated. Gonna repurchase.
