reviews.product_name: CC+ Cream Oil-Free Matte with SPF 40
reviews.review_text: I love this so much! I wanted something a little less coverage than my holy grail too faced peach perfect fountation. I have huge pores and my chin pores are so huge when i wear full coverage foundation u can see them it looks like i shave. This cc cream makes them non existant! I have a sample still and ive already used it 3 times. Love this stuff

reviews.product_name: Glow2OH Dark Spot Toner
reviews.review_text: Ive used this for 2 nights and i already love it. It made a huge difference on my skin. My makeup looked amazing the next day after using it. It really helps alot with texture. Ive had hormonal acne the past 3 months due to pregnancy but this really helped! Im excited to see what more this will do after more uses. Ive tried the green toner but i have more dry skin so that one didnt work for me. I dont mind the smell to this one i actually love it. Ive seen reviews about it being reviews by people that have been sent this but this is my honest review!

reviews.product_name: The Dewy Skin Cream Plumping & Hydrating Moisturizer
reviews.review_title: Dew urself a fav and buy!
reviews.review_text: I had been looking for a moisturizer that i could use without having to add oil to it. My skin is been so dry during this pregnancy. And my makeup was just looking so flaky and dry. Ive tried many and when i first tried this on it felt amazing i instantly said yep this is it. I even have the Camellia oil by tatcha as well and added 3 drops and i instantly fell inlove! I dont necessarily need to add the oil as the cream does good on its own but i love the luxurious feeling lol. The smell is so good! So clean. I use the tatcha primer as well. My makeup is looking BOMB these days. I highly recommend this!!!

reviews.product_name: Adaptogen Deep Moisturizing Cream with Ashwagandha + Reishi
reviews.review_text: I am on my third jar of this and been the best moisturizer ive ever used. I just this with Flora + Bast cbd facial oil and its perfection. Both help with redness. My skin is left looking calm and clear!!

reviews.product_name: Mini Adaptogen Deep Moisture Cream with Ashwagandha + Reishi
reviews.review_text: I am on my third jar of this and been the best moisturizer ive ever used. I just this with Flora + Bast cbd facial oil and its perfection. Both help with redness. My skin is left looking calm and clear!!

reviews.product_name: Moisturizing Eye Bomb with Squalane
reviews.review_text: This eye cream is so hydrating! It’s feels lightweight and combined with the vitamin c cream, they left my skin feeling so moisturized. It does have a faint scent to it. I also like that a little goes a long way.

reviews.product_name: Aqua Bomb Brightening Vitamin C Cream
reviews.review_text: I love this cream. It leaves my skin so hydrated without feeling sticky. I love that it brightens my skin because I can wear it on my no makeup days with sunscreen and an eye cream.

reviews.product_name: 5 Stars Retinol + Niacinamide Eye Serum
reviews.review_text: This is a great product! I love that it’s gentle and doesn’t irritate my skin like most products with retinol do. The applicator is also nice and makes application easier. I have not noticed much of a difference in my fine lines because I have not used it long enough but I do like the hydration it provides after applying it.

reviews.product_name: Vitamin Enriched Face Base Priming Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: This moisturizer is my favorite for travel because it is also a great primer for makeup. It has a fresh scent that is very pleasant and light. I like that the scent does not linger. I like that it does not leave my skin greasy. Definitely recommend for a simpler skin prep for makeup application.

reviews.product_name: Glowscreen Sunscreen SPF 40 PA+++ with Hyaluronic Acid + Niacinamide
reviews.review_text: I love this sunscreen. It feels very lightweight on my skin and gives me a nice glow. I like to apply it with and without makeup. It absorbs into the skin nicely and doesn’t clog my pores. I love that it is tinted because it doesn’t leave any kind of white cast.

reviews.product_name: Protini Polypeptide Firming Refillable Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: So far I have loved DE’s items (before this I had the Luxury Marula Oil, Babyfacial, and C-Firma) but I wasnt expecting how awesome this cream is! I never though anything would replace my Belif moisturizer but this just may. Although I don’t feel the rich hydration that I get from Belif, this just does...something to the skin. It hydrates it just the right amount and makes it SO plump and soft....literally couldnt stop touching it after my first use. I’m excited to see what the long-term benefits may be. You have done it again DE!

reviews.product_name: T.L.C. Framboos Glycolic Resurfacing Night Serum
reviews.review_text: Love this serum, it really does improve texture. I use it before bed 2-3 nights a week and my skins never looked better!

reviews.product_name: Beste No. 9 Jelly Cleanser
reviews.review_text: Looooove this cleanser. It has a unique texture, super gentle, and scent free. Received this from Influenster, but I’ve used this in the past. Will def repurchase.

reviews.product_name: Lala Retro Whipped Refillable Moisturizer with Ceramides
reviews.review_text: I loved the old formula, but I love this new one with ceramides even more. I use tretinoin and that can wreck havoc with skins moisture barrier, so anything I can get to aid in preserving that, I’m all about. A+ cream. It feels a little lighter than the previous version, while still being as hydrating.

reviews.product_name: Lippe Balm
reviews.review_text: Very nice lip balm, although....its just a balm. Its def of higher quality, but expensive for what it is.

reviews.product_name: C-Tango Vitamin C Eye Cream
reviews.review_text: Really hydrates quite well, and keeps my dry under eyes quenched. The inclusion of Vitamin C is a huge plus!

reviews.product_name: Facial Treatment Essence (Pitera Essence)
reviews.review_text: Just ok. My skin felt hydrated afterwards and my entire routine did leave a glow but I don’t believe it can be attributed to this product.  I think you are paying for a name and hype. There are more affordable products out there with similar results. I will not repurchase.

reviews.product_name: The Essence Skincare Boosting Treatment
reviews.review_text: I love this product! Makes my skin feel plump and hydrated immediately! Worth the hype for sure. I love Tactcha skincare.

reviews.product_name: Mini The Essence  Skincare Boosting Treatment
reviews.review_text: I love this product! Makes my skin feel plump and hydrated immediately! Worth the hype for sure. I love Tactcha skincare.

reviews.product_name: Indigo Overnight Repair Serum in Cream Treatment
reviews.review_text: This night cream does all the right things. I have dry to combo skin. This goes on smooth wakes up still moisturized. Tatcha does it again. I received this product in exchange for my honest opinion.

reviews.product_name: Mini Indigo Overnight Repair Serum in Cream Treatment
reviews.review_text: This night cream does all the right things. I have dry to combo skin. This goes on smooth wakes up still moisturized. Tatcha does it again. I received this product in exchange for my honest opinion.

reviews.product_name: Santorini Grape Poreless Skin Cream
reviews.review_text: I received this for free in exchange for my review. The cream is nice. A little thin but does help skin feel hydrated and very smooth.

reviews.product_name: T.L.C. Framboos Glycolic Resurfacing Night Serum
reviews.review_text: I received this product in exchange for my honest feedback.  After several weeks of using this product I really like it. It does a great job of smoothing my skin without irritation.  This is a product I would repurchase for my night routine.

reviews.product_name: Lala Retro Whipped Refillable Moisturizer with Ceramides
reviews.review_text: I received  this product from Influenster for my honest opinion. After using it the past few weeks I am pleased with it but not overwhelmed.  It is a bit pricey.  It is more of a night cream in my opinion because it is thick.  Would I purchase it again? Probably not. However if you like the ingredient list, look for unscented products then this could be for you!

reviews.product_name: Ultra Facial Moisturizing Cream with Squalane
reviews.review_text: I picked this up in the mini size as I was waiting to checkout (I know, Sephora succeeded in making me impulse buy this while standing in line for the checkout, lol). But omg. This is the best impulse buy I’ve ever made! This is SO hydrating and nice on the skin. I put it on right before I go to bed and when I wake up, I feel hydrated and even notice that my redness is a bit toned-down. Seriously love this stuff. Will be repurchasing in the regular size when my mini runs out!!!

reviews.product_name: Mini Ultra Facial Moisturizing Cream with Squalane

reviews.review_text: I received this product complimentary from Farmacy Beauty. I believe this moisturizer will easily become my go-to, especially for the upcoming colder season. First of all, this baby is thiCC (YES - with two C’s!)!!! We are talking about some super rich texture here that glides on smoothly and sinks into the skin like a dream! I find that it’s best applied with my fingers and works well during the evening. It also sits well under makeup for use during the mornings. It’s got a rather light, earthy smell that I find disappears after it is on the face. Farmacy has some great products. And this Honey Halo is certainly no exception!

reviews.product_name: Watermelon Glow Niacinamide Dew Drops
reviews.review_text: This new release was gifted by Glow Recipe. These drops are perfect for smoothing the skin pre-makeup and brightening the skin! The texture is absolutely heavenly and it’s light consistency absorbs quickly into the skin when applied with the fingers.

reviews.product_name: Rose & Hyaluronic Acid Deep Hydration Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I have actually tried the first formulation along with this one that was gifted by Fresh to me. I actually had to return the first one because it was so fragranced - this one is also fragranced, but not near as bad in my opinion. This feels lovely on the skin, but I find it’s not revolutionary as other Fresh products (their lip products especially). It’s a great formulation and smells very fresh and clean, but overall I believe I have better in my collection from this brand.

reviews.product_name: Barrier+ Triple Lipid-Peptide Face Cream
reviews.review_text: I absolutely love this new moisturizer! I was in the market for a new one knowing that I love VERY hydrating products, and I find this one fits the bill nicely! It’s got just enough hydration to where it doesn’t leave me feeling greasy, but does leave a great layer of hydration to the skin. One star off because it’s so pricey. Other than that, a lovely product!

This has aloe Vera juice, and I think that ingredient helped with my acne and dryness from acne medications . TOTALLY RECOMMEND

The only thing I don’t like about it is that it leaves a heavy white cast, but it goes away within 5 minutes if rubbed in properly . I have acne prone skin, and it doesn’t seem to irritate or break me out :)

reviews.product_name: C-Firma Fresh Vitamin-C Day Serum
reviews.review_text: New formula is amazing ! It does NOT smell like hot dogs ( like it did with the old formula ), new one smells like their tlc serum , and it does not feel sticky, like the old c-firma did  !

reviews.product_name: Protini Polypeptide Firming Refillable Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: Not for acne prone skin ! I bought this exactly 1 week ago, barely had any acne , and now this is what my skin looks like after using Protini .

reviews.product_name: The Water Cream Oil-Free Pore Minimizing Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: Everything about this moisturizer is amazing ! The texture, hydration level, and scent is perfect ! I do have acne prone skin , so I was worried it will break me out because of the fragrance , but surprisingly it didn’t ! I will say that if you apply too much , your face will feel too “suffocating”, so a little does go a long way with this moisturizer ! If your like me , and have tried Drunk Elephant Lala retro and that breaks you out , this might be the moisturizer for you ! Much more hydrating also !

reviews.review_text: Debating whether I should give this 1 star or 2 stars …. Crème de la mer  is definitely hydrating and moisturizing , but only 30 min to 1hr after application . I apply crème de la mer in the evenings , and the next morning, my skin feels extremely dry and tight , to the point where I need to apply aquaphor all over my face . I believe the fragrance is to blame . This crème is very thick , so if you are not too dry , this might not be the one for you . Felt very waxy and very hard to spread. Oh and by the way , this smells exactly like cetaphil face wash (not a good thing , I hate that smell !) But hey , if you have the money to spend $200 only for 1 oz , go ahead ! Tryit yourself . I have dry acne prone skin and this product was horrible ! Yuck

Got it as a sample and now I own everything in the line, cause I don’t want to use anything else in my face ever again !

reviews.review_text: Game changer sunscreen ! It’s very thick so a tiny little bit goes a long way. Haven’t tried it with makeup but I think it might be too thick for matte foundation, maybe something you don’t want to stay matte. It’s great at color correction too ! I love this whole line! I have VERY sensitive skin and I’ve tried so many different brands, products and active ingredients and they all made my skin sensitive. This whole line has calmed my skin down and made it better. I received this for testing purposes but I absolutely love the whole line and will repurchase. I honestly feel no need for any different or new skin care products !

reviews.product_name: Moisturizing Eye Bomb with Squalane
reviews.review_text: I’ve been using this for 2 months now (I got it as a sample a long time ago) and it’s the best eye cream I’ve ever used! I just got another sample but will repurchase when I run out. A little goes a long way so it will take me long to go through both jars.

reviews.product_name: The True Cream Aqua Bomb
reviews.review_text: I love the water cream! I have gotten over 5 samples of it and every time I love it and tell myself I’ll buy it on the next sale lol it’s very lightweight but hydrating enough for my dry skin to use during the day. Definitely recommend!

reviews.product_name: Vinoperfect Radiance Dark Spot Serum Vitamin C Alternative
reviews.review_text: this is one of my favorite serums and I have purchased and repurchased this time and time again because this serum feels great on the skin and does not leave a sticky residue. While you dont necessarily see results right away, after a month or two, my skin was more radiant and brighter. This serum is gentle on the skin yet effective.This review is being reviewed as part of an Influenster contest.

reviews.product_name: Soy Hydrating Gentle Face Cleanser
reviews.review_text: The soy cleanser isn’t overly scented and doesn’t leave a lingering scent after being rinsed off your face. In use, however, it does give off some notes that remind me of cucumber, but nothing overpowering. The cleanser is a sort of gel consistency. No lather. And while it leaves your skin feeling fresh, it is rather gentle and doesn’t strip away the natural oils and layers of your skin. my skin always feels smooth and soft post cleanse.

reviews.product_name: Lip Glowy Balm
reviews.review_title: lip balm that gives the shine of a gloss
reviews.review_text: I normally keep it pretty basic when it comes to lip balms because I live in a dry climate and no matter how much water your chugging back daily, you still go through a lot of lip balm in a year. But regardless, since these were released, they have on my list of things I wanted to try, so I was super stoked to be sent this by Topbox circle for testing purposes.This balm is tinted, although, I think if your lips are more pigmented, the tint won’t be too pronounced, as the tint is quite subtle. It has the feeling and hint of a gloss without the tackiness that some glosses tend to have. It does have a light berry scent, but nothing that lingers after application.

reviews.product_name: Sugar Strawberry Exfoliating Face Wash
reviews.review_text: The exfoliator doesn’t have super coarse sandy bits rather very fine sugar crystals, so it is not abrasive and is a gentle exfoliator. A small dollop of product goes a long way and likely this exfoliator will last a while. It is lightly scented and smells of strawberries lightly. This exfoliator leaves the skin feeling nice and soft afterwards and doesn’t dry out the skin. Please note that this exfoliator was sent courtesy of Influenster for testing purposes.

reviews.product_name: PHAT Glow Facial Mask
reviews.review_text: I love that this mask comes in an opaque bottle with a pump as opposed to in a jar where you have to scoop out product every use. I feel this makes masking a less messy experience and wastes less product. This mask feels comfortable on the skin and after the 15 minutes it is supposed to sit on the skin, it doesn’t feel overly dry or like it is pulling, as some clay masks sometimes leaves your skin. The one drawback to this mask is that it does have a scent to it and I would have preferred it to be completely unscented. Overall, after washing this mask off my face, I did notice that it felt softer and smoother. This mask is supposed to also instantly exfoliate and illuminator. I would say it was a relatively mild and gentle exfoliator. I didn’t necessarily notice my skin appearing to be more radiant and brightened right away, and think it would take a more prolonged use to see those kinds of effects!

reviews.product_name: Banana Bright 15% Vitamin C Serum
reviews.review_text: Postpartum skin can be unpredictable and hormonal, so I’m here for this serum and happy to add this to my daily routine. It smells lovely, nothing overly fragrant, and feels really great on the skin upon application. I’ve used it for about a month and a half and my skin feels better, and looks amazing! My skin feels soft, dewy, and smooth texture-wise as opposed to dry and tight. It looks all around a bit more radiant and healthy.

reviews.product_name: Volcanic AHA Pore Clearing Clay Mask
reviews.review_text: I don’t use clay masks too frequently these days because my skin is now more dry and not nearly as acne prone as it used to be, and I find clay masks have a tendency to dry my skin out. This clay mask however, is not nearly as drying. I only applied a super thin layer on my face with more focus on the poresnon my nose. It was easy to spread on your face without getting super thick or heavy. Washing this off was a relatively quick and painless process. I noticed my skin didn’t feel dry or tight afterwards and my skin felt smooth. My pores also felt a little less clogged.I think if you are looking for a clay mask that is on the gentler side and have sensitive or acne prone skin, this might be the mask for you! #freeproduct

reviews.product_name: Unseen Sunscreen SPF 40 PA+++
reviews.review_text: This is my new favorite sunscreen. You don’t get the heaviness and shine that you typically get from sunscreen.

reviews.product_name: Mini Unseen Sunscreen SPF 40 PA+++
reviews.review_text: This is my new favorite sunscreen. You don’t get the heaviness and shine that you typically get from sunscreen.

reviews.product_name: AHA 30% + BHA 2% Exfoliating Peeling Solution
reviews.review_text: This should be a part of everyone’s beauty regimen. I can’t say it helps with my melasma, but discoloration aside, my skin looks amazing!

reviews.product_name: Glycolic Acid 7% Exfoliating Toning Solution
reviews.review_text: The Ordinary does it again! I love this toner. If you have problems with unevenness, give this a whirl.

reviews.product_name: Watermelon Pink Juice Oil-Free Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: My skin just drinks it up right away. It’s really light and I live that it comes with a pump.

reviews.product_name: Mini Daily Microfoliant Exfoliator
reviews.review_text: I buy a lot of skincare products, and I’ll admit that I’m pretty hard to impress. My skin is now glowing, and supple. It’s been 2 days since I’ve exfoliated and my skin still looks and feels great. The added bonus? It’s cruelty free.

reviews.product_name: Urban Environment Oil-Free Sunscreen Broad-Spectrum SPF 42
reviews.review_text: This sunscreen is amazing. It’s scent is light and it doesn’t leave a white cast. Even though it is oil free, i don’t find it to be too drying. I’d repurchase!

reviews.product_name: Urban Environment Fresh-Moisture Sunscreen Broad-Spectrum SPF 42
reviews.review_text: This sunscreen is my new go to. I have dry skin and this is extremely hydrating and nourishing. It left me looking refreshed and glowy. It didn’t pill over skin care or under my makeup. I will definitely be repurchasing throughout the summer.

reviews.product_name: Aqua Bomb Brightening Vitamin C Cream
reviews.review_text: I just love everything from belif. My skin drinks this up and looks brighter immediately. I already loved their aqua bomb so i’m so glad to have a vitamin c version

reviews.product_name: The Dewy Skin Cream Plumping & Hydrating Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: This is my ride or die moisturizer! Everyone who’s saying it’s too “oily” or “greasy” is using too much! A little goes a LONG way! I only have a sample size and I’m not even halfway through after using it morning and night for 2 weeks straight.

reviews.product_name: The Essence Skincare Boosting Treatment
reviews.review_text: Hydrates the skin & leaves a natural glow! It helps to make it so your actives absorb better!

reviews.review_text: Hydrates the skin & leaves a natural glow! It helps to make it so your actives absorb better!

reviews.product_name: The Camellia Oil 2-in-1 Makeup Remover & Cleanser
reviews.review_text: I live this stuff! It does a great job removing make up & it leaves your skin feeling silky soft!

reviews.product_name: Blueberry Bounce Gentle Cleanser
reviews.review_title: gentle even for sensitive skin types
reviews.review_text: I have very sensitive & dry skin so most products cause a reaction, however, this product was very gentle and did a great job at cleansing! I alternate between this and the Tatcha cleansing oil.

reviews.product_name: The Water Cream Oil-Free Pore Minimizing Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: This smells like a spa (cucumbers). It works well and dries fast. If you have super dry skin like me, the dewy skin cream is the better option.

reviews.product_name: Mini The Water Cream
reviews.review_text: This smells like a spa (cucumbers). It works well and dries fast. If you have super dry skin like me, the dewy skin cream is the better option.

reviews.product_name: The Deep Cleanse Gentle Exfoliating Cleanser
reviews.review_text: I honestly wasn’t the biggest fan of this. I love the cleansing oil but this had what felt like little grains in it that felt rough. I felt like it was a lot messier to clean my face with than the oil.

reviews.product_name: Mini Deep Cleanse Gentle Exfoliating Cleanser

reviews.product_name: The Kissu Lip Mask
reviews.review_title: this is the cure for dry lips
reviews.review_text: I have super dry lips and this moisturizer keeps your lips soft and moisturized all day long! A little goes a long way.

reviews.product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C
reviews.review_title: Cannot imagine my life without this lip mask
reviews.review_text: G.O.A.T. lip product. Lasts for a zillion years. This products changed my lips. I used to think that there was no way I could not wake up with chapped or dry lips every day. Now I can’t remember the last time I have. Get this for everyone you know, it will last them forever, they’ll love it, and you’ll be a hero. Amazing deal.

reviews.product_name: Jet Lag Mask
reviews.review_title: May duplicate other products but nice mask
reviews.review_text: This ended up not being a favorite but I don’t think it’s a bad product. Since I already use moisturizer, there was never a time where this filled a void that couldn’t just be filled by my regular products. I think the ideal user for this might be a person who usually uses light products.

reviews.product_name: Facial Radiance Pads
reviews.review_text: Great quick fix for when I can tell a breakout is on the horizon. Strong in a “this is working“ way but not overpowering.

reviews.product_name: Caffeine 5% + EGCG Depuffing Eye Serum
reviews.review_text: Didn’t cause trouble but didn’t work for me. Nice and light. Granted, my under eye area is plagues with dark circles. This was not the solution to my woes.

reviews.product_name: Brighten-i Eye Cream
reviews.review_title: Promising for dark circles, dry, sensitive eyes
reviews.review_text: I really like this. Just arrived yesterday but good results. I LOVE the applicator, it feels so good to use it as a massage tool. My dark circles are pretty terrible and the skin around my eyes is thin and one eye is super sensitive due to a tear-duct condition, so I don’t expect a miracle. That said, it was nice to put on, not irritating, and its hydrating without being heavy. Excited to see how this works for me.

reviews.product_name: Virgin Marula Luxury Face Oil
reviews.review_text: I never thought I’d buy this when (seemingly) the same thing is available for super cheap from The Ordinary. But this is a truly superb product that I never want to be without. It is so light, so elegant, it absorbs so beautifully. I’ve always had skin that tends toward dryness but lately it’s been extra dry. This formulation works beautifully for day or night. It gets rid of the little dry patch near my eyebrows which means that my tinted moisturizer looks pretty instead of flaky. It fills in fine lines. It is also AMAZING on my arms- just a few drops once a day keeps the upper arms soft, smooth and bump-free. The Ordinary Marula Oil is fine (if you want a cheap oil, I think their “B” Oil is their best as long as you don’t mind a very green, vegetal smell) but it’s clunkier. It does not absorb as well into my skin. Drunk Elephant Marula Oil is worth the money.

reviews.product_name: The True Cream Aqua Bomb
reviews.review_text: I love this moisturizer! When I use it my face does not feel tight afterwards, and I have sensitive skin and it has not broken me out at all. When you put it on it sinks into your skin immediately and not leave you feeling greasy. The moisturizer has a very light scent that has a slight medicinal smell that does not bother me because you can only smell it when you put it on and disappears almost immediately. Overall I love this product.

reviews.product_name: Umbra Sheer Physical Daily Defense SPF 30
reviews.review_text: Although the sunscreen claims to not leave a white cast, it does. It goes away after a while, but when you first put it on the cast is quite obvious. I have very sensitive skin and this did not break me out like a lot of other sunscreens have. Another thing is the smell, after you put it on you can smell a weird mayo like smell that is not pleasant.

reviews.product_name: Balancing Force Oil Control Toner
reviews.review_text: This is a very nice toner. It doesn’t dry out my skin and makes it feel clean and balanced. I’m not very sure if it’s exfoliating my skin due the the AHA and BHA, but it feels good after using it... so maybe? Overall I would recommend this product for anyone who wants a good reliable toner.

reviews.product_name: Blueberry Bounce Gentle Cleanser
reviews.review_text: This is an amazing cleanser! The pump is so convenient and easy to use in the shower. when you pump it out you get the perfect mount of cleanser, no more no less. The texture of the cleanser is gorgeous! It is a jelly texture that feels great on the skin. When you rub it in it creates a great lather without stripping the skin. The smell is also great. It is sweet and berry like, so it reminds me of candy. If you don’t like sweet scents don’t worry because the smell is not strong at all and very light and refreshing. Overall I would highly recommend this cleanser. Ps. The packaging is adorable!

reviews.product_name: Unseen Sunscreen SPF 40 PA+++
reviews.review_text: Great sunscreen. No white cast and leave a dry touch matte finish.

reviews.product_name: Mini Unseen Sunscreen SPF 40 PA+++
reviews.review_text: Great sunscreen. No white cast and leave a dry touch matte finish.

reviews.product_name: Ready Steady Glow Daily AHA Tonic
reviews.review_text: This is my favorite toner off all time. It gently exfoliates your skin every time you use it, so you don’t even need to do an extra exfoliation. It is not drying at all and it even works for my sensitive skin.The pump is really nice and the bottle lasts for a long time. I would highly recommend this.

reviews.product_name: Mini Ready Steady Glow Daily AHA Tonic
reviews.review_text: This is my favorite toner off all time. It gently exfoliates your skin every time you use it, so you don’t even need to do an extra exfoliation. It is not drying at all and it even works for my sensitive skin.The pump is really nice and the bottle lasts for a long time. I would highly recommend this.

reviews.product_name: Sugar Hydrating Lip Balm
reviews.review_text: I obsessed with the OG SUGAR LIP CARAMEL so when I saw on instagram that fresh was coming out with a coconut edition - I went bananas (there’s an idea)! Needless to say, I picked one up also knowing it’s limited edition. I’m obsessed with anything coconut. I’m still working through my first pot of Lip Caramel so i can’t wait to bust this open! The texture/formula is a bit different. After reading the ingredient list, I discovered there is no actual coconut oil in the formula which I find surprising, just coconut fragrance. The textures are a bit different, this one I found to be more waxy and less “caramelly“ than the original. There is also a limited edition lemon version I will be picking up when released.

reviews.product_name: Facial Radiance Pads
reviews.review_text: The best non-physical exfoliate. Super gentle on sensitive skin. Don’t be scared of the tingle. Smooth the non-texture side of the pre-moistened pad over your skin, wait 1 minute, flip over the pad and “slough“ off the exfoliated dermis with the textured side of the pad. No rinsing required, the residual will continue to do its magic. This is probably best done in the evening and gentle enough for daily use but find daily is a bit overkill.

reviews.product_name: Vegan Milk Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: This Is a very thick, heavy weight moisturizer it is light enough to be worn during the day if you have dry to normal skin but especially good for the evening. The Milk moisturizer doesn’t seem to have any added fragrance which is a nice alternative to all the heavily fragranced skin and cosmetic products on the market. I do not recommend this moisturizer for anyone with combination or oily skin.

reviews.product_name: The Kissu Lip Mask
reviews.review_text: This really helps with dry chapped lips especially in winter months. I like the texture and it stays on well without feeling heavy or sticky. This product is the best best thing to keeping hydrated.

reviews.product_name: Sugar Strawberry Exfoliating Face Wash
reviews.review_text: I love the texture and scent of this product it definitely does it’s job for a gentle physical exfoliants however in terms of cleansing it really does nothing to strip the skin of oil.

reviews.product_name: Abeille Royale Advanced Youth Watery Oil
reviews.review_text: This product is not suited for my skin type and preferences. What I do like about this product is its texture, the concept of having a light weight oil/serum that isn’t oily feeling is very appealing and it does leave the skin looking visibly hydrated however because it is so heavily scented I simply don’t like it. It’s not a natural/botanical scent either, it’s a soapy, floral perfume scent. In addition, I do not like the dry down on the skin, its very tacky feeling and feels like my skin can’t breathe.

reviews.product_name: Mini Abeille Royale Advanced Youth Watery Oil
reviews.review_text: This product is not suited for my skin type and preferences. reviews.product_name: Mini Rose & Hyaluronic Acid Deep Hydration Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I received a sample of this and really loved how nourishing and hydrating it is. It leaves a very dewy finish on my skin. I would recommend this product in winter or transitional months.

reviews.product_name: Jet Lag Mask
reviews.review_text: Just got this product- I applied it last night to wear overnight and my skin almost instantly soaked it up, to the point where there was nothing visible and I could feel a new, very soft/smooth texture to my skin. With this softness, I noticed the “glow“ that this mask is supposed to give within seconds. I did not get much of the tingling that some people report. It just felt soothing to me. I was worried to see if I had breakouts in the morning since I have sensitive and acne-prone skin but my skin just looked smooth and soft! I decided to apply the mask again in the morning, just for the 10-minute interval, and my skin just drank it up again so there was no residue for me to wipe off.I do moisturize regularly but it’s hard to keep up in the winter months. This mask actually worked really well for me to hydrate and soften my skin and give me the glow of drinking 10L of water :)

reviews.product_name: Mini Jet Lag Mask

reviews.product_name: Luminous Dewy Skin Mist
reviews.review_text: My first Tatcha product and I’m so excited! Sprayed this on my bare skin and noticed an instant dewy glow just like the product says. Very soft coating and very fine mist that comes out but it’s just the amount you need. 3 spritzes did not feel like a lot but gave me the desired effect! Also I have dry, sensitive, acne-prone skin and the product did not cause any issues :) Also, the bottle and packaging are beautiful and came with a small piece of parchment describing a brief history of Tatcha, which I enjoyed and made me feel like I had unlocked some ancient beauty secret!

reviews.product_name: Moisturizing Eye Bomb with Squalane
reviews.review_text: I just got this. I’d been looking for effective eye product with non-harmful ingredients, as my eyes have been looking puffy and tired. I’ve tried IT Cosmetics under-eye cream which I liked but didn’t see amazing results. Also I thought it was too thick to “gently“ apply to the under-eye area. This BELIF cream reminds me of the Rodan   Fields eye cream, except I think this one is better (and cheaper)! I saw results the morning after I woke up! I applied this before bed and woke up to radiant and non-puffy under-eyes. It’s a very light cream and is very easy to apply gently. You also only need a very tiny amount so it should last awhile. I’d recommend only using this at night, as the cream does last up to 26 hours like they advertise (crazy!!!) and it is VERY moisturizing!

reviews.product_name: Sugar Hydrating Lip Balm
reviews.review_title: Not much of a tint but a good balm nonetheless
reviews.review_text: I bought this balm in blood orange. The things I love about it are the packaging, the scent, and the moisturizing effect without feeling sticky. It also gives a nice satin sheen to lips, not glossy, which I like a lot. I do wish it gave a bit more of a tint to the lips. It’s there (maybe?), but so very slight that I think it could just be an enhancement of my own lip color. I also wish it lasted on the lips longer. Maaaybe it lasts an hour? I tend to rub or smack my lips a lot when I have something on them, so partly it’s my fault. I gave it 4 stars because of those things, in combination with the $18 price tag that seems kind of steep. Overall, though, it is a pretty superior balm and it feels and looks good on the lips.

reviews.product_name: Watermelon Glow PHA + BHA Pore-Tight Toner
reviews.review_title: Fresh and does what it says
reviews.review_text: I am 30 and have combination/sensitive, acne-prone skin. I’ve used Thayer’s witch hazel toner which I like but wanted to upgrade. I found this and am not disappointed! I use this after washing my face and it tightens my pores and evens my complexion. It also gives a beautiful, non-greasy glow so that my skin looks fresh and hydrated. I’ve been using this for about a week and it has not caused breakouts. It smells like a cucumber-y watermelon, which is nice to wake up to. I highly recommend!

reviews.product_name: Mini Watermelon Glow PHA + BHA Pore-Tight Toner
reviews.review_title: Fresh and does what it says

reviews.product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C
reviews.review_text: So I decided to buy this lip mask to help out with my sometimes dry lips so I can wear dark liquid lipsticks. I also decided to make some at home lip exfoliant (sooo easy & sooo cheap!) I first exfoliate then throw this sucker over them before I go to bed. Nice and moisturized!! Ps. Does anyone else LOVE the little pink matching spatula it comes with!? I’m obsessed!

reviews.product_name: Oil-Absorbing Pore Treatment Strips
reviews.review_text: Guys... these are amazing. I was FULLY prepared to be disappointed in the results like ever other black head strip, but these seriously surprised me!!! After 3 hours I can already see stuff it’s pulled out of my pores, & honestly most strips don’t get much out for me. These are amazing and absolutely worth the price. I’m so stoked & will stock up, these will be great to have on hand.

reviews.product_name: Sugar Advanced Lip Balm Intense Hydration Treatment
reviews.review_text: I got this in my play box, & immediately went and bought the full sized tube once I was out. I love love love this stuff! I wear it all through out the day & find that it lasts quite a while, my lips don’t ever get dry & flakey anymore!

reviews.product_name: Clear Improvement Charcoal Honey Mask to Purify and Nourish
reviews.review_text: Love that there is a clarifying mask for DRY-NORMAL skin!!! Some clarifying masks are just too much and dry my skin out wayyyy too much. This is the perfect balance, & I’m especially a huge fan of skincare that has honey in it :) so nourishing

reviews.product_name: Sugar Hydrating Lip Balm
reviews.review_text: I grabbed this randomly as I was about to leave Sephora, picked it up and smelled it. This balm smells sooo good, coconut is my weakness. Not only does it smell amazing, this balm is not sticky, or too oily. It’s the perfect consistency & when I put it on before bed it lasts until morning. My lips feel so moisturized and plumped. I really hope they keep this scent around :D

reviews.product_name: Avocado Fine Line Eye Cream with Retinol
reviews.review_text: I got this as a sample, and while it is a nice eye mask I didn’t find myself always reaching for this because I’m honestly really lazy and only wash my face and do a massive skincare routine at night (I know, I know...not the best) because I don’t have too many skin issues, just dryness & I use really heavy duty stuff at night. I love having this retinol eye cream in my arsenal don’t get me wrong. The consistency of the mask isn’t super duper heavy in my opinion, not thin either, but like I said I’m super dry so I like a cream that’s pretty thick. I think the amount you get in this jar is PLENTY! It’s only a 6 month expiration on this, so I think you’ll have more than enough. It’s great having a retinol eye product, I didn’t have one before this. I haven’t noticed any Stellar benefits from it yet, I’ve used it several times but I’ll update if I notice anything down the road!

reviews.product_name: Good Genes All-In-One AHA Lactic Acid Treatment
reviews.review_text: Yep, I can confirm that the formula has changed. This makes me really sad as good genes was my favorite splurge. After reading reviews I was concerned with buying a full sized so I spent my points on a sample size.. i was unbothered by the original formulas scent, it smelled like lemongrass to me & the scent didn’t linger very long. This new formulation INDEED smells like straight up lemon. Not like the old stuff. I have the old formulation right here to compare & it’s not the same by a long shot. I get no tingle, and the texture is much more lotion like- but absorbs really fast, so I’m having to apply way way way more. This sample size will prob be good for two applications... if it were the old formula I think it would’ve gotten me at least a week and a half. Very bummed out. I just wish they’d be honest and come right out & let everyone know that they changed the formulas. I’ll finish this tiny tube out, as long as i don’t have any adverse reactions. My god the lemon scent lingers so bad, I put it on quite a while ago. Oh well :(

reviews.product_name: The True Cream Aqua Bomb
reviews.review_text: I have not tried this before and I have to say I like it a lot . I have dry sensitive skin and this works great for me underneath makeup and without

reviews.product_name: Moisturizing Eye Bomb with Squalane
reviews.review_title: Works well on dry under eyes
reviews.review_text: Definite purchase , I have used only one other eye cream that I really enjoyed which was by Lancome and is very pricey . When I received this product I was very pleased with the consistency and how well it moisturized my under eyes and I  think I will definitely rebuy once it runs out

reviews.product_name: Aqua Bomb Brightening Vitamin C Cream
reviews.review_text: Works well on my sensitive combo skin and is perfect for humid climates , I have worn it under makeup with no problems just make sure to add plenty of spf , I do notice a clearness in my complexion since using it and no sensitivity either which is a plus. I received this complimentary from Influenster and am glad as I will definitely pick up more once it’s gone

reviews.product_name: Triple Algae Eye Renewal Balm Eye Cream
reviews.review_text: I am very dry and sensitive I don’t buy many eye creams as I feel they don’t do much but this really does hydrate under the eyes and helps my concealer set smoother and way less creasing under the eyes , the price is up there but if you can afford it I think it’s an awesome choice for creating a nice under eye base and hydrating I’ll def be checking out other products in mini sizes when available

reviews.product_name: Urban Environment Oil-Free Sunscreen Broad-Spectrum SPF 42
reviews.review_title: Great love the travel friendly design
reviews.review_text: I am dryer skinned so I didn’t use this much on the face but did use it on my neck and hands works very well does not pill up which surprisingly so many products do and I also love the size of the packaging, makes it really easy to travel with I will def check out more from the Shiseido brand

reviews.product_name: Urban Environment Fresh-Moisture Sunscreen Broad-Spectrum SPF 42
reviews.review_text: I don’t have too much experience with higher end sunscreens but I will say this one was pretty great. As someone with sensitive acne prone skin that is dryyy this performed well under makeup and provides a nice moisture and doesn’t dry out my skin

reviews.product_name: T.L.C. Framboos Glycolic Resurfacing Night Serum
reviews.review_title: Great but use sparingly on sensitive skin!
reviews.review_text: The exfoliant in this serum was a bit too strong for my rosacea. I noticed that I was able to use this but very sparingly and only once or twice per week. Even using this produce once per week I noticed improvement in my skin’s texture and appearance. You just need to find the adequate quantity for your particular skin type.

reviews.product_name: Beste No. 9 Jelly Cleanser
reviews.review_text: This cleanser works very well at removing dirt/makeup from the face but I found it very drying. Since I live in an arid climate anything drying is felt ten-fold, so my skincare regimen is much better with the oil cleansers.

reviews.product_name: Lippe Balm
reviews.review_text: This is my new favorite lip balm! I love that the ingredients are clean and that it leaves my lips feeling moisturized and happy. This product is moisturizing but also acts as a subtle gloss without being sticky. My only complaint is how wide the tube is ~ it’s hard for me to avoid getting balm on the skin outside my lips. Super cute and chic packaging, too! Overall a great product!

reviews.product_name: C-Tango Vitamin C Eye Cream
reviews.review_text: This is a great underlie brightener that packs a powerful punch! I use this on mornings where I haven’t gotten enough sleep or just need to brighten up my eye area. I gave it 4 stars because I noticed that this is too strong to apply to my lid, so I use a different product on the lid on the mornings that I use C-Tango. Overall very effective!

reviews.product_name: Lala Retro Whipped Refillable Moisturizer with Ceramides

reviews.review_title: Too much money for too little
reviews.review_text: This product is not bad but it was $70 I was risking to get that moisturized feel I was looking for. My Olay regenerist provided a better plump to my face for less. reviews.review_title: Feels like a exfoliating pad so great!
reviews.review_text: This is my second First Aid Beauty product I’ve used and again no disappointment here. These have alot of the exfoliating acids ive been looking for at an affordable price! reviews.review_text: This clay mask is AMAZING.... it softens all dirt inside my pores I can easily make some extractions. I have extremely sensitive skin and compare to the murad pomegranate mask this innisfree mask was softer for my skin. My skin gets red easily with a little bit of ingredients because of sensitivity and this didnt do that thank goodness! I am in love with this mask definitely want to let my hubby try it soon since he works outside alot. Give it a try if you are looking for a gently and cleaning mask!

reviews.review_text: I received a sample with my order the sample lasted me for three washes. Im not sure if this is an exfoliating scrub it didnt feel like it was strong enough but I think this scrub is still amazing the papaya and pineapple ingredients in it left my skin so refreshed. This is probably the best face cleaner it refreshes and hydrates at the same time its so gentle enough for sensitive skin. I bought a bigger size because this is the only facial cleanser that I felt left my skin soft but without feeling like it has a ton of product on. The only downside is that the scrub acts as if its dead skin it feels like wet paper which is awkward I wish I could eliminate that factor regardless I bought it because of how refreshed and hydrated how lightweight it left my face feeling. All that without needing a sheet mask go figure!

I’m planning on sticking with physical sunscreen for awhile but may come back to this in the future!

reviews.review_text: Well, I bought this thinking it would be a fragrance free dupe for the tatcha dewy skin cream. It’s also very simple, which is good if you have a complex routine. I just doubt that it’s worth the price... I feel like you could get a simple moisturizer that’s just as good at the drugstore or on yesstyle for less. But if you want to spend money this one is decent.

reviews.product_name: Cream Skin Toner & Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: As someone with dry skin this is one of the most amazing toners I’ve ever tried. It’s a toner that feels like it actually does something because it contains moisturizing ingredients. My “”basic”” hydrating routine goes cleanser -> first essence -> serum -> cream skin -> moisturizer and it works wonders for sealing in hydration, as well as being pretty hydrating itself. I wouldn’t replace my moisturizer with it but that’s just because of how dry my skin is. Bonus: fragrance + essential oil free, which isn’t something that can be said for most products at Sephora. It’s really become a staple in my routine. Would recommend this version over the spray just because the spray irritated my eyes and I prefer applying this product my rubbing it in my hands and then patting it on my face just because for some reason it feels better.

reviews.product_name: Vitamin C Suspension 23% + HA Spheres 2%
reviews.review_text: About a month ago I bought this for my skin issue I was told that using a vitamin C suspension would help it, not to mention my lines and wrinkles lol.  I was afraid of trying this since I have such sensitive skin but wow am I glad I did! I’m feeling like I’m getting the high end treatments at a seriously budget price and I’m doing a happy dance over here. This suspension has done exactly what I was told it would do. It has helped to make my skin smooth and ease my lines and wrinkles. I use it 2 times a week. I wash my face, blot dry use a fingertip drop of this suspension smoothing on my neck as well, then a facial oil applying on the face and neck, then I use The Ordinary moisturizer patting it all over my face and neck. I’ve not been burned and only have had an amazing experience with this. I will repurchase this again and I recommend this suspension very highly! Thank you The Ordinary for allowing those of us with beer pockets to experience the champagne treatments!

reviews.review_text: Loved this. Received it for free from Influenster and I wish I had a bigger jar. The formula is gel-like and super light weight. It smells amazing-really grapefruity and clean! My skin reacted really well to this, it’s definitely more moisturizer and glowy, not oily at all! I put it on before bed and woke up with super soft skin. I also used it another morning before my makeup primer and was so impressed. It absorbed right into my skin, leaving a flawless base to begin my makeup routine. I’ll probably buy this after my sample runs out- it’s a great every day, light weight product.

reviews.product_name: Original Skin Retexturizing Mask with Rose Clay
reviews.review_title: Evened out skin, not a game changer
reviews.review_text: I received this product for free through Influsnter. I was pleasantly surprised by how the mask performed. The mask smells great and applies really smoothly. It’s cute and light pink, too, so if Insta pics are your thing... After washing the mask off, I noticed my skin look more even and a little brighter. I can’t say this mask is a game changer, but it was an overall positive experience. No harsh smells or texture- sometimes masks can make my eyes water or really irritate because they smell obnoxious.

reviews.product_name: Tonique Confort Re-Hydrating Comforting Toner with Acacia Honey
reviews.review_text: Like many other reviews have said, this definitely hydrates! I’ll be saving the rest of mine to use during the winter when my skin is really dry. I like a squeaky-clean feeling for the summer so I tend to go for toners that aren’t meant to be hydrating or illuminating. However, this gets five stars because it does exactly as it claims! It smells great and made my skin feel awesome. The formula consistency is kind of odd, so that takes some getting used to-expect a liquidy-gel cross? I received this product for free to review from Influenster!

reviews.product_name: Hydra Zen Gel-Cream Oil-Free Moisturizer with Salicylic Acid
reviews.review_text: I received this product just days after I got sunburnt! I can’t tell you how happy I was to have a cooling moisturizer that didn’t sting my sunburnt skin. This smells great and smooths over your skin easily- it’s so smooth and silky. I usually don’t put an intense moisturizer on under makeup, but I tried it out with this and had no issues with my makeup routine. It doesn’t make me greasy and shiny, but I still felt hydrated all day. I received this product for free from influenster’s testing program, but I just may put this on my regulars list

reviews.product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C
reviews.review_text: J’ai acheter un petit format dans un ensemble Laneige et je dois dire que je l’adore ! J’aime la texture, la senteur et l’effet sur mes lèvres. À essayer !

reviews.product_name: The Rice Polish Foaming Enzyme Powder
reviews.review_text: J’ai reçu ce produit en échantillon gratuit avec ma commande et je dois avouer que j’aime bien. La texture est douce et agréable. Ça n’en prend pas beaucoup pour faire tout le visage. À ce prix là, par contre, je ne pense pas en acheter...

reviews.product_name: Superfood Antioxidant Cleanser
reviews.review_text: Le produit sent très bon, mais je n’irais pas jusqu’à dire qu’il est différent des autres savons doux que j’ai essayé...

reviews.product_name: Mini Superfood Antioxidant Cleanser
reviews.review_text: Le produit sent très bon, mais je n’irais pas jusqu’à dire qu’il est différent des autres savons doux que j’ai essayé...

reviews.product_name: Blue Tansy BHA and Enzyme Pore Refining Mask
reviews.review_text: Ce masque n’est pas “parfait“ : la texture est très liquide, il ne sent pas très bon et la couleur est assez décevante (c’était plus gris que bleu)... Mais malgré tout, ce masque est un des meilleurs que j’ai testé! L’effet est saisissant, après une seule application j’ai senti que la texture de ma peau était améliorée. Et puisque c’est l’effet qui compte plus que les aspects “esthétique“ du masque lui-même, je le conseil vivement !

reviews.product_name: Hello FAB Coconut Skin Smoothie Priming Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: This is my favourite primerIt smells amazingFeels amazingAnd a little bit goes a super long way

reviews.product_name: SEA drink of H2O hydrating boost moisturizer
reviews.review_text: Super great moisturizerClears up my skin right away and makes it look look bright, clear, and supple

reviews.product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C
reviews.review_text: Love this so much! It smells amazing and feels amazing!My lips are always nice and soft in the morning and there is usually still some on my lips when I wake up so I don’t need to reapply lip balm.I use this sometimes through the day when I am at home as a lip balm but it is too big to carry around with me.

reviews.product_name: Oat Cleansing Balm
reviews.review_text: Fantastic at removing my makeup!Does not leave my skin feeling oilyI always follow up with the salicylic cleanser after

reviews.review_title: Updated version of an old school skin care classic
reviews.review_text: I received a deluxe sample size to try.   I’ve been using it in conjunction with my other nightly serums.  It’s absorbs into the skin well and doesn’t leave a sticky residue.  My skin feels smoother and a bit more hydrated.  I’ll need to invest in the full size to determine the long-term results.

reviews.product_name: Ultimate Sun Protector Lotion SPF 50+ Sunscreen
reviews.review_text: This is a great lightweight sunscreen lotion that absorbs quickly into your skin. Living in Florida, I have to use 50+ sun protection on my face every day. The formula is moisturizing and would be great for people with normal to dry skin. The formula is a clear pinkish color that doesn’t leave a white cast. There is a bit of a stronger scent but it’s pleasant and not a typical sunscreen smell. The scent doesn’t linger either.

reviews.product_name: Clear Sunscreen Stick SPF 50+
reviews.review_text: This is a great and convenient option for sun protection. The stick formula is clear with a light and fresh scent, and leaves no residue behind. I use 50+ spf all year round on my face and this makes it so easy especially if I forget to put sunscreen during my morning skincare routine. I’ll definitely always have this in my purse for on the go sun protection.

reviews.product_name: Urban Environment Oil-Free Sunscreen Broad-Spectrum SPF 42
reviews.review_text: This is a good lightweight sunscreen that sits well under makeup and doesn’t leave a white cast. There’s a small amount of product for the price point but I feel like a little goes a long way.

reviews.product_name: Ultimate Sun Protector Lotion SPF 50+ Sunscreen
reviews.review_title: I have the sunscreen, now I just need some sun!
reviews.review_text: This is definitely the fanciest sunscreen I have ever used & I love it.  I really like that it comes in recyclable packaging too.   Pros: it has a wonderful scent! Love love love how good it smells.  It not only protects, but moisturizes your skin and gives it a nice appearance (bonus that not many other sunscreens offer). Goes on easily and isn’t cakey. Also naturally I’m happy about it being ocean-friendly and the typical aspects of a high spf protection. Cons: while it isn’t the messiest of sunscreens, it is VERY thin, so if you aren’t careful, it can easily spill out and that would be a very expensive spill. I think the bottle could use a little better of a stopper at the top to prevent spills (mom life). It is advertised as for body AND face but I actually prefer the shiseido stick for the face, instead of this stuff. I love it for body but it is a tad tacky feeling on my face. Although I think if I put it on under my makeup, it may have been better. But on top wasn’t my favorite texture.  Overall, happy with the product! It is very high quality and is doing almost everything right.

reviews.product_name: Clear Sunscreen Stick SPF 50+
reviews.review_text: Okay honestly I was so pleasantly surprised by how much I loved this!! I was worried it would be greasy and tacky but it is quite the opposite--so smooth and light! It is easy to use even with your everyday makeup which is a huge plus. As a bonus, it has a beautiful & ’not typical smelly sunscreen scent’ to it which is great.  I also love that this is ocean-friendly, I hope all is screen will be that way in the future--not so chemical’y.  Super convenient size and mess-free. I can’t wait to take this hiking! Overall very happy with this product. This has been the nicest sunscreen I’ve used.

reviews.product_name: The Essence Skincare Boosting Treatment
reviews.review_title: You need it! So fresh and firm
reviews.review_text: Huge fan of this product! The packaging and presentation is beautiful, as expected.  I was skeptical of this product as it seemed like a typical ’over promise, under deliver’ scenario--but I was so happy I was wrong!  The first time I used it I didn’t notice a huge difference but after 4 days, I really started to feel my face actually gain firmness, I was impressed!  The texture is similar to a typical serum. And I can’t argue that the results are completely beautifying! It just makes my skin feel and look more fresh and vibrant.

reviews.product_name: Mini The Essence  Skincare Boosting Treatment
reviews.review_title: You need it! So fresh and firm
reviews.review_text: Huge fan of this product! The packaging and presentation is beautiful, as expected. reviews.product_name: Double Serum Firming & Smoothing Anti-Aging Concentrate
reviews.review_text: I love love love this serum!  It helps replenish your skin and has incredibly beneficial natural ingredients that promote a healthy appearance for your face.  I used this after exfoliation and vitamin c application and it made my face feel and look so healthy and bright.  I would definitely recommend this product. I also love that a little bit goes a long way!

reviews.product_name: Retinol Anti-Aging Serum
reviews.review_text: I was amazed how quick it worked, my  skin feels a lot smoother and fine lines near eyes have improved. I’m very impressed with this product, my skin is so much smoother and more glowing. A small portion goes a long way. Absolutely love this product!

reviews.product_name: Facial Radiance Pads
reviews.review_text: I love everything about this First Aid Beauty Facial Radiance Pads, Exfoliating Pads with AHA. The design and how easy these can be used! The pads come fairly wet but not dripping (no mess. These were gentle, and made my face feel soft and smooth, been using twice a day for a couple weeks. My face was noticeably more radiant and glowing after use. Does everything is claims to do. Your skin is radiant, and these pads provide the right amount of exfoliation when you use them at least twice a day. I highly recommend theses high quality pads for your face.I received a free product for the purpose of my review. Opinions are 100% my own.

reviews.product_name: Advanced Night Repair Eye Concentrate Matrix Synchronized Multi-Recovery Complex
reviews.review_text: Estee Lauder Advanced Night Repair Eye Concentrate Matrix. I have to say, this has done EXACTLY what it said it would--and I have started seeing results within the first week. Nothing worked on my dark circles,  but this actually work on darkness around eyes you will notice your under eye will become healthy, and there will be reduction in darkness, but you have to use it continuously and you will love using it. I am amazed at how well this cream has worked. It brightens my eyes and makes the wrinkles look less severe. Definitely recommend this product. I received a free product for the purpose of my review. Opinions are 100% my own.

reviews.product_name: Santorini Grape Poreless Skin Cream
reviews.review_text: Korres santorini grape poreless skin cream. A lightweight gel moisturizer that blurs pores and mattifies skin while providing optimal, up- to- all- day hydration. Soft texture, easy to absorb, provide water for skin! Replenish the nutrition you need! It can help reduce many signs of skin aging. I find my skin soft, supple, never feels dry, and has a youthful glow. I was amazed by the fast results and I feel way more confident with my face and skin. I would recommend to everyone! I received a free product for the purpose of my review. Opinions are 100% my own.

reviews.product_name: The True Cream Aqua Bomb
reviews.review_text: I got this product to try for free from Influenster! This stuff is pretty cool, like a lotion /gel , very light weight feel. Not sticky at all, not really a scent to it, its just nice! Even after a few days my skin is feeling more hydrated!

reviews.product_name: Aqua Bomb Hydrating Toner
reviews.review_text: I got this free to try from Influenster!  The toner is very nice, not oily at all. There is no heavy over powering scents at all. My skin does feel more moisturized after a few days of using this already !

reviews.product_name: Cold Plunge Pore Remedy Moisturizer with BHA/LHA
reviews.review_text: I received this as a super secret voxbox from Influenster! I have more of a dryer skin type , but my nose does tend to be a bit more oily than the rest of my face . The texture of this moisturizer is great, nice a smooth but a bit jelly like . It wasn’t  sticky after , my skin feels smooth and matte , no oily skin . I really enjoy the eucalyptus scent and the cooling sensation.

reviews.product_name: Moisture Surge 100H Auto-Replenishing Hydrator Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I received this complimentary sample from Influenster.I was a bit shocked at how tiny it was , but a sample is a sample ! I enjoy the gel cream formula of this moisturizer. My skin really like these types of moisturizers since it is very dry , it hold the moisture in well ! It’s very smooth going on and not sticky at all . I didn’t notice a scent at all either . I’d definitely buy a larger size in the future of this !

reviews.product_name: Protini Polypeptide Firming Refillable Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I love this moisturizer so much – it keeps my skin soft without being too heavy for pacific northwest weather (I use this year-round, although it might not be strong enough in places with harsher winters), and it has never irritated my sensitive skin. It applies really smoothly (I love the consistency!), it’s lightweight and fast-absorbing, it does not have any scent, and a little goes a long way! It’s not cheap, but the 50 mL jar will typically last me 4-5 months (using 1 pump a day).I do wish the packaging had some way to indicate how much product is remaining, because you never know which day you’re going to run out, but I love that it has an airtight pump that keeps the product fresh and uncontaminated. You can also use the top surface of the pump to mix this product with other products, which is great if you use the DE ’smoothie’ approach. Unlike many other reviewers, I have never had a problem with the pump breaking with product still left in the container.If you like the feel of thick, heavy cream moisturizers, this is probably not for you, but if you’re looking for a light gel moisturizer then I cannot recommend this enough!

reviews.product_name: Superfood Antioxidant Cleanser
reviews.review_text: This is a great cleanser that leaves my skin feeling very clean, and it has a clean, gentle list of ingredients! It for sure smells kind of earthy/like vegetables, but I actually quite like it.I feel like a lot of people buy this product because Hyram says that it’s fantastic (and it is!) and more particularly that ’it’s not stripping’ – this is true and not true. It is definitely less stripping than many other cleansers I’ve tried, and I will probably buy it again because of that, but I can’t use it to cleanse once a day or my skin *will* slowly start to feel a little bit dry and tight. I don’t think people with more resilient skin would have this problem, because it is *very* gentle, but if your skin is super difficult with cleansers then don’t expect it to be a 100% hydrating miracle.

reviews.product_name: Mini Superfood Antioxidant Cleanser

reviews.product_name: E-Rase Milki Micellar Water
reviews.review_text: I use this product every day after I do a workout, and it’s great for getting all the sweat and grime off – it leaves me feeling refreshed and clean! I don’t think this would be great for getting off a full face of makeup (although I haven’t tried), but it’s definitely a great choice as a light and gentle cleanser when you aren’t wearing any makeup.I especially love that this product has never left my skin feeling stripped – most cleansers leave my skin feeling tight/dry right after, but this one never does!

reviews.product_name: E-Rase Milki Micellar Water Mini
reviews.review_text: I use this product every day after I do a workout, and it’s great for getting all the sweat and grime off – it leaves me feeling refreshed and clean! I don’t think this would be great for getting off a full face of makeup (although I haven’t tried), but it’s definitely a great choice as a light and gentle cleanser when you aren’t wearing any makeup.I especially love that this product has never left my skin feeling stripped – most cleansers leave my skin feeling tight/dry right after, but this one never does!

reviews.product_name: T.L.C. Framboos Glycolic Resurfacing Night Serum
reviews.review_text: I absolutely adore this product - when I wake up after using it my skin always feels so soft and clear and fresh. I use this every other night with DE Protini moisturizer (I found every night too intense), and that’s all I need – my skin stays breakout-free and glowing! It’s also been super effective as a spot treatment, which I use the second I can feel a pimple coming on – it stops them from ever appearing. Magic!I was super skeptical about the price of this product, so I initially only purchased it because I had $100 from a Sephora giveaway, but the price actually ended up feeling somewhat reasonable given how long it lasts - I started using it in late August 2020 and I’m still on the same bottle by May 2021! (using one pump every other night)Important disclaimer – this review is for the original formulation of the product (and I managed to purchase a second bottle of the old formulation before it completely vanished from stores), but the formulation changed in early 2021 (the % of AHA and BHA was reduced). I have no idea if the new formula works as well as the old one.

reviews.product_name: Aqua Bomb Hydrating Toner
reviews.review_text: I love this stuff! I just needed a few drops on my cotton pad, and it felt so good going on. I’m using this as my morning toner to give my skin a little extra hydration before I put my makeup on. It feels amazing.

reviews.product_name: The True Cream Aqua Bomb
reviews.review_text: I received this from Influenster to test out. Upon opening it, I was impressed with the smell and consistency. It’s almost like a gel, and I love gel moisturizers. I am a fan of Peter Thomas Roth Hydra Drench and this product reminds me a lot of it. It almost melts into your skin. Only downside is that is does leave a bit of a shine to my skin, but I guess you could call or dewy.

reviews.product_name: Watermelon Glow PHA + BHA Pore-Tight Toner
reviews.review_text: I wanted to love this whole line, but I didn’t. This toner did nothing for my skin, and the smell was unpleasant. It was thick, and when applied, it felt like nothing. I tried with my hands and with Shiseido cotton pads, no difference.

reviews.product_name: Mini Watermelon Glow PHA + BHA Pore-Tight Toner
reviews.review_text: I wanted to love this whole line, but I didn’t. This toner did nothing for my skin, and the smell was unpleasant. It was thick, and when applied, it felt like nothing. I tried with my hands and with Shiseido cotton pads, no difference.

reviews.product_name: Plum Plump Hyaluronic Acid Serum
reviews.review_text: I wanted to love this line, I really did - but nothing wowed me! This serum did nothing for the texture or the look of my skin. I was disappointed that I never noticed a difference, except that it made my cheeks more pink.

reviews.product_name: Avocado Fine Line Eye Cream with Retinol
reviews.review_text: I bought the entire line, and this was the only thing i liked. I LOVE it. It is so creamy, and so hydrating. It feels amazing when you put a generous amount, and it feels amazing when you put a small amount - it’s lovely for hydration.

reviews.product_name: Blueberry Bounce Gentle Cleanser
reviews.review_text: I love the smell. I don’t know why, but it makes me feel nostalgic, so I really enjoy using it! However, it doesn’t do anything amazing to my skin for the price. I will use the rest of the bottle, but I wouldn’t repurchase.

reviews.product_name: Water Drench Hyaluronic Acid Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I just love this stuff. When I say a little goes a long way, I seriously mean you just need a bit to spread. It lasted me a long time, and it always feels so refreshing and amazing everytime I apply it.

reviews.product_name: Protini Polypeptide Firming Refillable Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: This moisturizer packs a punch. It locks in moisture and leave your skin feeling instantly hydrated and locks it in. I have dry skin on my forehead that is so annoying. No matter what I use it never seems to go away more than a day or two at max. Since using this product I have not seen the pesky dry skin. It’s an awesome product that I’m grateful to have gotten free. I will definitely be purchasing again, again and again.

reviews.product_name: Aqua Bomb Overnight Lip Mask
reviews.review_text: This is one of the most hydrating and moisturizing lip masks or even a glamorized Chapstick if you will that I have ever used. It instantly coats your lips concealing any sort of chapped or dryness and providing instant relief. It goes on smooth and feels wonderful, a little heavier than a chapstick but this is some thing I would definitely wear to bed as well as using when my lips feel dry and cracked during the day. I don’t find that it has an odor and if you accidentally taste it it’s similar to what I’d compare to as maybe Vaseline. It’s definitely a smooth moisturizing product that provides instant relief and long lasting affects giving your lips hydration leaving them soft and supple. For the winter this is a must have. I did receive this product complementary in exchange for my honest review and honestly if in the winter or at all you struggle with dry or  chapped lips this is definitely the product for you.

reviews.product_name: Clear Improvement Charcoal Honey Mask to Purify and Nourish
reviews.review_text: The packaging is cute, and when opening it, it’s a grayish charcoal color with gold glitter infused throughout it. The consistency is on the thicker side and it has a scent that’s a little strong but I cannot find something to compare it to. It terms of use I would have loved it came with an applicator to apply, but it was easy to apply with my fingers or a silicone brush. It feels sticky on the skin but my skin feels smooth and hydrated after. To me the gold glitter is to replicate what honey would look like mixed in the mask. It’s a mask I would use on a self care night, to give some hydration to my skin. I’m hoping with more use I’ll see some significant changes, however until then I have just noticed a nice shine, and hydration to my skin. If you enjoy a mask on a self care day this one is nice to apply. If you don’t like scented skincare this may not be the mask for you.

reviews.product_name: Confidence in a Cream Anti-Aging Hydrating Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: Due to the name I started using this with high expectations and it is not often a product lives up to the hype. However, this is now a must have in my routine and I refuse to live with out it. With that being said, I normally struggle with occasional dry skin due to the seasons and weather being hot and dry. Since I started using this I noticed that not only did I not break out due to introducing a new product to my skin routine, but it also does not pill when mixed with my other products. The consistency is thick and creamy but it is not heavy on the face and my skin drinks it right up. Since using this I have not had a single issue with dry skin. My skin feels more youthful,  plump and HYDRATED. I cannot stress it enough that this is the best moisturizer I have come across, and I thought I had found the one. The price is a little steep, but it’s cheaper than a lot of popular moisturizers and it really does work. I appreciate that there is no fragrance, and that it is not heavy on the skin. I apply it at night before bed and sometimes in the morning before I start my day. I wish I could apply it to my entire body because the difference I have noticed in my skin has been amazing.

reviews.product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C
reviews.review_text: I first want to say I love the packaging of this! It comes in a cute pink box and has a little silicone applier that applies a super smooth coating. The amount of product is reasonable as well with how little it takes to coat your lips.As for the mask itself it has a slight fruity smell and is super glossy. I give it 4/5 stars because I had a small part of my lips that was chapped and it did burn a little when I had product on it for a bit. Otherwise my lips felt super moisturized!

reviews.product_name: Moisturizing Eye Bomb with Squalane
reviews.review_text: Belif’s moisturizing eye bomb is surprisingly amazing! I have been loyal to my StriVectin-TL tightening eye serum, but was given the opportunity to switch it up and I am pleasantly surprised. I had been noticing some dryness underneath my eyes due to my makeup getting patchy after a long day’s wear however after using this, the patchiness is gone and my under-eye area is super smooth!  Pros: A little goes a long way - I have used it every day/night for the week that i’ve had it and am still basically at the top of the jar as it I hadn’t touched it. The product absorbs easily into the skin, definitely is moisturizing, and doesn’t have a pungent odor. I’m excited to continue to have this in my skincare routine! Note: I received this product as a free sample for reviewing and sampling purposes.

reviews.product_name: Cold Plunge Pore Mask
reviews.review_title: Left my face cool and refreshed
reviews.review_text: I received this complimentary to test and I was not disappointed! It does what it says it will and feels cool when on and leaves your skin also chilled and feeling refreshed!I luckily have never really had a problem with my pores, but I do notice that after the mask, my skin looked amazing.Would definitely recommend!

reviews.product_name: Honeymoon Glow AHA Resurfacing Night Serum
reviews.review_title: A must have staple in your nighttime skin routine
reviews.review_text: One of my new favorite staples in my skincare routine. My skin is noticeably softer, smoother, and I have less breakouts! I have sensitive skin and it’s gentle enough to where I don’t get any redness which sometimes happens when I apply acids. Would definitely recommend if you’ve been thinking about trying!

reviews.product_name: Benefiance Wrinkle Smoothing Eye Cream
reviews.review_text: I’m really enjoying this product so far. It’s a nice, thick cream with a light, fresh scent.  It goes on very smoothly, unlike some other eye creams I’ve used where I felt like I had to tug to apply.  It feels very hydrating when I apply it, although it does seem to take a while to absorb. I’ve been using it day and night but I think I would like it better as a night cream under normal circumstances (quarantine=no makeup so day is fine for now). I do feel like things look a little smoother after using this product but time will tell how effective it is.  I love that it came with a little spatula so you can keep your fingers out of the jar!

reviews.product_name: The Dewy Serum Resurfacing and Plumping Treatment
reviews.review_text: The packaging is exquisite, the scent is nice and light, and the application is great. I also like the pump feature. 4/5 stars because I don’t feel like my skin looked any different, but most products like this require regular use to really see a difference.

reviews.product_name: Facial Treatment Essence (Pitera Essence)
reviews.review_text: I’m honestly not sure what this product is supposed to do, but maybe I’m just not enough of a skin care guru. I received four different SK-II products to test and replaced all my regular skin care items to really give it a shot. I used them all regularly for several weeks. I saw no difference in my skin, good or bad.  I found the application of this product to be awkward as well and often ended up just dripping it all over.
