reviews.product_name: Aqua Bomb Overnight Lip Mask
reviews.review_text: I’ve only used this a couple times but it seems to work as promised. I keep forgetting to apply it at night as intended, but I’ve used it as a regular lip balm during the day and it kept my lips very hydrated. It’s very thick and stays on pretty well.

reviews.product_name: Capture Totale Super Potent Eye Serum
reviews.review_text: I’ve been using this product for a couple weeks now, in the morning as an extra moisturizing boost (I use a medical-grade product at night).  Overall I’ve been pleased with it. The serum absorbs well into the skin and the metal applicator feels nice. It does well under makeup.  There’s no scent that I’ve noticed.

reviews.product_name: Watermelon Glow Niacinamide Sunscreen SPF 50
reviews.review_title: The best smell and comfort sunscreen
reviews.review_text: This made my skin feel very soft and moisturized. Wasn’t greasy at all. Makeup sat very well on top of it and I didn’t see any pilling. It smells SO GOOD!!! I am obsessed. Will definitely be purchasing in the future. It made my skin look hydrated and glowy. Can go without makeup honestly. Was very comfortable 5/5

reviews.product_name: Tea Elixir Niacinamide & Hyaluronic Acid Anti-Aging Serum
reviews.review_text: This fresh serum smells and feels so good on the face. I use it at night and in the morning my face feels really refreshed and bright, and it feels smoother too. Such a great product. Can’t wait to use it more

reviews.product_name: Mini Daily Microfoliant Exfoliator
reviews.review_text: Good stuff. Gifted by dermalogica sampling. Can’t wait to see results

reviews.product_name: Daily Microfoliant Exfoliator

reviews.product_name: Retinol Youth Renewal Serum
reviews.review_text: The retinol youth serum gifted by Murad skincare is truly amazing in the ways that it’s strong enough to actually work but gentle enough not to irritate your skin and moisture barrier. Loving my results.

reviews.product_name: Mini Retinol Youth Renewal Serum
reviews.review_text: The retinol youth serum gifted by Murad skincare is truly amazing in the ways that it’s strong enough to actually work but gentle enough not to irritate your skin and moisture barrier. Loving my results.

reviews.product_name: Hydro Biotic Recovery Sleeping Mask
reviews.review_text: I am really liking this mask. I received it in my latest Influenster box. It’s lightweight and feels just like a gel moisturizer. It doesn’t leave my skin oily or feel heavy on skin. It has a light minty smell but it doesn’t tingle or anything. In the morning my skin is still soft and supple.

reviews.product_name: The Silk Peony Melting Eye Cream
reviews.review_title: Small container but product goes a long way.
reviews.review_text: I received my cream complimentary from influenster to review. I will say upon receiving I was surprised how small the container was for $60 even though the packaging is beautiful and follows suite to Tatchas signature white and gold packaging. But after I began using I see that the products goes a longgg way. The cream is very dense and melts into your finger when you dip into it which makes it very difficult to use too much product at once. It gives a thin application of product that literally melts into your skin and leaves silky, smooth, and hydrated. Product feels very luxurious on skins. The scent is very mild and not overpowering at all.  I highly recommend this eye cream.

reviews.product_name: Watermelon Glow PHA + BHA Pore-Tight Toner
reviews.review_text: I really enjoy this product as I do everything I’ve purchased from Glow Recipe thus far. It has a great watermelon scent. I tried applying with cotton pad and I didn’t love I felt like it absorbed a lot of product and then I read on box to apply with fingers. I liked way better when I applied with fingers. It’s very moisturizing. No burning. My pores are overly large but it does make my skin feel tighter after using.

reviews.product_name: The Rice Wash Skin-Softening Cleanser
reviews.review_text: I received this product complementary from Influenster to try and it did not disappoint! This product comes out thick and slightly gritty but once activated with water turns into a smooth gel that foams slightly. My face feels so clean after using. Product has a very mild scent and is not harsh at all! Very little product needed per application- I would say dime size. Love the way my skin looks after using! Would highly recommend.

reviews.product_name: Mini Rice Wash Skin-Softening Cleanser
reviews.review_text: I received this product complementary from Influenster to try and it did not disappoint! reviews.product_name: The True Cream Aqua Bomb
reviews.review_text: This is my FAVORITE spring and summertime moisturizer. It provides just enough hydration while still being lightweight. I originally discovered this in a Sephora PLAY! box and I am hooked. I also use the moisture bomb and water essence. The Water Essence  is great if you’re looking for more hydration. Would completely recommend this product despite the higher price tag.Note: I have normal skin (oily t zone) while using this product

reviews.product_name: The True Cream Moisturizing Bomb
reviews.review_text: This is my everyday moisturizer and I can’t say enough good things. I have the jumbo size and the travel size which I use when I’m away for the weekend. I use this mainly during fall and winter when my face is dryer and seeing less moisture from the air (I live near the ocean). I have normal skin with an oily t zone and this moisturizer provides the perfect amount of hydration. I use it with the water essence if I’m feeling overly dry.

reviews.product_name: C.E.O. 15% Vitamin C Brightening Serum
reviews.review_text: YES Sunday Riley has done it again! I got this as a sample and then I went out and bought the full size. This has done wonders for my face especially during the winter when I’m super dry and dull. The citrus scent is super light but still noticeable giving you a super fresh feeling!

reviews.product_name: Midnight Recovery Concentrate Moisturizing Face Oil
reviews.review_text: This night time oil is going to blow you away. First of all the smell is intoxicating. Its amazing and I need it in a perfume asap plz Kiehl’s. Its super lightweight but also very smooth on the skin. You only need 2-3 drops NO MORE I SWEAR. If I have an extra I rub in on my hands and neck. I saw instant improvement in my skin being more youthful looking and less dull.

reviews.product_name: Auto Correct Brightening + Depuffing Eye Cream for Dark Circles
reviews.review_text: This was my first time trying Sunday Riley products and I am highly impressed. I struggle with dark undereye circles, wrinkles and fine lines. This is the first product that has made any difference in my dark circles. I love using it in the mornings before applying my makeup to help with depuffing. I will repurchase.

reviews.product_name: ICE Ceramide Moisturizer with Vitamin F
reviews.review_text: This was my first time trying Sunday Riley products and I am highly impressed. This is an incredible moisturizer. It is a thick cream which I love, especially when my skin is feeling extra dry. It is not so thick though that it doesn’t sink into your skin.  I have normal to dry skin. My skin feels incredibly soft after using this. I will definitely repurchase. I think the price is fair since a little of the product goes a long way.

reviews.product_name: Confidence in a Cream Anti-Aging Hydrating Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I love that the Confidence in a Cream moisturizer is a thick yet easily blendable formula. I think the consistency lends it to be a great moisturizer for both summer & winter. Not only have I noticed myself, but I have also received many compliments about how much better my skin looks. My skin is smooth & glowy! I will definitely continue to purchase this product. I have already recommended it to my family & friends.

reviews.product_name: Advanced Génifique Radiance Boosting Face Serum
reviews.review_text: Worked great. Such a nice serum. I definitely noticed more radiance. I would purchase this again for sure.

reviews.product_name: The Rice Wash Skin-Softening Cleanser
reviews.review_text: Love this cleanser! It gives such a dewy look and clean feel when I use it.  me such a pretty dewy look when I use it! Love the lather and the smell. Hydrates really well. Received it in a Trendmood box. Love it!

reviews.product_name: Mini Rice Wash Skin-Softening Cleanser
reviews.review_text: Love this cleanser! It gives such a dewy look and clean feel when I use it.  me such a pretty dewy look when I use it! Love the lather and the smell. Hydrates really well. Received it in a Trendmood box. Love it!

reviews.product_name: Luminous Dewy Skin Mist
reviews.review_text: Love this mist! Gives such a soft and dewy look. Hydrates really well and doesn’t have a strong scent, which I love. Received in my Trendmood box. Love it!

reviews.product_name: The Serum Stick: Treatment & Touch Up Balm
reviews.review_text: Works really well to hydrate specific areas on the face. Great for on the go! I apply it on my undereye area and it brightens really well. Received in my Trendmood box and I love it!

reviews.product_name: Plum Plump Hyaluronic Acid Serum
reviews.review_text: Had been wanting to try this serum since I saw it was a new Glow Recipe item! Got it in my Trendmood box a d absolutely love it! Hydrates really nice and I love it as part of my skincare routine

reviews.product_name: Clear Improvement Charcoal Honey Mask to Purify and Nourish
reviews.review_text: I was hesitant about this product since my skin can be sensitive and anything with honey usually irritates it but desperate times call for desperate measures and this did not disappoint. At first application I felt a little tingling but it quickly dissipated. After removing the mask my skin felt clean and looked glowing, hydrated and refreshed. I’ve been using twice a week now followed by Origins Hello Calm mask. My skin has been clearer and more hydrated. I think I found a winner.

reviews.product_name: Superberry Hydrate + Glow Dream Night Mask with Vitamin C
reviews.review_text: This is my new favorite mask. It applies smoothly and leaves my skin looking smooth and glowing in the morning. A little goes a long way, so this jar will last a while. The smell is amazing and makes me feel like I’m somewhere tropical instead of in a snow storm.

reviews.product_name: Mini Superberry Hydrate + Glow Dream Mask
reviews.review_text: This is my new favorite mask. It applies smoothly and leaves my skin looking smooth and glowing in the morning. A little goes a long way, so this jar will last a while. The smell is amazing and makes me feel like I’m somewhere tropical instead of in a snow storm.

reviews.product_name: Sugar Hydrating Lip Balm
reviews.review_text: I didn’t want to like this because I feel that that amount you get is not worth the $18 but the moment I tried it I totally understand the price point. You don’t need very much to cover your lips and the moisture it locks in is ahfreakingmazing. I usually like to put it on before I go to bed and when I wake up my lips are soft and moisturized. Not to mention the coconut flavor is out of this world.

reviews.product_name: T.L.C. Sukari Babyfacial AHA + BHA Mask
reviews.review_text: So I absolutely love Drunk Elephant and their products have changed my skin game. I think it’s really important to highlight though to use this product EXACTLY as directed. The formula is super powerful and you will more than likely feel some tingling when you apply. My skin is always brighter and clearer after my once a week use. I like to follow with a overnight mask and I wake up to glowing skin.

reviews.product_name: A-Passioni Retinol Cream
reviews.review_text: This product will get rid of my acne so quick and smooth my face. I’m not too good with routing and I didn’t buy it for rinkles (although I’m sure it will turn over skin cells and get rid of fine lines), but this product is a win-win for sure. Over night I will wake up with softer and smoother skin. Worth the money? Depends because this has a high % of retinol but, I would re-puchase this product!

reviews.product_name: Mini Virgin Marula LuxuryFace Oil
reviews.review_text: I’m rating this 5 stars because I havent used a better facial oil. This oil is very light and locks in moisture to my skin. Its not greasy or uncomfortable at all! I think its a little too pricy.

reviews.product_name: Caffeine Eye Cream
reviews.review_text: LOVE LOVE LOVE THIS!! I noticed the next morning when I put it on my eyes that the dark circles were completely brighter. It feels so smooth and hydrating and a little goes a long way. Ive tried 90$ eyecream from kate somerville, and other expensive eye creams, but this showed results and I’m certain that you will love it.

reviews.product_name: Banana Bright 15% Vitamin C Serum
reviews.review_title: GO TO YOUR NEAREST SEPHORA RIGHT NOW!!
reviews.review_text: I bought this product sceptical because I’m very picky with my creams but Ill have to add this one to my collection and routine! This product is HANDS DOWN INCREDIBLE. First use I used it before I went to sleep and I woke up with glowing, brighter, and softer skin!!! This is a must if you want a plumping moisturizer that isnt sticky. This is an amazing way to also nourish the skin with vitamin c. This product is scented. I don’t typically go for the scented skincare but this is an ACCEPTION!!!!

reviews.product_name: Crème de la Mer Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: Received my Creme de La Mer gifted by La Mer and I absolutely loved it. Definitely gonna splurge and buy the big bottle. Love how it makes my skin feel, super smooth, soft, plump and glowy. Absolutely love it!

reviews.product_name: Mini Crème de la Mer Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: Received my Creme de La Mer gifted by La Mer and I absolutely loved it. Definitely gonna splurge and buy the big bottle. Love how it makes my skin feel, super smooth, soft, plump and glowy. Absolutely love it!

reviews.product_name: Rose & Hyaluronic Acid Deep Hydration Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: Received this moisturizer gifted by Fresh and it’s my favorite. Love their cleanser and toner. The moisturizer leaves my skin hydrates, soft and glowy. This moisturizer is a a must in your skin care routine.

reviews.product_name: C.E.O. 15% Vitamin C Brightening Serum
reviews.review_text: I love Sunday Riley products and this one is my favorite. This product was gifted to me by Sunday Riley. This vitamin c brightening serum is the best! Love how my skin looks even after just a week of using it.

reviews.product_name: Mini Daily Microfoliant Exfoliator
reviews.review_text: Received the daily exfoliant gifted by dermalogica and it’s amazing!!! My face feels completely clean and soft, I used the dermalogica vitamin c serum after and my skin is always glowing. Definitely will use this product in my skincare routine.

reviews.product_name: Daily Microfoliant Exfoliator
reviews.review_text: Received the daily exfoliant gifted by dermalogica and it’s amazing!!! My face feels completely clean and soft, I used the dermalogica vitamin c serum after and my skin is always glowing. Definitely will use this product in my skincare routine.

reviews.product_name: Moisturizing Eye Bomb with Squalane
reviews.review_text: I have been on the hunt for my perfect eye cream and I have finally found it! Really nice consistency to this product and extremely moisturizing! It does have a little bit of a fragrance but it doesn’t linger.

reviews.product_name: CC+ Cream Oil-Free Matte with SPF 40
reviews.review_text: I’ve worn this a few times in the Florida heat and it’s keeping my oily skin matte. It has pretty good lasting power and feels lightweight on the skin. I would say high-medium coverage. I appreciate the added spf and there’s no fragrance I can detect. I would recommend

reviews.product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C
reviews.review_text: I LOVE this product. The smell is divine. It has a very nice thick texture and really nourishing. The size is generous as well. My only con is the jar packaging. I don’t like having to stick my fingers in something going on my lips, but that just personal preference.

reviews.product_name: Violet-C Brightening Serum 20% Vitamin C + 10% AHA
reviews.review_text: Like others, I went into this with high hopes. I NEVER purchase skincare products this expensive so this was most definitely a splurge for me and most definitely left me disappointed. I have sensitive skin but because the texture was so thin and other reviewers had positive things to say, I thought all would be good. I broke out like a few days after using. I didnt even realize what the issue was because I was so convinced by the product and brand name. But that was the only change to my routine. I’m happy it worked for others but for me it was just too harsh on my skin. Feeling very let down. I’m still trying to recover my skin.

reviews.product_name: Sugar Hydrating Lip Balm
reviews.review_text: This straight up smells like coconut frosting and its beautiful. I love the feel and it definitely moisturizes. My issue is the price. It is so much money for such little product concealed in a huge container! You pay for the name like anything else. I dont regret my purchase, it was a nice splurge but it’s not something I would buy again.

reviews.product_name: Greek Yoghurt Foaming Cream Cleanser
reviews.review_text: This cleanser is amazing. I’ve been using it for a year now and have tried others but they just cant meet the quality of this product. Scent is a huge thing with me and this smells warm and creamy and light all at the same time, think vanilla yogurt! Its soothing and gets my face squeaky clean without that tight skin feel afterward. I have redness and dry patches and it completely calms my skin. The quality, quantity and price point are all spot on. I will continue to purchase!

reviews.product_name: Hello FAB Coconut Skin Smoothie Priming Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: Friends, let me start by saying I am NOT a fan of FAB. At all. In fact, I purchased this on a whim after deciding not to go with Too Faced’s Hangover primer. I am so glad I did. This primer is gorgeous. Its silky, glides on smoothly, absorbs quickly and my foundation is still going strong. Not to mention the coconut scent is just divine. There is a bit of shimmer to it which I personally like in the case that I want to wear it alone without foundation, but beware if you aren’t into that sort of thing. I will be back for more!

reviews.product_name: Barrier+ Triple Lipid-Peptide Face Cream
reviews.review_text: I received a sample in my January bag and I’ve used it for a few days now and absolutely noticed a difference in my damaged skin. I have combo skin that’s sensitive and acne prone but I had dry patches by my eyes and was super sensitive to products (they burned). This almost healed it overnight. It’s a bit thicker so a little goes a long way but I find the consistency soothing. There is also definitely a smell but I dont mind it. It almost reminds me of powdery plastic 80s toys (remember those?). I can’t quite place it but I dont think it’s terrible. If you have damaged skin it’s worth a try! Get the mini to try it out. :) I just bought a full size!

reviews.review_text: This stuff is amazing for my oily/combo skin and helps my makeup last longer in the Florida humidity. As a bonus, it also smells great (due to essiential oils, not unnecessary fragrance).

reviews.product_name: Benefiance Wrinkle Smoothing Eye Cream
reviews.review_text: I love this cream. I am over 40 with two small kids a full time job and a husband who recently broke both arms. I don’t sleep enough but this helps me look like I did. It’s the tiniest bit heavy for daytime here in Florida where it’s already in the high 80s but I use a touch less during the day and it’s all good. I highly recommend it.

reviews.product_name: Facial Treatment Essence (Pitera Essence)
reviews.review_text: It’s hard to explain what this product does but I can say my skin is visibly better using it. A touched brighter, a touch smoother, a touch less red, pores a touch more refined. It makes a difference and I don’t want to be without it for my sensitive, oily skin with large pores and rosacea. I recommend trying it. Tip: after I apply to my face I press any residual essence onto the tops of my hands to use every last bit!

reviews.product_name: Jet Lag Mask
reviews.review_text: I really like this product but unfortunately don’t think of it as a mask. I use it as an eye cream, and after I do any type of strong facial (peel, AHA, BHA.) I do have oily skin so I usually put it on after that and leave it on. It’s also nice to put on after a deep exfoliation as a calming treatment to soothe and make your face less red. I used this morning and night as an eye cream, as it works well as a depuffer, and about 2-3 times a week after a mask or deep exfoliation.

reviews.product_name: Mini Jet Lag Mask
reviews.review_text: I really like this product but unfortunately don’t think of it as a mask. I use it as an eye cream, and after I do any type of strong facial (peel, AHA, BHA.) reviews.product_name: Self Tanning Bronzing Face Drops
reviews.review_title: Would only use for face and décolletage
reviews.review_text: For your face, these self-tanning drops are the best. They don’t break me out, and they leave you with a lovely looking color that develops in a few hours. I wouldn’t recommend using this as night as I have had an issue with unevenness because it’s rubbed off on my pillow, but my friend doesn’t seem to have a problem with this and uses it at night. I add this to my moisturizer in the morning after washing, toning and acne treatment. I mix 1-2 drops of this with my moisturizer. I typically lightly run a towel over my eyebrows and hairline as I have blonde hair and have noticed it can VERY slightly (probably only noticeable to me) change the color a bit. Since doing this with the towel, I haven’t noticed the staining. I then use foundation directly after and go about my normal make-up routine. One thing I will say that I’d use a lighter hand with make up on the day you apply this, so cut back on the bronzer or blush a bit more as the color will develop throughout the day. I have tried this on my body and don’t love it. I sometimes do it on my décolletage and that hasn’t been okay, but be sure to use a tanning mitt and moisturizer. For your body, I’d definitely recommend the Isle of Paradise foam. For me, these drops just don’t have enough “oomph” for the body but they are incredible for the face. Be sure to start off with a small amount of drops as it’s easier to add color than remove.

reviews.product_name: Blue Tansy BHA and Enzyme Pore Refining Mask
reviews.review_text: I love love this product. I’ve used it as a face mask and spot treatment (I’ve used overnight for pimples, but would not recommend unless your skin can really handle it.) It definitely helps with pimples and calms your skin.

reviews.product_name: The Camellia Oil 2-in-1 Makeup Remover & Cleanser
reviews.review_text: I’ve been using this cleansing oil for a year now and I wouldn’t use anything cleansing oil of other brands now. This is so amazing, feels so smooth and gentle on your face and doesn’t burn your eyes. This product is just amazing!

reviews.product_name: Ultra Repair Cream Intense Hydration
reviews.review_text: Very soothing and moisturizing, smell like medicine tho

reviews.product_name: Hyaluronic Acid 2% + B5 Hydrating Serum
reviews.review_text: Super hydrating on the skin, fast absorbing and holds onto moisture well. Great product at affordable price

reviews.product_name: Cicapair Tiger Grass Color Correcting Treatment SPF 30
reviews.review_text: Okay so I’m a little torn about this product. Does it make redness less obvious? Yes. Does it eliminate redness completely? No. Does is leave a slight white cast? Yes. It has the weirdest grainy texture and can easily leave a cast on your skin if you use too much. But as someone who doesn’t like to wear foundation but has sensitive skin I do think this is a great product. It takes the edge of my redness and lasts for most of the day. However if you use foundation this product doesn’t add any additional coverage of redness I did receive this product for free to review.

reviews.product_name: Cicapair Tiger Grass Cream
reviews.review_text: Surprisingly light weight for it to be a cream. I love that it doesn’t have that super thick texture many calming creams have. It applies nicely and doesn’t clog my pores overnight. When used with the other Tiger Grass products I did notice an overall reduction in my redness and sensitivity. But this is not an overnight cure for all your redness problems! I did receive this product for free to review.

reviews.product_name: Cicapair Tiger Grass Serum
reviews.review_text: This is an overall very nice serum to use at night. It’s lightweight, doesn’t clog pores, hydrates, and soothes the skin. Please don’t expect it to be a miracle cure that takes away redness. But with every day use I did notice an overall calming of my skin. I did receive this product for free to review.

reviews.product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C
reviews.review_text: Lip saver! My dry lips were peeling multiple times a day as a side effect from medication. Using this every night has really made a difference to my lips.

reviews.product_name: Luminous Dewy Skin Mist
reviews.review_text: I didn’t want to like this because of the price, but it is amazing. Glowy but not greasy looking.

reviews.product_name: Hello FAB Coconut Skin Smoothie Priming Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: Smooths the skin and is very hydrating, I don’t notice a difference in the longevity of my makeup. Love the smell!

reviews.product_name: Good Genes All-In-One AHA Lactic Acid Treatment
reviews.review_text: I’ve had stubborn clogged pores since I can remember. My skin had always felt rough and dull.I had tried using Drunk Elephant’s Framboos Night Serum, hoping it would do the trick. Finally, I caved and bought Good Genes. This has changed the texture of my skin like no other product I have used!I use it along with the Ceramic Slip Cleanser (and Marula Oil every now and then).1. It completely cleared out my blackheads.2. It made my skin conistently smooth.3. It accelerated the healing process of old pimples, buried under my skin (just an FYI, breaking out when using a new product isn’t necessarily ‘bad’... sometimes a new product just activated your skin and pulls out all the dirt that was buried undee the surface of a layer of dead skin).4. I love lemongrass, so the smell does not bother me in the slightest!5. 1/2 - 1 pump goes a long way! Less is more :).I will say this though:1. Don’t be shocked if your skin peels at first. We need to give a product enough time to readjust! 2. WEAR SUNSCREEN. This product gets rid of the dead skin layer, making it more vulnerable to sunrays.Quintessence: best face product I have ever found! :)

reviews.product_name: Superfood Antioxidant Cleanser
reviews.review_text: After a stressful year of trying to find a cleanser that A. Removes make up, B. Doesn’t dry out C. Doesn’t make my skin oilier than it already is, I have finally found my match!It smells great, helped clear up my break outs, gives me a glow

reviews.product_name: Mini Superfood Antioxidant Cleanser
reviews.review_text: After a stressful year of trying to find a cleanser that A. Removes make up, B. Doesn’t dry out C. Doesn’t make my skin oilier than it already is, I have finally found my match!It smells great, helped clear up my break outs, gives me a glow

reviews.product_name: Original Skin Retexturizing Mask with Rose Clay
reviews.review_text: This mask compliments the Origins Willowherb Matte Moisturizer super well!I have very oily skin and recently started using the origins willowherb moisturizer. After getting such incredible results, I wanted something that could boost my skin with a bit of a glow, but I don’t like serums or using a ton of stuff on my skin (minimalist) so I thought I’d give this a try. And oh my gosh... I love it!I put it on once a week at night, and after the 10 recommended minutes I begin to wash it off slowwwwly with cold water, with circular motions and only gently applying pressure with my hands, so that I can get the full benefits out of the mask. The jojoba beads really do a great job at removing dead skin without leaving my skin looking like a shedding snake, and I feel refreshed and soft. BUT the next morning... my skin glows like a glowstick!! It’s soo incredible that a ‘clean’ product can leave such awesome results. My husband probably wouldn’t notice if I shaved my hair off haha, but he actually stopped to say “wow! your skin looks so less tense!” Whatever that means but I’ll take it, hahaha.My skin has never felt and looked healthier.

reviews.product_name: Good Genes All-In-One AHA Lactic Acid Treatment
reviews.review_text: I was gifted by Sunday Riley to use this product. This is my first time using their products and I am very impressed. I can tell right away that my skin feel so smooth and soft just right after applying the product. After using Good Genes for a week, I can see a big improvement in fine lines and wrinkles and the most important is that my dark spots are faded away  which is very exciting because I have tried so many other products with no help!!! I haven’t seen a big change with my pores but I am hoping they will get smaller as I am continuing to use Good Genes. Oh, I almost forget to mention that soothing lemongrass scent. I swear I can’t wait every night to use this product. I think I have an addiction problem!!!

reviews.product_name: Crème de la Mer Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I received this complimentary from La Mer. This product really keeps my skin healthy and hydrated. When I apply on my skin, it feels a little greasy at first but it only takes a few minutes to absorb which isn’t bad. I am not a fan of the scent. It smells really strong to me.

reviews.product_name: Mini Crème de la Mer Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I received this complimentary from La Mer. This product really keeps my skin healthy and hydrated. When I apply on my skin, it feels a little greasy at first but it only takes a few minutes to absorb which isn’t bad. I am not a fan of the scent. It smells really strong to me.

reviews.product_name: Mini Daily Microfoliant Exfoliator
reviews.review_text: I received this complimentary from Dermalogica. I really like the exfoliation when rubving it on my face.  My skin felt so hydrated and soft right after each use.  The scent is amazing. It smells like mild soap which I like. I didn’t notice it brighten my skin like the description though.

reviews.product_name: Daily Microfoliant Exfoliator
reviews.review_text: I received this complimentary from Dermalogica. I really like the exfoliation when rubving it on my face.  My skin felt so hydrated and soft right after each use.  The scent is amazing. It smells like mild soap which I like. I didn’t notice it brighten my skin like the description though.

reviews.product_name: Glow2OH Dark Spot Toner
reviews.review_text: I received this product to review and I’m super glad I did! It’s so easy to use and my skin is looking so glowy and smooth after using. I use it as a step one at night and I notice that when I wake up my skin looks a lot better and my makeup will go on much smoother/look better. I did notice a bit of a tingling sensation the first time I applied but it went away quickly and was not off-putting for me but wanted to call that out.Overall, I definitely see myself using the entire bottle and will likely repurchase!

reviews.product_name: Lotus Anti-Aging Night Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I received this product from Influenster to test oir and I’m so glad I did! It is such a great night cream for an oily girl like me. Perfect combo of moisturizing without leaving me waking up a greasy mess. Instead, I wake up glowy and plump!

reviews.product_name: Lotus Anti- Aging Daily Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: Really enjoy this night cream from Fresh! It’s the perfect balance of being moisturizing without feeling heavy and leaving me waking up greasy. The smell is lovely and I feel like my skin is more glowy and plump when I use it I received this product complimentary for review purposes.

reviews.product_name: Cicapair Tiger Grass Color Correcting Treatment SPF 30
reviews.review_text: I got this product in my sephora play box and it is hands down the best product I’ve ever received. My skin has been so broken out and so dry from the cold weather and this definitely saved my skin!

reviews.product_name: Mini Cicapair Tiger Grass Color Correcting Treatment SPF 30
reviews.review_text: I got this product in my sephora play box and it is hands down the best product I’ve ever received. My skin has been so broken out and so dry from the cold weather and this definitely saved my skin!

reviews.product_name: T.L.C. Sukari Babyfacial AHA + BHA Mask
reviews.review_text: this has been a life saver for my cystic acne! my skin feels amazing after I use it! worth every penny!

reviews.product_name: U.F.O. Salicylic Acid BHA Acne Treatment Face Oil
reviews.review_text: If you have oily acne prone skin YOU NEED THIS! I went into Sephora looking for something to help with my cystic/hormonal acne and I ended up talking to a Sunday Riley Representative. He told me that this oil would change my skin- I only half believed him at first. Then I started using this and after a week the results I saw where insane!! I’ve been using it for almost a month now and my face is practically completely clear! So worth every penny!

reviews.product_name: Luminous Dewy Skin Mist
reviews.review_text: I wanted to love this so bad! Every beauty influencer loves and swears by this. I used it multiple times and every time it made me into an oil slick. Not good for oily skin

reviews.product_name: Protini Polypeptide Firming Refillable Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: Worth every penny. Leaves my skin hydrated not greasy. I am on my second container and I think my skin tone has evened and my fine lines have improved. My favorite thing about this though is the packaging. Two pumps gives me just enough and it pumps the container bone dry.... no waste of product or money. I don’t know how many times I have bought product that has some fancy container that ends up wasting whats inside because you can’t open it.

reviews.product_name: Ready Steady Glow Daily AHA Tonic
reviews.review_text: Really faded my sun spots. They are barely noticeable after a month or so of using this. Of all the products I’ve tried this is the best. Bottle goes a long way and I am happy with the price.

reviews.product_name: Mini Ready Steady Glow Daily AHA Tonic
reviews.review_text: Really faded my sun spots. They are barely noticeable after a month or so of using this. Of all the products I’ve tried this is the best. Bottle goes a long way and I am happy with the price.

reviews.product_name: GENIUS Sleeping Collagen Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: Nongreasy, left my face firm in the morning. Definetley saw results in my pores and fine lines. A little goes a long way, you get alot of product in the jar.

reviews.product_name: Superfood Antioxidant Cleanser
reviews.review_text: Only used it a few times and it didn’t really do anything for my skin. My main issue with the product is that it comes in a glass bottle that is hard to hold in the shower, so of course I dropped it and it broke. Wouldn’t repurchase.

reviews.product_name: Mini Superfood Antioxidant Cleanser
reviews.review_text: Only used it a few times and it didn’t really do anything for my skin. My main issue with the product is that it comes in a glass bottle that is hard to hold in the shower, so of course I dropped it and it broke. Wouldn’t repurchase.

reviews.product_name: Cold Plunge Pore Remedy Moisturizer with BHA/LHA
reviews.review_text: This moisturizer has a minty smell and also feels very cooling on the skin. I didn’t experience any irritation - my skin is sensitive normally so I feel that this moisturizer would be good for those with sensitive skin. My pores looked less visible within a minute of applying. It’s also extremely moisturizing as well! I’ve been on accutane recently so my skin is very, very dry. I’ve had to resort to thick creams which leaves a sticky residue. This moisturizer feels very lightweight and doesn’t leave that sticky residue. It will be my go-to from now on!It’s to be applied both AM/PM so you don’t have to worry about getting a separate night moisturizer either.

reviews.product_name: The True Cream Aqua Bomb
reviews.review_text: This was such a joy to be able to review. It’s super lightweight and hydrating without leaving you with that greasy feeling. I have oily and acne-prone skin, but this cream was perfect and didn’t cause any breakouts!

reviews.product_name: Aqua Bomb Overnight Lip Mask
reviews.review_text: This is one of the BEST lip masks on the market. It’s not sticky and feels super light. It’s actually light enough to wear during the day as well if your lips need a hydration boost. It’s super hydrating and revives chapped lips overnight. This will be my saviour during winter months!

reviews.product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C
reviews.review_text: I am the type of person that hates dry lips so I always apply lip balm before bed, but this product does a better job than your standard lip balm. My lips feel softer after I use this and I don’t feel the need to constantly apply lip balm throughout the day like I usually do.

reviews.product_name: Glow2OH Dark Spot Toner
reviews.review_text: I received this toner for free for testing and reviewing purposes. This toner tops all others I have tried, from drug store brands to korean beauty brands... this is the best toner. I noticed breakouts going away much faster than usual and some being gone before really even becoming an issue. This also improved my skin texture and it isn’t a gentle toner, but that is a given because it contains AHA which is an acid. I have sensitive skin and I found it to be fine for myself but other may be more sensitive. I think that this is a great product and I will be buying it when I run out of the one I have currently!

reviews.product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C
reviews.review_text: I love using this to hydrate my lips. Before using this product i would apply lip balm several times a day and do a thicker layer before bed to hydrate my lips more. However, this product does a superior job to any lip balm and leaves lips soft and plump and i don’t feel like i need to use lip balm as much throughout the day and feel better about the appearance of my lips wearing tints or liquid lips.

reviews.product_name: PHAT Glow Facial Mask
reviews.review_text: This mask is so pretty but also very functional. It does have a scent to it but my sensitive skin didn’t react at all. It was easy to apply and remove and left my skin feeling very soft and i did notice a nice glow as well. I typically go for a matte look but it was nice to have healthy looking skin. I love that this mask has a pump so it is easy to use as well. I think this is a great mask overall. I received this product from Influenster for testing purposes.

reviews.product_name: ExfoliKate Glow Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: Beautiful moisturizer. Makes your skin feel beautiful and gooey. I received this product as a part of an Influenster contest.#ExfoliKate #AllGlowNoGlitter #contest @KateSomervilleSkincare @Influenster

reviews.product_name: Vinoperfect Radiance Dark Spot Serum Vitamin C Alternative
reviews.review_text: Face looks radiant after using it for three months. Beautiful skincare.

reviews.product_name: Vinosource-Hydra Moisturizing Sorbet
reviews.review_text: So moisturizing and smooth on the skin. Smells amazing too.

reviews.product_name: Vinopure Natural Salicylic Acid Pore Minimizing Serum
reviews.review_text: I’ve been using this for a few months, and it just works! My skin is clearer and softer than ever. Smells nice, goes on easy. A keeper.

reviews.product_name: The Deep Cleanse Gentle Exfoliating Cleanser
reviews.review_text: Amazing!! I got a trial size for free and fell in love. Bought a full size bottle right away! Five weeks later, I haven’t broken out once, even though I’m wearing a mask every day. I wash my face with it morning and night, then follow with the Caudalie vinopure serum. Skin is so happy! Other reviews about the bottle are true. Please consider a pump or a tube, Tatcha!

reviews.product_name: Mini Deep Cleanse Gentle Exfoliating Cleanser
reviews.review_text: Amazing!! I got a trial size for free and fell in love. Bought a full size bottle right away! reviews.product_name: The Water Cream Oil-Free Pore Minimizing Moisturizer
reviews.review_title: Nice but not worth the price
reviews.review_text: This stuff is really nice, but it’s too expensive to justify buying it. I usually use the Neutrogena Hydroboost Water Gel, but I thought I’d try this as a sample. Its lovely -- smooth and light -- but it pretty much does the same thing for my skin as what I already use. And it costs 4.5x more for the same amount. So I’m sticking with Neutrogena.

reviews.product_name: Mini The Water Cream
reviews.review_title: Nice but not worth the price
reviews.review_text: This stuff is really nice, but it’s too expensive to justify buying it. I usually use the Neutrogena Hydroboost Water Gel, but I thought I’d try this as a sample. Its lovely -- smooth and light -- but it pretty much does the same thing for my skin as what I already use. And it costs 4.5x more for the same amount. So I’m sticking with Neutrogena.

reviews.product_name: Avocado Fine Line Eye Cream with Retinol
reviews.review_text: I’ve been using this product for maybe a week and I’ve lost definitely seen a difference in my eyes! They’re much smoother and hydrated. Most definitely repurchasing, and highly recommend!!!

reviews.product_name: Green Clean Makeup Removing Cleansing Balm
reviews.review_text: Definitely happy I purchased this product!I normally wear a full coverage foundation and this product removes it so effortlessly. Super awesome for colorful eye makeup up removal as well!! :)

reviews.product_name: Green Clean Makeup Meltaway Cleansing Balm Limited Edition Jumbo
reviews.review_text: Definitely happy I purchased this product!I normally wear a full coverage foundation and this product removes it so effortlessly. Super awesome for colorful eye makeup up removal as well!! :)

reviews.product_name: Ready Steady Glow Daily AHA Tonic
reviews.review_text: I’ve been using this product for 3 months now and my skin has changed in the absolute best way! My acne is minimized my pores are minimized over all skin is soft as a dream. LOVE! :)

reviews.product_name: Mini Ready Steady Glow Daily AHA Tonic
reviews.review_text: I’ve been using this product for 3 months now and my skin has changed in the absolute best way! My acne is minimized my pores are minimized over all skin is soft as a dream. LOVE! :)

reviews.product_name: Retinol Anti-Aging Serum
reviews.review_text: This is a great reunion product for the price. I personally did not have any negative reaction to it, feels gentle on my skin. If you are looking to try retinol but don’t want to pay big bucks to start, this is definitely a great option!

reviews.product_name: Superfood Air-Whip Lightweight Moisturizer with Hyaluronic Acid
reviews.review_text: Worth every penny. It feels wonderful and I have really seen a difference. Plus I love that it’s vegan and cruelty free

reviews.product_name: Skin Perfecting 2% BHA Liquid Exfoliant
reviews.review_text: Absolutely fantastic. I have seen a noticeable difference in my skin since I started using this for months ago. Fantastic for oily, acne prone skin. I have even seen an improvement in my hormonal acne.

reviews.product_name: The Deep Cleanse Gentle Exfoliating Cleanser
reviews.review_text: This is my favorite morning cleanser. It has just the right amount of gentle exfoliation for daily use.  My skin feels fresh and clean without feeling dried out at all. I’ll definitely be buying this again in the future.

reviews.product_name: Mini Deep Cleanse Gentle Exfoliating Cleanser
reviews.review_text: This is my favorite morning cleanser. It has just the right amount of gentle exfoliation for daily use.  My skin feels fresh and clean without feeling dried out at all. I’ll definitely be buying this again in the future.

reviews.product_name: Balancing Force Oil Control Toner
reviews.review_text: I love this stuff. It feels so cooling and refreshing. One of my absolute must haves in my skin care routine, not sure how I ever lived without it.

reviews.product_name: The True Cream Aqua Bomb
reviews.review_text: I received this as a free sample and tried it out one day when my skin was feeling dry. It made me break out sooooooo badly. I’ve spent two weeks trying to get my skin back to normal. To be fair, I do have oily, acne prone skin, so I think this product just really isn’t meant for people with acne prone skin. I would just avoid it if you break out easily. But it might be good if you have dry or normal skin, it felt very nice going on.

reviews.product_name: The Silk Peony Melting Eye Cream
reviews.review_text: I didn’t think I would like this as much as I did. I got a free sample as a promo and then ended up purchasing a full jar because I like it more than any other eye cream I have on my shelf. It’s sort of balmy, a much thicker texture than most eye creams. It seems to have a bit of a pink tint on me so between that and the thickness I wouldn’t use it under makeup during the day but at night... it’s absolutely perfect for the night. This is the only eye cream I’ve ever used that when I wake up, I can still feel it there. I toss and turn a lot when I sleep, so for it to still be there is a small miracle. And, my under eyes definitely feel plump and moisturized when I wake up too. I wouldn’t say this cream does anything other than moisturize, so if you’re looking for other effects too, this wouldn’t be for you. But if you’re looking for a nice, luxuriously moisturizing eye cream for night time, you’ll really like this.

reviews.product_name: The Essence Skincare Boosting Treatment
reviews.review_text: This product makes my skin feel super hydrated. The packaging is beautiful and easy to use. After application, the product absorbs quickly and the skin feels much softer. I enjoy the idea that this product can work with any skin care product and not just products made by Tatcha. Overall a great product to add to your daily skin care routine.

reviews.product_name: Mini The Essence  Skincare Boosting Treatment
reviews.review_text: This product makes my skin feel super hydrated. The packaging is beautiful and easy to use. After application, the product absorbs quickly and the skin feels much softer. I enjoy the idea that this product can work with any skin care product and not just products made by Tatcha. Overall a great product to add to your daily skin care routine.

reviews.product_name: Violet-C Brightening Serum 20% Vitamin C + 10% AHA
reviews.review_title: Easy to Use and Shows Results
reviews.review_text: This is the first time I have used a high-end skincare product and I am not disappointed. The packaging is beautiful and feels expensive. The product its self has really shown results. I have been using this serum for a couple of weeks and my skin already looks brighter and evenly tones. My skin still needs a lot of work but I think if I continue to use this I will get some amazing results. The only small issue I have is that right after application my face feels a little sticky. However, after a while, the stickiness goes away. Overall a great product that is easy to use and shows results.

reviews.product_name: Hydra Zen Glow Liquid Lightweight Moisturizer with Hyaluronic Acid
reviews.review_title: Not the Best for my Oily Skin
reviews.review_text: I was excited to receive this moisturizer simply because it said it was anti-stress however, I believe it doesn’t work the best for my oily skin. I know it mentions it works for all skin types, it is actually very lightweight, but it tends to keep my skin a little too oily during the day and it shows through my foundation. The scent is nice and I don’t mind using it but I would rather use something else on a daily basis. If you have combination or dry skin, I am sure you will love this!

reviews.product_name: Good Genes All-In-One AHA Lactic Acid Treatment
reviews.review_text: Good product, makes my skin extremely soft. I tried The Ordinary’s lactic acid treatment for a while because it was a lot cheaper, but it was so sticky and made me break out. I’ve been using Sunday Riley off and on for a year or so, but I never stuck with it for long because I’d get the small sizes. I finally ordered the full-size bottle, and I’m hoping I see good results from it!

reviews.product_name: AHA 30% + BHA 2% Exfoliating Peeling Solution
reviews.review_text: I was surprised that this product would work because of how cheap it was, but it does! I’ve tried a few products from The Ordinary, and I think this is the best one. All their other products are far too sticky for me and break me out. But this one unclogs my pores really well! Will definitely keep buying it.

reviews.product_name: Luna Sleeping Retinoid Night Oil
reviews.review_title: Really good, but could be the greatest...
reviews.review_text: This product makes my face feel so incredibly soft and supple. However, I’m knocking off a couple of stars because of it’s promise to help with redness. The blue tint of this product does absolutely nothing for facial redness, so if you’re looking to buy it for that reason, don’t waste your money. In fact, I think it makes my slightly redder than usual, but it’s usually gone by morning.

reviews.product_name: The Dewy Serum Resurfacing and Plumping Treatment
reviews.review_text: I am a huuuuge skincare junkie and an even bigger Tatcha fan, so I was super excited to try their new My Dewy Serum. First, let me start by saying it’s got that nice, light citrus smell that reminds me of Tatcha’s Liquid Canvas (which I use religiously). It’s also super lightweight and absorbs very well. I’ve been testing this serum by using it every morning, and let me tell you - after only a few days, I’m sold! My skin feels so soft and smooth, so I’ve decided to start using this at night as well. I will definitely be buying another bottle when this one runs out!

reviews.product_name: Indigo Overnight Repair Serum in Cream Treatment
reviews.review_text: I have very oily skin to begin with, but I noticed since wearing masks that my cheeks and forehead started to get very dry. This skin cream gave my skin a big drink of water, and didn’t break me out! I was concerned about it being too heavy for my oily skin, but it didn’t bother my acne either. I think it is even helping my acne too!

reviews.product_name: Mini Indigo Overnight Repair Serum in Cream Treatment
reviews.review_text: I have very oily skin to begin with, but I noticed since wearing masks that my cheeks and forehead started to get very dry. This skin cream gave my skin a big drink of water, and didn’t break me out! I was concerned about it being too heavy for my oily skin, but it didn’t bother my acne either. I think it is even helping my acne too!

reviews.product_name: Aqua Bomb Overnight Lip Mask
reviews.review_text: It’s a really good lip balm, just wish it smelled and tasted like something. If you like unscented products, this is perfect. A little goes a long way. I used it for about three nights and saw a real difference in my lips.

reviews.product_name: Santorini Grape Poreless Skin Cream
reviews.review_text: Left my skin so smooth and poreless! The smell is great, and I think the price is reasonable.

reviews.product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C
reviews.review_text: I use this all day! It has really improved the texture of my lips. I hate the gummy/sticky texture of most lip products, but the consistency of this is perfect. There is almost no color when it is on, and it is not highly glossy, so it can also be used in smaller amounts by those who otherwise dislike balms (I’m thinking of you, chapped-lipped fellas).

reviews.product_name: Protini Polypeptide Firming Refillable Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I really like this, I feel like it has helped with my fine lines. Applying too much leaves me shiny (I have oily skin to start with), but it is lovely with a light layer fresh out of the shower. I feel like it has been good for my eyebrows, too, odd though that may sound. One note- either give it a fair amount of time (~15-20 min) to soak in before applying eye makeup, or avoid the eye area. Otherwise, you will find your makeup creases.

reviews.product_name: Good Genes All-In-One AHA Lactic Acid Treatment
reviews.review_text: I have found other products that work better for me in the Drunk Elephant and Glow Recipe lines. It does *something*- I’m finishing up this product trying to reduce texture/milia on my upper arms- but it wasn’t an HG for me. No breakouts or other ill effects, though, it’s a quality product overall, but not best for me.

reviews.product_name: T.L.C. Sukari Babyfacial AHA + BHA Mask
reviews.review_text: I really like how soft this makes my skin feel! You can take the dispenser apart to check how much you have left.

reviews.product_name: Facial Treatment Essence (Pitera Essence)
reviews.review_text: Sometimes I get lazy with skincare and instead of going through my 3-5 step routine I just slap this on my face. No need to massage anything in like other serums, just pat pat done. Keeps my combination, acne prone skin hydrated and does not irritate. I find that my other products do work better than this (when I started incorporating this into my routine I saw no additional benefits), but for the ease of application I could not ask for more.

reviews.product_name: Mini Facial Treatment Essence (Pitera Essence)
reviews.review_text: Sometimes I get lazy with skincare and instead of going through my 3-5 step routine I just slap this on my face. No need to massage anything in like other serums, just pat pat done. Keeps my combination, acne prone skin hydrated and does not irritate. I find that my other products do work better than this (when I started incorporating this into my routine I saw no additional benefits), but for the ease of application I could not ask for more.

reviews.product_name: Vinoperfect Radiance Dark Spot Serum Vitamin C Alternative
reviews.review_text: I’m a caudalie junkie so I impulsively picked this up when my previous brightening serum ran out. For the last couple years there have been a few persistent acne scars on my face that nothing seemed to get out. After a month of using this I can confidently say the spots are fading, as well as some light scarring from a recent breakout. I can’t say much about any other skin concerns this serum might address, but it is definitely my HG brightening product now.

reviews.product_name: Vinopure Natural Salicylic Acid Pore Minimizing Serum
reviews.review_text: I’ve had bad skin since middle school and over the years have tried who knows how many acne creams and serums. I typically go for salicylic acid - benzoyl peroxide dries me out. For salicylic acid serums, I have to say that this is the best I’ve tried. A lot of serums (same concentration of salicylic acid) are still too harsh on my skin but caudalie’s serum is very gentle, so I don’t get any weird patches of dry or bumpy skin, but still reap all the benefits. I’m not going to say that my skin is perfect and this is a miracle product (I’m not a crazy person), but I have yet to find anything better.

reviews.product_name: Adaptogen Deep Moisturizing Cream with Ashwagandha + Reishi
reviews.review_text: I have oily, acne prone, textured skin. I’ve always searched for a face lotion that felt like it “skins in” and there is absolutely no contest to this moisturizer. I use it every night as my holy grail moisturizer and my skin is more smooth and radiant, and so much less greasy and textured. And no zits!! I’m obsessed!

reviews.product_name: Superfood Air-Whip Lightweight Moisturizer with Hyaluronic Acid
reviews.review_text: Really like how this feels when you apply it, almost like water. I use this as my daytime moisturizer because it’s fairly light but still hydrating. The only downside is the overwhelming smell of kale.

reviews.product_name: Superberry Hydrate + Glow Dream Oil
reviews.review_text: Feels nice and dry but glides easily on your face. This product has absolutely has helped my dark spots as well as making my skin appear more supple and moisturized. Smells unbelievably good! Will be repurchasing over and over.

reviews.product_name: Oil-Absorbing Pore Treatment Strips
reviews.review_text: I typically have a lot of blackheads around my nose especially during the summer and this took it all out easily!

reviews.product_name: Microneedling Anti-Wrinkle Retinol Patches
reviews.review_text: Really effective for the price! My face is sensitive and lucky I don’t irritate from any of this brand products. My fine lines were less visible.

reviews.product_name: Salicylic Acid Acne Healing Dots
reviews.review_text: I placed a an acne healing dot on a pimple I had overnight and it did a great job at making the pimple smaller. I couldn’t feel the dot and it didn’t move in my sleep. It has helped subside it a lot and is less drying than the typical drying lotion.

reviews.product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C
reviews.review_text: Huh. I’ve been using the “green” Laneige lip mask for over a month, and I only just now learned that it’s supposed to smell like apple and lime. I’m *that* attentive to what I’m slathering over my mouth. Anywho, my experience of the feted lip mask is a minority one. I find it— heretical as this is— drying. Which, I admit, is weird. I don’t know... maybe I’m imagining it. Wouldn’t be the first time I went cray-cray. Issues of sanity notwithstanding, the lip mask has proved harmless (but sticky) and pleasantly aromatic (apple lime. Who knew?). All said and done, I’m glad I tried it. Now I’m off to try Agave... I wonder what that will smell like. Cucumber and lemon?

reviews.product_name: The True Cream Aqua Bomb
reviews.review_title: O Romeo, Romeo... wherefore art thou Belif?
reviews.review_text: Drunk Elephant has the whimsical brand name. Tatcha has the pretty pastel containers. Sunday Riley has Good Genes (literally). Because I’m easily dazzled by marketing, my attention is generally captured by the showiest lines (I’m looking at you, Glow Recipe!). Belif, being about, like, skincare, lacked the glamour of her more flashy rivals, and it was only via a Sephora sample that I even bothered with Belif. I dipped my finger in the trial Aqua Bomb, touched the cream to my cheek, and voila. That Bomb exploded into my skin and destroyed my attraction to cute bottles shaped like pineapple. It was love at first feel— that’s what the Aqua Bomb is all about. An amazing feel against your skin. Conveniently, it also makes your skin look amazing! Plump, hydrated, soft, smooth. I could write sonnets about the Aqua Bomb... it’s my moisturizer Romeo. My skin’s true love... the true cream.

reviews.product_name: Good Genes All-In-One AHA Lactic Acid Treatment
reviews.review_text: J-Lo and her butt are half a century old. Nicole Kidman and her (admittedly, kind of creepy) line-less skin are even older. Good genes. And perhaps Good Genes. I mean, these age-defying dames have to use some form of skincare (it’s the law) and I doubt Jenny-from-the-block is using Vaseline while Nic cleanses with bar soap. Drunk Elephant’s impressively pricey bar soap notwithstanding. Good Genes isn’t the fountain of youth, but it really wants to be it. And it tries so hard! All you have to do is pump a little out, rub a little in, and boom. That weird-smelling elixir is frantically perfecting, smoothing, resurfacing your skin like an overzealous maid attacking a dusty dresser with her trusty feather-duster. That’s Good Genes in a nutshell. Whenever I want my naked skin to look like it’s not naked (oh the fun of being female), I put on my Genes and I’m good to go. I don’t know the secret to J. Lo’s million dollar buns (I do know that they’re impressively insured) but I can take a guess at the secret to her complexion. Good genes combined with Good Genes. And a boatload of Botox. As for the world’s palest Australian, I’m sticking with bar soap. Either Ivory or Irish Spring. As she gazes out her window to watch pigs fly. The moral of the story is, until somebody removes the fountain of youth from Jennifer Aniston’s basement (greedy Rachel!), long live lactic acid! And butt-coverage.

reviews.product_name: Moisturizing Eye Bomb with Squalane
reviews.review_text: At the risk of sounding like a classified ad (remember those? Me neither), I’m seeking an eye cream that contains more moisture than a pristine waterfall tumbling into an idyllic lagoon. It’s a big ask (mind, it could be bigger. I could have asked for, like, Lake Superior. But I didn’t. Because I’m realistic). Moisture, moisture and more moisture. Maybe some vitamin C but my success rate with vitamin C-rich eye creams, Olehenriksen aside, has been dark. And dry. Unlike the Belif Moisturizing— now there’s a word melikes— Eye Bomb! It might lack the vitamin of oranges and strawberries, but it does capture the essence of a pristine waterfall. Take that Tatcha! I can’t speak to its impact on dark circles or under-eye bags as I’m not prone to either, but I can confirm the moisture. It’s the bomb! (I know, ouch, lame-o)

I’m currently using it as a hand cream and it works fine, but the thickness makes it feel icky. I’m really disappointed.

reviews.review_text: I just purchased this during the Beauty Inside Sale and I absolutely LOVE this product! The formula is thick and super creamy without feeling heavy and it provides immediate hydration for your skin. It can also be used around the eyes which is an additional bonus for me because I struggle with dry skin. I’ve left it on overnight and woke up with glowing skin.

reviews.product_name: Mini Jet Lag Mask
reviews.review_text: I just purchased this during the Beauty Inside Sale and I absolutely LOVE this product! The formula is thick and super creamy without feeling heavy and it provides immediate hydration for your skin. It can also be used around the eyes which is an additional bonus for me because I struggle with dry skin. I’ve left it on overnight and woke up with glowing skin.

reviews.product_name: B-Hydra Intensive Hydration Serum with Hyaluronic Acid
reviews.review_text: A Sephora employee recommended this as an extra boost of hydration for my dry skin. I love that it’s super light and Drunk Elephant uses clean ingredients without adding extra additives that are unnecessary. I use 1-2 pumps mixed with my moisturizer and I’m already noticing softer more hydrated skin.

reviews.product_name: Luna Sleeping Retinoid Night Oil
reviews.review_title: Product that I keep going back to
reviews.review_text: I’ve tried other retinol based products but none of them have shown results as great as this or feel harsher on sensitive skin. This product works great with the retoinoid to eliminate fine lines and leave a glow to the skin while the blue tansy soothes the skin. Essential oils give it a really soothing smell to skin for an added calm at night time. I work long hours in healthcare and don’t always want to spend a long time on a night routine so this is a perfect all in one night oil.

reviews.product_name: Blue Tansy BHA and Enzyme Pore Refining Mask
reviews.review_text: I LOVE this mask. I used it for the first time this morning. My skin is pretty sensitive so I removed it after slightly less than 20 mins. My skin was instantly smoother and more glowy! I have some larger pores around my nose and cheek area that had significantly minimized. This product is magic. I’m obsessed!

reviews.product_name: The Dewy Skin Cream Plumping & Hydrating Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I recently moved to Chicago from California and needed to up my moisturizing game. I will only consider products with quality ingredients that do not test on animals. (There is no need to test on animals in 2020!) A quick online search will tell you which brands meet these specifications

reviews.product_name: Superfood Antioxidant Cleanser
reviews.review_title: Great cleanser from a great company!
reviews.review_text: I love all things Youth To The People! This cleanser smells fresh and light, the ingredients are fantastic, and they are cruelty-free! (A quick google search of any brand will tell you if they’re actually cruelty-free, don’t just trust what a company says on its site, there are very loose rules about a company being able to claim they’re CF on their marketing material) I use Farmacy Green Clean to thoroughly remove all my make-up before using this, if you wear long wear makeup you may want to do the same. I follow with their Dream Mask at night and Tatcha Dewy Skin Cream or YTTP Adaptogen Cream in the am. I recently moved to Chicago from California and my newly dry winter skin is happy once again :)

reviews.product_name: Vitamin Enriched Face Base Priming Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I ordered this moisturizer because of the great reviews and I like the idea of combining steps in my morning routine. I made the impulse buy online without ever sampling the product (it was on a flash sale). My first reaction was the awful fragrance! It is STRONG for a product you put on your face. I seriously sneezed the first few times I put it on, it reminds me of something my grandmother would wear. Then, after I had already purchased it, I did a quick search to see if Bobbi Brown products are cruelty-free. I assumed they were because, well, I like Bobbi and she seems lovely? Lol. But she is NOT CRUELTY-FREE. There is no reason to not be cruelty-free in 2020!! There are so many great brands that  are good to the planet. I returned this and got Youth to the People Adaptogen Cream and Smashbox Photo Finish Primer. Amazing creams for my dry skin, mild, reasonable fragrances and company practices I want to support. We vote with our $ and I’m voting elsewhere now. Sorry Bobbi

reviews.product_name: Superberry Hydrate + Glow Dream Night Mask with Vitamin C
reviews.review_title: Love!! And a company you can feel good supporting!
reviews.review_text: I love all things Youth To The People! This mask (really a moisturizer) is nice and thick, the ingredients are fantastic, their company ethos is so good to people and the planet, and they are cruelty-free! (A quick google search of any brand will tell you if they’re actually cruelty-free, don’t just trust what a company says on its site, there are very loose rules about a company being able to claim they’re CF on their marketing material). My dry skin is replenished and super soft in the morning. Not sure how it would work for combo or oily skin, but they do offer lighter moisturizers that I have not tried. I remove makeup with Farmacy Green Clean, wash with YTTP cleanser or Milk Makeup milk cleanser and finish with this or Tatcha Dewy Skin Cream (which I feel is even thicker than Dream Mask) I recently moved to Chicago from California and learned for the 1st time what winter can do to skin! Finding this mask has solved the problem. If I’m having a low-key no makeup day, I’ll even wear it in the am.
