reviews.product_name: Vegan Milk Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I received this as a sample when I purchased Milk Makeup Cleanser (also amazing) and immediately purchased the full size. I cannot say enough good things about this moisturizer! I recently moved to Chicago from San Francisco and am learning for the first time the havoc winter can wreak on skin! I have been dry and patchy and on the hunt for a solution from a brand I can feel great about supporting. Enter Milk Makeup. The ingredients are fantastic, the company ethos is amazing (check their site), they are cruelty-free, and the product is phenomenal. (There are a surprising amount of cosmetic companies that STILL test on animals!! There is no need for that in 2020!! A quick google search will tell you if your products are on the list) This moisturizer is thick and creamy with no fragrance. (Who wants a strong fragrance on their face??) The first night I tried it I woke up with unbelievably soft, plump skin. Dry patches gone. It absorbs amazingly. I wear it under makeup with equally great results, followed by Smashbox Photo Finish Primer. If I want even extra moisture at night I will mix it with Youth To The People Hydrate

reviews.product_name: Magic Cream Moisturizer with Hyaluronic Acid
reviews.review_text: Luxury in an adorable tub! Charlotte Tilbury’s Magic Cream is truly magical! I have incredibly sensitive, dry skin so I’m always hesitant to try new creams but WOW! My skin felt so moisturized and hydrated all day long- no need for reapplication or facial mists throughout the day!

reviews.product_name: Watermelon Glow Niacinamide Sunscreen SPF 50
reviews.review_text: LOVE LOVE LOVE!! This is my new go to sunscreen- it makes my skin feel so hydrated without the greasy fee that sunscreen usually adds. It also brightens my skin and gives my that glass skin look! Thank you Glow Recipe!!

reviews.product_name: Glowscreen Sunscreen SPF 40 PA+++ with Hyaluronic Acid + Niacinamide
reviews.review_text: The most glowy and dewy sunscreen!! I definitely didn’t get the right shade- it’s just a touch dark for me but I blend it out a bunch and it looks super natural! Doesn’t burn my eyes, has great sun protection and doesn’t pill!

reviews.product_name: Sugar Lip Balm Hydrating Treatment
reviews.review_text: soooo hydrating!! the color is absolutely stunning and starts of super sheer and glowy, but every application becomes so buildable and stunning. such a beautiful pinky rose that leaves the lips sooo soft and plump

reviews.product_name: Squalane + Vitamin C Rose Firming Oil
reviews.review_text: I love this face oil, it smells so good, and it makes my skin glowy. I have dry skin and I feel like this helps add moisture back into it.

reviews.product_name: Honey Halo Ultra-Hydrating Ceramide Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I received this product to try and I love it! Firstly, I love that it comes in a glass container with a spatula that is magnetic and sits on top the lid. Also, it’s a clean product which is so nice, I don’t have to worry about chemicals on my face. And it gives me extra moisture without being greasy. I will definitely be adding it into my routine for the fall and winter season.

reviews.product_name: Plum Plump Hyaluronic Acid Serum
reviews.review_title: Made my skin look & feel hydrated!!
reviews.review_text: I love this Serum!  It was gifted by Glow Recipe to me and I have been testing it out.  It is lightweight, smells nice, and the packaging is so pretty. I have been using it at night, and when I wake up in the morning my skin feels hydrated and fresh. I will definitely be adding this to my skincare routine.

reviews.product_name: 5 Stars Retinol + Niacinamide Eye Serum
reviews.review_text: I absolutely love Sunday Riley products and this one did not disappoint. The applicator makes the product glide on so easily, and it has a creamy texture. I woke up the next morning with my under eyes still feeling moisturized, it is gentle enough for everyday use so I will be adding it to my nightly routine.

reviews.product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C
reviews.review_title: WINNER! LIP MASK WILL HAVE PEOPLE TALKING!
reviews.review_text: This is a WONDERFUL SURPRISE! I got this little lip mask in my PLAY box and I’m in love! I’m getting more immediately! My lips have suffered from winter and summer. All the lipstick and gloss in the world can’t fix it but THIS CAN! Wow! My lips are softer, smoother and the lines are lesser than they have been in years! Not only that but the berry taste is delicious and irresistible! If your lips are dry or just need a rescue, this is your fix!

reviews.product_name: The Dewy Serum Resurfacing and Plumping Treatment
reviews.review_title: MY NEW FAVORITE SERUM IS HERE
reviews.review_text: I love the Tatcha Dewy moisturizer so I thought I would give this serum a try! I love it! It’s so smooth and soft on my skin. It’s not harsh or sticky as many brands are. I have super sensitive skin and it didn’t irritate it at all. My skin looks radiant and feels amazingly smooth after use and throughout the day. I would highly recommend it to anyone. It’s worth the price for this high quality product!

reviews.product_name: Indigo Overnight Repair Serum in Cream Treatment
reviews.review_text: This is one product that’s worth every penny! If you have redness, sensitive skin or just need a great infusion of moisture in your skin, this is for you. And if that’s not enough, it has the serum right inside. My skin loves this product every night!

reviews.product_name: Mini Indigo Overnight Repair Serum in Cream Treatment
reviews.review_text: This is one product that’s worth every penny! If you have redness, sensitive skin or just need a great infusion of moisture in your skin, this is for you. And if that’s not enough, it has the serum right inside. My skin loves this product every night!

reviews.product_name: Watermelon Glow Niacinamide Sunscreen SPF 50
reviews.review_text: I am a fan of Glow already but I tried this sunscreen on a recent vacation to Phoenix where it was 105 all week. My very pale, cotton ball white skin was wearing this product all week and I didn’t burn at all. It’s so nice and gentle with a light, subtle scent that goes away after application. It did not irritate my face as many brands have. It softened my skin. I love it!!! I bought more for my trips to Chicago and Miami!!!

reviews.product_name: Pure Skin Face Cleanser
reviews.review_text: I have dry sensitive skin and this works great! It took off all of my makeup, has minimal foam to it. It’s a great everyday cleanser and didn’t strip my skin. Has an almost regular soap smell to it. Not my #1 favorite from their line but is nice. I prefer their deep cleanser to this one. But do still recommend it especially for the price.

reviews.product_name: Hello FAB Coconut Skin Smoothie Priming Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: Wow this is nice for me to use in the a.m. under makeup. It’s thin and light but really does give that primer feel to the skin when applied. A little goes a long way. I love it! I have dry sensitive skin and this did not irritate my skin, but I think all skin types can use this. Highly recommend!

reviews.product_name: Moisturizing Eye Bomb with Squalane
reviews.review_text: May work for others but not me. Love the consistency and the way it sinks into the skin but this broke me out right under my eyes and so did their original eye cream. There’s just something in them that my skin doesn’t agree with. I have dry/sensitive skin.

reviews.product_name: Ultra Facial Moisturizing Cream with Squalane
reviews.review_text: I have dry skin and this still worked for me too. I love that it is fragrance free. I only need a pea size to cover my entire face and it dries down, doesnt feel sticky. Just a great no fuss moisturizer. I highly recommend at least trying!

reviews.product_name: Mini Ultra Facial Moisturizing Cream with Squalane
reviews.review_text: I have dry skin and this still worked for me too. I love that it is fragrance free. I only need a pea size to cover my entire face and it dries down, doesnt feel sticky. Just a great no fuss moisturizer. I highly recommend at least trying!

reviews.product_name: Confidence in a Cream Anti-Aging Hydrating Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: Wow I’m impressed! I tried this for 2 weeks and love it! It makes my skin feel super soft but also, I have dry skin that congests very easily. This didn’t break me out! A little goes a long way and it can feel greasy if you apply too much. But just a small amount and it sinks in and leaves my face feeling really soft! Smells a lot like the original confidence in a cream too. If your skin congests easily like mine, I highly recommend!

reviews.product_name: PHAT Glow Facial Mask
reviews.review_text: I love this product! I’ve tried it out two times this week (you can only use it twice a week) and it made my skin feel super plump and soft! It gave my skin a nice glow to it but the main reason I love it is because of how smooth my face felt after using it each time. I received this product complimentary for testing purposes through Influenster.

reviews.product_name: The True Cream Aqua Bomb
reviews.review_text: I received this product free for testing purposes and it’s amazing! It’s a really great day cream. It’s light weight but hydrates your face perfectly. It also has been clearing up my skin and making it look more bright and fresh!

reviews.product_name: Aqua Bomb Hydrating Toner
reviews.review_text: I received this product free for testing purposes and I absolutely love it! I’m not usually a huge toner lover because my skin tends to freak out from them but my skin loves this one. I have terrible pores and this makes them appear smaller. This toner also doesn’t give you that awful, tight and drying feeling. I’ll definitely be purchasing this once I run out!

reviews.product_name: C.E.O. 15% Vitamin C Brightening Serum
reviews.review_text: I’ve been using this serum for about two weeks now and I’m loving it! I was a little skeptical at first because vitamin c tends to break me out but this did nothing but improve the appearance of my skin. It’s helped lighten up my acne scars and makes my skin have a nice glow to it! I’m really impressed.

reviews.product_name: Tonique Confort Re-Hydrating Comforting Toner with Acacia Honey
reviews.review_text: This is great toner. I have dry skin and this toner has changed my routine. I’ve noticed a difference in my skin in just a short time and really like the consistency, it’s a bit thicker. I also think it smells great! I was able to test this toner thanks to Influenster and would definitely recommend it and will be buying it in the future for sure!

reviews.product_name: Hydra Zen Gel-Cream Oil-Free Moisturizer with Salicylic Acid
reviews.review_text: This is a great moisturizer, I really liked how I noticed a difference in my skin after using this product. My skin is typically pretty dry but this helped hydrate my skin and I also really enjoyed how easy it went on, it wasn’t too thick but had a nice texture. I was able to try this wonderful moisturizer thanks to Influenster and would highly recommend giving it a try if you are looking for something to help your dry/sensitive skin!

reviews.product_name: Jet Lag Mask
reviews.review_text: I haven’t used a lot of face masks, but this one worked pretty well for me and I actually used it a few travels after business travel in the last month. With always being on the go it’s nice to know this product works and is easy to use.

reviews.product_name: Mini Jet Lag Mask
reviews.review_text: I haven’t used a lot of face masks, but this one worked pretty well for me and I actually used it a few travels after business travel in the last month. With always being on the go it’s nice to know this product works and is easy to use.

reviews.product_name: Advanced Night Repair Eye Concentrate Matrix Synchronized Multi-Recovery Complex
reviews.review_text: I received a sample of this to try complimentary of Influenster and have been using for the last two weeks and can honestly say I’ve seen some reduction of fine lines and the morning puffiness from waking with a baby multiple times a night! The applicator was nice and it left my skin feeling moisturized! I’m excited to keep seeing progress.

reviews.product_name: Vinosource-Hydra Moisturizing Sorbet
reviews.review_text: This moisturizer has saved my skin! I have used a million moisturizers (professional brands too) and nothing has compared to this! My face stays soft and moisturized all day and it calms the redness in my cheeks :)

reviews.product_name: Blueberry Bounce Gentle Cleanser
reviews.review_text: Love it, makes my skin feel so soft and smooth. Doesn’t make skin tight after washing, works great as a mask too!

reviews.product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C
reviews.review_text: This is the holy grail for soft lips! The vanilla scent is delightful and not too overpowering! It transformed my chapped lips overnight. I will be getting the berry one too!

reviews.product_name: The Rice Polish Foaming Enzyme Powder
reviews.review_text: Absolutely love this!! I have super sensitive skin and it’s perfect for everyday use, my skin feels so unbelievably soft and not tight at all after using the Rice Polish in Classic. I will definitely be repurchasing! You barely need any powder and just a bit of water, so it’ll last a long time.

reviews.product_name: Cicapair Tiger Grass Serum
reviews.review_text: I absolutely love this serum. The applicator is the best dropper applicator I’ve ever used. The serum soaks nicely into the skin and really improves my skin overall. I have dry, sensitive skin and have noticed an improvement in hydration with no adverse reactions. I will definitely purchase once this runs out. I received this product for free for testing purposes.

reviews.product_name: Cicapair Tiger Grass Color Correcting Treatment SPF 30
reviews.review_text: I was surprised by how much I liked this product. I deal with some redness and unevenness in my skin and this definitely made a big difference. I love the consistency of this product. It’s light but effective and it smells great. I will definitely purchase. I received this product for free for testing purposes.

reviews.product_name: Mini Cicapair Tiger Grass Color Correcting Treatment SPF 30
reviews.review_text: I was surprised by how much I liked this product. I deal with some redness and unevenness in my skin and this definitely made a big difference. I love the consistency of this product. It’s light but effective and it smells great. I will definitely purchase. I received this product for free for testing purposes.

reviews.product_name: Cicapair Tiger Grass Cream
reviews.review_text: This moisturizer definitely helped with my extremely dry skin. It smells great and skins into the skin nicely. It doesn’t feel heavy or greasy. I would definitely purchase. I received this product for free for testing purposes.

reviews.product_name: B-Hydra Intensive Hydration Serum with Hyaluronic Acid
reviews.review_text: My skin is glowing and beautiful after using this product. It’s expensive, but I see a difference in my skin making it totally worth it. I received this product for testing purposes.

reviews.product_name: Umbra Sheer Physical Daily Defense SPF 30
reviews.review_text: I’m not a big fan of this product. I find that it doesn’t sink into the skin...it just kind of sits on top. It left a slight white cast. For the price I don’t think it’s worth it. I received this product for testing purposes.

reviews.product_name: The True Cream Aqua Bomb
reviews.review_text: This smells so good, and I love the gel texture and color. It is very lightweight, and I have dry skin, so I would probably try the Moisturizing Bomb next time instead. Need something a little heavier for dry skin.

reviews.product_name: Luminous Dewy Skin Mist
reviews.review_text: This smells so lovely, and feels so refreshing. It is great to use before or after makeup, when my skin feels tight or dry. It is pretty expensive, so I wouldn’t buy it regularly but makes a nice gift.

reviews.product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C
reviews.review_title: BEST lip moisturizer I've ever used!
reviews.review_text: I use this every night before bed and wake up to moisturized lips. The original scent smells amazing, and I love the color and rich texture. The little applicator makes it easy to use without it being messy.

reviews.product_name: Vinosource-Hydra Moisturizing Sorbet
reviews.review_title: Nice texture, too lightweight for dry skin
reviews.review_text: I love the packaging and texture of this. It has a light, fluffy texture and smells nice. I have been using it at night since it doesn’t have SPF. Unfortunately, it is too lightweight. It feels nice when I put it on, but the very dry areas still feel tight. This would probably be a great option for those with oily skin. It is a nice formula, which is why I still gave it 4 stars. Just need something creamier/heavier for dry skin.

reviews.product_name: T.L.C. Sukari Babyfacial AHA + BHA Mask
reviews.review_text: This treatment is amazing, but you have to make sure it comes fully equipped with the right things, after using  you’ll want to use a good quality, unscented moisturizer, or you can take the easy route and just use their marula oil. both options are nice, and I also love how nice my skin feels right after. do not use if you have really sensitive skin.

reviews.product_name: Ultra Repair Cream Intense Hydration
reviews.review_text: i have SUPER dry skin. it peels even in the summer. i don’t know why this is, and i’ve been searching forever to find the perfect moisturizer. i found it! it calms my skin and makes it feel plump.

reviews.product_name: Green Clean Makeup Removing Cleansing Balm
reviews.review_text: ok i love love love this. but it has harmful plastics. the plastics harm your skin and the environment. please don’t buy.

reviews.product_name: Green Clean Makeup Meltaway Cleansing Balm Limited Edition Jumbo
reviews.review_text: ok i love love love this. but it has harmful plastics. the plastics harm your skin and the environment. please don’t buy.

reviews.product_name: Protini Polypeptide Firming Refillable Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: honestly it’s a no from me. it’s so overpriced and it broke me out. if you want a dupe, the peptide cream from the inkey list is great.

reviews.product_name: Beste No. 9 Jelly Cleanser
reviews.review_text: sadly this is a no from me. it’s so overpriced for what you get. i recommend the yttp cleanser or the cerave one. this is trash.

reviews.product_name: Sugar Hydrating Lip Balm
reviews.review_text: i really wanted to love this. i took a leap of faith and bought this. it’s not worth a penny. it barely worked and there’s so little product in one container. i recommend the laniege version.

reviews.product_name: D-Bronzi Anti-Pollution Bronzing Drops with Peptides
reviews.review_text: i really wanted to love this. i have pale skin and a little bronze wouldn’t hurt. i wore this in my moisturizer and at work my co worker told me i looked like trump. i came home to find that i was orange and crusty.

reviews.product_name: Lala Retro Whipped Refillable Moisturizer with Ceramides
reviews.review_text: what a disappointing product. i have horribly dry skin and this product claimed to help. newsflash: it didn’t. it inflamed my skin and made me break out all over. i’m still fixing what this brand destroyed. the packaging is also super wasteful. so much plastic! don’t buy!

reviews.product_name: Lippe Balm
reviews.review_text: this is such a waste of money. there’s barely any product in this and it’s so expensive. just buy some aquaphor. this whole brand is a fad.

reviews.product_name: Avocado Fine Line Eye Cream with Retinol
reviews.review_text: it honestly didn’t work for me. it moisturized but it didn’t help with my wrinkles at all. it’s pricey and not worth it. i don’t recommend.

reviews.product_name: Water Drench Hyaluronic Acid Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: awesome! i have super dry skin and this helps! if you want a cheaper dupe, the neutrogena hydro boost moisturizer works as well. this one works better though. the texture is lovely and it hasn’t ever made me break out.

reviews.product_name: Superfood Air-Whip Lightweight Moisturizer with Hyaluronic Acid
reviews.review_text: i have super dry skin, so this didn’t work for me. i gave it to my friend and she loves it! she has combo skin and this has worked wonders. my dry skin loves the other moisturizer from this brand.

reviews.product_name: F-Balm Electrolyte Waterfacial Mask
reviews.review_text: i wanted to love this. i bought most of the products from this brand and they were all disappointing. little to no results and super pricey. just a waste.

reviews.product_name: Violet-C Brightening Serum 20% Vitamin C + 10% AHA
reviews.review_text: this just didn’t work! it did nothing and i never saw results. it’s pricey for no reason.

reviews.product_name: Glow2OH Dark Spot Toner
reviews.review_text: Love the smell of this product, its refreshing and doesn’t have any alcohol sting like I’ve had with other toners. I don’t notice a difference with my pores/blackheads but I’ve had less breakouts since I started using this daily with the Sheer Transformation Perfecting Moisturizer.

reviews.product_name: Take The Day Off Cleansing Balm Makeup Remover
reviews.review_text: Love this product. It’s a great balm, is creamy and removes all my makeup. Then it rinses off so easily, I thought it would be difficult to rinse but it’s not at all. I will repurchase.

reviews.product_name: Mini Take The Day Off Cleansing Balm Makeup Remover
reviews.review_text: Love this product. It’s a great balm, is creamy and removes all my makeup. Then it rinses off so easily, I thought it would be difficult to rinse but it’s not at all. I will repurchase.

reviews.product_name: Hyaluronic Acid 2% + B5 Hydrating Serum
reviews.review_text: I really like this product. It does feel sticky when applying, but it does absorb and then it’s fine. For the price, it can’t be beat. I like to use a toner/essence right before and apply this while my skin is still damp. I feel instantly hydrated. Will definitely repurchase.

reviews.product_name: Squalane + Omega Repair Deep Hydration Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: Okay, I love this moisturizer. I’ve been going through some trial size moisturizers I’ve gotten, including belif moisturizing bomb, yttp super berry mask, both of which I was super excited for and somewhat disappointed. This one I wasn’t excited for but wow, I love it! I was actually so sad when it ran out when normally I’m just looking forward to trying a new product. I’ll be ordering them full size ASAP. This moisturizer is a great texture, leaves my skin feeling plump and hydrated. The smell is not great but it’s fragrance free which is a huge plus for me. Love it!

reviews.product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C
reviews.review_text: I had a rough dry patch on my upper lip for months. After using a sample of this for a week I bought the full size. The rough patch had disappeared in three uses. I love the way my lips feel each morning when I wake up after it has performed it’s magic all night.  I get a ton of samples (friend works the skincare counter at a very high end department store and is liberal with samples and I buy most of the Sephora try-me packages) but might find one product in 15 that is a keeper. This one definitely is!

reviews.product_name: Cicapair Tiger Grass Color Correcting Treatment SPF 30
reviews.review_title: Cover the Red, Moisturize, Protect in one Product!
reviews.review_text: I love this product!  It is not at all greasy and I can watch the redness from my mild Rosacea disappear as it dries.  It leaves my skin soft and ready for makeup.  I initially received it as part of a Sephora travel bundle and loved it so much I bought the full size before the small size was gone so I can continue to use the small size for travel.

reviews.product_name: Mini Cicapair Tiger Grass Color Correcting Treatment SPF 30

reviews.product_name: Soy Hydrating Gentle Face Cleanser
reviews.review_text: The good is that it cleanses well without stripping moisture.  The bad is that it has an overwhelmingly strong scent of cucumber.  The scent is so off putting that I’d never buy this product.  I received it as a deluxe sample and will use it up, but that’s as far as it will ever go.

reviews.product_name: Midnight Recovery Concentrate Moisturizing Face Oil
reviews.review_title: The Scent Alone Makes It a Must-Have
reviews.review_text: I have been using this product for over five years.  The scent is so relaxing--perfect for using before bed.  I use it under my moisturizer as a serum, on my neck, or if my cheeks are windburned or nose is chapped from blowing, I apply it morning and night (and even a few extra times during the day around my nostrils).  It’s very soothing and definitely prevents flaky, dry skin.

reviews.product_name: Midnight Recovery Concentrate Moisturizing Face Oil

reviews.product_name: Vinosource-Hydra Moisturizing Sorbet
reviews.review_text: If you are looking for a moisturizer that works well on dry skin, look no more!  In addition to a wonderful scent, the sorbet has a great texture that soaks in quickly and is highly effective even for super dry winter skin.  It doesn’t feel at all greasy, either.

reviews.product_name: Lippe Balm
reviews.review_text: Overall a good lip balm. It is quite small and the shape is awkward when applying to the lips. These are the only true downfalls I noticed for this product. Very smooth application, lips feel very silky. Seems to wear off lips in about a half an hour but I consider this normal for most lip balms.

reviews.product_name: T.L.C. Framboos Glycolic Resurfacing Night Serum
reviews.review_text: I use this product every other night along with the drunk elephant jelly cleanser. Absolutely love the combo. There are no harsh scents or dyes. I have sensitive skin and have had no irritation from this product. My skin has seemed much smoother and clear of breakouts sense I began using this product.

reviews.product_name: Beste No. 9 Jelly Cleanser
reviews.review_text: I have been trying to clear my breakouts for months. I started using this product two weeks ago and the results are already pleasing. I have sensitive skin and alternate this cleanser every other day and have no problem with drying. Definitely worth the cost!

reviews.product_name: Lala Retro Whipped Refillable Moisturizer with Ceramides
reviews.review_text: Love this moisturizer. I have big problems with drying and cracked skin (especially in the winter) and since using this product, I have had only soft, hydrated skin. Definitely recommend for dry, sensitive skin types.

reviews.product_name: C-Tango Vitamin C Eye Cream
reviews.review_text: I was hesitant about this product due to my sensitive skin, however I have had no problems with irritation! I only use this product about 2-3 times a week and already notice my under eye seems brighter. Love that there are no harsh chemicals or dyes.

reviews.product_name: The True Cream Aqua Bomb
reviews.review_text: I have both the Belif aqua bomb and the regular moisturizer. With dry skin, the aqua bomb is perfect for a deep-moisturize but in the morning skin won’t necessarily feel totally hydrated. Definitely worth having on the shelf, and otherwise a great product.

reviews.product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C
reviews.review_title: Amazing if you can get past the flavor!
reviews.review_text: I have extremely sensitive skin and suffer from perioral dermatitis flare-ups from using products on my lips and chin. This mask was a dream to use! My sensitive skin didn’t flare up at all within the past month of us. Works wonderfully and effectively. Every so often the flavor gets to be a little too “bubblegum“ reminiscent. Definitely recommend.

reviews.product_name: The Water Cream Oil-Free Pore Minimizing Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: Incredibly refreshing and lightweight. Will be repurchasing again and again.

reviews.product_name: Mini The Water Cream
reviews.review_text: Incredibly refreshing and lightweight. Will be repurchasing again and again.

reviews.product_name: The Deep Cleanse Gentle Exfoliating Cleanser
reviews.review_text: Got the sample of this and the Water Cream using points, and was surprised by how much I love! I have sensitive skin and was impressed by how refreshing the exfoliant felt and how rejuvenated my skin seemed afterwards. Only disappointment was the bottle. It seems like a poor design in terms of getting all of the product out. Planning on repurchasing the full size!

reviews.product_name: Mini Deep Cleanse Gentle Exfoliating Cleanser
reviews.review_text: Got the sample of this and the Water Cream using points, and was surprised by how much I love! I have sensitive skin and was impressed by how refreshing the exfoliant felt and how rejuvenated my skin seemed afterwards. Only disappointment was the bottle. It seems like a poor design in terms of getting all of the product out. Planning on repurchasing the full size!

reviews.product_name: The Silk Peony Melting Eye Cream
reviews.review_text: I love Tatcha products but was surprised by how much I didn’t love this sample I received of the eye cream. It might’ve been the sample size (for disclaimer) but it came out incredibly dry, and almost cracked. I had to really rub it in for it to absorb and still felt like it was on the top layer of my skin and not soaking in.

reviews.product_name: Sugar Hydrating Lip Balm
reviews.review_text: This is one of the best lip balms I’ve ever used. You don’t get a lot of product but a little goes a long way and my lips feel and look great. I usually end up with dry cracked lips but I haven’t noticed that with this.

reviews.product_name: Avocado Soothing Skin Barrier Serum with Ceramides
reviews.review_text: I love this! I’ve noticed my skin doesn’t freak out as much since using it.

reviews.product_name: Greek Yoghurt Foaming Cream Cleanser
reviews.review_text: I really like this cleanser. I’ve been using it for almost a year now I think, and I’m very happy with the results. I’ve always had dry skin with blemishes, and I get way less blemishes now and I’ve seen a huge improvement in my skins texture.

reviews.product_name: GENIUS Liquid Collagen Serum
reviews.review_text: I would give this 5 stars, but the PRICE!! UGH!! I love the way this makes my skin glow and how it helps repair years of damaged skin due to acne and lack of skincare knowledge, it really has helped my skin. I just can’t justify the price so I bought a large size in a package that came with an eye cream and moisturizer. I will probably buy it again even though it hurts my bank account so much. lol.

reviews.product_name: Mini Watermelon Pink Juice Oil-Free Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I’m not too sure about this product. I received it as a points-reward a few weeks ago when I bought a perfume at Sephora. I’ve been testing it ever since then on and off, usually underneath the Watermelon Sleeping Mask before I go to bed. The scent is strong, like a watermelon candy, but with a slight alcohol-y scent? That wouldn’t bother me too much if I enjoyed the effects of the product, but I actually have not noticed too much. In the instructions it said that this moisturizer is best for oily skin, but if you have dry skin you can use this as a serum. My skin is super dry, so I have been trying it as a serum, but I haven’t noticed anything new or remarkable. It just makes your skin feel a little bit sticky after applying it. I thought maybe this moisturizer was part of the reason my skin felt so soft and smooth the morning after using the Watermelon Sleeping Mask, but one day I tried the sleeping mask on its own, and the results were the same. So I don’t really think that this moisturizer does much for me at all... :( I’d recommend the sleeping mask, though.

reviews.product_name: Honeymoon Glow AHA Resurfacing Night Serum
reviews.review_text: This is the first chemical exfoliant I’ve ever tried. I didn’t really notice any changes at all for the first week, so I kind of wondered if I had wasted my money on an expensive product that had no results. I was very wrong!! When used consistently every other day or every 2 days, this makes your skin sooo smooth and soft and clear. My skin hasn’t felt this soft since elementary school. Honestly, my pores don’t look smaller or anything, but my skin has been really dry and crackly this year to the point that it felt rough and flaky a lot of the time... even when I was using a manual/physical exfoliant!! With this, my skin feels like silk?? Velvet? Just like something extremely soft. It also seems to have cleared up some small under the skin bumps on my forehead. Although it’s really great, I’m not sure if I’d recommend this for the price it’s at... I’ll have to try some cheaper alternatives once I run out of this to see if I can get similar results. We’ll see. I’ll definitely repurchase if I can’t find anything comparable. As for negatives..... it doesn’t smell great, and it will slightly burn or tingle for the first few seconds after you put it on. My least favorite thing about it is the smell, but it’s worth putting up with for the results. I still rate it 5 stars because I prefer my products to not have a masking fragrance anyway, and so far my skin is looking amazing.

reviews.product_name: Protini Polypeptide Firming Refillable Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: This has really helped even out my skin tone and is not sensitizing at all. For me, it doesn’t over-hydrate (causing blocked pores) or under-hydrate (leaving skin feeling tight)-- it’s a nice medium that I rarely find in other moisturizers. Most moisturizers also tend to break me out somehow, despite me having dry skin... but this one has never caused a breakout. I’ve found it’s helped fade dark spots on my skin from acne really quickly. I’m taking one star off because although I like that it’s in a pump for hygienic reasons, I wish the pump was designed to stay cleaner for longer (I don’t like wiping it off every time). Also, I don’t like how you can’t see how much product is left in the container.... Lastly, I think the price is ridiculous, but I have never found another product that can give me the same effects, so I will continue to buy it. I got the sample size for my birthday and it lasted me a couple of months, so hopefully this full size will last a long time too.

reviews.product_name: Beste No. 9 Jelly Cleanser
reviews.review_text: First off, I want to say that this is a heavy duty cleanser, so keep that in mind when using it. While I don’t recommend it for everyday use for people with dry skin like me, it works wonders for removing makeup, sunscreen, sweat, dirt, etc etc!! It’s super effective, but I only use it only on days I wear makeup and/or sunscreen to make sure my skin doesn’t get dried out over time. It’s also pricey, so using it sparingly has been better for my wallet anyway. My routine used to be multi-step (balms, oils, other cleansers, etc....) and I still had trouble removing all of my makeup. Somehow, this cleanser somehow gets everything off in just one wash! It honestly seems too good to be true. I’m always happily surprised when I follow up with micellar water and the cotton pad comes back completely clean. After washing, your skin won’t feel dry or tight for a few minutes, so I recommend to apply moisturizer ASAP to lock in the moisture. My skin has cleared up a lot since I started to use this and I’m really happy! I have had the same tube of this cleanser since December 2019, and it’s now July 2020. I’ll definitely repurchase when I run out :)

reviews.product_name: Superfood Antioxidant Cleanser
reviews.review_text: I tried this last year as a sachet sample (the kind you choose at Sephora checkout online), but the amount of product included in that wasn’t nearly enough to wash my face effectively. I wasn’t impressed at all and I assumed it was just another overhyped cleanser. This year, I decided to give it another try by getting a deluxe sample bottle. It has now lasted me a few washes (and there’s still about half of the bottle left), and I really love it!! It smells fresh, it cleanses my face really well (even takes off makeup!), and afterwards my face feels very clean and soft. I also love how it comes in a glass bottle instead of plastic. I’m actually planning to keep the mini glass sample bottle so I can use it as a travel refill for overnight or weekend trips!! Of course that means I’m going to buy the full size soon, too. I really wish that the sachet sample I tried last year had been more substantial... I would have bought this instead last time I went out to get a cleanser. This one is really pleasant to use and it’s also very effective. I can’t wait to switch over to it fully

reviews.review_title: Good price point for a quality product!
reviews.review_text: This eye cream is amazing for the price point. I love the cooling tip and honestly saw a difference after only a week of use. I have terrible puffs and circles under my eyes and this definitely improved them a lot!

reviews.product_name: U.F.O. Salicylic Acid BHA Acne Treatment Face Oil
reviews.review_title: Life saver if you’re dry but still have acne!
reviews.review_text: I have very dry, sensitive skin and acne as well. It’s such a struggle to treat my breakouts and not cause a reaction or dry out my skin.. but this product is the perfect balance! The salicylic acid effectively treated my acne and the oil formula helped to keep my skin from drying out.

reviews.product_name: Soy Hydrating Gentle Face Cleanser
reviews.review_text: Awesome cleanser! I love the light scent and how clean and glowy it leaves my skin feeling. I’m very dry so I like that it doesn’t completely strip my skin as well.

reviews.product_name: Sugar Strawberry Exfoliating Face Wash
reviews.review_text: Nice, gentle exfoliation. Leaves my skin feeling clean and soft!

reviews.product_name: Daily Greens Oil-Free Gel Moisturizer with Moringa and Papaya
reviews.review_text: Farmacy gifted me this moisturizer and I LOVE it! It smells amazing and the oil free formula is perfect for my combo skin! It gives me moisture in the areas needed without overloading my oily t-zone.  I will definitely repurchase!

reviews.product_name: Honey Halo Ultra-Hydrating Ceramide Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I received this product complimentary from Farmacy Beauty. I am a skeptic when it comes to most skincare, but this moisturizer is headed for holy grail status in my book! First of, the packaging is stunning! And the magnetic cap to hold the metal spatula is a genius touch! It smells like honey heaven and feels like silk on my skin! It leaves my skin plump and hydrated with a hint of shimmering radiance that wears beautifully under makeup. I will DEFINITELY be repurchasing!

reviews.product_name: Watermelon Glow Niacinamide Dew Drops
reviews.review_text: (Gifted by Glow Recipe)This is my new favorite primer! It leaves my skin hydrated and glowy and has just the right amount of tackiness on the skin to grip onto my foundation and make it last all day long. The glass bottle is a stunner on my vanity and the serum itself smells yummy! I highly recommend!

reviews.product_name: Crème de la Mer Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: Gifted by La Mer: When I think of luxury skincare only one product comes to mind...the Lamer Créme De La Mer! This cream is totally iconic for a reason! It is pure luxury from the time you open the jar until the very last drop. If makes my skin feel like silk and keeps me hydrated all day. If you don’t like fragrances in your skincare I would pass on this one, but I personally love the scent and it doesn’t irritate my skin at all. HOLY GRAIL STATUS!

reviews.review_text: Gifted by Dermalogica: Precleanse Oil is one of my very favorite makeup removers! It melts away all of my makeup including waterproof liner and eyelash glue with no tugging on my eye area or greasy residue left behind. It’s the perfect first step of a double cleansing routine!

reviews.review_text: Gifted by Dermalogica: If you are looking for the perfect gentle exfoliator then look no further, because you’ve found it! reviews.product_name: Vitamin Enriched Face Base Priming Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: As a first time user of this product, I can see why it has a cult following! It is a one stop shop for moisturizer/primer before makeup application and it makes any product on top of it look amazing! I will definitely continue to use!

reviews.product_name: Sugar Lip Balm Hydrating Treatment
reviews.review_text: Gifted by Fresh Beauty: Fresh Sugar lip balms have been my favorite for years, so I am thrilled to see a new shade join the fam! Papaya is the perfect summery pink to give your lips a hint of color (and lots of moisture and protection!) while you’re out having fun in the sun!

reviews.product_name: Plum Plump Hyaluronic Acid Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: Gifted by Glow Recipe: I am a huge fan of the Plum Plump Serum, so I was super excited to try this cream and it definitely lives up to its serum sister! It is hydrating without being too heavy or greasy and I notice visible plumping of my fine lines when I apply in conjunction with the serum. If you love the Plum Plump lineup like I do, you need this cream!

reviews.review_text: Gifted by Glow Recipe: I am a huge fan of the Plum Plump Serum, so I was super excited to try this cream and it definitely lives up to its serum sister! If you love the Plum Plump lineup like I do, you need this cream!

reviews.product_name: Papaya Sorbet Smoothing Enzyme Cleansing Balm & Makeup Remover
reviews.review_text: So this review will be based on my first impression on how I found using this cleansing balm for the first time.A little bit about me:- I have VERY sensitive skin; the littlest things can irritate me.- I have rosacea; I can get very flushed, red checks on products that I can’t tell irritate me. Sometimes, the ingredients can sting my eyes, cause flushing around my T-zone, or a few hours later I can see new tiny bumps form. Now, I have read some of these reviews which played a huge part in me purchasing this. First off, the ingredients list was impressive, very minimal, and a bonus that this is certified Clean from Sephora! Also, I have never used anything from Glow Recipe as I find their products heavily fragranced (terrible for acne prone, rosacea and even my sensitive skin).However, I read the instructions and it was super easy to apply. I don’t know why some of these reviews say that it leaves residue; cause it really doesn’t. They must be using it on drenched skin... When I use the spoon to scoop up the balm, I first rub it in my hands then gently apply to where I have makeup/SPF. I gently use circular motions so that I know the balm has melted. When you can tell the balm is a warm-liquid against your face, that’s when you know it’s ready to wash off. I used luke-warm water to wash any trace off and followed up with my Cetaphil Gentle Cleanser (which is a must have for anyone who suffers from sensitivity) and I must say, my face felt clean, nourished, and plumped with no visible redness.I will continue to use this balm but only after a long day of work as I have to wear a mask for 8 hours. This is ideal to use once a day, preferable in the evening as a good way to ensure your skin has been thoroughly cleansed from all traces of makeup/SPF/build up oil.

reviews.product_name: Adaptogen Deep Moisturizing Cream with Ashwagandha + Reishi
reviews.review_text: This moisturizer does it all- moisturizes, reduces redness, provides lasting relief to sensitive skin, and offers antioxidants and peptides to protect skin. I recommend this to all those with rosacea and sensitivity. You will not be disappointed and it is certified Clean on Sephora! Best of both worlds.

reviews.product_name: Mini Adaptogen Deep Moisture Cream with Ashwagandha + Reishi
reviews.review_text: This moisturizer does it all- moisturizes, reduces redness, provides lasting relief to sensitive skin, and offers antioxidants and peptides to protect skin. I recommend this to all those with rosacea and sensitivity. You will not be disappointed and it is certified Clean on Sephora! Best of both worlds.

reviews.product_name: Oat Cleansing Balm
reviews.review_text: I really like the texture and the feel of this balm, but the packaging and tube look is not the best. You really have to squeeze the product out and on most occasions it’s just a hassle to do. If your environment is warmer than normal, then this will help you out when trying to push out the balm. If not, you will experience some frustration. If The Inkey List improved their overall packaging and distribution for this product, I would give 5/5 stars because this product deserves better care! If you don’t mind the packaging and the way it is distributed, then I would recommend this! On the product alone, it works to keep skin moisturized and calms skin immediately. Very good for extremely sensitive skin!

reviews.product_name: Superfood Antioxidant Cleanser
reviews.review_text: This product is amazing. I have very sensitive skin and rosacea and ever time I use this in the morning, I can feel just by the texture of my skin just how clean it really is. The smell is very fresh, as if I am in the garden. For someone who is sensitive to fragrance, this did not sting my eyes! I highly recommend this to those prone to redness and sensitivity. It’s just that good! Your skin will thank you.

reviews.product_name: A-Passioni Retinol Cream
reviews.review_text: As a first time beginner using retinol, the packaging and instructions given was reassuring that I was using the right amount. I have easily irritated skin/rosacea and this did not leave any burning sensations or dryness. All you need it a pea sized amount and to use it once a week to see results. I was really intrigued that this formula was vegan and fragrance free, as I am very cautious of ingredients! I started to see results after three weeks, so be patient! Definitely worth a try for those with sensitive skin.

reviews.product_name: Protini Polypeptide Firming Refillable Moisturizer
reviews.review_title: Great Moisturizer for All Skin Types!
reviews.review_text: I selected this as my free sample at checkout and I am now excited to get the full bottle! For those that experience burning sensations, this cooling cream provides comfort to the skin and melts right in, not leaving any residue or stickiness. I really love the fact that there are no irritating ingredients that can harm my skin, and rather focuses on hydrating and providing antioxidant relief! Great choice for all skin types.

reviews.product_name: Niacinamide 10% + Zinc 1% Oil Control Serum
reviews.review_text: This is a great serum for those looking to reduce pore size, control breakouts, and keep their skin looking healthy. I have very sensitive skin, and this has not irritated me at all! I use it every night under my Cerave moisturizer and I have seen notable difference in my skin texture after the second week of using this consistently. I recommend applying this to damp skin, as it sinks in better and does not leave a “sticky” feeling many others might have experienced. For the price point, this is definitely worth every penny! For anyone with oiliness and irritation, give this a try!

reviews.product_name: Caffeine Eye Cream
reviews.review_text: This eye cream is just ok. I have had dark circles for those times where I didn’t get a good night sleep. The caffeine in this product is not enough to plump and redefine my eyes. The texture is nice; it does not get messy or leave a sticky residue after application. However, I’ve used this nightly for two weeks and haven’t seen a notable difference... For the price point, it is a good basic eye cream, and would work more for teenagers who are intrigued with the idea of such skin care. Perfect for beginners, but not for instant results unfortunately.

reviews.product_name: Moisture Surge 100H Auto-Replenishing Hydrator Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: Oh my gosh this is by far the most HYDRATING and BOUNCY moisturizer I have ever encountered! I have sensitive skin with rosacea and this did not irritate or cause breakouts! Not only is it oil free but has no fragrance which makes this moisturizer my perfect go-to. The texture is lovely; watery yet not too messy when applying it to my skin. I love that it also has aloe vera, which is known to keep skin looking healthy with a natural glow. Highly recommend this product!!

reviews.product_name: Cicapair Tiger Grass Cream
reviews.review_title: A Moisturizer that Packs a PUNCH!
reviews.review_text: For reference, I have very sensitive skin with mild rosacea and this product really helped calm my redness along my t-zone. Fragrance did not bother me at all, even though it only contains essential oil‘s and not synthetic fragrance. Every time I use this my face looks more plumped and healthier than it was before. My dermatologist recommended this line for me, and after two weeks I have seen immediate results with my consistent dryness and skin texture. I would recommend this moisturizer to anyone looking to improve their facial redness, dryness, and uneven skin tone. You will not be disappointed!

reviews.product_name: Take The Day Off Cleansing Balm Makeup Remover
reviews.review_text: This cleansing balm is a miracle worker. All you need is a little scoop, rub it in-between your hands, then use circular motions along your face to remove all your sunscreen and/or makeup. I’ve work heavy makeup, and water proof mascara and sure enough, this product takes it all off! When you add some water, you can see just how powerful this balm is as it breaks down your makeup in seconds. I use this as my first cleanse, and follow up with a water based cleanser. Afterwards, my skin looks and feels clean! Perfect for even the most sensitive skin types. Worth every penny!

reviews.product_name: Mini Take The Day Off Cleansing Balm Makeup Remover

reviews.product_name: Hydro Biotic Recovery Sleeping Mask
reviews.review_text: This overnight mask does wonders for my rosacea skin. I have redness along my check that flare up randomly, whenever I apply this gel mask, it instantly calms my skin! There is a slight lavender scent to this that doesn’t irritate my eyes or skin. I am very sensitive to almost every ingredient, yet the ingredients list price to not only soothe my skin, but leave it looking plumped and healthy! Worth a try for those with irritated skin!

reviews.product_name: 100% Organic Cold-Pressed Rose Hip Seed Oil
reviews.review_title: Best Facial Oil for Sensitive Skin!
reviews.review_text: If you have sensitive skin, dryness, redness, and constant irritation, you need this in your night time routine ASAP! It is lightweight, is easily absorbed into the skin, and you wake up looking like a glowing goddess. Trust me, this is worth every penny and will NOT break out your skin. Ironically, this will help strengthen your skin’s moisture barrier :) Go out and get it!

reviews.product_name: Niacinamide 10% + Zinc 1% Oil Control Serum
reviews.review_text: After all the great reviews and benefits that this product is supposed to offer, I was so disappointed with this! First of all, it has a very sticky texture that I don’t enjoy and takes a while to dry down. But the real issue is that I used it and immediately began breaking out. I wasn’t sure if this was an “adjustment period“ to the product so I kept on using it, but after several weeks my breakouts continued to be terrible and I stopped using the product. Immediately, my pimples were less agitated and now are in the process of healing away entirely. I guess this is just my skin’s reaction so I’m not sure what made mine react that way, but I was bummed because the price is great.

reviews.product_name: Lip Glowy Balm
reviews.review_text: Just a straightforward, great balm! I like the lip sleeping mask scent which matches this, so it’s a great, slightly lighter daytime alternative.

reviews.product_name: Umbra Sheer Physical Daily Defense SPF 30
reviews.review_text: I’ve used this for several months and have found that it overall isn’t worth the money for the issues. I have rather fair skin so the white cast isn’t too troubling, but it is hard to rub the product in to reduce the whiteness to an even acceptable amount. Also, it starts to gather up into white specs a lot, especially in my eyebrows and along my hairline which is hard to get rid of. Now that it is summer, the product is especially frustrating because it is not drying down very well and if I sweat just a bit, the whiteness reemerges and creates little white pools on my face (other sun screens on me don’t do that even if I sweat). Also, the texture makes it almost impossible to put makeup on over it unless I wait 30  minutes with fan blowing on my face to make sure it dries down. Due to the added issues in the summer, I’ll probably not be able to use this again until late fall/winter and will definitely not be repurchasing.

reviews.product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C
reviews.review_text: I impulse bought this a year ago because I wanted to start taking better care of my lips and I recommend this to anyone who will listen! It smells great and lasts so long. I know some people think Vaseline works just as well, but for the longevity and scent, I’d prefer this for my lips any day

reviews.product_name: Green Clean Makeup Removing Cleansing Balm
reviews.review_title: Not so great for eye makeup
reviews.review_text: Overall this made my face makeup and residue come off well, but I found with eye makeup, especially mascara, it wasn’t as effective as I’d hoped. Typically I’d have to use eye makeup remover first then use this balm for the rest of my face because trying to remove my eye makeup with this took much longer to rub it in and often caused my eyes to burn because I was rubbing it along the lashline too closely to get mascara off. However, I feel like this is true for many cleansing balms I use (maybe I’m impatient and want the eye makeup off too quickly) so I’d still say the product works well overall.

reviews.product_name: Green Clean Makeup Meltaway Cleansing Balm Limited Edition Jumbo
reviews.review_title: Not so great for eye makeup
reviews.review_text: Overall this made my face makeup and residue come off well, but I found with eye makeup, especially mascara, it wasn’t as effective as I’d hoped. However, I feel like this is true for many cleansing balms I use (maybe I’m impatient and want the eye makeup off too quickly) so I’d still say the product works well overall.

reviews.product_name: Cicapair Tiger Grass Color Correcting Treatment SPF 30
reviews.review_title: Takes some patience to figure out for you
reviews.review_text: I have naturally pink cheeks and am not a fan of wearing lots of face makeup, so I bought this for its SPF protection and with the hopes of reducing my redness. After using it for quite a while, I’ve found it does not look great on me as a full face product. When applied to my whole face in a thicker layer, it gets a bit too orangey for me and feels thick probably due to the physical sunscreen aspect (though I use other physical sunscreens that are definitely not as thick feeling). In light of this, I’ve found this works best for me when applied very sparingly on the cheeks just for a bit of coverage on those red areas. Then it’s easier to blend that into my regular skin without being too different in shade. Unfortunately, this sparing application means it doesn’t work as a solitary SPF for me so I just layer SPF to ensure coverage. If you have some patience and don’t expect it to cover everything like a full foundation, I think this is a great addition to a simple face routine.

reviews.product_name: Protini Polypeptide Firming Refillable Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: This moisturizer was just an impulse buy while I was on vacation but I am so glad I got it. This truly makes my skin immediately feel softer and more hydrated than anything else I’ve ever tried. I love the packaging and am absolutely going to repurchase.

reviews.product_name: The Deep Cleanse Gentle Exfoliating Cleanser
reviews.review_text: I struggle to know how to categorize my skin (seems oily at times but also dry so I just try to drown it in moisture and hope for the best) but I found for my skin type, this is too drying for everyday use. I like the feeling and the gentle exfoliating, but I use it once or twice a week, usually on days that I’m not using a chemical exfoliant just so it’s not too abrasive on my skin in one day. Not sure if that’s best since perhaps deep double exfoliating could be extra great, but I think this works to not strip my skin too much at once.

reviews.product_name: Mini Deep Cleanse Gentle Exfoliating Cleanser
reviews.review_text: I struggle to know how to categorize my skin (seems oily at times but also dry so I just try to drown it in moisture and hope for the best) but I found for my skin type, this is too drying for everyday use. reviews.product_name: Luminous Dewy Skin Mist
reviews.review_text: I was having horribly dry skin this winter so I picked this up while on a trip because I wanted something portable to give me immediate relief. It was effective for that but over time the mister, which was so fine and lovely at first, seemed to get clogged/distributed product blotchy at times. Also, I just feel like it is so pricey for so little and have since found a whole  new world of less expensive, just as effective hydrating sprays.

reviews.product_name: Brazilian Kiss Cupuaçu Lip Butter
reviews.review_text: I love the smell of this product and the giant applicator is just a funky feature (I’ve had multiple people ask me if it’s a glue stick). I think it lasts quite a while and the only downside I’ve seen is the lid feels weirdly not secure because it doesn’t snap into place. However, it’s never fallen off so I guess it somehow works!

reviews.product_name: Vinopure Natural Salicylic Acid Pore Minimizing Serum
reviews.review_text: I’ve been using this product for 4 weeks now and I have fallen in love. I have noticed that my skin has become more even toned, the pores on my nose have shrunken slightly and my skin is more soft. Now everyone has different results but I use this consistently every day for 1 month and noticed a change. I highly recommend this product even though it is on the more pricey side. I’m more inclined to pay a higher price for a product that actually works.

reviews.product_name: The Rice Wash Skin-Softening Cleanser
reviews.review_text: This cleanser left my skin so soft. The price is pretty good as well for being a Tatcha product. This has not irritated my acne prone skin at all, in fact I feel like it calmed my inflammation. I recieved this in my Trendmood Box Volume 6.

reviews.product_name: Mini Rice Wash Skin-Softening Cleanser
reviews.review_text: This cleanser left my skin so soft. The price is pretty good as well for being a Tatcha product. This has not irritated my acne prone skin at all, in fact I feel like it calmed my inflammation. I recieved this in my Trendmood Box Volume 6.

reviews.product_name: Luminous Dewy Skin Mist
reviews.review_text: I have really dry skin and I always use this to primer my face before any makeup application. It helps my foundation lay down smoother and not accentuateany dry patches as much. I also use this after any powder and it melts it into skin so beautifully. Just do not over spray it to set your makeup. I recieved this in my Trendmood Box Volume 6.

reviews.product_name: The Serum Stick: Treatment & Touch Up Balm
reviews.review_text: I absolutely love using this under my eyes bc they get extremely dry. It is a must for me especially before I apply foundation and concealer bc if I don’t within an hour you can see the dryness. The morning after using this all over my face it always feels so nice. I recieved this in my Trendmood Box Volume 6.

reviews.product_name: Plum Plump Hyaluronic Acid Serum
reviews.review_text: This is the cutest packaging ever. It literally looks like a plum. This is one of my favorite hyaluronic acid serum formulas. I apply it at night and when I wake up I do find that my face is more plump and hydrated. I love that it soaks into the skin fairly fast. You don’t need to use that much product because I use a pea size amount and it spreads so far all over my face and neck so the bottle will last longer than other products. I highly recommend this product.

reviews.product_name: Double Serum Firming & Smoothing Anti-Aging Concentrate
reviews.review_text: I’ve used this for about a month and I do feel like my skin is firmer but I really do need more time. I truly believe when you use a skincare product that you need 2 to 3 months before you actually start visually seeing the benefits. Regardless this had 21 potent plant extracts that amazing for the skin. the ingredients are awesome & it’s definitely jam backed with greatness BUT my one issue is fragrance in this. Fragrance is the 11th on the ingredients list so it’s high up there...WHY WHY put that in this! I don’t understand why companies still do this, there’s no benefit to it and actually is bad for the skin!

reviews.product_name: Revitalizing Supreme+ Youth Power Creme Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: This feel great on the skin leaving me hydrated. I’ve been using it for about 3 weeks and my skin does feel smoother but I think it would have to be used for a longer period of time to see the anti aged affects.

reviews.product_name: Mini Revitalizing Supreme+ Youth Power Creme Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: This feel great on the skin leaving me hydrated. I’ve been using it for about 3 weeks and my skin does feel smoother but I think it would have to be used for a longer period of time to see the anti aged affects.

reviews.product_name: The Water Cream Oil-Free Pore Minimizing Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: This moisturizer was fairly light and would work well for spring to fall climates, however for truly dry, flaky skin, I would recommend the Tatcha Dewy Skin Cream or the Belif Moisturizer Bomb over this option as they are heavier and last longer. There is very little smell to this moisturizer which I enjoyed, and you can tell it is high quality based on everything from the box, the cute bottle and gold spatula it comes with, and most importantly the product itself felt high quality. While it is light and didn’t seem to penetrate the skin to give a truly soft feel, it also didn’t have that oily, stay around feel either which I can’t stand. Your skin will absorb with product in no time and leave you feeling softer and will let your pores breathe. Great company but again, for skin truly in need of moisture, the Dewy Skin Cream is much better option in my opinion.

reviews.product_name: Mini The Water Cream
reviews.review_text: This moisturizer was fairly light and would work well for spring to fall climates, however for truly dry, flaky skin, I would recommend the Tatcha Dewy Skin Cream or the Belif Moisturizer Bomb over this option as they are heavier and last longer. reviews.product_name: Creamy Eye Treatment with Avocado
reviews.review_text: I’ve run through hundreds, maybe thousands of dollars trying every eye product on the market to combat dark circles and that look of being sleep deprived. This product I can comfortably say takes the cake for quick results and one of the most incredible feelings you can get for a reasonable price. I purchased the larger jar and honestly with how little you need, this bottle should last me months. Apply a small amount from the tear duct to the temple, and immediately you’ll see this glowing radiance that makes you look awake and rested as it deeply moisturizers into your skin provides instant results. I’ve been using this for a few weeks now and everyone has said I look more rested and that it looks like I had an eye surgery done for bags. Will have to compare with the La Mer Eye Cream when I purchase it next, however at this price point I can  comfortably say I’ll be buying this for years to come as it truly is a special product. Kiehls to me has always been mid-ranged priced beauty products with an expensive feel. The eye cream, calendula toner, and ultra moisturizer are all must-haves for anyone looking to get past their drug store skin care routine while not breaking the bank.

reviews.product_name: Greek Yoghurt Foaming Cream Cleanser
reviews.review_text: I’m a huge fan of more natural products that don’t irritate the skin, especially being a fair skin individual who gets easily hit with redness or rashes when a product doesn’t agree. I had been wanting to try this in a sample before buying any larger amounts, and wow does this ever live up to expectation. This product has a light but enjoyable scent, creates a thick lather on dampened skin, and leaves your face softer and pores smaller after a couple uses. I got AM and PM out of a small sample pack, which leads me to believe that a little goes a long way with this stuff. Compared to the more expensive cleaners like La Mer, it doesn’t necessarily compare in terms of scent, feel and effect, but value-wise and given this likely has about half the ingredients if not less when compared with other cleaners, this might have to be my go-to going forward. Backed by tons of positive reviews, this product is a must-have for anyone trying to go the more natural route and will leave your skin feeling refreshed and clean without being dried out. Next big purchase I make will surely include a bottle of this cleanser. I’ll say it again, but ordering online with Sephora seems to be the way to go, as I always receive my orders within a matter of days, get great discounts being a VIB member, choose from numerous free products to see how I like them, and most of all build up points that can be redeemed for cash deductions off orders or for travel-size products from top of the line companies such as Kate Somerville, Tatcha, Murad and many more. Couldn’t be happier with my skin care routing and I owe that to Sephora, Reddit and MakeUpAlley unbiased reviews.

reviews.product_name: Crème de la Mer Moisturizer
reviews.review_title: IF YOU CAN AFFORD IT, BUY IT
reviews.review_text: This stuff is like butter for your skin that leaves your face shine all day without an oily/greasy look. It penetrates deep into the skin, has a very nice light scent to it, and has a consistency different to any other moisturizer I have ever tried. While the price is sort of insane, I would reserve this product only for those who have high income as there are other alternatives that are cheaper such as Belif or Tatcha. Mind you, this indulgence will leave your skin looking amazing all day and will absorb during the night, making you look like you just stepped out of a facial all throughout the day. I couldn’t be happier. Just got the La Mer Moisturizing Soft Cream and will compare. From first glance and use, I must say the Creme de La Mer stands out much more and will likely be my go-to for a while once I purchase the much larger version as these ones were only the 15ml for a test run. La Mer is truly the cream of the crop in beauty products.

reviews.product_name: Hyaluronic Acid 2% + B5 Hydrating Serum
reviews.review_text: Ordinary provides you with top quality products for a very, very reasonable price. I absolutely love using the Hyaluronic Acid as it goes on wet from the dropper and dries quickly. Seems to be helping my skin and for the dirt cheap price who could say no? Ordinary is really going to put the overpriced brands out of business when it comes to products such as the aforementioned and other acids/mixed for your face and hair. Top notch.

reviews.product_name: Balancing Force Oil Control Toner
reviews.review_text: Love this product as it has a minty, clean finish and seems to clear up my skin and remove all the junk at the beginning and end of the day. I still prefer the Kiehls Calendula Toner, as it seemed to work better for my skin, but I’ve been experimenting as I’m still relatively new to skincare routines, and this stuff gets the job done well. Pretty much anything I’ve tried by OLEHENRIKSEN has been great for the price-point. If you’re looking for a go-to company that provides solid products at a reasonable price, look no further.

reviews.product_name: Ultra Facial Moisturizing Cream with Squalane
reviews.review_text: Kiehl’s is a great company that consistently puts out top products at a fair price. This moisturizing cream in particular has no scent, goes on light and absorbs quickly, leaving your skin feeling silky smooth all day. There are other moisturizers I prefer, however for the price and scent-free aspect, I think this product could be a fan favourite for many. With Kiehl’s, I’m never disappointed and always know what I’m getting. Much like their daily cleanser, I can rely on it being high quality, scent-free, and leaving my skin better than before.Give this a try if you find scented moisturizers irritate your skin or bother you throughout the day. The great thing about this company is they make smaller sizes, which allows you to try their products without having to commit to a larger size.

reviews.product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C
reviews.review_text: So rich and velvety! Looks waxy in the jar, but applies like a cream-oil. In the jar it smells like sweet berries, but on the lips I don’t smell it anymore. It looks shiny too when you put it on = luscious lips! I use it at night, but I can see where this would be a great product for during the day as well especially in dry and cold environments. It seals lips with moisture, and it seems water resistant like it lasts on the lips for a while even if you drink water, lick your lips etc. Truly you apply the tiniest amount and it’s so rich and covers lips so well. The jar lasts a long time because of it. And did I mention how cute the spatula is?? It is pink, white, and silver, and it comes with its own little sleeve to store it :-)

reviews.product_name: A-Passioni Retinol Cream
reviews.review_text: Ok guys here’s the gist. I love this product, but some interesting things happened too. Ok so I’m 34 combo skin, not sensitive. I have used other 1% retinols including the 1.5% from PTR. I am used to using those daily at night with zero issues. Now for the DE one... I read the usage instructions to start once a week, but since I’ve used high strength OTC retinols before on a daily basis 8 figured I’d be ok. Well, I wasn’t lol. I applied 5 days in a row, daily, at night. After that, my skin was super sensitive, peeling, a bit burned kinda like you had a chemical peel at the derm’s office. It’s now been 3 days since I stopped using it and only using gentle products to recover, but I’m still struggling. So on one hand, I want to believe this product is so incredibly effective that it causes the peeling and therefore the renewing of the skin, which my other 1% retinols didn’t do. On the other hand, it means I can only use it very sparingly, and I am not sure that once a week will produce strong results, but I’ll give it another try at a reduced frequency once my skin recovers. I did use this with the oil to reduce irritation too. So anyway, I’m surprised, and wanted to share my experience. I still think it’s a great product. I loved the texture (creamy and hydrating, but I personally didn’t find it waxy or heavy). It absorbed well and played nicely with other DE and PTR products. Good luck! :-)

reviews.product_name: C-Tango Vitamin C Eye Cream
reviews.review_text: I absolutely love the texture of this cream, and it’s the perfect level of moisture without feeling like vaseline (as in too heavy). So many eye creams I’ve used say they provide moisture, but an hour in my eye area is dry. I have really dry eye areas, and thin skin with some discolorations, light under eye circles and light eye puffiness. I bought it expecting it not to be great, but I really fell in love. The ingredients are bomb if you do some research. In texture, I found it similar to Kiehl’s avocado eye cream, maybe a bit more gel like, Kiehl’s is more like heavy cream. Way better than that one in terms of ingredients and it already has avocado oil in it as well. It sinks right in, sits well under makeup, I had zero adverse reactions, just soothed, healthy-looking , awake eye area, with less wrinkles and more elasticity. I am so so glad it worked for me! I hope it does for others as well.

reviews.product_name: Virgin Marula Luxury Face Oil
reviews.review_text: Oh my gosh. I have switched to the entire DE line, but I was skeptical of the oil because I love the Herbivore oils. I figured this is a one note oil, mixes are better. Surely, it couldn’t make a difference, I thought. Boy was I wrong! The moment I added to my DE routine, it just made everything tie in well together, not sure how to put it. I have combo skin, and it took my skin time to adjust to the lack of silicones that we’re all so used to. This winter, I was having eczema and all sort of redness and itchiness. I switched to DE entirely and most of the symptoms went away except for I still had some dryness. Enter marula oil. Perfection! Not heavy, truly gives that lit from within glow, I mix it with whatever I feel like from the DE line. Weird thing is I mixed DE with other oils, and it simply doesn’t perform the same as when mixed with marula. Amazing! I’m a fan for life! No mote eczema, redness, itchiness, or tightness in my skin. Just comfortable, soft, clear skin that is balanced. This is NOT a sponsored review.

reviews.product_name: Slaai  Makeup-Melting Butter Cleanser
reviews.review_text: This product is absolutely amazing! I use it as part of and a double cleanse routine with Slaai first, followed by Bestee or the DE soap bars. Yes, it does leave a “film”, but for me it’s not really a film, but simply hydration. Like they say in the marketing, it leaves behind the good stuff. No breakouts here after several uses, I’m combo skin, and this balances out my dry areas phenomenally. It took off a full face of makeup plus sunscreen for me very effectively. Also, I hope they release the powder in the skajer by itself, as it is phenomenal! Leaves behind baby smooth, exfoliated skin, even if the granules seem very fine, and not scratchy at all. Love this so much! Butter smoothness, all clean and moisturized. Awesome!

reviews.product_name: D-Bronzi Anti-Pollution Bronzing Drops with Peptides
reviews.review_text: Love DE and I literally ONLY use their line, no joke.l, like EVERYTHING in the line. My skin has never looked as good, so I am one of their biggest fans! The only thing I wasn’t using was D-Bronzi because I never use bronzers, but I finally decided to try it. Pros: lightweight texture, mixes with other DE products like a dream (depending on my skin on any given day I’d mix with either marula, bhydra or protini), it did give my dry-ish skin a beautiful glow (half a pump or one pump mixed in), and I didn’t notice any specific breakouts. BUT... the biggest Con for me, and I must be an isolated case somehow, it accentuated any brown spots/melasma I already had, and any redness. So instead of evening out my tone in any way, it was adding a tanned glow look everywhere, and my clear skin looked phenomenal, but those areas with brown spots looked so dark and accentuated! I got really scared because if you’re fighting melasma you know how hard it is to diminish it even with peels, hydroquinone etc. It took about two weeks before my spots started darkening, and when I realized what was happening, I returned it. After a couple of days of not using it, my skin is returning to luminous, clear, and faded brown spots like I had before. How weird is that? Stellar product otherwise, state of the art, wish I didn’t have melasma but I do. If you’re in my situation be careful. I did have a sample from the Out of Office set, but I was only using it sparingly, maybe once or twice a week. Once I bought the full size and used it daily for 2 weeks straight, that’s when my spots darkened....

reviews.product_name: Protini Polypeptide Firming Refillable Moisturizer
reviews.review_title: great cream but gave me too many blackheads
reviews.review_text: I’ve been using this for a full year, so I’ve had plenty of time to see how it works for my skin. Love the texture, the packaging, and the ingredients. Texture is between a cream and a gel. It is light and spreads easily. And I do think it keeps my skin plump and perfectly hydrated for daytime (I have normal/dry mid 30s skin). HOWEVER, after using it for a year, I noticed it gives me large blackheads in a lot of random places. I never broke out like other people, but I kept having blackheads that were hard to remove. I kept going to an esthetician to get them removed nicely, but then they would reappear within a week or two. I ran out of Protini 3-4 weeks ago and decided to use Lala instead as I already had it, and boom, no more blackheads at all. So weird because Lala is heavier, but that does not affect my pores badly. Protini did. So weird. It’s a great cream but I don’t want blackheads galore so after a full year of use I won’t repurchase. Lala is fine though! Or maybe  your skin will be fine on it! Everyone is different

reviews.review_text: I admit at first I was skeptical. I had a sample and was like oooh I don’t know. I was using it by itself in place of a moisturizer. My skin is very dry and I live in Vegas, so it wasn’t doing much. BUT then I started using it per instructions, on top of moisturizer as intended (final step in night routine) and boy oh boy was I pleasantly surprised. It’s an extra thin layer of plush moisture without being heavy and does leave a glow on my face. Once I put it on during the day even, with makeup on top, and my skin held more moisture throughout the day and showed less crepey under makeup and powder. So far it is not clogging up my pores being using it for 2 weeks on and off. I have very dry skin like I said though, mid thirties. I have to say I am hooked! I use it with other Drunk Elephant products as well as on top on Paula’S Choice moisturizers and it works well in both cases!

Like literally I put it on and 2 days later I have a zit on my chin that is painful and takes forever to heal. I never had acne in my life btw and my pores are small and clean.
