Great value and great product!

reviews.product_name: Green Clean Makeup Removing Cleansing Balm
reviews.review_text: Great cleansing balm! I have had trouble in the past getting ALL my makeup off I’d use micellar water and cotton pads, pat my face, cleanse my face, do skin care, and wake up the next morning still with some mascara raccoon eyes and leftover foundation. This is the first cleansing balm I tried per recommendation of a friend, but I’m very happy with it. It feels luxurious and very hydrating on the skin. I still have to use Nutrogena waterproof makeup remover to get off my waterproof eye makeup, but this takes off everything else. I found this really helped to get rid of every last bit of makeup and is a really nice, calming routine. It smells fresh and feels nourishing. Would be great for all skin types (I have combo/more dry skin) but especially for dry skin. Very gentle way to remove makeup. I took off a star because it doesn’t take off waterproof eye makeup and it blurs your vision if it gets in your eye (but does’t sting).

reviews.product_name: Green Clean Makeup Meltaway Cleansing Balm Limited Edition Jumbo

I have had trouble in the past getting ALL my makeup off I’d use micellar water and cotton pads, pat my face, cleanse my face, do skin care, and wake up the next morning still with some mascara raccoon eyes and leftover foundation. reviews.product_name: Skin Perfecting 2% BHA Liquid Exfoliant
reviews.review_text: Perfect for face and body acne! I recommend using a cotton pad with a small amount, it’s very potent! Gives the skin a nice glow but can be drying if you use too much.

reviews.product_name: The Kissu Lip Mask
reviews.review_text: I’m a girl who’s obsessed with lip products. I love thick and creamy lip masks. The lineage lip mask broke me out around the lips. This one keeps my lips hydrated all night with no breakouts! Love using this going out because it gives lips a glossy plump look. If you’re looking for a thick luxurious balm this is for you!

reviews.product_name: Avocado Soothing Skin Barrier Serum with Ceramides
reviews.review_text: am in love with this serum. Normally avocado don’t work well with my combination/ oily skin but this , omg so good ! It’s lightweight and sinks into skin almost immediately. It also have a fresh cucumber scent that relaxes me. I love how the pump is easy to use and the bottle comes in glass to make it easy to recycle. This serum also help calm down my sensitivity that was around my nose. Will continue to use and see how it works with the redness near my temple. Would highly recommend!

reviews.product_name: Facial Treatment Essence (Pitera Essence)
reviews.review_text: I understand why this essence is super popular here and all over Asia ! It’s super light and lovely and sinks into my skin easily. After using the toner I also feel my skin plump and brightened

reviews.product_name: Mini Facial Treatment Essence (Pitera Essence)
reviews.review_text: I understand why this essence is super popular here and all over Asia ! It’s super light and lovely and sinks into my skin easily. After using the toner I also feel my skin plump and brightened

reviews.product_name: Jet Lag Mask
reviews.review_text: After hearing concerns from consumers regarding burning caused by this mask. Summer Fridays reformulated this popular Jet Mask. I never tried the OG version so can’t speak on how it compares. So my first impression on this reformulation is that it made my skin so soft and hydrated. I didn’t feel any burning or sensitivity. It is a quiet on the thicker side to me since I’m more of a gel mask type of gel. *SummerFridays gifted this for me to try for my honest opinion.

reviews.product_name: Mini Jet Lag Mask
reviews.review_text: After hearing concerns from consumers regarding burning caused by this mask. Summer Fridays reformulated this popular Jet Mask. I never tried the OG version so can’t speak on how it compares. So my first impression on this reformulation is that it made my skin so soft and hydrated. I didn’t feel any burning or sensitivity. It is a quiet on the thicker side to me since I’m more of a gel mask type of gel. *SummerFridays gifted this for me to try for my honest opinion.

reviews.product_name: Aqua Bomb Overnight Lip Mask
reviews.review_text: I receive this complementary from Influenster and Belief. I like this lip mask. It goes on very High Shine but NOT sticky at all which I love ! It has very to no scent.

reviews.product_name: Plum Plump Hyaluronic Acid Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: OKAY.... I AM IN LOVE WITH THIS PRODUCT. The texture is light weight,  creamy water,  fresh. It glides sooooo well onto the skin. Feels hydrating and plumping. Light scent that doesn’t over power . Give the face a nice natural glow *Gifted for free by glow recipe but opinions are my own

reviews.product_name: Mini Plum Plump Hyaluronic Acid Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: OKAY.... I AM IN LOVE WITH THIS PRODUCT. The texture is light weight,  creamy water,  fresh. It glides sooooo well onto the skin. Feels hydrating and plumping. Light scent that doesn’t over power . Give the face a nice natural glow *Gifted for free by glow recipe but opinions are my own

reviews.product_name: Rose & Hyaluronic Acid Deep Hydration Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I love fresh brand especially their rose line. The moisturizer is deeply hydrating and moisturizing. I believe it’s great for all skin types. It leaves the skin radiant and plump. A plus is that the packaging is so lux.*gifted by fresh

reviews.product_name: Tea Elixir Niacinamide & Hyaluronic Acid Anti-Aging Serum
reviews.review_text: This face serum comes in a beautiful luxurious glass dropper bottle. It’s super lightweight and spread so nicely. This serum has amazing ingredients that helps with everyday stressors For me the only downside is the scent. It has a strong minty herbal tea scent that I’m not aFan of.

reviews.product_name: C-Firma Fresh Vitamin-C Day Serum
reviews.review_text: It’s so innovation and smart to put the powder and active separate. Because of this the product can last longer. When vitamin c is sitting for too long the active ingredient decrease in potency, so by having it separate , the user and wait until they are ready to use to use.

reviews.product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C
reviews.review_text: I love this product.  I usually wear a lip balm at night so I don’t deal with a lot of dryness but this product totally surpassed the others by a mile.  First of all it stays on.  It’s comfortable to wear and it hydrates to a plumper state.  I wake up in the morning with smooth, plump lips.  It’s the perfect compliment to my liquid lipsticks as they tend to dry a bit.  I am so glad I tried this in the store and brought some home! It’s so much better than I had expected.

reviews.product_name: Dreamskin Skin Perfector
reviews.review_text: I got this as a sample and finally used it the other day.  Wow.  I have issues with tone, pores, and fine lines and after using this my skin looked flawless.  In that respect it does what it says, and very well I might add.  There was little. direction on how exactly this should be used though.  I finally determined that I would use this as a primer.  I did not notice that it helped to prolong the wear of my makeup, but the product doesn’t claim to.  So maybe I do wear a primer too?  IDK, seems like a lot when this product has most primer properties already.  I wish it helped my makeup stay on, then I would feel better about the price.  It really is that good.

reviews.product_name: Protini Polypeptide Firming Refillable Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: This was my birthday sample from Sephora this year.  I decided to crack this open when I ran out of Saturday Skin.  I love this moisturizer so much.  Almost immediately I saw a difference in firmness, tone, and texture.   It really does help my 50 yo face look younger.  I love that it’s a clean product too.  I am debating whether I can really afford the extra $20 this will cost me over what I’ve been using...  I think it’s worth the expense though.

reviews.product_name: Superfood Air-Whip Lightweight Moisturizer with Hyaluronic Acid
reviews.review_text: I’ve been looking for a clean moisturizer and this one is pretty good.  I tend to run a little oily and this moisturizes without turning me into a grease pit.  It claims to work on fine lines, wrinkles  and firmness, but I haven’t used a sample big enough to test this claim.  My skin clarity was good with this, I did not break out and it did not irritate.  Overall I like this cream, I’m just not sure how much it does for anti aging.

reviews.product_name: Luna Sleeping Retinoid Night Oil
reviews.review_text: I bought this on a whim.  i love retinol, but hate how it can irritate, so much so thT I’ve sworn off it.  The product promised to be gentle and calm redness, so I decided to try.  i was very pleasantly surprised.   The next morning my skin was bright and clear.  Not only were my pores reduced , but my skin felt a bit firmer as well.  I have yet to see how well this works over time but I am impressed already.  As for redness that tends to accompany retinols there was no trace.  I have had no drying or flaking either.  The oil has a pleasant herbal smell to it and was easy to massage in.  So far I’m in love!

reviews.product_name: Good Genes All-In-One AHA Lactic Acid Treatment
reviews.review_text: This is a truly wonderful product.  It does tingle a bit when you first start using it, but it is less noticeable over time.  It has really helped my skin look more youthful and radiant, and it helps if I’m having skin congestion as well.  Despite that initial tingling I had when first using the product, I have very little irritation with this.  I like to layer this with the Luna oil at night, every other day.  Love the combination and results!

reviews.product_name: Retinol Eye Stick
reviews.review_text: I really wanted this to work out and so far I am very happy.  This balm is easy to apply and (for me) non irritating.  While it did not do what my perricone does in terms of moisture it was adequate enough that I did not feel dry the next day.  What I was really excited about was the reduction in wrinkles around my eyes in 4 days.  I have been comparing close ups and there is definitely something happening.   I love the no mess delivery system and the price is awesome as well.  I think I’ll be using this quite a bit!

reviews.product_name: Magic Cream Moisturizer with Hyaluronic Acid
reviews.review_text: This is one of the best creams I’ve ever used, no exaggeration.  The jar itself is beautiful and definitely makes a statement, but the cream is truly the star.  It’s thick and very rich going on, but there is no hint of it being greasy or heavy.  It is very moisturizing without congesting my skin and leaves my face plump and luminous.  I like that the cream also contains anti aging ingredients, so that over time it helps erase signs of aging.  I love products that multi task as well bc that means less steps for me.  My skin was improved with minimal use, which is also a plus.  I also like that you can purchase refills for the jar.  Very eco conscious move.  I think everyone should try this for themselves to see how beautiful it really is.

reviews.product_name: Watermelon Glow Niacinamide Sunscreen SPF 50
reviews.review_text: I am enjoying this very much.  This blend of sunscreens is not breaking me out the way most single formulas do.  I find it absorbs well with a little bit of patience.  I have only had a pilling issue once, and then it was only bc I had applied too much.  I applied this after my serums and in place of my moisturizer and it does a good job at both protecting me from sun and dryness.  I would definitely buy this again.

reviews.product_name: 5 Stars Retinol + Niacinamide Eye Serum
reviews.review_text: It’s true to it’s namesake! I was gifted but will be buying again. Easy application with instant hydration. I was using every other night but now every night. Visible difference to my under eye bags.

reviews.product_name: Precleanse Cleansing Oil
reviews.review_text: I love and trust Dermalogica so I was very excited when I was gifted by Dermalogica this oil to try. It feels nice and rich on the skin and gently washes away make up. Even stubborn mascara! I’ll be buying again!

reviews.product_name: Mini Precleanse Cleansing Oil
reviews.review_text: I love and trust Dermalogica so I was very excited when I was gifted by Dermalogica this oil to try. It feels nice and rich on the skin and gently washes away make up. Even stubborn mascara! I’ll be buying again!

reviews.product_name: Floral Recovery Overnight Mask with Squalane
reviews.review_text: So happy I found this product! Love this mask! Noticed a real difference in redness the morning after wearing it to bed overnight. A new staple in my skincare routine now especially before a big day!

reviews.product_name: Vitamin Enriched Face Base Priming Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: This is soooo luxurious I LOVE IT! Rich without being too heavy. I checked the ingredients prior to using to make sure there wasn’t anything that could possible clog my pores and was super impressed there wasn’t given how hydrated and rich it feels.

reviews.product_name: Retinol Youth Renewal Serum
reviews.review_text: Wow! I’m the biggest fan of Murad. I love trying their new products. This is my new fave retinol. I’ve quite sensitive skin but so far so good with this.  Fine lines be good! My skin looked less tired after only a week of using.

reviews.product_name: Mini Retinol Youth Renewal Serum
reviews.review_text: Wow! I’m the biggest fan of Murad. I love trying their new products. This is my new fave retinol. I’ve quite sensitive skin but so far so good with this.  Fine lines be good! My skin looked less tired after only a week of using.

reviews.product_name: Watermelon Glow Niacinamide Sunscreen SPF 50
reviews.review_text: I loved this! Left me with a really nice glow. I felt hydrated all day long. I really appreciated how non greasy and lightweight it was on application. I was able to wear under make up too which I liked.

reviews.product_name: Sugar Lip Balm Hydrating Treatment
reviews.review_text: I love anything for my lips with a nice tint and this does just that while being really moisturizing. It’s the perfect shade. Not to dark or bright.  Perfect all year round. It was gifted by Fresh! :)

reviews.product_name: Tea Elixir Niacinamide & Hyaluronic Acid Anti-Aging Serum
reviews.review_text: I love everything Fresh do and this is no exception. The serum feels luxurious while still feeling light weight. The application is nice and the bottle feels more expensive than it is.  Really happy with it

reviews.product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C
reviews.review_text: I use this 4-5 nights a week and wake up with baby butt soft lips.  Even with that much use, there is still 85% of the product left.  It’s thick so only a small amt is needed.  Definitely recommend!

reviews.product_name: Cleansing & Exfoliating Wipes
reviews.review_text: I have insanely sensitive skin that flares up for no reason so I can’t use many makeup removal wipes.  These are one of the very few and now the only ones I use and the Rose wipes actually do brighten my skin!  They don’t irritate my skin and as long as I store them upside down, they all stay wet for the month.  I’ve gotten my Mother and 2 friends hooked on them as well!  I’m very excited to try the Watermelon ones now!

reviews.product_name: Superfood Air-Whip Lightweight Moisturizer with Hyaluronic Acid
reviews.review_text: This is a great moisturizer for oily skin, has a nice fresh scent and sinks in quickly.  My skin has been leaning more combo-oily instead of combo-dry and while I need to add MUFE Skin Booster in the winter under makeup, it is perfect by itself the rest of the year.

reviews.product_name: Moisturizing Eye Bomb with Squalane
reviews.review_text: I use and love other Belif products so I decided to try this because my under eyes have been extra dry this winter. After one month, the dryness is gone, my skin is brighter and my concealer looks so much better throughout the day.  I’ve never been a believer in eye cream but this one changed my mind.  Definitely recommend.

reviews.product_name: Sugar Advanced Lip Balm Intense Hydration Treatment
reviews.review_text: I absolutely love the Fresh Tinted balms and have one stashed in multiple places but decided to try this as I was looking for a balm without a tint.  Unfortunately, this just does not provide the hydration that the tinted balms do and I need to reapply every 20 min or so.  The tinted balms have a thicker formula than this does which is probably why they don’t wear away as quickly.  I’m not planning on returning this but I’d only recommend this to those without really dry lips.

reviews.product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C
reviews.review_text: I love this lip mask, especially during the windy NYC winters, so when I ran out of the original berry, I decided to try the vanilla. Unfortunately, I don’t like the scent/taste as much as I had hoped.  It does have a slight vanilla scent but underneath, it almost smells and tastes like plastic. I’ve used it a few times and it’s the first scent that I’m not a fan of.  Both the berry and green apple versions are great and neither have this plasticky flavor.  I definitely recommend this lip mask but not the vanilla version and I think I’ll be exchanging it for the berry.

reviews.product_name: The True Cream Aqua Bomb
reviews.review_title: Best day cream for oily and combo skin
reviews.review_text: This wasn’t hydrating enough until about 6 months ago when I noticed my skin getting oily and now it’s a holy grail day cream.  A little goes a long way, it sinks in quickly and wears beautifully under makeup.  If I do have any dry patches, I’ll top this with a bit of marula oil on those areas only, it never pills up and I’ve actually noticed my makeup lasts longer.  I wish it came in an airless pump but I bought one from Amazon and I find it helps me use less.  I get about 3 months out of the 1.6 oz tub.  I’ve used the Belif Moisture Bomb at night and the Eye Bomb day and night for years and the entire line is fantastic.  I definitely recommend this for those with oily and combo skin although normal skin types may also like it.

reviews.product_name: The Water Cream Oil-Free Pore Minimizing Moisturizer
reviews.review_title: Made my combo oily skin dry
reviews.review_text: I know this is a hyped product but it didn’t work for me.  This didn’t provide any hydration and actually made my combo oily skin feel dry.  My makeup looks cracked and cakey even after a hydrating facial mist.  I got the mini as a point perk and will not be buying the full size.  I’ll be sticking with the Belif Aqua Bomb instead.

reviews.product_name: Mini The Water Cream
reviews.review_title: Made my combo oily skin dry
reviews.review_text: I know this is a hyped product but it didn’t work for me.  This didn’t provide any hydration and actually made my combo oily skin feel dry.  My makeup looks cracked and cakey even after a hydrating facial mist.  I got the mini as a point perk and will not be buying the full size.  I’ll be sticking with the Belif Aqua Bomb instead.

reviews.product_name: Brighten-i Eye Cream
reviews.review_text: I’ve used the Belif Eye Bomb for years but it’s started to give me milia, so I bought this as it seemed lighter. Unfortunately, the consistency is too thin and it’s not hydrating enough, especially under makeup. Also, I hadn’t even used it for a week when it seemed to be separating as I squeezed it out. All this aside, I gave it to a friend that doesn’t have dry under eyes and she likes it so I suggest a sample first.

reviews.product_name: Niacinamide 10% + Zinc 1% Oil Control Serum
reviews.review_text: I have ultra sensitive, reactive and acne prone skin and, rather than controlling acne as described, I woke up with whiteheads all over my face after just one use. I’m hyper vigilant about ingredients in the hopes that I can avoid reactions and I’ve used Niacinamide products before without issue so I’m pretty sure the Zinc caused this reaction.  Clearly many people love this but I don’t recommend it to those with sensitive skin.

reviews.product_name: Vegan Milk Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I received a sample of this in a recent order and although it’s very hydrating, I developed numerous painful under the skin breakouts after 1 use. I have ultra sensitive, reactive and acne prone skin so I’m hype vigilant about ingredients and avoid products that contain essential oils and significant amounts of plant and flower extracts as they irritate me personally. While the ingredients in this didn’t cause concern, something in it didn’t agree with my skin. I think those that aren’t sensitive or acne prone and have normal to dry skin may like this but I think it may be too rich and heavy for those that are combo or oily.

reviews.product_name: Sugar Advanced Lip Balm Intense Hydration Treatment
reviews.review_title: Pink is just as great as clear!
reviews.review_text: The clear Advanced Therapy has been my favorite, and most repurchased, lip balm for a few years but I finally decided to try the pink one and I love it just as much.  The Advanced Therapy formula is thin and melts into the lips but is extremely hydrating and nourishing. Winter here in NYC can be very cold and windy but I haven’t dealt with chapping, dryness or flaking since I started using this balm.  It’s perfect under masks and I have one stashed in multiple places so I’m never without it.  The pink shade is almost nonexistent and although it can be built up slightly, I don’t see much of a difference between it and the clear. This is one of my most recommended products. **Fresh’s Tinted balms have a different, and inconsistent, formula that varies depending on color so I recommend the Advanced Therapy line for healing and the Tinted line for color.

reviews.product_name: The Rice Wash Skin-Softening Cleanser
reviews.review_text: I never thought I’d get excited about a cleanser but I love this!!  I have ultra sensitive and reactive skin so I rarely switch up my skincare products but my skin has become more dry over the last year so I wanted to try a cream cleanser instead of the gel that I’ve used for 8 years.  The formula is creamy and rich, cleanses my skin without stripping it and doesn’t cause any irritation.  Rice gives it a texture that mildly exfoliates but in the most gentle way possible - it truly does live up to the skin softening claim!  It does have the typical Tatcha scent that I’ve never really liked but it’s not nearly as strong as it is in other products from the line.  This cleanser has definitely replaced my longtime favorite and I can’t recommend it enough for all skin types.

reviews.product_name: Mini Rice Wash Skin-Softening Cleanser
reviews.review_text: I never thought I’d get excited about a cleanser but I love this!!  I have ultra sensitive and reactive skin so I rarely switch up my skincare products but my skin has become more dry over the last year so I wanted to try a cream cleanser instead of the gel that I’ve used for 8 years.  The formula is creamy and rich, cleanses my skin without stripping it and doesn’t cause any irritation.  Rice gives it a texture that mildly exfoliates but in the most gentle way possible - it truly does live up to the skin softening claim!  It does have the typical Tatcha scent that I’ve never really liked but it’s not nearly as strong as it is in other products from the line.  This cleanser has definitely replaced my longtime favorite and I can’t recommend it enough for all skin types.

reviews.product_name: Sugar Hydrating Lip Balm
reviews.review_text: I’m not the biggest fan of lip balms in a pot but Fresh’s Advanced Therapy balm is my holy grail so I decided to try this one.  What I love most is the watermelon scent/flavor as it’s not overly sweet or artificial.  The formula is not too thin or too heavy and has a smooth texture but I do find myself needing to reapply quite often so I went through it very quickly.  It didn’t dehydrate my lips but just doesn’t provide as much moisture as I need, especially in the winter.  I’m glad I tried it and I do recommend it for those looking for a great smelling, basic balm but it won’t replace my Advanced Therapy balm.

reviews.product_name: Honey Halo Ultra-Hydrating Ceramide Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I’ve tried a few new moisturizers over the past couple months and I don’t care for this much.  I have combo dry skin, more dry during the winter, that’s also ultra sensitive and reactive and while this didn’t cause any irritation, I’m not a fan of the strong honey scent.  It layered well with my other products but it didn’t sink in as well as other moisturizers I have so my skin seemed slightly oily rather than glowing.  I forced myself to use it for about a week and just couldn’t get past the scent anymore.  I think this could work for very dry skin types but I’m just not a fan.

reviews.product_name: Caffeine Eye Cream
reviews.review_text: I wanted to love this but after 2 months, I don’t see any difference.  On the one hand, it’s lightweight, layers well, didn’t irritate my ultra sensitive and reactive skin or burn my eyes.  On the other hand, however, it didn’t make any noticeable difference in fine lines or puffiness, something I’m noticing more and more now that I’m 41.  I wasn’t expecting a miracle or a result that only filler can give but I was hoping to at least see something after 2 months.  Maybe this could work as a prevention product but I wouldn’t recommend to someone looking for significant results. **Just a hint - I learned in the 90s that a little hemorrhoids cream helps to reduce under eye puffiness and it’s still the best tip I can give!

reviews.product_name: Aqua Bomb Overnight Lip Mask
reviews.review_text: I tried for over a week to love this lip mask but it’s just not my favorite.  It’s very stiff in the jar and there’s no applicator so I’m forced to dig into it with my finger, which I just don’t like.  There also doesn’t seem to be a happy medium in terms of how much to apply as it gets goopy fast but a thin layer is gone in an hour, and I didn’t find it to be nourishing enough to use as an overnight mask.  I’m disappointed because Belif products have been part of my skincare routine for a few yrs but this just doesn’t compare to my favorite lip masks from Fresh and Laneige.

reviews.product_name: Soy Hydrating Gentle Face Cleanser
reviews.review_text: Does what it is supposed to. Does not irritate my sensitive and acne prone skin. Not the most exciting or fun product I’ve ever used but also doesn’t cause me any problems!

reviews.product_name: Niacinamide 10% + Zinc 1% Oil Control Serum
reviews.review_text: This product works well for my sensitive and acne prone skin. The only major problem is it does not layer well with other products at all. So I can’t use it during the day or it sort of balls up and does not look good on spots. I only use at night with very minimal other skin care products at the same time.

reviews.product_name: Take The Day Off Cleansing Balm Makeup Remover
reviews.review_text: I would say this is the most effective and non-irritating cleansing balm I have found for my skin as the first step of a double cleanse process. Works very well and does not break me out/ inflame my sensitive skin.

reviews.product_name: Mini Take The Day Off Cleansing Balm Makeup Remover
reviews.review_text: I would say this is the most effective and non-irritating cleansing balm I have found for my skin as the first step of a double cleanse process. Works very well and does not break me out/ inflame my sensitive skin.

reviews.product_name: Watermelon Pink Juice Oil-Free Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I really enjoy this product. I believe that all the claims the brand has about this product proved true on my skin. I find it to be very hydrating and non irritating on my sensitive and acne prone skin. I enjoy the smell and find it to be not overpowering.

reviews.product_name: Cream Skin Toner & Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I enjoy this product. It layers well, is non irritating, moisturizing and calming. Simple and effective for what it is meant to do.Also for those who care, I find the packaging to be very impressive. A unique top for the bottle.

reviews.product_name: Vegan Milk Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: Love this product from Milk Makeup. I am a huge fan of the brand and have found this to be one of my fave products they have released. Very moisturizing but not greasy. Did not break out or irritate my sensitive and acne prone skin.No complaints!Also love the very sturdy packaging.

reviews.product_name: Vinopure Natural Salicylic Acid Pore Minimizing Serum
reviews.review_text: I found this product to work very effectively at mattifying and smoothing the skin. I did find that it seemed to irritate my skin if I used it every day and had to scale back a bit when I felt I went overboard. Good in moderation.

reviews.product_name: Rose & Hyaluronic Acid Deep Hydration Toner
reviews.review_text: I love the smell of rose, and this toner has the perfect rose scent. Not perfumey or overpowering, but very light and natural. The packaging is great and looks pretty on my bathroom counter. The rose petals in the bottle are a nice touch and make it extra luxe. The product itself works great and is very hydrating on my uber dry winter skin. I still need to follow up with a moisturizer, but this helps to add extra hydration. The price is steep but worth it for a ‘treat yourself’ skincare product.

reviews.product_name: Barrier+ Triple Lipid-Peptide Face Cream
reviews.review_text: I was gifted this product to review. I found it to be the perfect balance of hydrating but not too creamy and sticky. Makeup layers great on top of it. The packaging is super cool! I love that you just pump the top and the perfect amount comes out (for your face) and a second pump for your neck and chest area. There isn’t a distinct scent - but it does have that in scented ‘smell’ - if you know, you just know. Overall I highly recommend.

reviews.product_name: Mini Barrier+ Triple Lipid-Peptide Face Cream
reviews.review_text: I was gifted this product to review. I found it to be the perfect balance of hydrating but not too creamy and sticky. Makeup layers great on top of it. The packaging is super cool! I love that you just pump the top and the perfect amount comes out (for your face) and a second pump for your neck and chest area. There isn’t a distinct scent - but it does have that in scented ‘smell’ - if you know, you just know. Overall I highly recommend.

reviews.product_name: Daily Greens Oil-Free Gel Moisturizer with Moringa and Papaya
reviews.review_text: Farmacy gifted me this moisturizer and I’m so glad they did! I have been struggling to find a moisturizer that works for days when I’m oily and also works for days that I’m dry. This one seams to do the trick. It’s light weight and almost feels like a gel, but it’s hydrating and makes my skin feel like it just drank some water. The smell is not my favorite - almost a ginger scent. But overall this is a very good moisturizer and I would recommend to friends and family.

reviews.product_name: Avocado Fine Line Eye Cream with Retinol
reviews.review_text: This eye cream was gifted to me for review purposes. Overall I liked it. The jar seams huge and like it will last a long time. The packaging is very nice. I don’t love the smell, but that’s the only downside really. The eye cream itself is creamy, not too thick, and applies really evenly. So far it hasn’t given my milia bumps, which is a problem with other eye creams. Makeup applies great ontop of it. I do wish that GlowRecipe would come out with and eye cream that doesn’t have retinol in it for the pregnant and breastfeeding mamas.

reviews.product_name: Watermelon Glow Niacinamide Dew Drops
reviews.review_text: This product was gifted by Glow Recipe for review purposes and I must say, it really like it! The smell is a wonderful sweet watermelon scent - smells just like their sleep mask. I’ve been using it both as a primer under makeup and alone on days I don’t wear makeup. The cold winter air has been giving me really dry chapped skin and this product seams to give it a little more life and glow. The ingredients haven’t caused any irritation or breakouts. I would love to see more products added to their watermelon line!

reviews.product_name: Honeymoon Glow AHA Resurfacing Night Serum
reviews.review_text: I absolutely love this serum! It’s a cheeper alternative to some of the other AHA/BHA serums I love. It makes my akin feel nice and plump and hydrated in the morning. I also do t have any issues with it making me breakout or irritate. Absolutely recommend! This product was provided complimentary from Farmacy Beauty for review purposes.

reviews.product_name: 5 Stars Retinol + Niacinamide Eye Serum
reviews.review_text: Products like this are hard to see a difference with until you use them for a couple of months. I’ve had mine for about 2 weeks and so far so good. It’s a thinner formula which is nice for daytime use. Makeup applies on top of it very nicely. The package makes it super easy to apply and you aren’t forced to use your finger or stick your finger into a pot of product, which I hate. I typically really like Sunday Riley products so I’m hopeful that with continued use I’ll see a difference with some fine lines and wrinkles!

reviews.product_name: Mini Precleanse Cleansing Oil
reviews.review_text: If you are looking for a gentle cleansing oil, this is it! It works wonderfully at removing SPF, face makeup, cheek makeup & eye makeup. If you need something to remove mascara, I recommend their cleansing balm instead. The smell is wonderful and it is a wonderful first step to my facial cleansing routine. This product was gifted by Dermalogica for review purposes but I have gone through countless bottles prior to this. Highly recommend!

reviews.product_name: Precleanse Cleansing Oil
reviews.review_text: If you are looking for a gentle cleansing oil, this is it! It works wonderfully at removing SPF, face makeup, cheek makeup & eye makeup. If you need something to remove mascara, I recommend their cleansing balm instead. The smell is wonderful and it is a wonderful first step to my facial cleansing routine. This product was gifted by Dermalogica for review purposes but I have gone through countless bottles prior to this. Highly recommend!

reviews.product_name: Plum Plump Hyaluronic Acid Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I’m been using this cream as my daily moisturizer. It smells good but isn’t over powering. It has a gel like consistency but still feels very hydrating and nourishing on my skin. It reminds me a lot of the Fresh arose moisturizer. I also love that you can refill the jar with a refill pod! What a genius way to help the environment!

reviews.product_name: Mini Plum Plump Hyaluronic Acid Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I’m been using this cream as my daily moisturizer. It smells good but isn’t over powering. It has a gel like consistency but still feels very hydrating and nourishing on my skin. It reminds me a lot of the Fresh arose moisturizer. I also love that you can refill the jar with a refill pod! What a genius way to help the environment!

reviews.product_name: Vitamin Enriched Face Base Priming Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I have used this face primer many many times in the past and forgot just how magical it is. It provides the most perfect base for makeup and is the perfect amount of thickness to moisturize your skin but not leave it heavy or sticky feeling. Is perfect for normal to dry and combo skin. Oily skin o would not recommend.

reviews.product_name: Magic Cream Moisturizer with Hyaluronic Acid
reviews.review_text: This is 100% my favorite moisturizer of all time. I LOVE the light clean rose scent to it. The packaging is beautiful and it looks pretty on my bathroom sink with my other skincare. But most importantly, it feels so nice on your skin. Hydrating, thick but not too think, smooth and wears perfectly under makeup (both powder and liquid foundation). I truly have no complaints or suggestions to make it better. It’s perfect just the way it is. For reference I have normal to dry skin and it works well for me year round. If you have more oily skin I recommend the light version.

reviews.product_name: Rose & Hyaluronic Acid Deep Hydration Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: Hands down the best moisturizer I’ve ever used. It smells very lightly of rose, applies great, not sticky or thick, and super hydrating. The packaging is nice and sturdy and a little bit of product goes a long way. Highly recommend for anyone with normal to dry skin.

reviews.product_name: Sugar Lip Balm Hydrating Treatment
reviews.review_text: Another wonderful product by Fresh! Their lip balms are my favorite! This one has the perfect ‘I just ate a popsicle’ tint to it without being bright red or pink. It moisturizes my lips wonderfully and smells like citrus. Definitely recommend if you are looking for the perfect tinted lip balm this summer! Gifted by Fresh for review purposes.

reviews.product_name: Tea Elixir Niacinamide & Hyaluronic Acid Anti-Aging Serum
reviews.review_text: I instantly noticed a difference when using this serum. My skin feels more hydrated, bouncy and smooth. The applicator dispenses the perfect amount of product and it has a really nice light fresh scent to it. I highly recommend!

reviews.product_name: GENIUS Liquid Collagen Serum
reviews.review_text: Ok so I wouldn’t day this ‘diminished the look of fine lines’ in 10 days BUT it is still a great serum! It makes my skin feel very youthful and hydrated, almost plump. The bottle is very luxe and the smell is mild. Makeup and moisturizer layer well onto pic it and it didn’t cause my skin to break out or anything weird like that. I look forward to seeing the effects after another few weeks of use. Gifted by Algenist.

reviews.product_name: Lip Butter Balm
reviews.review_text: I’m a vanilla ‘snob’ and only like certain vanilla scents. THIS LIP BALM smells amazing! I wish I could put it on a spoon and eat it! The tip of the applicator is also really cool, it has an indent in it so it hugs your lips nicely. Makes my lips feel soft and smooth and doesn’t have a gross taste to it. Isn’t sticky or thick, just a nice balm. Highly recommend.

reviews.product_name: Retinol Youth Renewal Serum
reviews.review_text: I’m 34 with ‘normal’ skin but am getting to the point where I really want to prevent any fine lines from forming on my face. This is the first time I’ve tried retinol in a serum and I liked it! My face appeared smoother and more vibrant after using this product for about 2 weeks. I didn’t see a reduction in the imperfections I already have, but I also didn’t notice any new ones. I’m excited to keep playing with this to see how it works.

reviews.product_name: Mini Retinol Youth Renewal Serum
reviews.review_text: I’m 34 with ‘normal’ skin but am getting to the point where I really want to prevent any fine lines from forming on my face. reviews.product_name: The Silk Peony Melting Eye Cream
reviews.review_text: I received this product complementary for testing purposes through Influenster and immediately added it to my daily routine- I’m currently 2 weeks into product use. It hasn’t lightened or brightened any dark circles but it does smooth the look of fine lines around my eye areas pre-makeup application. It’s easy to apply with fingertips. The texture is rich but absorbs relatively quickly. I’d recommend this product for skin prep before makeup. I’ll update once I have more use under my belt to speak to any longer-term benefits.

reviews.product_name: T.L.C. Framboos Glycolic Resurfacing Night Serum
reviews.review_text: I am truly surprised how much I’m enjoying this! I tend to have trouble with this sort of product, but using in conjunction with the Drunk Elephant Lala Retro cream is a winning combination! If you’re on the fence- go for it. If it’s too harsh, try using it only every other day and pair with a nourishing moisturizer (like Lala).

reviews.product_name: Beste No. 9 Jelly Cleanser
reviews.review_title: Fantastic product- I never want to run out!
reviews.review_text: I am honestly a little blown away by how much I like this cleanser! I followed the instructions for use and deposited a pea sized amount into my hands and was surprised by the (complete lack-of) color and texture. It really truly is jelly consistency! I wasn’t sure if such a small amount would cleanse my face- and remove my long-wear makeup, but it distributed beautifully. I was pleasantly surprised by the lather, too! I felt clean, fresh, and was totally makeup free after use. My skin becomes painfully dry in the winter and I generally have to be mindful of my cleansers because, obviously, they can exasperate the issue. With this cleanser, I needn’t worry. My skin was hydrated and happy! I’ll definitely purchase another once this bottle is gone (which may take a while- considering how little product I need for each use!). Very pleased!

reviews.product_name: Lala Retro Whipped Refillable Moisturizer with Ceramides
reviews.review_text: I love Lala Retro for my evening skincare routine! My skin becomes incredibly dry and flaky in the winter and this is, so far, the only product that I don’t need to cake on to moisturize my skin. I use 1 pump paired with 1 pump of Drunk Elephant’s Framboos Glycolic Night Serum and call it a night! I wake up feeling hydrated, fresh, and clear. I have very sensitive skin that is prone to breakouts and I haven’t experienced any issues. Go for it!

reviews.product_name: Lippe Balm
reviews.review_text: I am very critical of lip balms and, while this one is nourishing and lasts for a decent amount of time, I’m a bit put off by the oddly shaped tube and the large circumference. The product is lovely, but not mind blowing. I think it works well. It’s unlikely that I’ll replace mine once it’s gone.

reviews.product_name: C-Tango Vitamin C Eye Cream
reviews.review_text: I like the consistency and it applies very smoothly. The benefits of the product remain to be seen but so far, I’m optimistic! I use this in the evenings and I feel like I wake up with a fresher, brighter eye-area so far.

reviews.product_name: Benefiance Wrinkle Smoothing Eye Cream
reviews.review_title: Give it a week and WOW!
reviews.review_text: Fine lines? Not here. This even calmed down the angry trench that worry and stress dig into the space between my eyes. I’m in love!

reviews.product_name: C-Firma Fresh Vitamin-C Day Serum
reviews.review_title: You’re going to love this stuff.
reviews.review_text: This stuff is WONDERFUL! I love Drunk Elephant products so I was eager to try this (thank you @Influenster!). It did not disappoint! It’s rich and hydrating without feeling heavy or greasy. The vitamin C packs a punch and my (rather sensitive) skin LOVES it. Don’t hesitate! You’ll love it too!

reviews.product_name: Squalane + Omega Repair Deep Hydration Moisturizer
reviews.review_title: Missed the 5th star by the nose
reviews.review_text: This feels great. My skin really likes the consistency and I definitely feel hydrated, nourishes, and glowing after use, but… the smell is off-putting and, unfortunately a bit overpowering for someone as sensitive to aromas as I am. I wanted to love LOVE it, but I’ll settle for liking it.

reviews.product_name: The Deep Cleanse Gentle Exfoliating Cleanser
reviews.review_text: This by far is THE BEST facial cleanser I’ve ever used, and this is coming from a 43yr old woman with combo skin who’s been looking for THE perfect facial cleanser for literally all her life. The creaminess of the cleanser combined with tiny bit of exfoliant makes the perfect combination of a cleanser.Will be buying the deep cleansing exfoliant to use with a microdermabrasion scrub. My recommendation for women my age is to use both 2 weekly but spaced out, using a clay gel mask in one of those nights. Perfect skin results, especially when using a deep hydrating moisturizer ♥️Pic is the day of my glow up at Sephora ♥️

reviews.product_name: Multi-Peptide + HA Serum
reviews.review_title: Amazing for Skin and Your Wallet!
reviews.review_text: I bought this a few weeks ago and I absolutely adore this as a day serum. For the price, it works better than a majority of the expensive serums out there. I highly recommend it if you’re on a budget. The only critique I have is the scent. Perfect if you’re not big on scents because it’s not really scented but I find it does have a slight scent as I am very sensitive to scents.

reviews.product_name: Blueberry Bounce Gentle Cleanser
reviews.review_text: Just recently purchased this and I have to say that I’m absolutely in love with this cleanser. Within the first few I noticed that my skin was clearer and softer. I also noticed that any congestion that I had on my face was disappearing as well. It doesn’t dry your skin if you have combination/oily skin and I found that it actually helped with that. I use it with the toner and day lotion and my skin just looks so much better now. I absolutely love this skincare line.

reviews.product_name: Watermelon Glow Niacinamide Dew Drops
reviews.review_text: Love this product. Noticed my skin is more bright and that dark spots and any scars from the occasional break out disappear quickly more so than any other product. Worth getting!

reviews.product_name: Confidence in a Cream Anti-Aging Hydrating Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I love how hydrating this confidence in a cream is for my dry combination skin. This helps firm and smooth fine lines, wrinkles, pores and the dark spot on my cheek. Gives a more youthful appearance and comes in a nice size jar. Alittle bit goes along way because it is a more thicker cream so I use it more in my night time routine. This is loaded with lots of anti aging benefits and ingredients to give you the confidence back in your skin.

reviews.product_name: C-Firma Fresh Vitamin-C Day Serum
reviews.review_text: I was gifted by Drunk Elephant. I love the unique packaging and how the product comes in a powder form and needs to be mixed to be activated. I noticed slight changes in my skin as it looks more brighter ,youthful and faded dark spots. I liked that this serum is lightweight and doesn’t leave a sticky feeling behind.

reviews.product_name: Double Serum Firming & Smoothing Anti-Aging Concentrate
reviews.review_text: I was gifted by Clarins. I love this serums bottle and how it dispenses out 2 different sizes amounts that makes it easy to choose how much product you want to use . Gentle enough for my sensitive skin and has I lightly texture that absorbs quickly. Skin looks more youthful, hydrated, smoothes out wrinkles and fine lines.

reviews.review_text: I absolutely adore this moisturizer and how well it hydrates and plumps my skin. It leaves the skin looking plumper and has a dewy glow. reviews.product_name: Alpha Beta Extra Strength Daily Peel Pads
reviews.review_title: Gave me a tight, youthful, and clean glow
reviews.review_text: left my skin feeling tight, fresh and clean. It was super easy to use and worked in a matter of minutes. I was very happy with the results and would try again.

reviews.product_name: Charlotte’s Magic Serum with Vitamin C
reviews.review_title: It’s a good product but feels a tad bit heavy
reviews.review_text: I received a free sample of this product via Influenster but the views are my own. I think I wanted to like this product more than I did. Usually for me to love products I take a few things into account: does the product work as intended? Does it leave my skin soft and smooth? Does it absorb well? And does it break me out? And the Magic Elixir was good on all of those fronts except the absorption part. It wasn’t bad by any means but it felt a little heavy on my skin compared to other serums that I use. I did have an amazingly dewy and soft finish the following day after using this product and will continue using it to see if I have continued lightening and brightening of my skin but am unsure if I will buy it out of my own pocket yet. The major thing that sets me off is the scent. Something about it makes it feel very HEAVY. Just the combination of the serum with the scent makes it feel rich, heavy, luxurious even—but for me I just want a serum that absorbs like a dream and barely feels like anything because I layer stuff ontop of it. I will say that my skin felt pretty amazing the next day when I used this in conjunction with the Magic Cream. Both together left my skin feeling moisturized, dewy, glowy and youthful. I am also a big fan of the packaging. It just feels rich. And I appreciate that when I spend a lot on a product. Overall it’s a good product—I just like something a little lighter and unscented for a serum.

reviews.product_name: Magic Cream Moisturizer with Hyaluronic Acid
reviews.review_title: It’s lovely but perhaps a bit too pricey
reviews.review_text: It’s luxurious cream moisturizer that leaves your skin baby soft and smooth. I don’t know if the product justifies the price, however bc there are other cheaper products that do the same thing. But if you want to pamper yourself and splurge then this may be for you. It absorbs pretty well and feels good on my skin. You’ll awake with moisturized, slightly dewy and glowy skin.

reviews.product_name: Plum Plump Hyaluronic Acid Serum
reviews.review_text: Smells amazing! I got this in my trendmood box and love the way I can smell little bits of the formula when I turn my head. It just has a really lovely scent that feels clean and sweet. The formula itself absorbs really well and makes my skin feel hydrated and bouncy.

reviews.product_name: Skin Perfecting 2% BHA Liquid Exfoliant
reviews.review_title: The BEST Chemical Exfoliator Out There!
reviews.review_text: This is a *must have* product for anyone dealing with acne, large pores, or uneven texture and dullness. I’ve used a lot of different chemical exfoliators and this is by far my favorite one—hands down! Some chemical exfoliators can be too drying or irritating but this is so gentle yet really did resurface my skin. I have an immediate glow and smoothness that becomes apparent immediately. There is no drying, redness or flaking like I get with other exfoliators, in fact it almost feels like I have a protected sheen over my face afterwards. After a week of using the product my pores have begun to shrink and the hormonal and stress acne that has blanketed my face during Covid has mostly cleared up. It’s also evened out the texture & redness on my face from Rosacea. While I have somewhat sensitive skin, I’ve found this product to work so well for my sensitive combo Rosacea-prone skin type. So I would recommend this to any kind of skin type—but it works particularly well for people who have tried other exfoliators and found them too drying or irritating. It can be used as a total exfoliator—using a pad of cotton and wiping it over your face or as a spot treatment for acne. I think it’s gentle enough to use daily (or even twice daily) and following up with a nice moisturizer for incredibly smooth and glowing skin!

reviews.product_name: Rose & Hyaluronic Acid Deep Hydration Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I’m a big fan of the brand Fresh—they’re products are clean and you know when you purchase them that you’re getting premium and quality products and ingredients. So I was excited to try out their Rose Moisturizer and was not disappointed in its efficacy. First, I generally dislike rose scents. I find them overpowering and not pleasing whatsoever, but this has a really light fragrance that doesn’t bother me whatsoever. It’s actually really pleasing and soothing. As for how it works it is a medium thickness moisturizer that feels super creamy. It feels nice on my skin and absorbs decently although it doesn’t absorb like a gel cream would, per say. But that almost works to its advantage. I took towards wearing it at night because I would awake in the morning with the most soft and supple skin I’ve ever felt. I feel this would be a great product for those who have normal to dry skin, in particular. I would purchase again.

reviews.product_name: Jet Lag Mask
reviews.review_title: New formulation is a game changer!
reviews.review_text: I’ve used the original Summer Fridays Jet Lag Mask and had some issues with irritation and redness due to the excessive essential oils in the formula. I’m happy to see that Summer Fridays listened to feedback and changed their formula accordingly. Their new formulation works incredibly well to moisturize and protect. I found I enjoy using it more overnight as a moisturizer or a night mask. It did relatively well layering with most products although it is slightly heavier so you don’t need to use a ton of products in conjunction with it. I like that I don’t have to rinse it off the next day and can continue to have moisturizing benefits throughout the day. I found it gave me a lot of radiance, suppleness, and hydration—so it’s a particularly good product for drier times of the year. As far as the new formulation goes I can’t find anything I dislike about it! It absorbs well and while it is a heavier formulation, it doesn’t feel heavy on my skin. It’s a clean formula and doesn’t have any irritants or icky ingredients in it. I will repurchase the new formulation when this tube is gone!

reviews.product_name: Niacinamide 10% + Zinc 1% Oil Control Serum
reviews.review_text: I have been using this product every morning for over a year, and WOW—it has helped my oily/combo skin feel smooth, nourished, more even, and less oily. I tend to get really oily around my nose and this helps reduce my oils. It’s definitely not perfect and tends to pill under silicone make up primers, but has helped keep my skin balanced.

reviews.product_name: Lip Glowy Balm
reviews.review_text: To start, the pear flavor so fun and unique. There is nothing on the market quite like it! Having never tried the lip sleeping mask, I didn’t know what to expect. I was pleasantly surprised that the scent is quite natural and refreshing. It smells like a freshly cut pear with a hint of sour Granny Smith apple. It’s not sticky like other clear lip glosses and lasts for about an hour or two (if I’m not licking my lips, eating, or drinking) before I need to reapply. I purchased this on sale, so I wouldn’t normally spend $15 on a lip balm, but if I can catch these on sale, I may try other flavors. I noticed my lips do feel hydrated and not irritated after wearing this lip balm, but I wouldn’t say it’s claims are super unique or it’s performance is better than any other lip balm.

reviews.product_name: AHA 30% + BHA 2% Exfoliating Peeling Solution
reviews.review_text: I bought this to replace my Drunk Elephant Babyfacial deluxe sample that has lasted me over a year! I decided to give this a try and woah—I have sensitive skin, but this BURNS! Definitely don’t place it anywhere near your eyes, but I was able to tolerate the moderate stinging sensation for about eight minutes before it easily rinsed off. Despite the burn, my skin was clear, bright, and glowy! I followed with a bit of marula oil and moisturizer, and my skin felt so soothed. I definitely recommend this product in place of DE, but be wary of the instructions and do not leave on for more than ten minutes.

reviews.product_name: T.L.C. Sukari Babyfacial AHA + BHA Mask
reviews.review_text: I have been using a deluxe 0.5oz sample and this has lasted me a YEAR! A little goes s long way and it has soothed my skin, helped reduce oil production, and evened my skin tone. This stuff is seriously transformative and surprisingly has not irritated my sensitive skin!

reviews.product_name: Superfood Air-Whip Lightweight Moisturizer with Hyaluronic Acid
reviews.review_text: This is a nice lightweight, soothing, whipped moisturizer. I have a deluxe sample and a little goes a long way! I can usually use a dime sized amount for my whole face. I like that this product isn’t heavily fragranced and sinks into the skin quite nicely. The hyaluronic acid is a nice addition and should help with oil production.

reviews.product_name: Ginzing Vitamin C Eye Cream to Brighten and Depuff
reviews.review_text: I’ve used Origins Ginzing in the past, and I love the ease of application and brightening effect. I received this product to review for free from BzzAgent and received the original color, best for light skin tones. Upon application, I noticed an immediate light brightening effect, and I also quickly realized that a little goes a loooonnggg way! It’s much less thick and sticky than other eye creams I used, and I can use this both morning and at night. When used under makeup, I didn’t notice any ill effects with layering other products. I’m not sure if I noticed any depuffing effects, but my under eyes definitely appear brighter.

reviews.product_name: Ultra Facial Moisturizing Cream with Squalane

It is not greasy and my skin feels hydrated without it making my skin feel heavy with product.

I got this serum 5 days ago and have been using it every night since (my skin is very used to high strength AHA products otherwise I wouldn’t recommend doing this). Since i have started using this i have had NO new pimples (which is unheard of for me) and the congested pores and blackheads have smoothed out considerably. My skin is absolutely glowing and looks better than it has in YEARS!!

Best brightening product Ive ever used I will buy this forever!

I had a bit of sunburn on my cheeks, and I also applied this to that area. It was great for that purpose too! I’m not hot pink anymore!I did think the bulb on the wand to apply was a bit small, but I am using a sample and it’s probably better in the full size. It was a fun application, I’ve done regular and triple roller ball products, but not a wand like this.

reviews.product_name: Urban Environment Oil-Free Sunscreen Broad-Spectrum SPF 42
reviews.review_text: This SPF started off with a rather intimidating alcohol scent. I know, I know, alcohol doesn’t actually dry you out, as long as it’s the right kind. (This seems to be SD Alcohol, which is normally one of the wrong kinds, tho!) Alcohol also makes it cosmetically elegant, and light. It definitely leaves a sheen you can see, but dries down into something that you can’t feel. I use the Three Finger Method for SPF application to cover my face, and this formula works relatively well with that. As a greaseball, it’s not my favorite in the world (Paula’s Choice Super Light, and Pink Missha have it beat) but it is very good for a US SPF formulation!

reviews.product_name: Urban Environment Fresh-Moisture Sunscreen Broad-Spectrum SPF 42
reviews.review_text: There is a light scent to this that I love. It’s a gentle floral scent. But, there is a slight sheen to the formula that I do not love. The pearl powder is very pretty, but I’m a Greasy Gus. The last thing I need is to add on glow! It’s a light fluid, I think even sunscreen haters would be willing to apply every 2 hours.

reviews.product_name: Aqua Bomb Brightening Vitamin C Cream
reviews.review_text: This is one that feels great for summer, but beware, there are sensitizing citrus oils in the ingredient list! You’ll be able to tell from the fresh and natural citrus scent. Most people don’t turn pink as quickly as I do, but I could also tell there were citrus oils in there from my redness. I’m not a gal who enjoys silicones in my facial products, I prefer more interesting ingredients at the top of the list. This product goes water, then silicone, so it’s nice and light, but it has that silicone feel that you either love or hate. No breakouts for me, which I was worried about with the concentration of ’cones, but no long lasting or noticeable results either. Feels nice, but for me at this cost, it’s not worth it!

reviews.product_name: Slaai  Makeup-Melting Butter Cleanser
reviews.review_text: Another great product by Drunk Elephant! I used to use the SK-II cleansing gel until I finished it. That product introduced me to double cleansing and the purpose/importance of using an oil cleanser. Unfortunately I cannot repurchase the SK-II cleansing gel in the US (I got it in Hong Kong).  So, I’ve been searching for a comparable product. I’ve tried cleansing oils but I did not like how it ran down my hands. So I knew I liked balms. When I heard Drunk Elephant was releasing their own cleansing balm I was instantly hyped. I have all their products (I purchased the trunk in November) and I absolutely love them. I have noticed a huge difference in the quality and texture of my skin. I never had acne but I my skin has undergone may transitions from oily to dry to extremely textured due to eczema etc.  Drunk Elephant cut all this out and I can say I have normal skin for the most part. Therefore, I knew I was going to like this so I bought it as soon as it launched. I absolutely for Slaai my make even the waterproof mascara came off instantly and their was absolutely no irritation to my eyes (something that I experienced with the SK-II cleansing gel especially if it accidentally ran in my eye). A little goes a long way so I know it going to last a while just like their other products. I also like the physic exfoliation powder. It’s a nice addition but I wish it can be sold separately just in cause I run out and I didn’t finish the jar of cleanser. In the end I highly recommend this product!

reviews.product_name: Jet Lag Mask
reviews.review_text: This really makes your skin feel soft the next morning. I use this in conjunction with my retinol cream which always makes me flaky but this mask mitigates that issue. So if you use strong active ingredients that’s strip your skin’s protective barrier I highly recommend this as it you hydrate your skin back to life.

reviews.review_text: This really makes your skin feel soft the next morning. I use this in conjunction with my retinol cream which always makes me flaky but this mask mitigates that issue. reviews.product_name: Papaya Sorbet Smoothing Enzyme Cleansing Balm & Makeup Remover
reviews.review_title: Pretty good but not the best
reviews.review_text: Unlike many reviews here I actually bought this with my own money. On the pros side I believe that this is a nice and innovative cleansing balm. The balm is very soft and melts easy into the face. I love that it has papain in it to help exfoliate dead skin. I was skeptical about the addition of papain because I thought that it wouldn’t actually exfoliating the skin.  You can rest assured that i found it made my skin smooth after 1 minutes of messaging the cleansing balm into my skin. I also like that it has a light fragrant smell from all the fruit extracts that isn’t overpowering. I like this because the cult favorite Then I Met You cleansing balm smelt to medicinal to me which is one of the reasons why I didn’t like that particular balm. Overall these benefits are winners in my eyes On the cons side this balm is extremely hard to get of the face because it does not emulsify well with water. I’ve have never had a cleansing balm or oil that required me to rub my face for a few minutes just to feel like I got most of the balm after. Although they rave about not using PEGs they are a known scientific based class of emulsifiers which is why they’re found in almost cleansing balms because they make it easier to rinse of the face. Since they replaced the PEGs with sorbitan oleate it do not have the same chemical properties of PEGs it makes it harder to remove it from the face. However, I recognize that PEGs can cause issues for some individuals which is why I only removed one star. But you have to double cleanse with this balm. So if you don’t like double cleansing I would pass on this because you will have a hard time trying to remove it from the face. Beside this con I think this is a wonderful cleansing balm and I will probably purchase it again in the future

reviews.product_name: Lip Glowy Balm
reviews.review_text: I was lucky enough to find one of these in my local Marshall’s the other day. I’ve been wanting to try this product for awhile because I got a sample of the sleep mask in the apple scent and was absolutely head over heels for it. Last year I bought four tubes of the Bite agave lip mask prior to their reformulation which is the reason why I have pushed off buying the Laneige lip balm. I have to say that I actually like this more than the laneige sleep mask and the bite agave mask simply because it’s in a squeeze tube and I don’t need to use my fingers to apply the products (the sample lip mask doesn’t come with the cute little spatula). I’ve found that the lip sleep mask and the lip balm have very similar consistency and lasting power. I have applied the lip balm prior to going to bed and still wake up with it on my lips (I also had the same experience with the sleep mask but not with the old formula bite beauty lip agave mask). In the end, if you’ve been wanting to try the sleep mask but have been apprehensive just get this lip balm. Don’t get me wrong the sleep mask is absolutely amazing and if this product wasn’t available I would be tell you to get that instead. But You will have nearly the same experience and you have the convenience of being able to throw it in your purse, your car, your desk or wherever you store you lip balms without needing to use your fingers.

reviews.product_name: Ready Steady Glow Daily AHA Tonic
reviews.review_text: I got a sample of from Sephora and it’s just alright. I do feel like it exfoliates the skin and it’s definitely not as strong as other acid toners I’ve used in the past like the Tarte Knockout and the GlamGlow Supertoner. I think it’s in the nice middle spot where it’s not too gentle but you still feel like it does something. The reason why I don’t really like it and I won’t be purchasing a full size version of this is because it feels soapy on the skin. When I put it on a cotton pad it kind of feels like a surfactant which is very strange to me and I don’t like that feeling. Your probably thinking maybe you have residual cleanser on your face but i only use this toner once a day and I always cleanse my face in the shower to make sure that I throughly wash my cleanser of my face so I don’t really know why I get that soapy texture on my skin I just know I don’t like it and this is a pass for me.

Not sure if it actually eliminates fine lines but it definitely does hydrate your skin so you have less wrinkles and bags under the eye. It’s a great addition to my skincare routine. I know other complained of irritation but I did not have any issues. It was great.

reviews.product_name: C.E.O. 15% Vitamin C Brightening Serum
reviews.review_text: I was hesitant in buying this bc so many products will cause a break out. I was pleasantly surprised that it smoothed my skin’s texture, helped shrink existing pimples, and lightened dark acne scars. It works better when I place it on before I sleep. I’m so glad I made the decision to try it.

reviews.product_name: Blueberry Bounce Gentle Cleanser
reviews.review_text: I really wanted to love this cleanser, but it stripped my skin. I had to skip my toner and moisturize immediately to stop my dry skin from itching. Positives include: very little is needed to wash your face, it lathers easily, and washes make-up off well. The scent is subtle, I wanted a delicious blueberry smell but it didn’t smell like it to me.

reviews.review_text: This product is super shiny and bright, so it seemed to act more like a concealer than I would’ve liked. It’s also impossible to get out the last bits of product — the product is inside a plastic bag connected to the pump, which feels unnecessary and wasteful. I used a pump of product twice a day for less than a month before it ran out. The directions on the box said use two to three pumps per use, which is impossible if you want it to last!

reviews.review_text: I’ve had ridiculously dry skin because of disinfecting and masking (thanks rona!) — I’ve never had dry skin before, I’m usually combo/oily in my T-Zone. I swear this is a miracle product — one use and my skin is already softer and more supple! I’ve loved everything I’ve tried from YTTP and I can’t wait until they release more products!

reviews.product_name: Superberry Hydrate + Glow Dream Oil
reviews.review_text: I have dry skin for the first time in my life and this oil is perfect for it! I have been double-masking and sanitizing and sweating, so my skin is not having a good time. Used this twice and my skin is happy again! I am glowing, I am hydrated, I am living my BEST life with this!

reviews.product_name: Salicylic Acid Acne Healing Dots
reviews.review_text: I really like them, I think they do what they say they’d do and it makes sense they’re not going to work too well on blemishes without heads -- the patches can’t draw out the pus when there’s no opening but they do treat them somewhat with the salicylic acid. HOWEVER, on open blemishes, they do draw out the impurity and oil and help flatten the pimple pretty drastically. I’ll take off the patch in the AM and the bump is almost completely gone. I will say that you should wash your face well after you take off the patch because it can leave a tiny residue. Salicylic acid isn’t going to magically make it less red or discolored though, so you can put concealer on it and it won’t show as a bump.

reviews.product_name: D-Bronzi Anti-Pollution Bronzing Drops with Peptides
reviews.review_text: I am really loving this product.  I’d say it’s similar in concept to Niod’s tan opacity fluid except that this product appears to have more “good for your skin” ingredients and i personally think the bronzing tone is much prettier and lasts substantially longer as well.  I don’t think it does anything in terms of changing my skin’s texture or clarity but it appears best designed to protect from the elements so i wouldn’t anticipate any short term noticeable effects since it’s more preventative.  I’d caution against mixing this with your sunscreen only because diluting sunscreen is a big no no since mixing anything into it will reduce the SPF and sun protection properties. This product does mix wonderfully with both moisturizer and serum though.  I’ll for sure repurchase this!

reviews.product_name: AHA 30% + BHA 2% Exfoliating Peeling Solution
reviews.review_text: I’m a skincare fanatic and this is one of my hero products.  For anyone with sensitive skin that hasn’t introduced acids into their regimen, you probably should start with much less concentrated acids before working up to something like this. Please don’t rate a product poorly simply because your skin is too sensitive to actually test a product’s efficacy (or lack thereof).  My skin isn’t sensitive (combo/oily, large pores on my nose) nor is it acid naive.  I’m able to leave this product on for 15 minutes without issue and since that’s what works best for my skin, that’s what i do.  But i did work up to that by trying 5 min first and after no issue went up to 10 min, etc.  Been using this for nearly a year now & this is hands down one of the best home acid treatments and the price point can’t be touched. Completely resurfaces my skin, helps to even my tone & texture, and minimizes flaking from my Rx retin-A.  I’ll never be without this stuff!

reviews.product_name: Slaai  Makeup-Melting Butter Cleanser
reviews.review_text: Thought I’d be obsessed but unfortunately it’s not as great a balm cleanser as i wanted it to be. I’ve used a few others (Farmacy, Clinique, etc.) and this is one of my least favorites.  The balm doesn’t liquify as well to an oil on contact with the skin nor does it emulsify as well once water is added. The result is it actually makes it tougher to remove makeup (in particular my eye & brow makeup) than I’m used to with other balms and it does a less thorough job at removing makeup as well.  I’ve always gone over with micellar water for a 2nd cleanse to remove any traces left behind and with this cleanser I pick up a lot more than with that 2nd cleanse than others. It’s not terrible and I’ll use up the tub I have but after that I’ll be going back to Farmacy’s balm. I do love how the spatula is magnetized to the lid though, great and convenient concept :)

reviews.product_name: The Kissu Lip Mask
reviews.review_title: Been waiting a year for this!
reviews.review_text: Managed to snag this last year before it sold out and absolutely loved it so much. I’m beyond excited it’s finally back and a permanent product in the Tatcha lineup.  I’m forever plagued by dry lips, my constant nemesis. This mask is a thicker consistency and literally just melts into the lips. Absorbs well, but coats well enough to last me all night while i sleep.  I wake up to soft, hydrated lips - and while that is typical for most lip moisturizers i use, what’s different about the Tatcha mask is my lips stay well hydrated all day.  It’s really the best lip mask I’ve ever tried and I’ve got two backups just in case.  I really hope Tatcha never discontinues this beautiful product!

reviews.review_text: I’m personally the type that likes a bit of grit in my scrubs. this scrub is not that. rather it’s very gentle and that can be a great thing, especially if you like to use a mechanical exfoliant multiple times a week. does a fine job of getting off the dead skin and leaving me a smooth canvas to work with, so it’s great as prep before any kind of heavier foundation that might cling to dry patches.

reviews.product_name: Ultra Repair Cream Intense Hydration
reviews.review_text: I have been using this product for about 7 months. As someone with acne-prone skin and using anti-acne products, my skin develops dry patches in some areas, in addition to being oily type skin. Using First Aid Ultra Repair Cream Intense Hydration had helped my skin stay clear from the dryness of the acne medications. I like how it keeps my skin hydrated throughout the day without being too greasy. I am able to apply a small amount of it under my sunscreen. It does not have a scent, which is great to me. The 8 oz tube lasts a long time, so it is a great deal for the price.

reviews.product_name: Daily Greens Oil-Free Gel Moisturizer with Moringa and Papaya
reviews.review_text: I received this moisturizer complimentary from Farmacy. I was excited to try it out because this moisturizer is made for oily-combo skin which is my skin type! The texture is a bit thicker than the average gel moisturizer and but not as thick as a cream. The finish of the moisturizer is dewy on my skin. It has a scent resembling that of Green Clean, so if you enjoy that cleansing balm, you will enjoy this one. It keeps my skin very well moisturized and soft throughout the day and layers well with my other skincare steps like sunscreen. I am satisfied with Daily Greens so far and can see this being a great option in these cooler months.

reviews.product_name: 5 Stars Retinol + Niacinamide Eye Serum
reviews.review_text: This eye serum feels so nice on my undereyes. It has a rich texture without being too heavy. Perfect for keeping my undereyes moisturized and not puffy.  I like that it has nourishing ingredients such as ceramides and niacinamide. The applicator tip gives a nice cooling effect upon application! With regards to its effects on wrinkles, I cannot say because I am using this for preventative measures. I am enjoying this one!

reviews.product_name: Watermelon Glow Niacinamide Sunscreen SPF 50
reviews.review_text: This sunscreen is a chemical + mineral hybrid. Things I like about include: it did not leave a white cast for my skintone, the texture is very lightweight, does not have a greasy finish, and gives my skin a nice glow. I was impressed by these aspects.  I like that it has a faint watermelon scent, a signature of Glow Recipe! It is almost the perfect sunscreen for me.  My concern with this sunscreen is I have to be very careful with application otherwise it will pill. I need to pat in the sunscreen in small amounts at a time. Too much rubbing motions caused this to pill on my skin. This also made reapplication during the day a bit tedious. That is my only con.

reviews.product_name: A-Passioni Retinol Cream
reviews.review_title: BEST RETINOL I’VE TRIED SO IN LOVE!
reviews.review_text: I’m 23 years old. Acne prone skin and have super pigmentation. Retinol is the only product that help me with my dark spots. I used retino-A that I bought I over the counter a few years back... I was curious about drunk elephant retinol since it was 1% which is strong. I tried it and fell in love!!! It’s really work wonders for my skin. Your face will peel a bit after a month of use that it totally fine. No need to panic lol. Highly recommend this product!Disclaimer: if you are new to this product try using it 2-3 time a week. Do not use any chemical exfoliating products with this. I was using this every day and using the baby facial on weekends on a day I wasn’t using the retinol, I basically was using way to much retinol and the baby facial at the same time and it literally burn my skin. So be careful with that. I would say use the retinol and stay away from the baby facial or any AHA/BHA products for a while.I use the virgin Marula oil for a few day’s which helped with my burn skin to heal.

reviews.product_name: Hyaluronic Acid 2% + B5 Hydrating Serum
reviews.review_title: Leaves you with such a soft, hydrated face!
reviews.review_text: I’ll start this review off by saying I’ve never had a skin care routine. Never thought I needed one and I wasn’t into the multiple step process. During quarantine I decided to focus on self care and develop a skin routine. I did tons of research on what products, how to apply them and what order to apply them in. I decided on The Ordinary because of the price point (didn’t want to break the bank), reviews and that they’re vegan and cruelty free. I’m so happy with these products, my skin has never felt so tight, hydrated, soft and looks so clear! I use this product in the AM after The Ordinary’s Caffeine serum and The Ordinary Buffet and after my moisturizer. And in the PM after The Ordinary’s Retinol 2% in Squalene and after the Buffet and before moisturizer. I highly recommend this product and trying in in these AM/PM routines because your face will glow and feel incredibly soft.
