reviews.product_name: Honeymoon Glow AHA Resurfacing Night Serum
reviews.review_title: Almost too good to be true
reviews.review_text: This product has become my new ‘go-to’. I was experiencing a small breakout and this product cleared it up almost over night! Within a few days my skin was completely clear. I have very dry and sensitive skin so I was skeptical to incorporate this AHA into my routine. The thought of using an acid on my face left me hesitant. But I’m sure glad I did my research and got over my fear. My skin is glowing now. For anyone questioning whether or not to try this, you definitely should! If any of you are wondering what AHAs are, it’s Alpha Hydroxy Acid, which is actually recommended for people with sensitive skin. It helps with acne, brighten skin, and helps reduce redness amongst many other things. BHA’s, while having their many amazing benefits, are a little more harsh because they cleanse deeper into the pore, and are more-so for people with oily to combination skin. Anyways, you’ve got to do your research and see what works for you, but as for me, I love this product — it rocks!

reviews.product_name: Tonique Confort Re-Hydrating Comforting Toner with Acacia Honey
reviews.review_text: First off, I’m a sucker for any product with Honey. So when I found out about this I had to try it! This product is a little bit on the thicker side as it provides good hydration. I would say it has serum like texture. I tend to have sensitive and dry skin, and this product worked really well for me! Previously I had tried the Bi-Facial toner/make up remover, however, because of my sensitive skin it would always cause me to breakout. I didn’t think Lancôme products were for me. I’m glad I gave them a second try! I’m absolutely in love with this toner and will definitely buy again.

reviews.product_name: Salicylic Acid Acne Healing Dots
reviews.review_text: I bought these when I had run out of my Peter Thomas Roth Acne-Clear Invisible dots and my local Sephora did not have any more in stock. At almost $1/dot, they are a LOT more expensive...however, I did notice that they are also a LOT more effective! They are nice and thick and do a good job of drawing out all the gunk and minimizing inflammation, in a quicker time period than the PTR. I’ll probably still buy the PTRs, but use these for emergencies/big breakouts.

reviews.review_text: I’m a lip balm afficianado. I’ve tried everything from By Terry Baume de Rose to Gucci Baume a Levres to Laneige to plain old chapstick that I get for free from work events. I’m also a sucker for anything by Sol de Janeiro, so I just had to buy this and try it out.This lip balm is FANTASTIC. It has the signature Bum Bum Cream scent, but very light, so it’s not nauseating. Unlike other commenters, I haven’t really noticed a taste. It feels super hydrating on my lips without being greasy. The best part!? The tube is way bigger than I had accounted for (pics below).  It is .21 oz/6.2 g compared to a regular Chapstick’s .16 oz/4.67 g.This is by far my favorite lip balm out of all the others I’ve tried. I think it’s worth every penny.

reviews.review_text: This product has changed my life! I randomly started struggling with acne after having clear skin for 28 years. Out of pure desperation I invested hundreds of dollars into high end skin care. Some products helped, but nothing completely cured my skin. I eventually came to terms with having acne...until I received a sample of this UFO oil as a 100 point perk. I have been using it every night before bed for the past 2 weeks and I haven’t had a new blemish since. All of my old acne is healing/fading beautifully. It’s amazing how much your skin can affect your self esteem and this product has given me my confidence back!

reviews.product_name: Protini Polypeptide Firming Refillable Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: This moisturizer works wonders on my skin! For reference I have dry, sensitive skin and most moisturizers that I try either break me out or aren’t hydrating enough. I typically favor richer creams like DE’s Lala Retro, especially during the winter months, but I find Protini is much more hydrating than Lala despite its gel formula. It hydrates beyond the surface layer and leaves my skin feeling plump and nourished all day (or night) long. I love that it has the benefits of a serum with the added moisture of a cream. I purchased Protini with intentions of using it as my morning cream, but I love it so much I’ve also been using it at night in place of my beloved La Mer soft cream. It sits beautifully under makeup or over serums - absolutely no pilling. I’ve tried every DE product aside from their eye serum and Protini is by far my favorite!

reviews.product_name: E-Rase Milki Micellar Water
reviews.review_title: Not a micellar water but still nice!
reviews.review_text: I find the name of this product is somewhat misleading since it is nothing like a traditional micellar water. It’s thick like a serum and has a milky white texture. With that said I wouldn’t use this to remove makeup simply because of the price tag and the amount of product needed to do so. However, I do love using this when my skin needs a quick pick me up or mornings when I’m too lazy to wash my face. I use it with the Shiseido facial cotton and it does a beautiful job of making my very dry skin feel clean & hydrated. I usually use micellar water as my first cleanse prior to washing it but hate that it strips the skin. I really like that DE came out with a no-rinse micellar product.

reviews.review_title: Didn’t do anything other than break me out :(
reviews.review_text: I wanted to really fall in love with this product but sadly my skin like many others didn’t take too well to this. In terms of the actual product, it’s a somewhat sticky consistency but absorbs pretty well. It left a very minimum stickiness on my skin. The reason I am giving it two stars is because I didn’t see any visible difference after using this. Now granted, I’ve only been using it for about 2 weeks somewhat regularly but I had to stop it because my skin broke out like the constellations in the sky. It could either be this or the Niacinamide and Zinc solution that’s caused the breakouts but I have a very strong feeling it’s this serum because I applied the Buffet serum to one half of my face regularly and the zinc solution to the other side also regularly and the side that is currently breaking out is the one where I applied the Buffet serum. I would have maybe given it 3 stars if it had done something beneficial but I feel like my skins the same if not worse. Take caution if you have normal/dry, sensitive skin like mines!

reviews.product_name: Green Clean Makeup Removing Cleansing Balm
reviews.review_text: This is a great makeup removing balm - very gentle on the skin while being effective! I love how simple it is to break down heavy eye makeup or face makeup with just a small amount of this balm. I do follow this up with my Clarisonic and purity face wash by philosophy, just so I am sure that I have gotten all the dirt and makeup out of my pores! I will say - I tried to use this as a daily face cleanser after coming home from work (where I don’t wear any makeup) and it seemed to be a tad bit too harsh for my sensitive skin. It didn’t wreck it completely, but I noticed a few small bumps and some dryness after repeatedly using it on my bare-no makeup face. So I would recommend using it solely as a makeup remover!

reviews.product_name: Sugar Hydrating Lip Balm
reviews.review_title: Glorified lip balm that also made my lips burn :(
reviews.review_text: Ehh...not really sure how I feel about this one. I saw all the positive reviews and was excited for a fantastic new favorite to add to my lip balm collection, but it was just average to be honest. You don’t really get a whole lot (granted, you don’t need a whole lot for your lips! But I wanted to point that out based on the price point for this product.) The texture is very smooth and buttery. It glided onto my lips and I could feel it but in a ‘moisturizing’ kind of way. The reason why I didn’t give this four stars is because after using this for the first time, my lips started to burn very mildly hours afterwards. I didn’t know if it was this product or a lipstick that I had searched earlier the same day, so I continued to wear this for the next two or three days. Same burning sensation occurred and I experienced it in the same places that I had applied the balm (the outer border of my lips and the inner corners as well.) Considering that this is ‘fresh’ and they are known for their lip balms and ingredients, I’m disappointed by the performance of this particular product. I honestly could be allergic to one of the 30 something ingredients included in this (why are there so many??) I’ll probably keep this to moisturize my elbows and knees but that’s about it.

reviews.product_name: Superberry Hydrate + Glow Dream Oil
reviews.review_text: I love this oil and incorporate it every night into my PM skincare routine after work. The oil is super light weight and absorbs right into the skin in about 20-30 minutes. I like to apply this with my hands and pat it onto my face, focusing on my cheeks and nose and then applying whatever is left to my forehead and chin. I then use my jade roller to just help the oil sink into my skin more and absorb in. I have pretty normal/dry, dull skin, which understandably gets drier in the winter months. After using this for about a week-a week and a half, I had people asking me at work about how my skin was ‘glowing’ and I was very happy! :) I like that the scent in this is not too strong and I love the ingredients. The biggest positive for me is that this didn’t break me out!! It’s so hard to find a new skincare product to incorporate, especially not knowing if it’ll cause your skin to break out like the constellations. I use this after applying a niacinamide serum from The Ordinary and have seen improvements in my dark spots. I also use the Sleeping Mask from YTP once a week and that is also one of my top favs!

reviews.review_text: I received this initially as a sample and never, NEVER, used it to the point I had no idea where I placed it. Is the best product I had ever use and that actually worked. My lips are not cracked anymore and they feel so soft after each use. I had to admit I’m so addicted to it I use it day and night.

reviews.product_name: T.L.C. Sukari Babyfacial AHA + BHA Mask
reviews.review_text: Love love love this facial cream. I use it once weekly, and my face feels amazing after each use. It does feels tingly as soon as you apply it but after few minutes it stops. My acne is more controlled and my pores are smaller. It has a very similar result to my regular facials with my aesthetician. Is a must in everyone with oily skin!

reviews.product_name: Vinopure Natural Salicylic Acid Pore Minimizing Serum
reviews.review_text: It does work! I have combination to oily skin mostly on my T zone, in addition to very enlarged pores and blackheads in my nose. I started using it with my daily routine and I definitely has noticed the pores are tighten, and my skin is less oily. After using it multiple times I can notice my skin more radiant. I gave only four stars because the smell is a little strong, I can’t really describe it well but is minty, with a combination of hemp. The only good thing is that it dissipates fast. Definitely I do recommend this product.

reviews.product_name: ExfoliKate Glow Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: It applies a little thicker than I’d like (I have oily skin so I was at first concerned since it feels like it would make me oilier when I first applied it), but after rubbing it in and letting it settle into my skin, it is so light weight yet moisturizing. My skin feels great, soft, moisturized, but not oily! A little bit goes a long way for me, so one tub will last a while!

reviews.product_name: E-Rase Milki Micellar Water
reviews.review_text: Im a micellar water user for makeup removal, so I was little off putted from the thickness of this at first, but it turns out to remove waterproof makeup SO WELL! This is great if you like combining makeup removal and face wash all in one step!

reviews.product_name: E-Rase Milki Micellar Water Mini
reviews.review_text: Im a micellar water user for makeup removal, so I was little off putted from the thickness of this at first, but it turns out to remove waterproof makeup SO WELL! This is great if you like combining makeup removal and face wash all in one step!

reviews.review_text: I have always loved shiseido face lotion! I love this sunblock just the same. I wish it were a little thinner so I can use it every day casually, but knowing it’s water proof, it’s worth it! So smooth going on. I forget I’m wearing sunblock!

reviews.product_name: Microneedling Anti-Wrinkle Retinol Patches
reviews.review_text: I have tried this Peace Out Microneedling Anti-Wrinkle Retinol Patches and found them to improve the appearance of fine lines in my forehead and around my eyes a lot.My skin looks more softer and smoother and I have a more youthful appearance.The patches work effectively at eliminating the appearance of fine lines and wrinkles.The product is very easy to use and great for on the go.I do not have to worry about my appearance when going out in public and this product has given me more confidence in my look.I like how it did not leave any skin reaction for me and was gentle on my skin.I would consider purchasing this product in the future to combat wrinkles and fine lines.

reviews.product_name: Skinlongevity Long Life Herb Anti-Aging Face Serum
reviews.review_text: I love this Skinlongevity Long Life Herb Anti-Aging Face Serum and it does not leave any skin feeling after using this product or residue.I like how it keeps my skin healthy and clean looking and minimizes the appearance of fine lines.I received this product for free from PINCHme.I like that it absorbs quickly in my skin and it works effectively.I would consider purchasing this product in the future when needed.

reviews.review_title: Amazing eye cream that brightens and depuffs
reviews.review_text: I love this product and I saw immediate results after using this product consistently and my dark circles under my eyes are less visible.I think that this product compared to other eye creams I have used in the past is superior and better quality than what I have used.It is a well known brand and I love that it is made with superior ingredients.It is gentle on sensitive skin and I would recommend this brand to anyone.I like that the ingredients are natural and clean and a trusted brand.I would purchase this brand in the future when looking for an eye cream and recommend this brand to others.I think just a little bit of this product goes a long way and it works quickly and is very effective at lessening the appearance of wrinkles,dark circles and bags under the eye.It is an amazing product and one of my favorite brands and eye cream.

reviews.review_text: Really great for winter dryness. My only complaint is that it can sit on the surface for a bit and can leave you feeling a little greasy. By morning it’s 95% absorbed and it feels amazing.

reviews.review_text: I cannot live without this!With a week the texture of my skin was smooth and clear! People complain about the smell, but I don’t mind it in fact I kind of enjoy it. A little goes a long way as well so it’s a value!

reviews.product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C
reviews.review_title: This rescued my poor chapped lips!
reviews.review_text: This lip mask got me through my first north east winter with ease. I’m from a hot humid climate originally, so my lips were in a panic in all the negative degree temperatures, wind, and snow. The cold dry air was absolutely assaulting my lips - until I found this gem! Used in combo with a sugar scrub, this product repairs, hydrates, and protects your lips in an instant. This product feels so luscious and smooth, and makes your lips so plump and pouty and soft. This is an absolute fall and winter essential! I can’t imagine a winter without it now. It’s a true necessity.

reviews.product_name: Protini Polypeptide Firming Refillable Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: Drunk Elephant is quickly becoming my favorite skincare brand! After trying their products I see why they come with a hefty price tag. It’s worth every penny. This is the best moisturizer I’ve ever used period. Whenever I use this moisturizer I look so baby faced, fresh, and glowing. It leaves my skin feeling truly baby soft, supple, and plump like no other product I’ve tried. It’s not too sticky, it’s not too watery, it’s not too heavy - it’s just perfect. It has almost a pillowy texture, and leaves your skin with that same pillowy plumpness. It feels like it’s genuinely hydrating my skin so deeply. I’m in love - this is my forever favorite moisturizer! Can’t recommend this product enough.

reviews.product_name: Beste No. 9 Jelly Cleanser
reviews.review_title: My skin has never felt so clean!
reviews.review_text: Genuinely the best cleanser I have ever used. My skin can be oily and acne prone, so it can be hard to find a cleanser that doesn’t leave my skin super dry and stripped or leave residual oil and dirt on my skin. There’s a fine line between over-cleaning and under-cleaning when it comes to cleansers, and this product walks that line with perfect balance. This product gets every last bit of oil, dirt, and residual makeup off of my skin with ease - and still leaves my skin supple, soft, and not dried out after cleansing. I’ve noticed a significant decrease in breakouts while using this product. I’ve found it also works even better when applied to dry skin before being massaged and rinsed off with warm water. It’s everything I want in a cleanser.

reviews.product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C
reviews.review_text: This product is the jam. I pretty much use it nightly. It really helps with dry lips. Also this may be in my head but I could sweat it plumps them a bit. It smells amazing, but don’t make the mistake of licking your lips. I received this product complimentary for review purposes but all opinions are my own.

reviews.review_text: This product is phenomenal. I’ve just finished my first bottle and plan to purchase another. With other brands, no matter how hard I tried I could never get it to be perfect. It never rubbed off, there are no splotchy areas, it fades away naturally and applied easily. My absolute only complaint, is the spray bottle can be hard to use as the bottle needs to be kept upright at all times or nothing will come out. The other thing is that the direction say to spray on to your body then use your glove to spread it around. I found it better to spray on to the glove so that I wasn’t a: wasting product b: getting tanner all over my washroom. All in all, it’s a do again people!

reviews.review_text: I recieved the GOOPGLOW 15 percent Glycolic Acid Overnight Glow Peel by Goop Beauty complimentary from GOOPGLOW. This does not persuade my thoughts and opinions in any way! This GOOPGLOW made my skin feel so smooth and soft! After 1 use and leaving it on overnight, my skin was incredibly soft and felt so much smoother than it did before I used the product. Upon applying with the pad I did get a little bit of a burning feel around my breakouts but nothing too bad. It went away rather quickly. I had no bad reactions from the product. I loved how sizable the application pad is. Most of the time when products have a pad like that, they are really small and thin but not this one. It was the size of my palm and really thick so it made application really quick and easy. After you apply the product to the face and neck it does leave a sort of tacky feel to the skin all night so you want to avoid touching your face until morning when you rinse it off. After 2 uses I could really see a huge difference in the tone and texture of my skin which is great because I have really dry and acne prone skin and this GOOPGLOW Overnight Glow Peel has really helped. I’ve been impressed so far. I also have to mention I love the look of the simple yet pretty packaging. I would definitely recommend it to anyone!

reviews.review_text: I LOVE this mask. I love wearing this as an overnight treatment because it really smoothes my skin and reduces my redness. I notice the texture and irritating my skin sometimes has is nourished with this mask and I just love how this feels on the skin. I really recommend this!

reviews.product_name: Vitamin Enriched Face Base Priming Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I am OBSESSED with the vitamin enriched face base. It creates the perfect canvas for makeup because it hydrates my skin and has the appearance of smoothing my skin so makeup just glides on. I also find that my makeup lasts longer when I use this first. It’s also great on its own and is my go to moisturizer for no makeup days. I truly love this product, and think it’s worth the hype and the price.

reviews.product_name: Tea Elixir Niacinamide & Hyaluronic Acid Anti-Aging Serum
reviews.review_text: Okay firstly this smells AMAZING! It smells like, no pun intended, fresh and like the ocean. It’s such a pleasure to apply for that alone. I’ve been using this for only a few weeks now but have seen such a difference in the elasticity of my skin. It looks more plump and bouncy if that makes sense? I’ve been really enjoying using it. And the packaging feels really luxe and looks pretty on my bathroom counter too!

reviews.product_name: Aqua Bomb Sleeping Mask
reviews.review_text: WOW. I just bought this and my face is already looking great. As soon as the weather started to cool down my face started to get dry and flakey. This was recommended to me by an employee and I’m super impressed. I have a cabinet full of moisturizers and this is by far the best. I chose this one because it’s a clean brand and it’s an overnight mask, so basically a one and done deal for the night. I don’t like having multiple steps in my skin routine and this is perfect for that. Any dry patches I had are gone just after two nights. Also, this is pretty affordable for the amazing quality and the amount you get. This should last around 2-3 months because a little bit goes a long way. I recommend asking for a little spatula that they use for samples in-store. I will definitely buy this again!

reviews.product_name: Ultra Repair Cream Intense Hydration
reviews.review_text: Great formula. This stuff feels really nice when I put it on and my skin looks healthy and supple after. I have combination skin that gets red from cleansing, toning, or face masks. I will repurchase.

reviews.product_name: U.F.O. Salicylic Acid BHA Acne Treatment Face Oil
reviews.review_text: As long as I use this a couple times a week, my face stays 100% clear. Even hormonal acne. This product is a god send for me. I have normal-dry skin and this is wonderful for me. My boyfriend used it and it cleared up multiple new acne spots over night ✨ I swear by this, worth every penny.

reviews.product_name: Honey Halo Ultra-Hydrating Ceramide Moisturizer
reviews.review_title: I am basically Winnie The Pooh
reviews.review_text: I LOVE anything with honey in it, so this whole line of honey products by Farmacy is in my cabinet. Honey is a natural humectant, which means that not only does it hydrate, it actually locks in moisture too. Add in the ceramides and this is a dream concoction! My skin is so bouncy, bright, and hydrated. I was having trouble with combo skin, this helped balance me out so much. The honey farmacy products were all I needed for perfect skin. This is my routine: Ultrabland Cleanser (honey & beeswax) from LUSH, La Roche-Posay cleanser for dry-normal skin, Lancôme Tonique Confort (acacia honey), Farmacy Honeymoon Glow, Honey Halo Mask (2x/ week), and ofc this god send moisturizer! I also rotate between the honeymoon glow serum and Sunday Riley UFO (salicylic acid) to fight off hormonal acne. I literally have not had a break out in 6 months since I started doing this routine. Everyone is different, so just give your skin what it actually *needs!!

reviews.product_name: Cream Skin Toner & Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: The BEST toner for dry skin - especially with winter coming soon. It’s light and creamy and feels amazing on the skin. I’ve noticed a difference in hydration already and there have been times when I’ve fallen asleep before putting on moisturizer (after retinol, yikes!) and this toner saved my skin from drying out. 10/10 recommend!!

reviews.product_name: Lala Retro Whipped Refillable Moisturizer with Ceramides
reviews.review_text: i have sensitive skin and this product works well for me if you only use it around 2-3 times a week or less because it is strong and if I use it everyday I can break out. it is also very expensive for a tiny amount, but if you are looking to splurge on a moisturizer I recommend this!

reviews.product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C
reviews.review_text: This product is amazing. During the night my lips can get dry and chapped however when I put this lip mask on I wake up the next morning with soft, hydrated lips. It smells amazing and feels good. Nothing compares to this!!!

reviews.product_name: Clear Sunscreen Stick SPF 50+
reviews.review_text: great sunscreen but when I put it on and don’t shower for the day I notice bumps appear on my face.

reviews.product_name: Beste No. 9 Jelly Cleanser
reviews.review_text: I did not like this cleanser. Hated the smell, and how it felt on my skin. I woke up with blemishes on my skin after using. Overpriced for a basic cleanser aswell.

reviews.product_name: Lip Glowy Balm
reviews.review_text: This product is for the gorgeous girlies! A subtle but nice tint to your lips, a gloss that fades down, and it moisturizes and feels amazing on the lips.

reviews.product_name: Watermelon Pink Juice Oil-Free Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: My absolute fav moisturizer. Lightweight, nice smell, goes on easily and isn’t sticky, there’s a pump, it’s just amazing. This product is THAT GIRL!

reviews.product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C
reviews.review_text: this isn’t nearly as moisturizing as the other flavor. i own gummy bear and my lips feel way more softer when i wake up than this. returning! get another flavor

reviews.product_name: GENIUS Sleeping Collagen Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I love this moisturizer! When I wake up in the morning after using this product my skin is butter-soft and it really seems to be helping with my dry patches. This product also seems like it’s going to last FOREVER. I’ve been using it nightly for a month now and it still hardly looks like I’ve touched the jar! *I received this product complimentary for sampling purposes, but all opinions are my own*

reviews.product_name: Hydra Zen Glow Liquid Lightweight Moisturizer with Hyaluronic Acid
reviews.review_text: I know a lot of people are taking issue with this product’s scent, but even being someone who is not a fan of rose/floral scents I don’t find this one to be too overpowering and it goes away upon application. I find that this product leaves my skin looking dewy without making it greasy, and I really feel that it has improved my tone overall over the course of about 2 weeks.

reviews.product_name: Skinlongevity Long Life Herb Anti-Aging Face Serum
reviews.review_text: I found this product to be very moisturizing but also quickly absorbing, so it is perfect for me to use in the day under my makeup and at night before applying moisturizer. I felt that upon immediately applying my skin looked a lot brighter and smoother, and after a week of use I’ve seen a lot of improvement in the radiance and texture of my skin. I would highly recommend!

reviews.product_name: Estee Lauder Advanced Night Repair Synchronized Multi-Recovery Complex Serum
reviews.review_text: I really enjoyed testing out this serum. I used it before applying moisturizer at night. I have very dry skin with some texture and recent acne scarring. I found that this product was moisturizing enough that it was comfortable under my moisturizer and did not leave an oily residue or feeling on my skin, so I feel that it would work for those with oily skin as well. It absorbs quickly after application. I felt that it improved my overall skin texture, leaving it much smoother and softer. I do not have any dark spots on my skin but it did seem to help heal the recent acne scarring. This is really one of the best serums I’ve been sent to review.

reviews.review_text: This is a great micellar water, it definitely gets the job done. It removes even waterproof makeup without having to scrub and it leaves skin moisturized after use. I personally still prefer a cleanser to remove my makeup, as I did notice some small breakouts after using this product in place of my regular cleanser.

reviews.product_name: Aqua Bomb Overnight Lip Mask
reviews.review_text: This lip mask is very hydrating and helps a ton with chapped lips during this fall/winter season. A thin layer is all you need and you just wipe off the excess that hasn’t absorbed in the morning.

reviews.product_name: Glow2OH Dark Spot Toner
reviews.review_title: Does it exactly what it says!
reviews.review_text: This product is a wonder! Gives a little “spicy” feeling to your skin, but it goes away quickly. I definitely saw some improvement to my dark spots. I’ve used my whole bottle and I quickly need to go purchase a new bottle.

reviews.product_name: C-Rush Vitamin C Gel Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: This is one of the best moisturizers I have ever used. I have extremely dry skin and it hydrated, plumped and absorbed quickly. I LOVE THIS STUFF!

reviews.product_name: Glowscreen Sunscreen SPF 40 PA+++ with Hyaluronic Acid + Niacinamide
reviews.review_text: I love this stuff! The original SuperGoop Sunscreen was great, but it caused me to have little bumps on my face. This new version has not caused my skin to react in that way and I am LOVING it! It’s creates such a nice glow too!

reviews.product_name: SEA drink of H2O hydrating boost moisturizer
reviews.review_text: It’s good, but not great. I feel like you get the same feeling from a drugstore hydro moisturizer. Don’t splurge on this when you can get the same formula from Neutrogena.

reviews.product_name: Mini Glowscreen Sunscreen SPF 40 PA+++ with Hyaluronic Acid + Niacinamide
reviews.review_text: I love this stuff! The original SuperGoop Sunscreen was great, but it caused me to have little bumps on my face. This new version has not caused my skin to react in that way and I am LOVING it! It’s creates such a nice glow too!

reviews.product_name: Green Clean Makeup Removing Cleansing Balm
reviews.review_text: I have very sensitive skin and this balmis perfection!

reviews.product_name: Green Clean Makeup Meltaway Cleansing Balm Limited Edition Jumbo
reviews.review_text: I have very sensitive skin and this balmis perfection!

reviews.product_name: Skin Perfecting 2% BHA Liquid Exfoliant
reviews.review_text: Like it but don’t love it. It’s great to use for a daytime exfoliant but if you want a good night time one, go with the Summer Friday’s version.

reviews.product_name: Original Skin Matte Moisturizer with Willowherb
reviews.review_text: I was pretty hesitant when I first got this moisturizer as it claimed to be a hydrating matte one however I was pleasantly surprised that it helped to give my normally dry skin a nice matte but also hydrated appearance. This product was sent to me for free for review purposes.

reviews.product_name: Original Skin Retexturizing Mask with Rose Clay
reviews.review_text: I really enjoy using this mask especially if my skin is feeling sensitive at all.  It’s not a regular rotation for me bc I have severely dry skin but it’s nice to use occasionally. I received this product for free for testing purposes.

reviews.product_name: Clear Improvement Active Charcoal Mask to Clear Pores
reviews.review_text: I was surprisingly impressed with this charcoal mask bc the market is pretty saturated with them at the moment. The white clay ingredients are what I believe helps to set this apart from all the others. Origins is such a great brand with so many hit products and this one is another hit for the Origins team.  I have really seen more improvement around my nose area as that’s where most my prominent pores are, so the area has seemed much smoother after using this mask.  I did receive this product for free for testing purposes however all opinions are my own!

reviews.product_name: Benefiance Wrinkle Smoothing Eye Cream
reviews.review_text: I love most things I have tried by Shiseido, and at first I thought this one was gonna let me down bc the texture at first felt too tacky for every day where. Boy was I wrong! I put all my skincare into my skincare fridge and keep it there, so I placed this into my skincare fridge to get cool before applying to my under eyes and that seemed to dissipate some of the tackiness I once felt. From that point on, I tested this product for 2 weeks morning and night before giving my opinion. My skin type is dry it’s semi oily spots on my tzone but very dry under eyes with very fine lines and some wrinkles (my age is getting up there). This cream is very emollient and almost luxury feeling when applied. It really provides that long lasting hydration to the skin and almost plumps it, atleast for me I could almost say this has line blurring/filling properties! It goes great with a myriad of different skincare products and works great under primer and makeup! I’m super impressed and highly recommend putting it in the fridge (even if it’s not a dedicated skincare fridge, I’m just extra) because it makes the product even more luxurious! Yes I was sent this by influenster for free for testing purposes but I always give my honest feedback and this is one I def recommend if you are in the market for one!

reviews.product_name: E-Rase Milki Micellar Water
reviews.review_title: One of the better Micellar waters!
reviews.review_text: I spent almost a month with this product before leaving my review as I don’t recommend skincare lightly! Drunk Elephant is one of my fave skincare brands and this product did not disappoint. It removed makeup, even heavy & waterproof makeup, plus the daily dirt & grime easily with having to use little product. Now I know there are less expensive Micellar waters that work well but this one has a good ingredient list that isn’t too harsh on the skin and leaves it feeling nice and refreshed afterwards! So for me this is worth the price increase and will be something I buy when this one runs out! Highly recommend!

reviews.product_name: Clear Improvement Charcoal Honey Mask to Purify and Nourish
reviews.review_text: I’ve used Origins original Clear Improvement Charcoal Mask for a long time but found it a bit drying when my skin was working up/during winter time. I’m so happy they released this version with honey as an added ingredient! Honey is one of my favorite ingredients for my drier/sensitive skin. This mask does a great job of clearing the pores without irritating the skin and balancing out oils. I’ve used it a few times per week and definitely see my skin clearing up. I received this complimentary product for testing purposes, but would definitely recommend to anyone with drier/sensitive skin types looking for a purifying mask!

reviews.product_name: Jet Lag Mask
reviews.review_text: I’m always on the search for hydrating products and this one has been so hyped! It comes in a stunning blue tube that looks pretty on any vanity. When I first applied this onto the face as a mask, it stung a bit but the tingy feeling went away really quickly. After a few times, my skin no longer got that tingly feeling at all. Since the mask can be used both for hydration but also for gentle exfoliation, I wasn’t too surprised my skin had that initial reaction.I’ve tried using this as a sleeping mask and a normal mask. My favorite way to use it is to apply right after I clean my face at night. I’ll leave it on for a few hours then wipe it off with a warm towel and then apply my normal moisturizer or oil before sleeping! This method gives my skin an extra boost of hydration. It also works wonderfully as a sleeping mask, but is a bit sticky for my taste when going to bed.

reviews.product_name: Mini Jet Lag Mask
reviews.review_text: I’m always on the search for hydrating products and this one has been so hyped! It comes in a stunning blue tube that looks pretty on any vanity. reviews.product_name: Hyaluronic Acid Hydrating Serum
reviews.review_text: One of the best affordable hyaluronic acid serums I’ve used! I normally have the Ordinary hyaluronic acid serum in my rotation, but I may fully replace that one with this. I love the texture of this one and how quickly it sinks in/never sits on top of the skin. It also sits really well under makeup, which is an issue I had with past serums. This is also so affordable! The simple packaging is a plus as well.

reviews.product_name: Caffeine Eye Cream
reviews.review_text: Eye creams are super tricky for me - not only is my eye area super sensitive and dry, my eyes also get irritated by so many ingredients. I love this new eye cream by Inkey and how simple it is. Even if some people may find it pretty basic, this eye serum has as lovely gel/lightweight texture that doesn’t cause milia and also sinks into the skin super quickly. I love putting this on under makeup or right before I sleep to help depuff and hydrate my eyes. I haven’t seen too much difference on my dark eye circles, but I don’t have horrible circles to begin with. Definitely a great option for anyone looking for a simple eye cream!

reviews.product_name: Retinol Anti-Aging Serum
reviews.review_text: As a retinol newbie, I’m always very careful when trying out any new products! This one is non irritating and great option for those who are still adjusting to retinol. I’ve used this for two weeks now and only use it every few days. I haven’t seen any drastic changes to my skin yet, but I don’t struggle with fine lines yet! Overall, it has kept my skin feeling healthy and happy for the past two weeks without causing any irritation!

reviews.product_name: F-Balm Electrolyte Waterfacial Mask
reviews.review_text: I suffer from super dry skin especially in the winter months and sleeping masks are a must! As a huge fan of Drunk Elephant, I was so excited to see this new release from them. I’ve been using this two to three times a week and my skin is so happy! It has a nice lightweight consistency compared to other sleeping masks and really helps calm any dry patches and tight skin. I can’t wait to continue using this! I love how it doesn’t clog my pores either!

reviews.product_name: The Dewy Skin Cream Plumping & Hydrating Moisturizer
reviews.review_title: Helped my dry skin look and feel bouncy
reviews.review_text: This product makes my dry skin look and feel so supple and bouncy. I absolutely love it! It has definitely eased some dry irritated spots that I’ve struggled to keep moisturized.

reviews.product_name: Superfood Antioxidant Cleanser
reviews.review_text: I love how this feels as I massage it into my skin. It smells so good and it cleanses nicely. I’ve seen such a positive change in my skin, it looks clearer and more smooth!

reviews.product_name: Mini Superfood Antioxidant Cleanser
reviews.review_text: I love how this feels as I massage it into my skin. It smells so good and it cleanses nicely. I’ve seen such a positive change in my skin, it looks clearer and more smooth!

reviews.product_name: Superberry Hydrate + Glow Dream Night Mask with Vitamin C
reviews.review_text: After this I wake up with such moisturizes skin! It feels so smooth during application and absorbs in in just 10 minutes. It has helped reduce the redness induced by dry skin!

reviews.product_name: Mini Superberry Hydrate + Glow Dream Mask
reviews.review_text: After this I wake up with such moisturizes skin! It feels so smooth during application and absorbs in in just 10 minutes. It has helped reduce the redness induced by dry skin!

reviews.product_name: Rose & Hyaluronic Acid Deep Hydration Toner
reviews.review_text: I love the rose scent and this toner has really helped my skin stay hydrated. I suffer from dry skin which leads to redness, I’ve noticed a much more balanced skin tone and supple texture

reviews.product_name: Luna Sleeping Retinoid Night Oil
reviews.review_text: This product feels so good when you are rubbing it into your skin. In the mornings my skin is glowing and left so plump! I love this product so much!!

reviews.product_name: C-Rush Vitamin C Gel Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: It smells really really good I wanted to eat it. Its consistency is very creamy, I thought it would be more gel-like  (because of the name) but it is so smooth. After I applied it my skin looked very glowy, very healthy but after a few minutes my skin felt sticky, this sensation went away eventually and lasted about 15 minutes after application. My skin overall felt very soft, hydrated and looked plump for several hours. What I liked the most was the instant glow it gave me without having my face looking greasy. I received this product complimentary for sampling purposes but all opinions are my own.

reviews.product_name: Indigo Overnight Repair Serum in Cream Treatment
reviews.review_text: It feels so good and calming! It truly feels like silk on my skin, I have dry skin, it glides so easily without being greasy. Next day my face was so soft, less red and as days passed even my skin texture felt better.

reviews.product_name: Mini Indigo Overnight Repair Serum in Cream Treatment
reviews.review_text: It feels so good and calming! It truly feels like silk on my skin, I have dry skin, it glides so easily without being greasy. Next day my face was so soft, less red and as days passed even my skin texture felt better.

reviews.product_name: Santorini Grape Poreless Skin Cream
reviews.review_text: It has a sweet but very light scent which I like, it hydrates real good, it does not leave a residue or film and best of all itIs not greasy at all. Good as a moisturizer at night time skincare routine. Good for day before SPF. I’d recommend it.

reviews.product_name: Double Serum Firming & Smoothing Anti-Aging Concentrate
reviews.review_title: feels great but wouldn’t spend on it
reviews.review_text: Smells amazing, feels great, hydrating and smoothing serum. Used along with the eye serum and my skin felt so different from the minute before. I think it’s too expensive for me, I wouldn’t buy as I didn’t see any lasting results after 7 days

reviews.product_name: Squalane + Omega Repair Deep Hydration Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: This feels so good on my skin that a simple review won’t be enough. It makes my skin so smooth and it is so hydrating without being greasy, not runny and very creamy. I love it being unscented, my sensitive skin appreciates it. I use it morning and night I can’t get enlighten  of it, skin feels supple, smooth and soft

reviews.product_name: Alpha Beta Extra Strength Daily Peel Pads
reviews.review_text: I loved the Dr. Dennis Gross Alpha Beta Extra Strength Daily Peel. This was my first time trying a chemical peel and I was a bit nervous but I was blown away with the results! I am never going back to exfoliating scrubs! My skin felt so smooth after using the peel and in the areas around my nose and chin where it normally feels bumpy it was the smoothest it has ever been. My skin has never felt better and this is definitely going to be a new staple in my skin care routine!

reviews.product_name: Cicapair Tiger Grass Color Correcting Treatment SPF 30
reviews.review_text: Love, love, love this product!!! It really makes my skin look flawless. I have dry skin and pink/redness in my cheeks and in the creases of my nose. I have really dry skin and it always looks so dull and my cheeks are always pink/red. After using this cream I havent had any flakiness(which i normally have) and my skin has looked so much more even. This is my favorite product from the Cicapair line. I have also noticed a difference in the fine lines on my face. I feel like they are less noticeable. I recieved this product from my Influenster voxbox for free to review.

reviews.product_name: Cicapair Tiger Grass Serum
reviews.review_text: I LOVE this serum!! My cheeks get so red and this really calms them down. It feels great on my skin and isnt too oily. I really like the dropper. It’s so different than other serums. I recieved this product from Influenster for free to review.

reviews.product_name: Confidence in a Cream Anti-Aging Hydrating Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: This is a nice medium-light moisturizer. I would say it’s better for normal skin than dry skin. It is better for me in the summer when my skin is not as dry. I prefer a heavier moisturizer. But if you have normal skin type this would be great. It has a nice light scent and didn’t irritate my skin at all.

reviews.product_name: Sugar Lip Balm Hydrating Treatment
reviews.review_text: I absolutely love this lip treatment! The color is gorgeous, and it doesn’t pill on your lips like some products do. You can continue building color with it if you’d like, or just leave it as a slight tint. This product was gifted by Fresh.

reviews.product_name: Vitamin Enriched Face Base Priming Moisturizer
reviews.review_title: A must-have for a glowy base.
reviews.review_text: I have really enjoyed this moisturizer/primer! On days that I don’t wear makeup, it provides the perfect amount of hydration and glow. Underneath makeup, it has kept my foundation and concealer base looking flawless! While it smells luxurious, I could do without the fragrance, as that tends to irritate my skin. However, I have not had any reactions yet, and have been careful about avoiding my eye area (as instructed on the product). Hoping this product continues to be wonderful!

reviews.product_name: Avocado Soothing Skin Barrier Serum with Ceramides
reviews.review_title: Does the trick for dryness/uneven skin texture.
reviews.review_text: I have used this product for a little over a month, and appreciate the glow and refreshing feeling it provides. My skin is also decently sensitive, and I’ve experienced no irritation thus far, which was frankly unexpected given the scent. While it is a bit expensive, I do think that if you’re looking for a lightweight formula to brighten and hydrate your skin, this does the trick.

reviews.product_name: Auto Correct Brightening + Depuffing Eye Cream for Dark Circles
reviews.review_text: I typically splurge for Sunday Riley because their results are unmatched. While this eye cream does work well, I don’t believe it has results that are worth the price. It does have a very refreshing and luxurious feel, however.

reviews.product_name: C.E.O. 15% Vitamin C Brightening Serum
reviews.review_text: This product works well, and the consistency is very hydrating. It also leaves a nice shimmer. However, I’m not a huge fan of the fragrance, but it is definitely more subtle than some of the other Vitamin C products I have tried. Given the price point, I wouldn’t say it’s life-changing, but it does work as advertised!

reviews.product_name: T.L.C. Framboos Glycolic Resurfacing Night Serum
reviews.review_text: This is by far my favorite drunk elephant product I have ever used. I’ve been using it a month and the way it is clearing up my skin and scars is amazing. If I had to recommend anything from DE it would be this product. It transforms your skin.

reviews.product_name: Beste No. 9 Jelly Cleanser
reviews.review_text: I received this product to review from influenster and I have enjoyed it. I didn’t feel it stripped my skin or made me break out. It is a pleasant gelly cleanser. I don’t think it is the best cleanser I have ever used, but I would recommend to a friend. Not sure if I will purchase again but I like that I have it.

reviews.product_name: Lala Retro Whipped Refillable Moisturizer with Ceramides
reviews.review_text: I received this product to review from influenster and I was initially worried that it would be too much for me. I’ve tested it now for a little over a month and I have actually loved it. I can’t use a whole pump and I might have to stop using this in the summer, but this is a perfect moisturizer for the dry winter.

reviews.product_name: Lippe Balm
reviews.review_text: I didn’t think I was going to like this lip balm as much as I do. It tastes and smells great. It moisturizes your lips amazing. I love how big it is. I guess the size is slightly weird to be caring in your pocket but I will definitely buy two more just to have around.

reviews.product_name: C-Tango Vitamin C Eye Cream
reviews.review_text: I am not somebody that swears by eye cream, but this one transformed my under eyes in a month. My fine lines are less prominent and I feel as though I never have or dark circles or bags anymore. I used to really feel the need to put concealers under my eyes before leaving the house, but I feel like I don’t need to anymore. I’m dreading having to purchase this again because it’s so expensive.

reviews.product_name: Mini Daily Microfoliant Exfoliator
reviews.review_text: I have dry skin. My friend recommended me this, so I got the mini size. Awful. I don’t understand the positive reviews, but if it works for you, go ahead. For me it did nothing, no matter how many things I tried.

reviews.product_name: Daily Microfoliant Exfoliator
reviews.review_text: I have dry skin. My friend recommended me this, so I got the mini size. Awful. I don’t understand the positive reviews, but if it works for you, go ahead. For me it did nothing, no matter how many things I tried.

reviews.product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C
reviews.review_text: Have used this stuff for years. I have two of these and they’re both half full so they’re pretty good! Tastes like grape.

reviews.product_name: Lip Glowy Balm
reviews.review_text: Good but you can skip it if you have the lip mask. I guess this is easier to apply if you’re on the go, but not worth it to me.

reviews.product_name: Hyaluronic Acid 2% + B5 Hydrating Serum
reviews.review_text: I thought all hyaluronic acid serums were meant to be sticky…I was wrong. I’ve tried several others (one the same as this, hyaluronic acid 2% and b5) and none of them were sticky. When I’m out of this, I will not be repurchasing. Only redeemable part of this is the low cost compared to others like it.

reviews.product_name: Watermelon Glow PHA + BHA Pore-Tight Toner
reviews.review_text: Awesome for my super dry skin! Replaced my glossier solution. Exfoliates and moisturizes…what more can I want?! Will be repurchasing. Got the mini mini in the fruit babies kit. Sooooo good. Never change the formula

reviews.product_name: Mini Watermelon Glow PHA + BHA Pore-Tight Toner
reviews.review_text: Awesome for my super dry skin! Replaced my glossier solution. Exfoliates and moisturizes…what more can I want?! Will be repurchasing. Got the mini mini in the fruit babies kit. Sooooo good. Never change the formula

reviews.product_name: Plum Plump Hyaluronic Acid Serum
reviews.review_text: This stuff is amazing. Got it in the minis kit and it’s now my favorite serum. Plus I love how the full size is a cute plum shape. Id love a half ounce size though! Not sticky and doesn’t pill.

reviews.product_name: Blueberry Bounce Gentle Cleanser
reviews.review_text: Leaves you with that tight, dry feeling. Not good. Feels nice in your hands but its also super sticky.

reviews.product_name: Mini Blueberry Bounce Gentle Cleanser
reviews.review_text: Don’t waste your time if you have DRY skin. Probably fine for all other types. Leaves you feeling tight and dry… super sticky as well

reviews.product_name: Watermelon Glow Niacinamide Dew Drops
reviews.review_text: I don’t know why this works, but it does. No time to askquestions. Only glowing!

reviews.product_name: Protini Polypeptide Firming Refillable Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: Really wanted to love this product as I am always in the market for a good moisturizer but I just don’t love it. I have very dry sometimes sensitive skin and I thought that allergies were causing me to itch on my chin so I kept using this product, but then tried switching back to my old moisturizer a couple days, then back to this, and I am pretty sure this moisturizer is making my chin itch. Also not a huge fan of the way it comes out of the top. One light pump is not enough but two pumps is too much but it is hard to do a half pump with this top. I will try other Drunk Elephant products because I hear great things, but this was not for me.

reviews.product_name: Superberry Hydrate + Glow Dream Night Mask with Vitamin C
reviews.review_text: I have somewhat mixed feelings about this product. I have very dry skin and have been using 2-3 times per week before bed. It is like a thick moisturizer and I do not rub it in fully like I would a day time cream, I apply a little extra so it feels a little much not going to lie. I am very fair so it gives me a slight yellow tint but I am going to bed so who cares. It has amazing reviews and my skin has been looking pretty good lately, I guess I was just expecting even MORE. I will try something else similar when I run out of this and will get a better idea of if this is really spectacular or if other night creams do the same. I do like it, just not sure I am blown away.

reviews.product_name: Mini Superberry Hydrate + Glow Dream Mask
reviews.review_text: I have somewhat mixed feelings about this product. I have very dry skin and have been using 2-3 times per week before bed. reviews.product_name: Yo Glow AHA & BHA Facial Enzyme Scrub
reviews.review_text: One of my favorite products! Can not get enough of the smell of this! Not sure what it is exactly, but it reminds me of vacation and my childhood. Maybe a light tropical scent? I use about 3-4 times per week. I have very dry and somewhat sensitive skin and this does not give me any problems at all.

reviews.product_name: Mini Yo Glow AHA & BHA Facial Enzyme Scrub
reviews.review_text: One of my favorite products! Can not get enough of the smell of this! Not sure what it is exactly, but it reminds me of vacation and my childhood. Maybe a light tropical scent? I use about 3-4 times per week. I have very dry and somewhat sensitive skin and this does not give me any problems at all.

reviews.product_name: Honeymoon Glow AHA Resurfacing Night Serum
reviews.review_text: Probably my favorite product and holy grail. Will purchase over and over again. I use Peter Thomas Roth Peptide Peel Pads to get a good base and then this before bed. I definitely feel a warming sensation for about an hour. My husband who has combination skin that is less senstive than mine says he hardly feels anything at all. But we both wake up with noticable shiny, glowing skin. I could probably use every night because I love it so much but I also like to switch it up and try new things. Will always be a staple and main in my routine.

reviews.product_name: Avocado Fine Line Eye Cream with Retinol
reviews.review_text: I like this a lot - very hydrating and nice creamy texture. However, I hate the bottle it comes in. It comes with a little plastic scoop which of course I lost, and the consistency is kind of jelly so you can’t just dip your finger in, you need something to get it out or a long nail which I don’t have. I eventually got something to get it out but thought it was a little annoying for the few days I had nothing.

reviews.product_name: Tonique Confort Re-Hydrating Comforting Toner with Acacia Honey
reviews.review_text: Love this and will purchase again when I run out which I never do since I like trying new things. Super thick and a little goes a long way. Great smell. Leaves me feeling hydrated and refreshed after cleansing.

reviews.product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C
reviews.review_text: I don’t know what is in this that my lips disagreed with, maybe the vitamin c, but it made my lips drier and peel more. Sad, be ause it did look pretty on.

reviews.product_name: Superfood Antioxidant Cleanser
reviews.review_title: Nice but not for dry skin
reviews.review_text: I liked the glass bottle and it was a nice cleanser. It did make my skin squeaky clean and with dry skin, that isn’t a good thing. I dont think I woukd repurchase.

reviews.product_name: Mini Superfood Antioxidant Cleanser
reviews.review_title: Nice but not for dry skin
reviews.review_text: I liked the glass bottle and it was a nice cleanser. It did make my skin squeaky clean and with dry skin, that isn’t a good thing. I dont think I woukd repurchase.

reviews.product_name: Cicapair Tiger Grass Color Correcting Treatment SPF 30
reviews.review_text: I really wanted to like this but the color the treatment turned to was a dark beigey tan, and something 10 shades darker than my skin. I will pass this on :(

reviews.product_name: Mini Cicapair Tiger Grass Color Correcting Treatment SPF 30
reviews.review_text: I really wanted to like this but the color the treatment turned to was a dark beigey tan, and something 10 shades darker than my skin. I will pass this on :(

reviews.product_name: Benefiance Wrinkle Smoothing Eye Cream
reviews.review_text: I am very picky about eye creams. I can’t use many ingredients and my eyes are very sensitive. I have crepey-ness around my eyes, dark circles and get milia easily. I was pleasantly surprised by this eye cream. The scent is ridiculously strong of baby powder but thankfully fades by the time I am done patting it in. I use a VERY small amount for the entire perimiter of my eyes and vetween my brows. Honestly, I have noticed a difference after 2 weeks of use, to my shock. My dark circles are reduced and under my eyes are plumped. This is very emollient and it doesn’t soak in completely even after a whole night of sleep. I don’t think I would use this under makeup, or if I dod, only the very barest amount, but at nighttime this is my go to eye cream. I am thankful I got this one to try, but that price tag, yikes. Unfortunatelu bc of my pickiness, this one actually does the job so I will wait for a coupon and buy it again.

reviews.product_name: The True Cream Aqua Bomb
reviews.review_title: Love this one, have used multiple jars
reviews.review_text: I have dry very sensitive skin with rosacea.  This moisturizer worked well for me for under makeup and even layering with products in the evening- it moisturized but never felt too heavy.  For dry skin this is a great summer moisturizer.  I used it some in the winter too but it is definitely more of a summer one.  That price though... whew.  I just can’t justify it when there are so many good ones out there.  The package is very deceptive, you don’t get nearly as much as what the packaging shows. I wish they would reduce the packaging and give you more product.  If you can afford it though, this is a great moisturizer- I like it even more than the one for dry skin.

reviews.product_name: Plum Plump Hyaluronic Acid Serum
reviews.review_text: This serum is nice for what it is. it is a hyaluronic serum that driea quickly and goes under moistuizer and makeup with no pillingm it hydrates skin well. I am enjoying using it.

reviews.product_name: Retinol Reform Treatment Serum
reviews.review_text: Excellent for sensitive skin. I have very dry very sensitive skin with rosacea. I started slow, only once per week and am now up to twice per week. No reaction, no purging. I know it takes a while to see results, but I am very happy with this. I can already see that my skin is more smooth from the actives in it. It’s expensive but this bottle will last me an entire year. Highly recommend!

reviews.product_name: Mini Retinol Reform
reviews.review_text: Excellent for sensitive skin. I have very dry very sensitive skin with rosacea. I started slow, only once per week and am now up to twice per week. No reaction, no purging. reviews.product_name: Salicylic Acid Acne + Pore Cleanser
reviews.review_title: Fell in love after first use
reviews.review_text: I fell in love with this cleanser after my first use. It not only left my skin feeling so clean. But it left it feeling super soft as well. It didn’t leave my skin feeling dried out and tight. This cleanser really is amazing. It didn’t have much of a scent. So if you’re sensitive to scents you should be fine. And I love that it’s so inexpensive too. I highly recommend this cleanser. I know I’ll definitely be repurchasing.

reviews.product_name: Alpha Beta Extra Strength Daily Peel Pads
reviews.review_title: I love it! I just wish it was more affordable
reviews.review_text: I received a 3 day sample of the Dr. Dennis Gross Skincare Alpha Beta Extra Strength daily peel free from PinchMe. I think these are really great. I love that it’s a quick 2 step process that I don’t have to wash off. It wasn’t harsh on my skin. It didn’t dry it out. My skin felt clean and more vibrant. I just wish that it was more affordable.

reviews.product_name: Vinopure Natural Salicylic Acid Pore Minimizing Serum
reviews.review_title: A little strong on the peppermint
reviews.review_text: The Caudalie Vinopure Natural Salicylic Acid Pore Minimizing Serum is an alright serum. It has a very nice consistency that makes it easy to apply and spread across the face and neck evenly. It doesn’t seem to clog my pores any which is nice. But there is a bit of a strong peppermint scent. And possibly some peppermint oils I don’t know because I don’t have an ingredient list. So if you’re sensitive to that be careful. #freeproduct #trywithtopbox

reviews.product_name: Skinlongevity Long Life Herb Anti-Aging Face Serum
reviews.review_text: I absolutely love Bareminerals products. So I was super excited when PinchMe sent this to me free for review. It really made my skin feel so soft and radiant. The skinlongevity anti-aging serum is a really great serum.

reviews.product_name: Revitalizing Supreme+ Youth Power Creme Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I’m not a huge fan of thick moisturizers. But I have to say I’ve really enjoyed trying out the Estee Lauder New Revitalizing Supreme+ Youth Power Creme. My skin looks and feels soft and glowing after using this moisturizer.

reviews.product_name: Mini Revitalizing Supreme+ Youth Power Creme Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I’m not a huge fan of thick moisturizers. But I have to say I’ve really enjoyed trying out the Estee Lauder New Revitalizing Supreme+ Youth Power Creme. My skin looks and feels soft and glowing after using this moisturizer.

reviews.product_name: Ultra Repair Cream Intense Hydration
reviews.review_text: I have  really enjoyed this cream. I have had it almost a month. My face is super sensative to the point, I have spent hundreds of dollars on products from cheap to expensive to just find something, anything that works. This is really helping keep it soft and not flaky. I am managing my breakouts which is nice.  I am still having problems with my skin concerns but that is to expected but I am happy with it.

reviews.product_name: Green Clean Makeup Removing Cleansing Balm
reviews.review_text: I love this prodcut! It smells great but it feels amazing. I love to wash my face. It makes me feel like I am actually cleaning it. It might just be because I’m mixing with another product but definitely buying once I’m done with this one.

reviews.review_title: BUY IT! Best oil cleanser ever.
reviews.review_text: I absolutely love this. Even if your oily you will love this, don’t me scare to use oil cleansers just because your oily. It definitely works amazing to breakdown any waterproof makeup face/eyes. After I use this I would either go with the rice enzyme powder or the boscia charcoal detox cleanser (I think that’s what it’s called, it’s in a black container)

reviews.product_name: Balancing Force Oil Control Toner
reviews.review_title: on my third bottle, it’s amazing.
reviews.review_text: My skin is combination but leans more on the dry side and my pores get clogged very easily. I find this toner to be a great balancer for my skin, it cleans my skin and any excess makeup I have and helps for my skin to not get clogged. I do moisturizer very well afterwards since salicylic acid can dry you out a bit, but as long as you hydrate well afterwards, it’s freaking perfect.

reviews.product_name: Slaai  Makeup-Melting Butter Cleanser
reviews.review_text: Horrible product. Get pharmacy balm cleanser instead. This product clogged my pores like crazy and felt like I had wax in my face it didn’t properly take my makeup off. My face did not felt clean what so ever.

reviews.product_name: Watermelon Glow Niacinamide Dew Drops
reviews.review_text: The Glow Recipe Watermelon Glow Niacinamide Dew Drops where gifted by Glow Recipe and are definitely a must try. The formula is lightly scented like watermelone yet nothing overpowering. I’ve loved applying the dew drops with and without makeup. Without makeup my skin looks hydrated, radiant and healthy. When I do apply makeup over it, I find that my makeup looks more polished. I cannot not say that I have seen a difference in the longevity with my makeup using this product being that my skin is pretty controlled and most times I can skip a primer.  The product did not pill under my makeup and did not leave my skin feeling sticky or tacky is can be a turn off.

reviews.product_name: Vitamin Enriched Face Base Priming Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I received complimentary the [SEPHORA] Vitamin Enriched Face Base. I did not know what to expect as I’ve had my eye on this product for a while and hadn’t had the opportunity to try it. I can honestly tell you what they say is true and it’s not all hype. This creates a beautiful hydrated base for your makeup while helping it last longer and stay I put on the skin. A little goes a very long way and it’s definitely a product everyone should try.

reviews.product_name: Vitamin Enriched Face Base Priming Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: Such a good moisturizer and/or primer. Sometimes I’ll use it on top of a moisturizer, with another primer or top, or just alone and either way my make-up looks so nice. I have a really oily forehead and nose and this product is really nourishing, but when I use it my makeup will look really luminous and healthy without looking too oily (if I don’t powder), and when I do powder I just stays glowy without looking oily. It’s really unique and I’m swearing on my my life that this isn’t just like any other super nice moisturizer, it’s different in the sense that it’s super thick and kind of leaves a “residue,” but it’s not offensive, ugly-looking, or uncomfortable. In fact it’s what makes my face luminous and is a great barrier between my makeup and skin. The only thing is that it’s kind of expensive and the bottle is a weird shape where you have to scoop in weird areas to get the rest of the product. Overall I still think it’s a 5/5 and I already repurchased it for the rouge sale. Try it!

reviews.product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C
reviews.review_text: After my move from Southern California to the Sierra Nevadas, my lips definitely went from being pretty moisturized from a morning application of balm to constantly being dry and chapped all day long. It was pretty awful. I needed something more!I decided to try this sleeping mask and literally use it every morning and night before bed. My lips are giving me so much thanks because they literally were the Sahara desert and now they’re even more moist than before my move. The product was so good it even put me on to try a few other laneige products.I find that their products contain loads of product for (in my opinion) a great price. With that being said, the quality is in no way sacrificed due to this great value for money. So glad I tried this brand, they’re pretty good! Try some samples for sure

reviews.product_name: GinZing Ultra-Hydrating Energy-Boosting Cream
reviews.review_text: This moisturizer smells so delicious and instantly wakes me up after I wash my face in the morning. It hydrates my skin well and sinks in quickly so I can move on my to makeup routine efficiently.

reviews.product_name: The True Cream Aqua Bomb
reviews.review_text: I have oily/combo skin and this moisturizer is so BOMB I literally just bought the jumbo size two seconds ago. Can’t wait to soak up this product because my skin literally loves it. No pimples or weird reactions, it has a pleasant scent, it absorbs well, and it keeps me moisturised without throwing off my oils out of wack. Love it!

reviews.product_name: Ultra Glow Serum: Glow + Strengthen Vitamin C Serum
reviews.review_text: I’m so glad I purchased this serum, it was a toss up with the Glow Recipe Pineapple one.I definitely think you shouldn’t take shortcuts in your skincare, however this product is clean which is so surprising since it’s literally so much more affordable than some other serums. But what truly sold me was the fact that the packaging (glass and box) were made of recycled products. Off topic but that’s kind of a major plus since unfortunately our world wastes a lot of unnecessary paper, plastic, and packaging in general... anyways the actual product is amazing! The consistency is pretty easily spread and once it’s set, it’s somewhat sticky. I like this because it helps me look more youthful and radiant. If you don’t like a sticky feel, if you put on a moisturizer, the stickiness kind of goes away but you’re still left looking glowy. The smell is pleasant, nothing too strong and I look forward to seeing if this makes a major improvement in my skin as I’ve only had it for a little bit.

reviews.product_name: Ultimate Sun Protector Lotion SPF 50+ Sunscreen
reviews.review_text: I really enjoyed this product! Did not expect the fragrance but I really liked How my skin felt protected all day. I also felt I didn’t have to use so much product which is a plus. Loved the package, loved it!

reviews.review_text: Really enjoying this one! Feel very smooth and nice on my skin. At fist I was having a little tingling but a few days after I didn’t have it .. in the morning my skin feels like a baby!! Love it! Definitely a buy!

reviews.product_name: Clear Improvement Active Charcoal Mask to Clear Pores
reviews.review_text: The Origins Clear Improvement Active Charcoal Mask is great! I really feel like it helps clear out my skin and remove toxins and impurities. Dirt and oil feel like they are being pulled from my pores and I feel immediately detoxified. my skin feels glowing after use. The active charcoal and White China Clay ingredients are incredible. It makes the product feel lux and expensive! I’ve been using this every few days and my skin is looking better and better. I received this product free for testing purposes, but all opinions are my own and I will definitely be repurchasing when I run out !

reviews.review_text: This is one of my all time favorite beauty products! I always knew a bottle of this on hand! I received this bottle complimentary to review but I have been using this product for years and will continue to do so!

The cleanser feels natural and you can tell that its really getting your face clean and adding to that beautiful k beauty glass look. I look forward to using it every day in my skin care routine!

I love this stuff!

reviews.product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C
reviews.review_text: I suffer from frequent cheilitis flair ups- which is cracking/swelling/flaking in the corners or edges of my lips. I searched and searched, finally finding consistent relief with Aveda Lip Saver. Then I discovered this product, and it was a game changer. When I feel my lips are becoming irritated or flakey, this heals things over night. I ha ent had a flair up since using this product, even if I wear drying lip mattes during the day. You don’t need to use this every night, but you will want to! BUY THIS!

reviews.product_name: Alpha Beta Extra Strength Daily Peel Pads
reviews.review_title: Great if you don’t mind RETINOL
reviews.review_text: I purchased this, loved it, and purchased a second box. Unfortunately, I will be returning this. I prefer not to use retinol in my skincare because of its debatable safety/toxicity. I was unaware that this contained retinol, until I reviewed all my products while trying to conceive. It’s on me that I didn’t thoroughly review the ingredients in the first place, but it’s disappointing that none of the peels in this line are retinol-free, including the gentle daily peels. I also dislike that the retinol isn’t listed with the active ingredients on their chart comparing ingredients of each level of peels. I know that some people seek products with retinol. In that case, this product delivers the results that it promises, quite intensely. Over time I increased my frequency of use, but if my treatments were more than 3x/week, my skin appeared plastic with a dry shine. I mean mirror SHIIIIINE. But this cleared my pores and the texture across my cheeks beautifully. I’d recommend starting slow and definitely don’t slack on your daily spf.

reviews.product_name: Facial Radiance Pads
reviews.review_text: I originally purchased these to use in between Dr Dennis Gross peels, to maintain the results and space out the frequency I used them (so expensive). I honestly had really low expectations. At first it was hard to measure the results because I’d already been using such a potent product for exfoliation. *BUT* I started backing off the Dennis Gross peels and discontinued them when I learned they contain retinol. I’m only using these Radiance Pads 1x/day and they are maintaining great results- thankfully without retinol. Even if you use these 2x/day, they are WAY less expensive than Dr Dennis Gross peels and equally, if not more, effective. My skin feels and looks radiant :)

reviews.product_name: Moisturizing Eye Bomb with Squalane
reviews.review_text: I love this eye cream and can’t wait to try Belif’s other eye products. I previously used Bobbi Brown’s eye moisturizing eye cream and just wanted to try something new. I liked this a little bit more than Bobbi’s, but they have similar goals and feels. Bobbi’s consistency is much lighter, and this is a thicker consistency while still managing to be light. This delivers great moisture and layers well under concealer. I bought this jar in February, use 2 generous applications per day, and I expect to replace it in May/June.

reviews.product_name: The Camellia Oil 2-in-1 Makeup Remover & Cleanser
reviews.review_title: don’t waste time trying other oils
reviews.review_text: I switched to this product from Bobbi Brown’s oil cleanser while trying to transition to minimally toxic & ingredient-conscious brands. I haven’t been disappointed. I purchased in Dec/Jan & still have 1/3 to 1/2 the bottle left. This is my 1st step in double cleansing at night(2 pumps) & my single cleanse(1 pump) in the a.m.. This also really effectively removes make up, I have minimal makeup residue around my eyes left for my second cleanser. When using this, I apply it to my dry skin, starting with my eyes and gently press & hold against my eye lashes. Then I let it soak into my lashes while I migrate around the rest of my face, & return to my eyes 1-2 times before fully rinsing. I’m sharing this because I think it has maximized the effectiveness and gentleness of this product- I hate harshly rubbing at my lashes to remove makeup. For those who are apprehensive about oil on your face: I never used oils on my face growing up, so the texture of oil against my dry face is *cringe*. So, I start dry per the directions, and part way through I just dip my fingertips in water. This helps loosen up the consistency and dry + oil feeling.

reviews.product_name: T.L.C. Framboos Glycolic Resurfacing Night Serum
reviews.review_text: This works. I previously used Dr Dennis Gross extra strength daily peel. This worked better for me, and has reduced the texture on my face by 50-75%. I can also use this every night, but could not tolerate the peel pads daily. I do use this in combo with marula oil as described in the directions. It makes it more effective and keeps this from drying out my skin. I wish I didn’t have to buy a second product to make this function at its best & prevent drying. And yet, the fact that they are separate allows me to adjust how much oil to add depending on season etc, so it’s also a positive.

reviews.product_name: Luminous Dewy Skin Mist
reviews.review_text: I purchased the .4 oz mist in January, & find this to be average. I used it every day for at least the first week. I have combo skin (dry/pore congestion) & I kept fearing that this would clog pores or cause a breakout. Neither happened. And while it didn’t leave my skin super oily, it was more oily than matte. I know it’s a ‘dewy skin mist’ but I didn’t care for the way it felt & sat on my skin (the appearance was fine). The end point is that I just didn’t love or hate this product and I lost it in a bag but never cared to look for it. Some will love, some will find it pointless.

reviews.product_name: Virgin Marula Luxury Face Oil
reviews.review_text: I really hesitated to buy this, but I’m so glad I did. I use it with the TLC Framboos glycolic serum almost every night. I’m not sure if my skin would have tolerated the serum without this soothing oil to balance it. The two mix together so easily. I’ve never used oil directly on my face because I have combo skin and struggle with congested pores. Miraculously, this hasn’t clogged my pores at all. I can adjust how much I mix in based on my skin’s current needs. I initially tried this on the back of my hands just to see how my skin responded- wow I wish I could afford this as a hand treatment because they were so soft. Just can’t say enough good things.
