reviews.product_name: 5 Stars Retinol + Niacinamide Eye Serum
reviews.review_text: I am totally in love with this amazing eye cream. First of all, Sunday Riley has never disappointed me. This brand always creates the most beautiful skincare and I can’t recommend the products enough. They always have the top of line quality ingredients and effective skincare. Second, this eye serum is just perfect. It brightens and lightens under-eye pretty quickly. I have an energized toddler and I barely have time to sleep. I have dark circles under my eyes all the time and this serum has been a lifesaver. Also, I like the cooling effect that it gives when I apply the product. It feels so so nice and relaxing. It smoothes my under eyes skin and it is gentle on my skin. Even though I have sensitive skin, my skin reacts well to this amazing eye cream. Another cool thing about it is that when I use it with makeup, it doesn’t crease my makeup at all. It has olive oil, Niacinamide, and retinol which are the top ingredients for hydration and nourishment of your skin. Overall, I amobsessed with this eye serum and I would highly recommend it to all my friends!

reviews.product_name: Precleanse Cleansing Oil
reviews.review_text: In general, I wouldn’t buy an “oil based cleanser“ and avoiding anything that can make my skin oilier than it is, but this product is something different. I have combination skin- sometimes dry chic and shiny nose or redness and blackheads.. For those reasons I am extra picky about my cleansers left alone other cosmetic. The first time I used it, I felt my skin so silky soft and it removed perfectly my make up. Aaand it smells amazing!! The bottle is pretty large, and I think it will last a LONG time. I only use about a pea size of product in my palm and it takes off all my makeup, like all of it primer, foundation, powder, blush, two solid layers of mascara, eye liner, and eyeshadows. Highly recommend it!

I pair it with some chemical exfoliation (usually not on the same day just to minimize irritation) and this has been great for my skin!

reviews.review_title: Very hydrating for dry under eyes
reviews.review_text: I tried the Belif face moisturizer last year and I have loved their products ever since. When I use it at night, I wake up to hydrated under eyes that aren’t at all puffy. When I use it before makeup, it sinks in quickly so that when I apply my foundation it goes on smoothly and crease free. I truly can’t say enough good things about this!

reviews.product_name: Watermelon Glow Niacinamide Dew Drops
reviews.review_text: Glow Recipe gifted me their Niacinamide Dew Drops in exchange for my honest review, and it has me wondering where it’s been all my life! This serum can be worn over makeup in the high points of the face, as a gloss on eye lids, as a primer, mixed with foundation for a glowy look, or alone without makeup. Antioxidant rich watermelon, brightening niacinamide, and hydrating hyaluronic acid brightens uneven skin tone and dullness and minimizes the appearance of pores to make skin truly glow. My favorite way to use this is all over my face with no other makeup. It gives a beautiful youthful glow that makes skin look like glass. It’s a dry skin lover’s dream! It’s incredibly hydrating and gives skin a blurring effect. It even helps my skin’s texture. Plus it smells delicious! This has definitely become a staple in my beauty routine!

reviews.product_name: Barrier+ Triple Lipid-Peptide Face Cream
reviews.review_text: First of all, I absolutely love the packaging and the way that the product is dispensed. You just press down and the product comes out. It’s great for keeping bacteria away, although you can unscrew the the second lid and scoop out the product if you’d like. That being said, I really wanted to love this product! I have very dry, dehydrated skin, but it’s also sensitive so I started breaking out after using this cream. It’s a very thick, hydrated cream made with Shea butter, which clogged my pores. If your skin isn’t sensitive I would recommend it because it really is so hydrating and makes skin feel silky hand moisturized.

reviews.review_text: This moisturizer is wonderful for my dry skin! It’s light and gel like consistency feels so silky when applied. It sinks in quickly and I don’t notice a lingering scent at all. It makes my skin look radiant and feel so hydrated. The hydration lasts all day and stays put under makeup. A little goes a long way! I also love the packaging. The pod is detachable and comes out when finished so you just have to buy a replacement pod instead of a whole new jar. I highly recommend trying this out!

reviews.product_name: Mini Plum Plump Hyaluronic Acid Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: This moisturizer is wonderful for my dry skin! It’s light and gel like consistency feels so silky when applied. It sinks in quickly and I don’t notice a lingering scent at all. It makes my skin look radiant and feel so hydrated. The hydration lasts all day and stays put under makeup. A little goes a long way! I also love the packaging. The pod is detachable and comes out when finished so you just have to buy a replacement pod instead of a whole new jar. I highly recommend trying this out!

reviews.product_name: Floral Recovery Overnight Mask with Squalane
reviews.review_text: I have very dry skin that is often red and uneven and I’ve noticed since using this overnight mask a few times, my skin is more even toned and very hydrated. I wake up with glowing skin that looks and feels amazing. This cream itself is very thick and feels like silk going on my skin. Even though it has a thick texture, it sinks in quickly and doesn’t feel greasy at all. It does have a light scent that smells really pretty, but it disappears quickly and doesn’t linger. I highly recommend this especially for the winter months!

reviews.product_name: Santorini Grape Poreless Skin Cream
reviews.review_text: I thought this moisturizer might be too drying for my dry skin, but I was wrong. My skin feels nice and hydrated and looks nice and smooth. I received this complimentary from Influenster for my honest review.

reviews.product_name: Magic Cream Moisturizer with Hyaluronic Acid
reviews.review_text: I’ve wanted to try this for so long and I’m so happy that I finally did! This moisturizer is quite thick and is perfect for my dry skin! It does have a bit of a scent, but it does fade away quickly. A little bit of this cream goes a long way! My skin looks luminous after I use it and feels so hydrated all day long! It also wears beautifully under makeup and helps foundation last longer.

reviews.product_name: Watermelon Glow PHA + BHA Pore-Tight Toner
reviews.review_text: The first thing I noticed about this toner is how good it smells! If you’re not a fan of fragrance in skincare, this isn’t for you, but it has a very pleasant, fresh watermelon scent. I applied this toner using a cotton ball and just using my hands, and I found both ways to be very effective. It makes my dry,sensitive skin feel hydrated and look radiant. I also notice that it helps calm my skin. My skin was red from a different skincare product I was using, and I used this toner once and the redness faded and my skin looked clear and my pores vanished. The consistency is a bit slimy in my opinion, but I love how it makes my face look and feel, and once it dries it doesn’t feel slimy on my skin. I highly recommend this toner if you want hydrated and clear skin!

reviews.product_name: Mini Watermelon Glow PHA + BHA Pore-Tight Toner
reviews.review_text: The first thing I noticed about this toner is how good it smells! I highly recommend this toner if you want hydrated and clear skin!

reviews.product_name: Tea Elixir Niacinamide & Hyaluronic Acid Anti-Aging Serum
reviews.review_text: I have sensitive skin with sone texture on my checks and after one day the texture was significantly less! My skin feels so soft and smooth after using this. My dry skin feels hydrated and my face is glowing! It looks like I’m wearing highlighter and using a filter, but I’m wearing nothing but this serum!

reviews.product_name: Hyaluronic Acid 2% + B5 Hydrating Serum
reviews.review_text: This is my third time purchasing this product. It provides extra hydration for my dry skin. I apply it on wet skin and put my moisturizer on top. Dries down quickly and does a great job for it’s affordable price.

reviews.product_name: Glycolic Acid 7% Exfoliating Toning Solution
reviews.review_text: This is too harsh to be part of my everyday routine but a great product for treating problem area when needed (blackheads or uneven skin) It’s low price point makes it a good purchase for your face and body (underarms)

reviews.product_name: Self Tanning Bronzing Face Drops
reviews.review_text: This is a great product but it needs to be applied as suggested to get the desired results. Before looking into it I used too much and it turned out orange with very patchy spots. For me less is better 2 drops with my moisturizer is more than enough.

reviews.product_name: Natural Moisturizing Factors + HA
reviews.review_text: The pricing on this product is amazing! This is not my everyday moisturizer but I love having it to use when I need extra hydration during the day( I have very dry skin)

reviews.product_name: Superfood Antioxidant Cleanser
reviews.review_text: This is a great cleanser, doesn’t leave a residue and gently cleans the skin. It has a pretty strong natural scent and is quite refreshing. However, there are more affordable options.

reviews.product_name: Mini Superfood Antioxidant Cleanser
reviews.review_text: This is a great cleanser, doesn’t leave a residue and gently cleans the skin. It has a pretty strong natural scent and is quite refreshing. However, there are more affordable options.

reviews.product_name: Hyaluronic Acid Hydrating Serum
reviews.review_text: This is the best affordable hyaluronic acid. It absorbs into the skin so fast and makes it instantly smoother and bouncier. No tackiness or pilling if you layer multiple products. So worth it. Great for an extra boost of hydration.

reviews.product_name: 100% Organic Cold-Pressed Rose Hip Seed Oil
reviews.review_text: Great as a last step in my nighttime routine. I wake up with my skin feeling soft and hydrated and glory. Very affordable! So worth it.

reviews.product_name: E-Rase Milki Micellar Water
reviews.review_text: I love to use this after a workout or in the morning. It’s not the best to remove heavy make up but works great for a gentle non irritating cleanse.

reviews.product_name: E-Rase Milki Micellar Water Mini
reviews.review_text: I love to use this after a workout or in the morning. It’s not the best to remove heavy make up but works great for a gentle non irritating cleanse.

reviews.product_name: Watermelon Glow PHA + BHA Pore-Tight Toner
reviews.review_text: I bought this after seeing it on TikTok and I am not disappointed. I use this product in the morning along with the GR dew drops. Makes my skin glowing and dewy but not sticky. I have very sensitive skin and was worried the scent would break me out but that is not the case. I would recommend this product if you’re looking for a natural makeup free glow!

reviews.product_name: Mini Watermelon Glow PHA + BHA Pore-Tight Toner

reviews.product_name: Watermelon Glow Niacinamide Dew Drops
reviews.review_text: I use this in the morning after the Glow Recipe toner and love it! It makes my skin shine and gives a glowy look either without makeup or under makeup. I 100% recommend this product if you’re looking for soft dewy skin! The scent is light and enjoyable.

reviews.product_name: Midnight Recovery Concentrate Moisturizing Face Oil
reviews.review_text: I really enjoy this product. Great as the last step in my night routine. The smell is really nice and calming. Quite expensive but lasts a long time

reviews.product_name: Midnight Recovery Concentrate Moisturizing Face Oil
reviews.review_text: I really enjoy this product. Great as the last step in my night routine. The smell is really nice and calming. Quite expensive but lasts a long time

reviews.product_name: Papaya Sorbet Smoothing Enzyme Cleansing Balm & Makeup Remover
reviews.review_text: I’ve purchased this product multiple times now and find it is the best cleansing balm on the market (I’ve also tried Clinique and Farmacy) it smells amazing, has a great consistency and melts quickly to remove all your makeup. After using it, my skin feels soft and clean without the tight feeling that other cleansers may give you.

reviews.product_name: Daily Greens Oil-Free Gel Moisturizer with Moringa and Papaya
reviews.review_text: I received this product complimentary from Farmacy. I love the texture of this gel moisturizer! As Spring/Summer is coming this is the perfect moisturizer to add to my routine. The scent is a bit strong but pleasant and fades as it’s applies. It wears well over other products and doesn’t pill under makeup. Will be a staple in my routine!

reviews.product_name: Watermelon Glow Niacinamide Dew Drops
reviews.review_text: This product was gifted by Glow Recipe in exchange for my honest review. I love this serum! It smells yummy like the rest of the watermelon line. It absorbs really nicely and gives my skin an incredible glow! It absorbs quickly and layers nicely with other products and under makeup.

reviews.product_name: Good Genes All-In-One AHA Lactic Acid Treatment
reviews.review_text: I received this item as a gifted by  Sunday Riley in exchange for my honest review. I have very sensitive skin so I was very pleased that this didn’t irritate my skin. The next day I already saw my skin was brighter and more even. With continued use I have seen an improvement in some fine lines I had in my forehead. Very happy with the results of Good Genes

reviews.product_name: Rose & Hyaluronic Acid Deep Hydration Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I love the thick texture it’s almost a cream gel hybrid. It’s pretty thick but still absorbs nicely. It makes my dry skin feel very moisturized. The scent is very strong so if you’re sensitive to that it’s something to be aware of. It does linger a bit but eventually dies down. It does leave a nice dewy finish which I liked a lot.

reviews.product_name: Jet Lag Mask
reviews.review_title: Great for dry and sensitive skin!
reviews.review_text: I received this complimentary from Summer Friday’s I’m so happy with this new reformulated Jet Lag Mask!  I apply a thin layer, you really don’t need a ton of product, as the last step in my nighttime routine and my skin felt calm and was so soft. No dry patches and no irritation. I think this new unscented version is a huge upgrade from the original especially if you have sensitive skin

reviews.product_name: Precleanse Cleansing Oil
reviews.review_text: This is such a great first cleanser. It has a nice lightweight slippery texture that fully breaks down and removes all my makeup. There’s no discernible scent which I like. It leaves my skin feeling thoroughly clean without it being dry and tight.  Gifted by Dermalogica

reviews.product_name: Mini Precleanse Cleansing Oil

reviews.product_name: Plum Plump Hyaluronic Acid Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I really enjoyed the nice thick texture of this cream! It absorbs nicely with no sticky feeling. I immediately noticed my skin felt very soft and looked hydrated and plump. It layers well with my other products with no pilling. It’s quite lovely!

reviews.product_name: Mini Plum Plump Hyaluronic Acid Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I really enjoyed the nice thick texture of this cream! It absorbs nicely with no sticky feeling. I immediately noticed my skin felt very soft and looked hydrated and plump. It layers well with my other products with no pilling. It’s quite lovely!

reviews.product_name: Tea Elixir Niacinamide & Hyaluronic Acid Anti-Aging Serum
reviews.review_text: I have not been using this long enough to see the full results so this is a little of a first impression. The serum itself is very scented so if you are sensitive to fragrances I would definitely take extra care in patch testing. It has a lovely milky consistency, it absorbs really well and layers well with my other products. What I notice is immediately when I use it my skin has a beautiful lit from within glow. The combination of hyaluronic acid and niacinamide it really helps plump your skin keeping it hydrated while still giving you that glow. I have easily sensitized skin I experienced no sensitivity issues from the fragrance or any of the ingredients in the serum. This will be staying in my routine

reviews.product_name: Barrier+ Triple Lipid-Peptide Face Cream
reviews.review_text: I absolutely love this SkinFix face cream! It is creamy and thicker than the face lotion from the same Barrier+ range, but I like that. It is especially hydrating for those with a dry skin type like mine, and this product is soothing, never sensitizing.

reviews.product_name: Mini Barrier+ Triple Lipid-Peptide Face Cream
reviews.review_text: I absolutely love this SkinFix face cream! It is creamy and thicker than the face lotion from the same Barrier+ range, but I like that. It is especially hydrating for those with a dry skin type like mine, and this product is soothing, never sensitizing.

reviews.product_name: Jet Lag Mask
reviews.review_title: New & improved formula is better than ever!
reviews.review_text: I love this revamped Jet Lag mask. It is more hydrating than ever before and it does not cause any sensitivity issues at all. I use it overnight and wake up looking glowy and refreshed. This product is complimentary from Summer Friday’s

reviews.product_name: Mini Jet Lag Mask
reviews.review_title: New & improved formula is better than ever!
reviews.review_text: I love this revamped Jet Lag mask. It is more hydrating than ever before and it does not cause any sensitivity issues at all. I use it overnight and wake up looking glowy and refreshed. This product is complimentary from Summer Friday’s

reviews.product_name: Precleanse Cleansing Oil
reviews.review_text: A great first cleanser (complimentary from Dermalogica). Even though it is an oil it is not heavy or greasy at all. In fact, it just melts away all the makeup and impurities easily. I can remove even the toughest mascara without being too forceful on my eyes.

reviews.product_name: Mini Precleanse Cleansing Oil
reviews.review_text: A great first cleanser (complimentary from Dermalogica). Even though it is an oil it is not heavy or greasy at all. In fact, it just melts away all the makeup and impurities easily. I can remove even the toughest mascara without being too forceful on my eyes.

reviews.product_name: Plum Plump Hyaluronic Acid Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I love that Glow Recipe is thinking sustainably with the packaging of this product. The glass jar and refillable pod is just what we need! The plum cream itself has a very smooth, whipped gel-like texture that melts into my skin leaving behind a lightweight hydrating dewy finish. Easy to use in am or pm routine!

reviews.product_name: Mini Plum Plump Hyaluronic Acid Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I love that Glow Recipe is thinking sustainably with the packaging of this product. The glass jar and refillable pod is just what we need! The plum cream itself has a very smooth, whipped gel-like texture that melts into my skin leaving behind a lightweight hydrating dewy finish. Easy to use in am or pm routine!

reviews.product_name: Vitamin Enriched Face Base Priming Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: A delicious primer that serves as a moisturizer. It preps my skin for makeup and leaves my face dewy and plump. It is perfect for a “no-makeup/makeup”clean look! I love the multivitamin blend and hyaluronic acid ingredient in it.

reviews.product_name: Watermelon Glow PHA + BHA Pore-Tight Toner
reviews.review_text: This is the best toner for summer! It is light and refreshing plus it has the great Glow Recipe signature watermelon scent! It makes me happy to use and it is effective at reducing my texture and hydrating my skin. Love!

reviews.product_name: Mini Watermelon Glow PHA + BHA Pore-Tight Toner
reviews.review_text: This is the best toner for summer! It is light and refreshing plus it has the great Glow Recipe signature watermelon scent! It makes me happy to use and it is effective at reducing my texture and hydrating my skin. Love!

reviews.product_name: Sugar Lip Balm Hydrating Treatment
reviews.review_text: I love a lip product that is multi use like this one by Fresh. If not only hydrates, moisturizes, and soothes my lips, it also gives the perfect touch of a gorgeous sheer color that is beautifully buildable. Gifted by FRESH.

reviews.product_name: Mini Daily Microfoliant Exfoliator
reviews.review_text: I love this Dermalogica exfoliant. It is really easy to use, non-irritating, and leaves my skin feeling super clean! The after glow effect is real! Definitely a fan of this innovative powder to cream product. Gifted by Dermalogica sampling.

reviews.product_name: Daily Microfoliant Exfoliator
reviews.review_text: I love this Dermalogica exfoliant. It is really easy to use, non-irritating, and leaves my skin feeling super clean! The after glow effect is real! Definitely a fan of this innovative powder to cream product. Gifted by Dermalogica sampling.

reviews.product_name: Retinol Youth Renewal Serum
reviews.review_text: A retinol is a must in my routine and this renewal serum with retinol packs a punch! It helps smoothen my skin and Target fine lines and wrinkles while still delivering some hydration with the hyaluronic acid.

reviews.product_name: Mini Retinol Youth Renewal Serum
reviews.review_text: A retinol is a must in my routine and this renewal serum with retinol packs a punch! It helps smoothen my skin and Target fine lines and wrinkles while still delivering some hydration with the hyaluronic acid.

reviews.product_name: Lala Retro Whipped Refillable Moisturizer with Ceramides
reviews.review_text: This is such an amazing night time moisturizer for dry skin! I have combo skin but struggle with my skin being extremely dehydrated and flaky. That’s why I like to load up on moisture at night. I struggle to find a moisturizer that still leaves my skin feeling plump when I wake up. So far I’m absolutely loving this moisturizer. Is so thick and you only need a small amount for your entire face. It’s fragrance free and cruelty free which I love. I haven’t used it long enough to test out long term results but as of now I would absolutely repurchase this with my own money. I received this product complimentary from Influenster.

reviews.product_name: C-Tango Vitamin C Eye Cream
reviews.review_text: Drunk Elephant C-Tango Multivitamin Eye Cream has a lovely thick texture that I like in an eye cream. It sinks in nicely and wears well under makeup. I’ve used it for a few weeks so I’m not sure on if it has long term results yet. I love that it’s in air tight packaging and I don’t have to stick my finger into it every night. It’s fragrance free as well which an eye cream should be. My only complaint is that I feel a slight burning sensation sometimes when I use it. I’m not sure what it is I’m sensitive to. I received this product complimentary from Influenster for review.

reviews.product_name: T.L.C. Framboos Glycolic Resurfacing Night Serum
reviews.review_text: This product is awesome. It really helps resurface my skin and take away texture when I use it at night. It does have a slight tingling like most chemical exfoliators when it’s applied but overall I find it gentle enough to use nightly once I built up to it. I love that it has non irritating ingredients and is fragrance free. Only thing I don’t love is the price tag - so pricey! I received this product complimentary for review purposes.

reviews.product_name: Beste No. 9 Jelly Cleanser
reviews.review_text: Drunk Elephant Beste Jelly Cleanser has a lovely bouncy jelly texture. It foams up on my face and I feel my skin is completely clean after. I’m not sure how good it is at removing makeup because I usually use my makeup eraser and some sort of cleansing oil as a first step. I love hay it’s fragrance free and gentle on the skin. I do feel my skin is slightly dried out after using this - but I’ve never used a cleanser that doesn’t clean my skin without drying it out at least a little bit. Over all I really enjoy this cleanser and would recommend it! I received this product complimentary from Influenster.

reviews.product_name: Lippe Balm
reviews.review_text: Drunk Elephant Lippe is a regular lip balm th it’s fragrance free. I’ve tried this out a few times and it’s definitely not enough moisture to put it on before bed. It feels moisturizing initially but doesn’t last very long on the lips. It’s ok for prepping lips for makeup. But I don’t think I would recommend this for the $18 price tag. There are better products for your money. I received this product complimentary from Influenster.

reviews.product_name: Daily Greens Oil-Free Gel Moisturizer with Moringa and Papaya
reviews.review_text: I’ve received this product complimentary from Farmacy and I’ve really been enjoying this moisturizer! It’s great for daytime for me, not quite enough moisture for at night because I’m dry and need something a little thicker at night. But for day time it’s perfect. It wears beautifully under makeup and keeps my skin hydrated all day. It does have a light fresh/fruity scent but I suspect that’s the papaya and I don’t mind it one bit. I definitely enjoy this more than their original light weight moisturizer because I find it more hydrating. Definitely would recommend!

reviews.product_name: Barrier+ Triple Lipid-Peptide Face Cream
reviews.review_text: I received this product complimentary from Skinfix. I’ve really been loving this moisturizer for night time! It’s thick and luxurious but not greasy.  I love that there’s no fragrance or essential oils in this. It is a little pricey for a simple moisturizer but I definitely prefer this over Drunk Elephant La La Retro if you’re not sure. This one is so much better!

reviews.product_name: Mini Barrier+ Triple Lipid-Peptide Face Cream
reviews.review_text: I received this product complimentary from Skinfix. I’ve really been loving this moisturizer for night time! It’s thick and luxurious but not greasy.  I love that there’s no fragrance or essential oils in this. It is a little pricey for a simple moisturizer but I definitely prefer this over Drunk Elephant La La Retro if you’re not sure. This one is so much better!

reviews.product_name: Watermelon Glow Niacinamide Dew Drops
reviews.review_text: I received this product complimentary from Glow Recipe. I’m really enjoying this product. I know it’s multi use but the way that makes most sense to me is as a primer. It adds a thin layer of hydration and tackiness to the skin. My skin was nice and glowy but I have SO many glowy products. Is it nice? Yes. Do you absolutely need it? No but I’m really enjoying it and happy to have it!

reviews.product_name: Good Genes All-In-One AHA Lactic Acid Treatment
reviews.review_title: Amazing but please remove the fragrance!
reviews.review_text: This product was gifted to me by Sunday Riley. I’ve used mini’s of this serum in the past and it’s absolutely amazing at gently resurfacing the skin and leaving a glowing complexion. Some acids are too harsh on my dry skin and this one isn’t. My only wish is that they would take out the lemongrass scent. It’s no necessary and would be even more amazing without fragrance!

reviews.product_name: Rose & Hyaluronic Acid Deep Hydration Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: This product was gifted to me by Fresh. I absolutely love this moisturizer. It has a rose scent but it’s very light and nothing too intense which I appreciate. The texture of this is moisturizing and luxurious but not heavy. A little goes a long way and it really sinks into the skin and the hydration lasts. I’m so glad I got the opportunity to try this moisturizer

reviews.product_name: Honeymoon Glow AHA Resurfacing Night Serum
reviews.review_text: This product was gifted to me by Farmacy. But this isn’t the first bottle of honeymoon glow I’ve been through. It’s such an amazing resurfacing product to use a few nights a week. I wake up with my skin looking renewed and glowy. And it’s not too harsh. A great chemical exfoliation option!

reviews.product_name: Plum Plump Hyaluronic Acid Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: This is a really lightweight water cream. It almost feels like water as you rub it onto the skin. But it somehow does leave a light layer of hydration and tackiness which is perfect for makeup prep. I have dry dehydrated skin so this isn’t enough for me during the day in winter but it will be perfect for Summer!

reviews.product_name: Mini Plum Plump Hyaluronic Acid Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: This is a really lightweight water cream. It almost feels like water as you rub it onto the skin. But it somehow does leave a light layer of hydration and tackiness which is perfect for makeup prep. I have dry dehydrated skin so this isn’t enough for me during the day in winter but it will be perfect for Summer!

reviews.product_name: Vitamin Enriched Face Base Priming Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: One of the best hydrating primers I’ve ever used! It has such a luxurious texture and leaves a perfect base for makeup without being oily or too much. This is 100% worth the hype. I also love the glass packaging jt comes in and beware it does have a light citrus type scent but I don’t find it irritating at all.

reviews.product_name: Floral Recovery Overnight Mask with Squalane
reviews.review_title: Nice but wish it didn’t have floral scent
reviews.review_text: This has a really lovely thick texture. It goes on thick and doesn’t seem Ike it will sink in at first, but after a few in it really sinks in and moisturizes nicely. I wish it didn’t have a scent but it does smell decently floral which I feel is I necessary. Hard to tell whether it has a calming effect but get decent moisture from this.

reviews.product_name: Glowscreen Sunscreen SPF 40 PA+++ with Hyaluronic Acid + Niacinamide
reviews.review_text: This shade is deeper and bronzier than the original. Less orange which j appreciate and a better option for deeper skin tones. This will definitely only work in summer for me but I enjoy it! It’s even deep enough to use as an SPF cream bronzer!

reviews.product_name: Tea Elixir Niacinamide & Hyaluronic Acid Anti-Aging Serum
reviews.review_text: This product was gifted to me by fresh. Overall the texture of this serum is nice. It has a light creamy texture that plays well with other skincare. But it is very fragranced like most fresh products, which I could do without.  Nice but haven’t noticed any insane results yet for the high price tag.

reviews.product_name: Beste No. 9 Jelly Cleanser
reviews.review_title: If your skin feels tight after washing, try this!
reviews.review_text: Jelly cleansers are the only type of cleansers that don’t completely dry out my skin.  I can’t find many gel cleansers on the market.  This will work for all skin types, but people with dry and sensitive skin like mine will see the most impressive results.  No more tight skin feel after washing my face.

reviews.product_name: Lippe Balm
reviews.review_title: Worth the price and the hype.
reviews.review_text: One of the best lip balms I’ve ever tried.  Faint, clean nut oil scent.  Very hydrating, melts into lips like butter, and doesn’t feel sticky.  I like to forget my lip balm is there, and this does exactly that.  Lasts awhile so you’re not constantly having to reapply it.  It’s pricy, but you are getting a fair amount of product.  Also, very cute, minimalistic packaging.  I like pulling it out of my bag to apply.

reviews.product_name: Virgin Marula Luxury Face Oil
reviews.review_text: This is so light weight, hydrating and reasonably priced for what it does.  Has a light marula scent.  I think it’s comparable to much more expensive brands in the way of facial oils like the Sisley Paris Rose Oil.  You will need to use it in conjunction with a good moisturizer, as it doesn’t really work on it’s own.  It can also be used in multiple ways.  Use it over the top of a moisturizer as part of a skincare routine, add it over the top of a tinted moisturizer or foundation for a dewy, “glass skin“ look, or one of my favorite ways to use it is on the dry chapped skin on my elbows.

reviews.product_name: Protini Polypeptide Firming Refillable Moisturizer
reviews.review_title: Everything you'd want in a moisturizer.
reviews.review_text: Everything you’d want in a moisturizer, nothing you don’t.  Very hydrating, never heavy or clogging.  My skin is perfectly balanced with this.  One of Drunk Elephants best products.

reviews.product_name: B-Hydra Intensive Hydration Serum with Hyaluronic Acid
reviews.review_text: This works amazingly IF used in conjunction with a moisturizer to lock in moisture.  I apply it after cleansing, but before moisturizer.  Skin looks brighter!

reviews.product_name: Umbra Sheer Physical Daily Defense SPF 30
reviews.review_title: The Only Sunscreen I Can Use On My Face
reviews.review_text: My face is very sensitive to sunscreen and nearly always causes my skin to flake.  This is the ONLY sunscreen I’ve found that doesn’t cause problems.  It also goes on light and smoothe and doesn’t break up face makeup.  Also loving that it’s fragrance free.  Huge fan!

reviews.product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C
reviews.review_title: Does what it claims it does.
reviews.review_text: I was a little skeptical at first and figured this would basically be just a heavy lip balm, but no!  It really does stay on almost all night and you wake up with the softest lips.  I got the Gummy Bear scent and it smells  amazing.  You do have to follow it up with lip balm during the day or you’ll lose the effects, but that’s to be expected.  Definitely worthy the hype!

reviews.product_name: Lip Glowy Balm
reviews.review_title: This is basically a make up product.
reviews.review_text: I picked this up because I love the Gummy Bear version of the LANEIGE sleeping mask.  I purchased believing this to be a lip balm.  It’s not.  It’s a very high shine formula lip gloss with a lilac tint.  It’s very pretty, but it’s most definitely a makeup product and not skin care. While it’s moisturizing and I like it, I do feel that the marketing is a little bit misleading.

reviews.product_name: Magic Cream Moisturizer with Hyaluronic Acid
reviews.review_text: This is one of the best moisturizers on the market.  Just amazing.  And it may seem expensive, but it’s really not if you compare it to other high end skincare.

reviews.product_name: Ultra Facial Moisturizing Cream with Squalane
reviews.review_title: It's good, but not the best for dry skin.
reviews.review_text: This would be perfect for normal or combination skin, but dry skin is going to need something more rich.  If you don’t have dry skin, it’s a very nice basic face cream moisturizer.

reviews.product_name: Hyaluronic Acid Hydrating Serum
reviews.review_text: OMG!! Do yourself a favor and buy this now!!! I’m often skeptical of hyaluronic acids as I don’t often find they really moisturize my skin as well as I’d like HOWEVER I’m a total believer after using this product. Affordable, great amount of product and really helps to plump and moisturize my skin.  I am such a fan of this product and the line. Thank you Sephora for carrying it and thank you Inkey List for a great product! I received this product complimentary for testing purposes.

reviews.product_name: Lotus Anti-Aging Night Moisturizer
reviews.review_title: A DREAM come true for your skin!!!!
reviews.review_text: “Ahhhhhh!” The sound I make when applying this to my face at night!! Seriously!!! This cream is amazing!! I use it at night and boy have I noticed a huge difference! It Has a pleasant scent and is very moisturizing without feeling greasy. I wake up with bright, smooth, glowing and refreshed skin. What more could a gal ask for?? Love that it is paraben and SLS free. Definitely recommend!!! (I am so grateful to receive this complimentary for testing purposes :)

reviews.product_name: Lotus Anti- Aging Daily Moisturizer
reviews.review_title: A drink of water for thirsty skin!!
reviews.review_text: Yes yes yes!! This moisturizer feels so luxurious and amazing upon application!! I travelled all day on an airplane and it was so refreshing and moisturizing and plumping for my super parched skin. It has a very light pleasant fragrance and easily melts into my skin. Definitely recommend!! I am grateful to receive this complimentary for testing :)

reviews.product_name: Double Serum Firming & Smoothing Anti-Aging Concentrate
reviews.review_title: The serum you NEED in your life!!
reviews.review_text: Omg!!! I like serums but don’t normally see results right away. This was my first time using this serum and I am blown out of the water!!! It is so gorgeous and instantly made my skin look glowing (even after too much to drink haha!!). I am in LOVE AND definitely  recommend it!!

reviews.product_name: C-Firma Fresh Vitamin-C Day Serum
reviews.review_title: My new go to vitamin c serum!!
reviews.review_text: Wow!! This product is amazing!! It is my new go to vitamin c product! It is super easy to mix and within a week I’ve already noticed my dark spots fading, my skin more radiant and my skin tone more even. It does have a bit of a smell at first but it is easy for someone sensitive to smell to get used to. Love it and will definitely purchase this in the future!

reviews.product_name: Smart Clinical Repair Wrinkle Correcting Cream
reviews.review_text: I love this new moisturizer from Clinique!!! Gosh it applies so nicely and left my skin super looking plump and moisturized when I woke up on the morning!!! It feels smooth and light on my face and I would definitely add it into my nightly routine!!!

reviews.product_name: Magic Cream Moisturizer with Hyaluronic Acid

Highly recommend!

reviews.review_text: Love the light texture. I cant wait to see results in 3 weeks time. It was super hydrating and moisturizing. Didn’t irritate my eyes either. I quite liked the squeeze tube so I can get the how much I want to apply.

reviews.review_text: I love thi sunscreen so much it’s such a staple in my skincare and makeup look. The texture is smooth and applies without pilling. Love there’s a sheen but not greasy looking. Highly recommend sunscreen!

reviews.product_name: Sugar Lip Balm Hydrating Treatment
reviews.review_text: I love fresh sugar lip treatments and this peony color is so beautiful! It smells delicious and the shade gives my very pale lips a lovely color that’s not too glossy or too matte. It’s perfect for summer days! “Gifted by Fresh

reviews.product_name: Tea Elixir Niacinamide & Hyaluronic Acid Anti-Aging Serum
reviews.review_text: Love this serum smells like freshly brewed tea.The texture is lovely and milky it really sinks into the skin without feeling greasy. reviews.product_name: Tonique Confort Re-Hydrating Comforting Toner with Acacia Honey
reviews.review_title: Skin is super clear and luminous without breakouts
reviews.review_text: Love this product! This is perfect for the summer because it is so light, with a subtle clean scent. I apply this with a cotton ball on my face and follow up with the HydraZen facial moisturizer when it is less humid and I feel I need additional moisture. I noticed a dramatic difference in my skin immediately. It was suddenly radiant and dewy. I didn’t feel the need to wear makeup, as my own skin looked so fresh. Perfect amount of moisture in a toner, while preventing oil buildup in my pores. I received this product complimentary, but will definatley be purchasing it in the future.

reviews.product_name: Hydra Zen Gel-Cream Oil-Free Moisturizer with Salicylic Acid
reviews.review_text: I love this! It has a light, fresh scent that doesn’t irritate my skin. This lightweight gel is perfect for the summer, but also super moisturizing for dry skin. I love how my skin looks radiant immediately after using it. I start from my neck up when I apply to avoid pulling my skin. This is very easy to rub into skin. I got this product complimentary.

reviews.product_name: Magic Cream Moisturizer with Hyaluronic Acid
reviews.review_text: I love this formula! It’s heavy but doesn’t feel oily or uncomfortable on my skin. It has a subtle scent which kind of reminds me of sunscreen. This is great for dry skin.

reviews.product_name: B-Hydra Intensive Hydration Serum with Hyaluronic Acid
reviews.review_text: I cannot get enough of this! My skin is more moisturized and radiant than it has ever been. I love the even complexion it gives me with no irritation at all. My skin looks healthier and flawless. Great for all weather.

reviews.product_name: Umbra Sheer Physical Daily Defense SPF 30
reviews.review_text: Super lightweight and great for summer or in combination with a facial oil. Love how radiant my skin looks and it doesn’t irritate my skin or have a funky smell with such high SPF

reviews.product_name: Benefiance Wrinkle Smoothing Eye Cream
reviews.review_text: Love this! The consistency is so creamy and moisturizing, absorbs into skin quickly. Very light, fresh scent with no irritation. My eyes look hydrated and skin looks plumper, minimizing dark circles and veins.

reviews.product_name: Dreamskin Skin Perfector
reviews.review_text: I love everything about this product. It smells great and it’s not overpowering at all. My skin looked super healthy and radiant and my makeup stayed in place. I noticed a change in my skins appearance with or without makeup.

reviews.review_text: I have very sensitive skin so I was hesitant to try this. Influenster or sent this as a complimentary sample. It is so soothing and gentle and it really does make my skin look smoother and younger!

reviews.review_text: I was skeptical that this product would work for my dry skin, because oil control and pore blurring products generally don’t. Boy was I wrong! My skin loves this and can’t stop using it!

reviews.product_name: Triple Algae Eye Renewal Balm Eye Cream
reviews.review_text: I wasn’t sure what to expect with “balm“ in the title, but the texture was very creamy and nice. It leaves my skin feeling hydrated and smooth. I’ve been using this eye cream for about two weeks,and I’ve noticed myself skipping concealer because my undereyes look so good! Gifted by Algenist

reviews.product_name: Charlotte’s Magic Serum with Vitamin C
reviews.review_text: I had really high expectations for this serum, mean that it is Charlotte Tilbury and at such a high price point. I was a little skeptical when I read the ingredients and saw that there was a lot of like Crystal extracts which isn’t really proven to do anything. but I am in love! this serum is the perfect glowy serum for daytime no makeup or for wearing under makeup for that I woke up like this glow it is so beautiful!

reviews.product_name: Tea Elixir Niacinamide & Hyaluronic Acid Anti-Aging Serum
reviews.review_text: I have dry skin, so I’m a big fan of exfoliating but that means I can overdo it and leave my skin stronger. I have noticed that my fine lines are diminished and my dark spots are lightening, and this serum is also very hydratin! I will definitely be repurchasing!

reviews.product_name: T.L.C. Framboos Glycolic Resurfacing Night Serum
reviews.review_text: Okay, this one, I actually liked the first few times I used it. It felt nice on my skin, sunk in quickly, and again, comes in a really cute lil bottle. I don’t think I used this one long enough to really give it a good test (I ended up returning it), so this one might actually be a product that works/is worth your money, but the only thing I can really say about it is that it’s not a miracle product or anything - I didn’t notice any differences in the 2 weeks I used it (not that you’re necessarily supposed to) - and I, again, just felt like it was overpriced for what it was.

reviews.product_name: Virgin Marula Luxury Face Oil
reviews.review_text: There wasn’t anything bad or wrong with this product, but I definitely didn’t feel at all like it was anything special - there are other brands who sell marula oil for much cheaper and I’m inclined to believe they’re the same thing (minus the cute DE packaging). I haven’t tried any other marula oils as of yet, but I do have to say that this one, at least, didn’t sink into my skin very well - I was left with a greasy “film“ on my face for hours after applying it (and that says a lot for me, since I have pretty dry skin - usually greasier/heavier products don’t bother me).

reviews.product_name: B-Hydra Intensive Hydration Serum with Hyaluronic Acid
reviews.review_text: This product is weird in that it claims to be a “hydration gel,“ yet I’ve actually seen a few people complain that it dries them out. I never used this product on its own, without any other moisturizers, so it never dried me out, but I also didn’t feel like it was anywhere near hydrating enough to be worth the price. Basically, it seemed like it just didn’t do anything at all.

reviews.product_name: Clear Improvement Charcoal Honey Mask to Purify and Nourish
reviews.review_text: I really like the look of this mask, first of all. It’s a shiny gray color which I think is really cool-looking. I also like the fact that it’s pretty quick to dry and does dry down all the way so you know when to rinse it off. Face masks don’t usually make a huge difference in my skin, at least not that I notice, and this one was no different, but it was fun to use and I’d recommend it to anyone looking for a new fun face mask to try! Also, it really does have a nice honey scent!I received this product complimentary for testing from Influenster.

reviews.product_name: Luminous Dewy Skin Mist
reviews.review_text: Tatcha’s products are always so luxurious and amazing and this one is no different. I like to use this spray when I’m done doing my makeup to melt the powders into each other so my skin doesn’t look as powdery, or just on days where my skin is feeling a little dull or dry and I need a little spritz of hydration. The only thing that’s not perfect about this product is that the mist isn’t quite as fine as I would like - it does sometimes leave little water droplets on my face lol. But that’s not a huge problem; I can always just fan my face and they’re gone in no time, but it’s just something worth mentioning. reviews.review_text: This product is very luxurious-feeling, just like all of Tatcha’s products. However, with this particular product, I didn’t know what to think of it at first since I’m not really familiar with cleansing oils. No more waiting a week for the waxy residue to finally wear away; I finally found something tough enough to remove it but gentle enough for the face! reviews.product_name: Vegan Milk Moisturizer
reviews.review_title: So Glad I Didn't Wait to Purchase This!
reviews.review_text: This moisturizer is AMAZING for people like me who have dry or dry-to-normal skin. She thicc and although I do love it, I don’t think it’s accurate to describe it as ’lightweight’ (which they do on the Milk Makeup website) - it’s just not that lol. It sort of reminds me of the Tatcha Dewy Skin Cream, which I bought at the same time as this, and I think both are more suited to people with dry or normal skin types. I think oily or combo folks might enjoy a thinner/lighter moisturizer rather than these thick, rich creams. That said, this is fragrance-free and has no detectable scent (unlike the Tatcha Dewy Skin Cream, which does have their signature scent), is vegan and cruelty-free (yay!), and is much cheaper than the Tatcha Dewy Skin Cream (this Milk Makeup Vegan Milk Moisturizer is $38 USD for the full size, and the Tatcha Dewy Skin Cream is $68 USD for the same amount of product). I love pretty much everything about this moisturizer for me, personally, but I do notice that when my skin is a lil sensitized from maybe too much exfoliation (oops!) or whatever else, this does sting a bit in those sensitized areas despite it being fragrance-free and everything, so just keep that in mind! Other than that, it has become one of my favorite moisturizers and I’m so happy that I purchased it immediately when it came out instead of waiting because I really, really am enjoying it! (Plus, I couldn’t resist the cute, vibrant yellow packaging lol!)

reviews.product_name: Mini Cream Skin Toner & Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I got this lil deluxe sample of the Laneige Cream Skin Toner from Sephora with my last purchase. I’ve been trying it out and I’ve really been loving it and feel like I’m gonna have to go ahead and get the full size once I finish up this sample haha.⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀It’s definitely not a traditional toner, so if that’s what you’re looking for, this ain’t it. However, if you have dry skin or just want a super moisturizing toner step in your routine, this is just amazing for that! It’s lightweight enough that you can use it as one of the first steps in your routine, but moisturizing enough that you really feel like you’re doing your skin a hydration favor everytime you use it!

reviews.product_name: Vinopure Natural Salicylic Acid Pore Minimizing Serum
reviews.review_title: Thoughts on the Caudalie Vinoperfect Serum...
reviews.review_text: I got the Caudalie Vinoperfect skincare set that includes the Vinoperfect cleanser, toner, and serum, and I have thoughts.This was the product I was most excited for in the set, but unfortunately, it ended up being the one I enjoyed the least out of the three :/ First of all, like I said, the fragrance in this was just so potent and made me feel like it would counteract whatever benefits the other ingredients in this might be providing. Also, I really didn’t like the texture/consistency of this serum. It was quite tacky/sticky and seemed to completely dry up before I got it completely rubbed in unless I used a ton of product at once, like four pumps instead of just one.⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀Another thing I wanted to note is that I didn’t notice any changes, good or bad, in my skin that I could attribute to any of these Caudalie products, which sucks cause I dropped $50 on this set! Oh well, I’ve been wanting to try Caudalie for a while, so at least I finally did that, right?

reviews.product_name: The True Cream Aqua Bomb
reviews.review_text: This is a deluxe sample size of the belif “the true cream - aqua bomb.“ I feel like this is actually (for once) a decently-sized sample so you can actually get a few uses out of it and really put it to the test to see if it sort of agrees with your skin or if it aligns with your skincare preferences. In the second photo, you can see the color and texture of the product - I’d say it does lean slightly more towards being a gel than a cream moisturizing product, but I’d honestly hesitate to call it either one because I feel like it’s actually more accurately described as a sort of cream-gel hybrid. It’s very lightweight, like a gel, but also very, very powerfully hydrating like a typical thicker cream moisturizer. I did genuinely enjoy trying out this belif aqua bomb deluxe sample and especially enjoyed the soft, velvet-y smoothness it gave my skin right after being applied, but I don’t know that I’d ever go out of my way to purchase a full-size version of this particular moisturizer. I definitely have other thicker, more creamy moisturizers that I feel pack more of a punch on my dry skin type than this guy does, so nothing bad to say about this guy, but also wasn’t head over heels for it either!

reviews.product_name: Mini Adaptogen Deep Moisture Cream with Ashwagandha + Reishi
reviews.review_text: Youth to the People has slowly but surely worked its way up to being one of my top favorite skincare brands at Sephora. I do wish they’d be a lil more chill with their prices because ya girl is broke, but I can understand how they get away with it with products this good quality. One of my absolute favorite products from the brand is the Adaptogen Deep Moisture Cream - I’ve admittedly only used mini and sample sizes as of yet, but I can guarantee you that whenever I’m in the market to purchase a new moisturizer, this one will definitely be on the top of my list. It feels great on my dry skin but sinks in quickly and doesn’t leave my skin feeling sticky or heavy like some other super-hydrating creams do.

reviews.product_name: The Dewy Skin Cream Plumping & Hydrating Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: This lovely texture and packaging belong to the one and only the Tatcha Dewy Skin Cream! I’ve been hearing people rave and rave about this product for quite a long time, and it definitely had my interest especially because I have a dry skin type and tend to love anything that claims to be dewy. However, when I investigated further and discovered that the price tag on this guy is $68 (for a pretty standard size of 1.7 oz!), I definitely started to second guess whether I really *needed* to give this product a try or not. I gave it some time and consideration, but found myself always coming back to it and constantly adding and removing it from my Sephora cart, so eventually I just decided to go ahead and finally splurge on this pricey moisturizer to find out what all the hype was about. And I must say I’ve been pleasantly surprised! I was a lil worried that the word ’dewy’ was in the product’s name solely for marketing purposes and that it wouldn’t translate to being actually dewy-looking, especially on my dry skin. But I was mistaken! This moisturizer is luxuriously moisturizing and definitely does its name justice in the dewy department. And, luckily, the seemingly mediocre 1.7oz of product you get actually goes a long way because you truly only need to use a very, very small amount of this moisturizer to reap its benefits. I find myself using about half of the amount of product I’d typically use with most moisturizers when I use this particular product. Which leads me to my next topic, which would be whether or not I think the Tatcha Dewy Skin Cream is worth its high price: to that I say that, honestly, it depends! If you have a drier skin type, tend to love any product that claims to be ’dewy,’ and can appreciate the bougie details like the luxe packaging and subtle but refined scent of Tatcha products, then I think it’s definitely worth it to look deeper into the idea of purchasing this moisturizer to give a try for yourself! If not, then it might not be for you!

reviews.review_text: I got this lil deluxe sample of the Laneige Cream Skin Toner from Sephora with my last purchase. I’ve been trying it out and I’ve really been loving it and feel like I’m gonna have to go ahead and get the full size once I finish up this sample haha.⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀It’s definitely not a traditional toner, so if that’s what you’re looking for, this ain’t it. However, if you have dry skin or just want a super moisturizing toner step in your routine, this is just amazing for that! It’s lightweight enough that you can use it as one of the first steps in your routine, but moisturizing enough that you really feel like you’re doing your skin a hydration favor everytime you use it!

While I won’t rush to repurchase this simply bc I do have so many open facial oils in my collection atm, I would definitely consider repurchasing it after I start to use up some of my opened products - and if you’re on the lookout for a facial oil but have yet to find something as luxe and lightweight as this one, I’d highly suggest giving this one a try! It’s a pretty penny but it’s honestly different enough from my other facial oils, and I enjoy using it enough, that I feel like it’s worth the price imo!

reviews.product_name: ExfoliKate Glow Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: It’s the very first time that I am trying Kate Somerville Glow Moisturizer. I received a sample of it from a Sephora store. It smells citrusy, I like it’s creamy and soft texture. As soon as it touches my skin, it leaves a cooking sensation. It feels like it’s exfoliating my skin yet at the same time, leaving it adequately moisturized. As I rub it on my facial skin, it feels as if the heat from my skin is leaving and moisture is replaced and cools it down. Totally feels like a citrus scrub/exfoliator except that it’s a moisturizer. Gives shine to my skin and leaves a sensation of dry pores being opened up so that moisture can be replaced with them. Feels very light on my skin. Citrusy smell isn’t annoying because it’s slightly strong and doesn’t sting. It definitely does the job by exfoliating and moisturizing all at the same time and therefore the name fits perfectly. After a few minutes of moisturizer being on my face? I tried to touch,see how it feels. I could not stop touching! I loved it! Felt so smooth, like a baby’sibaby’s bottom! I’d definitely recommend it. A pro tip: do not use too much or it’ll look oily. One coat does the job, and it’s coming from a girl who already has a very dry skin. Doing this sampling test for a contest. #Exfolikate #contest #AllGlowNoGlitter #influenster

reviews.review_text: This Inkey List Hyaluronic Acid Hydrating Serum works effectively on my skin. I have a dry skin and so it quickly gets absorbed into my skin. This is a transparent liquid texture serum. I liked it overall because it didn’t give me any side effects. I just don’t like the scent of it. It has a weird scent to it. But for functionality, I’d recommend it.

reviews.product_name: Volcanic AHA Pore Clearing Clay Mask
reviews.review_text: I received this product complimentary from innisfree. I applied a thin layer of this mask on my clean and dry skin. Then I allowed it to sit and dry for about 10 minutes. I removed the mask using warm water and gentle circular motions. I found this pore clearing clay mask with super volcanic clusters to be very effective. I had no visible pores after even a single use. Make sure to quickly spread the mask because it dries off quickly on the skin. I have a dry skin and thankfully this mask didn’t further dry out my skin. It cleaned and clarified my skin deeply. I like that the mask is effective and easy to use. Pro-tip: Use a very thin layer because otherwise, it can take some time to fully remove the mask and you might need to use your fingers to scrub it off to remove it. I noticed that the packaging seemed heavy at first but it comes in a super cute jar. It worked for me so I will definitely recommend this mask to everyone.

reviews.product_name: Watermelon Glow Niacinamide Dew Drops
reviews.review_text: I received this product complimentary from Glow Recipe. This watermelon glow dew drops highlighting serum came in a beautiful pear shaped bottle. The product was light pink with a lightweight gel texture to it. It had a nice watermelon scent to it. I used this product many different ways for several days. I liked using it as a serum the most because it gave me a youthful look. It gave me a cooling sensation and it was lightweight and gentle on my skin. I loved using this serum because it gave me a nice glow even without the need of any makeup.  A word of caution: do not use more than necessary, since it could become sticky if overused. This product was very versatile as it could be used by itself for a nice glow as the last step of the routine or used over makeup. It could also be used as a primer before makeup as well as with makeup by mixing it with foundation. Used a serum before moisturizer application allowed a nice glow all day. It is cruelty free, vegan, free of parabens, and mineral oils. I love that it’s free from drying alcohol because it can be used as a daily basis without fearing the skin to become dry unlike with some other serums I’ve used before.

reviews.product_name: Skinlongevity Long Life Herb Anti-Aging Face Serum
reviews.review_text: I applied this skinlongevity long life herb serum on my skin after cleansing. I like that it’s easy to get absorbed into my skin. A little goes a long way. It made my skin soft and smooth. I’d definitely recommend this product to everyone.

reviews.product_name: Good Genes All-In-One AHA Lactic Acid Treatment
reviews.review_text: I received a complimentary sample from Sunday Riley. I used this Good Genes All-in-One Lactic Acid Treatment Sunday Riley on my clean and dry skin. I used it multiple different ways: as a mask, as a serum before moisturizer and by itself. After using the products for only a few days, I noticed a uniform skin tone and a clarified skin. I also noticed that my pore size was shrunk and the fine lines were less apparent. This serum comes in a pump bottle. I used about 1-2 pumps when I used the treatment as a serum by itself and before moisturizer. On the other hand, I used three pumps when I used the treatment as a mask. I like that it has a creamy texture that is easy to absorb. It is also lightweight and doesn’t feel oily. When I used it by itself and as a mask, I did notice that it made my skin look shinier. So in order to avoid that, one should use a cream or a moisturizer after using this product. It is an effective product as mentioned before, it reduced lines, and the appearance of pores and reduced dark spots and redness. I’ll continue using it and I’d definitely recommend this product to everyone.

reviews.review_text: I have used this product for a couple weeks now and I love the results! My skin feels refreshed and softened after regular use. I love the light rose scent and the way it feels when I apply it. It’s wonderful!

reviews.product_name: Magic Cream Moisturizer with Hyaluronic Acid
reviews.review_text: This product is creamy and light. I have really enjoyed using it and feeling the benefits of smooth, clear, skin. I like the scent—though I can’t nail it down. I like how creamy it feels, while still feeling light and refreshing! I gave it three stars because it is so so pricey for such a small container. I received this product complimentary for testing purposes from Influenster.

reviews.product_name: Lotus Anti-Aging Night Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I have been really enjoying the Fresh Lotus line of products! I have liked this night cream more than the day; primarily because of the scent. The cream is light, very hydration, and it doesn’t feel like it’s still on my face when I wake up. It feels slightly stress relieving when applied. Cool, calming, and light. I really like this product!

reviews.product_name: Lotus Anti- Aging Daily Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: This product is so, so good. It has a light scent and a hydrating finish. A little goes a long way, and it doesn’t feel thick on the skin. I have had clear skin since having this product, and it has left my skin feeling clean, hydrated, and fresh. I cannot speak to its youth preservation yet as I haven’t been using it that long, but I can update my review when the time comes. Fabulous product!

reviews.product_name: Aqua Bomb Brightening Vitamin C Cream
reviews.review_text: I received this product free to try, and my opinion is my own. Alrighty, I actually usually add a citrus oil such as grapefruit or green mandarin to my moisturizer, so I was SHOCKED at how citrusy this product is. It’s legit. I add oil for brightening purposes, so i do believe that this product will brighten your skin due to its citrus content. The light weight texture is JUST what I love—it feels almost gel-like, and doesn’t feel heavy on your skin. I use a lot of moisturizers, and this one is definitely one I would consider purchasing. The only reason I’m giving it 4 stars is because I do use essential oils to brighten my skin tone, and I think I can do it using the oil and save a bit of money over the long term. Otherwise—highly recommend!

reviews.product_name: Beste No. 9 Jelly Cleanser
reviews.review_text: This product left my face feeling completely clean. It’s great for night or morning. It is a clear jelly liquid but it can lather up if used with water. Price is fake for the 5oz bottle size.

It’s true that it glides on smoothly and gives an instant glow. Also, I have seen a huge difference in how this product evens out my skin tone.  It’s the best anti aging serum and can also be used as a face moisturizer. Over all, this multi purpose TATCHA serum visibly reduces dryness, improves skin texture, and gives an instant glow and reduces appearance of fine lines.

reviews.review_text: My skin is super sensitive and I was worried my skin would freak out but I took extra caution by applying it every other night to start. The first change I noticed was how plump and radiant my skin looked even after hours of sleep!

reviews.product_name: Retinol Anti-Aging Serum
reviews.review_text: I really enjoy using this product. It is super easy to apply and you don’t need tons of it. It doesn’t have an unpleasant or overpowering smell. It absorbs easily into my skin and was heavy. After two weeks of use I was impressed. My skin is noticeably softer and looks healthier. I will continue to use.

reviews.product_name: Banana Bright 15% Vitamin C Serum
reviews.review_title: Smells like summer in a bottle.
reviews.review_text: I really like this serum. First off it smells like fresh squeezed oranges. The scent is strong and powerful. I’m all for it. It’s very light once applied, but I definitely recommend applying your moisturizer right after. I found if I didn’t do this right after I applied the serum, my skin felt a little tacky. Otherwise I have absolutely no complaints. I think my skin looks better all around. My skin is very soft and I think my dark spots have lightened up. It leaves your skin feeling super hydrated and firm. I’m going to continue using this and I recommend it.

reviews.product_name: Alpha Beta Extra Strength Daily Peel Pads
reviews.review_text: These are amazing. The directions are super easy to follow. After the first use my skin felt smoother and softer. It also looked great. I used them for 3 days in a row and was super happy with the results. I will definitely be getting more.

reviews.product_name: Volcanic AHA Pore Clearing Clay Mask
reviews.review_text: I received this complimentary from Innisfree in return for my honest review. I was gifted this by Innisfree. I am a big mask user, so I was pumped to try this Pore Clearing Clay Mask. I have really large pores. Anything to help clear them out and make them look smaller is my type of product. I applied this mask with a brush and it went on like butter. It was so smooth. It was cool and made my face feel awesome. It’s not heavily scented at all. I left it on for about 15 minutes to fully dry. It washed away easily and didn’t make a huge mess. My skin felt so soft after. It left my face feeling clean and refreshed. I really like this mask. It made my skin feel amazing after just one use. I definitely recommend it.

reviews.product_name: Barrier+ Triple Lipid-Peptide Face Cream
reviews.review_text: I received this complimentary from Skinfix in return for my honest review. I was gifted this by Skinfix. This moisturizer is a game changer. First let’s start with the container it comes in. At first I thought it was strange that it looked like it had two lids until I learned how to use it. I love that you don’t have to dip your fingers into the same pot daily. The potential for contamination is extremely high. Now on to the actual cream. The texture for me is perfect. It thick and creamy but not tacky or sticky. It applies easily and absorbs well into the skin. It isn’t scented which is nice. It made my skin look and feel very hydrated. It a great all around moisturizer that would work for everyone. I love the ingredient list too. I highly recommend this.

I have had dark circles since I was a kid and I have only had a few products actually make visible difference. I think when you first use the cream because it’s so thick it does make them look lighter. Unfortunately I think it might be from the cream not drying yet. It does take a long time to dry. It’s fine at night but not so great for the morning with kids routine.

reviews.product_name: Santorini Grape Poreless Skin Cream
reviews.review_text: I really liked this cream. It’s hydrating but doesn’t leave my skin greasy at all. Living in Florida with the humidity this is really important to me. It doesn’t have a strong scent at all so it’s great for anyone. I really like that it’s vegan friendly and cruelty free. It works great as a base for makeup because it blurs your pores. I have huge pores and I definitely noticed a difference. I would definitely recommend it.

reviews.product_name: The Silk Peony Melting Eye Cream
reviews.review_text: First of all the packaging is absolutely beautiful. I think the packaging alone just sets it apart and shows that it is a high end product. This eye cream truly feels like butter and it melts into your skin. After I applied it my eyes looked refreshed & radiant. It left my skin feeling so silky & smooth. I did receive this product complimentary & I would definitely recommend it!

reviews.review_text: The formula feels so smooth going in your skin & instantly feels more hydrated. My under-eye area looks smoother with each use. I can definitely tell a difference in the fine lines & wrinkles that I had around my eyes. Would highly recommend this product.

reviews.product_name: Banana Bright 15% Vitamin C Serum
reviews.review_text: This is a great product for targeting dullness, fine lines, wrinkles & dark spots. I saw such a big difference in the brightness of my skin. It smells great & feels great on your skin. I will definitely be adding this product to my beauty regimen. I highly recommend.

reviews.review_text: I had heard how great this eye cream was so I bit the bullet. I do like it for nighttime. It’s thicker than any eye cream I’ve used before. I did find that I don’t like using it in the morning because it causes my makeup to ball up. I chose the rating because at this price I should be able to use both day and night. I was a bit disappointed. I do love many other Drunk Elephant products! A little goes a long way so this will last me quite a while.

reviews.product_name: B-Hydra Intensive Hydration Serum with Hyaluronic Acid
reviews.review_text: A little goes a long way combined with my moisturizer.  I purchased this based on a deluxe sample size I had.  I didn’t have problems all winter with dry skin!  I feel like for the money, this was a great Drunk Elephant purchase.  I will be purchasing again when I’m out.

reviews.product_name: Alpha Beta Pore Perfecting & Refining Serum
reviews.review_text: I’ve never been unhappy with a Dr. Dennis Gross product.  This is no exception.  My face has responded well to this product.  I love that a little bit goes a long way with this serum.  I have used it morning and night and still have more of my sample to go.  I do notice that my face is brighter and clearer.  I didn’t feel the need to use foundation this morning, so that’s a plus!  I don’t know that I’ve see enough to convince me to buy a whole bottle yet.

reviews.product_name: Retinol Anti-Aging Serum
reviews.review_text: First, the price of this product is better than great.  It made me skeptical.  What’s great about this product is that you can use it daily with no negative effects.  The downside would be that I haven’t really seen a major change.  I will keep using it to see if I am seeing any positive changes.  I don’t know if I would purchase again from what I’m seeing so far.  Only time will tell.
