It provides so much relief to dry flaky, scaling skin. I highly recommend this product even if you don’t have extremely dry skin as it definitely gives a youthful, hydrated glow.

reviews.product_name: The True Cream Aqua Bomb
reviews.review_text: I loved this moisturizer from the moment I set eyes on it. The packaging is okay, not super high end but i was happy with it. The moisturizer itself is amazing! It’s lightweight and great for the summer, and the gel like consistency goes on very smoothly. It also smells lovely, and I will definitely be purchasing this after I run out. A little goes a long way! It will last you quite a long time.

reviews.product_name: Aqua Bomb Hydrating Toner
reviews.review_text: I really like this toner! The best thing about it for me is the smell. It’s not overpowering, it smells amazing and I love using it for that reason alone. It also is great on my skin, and non irritating which is great. No stinging here! I have only been using it for a few days but so far I am happy with the product.

reviews.product_name: Abeille Royale Advanced Youth Watery Oil
reviews.review_text: I recieved this product for free from Influenster in exchange for my honest review. As the title states, this oil is much thinner and more “watery” than others I’ve tried. This makes it feel less heavy on the skin, and I find it absorbs extremely well! I don’t mind the scent myself, but if you prefer non scented products, be aware that this does have a pleasant smell. I haven’t found that it has improved my skin very much, but I’ve had a good experience with the oil and I would recommend trying it.

reviews.product_name: Mini Abeille Royale Advanced Youth Watery Oil
reviews.review_text: I recieved this product for free from Influenster in exchange for my honest review. As the title states, this oil is much thinner and more “watery” than others I’ve tried. This makes it feel less heavy on the skin, and I find it absorbs extremely well! I don’t mind the scent myself, but if you prefer non scented products, be aware that this does have a pleasant smell. I haven’t found that it has improved my skin very much, but I’ve had a good experience with the oil and I would recommend trying it.

reviews.product_name: PHAT Glow Facial Mask
reviews.review_text: I have been a fan of Olehenriksen products for about a year now because so far, the products that I’ve used have been promising. So when I tried out the Phat Glow Facial, it was no surprise to me that it would be amazing. I saw changes in my skin immediately. Smaller pores, brighter skin and overall, my skin looked healthier. My only problem is that the product is a bit sticky and feels like bubble gum. However, that does not stop me from using the product. I used a free sample of this product through Influenster.

reviews.product_name: The True Cream Moisturizing Bomb
reviews.review_text: My skin drank this up! When I read “moisturizing bomb” on the bottle I was a little afraid that it would leave my skin looking and feeling oily. Well I was wrong! This product isn’t too thick, and leaves my skin glowing! I would definitely recommend - especially to those who get dry skin during the winter season!

reviews.product_name: Lemonade Smoothing Scrub
reviews.review_text: I’ve been a fan of Ole Henriksen products for some time now. This scrub did not disappoint! I’ve used it a few times now and my skin feels and looks fresher and brighter every time! Talk about GLOWING!! I have no complaints with this product. It doesn’t leave my skin feeling dry and flaky (especially during the winter season). Overall, I would definitely recommend!

reviews.product_name: Soy Hydrating Gentle Face Cleanser
reviews.review_text: I used to use foaming cleansers in the past and always felt they dried out my skin way more than I liked, this cleanser is my everyday goto for night cleansing. It’s gentle and can be used as a 2nd step cleanser if you double cleanse.

reviews.product_name: Vinopure Natural Salicylic Acid Pore Minimizing Serum
reviews.review_text: Love!! As a brown girl every time I see some congestion on my forehead or on a cheek I cringe because I know I’m going to have a zit/pimple and I know it’ll leave a scar due to good old hyperpigmentation (yay melanin). I don’t have acne prone skin but sometimes I do have the occasional pustulant visitor, not once did I experience this after using this serum. As soon I see signs of congestion, I use this to spot treat the area and it works!

reviews.product_name: Retinol Reform Treatment Serum
reviews.review_text: Loved this! I used PTR’s 1.5% retinol serum initially, love this one wayy more. I’m definitely beginning to see a difference in my skin quality, from a product usage perspective a little goes a long way- my kind of product :)

reviews.product_name: Mini Retinol Reform
reviews.review_text: Loved this! I used PTR’s 1.5% retinol serum initially, love this one wayy more. I’m definitely beginning to see a difference in my skin quality, from a product usage perspective a little goes a long way- my kind of product :)

reviews.product_name: Smart Clinical Repair Wrinkle Correcting Eye Cream
reviews.review_text: I got it in sample from topbox as a #freeproduct.i used it at night after Moisturizing my face.it feels good and refreshing for eyes but i just used it 2 days so not very sure about long term effects.

reviews.product_name: Smart Clinical Repair Wrinkle Correcting Cream
reviews.review_title: Best night cream for wrinkles n fine lines
reviews.review_text: I have received the product in tester sachet #freeproducct from topbox.i used the product at night.it is soo soothing for my skin and clinique has been always too good with their products.it has very calm smell and texture is very light to handle.definetly will recommend this.

reviews.product_name: Smart Clinical Repair Wrinkle Correcting Serum
reviews.review_text: I got it as a #freeproduct from topbox as a sample packing.i was able to use it 2 times only but amazed with results ,its very light weight and very hydrating serum for skin. I used it before my Moisturizer at night time.

reviews.product_name: Green Clean Makeup Removing Cleansing Balm
reviews.review_text: Very light texture and comfortable to use. Feels soft on skin and not irritating or heavily greasy at all.

reviews.product_name: Green Clean Makeup Meltaway Cleansing Balm Limited Edition Jumbo
reviews.review_text: Very light texture and comfortable to use. Feels soft on skin and not irritating or heavily greasy at all.

reviews.product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C
reviews.review_text: This mask works really well. Using overnight works best but I still love using it as a prep step while doing my skincare and before applying makeup. Lips feel super soft and hydrated.

reviews.product_name: Honey Halo Ultra-Hydrating Ceramide Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I’ve tried 3 products from the brand so far and have loved them all. I use this nightly due to its richness and lovely, light honey scent. I enjoy it being my final step as it’s envelopes the skin and locks in all other products. A really great option if you’re looking for a heavier cream that doesn’t leave you feeling greasy or filmy.

reviews.product_name: Niacinamide 10% + Zinc 1% Oil Control Serum
reviews.review_text: This product is great at purging the skin of all the sebum. At first my skin looked red and whiteheads were popping around my nose. My skin actually looked worse than before I started using it. But I had read some reviews claiming that this goes away so I kept using it and after a week, my skin got smoother, my pores started clearing out and the redness went away. It even faded out my old acne scars. I have been using this for about 2-3 weeks now. My skin hasn’t become completely flawless but at the rate this product is working, I’m thinking I’ll be close to achieving that soon!

reviews.product_name: Hyaluronic Acid 2% + B5 Hydrating Serum
reviews.review_text: This product is awesome. Holds hydration and my skin feels soft and plump after use. Bye bye dryness.

reviews.product_name: Oat Cleansing Balm
reviews.review_text: Its ok. These days yi can find a cleansing balm literally by every company out there. This one isn’t really easy to work with. Feels sticky like grease and doesn’t spread easily like the farmacy one or the Heimish one from Amazon. I wouldn’t repurchase, even for the affordable price.

reviews.product_name: Mini Oat Cleansing Balm

reviews.product_name: Salicylic Acid Acne + Pore Cleanser
reviews.review_title: Good cleanser for acne prone skin.
reviews.review_text: This is a great cleanser. I don’t need to use much. It foams up very gently and definitely exfoliates my skin. purges all the gross stuff out and treats acne mildly. I don’t think it could be used as a main acne treatment but if in you have acne, you should definitely use this on top of your main acne treatment. It also doesn’t make the skin feel super dry after use.

reviews.product_name: The Kissu Lip Mask
reviews.review_title: Overpriced, sticky, doesn't sink in to hydrate.
reviews.review_text: Not worth the money. Overpriced. It just sits on top of the lips, so if you alreqdy have dry lips, its not going to actually soak in and hydrate. It feels very greasy on my finger after application. Vaseline lip therapy is way better than this. My lips feel hydrated and not sticky when I apply vaseline lip therapy. Its way less costly. pricey doesn’t always mean quality, I guess. I won’t rebuy.

reviews.product_name: Indigo Overnight Repair Serum in Cream Treatment
reviews.review_title: Greasy: only for extremely dry skin, maybe!
reviews.review_text: Overpriced. Sits on the face like grease. Feels like grease. I have broken out previously after using it, so I didn’t use it for a while. After a couple of months I thought, lets try it again, thinking, maybe I was mistaken. I was wrong. It is certainly not for combination or oily skin. I think the only skin type this product might work for would be extremely dry skin. In fact, its so greasy that I used it on my lips as a lip balm/serum and it worked great! So I guess I’ll be finishing the jar as a lip balm. After that, no repurchase.

reviews.product_name: Mini Indigo Overnight Repair Serum in Cream Treatment

reviews.product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C
reviews.review_text: After one try at the store I decided to purchase this even if it was more pricey then I was willing to pay for lip moisturizer... but after the FIRST NIGHT my dry dehydrated lips were plump and juicy!  I had kissed my boyfriend before bed and even his lips were soft and flawless -  this is a must,  would love to try the grapefruit version

reviews.product_name: Clear Sunscreen Stick SPF 50+
reviews.review_text: Nought this after receiving a free sample!It is easy to apply under or over makeup!! (it is a clear stick)It is completly flawless,  it doesnt show at all on my dark skin!  Takes to seconds to apply, I am in love with this

reviews.product_name: Blueberry Bounce Gentle Cleanser
reviews.review_text: I have sensitive skin because I took Cortisone heavily and it left my skin a mess....  So I tried everything to get rid of blemishes and acne, and this is the lightest most efficient cleanser. The smell is not overwhelming, and it cleans suprisingly well!   Perfect for people ith sensitive skin who react to others such as Clinique, Vichy etc.

reviews.product_name: Alpha Beta Extra Strength Daily Peel Pads
reviews.review_text: Great product! I actually used to purchase this and then pinchme sent me a complimentary sample. My makeup goes on smoother after using this and I feel like it helps with my pitted acne scars.

reviews.product_name: Ultimate Sun Protector Lotion SPF 50+ Sunscreen
reviews.review_text: I really enjoyed this product! Be sure you give it a good shake before using! It is very light weight. I used it on both my face and body and it didn’t break me out! I also love that it is ocean compliant!

reviews.product_name: Charlotte’s Magic Serum with Vitamin C
reviews.review_text: Love the packaging on this product, it feels luxurious and the dropper works well. The biggest benefit I’ve had with the magic serum is that my skin just looks healthier after applying, texture/pores are minimized and skin has a nice glow to it while also looking a bit more plumped. A little goes a long way with this product, dries down quickly. Wears well under makeup and serves as a great base for makeup application. I love that this product contains niacinamide and the vitamin c was not irritating which i sometimes have breakouts from. The only thing I’m not a huge fan of is the scent, smells like roses to me but it doesn’t linger for long. Overall would recommend!

reviews.product_name: Vinoperfect Radiance Dark Spot Serum Vitamin C Alternative
reviews.review_title: Only radiance boost that's ever visibly worked....
reviews.review_text: This is the only product that has boosted my skin’s natural radiance. It literally works like magic! I have acne prone skin my entire life and it really helps fight the spots with time...

reviews.product_name: Moisturizing Eye Bomb with Squalane
reviews.review_text: Best eye cream I’ve ever used in my life! I highly recommend this to EVERYONE all skin types and ages.

reviews.product_name: Adaptogen Deep Moisturizing Cream with Ashwagandha + Reishi
reviews.review_text: I prefer this to my Tatcha water cream. This is so much more moisturizing. A little pricey but worth it! Especially during winters, and it’s moisturizer that lasts.

reviews.product_name: Mini Adaptogen Deep Moisture Cream with Ashwagandha + Reishi
reviews.review_text: I prefer this to my Tatcha water cream. This is so much more moisturizing. A little pricey but worth it! Especially during winters, and it’s moisturizer that lasts.

reviews.product_name: Vitamin C Suspension 23% + HA Spheres 2%
reviews.review_text: This product is amazing. Within 2 days of use I have noticed a difference to my skin, with no other changes to my routine. It appears brighter, clearer, soft and supple. I know the difference is real because my MOM complimented the appearance of my skin- something she has never done. I actually just bought one for her as well.To get over the grainy texture I use at night only, and gently pat it onto my skin (no rubbing).

reviews.product_name: Cream Skin Toner & Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I’ve been using this for about a week now and it’s quickly become a product I can’t go without. I have combination skin. I use it as the first step after cleansing morning and night. I’m noticing an improvement in the texture and hydration of my skin, and less noticeable pores, with this being the only thing I’ve changed in my routine.  Honestly wasn’t expecting to like this product but it is impressive.

reviews.product_name: MINI GINZING VITAMIN C EYE CREAM TO BRIGHTEN AND DEPUFF
reviews.review_text: I love this product! Using it in place of concealer for my under eyes during the day and it’s a really nice lightweight texture and seems to hydrate the area nicely while brightening and hiding my dark circles. As for long term effects of decreasing fine lines and dark circles, not really noticing much of a difference there but as camouflage it works beautifully.

reviews.product_name: Protini Polypeptide Firming Refillable Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I am in my 30s, do not have sensitive skin, and have mostly normal and sometimes combination skin. I received a mini size as a bday Sephora gift. I layered the moisturizer over a retinol serum and the result was super moisturized, hydrated, bouncy skin. The next morning I would wake up to very smooth, more even toned, soft skin. That only last for about the 3 days. Afterwards I noticed tiny bumps on my forehead and cheeks. I checked out the ingredients and noticed exfoliating acids in the moisturizer which I think became too much being that I use a retinol every night. That is my guess anyway...unfortunately I will not purchase the full size as retinol is a staple product in my regimen that I don’t see myself not using anytime soon. I believe in the product description, somewhere it should be mentioned that there are exfoliating acids in it. But overall, I believe this moisturizer is a good one, you just have to be careful as to what other products you are using with it at the moment.

reviews.product_name: Honeymoon Glow AHA Resurfacing Night Serum
reviews.review_text: Used it for 2 nights and I have to say after the first night I noticed a dramatic change in skin texture when I woke up in the morning. I love this stuff! My skin looked so smooth and brighter, pores a little smaller. It stings a little when I apply but it doesn’t leave a redness. I don’t have sensitive skin. My skin type is normal with occasional breakouts.

reviews.product_name: Glycolic Acid 7% Exfoliating Toning Solution
reviews.review_text: It does it’s job. Exfoliates. I had gone a few weeks without really caring for my skin and saw my pores were looking congested with that white stuff if you look up close in a mirror and my skin texture was uneven and bumpy. Used this one time after cleansing. Took a cotton pad and swiped away, the white stuff disappeared. The next morning my skin looked pretty smooth. Only thing I will say is I formed 2 breakouts...one on cheek and one close to the chin. Not sure if this toner caused it as it’s that time of the month for me. I tend to get a bump or 2 around that time anyway. I don’t have sensitive skin and it adjusts pretty well to new products.

reviews.product_name: Salicylic Acid Acne + Pore Cleanser
reviews.review_text: I have combo skin during summer. I’m simple and not picky about products as I don’t have sensitive skin or other skin issues. I found that this cleanser did it’s job with cleansing that white stuff that fills your pores after you neglect skin care for a couple of weeks. I didn’t have any bumps or breakouts before using this. After using this one time, I did develop 2 pimples...one on cheek and one near my chin. I won’t be quick to say this cleanser caused it 100% as it’s that time of the month for me. But I found this cleanser to clean really well. I used it with my Flawless Hydro Vibrating Facial Cleanser tool. The price is decent for me.

reviews.product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C
reviews.review_text: Actually heals my lips over night!! In the morning they are always perfectly smooth and less dry looking. The formula feels good to wear over night but I wouldn’t wear it during they day since it is pretty thick. The Original reminds me of cherry lip smackers. So good. I tried the vanilla on in store and it was also good.

That being said this one smells better and the packaging is beautiful and reusable too :)

reviews.product_name: Volcanic AHA Pore Clearing Clay Mask
reviews.review_text: This product has been gifted to me by Innisfree. This product has a really beautiful, smooth tecture that I love. I really do notice a differece in my skin after using this. I love that this is a wash off mask. Overall, love the product.

reviews.product_name: Daily UV Defense Invisible Broad Spectrum SPF 36 Sunscreen
reviews.review_text: his product was gifted by Innisfree. This sunscreen is really good! I love it because it leaves no white cast, which is really hard for me to not have because I do have tan skin. Overall, excellent product!

reviews.product_name: Good Genes All-In-One AHA Lactic Acid Treatment
reviews.review_text: This product is gifted by Sunday Riley. This product is really good. I noticed a difference on n my skin, it looked much brighter and smoother. I would recommend this product to anyone. Definitely give it a go.

reviews.product_name: The Serum Stick: Treatment & Touch Up Balm
reviews.review_text: I’ve been curious about the Serum Stick for a while now. I was thrilled when it was included in the latest Trendmood Box. Being in my 50’s my skin is changing. This serum stick is wonderful. I have used it under my eyes, on any dry patches on my cheeks. This will be great in the winter when my skin will be drier due to the heat.

reviews.product_name: Original Skin Matte Moisturizer with Willowherb
reviews.review_text: i love this product so much!! i received it complimentary for testing purposes from influenster. it is one of the best moisturizers ive ever used. i have never used anything like it

reviews.review_text: i received this product free for testing purposes from influenster. i love how it makes my skin feel. my skin looked vibrant and even. the smell is great and it goes on nicely. would recommend!

However at the end of my cleanse, it left my face feeling a little dry. Hence the three stars. It’s a really nice product but I do think that there are better other products on the market for cheaper.  I don’t know that I would repurchase this.

reviews.product_name: T.L.C. Framboos Glycolic Resurfacing Night Serum
reviews.review_text: Absolutely love tihs product. I can see an instant change as well as a lasting one in the continued use of this product. It has made my pores practically nonexistent and my skintone has evened out so much!

reviews.product_name: Lala Retro Whipped Refillable Moisturizer with Ceramides
reviews.review_text: The packaging is lovely and dispenses a perfect amount. I have very dry skin and this plumps and hydrates perfectly. I do wish there was more product in the item itself though for the price. But at the same time it is so so so good and has worked wonders on my skin.

reviews.product_name: Lippe Balm
reviews.review_text: Just eh. For the price its very little product, while the product moisturizes my lips, it doesn’t last long, I find my self reapplying multiple times a day without much avail.

reviews.product_name: C-Tango Vitamin C Eye Cream
reviews.review_text: I love this and will be repurchasing again and again. This is the first vitamin c eye cream that has not dried my skin out! I saw results instantly and woke up with hydrated and brightened undereyes. However use the product sparingly as it can sting.

reviews.product_name: Lip Glowy Balm
reviews.review_text: I got this product free from Influenster to test and leave on honest review. I loved the color and the formula. It smells amazing and leaves my lips feeling very smooth. I was happy with the packaging of it as pink is super cute. I love that this product has a slight tint because it just adds an extra *bam* to your lips.

reviews.product_name: Double Serum Firming & Smoothing Anti-Aging Concentrate
reviews.review_text: The serum feel amazing. It leaves my skin with an amazing glow and feeling super hydrated. I definitely recommend you add this to you skincare routine ☺️ I got this product for free from Influenster in exchange for my honest review.

reviews.product_name: Squalane + Omega Repair Deep Hydration Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I loved this product. It left my skin feeling amazing and smells so yummy. I got this product for free in exchange for an honest review. Now I’m stuck because I loved it and will be buying more!

reviews.product_name: Retinol Eye Stick
reviews.review_text: This product is in a very convenient cute carrying size! I highly recommend it it rolls on super easy and stays on. I use it at night before bed. I feel like my skin under my eyes is already looking softer I will continue to use it. And the price is definitely worth It

reviews.product_name: Microneedling Anti-Wrinkle Retinol Patches

reviews.review_text: These acne dots have become a part of my life. They really do work. I tend to use them at night I put them on my pimple and go to sleep snd in the morning it’s completely flat. I highly recommend this product for sure

reviews.product_name: Microneedling Anti-Wrinkle Retinol Patches

reviews.review_text: This product definitely helps with the puffiness under my eyes. I use this product in the am and pm. Recommend this product!

reviews.product_name: Triple Algae Eye Renewal Balm Eye Cream
reviews.review_text: Great product! Skin felt smoother and noticeable decrease in puffiness.

reviews.product_name: The Dewy Skin Cream Plumping & Hydrating Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I love this skin cream, it gives me the perfect amount of moisture without feeling overly oily.

reviews.product_name: T.L.C. Sukari Babyfacial AHA + BHA Mask
reviews.review_text: This mask is amazing! It made my skin tingle and turn a bit red immediately after use but after a few hours my skin was baby soft.

reviews.product_name: Slaai  Makeup-Melting Butter Cleanser
reviews.review_text: This product is great for removing make-up. I use it as a make-up remover before my second cleanse. It left my skin feeling silky and smooth

reviews.product_name: Soy Hydrating Gentle Face Cleanser
reviews.review_text: OMG, this is probably my favorite daily cleanser at the moment. I received this product from Influenster and it became my daily holy grail. Every night I will use this cleanser to remove my makeup and it works really well (even with waterproof mascara on.) This soy cleanser feels very very soft on my face and definitely makes your skin glowy and radiant. I have tried different types of cleanser before will make my face very dry and harsh towards my skin, but not this one. The only cons about this product is very pricey. $40 for a cleanser I feel is a little too much.

reviews.product_name: Sugar Strawberry Exfoliating Face Wash
reviews.review_title: TWO THUMBS UP FOR THIS ONE
reviews.review_text: I have heard numerous feedbacks from my friends on how well Fresh products works for them and their quality; so finally I gave it a try and it sure didn’t let me down! This new sugar strawberry exfoliating face wash works so well for my combination skin (oily forehead and dry t-zone.) I have tried many other exfoliator which will always make my face super tight and dry, however, this one from fresh feels amazing after every wash. You can see immediate result of glowy soft skin. I only use this exfoliator once a week with a quarter size drop and its enough. I rub it all over my face and the strawberry scent felt amazing! After washing you will feel very refreshing and it completely removes all dirt, oil and make up from your face. Two thumbs up for this product!

reviews.product_name: Lemonade Smoothing Scrub
reviews.review_text: ONE OF MY FAVORITE EXFOLIATE CLEANSER! This product makes my skin very refreshing, clean and most importantly soft. It removes my dead skin and pores that you can feel the softness and how clean your face feel even after one wash. This exfoliator also have a nice lemon aroma to it. I just this 3 times a weeks. Will definitely purchase this product again

reviews.review_text: Such a refreshing mask! I love how this cleans out my skin and feels so cold like it’s really shrinking my pores!! I love everything ole makes and immediately had to purchase this :)

reviews.product_name: Glow2OH Dark Spot Toner
reviews.review_text: I purchased this about a week ago and omg.... I can’t see myself not using this. My skin feels so much more refreshed and hydrated after I use it and I for sure can tell my moisturizer sinks in better. My texture on my cheeks looks and feels smoother and don’t know why I’m surprised, I’ve never been disappointed by a Ole product!! 5 starts all the way

reviews.review_text: I love this toner! My skin is combo but has been super dry lately and this makes it feel so soft and supple! I break out easily and this has been gentle on my skin with no flare ups ! Can’t wait to continue to use it :)

reviews.review_text: OMG, I love it! This Shiseido Clear Sunscreen Stick SPF 50+ is amazing! I really recommend it a lot even for winter or summer use. I’m using everyday!!

reviews.review_text: Wonderful for oily skin. It does not contain oil in the composition and I can use whole day and apply makeup on top.  I highly recommend it, it has already become my must have!

reviews.product_name: Retinol Anti-Aging Serum
reviews.review_text: I’ve been using the Inkey List Retinol Anti-Aging Serum for a couple weeks now, and I’m surprised at the noticeable difference in my skin.  In the last week my skin has started looking brighter and more youthful.  I don’t have issues with wrinkles yet, as I am only 37, but lately I have noticed my skin has seemed somewhat dull.  After only several weeks, it is exciting to see how this serum is already improving my skin.

reviews.review_text: I was a little apprehensive about trying these Peace Out Wrinkles patches because“microneedling“ sounded a bit intimidating, but there was no need to worry!  I put these on before I went to bed, and they were so easy to use.  I didn’t have any issues like the other reviewer who said that she had issues with them staying in place.  I used these patches on a couple small wrinkles on my forehead, and after a few uses I could see a noticeable difference.

reviews.review_text: I received a sample of this product, but honestly it was not enough product to make a determination on whether it makes a difference.  I had no bad effects though, and my skin felt good after.

Used it right after cleansing my face and at first swipe, you can feel rejuvenated skin, smooth, subtle and overall quite happy. The scent is very subtle and almost undetectable. Loved incorporating this beauty in my routine and it has def become a staple.

I am 34 with some fine lines (and a deep laugh line on one side of my face). My laugh line is so faint now it’s unnoticeable. Keep at it to see results.

reviews.product_name: Watermelon Glow Niacinamide Dew Drops
reviews.review_text: Glow Recipe Watermelon Glow Niacinamide Dew Drops has a lightweight gel texture without any glitter or shimmer. Such a versatile product - can be used as a serum, primer, mixing with foundation or over make up. I like using it as a serum and I notice it controls oil during the day still being very hydrating. I also tried it as a primer and ended up adding a drop on the high points of my face over make up, and it didn’t mess up my foundation underneath! Just keep in mind the gel is sticky and if you want to use the product this way, make sure to dab off excess. *gifted by Glow Recipe in exchange for my honest opinion

reviews.product_name: Avocado Soothing Skin Barrier Serum with Ceramides
reviews.review_text: My skin is sensitive, so I always need to have something soothing in my skincare routine. This serum works great for my skin. It’s not thick like some other ceramide skincare products, and it doesn’t make my skin greasy. The serum is lightweight, spreads easily and absorbs in seconds. I noticed it definitely reduces redness and calms down my skin. I like applying it the next day after using exfoliating skincare in the night. Also the ingredients list is great! Many ceramide containing products have much lower concentrations. In this serum we see ceramides in the very top of the list. It also packed with Niacinamide, Avocado Oil and Extract. The packaging is stunning! The only thing I’m not a fan of is the scent of fresh cucumbers. Thank goodness it doesn’t linger!

reviews.product_name: Floral Recovery Overnight Mask with Squalane
reviews.review_text: I have oily sensitive skin, and I honestly love this mask! It’s so nourishing and soothing. Doesn’t feel heavy or sticky, absorbs well. Has a gorgeous velvety finish. The packaging is lovely and luxe. Yes, it’s pricey, but you get a generous amount of product!

reviews.product_name: Self Tanning Bronzing Face Drops
reviews.review_text: I like the color it gives, very natural and truly deep. Also it works fast, I can see my skin darker in just an hour. It’s super easy to use, I mix it with my moisturizer. Doesn’t feel tacky, absorbs well and quickly. I am not a fan of the scent that I can’t put my finger on, I’d say it smells almost nutty, better than a typical sunscreen’s scent. Overall, I think this product is decent, above average. Gifted by Isle of Paradise

reviews.product_name: Sugar Lip Balm Hydrating Treatment
reviews.review_text: Love this lip treatment. It is super effective, nourishing and feels extremely comfortable on my lips. It gives a beautiful tint that stays impressively long. Will purchase it in another shade! Gifted by Fresh beauty

Absolutely clear on the skin and also invisible with quick absorption n very pleasantly scent like fresh n clean kinda scent. Easy applying  and love the formula. I do love it and I do highly recommend it!

reviews.product_name: Daily Greens Oil-Free Gel Moisturizer with Moringa and Papaya
reviews.review_text: this is a serious win for oily faces everywhere!! it’s a bit thicker than most gel moisturizers, even honey drop is lighter. BUT this dries faster than any gel i’ve ever tried and has a noticeably matte finish, perfect for combo/oily skin types who feel like dewy = greasy on them (me) this is already one of my favorite moisturizers and i can see myself purchasing it again and again in the future.

reviews.product_name: Avocado Fine Line Eye Cream with Retinol
reviews.review_text: I received this complimentary from Glow Recipe. My under eyes are really easily irritated, but I didn’t experience any irritation while using this, it’s so gentle but effective! I noticed my eyes looked less tired and baggy in the morning within a few days, and the consistency of the cream is super smooth and not heavy at all like some other overnight creams.

reviews.product_name: Watermelon Glow Niacinamide Dew Drops
reviews.review_text: Received complimentary from Glow Recipe. Absorbed quickly but it was very easy to use too much for my oily skin. I find a smaller amount works best for me, and it makes my skin look more nourished and wears wonderfully under makeup! The texture is light and gel-like almost

reviews.product_name: Avocado Soothing Skin Barrier Serum with Ceramides
reviews.review_text: The texture is very light and pleasant but takes a bit of extra rubbing in to sink into the skin, but nothing crazy. I will definitely keep this in my routine as I think it has made my skin look overall healthier and has improved my skin barrier, but I can’t say I’ve noticed any decrease in redness.

reviews.product_name: Vitamin Enriched Face Base Priming Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: Truly a luxurious face cream a bit on the thicker side, but it creates a wonderful base for makeup without being overly heavy or not able to sink into the skin. I do only wear primer and a powder foundation usually but it works great in my makeup routine!

reviews.product_name: Tea Elixir Niacinamide & Hyaluronic Acid Anti-Aging Serum
reviews.review_text: Really nice formula and consistency, I feel a little oilier than usual when I include this in my routine but it may be the order of my products. But this serum is super light and delivers great benefits-my skin is so soft!

reviews.product_name: Daily Greens Oil-Free Gel Moisturizer with Moringa and Papaya
reviews.review_text: I received this product complimentary from Farmacy Beauty, but all thoughts remain my own. As someone with very oily skin, I was so excited to test the new gel moisturizer, especially given its reduced shine claims. In terms of consistency, it’s a wonderfully light gel that melts easily into the skin. There’s a light fragrance, but overall the application is really seamless. However, I don’t find that this actually makes a difference in oil production, especially from the day-to-day. If you were eyeing this specifically for the pore-minimizing/shine-reducing claims, I’d take a second glance. (I’ve tried other toners/serums that have made a difference.) But as a featherlight daily moisturizer, it’s a really solid choice.

reviews.product_name: Watermelon Glow Niacinamide Dew Drops
reviews.review_text: This is a makeup/skincare hybrid that doubles as both a serum and dewy base, gifted to me by Glow Recipe. The packaging is soo lovely —a convenient pump that squeezes out just the right amount of product. The texture is a thick serum that melts instantly into the skin. Really effortless application. It leaves behind a visible glow, but I would describe it as just a pure shine. Nothing slick or slippery. It does “set“ after a while, but still maintains a faint glow. Overall, I’m really loving it as a morning treatment. It wears surprisingly well on my oily skin, (doesn’t accentuate or exacerbate any oiliness), and gives me the dew I’ve always wanted!

reviews.product_name: 5 Stars Retinol + Niacinamide Eye Serum
reviews.review_text: This is actually a really nice eye cream: the texture is thick, rich, and incredibly hydrating, but it melts into the skin instantly. I also find that it has a slight cooling or depuffing effect, and for that reason I love to use it in the mornings. I wish the price point was a bit lower, but it’s truly nourishing — without leaving much tackiness or stickiness either.

reviews.product_name: Sugar Lip Balm Hydrating Treatment
reviews.review_text: I love this lip tint. I really think they reformulated, based on the other fresh lip tints I own from a few years ago. Those all have the same problem: they’re way too soft, and they melt and deform in any sort of heat. It actually makes them messy to bring anywhere and irritating to apply.This new lip tint in plum has none of those problems - the consistency is way firmer, and for that reason it’s way easier to get a consistent layer of pigment. The shade is also soo beautiful — it’s a sheer blackberry, and I could see it working for a whole range of skin tones. Same delicious fruity scent and same hydrating qualities as the old formula. Just a way better and more sophisticated consistency. This was gifted to me by Fresh.

reviews.product_name: Tea Elixir Niacinamide & Hyaluronic Acid Anti-Aging Serum
reviews.review_text: This is such a lovely serum: it’s ultra lightweight, nourishing, hydrating and overall a treat for my oily/combo skin. I really adore how effortlessly it sinks into the sink, and how soothing the application process is. It also has a very calming scent - reminds me of eucalyptus or something similarly fresh and herbal.

reviews.product_name: Clear Improvement Charcoal Honey Mask to Purify and Nourish
reviews.review_text: My all time favourite mask it’s so beautiful it makes my skin feel amazing it’s helped me with my blemishes! Smells so great overall worth the price mine has lasted about a year and I definitely will buy a new one when it runs out!

reviews.product_name: Hello FAB Coconut Water Cream
reviews.review_text: This is so amazing I have pretty oily skin but this just soaks right into your skin and feels so great. I definitely will be never changing I am in love with this product.

reviews.review_text: Very good for double cleansing you will definitely need another cleanser to rinse this off but it does a wonderful job removing makeup and sunscreen from my face.

reviews.product_name: Vinopure Natural Salicylic Acid Pore Minimizing Serum
reviews.review_text: I have acne prone combo skin and was exited to try out this serum and see if it left my skin clearer.  On first glance, it seemed great.  Very lightweight on my fingers and a wonderful smell.  That’s where my excitement ended.  Immediately after smoothing on my skin, I had to grab some moisturizer since the serum was incredibly drying.  I figured that might be normal since it’s supposed to clear up your skin.  Nope, woke up to a smattering of whiteheads along my jawline.  I kept with the serum for a week to see if maybe it was just drawing out impurities, but I never saw any improvement.  Not a product I can recommend.Note:  I received a deluxe sample for free in return for an honest review

reviews.product_name: B-Hydra Intensive Hydration Serum with Hyaluronic Acid
reviews.review_title: Nice addition to my morning routine
reviews.review_text: I’ve been using this is the AM with the C-Firma and I’ve been impressed with how my skin looks and feels.  The product has no discernable scent and applies smoothly and evenly on my skin.  It takes no time to absorb and my makeup goes on well on top of it.  I will say I was expecting my skin to be a bit softer to the touch.  While it looks more hydrated, I didn’t have the physical sensation of my skin being smoother.

reviews.product_name: Umbra Sheer Physical Daily Defense SPF 30
reviews.review_text: After all the negative press non-mineral based sunscreens have been receiving lately, I was excited to try Drunk Elephant’s Umbra Sheer Sunscreen.  The first thing I did when I received it was check out the active ingredients which only lists 20% Zinc Oxide so I believe the brand is committed to formulating clean products.  The sunscreen itself is thicker than I’m used to, but applies evenly and absorbs quickly without leaving a white residue.  Overall a great substitute for chemically based sunscreen.

reviews.product_name: Mini Daily Microfoliant Exfoliator
reviews.review_text: When I received this product, I wasn’t sure what to expect since I’ve never used a dry facial product before.  As I massaged the powder together in my wet hands, it created a paste like substance and when I massaged the paste onto my face, I could only feel the slightest trace of an exfoliant so I was pleasantly surprised how gentle it was on my skin.  After a weeks use, I was amazed how soft my skin was feeling, even before putting on my moisturizer.  I’ve only been using for about two weeks now so I can’t comment on how it can help with brightening, but compared to other exfoliators and microexfoliators I’ve used, I feel like this one has done the best on changing the surface of my skin.  As a tip, your hands need to be very wet when massaging the powder together.  I found using in the shower is more effective than when washing your face at the sink.Note:  I received this product for free in exchange for an honest review.

reviews.product_name: Benefiance Wrinkle Smoothing Eye Cream
reviews.review_text: I’ve been using this eye cream for about a month and it is highly moisturizing.  While that is a good thing, I do feel like I can only apply this in the evening.  The product is so rich that it absorbs slowly and it would be impossible to try and adequately layer eye makeup on if you attempt to use in the am.  If you are strictly looking for a night time eye cream, this is a good one and has helped with the look of my fine lines, but if you want a cream that can do double duty for morning and night, I would look elsewhere.

reviews.product_name: Revitalizing Supreme+ Youth Power Creme Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I received a free sample of this products for an honest review and used it 2xs a day for almost two weeks.  The cream is on the heavier side, but not too thick where I felt it was suffocating my combo skin.  There was no discernible fragrance and it absorbed easily.  I was happy with the amount of moisture it provided and I think it’s gentle enough for anyone with sensitive skin.  My only reservation is for the price point, I would expect to be a bit more wowed by the product.  I’ve tried many different moisturizers from low end to high end and there was nothing about this one that stood out as super special compared to others.  I would happily use it again, but it’s one that I can easily forget as well.

reviews.review_text: I really like this toner! I have rosacea oily acne prone skin and if I use this everyday my skin does start to get very dry and peel a little so I’ve just been using a couple times a week! :)

reviews.product_name: Greek Yoghurt Foaming Cream Cleanser
reviews.review_text: i had a sample of this and loved it so much that i bought two full size bottles during the Sephora sale! it makes my skin feel so clean, soft and hydrated at the same time! i have rosacea+acne+sensitive skin and i’m amazed with how it has minimized redness and cleared my acne AND texture on my skin! my skin has never felt better and never felt this smooth! this is definitely a staple in my skin care routine now :)

reviews.product_name: Oil-Absorbing Pore Treatment Strips
reviews.review_text: I’ve always struggled with big/clogged pores and never tried pore strips (charcoal ones) before because I heard they stripped your skin, UNTIL I found these! These pore strips are life changing and you see the results immediately. I don’t feel any harshness on my face. I use mine all night long while I’m sleeping for maximum results. Upon taking them off, you can see what has been extracted - I even got my boyfriend using them! These are amazing and I plan on continuing to use in the future!! Amazing!!

reviews.product_name: Watermelon Glow Niacinamide Dew Drops
reviews.review_text: I was so excited when I received this product complimentary from Glow Recipe! I love using this as part of my skincare routine before my makeup application! I love the glowy, dewy look it gives my skin! For someone with oily skin, I don’t really prefer a dewy look, but this is the perfect balance. It absorbs so quickly and effortlessly! I’ve been very impressed with this new launch and am so happy I’ve been enjoying!

reviews.product_name: Rose & Hyaluronic Acid Deep Hydration Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I was so happy when I received this moisturizer! I’ve always wanted to try and have been absolutely loving it! It works perfectly with my oily skin & is perfect for summer time! Thank you fresh beauty!

reviews.product_name: Superfood Antioxidant Cleanser
reviews.review_text: I’ve been loving this YTTP cleanser! My face feels so clean after cleansing and knowing it’s a clean skincare product makes me love it even more!

reviews.product_name: Mini Superfood Antioxidant Cleanser

reviews.review_text: I was so excited when I saw I was accepted to try Sunday Riley’s new launch! I’ve been loving the eye cream and absolutely adore the applicator!! I experienced zero irritation, which I’m very happy about! I will be continuing to use! Thank you SR!!!

reviews.product_name: Squalane + Omega Repair Deep Hydration Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I have acne-prone, oily/combo skin. In the winter I’ve noticed the past few years my skin dries out. I love that the brand is cruelty-free and doesn’t contain lots of chemicals. A little goes a long way with this, and it’s ultra hydrating. It has not caused me to break out, and I’ve seen a little bit of improvement in my skin coloring and rosacea. I received this product complimentary for sampling purposes but all opinions are my own.

reviews.product_name: Greek Yoghurt Nourishing Probiotic Gel-Cream
reviews.review_text: I used this out of the shower on clean skin. It is a little thicker and creamy with a sort of yogurty smell. I liked how hydrated it made my skin feel, and how easily it massaged into my face. I have sensitive, acne-prone skin, and it didn’t irritate it or break me out!

reviews.product_name: Clear Sunscreen Stick SPF 50+
reviews.review_text: I like stick sunscreen because it’s easy and convenient.  This glides on and has a subtle smell.  It feels good on my skin and doesn’t make my skin feel greasy or tinted!

reviews.product_name: Advanced Night Repair Eye Concentrate Matrix Synchronized Multi-Recovery Complex
reviews.review_text: I received a tester sample and loved the bottle and little applicator. I haven’t noticed a huge difference under my eyes,  maybe I need to use it longer term.  However it feels cool and luxurious as part of my nighttime ritual before bed!

reviews.product_name: 5 Stars Retinol + Niacinamide Eye Serum
reviews.review_text: First of all I love the packaging of this product. The eye cream feels really creamy and a medium thickness that was easy to apply on my under eye area and on the corners of my eyes. I have sensitive skin and had no breakouts or irritation noted. It was gentle to use every day and I think has decreased the lines under my eyes after a few weeks!

reviews.product_name: Cicapair Tiger Grass Color Correcting Treatment SPF 30
reviews.review_text: WOW this product is a life-changer! I was honestly so skeptical that this would work, I have really red skin and hypepigmentation from acne marks. However, this helps my skin look so much better PLUS it has SPF! I love wearing this on days that I don’t want to do a full foundation. It is a little thick, but I have acne prone skin and it hasn’t broken me out yet. It would be nice to using something lighter on days that you don’t want to apply such a thick product to your skin tho. But overall I’ll give it 5 stars because it helped so much with my redness!!

reviews.product_name: Facial Treatment Essence (Pitera Essence)
reviews.review_text: I received this product complimentary from Influenster for my honest review! I don’t know exactly what it is, but there is just something about SK-II’s essences that make them so magical! My skin always glows after I apply their essences and this one was no exception. It offers a lot of hydation upon application, you do feel like drinking a shot of water right away. My skin is very sensitive, but I have no problem with this product. It’s very gentle and safe to the skin. However, that hydrating feeling goes away fairly fast. I’m not sure what this cream offers to the skin, besides the fun gimmick of having a white cream turning into watery texture. I don’t see any active ingredients that are notable in this. There’s definitely not enough occlusives in this cream to trap in the moister. I think this is just another way chemical companies try to trick people to buy products, because you might like the feeling of trying it on at first. It offers no long term benefits to the skin, nor does it do anything really.

reviews.product_name: Mini The Water Cream
reviews.review_text: I love the texture of this cream a lot. It’s very light and fluffy, turns into watery substance up on touching the skin. It offers a lot of hydation upon application, you do feel like drinking a shot of water right away. My skin is very sensitive, but I have no problem with this product. It’s very gentle and safe to the skin. However, that hydrating feeling goes away fairly fast. I’m not sure what this cream offers to the skin, besides the fun gimmick of having a white cream turning into watery texture. I don’t see any active ingredients that are notable in this. There’s definitely not enough occlusives in this cream to trap in the moister. I think this is just another way chemical companies try to trick people to buy products, because you might like the feeling of trying it on at first. It offers no long term benefits to the skin, nor does it do anything really.

reviews.product_name: U.F.O. Salicylic Acid BHA Acne Treatment Face Oil
reviews.review_text: This is seriously the most amazingly smell ever. it’s exactly like the Tom Ford jasmine rouge, which is $500 a bottle or something close. I would buy this just for the perfume all day. It’s so good. Product is effective, texture super nice and fast absorbing. All around awesome.

reviews.product_name: Aqua Bomb Hydrating Toner
reviews.review_text: This toner does have simply ingredients, no harsh chemicals, less irritants. It feels nice on my face but it also doesn’t do anything other than hydrating. Toner is one of my favorite steps in my routine, and I like to pack some skin loving galactomyces or other easily absorbed ferminted goodness in there. My skin drinks up the toner in the morning so I want to make it count. I got this as a free sample, but wouldn’t purchase, because for this price. You can get either a Sephora brand spray for $10, or many other fun toners sprays that have simple ingredients for much less. I don’t like to waste any steps in my routine.

reviews.product_name: B-Hydra Intensive Hydration Serum with Hyaluronic Acid
reviews.review_title: nice to layer with vitamin C. Not great by itself
reviews.review_text: I’m a big product junkie and love layering different products together. One of my favorite active is Vitamin C, but unfortunately C doesn’t combine so well with others especially B3 niacinamine. This B5 is recommend to be paired with the C serum, so I got very excited to find a friend for my vitamin C to play with.  It does enhance the brightening properties of the c creams, and hydrate fairly well. They compliment each other in a way, that you really don’t need to add much anything else other than a cream on top to trap everything in. However, this B-hydra don’t do much by itself. It doesn’t brighten on it’s own. For hydration I can get from my toner and other much cheaper products like a hyaluronic acid. For the price tag, I find it a little expensive for just a best friend of a work horse active. But if you don’t mind spending the $, this is super fun to pair and layer.

reviews.product_name: Cream Skin Toner & Moisturizer
reviews.review_title: did not work in my routine. gimmicky.
reviews.review_text: When this came out and sold out so fast on Sephora, I felt I couldn’t afford to miss it when it became available again. Now after using for a few week, I must say Im no impressed. First of all, this is NOT a toner. Its a liquid moisturizer. Im the biggest hoarder of toners(about 20 bottles in my collection right now). I’ve rarely bought a toner I don’t like. Even if they are not the best, I would try to make it work somehow. Not this one, because the texture is just way too heavy. I feel like I can’t really follow up, and layer with my serums and essences on top, because this is already like a cream. if I use this after my serums, my products would getting flooded. It’s very moisturizing on it’s own, but I need more in my routine, such as a vitamin c. You still need to follow this up with another cream anyway, because the occlusive properties of this is not significant enough to trap the moister. you will end up doing a cream twice, rendering this one redundant. I think this could work if you want a super simple skin care routine. In which case, I guess, this saves one step. Overall, I find this cream toner to be a gimmicky product from a huge skin care brand to sell product under the pretenses of uniqueness. I will most likely use this on my neck and body.

reviews.product_name: Luna Sleeping Retinoid Night Oil
reviews.review_text: I love this retinol. It’s very unique in its application, where it’s a oil instead of cream like most retinol on the market. it absorbs quickly and very calming going on the skin. extremely hydrating sort term. I love how my skin wakes up super soft and smooth in the morning because of the blue tansy in the ingredients. Long term, I noticed my little fine lines plumped and skin elasticity improving, especially around the lips area. You can see results pretty right away upon first application, and lines demised after about 2 weeks. A little goes a long way with this oil, because you really only need about 2/3 drops to get the whole face. I really love the smell also, which reminds me of a Italian herb garden. All in all, one of my top 5 retinols.

reviews.product_name: Mini A-Passioni Retinol Cream
reviews.review_title: Love the retinol, stop making me buy the B-hydra
reviews.review_text: I’ve heard about the DE retinol for quiet sometime, but didn’t want to commit to the investment of full price, especially since I have about 4/5 AMAZing retinols I tried and LOVEd so much that I rotated in and out. When this value pack became available, I had to get it since it’s a great opportunity for me to try it finally at a sample size pricing. I wish I didn’t have to get the B hydra with it. I think DE is having a lot of problem selling the B, because it’s literally in ever sample package they try to jam us with. Whatever, it’s worth it for me just to get a taste of the amazing retinol. I love it, and it’s up there with all my favs. I will get the full size once I finish with the mini.

reviews.product_name: A-Passioni Retinol Cream
reviews.review_text: This retinol is very effective and does everything a retinol suppose to do. However, you have to really get adjusted. I’ve been using various retinol for years, but getting use to this took me over a month. I had peeling, rash and burn in the beginning. However, Patience paid off as it’s now one of my favorites.

reviews.product_name: Mini Superberry Hydrate + Glow Dream Mask
reviews.review_text: im not sure what’s in here that stings my face, but it always starts to burn after 20 mins of my trying to put it on. my face does feel nice and soft after, so I do like it. I wish I could use it as a night mask, but unfortunately it couldn’t do it after several tries. 4 stars for the high pricing, as I see better masks for cheaper.

reviews.product_name: Superberry Hydrate + Glow Dream Night Mask with Vitamin C
reviews.review_text: im not sure what’s in here that stings my face, but it always starts to burn after 20 mins of my trying to put it on. my face does feel nice and soft after, so I do like it. I wish I could use it as a night mask, but unfortunately it couldn’t do it after several tries. 4 stars for the high pricing, as I see better masks for cheaper.

reviews.product_name: AHA 30% + BHA 2% Exfoliating Peeling Solution
reviews.review_text: This is all over instagram and I finally gave in and got it. I liked it and it does its job, but it’s just a aha solution and nothing too special. I like the pricing. It could be a little intense for my face these days so I also use it on my legs.

reviews.product_name: Avocado Soothing Skin Barrier Serum with Ceramides
reviews.review_text: Like all other Glow recipe stuff, this didn’t do much of its lofty claims. However, it’s average and hydrating, the smell is lovely. They are showing up in boxycharm’s pop up for 50% off.

reviews.product_name: Benefiance Wrinkle Smoothing Eye Cream
reviews.review_text: I have used Shiseido products for years and am a big fan. This wrinkle smoothing eye cream is so good. It has literally made some of my minor crows feet disappear. My eye area looks bright and supple with a healthy glow. When I’m done applying my eye cream I dab my lips so they can benefit as well.

reviews.product_name: Salicylic Acid Acne + Pore Cleanser
reviews.review_text: I like this gel cleanser as it foams nicely to really clean out my pores. The addition of salicylic acid has helped to clear most of my blemishes though I only suffer from minor acne. I like that this cleanser has good, clean ingredients and no artificial scent.

reviews.product_name: Retinol Reform Treatment Serum
reviews.review_text: This Retinol Reform serum has made a noticeable difference in the texture of my skin. I love it because it has a clean formula but actually works too! My skin is softer and smoother. My dark spots have faded a bit too. It is gentle on my skin and has not caused any acne. I love it!

reviews.product_name: Mini Retinol Reform
reviews.review_text: This Retinol Reform serum has made a noticeable difference in the texture of my skin. I love it because it has a clean formula but actually works too! My skin is softer and smoother. My dark spots have faded a bit too. It is gentle on my skin and has not caused any acne. I love it!

reviews.product_name: Skinlongevity Long Life Herb Anti-Aging Face Serum
reviews.review_text: I received this as a sample. While it made my skin feel soft and hydrated I cannot attest to the long term effects of the product. It does feel good though!

reviews.product_name: Good Genes All-In-One AHA Lactic Acid Treatment
reviews.review_text: I am shocked at how much my skin has transformed by using Good Genes. My congestion has cleared up faster with this product than with any other product I’ve tried. Because of the oily texture my skin is not drying out one bit. My skin feels so soft and some of my baby fine lines have disappeared.  My best friend said my skin has improved and looks healthier. Total wonder product! Gifted by Sunday Riley.

reviews.product_name: Avocado Soothing Skin Barrier Serum with Ceramides
reviews.review_text: My skin absolutely loves this serum! After I apply it, my skin feels super soft and hydrated. This is also very soothing to my sometimes inflamed skin.  The scent is lovely, very light. Glow Recipe has done it again, so great!

reviews.product_name: Confidence in a Cream Anti-Aging Hydrating Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: This IT Cosmetics Confidence in a Cream is a nice face cream. I love the way it feels on my skin. It adds moisture to my skin while offering anti-aging benefits. This updated formula is supercharged with Ceramides, Peptides, Hyaluronic Acid, and Niacinamide. I love that this cream absorbs well because I have combination skin and sometimes face cream can make me oily. Since I have been using this my skin is softer and smoother. I have had great results. My only complaint is that the scent. While I like the way it smells, it is a bit too strong. Overall, I like this cream and recommend it.

reviews.product_name: Beste No. 9 Jelly Cleanser
reviews.review_title: Not an Every day rinse, but still a great cleanser
reviews.review_text: I truly love this cleanse. I have combination skin. I tried to use it daily, but it left me to dry so I started using it about twice a week and Used my Honest daily cleanser and my skin felt Amazing! Nice, clean and smooth! I don’t have a lot of acne, but it works well for my skin! ☺️

reviews.product_name: Caffeine 5% + EGCG Depuffing Eye Serum
reviews.review_title: Helped a lot for my Puffy eyes!
reviews.review_text: I purchased this because at times I tend to suffer from having puffy eyes, and this product helped me out so much for that.I can’t justify for dark circles just because I didn’t really have dark circles from the beginning, but I will say the my under eye looks more vibrant (:Great product! I mainly use it for my daytime routine, and sometimes at night.

reviews.product_name: Vegan Milk Moisturizer
reviews.review_title: Enjoyed it. mainly used it as a Night cream.
reviews.review_text: This product can be thick so if you have oily or even combo skin I do recommend using a method where you dab small amounts around your face before spreading it all around. Overall, I used this as my night cream moisturizer and I loved it so much! Felt like my face started to look smooth!

reviews.product_name: Honeymoon Glow AHA Resurfacing Night Serum
reviews.review_text: I loved this product. It legit felt like my skin was glowing way more than before and I could tell how smooth my skin was after the first few weeks and being consistent with my skin care routine.Cons: The scent of the serum is strong. It has like a woodsy/grassy smell. I was able to tolerate it and I feel like I can just dismiss it now lol.Disclosure on my skin: I have combo to normal skin. Sensitive skin. Fairly clear skin until TOM comes around.

reviews.product_name: Superberry Hydrate + Glow Dream Night Mask with Vitamin C
reviews.review_text: I personally enjoyed this product for my night time routine just because I read on how well the moisture is for this product. I did use this product during the winter time and I tend to just try up pretty nasty so this worked well for me lol.I will say that I used this with my Farmacy Honeymoon glow night serum and I ended up with good results! (:

I had to scrub and add more balm in order to remove my waterproof my make-up but it did a good job for that. My thing was is that even though it does remove my make up I could still see plenty of residue from my foundation when I was done washing my face pretty heavy. So, I still had to use my cleanser to remove any residue that was left. I think for it stating to remove the residue and being a cleanser it is priced a little high so that was a “ehhhh” for me, but I can’t pretend that I don’t love the feel when I am removing my make-up. A Solid 4 for me!

reviews.product_name: Multi-Peptide + HA Serum
reviews.review_text: Personally loved this serum. I used it as a night and sometimes day time routine. Felt like with worked well with most of my moisturizers and I could tell how well it repaired my skin for the healthy look. This one is definitely a repurchase! (:

reviews.product_name: Ultra Repair Cream Intense Hydration
reviews.review_text: I have been using the First Aid Beauty Ultra repair cream intense hydration for about 2 months now. I originally bought the small ounce bottle and fell in love with the product and I immediately bought the 6 ounce. - It hydrates- No grease feeling- Left my skin looking smoothAll I could say if you do have oily skin, the hydration may be a bit too much, but for my combo skin/sensitive I felt like it was fine. I would definitely repurchase this product (:

reviews.product_name: Retinol Anti-Aging Serum
reviews.review_title: Left my skin with an even texture!
reviews.review_text: This is the Inkey List Retinol anti aging serum. Purchased it because I wanted to see how well it would help for with uneven texture and dullness, but it became my favorite. The results were amazing and for me the price for it is pretty affordable. They offer two different size bottles and both are affordable in pricing. It’s actually for all skin types too so I say test it out if y’all want. It’s my favorite for my night time routine!

reviews.product_name: GOOPGLOW Microderm Instant Glow Exfoliator
reviews.review_text: Sent complimentary from Goop - A facial in a tub! That’s what I have to say about this! Seriously - my skin has NEVER look smoother and brighter ever before! I know the price tag is quite something but you have to use such a tiny little bit that this will last you ages!! I was gifted this from the brand but would def repurchase on my own!
