reviews.product_name: Watermelon Pink Juice Oil-Free Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: First time venturing into the world of Glow Recipe and I’m in love. Chicago winters are brutal and even though it’s just fall right now - this has been a life saver and a game changer! My skin is always left feeling hydrated from within and I’ve noticed it getting better with use! Love the sleek packaging, the branding and scent and the general vibe of the brand! Can’t wait to try out more products! Complimentary from Glow Recipe

reviews.product_name: Watermelon Glow Niacinamide Dew Drops
reviews.review_text: Insanely hydrating! Chicago winters are brutal and this one hydrates your skin so well without having your makeup slip here and there! Can’t rate the unique packaging enough! Looks super sleek on my vanity and for those insta shots too! Product sent complimentary from Glow Recipe for  testing purposes.

reviews.product_name: Avocado Soothing Skin Barrier Serum with Ceramides
reviews.review_text: Gimme all the avocados. On my face, in my body - I mean in a fan. Love everything by the brand and this is no exception. With the Sephora sale looming this will be a repurchase for me for sure! This post partum mamas skin just soaks it up.

reviews.product_name: Rose & Hyaluronic Acid Deep Hydration Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: Love everything by fresh and this is no exception. This has truly become my fav skincare brand - everything I’ve tried has been so on point. As a post partum mama I rarely have time to do elaborate skin care regimens anymore and this packs a punch.

reviews.product_name: Barrier+ Triple Lipid-Peptide Face Cream
reviews.review_text: Made the biggest difference to my skin. This is such a killer moisturizer - just need one pump for my face and neck and I’m feelin pump and hydrated all day. Barely any scent- love the top push mechanism for getting it out as well!

reviews.product_name: Mini Barrier+ Triple Lipid-Peptide Face Cream
reviews.review_text: Made the biggest difference to my skin. This is such a killer moisturizer - just need one pump for my face and neck and I’m feelin pump and hydrated all day. Barely any scent- love the top push mechanism for getting it out as well!

reviews.product_name: 5 Stars Retinol + Niacinamide Eye Serum
reviews.review_text: First time using any Sunday Riley profit and I now know why people are always hyping this up!!! Can’t wait to try more from the brand since this is phenomenal. Anyone getting into regional would love this especially its ease of use.

reviews.product_name: Vitamin Enriched Face Base Priming Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: Now I k ow why classics are classics - it’s always for a reason. I think I’ve known about this cream since years but never got a chance to try it - love it!!! Can’t believe it hasn’t been in my rotation since so long! Beautiful texture, great hydration and works wonderfully underneath makeup!

reviews.product_name: Sugar Lip Balm Hydrating Treatment
reviews.review_text: Always love these little tubes of goodness. They’re so so moisturizing and you get the most beautifulTint too. Perfect for the no makeup makeup look or to reapply after a meal out. Can’t recommend them enough Gifted by fresh

reviews.product_name: Hydra Zen Gel-Cream Oil-Free Moisturizer with Salicylic Acid
reviews.review_text: I love the scent of this moisturizer - it’s soft and floral. So pretty! The gel is incredibly moisturizing and lasts all day. My face feels smooth and looks more alive. I received this complimentary but opinions are my own.

reviews.product_name: The Essence Skincare Boosting Treatment
reviews.review_text: The bottle makes it easy to control how much comes out and the essence did make my pores seem smaller. Other than that I didn’t see much difference. I received it complimentary from Influenster but all opinions are my own.

reviews.product_name: Mini The Essence  Skincare Boosting Treatment
reviews.review_text: The bottle makes it easy to control how much comes out and the essence did make my pores seem smaller. Other than that I didn’t see much difference. I received it complimentary from Influenster but all opinions are my own.

reviews.product_name: Violet-C Brightening Serum 20% Vitamin C + 10% AHA
reviews.review_text: Thick and goes on easy. Doesn’t dry out skin or leave it oily. Has a nice scent. Didn’t see much of a difference after using for over a week. I received this complimentary from Influenster but all opinions are my own.

reviews.product_name: Papaya Sorbet Smoothing Enzyme Cleansing Balm & Makeup Remover
reviews.review_text: Great way to get your makeup and other products off your face before washing! Easy to use and feels nice on your skin!

reviews.product_name: Auto Correct Brightening + Depuffing Eye Cream for Dark Circles
reviews.review_text: This cream is so creamy! It glides on smooth and soaks into the skin. I could see a difference using it on mornings I was extra tired.

reviews.product_name: ICE Ceramide Moisturizer with Vitamin F
reviews.review_text: I love this stuff! It feels thick when you are applying it but doesn’t feel thick on your skin. It moisturizes so well and makes your skin feel great!

reviews.product_name: Vitamin Enriched Face Base Priming Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I love this base. It goes on so smooth and leaves your skin feeling soft! It has a good, creamy thickness and a light, kind of sweet scent. It melts into your skin and gives you a really good base for makeup. I’m a big fan!

reviews.product_name: Magic Cream Moisturizer with Hyaluronic Acid
reviews.review_title: Feels great and gives natural glow!
reviews.review_text: I love the texture of this magic cream! It’s light but you can feel the moisture instantly. It has a pleasant smell and the packaging is gorgeous - definitely one you keep out in the counter! My skin looked refreshed and full of life after just one use!

reviews.product_name: Watermelon Glow Niacinamide Sunscreen SPF 50
reviews.review_text: This has a nice scent to it mixed with a bit of sunscreen smell. It definitely gave my skin a nice glow and absorbed easily. I work in small sections instead of rubbing it all over at once. Feels nice on the skin and makes my skin feel soft!

reviews.product_name: Glowscreen Sunscreen SPF 40 PA+++ with Hyaluronic Acid + Niacinamide
reviews.review_text: I am obsessed with this sunscreen! It gives you the perfect amount of dewy, glowing color and absorbs nicely. It’s a great base for makeup - I actually don’t even need foundation when wearing it! I also love how it makes me skin feel soft.

reviews.product_name: Sugar Lip Balm Hydrating Treatment
reviews.review_text: I absolutely love Fresh Sugar Lip Treatment!! I’ve used the original and rosé before and have always been a big fan. The plum is just as amazing! The color is a fun, berry that can give you a light pinkish purplish color and is buildable! I like doing a few coats for a bolder color. Great texture and lasting moisture! Gifted by Fresh.

reviews.product_name: Confidence in a Cream Anti-Aging Hydrating Moisturizer
reviews.review_title: Great moisturizer for all skin types
reviews.review_text: This moisturizer is so creamy!! It glides on easily and gives your skin a healthy boost. My face looks hydrated and more radiant after using it. I’ve noticed my make up lasts longer and stays more vibrant when this is underneath! Really happy with the results so far and will continue to use it!!

reviews.product_name: The True Cream Moisturizing Bomb
reviews.review_text: This moisturiser is the best product I jave used on my combo skin. It work’s great year round. I have been using this consistently for a year. I use it a.m. and p.m. and get burst of hydration to my skin. However, I don’t like the packaging. It looks like you are getting more product than you are and when you open the product it’s half the size of the product, which I don’t like. I don’t like the price of the product  only due to I purchase this product every 3 weeks. People often ask me how or your using too much product but when I say I use it a.m. and p.m. they understand how I use it and have to purchase it every 3 weeks. I find that if the packaging was consistent and didn’t change halfway through and you got the full amount of product and not half the product I wouldn’t be as annoyed. However, I do like this product but I would like it if I didn’t go through it as much or as often.

reviews.product_name: Lippe Balm
reviews.review_text: This is best product I have used for my lips. The formula is not sticky and applies on smooth. I don’t like the packaging. The product needs to be smaller, I find it difficult to apply. However, this is the best lip balm I have used. The formula is hydrating and moisturizing. With one use my lips are softer, smoother, plumber and moisturized.

reviews.product_name: Luminous Dewy Skin Mist
reviews.review_text: I’m obsessed with this spray! It gives my skin that natural dewy finish. The formula is not sticky and is lightweight on my skin. It has a smell however, it’s not overwhelming and is a nice herbal smell. It hydrates my skin throughout the day and acts as a nice refresher if I need a pick me up. I purchased the travel spray instead of the full size to test it and see if it works for my sensitive combination skin. I definitely like this product and I am concerning on purchasing the full size, it’s the price I can seem to get past however, I definitely would purchase the travel spray.

reviews.product_name: Luminous Dewy Skin Mist
reviews.review_text: I enjoy this dewy skin mist. I like my foundation dewy and this achieves what I like as a finish. The mist is light weight and it doesn’t leave a cast on my skin. I don’t use this daily since it is expensive. It’s definitely a  favorite. The only issue I have is that it’s expensive for a spray.

reviews.product_name: Blue Tansy BHA and Enzyme Pore Refining Mask
reviews.review_text: This mask is incredible! I have normal to combination skin with some sensitivities. I decided to purchase this mask based on the over 700 reviews and that over 540 of them are 5 star reviews. I have normal skin when it comes to acne. However, I do get hormonal cyst, which are definitely my main skin care concern. I tend to get these cysts in my t zone area, especially on my chin and the only thing that seems to be effective is getting in injected by my dermatologist. These constant reoccurring hormonal cyst have raised my concern for scaring and texture. I got this mask recently and have used it 3 times. I know that’s not a ton of time using it but I have noticed just in 3 uses that it has cleared up most of those stubborn blackheads on my noise and the t zone around my noise. It has helped to reduce texture from previous cysts as well on my chin. When I first applied the blue tansy mask it did sting and I did experience a burning sensation but haven’t used AHA’s and BHA’s in awhile. I’m assuming it was from that. The second use I didn’t experience any burning sensation. You do have a slight stinging sensation, which is more of a tingling sensation. This mask doesn’t smell the best from it being natural ingredients. The smells not bad enough to make me not want to use it and you get used to it. Definitely will continue to use this! It seems to be effective and doing what the product claims to!

reviews.product_name: Sugar Hydrating Lip Balm
reviews.review_text: This smells so incredibly delicious! This is my ideal coconut scent! As for the product I like it.... I’m sure you figured that out. I would prefer this coconut lip balm in a gloss or a solid balm like the sugar collection. I’m not a person that likes products that you have to put your fingers in.... it’s not my favorite.

reviews.product_name: Vinopure Natural Salicylic Acid Pore Minimizing Serum
reviews.review_text: I have been using this serum for 3 day’s and let me say I am impressed! In 3 day’s my pores are smaller, my skin looks smoother and my pores look incredible! I get those stubborn blackheads on my nose and I’m sure you understand me when I say they are a pain to get rid of. This serum has helped my pores dramatically and rapidly. I use this with my Drunk Elephant C-firma serum and I’m all for it! I did use both serum on day 1 and switched it on day 2 and 3, only using this serum to see if there would be a difference and I didn’t notice anything different from using the 2 products compared to one over the other. The smell is light and fresh. The serum didn’t irritate my sensitive combination skin, which is a plus. The texture of this serum is smooth and silky. It feels like water on the skin. It’s hydrating and smells minty when applied. Personally, I have normal skin when it comes to acne though I do get hormonal cysts, which I go to a dermatologist for so I’m hoping this serum does what it claims and helps kill the bad bacteria while dissolves the dead skin cells that cause these hormonal cysts. In a short period of use, it seems to be going good thus far. I definitely would recommend it for combination acne prone skin or any skin type really!

reviews.product_name: Salicylic Acid Acne Healing Dots
reviews.review_text: These are incredible! They work so well for me and help suck up the gunk from my pores. I have sensitive combination skin and these work so good. I get hormonal cysts and when I have a cyst coming on I put one of these on and it sucks up the gunk and brings a head to the surface. I have repurchased like 6 to 7 of these. I’m so impressed. I have purchased everything from this brand the dots, the nose strips, the eye patches and everything has me impressed. I would definitely recommend these. If this brand offered other products I would definitely purchase them and would enjoy to see them come out with different sheet mask to help with inflammation, hydration, anything!

reviews.product_name: Lip Glowy Balm
reviews.review_text: I purchased the pear lip bomb and I will say the formula is good but it’s definitely different compared to the original. The formula in this seem more liquid like I see liquid in the package. I’m not sure if it’s supposed to be more watery or not but it is definitely watery. I do noticed that this does hydrate my lips well and the formula is lightweight so that’s a plus. With that in mind, this formula is more glossy compared to the original, in my opinion. I prefer glossy lips so for my personal preference I enjoy when my lips look like water and I have that glass like finish to my lips. I’m not sure if people who don’t enjoy lip gloss will like this product. As for the pear scent, it’s not my personal favorite. I would like to purchase the original berry scent to see if that would make  a difference for me to enjoy the product more. I’m sensitive to scents and the pear scent is just too overwhelming for me. I enjoy that original lip mask and the scent but this packaging is what I have been waiting!

reviews.product_name: Hyaluronic Acid Hydrating Serum
reviews.review_text: This is so good! I have combination skin and this gives me hydration where I need it but dosen’t make me look oily in my t zone. The formula is so lightweight, non sticky, non irritating to sensitive skin and it dosen’t clog my pores! I enjoy using this prior to makeup application as it gives my skin a burst of hydration! Plus you can get it for a great price!

reviews.product_name: Balancing Force Oil Control Toner
reviews.review_text: I have combination skin and acne prone. I enjoy using this toner. I definitely feel like it’s deep cleaning / clearing the gunk out of my pores. The formula is lightweight and dosen’t feel oily or makes skin have a residue. It feels cooling on the skin leaving a fresh minty sensation. I will say it’s definitely more abrasive compared to the Pixi glow tonic. I don’t have super sensitive skin but I do have sensitivity. The formula does have a tingling sensation but I personally don’t mind that. I will say it can slightly sting if you have an open cut or if you have irritated skin. This product doesn’t make my skin irritated or red but I have noticed it depends on what facial cotton I’m using. For instance, if I’m using a cheaper cotton round I do get red and irritated when gliding the cotton on my skin. With that in mind, I don’t have any redness or irritation when I use the Shiseido facial cotton pads. I’m not sure why cotton would make that big of a difference but it definitely does! I would recommend this toner if you have acne or cystic acne. The ingredients are great for keeping your pores clean and your skin clear!

reviews.product_name: Caffeine Eye Cream
reviews.review_text: This is incredible! The formula of this is so lightweight and hydrating! It blends in completely and doesn’t leave a residue on your skin. Plus, it dosen’t ball up like other products I have used. My eyes feel so plump and hydrated. The formula looks great with makeup on too. You don’t need much product so this will be around for a while too. I can’t get over the quality especially for the price! I enjoy this one over some of my high end eye creams. For instance, origins and belif. Why wouldn’t you purchase it for the price? It’s incredible!

reviews.product_name: The Rice Polish Foaming Enzyme Powder
reviews.review_text: The formula is incredible! It cleanses and exfoliates my skin so well. I enjoy that formula. It foams up but it’s a light foam or lather. I use this 2 to 3x a week. It’s so gentle on the skin. I don’t experience any inflammation and rednes. I enjoy that this exfoliator is like a spa experience.

reviews.product_name: Niacinamide 10% + Zinc 1% Oil Control Serum
reviews.review_text: I have been enjoying this serum for inflammation and hormonal cysts. It helps calm redness caused by inflammation as well. The serum is so lightweight and feels like water. It does have fragrance in it so that’s incredible. I have no issues with it causing acne or any irritation to my skin. I do have combination skin which is getting dryer with the cold weather. As for the amount of product you get the smaller bottle lasted awhile for me with daily use in the a.m. and p.m.. I just repurchased another bottle of this.

reviews.product_name: Good Genes All-In-One AHA Lactic Acid Treatment
reviews.review_title: Good Genes is my skin saver!
reviews.review_text: I had oily and acne-prone skin with dry, flaky patches last winter when I started using Good Genes. Only a month later, those dry patches were gone and my skin texture had improved tremendously. Lighter hyperpigmentation, smaller pores, and my face is now less oily. I use Good Genes with A+ and CEO cream as my bedtime skin regimen.

reviews.product_name: Luna Sleeping Retinoid Night Oil
reviews.review_text: I started using this oil together with CEO Glow before bed. Both oils absorb quickly into my skin, but there is still a sheen to my face. I use these two oils along with drugstore moisturizer and the combo seems to keep dryness and breakouts at bay for me. I  am not sure if the Luna does any wonders on my skin, but I do notice my hyperpigmentation is lighter and less clogged pores with this combo. I am very pleased and getting more and more confident I’m not wearing foundation.

reviews.product_name: C.E.O. 15% Vitamin C Brightening Serum
reviews.review_title: Great serum for brightening your skin!
reviews.review_text: I ran out of this Vit C serum so fast as I would wear it morning and night. I could see my skin brightening up within weeks of using it. Many people noticed the change, too! Not only it reduced hyperpigmentation, it also reduced the appearance of my large pores. It didn’t break me out and I could wear it under my makeup (unlike the CEO Glow Oil).

reviews.product_name: Cicapair Tiger Grass Color Correcting Treatment SPF 30
reviews.review_text: I like that the balm has SPF, but it applies a little on the thicker side. I find that it makes my oily skin even more oilier, and my makeup doesn’t stay as long as the Cicapair Camo Drops.

reviews.product_name: Mini Cicapair Tiger Grass Color Correcting Treatment SPF 30
reviews.review_text: I like that the balm has SPF, but it applies a little on the thicker side. I find that it makes my oily skin even more oilier, and my makeup doesn’t stay as long as the Cicapair Camo Drops.

reviews.product_name: Green Clean Makeup Removing Cleansing Balm
reviews.review_title: Best cleansing balm in the market!
reviews.review_text: I can say enough about this fantastic cleansing balm! I was suffering from acne, dry & flakey patches around my mouth, and just really bad skin in general last winter when I stumbled upon a sample of Green Clean. It brought me to religiously commit to a 3 step cleansing routine (balm, cleanser, toner) because the balm gently melted off my makeup without making my already troubled skin feel dry or more irritated. I finally had hope my skin condition could improve, and it did after using the Green Clean and the other Farmacy products i.e. Clean Bee, Honey Potion, and Honey Drop. My 36 yr old skin just cannot be any happier!

reviews.product_name: Green Clean Makeup Meltaway Cleansing Balm Limited Edition Jumbo
reviews.review_title: Best cleansing balm in the market!
reviews.review_text: I can say enough about this fantastic cleansing balm! I was suffering from acne, dry & flakey patches around my mouth, and just really bad skin in general last winter when I stumbled upon a sample of Green Clean. It brought me to religiously commit to a 3 step cleansing routine (balm, cleanser, toner) because the balm gently melted off my makeup without making my already troubled skin feel dry or more irritated. My 36 yr old skin just cannot be any happier!

reviews.product_name: Facial Treatment Essence (Pitera Essence)
reviews.review_text: I personally think that the essence works much better if used with the lotion (toner) and, honestly, the rest of the SKii system. My skin has gotten so much softer after using the cleanser, toner, essence, and lotion for a week, twice daily (with spf during the day).

reviews.product_name: Mini Facial Treatment Essence (Pitera Essence)
reviews.review_text: I personally think that the essence works much better if used with the lotion (toner) and, honestly, the rest of the SKii system. My skin has gotten so much softer after using the cleanser, toner, essence, and lotion for a week, twice daily (with spf during the day).

reviews.product_name: Magic Cream Moisturizer with Hyaluronic Acid
reviews.review_text: You only need VERY little amount to hydrate your skin. The packaging is beautiful & the scent is so nice and not overpowering. I love it. But, with my oily skin, I’m not a big fan a moisturizer in form of a thick cream. My mom has dry, mature skin and her skin seems to benefit most of this CT Magic Cream. She reported that her skin stayed hydrated for hours and feels more supple after one week of daily use (morning & night).

reviews.product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C
reviews.review_title: Very good for extremely dry and chapped lips
reviews.review_text: I have extremely dry and chapped lips and am always on the lookout for good lip balm. I bought trial size of this as well as the other Agave lip mask. My initial impression wasn’t great on the first day but then I realized that I just used the sheer layer from the top layer of the product jar. I gave it another run for 3-4 days and it’s really really good. Gives me softer lips longer than any other balm. This also has more lasting results than Agave mask. Agave mask is good as long as it is on the lips but this one has longer lasting results.I do have to keep reapplying the both but I need less applications of this.This is a great night time lip mask and can also be used a thin layer like a balm during the day.

reviews.product_name: Ultra Repair Cream Intense Hydration
reviews.review_text: This cream hydrates without feeling greasy or tacky. This works well on dry dry and sensitive skin though if there is roughness

reviews.product_name: Protini Polypeptide Firming Refillable Moisturizer
reviews.review_title: Excellent moisturizer with multitude of benefits
reviews.review_text: This is absolutely wonderful moisturizer, full of peptides and good for skin ingredients. It absorbs well, plums

reviews.product_name: Adaptogen Deep Moisturizing Cream with Ashwagandha + Reishi
reviews.review_text: This is a nice moisturizer but a little light. It absorbs well and feels nice on the skin but wasn’t enough for me. Good to mix with other oils and moisturizers because my skin felt bit dry only after couple of hours of applying it. Might be a good moisturizer on it’s own for summer months especially for oilier skin folks.

reviews.product_name: Mini Adaptogen Deep Moisture Cream with Ashwagandha + Reishi
reviews.review_text: This is a nice moisturizer but a little light. It absorbs well and feels nice on the skin but wasn’t enough for me. Good to mix with other oils and moisturizers because my skin felt bit dry only after couple of hours of applying it. Might be a good moisturizer on it’s own for summer months especially for oilier skin folks.

reviews.product_name: D-Bronzi Anti-Pollution Bronzing Drops with Peptides
reviews.review_text: This is good and useful to mix with their plain un-tinted sunscreen but nothing life changing. Also I had heard this initially promoted it as skincare product with bronzing effects and along the line it was getting mentioned as “bronzer with skincare benefits“ so I am not sure. Not sure if I would re-purchase this after I finish. Not a must have item for me. I would rather buy the tinted sunscreen for 34 than buying this  plain sunscreen for double the price. Also, after using retinol, if I was using this product, there skin was more sensitive

reviews.product_name: Natural Moisturizing Factors + HA
reviews.review_text: This is really good moisturizers with effective ingredients and no harmful ones, biggest plus that does not have silicone. Keeps skin hydrated in summer months and works in winter months well along with a face oil. Use it morning and night with buffet for evened out skin tone and bright skin

reviews.product_name: Multi-Peptide + HA Serum
reviews.review_text: This one brightened the dull skin so much! Skin looks radiant and much more even toned now. Started with lacklustre skin, 4 weeks of using this along with Moisturizer made a great difference. Will continue to buy it. Great ingredients.

reviews.product_name: Microneedling Anti-Wrinkle Retinol Patches
reviews.review_text: Love these! They work so well and you can instantly see a difference. Great price point too!

reviews.product_name: Oil-Absorbing Pore Treatment Strips
reviews.review_text: I think these work well for the price point. My skin definitely looks better after.

reviews.product_name: Daily UV Defense Invisible Broad Spectrum SPF 36 Sunscreen
reviews.review_text: I received this product complimentary from innisfree. I LOVE this sunscreen. It is so light and airy without the heavy sunscreen smell. Doesn’t make my skin sticky and goes great under makeup. Highly recommend!

reviews.product_name: Avocado Soothing Skin Barrier Serum with Ceramides
reviews.review_text: I am obsessed with this product! From the beautiful bottle and packaging to the texture and smell — it works great and really does make a huge difference in the redness of my face. Highly recommend and loving it so far!

reviews.product_name: Triple Algae Eye Renewal Balm Eye Cream
reviews.review_text: This product has made such a difference with my eyes! It really has brightened up my undereye circles and makes me look 10 years younger. The texture is rich and the scent is minimal but refreshing. Gifted by Algenist

reviews.product_name: Rose & Hyaluronic Acid Deep Hydration Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I am obsessed with this product and how they combined two things into one. It works great and the texture is luxurious. I can already see a better texture on my skin and my skin is overall a lot brighter!

reviews.product_name: Mini Daily Microfoliant Exfoliator
reviews.review_text: This product works so well and makes my skin feel so nice! I love how gentle it is and a little bit of product goes a really long way. My skin feels silky smooth and polished after using it and I’m a huge fan. Gifted by Dermalogica Sampling

reviews.product_name: Daily Microfoliant Exfoliator
reviews.review_text: This product works so well and makes my skin feel so nice! I love how gentle it is and a little bit of product goes a really long way. My skin feels silky smooth and polished after using it and I’m a huge fan. Gifted by Dermalogica Sampling

reviews.product_name: Vinoperfect Radiance Dark Spot Serum Vitamin C Alternative
reviews.review_text: I was gifted this from Caudalie but I really like this serum. It has a light scent and a milky texture. It’s easy to apply and a little bit goes a long way. I definitely could tell right away that my skin had a radiant look and appeared brighter. I can still see traces of my dark spots but they slightly improved. #freeproduct #trywithtopbox

reviews.product_name: Retinol Eye Stick
reviews.review_text: I really like the concept of this. It’s super easy to use. I didn’t have a problem with it tugging at my skin, I swept the product in an upward motion and it went on fine. I was worried it would be greasy because it looks like a solid stick but it actually didn’t get greasy.

reviews.product_name: Crème de la Mer Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I received this complimentary from La Mer. This is a very rich and hydrating cream and it’s highly fragranced, so if you’re not into that in your skincare then I definitely don’t recommend this. I didn’t mind the smell, it has a powdery floral scent. I enjoyed using this cream, it’s very luxurious and it wasn’t irritating. This cream is definitely hydrating. Although I didn’t notice any drastic change in my skin so I don’t think I could justify the price point for me.

reviews.product_name: Mini Crème de la Mer Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I received this complimentary from La Mer. This is a very rich and hydrating cream and it’s highly fragranced, so if you’re not into that in your skincare then I definitely don’t recommend this. I didn’t mind the smell, it has a powdery floral scent. I enjoyed using this cream, it’s very luxurious and it wasn’t irritating. This cream is definitely hydrating. Although I didn’t notice any drastic change in my skin so I don’t think I could justify the price point for me.

reviews.product_name: Jet Lag Mask
reviews.review_text: I really liked using this mask. I used this as an overnight mask and it was super hydrating. My skin felt smooth, soft and hydrated in the morning. It’s unscented and didn’t cause me any irritation.

reviews.product_name: Mini Jet Lag Mask
reviews.review_text: I really liked using this mask. I used this as an overnight mask and it was super hydrating. My skin felt smooth, soft and hydrated in the morning. It’s unscented and didn’t cause me any irritation.

reviews.product_name: Magic Cream Moisturizer with Hyaluronic Acid
reviews.review_text: I received a complimentary of this from influenster and Charlotte Tilbury in exchange for my honest review. This was my first time trying a Charlotte Tilbury product so I was excited to try. I liked using this cream, I have  combination skin and this worked for my skin. It was hydrating and didn’t feel oily for me, I liked how it made my face look, it was glowing. This cream does have a scent, it has a powdery rose type of smell, I didn’t mind it, it sort of reminded me of La mer but I could see how the smell might bother some people. This stuff is definitely pricey, for the price I wish it would have cake with a scoop or spatula to apply the cream since it is in a jar.

reviews.product_name: Urban Environment Oil-Free Sunscreen Broad-Spectrum SPF 42
reviews.review_text: I received a sample of this in return for my honest review and I’m so glad I did. I love this sunscreen! It absorbs in the skin quickly and didn’t leave a white cast. This leaves my face feeling smooth and hydrated without feeling too oily so it’s good to wear under makeup.

reviews.product_name: Urban Environment Fresh-Moisture Sunscreen Broad-Spectrum SPF 42
reviews.review_text: I received a sample of this product in exchange for my honest review. This was a great sunscreen for me. The texture feels like a lotion and absorbs well in the skin. This is definitely hydrating and didn’t leave a white cast. It does have a slight sunscreen scent but to me ot was pleasant. I wear sunscreen everyday and this is something I could use everyday, for the summer I would switch to the urban environment oil free version that is more matte, but I did enjoy using this product.

reviews.product_name: Multi-Peptide + HA Serum
reviews.review_text: My mom loves this stuff. She said the buffet was great for her fine lines. This is my second purchase.

reviews.product_name: Niacinamide 10% + Zinc 1% Oil Control Serum
reviews.review_text: Great when just using hyaluronic acid and moisturizer. But does not mix well with anything else. It peels under sunblock and other products.

reviews.product_name: Hyaluronic Acid 2% + B5 Hydrating Serum
reviews.review_text: Bought after a great recommendation. Is slightly sticky which I love. Great for that glass skin finish plus I truly feel hydrated with it.

reviews.product_name: AHA 30% + BHA 2% Exfoliating Peeling Solution
reviews.review_text: When I am having dull skin moments I turn to this product! See the best results in my t zone. I don’t use more than once a week

reviews.product_name: Caffeine 5% + EGCG Depuffing Eye Serum
reviews.review_text: It works great in the morning for tired puffy eyes.

reviews.product_name: Avocado Soothing Skin Barrier Serum with Ceramides
reviews.review_text: I wasn’t expecting to love this product but I really do. I had high expectations after loving the avocado retinol and it delivered. My redness is slight and concentrated most around my t zone. This was gentle and calming and love for my no makeup days.

reviews.product_name: Lactic Acid 10% + HA 2% Exfoliating Serum
reviews.review_text: I mostly use this for spot treatment. It stops pimples in the early stages and keeps my skin bright.

reviews.product_name: Brighten-i Eye Cream
reviews.review_text: My favorite eye product right now. I have repurchased multiple times. The luminous effect make my dark circles look significantly better does well alone no concealer needed.

reviews.product_name: Watermelon Pink Juice Oil-Free Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: This moisturizer was gifted to me by Glow Recipe to try and review, and here are my thoughts on the product so far.Always been curious about this brand especially their watermelon line. This is my first product from them, and I’m glad it left a good impression. This product claims to be hydrating and moisturizing. My skin definitely felt refreshed after application. It has a lightweight, watery gel consistency. Initial sticky feel, but easily absorbed by the skin. Once fully absorbed and has sunk to the skin, my face felt really hydrated. True to its ‘glow’ in the name, I also noticed that glow especially on my cheekbones after application. It has that watermelon scent which I can’t pinpoint if I like or not. It’s not completely ‘natural’, it has that mix with a candy scent (which some people might not like). I’m okay with it, but would like it better if they turned it down a bit. They have suggestions on how to use it for diff skin types — moisturizer for oily/combo, serum for dry (I tried both). Can also be used to mix with foundation for radiance, but haven’t tried that yet. I’ll continue using this for sure! I’m more curious about their other products as well!

reviews.product_name: Watermelon Glow Niacinamide Dew Drops
reviews.review_text: I received this serum complimentary from Glow Recipe. Really curious about this product, so I was excited to try this! Lightweight and moisturizing to the feel! It gives a glow to my skin, and I’m also pleased that you can use it several ways. I’ve tried using it as primer and also mixing it with foundation. This works really well! Pleasant and yummy watermelon smell too!

reviews.product_name: Good Genes All-In-One AHA Lactic Acid Treatment
reviews.review_text: I got this complimentary from Sunday Riley. Heard so much about this product so I was really curious! This is my first Sunday Riley product and I’m happy to report, this one did not disappoint!!! It’s been only a week since I started using this and noticed significant changes in my skin texture on forehead area! My skin feels softer too! No stinging feeling as with other exfoliants. It has a scent too similar to ginger, but it doesn’t bother me much. Will keep using this, my skin seems to love this!

reviews.product_name: Avocado Soothing Skin Barrier Serum with Ceramides
reviews.review_text: This sinks so nice in my skin! My skin feels hydrated. Now I don’t have much redness on my skin to test that effect, but I do feel though that it makes my skin softer and smoother. As with other Glow Recipe products, this also has a scent, but something I don’t find bothering at all!

reviews.product_name: GOOPGLOW Microderm Instant Glow Exfoliator
reviews.review_text: I got this complimentary in exchange for review. For its price, I would expect great results. However, I could get the same physical exfoliator result from more affordable brands with more product content. This one such a small jar, and one thing I can’t stand is the smell. I don’t think this is worth it.

reviews.product_name: Mini GOOPGLOW Microderm Instant Glow Exfoliator
reviews.review_text: I got this complimentary in exchange for review. For its price, I would expect great results. However, I could get the same physical exfoliator result from more affordable brands with more product content. This one such a small jar, and one thing I can’t stand is the smell. I don’t think this is worth it.

reviews.product_name: Facial Radiance Pads
reviews.review_text: Noticed results in just a week’s time of use! I have sensitive skin, so I’m very careful and picky when it comes to exfoliating products. I also always do patch tests especially for products with acids or strong ingredients. I’ve heard from others that these pads are very gentle even for sensitive skin. I still had a bit of sting during the first few uses (yup, skin’s that sensitive), but no burning, redness or irritation. It says in the product label that it can be used 2x a day, but I just use this during my PM routine. On days that I include this on my AM routine, I make sure I slather on a lot of SPF. Received as sample, but opinions are my own.

reviews.product_name: Precleanse Cleansing Oil
reviews.review_text: I got this complimentary from Dermalogica. I’ve always been a cleansing balm lover, but this one was very satisfying to use as a first cleanse! Gentle and didn’t feel stripping or drying to my skin. I also like that it comes with a pump so it was hygienic!

reviews.product_name: Mini Precleanse Cleansing Oil
reviews.review_text: I got this complimentary from Dermalogica. I’ve always been a cleansing balm lover, but this one was very satisfying to use as a first cleanse! Gentle and didn’t feel stripping or drying to my skin. I also like that it comes with a pump so it was hygienic!

reviews.product_name: Floral Recovery Overnight Mask with Squalane
reviews.review_text: This is really good for me especially this coming winter. It really helps my skin when it gets really irritated. I don’t really suffer from redness issues regularly , but my skin can be really sensitive (the reaction subsides after some time), and this helps a lot calming my skin down.

reviews.product_name: Plum Plump Hyaluronic Acid Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: This is such a good pre-makeup skincare! My base looks really good because of the moisturized and plump skin! Love the packaging as well! Texture feels so nice on my skin and really helps hydrate my dry skin.

reviews.product_name: Mini Plum Plump Hyaluronic Acid Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: This is such a good pre-makeup skincare! My base looks really good because of the moisturized and plump skin! Love the packaging as well! Texture feels so nice on my skin and really helps hydrate my dry skin.

reviews.product_name: Tea Elixir Niacinamide & Hyaluronic Acid Anti-Aging Serum
reviews.review_text: Love how luxurious this feels to the skin! It has an earthy nature like smell that I like! Not heavy to the skin but feels nourishing and not tacky.  Been using this for a few weeks now and I can see that my skin is smoother in my textured areas.

reviews.product_name: Salicylic Acid Acne + Pore Cleanser
reviews.review_text: great cleanser for the price! I use it with my foreo and it feels great.

reviews.product_name: Volcanic AHA Pore Clearing Clay Mask
reviews.review_text: this is great. I love the way it tingles on my skin and how soft it leaves my face feeling.

reviews.product_name: Brazilian Kiss Cupuaçu Lip Butter
reviews.review_text: ok so it’s super moisturizing and does not leave my lips dry at all. I love this brand’s signature scent as well. but also it is 18 dollars for a tube oh chapstick soooo dunno if I will repurchase. maybe.

reviews.product_name: Soy Hydrating Gentle Face Cleanser
reviews.review_text: This cleanser is “the one“ for me. I love the scent, abs my face loves it. I really, really wish they would switch to glass or something other than plastic for their packaging!!

reviews.product_name: Pure Skin Face Cleanser
reviews.review_text: Summer, winter, morning, night--this is my holy grail cleanser. Doesn’t irritate or strip the skin yet thoroughly cleans. Fragrance free!

reviews.product_name: Lactic Acid 10% + HA 2% Exfoliating Serum
reviews.review_text: I tried to go back to good genes after using a bottle of this up but honestly think this is far better. I have fairly sensitive skin and found this to be non irritating. My acne scared skin has looked so much better after using this.

reviews.product_name: Hello FAB Coconut Water Cream
reviews.review_text: This is my summer skin go to. It works so well with oily skin while keeping you hydrated all day. I love everything from FAB. More brands need to go fragrance free!

reviews.product_name: Aqua Bomb Overnight Lip Mask
reviews.review_text: Solid lip mask. Great for day or night, lasts a long time and leaves my lips very soft. Doesn’t smear like some others tend to do, so I can even dab a little lipstick over it during the day. And no coconut oil, thankfully, which can give me nasty whiteheads around my lip line.

reviews.product_name: 5 Stars Retinol + Niacinamide Eye Serum

reviews.product_name: The True Cream Moisturizing Bomb
reviews.review_text: A solid staple. This seems to hydrate my skin well and, when used under makeup, form a smooth base. I switch between this and Dr. Jart’s Ceramidin Cream in the winter, and I use this more by itself in the spring and summer, or under makeup. It is lightweight and not very greasy. Sometimes I need to re-apply because it absorbs into my skin and is a fairly gel-like cream consistency instead of a thick cream. But this means it is easier to spread.  The product lasts me a long time as well—a little goes a long way.

reviews.product_name: Cold Plunge Pore Mask
reviews.review_text: After weeks of regular use, I noticed a reduction in the number of breakouts I had and in my hyperpigmentation spots. Be careful about going in the sun after using this; since it has AHAs you need to make sure to use plenty of sunscreen! Your skin may also “purge” a bit—I.e., the AHA will bring pimples to surface. But afterwards, your skin should look extra clear. That was my experience, and I also liked the cooling effect. This bottle lasted me about 3 months with 2-3/weekly use. Just don’t overdo it. I’d recommend 1-2/week max instead.

reviews.product_name: Hyaluronic Acid Hydrating Serum
reviews.review_text: Broke me out. This is the only thing I added to my normal skincare routine which I’ve been using consistently for months, and the morning or two after I noticed multiple pimples when generally I don’t get many anymore. Not sure why my skin reacted this way, but I won’t be using this anymore.

reviews.product_name: Lactic Acid 10% + HA 2% Exfoliating Serum
reviews.review_title: good for keratosis pilaris (KP) on my arms!
reviews.review_text: I use this on my upper arms for keratosis pilaris, and I think it works really well in reducing the redness and bumps. My dermatologist makes a lactic acid arm cream specifically for KP, but she only sells it in her office which is far from me. So, I’ve been buying this to combine with lotion for an alternative to her cream in the meantime. It does the job! I apply it to my upper arms after a shower and then, after it soaks in, apply skin fix’s glycolic acid cream for KP—or mix a few drops of the lactic acid into the lotion. The two together seem to work better than the skin fix-brand cream alone. I love that this is an inexpensive product, too. I haven’t tried using it on my face.

reviews.product_name: Greek Yoghurt Foaming Cream Cleanser
reviews.review_text: My go-to since 2019. I have rosacea and this is very soothing on my skin, doesn’t increase acne (in fact I feel it has helped clear my skin), and leaves my skin feeling soft. A little goes a long way; it foams up very well. I love it.

reviews.product_name: Dreamskin Skin Perfector
reviews.review_text: When I think of Dior, I think of high quality and visible results, and fragrance.  This product met all three.  First off, as with every Dior product I’ve tried, there is a light floral perfume fragrance.  It’s not overwhelming, but it’s definitely noticeable.  That doesn’t bother me.  The packaging is a slightly rounded large glass pump.  Very sleek and classy.  The product is like a lightweight lotion feel, slightly pink peach in color, with a subtle glow and shimmer.  It feels amazing on the skin and sinks in nicely leaving the skin soft and hydrated, not tacky.  I did a before and after picture.  My skin has redness and some visible fine lines and wrinkles.  The after picture was noticeably different and better.  My skin looked overall evened out and less red with a reduction in the appearance of fine lines.  I’ll continue using this product.  The fragrance may be too much for someone, but the results are solid and I would recommend this.   This product was gifted in exchange for my honest review and opinions.

reviews.product_name: Double Serum Firming & Smoothing Anti-Aging Concentrate
reviews.review_text: I enjoy this product and the way it melts into my skin.  With only getting sample packaging to use, it was a bit difficult to mix together apply, but the product itself was lovely on my face and the result was an instant glow and smoothness.  I would recommend this to others.

reviews.review_text: This is my perfect moisturizer! I have normal skin and usually use something like Embryolisse Lait-Crème Concentré, Weleda Light Skin Food or Ultra Repair Cream. I always use the same moisturizer morning and night, from that step I need just hydration after a cleanse. This cream is amazing by itself, not just as a primer! It is rich yet not greasy. It says it dries matte but it beautifully works during the night and leaves my skin hydrated.It is unbelievably good under the makeup as well as just a step in my skincare routines both mornings and nights.Love the product and do not find it expensive.It is a fair price for such a quality. Also the smell and the packaging are fantastic!

reviews.product_name: Retinol Eye Stick
reviews.review_text: Hands down, it is life changing product.I am very skeptical to any eye products, I am from this group of people, who believes that eye creams are just expensive moisturizers. I have never noticed any difference with or without eye creams. Perhaps it is because I am 28 and have a good skin.My skin around eyes is not dry and is not sensitive. I also drink a lot of water, do not drink alcohol and sleep a lot (no less than 9 hours), so I do not have dark circles either.HOWEVERThis eye stick made a noticeable difference the next day after I have applied it at night. And HUGE difference was after 3rd day as well.I apply it under my eyes, onto the lids and around my nose at my smile lines.It really brightens up the under eye area (which in my case was fine!), it made skin smooth as crazy, it reduces wrinkles significantly. It also brightened up my lids as well.I have no irritation, no peeling, but my skin is not sensitive.This retinol stick is my holy grail in every night skin routine.Highly recommend!Good luck!

I have a sample size jar that I refill out of my larger jar--doesn’t spill and no need to bring both face cleanser and eye makeup remover! I also like that it is unscented as I’ve become more wary of heavily scented products over time. I also feel that the price is quite reasonable, especially since the majority of cleansing balms out there are quite expensive.

I have a sample size jar that I refill out of my larger jar--doesn’t spill and no need to bring both face cleanser and eye makeup remover! I also like that it is unscented as I’ve become more wary of heavily scented products over time. I also feel that the price is quite reasonable, especially since the majority of cleansing balms out there are quite expensive.

reviews.product_name: Creamy Eye Treatment with Avocado
reviews.review_text: This product is super thick, which I’m not the biggest fan of when it comes to eye creams, but it does do a great job of moisturizing if you’ve got really dry skin. I also appreciate that it’s not scented.

reviews.product_name: Hyaluronic Acid 2% + B5 Hydrating Serum
reviews.review_text: In the winter I have horribly dry skin between the combination of the cold and my retin-A. This stuff really makes a huge difference in terms of hydration. I have not had some of the problems other reviewers have mentioned-no white residue or pilling on the skin. I use a few drops on its own on my skin directly after cleansing, AM and PM, before going in with my usual serum and moisturizer. I wake up in the morning with a baby smooth face!

reviews.product_name: AHA 30% + BHA 2% Exfoliating Peeling Solution
reviews.review_text: I’m a nightly trentinoin user so I do not use this on my face...but I have had a lifetime battle with keratosis pilaris, on the backs of my upper arms and also on the front of my thighs. I’ve used AHA lotions for years with great effect and figured I’d give this a go. While it’s not a cure-all, and doesn’t help with the pigmentation aspect of it, it definitely helps to soften the texture of my skin in my KP problem areas. Will definitely be adding this to my arsenal of KP products. I think dermadoctor KP duty which I’ve been using a long time still works better, it’s a little messy and it’s physical exfoliant can be a bit abrasive when used all the time, so I think this little guy may be my in between day go to.

reviews.product_name: Caffeine 5% + EGCG Depuffing Eye Serum
reviews.review_text: Did not depuff or get rid of dark circles. Basically just a sticky hyaluronic acid serum. Would not recommend. Even if you wanted more hydration - you can just bring your normal serum around your eyes. It’s an added step in the routine that’s not worth it.

reviews.product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C
reviews.review_title: Not bad, but not any better than other balms
reviews.review_text: This stuff is quite hydrating on the lips and has a nice texture. However, I’m not sure that as a “sleeping mask“ its honestly any more effective than using any other lip balm prior to going to sleep. As such, even though I very much enjoy this product but I’d rather use a less expensive balm that comes in a tube, as dealing with cleaning hands before and after with the pot is just not worth it.

reviews.product_name: Niacinamide 10% + Zinc 1% Oil Control Serum
reviews.review_text: I really wanted to like this product as it has such a cult following but it was honestly so bad I threw almost the entire bottle out. I bought it to help with the appearance of pores, redness and oiliness just around my nose (since I’m pretty dry elsewhere) and I can’t comment on how effective it is because I found this unusable. It smelled horrible and the texture was so bad. The ordinary makes some products with fantastic ingredients but their formulations often leave a lot to be desired. This was slimey and didn’t sink it well into my skin - and did not play well with my other products.

reviews.product_name: Pure Skin Face Cleanser
reviews.review_text: I really enjoy this cleanser. It does a good job of removing dirt and makeup, has a nice texture. I also like that it has a gentle foam without leaving my skin feeling stripped afterwards.

reviews.product_name: B-Hydra Intensive Hydration Serum with Hyaluronic Acid
reviews.review_title: effective for dry skin, nice texture
reviews.review_text: This is a fabulous serum. It does a fantastic job of hydrating my extremely dry skin. The texture is fabulous. It sinks in nicely and doesn’t have the slimey texture I’ve experienced with many cheaper HA based serums. It’s also a 1.7oz bottle, unlike most serums both at Sephora and the drugstore at 1oz. So it’s actually more reasonably priced per oz than most other serums at Sephora.

reviews.product_name: The Silk Peony Melting Eye Cream
reviews.review_text: This eye cream is not bad but not worth it. It does a decent job at moisturizing, but so do much cheaper alternatives. The texture is quite thick, but it does not provide any more moisture than many gel consistency or thinner alternatives. I have not noticed any changes to my under eyes.

reviews.product_name: Mini Deep Cleanse Gentle Exfoliating Cleanser
reviews.review_title: Meh. Horrible packaging. Beads too big.
reviews.review_text: Overall this is an ok cleanser. I have only used this in the summer when my skin is more normal. It does not leave the skin feeling overly stripped but does get it clean. However, the beads really do not add much for me. There are too few for them to be really exfoliating and they are huge. The packaging is also horrible. It is very difficult to get the last bit out and squeezing the bottle gives you limited control over how much comes out. They should really put this in a pump.

reviews.product_name: The Deep Cleanse Gentle Exfoliating Cleanser
reviews.review_title: Meh. Horrible packaging. Beads too big.
reviews.review_text: Overall this is an ok cleanser. I have only used this in the summer when my skin is more normal. It does not leave the skin feeling overly stripped but does get it clean. However, the beads really do not add much for me. There are too few for them to be really exfoliating and they are huge. The packaging is also horrible. It is very difficult to get the last bit out and squeezing the bottle gives you limited control over how much comes out. They should really put this in a pump.

reviews.product_name: Green Clean Makeup Meltaway Cleansing Balm Limited Edition Jumbo
reviews.review_text: This product definitely gets my sunscreen off and does a decent job at my waterproof mascara. However, it can slightly sting a bit and thus is just not worth it in my opinion.  I’m also not the biggest fan of the scent.

reviews.product_name: Green Clean Makeup Removing Cleansing Balm
reviews.review_text: This product definitely gets my sunscreen off and does a decent job at my waterproof mascara. However, it can slightly sting a bit and thus is just not worth it in my opinion.  I’m also not the biggest fan of the scent.

reviews.product_name: Beste No. 9 Jelly Cleanser
reviews.review_text: I absolutely love this cleanser. It is a gel formula and is very gentle. However, unlike other gentle cleansers, it works up to a nice texture and actually feels like you are washing your face and getting it clean. It does not make my skin feel overly dry/stripped afterwards. Absolutely lovely and will definitely stay in my cleanser rotation.

reviews.product_name: Mini Oat Cleansing Balm
reviews.review_text: This is a very meh cleansing balm for me. I use a cleansing balm or oil as a first step in my double cleanse to get rid of SPF and eyeliner/mascara (don’t really wear complexion products). I mostly wanted to try this because of the good reviews, as well as the tube format, which I thought would be more convenient than a tub like most other cleansing balms. Well, this is thick and difficult to get out of the tube. I literally hurt my hand trying to get out enough product every night. And the product itself does not do a good job of removing my eye makeup. It just does not emulsify as well as other cleansing balms I’ve tried. Definitely won’t be repurchasing and honestly probably too fed up with the packaging to even finish this tube. The only bright side is that it’s inexpensive compared to most cleaning balms so I didn’t waste too much money.

reviews.product_name: Oat Cleansing Balm
reviews.review_text: This is a very meh cleansing balm for me. reviews.product_name: Self Tanning Bronzing Face Drops
reviews.review_title: Great idea, but results aren’t the best
reviews.review_text: I was really hoping this product would work well. It definitely does tan your skin and I really liked the idea that you can mix it into your own favorite skincare products. The tanner smell is not bad and I found that the drops did not really affect the texture of my products, which is great. However, I honestly am not super impressed by the results. I definitely look tanner, but instead of “evening out skin tone,” I feel like it has accentuated the areas of unevenness in my skin tone. And for the price - it’s a ton of drops if you want to use it for your body. About 2 drops was good for my face, and a tan built up after a couple of days. However, to cover your whole body in lotion and to maintain it - you would be going through bottles of this stuff quickly.

reviews.product_name: Mini Unseen Sunscreen SPF 40 PA+++
reviews.review_title: colorless, but too silicone-y for my taste
reviews.review_text: Overall I think this is an excellent sunscreen and would be amazing option for those with darker skin tones. It also looks quite natural (ie less greasy) than most chemical sunscreens I have used and the sunscreen smell is not too apparent. It dries down quickly to a natural finish, so would likely be a good option for most skin types. My biggest gripe with it is that the texture is extremely silicone-y. It almost feels like a pore filling primer if that makes any sense. I prefer sunscreens that feel more like lotions, but that’s a personal preference. For those who like that kind of effect, this may be the perfect sunscreen for you. For me, I will not be purchasing the full size once I use up the mini one that I have from the Sephora sunscreens kit.

reviews.product_name: Unseen Sunscreen SPF 40 PA+++

reviews.product_name: Ultimate Sun Protector Lotion SPF 50+ Sunscreen
reviews.review_text: I’ve used several iterations of this sunscreen. I will say that over the years through the various formulations, the sunscreen scent on this is less noticeable and this does have a pleasant fresh scent, although the scent is quite strong.Overall, I think this sunscreen is just too greasy. I think the current formulation is definitely better than what they had before but because there are now so many amazing sunscreens with better textures, I won’t be returning to this one again.

reviews.product_name: Squalane + Omega Repair Deep Hydration Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: This is a thicker cream and the consistency is decent. However it doesn’t seem to be as moisturizing as other creams I own with similar textures. The dealbreaker for me is the horrible smell. It honestly smells absolutely rancid.

reviews.product_name: Skin Perfecting 2% BHA Liquid Exfoliant
reviews.review_text: Definitely has had a noticeable difference for my pores on my nose in terms of clearing them up. I don’t really have much acne these days but have a lot of sebaceous filaments and overall congestion just on my nose. Other salicylic acid products really have not made a difference. Within two weeks of using this twice daily, I feel like it is noticeably better. Definitely not a miracle but it’s the first product that I feel like has done anything.

reviews.product_name: C-Firma Fresh Vitamin-C Day Serum
reviews.review_text: I might be in the minority here but I actually much prefer the new formula. It is less sticky and easier to apply. For those having issues with the pump getting stuck, I think you might not be mixing well enough. You need to shake until 100% of the powder is dissolved.For those who are mad they reformulated - they had to change the formula because of patent infringement suit brought by l’Oreal as the old formulation was too similar (clearly a copy honestly) of the Skinceuticals C E Ferulic. So they definitely aren’t bringing it back…

reviews.product_name: Watermelon Glow Niacinamide Dew Drops
reviews.review_text: This product was gifted by Glow Recipe. The Niacinamide Dew Drops is one of my favorite products from Glow Recipe so far. It wears wonderfully under makeup, leaving a just-tacky-enough dew that gives you a nice glow. Has the same fragrance that all of their watermelon products have. If you like watermelon, you’ll love how this smells.

reviews.product_name: Barrier+ Triple Lipid-Peptide Face Cream
reviews.review_text: This is the fourth product I have tried now from skinfix and I like this one just as much as rest. Their products are perfect for me dry, sensitive skin and and often compromised moisture barrier. My only complaint is that this cream tends to pill if you apply too much or layer with too many other products. Otherwise, loving this cream!

reviews.product_name: Mini Barrier+ Triple Lipid-Peptide Face Cream
reviews.review_text: This is the fourth product I have tried now from skinfix and I like this one just as much as rest. Their products are perfect for me dry, sensitive skin and and often compromised moisture barrier. My only complaint is that this cream tends to pill if you apply too much or layer with too many other products. Otherwise, loving this cream!

reviews.product_name: Crème de la Mer Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: This product was gifted complimentary from La Mer for review. For the price I do not think this product is worth it. It’s a thick cream that doesn’t apply easily without tugging on your skin. It reminds me of the Nivea cream in the blue tin - a basic, old fashioned drug store cream that hasn’t been updated in decades. Smells outdated as well.

reviews.product_name: Mini Crème de la Mer Moisturizer

reviews.product_name: 5 Stars Retinol + Niacinamide Eye Serum
reviews.review_text: Retinol is one of my favorite ingredients and my eye area is my biggest skincare issue, so naturally I gravitated toward this product right away. This is a perfect eye cream for night time. Works well so far and I look forward to seeing more results over time.

reviews.product_name: Rose & Hyaluronic Acid Deep Hydration Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I usually stay away from rose products for a couple reasons. I don’t always love the scent and my skin doesn’t always tolerate it. But, this is one of the best rose products I’ve tried. Very sophisticated, pleasant smelling and hydrating for my sensitive skin.

reviews.product_name: Floral Recovery Overnight Mask with Squalane
reviews.review_text: Instantly obsessed. The best product I’ve tried from Fresh I think. I have very dry and sensitive skin, especially during winter, and have been using this as an overnight treatment more than a mask. It really works so well!

reviews.product_name: Retinol Youth Renewal Serum
reviews.review_text: This is one of the best retinol serums I’ve ever tried, and would be suitable for retinol beginners as well. Has made a noticeable difference in my skin in just a few uses. I would not use daily if you have sensitive skin or are new to retinol. Definitely recommend!

reviews.product_name: Mini Retinol Youth Renewal Serum
reviews.review_text: This is one of the best retinol serums I’ve ever tried, and would be suitable for retinol beginners as well. Has made a noticeable difference in my skin in just a few uses. I would not use daily if you have sensitive skin or are new to retinol. Definitely recommend!

reviews.product_name: Magic Cream Moisturizer with Hyaluronic Acid
reviews.review_text: Lives up to the hype as an under makeup primer. Works well for my dry and sensitive skin. Highly recommend!

reviews.product_name: Tea Elixir Niacinamide & Hyaluronic Acid Anti-Aging Serum
reviews.review_text: I love a product like this that can be used in any routine. This has been a welcome addition both morning and night! The packaging is gorgeous, feels like a little slice of luxury. Works great for my dry, maturing skin.

reviews.product_name: AHA 30% + BHA 2% Exfoliating Peeling Solution
reviews.review_text: This stuff is miraculous! Say goodbye to pores and texture, and the price can’t be beat!

reviews.product_name: The Dewy Skin Cream Plumping & Hydrating Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: Tatcha does it again! This cream is super luxurious and leaves my skin soft and glowing!

reviews.product_name: T.L.C. Sukari Babyfacial AHA + BHA Mask
reviews.review_text: This stuff is truly amazing! I’m 40 so I use a lot of acid/retinol based products. I wasn’t hopeful that it would outshine all the rest but I was sooo wrong! This has a slightly weird texture, kind of tacky or sticky and did burn slightly the first time I used it but holy moly my skin looked like GLASS afterwards! My face felt super soft, my pores were invisible, and it was not drying at all. This is totally worth the splurge!

reviews.product_name: Niacinamide 10% + Zinc 1% Oil Control Serum
reviews.review_text: Don’t really see a difference and HATE the texture. It’s super sticky and makes my makeup settle weird.

reviews.product_name: Lactic Acid 10% + HA 2% Exfoliating Serum
reviews.review_text: Does it’s job but I hate the texture. Prefer the creamy consistency of Sunday Riley but...you can’t beat this for the price.

reviews.product_name: GENIUS Liquid Collagen Serum
reviews.review_text: I absolutely love this product! It smells sooooo good and leaves my skin soft and plumped!

reviews.product_name: Retinol Youth Renewal Serum
reviews.review_text: Saw better results with this than Sunday Riley and it smells phenomenal!

reviews.product_name: Mini Retinol Youth Renewal Serum
reviews.review_text: Saw better results with this than Sunday Riley and it smells phenomenal!

reviews.product_name: The Dewy Serum Resurfacing and Plumping Treatment
reviews.review_text: I don’t know how Tatcha does it, but every single product they make is fantastic! This makes my skin so beautiful, soft and glowy, smells amazing and feels like silk!

reviews.product_name: Facial Treatment Essence (Pitera Essence)
reviews.review_text: This is the ultimate splurge for me. It’s a game changer as far as hydration and a tiny little bit goes a really long way. Just put a few drops in your palm and pat it into your face, neck and décolleté. Don’t make the mistake of using a cotton ball or pad because it just wastes product. It completely changes the way your skin absorbs the rest of your products and makes them infinitely more effective!

reviews.product_name: Mini Facial Treatment Essence (Pitera Essence)
reviews.review_text: This is the ultimate splurge for me. It’s a game changer as far as hydration and a tiny little bit goes a really long way. reviews.product_name: The Rice Wash Skin-Softening Cleanser
reviews.review_text: I use this as part of a 3 step cleanse, after an oil wash and before the Tatcha rice polish. It’s gentle yet effective. Never makes me feel tight or dry.

reviews.product_name: Mini Rice Wash Skin-Softening Cleanser
reviews.review_text: I use this as part of a 3 step cleanse, after an oil wash and before the Tatcha rice polish. It’s gentle yet effective. Never makes me feel tight or dry.

reviews.product_name: Dewtopia 20% Acid Night Treatment
reviews.review_text: I spend a LOT of money on my skin care and have tried pretty much everything. I’ve never been a huge user of Olehenrikson, for no other reason than I was using other brands. I finally tried this and I’m a total convert! Better than Good Genes! My only complaint is you get very little product for what you pay.

reviews.product_name: The Kissu Lip Mask
reviews.review_text: I don’t love the texture of this, it feels very sticky when you first put it on but it DOES hydrate my lips. I prefer Laneige lip sleeping mask at night but this gives my lips a fun shiny glossy look during the day.

reviews.product_name: Vinopure Natural Salicylic Acid Pore Minimizing Serum
reviews.review_text: I receives this sample size for free in my VoxBox from Influenster. I have very sensitive skin and large pores. It says it will help to minimize the pores and help with the blackheads and excess oil. After using it for 2 weeks, I did not see any great improvements yet on my skin. My pores are still the same and I still have my blackheads but it did make my skin dried up a little bit. The serum was very sticky at first but it absorbed pretty fast. Love the minty fresh smell. My skin became a little bit dried after using the serum. However, after using my moisturizer, my skin is looking good. The serum is safe for my sensitive skin just a little bit concern when it says that I need to avoid sun exposure due to possible sunburn. It is recommended for people with oily skin. I received this product complimentary for testing purposes only but the review is all mine.

reviews.product_name: The Serum Stick: Treatment & Touch Up Balm
reviews.review_text: This is my first time trying Tatcha brand and serum in stick form. It’s easy to apply, and it is very convenient as to go and travel item. Perfect to patch up dry spot on my face especially in winter time. It can be used as a primer before applying make up or just by itself as a serum.  Both work perfectly for me. I don’t like the overly perfumed skin care, and this serum stick don’t have noticeable scent. After using it for almost a month, it’s reduced my fine lines and made my face smoother. The only down side is that during winter time, I need to apply it a little bit thicker so make it value for price is a little bit high, but it is still definitely recommended. I received this product a complimentary for testing purposes from as complimentary in my VoxBox from Influenster.

reviews.product_name: Estee Lauder Advanced Night Repair Synchronized Multi-Recovery Complex Serum
reviews.review_text: I loves how the serum effects on my skin, instantly hydrating, fast absorbing and no sticky feelings after every application. It smells okay for me not overpowering. After 7 days of using it, my skin looks more hydrating, moist and dewy. Definitely recommended!

reviews.product_name: Mini Advanced Night Repair Synchronized Multi-Recovery Complex
reviews.review_text: I loves how the serum effects on my skin, instantly hydrating, fast absorbing and no sticky feelings after every application. It smells okay for me not overpowering. After 7 days of using it, my skin looks more hydrating, moist and dewy. Definitely recommended!

reviews.product_name: Advanced Night Repair Synchronized Multi-Recovery Complex Duo
reviews.review_text: I loves how the serum effects on my skin, instantly hydrating, fast absorbing and no sticky feelings after every application. It smells okay for me not overpowering. After 7 days of using it, my skin looks more hydrating, moist and dewy. Definitely recommended!

reviews.product_name: The Dewy Serum Resurfacing and Plumping Treatment
reviews.review_text: First of all I always amazed by Tatcha packaging, it always has neat and elegant packaging. I love this serum, the milky white color make this serum looks like face emulsion but it is a serum. It is light weight, fast absorbing, and has very light scent. It works wonder under the make up not make your face too oily, but still give you that dewy skin look. After few weeks usage, I saw improvement on my pores it is getting smaller, my skin is more glowing and radiance. I have a sensitive skin but this serum doesn’t cause any breakout on my skin. It is definitely recommended!

reviews.product_name: Avocado Soothing Skin Barrier Serum with Ceramides
reviews.review_text: I’m lucky enough to be the first to get complimentary newest Avocado Ceramide Recovery Serum that launch on March 30, 2021 from @Glowrecipe. This serum is rich in antioxidant ingredients that smooth and moisturize dry, chapped skin. It’s also rich in skin-identical ceramides that help to reduce redness by supporting skin barrier health. This product also contains Allantoin that multifunctional and effective skin protectant that moisturizes and smooths skin, and Rice Milk that used a lot in K-beauty products as soothing and hydrating properties. It’s a product that vegan, cruelty-free, free of parabens, mineral oil, sulfates, silicons, phthalates, synthetic dyes, fragrances and drying alcohols.On the first usage of this product, I got an instant hydration and glow on my skin, the texture is pretty smooth and easily absorbed into my skin and not leaving sticky feeling in my skin which I like. As far as for redness in my skin it’s reduce the visibility in one or two hours later after usage. After using in for few days, I definitely see improvement in my skin redness and texture. I have a sensitive skin, this serum is a big helper for my skin. I will definitely continue using it in my skincare routine. It’s works quite good compared to the serum that I have already been using.

reviews.product_name: Crème de la Mer Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I’ve been fortunated enough that La Mer gifted me their Crème de la Mer. Having a sensitive skin that means you are prone to skin break out, dryness and redness. Whenever weather changing, your skin always reacted too. I tried  Crème de la Mer for a few days already, and I love how it helped with my sensitive skin problem. This cream has a very thick creamy texture, but once you warm it up with your fingers it melts. Once the cream became translucent just press it gently to your face and neck, it does feel a little bit sticky when you applied it after few minutes it went away (I have a dry skin so it absorbed really fast on my skin). It has a pleasant floral scents to it, and it doesn’t bother me nor my skin. My skin definitely looks more plump and healthier, with all the dryness and redness gone. Definitely recommended with people with dry skin! Oh, and I also love that this Crème de la Mer came in a pretty little green pouch. The design is simple but always has that luxurious presentation.

reviews.product_name: Jet Lag Mask
reviews.review_text: Thank you summer Friday for gifting me your Jet Lag Mask in exchange for my honest review. I love that this mask can be used as a no-rinse mask or as a moisturizer, it can even be used under your eye. It has metal tube packaging that likes some ointment. I don’t quite like the packaging, for me it going to be hard to squeeze out once you down to your last portion of the mask. This mask has that rich creamy white texture that doesn’t have any unpleasant smell to it (fragrance-free). I’ve tried it as a mask or as a moisturizer both works and do the job of giving me super hydration and make skin look moist and dewy. You don’t need to rinse it if you using it as a mask, you can leave it for 10 minutes for maximum hydration and blot it with a warm cloth or tissue if you want to or just leave it overnight and used it as a moisturizer for more hydration. Their new formula is very friendly with my sensitive skin doesn’t cause any breakout. It’s perfect for traveling or on the plane that usually causes your skin to be dehydrated.

reviews.product_name: Santorini Grape Poreless Skin Cream
reviews.review_title: Work wonders on my combination skin
reviews.review_text: I never heard of this brand before and this is my first time using it. This light yellow thick lotion-like texture with a light pleasant scent smells like the fresh scent in baby’s product. This moisturizer smooths my skin well and my skin feels so soft after applying this cream. It’s lightweight, fast-absorbing, and doesn’t dry your skin even though it’s giving you the matte-clean-like face feel. I have combination skin that has an oily T-zone area, this cream helps control the oil shine on the T-zone area and makes my makeup look more even. A product that has control shine benefit, tends to dry your skin more and cause a breakout. This cream works wonders, it controls your shine, does not cause a breakout, and hydrates the skin at the same time. Recommended! And will purchase some more in the future.

reviews.product_name: Urban Environment Oil-Free Sunscreen Broad-Spectrum SPF 42
reviews.review_text: This sunscreen has a light peach and a watery-like texture. It also has a very light scent too. It’s oil-free so it’s more suitable if used as a primer if you are wearing makeup on top. It mattified your skin and preps it for the next step of your makeup routine. It doesn’t dry up your skin even though it’s mattified your skin. It helps control your oil while it protects your skin from harmful UV rays. It works well and is recommended for people with dry skin like me who wear make-up daily.

reviews.product_name: Urban Environment Fresh-Moisture Sunscreen Broad-Spectrum SPF 42
reviews.review_text: This sunscreen has a white, lotion-like texture with a very light scent. It hydrates your skin while protecting it from harmful UV rays. It contains hyaluronic acid that gives intense moisture and reduces your fine lines. It’s lightweight and does not leave a white cast after application. It works like magic for my dry skin. It gives you that dewy look every time you applied it. Definitely recommended for people with dry skin, it also works for all skin types with a little adjustment if you want to wear makeup on top.

reviews.product_name: Mini Daily Microfoliant Exfoliator
reviews.review_title: A half-teaspoon is all you need.
reviews.review_text: Thank you dermalogica for gifted me Dermalogica Microfoliant Exfoliator in exchange for my honest review.This white powder might seem underestimated. What can a half-teaspoon do to your face? I was skeptical at first, but once I tried it, I was impressed with a half-teaspoon these powders can do. It felt soft and grainy at first. Once you put drops of water, it lathers well and dissolves all those grains. It doesn’t have any distinctive scent. Apply it to your face in a circular motion and massage it for one minute but make sure to avoid the eye area, then rinse thoroughly. Your skin feels so soft afterward. No more bumpy skin. It looks brighter too. The best part is it doesn’t dry out my skin that has already dried. It is recommended for people that have an uneven skin tone that wants to exfoliate every day. I definitely will purchase more in the future.
