reviews.product_name: Niacinamide 10% + Zinc 1% Oil Control Serum
reviews.review_text: Wow! This serum has become both a part of my AM and PM skincare routine. After only using this serum once, I noticed my skin was a lot clearer the next morning and since then it has become holy grail. It also gives a healthy glow to the face that I absolutely love! I would definitely suggest buying the 2oz bottle if you are using it on your whole face, because it is easy to use up, but a little does go a long way. In terms of its effectiveness on acne, I have noticed that spots go away a lot faster (sometimes overnight!) and the scars seem to fade faster as well.The one thing that bother me is that I have noticed even when letting the product sink in for 30 minutes before going in with a moisturizer, it tends to pill a lot and can be difficult under foundation. That being said, given the price, amount of product, and results I have seen, I would definitely recommend trying it out.

reviews.product_name: Salicylic Acid Acne Healing Dots
reviews.review_text: As much as I hate to keep repurchasing these, I will continue to do so because of how well they work. If you have multiple spots on your face, these are going to use up quickly, but I have truly not found another product that works to get rid of pimples as quickly overnight like these do.These also seems to work on spots with a white head, but not on those that are deeper under the skin.Cons: unnecessary packaging (each sticker sheet comes in a separate plastic package), high price (price is ~$1 CAD for each sticker), and uses up quickly if you have a lot of acnePros: works so quickly overnight to minimize the pimple, can wear under mask all day, works to stop me from touching the spot

reviews.product_name: Hyaluronic Acid 2% + B5 Hydrating Serum
reviews.review_text: I have seen pretty dramatic effects using The Ordinary Hyaluronic Acid. I have incredibly dry skin and adding this product to my skincare routine has definitely helped! I generally spray a water mist on my face before the serum and I have found that my skin has improved and become almost dewy with continued use. I also mix this serum with The Ordinary Lactic Acid in my nighttime skincare routine in order to dilute it a bit, so I am finding multiple uses for this product. I will continue to repurchase when I have finished this bottle, can’t beat the price and quality for this one.

reviews.product_name: Glycolic Acid 7% Exfoliating Toning Solution
reviews.review_text: I like to use this toner in my PM skincare routine after cleansing. I haven’t experienced any oiliness on my skin as many others have, nor does the smell bother me that much. What does bother me about this toner is that tight feeling in my skin after using it which I generally associate to a product being too stripping. That being said, I believe this product has helped with my breakouts, and I use it on alternate days with The Ordinary Lactic Acid. Will probably try another toner after this one, but this one does work.

reviews.product_name: Yo Glow AHA & BHA Facial Enzyme Scrub
reviews.review_text: This scrub has quickly become one of my favourites! I was wary at first when I received a sample of this product, because I tend to avoid scrubs, finding them too harsh for my skin. However, after one use, I immediately went online to purchase the full size. This enzyme scrub is extremely gentle and my skin does not feel stripped at all after using this. It makes my skin feel incredibly clean, soft, and does a good job rubbing away any dead skin cells. I always use this scrub when my skin is feeling dull and immediately after using, my skin has a shine again that I have only experienced from using this product. Would 100% recommend to anyone struggling with dullness or flakiness in their skin.

reviews.product_name: Mini Yo Glow AHA & BHA Facial Enzyme Scrub
reviews.review_text: This scrub has quickly become one of my favourites! reviews.product_name: Caffeine 5% + EGCG Depuffing Eye Serum
reviews.review_text: I generally love The Ordinary products, so I was really excited to try this one out. However, I have noticed little to no improvements and I have been using this solution for a little over a month now. That being said, I am using this product to combat dark circles under my eyes and I have noticed more reviews saying it has helped with their puffiness. So if you are struggling with puffiness under your eyes, you might want to give this product a shot. Personally, I have not noticed any change for dark circles though. I will continue to use this product until I have finished it, but I would not repurchase.

reviews.product_name: 100% Organic Cold-Pressed Rose Hip Seed Oil
reviews.review_text: I was looking for an oil to add to my PM skincare routine, but this one is just too heavy for me. The oil seems to sit on top of my skin and has a hard time getting absorbed. However, when I’ve used this oil by itself, and not on top of other products, it has absorbed into my skin nicely. Would definitely recommend using this oil and a gua sha tool in your nighttime routine!

reviews.product_name: Lactic Acid 10% + HA 2% Exfoliating Serum
reviews.review_text: Would definitely recommend this product if you are struggling with acne! I have been mixing this product with The Ordinary Hyaluronic Acid until my skin is used to it. But I have noticed almost immediate results from this, waking up the next morning and my pimples are minimized and my skin is looking a lot clearer. The solution definitely seems a little strong though, I would not recommend it to anyone with sensitive skin. I would also recommend slowly introducing this in your routine by mixing it with The Ordinary Hyaluronic Acid and using it on alternate days. You don’t need a lot of this product to see results, the one bottle I have barely has a dent in it, and I’ve been using it for about a month.

reviews.product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C
reviews.review_text: Love this sleeping mask! First got the small version of this mask as part of the Laneige birthday present this year, and I eventually decided to purchase the full size version. Keeps my lips moisturized all night and when I wake up, my lips are super soft. You don’t need a lot of product, so the full size version should last quite a long time. Will definitely continue to repurchase when I am done and try some other scents.

reviews.product_name: Watermelon Pink Juice Oil-Free Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: This moisturizer is just ok in my opinion. The packaging is so cute and it smells delicious, but other than that, it performed just as well as some of my drugstore gel moisturizers. My skin felt moisturized and hydrated. The product does what it says, but you can get the same effect from a cheaper moisturizer.

reviews.product_name: C-Rush Vitamin C Gel Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: This is so a great product, keeps my face moisturized for the whole day. I love the orange cream scent of it. The gel based creme is very cooling on my face. I can see this amazing glow on my face and cheek bones once I apply the creme. I totally can see the results of my fine lines and wrinkles disappear. I received this product complimentary for sampling purposes. All of the opinions are all my own.

reviews.product_name: Hyaluronic Acid Hydrating Serum
reviews.review_text: I love how my skin is softer and much clearer. I use it in the morning and at night. It is super easy to use and skin looks amazing.

reviews.product_name: Honey Halo Ultra-Hydrating Ceramide Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I received this product complimentary from Farmacy Beauty. I love how luxurious this amazing moisturizer feels. My skin feels super hydrated and I love that I can use it in the daytime and at night time. I love how my skin is no longer dry and fully moisturized. It feels super hydrated, and I can feel my skin is also getting firmer. Totally love this moisturizer.

reviews.product_name: Barrier+ Triple Lipid-Peptide Face Cream
reviews.review_text: Skin fix gifted me Barrier plus triple lipid-peptide cream. It is by far amazing and really has done wonders for my skin.

reviews.review_text: I love this resurfacing clarity mask. It is amazing how gentle it is on my skin. I love that it helps my skin feel energized and refreshed. I also really love the amazing cool blue shade of this mask. The blue tansy resurfacing clarity mask by herbivore was gifted to me.

reviews.product_name: Rose & Hyaluronic Acid Deep Hydration Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I love this moisturizer so much. It is super gentle on my face. And I totally love how refreshing it is. Definitely one of my all time favorites. The formula is non greasy which I totally love so much.

reviews.product_name: Honeymoon Glow AHA Resurfacing Night Serum
reviews.review_text: The honeymoon glow serum is totally fantastic. I totally love how it hydrates and a super gentle to my skin. I use it to to three times a week, and it totally has given my skin a beautiful youthful glow. This serum was  complimentary from Farmacy beauty.

reviews.product_name: 5 Stars Retinol + Niacinamide Eye Serum
reviews.review_text: I totally love this eye serum. It is super effective and makes my skin feel amazing. I’ve noticed on my under eye area is really looking great and it’s definitely wrinkle free. I also love that it helps support healthy collagen.

reviews.product_name: Precleanse Cleansing Oil
reviews.review_text: This pre-cleanse is amazing. Not only does it help with keeping my skin hydrated and smooth. But it removes all of my make up at once. I totally love it. I’ve noticed that it really has changed the way my skin looks and feels. This product was gifted by Dermalogica.

reviews.product_name: Skinlongevity Long Life Herb Anti-Aging Face Serum
reviews.review_text: In just a few weeks this serum has totally transformed my skin! It’s so smooth & absolutely glowing! My fine lines aren’t as noticeable & my skin is much softer. I definitely recommend this serum!

reviews.product_name: Avocado Fine Line Eye Cream with Retinol
reviews.review_text: I’ve been using the avocado melt retinol eye sleeping mask, gifted to me by Glow Recipe, for a couple of weeks & I really like it! It’s very moisturizing but not too heavy & leaves my under eye area nice & hydrated. I’ve been using it in my nighttime routine, but it is definitely lightweight enough to use in the morning & under concealer. A little goes a long way & I love the cute little spoon it comes with for easy application! I can already see a slight improvement in my fine lines & I’m excited to see even more as I continue to use it! Overall, this is an awesome eye mask & I highly recommend it!

reviews.product_name: Watermelon Glow Niacinamide Dew Drops
reviews.review_text: The formula of these drops is amazing. You can either use them as a serum, a primer under your makeup or to add some glow on top of your makeup! I haven’t tried it over my makeup yet, but I’ve been loving using it as a primer & nighttime serum. It gives me a beautiful glow under my foundation. It absorbs fairly quickly & is a tiny bit sticky but that goes away pretty quickly & I feel like it helps hold my makeup in place. I love the scent too! I’ve been using this nonstop over the last few weeks & my skin is noticeably smoother & glowing! Highly recommend this! (Gifted by Glow Recipe to review)

reviews.product_name: Good Genes All-In-One AHA Lactic Acid Treatment
reviews.review_text: I love this serum! After just a few days I could already see a difference in my skin’s appearance & texture. My skin is more hydrated & glowing. I love how soft & smooth my skin feels! Definitely worth the price point! *I received this product complimentary from Sunday Riley

reviews.product_name: Avocado Soothing Skin Barrier Serum with Ceramides
reviews.review_text: This is such a great serum. I love the texture & I especially love that there is no strong fragrance. A little goes a long way & it absorbs really nicely into the skin. It is really hydrating & leaves my skin feeling soft & smooth. I especially love using this after a mask or peel to help calm my skin. (Gifted by Glow Recipe in exchange for my honest review)

reviews.product_name: Honeymoon Glow AHA Resurfacing Night Serum
reviews.review_text: I was gifted this serum complimentary from Farmacy Beauty & I love it! I use it a few times a week during my nighttime routine. My skin feels hydrated & smooth the next morning. I love the gentle exfoliation & how radiant my skin looks!

reviews.product_name: Mini Jet Lag Mask
reviews.review_text: I love this mask! I have dry skin and this has been a life saver! I like to put it on at night & use it as an overnight mask for extra hydration. My skin feels smooth & plump the next morning. Highly recommend this mask!

reviews.product_name: Jet Lag Mask
reviews.review_text: I love this mask! I have dry skin and this has been a life saver! I like to put it on at night & use it as an overnight mask for extra hydration. My skin feels smooth & plump the next morning. Highly recommend this mask!

reviews.product_name: 5 Stars Retinol + Niacinamide Eye Serum
reviews.review_text: I love Sunday Riley skincare & I couldn’t be happier with this eye serum. The texture is amazing & I love the ingredients. The retinol is gentle & I haven’t had any irritation from it like I’ve experienced with other eye serums & creams. Highly recommend this one!

reviews.product_name: Plum Plump Hyaluronic Acid Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I love Glow Recipe products & this is no exception! This moisturizer is very hydrating & leaves my skin feeling super soft. I love that there’s no sticky residue like the moisturizer I’ve been using until now. And I especially love that they made it refillable! Such a great idea!

reviews.product_name: Mini Plum Plump Hyaluronic Acid Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I love Glow Recipe products & this is no exception! This moisturizer is very hydrating & leaves my skin feeling super soft. I love that there’s no sticky residue like the moisturizer I’ve been using until now. And I especially love that they made it refillable! Such a great idea!

reviews.product_name: Vitamin Enriched Face Base Priming Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: This is an amazing primer especially for my dry skin! I’ve tried plenty of hydrating primers but this one is definitely a favorite. It adds just the right amount of hydration & sinks into the skin nicely & makeup looks absolutely beautiful on top of it! It does have a bit of a fragrance which I’m not a fan of but it’s not too bad. Definitely recommend trying this!

reviews.product_name: Watermelon Glow PHA + BHA Pore-Tight Toner
reviews.review_text: This toner is so good! It has a pretty unique texture & it’s a bit tacky on the skin. But it makes my skin feel super soft & hydrated. It exfoliates without drying out my skin & has really improved the look of my texture. I’m loving the results I’m seeing so far!

reviews.product_name: Mini Watermelon Glow PHA + BHA Pore-Tight Toner
reviews.review_text: This toner is so good! It has a pretty unique texture & it’s a bit tacky on the skin. But it makes my skin feel super soft & hydrated. It exfoliates without drying out my skin & has really improved the look of my texture. I’m loving the results I’m seeing so far!

reviews.product_name: Tea Elixir Niacinamide & Hyaluronic Acid Anti-Aging Serum
reviews.review_text: I’m loving this new serum for my dry skin! I love the milky consistency, it’s super hydrating & makes my skin so soft & smooth. My only issue is I really don’t like the scent. I’m very sensitive to fragrance & this one is pretty strong in my opinion. Thankfully it dissipates quickly though.

reviews.product_name: Confidence in a Cream Anti-Aging Hydrating Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I love this cream so much! It’s so rich & luxurious. It’s super moisturizing & feels great on the skin. It’s not too heavy & gives your skin a beautiful radiant glow.

reviews.product_name: Multi-Peptide + HA Serum
reviews.review_text: I have dry skin with the beginning signs of aging, and I’m 35. I use this serum am and pm, after toners and before creams and oils. When I wear it under makeup, it does not disturb my makeup, you just have to wait until it absorbs that’s all. It does feel mildly sticky upon initial application, but that does go away after a few minutes. You do not need a lot. Using twice a day, each bottle lasts me a little over two months. I have been using this for six months. I wanted to write this review because I noticed some complaints about excessive stickiness and poor absorption/dry down. I think those customers may have been applying too much. After a few weeks of using, I noticed that my skin had a firmer more supple appearance and my fine lines on my forehead are reduced in size and depth. My skin is smoother overall and I think this is a very effective and wallet friendly treatment that also happens to be vegan and cruelty free. My mom has combination skin and she likes this as well. Definitely give it a shot, and definitely don’t use too much. It did take a few weeks to see results.

reviews.product_name: Protini Polypeptide Firming Refillable Moisturizer
reviews.review_title: Another pricey but worth it DE product
reviews.review_text: I am a total skincare junkie. Maybe even more so than makeup. I am 35, have dry skin, and I am fighting the first signs of aging. I love this anti-aging moisturizer. It does not give the velvety feel to your skin that lala does, however, I find that using this twice a day in addition to hyaluronic acid from “The Ordinary” definitely does allow me to maintain my moisture levels, even in the winter. But what I really love about this, is the anti-aging effects. It definitely does make my skin appear more plump, firm, and smooth. It’s exactly what I was hoping for in a moisturizer. One that goes beyond simple moisturizing. And this does. I think if you are currently fighting dry and scaly patches, this may not be enough for you, but if you already have those effectively managed, this is a great addition to your skincare routine. It works fine under my makeup and does not pill or cause my makeup to break apart. Thank you again DE! And yes, I realize it is expensive, but I’d say this one is worth the splurge if you are looking for the same benefits I was.

reviews.product_name: Hyaluronic Acid 2% + B5 Hydrating Serum
reviews.review_text: This really needs to be sold in a much larger bottle. I love this hyaluronic serum much more than any other I have ever tried and the low price is amazing! It’s very important to know that hyaluronic acid on its own will not hydrate your skin, but when you use this under your favorite moisturizer, that’s when the magic happens. I have very dry skin and no thyroid, so talk to me if you “think” you have dry skin. I’m the winter, it becomes almost unbearable. I like to use this on my body as well, and that’s why this should be sold in a large bottle, because it’s effective everywhere you want to use it as long as you apply it under your moisturizer. For maximum hydration, follow your moisturizer with an oil. I personally like rose hip seed oil the best, but whatever oil is your fave is fine. If you suffer from flaking, itchy, dry skin... it will be solved after the first 1-2 uses. As long as you use this in conjunction with moisturizing cream that is.

reviews.product_name: Caffeine 5% + EGCG Depuffing Eye Serum
reviews.review_title: You need this more than you thought you did
reviews.review_text: I use this twice a day as the instructions suggest, and I find it makes a huge difference. I use a very small amount. It is very emollient and it takes a few minutes to absorb. So a wait a bit before applying my eye moisturizer until it has fully absorbed into my skin. My puffiness is gone, and even my top lid appears tighter. However, I will say that this is a product that you have to keep using in order to reap the benefits. If I forget to use it, the puffiness returns. But since such a small amount is needed, and since the price is so low... that doesn’t bother me.

reviews.product_name: Natural Moisturizing Factors + HA
reviews.review_title: For the price, can’t be beat
reviews.review_text: If you are looking for a decent moisturizer on a budget, look no further. I do find that this is more effective on my dry skin when I layer it over the hyaluronic serum from the same brand, but I would definitely say it is a decent product. Also, if you are new to lactic acid or one of their other “more harsh” treatments, you can totally mix this in and apply together for less irritation while helping your skin become accustomed to your new routine. All in all I would recommend this to anyone, but I would not say it’s the best moisturizer out there. However, for the price... yeah, definitely the best at this price point.

reviews.product_name: 100% Organic Cold-Pressed Rose Hip Seed Oil
reviews.review_text: Of all singular facial oils, rose hip seed oil is my absolute favorite. I use this as the last step of my nightly skincare routine and it makes a huge difference. And finally, a brand that I can trust is offering it a a very reasonable price! What’s not to love about that?!? If you are trying to fight signs of aging, and want a singular oil, this is the one for you. It will help you maintain your skin hydration and it will also make your skin appear more plump and bright.

reviews.product_name: Honey Halo Ultra-Hydrating Ceramide Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I have dry skin, and I live in the northeast, and it’s currently winter time. Not only this, but I also do not have a thyroid, which despite being on medication, this definitely exacerbates dry skin. But this moisturizer is fantastic! It feels almost soothing when I apply it, but it definitely sinks in and does not leave me with a greasy or a heavy feeling. Makeup does well with it too so I can apply it day or night, or both if I choose. I also love the fact that it comes with a spatula which stays on the magnetized lid so I don’t lose it. They thought of everything and I really appreciate that. I hate dipping my hands into a jar of moisturizer, so I think this was so smart of them to include for us and I wish more brands would do this. I can’t speak for those with oily skin, but I do think that anyone with dry or normal skin would love this moisturizer. It does have a bit of a natural scent to it, which I wouldn’t exactly say is pleasant, but it’s very light, and fades away in a few minutes. For me, it’s not something that would deter me from using this great product. I will definitely repurchase, and will probably grab the value size next time! Oh, and my elbows were getting a little scaly, and one application at night before bed cleared that up for me.

reviews.product_name: Water Drench Hyaluronic Acid Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: Bought this to try it out before getting the full size. Well it’s on to the full size. This is the perfect HA cream imo. The ingredients can’t be beat. Love that it has all the ceramides   Good for skin barrier repair. It’s very hydrating. Can layer other products over like a thicker moisturizer (if needed) or makeup. I read a few reviews that it pills for some people. That is one thing I am always picky about and why so many other products don’t work for me. Case in point the watermelon mask. That instantly balls up on me. Anyway, didn’t happen with this one at all. There’s no discernible scent that I can detect. It didn’t irritate or make my eyes water and the best part was it gave my hydrated dewy skin. Love love love

reviews.product_name: GENIUS Liquid Collagen Serum
reviews.review_text: Received a sample bottle of this. First it’s nearly impossible to get the product from the dropper out onto skin. Maybe because it’s a sample and the dropper is so small the regular size bottle might not have this issue. So after fighting to get some product out... don’t see why it’s so heavily scented. Feels greasy. The capsules suspended in the base liquid don’t distribute evenly. This just seems very gimmicky to me for as much as it costs. Pass

reviews.product_name: Magic Cream Moisturizer with Hyaluronic Acid
reviews.review_text: This is a rich thick balmy type of cream. It’s awesome in the way it feels and preps for foundation. I have dry skin so it’s great for me. Those with oily skin might find this way to emollient especially for under makeup. I would give this baby five stars if it was fragrance free. I absolutely can’t put it anywhere close to my eyes due to the fragrance. My eyes started to water almost immediately. I will use up what I have and don’t think I will repurchase due to the fragrance. It smells fine it just does something to my eyes that I have never considered sensitive. I would suggest to get samples or buy the smaller version to see how your skin and eyes handle it before going full size.

reviews.product_name: T.L.C. Sukari Babyfacial AHA + BHA Mask
reviews.review_text: Truly effective at what it claims to do and without irritation. Have used the ordinary and it’s supposed to be higher in percentage of aha and I didn’t get the results from it. The cost of babyfacial is on the luxury end of products but, considering that you get many facials for about the same or less than a facial from the spa it’s not expensive. It somehow managed to exfoliate without irritation and the sting factor was only with initial contact and subsided quickly. This if it works for your skin could be one of those holy grail products that it is now for me. Try a sample if possible before investing in the full size.

reviews.product_name: B-Hydra Intensive Hydration Serum with Hyaluronic Acid
reviews.review_title: Mix it or layer. Makes all products better
reviews.review_text: In total love with this hydrating gel that is so powerful yet so gentle at the same time. First off, I have dry mature skin and I don’t use this as a stand alone product. I use it to put under moisturizer creams and oils. I love this for its ability to be mixed with other products or to layer under them. This is awesome when mixed with the C-Firma and now with the new DE retinol. My skin can be red, hot and flat out inflamed at times to the point where water can sting me. I can put this B-Hydra with a bit of cortisone cream for those times and it makes it easy to spread the medicine and makes my face feel cooler and not burn. I do love the packaging for this too. This is the one product that I use morning and night 365 days out of the year. It just makes everything better !

reviews.product_name: Luminous Dewy Skin Mist
reviews.review_title: I so don’t see the hype
reviews.review_text: Is this a bad product? NO. Is it the awesome and best ? NO. For this much money and this little of product I really expected more I guess. It didn’t hydrate me like I thought it would and honestly I didn’t see the Dewy effects from it either. I don’t hate this but, I don’t get the hype and I won’t ever repurchase it for close to 50 dollars for a little over one ounce. It just didn’t wow me to make it worth it.

reviews.product_name: D-Bronzi Anti-Pollution Bronzing Drops with Peptides
reviews.review_text: Omg!!!! I was afraid this would be to dark for me with even just a few drops. I mixed a half pump with la la retro cream and put it on like I would normally. This is so beautiful from the color to the way it applies. The fact that it has skin care benefits on top of cosmetic abilities makes this to me an exceptional product. I hate fountain because I never seem to be able to get it to apply the way I want. This is just so easy. It is a warm color and I like it. If I had one option I would maybe want it to be a little more on the neutral or cool toned. But, I have never had or tried anything remotely  good as this.

reviews.product_name: Protini Polypeptide Firming Refillable Moisturizer
reviews.review_title: use this as to cocktail serums instead of bhydra.
reviews.review_text: I love what’s in this. It’s not super moisturizing for me but, the way I use it is with one pump of this mixed with la la or Marula or JM Argan oil. I want the power of the peptides for my skincare and this has them for sure. If your skin is oily to normal than you could use this on its own. This stuff has definitely helped with smoothing out some wrinkles. I have pretty much decided that I love all drunk elephant products because they definitely work for my skin. The products aren’t horrible expensive but, when you use them all it does add up. I replaced using the byhdra with this peptide cream because I feel I get more benefit from this than the b hydra. Now I will mix this with the vitamin c serum in the am and then the retinol serum in the pm. La la on top with some oil depending on my skin moisture level that day. I really think that with no silicone in any of these products makes them all penetrate my skin better. None of them ball up on me like some other products that I have tried. The whole point of silicone is to sit on top of the skin so I really like not having them in my skincare.

reviews.product_name: Lip Glowy Balm
reviews.review_text: Really nice hydrating glow. I don’t mind the scent but, wish it was just a tad less scented. Makes lips soft and plumped up though.

reviews.product_name: C-Rush Vitamin C Gel Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I like the feeling of this but, the fragrance is ridiculously strong and so unnecessary imo. This type of vitamin c is more stable but, in jar packaging no antioxidants are safe for very long. I really don’t get why more companies don’t use the jar pumps or a plain tube when they include several different antioxidants. This is a nice albeit heavily fragranced moisturizer. My skin isn’t sensitive so I can use this up but, I won’t repurchase due to the jar and fragrance. This would be holy grail for me otherwise.

reviews.product_name: Lala Retro Whipped Refillable Moisturizer with Ceramides
reviews.review_text: Still awesome!!! However, the lid on the new container isn’t a good fit and doesn’t stay on. To me this is just as moisturizing as the old version. Feels less whipped to me maybe. To everyone saying it only lasts them two weeks to one month, you can open it and get every last bit of it. I go through them like every three mos because I cocktail it with other stuff. I was worried about the new formula and now am happy to say it’s still great with ceramides. Just please DE fix the lid. They have kinda imo fallen on being the best at product containers. Not happy with the retinol that comes out of the tube constantly and this new Lala container isn’t up to the same outstanding container as the previous one. If they are going to put their products in such huge containers so it protects the product the lid needs to stay on. And we need to be able to recycle them and so far these aren’t able to be recycled. That seriously needs to change

reviews.product_name: Brighten-i Eye Cream
reviews.review_text: More moisturizing than the caffeine version. Nice immediate brightening effect. Can’t speak to long term brightening yet. Not sure if this is more effective than vitamin c but, it is definitely more gentle especially for the eye area. Looks and works great under concealer. This is a nice eye cream for daytime imo. Can’t beat the price for sure.

reviews.product_name: Green Clean Makeup Removing Cleansing Balm
reviews.review_text: I don’t know what I’m doing wrong with this ? I have the DHC cleansing oil and it works great at removing my makeup, rinsing well and not make my eyes blurry. I thought this would be good to take on trips and it just isn’t doing anything that I thought it would. I gave it three stars for the way it smells and that it’s solid in consistency. Not sure if I should try another brand or just stick with liquid oil cleanser.

reviews.product_name: Green Clean Makeup Meltaway Cleansing Balm Limited Edition Jumbo
reviews.review_text: I don’t know what I’m doing wrong with this ? I have the DHC cleansing oil and it works great at removing my makeup, rinsing well and not make my eyes blurry. I thought this would be good to take on trips and it just isn’t doing anything that I thought it would. I gave it three stars for the way it smells and that it’s solid in consistency. Not sure if I should try another brand or just stick with liquid oil cleanser.

reviews.product_name: F-Balm Electrolyte Waterfacial Mask
reviews.review_title: Cherry on top of nightly skincare
reviews.review_text: This takes all the serum, moisturizer, and oil and kicks it way up. After applying bhydra with tlc then la la with marula oil... I put the four pumps of this f balm on top. At first I thought it was way to much and sticky. After a few mins it all soaked in. Next am my skin was so much more plump and hydrated than without it. Bummed that now this is just one more dang thing I need but, the results are to good to ignore. I do have over 50 dehydrated mature skin. Younger skin that has always used sunscreen could use this on its own and get benefits. I was perplexed how this was going to work over creams and oils because layering thinner to thicker is what I know. This is the exception to that rule because it goes on and does lock all that good stuff in and still reaches through it all to hydrate and plump.

reviews.product_name: The Deep Cleanse Gentle Exfoliating Cleanser
reviews.review_text: I recently picked up the 300 point reward for this cleanser and the water cream. I had used the cream many times before and knew what it was and how good it was already. So this cleanser, honestly, I have used so many cleansers over the years and wasn’t expecting it to be anything other than another exfoliating cleanser with good ingredients. Trying to get the cleanser out of that tiny bottle isn’t fun but, OMG!! The cleanser itself is flat out amazing. It got rid of all my dead skin without stripping or drying me out. I thought ok so I need to exfoliate better because I couldn’t believe how good this cleanser worked. I kept reading the ingredients trying to figure out what was making this stuff so effective. I still don’t know exactly how it works so well because it’s not a harsh exfoliation. Bottom line is this is just some kind of magic cleanser potion and I am mad that I ignored this stuff for so long. I’m back to buy the full size. I have nothing but love for this stuff and if I had only one complaint it’s the same as everyone else. The bottle. It needs a pump or a softer bottle. Won’t stop me from buying it though.

reviews.product_name: Mini Deep Cleanse Gentle Exfoliating Cleanser

reviews.product_name: E-Rase Milki Micellar Water
reviews.review_text: I really love Drunk Elephant and some of their products I use everyday like lala and tlc. This is just ok for me. It seems like I need a ton to remove makeup and I don’t like how it sits on top of the cotton pad. It’s like I’m balancing a glob of liquid on the pad and trying to use it before it slides off. I used it to take off my Marc Jacobs mascara and it took more effort and product than I feel this should. I will use up this bottle but, this isn’t a repurchase for me.

reviews.product_name: E-Rase Milki Micellar Water Mini
reviews.review_text: I really love Drunk Elephant and some of their products I use everyday like lala and tlc. This is just ok for me. reviews.product_name: Mini Rice Wash Skin-Softening Cleanser
reviews.review_text: Really nice cleanser that seriously you only need like a pearl size to wash with. I used to much the first time and it was hard to rinse it off. So now I know to only use a small amount. I was worried that this would be so over the top fragrance wise. To me this smells pretty much the same as their exfoliating cleanser and I love that one too. While I really like this cleanser I am not sure that I will repurchase it because I don’t like it more than others that work just as well that have no fragrance. The exfoliating cleanser I always will repurchase because that stuff is something that I can’t find that I like as much and use it a few times a week.

reviews.product_name: The Rice Wash Skin-Softening Cleanser
reviews.review_text: Really nice cleanser that seriously you only need like a pearl size to wash with. I used to much the first time and it was hard to rinse it off. reviews.product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C
reviews.review_text: I love this...as a lip balm. I hope no one hates on this review because I don’t like this product as a sleeping mask, but if they do they do. Here we go: I love this little guy—like I said—as a balm during the day. It’s great. It stays put. The only issue is you have to dig into the product with your fingers. Me? I don’t mind, but I know some people do. I just can’t use this at night. I’ve tried. I have horribly dry lips. Nothing ever seemed to work for me. If you are in the market for a balm that really works, I have to recommend the Nuxe Reve de Miel balm in the jar. It is heaven. I don’t know what I did before I found it. But back to the product I’m reviewing. I would lather it on. I would put just a touch on. I would try to put on an amount somewhere between lathering it and just a touch. No matter what it would always be gone in the morning and my dry cracked lips would be back. I don’t know what it is because other people rave about it. And I do love it. Just not for what it’s marketed for. Either way, I encourage you—if you’re thinking about getting it—to try it out! You might love it. Or it might be a good balm for you for the daytime. Also try to other balm I mentioned! Trust me on it!

reviews.product_name: Luna Sleeping Retinoid Night Oil
reviews.review_text: I absolutely adore the little pot. I love that it’s blue. I love the smell. I love that it’s a dropper. I love that it keeps me hydrated all night long and I wake up without that right feeling on my face—which I used to get if I didn’t use a strong enough moisturizer at night. I just love this little guy and will absolutely be repurchasing when I run out.

reviews.product_name: Brazilian Kiss Cupuaçu Lip Butter
reviews.review_text: Listen: I was not expecting to purchase a second tube of this stuff. I mean, yes, it’s moisturizing. But I have very chapped lips and I need something seriously heavy duty. So here’s the thing: I don’t use this at night. No way can it moisturize my lips through the night. But I ALWAYS have a lip balm with me throughout the day and I am ALWAYS reaching for this one. I can’t tell you when it happened, but this little dude has become my favorite lip balm. It’s honestly probably the smell that did it. If you’ve never smelled the Sol de Janeiro products: YOU NEED TO. Anyways sorry to bore you with an incredibly long review, but long story short this is an amazing little product. And you need it. (And 1 has lasted me a long time so, yes, if you were wondering, it is worth the money.)

reviews.product_name: Watermelon Pink Juice Oil-Free Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I LOVE Glow Recipe and their entire watermelon line. This is no exception. It’s amazing. The formula is amazing. The packaging is on point. The whole thing is just perfect (it comes with a pump). Really I am not complaining about this at all. But I will not be re-purchasing. I have very dry skin and this just did not cut it. I loved using it as a serum in the morning for some added moisture, but seeing as I don’t normally use serums, this would just be an added expense. Also since I do have dry skin and I used this every day, I used about three to four pumps each time and I ran out of it very quickly. If you do not have super dry skin and you love watermelon, PLEASE try this! It deserves love because it is SO good! It just doesn’t work for me. Perhaps when I’m rich and famous, I’ll splurge on serums (but not today).

reviews.product_name: Clear Improvement Charcoal Honey Mask to Purify and Nourish
reviews.review_text: I love this mask. It is such a beautiful and unique mask. The honey is so moisturizing and the charcoal is purifying. It works wonders. And the color of it is so unique. Is that weird to add? But I love the color of it. I also don’t leave it until it dries, although it feels like it would. I just don’t like that feeling so I wash it off before then and I still feel as though I benefit from it. 100% recommend.

reviews.product_name: Soy Hydrating Gentle Face Cleanser
reviews.review_text: Okay, let’s get this out of the way: this is not my favorite. I want it to be, but it is not. It does not leave my skin feeling tight. It has a nice gel-like consistency. It smells lovely (like soy). I just feel as though it does nothing good nor bad for my skin. So I can slide either way on the love it hate it wheel. It’s just kind of “meh“ for me. It’s good. I’ll use it. But it is not my favorite. And I won’t repurchase.

reviews.product_name: Jet Lag Mask
reviews.review_text: So I cannot speak to how this performs on flights. I would love to, but I don’t travel as much as I would like (or at all). I do LIKE this, but not as a mask. Every time I use it, it leaves my face a little red which makes me v nervous. The first time I got it, I tried to use it overnight, but it ended up leaving my face feeling very dry and tight in the morning. Then if I try to use it as a 10-minute mask, it ends up pilling. I am giving it 2 stars because I can use it as an eye cream. NOT as an eye mask (same thing: makes my skin red), but just a light layer under the eyes gives me much needed moisture. The only thing is it is a huge package to be using it solely as an eye cream. But as long as it is good, that is what I will be using it for.

reviews.product_name: Mini Jet Lag Mask
reviews.review_text: So I cannot speak to how this performs on flights. I would love to, but I don’t travel as much as I would like (or at all). I do LIKE this, but not as a mask. reviews.product_name: Superberry Hydrate + Glow Dream Night Mask with Vitamin C
reviews.review_text: I hate giving this product only 4 stars because it is good! I just don’t love it. It is very creamy and a little thick. The smell is very unique (I’m sorry, I’m horrible at describing scents). The product itself is very interesting in that every time I used it, I felt as though it almost made my face matte? It was so weird. My face was still plump and juicy and (not wet, but you could tell I had a mask on)...and yet it looked almost matte. I don’t know. Maybe I’m just weird. Anyways...and I prefer something that makes my skin glowy and dewy (even if they do the same thing, which is hydrate my skin during the night). It’s a nice mask and if you are interested in it at all, I’d say go for it. It does what it claims to. I didn’t wake up feeling dry or anything like that. I just prefer more glow-giving products.

reviews.product_name: Mini Superberry Hydrate + Glow Dream Mask
reviews.review_text: I hate giving this product only 4 stars because it is good! I just don’t love it. It is very creamy and a little thick. It’s a nice mask and if you are interested in it at all, I’d say go for it. It does what it claims to. I didn’t wake up feeling dry or anything like that. I just prefer more glow-giving products.

reviews.product_name: T.L.C. Framboos Glycolic Resurfacing Night Serum
reviews.review_text: This is my night serum of choice. I don’t love physical exfoliants because they can damage your skin, so this product is perfect. It’s a chemical exfoliant which means it is working to exfoliate your skin even though you can’t feel any extra bits AND you don’t have to scrub! I don’t have sensitive skin so I can’t say what that does to those of you who do (at least the first go around or so), but I do have to say that after using this for about two months now I do find my skin to be brighter and a little less dull. The only issue I have with it is I have no way of knowing when I’m going to run out (which I’m not about to dock a star for because I want the product to be covered and out of reach of the sun’s rays) but it is a $90 product and I don’t love that I’ll just be spending that immediately after this runs out. Also I don’t know if you have ever seen this in action (how the pump comes up from the lid) but it’s magical and deserves a YouTube video if it doesn’t have one already.

reviews.product_name: Lemonade Smoothing Scrub
reviews.review_text: I was excited to recieve this product free from Influenster for testing purposes. Overall,  it is a good facial scrub. Initially there is a slight burn when it goes on, but it does go away quickly. It has a lemonade smell. It smells good in the bottle but a little odd when rubbing on the skin. I like that there is AHAs in the product. It leaves my skin feeling very smooth and soft. In my opinion, it is a good product. However, I was a little shocked to see it costs $32....seems a little steep for what it is.

reviews.product_name: Retinol Eye Stick
reviews.review_text: This is such a great idea. I love how it is in a stick. It makes applying so easy. I was a little hesitant because I’ve had irritation with retinols before, especially around the eyes. However,  this did not cause any irritation at all. I’m really happy with this product and it’s results!

reviews.product_name: Rose & Hyaluronic Acid Deep Hydration Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I recieved this complimentary from fresh. Overall I am really happy with it. I expected it to be really thick and oily but it wasn’t. It was light but very moisturizing. It feels great on my face. I’m not a huge fan of the smell. It reminds me of an older lady rose smell. I would have preferred it to be unscented.

reviews.product_name: Jet Lag Mask
reviews.review_text: I recieved this item complimentary from Summer Fridays for my honest review.  I really enjoy it.  My skin feels extremely moisturized. A little bit goes a long way.  I had no skin irritation with it.  There was minimal smell which was nice. I liked that it could be used as a mask and didn’t have to be washed off. Great product.

reviews.product_name: Mini Jet Lag Mask
reviews.review_text: I recieved this item complimentary from Summer Fridays for my honest review.  I really enjoy it.  My skin feels extremely moisturized. A little bit goes a long way.  I had no skin irritation with it.  There was minimal smell which was nice. I liked that it could be used as a mask and didn’t have to be washed off. Great product.

reviews.product_name: Watermelon Glow Niacinamide Sunscreen SPF 50
reviews.review_text: I was super excited for this new release. I love a good SPF. I like that it’s a 50 SPF. Most of my other sunscreens are lower so it’s nice to have a higher option. I love the ingredients and that it has nicinamide in it. It absorbs well into the skin. I didn’t get a white cast. It has a light watermelon smell which is nice. This definitely makes me wanna buy more glow recipe items.

reviews.product_name: Watermelon Glow PHA + BHA Pore-Tight Toner
reviews.review_text: I was really impressed by this toner. The texture was very interesting....a bit thicker. I liked how it felt on my skin. I liked the light Watermelon scent. The bottle felt very luxurious and bigger then I expected. I’m loving the ingredients in it too!

reviews.product_name: Mini Watermelon Glow PHA + BHA Pore-Tight Toner
reviews.review_text: I was really impressed by this toner. The texture was very interesting....a bit thicker. I liked how it felt on my skin. I liked the light Watermelon scent. The bottle felt very luxurious and bigger then I expected. I’m loving the ingredients in it too!

reviews.product_name: Urban Environment Fresh-Moisture Sunscreen Broad-Spectrum SPF 42
reviews.review_text: This sunscreen makes my face feel so good. It feels more like a moisturizer then a sunscreen. It absorbs well, without a white cast. It doesn’t make me feel greasy or gross. There is minimal sunscreen smell. It’s a bit on the pricier side for a smaller sunscreen but a great choice if you’re willing to spend a bit more.

reviews.product_name: Urban Environment Oil-Free Sunscreen Broad-Spectrum SPF 42
reviews.review_text: This is a great sunscreen. It doesn’t really remind me so much of that typical sunscreen greasiness, smell or sensation. This one is so lightweight. It absorb into the skin well, with no white cast. It can be worn under makeup without any issues. I like that this one has a agitator ball in it to mix it up.  It is a bit on the pricier side for a smaller sunscreen but a great choice if you’re willing to spend a bit more.

reviews.product_name: Sugar Lip Balm Hydrating Treatment
reviews.review_text: I received this complimentary from Fresh Beauty for my honest review. It has a nice sleek package. It goes on so smooth. Like a silky feeling. I didn’t notice too much of a tint of color, but that’s my preference.  Left my lips feeling soft and moisturized.

reviews.product_name: Tea Elixir Niacinamide & Hyaluronic Acid Anti-Aging Serum
reviews.review_text: I received this complimentary from Fresh for my honest review. First off, the packaging is perfect.  I love the green and it feels very luxurious. I love the ingredients of this serum. It feels very hydrating and refreshing on my skin. I didn’t need a moisturizer after it even. I’m excited for long term results.

reviews.product_name: Mini Daily Microfoliant Exfoliator
reviews.review_text: I received complimentary from Dermalogica Sampling some samples of this for my honest review. I have tried this in the past and enjoyed this. It leaves my skin feeling soft and looking smooth. I do plan to purchase when I use up some other products.

reviews.product_name: Midnight Recovery Concentrate Moisturizing Face Oil
reviews.review_title: only kiehl's product line I buy
reviews.review_text: tldr: I don’t like kiehl’s but I can’t argue with these results-dry oil application-saved me on trips I didn’t have moisturizer-seems to even my skin tone, help it retain moisture better than anything else and evens out the texture on my cheeks-doesn’t aggravate my rosacea-can cause blackheads if overused/used without consistent cleansing/exfoliating-I like the combination of oils in this - it feels balanced and right for the priceI have dry skin, rosacea, and kp AND I live in the Canadian Rockies (eek!). I often have itty bitty blackheads and whiteheads when I don’t have the right routine and sometimes some hormonal/stress related acne. Getting the right combination of products is tough, but possible, so I’m cautious about moisturizing products and don’t love the idea of essential oils on my skin. I don’t want to cause acne while trying to relieve my redness. I’ve also tried lots of Kiehl’s products and have found most burn or are ineffective at best. So I want to dislike this oil BUT I CAN’T. It was one of the first products I bought years ago when I began university and moved to a different climate. Every time I go to find a new night oil to replace it with, I have to accept that this product is unique. It doesn’t break me out, it doesn’t seem to sit on my skin the way some moisturizers do, I wake up with even and glowy skin, it helps the texture on my cheeks from rosacea/kp/scars and when I take it out of rotation, I notice my skin doesn’t look as good.I haven’t had even skin without redness since I was a kid, but when I pair this with Caudalie’s SOS serum and a basic moisturizer, I get darn close. Reluctantly attached to this product.

reviews.product_name: Watermelon Glow PHA + BHA Pore-Tight Toner
reviews.review_title: press in and use with oil cleanse
reviews.review_text: GLOW ALRIGHT! For blackheads, this is great at loosening stuff - I do a 15 minute oil cleanse face massage 1-2x a week and have noticed a lot more blackhead gunk coming out. This would be 5 stars for the glow, hydration from the cactus water, amount of product for the price, and blackhead clearing but I gave it 4 because of the texture. I love that the first ingredient is cactus water but that makes it have a really unique texture. Since it’s a toner, I do wonder if my other products penetrate as well through it and I haven’t had much luck pairing it with other viscous gels like The Ordinary’s niacinamide. I find this absorbs better if you press it into your face with your fingertips for about 5 seconds - you can kind of feel little air bubbles popping and I find it leaves a more even surface and I feel that it’s not just sitting on top of my skin. I don’t know if it’s the best BHA toner out there since it’s only the second one I’ve tried, but I’ll likely repurchase because the first ingredient isn’t water!

reviews.review_title: not good for my dry, acne-prone skin + rosacea
reviews.review_text: I absolutely love the smell and ingredients in this cleanser and I’m glad I tried the mini version. I have dry, blackhead-prone skin with rosacea. Some products cause the little bumps on my face to raise and unfortunately this cleanser did that. I like either super hydrating cleansers or something that will tackle my acne, and this didn’t do anything particularly great. I think it would be great for some people, but I felt like there was missed opportunity in my routine to add something more beneficial for my acne or dryness/rosacea.

reviews.product_name: Mini Daily Microfoliant Exfoliator
reviews.review_text: I have dry skin with rosacea and often have a few breakouts. I recently tried the tatcha enzyme powder to compare, and while that one does dissolve faster and feel more luxurious, I’ve found dermalogica’s actually gives results. This stuff leaves my skin BABY SMOOTH with no irritation. It has significantly helped with my redness and rosacea and I didn’t realize it contained salicylic acid, but I now get why I don’t break out when I use it. I agree it can be drying, especially if you let the lather sit for a few minutes. I follow with hydrating products anyways, and I wouldn’t say it’s stripping or causes tightness the way some drying products can. I’d recommend this 1000 times over a chemical exfoliant for my rosacea peeps, it’s gentler than I can describe and one of the most effective products I own. Gotta get through that tatcha sample and then I’ll be getting the full size of this (the mini has lasted me almost 3 months).

reviews.product_name: Vinoperfect Radiance Dark Spot Serum Vitamin C Alternative
reviews.review_text: Used both old bottle and new sample versions. It’s sticky and effective, but I notice it fades quickly after stopping. Because of that, I’m not sure it’s worth the $. Definitely more brightening than vitamin c, but I notice my skin continues to look good after stopping vitamin c for a bit, not so much with this stuff. Maybe it’s just me. You need less than you think you do, use sparingly to avoid the stickiness.

reviews.product_name: Vitamin C Suspension 23% + HA Spheres 2%
reviews.review_title: Massage for grittiness, depends on age/batch
reviews.review_text: It’s so effective at brightening. I have used different bottles and the grittiness does depend on the age and likely the batch. The older, the grittier. The grit is the vitamin C itself, so it does need to be dissolved into the skin with massage. I just opened a new one that is so smooth after getting tired of the ends of my old gritty one. The grit will reduce if you either warm it in your hands first or massage into the face after a few minutes post application. Worth a try for anyone at this price honestly, especially with most Cs running higher and higher in price.

reviews.product_name: Adaptogen Deep Moisturizing Cream with Ashwagandha + Reishi
reviews.review_text: Love the ingredients, love YTTP, but I found it didn’t absorb enough to go about my day and definitely didn’t work for me at night (pillow would eat it up). It depended, yes, on what I used underneath it, but it wasn’t versatile enough. It might work for people who don’t like or want occlusives, but I live in a dry climate and have dry skin. The vitamin C mask definitely did a better job as a moisturizer for me.

I am in love, thank you.

reviews.review_text: I have been using inkeys retinol serum for a little over one week now, and can really see a difference in my skin. I look very dewy and soft. My skin is so soft that I don’t even need to apply primer before applying makeup. I’m very pleased with the results and have been telling all my friends about this, which is a must have if you have aging skin. Thank you for such a great product.

reviews.product_name: Microneedling Anti-Wrinkle Retinol Patches
reviews.review_text: These lil patches are magic! Applying them is very easy, after putting them on you might feel a little tingly feeling but, other than that these are very non invasive. I used the patches on my wrinkles that are most prominent, in between my eyebrows. After taking the patch off in the morning, you could really see a difference in the depth of the wrinkles. I am obsessing over these lol magic patches . After five uses...wow I almost look as if I don’t use those muscles when making an upset face, Lol! I highly recommend you try these.

reviews.product_name: GOOPGLOW Microderm Instant Glow Exfoliator
reviews.review_text: I was gifted this GOOPGLOW Microderm Instant Glow Exfoliator via Goop, my opinions are my own.I began using this as instructed with a clean and dry face. I am pleased to report that an amount as small as a pea, was enough to cover my entire face, and the upper part of my neck. This formula feels so luxurious, each time you rub this product in a circular motion..you can feel thousands of tiny exfoliating beads gliding across your face.  The feeling is very nice and the scent is very fresh and citrus like.  I immediately noticed my skin looking more even and toned.  This is some very powerful stuff for it to take only one use to see such a dramatic change in my skin.  I use this twice a week and have even been asked what procedures I’ve had done..lol none! It is just the magic of GOOP!

reviews.product_name: Cream Skin Toner & Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: Cream skin toner and moisturizer is a lazy girl dream come true when it comes to skincare. It is wonderful 2 in 1 toner and a moisturizer that saves you time if you are a busy mom, if you are traveling, always on the go, you can use it after gym to refresh the skin. I love the lightweight texture that provides enough moisture even for dry skin. My skin is dry and I typically go for thicker heavier textures but I was surprised that this gem can provide enough moisture even with being so lightweight. I use it both morning and evening after cleansing and leaves my skin soft, plumped, hydrated and more even toned. This is actually my first Laneige product and so far I am impressed. I received the free sample for review purposes.

reviews.product_name: Vinosource-Hydra Moisturizing Sorbet
reviews.review_text: Vinousource sorbet has been my go to for warm summer months to give me enough moisture but again it is so lightweight it absorbs immediately. I love this light texture when it is hot and humid. I used it post-beach and it soothed my dry and red skin. Caudalie just makes wonderful products, reasonably priced. Also I love the tube packaging makes it more hygienic and travel/purse friendly. What more can you ask for?

reviews.product_name: GOOPGLOW Microderm Instant Glow Exfoliator
reviews.review_text: I was so excited to try my first Goop glow product gifted to me. It is hard to find physical and chemical exfoliant in one and this is just that! It is powerful facial in a jar and you can enjoy all the benefits of professional skincare treatment at home in just 3 minutes. Applying this on cleansed skin once or twice a week depending on your skin type and need will give you luminous and healthy looking skin. Little goes a long way. Jar packaging might be tricky and not hygienic enough. I would love to see this product in a tube packaging. Overall it is worth every penny and does what it promises.

reviews.review_text: Gifted by Glow recipe. I love how multi functional this product is. You can use it before your moisturizer to boost hydration and even out skin tone - niacinamide also helps with pore and texture. Or you can use it after and before your makeup to add some glow to your complexion. It leaves my skin soft and plumped.  Little goes a long way. Scent is their usual watermelon but it is subtle and it fades away. Packaging is cute and it matches the rest of their Watermelon line. Probably my favorite Glow recipe so far.

Avocado in their products really soothes my skin and helps with any kind of irritation. Combination of the two really work well in this serum. I like to use it AM and PM before my moisturizer. It is very lightweight and absorbs nicely and layers nicely with your existing routine.

reviews.review_text: I can not express how happy I am to add Triple lipid peptide cream to my Skinfix routine! I adore their cleanser and lotion for warmer weather but the cream is so perfect for cooler weather and on days when my skin is extra dry and dehydrated from actives I use. This repairs my skin’s barrier so nicely! Love the airless pump it is so hygenic!

Lines are much smoother, skin is softer and hydrated and concealer goes on so much nicer. Love that I saw results very shortly and will keep using it. One pump is enough for the whole face and a little bit goes a long way. One of the best items ever from dermalogica.
