reviews.review_title: Amazing for dry and aging skin
reviews.review_text: I have been a long time user of Vitamin Enriched Face Base and it’s probably my favorite product from Bobbi. It is absolutely perfect for dry and aging skin because it gives such a nice boost of hydration, makes skin plumped and healthy/glowy looking. A little bit goes a long way since it’s creamy and it glides easily on the skin.  The only downside might be a jar packaging but I don’t personally mind. This pairs beautifully with any foundation liquid or powder and it just makes my dry skin look so much better and doesn’t let foundation set into pores or lines, nor it cakes.

reviews.product_name: Floral Recovery Overnight Mask with Squalane
reviews.review_text: I have never tried a product I didn’t love from Fresh. Simply this brand works so well for me. This is a lovely overnight mask that keeps my skin plumped, smoothed, soft. I do not have redness so can’t comment on that but I feel it helps a lot with dry skin during the winter heating season. It is wonderful if you overdo acids as well - it helps bring back skin to balance and protect it’s barrier.

reviews.product_name: Mini Daily Microfoliant Exfoliator
reviews.review_text: Lovely gentle daily exfoliant. I especially love to use it in the shower after the pre-cleanse oil also from dermalogica. It keeps skin glowy, soft on touch, brighter, and more even-toned. I follow with a serum and a moisturizer. A little bit goes a long way. True staple.

reviews.product_name: Daily Microfoliant Exfoliator
reviews.review_text: Lovely gentle daily exfoliant. I especially love to use it in the shower after the pre-cleanse oil also from dermalogica. It keeps skin glowy, soft on touch, brighter, and more even-toned. I follow with a serum and a moisturizer. A little bit goes a long way. True staple.

reviews.product_name: Retinol Youth Renewal Serum
reviews.review_text: I adore using retinol in my routine and this one is gentle enough that does not irritate my skin but at the same time I can see visible improvements in my skin. It smooths out the texture, corrects fine lines as well. You have to be consistent with the retinol and to slowly build up if you want to see results. Don’t forget if you are sensitive use a buffer like hyaluronic acid. Make sure you use SPF. I never experienced any redness or irritation with this one. Love the pump packaging, a little bit goes a long way.

reviews.product_name: Mini Retinol Youth Renewal Serum
reviews.review_text: I adore using retinol in my routine and this one is gentle enough that does not irritate my skin but at the same time I can see visible improvements in my skin. It smooths out the texture, corrects fine lines as well. You have to be consistent with the retinol and to slowly build up if you want to see results. Don’t forget if you are sensitive use a buffer like hyaluronic acid. Make sure you use SPF. I never experienced any redness or irritation with this one. Love the pump packaging, a little bit goes a long way.

reviews.product_name: Magic Cream Moisturizer with Hyaluronic Acid
reviews.review_title: What soft skin dreams are made of!
reviews.review_text: This is iconic for a reason! Rich creamy buttery texture works like a magic on all skin types but mostly on normal dry and especially aging skin to smooth fine lines and prep the skin for makeup application. It makes my skin soft and smooth, and just creates the perfect canvas for my makeup to look flawless. Charlotte can’t do no wrong!

reviews.product_name: Triple Algae Eye Renewal Balm Eye Cream
reviews.review_text: I received this complimentary from Algenist. I have loved and used Algenist eye creams since it launched first and when I thought they could not improve formula even more I was wrong. This is pure perfection. It is lovely thick and creamy and works so well on my skin that is dry around eyes and has fine lines. It smooths them, plumps the skin, and helps it look and feel hydrated. A bit goes a long way. Love love love. Algenist never fails me

reviews.product_name: Sugar Lip Balm Hydrating Treatment
reviews.review_text: I received this product complimentary from Fresh beauty. This is my absolute must-have! I have gone through numerous tubes of this gorgeousness - lightweight hydration, a perfect rosy shade that gives my lips but better vibe.

reviews.product_name: Tea Elixir Niacinamide & Hyaluronic Acid Anti-Aging Serum
reviews.review_text: Fresh can do no wrong. I incorporated this into my routine which is typically Rose Toner, and their Rose moisturizer. This just gives me added hydration, bounce and less sensitive skin. The bottle is gorgeous so luxe and heavy. I also use this at night after my Kombucha treatment.

reviews.product_name: Precleanse Cleansing Oil
reviews.review_text: This product was gifted to me by Dermalogica. I was very impressed with this product! As a licensed aesthetician I am very picky on what I use on my skin. I had the opportunity to try this pre cleanse cleansing oil and I love it . This cleansing oil has a pleasant smell and does an amazing job removing make up and sunscreen. My skin feels smooth and clean after using it!!! Definitely a keeper and I will get it again!

reviews.product_name: Mini Precleanse Cleansing Oil
reviews.review_text: This product was gifted to me by Dermalogica. I was very impressed with this product! As a licensed aesthetician I am very picky on what I use on my skin. I had the opportunity to try this pre cleanse cleansing oil and I love it . This cleansing oil has a pleasant smell and does an amazing job removing make up and sunscreen. My skin feels smooth and clean after using it!!! Definitely a keeper and I will get it again!

reviews.product_name: Vitamin Enriched Face Base Priming Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I was so excited to try this Vitamin Enriched Face Base Priming Moisturizer . Moisturizer works like miracle. After a couple of use you can see how smooth is skin and same time hydrated. Will definitely last for a while. My skin is combination and with large pores and I am very happy with the results. It’s creamy but not greasy, penetrate very fast leaving smooth and glowing skin. So easy to apply my make up after using this cream. Great product.

reviews.product_name: Retinol Youth Renewal Serum
reviews.review_text: Retinol Youth Renewal Serum from Murad feels very light and penetrate easy . Has some scent that I was not fan of it. I have normal skin type with t-zone,fine likens and it works great with my skin. You can see that product doing the job very soon. Great packaging. I was excited yo try it because I used to work with this brand and love their products. Overall I recommend this product.

reviews.product_name: Mini Retinol Youth Renewal Serum
reviews.review_text: Retinol Youth Renewal Serum from Murad feels very light and penetrate easy . Has some scent that I was not fan of it. I have normal skin type with t-zone,fine likens and it works great with my skin. You can see that product doing the job very soon. Great packaging. I was excited yo try it because I used to work with this brand and love their products. Overall I recommend this product.

reviews.product_name: Watermelon Glow Niacinamide Sunscreen SPF 50
reviews.review_text: I was excited to try this new product. The texture is supersmooth and light and easy to use. Very soft and pleasantscent. Definitely need to shake before using it. Skinlooks glowing. Beautiful package. Definitely recommendit. Don’t forget to use it every 2 hours ! Taking it with meto my next vacation!

reviews.product_name: Double Serum Firming & Smoothing Anti-Aging Concentrate
reviews.review_text: This is my 2022 serum. Let’s start from packaging it’s beautiful and so easy to use. Product texture is light and absorbs so easy. I like they way it feels on my skin when I apply it. After using it skin feels more hydrated and even skin tone . I have some pigmentation so it’s definitely getting lighter. Skin feels smooth. The only thing is this serum has fragrance and It not bothering me it’s not overwhelming.

reviews.product_name: Watermelon Glow PHA + BHA Pore-Tight Toner
reviews.review_text: Toner is must have in my daily routine. I have combination skin with occasional breakouts and this product help me to control it. My large pores on my Tzone look smaller and skin in general glowing and bright. I use it at night time right after I wash my face. Has lovely scent and beautiful packaging. Great addition to my skincare.

reviews.product_name: Mini Watermelon Glow PHA + BHA Pore-Tight Toner
reviews.review_text: Toner is must have in my daily routine. I have combination skin with occasional breakouts and this product help me to control it. My large pores on my Tzone look smaller and skin in general glowing and bright. I use it at night time right after I wash my face. Has lovely scent and beautiful packaging. Great addition to my skincare.

reviews.product_name: Daily Greens Oil-Free Gel Moisturizer with Moringa and Papaya
reviews.review_text: Gifted by Farmacy Beauty.As a professional skin care specialist I can tell that this moisturizer is great for people who doesn’t like to feel anything on their skin. Texture is so light but very hydrating same time. Scent is interesting definitely no perfume but has little pleasant scent. Absorb so easy and my skin feels very comfortable afterwards I am 40 and have normal skin. Great moisturizer for any age, clean ingredients.

reviews.product_name: GENIUS Liquid Collagen Serum
reviews.review_text: Gifted by Algenist. This serum exactly what my skin needs specially after summer. I am 40 years old and loosing elasticity so after using for about 2 weeks I feel improvement, my skin feels firmer, hydrated and bright. Definitely glowing skin. Love that packaging. Great ingredients list . Definitely a keeper.

reviews.product_name: Barrier+ Triple Lipid-Peptide Face Cream
reviews.review_text: Great moisturizer specifically if you like one without scent. Scooper hydrating and makes your skin feels smoother and healthier. I love clean ingredients list that what we all need these days. Great packaging and fast results specially during winter months will be great to keep your skin moist and protected.

reviews.product_name: Mini Barrier+ Triple Lipid-Peptide Face Cream
reviews.review_text: Great moisturizer specifically if you like one without scent. Scooper hydrating and makes your skin feels smoother and healthier. I love clean ingredients list that what we all need these days. Great packaging and fast results specially during winter months will be great to keep your skin moist and protected.

reviews.product_name: C-Firma Fresh Vitamin-C Day Serum
reviews.review_text: One of the best vitamin C products I ever used. Super lightweight formula and easy absorbs. Great results just after a week of using it. Skin is brighter and smoother. Definitely skin feels firmer. I use it in am and my skin is glowing all day.

reviews.product_name: Plum Plump Hyaluronic Acid Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: Complimentary from Glow recipe. Wow what a beautiful packaging. Really love this moisturizer. It helps my skin stay hydrated throughout the day. I love the scent too. I feel like it plump my skin and my like much smoother. Great overall definitely recommend.

reviews.product_name: Mini Plum Plump Hyaluronic Acid Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: Complimentary from Glow recipe. Wow what a beautiful packaging. Really love this moisturizer. It helps my skin stay hydrated throughout the day. I love the scent too. I feel like it plump my skin and my like much smoother. Great overall definitely recommend.

reviews.product_name: Avocado Fine Line Eye Cream with Retinol
reviews.review_text: I received this complimentary from Glow Recipe I have been using the Avocado Melt Retinol Eye Sleeping Mask for a couple weeks now, I really like the texture of this mask. My under eyes look more hydrated and refreshed, I havestarted to see a difference in my fine lines and dark circles. This keeps my undereye are hydrated without any irritation,  this will definitely be apart of my daily skincare routine.

reviews.product_name: Watermelon Glow Niacinamide Dew Drops
reviews.review_text: #giftedbyglowrecipe Watermelon Glow Niacinamide Dew Drops highlighting serum can be worn alone on no makeup days, or as the last step in your skincare routine.  You can also add it to the high points of your cheeks as a Highlighter and it is gorgeous. My skin instantly felt silky soft and had a beautiful radiance about it. This is a game changer for sure. The texture is very lightweight,  it wears great under makeup or alone & absorbes quickly without being sticky.

reviews.product_name: 5 Stars Retinol + Niacinamide Eye Serum
reviews.review_text: I have been using the 5 Stars Ete serum for about a week now. I have been using it nightly without any irritation (and I have sensitive skin). My under-eye are appears smooth and hydrated. It absorbes quickly without feeling heavy on my under-eye area.  I can’t wait to see the long term results from this serum.

reviews.product_name: Confidence in a Cream Anti-Aging Hydrating Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I absolutely love the hydration and nourishing moisture this adds to my dry skin. It is packed with skin looking ingredients and the packaging is so perfect. Definitely my new go to moisturizer.

reviews.product_name: Tea Elixir Niacinamide & Hyaluronic Acid Anti-Aging Serum
reviews.review_text: Complimentary from Fresh Beauty I absolutely love this New Yea Elixer Serum. I am starting to see fabulous results, skin looks smoother, firmer, plump and hydrated. I have been using it twice a day it absorbes quickly without being heavy or sticky. It has a light pleasant natural scent, the packaging is perfect. I can’t wait to see the long term results.

reviews.product_name: Auto Correct Brightening + Depuffing Eye Cream for Dark Circles
reviews.review_text: Gifted by Sunday RileyI absolutely love this eye contour cream. I have been using it fir a few weeks now and the brightening effect is instant, it is hydrating and absorbs quickly. It keeps my undereye are looking hydrated, brightening,  and youthful-looking. I definitely recommend giving this a try you won’t be disappointed. I have sensitive eyes and had zero irritation.

reviews.product_name: Vitamin Enriched Face Base Priming Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I absolutely love the hydration this gives my skin in prep for my makeup application. It is so nourishing and yet lightweight on the skin. It doesn’t leave the skin feeling greasy just hydrated and fresh. This will definitely be a staple in my makeup prep routine.

reviews.product_name: The Dewy Skin Cream Plumping & Hydrating Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I received a mini version of this moisturizer for free after making a purchase off the Tatcha website. However, if you purchase the mini version yourself, the retail value is $20. This seems a bit expensive for such a small amount of the moisturizer. This face cream absorbs into the skin well, and there isn’t necessarily anything “bad” about it. However, I much prefer The Silk Cream because it absorbs into the skin better and is slightly lighter. The Dewy Cream leaves your skin a little shiny/glowy, so this may be a good face cream for those searching for a winter moisturizer or those with dry skin.

reviews.product_name: B-Hydra Intensive Hydration Serum with Hyaluronic Acid
reviews.review_text: Although I don’t see any drastic difference after using this serum, it does keep my face extra moisturized without leaving behind a sticky residue. It absorbs into the skin super quickly and feels refreshing on the face. After applying, my skin feels smoother. For reference, I normally use this before applying the Tatcha Silk Cream.

reviews.product_name: The Deep Cleanse Gentle Exfoliating Cleanser
reviews.review_text: I love this cleanser - it feels so refreshing and has a subtle scent. When I first smelled it, it instantly reminded me of hotel soaps (which I was a little disappointed by because this cleanser is pretty expensive). Once I started using it, however, it felt like pure luxury. I’ve seen some people complain that it’s difficult to squeeze out the product. Well, I don’t if those people are extremely weak or what, because the bottle is pretty soft and easy to squeeze.

reviews.product_name: Mini Deep Cleanse Gentle Exfoliating Cleanser
reviews.review_text: I love this cleanser - it feels so refreshing and has a subtle scent. When I first smelled it, it instantly reminded me of hotel soaps (which I was a little disappointed by because this cleanser is pretty expensive). Once I started using it, however, it felt like pure luxury. I’ve seen some people complain that it’s difficult to squeeze out the product. Well, I don’t if those people are extremely weak or what, because the bottle is pretty soft and easy to squeeze.

reviews.product_name: The Rice Polish Foaming Enzyme Powder
reviews.review_text: I love this exfoliator because it is gentle yet effective! After using the Rice Polish, my skin feels so unbelievably smooth (not tight at all)! The packaging is well thought-out - there is a sliding cover to so that you can easily pour out a small amount of the powder. And, a little goes a long way, so one bottle will last a long time!

reviews.product_name: Violet-C Brightening Serum 20% Vitamin C + 10% AHA
reviews.review_text: This serum is SO amazing! I had a little white bump on my nose for months that I could not get rid of no matter how hard I tried - after using this serum for a couple weeks, the bump completely disappeared! I have also noticed that the serum helps lighten any dark areas on my face after a few uses.

reviews.product_name: Crème de la Mer Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: This cream makes your skin feel as soft as a cloud! It absorbs quickly and doesn’t leave behind any residue, so it won’t dirty your pillowcase at night. The scent is pleasant and not overpowering. The La Mer moisturizer is one of my favorite face creams (the other is the Tatcha Silk Cream).

reviews.product_name: Mini Crème de la Mer Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: This cream makes your skin feel as soft as a cloud! It absorbs quickly and doesn’t leave behind any residue, so it won’t dirty your pillowcase at night. The scent is pleasant and not overpowering. The La Mer moisturizer is one of my favorite face creams (the other is the Tatcha Silk Cream).

reviews.product_name: Volcanic AHA Pore Clearing Clay Mask
reviews.review_text: The Volcanic Pore Clay mask is a good mask at a low price. I usually use this mask if I notice a pimple forming on my face. After washing the mask off, the pimple is visibly smaller (because the mask draws out the oil). However, the clay can definitely dry out your skin, so make sure to moisturize after!

reviews.product_name: Rose & Hyaluronic Acid Deep Hydration Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I received this product complimentary from Fresh. This moisturizer does not feel oily and absorbs quickly into the skin. However, the moisturizer has a strong fragrance, which may irritate noses and sensitive skin.

reviews.product_name: Squalane + Marine Algae Firming & Lifting Eye Cream
reviews.review_text: I just received this eye cream, and it surpassed my expectations! The product has a light and airy consistency with little/no scent. I can’t speak to long-term effects as I only just started using it, but my undereye area was not puffy the morning after applying the product. There also was a slight lightening effect on my dark circles. It wasn’t anything drastic, but I noticed that I needed less concealer to hide them. One thing to note is that the eye cream doesn’t come with a little spoon, which would be helpful since the product is packaged in a jar.

reviews.product_name: Rose & Hyaluronic Acid Deep Hydration Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: This moisturizer is so hydrating! I absolutely love this formulation. This instantly blended in and left my skin feeling so smooth. I love that this doesn’t have a super strong scent! I highly recommend!

reviews.product_name: 5 Stars Retinol + Niacinamide Eye Serum
reviews.review_text: First of all, can we talk about the packaging? I’m so obsessed. This has niacinamide and retinol and glides on to the skin so well. The applicator is so easy to use and it feels so amazing on your skin. I highly recommend!

reviews.product_name: Floral Recovery Overnight Mask with Squalane
reviews.review_text: I was really impressed by how soothing this face mask is! I have been struggling with redness lately and saw my skin improve significantly. If you have sensitive and dry skin, this mask is definitely for you.

reviews.product_name: Vitamin Enriched Face Base Priming Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I love love love how this makes my face feel and look! I’ve been on the hunt for a new primer and this is definitely a game changer. When I normally apply makeup, I find myself struggling with dryness which makes my makeup look cakey and crease but this has definitely helped change that!

reviews.product_name: Self Tanning Bronzing Face Drops
reviews.review_text: These drops make tanning so easy! I cannot believe how well these work. Using drops is so much more convenient than any sprays or foams. These drops yield such gorgeous results, I highly recommend you try them out. This was gifted by Isle of Paradise for review purposes.

reviews.product_name: Watermelon Glow PHA + BHA Pore-Tight Toner
reviews.review_text: This toner is a must-have for glowy skin. It is insane how well this works! This is super gentle and while it does have a smell to it, it is very pleasant. I love applying this before doing my makeup because it helps even your complexion. I highly recommend you try this!

reviews.product_name: Mini Watermelon Glow PHA + BHA Pore-Tight Toner
reviews.review_text: This toner is a must-have for glowy skin. It is insane how well this works! This is super gentle and while it does have a smell to it, it is very pleasant. I love applying this before doing my makeup because it helps even your complexion. I highly recommend you try this!

reviews.product_name: Sugar Lip Balm Hydrating Treatment
reviews.review_text: I am so obsessed with this lip balm! It gives you the most gorgeous pink tint and it leaves you super moisturized. I absolutely love this so much. This was gifted to me by fresh beauty for review purposes!

reviews.product_name: Tea Elixir Niacinamide & Hyaluronic Acid Anti-Aging Serum
reviews.review_text: This new serum by fresh is amazing! This room instantly leaves your skin feeling revitalized and refreshed. After only a few uses, my skin is noticeably more glowing and hydrated. There is a scent to this however it is not overpowering.

reviews.product_name: Beste No. 9 Jelly Cleanser
reviews.review_text: I’ll be honest, I’m not too picky about my cleansers because they’re not on my face for very long.   This cleanser is gel-like and does a good job of removing makeup.   I use it with my Foreo.  It bubbles, but not too much, which is a good thing because I’ve found sudsy ones dry my face out.  I really like the consistency and the performance of this product.  I have combo skin and it seems to deal with both well.

reviews.product_name: Lala Retro Whipped Refillable Moisturizer with Ceramides
reviews.review_text: I really like this moisturizer.  It’s hydrating and absorbs easily.  The innovative dispenser prevents contamination.  It has a whipped consistency which glides easily onto the face.  I mix it with my tretinoin 3x a week and with the DE Framboise 2x a week.

reviews.product_name: T.L.C. Framboos Glycolic Resurfacing Night Serum
reviews.review_text: I love this product.  It is a powerhouse, so it should be used with caution. Start slow and build up days.  My face looks fresh in the mornings and more youthful.   I’m really loving the results!

reviews.product_name: Lippe Balm
reviews.review_text: I want to preface this by saying I’m allergic to many lip products and they make my lips peel, hence the 3 stars.   This did the same thing, but while it was on, it felt good and moisturizing.  I just can’t use it, which is a bummer!

reviews.product_name: C-Tango Vitamin C Eye Cream
reviews.review_text: I’m always on the hunt for a good eye cream because I have severe dark circles and troughs.    This is a good eye cream, it is hydrating, but it’s not necessarily brightening, which is what I need.   It doesn’t claim to be, though.   The Vitamin C is lessening the discoloration in a certain area of my eye, which is great!

reviews.product_name: Benefiance Wrinkle Smoothing Eye Cream
reviews.review_text: I have used this eye cream nightly for approximately 2 and a half weeks.  I have not yet noticed a reduction in wrinkles, but I have definitely noticed a reduction in puffiness. It’s a thicker consistency, so a little goes a long way when hydrating the under eyes. I have never really been into undereye products because my troughs are so deep and the hereditary dark circles are so dark.   But, with the puffiness down from this product, the dark circles are less noticeable because there’s less shadow.   Would purchase again!

reviews.product_name: Urban Environment Oil-Free Sunscreen Broad-Spectrum SPF 42
reviews.review_text: Oil-free, tinted and protective!  I am a fan of this sunscreen.  Shiseido knocked this one out of the park for a light, hydrating sunscreen for the summer.  It plays well with makeup, too.

reviews.product_name: Urban Environment Fresh-Moisture Sunscreen Broad-Spectrum SPF 42
reviews.review_text: This sunscreen is hydrating, protective, and works great as a primer underneath makeup.  It doesn’t have a strong scent to it, either. I would definitely buy again!

reviews.product_name: Pure Skin Face Cleanser
reviews.review_text: This is a great basic cleanser. Works well formy acne prone skin. It removes all my make up and doesn’t leave my skin feeling tight or dry.

reviews.product_name: Good Genes All-In-One AHA Lactic Acid Treatment
reviews.review_title: Good product but results did not last
reviews.review_text: Really amazing lactic acid treatment but results did not last. My skin unfortunately got use to the product fairly quickly and I didn’t continue to see the same results. Would still recommend to someone starting out with acid treatments, maybe they will have better luck.

reviews.product_name: The True Cream Moisturizing Bomb
reviews.review_text: Incredible moisturizer! This is my go to when my skin needs some xtra TLC. Love it!!!

reviews.product_name: Checks and Balances Frothy Face Wash
reviews.review_text: Made my skin feel very tight and dry. I have acne prone, combination skin.

reviews.product_name: Luna Sleeping Retinoid Night Oil
reviews.review_title: Great for first time retinol users
reviews.review_text: This worked really well in the beginning, but my skin unfortunately got use to it. This was my first introduction into the retinol world and since it is a natural retinol it was a good first step because it’s more gentle. I have since graduated to more intense retinols. I wish this still worked for my skin as the initial results were great. Definitely give it a shot but don’t be surprised if you get use to it.

reviews.product_name: A-Passioni Retinol Cream
reviews.review_text: I waited 2 months before writing this review and man this stuff is so good. First off I’m 31 with mild-moderate adult acne, redness and skin sensitivity.  Before purchasing this product I was breaking out with tiny flesh colored bumps all over my forehead as well as some pimples on my chin and cheeks. All this was brought on I believe by a bad combo of skincare products. I was so desperate to get my skin under control that I turned to a retinol. I’m not a stranger to retinols as I have used them in the past (peels too) but never have I had the same results as i did from this product. This stuff is good and strong. I have been using it for 2 months and still only use it 1x a week. To get the best results with the least amount of irritation make sure you are mixing this product with the b-hydra serum and then applying this combo on skin.  You will still have some peeling and flaking but it’s totally manageable. I still have some redness for 1-2 after using it. BUT my skin looks amazing! It’s smooth, clear

reviews.product_name: B-Hydra Intensive Hydration Serum with Hyaluronic Acid
reviews.review_text: As a stand alone serum its ok. For the price point I would expect better hydration and smoother results. However when used in conjuction with the A-passioni retinol its awesome because it cuts down irritation and redness by half!

reviews.product_name: Lotus Anti-Aging Night Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: This night cream is incredible!!!! After one use I woke up to smooth, hydrated, plump, glowing skin! I thought it was a fluke but it continues to impress. I am acne prone and this cream did not break me out. Not only is the cream amazing but the packaging is beautiful and looks great on your bathroom counter. My only issue is the peach smell which to me is too fruity and strong for a night time cream, but it’s a small price to pay for great skin. If the price deters you, they have mini you can try out. I highly recommend!

reviews.product_name: T.L.C. Sukari Babyfacial AHA + BHA Mask
reviews.review_text: Amazing peel! I was so nervous to try this product (afraid it would be too strong), but I’m so happy I did! For reference I have mild adult acne, skin sensitivity and can sometimes be dry. You definitely feel a slight tingling when you first apply it, but skin quickly adjusts and the tingling goes away. I apply it as directed and am left with smooth, glowing skin! No peeling or redness, but I do only use this product like 2-3x a month. Definitely recommend!

reviews.product_name: Oat Cleansing Balm
reviews.review_text: I’m loving this I key List Oat Cleansing Balm! It’s great for me since I have sensitive skin. There is no fragrance. It lathers well. My face feels fresh and clean after every use. I’ll be looking into more Inkey products. Would recommend!!!

reviews.product_name: Mini Oat Cleansing Balm
reviews.review_text: I’m loving this I key List Oat Cleansing Balm! It’s great for me since I have sensitive skin. There is no fragrance. It lathers well. My face feels fresh and clean after every use. I’ll be looking into more Inkey products. Would recommend!!!

reviews.product_name: Santorini Grape Poreless Skin Cream
reviews.review_text: I’ve been using this for about a week now. I’m pretty impressed with the results too!!! My skin looks much healthier. My pores seem smaller. My skin feel smoother. I honestly love it! I’ll continue to use and see how much more it helps with my skin.

reviews.product_name: Sugar Lip Balm Hydrating Treatment
reviews.review_text: I’ve really been enjoying this lip treatment. My lips feel nice and hydrated. Leaves a nice tint on my lips. I enjoy the scent and taste of it. The packaging is really nice. Overall I’m really impressed with this Fresh Sugar Lip treatment.

reviews.product_name: Confidence in a Cream Anti-Aging Hydrating Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I received this for free, that being said, I really enjoyed this cream! I noticed my fine lines and wrinkles weren’t as noticeable. The lines were less harsh. My skin always felt moisturized. My skin felt nice and smooth. Overall I was really impressed. I’ve used for about 2 weeks, will continue to use to see more results.

reviews.product_name: Tea Elixir Niacinamide & Hyaluronic Acid Anti-Aging Serum
reviews.review_text: I liked this a lot! The smell is amazing!!!! I felt that it really helped with my skin issues. My skin felt nice and over all looked amazing.

reviews.product_name: Mini Daily Microfoliant Exfoliator

You want to be gentle when using this mask because it tends to be a bit abrasive to the skin. I applied mine with a spatula because this one does not come with one. reviews.product_name: Capture Totale Super Potent Eye Serum
reviews.review_text: This serum has a lovely texture, smooth and luxurious, with a cooling nature on its own in addition to the cooling effect provided by the applicator. The applicator itself is convenient and perfectly shaped for the eye area, with ridges to help smoothly spread the product while gently massaging it in. After a few minutes I consistently notice a tightening of the skin under my eyes and at the edges, and it absorbs quickly and thoroughly, but I haven’t noticed the brightening effects I had hoped for. I’m very fair and experience some darkness under my eyes that is more pronounced. Over the month or so that I’ve used it, I have definitely noticed firming and lifting around my eyes. The only drawback is that dispensing enough product onto the applicator is a learning curve, but overall it seems there is less product waste than with more traditional potted eye products.

reviews.product_name: Abeille Royale Advanced Youth Watery Oil
reviews.review_text: This is a wonderfully luxurious product which feels more like a serum than an oil. It has a very smooth consistency, absorbs thoroughly, and there is a beautiful scent to it—not at all perfume-y, but subtle and natural smelling. I have used it for several weeks and have noticed a definite softening and smoothing effect on my skin overall, and calming of some of my redness. The only drawback is that it’s easy to go through it rather quickly. In order to dissolve the beads inside, Guerlain recommends warming the product in your hands, and it causes me to wonder how much is absorbed by your palms before it can be applied to the face. Overall, still a product I am definitely considering replenishing when it runs out.

I have used other creams in the past and this works the best, by far. There’s no itching or burning sensation. It comes with a small spatula to scoop out a pearl size amount of product and then rub it in a circular, outward and upward motion with your ring fingers. The only complaint I have is the fact that it doesn’t feel like it soaks it. Your skin will feel “wet” for hours. For this reason, I only apply at night. Some complain about this product being “pricey” but I truly think it’s worth it! I am hooked!!

reviews.review_text: Let’s start off with the GORGEOUS packaging. The radiant baby pink glass bottle is so beautiful and even refillable! I also use it alone as the last step in skincare before I go to bed. I will warn you though, that the product has a very strong smell. It reminds me of a Grandma’s lotion. Anyways, it dispenses into a peach colored light cream and absorbs easily when rubbed into the skin. Your face will feel a bit greasy but I can also feel it working it’s magic right away. It glosses over your pores reducing their appearance as well as fine lines. I’ve also noticed it does work well as a primer to make my makeup last all day. With continued use, I hope to see even more results. This bottle should last me quite a long time which is a huge plus.

reviews.review_title: Removes waterproof mascara, rinses off clean
reviews.review_text: I was initially scared to use a balm cleanser as I have oily skin that’s prone to breakouts, but I love this and have gone through 3 tubs so far. This doesn’t break me out and does a great job of removing makeup, including waterproof mascara which I wear everyday. You have to massage it into your lashes for maybe 20 seconds depending on how much makeup you wear, but that’s to be expected with removing waterproof makeup. You massage it to your dry face to break down makeup, then it turns into a milky consistency when you add water, and I love how easily it rinses off. Leaves your face clean and feeling moisturized but with no oily residue. I use this for makeup removal, so I follow with another cleanser. The tub lasts a long time for me as well, many months, since I probably only use about 1-2 pea sized amounts per use.

reviews.review_title: I wanted to love it, sensitive skin says no
reviews.review_text: Let me start by saying that I did extensive research before purchasing a moisturizer. I moved states and my skin went from dry to oily. It’s UBER sensitive and acne prone so I’m wary trying new things. The top of every google search and “20 best moisturizers” list was this one, so I tried it. It really hydrated my skin and the smell wasn’t as bad as other moisturizers I’ve tried. But I started noticing my skin was breaking out in places it normally didn’t. I wasn’t sure if it was the cleanser I had just switched to or if my face got too used to my primer/makeup. So I eliminated everything and went back to my old cleanser, and my skin kept breaking out. I went on a weekend trip and forgot my moisturizer and borrowed some from my friend I was with. My skin CLEARED. When I got back home and used the moisturizer, my skin broke out all over again. My skin hasn’t been this bad since before I went through acutane almost a decade ago. Do yourself a favor and don’t get this one.

I’m over half way done to bottle, I apply am and pm. there has been absolutely no difference in my skin. Sun spots still there, haven’t faded in the slightly. I know things take time but I would have thought I would have seen a slight difference by now. I think this is best for dry skin that needs hydration and that would be it.

This has definitely reduced the flakiness of my dry patches and has leaves my skin absolutely glowing when I wake up.

reviews.review_text: I’ve loved the Green Clean Cleansing Balm for about 2-3 years now, so I was so excited to try this oil-free gel moisturizer. First off, it smells great - very fresh, nothing overwhelming though. I love that it is a gel consistency, which is best for oily skin. I’ve tried many gel moisturizers and this one may be the most hydrating one to date. Some gel moisturizers leave my oily skin feeling tight, but this one doesn’t do that. It does absorb into the skin quite nicely, but I will say that it leaves a slightly tacky finish to the touch. It’s nothing that bothers me immensely, but thought I would note that. This is a phenomenal product and it’s become another one of my favorites from Farmacy Beauty.

reviews.product_name: Watermelon Pink Juice Oil-Free Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I received this product complimentary from Glow Recipe for reviewing purposes. I’ve wanted to try this for a while now because it sounds like it would be great for my combination-oily skin. I can confirm that if you have combination to oily skin, this will definitely work for you, but if you have normal to dry skin, it may not be moisturizing enough. It absorbs incredibly fast, which is great especially in my morning routine before makeup application. It has a slight residue after it dries, so I can see how it can perform as a makeup primer as well. It has quite a strong sweet scent right out of the bottle, which I know people either love or hate. I personally didn’t mind it too much because it doesn’t linger.  If you love their watermelon + aha glow sleeping mask, I think you’ll love this product too!

reviews.product_name: Watermelon Glow Niacinamide Dew Drops
reviews.review_text: This product was gifted by Glow Recipe for review purposes. The texture of this product reminds me a lot of their watermelon pink juice oil-free moisturizer. It’s lightweight and it is slightly tacky upon application, which is perfect for makeup prep. I was worried that these dew drops would make my oily/combination skin look too slick or greasy, but after using it under my makeup a couple times, I would actually say this product is amazing for oily/combination skin types who love a good glow. It provides the glow, but it does dry down so it doesn’t feel like an added layer of moisturizer or anything that might feel too heavy for people with a similar skin type as mine. You will definitely be glowing in a very healthy and natural way with this product.

reviews.product_name: Avocado Soothing Skin Barrier Serum with Ceramides
reviews.review_text: This product was gifted by Glow Recipe for review purposes. Honestly, this may be my favorite product from Glow Recipe thus far. I don’t have a ton of redness, so I can’t speak too much on that, but my skin was on the irritated and flaky side before trying this product. It really calmed my skin down and it provided a nice layer of moisture. The texture is light and it absorbs quickly. I also love that it is ever so slightly scented, which is ideal for people who don’t like too much fragrance in their skincare products. A lot of Glow Recipe’s products are much more heavily fragranced than this, so I’m especially thrilled that this is lightly fragranced. This is such a nice serum and it will definitely stay in the skincare rotation.

reviews.product_name: Rose & Hyaluronic Acid Deep Hydration Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: This product was gifted by Fresh Beauty for review purposes. I’ve tried the original version of this cream in the past, so I can say that this reformulated version definitely feels more hydrating than the original version. The scent and the texture is the same. It has a gel-like consistency, so it feels rather lightweight while being extremely hydrating. Because it is so hydrating, I can see it being even a better fit for people with drier and/or dehydrated skin types. This sat under my makeup with no issues so I can see most people using and loving this as their morning and nighttime moisturizer.

reviews.product_name: Precleanse Cleansing Oil
reviews.review_text: This product was gifted by Dermalogica. I really liked the way this cleansed my skin. It removed my makeup easily without any tugging at my skin. Even though I use another cleanser after using this, this was incredibly easy to remove and it didn’t feel tacky or waxy on my skin. It has a light citrus scent that is pleasant and isn’t overbearing.  Overall, I really like this, but I will say that it is quite pricey.

reviews.review_text: This product was gifted by Dermalogica. I really liked the way this cleansed my skin. It removed my makeup easily without any tugging at my skin. It has a light citrus scent that is pleasant and isn’t overbearing.  Overall, I really like this, but I will say that it is quite pricey.

reviews.product_name: Plum Plump Hyaluronic Acid Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: This moisturizer has been a great addition to my morning skincare routine. I like that it’s hydrating, but it’s lightweight. It’s actually more lightweight than I anticipated. If you have combination/oily skin, this moisturizer would be great even in the colder months. However, if you have a more dry skin type, this might not be enough. The scent is very mild. Also, the packaging is great because you can buy refill pods once you’ve emptied it.

reviews.product_name: Floral Recovery Overnight Mask with Squalane
reviews.review_text: I love this mask! I’m a huge fan of a lot of the fresh beauty masks and this one is no exception. It’s nice and thick and it really moisturized my skin. I have sensitive skin and it gets red and blotchy randomly every now and then. I haven’t been able to try this when my skin is red and blotchy yet, but I really liked how it felt on just slightly drier, winter skin. Because it can be left on overnight, I use it as the last step of my nighttime skincare routine and I wake up with smooth and soft skin.

reviews.product_name: Vitamin Enriched Face Base Priming Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: The Face Base is such an iconic product. This priming moisturizer is so moisturizing that I would definitely see this being ideal for people with a drier skin type. When I had oily skin a few years back, I felt like this was a little too heavy for my skin. I now have combination skin and I love it. A little goes a long way, so I’d start with a pea-sized amount. It gives the slightest tacky feeling, which helps the makeup to adhere, but it’s nothing obnoxious or uncomfortable. This is definitely a pricey product, but I think it’s such a nice product.

reviews.product_name: Salicylic Acid Acne Healing Dots
reviews.review_text: This product was gifted by Peace Out Skincare. I used this on a blemish and the blemish shrunk significantly overnight, so they do work. These are also larger patches than what I’m used to so I’d imagine you could actually cover 2 blemishes with one patch if your blemishes are really close together. This product definitely works and does what it claims to do, but it is much pricier than the ones I usually use. I also don’t find them to be vastly different than other brands as well, so I’m kind of on the fence about these ones.

reviews.product_name: Tea Elixir Niacinamide & Hyaluronic Acid Anti-Aging Serum
reviews.review_text: This product was gifted by Fresh Beauty for review purposes. I adore the ingredients in this products; my combination, acne-prone skin loves anything hydrating and helps with strengthening the moisture barrier. The texture is thicker and more gel-like; it truly adds another layer of hydration. I love the way it makes my skin feel and I can’t wait to continue using this product.

reviews.product_name: Water Drench Hyaluronic Acid Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: This stuff has so much silicone in it, it immediately clogs my pores. While this might make a good primer, I was not impressed with it as a moisturizer.

reviews.product_name: Good Genes All-In-One AHA Lactic Acid Treatment
reviews.review_title: Works, not worth the price tag
reviews.review_text: This product is way too expensive. There are other similar products out there that do the same job for a fraction of the price -- don’t be fooled. That being said, this is a good product. Its not the strongest acid, so I wouldn’t recommend for people who have built up a tolerance to resurfacing products. I wouldn’t use this as my main chemical exfoliant - I prefer something with glycolic. However, it did come in clutch after I overdid the acne creams, because it helped gently lift the peeling skin around my chin and mouth from over-enthusiastic acne treatment. I can definitely say that this works, however, for the price, I’ll keep looking.

reviews.product_name: Facial Radiance Pads
reviews.review_text: I enjoy these pads. They have a good mix of acids, that help refine my skin texture and gently exfoliate. Good for acne-prone skin. Does not irritate my skin.

reviews.product_name: Cream Skin Toner & Moisturizer
reviews.review_title: One stop product for oily skin
reviews.review_text: This is very different from the type of “toners“ that I’m used to, so I don’t see it replacing my toning step, but it is an AMAZING moisturizer. I am honestly shocked by how moisturizing this product is, as it is very lightweight and watery. I’ve been using it over a treatment serum and under my sunscreen, and it makes my skin feel really soft and vibrant without heaviness. I would not recommend using it under another face cream or lotion if you have oily skin like me. Does not break me out, feels very soothing and comfortable. Easy to use - I just drop a little on my fingertips and swipe it across my face. The bottle is made out of heavy frosted plastic and looks really nice, and it dispenses just the right amount of product. Overall, I highly recommend for anyone looking for a nice lightweight summer moisturizer. I received this product for free from Octoly.

reviews.product_name: Barrier+ Triple Lipid-Peptide Face Cream
reviews.review_text: I am so impressed with this cream. First of all, it’s formulated without fragrance, which is so unnecessary in any skincare. It also doesn’t have a bunch of fillers like silicones so you are really getting higher concentrations of hydrators and extracts. Also, it has one of the push applicators there release just the right amount of product which is way more hygienic than a tub and protects the actives in the formula from being oxidized early. I really appreciate how much thought skinfix puts into their formulations and packaging, and think this helps make the higher price point more reasonable. That being said, this is definitely on the pricier side. I do think it’s worth it, because a little goes a lot way, it’s super nourishing and you’re getting some really effective ingredients to support the skin barrier.

Also, it has one of the push applicators there release just the right amount of product which is way more hygienic than a tub and protects the actives in the formula from being oxidized early. I really appreciate how much thought skinfix puts into their formulations and packaging, and think this helps make the higher price point more reasonable. That being said, this is definitely on the pricier side. I do think it’s worth it, because a little goes a lot way, it’s super nourishing and you’re getting some really effective ingredients to support the skin barrier.

reviews.product_name: GOOPGLOW Microderm Instant Glow Exfoliator
reviews.review_text: I received this product complimentary from Goop for testing purposes. I happen to love physical exfoliation (sometimes using chemical-only exfoliation doesn’t quite get rid of that top layer of dead skin cells) and so I was really excited to test this out. The granules are incredibly fine and non-irritating, and they have a polishing effect on the skin, leaving your face feeling super smooth and even. I do really enjoy incorporating this into my routine, because it gives me that extra boost of exfoliation that helps keep acne and congestion at bay, which creating a smooth canvas for applying my other serums and moisturizers, as well as makeup. The glycolic acid is non-irritating - I felt absolutely no tingling leaving it on for the 3 minutes. I think this should be good for even very sensitive skin. However, this price point on this product is absolutely ridiculous, I can’t imagine repurchasing. I will however most definitely use this up.

reviews.review_text: I received this product complimentary from Goop for testing purposes. I happen to love glycolic acid, my skin just responds really well to it, and I find it gives me the best results for my specific skincare concerns (acne and evening skin tone). I also like that these are individually wrapped, although I guess it produces a lot of extra packaging and eventually trash. But I think these are super convenient for traveling. Like most Goop products, this is pretty pricy, but it’s not that much more than other comparable products. I like that each pad has more than enough product to cover your whole face, neck and décolleté. I even run it down my arms and legs because why waste good acids? It did not irritate me and I woke up feeling glowy.

reviews.product_name: Daily Greens Oil-Free Gel Moisturizer with Moringa and Papaya
reviews.review_title: Silicone free, but still has fragrance??
reviews.review_text: I have oil slick but dehydrated skin, so I was excited to receive this complimentary from Farmacy for testing purposes because it seems like the perfect summer moisturizer from the description. I’ve been using for a few weeks and here are my thoughts! 1) super light weight gel formula — very comfortable and sinks right into skin with no tackiness or texture. Works really well under sunscreen and makeup. 2) Why do brands keep putting things in jars?? It’s not the most hygienic, and as someone with acne prone skin I really appreciate tubes or pumps. 3) This has no artificial fragrance but that doesn’t make it fragrance free. Would like to see this without any fragrance components. Overall I really enjoy this moisturizer, and I’m loving that it’s silicone free, since a lot of gel formulations replace oils with silicones. It’s super comfortable and will be perfect for summer heat and humidity.

reviews.product_name: Watermelon Glow Niacinamide Dew Drops
reviews.review_text: The first thing I noticed about this serum is the scent. It smells strongly of watermelon fragrance, just like the other products in the watermelon glow line. Looking at the ingredients list, I noticed that it does have added fragrance, which is pretty disappointing because it’s potentially irritating with no dermatological value. That’s my only qualm with the product, however. It sinks right in, feels nice, and one pump is all you need for the whole face. I’ve been using for a week, so I can’t speak to the brightening effects, but so far I am happy. This was gifted to me by glow recipe.

reviews.product_name: Avocado Soothing Skin Barrier Serum with Ceramides
reviews.review_title: Finally a product without fragrance from GR
reviews.review_text: I love ceramide formulas so I was super excited to try this serum from glow recipe. After using it for a couple weeks, I can definitely attest to it reducing redness and calming sensitivity. I use a lot of resurfacing actives and acne treatments and this serum really helped my skin feel soothed and balanced. The formula itself includes 5 different types of ceramides, and a lot of different plant extracts with antioxidant and calming/soothing effects. It also doesn’t include added fragrance, unlike the majority of glow recipe formulas, which I hope they will continue to do! All in all I’m really impressed with this product and it’s definitely my favorite from the whole brand.

reviews.product_name: Rose & Hyaluronic Acid Deep Hydration Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I’m a sucker for the Fresh rose collection — it has the best rose scent. That being said, Fresh tends to use pretty heavy fragrance in their skincare products, which isn’t great if you have sensitive or reactive skin. I was pleasantly surprised to see that this cream does not seem to have added fragrance (according to the ingredient list), although it may still irritate the most sensitive skin because it is still scented. I found this moisturizer to sink in really well without any residue. It wore well under my sunscreen too. Overall I like it a lot, but I would prefer it in a tube/pump!

reviews.product_name: 5 Stars Retinol + Niacinamide Eye Serum
reviews.review_text: This eye cream has a really nice texture that is moisturizing and yet melts into skin without leaving a lot of texture. Since it HS retinol, I prefer to use it only in the PM, to avoid light sensitivity from the sun. Overall a nicely formulated product.

reviews.product_name: Precleanse Cleansing Oil
reviews.review_text: I love a good cleansing oil (honestly I prefer them over a balm) so I was excited to try this one out! It’s very gentle yet effective at breaking down makeup, sunscreen and even waterproof mascara. It also emulsifies really nicely with water — no scrubbing required to get the greasy texture off your skin. I wouldn’t say it’s particularly moisturizing, but that’s not what I’m looking for in a cleanser anyway. It definitely doesn’t strip skin, and it doesn’t clog pores.

reviews.product_name: Mini Precleanse Cleansing Oil
reviews.review_text: I love a good cleansing oil (honestly I prefer them over a balm) so I was excited to try this one out! reviews.product_name: Squalane + Marine Algae Firming & Lifting Eye Cream
reviews.review_text: This is a very rich eye cream, so keep that in mind if you are considering it. It is very hydrating and has a thick texture that definitely leaves behind some residue on the skin. I would personally not use it under makeup, as it would likely cause it to break up since the texture is quite rich. It feels nice, and is not irritating on my sensitive eyes, that being said I have other eye creams that have better finishes, so this will not be something I repurchase.

reviews.product_name: Triple Algae Eye Renewal Balm Eye Cream
reviews.review_text: This eye balm is super rich and moisturizing! I prefer to use it at night but if I’m feeling extra dry I’ll tap a small amount under my eyes in the morning. My only complaint is that I wish it came in a tube or pump instead of tub.

reviews.product_name: Watermelon Glow Niacinamide Sunscreen SPF 50
reviews.review_text: I received a deluxe sample of this in the Sephora favorites set, and unfortunately I just couldn’t make it work for me. The texture is nice and light and sinks easily into skin, but then it pills like crazy. I’ve tried it on top of 5 different moisturizers and even on its own on top of serum and it’s always just a mess.

reviews.product_name: Jet Lag Mask
reviews.review_text: If I could give this 10 stars, I would! This product is an all in one - I put this on before bed, I put this on before makeup application, I put this on when I’m feeling dry, I put this on when I’m looking flat or full - I’ll even put this on when I’m sad just to feel good inside. This formula sinks into your skin and stays put FOR HOURS feeding your skin hydration. Your skin will go from looking unrested, flat and dull to alive, plump, fresh and restored. This is a product where you’ll need to have a back up on hand at all times! You won’t want to go without this once you start!

reviews.product_name: GOOPGLOW Microderm Instant Glow Exfoliator
reviews.review_text: I am all about glowy skin these days, so I was super excited when Goop Beauty gifted me their Microderm Instant Glow Exfoliator to review! This product is part of their Goop Glow collection and it is a dual actioned product where you get the benefits of both physical & chemical exfoliants. This contains beneficial ingredients such as four different micro crystals, mineral exfoliants, glycolic acid and kakadu plum. I take a little larger than a nickel amount of the product and massage into my skin after washing my face with a cleanser. Once I’ve worked the exfoliator into my skin, I let it sit on my skin for about 4 minutes to let the chemical exfoliants sink into my skin to do their job. After those minutes have passed, I rinse my face off, pat it dry and wah-la - my skin is smooth, even toned and glowing! ✨ I would only recommend using this maybe once, twice at most, a week. This will retail for $125 at Sephora, so you can think of it as a luxurious treat for your skin!

reviews.product_name: GOOPGLOW 15% Glycolic Acid Overnight Glow Peel
reviews.review_text: Don’t have time to get a professional facial? That’s okay because Goop Beauty has created professional treatments that can be used at home and are fool-proof! Goop Beauty gifted me their new 15% Glycolic Acid Overnight Glow Peel pads to review & I was so eager to - I am a busy mom of two active boys and I work 6 days a week, so me taking the time out to go to an actual esthetician’s office is near impossible. Luckily, Goop Beauty has developed professional treatments that are clinically proven and you don’t have to be a skincare expert to use them! After you have cleansed your face thoroughly and you pat it dry, you would take one of these pads and evenly apply it to your face, neck and chest area. The unique quality of these pads is that each side of the pad is different, allowing you to customize your exfoliation routine. One side has a weaved groove that will give you a more intense exfoliation where the other side is smooth to allow you to buff and polish. After applying, you just go about your night and let the AHA sink into your skin to do it’s job! You could apply a bit of moisturizer after 15 minutes if the tingling sensation is too much for you. This is 15% so it is a more potent strength compared to Goop’s more milder 5% version. This product gets washed off in the morning and you’ll have skin that is retexturized and brightened!

reviews.product_name: Daily Greens Oil-Free Gel Moisturizer with Moringa and Papaya
reviews.review_text: I received the new Daily Greens moisturizer complimentary from Farmacy for review purposes. I have been a longtime fan of Farmacy’s products, so I was genuinely excited when they announced this new moisturizer. I love that Farmacy is a clean brand, so you know you are feeding your skin nothing but safe & beneficial ingredients. This gel-textured moisturizer delivers instant hydration to the skin and is formulated to provide long lasting hydration. It naturally has a refreshing sensation when you apply it, which helps with calming the skin or irritation your skin may be suffering from. I also found this moisturizer to minimize the appearance of pores and because this moisturizer is oil free, it also helps with oil control / shine. This is a great moisturizer to use day or night. You’ll be left with hydrated, soft, supple and fresh looking skin!

reviews.product_name: Honey Halo Ultra-Hydrating Ceramide Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I was recently gifted by Farmacy Beauty the new Honey Halo moisturizer and it is quickly becoming a new favorite of mine. This moisturizer is going to be a staple in my skincare routine during the upcoming cold months.  Infused with rich antioxidants, buckwheat honey, & ceramides, this moisturizer is the perfect cure for dry, distressed skin. I personally love to use this moisturizer as part of my nighttime skincare routine.  I wake up with soft, hydrated skin every morning. It is so hydrating that it plumps the skin & diminishes the appearance of fine lines. I love the packaging of this product too - a nicely weighted frosted jar with a wooden lid that magnetically holds a metal spatula. The magnetic spatula is a nice touch as you never have to worry about misplacing it and of course, it is sanitary as you don’t have to dispense product using your fingers. I would definitely purchase this product myself!

reviews.product_name: Barrier+ Triple Lipid-Peptide Face Cream
reviews.review_text: The colder weather is upon us, which usually makes my skin more on the dry side, so I was excited that SkinFix gifted me their Barrier+ Lipid-Peptide Cream. Clinically proven, this face cream is formulated with 3% healthy skin lipid complex to improve the health of the skin barrier. The texture of this face cream is lightweight and seeps into the skin effortlessly to provide hydration and nourishment. It doesn’t leave a sticky or tacky residue behind, does not feel weighted or heavy, and it is fragrance free!Key Ingredients Include:3% Peptide Protein Blend - helps with strengthening the skin barrier & protects the skin from damage 3% Seaweed Hyaluronate Blend - Provides moisture to give a smooth & more overall youthful appearance 3% Lily Root Extract - Tightens skin to reduce water loss & promotes long-time moisturization so your skin feels hydrated & nourished all day long 95% naturally derived. Allergy tested. pH balanced. Dermatologist tested & recommended. Free from fragrance, parabens, formaldehyde, phthalates, silicones, lanolin, gluten, propylene glycol & PEGs.

reviews.review_text: I am so happy that Glow Recipe gifted me their new illuminating drops! These are perfect for that extra glow from within and such a multi purpose product. You can wear this on bare skin, on the highlight points of your face and even on top of makeup as a highlighter for a beautiful, natural gleam! I absolutely love this product!

reviews.product_name: Good Genes All-In-One AHA Lactic Acid Treatment
reviews.review_title: Brighter & Smoother Skin Days are Ahead!
reviews.review_text: I was gifted by Sunday Riley to test & review this product and I have to say, I am impressed at how quickly I saw visible results with my skin. This lactic acid treatment serum can be used as a treatment where you rinse it off after 15 minutes, which is recommended for those with more sensitive skin, or if you have more tolerable skin like myself, you can leave it on as part of your skincare routine. This product is a great chemical exfoliator that removes dead skin cells, leaving your skin smoother, blemish free and brighter in appearance. I like to use this product during my nighttime routine and I highly recommend wearing SPF the following day (even though SPF is recommended to be worn everyday!).

reviews.product_name: Rose & Hyaluronic Acid Deep Hydration Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: This face cream is so incredibly hydrating and it sinks deep into your skin & lasts all day long! I love the natural rose floral scent - it definitely adds to the experience and makes it a touch more luxurious. As hydrating as this is, I appreciate that the formula is not heavy and doesn’t clog my pores. I definitely recommend this for those with dry skin, but it is also suitable for combo and normal skin. This is the perfect skin pick me up for when your skin is feeling & looking dry, dull, and flat. My skin appears more youthful, radiant and fresh when I use this product. My skin appears more plump and bouncy.

reviews.product_name: Avocado Fine Line Eye Cream with Retinol
reviews.review_text: I’m a long-time fan of Glow Recipe and was so excited to try out a new eye cream that was complimentary from Glow Recipe. I use this mask overnight and wake up to bright and refreshed eyes! It works wonders in hydrating and depuffing and the consistency isn’t too heavy or thick.

reviews.product_name: Rose & Hyaluronic Acid Deep Hydration Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I adore this cream. It felt heavenly when I applied to my skin after a long day out on the lake and I woke up with the dewest and freshest skin. I think it definitely helped with the dryness and peeling that comes from being fried by the sun.

reviews.product_name: 5 Stars Retinol + Niacinamide Eye Serum
reviews.review_text: This eye cream feels so luxe on. The packaging is ethereal. I don’t typically use eye creams because they can feel super heavy. I like the gel texture of this one. I’m new to Sunday Riley products, but have always heard great things, so I’m excited to see he results of this eye cream.

After rubbing for a few seconds, my eyeshadow and mascara slid off of my skin. Will definitely be keeping this cleanser in my rotation!

reviews.product_name: Tea Elixir Niacinamide & Hyaluronic Acid Anti-Aging Serum
reviews.review_text: I received this product complimentary from Fresh Beauty. I am a huge fan of their skincare and was so excited to come across this new product. These days my skin is feeling incredibly congested and dull. I felt that before application my skin was very dry and rigid and after application my skin soaked up the elixir so well. I noticed after a few days of application, my skin not only looks like it’s glowing but I feel less dry.

reviews.product_name: Lip Butter Balm
reviews.review_text: At first glance I was quite wary of this lip butter because lip butters tend to be sticky, however this one is absolutely not. It’s exactly soft and buttery and incredible hydrating! I’m a fan of scent in lip products and the vanilla scent is so subtle and not artificially overwhelming. I highly recommend.

reviews.product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C
reviews.review_text: I used another lip product that was 30 dollars and thought it was amazing... this is better! I put it on before bed and have not had any chapping on my lips. I also use it in the AM with a light coating before lipstick. The taste is light not overpowering. It will also last forever which makes the price not as bad.

reviews.product_name: Water Drench Hyaluronic Acid Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: This stuff is amazing!! I normally am all oily skin but this winter I ended up with some extreme dry patches and burns on my skin from a reaction to another high end make-up product I was using. I was pointed to this moisturizer and in no time skin was looking better than ever!!! It even keeps my oily skin at bay. Love it!

reviews.product_name: The Water Cream Oil-Free Pore Minimizing Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I really think Tatcha gets oily skin! I love this cream in combination with the liquid silk primer! They are just luxurious and the scent is fabulous! For oily skin this is fantastic because it absorbs and sets to a powdery finish. It is not for dry skin. But for my oily skin it gives my skin a fresh start and keeps the oil at bay! The little touches with this brand also are special. The little spoon and the packaging are the icing on the luxury cake! I love Tatcha! By the way, got this as a sample and bought the large size when I ran out!

reviews.product_name: Mini The Water Cream
reviews.review_text: I really think Tatcha gets oily skin! I love this cream in combination with the liquid silk primer! They are just luxurious and the scent is fabulous! reviews.product_name: Good Genes All-In-One AHA Lactic Acid Treatment
reviews.review_title: Works fantastic! Price is a little too steep...
reviews.review_text: Worked awesome! I love this with Luna because they work perfectly together. Has a wonderful scent (hard to place, almost citrus). The texture feels moisturizing. No major skin problems. It cleared up my new summer hyperpigmentation in a few months (from where my mask rubbed off my sunscreen). The only downsize for me is the price. I got a set with .5 ounces and it lasted 1.5 months with one pump. The One once will be around 3 months at 85 dollars. Less than 6 months for the 122 dollar bottle. The Luna oil at that size is only a third of the way done in comparison! It is a little two pricy for me. I am going to switch to The Ordinary Lactic Acid which is comparable for under 10 dollars! If on sale, I may grab it again!

reviews.product_name: E-Rase Milki Micellar Water
reviews.review_title: A Worthy Upgrade To My Old Micellar Water!!!
reviews.review_text: I upgraded from my drugstore micelles water. I am not a big face washer at night (I am usually so tired I can’t bear washing my face with water and getting wet). I have been using the miceller water to get rid of my eye makeup. I have not been using it on my face because of the greasy feel. This one is so healthy and moisturizing, I use it all over. I don’t use a lot and it takes off my Pat McGrath eyeshadow and Bobbi Brown Mascara (I don’t use waterproof so I can’t say if that come off as easy). The rest of my face comes off easy too. I love that is fast and I wake up in the morning to healthy skin, not greasy skin. It is worth the price and a real upgrade!

reviews.product_name: Creamy Eye Treatment with Avocado
reviews.review_text: I have a hard time with eye creams. My under eyes get so dry and patchy that my make-up settles and I look 20 years older. I have tried so many! The fact that we wear masks make it more obvious. I keep returning to this one. This cream works. It is thick, creamy and makes my under eyes look plump and hydrated. It also works all day, even now with the winter dryness. Love this. Only flaw is that I have dark circles and it really does nothing for that (but concealer sits nice over it so not a deal breaker).

reviews.product_name: Skin Perfecting 2% BHA Liquid Exfoliant
reviews.review_text: This does what it says! I only use it at night. I have oily skin and it feels too sticky to go under my make-up (I swap it out for the Tatcha Toner that goes with my routine in the AM). I cleanse and put it on. I spot treat any hyperpigmentation with vitamin C cream. It works fast and my pores are less visible. I wake with glowing smooth skin! I used to swear by the Ordinary Toner but, this just edged it out. Only complaint… very small for the price. I am going to need to restock more often.

reviews.product_name: Mini Crème de la Mer Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I’ve been using La Mer for about a year. My skin looks beautiful because of this cream. Not only when I’m wearing it, but all the time. My skin is so bright, hydrated, soft, & absolutely glowing. There is a reason this is a cult classic. Yes it is expensive, but it is absolutely worth the price tag.

reviews.review_text: This is hands down my favorite sleeping mask. It feels so good going on, very cooling & relaxing after a long day! Then when I wake up in the morning & was it off, it’s like my skin has been recharged overnight. I love the glow it gives me.

reviews.product_name: Good Genes All-In-One AHA Lactic Acid Treatment
reviews.review_text: I got a sample of this in my Birchbox about a year ago, and I haven’t been without it since. Yes, it is expensive, but not buying it just is not an option for me. This has absolutely transformed my skin. This has completely faded my melasma and makes my skin absolutely radiant.

reviews.product_name: SEA drink of H2O hydrating boost moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I got this with my points like a month or two ago & it’s just been sitting on my bathroom counter, because I already have a ton of moisturizers. I decided to try it this morning under my Tarte Amazonian Clay foundation & omg they worked so well together. My skin looked beautiful all day. And I did not have to blot all day, which is unheard of in my world. This is really good stuff.

reviews.product_name: The True Cream Aqua Bomb
reviews.review_text: This is a fabulous moisturizer. So hydrating, yet light & quick drying. I live the gel-like consistency. It is great for oily skin. I love everything I have tried from Belif. I got the Aqua Bomb Sleeping Mask first & I loved it so much I had to buy this. The Hungarian Water Essence is really great as well.

reviews.product_name: Self Tanning Bronzing Face Drops
reviews.review_text: These drops are absolutely amazing! I am blown away at how great they work. So easy to use & give a beautiful color.

reviews.product_name: Ultra Repair Cream Intense Hydration
reviews.review_text: Lays nicely under makeup. Very moisturizing. Non-greasy. Plays well with other products. One of my favorites for sure!

My skin looks so good.  So glowy & hydrated. Since I have been using this my skintone is more even, I am hydrated & less oily, it even helps heal breakouts. This is a must have for me. reviews.review_text: This gives my skin such a dewy look, which I love, & is my go to look for summer. There is a very fine line between dewy & greasy, but this is not greasy. It wears well under makeup, & is great at night. Usually it is one or the other, but this one can go either way. Kiehl’s Midnight Recovery Concentrate is amazing as well & the two work great together. There are a lot of good moisturizers out there, but there is something special about this one. I definitely recommend this!

reviews.review_text: This does a great job at removing makeup. No question about that. But this will also break you out like crazy. This has done some serious damage to my face & I am not really acne prone nor do I have sensitive skin. Use something else.

reviews.product_name: Salicylic Acid Acne Healing Dots
reviews.review_text: I always use the pimple patches from Target (Alba Botanica) or Walmart (Hanhoo). They never really worked, I mainly used them to hide a pimple. I picked these up while I was in Sephora getting some mascara & Good Genes. I honestly couldn’t believe the price when I was checking out, but oh well. Let me tell you these things work. They freaking work!! I have been dealing with a horrible embarrassing breakout for like a week & I have tried everything. Like I previously stated I use the pimple patches to cover up pimples & I figured these were just a little better quality. So imagine my surprise when I pulled these off & my pimples were almost gone. The bad ones were flattened & the little ones were gone. This is an unbelievably amazing product that has significantly improved my life. I will always keep a box of these on hand. I highly recommend this!

reviews.product_name: Protini Polypeptide Firming Refillable Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: Since I hit my 30’s my skin has become kind of dull, out of nowhere. This totally revives it like nothing I have ever seen. This is a must have for me. I love the gel like consistency. It absorbs quickly & sits well underneath my sunscreen, primer, & foundation which is absolutely a must. At night I mix it with the Marula Oil. Very pleased with this entire line. I highly recommend.

reviews.product_name: Jet Lag Mask
reviews.review_text: This mask delivers results after first use. This totally revitalized my skin. I use this as an overnight mask & wake up with glowing, hydrated, healthy skin. It doesn’t break me out either. This definitely gives the skin a nice pick- me-up! 5 star product! Highly recommend!

reviews.review_text: I have been using this about 5 months. This does exactly what it claims to do. Enough said. I highly recommend.  I could write a paragraph about what it has done for my skin, but the indications pretty much cover it.

reviews.product_name: Honeymoon Glow AHA Resurfacing Night Serum
reviews.review_text: I have been using this for a few weeks. I actually got a sample with another order & had to get it. I know nothing works overnight, but the first time I used it, that next morning I woke up to glowing skin. I know this is not what it advertises to do, but in 2 weeks it cleared up my skin. This is a fantastic product. It is worth the price. I highly recommend this.

reviews.product_name: Alpha Beta Extra Strength Daily Peel Pads
reviews.review_text: This would be wonderful,  had I not found Farmacy Honeymoon Glow. Works the same, lasts longer. Truth

reviews.product_name: Good Genes All-In-One AHA Lactic Acid Treatment
reviews.review_title: Works well but not as promised
reviews.review_text: I received this complimentary from Sunday Riley. I found this product to work, but not to the extent described. It claims to instantly plump look of fine lines and wrinkles in 3 minutes. I have not noticed drastic change in 3 minutes. However, it did well on reducing unevenness of my skin after using it for about a week. It also smells well and is fast absorbing.

reviews.product_name: Crème de la Mer Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I received this complimentary from La Mer. It is a wonderful moisturizer! Goes on smoothly and leaves the skin glowing. I have combination type of skin with my forehead super oily and cheeks super dry. It is amazing on my cheeks, but gives too much shine on my forehead.

reviews.review_text: First of all this has a great luxury scent. Second of all, it doesn’t give me a purple hue that some sunscreens give me. It provided me a good coverage for a fun day out! Definitely recommend if you’re looking for a high-end sunscreen to add to your collection!

reviews.review_text: This product feels amazing under the eyes. I deal with a lot of creasing underneath the eyes and this helped with moisturizing them so they didn’t crease as much. There is no scent and it did not irritate my eyes or skin. I used it at night and woke up with moisturized under eyes! Loved it!

reviews.review_text: Glow Recipe gifted me this product and I am so happy to have been able to try it out. I have been loving this product and it has def been a game changer in my skincare routine. It makes my skin more youthful and glowy and bouncy. It layers well under makeup. I did not have any issues with it. It doesn’t have a horrible smell and it did not irritate my skin. It comes in a beautiful bottle and I love having it for skin and aesthetic purposes haha

reviews.review_text: Thank to fresh for gifting me this moisturizer, I’m truly thankful. This moisturizer is very thick and is great for dry skin. If you love the smell of rose you are going to fall in love with this moisturizer.

It’s not too think so I wear it under my makeup some days. Mostly I used it as a night time moisturizer though. It doesn’t have a smell and it made my skin feel so plump in the best way.
