reviews.product_name: Watermelon Glow Niacinamide Dew Drops
reviews.review_text: Lots of presents under the tree but let’s focus on what was gifted by @glowrecipe. I had the opportunity to try the newest addition to the Glow Recipe line and I’ve honestly been putting off my review because, unpopular opinion: I’m unimpressed. This serum is marketed as a skincare/makeup hybrid formulated to reduce the look of hyperpigmentation and brighten over time for a dewy, reflective glow without mica, glitter, or gray cast. The Watermelon Glow Niacinamide Dew Drops contain niacinamide, Hyaluronic acid, and watermelon extract which work together to minimize the appearance of dullness and pores, hydrate, and brighten. Firstly, I love niacinamide and Hyaluronic acid; these are hero ingredients for me that I actively seek out in my routine. Unfortunately I don’t like the concept behind this product because if a product is supposed to deliver significant skincare results I don’t think it should double as something that I can tap on my eyelids for a glossy lid or use to create a natural highlight effect over makeup. Many have touted this as the “dupe” for the Glossier #futuredew which I also own and have mixed feelings about. The texture of this product is lighter and better suited for normal to oily skin and a warmer climate whereas the futuredew is definitely for my normal to dry skin people that are looking for a very dewy skincare topper or glowy makeup base. I found the longevity of this product to be adequate with an easy application both with and without makeup, though I strongly prefer it without makeup or used as a base. It absorbs quickly and makes the skin look hydrated but it is not worth $34 in my opinion. The fragrance is also a negative for me, although it’s low on the ingredients list they have included “fragrance” with no explanation of what is included under that blanket term and that’s often something I try to avoid in my routine as this could include any number of irritants. Overall, this is not a bad product but I do not think it’s worth it.

I guess with long term use you may get amazing results. I used for about a week.I truly believe everything and every product works differently on everyone so I understand why some thinks it great. I think it’s good but not great and not worth the price tag.

reviews.review_text: I actually really like this cleanser. I didn’t expect it to do anything for my skin because I’ve tried so many things and nothing ever makes a difference. I clean my makeup off with the makeup eraser towel and then I use this product to further cleanse my face. It even does a good job of getting my mascara and eyeliner off and doesn’t burn my eyes. I’ve been using this for the past month and my skin is looking so much smoother. I get a lot of clogged pores and congestion and I’m definitely noticing some of it going away. It’s gentle but it seems to penetrate the skin really well and get all that gunk out. I received this product complimentary for reviewing purposes but I definitely plan on buying another when this one runs out. I’m very happy with this cleanser!

reviews.review_text: I didn’t expect to love this product as much as I do but omg it has been so good for my skin! I’ve been using it every day and I notice that my face is so much smoother. I love exfoliating with it because it’s gentle but it still feels like it’s actually exfoliating your skin. It also smells really good so I always look forward to washing my face! I received this product complimentary for review purposes but when I run out I will definitely buy another because I am very happy with this product.

reviews.review_text: I have been using this product for a few weeks now and I am pleased with it. I like how smoothly it applies and it melts into my skin. I can apply makeup right on top and the product doesn’t affect the makeup or make it separate. I do notice that my under eye area looks less dark. I feel like I would have to use it for at least a few months to really notice more of a difference but I am happy with the results so far.

reviews.review_text: I have been using this product for a few weeks and I am really liking it so far. My skin feels very soft and smooth after I apply it and not sticky at all. I can apply makeup and it doesn’t affect my makeup at all, it actually provides a nice base so my makeup can go on more smoothly. reviews.product_name: Niacinamide 10% + Zinc 1% Oil Control Serum
reviews.review_text: I absolutely adore this product. I’ve been using it for several months now and I can honestly say it has transformed my skin. I have struggled with various skin problems for as long as can be remembered - pimples, acne scars, excess oil, dullness - and this serum really helped it all. After about a month of using this product, I started noticing the most beautiful glow and natural flush in my cheeks. My pores looked smaller, my skin’s texture was more even, and I stopped using foundation in my ’every day’ routine! I know I’m rambling, but man, I just can’t say enough about this stuff! And you can’t go wrong with that price, either!

reviews.product_name: PHAT Glow Facial Mask
reviews.review_text: This mask is so good, and the perfect pick-me-up for tired skin. I had surgery last week and ever since I’ve been getting no sleep, and I’ve been too tired to do my regular skincare routine... as you can imagine, my skin was looking pretty rough as a result. I received this mask from Influenster, and honestly after 2 uses my skin is right back to normal, if not better! My eye bags are gone, my colour is back, and I have the nicest, dewiest glow happening. I’m SO happy with how well this mask works. Also, I adore the pump bottle; I’m so used to masks in tubs or squeeze bottles, and they’re always so messy. The pump on this totally eliminates mess. Overall, I think this product is fantastic, especially if your skin is looking a little dull. I received this product free for testing purposes.

reviews.product_name: Aqua Bomb Cleansing Balm
reviews.review_title: the "bomb" - as long as you don't mind fragrance
reviews.review_text: I received this cleansing balm from Influenster a little over a month ago, and I’ve really enjoyed my experience with it so far! It functions very well as a makeup remover or a first cleanse in a double-cleanse routine; it removes all makeup and grime effectively without me having to tug and rub my skin. Also - it comes with a little tiny spatula to scoop out the product! I’m a sucker for little spatulas in skincare!Now, for the reasons it’s getting 4 stars instead of 5:- SO MUCH FRAGRANCE. I personally don’t have sensitive or reactive skin, but I imagine that anyone who does would not be able to use this product due to how fragranced it is. While the scent is very pretty, I think it’s a little much. I’d love to see a fragrance-free version!- I’ve found that you need a lot of the product in order to fully remove your makeup. As I said previously, I’ve had this product for a little over a month, and the container is already half empty. So keep that in mind if you’re looking into purchasing!All in all, this is probably my favourite cleansing balm I’ve tried. It does a good job of removing dirt, oil and makeup, and leaves my skin very soft and hasn’t caused any breakouts. If you’re in the market for a good cleansing balm and you don’t mind fragrance in your skin care, I’d say give this one a go!

reviews.product_name: Cold Plunge Pore Remedy Moisturizer with BHA/LHA
reviews.review_title: almost perfect... but a no for sensitive skin
reviews.review_text: I’ve been using this moisturizer for two weeks and I really like it! It does what it says it does: controls oil, keeps you feeling fresh and glowy without being greasy, and refines the look of pores. Unfortunately, I think the addition of fragrance and irritants will make it a problem for my sensitive skinned people. I have some of the toughest skin, and it still makes the skin around my eyes a bit angry some days. I’d say if you’re not sensitive skinned, definitely give it a go, but make sure you patch test first! I received this moisturizer for free in exchange for my honest review.

reviews.review_title: Creme de La Mer is amazing
reviews.review_text: I received Creme de La Mer complimentary from La Mer. I think this stuff is amazing! A little bit really does go a long way. Make sure to read the instructions to use it properly because at first I totally used it wrong. I was trying to apply it straight to my face from the jar but you’re supposed to take some in between your fingers and warm it up until it turns clear. Then press it into your face. If you just scoop it out of the jar and try to rub it in then it wont work right. It doesn’t smell great but it’s also not horrible. It reminds me of a shampoo that was made years ago. I am warming up too the scent. After I use this my face feels so soft and amazing. I really didn’t think I would like this and I was totally wrong about that. This has quickly become one of my go to products. My skin just feels more plumped and hydrated when I use it. I would definitely recommend and I would purchase it for sure.

I love this face cream and believe it could not have come at a better time with winter emerging from the shadows and I live in Ohio so we tend to have many cold days and evenings. This will help to keep my skin happy and moisturized throughout the season and keep me happy not having dry cracked skin. I would definitely recommend and would buy again.

reviews.product_name: Mini Daily Microfoliant Exfoliator
reviews.review_text: This product was gifted by Dermalogica Sampling. I was lucky enough to get to try out the Dermalogica Daily Microfoliant. It’s a rice based powder exfoliant that includes Papaya Enzymes, Salicylic Acid, and Phytic Acid for smoothing and brightening. I really like this exfoliant. You put some water in your hand then dump some of the powder exfoliant into it and make a thick creamy paste. Apply it to the face in a circular fashion and massage gently for 1 minute. Rinse thoroughly with warm water. Afterwards your skin feels so fresh and amazing. The more water you add the thinner it becomes, so start with the least amount of water possible and if you feel you should add more go ahead. There is a very light natural fruit scent that doesn’t linger after use. It comes off easily and makes me feel happy and excited to use it. It’s so gentle you can use daily but you can use it less often if you feel it’s too much. I would recommend to anybody wanting a great exfoliant because I feel it’s so gentle anyone could use it.

reviews.review_text: The formula has obviously changed but I’m not mad about it. This formula still feels light and smooth on the face just like the old one; however, this formula is not as moisturizing. It’s still GREAT, but I will be coupling this with an oil in the winter months.

reviews.product_name: Lip Glowy Balm
reviews.review_text: This lip balm smells amazing....and that is where the wow moment ends. I did not find it to be effective at moisturizing my lips at all. I do NOT have dry lips. I exfoliate regularly and I use a lip mask nightly. I purchased this to have something to carry around and use during the day. This has a very thin formula and I do not feel it on my lips longer than a few minutes. I anticipate using this up very quickly and I will not be repurchasing.

reviews.product_name: Squalane + Vitamin C Rose Firming Oil
reviews.review_title: My skin has never felt so wonderful!
reviews.review_text: I have eczema prone combination skin that, after washing, can become dry very around my nose and cheeks easily. This helped soften my face and neck, and feels so rejuvenating. My skin feels even younger, and I’m only 21 lol! I love this, and will use it forever. Love the fact that it’s EWG approved as well.

reviews.product_name: Plum Plump Hyaluronic Acid Moisturizer
reviews.review_title: My New Favorite Moisturizer for the Spring/Summer
reviews.review_text: Excellent! I have combination skin and the gel like consistency of this moisturizer works perfectly! It’s hydrating without clogging my pores. Will be using this all throughout the humid spring and summer months!

reviews.product_name: Mini Plum Plump Hyaluronic Acid Moisturizer
reviews.review_title: My New Favorite Moisturizer for the Spring/Summer
reviews.review_text: Excellent! I have combination skin and the gel like consistency of this moisturizer works perfectly! It’s hydrating without clogging my pores. Will be using this all throughout the humid spring and summer months!

reviews.product_name: Papaya Sorbet Smoothing Enzyme Cleansing Balm & Makeup Remover
reviews.review_text: Was looking for a somewhat hydrating cleansing balm that wouldn’t leave my skin too striped. I’ve finally found the answer. This balm smells amazing, and leaves my skin so hydrated, yet clean from dirt, oil, sunscreen and even color corrector! This is my new favorite product that I hope will be around for a long time.

reviews.product_name: Skin Perfecting 2% BHA Liquid Exfoliant
reviews.review_text: I’m past the faze of being a product junkie. As if gotten more into skincare, I’ve learned it’s always best to have simple staples. This liquid exfoliant is definitely one of them. This product helps my whiteheads and blackheads lessen and eventually disappear within a few weeks, and leaves my face bright and vibrant. Paula’s Choice is simply the best of skincare. It’s no wonder the brand has been around for so long!

reviews.product_name: Protini Polypeptide Firming Refillable Moisturizer
reviews.review_title: Small Packaging with a Big Polypeptide Punch
reviews.review_text: I received a mini-jar as part of a Sephora birthday gift, and WOW was I impressed! I loved the cool, silky texture, and even a little (blueberry-sized) amount went a long way to keep my skin moisturized. After a couple of weeks, my skin felt softer and more hydrated. Though the jar was small, it lasted me a few months and kept my skin looking healthy.

reviews.product_name: Beste No. 9 Jelly Cleanser
reviews.review_text: (Received a mini-size as part of a Sephora Birthday Set)I usually wear light-medium coverage makeup. A small dab (half the size of a pea, approximately) of Beste lathered nicely and removed my everything in one step, as confirmed by a clean makeup wipe! On the days I wore medium-heavy makeup, I used an extra dab, and the cleanser still cut through my makeup well! A little went a long way, and it took me about three months to finish a mini-bottle (30ml/1 fl. oz), using it twice a day. My skin did not feel as dry as it does with makeup wipes alone but felt more drying that micellar water makeup removers. I noticed that my skin began to feel tight about 2 minutes after rinsing with water. This sensation went away after applying moisturizer, but those dry/sensitive skin may experience this sensation more. Would I consider purchasing the full-size bottle? No, only because of the cost. This product does well, and I enjoyed using Beste No. 9. However, I feel you could get comparable results with other cleansers at a lower price. That being said, if you are interested in this cleanser and the price is within your budget, this product does deliver!

reviews.product_name: T.L.C. Framboos Glycolic Resurfacing Night Serum
reviews.review_text: (Originally purchased as part of DE’s NightBright™ Resurfacing Duo with DE’s Marula Oil & Received a Free Sample)This was a great first step into the world of chemical exfoliators! After about a month of usage, I noticed the texture of my skin was completely smooth. My skin has been subject to acne and scarring for years, and it felt amazing to feel what a soft, even skin texture feels like. I also noticed that a small smile line I was forming disappeared. A little bit of product went a long way. These two mini bottles lasted about 5 months (about 13mL/.44oz of product total).Though I enjoyed this product, I have gotten similar results with other chemical exfoliators that cost less and do not think it provides anything different. For me, I would not pay for the full size; however, if you have your heart set on this product, it will definitely deliver!

reviews.product_name: Virgin Marula Luxury Face Oil
reviews.review_title: Marula Oil in General? YES. DE Marula Oil?...No
reviews.review_text: (Originally purchased as part of NightBright™ Resurfacing Duo with TLC Framboos)I usually mixed this in with other DE products, especially TLC Framboos and Protini, for overnight use. This helped to lock in moisture, and my skin felt soft and hydrated in the morning.  It also wore well under makeup when adding it to my morning routine.Though I liked the mini-size, I wouldn’t pay for the full size. I have used the Ordinary’s Marula Oil, which worked just as well as this formula for $10, about seven times cheaper than the cost of the DE bottle. However, if you’re really eyeing this product specifically, it does work well.

reviews.product_name: Glow2OH Dark Spot Toner
reviews.review_text: This had a irritatingly strong lemony scent whenever I opened the bottle and stung upon contact with my skin the first few times I used it. After a couple of weeks of using Glow2Oh, my skin felt dry and broke out, which made my hyperpigmentation and skin texture worse! My skin got better after I stopped using this product.I also noticed that ingredients meant to treat hyperpigmentation were at lower concentrations on the ingredient list, even lower than witch hazel and fragrance, which can be (and have been, for me at least) irritants that make issues like dryness, breakouts, and hyperpigmentation worse. Given this, I don’t think I spent my money on a product that was geared to helping my skin heal long term. Bad experience + questionable formulation = I do not recommend. For skin that is dry, sensitive, prone to breakouts, or hyper pigments easily, I would definitely steer clear.

reviews.product_name: Hyaluronic Acid 2% + B5 Hydrating Serum
reviews.review_text: Within a day of using The Ordinary’s HA serum, my super dry lips were so soft and plump, even on cold days or days with low humidity. On my face, I use 1-2 drops before my moisturizer, and my combo-dry skin feels smoother and feels a bit more firm too. After a few days, I noticed that some of my acne cleared up, and the HA serum helped to re-hydrate my skin. I’ve even used this on other parts of my body, especially on my legs post-shave, or my skin just happens to look/feel tight and dry. I’m currently using my second bottle, and this serum will always be a staple in my skincare routine!

reviews.product_name: Superberry Hydrate + Glow Dream Night Mask with Vitamin C
reviews.review_text: I love this super moisturizing mask. It’s smells great and a little goes a very long way trust me! It’s a great value for the price and the perfect way to end my nighttime routine.

reviews.product_name: Mini Superberry Hydrate + Glow Dream Mask
reviews.review_text: I love this super moisturizing mask. It’s smells great and a little goes a very long way trust me! It’s a great value for the price and the perfect way to end my nighttime routine.

reviews.product_name: Unseen Sunscreen SPF 40 PA+++
reviews.review_text: I’m so glad I found this sunscreen!!! It is a clear sunscreen that applies beautifully. It sinks right into the skin and there is no greasy residue or dreadful white cast. There is a scent initially (typical sunscreen smell) but goes away soon after.

reviews.product_name: Mini Unseen Sunscreen SPF 40 PA+++

reviews.review_text: This leaves my face feeling hydrated and supple.I skip the cotton round and just apply with my hands. The rose petals may come out here and there but it never causes an issue or clogs the bottle for me. The scent is very fresh and not overpowering at all.

reviews.product_name: Hyaluronic Acid Hydrating Serum
reviews.review_text: I have been using hyaluronic acid for about a year now and it gets the job done. I use this in my skincare routine every single day because having a hydrated/moisturized face is very important to me. Also you can pair this with any other serums and toners, I love it.

reviews.product_name: Niacinamide 10% + Zinc 1% Oil Control Serum
reviews.review_text: i really like this so far!! i’ve been using it for about a month and here’s what i’ve noticed: 2-3 drops cover my entire face, so it definitely lasts a long time! i generally have very oily skin, and i think using this daily has lowered the oil production on my face, so it really ends up helping the longevity of my makeup. i use other products for acne and have been for years, but i think this has helped my acne as well. definitely recommend!!

reviews.product_name: Oil-Absorbing Pore Treatment Strips
reviews.review_text: these pore strips are so cool. i leave them on overnight and i’m both amazed and disgusted by the amount of oil on them in the morning, but they’re so effective!! i wish they weren’t so expensive but i love that they’re different than “traditional“ pore strips. definitely love treating myself to a pack of these every few months!

reviews.product_name: AHA 30% + BHA 2% Exfoliating Peeling Solution
reviews.review_text: i’ve only used this twice so far but it’s so good that i had to write a review already!! immediately after the first use, my skin was already smoother and after two uses (i use it once a week because i have sensitive skin) i noticed my acne getting better as well. i do have a couple of prescription acne products that i use daily, so i don’t apply them the night that i use this peeling solution just in case, but so far i haven’t found any issues! this is amazing, and you cannot beat the price of the ordinary. 11/10!!

reviews.product_name: Hello FAB Coconut Skin Smoothie Priming Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: i use this underneath a lightweight foundation and i love the glow it gives my skin!! it also provides a slightly tacky base for foundation to stick to (in my opinion) and it keeps my makeup looking great all day. doesn’t dry out my skin at all, and it smells nice!

reviews.product_name: Self Tanning Bronzing Face Drops
reviews.review_text: i’ve been using these drops for about a week and i like them so far! i’m insanely pale so i started with 3 drops per limb and noticed a slight difference, and have since gone up to 5 drops. these drops do not leave me orange and there’s no scent when applying, but i did notice that distinct fake tanner smell the next morning. only big issue i’ve come across is that i wear a hair tie on one wrist and it did rub off the self tanner overnight. overall a solid 8/10 though! and such a good deal because the drops go a long way.

reviews.product_name: Magic Cream Moisturizer with Hyaluronic Acid
reviews.review_text: this moisturizer is super effective but also really heavy - i have oily skin so it’s not great in the warmer months. i’m hoping that i can use it more in the winter!! for now, i’m only using it at night when my skin feels extra stripped of moisture. otherwise it just feels too greasy. it does the job, but it’s definitely meant for dry skin and not normal/oily.

reviews.product_name: Caffeine 5% + EGCG Depuffing Eye Serum
reviews.review_text: This product has changed the eye cream/serum game for me. It absorbs quickly, has decreased my tired looking eyes and has helped smooth out the skin around my eyes. I’m really enjoying this product.

reviews.product_name: 100% Organic Cold-Pressed Rose Hip Seed Oil
reviews.review_text: I love this product, my skin feels Wonderful while it’s on and looks and feels amazing in the morning once it has been fully absorbed. I would highly recommend this product.

reviews.review_text: I mix this product with my other drunk elephant products when I need an extra dose of moisture- and boy does this product to the trick! On a side note I also love how this product is dispensed (by pushing the top down)ensuring that bacteria is not contaminating the product.

reviews.product_name: B-Hydra Intensive Hydration Serum with Hyaluronic Acid
reviews.review_text: This is hands down my favorite moisturizer. I mix it with other Drunk Elephant products and am always happy with the end result.

reviews.review_text: I’m really enjoying this product for the every day glow. I mix this with my moisturizer in the morning and apply evening all over my face and neck, add some mascara, fill in my eye brows and I’m set for the work day.

reviews.product_name: C-Tango Vitamin C Eye Cream
reviews.review_text: I love this eye cream, I have been using the Shaba Eye cream by D.E for awhile and I like it. I wanted a thicker, richer eye cream and am really happy I started using this one. I’ve also been placing all my D.E products in the fridge and am loving the cool refreshing feel in the morning when I apply my products.

reviews.review_text: I want to start out saying I’m very picky with my sunscreen. I won’t use sunscreens that harm ocean life , but also have sensitive skin and am very pale. I LOVE that is formula is ocean friendly, and doesn’t hurt the coral reefs. It also went on completely invisible as advertised. It did not feel thick or goopy at all, which is very different from other reef safe sunscreens I’ve used. I forgot I was wearing it and it rubbed in perfectly, this will be a staple in my product shelf from now on.

reviews.review_text: I’m normally really weary when trying a new moisturizer because I have weird combo skin. I get oily super fast but when I put foundation on I notice a ton of extremely dry spots. It’s not heavily scented. It goes on very nice. It feels thicker than my other moisturizers when going on but doesn’t make me oily at all. I love this stuff.

reviews.product_name: Advanced Night Repair Eye Gel-Cream
reviews.review_text: This eye cream is moisturizing and light weight. It doesn’t make my skin feel weighed down or oily but my under eye looks way less dry and tired.

My only problem is I don’t like lotions in jars. I wish it were in a squeeze bottle so it would be easier to get out and cleaner.

reviews.product_name: Slaai  Makeup-Melting Butter Cleanser
reviews.review_text: I’ve stayed away from theses types of cleansers out of concern of clogged pores but I got a free sample of this so I tried it. After weeks of use, I’ve had no negative side effects.  Buying a full size.

reviews.product_name: Ultra Repair Cream Intense Hydration
reviews.review_text: I have had issues with eczema and have to be careful what I put on my face. This stuff is amazing.  I use it on my face and body to keep hydrated. It hasn’t had any negative impacts with my makeup or a prescription retinol I now use.  My parents tried a bit when they visited and now use it all of the time too.

reviews.review_text: I got this as the birthday gift choice and I’m glad I didn’t have to pay for it. I normally use Bite but thought I’d try this since it was free. It maybe lasted an hour and I woke up with dry lips. I tried it during the day and it was the same result.

reviews.product_name: The Dewy Skin Cream Plumping & Hydrating Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I had been searching for a replacement moisturizer after the brand I was using changed formulas. This was one of approximately a dozen brands I tried and it worked best for me. I accidentally overused a retinol which dried out my skin and this did an amazing job at normalizing my skin.  It is definitely worth the price for me.

reviews.product_name: The Kissu Lip Mask
reviews.review_title: Beautiful color and great for winter.
reviews.review_text: After reading a lot of reviews I decided to try this. Sephora was the only place the red camellia color is sold so I’m happy I was able to get one. It is a pretty color, just enough that I can use it for any winter occasion.  It hydrated all day too so my lips never looked chapped.

reviews.product_name: Self Tanning Bronzing Face Drops
reviews.review_text: I received a sample in a kit. It does work. I have a lovely glow. I don’t like it though because I have to mix it in a moisturizer which is just messy. If you don’t mix well enough you will not get an even tan. It is sort of buildable. I tried to do 6 drops instead of the normal 4 for my legs but that caused the dreaded orange hue to show up.   I’m going back to my normal lotion that I don’t have to mix. Love the concept and it can work well if you have a particular lotion you always want to use and you have great mixing skills.

reviews.product_name: The Rice Polish Foaming Enzyme Powder
reviews.review_title: Feels great and makes my skin feel smooth
reviews.review_text: I wasn’t sold on this at first. After a week I noticed my skin did feel smoother.  It also removes a lot of the makeup reside other cleansers miss. I also love that, since it’s not liquid, I can easily travel with it and save the space in my liquid bag for other things.

reviews.product_name: F-Balm Electrolyte Waterfacial Mask
reviews.review_text: I received this in my Voxbox for testing. And I love it! Mask is easy to use, fast absorbing, this is really good plus when you are going to bed. It has really good ingredients, I was shocked, when I saw it. It goes really well with their glycolic acid serum, only one pump of serum and 4 pumps of this mask after it, makes a wonder with your face.

reviews.product_name: Daily UV Defense Invisible Broad Spectrum SPF 36 Sunscreen
reviews.review_text: I received this product complimentary from innisfree. It came right before I was going for a trip to a hot Las Vegas, so I could test very well. I liked this sunscreen, it doesn’t leave a white cast, sinks very nicely to the skin. But I think it will be heavy for a oily skin, I kinda like it to use without moisturizer.

reviews.product_name: Avocado Fine Line Eye Cream with Retinol
reviews.review_title: Very gentle retinol for your eyes
reviews.review_text: I received this avocado melt retinol eye sleeping mask as a complimentary from Glow Recipe. I love that brands are making a good products with retinol for the eye area, sometimes it hard to find a good one. You know that you can’t use a regular retinol serum for your eyes right? It’s gonna be very harsh for your gentle eye area, it has to be made special for that area with gentle retinol form

reviews.product_name: Tea Elixir Niacinamide & Hyaluronic Acid Anti-Aging Serum
reviews.review_text: I love Fresh products and was happy to receive this for testing purposes. Consistency is really silky smooth, I love that it had niacinamide and ceramides in it. Niacinamide is one of the ingredients that I always search in serums and having extra hydration is the plus for me

reviews.product_name: Mini Daily Microfoliant Exfoliator
reviews.review_text: Gifted by Dermalogica Sampling. I love it, it smooth, gentle. Gives clean feeling afterwards, I usually foam it in my hands, and then put it in circular motion on my face for couple minutes, I think it’s great product for oily skin

reviews.product_name: Daily Microfoliant Exfoliator
reviews.review_text: Gifted by Dermalogica Sampling. I love it, it smooth, gentle. Gives clean feeling afterwards, I usually foam it in my hands, and then put it in circular motion on my face for couple minutes, I think it’s great product for oily skin

reviews.product_name: GENIUS Sleeping Collagen Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: Texture is creamy/oily but once you work it into your face, that completely dissipates and it does not look or feel greasy at all! Less is more and really work it in like a facial massage. I have sensitive skin and no irritation or breakouts! Smell is mild vanilla, but also disappears when you apply it.  In the am, my skin is plumpy and youthful appearing. First 2 ingredients are collagen and water! Best mask for my skin so far. I received this coproduction complimentary for testing purposes but my opinions are genuine. Ps: results are noticeable after the first use.

reviews.product_name: The True Cream Moisturizing Bomb
reviews.review_text: A little bit goes a long way! A dime size dallop is more than enough for the entire face. Using this amount ensures I don’t put too much on and it prevents that midday excess oil! I like to use this then my setting powder, then powder foundation. My skin feels super hydrated and my makeup works well in this order. I have combo skin and this product works really well to keep skin from drying out!

reviews.product_name: Benefiance Wrinkle Smoothing Eye Cream
reviews.review_text: I’ve been using this for over two years! It’s prevented new wrinkles from forming and diminished the older crows feet over time. My eyes look better now At 35 than at 33. It’s a great vase for concealer and doesn’t leave any creases! Highly recommend! Stay patient, the results will come and are totally worth it! And one jar lasts over 1.5 years so the price is a acceptable! A little dab goes along way! I can’t live without the cream!

reviews.product_name: E-Rase Milki Micellar Water
reviews.review_text: Excellent for after the gym to refresh and for removing makeup at the end of the day. The consistency is thicker than micellar water, so I find I have to use one swab for each side of my face. It’s super smooth and removes makeup well, and it’s especially gentle in the eye area. It removes my layers of mascara without having to rub! This bottle should last at least 3 months with daily use.  I use a simple micellar facecloth first to remove the bulk of makeup then follow with this to remove the rest and my eye makeup.  I don’t wash my face after that routine and I wake up with hydrated, clean skin.

reviews.product_name: Lemonade Smoothing Scrub
reviews.review_text: It was so pleasurable using this scrub! I use a variety of exfoliant scrubs and this so far is the only one that has not dried out my face!  It’s not harsh and my skin appears bright and lively after using.  I use the scrub in the am and leave on for a few minutes during my shower.  For reference I have combo skin and use retinA  nightly.  My skin likes this product and I will likely replace my other scrubs with this one. The scent is heavenly and does not linger. Highly recommend. No irritation, gentle, and exfoliating!

reviews.product_name: Hydro Biotic Recovery Sleeping Mask
reviews.review_text: I have really dry skin especially in the winter, so this gel-type mask is great for me. It’s cooling and definitely moisturizes so that my face feels bouncy and rejuvenated in the morning. My only issue with it is that it stays wet for a while (I sleep on my side) so it rubs all over my pillow if I put my face on it. Because it took a while to dry, I would use it as a night time moisturizer and leave it on till morning. Great product, definitely does the trick! I received this product complimentary from Influenster. All opinions are my own.

reviews.product_name: Cold Plunge Pore Mask
reviews.review_text: Super cooling and refreshing on my skin that left a tingle even after I washed the mask off. I left it on for 20-30 minutes until it completely dried, and I noticed that it had a tightening effect on my skin - felt my skin was a little firmer afterwards. I have sensitive skin, but I’m ok to use it 2x a week - love this product!I received this product complimentary from Influenster, all opinions are my own. :)

reviews.product_name: Ultimate Sun Protector Lotion SPF 50+ Sunscreen
reviews.review_text: Great product, goes on smooth and covers well. It does leave your face a little greasy so I didn’t like it as part of my skin care routine when doing my makeup, but for makeup free days and the rest of my body, it was great. *I received this as a complimentary product to review. All opinions are my own*

reviews.product_name: Dreamskin Skin Perfector
reviews.review_text: This product is nice! As much as I love unscented products, I do love the luxurious scent. It comes out pretty thick and sticky, but it doesn’t stay that way on the face. It absorbs quickly and spreads easily. It works as a great primer prior to applying makeup.

reviews.product_name: Lip Glowy Balm
reviews.review_text: This is my favorite gloss! It is exceptional! It’s hydrating and sooo pretty!!! And not sticky at all!!!!

reviews.product_name: Soy Hydrating Gentle Face Cleanser
reviews.review_text: This stuff is amazing!!! I loved it!!! Cleaned my skin and toned it out!

reviews.product_name: Sugar Strawberry Exfoliating Face Wash
reviews.review_text: This stuff is my new go to fav!

reviews.product_name: Ultimate Sun Protector Lotion SPF 50+ Sunscreen
reviews.review_text: Love this product so much! I received it complimentary through influenster and it will be my go to sun protection.

reviews.product_name: T.L.C. Framboos Glycolic Resurfacing Night Serum
reviews.review_text: I was a little nervous trying this skin care product line since I have very sensitive skin. After cleansing my skin with the drunk elephant jelly cleanser and applying this night serum my skin felt great. Refreshed, and no tacky feeling. I had a natural glow and I loved how soft my skin felt. This product is a bit expensive but it’s well worth the money when it leaves your skin nice, smooth and glowing.

reviews.product_name: Beste No. 9 Jelly Cleanser
reviews.review_text: Drunk in love with this jelly cleanser. I have very sensitive skin and I am limited when it comes to skin care products.  I was nervous about trying this new line but after using this wash with my Clarisonic my face felt soo smooth and clean! I loved that there was little to no scent, products with perfume irritate my skin and this product was lovely!

reviews.product_name: Lippe Balm
reviews.review_text: This product is cute but wide. There is no scent or light taste. It’s a very simple lip balm, I personally do not see the value of spending $18 on this I’ve used the hemp brand lip moisturizer and those are amazing. I was a little disappointed with how basic this product is.

reviews.product_name: C-Tango Vitamin C Eye Cream
reviews.review_text: I have been using this product for about a week now and there is a light tacky after feel once your apply it but I am starting to see good results under my eye. I am nervous what long term use will do to my skin since do have sensitive skin. There is no scent, and one pump is enough to apply under your eyes

reviews.product_name: Good Genes All-In-One AHA Lactic Acid Treatment
reviews.review_text: I know the price is high but this is the best! I have a little texture that I’ve had since I was young and it reduced the appearance which I’ve literally tried everything to get rid of it. I use this with the Luna oil every other night and my skin is so much clearer or brighter!

reviews.product_name: Luna Sleeping Retinoid Night Oil
reviews.review_text: I use this in combination with good genes and it leaves my skin looking so refreshed and bright in the morning. This is my go to night oil! Definitely a must to have!

reviews.product_name: Honeymoon Glow AHA Resurfacing Night Serum
reviews.review_text: This has become my go to night serum! My skin is super smooth, clear and glowing. I will say to make sure you put on sunscreen while using this product as my face got a little pink while in the sun and I usually don’t burn.

reviews.product_name: Daily Greens Oil-Free Gel Moisturizer with Moringa and Papaya
reviews.review_text: This is by far my favorite day moisturizer. I love that’s it’s a gel texture and it soaks into my skin nicely. It allows a great application for makeup. And it smells amazing!! Highly recommend!

reviews.product_name: Cicapair Tiger Grass Color Correcting Treatment SPF 30

reviews.review_text: Using this product along with the other Tiger Grass products is truly incredible. It has helped to calm my skin, something I have had to deal with for years. I received this as a free sample from influenster but will purchase it in the future once I run out!

reviews.product_name: Cicapair Tiger Grass Serum
reviews.review_text: This is the ONLY serum that has helped to calm my skin. I am often skeptical of these products but this one surprised me and I’m now a huge fan. I will be sure to purchase this after I finish the sample I received from influenster

reviews.product_name: Jet Lag Mask
reviews.review_text: I honestly thought this product was going to be overhyped but it is amazing. For my recently dry sky, it is moisturizing but not too think. I would highly recommend if you can only get one mask, make this it.

reviews.review_text: I honestly thought this product was going to be overhyped but it is amazing. For my recently dry sky, it is moisturizing but not too think. I would highly recommend if you can only get one mask, make this it.

reviews.product_name: Lemonade Smoothing Scrub
reviews.review_text: I love this product! The scent is SO refreshing, and my skin is feeling great after just a few days of using it. My face has been extra dry this winter, but the exfoliation has made such a difference in the texture of my skin, and it’s so gentle that I’ve had no irritation at all. I love how it’s taken my dull winter skin and added some extra brightness to it. I’ve added this into my permanent skincare routine!

reviews.product_name: Cold Plunge Pore Remedy Moisturizer with BHA/LHA
reviews.review_text: This moisturizer is very hydrating, and so refreshing to use in the summer! It has a nice cooling effect without being overwhelming, if you have sensitive skin it may be good to test a bit first just to make sure it does work for you! Overall it leaves my face feeling smooth and soft and I will definitely continue using it in my skincare routine!

reviews.product_name: Abeille Royale Advanced Youth Watery Oil
reviews.review_text: First off, this packaging is absolutely gorgeous, the quality is top notch! I was unsure if this product would be too oily, as I tend to not like heavier products on my face, but this was not a heavy oil at all! It’s such a beautiful, lightweight oil that sinks into the skin instantly. The tiny gold beads add to this products luxurious feel as well! I noticed an instant glow on my face after applying this product, which lasted throughout the day. I noticed some difference in plumping of fine lines, but not a huge difference. Maybe I will continue to see improvement over time. There is also a strong scent, which I didn’t mind! Overall it is a great product that feels fantastic on the skin, and brings a beautiful much needed glow during this dry winter season!

reviews.review_text: Overall this is a good moisturizer! I have normal skin with no real issues, and after using this moisturizer several times I noticed it was keeping my skin very hydrated. I feel like I noticed a more glowy look to my skin as well right after! I love the texture, it’s very lightweight and almost gel-like which I prefer over very heavy moisturizers. I would recommend this moisturizer to anyone who has normal skin and is looking for a medium level of hydration!

reviews.product_name: Hydro Biotic Recovery Sleeping Mask
reviews.review_text: If you’re struggling with skin sensitivity or redness I suggest you try this. I also have some psoriasis on my face that’s not very visible and this cream helps it soothe and not be so irritated. I love applying this mask at least half an hour before I go to bed. Let the mask sink in. Always wake up with the most hydrated, plump and glowy skin. I definitely recommend this mask to anyone, it would benefit any skin type in general. I have received this product for an honest review. From Influenster for free.

reviews.product_name: Ultimate Sun Protector Lotion SPF 50+ Sunscreen
reviews.review_text: Shiseido definitely has the best sunscreen I’ve tried.  Feels like a regular moisturizer. No residue. No greasy feeling. It soaks right into the skin. I apply it right before I apply my makeup and it works wonderfully. Love the actual scent of it! Definitely recommend to anyone !

reviews.product_name: Clear Sunscreen Stick SPF 50+
reviews.review_text: love this thing so much!! very easy application.  packaging is adorable and effective. I apply it under my makeup or when I’m not wearing any as well. scent is subtle and doesn’t overpower. Definitely a must!

reviews.product_name: The True Cream Aqua Bomb
reviews.review_text: A great moisturizer; nothing that completely impressed me but it worked, did what it claimed. Very hydrating and good for sensitive skin. Would recommend to any skin type.

reviews.review_text: I received this product complimentary in my spring voxbox from Influenster and it is my go to lip mask now. It smells super nice and left my lips super smooth. It does take a couple days to see the affects of it though.

reviews.review_text: I would give it five stars if it weren’t for the small size and big price tag. Beaufort radiant finish. I’ve already done through two containers though. Nice scent. Absorbs into your skin well so it won’t mess with your makeup application.

reviews.review_text: I tried this product and didn’t notice a difference. I will not be purchasing it again. I have normal to dry skin.

If I use a mask- I want it to have a little extra kick or oomph to it. Will not be recommending or purchasing this product.

reviews.review_text: This is a good spf for winter time only. I am returning it for now. I have dry skin and I can’t imagine using this during the summer when your skin already gets oily/dewy from all the heat. I tried it a couple times on sunny California days and my usual dry face looked so oily. There’s a difference between looking dewy and radiant versus oily. This is the latter. I could see myself repurchasing this during drier winter months.

reviews.review_text: This did wonders for my mother’s skin. After just a couple weeks of use, her skin has transformed. She looks ten years younger. Her skin is brighter, tighter, firmer, glowy, youthful and she’s in her mid fifties! Absolutely will be repurchasing. Wow wow wow!

reviews.review_text: Most effective lip treatment I’ve ever used. I bought this when it first came out and haven’t had a single day of dry lips. I only use it at night. It doesn’t temporarily moisturize your lips either where afterwards your lips are left even drier. I have gifted this to many friends and fam and highly recommend.

reviews.product_name: GENIUS Sleeping Collagen Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: Hands down one of the best finds of 2020 for me. My dry skin thanks me every night for this. I absolutely love the consistency. Somewhere between a heavenly butter and cream. Goodness do I enjoy lathering this on. Love the barely there natural scent.

reviews.product_name: Charlotte’s Magic Serum with Vitamin C
reviews.review_title: CT- stick to makeup and leave skincare to the pros
reviews.review_text: Once again, really good marketing and packaging has people duped! The ingredient list alone should tell you enough. I have been using this daily for weeks and there is no difference to my skin. I have normal and thankfully not overly sensitive skin. I rarely break out but since using this product, I’ve had 4 pimples appear on my cheeks which normally are completely acne free. I would like to ask CT herself, what am I really getting for $80 besides a cute well made bottle?

reviews.product_name: The Dewy Serum Resurfacing and Plumping Treatment
reviews.review_text: I bought this a week ago and immediately went to grab another one. I absolutely love the scent just like other Tatcha products. I love the Tatcha dewy cream already and I’m excited to continue using this. I took a star away because of the price. It’s only one ounce and I’m hoping it lasts a awhile.

reviews.product_name: The Essence Skincare Boosting Treatment
reviews.review_text: I used the entire bottle consistently and saw no difference to my skin. I stopped using it on purpose for a couple weeks to see if it made a difference and nope! I need to see results if I’m going to spend money and time on an extra skin care step.

reviews.review_text: This serum is amazing. It leave my skin so hydrated and glowing. I don’t not take care of my skin and I have a many stressors in my life and you can see the damage on my skin. This serum makes me look well rested and hydrated.

reviews.review_text: I loved using this product! It made my skin look brighter and feel softer after use. The treatments are not too expensive and easy enough to incorporate in any skincare routine.

reviews.review_text: This product did help with my under eye circles. I used this on the days where I did not get enough sleep. It helped my eyes look a lot better. It is not costly and is a good eye product to add to your skincare routine.

reviews.review_text: This product is so nourishing. It feels good on my face. The product does not have a strong smell. A little goes a long way. I am aware of the skincare products from Kiehl’s and have been using them for years. This will definitely help people who have dry skin.

reviews.review_text: The product itself has a light fragrant that leaves my skin moisturized and dewey. I got a sample years ago and could not stop thinking about it and although it’s a bit pricey you only need a few drops. Paired with the Vinoperfect Essence I find that my skin tone and texture has improved in the few months I’ve used it. I also love how it’s working to better my skin over time and if I stop using it because the stores are out of stock my skin won’t go bad. I want products that will help my skin now and have lasting results over time, not go lose effect the minute I stop wearing it.

reviews.product_name: U.F.O. Salicylic Acid BHA Acne Treatment Face Oil
reviews.review_text: First impression: As a dry oil this is the only one so far that doesn’t leave me oily and break out. You only need a few drops and can wear it alone or under makeup. With makeup it doesn’t crease or give a shiny look and at the rate I’ve used (it’s been 2 months) I anticipate it’ll last a year and half. My skin has cleared up quite a bit as well. Formula: not oily and absorbs fast Scent: At first it reminded me of tea tree oil but not in a burn your nose hairs way- It gives a diluted and non lingering scent at first then goes away. Longevity: Wore it day and night alone and with makeup and didn’t feel heavy, oily, or shiny  Breakout: none

reviews.review_text: First impression: it’s perfect alone and so moisturizing! I’ll add a few drops of the vinoperfect serum and both of them combined have been amazing foe my skin. I breakout often and have scars but these have calmed and helped clear up my skin. I’m noticing even skin tone and all you need is a little bit either in the morning or night. Formula: Light and spreads easily Scent: light/ none  Longevity: If I wear it in the day with makeup I find I don’t break out and it doesn’t make me crease or look and feel oily. Breakout: none

reviews.review_text: I received this mask complimentary from Innisfree but this is my honest opinion.What I love about innisfree is that it’s a good affordable brand delivering effective products! reviews.product_name: Beste No. 9 Jelly Cleanser
reviews.review_text: I chose this as my birthday gift and immediately loved this cleanser for how gentle it was on my skin while still feeling like it was cleaning. I don’t like cream cleansers and most gentle cleansers fall into that category. While not as gentle as cream cleansers it is much more gentle than non-cream cleansers I’ve tried which I greatly appreciated. My skin felt clean but not stripped. That being said, I find my skin feeling a bit tacky after use no matter how much I try to wash it all off. Not sure if it’s user error or what. However, this could be overlooked if it were extremely effective. This isn’t the case. While my face feels clean I can’t say I notice any less breakouts or anything compared with the drugstore cleanser I currently use. Given the price point, it’s lack of “wow factor” in its ability to fight acne or redness or anything makes this face wash just “okay”.

reviews.review_text: Another Drunk Elephant that I feel simply hasn’t “wowed“ me. I did get this as a birthday gift so thank god I didn’t pay the price.Don’t get me wrong, this stuff is nice enough.  It’s very lightweight, which is great in warm climates, and the consistency and texture are nice.  I love their dedication to clean ingredients and I did find my skin moisturized.  I just wouldn’t say it was any more moisturizing than what I really used.  I haven’t noticed any improvement in skin tone, texture, etc etc but that could also be because I’ve only used it for about a week.  Either way, given that my usual moisturizer is cheaper and also has SPF in it, I won’t be making any permanent changes into this brand.  Many of the other benefits I look to in my cleansers and face masks so I don’t personally think it’s worth paying that kind of money for them in a moisturizer.  Especially one I haven’t found to be amazing.

reviews.product_name: Clear Improvement Charcoal Honey Mask to Purify and Nourish
reviews.review_text: So far I’m liking this product a lot. Whenever I use it my skin feels softer and looks brighter. My pores look smaller but that lasts about 1 day max. However, I find that’s a usual thing for most face masks I’ve used. The mask spreads on easy and washes off without leaving any trace of product behind (I’ve tried products that leave a white cast on my face so I’m glad this wasn’t one of them). It doesn’t leave my face looking red nor do I feel any burning sensation that I’ve gotten with some masks. All in all, I’d say this is a solid product.

reviews.product_name: Soy Hydrating Gentle Face Cleanser
reviews.review_title: Decent but don’t like the smell
reviews.review_text: This cleanser does what it says: cleans my face without irritating my skin. It’s gentle but still foams up very well so my face feels clean after use. However, I couldn’t stand the smell at all. I don’t know where the scent comes from but it was absolutely horrible. If you’re sensitive to smells as I am I would not recommend this at all.

reviews.product_name: Superfood Antioxidant Cleanser
reviews.review_text: This is a pretty decent cleanser.  I don’t think it’s good for very dry skin as I can see how it’d be stripping but in the summer, when my skin leans more on the oil side, it’s quite good.  I do a double cleanse so I can’t speak on the ability to remove makeup or sunscreen or whatever but it does get off any remains of my cleansing balm.  I like the smell and I like the consistency.  For me it lathers up a decent amount and I don’t feel a need to use a whole lot, but I also admit that I don’t care for products that lather a whole lot in the first place.  One of my biggest complaints is that it does tend to sting my eyes so I’ve just learned to be a little more careful when using it in my eye area.I also love the packaging.  I know some people are worried about breaking glass bottles but honestly, the packaging is cute and very sustainable which I do like a lot. Overall, it’s a pretty good cleanser and while I do wish it were cheaper and wasn’t as prone to stinging my eyes, I still think it’s worth it’s price.

reviews.product_name: Green Clean Makeup Removing Cleansing Balm
reviews.review_text: Before this, I’ve used the Clinique Take the Day Off Balm which I loved and various cleansing oils that I hate. Of everything, this product is an absolute dream. It has a sorbet like consistency that makes melting the balm the between your hands effortless and comes with a way to store the spatula inside the jar but separated from the balm itself, keeping both the spatula and the product clean. I can’t speak to the makeup removing abilities as I only wear sunscreen but boy does it emulsify effortlessly and beautifully, not leaving a greasy film on my face after (but that doesn’t mean you can skip the regular cleansing step!). It has a soft key lime pie scent that I personally love (and I’m not generally a fan of scented products as I find them too overpowering).One of the main drawbacks for me is that it can be sometimes hard to remove the separator that holds the spatula and that gets annoying when I’m in a rush to get to bed.

reviews.product_name: Glycolic Acid 7% Exfoliating Toning Solution
reviews.review_text: I first started using this as a deodorant because I hate the smell of scented deodorants and didn’t want the white stains on my clothes. I just put it on with my hand (I notice a weird smell when I use my cotton round, no idea why, maybe because of the detergent I use to wash them) after my shower and no smell all day. It’s not an anti-perspirant so I still sweat but even when I sweat I don’t notice a bad smell. I more recently started using it to exfoliate my entire body every so often and it has helped with my backne. I love using it to prep my legs for waxing as well as some physical scrubs have irritated them in the past. Haven’t tried it on my face really but with the heat and sweaty face I’ll probably add this in to my face routine

reviews.product_name: The Deep Cleanse Gentle Exfoliating Cleanser
reviews.review_text: this is formulated with sodium cocoyl glutamate which is a surfactant (foaming ingredient) derived from coconut oil as the FIRST ingredient. I saw a lot of people mention it left a film on their face or their skin was still oily after washing and I experienced the same. After the 2nd use i saw a medium sized pimple underneath my mouth on left side of my chin. Then the 3rd use of this product I got two more pimples on the right side of my chin. I’m someone who is fairly good with my skin care and don’t experience breakouts due to not having acne-prone or sensitive skin. This was the first product that has broken me out in YEARS. It obviously stems from the surfactant deriving from coconut oil a high comedogenic ingredient. I’m really disappointed because I was really looking forward to enjoying the deluxe size sample I received of this.

reviews.review_text: This is a fairly descent 1st cleaning product. It absolutely destroys mascara and eye makeup. However, it doesn’t rinse clean and I need a sudsier 2nd cleanser to get off all the film.

reviews.review_text: This is a such a great first cleanse. It takes off all my makeup and RINSES CLEAN. Which is saying something because so many first cleanses leave a film on the face. I love it!

reviews.product_name: Facial Radiance Pads
reviews.review_text: These seemed to work for a few days. Then I had a breakout and decided to use them again to clear up congestion and they happened to make me breakout on my forehead where I had no previous zit. No thanks.

reviews.product_name: Natural Moisturizing Factors + HA
reviews.review_text: Not a particularly “special“ or “innovative “ moisturizer. It’s designed to be a simple moisturizer no frills and that is EXACTLY what it is. I’m giving 5 stars because the product is exactly what it claims to be. I have dry skin, so it is very moisturizing, but not for as long as moisturizers designed for dry skin are. It helps more with hydration and barrier repair but I do have to seal with an oil to avoid tewl. All and all, great on-the-go moisturizer but maybe not the be all end all of products. Perfect for a skincare reset.

reviews.product_name: Lotus Anti- Aging Daily Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: This moisturizer was so luxurious to experience. I’m not a “fragrance“ person by any means and typically avoid it, but I loved the cucumber-y lotus scent. It was cooling but not artificially like with menthols or peppermint oil and my skin really responded to it. It is a bit ’oily’ after using. the consistency starts off wet and leaves an oily finish for about 10 mins before sinking into the skin. it’s a little heavy for humid days, but maybe light for days that are too cold? I went through the sample and then bought the full size. it’s expensive, but since it’s more of a seasonal product I think it’s worth it if you believe in luxury products.I don’t have sensitive skin. I have dry skin prone to flaking and dullness so I can’t speak to sensitivity but I would guess oiler skin wouldn’t take well to this unless the weather was appropriate(dry, cold etc.)Worked well with the majority of my other products and with my actives. Great lotion, meh price.

reviews.product_name: Watermelon Glow Niacinamide Sunscreen SPF 50
reviews.review_text: I bought this product as soon as it came out.Best for normal to oily skinThe finish is a soft dewy glow with a very slight white cast on darker skintones (acceptable whitecast imo) its gorgeousThe wear is nice and it feels cooling on the skin, but can dry out the skin bc it has high % of zinc oxide, my skin is always dry after wearing this all day.Application is annoying and sticky. The product seems like its balling up or pilling into little clumps no matter what product is used underneath it (it’s not pilling but it seems like it). You have to really work it in to get that nice finish.Scent is classic glow recipe watermelon+ classic sunscreen. Not my fave but idc either.Overall, I think it’s worth it for oily skin people who like a dewy finish it’s a really gorgeous finish but it dries me out too much

reviews.product_name: Aqua Bomb Brightening Vitamin C Cream
reviews.review_text: Amazing! I love the belief line of products and the vitmin C moisturizer  doesn’t  disappoint! My skin looks brighter  and feels plump and hydrated. This product absorbs well and works under makeup.I  did recieve a sample for free from Influenster  for my honest review

reviews.review_text: This serum is amazing! I was given this product  for review purposes  but let me tell you I really love it! This serum is a bit tacky on the skin  acting like a gripping primer and works so well under make-up  I totally  recommend  this product!

reviews.review_text: It’s very hydrating, lightweight and lasts a long time since a little goes a long way. But I did notice that I have little bumps under my eyes now. reviews.review_text: It’s okay but I’m not crazy about it. Maybe I need to use it every night or every other night to see better results. A little goes a long way but it does come in a considerably small container for nearly $50. I’ll probably try out some other products from this brand but this one didn’t impress me.

reviews.review_text: I definitely love this product. I have oily skin and I think it works really well for my skin. I use it before I apply my moisturizer and it’s been wonderful so far. reviews.product_name: Good Genes All-In-One AHA Lactic Acid Treatment
reviews.review_text: This product was gifted by Sunday Riley; the opinion and review is my own. Been texting out this product for a few weeks now and it’s so nice! I feel like this has helped my skin texture so much, I can definitely tell lessened some wrinkles and minimized some pores! It also has just given a healthy glow to my skin overall. Overall, really like this product and would recommend it! Really have been liking this and I can’t wait to see it continue to improve my skin! Skin type: oily, acne prone

reviews.product_name: Avocado Soothing Skin Barrier Serum with Ceramides
reviews.review_text: I really enjoyed this serum! I didn’t notice a huge difference in redness, but I think over time, it would help significantly—plus I don’t have a ton of redness in my face! I liked the feeling of this on my face and it absorbs so nicely into the skin. There’s not a noticeable smell, which I prefer for skincare. I am definitely going to add this to my skincare routine and I can’t wait to try other glowrecipe products! In picture—left is before the serum and the right is after the serum had been on my face for about an hour.

reviews.product_name: Rose & Hyaluronic Acid Deep Hydration Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: Wasn’t sure I would like this due to the rose scent, but I was pleasantly surprised! This moisturizer is so nice and perfect for nighttime—with the added hyaluronic acid! The scent isn’t too overpowering and I felt like this really gave my skin the moisture it needed.

reviews.product_name: Barrier+ Triple Lipid-Peptide Face Cream
reviews.review_text: A solid moisturizer! I’ve tried several products from the SkinFix Barrier+ line and I think this one is my favorite! It is a thicker cream-type moisturizer and yet it doesn’t feel heavy on the skin. I like how smooth and soft my skin feels—this product definitely provides the right type of nourishment needed! Overall, a very good moisturizer!

reviews.review_text: A solid moisturizer! I’ve tried several products from the SkinFix Barrier+ line and I think this one is my favorite! Overall, a very good moisturizer!

reviews.product_name: 5 Stars Retinol + Niacinamide Eye Serum
reviews.review_text: I feel like Sunday Riley can do no wrong. Every product I’ve tried from them has been wonderful—and this is no exception! First off, the packaging is 10/10, so cute and fun! Second, the product itself is awesome. Definitely saw improvement in my fine lines. Obviously this is not a fix for those problems, but improvement is good for me! I liked how cooling it feels upon application and the applicator is perfect for being gentle under the eyes. Definitely gentle enough for everyday use.

reviews.product_name: Precleanse Cleansing Oil
reviews.review_text: Gifted by Dermalogica: I’ve tried several oil-based cleansers and this one was definitely at the top! It broke down my makeup quickly, wiped off cleanly, and left my skin feeling smooth and clean with no weird texture or overly-oily feeling. I would definitely recommend this!

reviews.product_name: Mini Precleanse Cleansing Oil
reviews.review_text: Gifted by Dermalogica: I’ve tried several oil-based cleansers and this one was definitely at the top! It broke down my makeup quickly, wiped off cleanly, and left my skin feeling smooth and clean with no weird texture or overly-oily feeling. I would definitely recommend this!

reviews.product_name: Floral Recovery Overnight Mask with Squalane
reviews.review_text: Really enjoy this product from fresh! The scent isn’t overwhelming at all and it really is gentle and does what it says it will. My skin feels soft and smooth and I’m excited to continue using this! Definitely recommend!

reviews.product_name: Sugar Lip Balm Hydrating Treatment
reviews.review_text: Gifted by Fresh: Such a pretty & practical product from Fresh! Love the natural color it gave to my lips that is buildable but also loved the hydration and help to my lips that it provided. It’s a little pricey but I’d definitely splurge again on this!

reviews.product_name: Tea Elixir Niacinamide & Hyaluronic Acid Anti-Aging Serum
reviews.review_text: It’s a nice serum from fresh, there are good ingredients in the serum and it was nice on the skin. However, I don’t think it’s worth the price. I think it could be $30-$40 less. Overall, it’s a pretty solid serum, just not my favorite.

reviews.product_name: Skinlongevity Long Life Herb Anti-Aging Face Serum
reviews.review_text: This is a super light weight serum that glides onto the face and leaves no tacky residue. I apply two pumps morning and night and follow with a moisturizer. My skin looks brighter and smoother when I use it. I haven’t had a reaction to it or broken out from it which is good. It has some fragrance in it so just be careful if you have super sensitive skin. I do not have any noticeable wrinkles so I am not able to say if it helps with that or not, but I do know that it seemed to smooth out my skin! Overall, this product wasn’t out of this world but I do like it. It has niacinamide to help with redness, blemishes and wrinkles (didn’t help with my blemishes), California poppy to fight free radicals and boosted long life herb to smooth skin texture and resist signs of aging.

reviews.product_name: Watermelon Glow Niacinamide Dew Drops
reviews.review_text: I was very excited to try this serum. It smells amazing (like a watermelon jolly rancher) which is my favorite part and makes applying it more fun. It says it is a “highlighting” product but to be completely honest it does not highlight when applying as the last step in your skincare routine. It gives your face a nice glow for about 5 minutes until it sinks into the skin and then it actually makes my skin matte for the rest of the day. When applying it over make up as a highlighting product it does do a better job at “highlighting” but it doesn’t last all day.  The texture is very unique and “sticky” but when applied to the skin it turns in to a soft serum that absorbed quickly. I really like this product but not for the reasons it is advertised. I really love that it mattifies my oily skin and makes my face look smooth and soft. Last but not least, I absolutely the smell! P.s. this was gifted by Glow Recipe but the opinions are my own.

reviews.product_name: Clear Sunscreen Stick SPF 50+
reviews.review_text: This is an amazing sunscreen. I love that it comes in an easy & compact twist-up tube. It applies easily and is non-greasy. It melts right into the skin and leaves you looking beautiful and protects you from the sun!

reviews.product_name: Ultimate Sun Protector Lotion SPF 50+ Sunscreen
reviews.review_title: It’s okay but not life changing
reviews.review_text: This sunscreen is good but not amazing. It is super liquidy and a little greasy looking on the skin. The shiny and oiliness does seem to disappear after some time. It is very gentle on my sensitive skin and doesn’t break me out which I like. If you set it with a powder, the shine disappears immediately but it does seem to get oily or build up  where I have “wrinkles” like on my forehead.

reviews.review_text: I love this stuff. I was surprised to bc I normally don’t like sleeping mask type stuff having oily skin. This makes my skin so soft and just what I need on nights I use a-passoni. I will absolutely repurchase.

reviews.product_name: C.E.O. 15% Vitamin C Brightening Serum
reviews.review_text: Save your money! It hasn’t broken me out at all but it just never seems to absorb into my skin, is tacky/sticky, and makes me really oily.  Even when I don’t use the Ordinary (water based) serum it still just sits on top of my skin.  My mother asked me why I was sweating the other afternoon and I realized it was just that my forehead was super oily and it was definitely because of this product (wasn’t wearing any makeup). I received this in my Allure box and was really excited to try it out as I’ve been looking for a vitamin c serum, will continue to use this but will definitely not purchase once I run out. reviews.review_text: I try not to throw around “holy grail status“ too frequently but there’s no denying that’s where I am with this cleanser.  I’m obsessed with skincare. It just feels wonderful, and my skin feels radiant and supple as a result of it. It does have a slightly weird smell... but I’m over that, I’m totally used to it, and you only notice right as you’re applying it. It absorbs so fast into my skin that it’s an easy first step after Tatcha’s Essence.

Now I adore it... it feels like it gives me this “rush“ of moisture, and it seriously feels like a burst of the purest water on my face, that somehow sinks in to give me just the right level of moisture :) Before this I used Ole Henriksen’s Sheer Transformation, but I had to switch my moisturizer when I started using Tatcha’s Silk Canvas... which I love, but which made the Ole cream pill terribly. Switching to Tatcha’s moisturizer fixed the pilling issue, and now I’m so happy because I just love the feel of this cream, it’s like my skin gets a “drink“ of water every time I use it :)

reviews.review_text: This is another Tatcha product I wish I wasn’t in love with. I can’t imagine being without it. I’m not all that frugal with it either, I splash it over face, neck, and upper body. Thankfully a bottle seems to last me a long time, even using it this way, and I just stock up during sales... I think I’m on my third full-size bottle now. It’s truly wonderful... just what I need after washing my face, so that it doesn’t have that tight feeling, and it feels like this refreshing splash of nutrients that really does seem to make a difference to the appearance and feel of my aging skin. I also feel like all my The Ordinary serums soak in so much better and are more effective as a result of this first step after washing my face (with Tatcha’s Rice Polish). Won’t ever go without this as long as they sell it :)

reviews.review_title: Ended up as part of my morning routine
reviews.review_text: I don’t really think this is a must-have product. Having said that, I thought I would go without it after running out of a travel size and a full size I bought... and then found that I really missed it! So much so that another full size is now sitting happily on the counter. I use in the morning, after my serums and before my moisturizer. I find it adds just that extra dose of moisture I need, without being heavy like facial oils can be. And it plays just fine with my makeup afterwards. I’ve also thought about (but not yet tried) adding a serum to it, as it’s such a lovely spritz, and I have one serum in particular that I feel would be better spritzed than applied as drops. The spritzer is amazing too... like a perfume sprayer, so fine. I often use 3-4 sprays. And I’ll certainly take it with me for my next flight in the travel size container... I can imagine it would be so refreshing after a drying flight!

reviews.product_name: The Rice Polish Foaming Enzyme Powder
reviews.review_title: Love Calming and Deep for PM/AM
reviews.review_text: I’ve tried three of the four Rice Polish Enzyme powders from Tatcha. The Calming one in the blue jar is my favorite (it has indigo in it, which is amazing for skin)! I use that one at night. But I often use the Deep one in the mornings, as I feel it tightens up my pores more, which gives me a slightly smoother canvas for makeup than the other polishes (the Classic was my least favorite, it’s just too mild somehow, and based on that, I figure I wouldn’t like Sensitive at all, as that one is supposed to be the mildest of all). The Deep one and the blue Calming one both feel like they do a good job getting into my pores and leaving me with sparkling, soft, skin that feels wonderful and not dried or harshly washed at all. I even use the little silk cloth Tatcha sells on their website, and that’s made me enjoy the rice polishes even more... not only do they work better with the cloth (seriously they do!), but it adds to the feeling of a “ritual“ where I’m taking care of my skin, and I love that :)

There’s something just right about this one... the color, the scent, the way it feels on my skin. It’s definitely not something I’ll ever be without. I use it with the hope of reducing slight color spots from sun exposure... I even add it to my body moisturizer as I think it’s great all over aging skin. My skin is overall soft and supple now, and both feels and looks younger. This is a nice “dry“ oil too, so I don’t feel a slick over myself when I use it :)

reviews.review_text: I’ve been trying this moisturizer for the past couple of days and I’ve truly loved every moment I get to place this on my skin, it gives the skin this high shine glow that is so beautiful especially underneath makeup!

reviews.product_name: Sugar Hydrating Lip Balm
reviews.review_text: This caramel hydrating balm has a smooth, yet thick feel. It did a good job at hydrating my lips. I didn’t have the urge to constantly lick my lips and it didn’t dry my lips out, as some balms do. I would recommend.

reviews.product_name: Sugar Hydrating Lip Balm
reviews.review_text: I had to go thru trial and error with this lip balm before arriving to my final conclusion. I am VERY serious about my lip balms. I always want my lips to look smooth and hydrated because there are days when I love going natural. I bought this product already being familiar with Fresh products, so no hesitation there. This balm does in fact smell like coconuts, which is nice, but the least of my concerns. I started out using during the day - that didn’t work out so well. It’s way too heavy feeling on my lips even if I use a small amount, but I could tell it’s very hydrating. So I thought to use it at night while sleeping - there resided my answer. I apply on my lips before going to bed and when I wake my lips are super hydrated and soft feeling. The balm has effectively saturated into my lips overnight and I don’t wake feeling I need to moisturize my lips with something. I definitely use it after exfoliating my lips (and outer edges and corners) and the effectiveness of the hydration can definitely be felt. I will certainly keep this product as part of my beauty regimen.

reviews.product_name: T.L.C. Sukari Babyfacial AHA + BHA Mask
reviews.review_text: This stuff is probably the best working product I’ve bought in my entire life!! Results are immediately felt and seen. On me...the results are felt and seen days after the once-a-week application (more than once a week will be too much). The results are brightening, tightening, even skin tone, smaller pores...and I’m sure there are more results working beneath my skin’s surface. I apply the thin layer (as instructed) with 3 pumps. I feel the tingling sensation as stated - I leave on for the 20 minutes - and rinse with lukewarm water. My skin feels great during the wash-off, so I’m always excited to actually see the results after I pat dry. This product is truly LEGIT!

reviews.product_name: Tonique Confort Re-Hydrating Comforting Toner with Acacia Honey
reviews.review_text: I have oily skin and decided to purchase to use on days when I feel a little dry from the cold weather and over heated house and when using products that can be a bit drying, such as retinol. This product is lovely. One splash in my hands covers my entire face. It’s a perfect balance on those as-needed basis days.

reviews.product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C
reviews.review_text: This is an awesome product. I try to scrub / exfoliate my lips weekly and follow up with this lip sleeping mask. I apply a thick layer and it doesn’t feel too heavy on my lips. I go to sleep with my lips feeling well moisturized and wake with the product absorbed into my lips and leaving them feeling very soft and looking beautiful. Totally satisfied.

reviews.product_name: C-Tango Vitamin C Eye Cream
reviews.review_title: Not for my eyes - no firming results
reviews.review_text: I didn’t like this product for myself. It made my eyes puffy. I immediately noticed a decrease once I stopped using. I promptly returned the product.

reviews.product_name: Luna Sleeping Retinoid Night Oil
reviews.review_text: I do like how Luna makes my oily skin look gorgeous and radiant without feeling or looking overly oily. But, like another reviewer noted, it enlarged my pores. I tried this product twice and both times the same results and it’s pretty obvious. The oil itself may be too heavy for my skin. I don’t recall breakouts, but would not doubt the possibility.

reviews.product_name: Original Skin Retexturizing Mask with Rose Clay
reviews.review_title: Loving this mask for my oily skin
reviews.review_text: I’m so happy with this inexpensive purchase! The results are noticeable (glowy, even toned, very smooth, oil controlled skin). One thing I am thoroughly impressed with is how little it takes to cover your face and how well it distributes - meaning this 2.5 oz should last a good while. Its subtle smell is pleasant and the micro jojoba exfoliant beads are VERY gentle. Lastly, I love having to only leave on for 10 minutes. I get tired of one mask after another requiring at least 20 minutes to work it’s magic. This one - only 10 minutes. I love ways to shorten my routine and still get results.
