reviews.product_name: Barrier+ Triple Lipid-Peptide Face Cream
reviews.review_text: I received this product for testing and review purposes, but I am genuinely impressed by the quality of the product. It’s undeniably high quality and is truly such a luxurious product to use. Even though it’s thick, it still works wonderfully for oily and acne prone skin types like myself. I would thoroughly recommend this to anyone who needs a fragrance-free, reliable moisturizer for the colder, dryer winter months.

reviews.product_name: Floral Recovery Overnight Mask with Squalane
reviews.review_text: I haven’t tried many products from Fresh, but I was really impressed by how hydrated this left my skin. I would highly recommend this for mature and dry skin because it really does make your skin feel softer and hydrated.

reviews.product_name: Retinol Youth Renewal Serum
reviews.review_text: Retinol takes a while to see results, so I’m not going to speak to that since I’ve only been using it for a few weeks. This is such a hydrating formula that hasn’t caused any irritation at all, but my skin already feels softer and smoother!

reviews.product_name: Mini Retinol Youth Renewal Serum
reviews.review_text: Retinol takes a while to see results, so I’m not going to speak to that since I’ve only been using it for a few weeks. This is such a hydrating formula that hasn’t caused any irritation at all, but my skin already feels softer and smoother!

reviews.product_name: Watermelon Glow Niacinamide Sunscreen SPF 50
reviews.review_text: Glow recipe does it again! This has to be one of the comfiest sunscreens that I’ve ever worn. It gives my skin a gorgeous, radiant glow too. I can skip moisturizer when I wear this because it’s so hydrating.

reviews.product_name: Watermelon Glow PHA + BHA Pore-Tight Toner
reviews.review_text: I found this chemical exfoliant extremely effective at reducing my breakouts. However it’s a bit stickier than I would have preferred and I also would have appreciated if it was fragrance free! If that doesn’t bother you though, I think you’ll love this.

reviews.product_name: Mini Watermelon Glow PHA + BHA Pore-Tight Toner
reviews.review_text: I found this chemical exfoliant extremely effective at reducing my breakouts. However it’s a bit stickier than I would have preferred and I also would have appreciated if it was fragrance free! If that doesn’t bother you though, I think you’ll love this.

reviews.product_name: Good Genes All-In-One AHA Lactic Acid Treatment
reviews.review_text: This is such a classic skincare product for good reason. It makes your skin look so glowy and gorgeous! It has helped a lot with my skin texture and it’s strong but doesn’t irritate my skin. A holy grail product!

reviews.product_name: Lippe Balm
reviews.review_text: My two favorite lip balms of all time are: Bite Agave lip mask and this. This is my at home, around the house, before bed, my casual, travel, anytime balm. It has no offensive smell, or any scent. I Dislike both greasy oily balms that spread around my mouth and drip(fiancé hates kissing me with these types). and I greatly dislike waxy, thick balms that coat my lips in gunk and don’t moisturize(like Chapstick, burts bees, EOS and the ever famous rosebud balm). This is perfect. It’s super moisturizing, it does make my lips very soft, plump and healthy looking . it’s not too oily or greasy. Not waxy or thick at all. Leaves a subtle sheen. I like the wide appilication. Little goes a long way. I got this as a sample with “The Littles” and I would buy it when I run out. Highly recommend.

reviews.product_name: U.F.O. Salicylic Acid BHA Acne Treatment Face Oil
reviews.review_text: Super oily, congested, breakout prone skin CAN be hydrated without more breakouts. It is with this oil I can make that happen for my skin. I try avoid oils on my face but this helps to keep my skin so clear and bright. I dont know how they do it with the 1.5% salicylic acid AND all the other ingredients, some which are oils. I dont mind the herbal smell, I like it actually. I primarily use this at night and sparingly during the day. It takes care of acne and my complexion has evened out. It’s expensive but worth every penny as it does the impossible for my skin. Dont ever discontinue this!

reviews.product_name: Violet-C Brightening Serum 20% Vitamin C + 10% AHA
reviews.review_text: Very lightweight. Great for oily skin types like myself and good for Summer. It DOES brighten and clarify my overall skintone, I just didnt think this worked as intensely as well as some other AHAs serums. That’s ok, I dont need to strip and scald my skin everyday. This is perfect to use daily with zero irritation.  Very gentle. However, i recommend once or twice a week using something stronger like retinol or maybe a BHA in combination with this. This is a great product if you are sensitive and or new to acids in skincare.

reviews.product_name: Sugar Strawberry Exfoliating Face Wash
reviews.review_text: I didnt think this did anything other than mildly clean my face. Didnt dry me out, didnt do anything for oil, didnt exfoliate, gently(hardly) cleans my face.... If you’re looking for something very mild, you would like this. I have oily skin with pores and it didnt do much or anything special other than it smells  good and looks like you are putting straight up jam on your face.

reviews.product_name: The Essence Skincare Boosting Treatment
reviews.review_text: If I had to pick only ONE Tatcha product, it is this. I was hesitant to spend the money at first, but Im truly impressed with each time I use this. I use this after my toner. I put a small coin sized amount and rub and pat it in all over my face and neck, before my serums/moisturizer. My pores seems smaller, skin is brighter, smoother, more youthful, and my serums sink in better. I is one of the few products that I can see a noticeable difference when I use it and stop using it. I think it’s the rice ferment in this. Whatever it is, it works and I cannot imagine not having it in my skincare routine.

reviews.product_name: Mini The Essence  Skincare Boosting Treatment
reviews.review_text: If I had to pick only ONE Tatcha product, it is this. I was hesitant to spend the money at first, but Im truly impressed with each time I use this. I use this after my toner. reviews.product_name: Luminous Dewy Skin Mist
reviews.review_text: The most soothing and hydrating face mist I have used. MUST have while traveling. Makes my skin glow and radiant. I dont use this often to set my makeup, but it doesn’t disturb it either when i use it later in the day. I have oily skin, and I still love this as it feels so delicate and light. I use this as a refresher and i love to use this the most when I’m not wearing makeup or very minimal. Excellent using this while I have a face mask and as the last step in skincare. I also like the smell(smells like all of tatchas products). Pretty much, it’s my favorite face mist. Expensive but worth it!

reviews.product_name: Lala Retro Whipped Refillable Moisturizer with Ceramides
reviews.review_text: Intensely moisturizing without being sticky, too oily, or causing breakouts. I have oily skin with large pores and I only use this night and more so in the Winter. I would not use this for as a daytime moisturizer. I also dont particularly reach for this in the Summer(unless im badly sunburnt!). Goes great with retinol products, and other nighttime rituals. I love the fluffy texture and there is no scent to this. It feels very rich and soothing, my skin looks plump and hydrated in the morning. I find this to be a great value as I  only need to use sparingly and one jar has lasted me over year. One of the best moisturizers I have ever used. Absolutely recommend!

reviews.product_name: Rose & Hyaluronic Acid Deep Hydration Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I recently tried the Fresh Rose Deep Hydration Face Cream for the firs time and I’m in love with the product!The cream comes in the typical Fresh glass jar packaging which is not my favorite for sanitary reasons. I wish it came with a tiny spatula or something to help with keeping the product sanitary.The scent of roses is light but very noticeable so if you’re not a fan of scented products, this may not be a product for you. I happen to like the scent. The cream itself has a great consistency. It’s very hydrating with ingredients such as hyaluronic acid and damask rose extract but still very light in texture.The cream seems to be good for any skin type. I have oily/combination skin and I prefer to use the Fresh Rose Deep Hydration Face Cream with my night time routine because it can be a little much for my daytime routine. I would definitely recommend this cream especially to someone with dry skin.

reviews.product_name: Floral Recovery Overnight Mask with Squalane
reviews.review_text: The Fresh Floral Recovery Calming Mask is a great overnight mask.The calming mask comes in a glass jar container which isn’t my favorite kind of packaging because of sanitary reasons but looks great on my counter! The calming mask itself has a light botanical scent that stays a while it is light enough that it shouldn’t be too bothersome for those sensitive to scents. I really like the scent and find it comforting. The texture of the Fresh Floral Recovery Calming Mask is like a thick cream so a little bit goes a long way and the calming mask goes on easily and smoothly. You can see immediate relief from dryness and improvement in the texture of the skin.I have been applying this cream as the last step of my skincare routine and wake up with incredibly smooth skin in the morning. While it is recommended for all skin types, I find that with my oily to combination skin I can only use this about 1 or 2 times a week.I would recommend the Fresh Floral Recovery Calming Mask!

reviews.product_name: Retinol Youth Renewal Serum
reviews.review_text: I love the Murad skincare line and I can already tell that the addition of the Retinol Youth Renewal Serum to my skincare routine is going to be a big game changer!First impressions: The Murad Retinol Youth Renewal Serum comes in a nice looking and easy to use cylindrical plastic bottle with a pump on top. I like the plastic bottle packaging because I have tile floors and have learned that glass packaging is not my friend. The serum promises to help revitalize the skin and aid in a more youthful appearance with retinol being one of the key ingredients.I found that the Murad Retinol Youth Renewal Serum has a very light lotion like consistency that easily spreads and absorbs quickly into the skin. The serum is very hydrating and absorbs without leaving any residue or tackiness which also gives an immediate improvement to the skin’s more finer wrinkles. I also noticed that unlike some other products that contain retinol, this serum didn’t cause any peeling (which happens with some retinol products) so it might be something someone with sensitive skin might want to try. (I want to note that I have oily-combination skin and have been using this product for a week.)Overall, I really like the Murad Retinol Youth Renewal Serum and would highly recommend it to anyone looking to improve the texture of their skin immediately and long term.

reviews.product_name: Mini Retinol Youth Renewal Serum

reviews.product_name: Watermelon Glow Niacinamide Sunscreen SPF 50
reviews.review_text: Glow Recipe gifted me their Watermelon Glow Niacinamide Sunscreen SPF 50 in exchange for my honest opinion. The Watermelon Glow Niacinamide Sunscreen SPF 50 is essentially Glow Recipe’s amazing Watermelon Glow Niacinamide Dew Drops with the addition of SPF 50!The sunscreen comes in an easy to use squeeze tube and has a nice lightweight formula that is non-greasy and dries quickly. The Watermelon Glow Niacinamide Sunscreen SPF 50 has a nice pleasant scent like the rest of their Watermelon Glow products and is easily absorbed into the skin leaving a nice dewy finish with no white cast while giving you protection against harmful UVA and UVB rays.I feel like the Watermelon Glow Niacinamide Sunscreen SPF 50 is something that will be a holy grail item in my morning skincare routine. Not only is it a sunscreen that protects you with SPF 50, it also improves your skin while you’re using it with it’s amazing combination of ingredients. And best of all, the Watermelon Glow Niacinamide Sunscreen SPF 50 is environmentally friendly and reef safe making it a must have for those days at the beach!

reviews.product_name: Sugar Lip Balm Hydrating Treatment
reviews.review_text: The Fresh Sugar Lip Treatment in Rose is a very hydrating lip product that has a subtle tint to it. This lip treatment comes in the traditional Fresh lip product metal tube packaging. I love that the cap is a twist off because I have more confidence in just throwing it into my purse without worrying about it opening inside my bag! The Fresh Sugar Lip Treatment in Rose is a very easy to apply balm-like lip product that moisturizes the lips immediately after application. The shade Rose is a very versatile neutral shade that goes well with or without other face makeup. I find myself reaching for it quite frequently.I would definitely recommend the Fresh Sugar Lip Treatment in Rose. It is a nice product that seems to hold up pretty well against the hot and humid summer heat.

reviews.product_name: Tea Elixir Niacinamide & Hyaluronic Acid Anti-Aging Serum
reviews.review_title: Great product that yields great results
reviews.review_text: This new Fresh Tea Elixir Skin Resilience Activating Serum is a very exciting product to add to my arsenal of skincare products. The Fresh Tea Elixir Skin Resilience Activating Serum is comprised of a special “adaptive phytocompound tea (APT) technology” that is a culmination of ocean kelp, 5kDA hyaluronic acid, niacinamide, and ceramide III. This particular APT technology is designed to help your skin defend against daily stressors while helping to restore the skin.The Fresh Tea Elixir Skin Resilience Activating Serum comes in a beautiful emerald colored glass bottle with a dropper applicator. The serum has a light refreshing herbal scent that dissipates quickly after application but may not be for those sensitive to fragrances. The serum itself is a light milky white shade and has a nice easy to apply consistency that is not too thick or runny. Upon application, the Fresh Tea Elixir Skin Resilience Activating Serum is quickly absorbed into the skin and dries without leaving any stickiness while immediately hydrating the skin giving it a more supple and youthful texture.Overall, I really like the Fresh Tea Elixir Skin Resilience Activating Serum and would highly recommend it because the serum yields some immediate results and I expect even better results over time.

reviews.product_name: Ultra Facial Moisturizing Cream with Squalane
reviews.review_text: I have Sahara desert dry skin and this is one of the few products that works. I converted to this Kiehl’s moisturizer 4 years ago and I haven’t looked back. My sensitive skin loves that it’s unscented but still keeps my parched skin hydrated. I wear a serum underneath for an extra boost of moisture and glow.

reviews.product_name: Mini Ultra Facial Moisturizing Cream with Squalane

reviews.product_name: Good Genes All-In-One AHA Lactic Acid Treatment
reviews.review_text: I got this as a deluxe sample and my really wanted to not like this product. It’s considered a HG but that price is eye watering. It’s worth every penny though. I had several pimples flare up the day I decided to start my sample. By morning most of them were barely visible. I wanted to cry because it worked so well for my skin but that price tag does not agree with my wallet. I love it and wish I could purchase it more often.

reviews.product_name: Honeymoon Glow AHA Resurfacing Night Serum
reviews.review_text: Started with a sample (some of the reviewers mentioned tingling and redness) so I could see how my skin reacted. I guess I’m used to acids since I experienced no tingling, burning or redness. WOW! Within 15 minutes of my first use, my skin felt smoother & was actually glowing. Love the Farmacy honey scent and it left my skin feeling moisturized and soft. Got the full size and my skin is still happy with the product and is actually glowing. I use it 2-3x/ week and I’ve seen an improvement in my texture.

reviews.product_name: Creamy Eye Treatment with Avocado
reviews.review_text: Based on the amazing reviews I decided to get a free sample of this product. I have dry/combo skin and it usually loves rich products. Not this. I started breaking out on my under eye skin within days of trying this sample. I stuck with it in hopes my skin was merely purging. NOPE. The breakouts only went away after I stopped using this and went back to my combo of Mario Badescu Hyaluronic Eye Cream in the day & Kiehl’s Midnight Eye. I loved the rich texture but my eyes didn’t. If you have sensitive skin be wary.

reviews.product_name: Jet Lag Mask
reviews.review_title: be careful with the new formulation
reviews.review_text: I’ve loved this mask in the past because the formula was great and didn’t break me out. I used to wear it when I flew and it left my skin soft even in the drying airplane cabin. BE CAREFUL: With the new formula, most of the positive reviews are from people they’ve sent PR packages to. The new formula is awful. I went to repurchase and asked a Sephora employee and like other folks here they warned me that many people have reacted to this new formula. I will not be repurchasing.

reviews.product_name: Alpha Beta Extra Strength Daily Peel Pads
reviews.review_text: I really wanted to love this. My skin responds pretty well to products, and I’m familiar with what it likes/needs. The only thing this helped with was not being as oily. Barely. I’m so sad. I really thought after a month this would help give me a natural glow like other brands and less expensive products. Maybe I need to use it longer, but as I mentioned I’ve used far less expensive brands for better results

reviews.product_name: Mini Jet Lag Mask
reviews.review_text: I don’t care for this mask, doesn’t really feel like it does anything? Just feels super soft after but tone looks the same. Maybe I’m using it wrong lol

reviews.product_name: PHAT Glow Facial Mask
reviews.review_title: one mask to rule them all!
reviews.review_text: If you’re looking for a quick skin pick me up prep before my makeup I woke up like this skin...say no more, fam! This powerful facial in a bottle even works a dream on sensitive skin (thank you PHAs!) be sure to continuously rub it in until it turns white then set it and forget it! 15m later GLASS SKIN!

reviews.product_name: Banana Bright 15% Vitamin C Serum
reviews.review_title: Instant glow. Not sticky. Smells yummy.
reviews.review_text: This is a wonder serum. Packed with powerful ingredients...you can’t go wrong. Not sticky like other serums. Has a nice slip to it. Once applied, you see instant results (hydrating/radiance) After a week, my skin felt tighter and smoother. Great results with a competitive price...some serums are +++$80! Worth the $65 IMO

reviews.product_name: Vinoperfect Radiance Dark Spot Serum Vitamin C Alternative
reviews.review_title: worth the cash for aging skin
reviews.review_text: Started with a small sample size loved it so much bought the LE 1.7oz. Instant results and really a great alternative to vitamin c type serums. The consistency is a milky line texture. Glides right on...skin feels soft and supple after. Longtime perks include lightening of dark spots/ radiance. Smell is very light which I appreciate.

reviews.product_name: Lemonade Smoothing Scrub
reviews.review_text: I’m obsessed with this scrub! It’s smells so yummy and makes my skin feel super smooth after. LOVE the fact that the sugar melts in water...feels super gentle on my skin! (Adds to routine)***received complimentary however opinions are my own

reviews.product_name: Dewtopia 20% Acid Night Treatment
reviews.review_title: BEST NIGHT SERUM I'VE EVER USED
reviews.review_text: THIS IS MY NEW HOLY GRAIL. Serums come and go but this one is sticking around in my PM routine! This texture is like no other...very cocooning (is that a word?) but also the results. I LITERALLY wake up and my skin is soooooooooo soft and glowing. A++++++ for this new serum. Thank you!

reviews.product_name: Hello FAB Coconut Skin Smoothie Priming Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I purchased this in the Once Upon a Prime gift kit. It came with 10 facial radiance pads.  The whole kit was cost lest than the cost of the primir alone. It applies cool to the touch ad well as creamy. It is more of a moisturizer than a primer but leaves my skin feeling very protected.

reviews.product_name: Lippe Balm
reviews.review_text: Drunk Elephant haw created magic for my skin. During these cold blistering days my lips feel dry and are always peeling.  I have tried several types of lip balm without seeing any long lasting effects.  This lippe balm goes on like butter. It doesn’t leave a greasy feeling like some other brands.  Lippe balm leaves my lips moisturized and smooth. It also says it can be used for an undereye treatment but I found it to be a too oily for that sensitive of skin.

reviews.product_name: T.L.C. Framboos Glycolic Resurfacing Night Serum
reviews.review_text: I know. I know its pricey.  It is worth it. One thing I love about Drunk elephant products is that they really are potent and they work. one pump, that’s it! mix it with your moisturizer and smooth onto your face. My skin feels smooth and looks refreshed and bright.  One pump at night and let it work.

reviews.product_name: Beste No. 9 Jelly Cleanser
reviews.review_text: I dont often use jelly like cleansers because I feel like they leave a film behind but this cleanser left my face feeling clean but not dry at all. One of the best parts is how little of it you really need. It says a pea size and that’s really all it took. The value alone made it a definite keeper.

reviews.product_name: Lala Retro Whipped Refillable Moisturizer with Ceramides
reviews.review_text: I probably never would have given the whipped creme a try because of its price point. That would have been a missed opportunity because BABY! when they tell you one pump that’s really all you need and when used with the TLC frambroos it thins it out making it much lighter on the skin and gives your face a suppleness

reviews.product_name: Dewtopia 20% Acid Night Treatment
reviews.review_text: I am rarely truly impressed with serums. Normally.  The Dewtopia however has blown my mind. Not only does my skin look smoother, it also makes my face to look your  It smells like lemons and absorbs quickly.

reviews.product_name: The Dewy Serum Resurfacing and Plumping Treatment
reviews.review_text: I received this product in my Influenster’s VOX Box and I’m so happy! My skin has never felt so hydrated and soft! This is an absolutely amazing product that is lightweight and non greasy. Absorbs like a dream into your skin and makes fine lines vanish!

reviews.product_name: Santorini Grape Poreless Skin Cream
reviews.review_text: I received a sample size of this product from influencer in exchange for my honest review. This product has a great consistency; smooth and creamy. Left my face feeling hydrated, soft and smooth all day without feeling greasy.

reviews.product_name: Squalane + Omega Repair Deep Hydration Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: This thick, rich and creamy moisturizer was exactly what my dry skin needed! Instantly, my skin felt hydrated and soft. My face had a natural glow and it did not feel greasy at all. The smell was natural and did not bother me at all.

reviews.product_name: Confidence in a Cream Anti-Aging Hydrating Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I really enjoy using Confidence In A Cream! My skin feels super hydrated and I’ve noticed a difference in the fine lines  around my mouth. This cream absorbs fast and doesn’t leave a greasy feeling.

reviews.product_name: Mini Daily Microfoliant Exfoliator
reviews.review_text: Thiis product was gifted by Dermalogica Sampling in exchange for my real and honest opinion. If you’re looking for a gentle, daily exfoliant, look no further. This product starts off as a powder, but once you add water it foams up nicely. I instantly felt that my skin was softer and after using this product for a week, my skin feels smoother and more hydrated.

reviews.product_name: Daily Microfoliant Exfoliator
reviews.review_text: Thiis product was gifted by Dermalogica Sampling in exchange for my real and honest opinion. If you’re looking for a gentle, daily exfoliant, look no further. This product starts off as a powder, but once you add water it foams up nicely. I instantly felt that my skin was softer and after using this product for a week, my skin feels smoother and more hydrated.

reviews.product_name: Green Clean Makeup Removing Cleansing Balm
reviews.review_text: This is the best makeup remover I’ve ever tried. Much more environmentally conscious, too. Easier to manage; takes off even the toughest of lipsticks in one go. I cannot recommend more highly.

reviews.product_name: Green Clean Makeup Meltaway Cleansing Balm Limited Edition Jumbo
reviews.review_text: This is the best makeup remover I’ve ever tried. Much more environmentally conscious, too. Easier to manage; takes off even the toughest of lipsticks in one go. I cannot recommend more highly.

reviews.product_name: B-Hydra Intensive Hydration Serum with Hyaluronic Acid
reviews.review_text: It’s costly, so I only use half-a-pump in the mornings with my vitamin C serum and moisturizer. I think it’s lovely and lightweight. While I love DE, I feel like some of their products are far too costly for what you actually get. THIS, however, totally worth the price.

reviews.product_name: Honeymoon Glow AHA Resurfacing Night Serum
reviews.review_text: I’m so in love with this serum. I use it nightly, but to start, I wouldn’t recommend doing that unless you’re very used to using a glycolic daily. I’ve really seen a difference in the overall texture of my skin after using this.

reviews.product_name: Good Genes All-In-One AHA Lactic Acid Treatment
reviews.review_text: I can’t find anything like this anywhere else. Good Genes is my work horse and I’m truly and utterly addicted to how great it works.

reviews.product_name: Retinol Anti-Aging Serum
reviews.review_title: More powerful than products twice the price
reviews.review_text: I absolutely love this retinol. It’s strong and does the job. This is my second time buying it and truly I love it more than any other retinol I’ve tried —including pricier brands like DE.

reviews.product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C
reviews.review_text: Absolutely amazing! Bought online so I was pleasantly surprised by how much product is in it! A little goes a long way, I have extremely chapped lips especially in the winter and this is the only product that keeps my lips fully hydrated and feeling healthy. I use it every night and now in the morning as well as 10 minuets before applying a matte or satin lip. Best lip product I’ve ever used (if you don’t want to funny commit I’d recommend getting the Laneige trial kit that includes this product in a smaller size that Sephora also carries)

reviews.product_name: Glycolic Acid 7% Exfoliating Toning Solution
reviews.review_text: Best toner I’ve every used. I absolutely love it! It doesn’t burn at all which is something I usually have a problem with. It also makes my skin brighter. I have slightly dull skin and this helps so much!

reviews.product_name: Watermelon Glow PHA + BHA Pore-Tight Toner
reviews.review_text: One of my favorite toners! I got this complimentary from Influenster to test and review. It smells so good and is alcohol free which I love. It is gentle but give big results! Shrinks the appearance of my pores. It also keeps my skin hydrated and gives me a slight glow on my skin! Honestly this is a great product and I will be buying the full size when it becomes available again.

reviews.product_name: Mini Watermelon Glow PHA + BHA Pore-Tight Toner
reviews.review_text: One of my favorite toners! I got this complimentary from Influenster to test and review. It smells so good and is alcohol free which I love. It is gentle but give big results! Shrinks the appearance of my pores. It also keeps my skin hydrated and gives me a slight glow on my skin! Honestly this is a great product and I will be buying the full size when it becomes available again.

reviews.product_name: GOOPGLOW 15% Glycolic Acid Overnight Glow Peel
reviews.review_text: I really do like this product. I got a free sample from Influenster and I could see a difference in just one use.y face was glowing and smooth, much better texture than usual. It also helped my face absorbed my serum and moisturizer much better after too. Overall I do recommend this but the price is a bit much. I won’t be purchasing but if you have the funds for it I’d definitely give it a try

reviews.product_name: Mini GOOPGLOW 15% Glycolic Acid Overnight Glow Peel
reviews.review_text: I really do like this product. I got a free sample from Influenster and I could see a difference in just one use.y face was glowing and smooth, much better texture than usual. It also helped my face absorbed my serum and moisturizer much better after too. Overall I do recommend this but the price is a bit much. I won’t be purchasing but if you have the funds for it I’d definitely give it a try

reviews.product_name: F-Balm Electrolyte Waterfacial Mask
reviews.review_text: I truly do love this product. It isn’t 100% necessary but I will continue to buy it because it does wonders for my skin. I have combination skin and it keeps me hydrated without my t zone getting oily. I use this as a night moisturizer pretty much and I wake up with hydrated glowing skin.

reviews.product_name: Skinlongevity Long Life Herb Anti-Aging Face Serum
reviews.review_text: Huge fan of this serum! It absorbs super quickly into the skin and leaves my skin glowing! It’s also helped with my dry spots which is fantastic and it doesn’t make my t zone oily at all! Highly recommend this serum! I also love that a little goes a long way and it’s cruelty free!

reviews.product_name: Lemonade Smoothing Scrub
reviews.review_text: This is my new go to scrub. With it being both a physical and chemical exfoliant it makes my skin so soft after I use it. I keep it on for 5 minutes to let the AHA work longer. The scent is nice and it doesn’t sting at all.

reviews.product_name: Ultra Glow Serum: Glow + Strengthen Vitamin C Serum
reviews.review_text: This is a good vitamin c serum if you’re new to the ingredient or new to skincare in general. It’s not one I personally love but I’ve tried higher end vit c serums which I prefer. It takes a second to absorb into the skin but it does make my skin look brighter after continued use. Not a bad product overall

reviews.product_name: Protini Polypeptide Firming Refillable Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: The headline says it all! It feels like a medium weight cream, but rub it it and dear god! Amazing! Plus you can cocktail or create smoothies with any of the other Drunk Elephant products or serums.

reviews.product_name: Beste No. 9 Jelly Cleanser
reviews.review_text: Super gentle.I live in the Canadian rockies.. not smart. it dries your skin out (look for oil based if your at a high altitude). I will day though if you want a “glass“ look then go for it!

reviews.product_name: B-Hydra Intensive Hydration Serum with Hyaluronic Acid
reviews.review_text: I got this to add to my collection. I’m an electrician who lives high altitude plus all the drywall dust (you residential construction people understand) my face was dry by days end. I use this with the Drunk Elephant murula oil in the morning and my face is fantastic!

reviews.product_name: Virgin Marula Luxury Face Oil
reviews.review_text: At first I wasn’t a fan of how oily but after adjusting my face is silky smooth all day! Just 5 drops in the morning and I’m golden

reviews.product_name: C-Tango Vitamin C Eye Cream
reviews.review_text: Sadly I can’t say much for the bags under my eyes. Although the moisture is a perfect mix plus if applied on eye lids and lashes wow! I’ve physically seen a huge difference in a week!

reviews.product_name: Mini Virgin Marula LuxuryFace Oil
reviews.review_text: Oh my goodness, perfect booster to any moisturizer!

reviews.product_name: Niacinamide 10% + Zinc 1% Oil Control Serum
reviews.review_text: I started this a month ago along with Vitamin C and an Aha/Bha serum to help clear my face of closed comedomes. Such an improvement and you definitely can’t go wrong with the price.

reviews.product_name: Blue Tansy BHA and Enzyme Pore Refining Mask
reviews.review_text: I got this to help with closed comedones. for how much it cost plus how much comes in the jar not worth it. i was using it twice a week with a slight improvement.

reviews.product_name: Blueberry Bounce Gentle Cleanser
reviews.review_text: it has a pleasant smell but definitely not blueberry. Lathers very nicely. i liked this in summer months but now it’s fall it’s too drying for the Canadian rockies.

reviews.product_name: Superfood Antioxidant Cleanser
reviews.review_text: It did it’s job. The one thing I’m neutral on is the odour. I’m going to guess either people like it or don’t. I have normal skin and it made my face a little taut afterwards.

reviews.product_name: Mini Superfood Antioxidant Cleanser
reviews.review_text: It did it’s job. The one thing I’m neutral on is the odour. I’m going to guess either people like it or don’t. I have normal skin and it made my face a little taut afterwards.

reviews.product_name: Sugar Strawberry Exfoliating Face Wash
reviews.review_text: I actually enjoyed this. Something I noticed is if you chose to do it in the shower it’s less exfoliating compared to just wetting your face. Smells like REAL strawberries.

reviews.product_name: Lala Retro Whipped Refillable Moisturizer with Ceramides
reviews.review_text: Super thick and you have to wait a bit before applying any makeup. Although this is nice right before bed. Also helps when using high AHA/retinol products so you’re not flaky. I prefer the protein moisturizer from Drunk Elephant WAY more.

reviews.product_name: F-Balm Electrolyte Waterfacial Mask
reviews.review_text: Amazing! I always love drunk elephant. Since using retinol and aha alternating days this has calmed and soothed my skin insanely! Because of this product I can remove some other from my routine.

reviews.product_name: E-Rase Milki Micellar Water
reviews.review_text: Sadly I really wanted to love this as I love almost all of Drunk elephants products and use daily. This does make the skin smooth, but if I don’t add anything after my skin is just oily. Also for the amount you have to use to spread nicely I think the price isn’t worth it. I prefer other micellar waters.

reviews.product_name: E-Rase Milki Micellar Water Mini
reviews.review_text: Sadly I really wanted to love this as I love almost all of Drunk elephants products and use daily. I prefer other micellar waters.

reviews.product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C
reviews.review_text: I received this product complimentary from Influenster for testing purposes only and let me tell you I love it! This is the best product I have tried. I love it!!! While matte lip stick makes your lips dry, this product moisturizes your lips. Love it. It’s a must have!

reviews.product_name: Sugar Strawberry Exfoliating Face Wash
reviews.review_text: This is an amazing face wash with little exfoliating that goes a long way. I got this complementary to Influenster for testing purposes but I’ve been using it twice a week since and I absolutely love it.

reviews.product_name: GOOPGLOW Microderm Instant Glow Exfoliator
reviews.review_text: Wow. Okay I didn’t expect this to work so well. I used it on a spot on my skin and it worked so well that I used it on my entire face. Highly recommend.

reviews.product_name: Mini GOOPGLOW Microderm Instant Glow Exfoliator
reviews.review_text: Wow. Okay I didn’t expect this to work so well. I used it on a spot on my skin and it worked so well that I used it on my entire face. Highly recommend.

reviews.product_name: Dewtopia 20% Acid Night Treatment
reviews.review_text: Amazing! I did receive this complimentary to Influenster. However, after using it for about 2 weeks, I def feel the difference in my skin. I highly recommend this product.

reviews.product_name: 5 Stars Retinol + Niacinamide Eye Serum
reviews.review_text: I love this product so much. I only used it for a couple of days now but it is literally so amazing. It not only has retinoids but also has niacinamide. My under eyes love this product so much. It hydrates my skin and also brightens my dark under eyes.

reviews.product_name: Precleanse Cleansing Oil
reviews.review_text: I tried this a couple of times after it was gifted by Dermalogica but before writing this review and honestly it was pretty great. It wasn’t harsh on my skin. It took off all my makeup and skincare without any harshness. I totally suggest this product.

reviews.product_name: Mini Precleanse Cleansing Oil
reviews.review_text: I tried this a couple of times after it was gifted by Dermalogica but before writing this review and honestly it was pretty great. It wasn’t harsh on my skin. It took off all my makeup and skincare without any harshness. I totally suggest this product.

reviews.product_name: Plum Plump Hyaluronic Acid Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: My skin feels so amazing after using this. I generally like Glow Recipe products but this is my new favorite. My skin felt so nice and hydrated all day after applying a tiny amount on my face. It also gave my face a natural glow.

reviews.product_name: Mini Plum Plump Hyaluronic Acid Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: My skin feels so amazing after using this. I generally like Glow Recipe products but this is my new favorite. My skin felt so nice and hydrated all day after applying a tiny amount on my face. It also gave my face a natural glow.

reviews.product_name: Retinol Youth Renewal Serum
reviews.review_text: I love serums with retinol in it. This serum helps improve the look of fine lines and wrinkles especially around the eyes. I personally use it in the evening all over my face and neck. I do wonder how much retinol is in it because it doesn’t specify but I’m very happy with the serum.

reviews.product_name: Mini Retinol Youth Renewal Serum

reviews.product_name: Squalane + Omega Repair Deep Hydration Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I love the consistency of this product. It nice and thick but doesn’t feel too much on the skin. It feels very natural. I love how moisturizing the product is on the skin as well. Overall, i will repurchase this product.

reviews.product_name: Sugar Lip Balm Hydrating Treatment
reviews.review_text: This smells divine! I absolutely love this lip treatment. Goes on the lips so nice and smooth. It also leaves the lips looking so nice and rosy. I highly recommend this especially for a no makeup makeup look. I received this complimentary from Fresh but this is my honest review.

reviews.product_name: Tea Elixir Niacinamide & Hyaluronic Acid Anti-Aging Serum
reviews.review_text: Used this Fresh Tea Elixir serum for a few days now and my skin just feels so smooth and hydrated. I have a visible glow that everyone keeps asking about! I absolutely love this serum and I am going to recommend it to everyone I know!

reviews.product_name: Jet Lag Mask
reviews.review_title: I won’t lie it’s confusing but worth the try
reviews.review_text: This is probably the most confusing product I’ve ever purchased. It’s incredibly hyped up yes but at the same time I can see why...When I used it as an overnight mask, after using my regular cleanser, I didn’t see anything amazing. When I used it as a moisturizer, I saw that my skin was a bit brighter and more hydrated especially being out in the Toronto winter. At the same time I can’t use it too much as a moisturizer because it’s so thick I feel like it clogs my pores but then again  it’s the only thing that’s hydrating my skin from the harsh winter air. When I used it as a primer, particularly with a matte foundation I saw great results. My favourite way to use this at the moment is after using Juice Beauty’s green apple chemical peel and going to sleep, so I guess as an overnight mask. But only as an overnight mask with this peel. I’ve only used this for about a month though so maybe I’ll figure it out in time.

reviews.product_name: Lippe Balm
reviews.review_text: Hands down this is my fave lippie. I really like the fact that it’s slightly bigger than your lip area so it catches a bit of the skin. However there needs to be more product! Especially since I started buying this last year and it was $22 which I found to be a bit much for the price and now I see that it’s $24. I’m going to have to find an alternative if they keep raising the price and not increasing the amount of product in the lippie.

reviews.product_name: Squalane + Omega Repair Deep Hydration Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I use this at night. I don’t find it overly thick where it’s sitting on my face like the DE Protini peptide (which I do like) I find that it sinks in nicely and doesn’t break me out. AND YES it smells like feet but you don’t smell it unless you stick your entire nose in the jar.

reviews.product_name: Squalane + Vitamin C Rose Firming Oil
reviews.review_text: I love this! I find it light and I wake up glowing! If only it wasn’t so expensive.  Right now I’m just using the Ordinary squalane oil and vitamin c serum to replicate this product since I finished it. But I love this and may bite the bullet again and splurge.

reviews.product_name: The Rice Polish Foaming Enzyme Powder
reviews.review_text: I love love love this!. I wish however that sephora would sell the travel size not sure why they stopped and only offer it in gift sets as the tacha website sells the travel size. But anyway I love this enzyme powder, it’s gentle that I can use it more then once a week and I have bought this over and over and over again. This is my first time buying the full size as I use to get the travel size on its own or in a gift set. I little go a long way and the travel size amount actually lasts me a long time. With this product I notice that it helps my skin in my t-zone and the area right under my bottom lips to feel smooth. I stopped using this because Sephora wasn’t telling the travel size version anyone and bought something else which did nothing for my skin. Now I finally bought the full size and happy to be using this product again.

reviews.product_name: Green Clean Makeup Removing Cleansing Balm
reviews.review_text: I really love this and would purchase it again. It great if you have sensitive eyes like me. Gets rid of your makeup without having to work hard at removing it. Keep this short and sweet, I would recommend this to people.

reviews.product_name: Green Clean Makeup Meltaway Cleansing Balm Limited Edition Jumbo
reviews.review_text: I really love this and would purchase it again. It great if you have sensitive eyes like me. Gets rid of your makeup without having to work hard at removing it. Keep this short and sweet, I would recommend this to people.

reviews.product_name: Brighten-i Eye Cream
reviews.review_text: Bought this as a gift for my mom with other stuff, my mom is hard to shop for and will tell me if she doesn’t like something I bought her. I’m surprised when she asked me a few weeks later after Christmas to buy her 2 more of this eye cream before she even finished the 1st one I got her. This means she really likes this product as she has only ever asked me once to repurchase something I got for her as a gift.

reviews.product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C
reviews.review_text: I really enjoy using this lip mask, I feel it works great and I would buy this again. I like this more than the lip treatment balm which I have. I wish this would also come with an applicator as the treatment balm does.

reviews.product_name: Green Clean Makeup Removing Cleansing Balm
reviews.review_text: Absolutely one of the best make up melts out there. I can feel my pores being hydrated even after I wipe it all off.

reviews.product_name: Green Clean Makeup Meltaway Cleansing Balm Limited Edition Jumbo
reviews.review_text: Absolutely one of the best make up melts out there. I can feel my pores being hydrated even after I wipe it all off.

reviews.product_name: Jet Lag Mask
reviews.review_text: I always take this little guy with me when I travel. Skin care routines can be strenuous but when you’re on the go, on the fly, or recovering from a busy schedule, this is an amazing recovering pick me up! I don’t use it habitually but it always works when I need it.

reviews.product_name: Mini Jet Lag Mask

reviews.review_text: I have brown skin, but my review is the same as all the others. For people with darker pigmentation I suggest using a dime size (a little goes a long way) and for my dry skinned people add a drop of rose oil or any of your favorite skin oil! It’s a phenomenal product but didn’t have dark pigmentation in mind with its beige tent

reviews.product_name: Glow2OH Dark Spot Toner
reviews.review_text: definitely approve of this product! Its amazing and I’m suprised to see results as quickly as I did. DO NOT USE IN THE AM. It will make you light/sun sensitive. I use it every night and an oil + Kiehls cream.

reviews.product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C
reviews.review_text: I wish I could give this 10 stars. I bought the value set (w/ the Sleeping Mask and sample moisturizer) and this was easily the star of the box. I used this once as directed at night and have since started using it as a straight up lip balm and even overtop my lipstick as a gloss (its that glossy). I have very peely lips and this softens the skin enough for it to be removed if used as a lip balm and as a night mask I always wake up with the softest lips.

reviews.product_name: The True Cream Moisturizing Bomb
reviews.review_text: incredible absolutely worth every penny. I usually have very oily skin but with the Canadian winter my skin has been more dry/combination and this has been a life saver. I also have very acne prone sensitive skin and I have not broken out at all - in fact I think its helped with my acne in combination with my other products. Its light enough that I can use it in the day but moisturizing enough for me to use at night. Works beautiful under my foundation but I may switch to the original Aqua Bomb for summer.

reviews.product_name: Aqua Bomb Sleeping Mask
reviews.review_text: I love this mask so much. The texture is really unique - it’s a jelly type pudding that once you rub between your fingers transforms to be more easily applied. I typically have rather oily skin but winter has made me more combo/dry. This is perfect - down to the smell, the texture, it doesnt make me break out, and a little goes a long way. Depending on how dry my skin is/how much I put on there is some stickiness but I really dont mind as I usually give it a good while to sink in before I put my head on my pillow. With some moisturizing masks I find theres too much of a cooling sensation and even a bit of a burn/sting - this is more soothing and calming. Worth every penny.

reviews.product_name: Blue Tansy BHA and Enzyme Pore Refining Mask
reviews.review_title: COOLING AND CLEARING BUT ROTTING FRUIT
reviews.review_text: I’m on the fence with this mask - I really enjoy it as a cooling and clearing mask (especially since clay masks can be more harsh sometimes) but the smell is God awful. It smells like rotting fruit and detergent. I was worried about going through it quickly because it’s more runny and is rather expensive but I havent picked it up as much because the smell is so off putting. I didnt notice a bug enough difference in my skin to get over the smell and power through.

reviews.product_name: Luminous Dewy Skin Mist
reviews.review_title: DEWY SKIN IS RIGHT - HYDRATION AND MODEL SKIN
reviews.review_text: Tatcha creates the boujie-est products I’ve owned - from the packaging to the actual ingredients in their skin care this is luxury luxury luxury. I loved this mist during the winter as my skin became DUSTY with the Canadian weather. This was great to add to my pre-makeup base as well as for some extra hydration going to bed. This will 3000% give you a dewy skin look and if you can commit to the price of it I say go for it. I have repurposed my old bottle to just spray water in between my serums/Hyaluronic Acid because it’s the best BEST mister on a spray bottle I’ve used.

reviews.product_name: Green Clean Makeup Meltaway Cleansing Balm Limited Edition Jumbo
reviews.review_title: Great slip, lovely scent, no waxy residue!
reviews.review_text: I bought this on a whim after realizing I was almost out of my squalane cleanser from the Ordinary. I prefer Farmacy way more as my first cleanser compared to any other oil/balm cleanser. The scent is not overwhelming or obnoxious, its light and citrusy. It doesnt take forever to melt down and the slip and glide makes it really enjoyable to break down my makeup/sunscreen before I go in with a second cleanser. My favourite aspect of this balm is that theres NO waxy residue left on my skin after rinsing off the balm (which is an issue I had with the Ordinary and a few other cleansing oils/balms). A little truly goes a long way and the 100ml size has lasted me well into April since purchasing it in January!

reviews.product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C
reviews.review_text: I keep a container of this in every single purse I own with back ups and one for my night stand. I cant go anywhere without this. I dont know how but this balm breaks down and softens the dead skin on my lips which gives me the SOFTEST and juiciest lips of my life. I wear it religiously at this point and have recieved compliments from my partners on how kissable my lips are because of it. It’s great as a stand alone gloss, perfect underneath/over matte lipsticks, soothing for chapped lips in the dead of winter and amazing as a night lip mask. I’ve tried multiple scents/flavors of it but the original berry and grapefruit as my favorites purely because the others (vanilla, apple, and mint) leave a bit of a milky colour over my lips as they have a fair amount of colour to them naturally. A little does really go a long way but I’m pretty over indulgent at this point - even so an entire jar lasted me well over 8 months. Worth every single penny.

reviews.product_name: Midnight Recovery Concentrate Moisturizing Face Oil
reviews.review_text: This did nothing for me beyond making my skin smell very floral. It has the consistency of a dry oil and does not offer much slip or glide over my skin which I prefer in my night time oils. While I did not break out from this I didnt experience any softening to my skin or any brightening as Kiehls markets this serum to offer.

reviews.product_name: Midnight Recovery Concentrate Moisturizing Face Oil
reviews.review_text: This did nothing for me beyond making my skin smell very floral. While I did not break out from this I didnt experience any softening to my skin or any brightening as Kiehls markets this serum to offer.

reviews.product_name: Daily Greens Oil-Free Gel Moisturizer with Moringa and Papaya
reviews.review_text: I’m really conflicted about this moisturizer and review as I wish I enjoyed this product more. Initally I loved the scent but overtime I found it just a touch too strong but I know that scent tolerance is unique to every individual. My favourite aspects of the moisturizer was that it was very hydrating and light - my skin felt very plump and hydrated which is perfect for my very oily skin in the summer months. I did experience some of the tacky/stickiness mentioned in other reviews but I oddly enjoyed that and it made for a great base for my foundation to grab onto if I wore it. I also really didnt need very much to achieve this result on a consistent basis. Aside from the smell my low rating is due to the fact that my fungal and hormonal acne reacted very negatively to this product. When I first recieved my order it was important for me to 1. Try this for at least 5 weeks and 2. Only introduce this one new product to my routine to ensure I could determine results (if any) without attributing it to another product. After about 2 weeks of use my hormonal acne was more inflamed and my fungal acne had spread at an alarming rate. But I pushed on as I was stubborn and wanted to give this a fair chance. After week 5 I gave up and switched back to my standard moisturizer and an exfoliant to clean up the damage done to my skin. Skincare is very personal but as my personal experience left me with a mess I now have to counteract I cant reccomend this product.

reviews.product_name: Mini Daily Microfoliant Exfoliator
reviews.review_title: BITE THE BULLET ITS WORTH IT
reviews.review_text: I truly get what the hype is about now. This product isnt life changing but it is damn good. I’ve exclusively used chemical exfoliants since physical exfoliants (looking at you St. Ives) absolutely destroyed my barrier and worsened my inflamed acne. The Microfoliant is a great addition to my routine when used correctly. You really dont need a lot to make a good foam (I wouldn’t call it a paste as they do on the bottle. If you did make a paste it would be very abrasive in my opinion) and it leaves my skin feeling really smooth without over stripped, raw or red. I haven’t noticed any changes in the size of my pores but it preps my skin so well for my evening routine. I almost wish I didnt enjoy this as much because the price is a prettty high but damn it’s worth it.

reviews.review_text: I bought this because I wanted to find a basic (no actives no harsh surfactants etc) cleanser whilst using my retinol/Adapalene. It is just that - basic, which isnt a bad thing!. I enjoyed it for its simplicity in that it gently cleaned my skin without over stripping it but I wont be repurchasing. At times I needed to use more cleanser to breakdown my makeup and/or sunscreen even after a oil cleanse which was frustrating given the price point.

reviews.product_name: Mini Superfood Antioxidant Cleanser
reviews.review_text: I bought this because I wanted to find a basic (no actives no harsh surfactants etc) cleanser whilst using my retinol/Adapalene. It is just that - basic, which isnt a bad thing!. reviews.product_name: Oat Cleansing Balm
reviews.review_text: I really loved this cleansing balm! I was in the market for a new c.b. as I couldnt justify the price of my Farmacy c.b. anymore. I love that it has zero fragrance and is on the thicker side (before it melts down). It does has a slight gritty/granular texture to it that I feel like could be irritating to sensitive skin but for me it isnt harsh at all. I wouldn’t use this as my only cleanser as it does leave a moisturizing feeling afterwards but because this product is meant to be a first cleanse that doesnt bother me. It does require some pressure to get out of the tube but I have transferred mine into a jar for convenience sake. I actually prefer this one to the Ordinarys Squalane C.B. as I felt that one took much longer to melt down and left thick film over my face even after using a second cleanser. Overall, the price cant be beat and for what it does its really amazing!

reviews.product_name: Cream Skin Toner & Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I love this toner! I bought this in a desperate attempt to soothe my very irritated and dry skin. It does feel like a toner and moisturizer- starts off very hydrating and then transforms into a rich (but light) moisturizing feeling. Aptly named Cream Skin. I’ve been on prescription Adapalene which has made my usually oily skin very dry and irritated. This doesnt burn, sting or make my skin itch when even my most basic moisturizers do. I feel like this has made a huge difference in how my skin has continued to adapt to the Adapalene, especially at night. I also like to use this as my morning moisturizer since my sunscreen is very moisturizing and this gives enough moisture without needing another layer of day cream. Love that it has no scent and a little does go a long way!

reviews.product_name: Rose & Hyaluronic Acid Deep Hydration Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: If you love the smell of roses then this moisturizer is for you. I love the way it makes my skin feel after it’s all cleansed. Doesn’t make my skin irritated and I love wearing it for a natural day or when I am wearing makeup.

reviews.product_name: Barrier+ Triple Lipid-Peptide Face Cream
reviews.review_text: Thick but not overbearing. It has the same smell as every other product in the line but I am okay with it. I have seen better texture within my skin and I only use a pump every time. I like that it doesn’t leave a white cast too.

reviews.product_name: Mini Barrier+ Triple Lipid-Peptide Face Cream

reviews.review_text: I’m young but I still want to take care of my eyes. The bags under my eyes don’t exist because of this product. I would like to keep it that way as I continue to age. Pop some of this on then use a cold jade roller...it’s life-changing.

reviews.review_text: OBSESSED. I used another cleanser before to take off my makeup and let’s just say that cleanser has nothing on this one. I use a reusable cotton pad to wash the cleanser off my face and my makeup is completely off.complimentary from Dermalogica

I’ve only been using it for a couple of weeks so I haven’t seen a huge difference but I am going to keep using it to see if I see results.

reviews.product_name: Mini Daily Microfoliant Exfoliator
reviews.review_text: One of my go-to products in my routine and I’ve seen a difference in my skin. This product is delicate on the skin but also does a good job. I feel like it really does clean the dirt and oil out of my pores, acne, and skin in general.

reviews.product_name: Daily Microfoliant Exfoliator

reviews.product_name: Sugar Lip Balm Hydrating Treatment
reviews.review_text: I love fresh lip balms. They are so lovely on my lips and even leave a nice tint color as well. If I want a no-makeup lip look, this is definitely the perfect product.  The packaging is super chic as well.  The product was gifted by Fresh.

reviews.product_name: Cleansing & Exfoliating Wipes
reviews.review_text: I love these wipes. They exfoliate my skin and leave it very clean. I feel my skin very clean with these wipes. Totally recommend for oily skin.

reviews.product_name: Sugar Hydrating Lip Balm
reviews.review_text: Love this lip balm. It has become one of my favorite lip balms. It leaves my lips so soft and smooth. Love the smell too.

reviews.product_name: Lala Retro Whipped Refillable Moisturizer with Ceramides
reviews.review_text: I bought this as a gift for my mom. She loves this cream. She has really dry skin and with this cream her face is always hydrated and feels very soft. I am so glad I bought this for her. She loves it.

reviews.product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C
reviews.review_text: I love this lip mask. I love the smell. It smells really good. The formula is beautiful. I love the original lip mask in the berry scent and this one smells really great too. I wake up to beautiful soft lips. I sometimes I use it during the day. It is a really great lip mask and I definitely recommend it. I just hope they bring out the mint chocolate one in full size again.

reviews.product_name: Hyaluronic Acid 2% + B5 Hydrating Serum
reviews.review_text: This is the best hyaluronic acid out there. Well at least it’s the best one I have tried. This is the second bottle I purchase I really do love it. It really does aid in everything being absorbed into the skin. Remember we all need hyaluronic acid in our lives.

reviews.product_name: C-Rush Vitamin C Gel Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I received this as a birthday gift from my mom and it was in a set and I am so glad because I loved it and I had to buy the full size. This moisturizer is sooo good. The formula is great. I have really really oily skin and this moisturizer is really good. It absorbs into my skin very beautifully. The best part is that it’s full of vitamin C and we all need vitamin C. Also it smells really nice.

reviews.product_name: The Rice Wash Skin-Softening Cleanser
reviews.review_text: This is one of the best cleansers I have tried. I have really really oily skin and this cleanser works great for me even though it’s not targeted for oily skin. I am loving this. It is a very gentle cleanser and it does not strip my face. It leaves my skin feeling so soft but hydrated. This cleanser and the Tatcha Deep cleanse are my favorite.

Can’t wait to see the results of this after a few weeks of using it.

It’s worked best for me by applying a light layer and letting sit for 10 mins after that I work it in by morning my skin feels so soft and plumped.

reviews.review_title: Great base for matte foundation during winter!
reviews.review_text: This is a great moisturizer for all skin types. If you are a fan of silicon free primers that prep the skin before makeup application then you’ll love this. I like to apply a light amount, I found that being heavy handed will definitely clog your pores as any rich moisturizer would.

reviews.product_name: Glowscreen Sunscreen SPF 40 PA+++ with Hyaluronic Acid + Niacinamide
reviews.review_text: I’ve been using the original formula for the past 2 years! I’m so happy that they now have 2 shades available for their Glow Screen. Same benefits but with a glowy finish. This is perfect for those who have dry skin or if you like a radiant finish.  A little goes a long way. A nice makeup tip is to use this as your primer and follow with your favorite foundation or tinted moisturizer.

reviews.product_name: Sugar Lip Balm Hydrating Treatment
reviews.review_text: Fresh Beauty really has some of the best lip treatments out there. This sugar lip treatment is a wonderful combination of lip care and lip tint. I got the shade Rosé and it has a beautiful color pay off. I love using this on minimal makeup days. (Gifted by Fresh)

reviews.product_name: Tea Elixir Niacinamide & Hyaluronic Acid Anti-Aging Serum
reviews.review_text: I’m a huge fan of Fresh Beauty products and I’m so happy I got to try their new Tea Elixir serum. It packed with ingredients that my skin already loves like niacinamide, hyaluronic acid. They also added (APT) which is supposed to be amazing for increasing the skin’s antioxidant protection. I’ve only been using it for a few days but I have already noticed a beautiful glow to my skin and it has definitely helped with refining my pores.

reviews.review_text: This priming base is incredible!! I love how smoothly it glides on your face and how it creates the perfect layer for me to apply my makeup. I’ve been using Bobby Brown products for years and this one easily ranks as one of my favorites.

reviews.product_name: Sugar Lip Balm Hydrating Treatment
reviews.review_text: I received this product complimentary from Fresh. I am obsessed with this lip balm. The color is great and super buildable, really hydrating on my lips. I love how it doesn’t feel too thick while still giving me great coverage!

reviews.product_name: Tea Elixir Niacinamide & Hyaluronic Acid Anti-Aging Serum
reviews.review_text: I received this product complimentary from Fresh. It’s a great serum and works so nicely with my normal skin type. I love how it’s made my skin feel smoother after just a couple uses. Would recommend as a daily add on for your routine!

reviews.product_name: Watermelon Pink Juice Oil-Free Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I loved this moisturizer because of the light sweet scent and the texture was different from most moisturizers. I like that it is gentle and easy for your skin to absorb. It doesn’t clash with the other skin care products that I’m using and has a very thin consistency which is really good for my skin to absorb product easier and faster. I haven’t tried anything from the recipe that I haven’t liked yet and I do love the ingredients that are in this moisturizer. This was gifted to me by glow recipe and I was so happy to try it.

reviews.product_name: Watermelon Glow Niacinamide Dew Drops
reviews.review_text: I tried this complimentary from glow recipe.Loved it! It’s a nice hydrating formula that is a great finishing touch to a skin care routine or make up prep. It has very subtle shimmer that looks natural which is nice and the bottle is so cute! Totally recommend and smells amazing like the rest of the line.

reviews.product_name: Good Genes All-In-One AHA Lactic Acid Treatment

It assists her with a deep clean without stripping her skin and it assists me with texture and dullness. I have combination skin. I like that this cleanser thoroughly cleanses my oily T-zone, but it doesn’t strip my dry areas. If you’re looking for an effective foaming cleanser for a great price point, this is it! reviews.product_name: Luna Sleeping Retinoid Night Oil
reviews.review_title: Fountain of youth for my chocolate skin!
reviews.review_text: I saw an immediate improvement after using this product consistently for a few days. A little goes a long way although the price point is startling. My skin is more radiant and plump thanks to this product. It is now a staple in my nighttime routine. Love it!

reviews.product_name: GinZing Ultra-Hydrating Energy-Boosting Cream
reviews.review_text: This has become my everyday staple in my skin care. I’m on my second jar and my skin couldn’t love this even more. This is definitely been a game changer in my skin care. It’s so light on the skin but yet the moisture lasts all day. I have a oily tzone and normal everywhere else and this has definitely helped with my minimizing my oil production in my tzone while still being able to balance the normal parts of my skin. I’ve always seen a different in how rediant my skin looks without me looking oily (if that makes sense). I’m sure this has also help in conjunction with my facial serum to help reduce my hyperpigmentation from my past battles with breakouts and acne and also to help fill out my smile line. My makeup doesn’t sit in my smile line like it use to. All in all, this is an amazing moisturizer. Since using it my breakouts have been soooooooooo minimal, my skin texture is more even and I always look forward to washing wash my face with the facial wash from the same line and then using this because they both smile like citrus heaven! Definitely a keeper and staple in my skin routine!!

reviews.product_name: Balancing Force Oil Control Toner
reviews.review_text: Very good toner for combination skin (I’m oily in my tzone normal everywhere else) it works great at control oil like it says without drying the normal parts of my face out. This has also help to control my breakout very well. Even after toning I find that i have a nice healthy glow (not an oil glow) just that the radiance in my skin is showing more. After 4 bottles this is definitely my holy grail toner, and for the price I’ll definitely keep buying.

reviews.product_name: Glow Cycle Retin-ALT Power Serum
reviews.review_text: This has become a staple item in my skin care. I’ve been using it nightly for the past almost 5 months (I went back into my purchase history to see when I bought it, yes it was back in August lol) and just scooped out the last drop a two nights ago. This has definitely been a game changer in my skin care. I have an oily tzone, and normal everywhere else. I suffered from hyperpigmentation from breakouts. I’ve tried so many different serums, but this by far has had the biggest impact on my facial skin. I was seeing an Aesthetician for almost two years to help with my hyperpigmentation, my smile lines and breakouts. This helped me with all of that. In the past five months I’ve ever only notice breakouts when it’s that time of the month and it’s usually two or three. And my makeup usuage have been wayyy less, very minimal these day. I use this serum in conjunction with the moisture, face wash and under eye cream from Origins orange line and my toner is from ole Henriksen green line for oil control. It’s definitely worth the price a little goes a long way!

reviews.product_name: Unseen Sunscreen SPF 40 PA+++
reviews.review_text: I would definitely recommend this sunscreen Especially to my brown and dark skinned girls looking for some sun protection. I have a sunscreen sensitivity, I break out into small rashes in the areas the sunscreen is in. This hasn’t done that and it’s been a 2 weeks of everyday use. It hasn’t broke me out, give me a rash, nothing. This was the best recommendation I’ve ever gotten from a Sephora employee and I trust NO ONE in a Sephora uniform lol. The consistency of this feels like a primer (mainly the smash box photo finish or the maybeline baby skin primer) and it feels like butter in the face. It’s translucent with a slight yellow tint. I apply this after my moisturizer everyday, even if there’s no sun out. There’s no type of cast on the skin (and I’m a dark skinned girl) I love that my face still feels hydrated and it has a slight velvet matte finish for a few hours but of course it will start to break down like any other sunscreen out there. A little goes a long way. I love how my skin looks with it on and even after it breaks down.

reviews.review_text: I very much enjoy this eye cream. I’ve been using it everyday since buying it almost two months ago and it definitely helps to reduce puffiness. I learned that it works WAY better as a night cream. When I wake up in the morning my eyes are not puffy like before. I always wash my face with cool water to help reduce my morning puffy lids but this, this has really helped out a lot. As for brightening, it’s ehhh, I’m dark skin and never really had a problem with dark circles. All in all this is a really great eye cream especially for the price!

reviews.product_name: Niacinamide 10% + Zinc 1% Oil Control Serum
reviews.review_text: Excellent product works with any other active ingredient I use. I’ve been using this for a little over a month. I use this both am/pm and it had changed my skin for The best. My skin is more brighter, smoother and I haven’t broken out since adding this to my routine. When I first started using  I had a huge blemish on my cheek with this addition to my skin care routine that blemish healed and went away within a 1-2 weeks. Some people need to understand that when you start using certain active ingredients products your skin will start to Purge out your pores meaning you may “breakout” as some actives bring congestion to the surface to be expelled out from the skin. And this does exactly that. NNiacinamide and zinc has become my favorite topical active and this one is definitely my favorite. Will definitely be buying the big bottle next!!!

reviews.product_name: Daily UV Defense Invisible Broad Spectrum SPF 36 Sunscreen
reviews.review_text: I’m obsessed with this sunscreen. It feels like skincare to me and that’s how I love my sunscreen to feel. As a dark skin black woman this is a dream come true. I prefer a chemical sunscreen over a physical because of the white cast left behind by physicals but there is only one or two I’d use. Ever since buying this one I’m always reaching for it. I think it’s because I prefer the hydrated feel and glowy dewy look to the skin I get with this one. My skin just looks healthy all day even when I reapply throughout the day. Out of all of the Korean sunscreen I’ve tried this is definitely number 1. Definitely a good by especially if you like a nice healthy shine to your skin. But it’s soooo annoying that it’s always in an out of stock. Definitely buying like two next time it’s in stock!
