reviews.product_name: Mini GOOPGLOW Microderm Instant Glow Exfoliator
reviews.review_text: This product was gifted to me by the goop beauty brand, however that doesn’t alter my opinion on the product. There is no heavy smell which I can appreciate .This microdermabrasion glow exfoliator is thick in consistency. It feels very luxurious and you don’t need much to spread around the face. The exfoliation isn’t harsh but you skin feel so smooth after. Also once you put on your moisturizer the glow you see is almost immediate. I really see myself continuing to purchase this after my first bottle.

reviews.product_name: GOOPGLOW 15% Glycolic Acid Overnight Glow Peel
reviews.review_text: I absolutely love these peels. My skin is usually very sensitive but this did not disturb or irritate my acne prone skin. I noticed a change in my skin, the texture seemed to decrease instantly . My skin seemed so smooth. I noticed my makeup went on a lot easier and seemed to blend more effortlessly. You only need to use it about once a week, so it’s not a high maintenance addition to my routine.this will be a staple from now on and I will be purchasing for the future. I received this product as a free sample.

reviews.product_name: Mini GOOPGLOW 15% Glycolic Acid Overnight Glow Peel
reviews.review_text: I absolutely love these peels. My skin is usually very sensitive but this did not disturb or irritate my acne prone skin. I noticed a change in my skin, the texture seemed to decrease instantly . My skin seemed so smooth. I noticed my makeup went on a lot easier and seemed to blend more effortlessly. You only need to use it about once a week, so it’s not a high maintenance addition to my routine.this will be a staple from now on and I will be purchasing for the future. I received this product as a free sample.

reviews.product_name: Watermelon Glow PHA + BHA Pore-Tight Toner
reviews.review_text: Absolutely love! I am really loving this toner. First things first the smell is refreshing and doesn’t smell over powerful or perfumey. The texture is thin but doesn’t have a sticky after feeling. Skin seems smoother and brighter after using it. I am truly impressed. Love the look to the packaging, it’s very aesthetically appeasing .

reviews.product_name: Mini Watermelon Glow PHA + BHA Pore-Tight Toner
reviews.review_text: Absolutely love! I am really loving this toner. First things first the smell is refreshing and doesn’t smell over powerful or perfumey. The texture is thin but doesn’t have a sticky after feeling. Skin seems smoother and brighter after using it. I am truly impressed. Love the look to the packaging, it’s very aesthetically appeasing .

reviews.product_name: Skinlongevity Long Life Herb Anti-Aging Face Serum
reviews.review_text: Loving this serum, especially in the summer. It is so lightweight and has a cooling effect when first applied to skin, nothing to irritate my sensitive skin, only to soothe it.love that it is non comedogenic and it won’t clog my pores or feel heavy so that I can wear makeup over it , if I feel.Plus you only need two pumps soI can see this bottle lasting a while so you get your money’s worth. It is supposed to prevent and address signs of aging which now in my 30s I’m all for! It also has Niacinamide which is great for blemished skin.

reviews.product_name: Plum Plump Hyaluronic Acid Serum
reviews.review_text: First thing first ... can we get into the packaging!? So pretty and a aesthetic all on its own. The first thing that popped out to me about this serum is that it is vegan and cruelty free , which is a big thing for me. This serum is compact and cute for your skincare cabinet or even for travel. There is no fragrance and , it is clear when pumped out of bottle. The feeling is much less sticky and soapy than the glow recipe watermelon toner , so I enjoy it a lot more. It doesn’t feel oily either just a perfect light weight feeling.  After application there is a slight sticky feel but once you put your moisturizer on , that easily goes away.  It has hyaluronic acid so it does give dehydrated and dry skin much needed moisture. You don’t need much only one pump, so I can see this lasting, so you get your money worth. I have sensitive , combination skin and didn’t receive any irritation  . I think this is perfect for mature skin.. all my ladies in the 30s! Get this!

reviews.product_name: Watermelon Glow Niacinamide Dew Drops
reviews.review_text: I received this complimentary from Glow Recipe but my thoughts are honest. First things first, glow recipe always has the cutest packaging for their products. I’m loving the texture of the serum, it is not sticky . It is very moisturizing and excited to see how the niacinamide does on my dark spots . There wasn’t a heavy scent , smelled fresh but nothing that would irritate the skin.There was a lot of product in the package soI feel it would last awhile.

reviews.product_name: 5 Stars Retinol + Niacinamide Eye Serum
reviews.review_text: Once I saw retinol and Niacinamide , I was so excited . I love this eye cream , it just melts into skin and also I have noticed slow lightening of my dark bags under my eye . The retinol is going to be helpful for my wrinkles as well, didn’t notice a heavy fragrance and it didn’t irritate my skin , excited to see what else this can help . I also loved the applicator , it helps to dot under eye and not make it messy.

reviews.product_name: Ginzing Vitamin C Eye Cream to Brighten and Depuff
reviews.review_text: I love this eye cream and the fact that it has a warm undertone for deeper skin tones. There is no sticky or tacky feeling when applied, goes on creamy and smooth and not irritating eyes. There was no fragrance . Loved using this creme under makeup , noticed less drying in under eye crease .

reviews.product_name: Original Skin Matte Moisturizer with Willowherb
reviews.review_text: I received a sample of this moisturizer with a purchase and absolutely loved it. I struggled with acne and used accutane for seven months to clear it. I am often critical of moisturizers that claim to be “matte” because they aren’t always. I used this moisturizer atop my cetaphil spf moisturizer and it remained matte all day!!!! Although the cetaphil moisturizer is oil-free, it usually leaves my skin feeling a bit too greasy for my liking. This Origins matte moisturizer did wonders. It smells great, has an amazing soft texture, did not cause any small breakouts or rashes on my sensitive skin, and left my skin feeling matte all day long in humid weather (I was on vacation). I even used this product at nighttime after cleansing my face and my face felt refreshed and clean in the morning. There were no excess oils. The sample size lasted me about 3 weeks; I’ve used it by itself during the day, on top of an spf moisturizer during the day, and at nighttime - loved it. In short, I absolutely recommend this product!

reviews.product_name: Unseen Sunscreen SPF 40 PA+++
reviews.review_text: I have a medium-tan olive complexion, and it’s always difficult to find sunscreens that don’t leave a white cast. This sunscreen is clear! I couldn’t be happier about that. I have also suffered from terrible acne and even used accutane, so I am wary of products that might irritate my skin. This sunscreen is so smooth, doesn’t irritate my skin, has a lightweight feel, and offers the protection my skin needs from the sun. I never liked using sunscreen because of the greasy/oily feeling and shiny outcome. The Unseen Sunscreen does not feel greasy AT ALL! And neither does it have that typical spf smell that is off-putting. To sum it up: YES, PLEASE! Love this sunscreen :)

reviews.product_name: Mini Unseen Sunscreen SPF 40 PA+++
reviews.review_text: I have a medium-tan olive complexion, and it’s always difficult to find sunscreens that don’t leave a white cast. This sunscreen is clear! I couldn’t be happier about that. reviews.product_name: Creamy Eye Treatment with Avocado
reviews.review_text: I enjoy the thick consistency of this under eye cream, and use it at nighttime and occasionally during the day. However, I cannot use it for two days consecutively because I start developing milia. So I can only use it once every two or three days, which is a bummer.

reviews.product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C
reviews.review_text: I initially started off with a sample of this product and instantly fell in love. The texture is smooth and not very sticky, and this stuff works like magic! My incredibly dehydrated lips are soft and smooth the next morning. I like it way more than just chapstick or Vaseline, both of which I was using regularly at night. I highly recommend this if you have chapped lips. The sample I tried was in the “original” scent which smells just like bubblegum. I purchased the larger size in Apple lime and I love this one so much better.

reviews.product_name: Lippe Balm
reviews.review_text: I’m not too sure about this one. I will say this, it does have a bit of plumping effect without the peppermint tingly feel. I have extremely dry lips and require the most moisturizing lip products. Lip balms alone won’t cut it. I consider myself an extreme case so I don’t fault this product for not being moisturizing enough. If you don’t have extremely dry lips, get this. If you do...probably not the best product.

reviews.product_name: T.L.C. Framboos Glycolic Resurfacing Night Serum
reviews.review_text: Serums take a while before making a change on your face, but so far I love the glow this leaves. I’m usually acne prone and this hasn’t broken me out. I’m so curious to see how this improves my skin over the next couple of months. The texture of my skin is nicer after I’ve washed my face the next morning.  Actually, I think the entire product line is making my skin nicer overall. Love it!

reviews.product_name: Beste No. 9 Jelly Cleanser
reviews.review_text: While this is supposed to help remove makeup and grim, I don’t feel that it did a great job at it. There was still a lot of dirt or makeup left over when I used my anti-blemish pads. However, it left my skin feeling so soft.  I feel like this is a product that will improve the overall look and feel of your skin the more you use it. But I would suggest you use something more effective in conjunction with this product. For soft skin, definitely get this.

reviews.product_name: C-Tango Vitamin C Eye Cream
reviews.review_text: I wasn’t big into eye creams, but this product makes me realize what I’ve been missing. It’s so moisturizing and really does something to the eyes but I can’t put my finger on it. I think make them look more brighter and alert. This is probably my favorite product from this brand. A little bit goes a very long way and I can see this lasting a very long time. Will be adding this to my skincare routine.

reviews.product_name: Magic Cream Moisturizer with Hyaluronic Acid
reviews.review_text: The packaging alone is 5 stars. When I say this is the most immaculate jar and packaging I’ve seen from a cosmetics brand...I won’t even through the empty jar away when I’m done, I’ll just leave it displayed for elevate a space. Now, for the cream itself: it’s ok. My skin is already pretty balanced from my skin care regimen, but I would say that it fits well into it, I can swap this for my regular cream and it still maintain the same hydration. If you’re looking for something that’s going to hydrate and plump and haven’t found it yet, definitely try this.

reviews.product_name: Soy Hydrating Gentle Face Cleanser
reviews.review_text: I got this in Boxycharm and it’s a nice daily cleanser. I do feel like the formula is gentle but it is pricey for what it is. You do get a lot of product which could explain the price point.

reviews.product_name: Green Clean Makeup Removing Cleansing Balm
reviews.review_text: I love this. It smells amazing and I have gone through at least three before writing this review. It helps to break down makeup and when you put water with it, the texture becomes a milky cleanser and keeps your face from being stripped. Try it if you haven’t already.

reviews.product_name: Green Clean Makeup Meltaway Cleansing Balm Limited Edition Jumbo
reviews.review_text: I love this. It smells amazing and I have gone through at least three before writing this review. It helps to break down makeup and when you put water with it, the texture becomes a milky cleanser and keeps your face from being stripped. Try it if you haven’t already.

reviews.product_name: Good Genes All-In-One AHA Lactic Acid Treatment
reviews.review_text: I have used this for months, and found a few things that work for my skin. This works best with Sunday Riley Facial oils, or when used in conjunction with another oil. It can be irritating when used too frequently and I find it helps to alternate retinols because my skin can become used to a regimen very quickly. Also, sunscreen is your friend.

reviews.product_name: Honeymoon Glow AHA Resurfacing Night Serum
reviews.review_text: I got this in my Boxycharm, but I would have bought it with my own money. This is an amazing product and works well with Good Genes. It’s much less irritating and overall a little more hydrating. It also smells better. I love to use this everyday and my face doesn’t get sensitive at all. But I do alternate with a few weeks on and off.

reviews.product_name: Alpha Beta Extra Strength Daily Peel Pads
reviews.review_text: These are pricey but they work. The reviews are definitely correct. I do find that it can be irritating if you’re not used to acids try the daily peel first or just use these sparingly until your skin is more used to them.

reviews.product_name: Tonique Confort Re-Hydrating Comforting Toner with Acacia Honey
reviews.review_title: Must-try! Even for my oily ladies!
reviews.review_text: I really did not think that I was going to like this product I really have oily skin and I (horribly) do not moisturize the way that I should because of that. However, I do use a retinol a few times a week and that leaves me peeling. I decided to use this underneath my retinol and WOW! My skin is so smooth and so touchable in the morning. It happened literally overnight I am so impressed and shocked that I don’t wake up looking like an oil slick and the texture of my skin is improving. The feel of it is amazing. It is fantastic after removing makeup and washing my face. My face still feels clean and not weighed down at all. Using this in conjunction with the toner is like a dream come true. I know that this was not advertised for oily skin which is why I am so shocked but I cannot even imagine what it does for other skin types. It really is a “must-try“. Lancome is - and has been my go-to makeup brand for a few years now. You get what you pay for. I received this product complimentary for review purposes.

reviews.product_name: Hydra Zen Gel-Cream Oil-Free Moisturizer with Salicylic Acid
reviews.review_title: Light and effective, even for oily skin!!

reviews.product_name: Clear Improvement Pore Clearing Moisturizer with Salicylic Acid
reviews.review_text: I have been using this product for about a full week. I was surprised that it had such a thick consistency and thought that maybe it would just sit on my face and/or break me out. I was already dealing with a surprise breakout so I was happy to get a product that said it would help with clearing skin. So far I notice a change with that breakout and it has not caused any new ones. I may be imagining it, but I see a difference in the amount of oil I am producing as well. I think this product will last a long time. There is quite a bit of product in the package and a little goes a long way.  I received this product complimentary to write an honest review.

reviews.product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C
reviews.review_text: I cannot tell you enough how much I LOVE THIS. My lips get very dry in the winter, after washing my face, in the morning, and overall just need some serious love. Not only is this product HIGHLY effective, it last F O R E V E R. I have the lip balm as well and cannot tell the difference in the two products. The spatula that comes with it is useless as its easy to lose but it was a nice thought.

reviews.product_name: Lip Glowy Balm
reviews.review_text: I cannot tell you enough how much I LOVE THIS. My lips get very dry in the winter, after washing my face, in the morning, and overall just need some serious love. Not only is this product HIGHLY effective, it last F O R E V E R. I have the original sleeping mask and cannot tell the difference in the two products but I am happy to have this portable version.

reviews.product_name: Tonique Confort Re-Hydrating Comforting Toner with Acacia Honey
reviews.review_text: Although this is a very good hydrating toner , I’ve prob. Used better toners for very minimal on the price. I do have combination skin so I just use before I go to bed and before I apply makeup. I received complimentary products to test.

reviews.product_name: Hydra Zen Gel-Cream Oil-Free Moisturizer with Salicylic Acid
reviews.review_text: I apply this before bed and before I apply makeup. I think it has some major good hydration, don’t like the sticky after feel but otherwise good product. Do I need it at this time in my life ? No. I received complimentary products.

reviews.product_name: Tea Elixir Niacinamide & Hyaluronic Acid Anti-Aging Serum
reviews.review_text: I loved this serum. It just hydrated my face so well. I it’s already been a few hours passing and it’s still just as soft as when I applied.  I’ll typically use this right after my face is nice and washed.

reviews.product_name: Mini Daily Microfoliant Exfoliator
reviews.review_text: After using this product on what was my at the time horrible skin, I’ve decided to implement this on my 6-step skincare routine . 1. Cleansing 2. Toning 3. Exfoliating (1-2x week) 4. Serum 5. Moisturizer and lastly 6. SPF . Just by being consistent and utilizing this apart of my 6-step, I’ve noticed fewer to no breakouts, pores began to close and a brighter complex . My scars are really bad on my face from the harm done from previous generic brands but Dermalogica has helped redeem a better facial complexion and ultimately saving my skin from permanent scarring. Definitely would recommend this to anyone needing help with their acne !

reviews.product_name: GENIUS Sleeping Collagen Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I absolutely loved this product. I was able to try it for free for testing from Influenster and it worked such wonders on my skin. I have very dry skin.

reviews.product_name: Ultimate Sun Protector Lotion SPF 50+ Sunscreen
reviews.review_text: I absolutely think that this Ultimate Sun Protector Sunscreen that I received as a free sample from Influenster is Ah-mazing! I love how sheen the lotion is and I also love the light scent that it has. It’s not super overwhelming! I also think that the silkiness gives my body a nice glow ! I usually don’t pay a lot for sunscreen but definitely feel that this is worth it if you have the funds! Highly recommend!

reviews.product_name: Clear Sunscreen Stick SPF 50+
reviews.review_text: This stick is so great to use! I love how convenient the stick is & how easily it can fit in many of my bags. This product glides on your skin so smoothly- I love it. The only downfall is that the price can be a little pricey for those who dont have the funds, but other than that I recommend to buy!

reviews.product_name: Abeille Royale Advanced Youth Watery Oil
reviews.review_text: I absolutely love this item! I got this as a sample from Influenster to try and for me, it works wonders. My skin is super dry and this product helps hydrate my skin as well as make my skin look illuminating. I highly recommend

reviews.product_name: Mini Abeille Royale Advanced Youth Watery Oil
reviews.review_text: I absolutely love this item! I got this as a sample from Influenster to try and for me, it works wonders. My skin is super dry and this product helps hydrate my skin as well as make my skin look illuminating. I highly recommend

reviews.product_name: C.E.O. 15% Vitamin C Brightening Serum
reviews.review_text: I purchased this product in May/Mother’s Day Weekend, lasted three months. I used this in the a.m. w/good genes & the c.e.o. oil. I experienced random breakouts on the side of my chin. When purchasing this product, I was told to be weary of breakouts. I do feel like the combo helped with my hyperpigmentation, but also created new scars, due to the breakouts. I will not be repurchasing this product at this time... maybe in the future. The Good Genes is amazing, the whole line is amazing... no regrets. For $85.00, I think I can find a cheaper vitamin C w/o the breakout.

reviews.product_name: Creamy Eye Treatment with Avocado
reviews.review_text: I am just about done with my jar. This product is thick, you have to pat it for a bit so it can work into the skin. I sometimes get eye irritations after applying this product. It has caused my eye to burn, turn red, etc.... apparently the product spread, moves up, etc... too close to the waterline. It doesn’t happen often but when it does... OMFG! I am going to go back to my Ole Hendrix banana brightening eye cream. I did not hate this product, just can’t deal with the eye burning. I don’t have dark circles or anything like that so it’s not worth the $50 to me. It did work well with my concealer tho, it did not crease or look caked up under my make up. I would recommend, but wouldn’t repurchase.

reviews.product_name: Ultra Facial Moisturizing Cream with Squalane
reviews.review_title: Ok Product, Just Not For Me
reviews.review_text: I have very dry skin. This product left me greasy... but not necessarily hydrated, if that makes sense. I felt like the product was on my skin, but not absorbing into my skin. Smell and texture was fine, just wasn’t for me. After reading the reviews, I was excited about trying. Finding the perfect moisturizer is hard... take your time with the search

reviews.product_name: Mini Ultra Facial Moisturizing Cream with Squalane
reviews.review_title: Ok Product, Just Not For Me
reviews.review_text: I have very dry skin. This product left me greasy... but not necessarily hydrated, if that makes sense. I felt like the product was on my skin, but not absorbing into my skin. Smell and texture was fine, just wasn’t for me. After reading the reviews, I was excited about trying. Finding the perfect moisturizer is hard... take your time with the search

reviews.product_name: ICE Ceramide Moisturizer with Vitamin F
reviews.review_text: I’m using 85% of Sunday Riley’s line (good genes, A+, C.E.O. Serum and ALL of the oils).... it’s safe to say, I love this line. I tried the water cream and the c.e.o cream, they didn’t work for me. I started following and reading upOn ICE on their Instagram page. I absolutely LOVE this. I have dry skin, so I need something to really absorb and last!! This is AH-MAZING!! In the morning, I use c.e.o., good genes and ICE. It’s not sticky, it’s not rolling off. At night, I used A+, tidal serum and ICE... BOMB! (I don’t have a set routine, I use the products different ways.) My skin looks very healthy and dewy. This product is thick but it absorbs well. This would be a must have for winters on the north/east coast. It has a sweet smell to it, but it fades very quickly. You only need a dime size for your whole face, so this 1.7oz bottle should last you a while. It come with a little scooper. Layering this with Tidal is a boost of extra hydration, but honestly you don’t really need the boost. It does good on its own. This product is IT. I rarely leave reviews, so I wouldn’t lie to ya. Promise!! I paid the FULL amount. I am not an employee. I am a regular working mom. This is not an #AD. You can trust this review :)

reviews.product_name: Good Genes All-In-One AHA Lactic Acid Treatment
reviews.review_title: H Y P E R P I G M E N T A T I O N
reviews.review_text: I was reading an article about African American women with hyperpigmentation. Sunday Riley was mentioned, I’ve been addicted since. I try to read as much as I can to understand my skin and what I Product ingredients I need. I am always on a hunt for  kojic acid, AHAs, ascorbic acid (vitamin C), licorice extract, and tranexamic acid, all of which can reduce hyperpigmentation.Sunday Riley’s whole line has what I need. Good genes was the first product I tried. It’s a lactic acid/AHA formula that exfoliates dead skin to allow your healthy skin cellsto thrive. It costs too much for me to Use as a mask. I put it on under my moisturizer (S.R.’s ICE)  for it to function as a serum. I also layer it with Luna at night, Tidal for a boost or hydration or U.F.O. When I’m having a hormonal outbreak. They all absorb good with each other. I let them absorb a bit before add the next layer. 90% of my products are S.R.... I am used to the high price points. My bottle is $158.  It makes sense in the long run to go ahead and get the larger one. The bottle lasts me 3 months, I only use ONE pump each application. You do NOT need more than ONE pump! You’ll run thru it too quickly using more, it’s not needed. I will say, my skin did do a purge for about a week. I contacted S.R. About it via their IG and they inboxed me and said my skin wasn’t breaking out, it was purging the impurities. I’m on my second bottle, so it’s safe to say, I do like this product. I can’t describe the smell, maybe kinda lemony... it doesn’t stink, nor does it last longer than like :30 seconds. The texture reminds me of lotion, but it absorbs good. This product is highly recommended for any woman who has hyperpigmentation.

reviews.product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C
reviews.review_text: Woke up with a very sore dry spot on my bottom lip. Felt like I had a tiny rock in my lip. I thought I was getting a cold sore for the first time at age 36. The doctor said I was having an allergic reaction. My lip was peeling and painful. I only used it one night. After 2 days of lots of water and nursing my lip day in and out, it’s finally better. I mentioned it to my friend. She said it severely dried her lip out but that’s it. If you have any type of sensitivities... STAY AWAY.

reviews.product_name: Unseen Sunscreen SPF 40 PA+++
reviews.review_text: Understands the assignment. It has no white cast, no pilling, no stickiness and no complaints. I previously used BG Sunscreen 45 spf from Target. I like that one also, but this one better.

reviews.product_name: Mini Unseen Sunscreen SPF 40 PA+++
reviews.review_text: Understands the assignment. It has no white cast, no pilling, no stickiness and no complaints. I previously used BG Sunscreen 45 spf from Target. I like that one also, but this one better.

reviews.product_name: Cicapair Tiger Grass Cream
reviews.review_text: This is a must have for the girls with sensitive skin and those who get chemical peels.

reviews.product_name: Crème de la Mer Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I use the La Mer Soft Cream now. However, this is my winter cream. It is super thick. I love it. If you have oily skin, I would not recommend. This is for us dry skin baddies. And No, Nivea doesn’t come close to this.

reviews.product_name: Mini Crème de la Mer Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I use the La Mer Soft Cream now. However, this is my winter cream. It is super thick. I love it. If you have oily skin, I would not recommend. This is for us dry skin baddies. And No, Nivea doesn’t come close to this.

reviews.product_name: Glow2OH Dark Spot Toner
reviews.review_text: I received this for free for my honest review. I honestly love this toner. I have pigmentations in my cheeks due to acne and have bought MANY products that state will lighten them but most of them didnt do much. This toner has done WAY more than the other products I have used. It is very fragrant, so people with sensitive skin might not like this but I like it.  I’m used to using acids and this one seems gentle but effective, plus it is not drying at all. I recommend this for people who want a gentle exfoliation toner, and a quick step to glory skin. I do use it with their sheer transformation moisturizer and it’s been great. I have used this for about a week now. It is not a one day miracle worker but if you use it consecutively it will work.

reviews.review_title: Soft skin but can be rough?

reviews.product_name: Good Genes All-In-One AHA Lactic Acid Treatment
reviews.review_title: Love it but need to continue to use it for results
reviews.review_text: This product was complimentary from Sunday Riley but all opinions are my own. Let’s start of with I love this product. First the packaging is nice and sturdy. I love that it’s in a glass container, as for the product itself it’s really nice. It states that it instantly plumps the look of fine lines, I can’t say anything towards that since I don’t quite have them but it will be good for when I do. What I can tell you is that it let my face brighter. I had a pimple that was growing but the day after using it, the pimple was reduced. It might be due to the lactic acid and the other great exfoliants (prickly pear,agave,cactus) it wasn’t irritating at all and it was soothing a bit? , could have been the aloe in it. I love that in the ingredient list it has a high quality of exfoliants and nourishing things it has squalene too! I think it leaves your face smooth because of the dimethicone but I don’t mind that ingredient because it’s farther down the ingredient list so the percentage it has is lower. It was easy to use, love the pump! It absorbed quickly and it had a nice lemon scent like my lemon tree. If you don’t like or your skin is sensitive to scented skincare this might not be for you. I recommend this, although it is pricey, this is one skincare that matches its price due to the ingredients and how awesome it is. I still will continue to use to see if it can get rid of my hyperpigmentation, that will be the real test but for now I’m very satisfied with the product.

reviews.product_name: Crème de la Mer Moisturizer
reviews.review_text: I give this a 4.5 stars. On the coldest days of winter, this is a godsend. It’s extremely moisturizing and long-lasting. I don’t wear this formula under makeup because it’s just too thick for the type of foundation I like to wear (light coverage & tinted moisturizer). I wear it on no makeup days or at night because it’s quite lubricating and doesn’t completely absorb. As someone with very dry skin, I appreciate this quality. To get the most out of this cream, make sure you warm it up between your fingers before you apply. It really does help it spread and absorb more easily. And if you’re lazy (like me) and don’t have time to stand around with moisturizer on your fingers for thirty seconds during your morning routine, just dot a bit on your face and continue on with your regimen while your body heat melts it a bit. Then after a minute or two, work the cream into your skin. I only use this cream in the winter, but it is an absolute necessity for my skin during that time.
